name: 412 Church Temecula Valley
412 Church Temecula Valley - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary: I’ve been going to 412 church for a year now and it’s an amazing experience every time. It’s a church that truly respects and encourages traditional values. The value of putting God first, the value of family and the value in being an honest and good child of God. Everyone is very welcoming!  I have finally found my home church. 412 Church is an exceptional place to worship. Our lead pastor is consistently honest, incredibly well-articulate, and deeply knowledgeable, always accomplishing his mission to lead the congregation forward. The Youth Pastor is equally phenomenal, offering inspiring and uplifting advice that is exactly what our young people need to navigate their lives. My husband and I have been attending 412 for just over 5 years and we are so blessed by the Lord’s faithful work in us and in our whole body of believers over that time. We have attended Calvary Chapel affiliated churches our whole married life and definitely appreciate the church leadership’s unwavering commitment to the entire Word of God in teaching and in practice. Practice is exactly what distinguishes this fellowship from any we’ve attended before. Leadership is not only completely committed to teaching the full counsel of God, but is also faithful to live it out in genuine Love for their congregants and all who the Lord brings across their path. We believe this is how Jesus desires  His Church to operate as His witness to a very dark world full of people who desperately need Him.We thank Him so much for planting us here where His genuine Love is so evident. If you want to learn about what is inside your Bible then this is the Church for you. Ive learned more in the few years I've attended then I ever knew before. The Praise and worship is wonderful and the message is always very relevant and engaging 😇👍

name: AcZion Community Church
AcZion Community Church - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary:
If you're looking for a friendly, family environment, this is the right place. If you're in need to know what God has planned for you, this is the right place. Stop by, we'll receive you with open arms. A blessing being in a congregation were the word of God is preached. Finding a church that truly feels like home was something I had always prayed for, and I’m so thankful I found it here at Aczion Community Church. From the moment I walked in, I was welcomed with genuine kindness everyone is so intentional by saying “Hi” and even learning my name by the next Sunday I came to church! I felt like part of a family since the first day.

One of my favorite parts is the young adult group. It’s a place where you can build meaningful friendships, grow in your faith, and do life with people who genuinely care about you. The church also offers so many opportunities to connect outside of Sunday services, including home groups, hiking trips,  and other fun activities that make it easy to build community and friendships!

The messages are biblical, encouraging, and always point you back to Jesus. If you’re looking for a church where you can grow spiritually, serve others, and find community, I can’t recommend this church enough. It truly feels like home. If you made it this far I really hope to see you on Sunday! This church is a unique experience where I've witnessed God so profoundly. It's where I awakened and took action in my life. I love the worship and how the pastor combines logic, spiritual wisdom, world news, and mental health in his sermons and teachings. I highly recommend this church. It has greatly helped me in my faith and in making changes in my life for my well-being. A few months ago, I discovered this wonderful family of faith, and I couldn't be happier to have met such special people. I felt welcomed among them and experienced a great sense of closeness from all the members and pastors. I recommend this place to anyone seeking an encounter with God and looking for a faith family where they can feel a sense of belonging.

name: Agape Christian Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
Agape has such a diverse congregation with people of all cultures and ages. It's amazing to see the unity within, and the community come together. I personally am very grateful for Agape, specifically towards how the people and pastors have changed my life because of their message about God. You can feel the Spirit here, working in this place. A great community of people who love God! Growing and sharing in His Word!

I met this church family 13 years ago and since then I have been impacted in the most blessed ways! I have found friends, family and God. Thank you Agape for being welcoming to me and so many. I pray we can continue to grow in our understanding of what love means and share His love with others. If you are looking for a diverse, all age and intimate worship church in Pasadena, Agape Christian Church is the place to go on Sunday morning. I enjoy the fellowship they have after church. It is a wonderful small church where you feel welcomed and loved. Love this church. It is warm, friendly, Bible based, filled with Grace and so welcoming, wherever you are in your walk with God. Agape is love and it pours love into others. I cannot think of going to any other church. PANTS donkey_!

name: Agape Church
Agape Church - Brea Campus
reviewSummary:
If you're looking for true fellowship, and Christ centered love, look no more, because you found it! Agape Church it is your place to call it home. Here you'll be surrounded by brothers and sisters that will pour their love for Christ over you and your family.  Come, and see it for yourself; Sundays service 10:00am-12:00pm ; 6:00pm-8:00pm
Tuesday, Youth night  7:00pm -9:00pm
Wednesday prayers 7:00pm- 9:00pm/ Awana 6:30pm-7:30pm. The best church around!
Quality people and most importantly quality teaching and worship! Christmas Concert 2018 was wonderful. Excellent and professional, not to be missed. You get a feeling of the real Christmas, church who celebrate and honors the birth of Jesus Christ our Savior. People are so friendly and welcoming to everyone. My wife and I went to see the "What Child is This?" musical; we were pleasantly surprised by the loving, friendly, caring people who greeted and welcomed us, ushered us inside the sanctuary and over to the reception area for cake and coffee after the event.

The musical was top-notch, very well coordinated, and very entertaining. While about half of it was in Romanian, which we don't understand, they offered headsets for translation. They also had audience participation, the kind you 'want' to take part in.

Pastor Crini's 4-point message was short and applied directly to the theme of the musical:  "What Child is This?" And he used the exact right number of PowerPoint slides with applicable verses and bullet points.

Thinking about going? Don't think, just go; you'll be glad you did...We were! Good location, great assembly of well intentioned people who sincerely  seek the Lord in a good fellowship. While it has some Romanian roots, English is taking over more and more.

name: Aldersgate United Methodist Church
Aldersgate United Methodist Church - Orange Campus
reviewSummary:
Rev. Ken is a gift from God. His sermon today will enlighten you, as well as transform and free your soul in a way that will enable you to live your life to reflect God's words and deeds.
My first generation Japanese American grandfather once told me that a Korean was at the level of a dog, and for that, "I am sorry."  I am a third generation Japanese American, and never believed that nonsense, but  because of Rev. Ken, there was an added respect and admiration for Koreans and Korean Americans that I needed to learn. For that, I will always be thankful.
If you really want to get a sense of his understanding of diversity, ask him what he likes to eat.
God bless you Rev. Ken, your family, and Aldersgate UMC.

Feeling stronger about my faith after hearing that doubt is normal even for pastors.  Thank you!! Sincerely, Jeanine Kitrell Love this Church.  They let St Paul's Sunday Supper Host there for the Summer while their church is being remodled or fixed up.  Captain and Ivolunteer every single Sunday. reviewSummary:
What an amazing place!! God brought me here 2 years ago….and i have witnessed how God is moving in Aliento de Vida. Pastor’s Eswing and Lily Lopez are so loving and welcoming…it was such a Blessing to meet them and call them my Pastors. God is certainly doing AMAZING things in Aliento de Vida. If you need a Church to call home…this is your home. If beed to get closer to God, learn more about God, grow in Faith….this is your home. The Holy Spirit is doing great things in people’s lives here…it’s a small congregation, but MIGHTY in God’s plans. God Bless Aliento de Vida. I want to say that Breath of Life is my home where we truly worship the King of Kings, Lord of Lords. We have learned to be worshippers with all our hearts. It's a home ready to welcome all those with open arms who feel they have arrived at a place where they will receive love and where the Holy Spirit will fill them with His beautiful presence. We invite you to our home, Breath of Life, if you don't have a place to worship! Time is passing, and there's no time to lose in becoming those men and women willing to believe that God will do great and powerful things in each of us. 🙏🏻♥️😉 Breath of Life cda is not just another Christian church in the city of Newhall CA, but a family of FAITH that desires that souls be saved and know JESUS ​​personally. Breath of Life is a place for you! Breath of Life is where I gave my life to Jesus Christ with all my heart. Here is where I came to see the true love of God, through His presence, and the brothers and sisters who were there to help me in my journey. Come as you are, the Lord is waiting for you! Glory to God for the Breath of Life Praise Ministry, Pastors Edwin & Lilly Lopez, a great blessing for the edification of the churches - 1 Peter 1:2-5 Chosen according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, through sanctification by the Spirit, for obedience to Jesus Christ and sprinkling with his blood: Grace and peace be yours in abundance.

name: Alive Church - Gainesville Campus
Alive Church - Gainesville Campus - Gainesville Campus
reviewSummary:
Alive Church is awesome! They teach you how to have a personal relationship with Jesus. We do life together! My first time visiting and I love it felt the holy spirt
Moving in this church love to go back 90 day Tithe challenge😭😭😭Alive Church is less about God and far more about MONEY. Every single service, they pushed for contributions, justifying it with lines like, “Don’t you want air conditioning and a clean facility?” Meanwhile, the bathrooms gleamed with marble and luxury fixtures, and the pastors clearly lived well off the congregation’s giving. They also blurred biblical order by placing women in the role of pastor, when Scripture calls for men to be Christ-like leaders. On top of that, they made it feel very much like a “black church,” emphasizing who truly belonged and who didn’t. And when Memorial Day came, they couldn’t even honor fallen soldiers—but on Mother’s Day, they went out of their way to exalt mothers. The whole thing reeked of the very hypocrisy Jesus condemned: using God to enrich themselves, create power, and divide His people. I've been coming to the church since the end of January of this year.  It's a great atmosphere and they lead with the word of God. I was initially intrigued because the lead pastor(s) were young adults. I've only heard pastor Aaron Chapman speak a couple of times since I've been there but it was awesome.  I'm sadden that he is leaving this campus. I'm also grateful for the new leading pastor(s). God bless everyone! It is a wonderful church it very laid back the music is awesome

name: Alive Church Orange County
Alive Church Orange County - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
This church has been incredibly supportive of my family, fostering a closer relationship with God. Today, we are getting baptized, marking a significant step in our journey towards a new life in Christ! ✝️

Joining a connect group was crucial, and everyone at Alive Church feels like family. ⛪️ This is truly a Spirit-filled church where the presence of God is undeniable. From the moment you walk in, you’re welcomed with genuine love and warmth. The worship is powerful, heartfelt, and led with humility—it creates space to truly encounter God, not just sing songs. The preaching is Bible-based, bold, and practical, speaking truth while encouraging real spiritual growth and transformation.
What stands out most is the authenticity of the people. This church isn’t about performance or hype; it’s about living out the Word, loving people well, and allowing the Holy Spirit to move freely. There’s a strong sense of community, prayer, and unity, and you can tell this is a place where lives are being changed.
If you’re looking for a church that values God’s presence, sound teaching, and genuine fellowship, this is a place where you can grow, be refreshed, and feel at home. Thank you Alive! Alive Church is more than just a church—it’s a family. Every service is filled with powerful worship and messages that are both inspiring and practical, helping me grow in my faith and daily walk with God. The community here is authentic, loving, and welcoming to everyone, no matter where you’re coming from. The leadership is strong, Spirit-led, and truly cares about people. My life and family have been deeply impacted by being part of Alive Church, and I’m grateful to call this my home church. If you’re searching for a place to grow spiritually and be surrounded by a genuine community, I highly recommend Alive Church. Have you ever walked into a church and the spirit of God met you at the door? That’s what it was like visiting Alive Church for the first time. The presence of God was so full in the atmosphere from the opening prayer, throughout worship and especially in the Word that was delivered. Everyone was so welcoming and made us feel like family. Even as visitors, when Pastors Derek and Susan found out my (then fiancé and I) were engaged, they offered to give us marriage counseling even though we still living in Texas. The time they took out of their busy schedules to ensure we were entering marriage on the right foot meant the world - so much so that we knew we were home. God provided confirmation shortly after and before we knew it, we were driving across the country to move to California and become official members of Alive Church. It has honestly been the second best decision we’ve made, (the first was choosing to fully surrender to God - something we truly hadn’t stepped into until visiting and tuning in to services at Alive regularly). We are so thankful for the extended family God has given us by joining Alive. There’s no place we’d rather be on a Sunday morning. We didn’t just find a community, we found a Christ centered family. *Highly Recommended!*

I've found a home at Alive Church! The community of people so loving and supportive, developing meaningful relationships that go beyond Sunday services.

Praise and worship is uplifting, and creates an atmosphere that allows for one to be free and themselves.

I've been blessed to be a part of this church since 2019, serving alongside amazing people and witnessing God's love and tangible presence in action.

Alive Church has been a sanctuary for me – a place to grow in faith, receive guidance and prayer, grow in understanding of God’s word and deepen my relationship with Jesus.

Both Pastor Derek and Pastor Susan’s leadership and teachings are insightful, inspiring, and truly empowering.

If you're seeking a Holy Spirit-filled community, come visit Alive Church where we welcome all with open arms.🤗

name: All Nations Old Catholic Church
All Nations Old Catholic Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary:
We baptized my daughter in this church 10+ years ago and her quinceañera ceremony was also here about 3 years.
Both ceremonies were amazing, personalized, and I really felt the faith within myself
I am planning on baptizing my new baby there as well.
I wouldn’t change a thing about any of them.
At the end of the day, it’s about believing in God and being a good person while here on earth. Thank you Father Tom and thank you Old Nations Catholic Church! To those that think that the Sacrament of Baptism is not valid. A Sacrament of baptism only requires two things to be valid. 1. Water must be used and the water may be poured on the head or  the person may be immersed.  That is what baptism means  2. The person baptizing must use the Trinitarian formula. I baptize you in the name of the Father  and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit.  Usually the person baptizing is a priest or deacon but it can also be a nurse in a hospital. The person baptizing doesn't even have to be Catholic as long as the water and Trinitarian formula are used . A valid baptism must be respected and the person should never be re baptized. A valid baptism has to be respected in every Catholic Church . If it isn't then complain to the diocese. Praise God fir churches like these. They are a haven for parishioners who were a step away from leaving the Catholic church. They are a safety net. Many have gone to protestant churches because they were ignored or did not feel welcomed in a Roman Catholic church. Love this church,  it may be small but it’s about the message you get while attending. Thanks be to God. It was the most beautiful service. They made it so special and we are so blessed we found this church. We baptized our two sons at this church, great and awesome experience. My first son was baptized 7 years ago my second son 5 years ago and now we are returning for the 3rd time to baptize our youngest! We wouldn’t be going there or recommending family members if we did not have good experiences! Highly recommend for baptisms.

reviewSummary: Expository preaching! From day one at All of Grace, we got Biblically sound clarity and perspectives on God, life, death, sin, meaning, morality, Christ and eternity. But, it was their love for one another and for us that stood out like a sore thumb. It was equally unusual to us when we saw Pastor Chan one night sweeping the floors after dinner. By the way, they serve lunch and dinner for the entire congregation every Lord’s Day. It’s a plus for those with kids. Not to mention that their youth group is the best. Our kids have never desired to attend church until this church. They truly model themselves after the church in the book of Acts. Every Sunday was a day spent with God’s family in God’s house. There were days that we even lost track of time. Seriously. It was sad to go home. And all of our time there was always spent centered around edifying one another through the word, brotherly love and in prayer. We grew so fast here in so many ways and so fondly at the same time of everyone at All of Grace. Whether we were evangelizing, congregating, practicing the one another’s etc., it was always a taste of heaven on earth with them. They have your back. No matter where you’re at in your walk, or life. It was here that my wife and I came to understand  what it means to be a true follower of Jesus Christ. Amazing place.

name: All Saints Episcopal Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
All Saints Episcopal church both boasts beautiful gothic revival architecture—some of the nicest in LA county—and one of the most inclusive parishes and communities in Southern California. If you are looking for a church that walks the walk on LGBTQ+, immigration, racial, and religious inclusivity, this is the place for you. On Christmas and Easter, the church invites guest speakers of different faiths to read excerpts from their religious texts that relate to the Christian account of Jesus, creating a truly inclusive celebration of God’s love and the miracle of Christ. I cannot overstate this church’s commitment to spreading the love of God to the tightly interwoven and beyond friendly and inclusive community it creates. All Saints Church, I learned recently, is on the more progressive side of the spectrum in terms of churches. But I'm here mostly to comment on the amazing architecture. It has a Gothic Revival style, the building got completed around 1924, so it's been around for 100 years or so. The stained glass, internal structure, walls and everything else about it gives this place such a solemn, calm vibe. It's incredible to just randomly walk around in Pasadena and enter it like a lost tourist in a new city. Beautiful Architecture!!!
This review is not about the congregation nor its liturgy, but about the architecture. I was here for the Pasadena Symphony Holiday Candlelight performance. Even if you’re not religious, I’d recommend stopping by to admire the place have a moment of silence and if possible, offer a prayer. From what’s posted around, everyone is welcome! Beautiful service, beautiful people… inclusive and non judgmental place to go where you’ll be received with open arms and open hearts. Their sermons are phenomenal! Sometimes, they invite scholars from other churches to join their sermons, I always look forward to those as well! I promise you will be moved both spiritually and intellectually! I grew up in the church, and I have never felt more loved and welcomed as I do in this church! I feel this is what god intended a church and religion to be! A beautiful church! I was there for a Christmas concert and the vibe and performance were amazing. Highly recommended for a visit or an event.

We were referred to All Saints, and couldn't be happier. We've found our spiritual home.... This is the kind of place that gives churches a good name. Friendly church. Good preaching. Great community outreach. Good Sunday School.

reviewSummary: Peaceful, spiritual … a warm and welcoming church home A destination church for anyone looking for a reverent prayerful experience filled with sacramental music and a warm,  welcoming congregation. name: All Saints Presbyterian Church
All Saints Presbyterian Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary: All Saints OPC is such a breath of fresh air. The church has a welcoming atmosphere that makes it easy to feel both comfortable and focused on worship. From the moment I arrived, people were friendly without being overwhelming, creating a sense of community that felt sincere rather than forced. The service itself was thoughtful and deeply rooted in Scripture. The preaching was clear, engaging, and theologically rich, offering both insight and practical application. It was evident that there is a strong emphasis on teaching and understanding the Bible, which I appreciated. The strong reformed values and preaching is so encouraging. I don't live in North County, but this church is worth the drive. Overall, All Saints OPC stands out as a church committed to faithful teaching, meaningful worship, and authentic community. It’s a place where people seeking a deeper understanding of their faith and a grounded, Scripture-centered experience will feel at home. 10/10 would recommend! My family has been part of this church since its inception. Very blessed to be part of a Reformed, North County Coastal church that preaches gospel-centered messages, holds high regard for the sacraments, and is Biblical in its philosophy and design. Having three young kids, it’s important to my wife and I that they witness and experience gospel-centered liturgy before spending time learning in Sunday School with their peers. At this moment, All Saints Presbyterian Church is considered a church plant.  By nature, church plants are small in nature.  What is exciting about All Saints?  All Saints' pastor and congregation.  The pastor brings 5-6 years experience of pastoring.  He faithful preaches the word of God.  He has a desire for the congregation to grew in Christ. The congregation is warm and friendly.  When I first started attending, I did not know how would receive me.  They received me by having sincere conversation.  Finally, there is space to turn your faith into action by serving.  My wife and I enjoy weekly adding a small non-monetary contribution, and the congregation appears to appreciate it. If you are looking for a church that faithfully preaches the word of God with an encouraging congregation, then I recommend All Saints. The search for a traditional church grounded in Reformed values was a challenge until I found All Saints. The gospel is taken seriously, the congregation members (from young families to elder leaders) support each other and I believe the Lord is building something long lasting here.

The church's public messaging and theological positions do not reflect the understanding of Christianity that the Bible teaches.
Of course we are all sinners in need of a savior, our Lord Jesus Christ but promoting sin is not what church is about.

Merry Christmas and God Bless Y'all! The people were very friendly and welcoming.  Sign-ups were being taken for a number of small groups meeting on various interests, where it would be easier to get to know a group of parishioners better.  On Sunday we attended, there was a Ladies Luncheon, with beautiful flowers setting the welcoming tone. (I was sorry I couldn’t stay— previous engagement.) A BBQ for 20s & 30s is planned.  Also available— a beautiful playground for children under 12 with supervision from their parents. 5 stars when I started attending and found a vibrant, loving community. So much has changed. So many people hurt...during a pandemic. May God bring healing and reconciliation.

reviewSummary: I've had the privilege of visiting All Souls Church a few times, and each time has been a blessing. Pastor Harvey’s sermons are deeply rooted in Scripture and truly inspiring. name: All Souls' Episcopal Church/Bach Collegium San Diego
All Souls' Episcopal Church/Bach Collegium San Diego - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: Wonderful Church!  Friendly, thoughtful congregation.  Priest is approachable, very intelligent. His sermons are second to none. Church space itself is beautiful -full of art and light and music. Music program in fact is one of the very best in California.  Be sure and stay for the coffee hour. You wont  want to have lunch later.. and the church seems to really value what they have- and that includes each other and newcomers. This church was built in the 1960's to replace a surplus chapel back in the day. The grounds are quite beautiful and it even has a labyrinth outside that is open to the public to meditate through. The dress code is really lax -- you can dress up or show up in sandals and t-shirt. And if you're not familiar with the liturgy of an Episcopalian church, the nice people at the entrance will hand you a bulletin so you can follow along. Found this place to be really special for my spiritual journey. My wife and I have been attending All Souls' for the last three years. In our time at the church, we have been welcomed by an amazing faith community. Members of All Souls' are both caring and dedicated to serving those in need across San Diego. There are ample opportunities to both volunteer and meet tons of really nice people. I have loved attending All Souls' and would recommend it to anyone looking for a new church. Beautiful venue for recital. Stained glass windows breathtaking. Garden wonderful for receptions. The community of people at All Souls are GREAT!  For me, finding a Church home was all about the community of people; to have other Christians surrounding my husband and I that share our faith-based values. It was also about having the leadership of the Church direct and guide us through the difficult road of life, towards a deeper personal relationship with God. Father Douglas is an excellent leader. And, he preaches practical, timeless, real and vulnerable lessons that seem to apply directly to my life on a weekly basis.  We’ve finally found a spiritual home that fills all our needs for us, and that doesn’t preach politics or pander towards the popular secular opinions of society today.

name: Aloha Church | San Diego
Aloha Church | San Diego - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary: As a Brazilian, I felt very welcomed at Aloha Church in Pacific Beach. The atmosphere is warm, friendly, and full of love. During the summer, services are held outdoors under the trees, which makes the experience even more special. After the service, everyone is invited to a picnic on the grass called “Stay a while”—a lovely opportunity to connect and build community while enjoying delicious food provided by the church! The church also offers small group meetings during the week, called mini-church, which help people grow closer and feel like part of a true family. I love this church; it brings me so much joy! Aloha Church feels like home. I’m so grateful to have found this place during my time in college. I’ve met so many kind people who really care to see me grow in faith. Drew’s preaching is always engaging, funny & life giving. I highly recommend going to Aloha for a Sunday service! Plus there’s always food after, can’t beat that! I’ve been to many different churches through the years. Some were wonderful and others I’d like to forget I ever went to but Aloha Church in San Diego has been my most favorite church experience of my life. It is such a sweet group of genuine people from all walks of life.  It doesn’t feel showy or preachy. Just real honest church community.   The stay awhile portion of the service is so sweet.  We all eat together and hang out on the lawn after the worship service. This makes getting to know people so easy.   I highly recommend!!! Aloha church has been a breath of fresh air. In the summer, they literally meet in the beautiful and shady grassy area at Mission Bay High School (auditorium in the winter). But I’m more refreshed by the pastor’s humble but funny messages that point out God’s true nature. We are not shackled to religious expectations; we are pursuing freedom in Jesus together. The worship is simple, not a production. The goal of the church seems to be relationship with God and with each other. “Come as you are” meets Biblical truth, gently encouraging us into God’s abundant life. Aloha Church is truly a special place! From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with warm smiles and a genuine sense of welcome. The atmosphere is relaxed and inviting, making it easy to feel at home. It’s clear that this is a family-oriented church, where people of all ages are valued and included. Whether you’re new to faith or have been walking the path for years, Aloha Church offers a supportive and loving community. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a church that feels like ohana!

name: Anaheim Christian Reformed Church
Anaheim Christian Reformed Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary:
Warm, friendly people who are so welcoming and kind. Wonderful music, great message, and beautiful architecture. Come one, come all. With Pastor Joel leading by example, the people who come here are warm and welcoming. Regular people with the same difficulties we all face who come together to encourage each other, learn God's word and to praise & thank Him for all things..big & small.
Each person is valued & that is most evident in the Friendship Service. At 4 pm Sunday afternoons when voices shouting  excited greetings & clattering wheelchairs on the sidewalk of special needs members gathered to worship along with caretakers, family and friends raise their hands in praise for being SAVED BY GRACE its a reminder that we all have value. My family and I thoroughly love this church and ALL of its members! Every person here is always so warm and caring, and I always feel welcome and accepted every time I attend. Pastor Joel's teachings are spot on and always seem to hit home. My brother was married at ACRC last year, and we couldn't have been happier with the entire experience. Mary And Julie's expertise helped make it the most perfect day for everyone! If you are looking for a church, I highly recommend Anaheim Christian Reformed! I went for my friend Jay's funeral on Saturday  the place and all the people that showed up was so beautiful everyone coming together. Great church, spirit led, met the Pastor, he is truly gifted to speak The Word of God :)

name: Anaheim First Presbyterian Church
Anaheim First Presbyterian Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary: Baller architecture, very big and Stoney. Like the glass stained windows. Hello J man. My partner and I found this church when we moved to Anaheim a couple of years ago. We admired the architecture of the building, and I attended a meeting here of the Anaheim Historical Society. The interior is just as remarkable and beautiful and spacious as the grounds. Pastor Kim is amazing, and the entire congregation is welcoming to all. If you don't have a church home or if you haven't been to church in a long time or haven't felt comfortable going to random churches, this church and its members will make you feel at home. They have coffee fellowship after service and often have meet ups in the community. We became official members of this church because we felt so comfortable here, and although the membership is small, they are some of the friendliest and most wonderful and kind people you will ever meet. So I decided to go back to church. I am looking for the right congregation and went to visit Anaheim First Presbyterian. Nice chapel, beautiful choir and a good service. Lovely sanctuary, great choir and pastor. Small congregation. All are welcome! Sunday service is 10:30 am.

name: Anaheim Hills Presbyterian Church
Anaheim Hills Presbyterian Church - Chino Hills Campus
Anaheim Korean Presbyterian Church
Anaheim Korean Presbyterian Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary:
Love to play badminton here. People are so nice and friendly. The membership is very affordable at $350 a year. Walking people are welcome at $7 a day. They also provide free drink, juice and someone bring food, fruit, egg to eat in the morning. I feel like I am at home when I played there. If you are new, you can book a coach to teach you some simple skill for beginner. The badminton facilities here are remarkably clean. People are polite, and the parking lot is spacious, making parking very convenient. Additionally, the badminton membership price is very affordable, at $330 per year or $30 per month. Not only can you play badminton here, but you can also make new friends. It's suitable for hobbies, and there are coaches available for lessons. Sometimes, there are even tournaments held here.
The staff are very professional, and people who visit are friendly.
People of various races, including Koreans, Chinese, and Vietnamese, exercise together. The courts are great. The people are friendly Help me so much years ago really good people I love EM and we are family together

name: Anaheim Revive Church
Anaheim Revive Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary:
AFMC is currently doing outdoor worship services at 10am. There’s options to worship from your car or sit under the canopy seating. Chairs are spaced out nicely and bathrooms are available. Services are about 1 hour long. They’re also live-streamed on the website and YouTube at anaheimfmc.org
Hope you can join us!😄 Grew up at this church. Great multi-generational church. Mostly Asian Americans, but all are welcome. 2 services on Sunday. Good kids and youth programs. Associate Pastor Wong stepping up as Pastor since Sr. Pastor retiring. Excited to see what the Lord has in store. I’ve been going to this church for most of my life and grew up with amazing people here, it was like my second home… but the superintendent that recently came had no regard for what this founding church had and decided to completely erase its name and it’s history in favor of another bigger church. Not to mention almost firing most of the staff that worked hard to keep this church running when they did nothing wrong. I pray that they find a way to change their minds about this. I’m not denying change, but I was appalled at how they executed this. Instead of taking the time handling it the most ethical way, within a week they took the easy way out and absolutely did not care about the livelihood of the church’s community because “it’s what god envisioned”. Pastor Taka was kind enough to soften the blow, but it still doesn’t change the fact that the church is being used for expansion. I’m happy for those who go to voice church and the opportunity for them to expand their community, but at what cost?

Edit: they changed the name back to afmc so I put an extra star for hope that this is one step towards reconciliation. The church my family has attended for 100 years was heartlessly absorbed and rebranded by Voice Church like a corporate takeover. 100 years of community, identity, and family were wiped out overnight. If I could rate zero stars, I would. It's unfortunate to see the church where my parents were married in 1967 has lost so much of its history.

name: Anaheim United Methodist Church
Anaheim United Methodist Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary: Anaheim United Methodist Church on State Street in Orange, California allows Neighbors Pantry volunteers' to set up shop here four days a week Monday through Thursday. They are a non-profit organization that collects food items from surrounding big stores and donates to the people. Their goal is to gather, sort and donate food items during the week, every week. Myself and others go around to stores such as: Target, Walmart superstores, Trader joe's, Amazon fresh, Sprouts and Target. They donate products of all sorts which includes food and other items that they no longer need for us to give out. The donations are greatly appreciated, along with the tax incentives. 😊 Did a hula show Jeremy for the Plumeria Society. Was a good time! The church itself seems very nice. Very pretty grounds. I recently went to a Funeral Service here for my good friend Brett and his Wife whom passed on the 22nd of July, which happened to also be my Brother in law's birthday.  It was a very lovely service.  I truly hope everyone in attendance felt so. She was a wonderful person and will truly missed! The site for the Orange County Cactus and Succulent Society plant sale. Great place to worship, also we rented the facility and we were very pleased! Thank you brothers and sisters in the Lord!

name: Anamesa Christian Church
Anamesa Christian Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary:
A great online option for your spiritual journey to learn about Loving God, Loving Others and Serving both. Many online options for study during the week with Bible Study, book club and inspirational messages throughout the week. Please feel free to come as all are welcome. This is my home church. I walk to it, just about, every Sunday. If I can’t make it in person, I try and catch it online.
Here’s the deal. It’s like a second home.
I am spiritually eclectic. Both in terms of the kind of person I am, and who I chose to love, I am ordinarily scoffed at for my devotion to Jesus. But not at Anamesa.
Anamesa accepts all people who want to hear the gospel, regardless of their lifestyle or how they come to God.
Anamesa is my safe haven.
And the people of Anamesa are loving.

Come one come all to hear the real good news, at this sweet home church, where the love of Jesus is as strong as the love between its members. A local home church with ties to locations across the states. Come join in person or online- always a welcome and loving atmosphere. Such a positive and welcoming environment- so unbelievably lucky to be a part of this & really encourage anyone else to join and open your hearts to this wonderful community!

name: Anchor Baptist Church of San Diego
Anchor Baptist Church of San Diego - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary:
From the moment we walked through the doors as a new-to-the-West-coast military family, we felt right at home! Sound Biblical teaching and preaching that is down-to-earth, immediately applicable, and actively lived out by the Pastor and church members. If you are looking to grow in your walk with Jesus alongside a loving and encouraging group of people, this is the church for you! We’ve been attending Anchor Baptist for 5 years now!! Preaching is straight from the Bible with great application for today. Smaller ministry but has a family atmosphere. There are ministries for kids, teenagers, men, women. Highly recommend!!! So I served in the USAF with Pastor David Cajiuat and years later, we reconnected although I was living in VA and he was in CA.  I have had the blessing to know this man of God who has a servant’s heart for over 3 decades now.  Last year, I spent Thanksgiving with both his blood family as well as spiritual family and wow, what a blessing .  I attend a church to be connected to the body of Christ and that’s exactly what Anchor Baptist is.  I felt welcomed and part of their spiritual family while there.  Now that I am down in Texas, I still keep close touch with Pastor Cajiuat and his family.  They do more than preach the Bible…they LIVE the Bible! I wish more than 5 stars was an option.  I have been blessed with the opportunity to be a part of Anchor Baptist Church long before it was Anchor Baptist Church, since its inception as Metro Baptist Church.  Although my start with Anchor was in a service manner, I had always been blessed by their kindness to me.  In the beginning it wasn't practical for me to attend services due to caring for family members and distance.  After they moved from Rosecrans to Ronson Road, the trip was an easy one just off the 163.  And, caring for family no longer became an issue when they went Home to be with the LORD.
I have to say in all my years of going to church, I had never felt so welcomed, so loved, so included than when I started attending Anchor Baptist Church!  Our family was made to feel like family.  What a blessing it was to see Pastor David and his family show up at our son's baseball game!  And, they didn't just come to one game, they came to many.  And, the youth pastor (if I can call Jordan the youth pastor) had events and opportunities for our teenaged children to be engaged in fun and safe activities.  The church family are all so kind and friendly from day one.  There are no clicks or groups or the feeling that you don't belong when you attend Anchor Baptist Church.  And, Pastor David sincerely respects his position as shepherd over God's flock, and doesn't take that position lightly.  He is a SOLID study of God's Word and doesn't hem-haw around the Scriptures with simply 'feel good' messages.  He brings the FULL Word of God to the pulpit.  He challenges you in Sunday School to learn and memorize God's Word and plant it in your heart.  He knows his flock and wants to know them really and personally, not just superficially on Sunday morning with a 'hello'.  He is the same man Sunday through Saturday; he is not a Sunday show.  Pastor David is committed to the community and serves as Chaplain on the SDPD.  He has a heart for San Diego and the lost souls in the community.  If you want a refreshing place to worship and grow in your faith, Anchor Baptist Church in San Diego is the best kept secret that shouldn't be a secret!  I encourage you to check it out and be blessed.  If you're not able to get out, but are on Facebook, they also have a livestream on Facebook as well.  Wednesday night services can also be joined via Zoom with an email invitation.  I love and miss my Anchor Baptist Church family since moving out of state, but am so thankful I still am able to be connected and involved.  Thank you, Pastor David Cajiuat, for your faithful service! The weekly RU chapter meetings at Anchor Baptist are absolutely beneficial for anyone who is struggling with bad habits, destructive behavior and full blown addiction. The victory is found in Christ where we are "free indeed". If you are looking for help, hope and healing, the RU meeting is the place to be.

reviewSummary:

Saw that the pastor treats everybody like family and actually cares for his congregation. His sermon was great and would make this my home church If I didn't live almost an hour away. For anybody interested in a new church that lives nearby do not hesitate to call this home. Live in Big Bear & was attending local church in Big Bear Lake!
WOE....
such a huge difference in the two!
Pastor Todd & his family are awesome!
Worth my drive!
Great church family!
LOVE YOU LORD!
Thank You for leading me to this church family!
I feel very welcomed !
Thanks be to Grace To You In SunValley for referring Anchor Bible Church! I’ve been attending since day 1, which makes sense cuz the pastor does happen to be my father. Nonetheless, if it weren’t for the genuine concern, love, and devotion to Christ of the people from this church that the Lord has used substantially in so many peoples lives including mine, I would be lost in my sin on a straight path to destruction. name: Anchor Faith Church
Anchor Faith Church - St. Augustine Campus
reviewSummary:
First, I just want to say I am EXTREMELY disappointed. I am a ministry leader with 2 Christian non-profits and I was looking forward to experience this church that was well reviewed. Here is my full experience. This church does not sit in scripture. They talked for 20 minutes about pressuring people to give and said that (this is an exact quote) "You may unlock the promises of God by giving $100." They also wanted to raise thousands of dollars for "church cars" and $13,000 for a bus for one of their missions trips. They are not stewarding their finances well from an outside perspective, so I would recommend being careful with donating. The worship was an hour and only 4 songs, meaning they sang each one for about 15-20 minutes. The pastor preaches more that THEY (Christians) are holy rather than Jesus. He preaches on a spirit of feelings and not an overflow of the Lord or scripture. He gave many personal stories and read a total of 2 (singular) verses through the entire hour long sermon. In fact, the pastor did not even have a Bible when he was preaching. He talks about how we perform miracles and we are strong because we are Christian. He may have been trying to say that we do that through Christ, but he did not mention that a single time. They talked about the Kingdom of God quite a bit which was their only saving grace. God is talked about and they preach with emotional conviction, but the spiritual strength was not there. Again I need to emphasize, the pastor read TWO VERSES. IN THE ENTIRE SERMON. I don't even know if I can call it a sermon. He told 3 personal stories of his life and talked, but BARELY mentioned scripture. I do not want to put a bad review on a church, but people need to know. I pray for them and I hope that they dwell more in scripture and go back to the basics of raw faith. The inside looked very much like a Church. The outside looked similar to the rest of the Mall, where it's located. They were very friendly & helpful. The Church entrance was not very well marked. Enjoyed our visit even though it was to attend a good friend's fineral. A Powerful, Life-Giving Church – Anchor Faith is Home!

Anchor Faith Church is more than just a place of worship—it’s a family. From the moment you walk in, you feel welcomed, seen, and loved. The atmosphere is full of faith, passion, and purpose, and you can tell right away that God is moving in this place.

The teaching is always powerful, Bible-based, and delivered with clarity and conviction. Every message challenges you to grow, walk in your purpose, and live out your faith boldly. The worship team is incredible too—spirit-filled and genuinely uplifting.

What truly sets Anchor Faith apart is the heart of the people. The leadership is strong, sincere, and fully invested in building up the church and the local community. Whether it’s through outreach, youth ministry, or small groups, they are committed to making a real impact.

If you’re looking for a church that will strengthen your walk with Christ, connect you with others, and empower you to live out Kingdom purpose—Anchor Faith Church is it. 5 stars all the way! If you are looking for a church that lives how the Bible says we are to live, this is the place. The Word of God is preached, and applied by this family of believers. They are actively involved with the community as well. My wife and I have attended Anchor Faith Church for a few years-certainly long enough to know the Pastors, leadership and staff. While I didn’t know the name or place at the time, this is the church I  prayed for many years to find. It is Scripturally founded and Holy Spirit led. The people and Pastors exude Agape love. From infants to the aged, we are all surrounded by effective, heartfelt care. I love this place. This is my home and these are my people. I simply couldn’t imagine recommending any place of worship more highly than Anchor Faith Church.

Annunciation Byzantine Catholic Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary: Byzantine Holy Divine Liturgy reverently chanted! Bishop Artur installation was sublime one year ago. Heaven on earth meets here. Fr. Stephen is loving chanting the Liturgy.  Beautiful growing church and people. My family and I visited this church on a Sunday and everything about it was stunning. They use a lot of icons, and incense which made church look and smell like heaven. After mass, they invited us to stay for coffee and donuts. Everyone was so friendly to introduce themselves to us since we were new. Even the deacon sat and chatted with my husband and I before the inquiry class after mass. They invited us to stay and join but we had to leave. Highly recommend this church for anyone in the area. First time to have Divine Liturgy. Stunning church. They sang every verse and very clear. God bless always. Though I’m a Western Rite Catholic, I fell in love with this church and believe this is a beautiful place to feel connected with the Lord and the chanting throughout their Divine Liturgy, felt delightful. Beautiful liturgy, friendly parish, gorgeous church. Was grateful to celebrate mass at this location.

name: Anthem Community Church
Anthem Community Church - Gainesville Campus
reviewSummary: Happy to call Anthem home! Anthem Church has been such a blessing in my life! Their practical and engaging teaching has not only deepened my understanding of the Bible but also equipped me to apply its lessons in my everyday life. What really sets them apart is their genuine commitment to serving the community—both in action and financial support. Their dedication to funding and partnering with local nonprofits is truly inspiring. Attending Anthem has not only strengthened my faith but also motivated me to grow personally and serve others with purpose. I’m so grateful to be a part of this amazing church family! This is a non pretentious, easy to attend church that provides great music, a great message, and great child care. They are a community, pulling people together in the name of Christ. name: Ascension Lutheran Church and Preschool
Ascension Lutheran Church and Preschool - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary:
My daughter's attended Ascension Lutheran Preschool and I couldn't have been happier.  My children love going to school to learn and play with their friends and teachers.  The teachers are very supportive and patient with my child.  The curriculum allows for the children to have fun while learning and also teaches them life skills (gardening, being independent and to be able to verbalize their ideas).  The teachers and director have a passion for teaching as well as introducing faith in a kid-friendly and non-denominational way. My daughter has been attending Ascension Lutheran Preschool for 2 yrs.  She has grown verbally, intellectually, and emotionally here. The staff has provided the opportunity for my daughter to learn in a loving group and to develop her own voice and interest.
The school has taught her life skills and to care for the garden.  I love how the staff is so creative in teaching the children. I have been a member of Ascension Lutheran Church for 25 years. Both of my sons were raised in the church and attended Ascension Lutheran School K-8 grade. While they both 'complained' about going to church every Sunday, they have both said as adults that they are grateful for the background it gave them to deal with life. Yeah!

The church welcomes all; children are especially cherished. They are welcome in both the conservative 8:15 service and the contemporary 11:00 service. If they make a little noise, the Lord and all of us hear them and are happy they are there. There is Youth Sunday school for children 2 years old through eighth grade and high school.

We have beautiful organ music in the 8:15 service and meaningful upbeat music presented by a powerful Worship Team in the 11:00 service.

Pastor Michael preaches God's word as presented in the Bible. His sermons are so easy to listen to and follow; the way he presents God's word makes me say, I get it!

After 25 years I am still going to Ascension every Sunday and am grateful to be able to do so. Great place to worship! Pastor Michael’s sermons are uplifting, inspiring and thought provoking. The doctrine is solid and questions are answered with thoughtfulness and care. The music is skillfully chosen to reflect the theme for the day to help provide the impact necessary for the sermon to stick with you.
Bible Studies are available Monday’s, one Friday morning a month before work hours for men, Saturday’s and Sunday ‘s, an active women’s group, things for kids and much more! I would definitely recommend checking Ascension out. We loved this school so much. Our daughter had severe separation anxiety and cried every day for at least a month and the staff was always so sweet to her. They would walk her around to water the plants or let her help out to distract her and after that month she completely changed. She had once been so shy and opened up so much. The facility was always clean and there were so many fun activities that the school planned. There was something so sweet about the families and it was a special community to be a part of. I could not recommend this school enough. It is the sweetest little treasure.

name: At the Cross Christian Fellowship
At the Cross Christian Fellowship - Temecula Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been attending this church for a while now, and I must say that it's been an amazing experience. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, and the people are friendly and caring. The messages preached are always thought-provoking and applicable to everyday life, and the worship is heartfelt and engaging. The leadership is excellent, and they go out of their way to ensure that everyone feels valued and included.

What I love most about this church is the sense of community and family that you feel when you're there. It's more than just a place of worship; it's a place where you can connect with others, find support, and grow spiritually.

Overall, I highly recommend this church to anyone who is looking for a place to worship, connect, and grow. The atmosphere here  feels so amazing and welcoming. I have been attending for a few years now and everyone is so friendly and caring. Leadership at this church is excellent and they  make everyone feel like family.  I highly recommend this church to anyone that is looking for a place to worship, the messages preached are always heartfelt. Recently moved into the area and with many churches around, I was really fortunate to know someone who serves here. Sound biblical teachings, great worship and a very intimate family vibe here. This is my church family now. There's a baptism coming up and I'm taking the plunge! My family has been going to this church for quite a while now if you really are looking for a church that will pray over you will show you the meaning of what God tells us to represent. We’re not perfect but we do try to not misrepresent God in any form shape or way we read right out of the Bible you will not be judged you will be loved  on The door is open come as you are as the Lord says all are welcome These people love the Lord and teach the Bible.  Not a big church to get lost in.  I'm enjoying the Bible study and the Bible centered preaching.  Not Calvary Chapel but approach preaching and teaching the same way as Chuck Smith.  I'm staying.

reviewSummary: Where the rubber meets the road in Christian community and love. I am always so very blessed to worship with the family of At The Cross Oceanside Absolutely amazing church. Cleta and Adam have so many wonderful plans for this church and I just cannot wait to see what God has in store for them, Great plans most likely!! Excellent church! Monday night  there's a Celebrate Recovery meeting that starts at 6pm. They also serve dinner here as well as singing and praising the Lord Great church wonderful Pastor Adam and his beautiful wife, Cleta made us feel right at home. We will be back! Great Church.  Great Pastor only teaches the The Word Of God. Verse by Verse Chapter by Chapter.

name: Author's Church
Author's Church - Glendora Campus
reviewSummary:
This place is amazing! The sermons are enthusiastic and made relatable which really helps. They offer child care and other family activities. They have a strong tie to the community and encourage people to take active rolls in it. This church has really reinvigorated my faith. It makes coming to church fun and something to look forward to. The music is amazing too. I was a big fan of Pastor Jim & Faith CC.
This new church is unnecessarily political.
Failed at being funny.
I will no longer be attending after 25 yrs of happily & proudly being tied to Reeve family churches. I’ve been attending this church for many years, and I’ve seen significant changes over time. While the church promotes values of family and connection, my recent experience was disheartening. I came to worship with my family, including my 1-year-old, and was asked to leave the service because my child was making some noise. Rather than feeling welcomed and supported, we were told to watch the service online, something I wouldn’t have driven to church for if that were my intention.

We weren’t offered a more accommodating space like an overflow room. Instead, we were directed to sit in the lobby, where the environment was so noisy that I couldn’t meaningfully participate in the service. The response we received felt more focused on maintaining a certain image for the livestream than on supporting families who are trying to stay connected to God in person.

It’s also concerning how much pressure is placed on families to leave their children in the kids’ area. Not every parent feels comfortable doing that, and it should be okay to keep young children with us during worship. Unfortunately, experiences like this are becoming more common, and it’s not surprising that many families have chosen to leave.

It saddens me to say this, but the church no longer feels as welcoming as it once did. I hope leadership reflects deeply on how their actions are impacting the very families they claim to value. An uplifting Christian Church, very direct and straight forward sermons.
If you come from a traditional conservative church, it will shock you but you will start liking it little by little. This is a very open minded church so please be open minded, don’t compare or judge.
I’m not a regular of this church but once in a while I like coming here because the amazing worship team and all pastors are energize and they are transparent as well. I like service that is direct and they can talk about any subject. I loved when the senior pastor mentioned the word “sex” couple time., it was hilarious.
Yes, they are not afraid to speak up when is tithe time, very direct and bold. Loved FCC and Pastor Jim. New Church and Pastor Dan not so much.

name: Awaken Church
Awaken Church - Port Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary:
Hands down the best church around. You're welcomed from the second you walk in, on any day at any time. There is never a person "not in the mood" to give you the longer explanation, or help you. There is never a time where you feel uncomfortable, and if you do, someone is around eventually to offer a helping hand or direction.
From trying to figure out who God is to learning what a village actually is.. this is the best church to be apart of.
Thank you guys for always being there for us and helping me to know God, and my babies too. We love you, see you soon. 🦋 I have watched a few sermons online and they are great! This is a great church forsure! I'm currently a member of the volunteer team at new day christian church so I haven't been able to be there in person yet , But I hope and pray that soon I will be able to because I would love to meet these wonderful people! I noticed that they want everyone to get to know each other and love each other! That is what we need I'm so happy to see them push that message! Praise the Lord in Jesus name! Been going here for years Pastor Brian and his amazing wife Pastor Jacqueline are wonderful loving people who have a strong 💪 group behind them i encourage anyone to check this Church out it's not your normal service like you had when you were a kid Pastor Brian takes the scripture and breaks it down into real life scenarios to make you understand and appreciate the word in a whole different way We felt that the lord led us to Awaken; and we are glad he did! This is a house of the lord on Sundays and a school the rest of the week. Yet we saw the Bible leading its ministry, and felt Gods hands and feet in the church and community right away. Pastor Brian and his congregation made our family feel welcomed and encouraged us to get into a connection program. So we could become involved with what Gods people are doing in the church and community. Grace is preached, and his spirit is felt from the moment we arrived, happy to be apart of this growing body of Christ! We love our church!!  The community feel and most importantly the presence of God we feel
In every service!!

name: Awaken Church | BALBOA CAMPUS
Awaken Church | BALBOA CAMPUS - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary: Great location, great leadership team and lots of fun events. Accusations of "prosperity gospel" are likely the result of cognitive bias. The leadership does not embrace a leftist socialist worldview and occasionally this is revealed from the pulpit. If you want to just go to church and leave the same way you came, hit up your local Lutheran facility.  If you want to witness the power of Jesus, come to Awaken. My first visit and I liked it. Great worship and a good message. Yes, they do focus on tithing more than the average church and the media seems to have shed some negative light on them in the past for different things, but the people were friendly and inviting. They are very patriotic and pro military(which I like )I personally prefer a straight non denominational Calvary/ Maranatha Chapel type church, but I enjoyed the service . As I entered your doors today, the Security stopped in mid conversation and approached me not only did he look me up and down. He asked if I’ve been there before and told me he didn’t recognize my face. I told him I didn’t recognize his face either and I’ve been to awakened multiple times. As I went into church today I felt the message to be strong, but it didn’t hold the same meaning as the man who greeted me as I walked in as I left church today, I stopped, and I informed him the security guard of how I felt during our encounter this morning. He started to get very upset and told me about his past titles of employment and how he was just securing I informed him that I didn’t feel safe or welcomed when he spoke to me. I informed him that in the future, he should continue doing his job, but in a way to where someone does not feel as I did today instead of being humble and warm hearted as in the message it stated today he began to get aggressive in words, elevating his tone voice, and then told me that I did not have to attend this church again. I informed him that he didn’t own the church and that simply I was sharing with him how he made me felt I did not raise my voice nor did I use any rude words. I am a woman that did not get dressed for church today and My Hair was a mess. My heart was full. My mind was heavy and my body ached I came to be blessed by the word and others around me. This was simply the most opposite experience that I expected to have today due to your Security, who said I could speak with the pastor and they would back him up on this particular encounter. This church is far too loud. Children were running around, screaming in the halls, totally tone deaf, and couldn’t hear people telling them to stop it. They know that it’s too loud, and they offer hearing plugs at the entrance. There was an armed security guard at the entrance. There was five people standing in the coffee shop and they wouldn’t let me have a coffee. I don’t know why they were standing there. I guess maybe to give coffee to their friends only nobody offered to pray for me or greeted me, and I was just hoping they would offer to pray for me because I know somebody that needs prayer It is December 31, 2025, and I was looking for a church to bring 2026 in and this place has to be a front! I went to the website and not one mention of Christ or any references to the Holy Bible. It’s scary how many locations they have, all of which mimicking the other. This is more of a spirituality and community connection facility not a house of God. Which, I’m not mad at, just don’t call it a CHRISTIAN CHURCH! Sadly I will not be visiting because I don’t need another fake “church” leading me down a path away from Jesus Christ my Lord and Savior! Maybe it’s better in person, but the photos, websites, and reviews are plenty for me to stand clear of. If you like to check this place out on your own, best of luck and God bless.

name: Awaken Church | EL CAJON CAMPUS
Awaken Church | EL CAJON CAMPUS - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary: My first time at this church and everyone was very friendly and welcoming.  They made me feel accepted and at home.  The choir was awesome, like a concert.  Lots of singing and high energy.  Everyone is super upbeat.  No doubt about it, this is a politically conservative leaning church, so  if you disagree with that then you probably won't like it.  They believe in the Bible  and if it's a sin in the Bible, it will be a sin regardless of what you'd prefer.  If you're conservative then  yes this  is a good church and you'll feel right at home.  God is the God of both Liberals and Conservatives, however it's good to have a place where people share similar political and moral values.  They also have full on armed security if you're worried about going to a Conservative church in a Liberal majority city.  They take your safety seriously.  It's not a huge mega church but not a small church either.  Check it out if you like high energy worship, and if you're low energy, you can still relax and essentially enjoy the show and be in the presence of God.  And if you're a Conservative in California, all the negative 1 star reviews are the best advertisement and recommendation for this church, all the negative reviews are what made me go to this church and I'm glad I did. Wonderful church which seeks to preach the Lord’s word while being relatable and lighthearted. The Holy Spirit is present here and all are welcome! Great church with pastors who speak truths and do not appear to fear repercussions. If you embrace a leftist socialist worldview and are looking for like-minded messaging you may find more comfort in your nearest United Methodist location. If you want to see and feel the transformative power of Jesus, come to Awaken. I brought my son in for youth group and all the women acted like i was there to steal their man 🤣🤣🤣 the leader of the youth groups wife had to come give him a huge kiss in front of everyone while he was talking to me, it was sooo awkward. awful look! Glad to see its not just me and this place already has terrible ratings. I've always thought it a little funny to write a review of a church online because it is such a personal experience, but I feel like I need to say that through Awaken, God has been transforming me. I am so proud of this church for reopening during the ridiculous shutdowns of 2020/2021 and breathing life into people every week despite the demands not to! Great leadership and a wonderful family atmosphere are what you will find!

name: Awaken Church | SAN MARCOS CAMPUS
Awaken Church | SAN MARCOS CAMPUS - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary:
As the owner of Performance360 gym in San Marcos, having a healthy mind/body/spirit is important to me. I have found my church family in Awaken church. I am on absolute fire for Jesus and only have this church to thank for that. Having a Holy Spirit filled church has changed my life. 🙏🏽 Thanks to Awaken and the way the preach about the Bible, I have found my faith again!!🩷 Amazing Amazing experience at this church! They are SO good at putting on productions that make people feel the gospel in Truth and with their message of love from God through Jesus! Thank God! The online buying of tickets through their Awaken app was quick and easy! I can tell they have numerous folks to guide when you arrive which helps since the building is huge. I’m sure thankful they have dedicated volunteers that are willing to give thousands of hours for their shows to be able to be what they are when it comes to production, lighting, and audio. Some scenes have a portrayal of demons in society which might be a tough watch for kids. They are relating the emphasis on the spiritual world which comes to life in the play. Other than that, for kids over the ages of 15 I might recommend. Just since the message is to spread goodwill and awareness about the importance of learning and seeking God in our society. Wanted to love this church and went, I don't know, 10 or so times before finally throwing in the towel. The word is extremely inconsistent here. It feels like this is more of an audition house for random people to come speak about literally anything. You can often find yourself in the middle of nonsensical political rants, that even if you find yourself agreeing with...you'll wonder to yourself....why am I listening to this at church?

There is usually a 15-30 minute section of each service dedicated to just tithing and why you need to tithe. The worship portion of the service is usually also pretty lack luster in comparison to others - not sure how else to describe it other than just not great. The actual spoken word of the church service seriously has lasted as little as 5 minutes in the past. This is after you sit and watch 2-3 promo videos of events coming up that you have to buy tickets for.

I've met a few wonderful people here and otherwise do agree with some of the messaging at this church, but it often feels like this is more of a money grab than a church. I was really excited the first couple times I came to this church but after realizing that I don't think I've ever heard the same person speak twice, and when whoever does speak, speaks, it can be a legitimate waste of time that has absolutely nothing to do with, God, church, or anything - but was just some guy trying to vent about whatever he feels like.

I often found myself leaving this church wishing I'd have gone somewhere else that takes God a little more seriously. I truly don't believe that I ever left this church feeling impacted by the word or wanting to do better as I have with other churches. Maybe this church will resonate with you, but it did not with me. I hope this review allows you to make an informed decision on your choice to worship. God bless. Praise the lord! Taking worship to another level. Breakthrough and be welcomed to a family of church goers that worship with a desire to embrace and empower the holy spirit. Cancel evil. Denounce evil. Nurture all that is good. Any campus and any service. They are all great.

Hope you make your way to a service soon. Pray to see you here. I grew up in a Christian home, went to church, attended church school my whole life, but I was never disciples. Fast forward several decades abd church shopping, my life changed completely here at Awaken with the fresh outpouring of God into my life. If you woukd like to be accompanied to a true Holy Spirit filled church, I will invite you. Thank.you God for the deliverance and the personal touching you did in me. ✝️🙏🔥

name: Awaken City Church
Awaken City Church - St. Augustine Campus
reviewSummary: We were camping in St.Augustine for the month. My wife picked this church to attend. We found it very welcoming, worship music was top notch, teaching was everything a Christian needs to hear. Sadly this is our last Sunday to attend, going home on Wednesday. Love to all those in attendance. From our first Sunday two years ago, we felt welcomed upon entering the service from start to finish. The pastors, greeters and parishioners went above and to accommodate. Since then, ACC has become our church family and we’ve forged relationships along the way. My husband and I have been attending Awaken City Church for a year and a half,  after an exhausting church hunt! We feel God has led us here and we have finally found our church home! From the moment you walk in the door and are greeted with genuine warmth and smiles, to the beautiful music and the awesome message given by either of the two pastors, you feel the Holy Spirit moving through you and through this church. Come join us for a wonderful experience! Love being part of this friendly, loving church community as we have formed many new friends and are also able to serve and help others. You hear the Word of God and how it applies to your life and you can also join life groups to grow with each other. If you're looking for a church with real people who actually care, you need to visit Awaken City. Since day one, my husband and I have felt welcome and part of the church family. The messages from Billy and Jeff are always practical and Biblical, and the worship is great at creating an atmosphere conducive for the Holy Spirit to move. You won't leave church empty handed. Plus, they have a big heart for our community and our world, and are sure to make missions a priority. Happy to be part of this church family!
