name: Banal Na Pag Aaral Inc
Banal Na Pag Aaral Inc - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
Very touching reenactment of Jesus Christ's sacrifice for us.  He's the way to Heaven.. this we have to remember all the time of our lives.  Amen. Grace is freely given.
A beautiful, life-changing encounter where God's presence is truly felt. I became involved with the BNP for a number of years as it was presented as an opportunity to study the Catholic faith and share in some Filipino culture. Unfortunately, this was under false pretenses. Catholics beware as their practices have been officially disavowed by many leaders in the Church and by several diocese. As far as religious cults go, the BNP is relatively harmless, however my personal story is one of psychological and emotional manipulation. I continue to pray for those I know are still involved The BNP changed my life for the better. I want to offer my life to God and to fight the battle of temptation, distraction, and sin with full force because of the way Ate Salve taught us how loving and powerful and how GOOD the Lord is to all of us. Thank you Ate Salve for turning many souls, including my family and I, towards the love of Christ and for helping us live out our one true purpose which is to know, love, and serve God and purify our soul in our lifetime so we can reach everlasting love and happiness in God’s kingdom for all eternity. I pray that people find it in their heart to see that this woman is nothing short of a humble servant bringing lost souls back to their Father, Jesus Christ, whom may also be known as the King of Kings, God the Father, God the Son, God the Holy Spirit, our LORD, our God, Christ our Savior, our one and only Creator, God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God we refer to him in tagalog Mahal na Ingkong, our Beloved Father. Thank you for teaching us how to humbly and wholeheartedly love our God and continue to become better servants to God. The founder never pointed glory towards herself but instead pointed EVERYTHING GOOD towards Christ and taught us how to glorify His name with our life as a testimony of how good he constantly is to each and every single one of us. Jesus was condemned and outcasted and called a false prophet too, many of the saints were outcasted and called false prophets and liars, be careful who you tear down… as you never know if you are cursing the very people God has chosen for a special task to gather souls and continue His salvation and spread His gospel. If you are worried, come join a retreat and see for yourself that the example people live their lives in the BNP and the way they CHANGED their whole self for the better to be presentable and worthy in the eyes of the Lord. Not through force but through the love of MNI. The change and the examples of these BNP member’s lives are much louder than the random hateful comments that are quick to put down a mission that only changed massive amounts of lives for the better and with the only intention to bring them back to God, where they belong. Attending the weekend retreat is once in a lifetime surprisingly delightful. The teaching’s and practices is Catholic and does not contradict the Bible’s content but indeed God’s comprehensive will  in a mysterious ways.

name: Baptist Church Mt Erie.
Baptist Church Mt Erie. - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: House of Worship with a BIBLE BASED PASTOR Dr. Walter G. Wells🙏🏽 I love this church!! Their choir is phenomenal! Pastor Wells and the congregation make you feel so welcome! And it's about half a mile from my cousin's house! The Absolute Best Choir in the city, An astonished pastor, bible teacher, scholar, leader, genuine,  one of a kind, charisma, and originality, small in stature,  but Bigger than goliath, if in need of spiritual food, go to the mount This is the best school in San Diego. The curriculum is off the chart. The one on one care is immaculate, and I wouldn't want it any other way. My home church since a kid. I will forever be grateful for this church

name: Basilica of The Immaculate Conception
Basilica of The Immaculate Conception - Jacksonville (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Such a beautiful church! I am visiting and as a lifelong Catholic, I treasured the offer of confession shortly before Sunday mass and the rosary being prayed softly over the loud speaker for all in attendance while we wait for mass to begin.

After the rosary, the Divine Mercy chaplet was recited. This was something new to me but so beautiful!

Mass being offered at 10am allowed me to travel the 20 minutes to get there easily, no rushing.

Such an inviting, lovely parish! So glad I visited! Went for morning Mass on a Tuesday at 7:30 a.m. It was about 30 minutes long. The church is beautiful inside and out, with a long history and very well preserved. There is good information available, and the atmosphere is peaceful. Very cool piece of history and also an active church building with daily worship services and confessions. One of the most peaceful and beautiful basilica’s I’ve ever visited!

Church parking across the street from the main entrance! Music program was excellent. Love the more traditional feel. Men in suits ladies wearing mantillas. Very moving, and spiritually rich mass. The LORD must have been pleased.

name: Basilica of the National Shrine
reviewSummary: The largest Catholic church in North America. A stunning architectural masterpiece and national pilgrimage destination with daily masses and reverent worship.

name: Bay Chapel
Bay Chapel - Tampa Palms Campus
reviewSummary: I have been lucky -- blessed (yes!) -- to sit by to some of the leadership from Bay Chapel in Tampa twice over the past few months. Their love of Jesus is infectious. An amazing group of people doing incredible things. God bless you!! Love is the best word to describe this place. I grew up in a Southern Baptist church, always felt judged, condemned, people giving funny looks if someone was not dressed right or reading a different version of the Bible. From the moment you walk in this place the entire staff and Congregation pour out nothing but Love. The people are what make this place such a great Church, but it's God's presence in them that shines the most. If you want a place to feel welcomed and love, this is your Church Great church amazing crew highly recommend This is not a church, it's THE CHURCH for you and your family. My family has lived in the Tampa Bay area for over 120 years. We have even pastored church's all over Tampa Bay. This church is the best church I have ever attended including our own when we pastored. The music is the best! The children's ministry is the best and we have 7 grandchildren. And all the pastors, staff and volunteers are truly loving to all the guest. You must visit Bay Chapel. My wife and I have been going to Bay Chapel for about six months and I want to share our experience. We have always felt welcomed and part of this family. I always sense God’s presence in this place. For example, in this morning’s service, I didn’t want the music to end because the praise was so meaningful. That is what Heaven must be like, right? And Pastor Bria’s preaching today (as well as how Pastor Wes preaches as our shepherd)  is biblically-based and beautifully vulnerable. I have never written a review on a church but felt led to voice this experience. If you are seeking a place to worship with kind and loving people, then try Bay Chapel. Bill Barksdale

name: Bayside Apostolic Center
Bayside Apostolic Center - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary: This church is amazing ! If you want to feel the Holy Spirit , this is the place to go . Jesus walks in this church and you can feel it as soon as pastor saiz starts preaching! Beautiful church with such a warm, diverse, and welcoming congregation. Pastor Steve Saiz Sr. and his wife Debbie are exceptional. When we moved from Utah to Southern California, we were so thankful to find a church family where we fit right in. Lots of great programs and ministries to get involved in if you feel God calling you. Looking for a great Apostolic Holy Ghost filled church. I love my church, Pastor Saiz and First Lady Saiz are very loving, caring and supportive. The ministry is awesome. Everything about Bayside is AWSOME..

name: Bayside Church Orange County
Bayside Church Orange County - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
They may got food in front. Ok worship but lack to be simple. Too much work for follow up. Lack of people skills shown here. Too much tech involved with the lights through most of service. Not coming again for those reasons. We have had such wonderful experiences at this church , at both their new campus off red hill and their previous location at vanguard. I love how well they invest in the full family - especially the children's ministry. Their vbs is a great opportunity to try out the church and invite friends ! Great new church in Orange County. I love their verse by verse Bible teaching with practical application. Worship has been great as well as great opportunity for connections. I like that it's connected to the Bayside network in NorCal which is know for its focus on kids/families, compassion outreach to the community and youth ministry. I would encourage everyone to check it out. Bayside OC has truly been home for me. After moving to Orange County in 2020-in the middle of covid- I was desperately seeking for community, not just any community, but a faith believing community. I found Bayside in 2021 and it is the first church that felt like MY home church. From the beginning, I felt welcomed, supported and spiritually challenged in the best way. One special moment that left a long lasting impression was how intentional Tyler (our lead pastor) was with learning and remembering my name.

I was baptized in 2023 and Bayside is also where I met my now fiancé-that is why Bayside holds such a special place in both our hearts. We are now deeply connected with the church. We serve on Sundays because it is one way to live out our faith and be active participants in what God is doing through Bayside OC.

Bayside is a bible teaching church, with amazing pastors who believe and embody the teachings of Christ. Bayside isn't just a place we attend on Sundays-- its a family that has shaped our faith, our relationship and our lives. Love this church! Cannot say enough good things about the staff and people at Bayside OC. The true key is to get connected so that you can make connections and be known! My girlfriend and I were initially drawn in after attending Bayside Granite Bay, but the difference maker has been getting involved in the Young Pro’s group and on the service teams. Having a loving community of people that genuinely care and support you through all the ups and downs of life while growing in your faith can truly be a difference maker in your life! Bayside is the place to be!

name: Bayview Presbyterian Church
Bayview Presbyterian Church - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary:
Bayview Church is a wonderful, warm, family-friendly church where the word of God is reliably taught every Sunday by pastor Jason. The congregation is small, but it is filled with kind, welcoming people. The worship consists of hymns. I would describe this church as the opposite of a seeker-friendly church. They will not alter the Bible in order to attract more people. The sermons are straightforward and easy to follow. It’s a good church for people of all age groups. I can’t recommend it enough! I've been going to Bayview Presbyterian in Chula Vista my whole life (33 years!) and it truly feels like family. The teaching is grounded in sound, scripture-based theology, and the people are warm and welcoming. It's more than just Sundays — there’s real fellowship happening throughout the week, from Bible studies to beach volleyball in Coronado. What really sets Bayview apart is the personal care — our pastor genuinely knows and shepherds his congregation. If you're looking for a place to encounter Christ and feel His love, I highly recommend Bayview. Finding this church has been such a blessing in my life. When Hector recommended me this church and from the moment I arrived, I was welcomed not just by Pastor Roger (retired) and the people, but by the unmistakable presence of the Lord. There’s a deep reverence for God’s Word here, and everything — from the worship to the fellowship — is centered on Christ.

Pastor Jason and the community is warm, inclusive, and truly reflects the love and grace of Jesus. Whether you’re a lifelong believer or just beginning your walk with the Lord, you’re made to feel like part of the family. No pressure, no judgment — just truth spoken in love and genuine care for one another.

If you’re looking for a church home that honors God with reverence, welcomes all with love, and stands firm in biblical truth, I wholeheartedly recommend this church. My Family has been attending Bayview OPC consistently since 2/11/2024. I found it by looking for a reformed church in Chula Vista. This church family and the sermons on Sunday are nothing short of a blessing! If you’re looking for a church that preaches from the Bible alone and want to encounter a church family that is loving, kind, and compassionate…look no more! You found it. When I think of the word “family,” I think of this church: There is love, support, counsel, and spiritual nourishment all in one place. The atmosphere is welcoming and happy. Pastor Jason’s sermons are Christ centered and edifying. I’ve been attending this church for a decade and will continue to call this church my “home.”

name: Beach Bible Church
Beach Bible Church - Huntington Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Beach Bible Church is precisely where I want to raise my children. Karoll knows all the children by name and makes Beach Bible a second home for each of them. Jonathan, the youth pastor, both lives and preaches the Gospel and makes sure that the students are firmly grounded in Scripture. It's so easy to be known in this community; every ministry feels focused on bringing everyone closer together and closer to God. Amazing church. Very small, but that just means everyone is like family and grows together with God. If you look at the other reviews that gave them 3 stars or 1 star, they do not say anything to back up their claims... coincidence? I think not. We are new to the area but have found the people in this small church community to be about the friendliest on the planet. The dinners on Wednesday nights are a great way to meet people, as are the small groups and bible studies. Services are insightful and thought-provoking. I catch them online if I am out of town on a Sunday, because I don't want to miss out! I feel at home here already. I have been attending Beach Bible Church for Four year. I am blessed each week as I am refreshed and refilled with  Gods Word.
The amazing music, worship, praise time to our Lord, is a beautiful time for me. I am so happy to be a part of BBC and I love sharing it. I love this everybody in there is so wonderful so beautiful inside the service is wonderful the pastor is absolutely lovely and everybody in there is very nice and it's a good place to go get get a message of the Lord I just wish you would open up very soon because I need to go to church and I love that church

name: Beach Church
Beach Church - Jacksonville Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Beach Church in Jacksonville Beach is a wonderful Christian church. The building is very nice, beautifully designed and decorated, large, has comfortable seating and childcare. The praise and worship team is truly fantastic and they do a great job every week. All of the pastors are really excellent as well. I was raised Baptist, My Husband was raised Catholic and we both enjoy coming here. They have a 9 AM and 11 AM service every Sunday. The people who come here are very welcoming and friendly! While this is not a church, I attend regularly, I recently helped out in their evening, homeless shelter, where they provided accommodation for nearly 90 individuals during a period of freezing temperatures.
They run a professional, kind, and generous operation that merits a tip of the hat Praise God for Beach Baptism in the ocean today! Jesus is smiling today!!!! I love this church!  The people are genuine and welcoming to everyone.  The music is outstanding and Pastor Jerry gives great practical sermons that can be applied to everyday life. Definitely a new experience!! It will kind of grow on you...  If you are more conservative,  this (church) will take some getting use to.

I’ve really enjoyed the teachings at Beachpoint Church and highly recommend Monday nights for those who need additional support during their recovery process.  You can be in recovery for anything, it doesn’t just solely target drugs and alcohol.  The music is wonderful and new comers are always welcome with open arms! I absolutely love Beachpoint Church! Their mission to develop authentic followers of Jesus Christ is inspiring. The church offers a variety of opportunities to serve both locally and globally. The messages are consistently relevant and encouraging. Whether you prefer a traditional or contemporary service, there's something for everyone. It's truly a multi-generational church with a strong sense of community and mutual support, who love God, one another, and our world. name: Bedrock Church Sarasota
Bedrock Church Sarasota - Sarasota Campus
reviewSummary:
We love Bedrock! It’s such a welcoming and friendly environment. The sermons are always meaningful, the pastor is amazing, and it truly feels like being part of a family. We’re so thankful to have found this church! My first time going to church since I was a child—I had some questions for Pastor Blake after the service and he was happy to talk me through my questions and gave me a beautiful leather bound Bible because I didn’t have one at home! Definitely my favorite church I’ve ever been to, everyone makes you feel completely at home even if you’re brand new to the church or to faith in general and the service was very insightful and eye opening! Will definitely be going again :) Bedrock is a wonderful church with strong Biblical teaching, great worship and super nice people.  Pastor Blake has such an approachable, authentic and genuine style but doesn’t water down the truth of the gospel and expresses the great hope we have on the cross. He has great knowledge of the Bible but isn’t too preachy and talks so much about how the all of it impacts our lives. He makes it much more relevant to what’s happening today and we really have not found this kind of spot on teaching at any other church we attended in Sarasota. The worship style is engaging but not too much of a “show”. Thankfully, no strobe lights or massive performances on stage. Bedrock is one of the best I’ve seen, experienced and now a part of when building community.  From the day we walked in our family has been welcomed with open arms.  Blake is one of the best I heard when communicating the gospel.  The way he breaks it down, brings a story line and then at the end, brings it all together with nexts steps to grow in your faith.  The worship is an experience that really ushers in the Holy Spirit to move the way it needs to.

If your looking for a community of believers who are like minded, growing in there faith and just want to “do life together” Bedrocks your place.   Thank you guys for what you do!! Bedrock Church is a great community of believers who want to grow and serve and help point others to the cross. We enjoy the well thought out worship and the strong biblical teaching and preaching each service.There are many opportunities to be involved and use your gifts and talents for the Lord. Bedrock also is truly striving to be a light to the community it is a part of and is a very welcoming place to worship.

name: Bel Air Church
Bel Air Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary:
Bel Air Church is one of those places that immediately makes an impression the moment you arrive, and it all starts with the views. Perched up in the hills, the scenery is nothing short of spectacular. No matter how many times I have been, the views never get old. They set such a calming, beautiful backdrop for the whole experience and really make it feel like a special place to spend your Sunday.

From the moment you drive in, it is clear that the church has thought of every detail to make the experience smooth and welcoming. There is plenty of parking, which is such a relief compared to so many other spots in Los Angeles. They clearly go above and beyond to make sure parking is never an issue. The attendants are some of the friendliest people you will meet. They greet you with a smile, direct you clearly, and honestly set the tone for how warm and kind the entire environment is once you step inside.

The hospitality continues as soon as you walk through the doors. On most Sundays you will find donuts, coffee, even popcorn, little touches that make it feel approachable, fun, and family-friendly. It is the type of detail that makes kids excited to come, while adults appreciate the sense of community it creates. And speaking of kids, Bel Air Church is truly great for families. There is always something happening for kids, and it is clear they are a priority. At the same time, I have often gone alone, and I can honestly say I have always felt completely comfortable. There is something about the environment that makes it feel safe, welcoming, and genuinely open to everyone, no matter what stage of life you are in or whether you know anyone else there.

The music is another standout. Week after week, it is consistently excellent, some of the best I have seen in any church. The quality, the energy, and the way it is presented all come together to make worship feel meaningful and uplifting. It is powerful without being overwhelming, and it adds so much to the overall experience.

Altogether, Bel Air Church creates a unique environment that combines stunning natural beauty with a true sense of community. Between the views, the music, the thoughtful hospitality, and the friendly people, it is a place that makes you want to come back. Whether you are going with your family, a group of friends, or completely on your own, you will feel at home here. For me, it has become one of those rare places that always leaves me feeling lighter, encouraged, and more connected than when I arrived. I have been attending Bel Air Church for years and beyond the amazing teaching by Dr. Drew Sams, I love that this church is intergenerational. Having members from different stages of life allows for different perspectives and insights for the growth of the church.

There is a traditional 9am service, with full choir and organ, and contemporary services at 11am and 6pm with worship band. All are amazing, and I encourage you to check one out!

If you're tired of "church shopping" and looking for a place to call home, we warmly welcome you! The church is in a beautiful site.  It's a moderate Presbyterian Church with a few different service options.  Maybe I'm old school, but I just wish people would come to church dressed a bit more appropriately.... instead of t-shirts, shorts, sneakers etc.  Message delivery is good but I wouldn't say amazing.  Anyhow come to church regardless.  God bless everyone! Gorgeous place! Looked at this sanctuary for a possible wedding ceremony and was absolutely amazed. The church sits on a hill overlooking LA, a breathtaking view. Their wedding coordinator is very accommodating and gave us a tour of the place. The sanctuary seats over 1,000 people I believe and there’s a hall across the sanctuary. There’s also a school attached at the lower part of the church. Very clean and staff are welcoming. I’ve never attended a service, but I am sure it is lovely. I am honestly surprised by the number of negative reviews this church has received, many of which seem to come from people who misunderstand its purpose. A church’s role is to teach and emphasize Scripture and the moral teachings of Jesus Christ. It should not be expected to alter biblical truth to avoid offense.

This church remains rooted in Scripture and clearly teaches biblical principles with love and conviction. I have never heard Pastor Drew speak hatefully or disrespectfully about any group of people. Instead, he focuses on Jesus Christ, moral accountability, and living according to God’s Word so that we may have eternal life. That clarity is rare and deeply needed today.

Pastor Drew is one of the best pastors I have encountered because he teaches the Bible as it is written, without watering it down. Just as a teacher must understand a subject fully in order to teach it properly, a pastor must faithfully explain Scripture and its purpose for our lives. That is exactly what he does.

Biblical passages such as Leviticus 18:22 and Romans 1:26–27 are part of Scripture and are often referenced in discussions about morality. Teaching from the Bible does not equal hate…it reflects faithfulness to Christian doctrine. Those who disagree are free to attend churches that align more closely with their beliefs, but this church should not be attacked for remaining biblically grounded.

I was baptized in 2023 and have personally experienced the presence of the Holy Spirit through this church. My faith has grown stronger, my heart has been transformed, and my walk with Christ has deepened. I do not judge or condemn anyone; I simply choose to follow Jesus Christ wholeheartedly and live according to His teachings.

This is a wonderful church for those seeking truth, structure, and genuine biblical teaching.

name: Believe LA
Believe LA - Woodland Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
I love my church family & Pastoral team At Believe  they bring the word of God weekly, 3 services times to be exact. One thing that our Pastoral team continues to do is lead by example. I was mentally going through a lot of trials and tribulations this past year, fighting up against spiritual warfare, and both of my Pastors came to my job and they helped me through one day. It doesn’t get better than that having Pastors who will help intercede and attack the enemy with prayer for you. Life sometimes is hard but one thing I know is that you can triumph with 4 amazing things THE WORD OF GOD, PRAYER, PRAISE & WORSHIP and A Great Church.  The Church is the people. At BELIEVE L.A.  they teach you how to walk in your everyday VICTORY with  3 GOD given tools. So glad I found this church because I searched for this place it’s nothing like this place, so this must be the place! It took me a while to write this review. I’ve attended this church on and off due to work but I've been there since its earlier days near the high school. It felt authentic and focused on Scripture and community. It was also nice seeing familiar faces from the music industry.

Over time it felt like the focus shifted toward growth rather than investing in the people already there. I joined a women’s group and was surprised the leader was a "new Christian" with limited biblical knowledge, the group began talking about zodiac signs and things got uncomfortable so I stopped attending. I later found out there was no system in place for how they picked these "leaders" you literally just volunteer and get can lead a small group...what?

There have also been instances where the pastor took jabs at “old school churches," which is not only where he comes from but a majority of us who now find ourselves in LA looking to fill the void of our home church. I find this off putting especially from the alter, or should I say stage as thats what its referred to and treated as. Once speaking in tongues and praise dancing was also being mocked from the pulpit, is anything sacred or off limits?  Although there are lead and associate pastors, both myself and two of my friends have tried to seek counsel/prayer and were not able to set a meeting with either. Instead as someone else commented here, I received a call from someone I had never met, which felt cold and awkward. Both of these people have since left the church and now it's my time to also move on.

Prioritizing growth and leadership without strong biblical teaching (like a consistent Bible study) is dangerous. Believe LA has been such a blessing. The pastor is incredible, and the worship service is always powerful. The church community is warm and welcoming, and we leave every Sunday feeling truly filled by the Word.

That said, for a church with such a strong young adult presence, it’s surprising how few opportunities there are to connect outside of Sunday service. There’s a real hunger among young adults to build community and grow in faith throughout the week, but currently, the church offers very limited options.

The young adult Bible study is only once a month (if that) and isn’t well-publicized. There’s no consistent mid-week prayer, no weekly men’s or women’s groups, no singles or marriage ministry, and no social gatherings or outreach efforts targeted toward deeper fellowship.

If you’re looking for a church that offers more in terms of weekly connection, discipleship, and community-building, you may find yourself needing to look elsewhere or supplement with another church.

Still, Believe LA is a beautiful place to worship on Sundays. I just hope to see more intentional investment in community life beyond that in the future. I initially started going to the church because I was invited by someone I knew. I went and enjoyed the church and decided to join. I took the membership classes and finished. However part of getting involved in a helps ministry you have to be interviewed by a member which is over the department. I decided to join the homeless or community service group and was interviewed by the leader. He was at first very nice but started asking me questions about church hurt and if I ever experienced it before. When I shared the story he told me I was gossiping which I wasn't, just answering a question he asked me. The call was very long and he eventually told me he would email me with more info on how to move forward. I never got a call, email, text, nothing after completing everything and sharing all these stories with a stranger on the phone. That was my experience so I stopped going. Also the church has a very Hollywood vibe so if you are into that you may enjoy it! ❤️❤️❤️ Let me tell you! This church is true community. From being genuinely greeted walking in, to the wonderful care at the children’s church. And can’t forget about the spiritually touching worship team singing and straight Bible teaching from pastor Aaron Lindsay. I’ve been attending since October and from the first service I knew I would call Believe La my church HOME! I LOVE IT HERE!! Anyone looking for real bible teaching and community, come check us out!  Till LA LOOKS LIKE HEAVEN 🙌🏾

reviewSummary:

I had the privilege of attending Bethel Assembly of God and it was truly a refreshing and meaningful experience. The worship service was powerful—not driven by hype or entertainment, and not overly loud—but a genuine, heartfelt expression of praise and glorifying God.

What stood out to me most is the simplicity of the church. It’s a small, closely knit community that feels very intimate, yet it does not compromise on truth. There is something beautiful about how pure and focused the atmosphere is—it really helps you grow deeper in your faith in Christ.

My wife and I were invited by Vilma and Daniel, and we are so grateful we came. If you’re looking for a church that values authenticity, strong biblical foundation, and a welcoming community, I highly recommend this church. The Sunday sermon is in English, but they provide a translator, and it's very welcoming to be in this group.

name: Bethlehem Lutheran Church
Bethlehem Lutheran Church - Encinitas Campus
reviewSummary:
Friendly inclusive members.  Work with quilt group and they are all joy to be with. A light and bright church -- in spirit, style and atmosphere. The people are friendly and welcoming in the best possible way, genuine and easy going. Worship style is liturgical but not stodgy. The teaching is an excellent blend of biblical (without being lost in the minutiae), accessible, challenging and socially current. Our kids are grown up but the children's/youth programs seem well attended and energetic. A very happy find for us. Bethlehem Lutheran has been our church home ever since moving to Encinitas over 20 years ago. We did some church shopping at the time and really appreciated the welcoming feeling we got at Bethlehem and the fact it was so family-friendly. Our daughter grew up going to Vacation Bible School here, attending Sunday learning circles, and eventually going through confirmation and the high school youth program.

The support our family has received from both the youth programs and the pastoral care from both past and current pastors has meant the world to us. In addition, the music programs are welcoming of people at all levels of musical ability -- if you are enthusiastic and want to participate, they will find a place for you! My husband and I have been in the handbell choir for years and really enjoy it.

Lastly, it is so important to us that Bethlehem became an all-inclusive church through the Reconciling in Christ process. Our congregation is welcoming of all people under the LGBTQIA+ rainbow. Our congregation also somewhat unique in that we are made up of folks of differing political beliefs and socioeconomic levels. To be honest, our makeup at present is not very diverse racially and ethnically, but leadership has taken steps to offer adult educational opportunities about racial and economic justice that have been well received.

Come check out Bethlehem Lutheran for a friendly, grace-filled, all-inclusive church home with wonderful music! We have a mixed race family & many kids.  Each went through Sunday school. Ate good food, had great fellowship. Lutherans drink COFFEE!!  Very welcoming of all people. May take awhile for some to warm up, but each person is accepted.  Good short sermons & a little singing  No admonishing, just support. At BLC you see and hear the words "all are welcome" a lot. It is not just a cute slogan it is a reality.  For me, with this congregation and our wonderful pastors, I feel I get better reception to the message of Christ than most places.

My cousins got Baptized there. another cousin of mine and his wife got married there. good service - although had to make myself get over the fact that one of the priests used the word "allow" - as I am an adult with a disability ( Autism) and I am very sensitive to that type of language as I find it infantilizing. Attended Easter Mass at this gorgeous decorated church in San Diego. This church has a dedicated choir that was amazing and sang for each of the Easter week services.
What a large, long church this is! Plenty of seating for sure. Very beautiful family church to attended. Everyone is friendly and welcoming. Father is great and the sermons have good messages that leave you thinking about life and lessons to grow closer with our lord. I enjoy all my visits to this church. A lot of my family attended school here. My sibling, multiple cousins, and Myself. All from preschool to 8th grade. We were all alter servers and our families made Blessed Sacrament our Parish. To attend Blessed Sacrament, it is not cheap. Tuition, uniforms, and the sports programs add up. We grew up and had kids. I was asked to be a godfather. And of course we wanted to get her baptized at Blessed Sacrament. And my cousin also wanted to get their child baptized as well. Blessed Sacrament denied us from this Sacrament because we personally didn't give enough money. Our parents did but not us. We were denied these children's religious journey because of MONEY! Just like jesus would of wanted. The Lord always put money first. Do not support this church. They put money infront of their "beliefs".

name: Blessed Sacrament Catholic Church - Westminster Campus
reviewSummary: We baptized our son the Cathedral. The priest was so kind and had a good sense of humor. The baptism took place during Covid and they were very prudent and respectful. It was such a beautiful ceremony and I cherish our memories. I definitely recommend. So warm, so peaceful Blessed Sacrement Church of Westminster. Try to make it every Sunday morning mass Open and accepting. KINDA. Depends on your approach. EXCEPT For the ushers and the Knights of Columbus. The ushers and the Knights of Columbus They will turn you away if you're not dressed extremely conservative and the Knights as a whole are lgbt phobic. Came here on Sunday for the 11am service. I am new to Westminster and was welcomed warmly. May the peace of Christ the Lord be with you.

name: Blessed Sacrament Church
Blessed Sacrament Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary:
Went there for this year's presidential election. Clean, simple, organized and very warm, the best experience ever! We love Blessed Sacrament preschool! We have now sent two kids here,  with a 3rd on the way. The teachers are fantastic and the school had a very flexible schedule. Lots of outdoor playtime which were really like.  Highly recommend! Last Wednesday, our family and friends gathered at the Blessed Sacrament Church in Placentia to bid farewell to my dear brother Victor. Amidst the sad atmosphere, we found unexpected solace and comfort in the embrace of Father Barrett and Father Batarseh.
Their collaborative efforts in leading Victor's funeral ceremony were truly remarkable. With unwavering compassion and grace, they gently guided us through the depths of our sorrow, offering words of solace that touched our hearts. Their presence provided much-needed comfort during our time of mourning.
We are deeply grateful to the church and Fathers Barrett and Batarseh for extending their love and support to our family during this difficult period of loss. Their kindness and empathy have left a lasting mark on our hearts. This wonderful Parísh has something for everyone.  It is a smorgasbord of spiritual offerings for all ages, including Worship, Music, Christian education, community outreach, and so much more.  The services provide a unique blend of a dignified traditional Mass, while the congregation creates a warm and Christ-filled love environment that is so special.  All are welcome to this intimate Bible and Prayer Book-centered church right behind the Placentia post office.  Come home and be blessed! Great break out rooms. Awesome worship center. I attended a big book workshop here. The facility was very welcoming and set up for a meeting.

Blinder Memorial Chapel - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary: Orthodox services were wonderful. We were Welcomed with open arms by Fr. and the congregation. Look forward to attending again. This is where Saddleback church does a Food Pantry Every 1st Wednesday of the month for Marines living at Camp Pendleton.  We help give them food donation from our Church. This place is easy to get to with base access. Small church with great value. This church also have a weekly food bank! Great function room right beside Blinder chapel! Was here for a retirement reception! Nice place to worship and meet with base religious leaders.

name: Bloom Lutheran Church
Bloom Lutheran Church - Santa Clarita Campus
Boca Raton Community Church
Boca Raton Community Church - Boca Raton Campus
reviewSummary:
The church impressed me with being the most friendly, Bible preaching church I’ve ever experienced as a 1st time attendee. My wife & grandson were with me & had a great time meeting & getting to know several people before & after service.

We loved the music & the acoustics & the seating was excellent.  First time I’ve seen an escalator in a church ... very functional with their movie-theater style seating!

The preaching was very thought provoking, insightful, encouraging & moving.

Can’t wait to bring our entire  family here for Christmas services in December when we plan to be in Boca Raton for the holidays. Pastor Free really is something else! He treated me like a pastor never should! Real arrogant and self centered! Please don’t ever go to this Church they will just ridicule you and try to take your money! Horrible horrible place! SHAME ON YOU PASTOR FREE! I love this church!!  Pastor Mathew is a scholar and a teacher of The Word.  He is a faithful man of God, and the music there is THE BEST! Yes yes yes. Really lovely kind people of all backgrounds. Always greet each other with a smile and a hug. Praise and worship is me meaningful and powerful. Sunday school is informative and follows the days message. If your looking for a good place to belong, belong here. We feel very welcome when attending Boca Community Church. We are always greeted with a number of genuine smiles welcoming us to worship. The music is very moving and prepares us to listen to Pastor Bill speak. Pastor Bill speaks the word of the Bible. He does a great job of of helping us relate his message to our own lives. This is a great place to worship. We are blessed to have such a great place to grow and worship.

name: Bonita Road Baptist Church
Bonita Road Baptist Church - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary: grew up here, love it. worships Jesus, the one and only true and living holy God. Pastor Bong preaches straight from the Bible. Thankful for being blessed with good friends and Church family 🥰🥹🙏💖 Is beautiful 😍

name: Bonita Valley Baptist Church
Bonita Valley Baptist Church - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary: I went to the church when I was 12 years old I was kicked out and I was asked to leave whoever knew that you could kick out a kid from church I'm curious who the pastor is now. Since that happened I've never gone to church again When I was pregnant with my second baby all the women gave me a beautiful baby shower. We had only been attending the church for less then a month. After I gave birth they showered me with love asking me if I needed help, and for the first week the  baby was home they cooked meals for my family and I so I didn’t have to. The amount of love these people show for you is unheard of. Your not just a number to them..your family. Pastor Jim is definitely gifted in explaining the Word of God so anyone can understand. They speak the truth of God’s Word unapologetically and the love and passion both the Pastor and his wife have for Jesus is incredible. Jesus is the center of it all! We attended BVBC for 4 1/2 years while we lived in San Diego. If I could give a million stars I would.  These people love Jesus, teach the Scripture faithfully, serve each other, and have sincere faith in the gospel of Jesus Christ. If you are looking for a church that really loves and values the Word of God (the Bible), you will find amazing teaching here. It has a smaller church feel, which means that you become family over time. No church is perfect or will offer everything to every person, but we adore BVBC and highly recommend it. Very beautiful facilities, great people who trully love God and people. Very family oriented and great youth group for my kids. They also have a Spanish ministry on Sundays 1:45pm I felt like God said welcome home when I landed here. Perfect for our family

name: Bouquet Canyon Church
Bouquet Canyon Church - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary:
It’s been a beautiful journey at Bouquet Canyon Church. The Lord has blessed both of us with his great love and mercies every day.  We went there for a Baptism in March 2011. We never left and we’re baptized Sept of 2011. The presence of the Lord is in there in his people. They welcome us with their arm open , just as Jesus Christ welcomes everyone. I miss all the smiling, the children at the coffee with all the snacks. Let keep in prayer for all our brothers,sisters in JC,and all the nations ♥️♥️🙏🏻🙏🏻 Meza’s Attended this church for a while a few years back.  Stopped going because of the disrespectful way I was treated. Very rude congregation.

If I'm telling the truth?  That's disgusting. In God's eye's I'm definitely telling the truth.  Thankful and grateful you showed your true colors.  Yes I attended for two months before I was told to get out of the seat I chose to sit in and your parishioners wanted to tell me where I could sit. I'm retired from the legal field and worked around educated and professional people. I'm physically disabled with a walker and was treated with ignorance and disrespect. Everyone should know and I have the right to openly tell people how I was treated.  No don't bother asking me to contact you because I'm not going to make you look good or feel good about yourself.  Don't worry about speaking with me, preach to your congregation. I used to go this church , and I love it. Great people to meet with and good times with friends and worship God. Everybody was so friendly and welcoming. The worship music was beautiful and not too loud. The pastor quoted many scriptures and backed them up with history and tied them all together to show us why Jesus came and what we are supposed to do about it. We had a Blessed night the kids was so fun
Great festival

name: Bow Down Church
Bow Down Church - West Palm Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
As visitors who have ministered for more than 40 years, desiring  the church to realize its apostolic calling, we were delighted to hear a message which provided the meat between the bread of worship and mission: discipleship. Excellent word, thank you, Bow Down Church.
Revs. Charles and Diane Wonnenberg My wife and I are vacationing in WPB and found Bow Down Church on Google. God is definitely in control as this was where we were supposed to be this morning. Excellent worship and Pastor Chris's message was right on! Excellent church, great outreach is happening and when we come down next year we know where to get filled ☺️❤️👍🇺🇸 I've been going here for a year now. In Titus, the women's group, I was able to get real with the other women in a safe and welcoming space, something that I haven't found at other places. I will say that if you go here, you go because you hold God's word as truth and THE standard, humbly submitting to Christ and acknowledging we are nothing apart from Him! If you want to be challenged in your faith, not some sugar-coated, people pleasing version of our faith, but biblical, real, soul cutting truth... with people that are genuine, loving, and on a quest for Christlikeness then this is where you need to be.

Check a sermon out online and come on over. Amazing church, completely Holy Spirit and biblically lead. Very welcoming and involved with the community. If you’re skeptical about churches to attend, save yourself some time and troubles and check out Bow Down! My wife and i attended this church for 2 months while wintering in Florida last winter.. The Pastor wants us to bring Bible. How about speaking directly to Candace Owens one on one before calling her names from the pulpit. The Bible says go to someone first then bring them before the church... I'm bringing this to you direct... i expect that your view on Israel gives you 'permission' to slander another now in front of millions of people.

name: Branch of Hope OPC
Branch of Hope OPC - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary: There are a few negative reviews about unfriendliness, snobbiness, and a lack of bible teaching. I wonder if there was a misunderstanding or if the people were writing a review for another google listing because this church is very friendly, deep in its teaching but not snobby, and they preach chapter by chapter. I think it is a great church! Been a member at this church for 9 years. I grew up in the church and, I believe, have been a Christian my whole life. I have grown and matured more in the these last 9 years, sitting under such faithful teaching and preaching, than the previous 20 years of being a Christian. No church will ever be perfect, this side of Glory, but the leadership here humbly desires and strives to faithfully preach the whole counsel of God & properly administer the sacraments. People are NOT friendly at this church, as with most that hold Reformed/Calvinistic theology. It will be hard to develop genuine relationships with people here due to the pervasive snobby intellectual atmosphere. Look elsewhere for a solid Christian community. We love this church. Pastor Paul is a gem among gems: a loving and kind shepherd, who earnestly seeks to properly preach the Word of God. Before the Lord led us to Branch of Hope, our biblical doctrine had been spotty at best. The teaching at Branch of Hope helped us to lay a solid foundation to understand and study God's Word and to trust in the Lord alone for our salvation. We became and stayed members of Branch of Hope for over a decade, and would have stayed there until the Lord took us home to glory, if employment changes had not taken us away. I pray that the Lord continue to bless His work through Branch of Hope for many, many years to come. Sadly, this church doesn’t teach the word of God. Unfriendly. And definitely not of Jesus! Visited the children’s room during service. Not a word of God taught…very sad!!!

name: Branches Christian Church
Branches Christian Church - Stanton Campus
Branches Church
Branches Church - San Clemente Campus
reviewSummary:
Branches church has an extremely low-key, unpretentious, and laid-back atmosphere. My wife calls it a "surfer church." That said there a people from all walks of life who attend with a strong contingent of young families.

The message is solid, but not pushy. I really enjoy the main pastor's delivery which often includes storytelling, historical context, and an explanation of the actual scripture language used. That may be my favorite part boiling down ancient teachings to terms that are easy to understand.

Should you decide to get more involved, there are many different ongoing service opportunities. They actually will support you if there is a cause you care about and want to start your own service initiative for others to plug into.

Last, if you have kids, there a two different rooms to drop them off to do crafts and activities that vary by their age.

Branches is a good group people up to great things. Definitely worth checking out if you are on a "church search." I moved to California for school and found myself feeling like a stranger in strange lands.  The folks at Branches were nothing but kind to me.  The community is very inclusive and participatory, and within a few weeks I was asked to share my skills as a musician and help the kids in worship.  Once I started hanging with the kids, I was really hooked!  I feel as though I was the one being ministered to.  The community poured back into me such positivity and rejuvenating love.  If that's not your thing, they also have donuts and coffee! If you are looking for a community of people that are genuinely seeking to bring about peace not just in their own lives, but in the community as well, then Branches is a place you'll want to visit.

Our family found that the community at Branches is great at welcoming people from any walk of life.  There is very little pretense here. If you're looking for a country club type of church, then this probably isn't the right fit for your needs. Things at Branches are pretty raw and honest and that seems to be the very thing that is healing this community and drawing others in.

This community is hungry for love, truth, and peace in the name of Jesus. So if you find yourself walking through the Dana Point Harbor on a Sunday morning, or if you're looking for a place to find a sense of belonging and purpose, then come visit Branches.

name: Branches Fullerton
Branches Fullerton - Fullerton Campus
reviewSummary: A reformed baptist Church in Fullerton. A Great Lords day service! Biblically sound teaching, participatory liturgy with prayer, responsive scripture reading, catechism, biblical/theological/practical preaching, worship in song, and the lords supper celebrated weekly. Solid pastor, beautiful church building, and a quaint coffee shop attached. I visited from out of town two weeks in a row and the people were genuinely friendly to me. The pastor is gentle and warm in person yet strong in his teaching and fidelity to truth. If you are looking for a place to grow and worship in community, this seems like a great church. We had trouble finding a church that felt welcoming to my family's diversety and after a few years of searching we found Branches.  We've been coming here for almost two years now.  Everyone has been extremely compassionate and supportive, we feel we've made life long friendships here.  Pastor Gomez goes out of his way to make sure his individual congregation members are able to feel strong in their faith and stay on mission.  We love to see new faces and make new friends! We were new to the Fullerton area and started going to Branches several months ago. We have never felt more welcomed, loved and served than at this church. Their desire to bring God glory and make the gospel known in this city has been so refreshing. We’re thankful to have been connected to such a loving community of believers and praying that His name would be known because of the work God is doing through Branches. One of the most authentic and down to earth churches we have ever visited! Everyone was so friendly. It was like a big family gathering. Israel and the leadership team are committed to the local community in a big way and it was clear that Jesus was the main attraction. Keep up the great work!! My wife and I live near the church.  We had driven by the property for years and noticed the new sign.  We decided to check it out.  We highly recommend you do the same.  The new Pastor Israel Gomez has been able to heal and grow this church through preaching from the gospel every Sunday.  The church is planning a significant upgrade to their Jr High and High School ministries because the number of young families attending is driving an immediate need.  The recent Chli cook-off had 11 entrants and 60+ judges and fed the entire church. Services are at 10:15. The new Worship leader is always full of energy and loves the Lord.

name: Brand New Life Christian Center
Brand New Life Christian Center - Orange Campus
reviewSummary:
This review is strictly my very own opinion based upon the few times I have been there.
Their music is extremely way too loud for the modestly sized sanctuary. Definitely will damage your hearing, no matter if you're a baby or over 100.  It's sometimes even too loud when standing outside the closed doors of the sanctuary.
The nursery is super small, there's not that many toys for the toddlers to play with, there aren't any cribs in there, and the person in there, just stays seated and doesn't even try to interact with the little ones being dropped off. The children are just left to cry really hard if they don't want to be left in there. Toddlers cling tightly to their parent and still cry uncontrollably even if the parent does stay in there with them. It's like the children are acting like they know it's not safe for them to be in there.
I personally think the area in the front of the sanctuary, looks like it's set up more for a stage production rather than a church service. They've got track lighting and big speakers. I can't say how much I enjoy attending this church . On Thursday night I went to the service and heard the pastor's wife preach a sermon on prayer. It was a very Moving Service and I seem to have really grasped what she had said. The People Are Awesome and the word is real Amazing pastor. His singing is so beautiful. These people are so judgemental, and make the volunteer people feel very uncomfortable. They literally force people to donate money and talk vulgarly of other religions to their faces. The pastor once told a Muslim man that he's wrong for believing in Allah, and that he's going to hell. They tell people that don't go to that church that they are going to hell. That is just WRONG. No one can judge anyone but God. These people think they are so holy and go around judging and putting everybody down. Great place to know about Truth and The Bible. Pastor Chuck and Amy do a good job preaching and have various guest speaker throughout the week. No childcare on the weekdays services.

name: Brazilian Church in San Diego
Brazilian Church in San Diego - Pacific Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Meu nome é Valeria tenho 38 anos sou casa tenho 3 filhos e um marido abençoado, sou Brasileira Deus é maravilhoso e me permitiu  conhecer essa igreja vai ser um privilégio ir no culto dia 12 de agosto em breve estarei aí com a permissão do senhor, conhecer o trabalho maravilhoso que vocês fazem com os Brasileiros que estão aí, graças à Deus pela vida de vocês Amem. Preciso conhece essa igreja, quero saber o horario do culto, em portugues. Um lugar de paz!

name: Bread of Life Church
Bread of Life Church - Temecula Campus
reviewSummary: Brothers and sisters in Christ coming together for worship were awesome to me and my two grandkids. Thank you BREAD OF LIFE! Beautiful building,  great people and specially the word of God At first people weren't that friendly. I kept thinking "Is it Racism?" 4 Older Mexican women rolled their eyes when I smiled and said hello. Pastor and his wife were welcoming and a few other Christians approached me to greet me warmly. I sat in on the Spanish and English service. Pastor had an interesting method of handing out the days scripture on a sheet where you fill out the answers to simple questions as he preached. What a great idea!! It kept me alert. The page had holes so it must go in a binder. It made me want a binder. Pastor's message was about Family and parental responsibilities. He seemed to advocate corporal punishment and shun transgender identity. His message, while powerful, was a bit on the "machismo" side. Then again, what do I know? I don't have a husband. Took my wife to their women's conference everyone was so nice to her ,she had a great time the pastor and his family are amazing people, please visit 🙏 ❤️ Everyone welcomed me just the way I am and for the first time in my life I felt so welcomed and blessed to have all of you guys now being part of my communion and where I most importantly found Jesus Christ.

name: Bread of Life Church - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary:
The church itself is okay, but the children center is very disappointing experience (BOLCC). I enrolled my son in their summer program for four weeks, and from the start, the teachers never greeted us—not even with eye contact. Later, they restricted my son from attending the weekly field trip because they felt he was “too playful.” The most frustrating part was that the teachers never spoke to us directly about any concerns. Instead, they always went through the Director, which meant we had no opportunity to discuss or work together on solutions.

We even offered to volunteer in the classroom to help with his progress, but they showed no interest in collaborating or making any plan to help my son stay in the program. Over time, my son became afraid to go to their school—a troubling sign, especially for a church-based program that should feel safe and loving. I personally saw him muster the courage to greet a teacher, only to be met with no eye contact and not even a quick nod. He was so disappointed.

While this may be an affordable option for families simply looking for basic daycare, I would never return, as the lack of professionalism, warmth, and genuine care was deeply disheartening. This church was very careful in controlling the flow of attendees. That was fine.
The service last Sunday was for Father's Day (June 17, 2022). But, instead of praising and encouraging the fathers,  the pastor scolded the fathers for 15 minutes for not taking care of the families, loving their children while using the American research of crimes, adding the Chinese traditional values of stern fathers.
He mixed up the two cultural differences, preaching to wrong choir, lumping them together to prove how good a father he was.
He mentioned he was preparing the sermon, his daughter screamed for pain from the earlier injury in a  game. He dropped the preparation to attend to his daughter, insinuating that what a good father he was.
But, earlier he said how a godly a minister he was.
Now let me ask you, " since how trusting you are to God, and a good minister faithful to your calling, then why did not you just pray to God's intervention to heal your daughter and continue to prepare for the sermon?"
He has already earned his reward on this earth (earthlings' praises).
Mat 6:1 ISV “Be careful not to practice your righteousness in front of people in order to be noticed by them. If you do, you will have no reward from your Father in heaven. This church is full of loving, caring people.  They made us feel part of their "family" and helped us in many situations.  If ever we are back in California, this is the church we would attend.  The Pastor gives fantastic sermons that hit right to the heart of your problems. Today, a group of blind Chinese Christian musicians came to visit the church. They performed serval music and delivered a very touching testimony. May God bless them and their mission. Bread of Life is a local place in Torrance for BSF on Mondays.
Come visit a selected BSF church.

Bread of Life Great Park Church - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary: Great people ;) So WONDERHOY 🌟 Life changing. Warmth, care, mission, worship, homecoming

name: Bread of Life Lutheran Church
Bread of Life Lutheran Church - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary: I would like them to open a Facebook account

name: Breakwater Church
Breakwater Church - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Went to the youth group here every Wednesday evening way back in like 1999. I loved it. Miss the people I met there. Still talk to a few I met but lost contact with most. Live in Aaska now. But will always remember the time I spent there. What a blessing it was to be at the church. The people are friendly, God fearing, and a pleasure to around. I do not attend since I now live on the east coast it was highly recommended...I was referred to a new church in Greenwood South Carolina. Great pastor. Friendly people. Lovely church with loving people!

name: Breakwater Community Church
Breakwater Community Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
It was my first time visiting Breakwater Community Church. I was invited by Pastor Johnny Martinez and I sat down next to his wife Bonnie who attend this Christian Church on a regular basis.

I arrived early at 10:30 a. m. so I could meet snd talk to some of their church members before the
service began at 11 a. m.  Some of the men and women I spoke to were very nice and they were friendly to me being a guest at this church.

In the morning, hot coffee and pastries are offered to the church members at no charge.

The service began at 11 a. m. It was very relaxing and casual atmosphere. I was just wearing blue jeans and a tee shirt. Some people were dressed up who work for this church but the member were
dressed casually and wearing shorts and a tee shirt.

Pastor Roger spoke about the Lord’s Prayer and everyone recited this Bible verse out loud.
Also Pastor Roger read from the Bible on Moses Chapter 8 Verse 4 and Exodus Chapter 4 Verse 12.

Then one guy was playing his acoustic guitar and everyone stood up and was singing this song Who Am I? The Pastor’s daughter was playing the keyboards.  Also one older woman had a beautiful voice and she was singing a solo on God,  It was really wonderful to listen to live music.
This church service started at 11 AM and lasted until 12 p. m. I enjoyed listening to Pastor Roger

name: Brentwood Presbyterian Church
Brentwood Presbyterian Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary:
I visited here last night with a friend to attend their Christmas Exalted Oratorio concert which was actually quite well done. While I am not a Presbyterian, the people I encountered here seem friendly enough and the church, which is an older building, appears to be well kept up. There is a small covered church parking garage next to the church just past the alley. There was a unisex restroom upstairs past the Brides dressing room. Someone said there was a bathroom on the first floor but I didn't find it. I enjoyed my time here. :-) My therapist mentioned this place for my friend to sober up. He went but I guess they charge $3.00 per visit which adds up. Not sure if they give sponsors.
I have never been there personally I have my own church. But the secretary was very good at directions and what happens there.
Thank you My mother went to the Thursday meeting for 33 years.  A great meeting. ...the last meeting mom & I went to was in 2000 . I have such fond memories .. Of a place that kept my mother strong & sober.  RIP mom.  ( 1931 - 2005 ). I am in my late 80ts.   I have a difficult time getting around, Dr's, marketing. The church, was there for me !!  They have a special program for people like me, ANGELES.  I have been able to not worry about getting to a Dr and market because of these Brentwood Presbyterian church angels.  I try not to take advantage of their services unless it's really important BPC has been my church home for 29 years. It is a warm, friendly church where everyone is welcome. The music is so special, and the pastors are devoted to this church family and the community. Come check it out.

name: Bridge Community Church
Bridge Community Church - Orange Campus
reviewSummary:
I would describe Bridge as a multi-generational, community Church.

My wife and I were married in September 2022 at Bridge by Pastor Andy. The entire church staff made the sanctuary so beautiful for our special day! It was perfect and we feel so blessed.

My wife has been attending Bridge Community Church since she was 10, and I started attending in 2016 when we first started dating. Many of her bridesmaids were her close friends she grew up with at Bridge, and many of my groomsmen were close friends that I have made at Bridge over the last 7 years.

We love our church family and feel at home at our wonderful church! The place the holy Spirit is moving mountains. I had backsliden for over 27 years and Jesus has brought me to my knees so I can praise him the way I was meant to and submitting my will to his. This church is blessed with the Holy Spirit. My ears had heard all about Jesus for years, my brains knows who he is but going to this church my eyes have seen him and my heart is in love with him greater than my first love. Thank you Bridge for opening the door to my wife and I. God is good Wonderful GODLY people felt very welcome!!! Love this church. Have been going there since 2004.
Pastor Danny is great, and so is the entire staff.
'Following Christ Jesus' is the main focus.
** In short, we see a family that is united by a common desire to live for God and a drive to open their hearts to those in need of what only He can give.
We seek to achieve this on a practical level through worship services, home groups, regular Bible studies, special events, outreach to the homeless and working poor, church services in the Orange county jail, daily emergency food distribution, periodic overseas outreach ** Bridge is an amazing church. With a warm welcoming loving congregation. Great worship and soul feeding word of God preached every Sunday

name: Burbank First United Methodist Church
Burbank First United Methodist Church - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary: Highly recommend!  Most recently, summer 2015, a new and energetic Pastor Sam Kim has joined the and the experience on Sunday mornings and beyond is exactly what we are looking for.  Lots of families with school age children attend making the environment a great place to meet other families.  Our kids ages 12 and 13 love coming to church and we are happy to say we have a church home here in Burbank! If you're looking for your forever church home, come to the big beautiful brick church on GlenOaks (a long time staple and icon to Burbank).  Great family setting, and their motto of 'Open Hearts, Open Mind, Open Doors' is very true.  We have been attending this church since moving to CA in 2009.  Our new pastor, Sam Kim, along with his family, has been an invaluable addition to our church family, and his sermons are encouraging, insightful, and refreshingly engaging.  I hope you'll join us one week to see the same for yourself. I have been attending FIRST UNITED METHODIST CHURCH for 15 years now and it has truly become my church home.  The people are warm and inviting and the pastor is a great leader.  My children both attended Sunday and were confirmed in the church. The church has become very involved in community outreach and has provided countless life lessons for my kids.  I will forever be grateful to God for leading my family to this church. My wife and I started attending BFUMC in November 2013 and we were welcomed with open arms. We have since had a child and are very excited to be raising him in this church. I have become involved helping out with the youth, BUMPS (Burbank United Methodist Players Theatre Group), and other various activities. This is a very active church and they always have something fun going on. Highly recommended if you are looking for a fun, warm, and exciting church to be part of. My family is very blessed for finding Burbank First United Methodist. Attended twice in the last three weeks and felt a very good vibe in this church...the people are energetic, friendly, and are engaged in a traditional progressive worship service.  I look forward to learning more about the church and the congregation.  The children's Sunday School is well set up with good coverage and the kids came out carrying an actual activity page with Bible content.  I loved that.

name: C3 Church Naples (Non-Denominational)
C3 Church Naples (Non-Denominational) - Naples Campus
reviewSummary:
A great church To make home – – even if you’re just a seasonal attendee.

Jean is an excellent biblical pastor and preacher

If you come as a stranger, you won’t leave like one —  just make sure that you join for the food after service We visited multiple churches before coming to C3. None of them felt like "home" until we came here. You can truly come as you are, but don't expect to stay that way! Pastor Gene is very knowledgeable and will challenge you to grow in your faith and I love that! This is a true non-denominational church, which means everyone is welcome no matter your denomination as they keep the main thing the main thing and don't believe on dividing over non-Gospel issues. The staff and members are welcoming and super nice too! Beautiful and loving church. Come as you are, they make you feel at home no matter what. My sister it’s a member of this church, and I visited while on vacations in Naples. Great location, and facilities. They even have a designated parking for first time visitors, you guessed it right, that’s where I parked my rental. God is doing amazing things here at C3 Church! My husband and I started going to C3 four years ago and fell in love. It truly is a real church for real people. It doesn't matter where you are in your walk with God, you are always welcome to hear His message at C3. My husband and I absolutely love C3! Pastor Gene has taught us so much while we’ve been attending here. C3 has everything a church should. Fellowship, prayer, the breaking of bread, and phenomenal teaching. It’s hard to find teaching like this anywhere else. Our walks with Christ has deepened tremendously since being involved with C3

name: C3OC Church
C3OC Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: For a long time, I chose to walk with a demeanor of discouragement as a result of years of "church hurt". I wanted to be in church, but I believed I wasn't good at being a part of a community. I found C3, and, while it hasn't been a smooth transition back into church community as I'm learning how to socialize again and learn what it truly means to be submitted and surrendered to the Lord, it has been one of the greatest blessings God has ever given me. The Spirit and His Word is alive and thriving in this family of believers. Gods Spirit is palpable and glorified in prayer, worship, teaching, encouragement, edification, fellowship, and the love everyone has for one another. C3 is a beautiful house built for the Lord and if you're like me and hesitant, hurt, or scared, I encourage you to seek the Lord, walk in faith, and trust that God has good things in store for you in life and at C3. There is healing with the Lord, your life has purpose, and God loves you so much. My husband and I had prayed so specifically for a church to call home and the Lord exceeded our expectations when He brought us to C3OC. From the incredible Pastors Joe & Christine Pringle, to the loving community, we were welcomed and poured into with loving arms & mentorship and we are forever changed for the best. This church is a declaration of God’s faithfulness, & goodness & if you’ve been searching to be healed, where you feel that you belong or to strengthen your faith with worship & great community, welcome home🤍 Church is at 10am every Sunday and we encourage you whole heartedly to come check it out! We were nervous about the prospect of searching for a church community in Orange County after we moved here. Amazingly, I was invited to C3 at a baby shower and we knew from the beginning we had found what we were looking for. We had been praying for strong friendships and sense of community that are prevalent at C3. Also, a strong theological commitment to the authority of scripture and worship that focuses on bringing glory to Jesus rather than catering to our Christian sensibilities was critical. C3 checked all those boxes and more and went above and beyond to nurture our family through my husband’s deployment. We love C3 and you can sit with us. This place truly feels like family – from the worship and the people to the pastors. I always leave each service feeling refreshed, and the powerful teachings inspire me throughout the week. They also have groups that meet during the week, so fellowship continues beyond just Sundays! Our kids love Sunday school too; they’re always excited to share what they’ve learned, which brings so much joy to our hearts as a family. Great to have a church that speaks biblical truth and stands firm on the word of God.. Talented worship team for a small and growing church.

name: California Heights United Methodist Childrens Center
California Heights United Methodist Childrens Center - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: We have sent two kids here for full time pre school starting at age 2 and both made wonderful friends and thrived in their development.  They've learned to count, write their name and many sounds of letters after a few years! They also spend time doing art projects and playing inside and outside every day.
