name: Calvary Baptist Church of Burbank
Calvary Baptist Church of Burbank - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary:
An interesting old set of buildings from the 1940's. There are creeky stairs and storage cupboards and rooms down obscure passages containing upright pianos, old audio tech and a nursery ready for the 1980's. No parking lot to speak of but if you need a church filming location, they will consider anything that's not blasphemous. A loyal group still meets there on Sundays and midweek. A great place for time travel! It's mostly original everything from galvanized pipes to ADA-what's that? Kitchen is large 1950's style. Bathrooms are small. Attic has character. Services on Sunday mornings begin at 10:45 a.m. and Sunday evenings services at 6:30 p.m. If you are not experiencing growth in your relationship with God, if you have never heard the Gospel, or if you seek greater understanding of the Word or are weary of messages that merely validate you or dispense a watered down gospel, then please visit Calvary Baptist Church of Burbank.

Update

I have now been attending CBC for a few months.

This is a small church but one where the Word is taught without the "feel good" distractions that veer people from understanding that we are indeed saved by grace.

Pastor Anthony is highly astute and highly educated pastor who is imbued with the rare ability to explain scripture and cross-reference New Testament verses with the original or related verses found in the Old Testament.

I believe any person attending CBC will greatly benefit from studying the Word as taught by Pastor Anthony. Personally, I have experienced real growth and understanding of what the Gospel really means to my life and why it is important to share the gift of salvation to those who are perishing. I also finally understand why genuine repentance is necessary.

Original Review

This was my first visit. I chose to visit because internet reviews mention the the pastor teaches scripture indepth.

The guest who spoke conducted a wonderful and immensely insightful study of Psalms 93.

This is a small church but I found today's visit enlightening and hopefully will help guide me in my walk. Rich, solid and understandable expository bible teaching every week. Caring Pastor Anthony and lovely wife, Jenny lead this congregation steadily into maturity through God’s powerful word.

People who come to this church are looking for a deeper relationship with God by understanding his word and be used in the everyday setting and not only on Sunday.

This church is not for the faint of heart. You will find explanations to your bible questions. After looking into many Biblically sound churches in the Los Angeles and Burbank area, my family and I stumbled upon Calvary Baptist of Burbank one Sunday. We immediately fell in love with the small yet diverse community of caring Christians. Pastor Anthony's expositional preaching stood out as gospel-centered, circumspect in putting the pieces of Scripture in light of Biblical context, insightful, and genuine. We now call this church our home and could not wish for a better family of Christian believers. If you are curious about Christianity and are seeking to know the truth about what the Bible teaches in its historical and original context, I can guarantee that attending the morning service will enlighten you and you will walk away more informed. If you are a Christian who is serious about your faith and wish to grow by delving deeper into the Word God, this church is definitely for you. You will find like-minded believers who would love to walk along side of you and encourage you in your spiritual walk. I love this church.  The pastor is very knowledgeable. He doesn't interpret his own opinion like most preachers. He will give you word for word what the Bible actually says. He uses the best interpretation from the original transcripts. He makes sure you thoroughly  understand what he speaks about.  His wife has this amazing voice when she sings. I  love the songs they sing. A lot I never heard of,but easy to remember. This Church is not a feel good preaching. It is real and its what this world really needs. The people are very kind there. Right now its tough to get too close.  We sit in every other pew, come in with mask. We get our temperature when walking in. Sanitizer station right at the door. They are very careful.  If you can't make it, they stream live. Here is an update. Been going here since April 2020.  The restrictions have lightened up now. More pews opened up.I decided to join. I  noticed someone mentioned about the structure of the building.  Not sure what that has to do with anything.  If someone wants to go to a church based on what it looks like, or how old,or anything that has nothing to do with assembly together to be fed,worship, and fellowship, you are going for the wrong reasons.

name: Calvary Bible Church
Calvary Bible Church - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a solid, Bible-believing church that has sound doctrine and congregants who are practicing their faith in the Lord Jesus. The most prominent portion of the Sunday worship services is the strong preaching (mostly expository). The leadership (pastors and elders) are committed to faithfully teaching God's word and shepherding the members of the church.

Currently, this church is medium-sized (around 300 attendees), so it can be challenging to get to know people. While some people are welcoming, it seems that others tend to keep to themselves or the people they're comfortable with. To be clear, I'm not saying that there are clear factions within the church. One can definitely build Christ-centered relationships with many people if he takes the initiative to do so.

While I have some minor disagreements on certain elements of church doctrine and practices, I believe that this church is genuinely God-fearing, Christ-exalting, and Spirit-filled. I became a member of this church in January 2024, and I'm thankful to be part of a body of believers that seeks to worship and glorify God. I have been coming to CBC for about a year and a half now. I absolutely love CBC! This is a Bible preaching & Bible Believing Church. I enjoy how friendly and inviting everyone is. CBC has various fellowship groups for everyone at every stage of life. Surely, would recommend. I'm very impressed. This is what church should be. The 9am service is 1.5 hours long. It's structured like most services that I'm used to: Singing, announcements, message, and closing song. You all know churches have a "feel" to them. I was very comfortable here. Most importantly the preaching was sound biblical teaching. It wasn't just an encouraging Joel Osteen type of message. The pastor really explained the passage and how we can relate this to our daily life. I've been visiting churches for a while trying to find the right church. It's Monday morning and I'm still moved by the message. It definitely spoke to me. I'm happy to go back next week for my second visit. Grateful for this body of believers who worship in spirit and truth. The leaders & pastors teach the word of God in this confused and darkened culture. Praise God for guiding me to this church! CBC is a solid bible teaching church with many sunday school classes, children & youth ministries and biblestudies/small groups that encourage fellowship and unity within the church! I've been here for the past 12 years and couldn't imagine being anywhere else on a Sunday!
If your looking for a consistent bible teaching church where the gospel is preached weekly, CBC should be your home! Come visit us!

reviewSummary: For anyone wanting to learn about Jesus this is a great place to start. Pastor Henry delivers the word verse by verse and delivers a great and powerful sermon all biblically based not opinionated straight from the book with love. If you don't believe me go see for yourself. We came here for the Wednesday 630 service i am familiar with calvary chapel, i have been listening to there radio broadcast since pastor chuck, and i continue listening with pastor laurie, , i heard a sermon with pastor henry and it was very good, we decided to come check out the church, pastor henry didnt speak but we got a great message with i believe a guest speaker playing a Shepard who walked us thru the birth and the day our lord sacrificed himself for our sins , he was excellent! The church was silent he had us feeling like we were in Jerusalem and.Bethlehem 5 star rating alone! We well be back for another Wednesday service it fits our work schedules, cant wait to hear more , I recommend Calvary Chapel Beaumont to anyone who is in need of a home based Church come as you are All is welcome. Ever since this church was started in Beaumont, I'd  drive by on Sunday's and saw the parking lot very full. I thought "this must be a good church." Years later I attended a service, and found that this church is 98% of what I had been looking for in a church. The people are friendly but not overly. The Worship part is just right. It isn't so long you don't enjoy participating. The Pastor is pretty good. He keeps himself with you and not above or better than you. His sermons are put in terms you can understand. He takes you verse by verse through the Bible and breaks it down to how it pertains to us in today's world. I'm  glad I went. New to the church (4 weeks) & my husband & I are praying about making CCB our new home church after just moving into Beaumont & we are loving the idea of it being our home church. We had the bar super high after moving 2 hours away from our home church where my husband attended for over 12 years & I attended over 6 years. Pastor Henry shares the word directly from the Bible & teaches it without bending the truth. That’s the most important part to us. He also encourages the congregation to bring your Bible, read & study the Bible for themselves, or request a free Bible from the church, & not to take what he’s saying blindly. We appreciate that he explains the word and its realistic application. He lays out main points of the sermon & points out main topics for note takers. His sermons are clear, organized, & flow well. It’s a plus that he has a great sense of humor & makes us laugh. He definitely has all the components of a great pastor. The church has an abundance of ways to stay connected to God everyday of the week with opportunities to fellowship with others & study the Bible. Everyone has been welcoming & friendly. I can’t say enough good things about pastor Henry and CCB church. My husband & I are intending to find a small group and get connected in more ways. I encourage anyone looking for a place to learn, worship, and grow to visit CCB.

While also learning the true meaning behind the words we are given a deeper, richer  understanding of our walk with the Lord, our families, and the world around us. Pastor Clark is an amazing Pastor!
He Teaches Us What Greek& Hebrew Words is and what they mean, He is Spirit Led!
He Talks Straight From The Bible, if You Need Prayer He Wants To Pray For You!
He Is Very Kind And Will Help You If You Ask!
Teaches Verse By Verse, Book By Book, I Learn Better That Way, So That is A Blessing and That Way I Could Understand GOD’S WORD more!
Every Time I Get To Church And At Church They Play Phil Wickham for Background Music so it makes Ready for Church Service! I Love The Worship The Worship Team Does, I Learn New Songs Every Wednesday and Sunday Which I Love!
Very Kind People I Have Made A Lot of Friends from Here! 🦁🫁🙌🏾🕊😇✝️
This Church Feels Like Home!
JESUS Blessed Me With This Amazing Family Of Believers! May GOD Bless This Church! Thank you Pastor Clark for your dedication, preparation, and heart for teaching the Bible. It does not go unnoticed, and I am very grateful. I gain so much every week, and it has truly helped deepen my understanding and walk with the Lord. This has been our home church for 11 wonderful years. We are truy blessed to hear n learn from Pastor Clarks teachings every week. I was raised in church since I was a child and thought I knew a lot about the bible. But every week I am thrilled to learn something new from Pastor Clark by his knowledge n love of God's word. If you are in search of learning more about Gods word and a have a deeper  relationship with our Lord n Savior come join us to  have "the socks blessed right off your stinky little feet!" Oh and Pastor Clark has a wonderful sense of humor also, come visit us soon. I've been attending Calvary Bible Fellowship going on 10 years now.  Pastor Clark Van Wick and his wife Sally who is the Director of the Women's Ministry both love the Lord, as do all the other pastors and ministry leaders. CCBF teaches the full gospel from Genesis to Revelation, with ministry groups for all ages. I recommend visiting their website to see all they offer and come out and be blessed!

name: Calvary Chapel Boca Raton
Calvary Chapel Boca Raton - Boca Raton Campus
reviewSummary:
I felt really welcomed, im just starting my process to come back to God. This church has been really good for me. IG: TRAVELWITHARCHER86

It's been quite some time since I last attended church, and my heart has felt some form of guilt. I've struggled with my understanding of God and have consistently, for years, desired to discover the clarity and a sense of certainty within my understanding and belief of God. I still am in the same head space. However, thanks to a wonderful friend who invited me to church tonight, I feel a sense of peace. The message from the young pastor who led the service was impeccable and RELATABLE. The message and story tonight (6/7/2025 Saturday) was about David and Nabal. I was captivated and fully invested from start to finish.

I want to directly give my thanks to the pastor and the PHENOMENAL band who touched my heart and re-invigorated my desire to search for my understanding and love for God.

Thank you!

-Joshua-
U.S. Coast Guard Veteran I truly love this church and I’m grateful to be a part of it. However, I feel the childcare situation needs more attention. Today during service there were 16 children placed in one room, ranging in age from 2 to 4 years old. While that may seem manageable to some, I personally felt that the age gap is far too wide and the ratio of children to caregivers is concerning. Younger toddlers have very different needs and abilities compared to older preschoolers, and it’s important for their safety, development, and overall experience that this be addressed.

Edit: today they moved my children to a different classroom without being told or informed of the change. The children’s ministry is a mess and for that reason I am leaving Calvary. I really feel  at home here. Truly a Bible centered church. The service was great and would love to be here full time. Unfortunately,  the Sunday school for the kids is very unreasonable and difficult to deal with. If you have young kids you might want to find another Sunday church home. If no kids or teenagers then a great church! Just not little ones.

name: Calvary Chapel Burbank
Calvary Chapel Burbank - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary: I have been going to this Church since May of 2023. The congregation here are some very lovely and welcoming people. I love that there are many kinds of different people here and it's not one ethnicity more than another. I also really enjoy the way Pastor Tim delivers scripture. Granted, he reads right out of the bible but he takes the time to stop and breaks things down so that it is easier to understand.   Since the Bible was written so many years ago it's very easy to misinterpret things or perceive them in a different way. Pastor Tim is really good at getting the point across and Giving examples as to how these stories do pertain to this day and age. I grew up in church but I never knew what it meant to have a church family until Calvary Chapel Burbank. The warmth and love felt here is genuine. The teaching of the word is verse by verse- solid and grounded in the Bible and not cultural opinions. When my Dad battle an illness, and eventually passed, my family and I felt the love and support from this body. It was a hard time, made lighter by the love of Christ poured out through CCB. The church has a strong kids, youth, and young adult program. Men’s and Women’s Bible studies, as well as retreats, to encourage fellowship. If you’re hungry for Jesus and for godly fellowship- come! Worship and the word. Pure and simple. I cannot recommend Calvary Chapel Burbank enough. I started attending the church 19 years ago and from the moment I walked in I felt so welcomed. I have grown so much under the leadership, teaching and worship. They supported me as I stepped out to do missions 17 years ago and were such a comfort for my family and I when my Dad passed in 2019. I can’t imagine living my life without this church who has indeed become my family. If anyone is unsure of church or has been hurt by religion in the past, I highly encourage you to join us. Don’t let the faults of man keep you from knowing Jesus for yourself. CCB is a safe place where all are welcome, the Bible is preached  and Jesus alone is glorified. I’ve been a member of Calvary Chapel since 2008 and I thank God for this church. Pastor Tim teaches God’s Word simply and with great knowledge.  I see the growth happening in me and in the church body. I recommend you come see for yourself how the Holy Spirit is present and working in this church. I love the pastor at this church. He really delves deep into the Bible. If you want to learn about what God teaches us in the Bible, this is the right place to go. He is well-versed in the scriptures. The fellowship here is also really nice, people are very friendly and welcoming. They also have a great kids program

name: Calvary Chapel Chino Hills - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
During COVID times this church had an outside screening of pastors preaching. This is a nice church and all but I couldn't get over how the preacher they were screening preached "get the COVID vaccine or accept the mark of the beast." Other than that they still were very community oriented. Pastor Jack is an excellent Bible teacher. He teaches the entire Bible, verse by verse. He doesn’t pick and choose which verses to cover. You will get a true teaching of the entire Word. I wouldn't trust this Church with sending your kids for VBS (Vacation Bible School) if you care for their wellbeing. My wife and I sent one of our sons to attend their VSB program over the summer and our son had a conflict with one of the other attending children. We brought it to the staffs attention however the conflict continued to happen.

My wife has attempted to call the Church multiple times since the conclusion of VBS, however, they've refused to return her phone call despite multiple messages left. We're truly disappointed with this experience. Have not been there in person but always listen to his sermons, everyday.
Love the teachings, I am blessed to have found his online, I live in Santa Maria Ca , but will visit the church soon.
I always feel God’s in all pastors word.
GOD BLESS PASTOR JACK HIBBS, so much knowledge 🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏💐🤗 Calvary Chapel Chino Hills has been my family and I's home church for the past six years! We got baptized with this church! Even though we don't live in state we are fueled by pastor Jack's sermons as he isn't afraid to speak truth from the Bible! He doesn't sugar coat his messages to make you feel good about yourself. Rather he presents God's word as it is to help you live your life on fire for Jesus! When we visited, everyone we met was so sweet and glowing with the Holy Spirit! Jesus fills this place inside and out! The Holy Spirit is working through the people here and if you live in the area I highly highly encourage you to come witness what Jesus is doing here! If you don't live in the area watch pastor Jack's sermons online! As they have been a tremendous blessing to my family and I! Praying blessing over Calvary Chapel Chino Hills, pastor Jack and his family, and the body of Christ here! 🙏🏻🧡

name: Calvary Chapel Chino Valley
Calvary Chapel Chino Valley - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
Visited CCCV for the first time yesterday on Mother’s Day, and I can honestly say it was such a beautiful experience. From the moment I walked in, everyone was so welcoming, kind, and genuine. You could truly feel the love, worship, and presence of God in the room.

Pastor Rosales delivered an incredible message that was powerful, easy to understand, and deeply moving. As someone who is intentionally growing in my relationship with Jesus and looking for a church home, this service really impacted me. The way the Word was taught felt real, relatable, and full of truth.

I left feeling encouraged, peaceful, and excited to come back. Even though it was my first time there, I genuinely feel confident saying this will be my home church. I’m looking forward to continuing to grow in my faith, getting connected with the community, and serving alongside such amazing people.

Truly grateful God led me here. I love the music singing to the LORD, 2016 it was around the time too vote and the pastor said to go to the gazebos and they will teach you how to vote if you don’t know how. And then he said who to vote for excuse me nobody tells me who to vote for, not a church or man, nobody. Amazing Church to call your home Church. Pastor Rosales is definitely one that belongs on the pulpit. He reads right from the Bible and gives a sermon that you can understand to the t. And the way he throws in his own life stories makes it very relatable.  The worship during service is so beautiful. But if I could make one suggestion I would say have a few more upbeat songs during worship. It's nice to have the slow ones but I think a few more upbeat songs would be great. If you haven't found a home church and you're looking this is definitely a church I would recommend. Pastor Hibbs has inspired me to read the bible and I just listen to his preaching now even his podcast. I am blessed by his teaching. We need more preachers like him who is not after to speak his mind about the truth and what the bible teaches. I love this place, my kids love this place! It’s truly a beautiful place to worship the Lord our savior.

name: Calvary Chapel Christian Fellowship
Calvary Chapel Christian Fellowship - Arcadia Campus
reviewSummary: Pastor Jim Sheets always has a wonderful message straight from the Word of God. God’s Word is taught word for word from the Bible. Pastor Jim is a very good teacher and Shepard. I look forward to hear him teach though the whole Bible. 😇 Visited this morning but had to leave abruptly before communion. Great message from the pastor on living a clear cut life for a Jesus. Very warm and friendly group. Very sorry we had to get home quickly! I have always been blessed by the teachings of Pastor Jim and his beautiful wife Jeantte! Thank you both for your service to us all these years! 📖⚔️🙏🏼 Amazing church,great pastor,great congregation,lots of amazing seasoned believers there,authentic Christians there! Love what jesus is doing at Calvary chapel west co!

name: Calvary Chapel Conejo
Calvary Chapel Conejo - Woodland Hills Campus
Calvary Chapel Conejo Valley
Calvary Chapel Conejo Valley - Woodland Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a remnant church. The minority of churches that still teaches the WHOLE council of God. Our first visit here was when pastor Dave was preaching the book of Revelation. Having studied this book in the past I knew this is not a popular book among pastors who try to please the congregation. This church and pastors are more concerned about saving souls than pleasing crowds. Which is what Christianity is about. Pastor Dave’s fire and brimstone message was delivered with as much compassion and love as one can bring to a tough teaching about God’s righteous judgement on a world who has turned their backs on God. I knew right there and then that this was a church I can call home. All walks of life are welcome and we love on everyone and teach them God’s word, but God’s word will not be bent or belittled to please people. As it should be. Best church we’ve ever been apart of. Loving, welcoming & pastors faithfully preach the truth. All about Jesus!! Also, love that the pastors / leadership don’t take salary or income from the church. So all tithes/ donations go to the Kingdom. Truly living out the Gospel We've  been on the search for a church which was open during covid.  Seems that Calvary Chapels are the only churches that seem to know that church is essential.  We have the Constitutional right to have church for the ministry of Jesus Christ  and the Holy Spirit to offer solace and community to believers in the  Lordship of Jesus, and anyone else that is seeking God's help and guidance.  CCConejo Valley is open and alive with systematic thru the Bible teaching of God's Word.   (Nothing less than a whole Bible will make a whole Christian."   (One of Pastor Dave's  favorite statements.)  People are  friendly, in love with Jesus, worship lifts up His Name and the Word of God is taught with a  passion for the heart of Jesus.  Studies available for all ages plus a study of New Testament taught on Sundays and  Old Testament onThursdays by Pastor Dave and his staff.
Thank you, Pastor Dave . Great place. Our pastors peach the word straight out of the Bible. If it's in the Bible they're going to talk about it. Straight, undistilled Truth. Up is up. Down is down. Truth is Truth. Pastor speaking in one breath that Christians should unite and not bicker with one another, and in the next breath judge Catholics and judge the Pope saying he's not saved - is too judgmental of a church for me.

name: Calvary Chapel Cornerstone
Calvary Chapel Cornerstone - Arcadia Campus
reviewSummary: Great family oriented word for word Bible teaching. Blessed are those who are pure in heart for they shall see God. Beautiful people to worship with and the place is so inviting. Everyone is friendly and polite, very peaceful Godly place to be in for worship. Beautiful sanctuary Staff were so helpful We were there for Memorial service My friend loved taking her family to this church Visiting Pastor Joe, 20 years after he married us, to thank him for being faithful to the Lord in teaching His word simply. Coming in as "Catholics" service was unusual to us in that mostly all congregants had a Bible and were reading along. The way he  taught the Word, verse by verse, chapter by chapter, and book by book helped us better understand and keep it in context. At first we were intrigued because they offered Free Weddings! Shortly after we began to attend, our children ages 2 and 4 began to want to go, they enjoyed children's church and getting taught at their level. Great church family and servants for the Lord! Thanks! Great church very welcoming. Solid expository tracking of the Bible. Line upon line precept upon precept. They have a robust youth ministry and seem to have a lot of ministry opportunities. Only been there a month but so far so good.

name: Calvary Chapel Corona
Calvary Chapel Corona - Corona Campus
reviewSummary: I just read another review by someone else- who said the Pastor has spoken about why he supports President Trump 🇺🇲❤️ So. This is why I am now planning on attending this church! Finally,  a Pastor who has the courage and spiritual understanding to inform,  and educate,  his church members! Thank you Jesus! I love this church but really wish we could just hear the gospel and not so much about politics. Feed me what I come for the word of the lord not for the politics or personal opinions. It’s sad how it’s drawn on and long over political beliefs and issues instead of the word. The pastor and his wife are wonderful.  A back stabbing group of women in the Bible study.   No signs of Godly love.  We will not be back Friendly folks but they don’t crowd you. The pastor speaks his mind which is rare in this social climate (3-2026) a feel preachy & music isn’t too loud. I've attended this church for a few weeks. I did find most people to be friendly and welcoming, however I do not believe that sermons should include politics, and the pastor was once preaching about the reasons for his support for Trump. This is the reason I did not give this church a good rating.

name: Calvary Chapel Costa Mesa
Calvary Chapel Costa Mesa - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
My 3 year old daughter and My 6 year old son attending their first Christmas performance at Calvary Chapel. Great school and staff. I love this church! I've been attending for roughly a month now and every Sunday I leave more motivated to love others. I look forward to plugging into a small group and getting to know the members on a more personal level.
If you are looking for a church centered on loving others, and could use some exhortation..this is the place to start. Many Calvary Chapels have been the beacon of truth in this ev1l world, offering truly biblical, verse-by-verse teaching. CC Costa Mesa has been one bright one among the wolves! My son has attended the school since kindergarten… Since he’s a sophomore in high school, I’m going to let him finish it out. My daughter who is in kindergarten, will not be attending the school. They’ve made changes that I don’t particularly like which would affect her and intern me. They continue to close off entrances and exits everywhere, which just makes it harder (and more time waiting at unnecessary red lights, because the other Entrance exit that used to be closed at 6:30… Is open but they closed off the part to drive-through. Why??  Idk kids are dumb now? Four years it’s been fine… Just suddenly now…    heating to wait at a light because there’s no way around. Can you tell I’m dealing with it as I’m writing this review? Because I am. And I’m so annoyed. Almost every day.)  for parents to pick up their kids from their extracurricular activities. So overall, not worth paying thousands of dollars just for the inconvenience at this point. Otherwise, teachers are great! Solid and mature church with uncertain future. This was the HQ of the Calvary churches until the organization sadly split into 2 (Calvary Chapel Association and Calvary Chapel Global Network) over some differences. I couldn't find much details to the reasons. I just visited once because Pastor Brian Brodersen does excellent teaching through Back To Basics podcast. He is a truly gifted teacher like Chuck Swindoll. Following the split, the church is now only half full and seems many have deserted CCGN because only Brian's son, Char, helps out on teaching. I don't know what caused the split but I wish both sides would reconcile and find a common ground. Splitting of churches is giving into Satan's primary agenda. "I think" this location needs a spiritual revival among the congregation and a renewed focus and directions communicated by their leadership. I hope they will survive the messy breakup and get back to basics of being the Salt and Light of the community. I would like to ask all Christians to pray for reconciliation, healing and revival of all churches, including Calvary churches.

name: Calvary Chapel Downey

reviewSummary:
One thing that has really bothered me about this church is the constant filming and photographing during worship. Worship should be a safe and private moment between people and God, not content for social media. Many people do not want to be recorded, and no one signs photo release forms before attending service.

Honestly, this is one of the main reasons I hesitate to walk to the altar when Pastor Art gives the altar call. I don’t want to end up posted on Instagram or social media (Posts, reels, or stories) later that night during one of the most vulnerable moments of my life.

Tonight was especially disturbing. Their Instagram is filled with videos and pictures of people who are clearly going through difficult situations, praying, crying, and broken  and yet the cameras continue rolling. It feels invasive and disrespectful to people who simply came to worship and seek God in peace.

There needs to be more respect for privacy during worship services. Not every moment needs to be turned into online content.

I also believe this could eventually become a legal and ethical concern. Many people attending church are in vulnerable emotional states, seeking prayer, healing, or support during difficult seasons of life. Filming and posting those moments online without clear consent can feel deeply invasive.

Not everyone wants their worship, tears, altar call, or personal struggles displayed on social media. Some people attend church specifically looking for a safe place away from public exposure. At the very least, there should be more transparency, respect for privacy, and an option for people who do not wish to be recorded. People come to church for healing, prayer, and peace  not to become content for social media. Worship should never feel like a production set. Privacy, dignity, and respect for vulnerable moments should come before cameras and online engagement. Who okay’ed this ?

|| I. INTRODUCTORY

1. The Phrase "His Name"

2. Classification.

II. PERSONAL NAMES OF GOD IN THE OLD TESTAMENT

1. 'Elohim

2. 'El

3. 'Eloah

4. 'Adhon, 'Adhonay

5. Yahweh (Yahweh)

6. Tsur (Rock)

7. Ka`dhosh

8. Shadday

III. DESCRIPTIVE NAMES OF GOD IN THE OLD TESTAMENT

1. 'Abhir

2. 'El-'Elohe-Yisra'el

3. `Elyon

4. Gibbor

5. 'El-ro'i

6. Tsaddiq

7. Qanna'

8. Yahweh Tsebha'oth

9. "I Am That I Am"

IV. New Testament NAMES OF GOD

1. God

2. Lord

3. Descriptive and Figurative Names

LITERATURE

I. Introduction:

To an extent beyond the appreciation of modern and western minds the people of Biblical times and lands valued the name of the person. They always gave to it symbolical or character meaning.

While our modern names are almost exclusively designatory, and intended merely for identification, the Biblical names were also descriptive, and often prophetic. Religious significance nearly always inhered in the name, a parent relating his child to the Deity, or declaring its consecration to the Deity, by joining the name of the Deity with the service which the child should render, or perhaps commemorating in a name the favor of God in the gracious gift of the child, e.g. Nathaniel ("gift of God"); Samuel ("heard of God"); Adonijah ("Yahweh is my Lord"), etc. It seems to us strange that at its birth, the life and character of a child should be forecast by its parents in a name; and this unique custom has been regarded by an unsympathetic criticism as evidence of the origin of such names and their attendant narratives long subsequent to the completed life itself; such names, for example, as Abraham, Sarah, etc. But that this was actually done, and that it was regarded as a matter of course, is proved by the name given to Our Lord at His birth: "Thou shalt call his name Jesus; for it is he that shall save his people" (Mt 1:21). It is not unlikely that the giving of a character name represented the parents' purpose and fidelity in the child's training, resulting necessarily in giving to the child's life that very direction, which the name indicated. A child's name, therefore, became both a prayer and a consecration, and its realization in character became often a necessary psychological effect. Great honor or dishonor was attached to a name. The Old Testament writings contain many and varied instances of this. Sometimes contempt for certain reprobate men would be most expressively indicated by a change of name, e.g. the change of Esh-baal, "man of Baal," to Ish-bosheth, "man of shame" (2Sa 2:8), and the omission of Yahweh from the name of the apostate king, Ahaz (2Ki 15:38, etc.). The name of the last king of Judah was most expressively changed by Nebuchadnezzar from Mattaniah to Zedekiah, to assure his fidelity to his overlord who made him king (2Ki 24:17).

My home Church for 28 years, and I still discover and experience wonderful people and community EVERY week!  It's a big church with a small church feel when you get plugged in to their countless small groups and opportunities to fellowship and be involved. A Warm, Bible-Centered Congregation at Calvary Chapel Fort Lauderdale

If you’re seeking a friendly, Bible-focused church in South Florida with practical teaching, welcoming community, and opportunities to grow, Calvary Chapel Fort Lauderdale is a standout. From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with hospitality, clear teaching, and a supportive, family-friendly atmosphere.

What makes it special
Grounded, practical teaching: Messages are verse-by-verse, easy to apply, and relevant to everyday life, offering clear takeaways for faith and daily living.
Warm, inclusive community: The congregation feels welcoming to newcomers and families, with a culture of genuine hospitality and support.
Discipleship-minded programs: Strong classes for adults, couples, and youth, plus study groups and outreach opportunities that encourage growth and service.
Family-friendly environment: A relaxed, inviting setting that’s accessible for all ages, with kids’ ministries and family activities that make church feel like a shared mission.
Prayerful, worshipful atmosphere: The worship experience is heartfelt and uplifting, complemented by a focus on prayer and spiritual growth.

Experience and vibe
Careful, faithful community: Calvary Chapel Fort Lauderdale emphasizes grace, practical faith, and authentic community life—creating a space where you can belong and grow.
Outreach and impact: The church is active in local outreach, missions, and community service, translating faith into action.

Practical tips
Arrive early to connect with others and settle in before worship.
Check schedule for services, midweek studies, and outreach opportunities to find your fit.
Explore small groups or volunteer opportunities to deepen connections and service.
Invite a friend or family member—sharing the experience often leads to meaningful conversations afterward.

Bottom line
Calvary Chapel Fort Lauderdale offers a warm, Bible-centered worship experience with a strong sense of community and active outreach. Ideal for families, newcomers, and anyone seeking authentic connection, solid teaching, and meaningful ways to serve. 2. 'Eloah:

The singular form of the preceding name, 'Eloah, is confined in its use almost exclusively to poetry, or to poetic expression, being characteristic of the Book of Job, occurring oftener in that book than in all other parts of the Old Testament. It is, in fact, found in Job oftener than the elsewhere more ordinary plural 'Elohim. For derivation and meaning see above under 1 (2). Compare also the Aramaic form, 'elah, found frequently in Ezra and Daniel.

3. 'El:

In the group of Semitic languages, the most common word for Deity is El ('el), represented by the Babylonian ilu and the Arabic 'Allah. It is found throughout the Old Testament, but oftener in Job and Psalms than in all the other books. It occurs seldom in the historical books, and not at all in Lev. The same variety of derivations is attributed to it as to ELOHIM (which see), most probable of which is 'ul, "to be strong." BDB interprets 'ul as meaning "to be in front," from which came 'ayil, "ram" the one in front of the flock, and 'elah, the prominent "terebinth," deriving ['El] from 'alah, "to be strong." It occurs in many of the more ancient names; and, like ['Elohim], it is used of pagan gods. It is frequently combined with nouns or adjectives to express the Divine name with reference to particular attributes or phases of His being, as 'El `Elyon, 'El-Ro'i, etc. (see below under III, "Attributive Names").

1. The Phrase "His Name":

Since the Scriptures of the Old Testament and New Testament are essentially for purposes of revelation, and since the Hebrews laid such store by names, we should confidently expect them to make the Divine name a medium of revelation of the first importance. People accustomed by long usage to significant character indications in their own names, necessarily would regard the names of the Deity as expressive of His nature. The very phrase "name of Yahweh," or "His name," as applied to the Deity in Biblical usage, is most interesting and suggestive, sometimes expressing comprehensively His revelation in Nature (Ps 8:1; compare 138:2); or marking the place of His worship, where men will call upon His name (De 12:5); or used as a synonym of His various attributes, e.g. faithfulness (Isa 48:9), grace (Ps 23:3), His honor (Ps 79:9), etc. "Accordingly, since the name of God denotes this God Himself as He is revealed, and as He desires to be known by His creatures, when it is said that God will make a name for Himself by His mighty deeds, or that the new world of the future shall be unto Him for a name, we can easily understand that the name of God is often synonymous with the glory of God, and that the expressions for both are combined in the utmost variety of ways, or used alternately" (Schultz, Old Testament Theology, English translation, I, 124-25; compare Ps 72:19; Isa 63:14 (refs2); also Davidson, Old Testament Theol., 37-38). This is a great place to come and study the bible. It is a small, intimate church where you can make friends, participate in outreaches and grow spiritually. Every week I am learning and praising I think this place is closed. Magnificent

name: Calvary Chapel Inglewood
Calvary Chapel Inglewood - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
I love this church. They go through the Bible a little at a time. Most of the praise songs they sing I am familiar with. They have a children's ministry. They are very down to Earth. Dress is casual.
Even though Bible study is separate from service (on Saturdays), the men are separate from the women, and the men and women alternate Saturdays (Women 2nd and 4th 9:30am, Men's 1st and 3rd 9 am) my partner and I both find the Bible study to be extra uplifting and inviting. It's somewhere you can quickly develop a support group to guide you in your spiritual journey.

I LOVE this church! I heard Pastor Bill on the radio (107.9 Kwave) and had to come check it out. Me and my family came one Sunday service and have never left (2 years later). This church is true to the word of God in a clear, precise and unadulterated way. The love and fellowship is authentic and life changing and God's hand is with this fellowship. If you want to change your life you will be equipped to do so with this congregation. Praise God for raising up a fellowship that stays true to His word. I give 5 stars based on the truth that is taught and the intent And words of the speaker, preacher, deacons, all those who speak in the church under the supervision of the most respected pastor  . They speak truth, not hype and care for the people they are speaking to. I have watched them for two years and they’re always consistent In being helpful , humble and truthful. They only want to help a person understand that the Lord does love them and is willing to help anyone going through a situation even if The situation is not students fault or undeserved. And if it is deserved, they Tell other their own stories and how God has helped them out other situation Then give advice what the person in a trial can do, which is always biblical . It’s not a hyped up  show off church. It’s only like in the beginning people coming together to learn of the Lord. And you feel the spirit of God’s Comfort, any service teaching or preaching or giving a class.
And they don’t blast us  over and over to give money Or else We’re all doomed
they trust the Lord will take care of the needs of the church It will provide direction like the children of Israel when they left to go to the promised land.
I’ve been in Churches over 50 years and Not related to anyone here . The way churches are these days many will drain you, but this one does not . It’s fun and enjoyable if you’re seeking to understand how to be in harmony with Jesus in your life One who cares for  truth, And to apply it in their lives Pastor Bill is an amazing pastor. He is strictly Bible (as it should be), and he adds humor and his life experiences to his sermons. He is transparent, making it easy for the congregation to relate to him. He has one offering time, and there is no forcing you with a sad story or a guilt trip speech if you can't/don't give.
I recommend attending CCI. Great pastor with a great understanding of the word. His delivery is easy to understand and keeps me engaged. God is definitely working through this church.

name: Calvary Chapel La Mesa
Calvary Chapel La Mesa - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary:
Very kind people. And their compassion is real. Lived over here next to them for over a year. Stepped in for a minute. Even though it was just some people will the few guitars very welcoming and so heartful spirit and welcoming. I will be going back and bring my guitar n maybe make some new friends n family near my home now in la mesa This is a small church with a comfortable atmosphere. There’s a time for contemporary worship, announcements and getting into the Word of God  with Pastor Dave Riley. Sunday school classes are offered for infants through high school. Donuts are provided on Sunday mornings and dinner is provided on Wednesday and Saturday evenings. Easy to get to. Plenty of parking. Casual/comfortable dress. Such a wonderful example for what "church" should be like!
Church is NOT a building but a family of believers everywhere❤️ That's what's evident here.
I've been part of THIS specific family since a few months now and I will never forget how I was welcomed with open arms❤️🙌 My cuzzin is going through it. I prayed to the Lord that my cuzzin would receive word.

The service Givin on the day we attended was all about what he is going through. He even asked me if I had the church prepare the massage.

God is good. Calvary Chapel is a wonderful place, my home church, where Pastor Dave shares and teaches GOD'S WORD. Full of exceptional people who make everyone who come through the doors feel welcomed and loved 💕 Please come and see for yourself how awesome the Lord is. MAY GOD BLESS YOU ALWAYS 🙏

name: Calvary Chapel Living Hope
Calvary Chapel Living Hope - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary: This is a place where you will be taught the Word of God from Genesis to Revelation.  But it’s more than great teaching, Pastor Brad loves the people.  I have known Pastor Brad since October 2005 and He has mentored me off and on for nearly 20 years.  The things he has spoken to me have made me a better man today.  Even when I walked away from the Lord and lost everything he corrected me and loved me enough to drive me closer to the Lord.  There’s not a lot of churches or men that would do that.  He truly is a servant of God and leads Calvary Chapel Living Hope with this grace.  Although we live in different states I still go back to glean wisdom and mentorship from Pastor Brad.  Thank you Lord God for Calvary Chapel Living Hope and Pastor Brad for they have been a lighthouse in my darkest hour.  🙏🏽🫶🏽 much love to you all Real people that are very accepting of all. It doesn’t matter what you have been through, or done in your life, you will always be accepted and loved at this church. A humble and loving congregation that just wants to grow stronger in Jesus. I absolutely love this church! The people at this church are very friendly and love Jesus. Pastor Brad is a great teacher who goes through the Bible verse by verse, boldly proclaiming the truths found in Scripture and reminding us of God’s abundant grace. If you’re looking for fellowship with a group of genuine, loving, unpretentious believers, you’ll love Living Hope. 💜 It has been a little while since  I attended Living Hope, the fellowship and the guidance of the Pastors, along with the support of the individual ministries created a solid foundation for me as I continue my walk with Christ. I really learned and grew so much at Living Hope, I'm grateful that The Lord led me there, and I was able to learn so much from the teachings of those Papa blessed my life with, my Pastors Paul & Brad, & all of my  brothers and sisters at Living Hope. Blessed🍃🙌🏼🌎 Calvary Chapel Living Hope is a wonderful place to hear the Word of God and grow in Christ. Located in downtown Oceanside, our church is friendly and welcoming. If you need to be transformed and encouraged you will find it in the Word, so come for a visit and then join our church family. It has been my church for nearly 25 years.

Calvary Chapel Living Water - Corona Campus
reviewSummary:
Great teaching and welcoming pastor and congregation.  A very family friendly church. We shopped 5 other churches and we’ve land here!  This church is not Bible light or Bible 101.  Solid biblical depth with no compromise! Over 20 years, in this blessed place.
Pastor is the BEST Bible teacher, I know !!! (And I listen to all the teacher's on K-Wave !) Congregate's  have outstretched hand's, to help anyone in need. English AND Spanish side.  :D
We now live in Idaho,  so I catch up, with the video's, Pastor Jerry (pj) puts together.  Love, to you all/ I miss you !_! It's a great church it's small the congregation very friendly and you'll learn the word of the Lord there and you'll meet all your needs at this place. Family feel church.  All are welcome Great place to worship and be fed the word of our Lord and savior Jesus Christ.

name: Calvary Chapel Living Water Garden Grove
Calvary Chapel Living Water Garden Grove - Garden Grove Campus
reviewSummary:
Teaching the word simply is why i love this church, been coming here for 6 years. Solid teaching, leads to solid growth and a genuine growth in Jesus I’ve been looking for a small church and seems like we found it. Everyone was very welcoming. But what got me the most was that my daughters attention was focused on the service. Pastor had a great teaching for our first time there. I look forward to congregating there God willing. Thank you Pastor for welcoming my family and I. We all know, If you find the perfect church and you start going there it's no longer perfect 😊
However; if you're desiring an ATV place ( Authentic, Transparent, Vulnerable), CCLW Garden Grove, is folks making a sincere endeavor to interact in that manner with God and one another!
A church that's not too big, with strong, anti-religion, emphasis on the TRUTH of God's Word, the Bible.
Exciting News!
We're now permanently established as leasees at the Excellent church plant of OC Grace, where Stanford meets 9th! Great Blessing!
PS... I just looked through these reviews. It should be noted that the comment "the pastor's wife is a babe" wasn't some 'off' person. It was the pastor Went to a Bible study,  good then attended Sunday service.   Haven't gone back due to passing of my father in law.  Family matters,  but will be back on Sunday , God willing.Amen !! I was told about this place by neighbor that on Fridays they provide those in need with food.  My funds were a little short that month and I was in need of produce and the beautiful thing is I was given a generous supply.  I have never gone to receive free food and I don't foresee it in the future but that month I was in need and they were generous and very sweet,  putting it in my car and wishing me a good day.

name: Calvary Chapel Living Word
Calvary Chapel Living Word - Laguna Niguel Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor Pat is an excellent teacher. The people are super friendly. There are two things everyone should look for in a church.
1. What are they teaching you?
A:  This church teaches you from the bible and doesn't dilute the messaging for todays tender ego's.  That is a big plus
2. How do they treat you?
A: They treat everyone as if you have been a member for years and you had just stepped away for a short time.
From your first visit you will feel how different this church is from the others. I am a member of CCLW and I proud of it. They are really lovely persons and Pastor Terry and his family are really honest and supportive person. They truly love God and you always welcome over there. They teach Bible and it is really good because you know you only listen to words of god. They have service Sunday and Wednesday. A member of Brian Brodersen's "Global Network" which has discarded the Calvary Chapel Distinctives, a template given to Pastor Chuck by the Lord. At the annual CC Pastors conferences, Chuck Smith continually held CC pastors accountable for their teaching. He always quoted Acts 20: 28-30, concerning that after his demise, CC pastors would compromise with the world, abandoning biblical doctrine for the sake of "unity", teaching from the Bible, rather than through it, allowing heretical teaching and affiliations (St. James NB Anglican church), notwithstanding, the dangerous heresies of the Ecumenical and Emergent movement which is part of the Great Apostasy (2 Thes. 2: 3; 1 Tim. 4: 1) the Bible warns about in the Last Days before the rapture. Unfortunately, and sadly this has happened within the Calvary Chapel movement, noting the division: CCGN (Calvary Chapel Global Network) churches, verses CCA (Calvary Chapel Association) churches which still ascribe to the CC Distinctives. Watch on YouTube: "Pastor Chris Quintana explains Changes within Calvary Chapel". Attended from 2005-2007. Love, love, love the people of Calvary Living Word with Pastor Terry. Simply a treasure in Irvine.

name: Calvary Chapel Mission Viejo
Calvary Chapel Mission Viejo - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
I love ccmv.  The people are all great and have become closer to me than my family.  If you are looking for a new church to call home I would highly recommend coming to a service and meeting the people who congregate here. A great Bible-based church that believes the Bible is the word of God.  I love listening to Pastor Nick's energetic preaching through the Bible. And the people are so friendly too. My wife and I have been members there for about 8 years. I've only attended a few times but my children and grandchildren attend regularly.  It seems to be a solid evangelical church with strong biblical teaching. And there appears to be a good sense of community.  The music is of the typical praise band genre, not particularly to my liking but I'm old! Have you heard that children’s song “The Old Gray Mare, She Ain’t What She Used to Be” ? Sadly this is the case for this once beloved church. What a mess!  Please pray for this church and the people who attend. This church needs a miracle of reconciliation and peace and an infusion of true love and compassion for all people! I love my church.  I've been attending Sunday service here for a little over a year.  The congregation is friendly and the people on staff are amazing.

If you're looking for a church that's not too big, this is my recommendation.  You aren't just a part of the crowd unless you want to be. It's not too big or too small.  It's just right.

name: Calvary Chapel Monrovia
Calvary Chapel Monrovia - Arcadia Campus
reviewSummary:
Hello,
Calvary Chapel Monrovia church is powered by the Holy Spirit of God, and prayer! Here's what you can expect to receive weekly:
1) Christ-centered Bible messages that are clear, concise, and relevant.
2) AMAZING worship and praise music that sweetly ushers you into throne room of Jesus Christ.
3) Lastly, a friendly and hospitable congregation.
I'm so grateful that God led me to CCM Church. 😊 I take my kids to their Fall festival every year on Halloween. It's free! The games are fun! They have live music! There is food available for purchase, so we always have dinner there: hot dogs, hamburgers, hot links... They also offer face painting and a photo area! Good family-friendly fun! Parking on street fills up quickly, but there is a shuttle that will take you from the metro ride-share lot to the church!! Super convenient! Great bible based church! No phony Bologna going on here from what I could tell. No female pastors either. I would recommend this church to anyone!
God Bless Bible taught very well! Always in the Word and most importantly the Gospel is shared ! Wish i lived closer😥!
Love the worship! What a sweet congregation. I was welcomed at the door by Manny, Patty May, and Pastor Angel. The worship was heartfelt. Pastor Richard had such a humble yet powerfully insightful way of teaching. Thank you Richard and Toni for praying for me.  I definitely appreciated my visit before heading back home to Texas.

name: Calvary Chapel Moreno Valley
Calvary Chapel Moreno Valley - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary:
A special thank you to Pastor Joel, Pastor John, and the entire team at Calvary Moreno Valley for helping us to honor our mom, Roberta Murdaugh, as she graduated to heaven. What a blessing you are to our family. God bless each of you as you faithfully serve your community! We started coming to Calvary Chapel in 2003 and unfortunately we fell out and went down the wrong path. We chose to get back into church and follow Christ to save our marriage. We tried different churches and ultimately came back to CCMOVAL. Pastor Joel and the congregation of loving, welcoming people made us fall back in love with our new journey and our church. DO NOT enroll your kids at the school for these reasons-
THEY ARE BEHIND PUBLIC SCHOOLING! We switched mid year and my child is behind due to them not being taught certain things yet.

Teachers do not need a teaching degree to teach, for a school that should be valuing education, that seems a little backwards.

They will use incorrect verbiage IN writing and then the pastor will try to change the narrative even though he’s NEVER participated in the meetings for my child.

They protect themselves, not your students. You will not be valued. If you are looking for a book by book, chapter by chapter, verse by verse place of worship then come on by we welcome you with open arms, all glory to our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ! Our church is one of the best in our community. If your in Need of any food They have a food pantry for those in need and Everyone is welcome

name: Calvary Chapel Murrieta
Calvary Chapel Murrieta - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary: Our family loves this church! We recently moved to Murrieta & we’re so blessed to have this church so close to our home. The worshipIs amazing! Everyone is so friendly & welcoming. Our kids love it here! Amazing worship music team. Reads from the Bible. Involved in international missions. Pastors are really nice and are very accessible. They are so humble they never ask anyone for tithes, they leave that completely up to each individual. This church also has a lot of programs for many different topics as well as free individual counseling services. I highly recommend this church not only for their passion for Christ but how they are involved with the community and individuals. Rise high is amazing!! Theres so much community and everyone is super nice and welcoming :3 This is a quiet, small to mid sized church with contemporary music.  It feels intimate and friendly.  There are also many events, programs and opportunities to get involved.  Highly recommend! Pastor Brian is spot on. He teaches the Word with no gray areas, is Biblicly sound, articulate, and fun to listen too.

name: Calvary Chapel New Beginnings City Terrace
Calvary Chapel New Beginnings City Terrace - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: The Lord led me and my family here to come serve along side Pastor Angel & Liz after another door closed. What an amazing heart these two have for not just the community here in City Terrace but people in general. They constantly make people feel loved & appreciated and aren’t afraid to speak it out and give hugs! If you’re looking to get plugged into a bible teaching church please come on down to Calvary Chapel City Terrace. All are welcome here! Jesus loves you! I often hear people say, to go to a church where the Lord calls you.  Calvary Chapel City Terrace is where He called us.  We go through some of the best bible studies you'll ever hear in your lifetime! The love and fellowship here is has been a tremendous blessing on our family.  Pastor Angel lays it down in simple terms so anyone can understand.  If you're looking for solid doctrine, it's here at City Terrace. SOOOOOOO amazing 👏 😍 🙌 💖 a blessing and an honor to get to go to City Terrace Calvery Chapel. What an awesome church! Come!

name: Calvary Chapel North Long Beach
Calvary Chapel North Long Beach - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
I write this as a 36 year old woman who has recently returned to Christianity (and to Long Beach, CA). I was looking for a church to call “home.” I googled a bunch and even attended another couple of services and Bible studies at other churches for a few weeks before finding the Cavalry Chapel of North Long Beach. Something about the building or the precise location didn’t speak to me at first when looking online or even as I had driven by it—but that was just my flawed judgement and preconception—I felt called to it nonetheless.

I first tuned into their Sunday recordings on YouTube and what immediately caught my attention is the way that Pastor Brandon dives deeply into the Bible every week. The Bible is read continuously, verse-by-verse, and explained which is great for exploring the depth of its meaning. The messages are powerful, firmly rooted in the teachings of Christ, and delivered with grace and clarity.

The one time I went to service in person I truly enjoyed the experience and felt that the congregants are kind, loving, and good-natured folks, but most importantly—I could feel the presence of God. Even if I can’t fully commit to worship in person, I find deep comfort knowing that I can reliably tune in on Sundays.

I truly think this church deserves more exposure and praise. I pray that this church flourishes and that more people find them because they are truly a hidden gem in our community. If you’re thinking about checking it out—don’t—just come as you are to service on Sunday and see for yourself. God bless this church and its congregants. 🙏♥️ ✝️ Wonderful Chapel. And Second Chance and the Calvary Chapel North Long Beach are a great combination for those who needs to make a positive change in their life. Pastor John and Pastor Brandon are a blessing I love the way they teach the bible studies, they're interesting and I learn a lot. never really visited this place but I give it a five stars because it's a peaceful area environment so I respect that Great people , pastors awesome, worship service was realy nice.

name: Calvary Chapel North Towne
Calvary Chapel North Towne - Pomona / Claremont Campus
reviewSummary: I have visited this church several times and the preaching is straight from God's word. The worship is beautiful and the prayer meeting on Sunday before service was heart felt.I have a home church but for anyone who doesn't I highly encourage you to attend a service. It is what it is . People paying respects , sobbing , families, friends comforting each other’s to grieve and let the departed Rest In Peace, it is a clean and artistically surrounded by flowers , birds, 2 iconic churches surround this Chapel. Meet a special person and the people there were very accepting and very nice. I would 100% love to come back! The NTCC Worship  Band is awesome. Great church to learn The Word Of GOD. Great place to worship come as you are

name: Calvary Chapel Oceanside
Calvary Chapel Oceanside - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
I love the worship night experience on 8/2/2026 and hope they do it again it was more of an experience of hearing Gods voice with quiet music and I wish more churches so this. It was such a fulfilling experience the way it was gently guided. I also wish they will do a typical worship night with band once a month. It’s a great congregation. The pastors here teach from the Holy Bible from Genesis all the way down to Revelation . There are so many great groups for everyone men’s group women’s groups, recovery groups, and addiction groups to help us all. I can’t say this enough there’s a great accountability system here. The men’s group is so awesome. I recommend the man to check it out. Mondays 7 PM show up hungry physically and spiritually. I say physically because we share a meal together at 7 PM before we start the study. We also have an awesome homeless ministry we offer showers for the homeless with our mobile shower trailer and meals and figure out their situation. There are  many ways to get involved if you’re looking to get plugged in and help CCO. Feel free to download the Calvary Chapel Oceanside app . Hope to see you here soon! I used to go to Calvary chapel vista for 20 years and I moved to Oceanside and moved churches when the Oceanside location opened up:

I Had a terrible experience with Pastor Dan Kettle to say the least. We ended up moving churches to North Coast Church . Pastor Chris Brown was extremely inviting and so happy god led me to North Coast and Chris Brown. I've been going to church here for the last 7 or 8 years. I love the body and have been blessed to work and serve here. I like how there is something for everybody but at the same time, the church isn't so big that you feel lost. They always strive to make you feel welcome and a part of the family. Keep making disciples, Jesus will build the church. Incredible service today at the parking roof top the San Clemente Outlets. Pastor John is outgoing and makes you feel involved and delivers the message in an easy to understand way. We, my wife and I were blessed to be invited my my sister Jennifer to attend today as well as get baptized at the beach. EVERYONE was very welcoming, friendly, kind and very supportive. This was one of the best days in our lives. Jesus is the way, the light and path to happiness, the Lord and his kingdom and we have now started our new chapter. Thank you to everyone who was there and Paster John. We will come back down to attend another service sometime again. God Bless and love ❤️ to pastor John, his congregation and all God's children that walk this earth 🌎

Calvary Chapel of Alpine - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary: We are looking for a new home church. We felt very welcome at this church and very thankful to hear verse by verse teaching again. We loved hearing sound doctrine. We are letting the Holy Spirit lead but we think this may be our new home church. Very kind warm people, felt well accepted

name: Calvary Chapel of Fullerton
Calvary Chapel of Fullerton - Fullerton (Sunny Hills) Campus
reviewSummary:
My Graduation from Trinity  Law school in Santa Ana, CA 🎓 was held here.. I finally met some of my classmates in person.. Congratulations! To us all. Real caring family group of people. Ladies ministry is strong. Kids ministry is very loving. Pastors are awesome real people. I like the Bible based teachings that are well thought out and very thorough in facts and researched. Kind people here. Just stopped in spontaneously. Was very much delighted in the warm welcome, excellent worship, and pastor Caleb's bringing out a great message on temptation. Praise God for excellent places of fellowship Wonderful people blessed by the living Lord Jesus Christ.
I and my family were blessed today with the message from the word Joshua 5  chapter

Christ is with me
Christ is before me
Christ is behind me
Christ is in me If you are seeking a solid bible teaching Church, you have arrived in the right place.  The pastor at this location is an excellent scholar and presents information in an easy to comprehend format. Your children will be well taken care of in the youth programs, will learn about Jesus and may occassionally be held accountable if they are off track (all with love of course).  This Church is large enough to provide a good support system but small enough that you will be welcomed.  We couldn't ask for a better place to nurture out walk with God.

name: Calvary Chapel of Fullerton Office
Calvary Chapel of Fullerton Office - Fullerton Campus
Calvary Chapel of Long Beach
Calvary Chapel of Long Beach - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Visited from out of town. Appreciated the warm welcome from many in the congregation. Pastor Cochran preached in a very approachable way and spoke truth from God’s word. Thank you for a great service. They go thru the Bible line by line and verse by verse. When you come, you are welcomed and you see that the setting is very simple, no laser shows here. Pastor Andrew teaches the Word in a manner that is easy to understand, often humourous and definitely full of love for Jesus. If you have a problem understanding a precept, he is available to talk to you one on one and point you to where in the Bible it states that precept. Great place!! Pastor Andrew and all the brothers and sisters in this church are warm inviting genuine and compassionate. The teaching of the Bible is informative, deep and leads everyone to the cross of Jesus Christ. This is an awesome church! My First time here was around the Christmas Holidays. The Pastor said for everyone that was new and there first time we have a Red Poinsettia for you. So after the service I went up on the stage to get one. It was the last one. Some lady was rude telling me U was going to get that one. I let her know it was my first time there. She did not get care and she even said she had been going there for awhile. If you were not married you could not do anything like be on the prayer team, be a usher, greeter. I was told by 2 people this is a married couples church and once a family invited me over to there home for Christmas. Couple of months later I was approached by a member asking me about it and I said yes I did go to there home. He flat out told me this is a married couples church and you need to hang out with single people. I finally left and attended a Calvary Church in Huntington Beach where I served as a usher and attended a home bible stay class and was the only single person and I was welcome. Unless things have changed there I was not recommend this church if you are single. I have learned so much here!
Sunday mornings through the New Testament one verse at a time. And Wednesday evening, through the Old Testament, one verse at a time. Before Pastor Roger went home to the Lord, and now Pastor Andrew, taking care of the sheep.

name: Calvary Chapel of Orange
Calvary Chapel of Orange - Orange Campus
reviewSummary: Minute attendance but very spirit filled. Love going whenever I visit my daughter in orange. Where's the Christians in Orange? Too busy counting their paper gains? Thank you Tracy, for the guitar 🙂🙃🙂 They don't have service on Wednesday like the sign says on the door 🚪

name: Calvary Chapel of Santee
Calvary Chapel of Santee - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary:
When I arrived my thought was that it's a Calvary Chapel Church should be great. The message of our Lord is spoken here and this should be enough. Unfortunately, when I found out that they have included politics in the church information, that was enough for me to walk away. Jesus said, give unto to Caesar what is his as a sign that he would not get involved in the political activities of His time. He told us to obey authority figures but there was nothing about pushing the people's political opinions. No, His Word is about how well we treat others. His laws are centered around how to behave towards all people. Most of all He wanted us to remember to Love God above all other things and second to that was to love our neighbors. Politics is far from this idea and the church should consider focusing on Love and Faith in the one true God. Just sad... Excellent Bible Teaching from Pastor James Class! My wife and I enjoyed the worship together  and hearing a solid Bible message on the Book of Daniel Ch. 11. My wife and I want to make this our home church to grow and be filled with the Holy Spirit and the Word of God. The staff is kind, attentive, and personable. We want to highlight Pam and Phil, amazing and loving ushers/ greeters. We love the atmosphere here and it’s not too far from our home in Santee. So blessed! Thank You, God.
🕊🙏🏽🕊🤍🤍🤍✅ On my first visit to Calvary Chapel of Santee, I filled out the connection card with all my information. I told them I was a first time guest and I had enjoyed the music and sermon very much. No reply at all from anyone at the church. Second time I went  I filled out the card again, asking for prayer and if they had any groups for 50+ adults. No reply from anyone at the church.
Third Sunday I went, I once again filled out the connection card.  I said I was disappointed that no one had reached out to me as a new comer and welcoming me to their church. I said, “do you not reach out to newcomers”?  Two days later I FINALLY get a voicemail from someone at the church saying they were reaching out because I asked them too! Really?? I have never once been to a church who did not reach out to me as a newcomer. Isn’t filling out the connection card mean you want someone to “connect” with you? I really love the music and the preaching but really don’t know if I want to attend a church where I don’t feel very welcome.  If you want to be anonymous, this is the church for you. I enjoy the message the pastor relays. I enjoy the music. Beautiful facility and the staff is very kind and respectful.

name: Calvary Chapel of the Harbour
Calvary Chapel of the Harbour - Huntington Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
With over 79,000,000+ views on my Google reviews as a Level 9 expert Google Reviewer, I always aim to give clear and honest feedback.

Calvary Chapel by the Sea is such a beautiful church property. The grounds are very well manicured and everything feels peaceful and welcoming the moment you arrive.
While visiting, everyone we encountered was friendly and kind which made the experience even more enjoyable. The atmosphere felt warm, uplifting and inviting which is always wonderful to see in a church community.
A lovely place to stop, reflect and enjoy a peaceful setting near the water. I'm late in writing this review until someone asked me how was church because they were genuinely curious about the mixed reviews. The truth is my experience was unsettling. The church felt a little cultish, strategic, and operated. On the surface they do what church do,  gather together,  pray, sing, woship read verses from the bible and call that a bible based church. But below the surface deeper something felt wrong about pastor Joe and even some of the other pastors and members there. I felt that pastor Joe spirit and heart didn't line up with what he teaches.
And it felt and looked performative. I mean it just didn't feel or looked genuine. It's like you see a false teacher,  you see a wolf, but everyone keeps saying that's a true teacher and that's a sheep,
And I went home and prayed and prayed. Then I audibly hear loud and clear, IT'S A WOLF!
I think many members are genuinely deceived, unaware of other members experience, but I also think some members or people are purposely part of the church gaslighting, manipulation, deception. Because Christians are supposed to have discernment but yet they don't appear to have discernment. It's like how can someone truly not have even the slightest feeling or senses that pastor Joe Pedick might be a wolf, seems like a wolf? But people have to make their own decision and use their own judgment.  But my confident discernment is It's A Wolf. This is an amazing church to attend. You can feel God's presence through the pastors preaching on Sundays. They also have numerous activities and service almost every day of the week. If you are a millennial I recommend Friday nights. If you are a zellenial I recommend Thursday nights. The best thing about this church was the congregation. I made a lot of friends here and felt at home, but I was having an episode related to my mental illness and the church kicked me out and wouldn’t let me come back when I got stable. They didn’t offer me any services or any assistance to help me in my darkest time. I volunteered at this church and was very involved. I worked on myself and tried to go back and they still wouldn’t let me go back. Pastor Chad and Catherine, Pastor Joe’s wife, were very rude to me as well. I don’t recommend this church to anybody. I recommend 5f church in Los Angeles. I’ve church hopped most of my life and finally found a place to be planted at that is very heavily anointed. You will feel the power of God here, get Healed and Delivered from any oppression of the enemy. Miracles happen every time Apostle Kathryn Krick speaks. If you can’t make it in person, watch her online. Miracles will even happen through the screen. 1000’s of testimonies are proof. I’m one of them. My mental illnesses are healed. Check out 5f church! Great church  nice location in Huntington Harbor. They put on a great free.professional  play of the Christmas Carol every year! A must see for the holidays!
