name: Calvary Chapel Open Door
Calvary Chapel Open Door - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a great church with amazing people who are always willing to help you whenever they are able.  From Pastor Marks teaching to all the other pastors and bible studies going on, there is something there for everyone. New people are welcomed with open arms at the church.  Nadine has helped my family out many times with whatever we need. Being a big family it is not always easy but she has made it so much easier on our family.  I would recommend this church to anyone. My kids have been going here now for over a year now and at first I didn't know what to think because we where coming from a pre school that was really good . So it seemed at first that I was trying to find something wrong all the time because I was still use to the last school. But with time my kids became family. We are good friends with the teachers, they know our kids good . My daughter knows bible  verses now . My kids are always being thought the word of God with there school work . You don't need fancy places  or fancy buildings to look like it's a good school . All we need is for teachers to love your children and teach them and protect them at school , so place does that for our kids . Thank you to Ms Christina , Ms Elda , Ms Fran , Ms Rose , Ms Sheila and to all the other teachers . Great job ladies ! Words can't describe the gratitude that I have for Calvary Chapel Anaheim. It is a wonderful church and family. Pastor Mark and all the Pastors at Calvary Chapel Anaheim are awesome men of God. They preach the word of God. Also Nadine is a wonderful woman who has helped my family in so many ways. For over 4 years, I attended the two main large Christian churches in orange county at separate times,...... including their bible studies during the week day. I did get some spiritual awakening, but I never felt spiritually fed in the way that I wanted. It seemed like each six months, the same information started over. There was no "meat" to review and ponder to make me want to be better, and say, "ahhh yes", that sermon fits me to a tee, I want to be better. I was really looking for a much stronger relationship with the Lord's word, and I wasn't getting it.
At the time, an acquaintance said "I'm going to a men's prayer breakfast, would you like to attend?". Sure I said. I liked the sermon at breakfast, because it was chapter and verse right from the bible. So I attended again on Sunday morning.
I liked the size and shape of the church hall. And the information in the sermon,..... well, there was so much information that I was overwhelmed to be honest. WOW, this was cool! Paster Mark's message was not only feeding me information chapter and verse, but referencing say ten or more other books and chapters in the bible to make the point(s) of his sermon. I went away that day thinking and thinking and thinking about his sermon and how I live my life. I knew this is what I was looking for. This pastor made me want to be a better person! I was home.
Pastor Mark is incredible, and his messages are incredible. I'm a thinker by nature, and like the challenge he brings to my life through his delivering of the Lord's word, chapter and verse.
My life has improved: confidence, satisfaction, happiness, income, sense of well being has been just some of the benefits that has come my way. I'm not going to dissect this part,...I know what it is, and I'm going to keep on doing it, cause' it's right for me, and I know that Calvary Anaheim is a big part of the changes in my life.
I'm a regular guy, a carpenter by trade and over 50. If your starving like I was, come give it a try. Know one will attack you,(if you know what I mean). CCOD has been such a blessing to me and my family. This church is filled with loving people who genuinely care for one another. They love God's Word and the worship is amazing!

name: Calvary Chapel Palos Verdes
Calvary Chapel Palos Verdes - Palos Verdes Estates Campus
reviewSummary:
Great church and Pastor Daniel always preaches the truth. The people are kind and welcoming and it is a wonderful community. I’m so happy to have landed at this incredible church! Everyone is warm and welcoming. The way the biblical teachings are broken down to give context, clear explanation and definition is something I find so helpful. They offer awesome kids ministry as well. We recently became part of this church, and I just had to share our experience. My family is open to different approaches to connecting with God, and we’ve visited quite a few religious places over the years. After reading some great reviews, I finally decided to stop by — WOW! For the first time, Pastor Daniel kept me glued to my seat the entire hour!!!
I’ve never seen a place so full, with a crowd so in sync it felt like our hearts were beating together.

Then I found out there are three services — 8:30, 10:00, and 11:30 — and I couldn’t help but wonder: will the same spirit carry through to the next one? Yes! Absolutely 💯

It was so engaging and powerful, I HAD TO COME BACK the following week just to hear what was next — Apostle Paul was on the move, boldly preaching despite being imprisoned multiple times.
Now my kids and I are looking forward to the next Sunday service.

name: Calvary Chapel Pasadena
Calvary Chapel Pasadena - Arcadia Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband and I started attending CCP at the beginning of this year and we know the Lord has led us here. We had been praying for a church with sound doctrine that teaches the actual word of God. The people here are very welcoming. The women's Bible study and marriage ministry have both been a blessing for us. It's really tough to come across a great church that teaches the word of God the way it should. We feel so blessed to have found this beautiful place. Thank you Jesus! 💕 if you're looking for a church that teaches straight from the Bible
, with a great community of believers and the gospel is not watered down then this one is it. I've been to other Calvary Chapels, namely the Chino Hills and Fullerton ones, and I have to say this one is by-far the worst.

They had a frankly absurd number of security staff, as though it were a TSA checkpoint or something. They all were wired up and mic'd up, all over the place, watching the congregation and patrolling the outside the whole time. It gave extremely dystopian, non-friendly vibes. Also, kind of LARP-y. There weren't that many people attending, and it is a pretty small building, so I think the amount of security was seriously overkill.

On top of all of this, the pastor (I didn't get his name, I don't think they mentioned it?) Gave a frankly horrible sermon. He is not the best speaker, and very clearly injected his own political bias' into every aspect of it. He repeated multiple times that he only abides by the bible, before quoting the bible, and building his own interpretation. It was also fraught with a level of smug that made me feel like they were more so trying to indoctrinate rather than build faith or new followers. He spoke badly about other churches, called them idiots, and said that essentially everyone he disagrees with is stupid, but he has the word of God on his side. But did not make a strong case for me to believe him.

If you're looking to convert a friend, or even just looking for a church that truly quotes from the bible, and doesn't build tenuous interpretations that are filled with political bias, DO NOT come here. I am shocked the Calvary Chapel would support this type of sermon. This is a Bible teaching church.  Pastor Reyes is super knowledgeable!. People are super friendly.  We were greeted and shown around by some people the 1st day. They have an amazing book store and a place to have coffee upstairs. Most people bring their Bible's and take notes.  If you're looking for a new church,  definitely check them out. I would like to Thank you ! For your prayers for my family! Psalm 23,91, I praise God for every church that has people open their Bibles and dive into the Word of God. Psalm 100 ! The book of Matthew and James was opened! Still my two favorites! I praise God for the couple next door to me! Their light was shining so bright! That Spoke to me ! what makes them. So different ? JESUS I can't say enough good things about my church! They have helped me in so many ways! I have a relationship with God today, that I never thought possible!

.

name: Calvary Chapel San Marcos

reviewSummary: Amazing church. Feels like family and Pastor Dave has so much knowledge of the Word to take in. Welcoming non-judgmental non-dinominational verse by verse Bible teaching church I just have to share more of my experiences with this church. After being saved years ago on the radio I was looking for a bible teaching church. I was lead to this church when they rented the boys and girls club. the Pastor David James and his wife Lori James would be there at the boys and girls club Sunday's at 7 a.m. setting up the church I knew I wanted the same love for Jesus that they had. I have witnessed things that only Jesus can do in this church, so many lives saved and touched in this church, I can remember back when Jesus gave us a permanent building even though we had no money to even make it in to the building Jesus took care off it, and all the materials cost for the renovation Jesus took care of it, I'm a contractor and worked with my brothers and sisters to perform the renovations and what a blessing it was working with them sure it was had work almost every weekend for 2 years but to watch the blessing our good lord gave us I would do it all over again and even today years later our lord Jesus keeps on blessing this church. No matter what church you choose, be led by the spirit and get involved in a bible teaching church the lord will lead you remember fear is a liar so don't wait please find the church he has for you and remember to get involve let Jesus use you if you want see what the body of Christ is all about don't sit on the side lines. I'm still a work in progress but I can't wait to see what our good lord has next for me. And remember if God is for us than who can be against us. Love the small church setting, everyone welcomes you like family. This church has helped my family through a tough year. Pastor Dave has a great message to share every Sunday! Bible based teaching by Dave James. Great worship, nice people ,very welcoming. Great Bible based preaching, wonderful worship service, welcoming people.

name: Calvary Chapel Santa Clarita
Calvary Chapel Santa Clarita - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary:
CCSC has been my home church for 12 years now. I love this church. It’s not just fellowship, it’s family. They teach the Bible verse by verse, book by book which is very important to me. Our pastor brings the application of scripture into daily life.
The people are so warm and welcoming.
The Children’s Ministry is amazing. My granddaughter loves it and is excited to come on Sundays. They teach and show her the love of Christ in ways that make it understandable and fun. They also have a really good youth program and pour into our teens along with fun events for them. I’m very grateful that my family is apart of this church. This is a wonderful church, great place to worship! Everyone is so friendly and welcoming. Pastor is friendly, funny and I love how he explains the scripture. If you’re looking for a church this is the one for you, if you live locally it’s definitely worth giving it a try. I’m a bit new to understanding the scripture all its meaning but our pastor really breaks it down so that even someone that has never read the Bible can understand. I've been a part the CCSC family for many years.  I'm grateful for a place of fellowship where I feel like part of a family that puts God first in our lives.  Studying the Bible chapter by chapter, verse by verse, has been a tremendous blessing and a vehicle for growth in my relationship with the Lord.  There are many opportunities to serve which is a great deal of fun, and always draws me closer to my brothers and sisters in Christ.  I would encourage anyone who is looking to be a part of a Christ-centered, Bible-believing fellowship, to come and worship with us.  God bless you! What I love most about our church is the people of God who cares and love for one another. Like all Calvary Chapels, you get the Word of God going through each book and verse by verse. If you let yourself absorb this kind of learning, you will become a different person (closer to the Lord). If your desire is to know the Lord, like Paul's desire to only know the Lord and the power of His resurrection (Phl 3:8-10), then this is the church for you! Calvary Chapel is a great church. The pastor is very great with the scriptures. I love that everyone is very welcoming. God bless all of you.

name: Calvary Chapel Signal Hill
Calvary Chapel Signal Hill - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
My father was a regular attendee during the COVID-19 pandemic. He faithfully supported the church with donations and deeply appreciated Pastor James Kaddis's sermons defending churches against the government shutdowns in 2020.

He entered a memory care facility in 2022 and recently passed away on July 12.  I flew from San Francisco to arrange his memorial service, called the church and left two voicemail messages over several days simply asking whether Pastor  James Kaddis would be available to officiate my father's memorial service. I never received a return call.
It is understandable Pastor Kaddis may have been ill or out of town.  However, he is the figurehead of the Church is responsible for its administration.

Shame on the church for its silence and complete lack of response. In an age where many water down the gospel to appease the world, Pastor James Kaddis of Calvary Chapel Signal Hill stands as a rare and courageous voice proclaiming the uncompromising truth of God's Word. His teaching is not only biblically sound, but Spirit-led, powerful, and deeply relevant for the times we’re living in.

Pastor James speaks with clarity, urgency, and conviction—always rooted in Scripture and driven by a genuine love for the Body of Christ. He is unapologetic in preaching the full counsel of God, not avoiding the hard topics but confronting them with grace and authority. Whether he's addressing current events through a biblical lens or breaking down complex passages verse by verse, you can sense his commitment to honoring Christ above all.

What sets Pastor James apart is his fearless devotion to truth coupled with a shepherd’s heart. He doesn’t just inform—he equips, challenges, and encourages believers to stand firm in their faith, to live righteously, and to keep their eyes on the soon return of Jesus. His ministry is a beacon of light in a darkening world, and Calvary Chapel Signal Hill is truly blessed to have such a faithful servant at the helm.

If you’re looking for a pastor who teaches the gospel with boldness, integrity, and a deep reliance on the Holy Spirit, look no further than Pastor James Kaddis. His commitment to truth is unwavering, and his passion for God's people is evident in every message he delivers.

May God continue to bless and strengthen him as he leads others in the path of righteousness, truth, and hope in Christ. I've listened to many pastors, but Pastor James Kaddis is different, profoundly different. Every word spoken carries weight, spoken from a place of deep conviction, passion for God's hands at work in our world, and the spiritual warfare taking place in our world right now.

No, Pastor James is not the bad person some misunderstood people think. He is a no-nonsense, no sugarcoating speaker. God has His people all over the world, and each one is different, and has different talent. Pastor James is one of them. No one is perfect because only our Lord Jesus Christ is. But He uses His people to prepare His church. He uses people who do not conform to societal standard, crowd-pleasing people, but those bold enough to dedicated themselves to edifying and educating and preparing God's people.  I highly recommend attending this church or listen to Pastor James Kaddis on YouTube. Know that God does not use your standard "pastor looking" people to speak the truth, but those who are obedient to His calling.
Yes, every speaker is different just like everyone of us are different.

I urge everyone not to expect a perfect flawless person everytime you step into a church, but discern the hand of God at work in a church and the leaders to help and prepare and bless the church.

Pastor James has shown me so much deep knowledge of the spiritual warfare taking place in our world right now. We praise God for this blessings. I watch the YouTube Sunday mornings and weekdays. I love this church and the guests from other churches he has on his show. Weather you're looking for a church or just want to hear the true gospel this is the place to be. Pastor Dale and James are wonderful people God has blessed everyone with. I began listenimg to Pastor James on You Tube in 2020. I am THANKFUL for his boldness to.speak truth completely surrounded im scripture. It is a Pastors responsibility to direct his church and he is the EXAMPLE of that! Thank you Pastor James for your obedience to Gods calling on your life.

reviewSummary: Visited this wonderful church last Sunday. So pleased to see the loving, welcoming fellowship, compelling and motivating message and music. Truly multigenerational.... And no cliques. I also help out on Wednesdays at the Calvary Kids Club, which is for elementary kids, where we play games and learn the gospel. We also have Tuesday night youth hangouts over Zoom. This church has something for all age groups! I'm in middle school and I love going to Calvary Chapel South Tampa! My family started attending right after we moved to Tampa. I get to learn about the Bible verse by verse and how it applies to my life. I have a twin sister and two younger brothers who also love going. My parents attend couples class, which is good for their marriage. We love helping out at Calvary Kids Club on Wednesdays as junior volunteers. Calvary Chapel is like our second home and family. The focus is on individual growth of the believer in Christ Jesus. We love the people here-they are like family to us. We’ve been attending 5 years. name: Calvary Church - Clearwater
Calvary Church - Clearwater - Clearwater Campus
reviewSummary:
I came to Calvary Church during a season of searching — not casually, but with intention. I was specifically looking for a Baptist congregation because of my deep personal connection to First Baptist Church in Lakeland, where I recently had the privilege of contributing to their campus through my work with Distinct Designs Custom Cabinets and Casework in Largo.

Only about four months ago, I was sanding surfaces, assembling drawers, fitting cabinetry, sweeping floors, and delivering finished pieces room by room — all alongside the great Jarek from Poland, one of the finest craftsmen I’ve ever known. To build even a small part of a church like FBC Lakeland was an honor. I prayed quietly as I worked, imagining the countless believers who would one day use those spaces. That experience left a mark on me, and it made me long for a Baptist church family of my own.

That longing is what led me to Calvary.

From the moment I arrived, the people here were warm, kind, and genuinely welcoming. The pastoral care team reached out quickly. Gaye Lene was attentive and organized, and both Pastor Mike and Pastor Justin took the time to speak with me about baptism and next steps. Their willingness to meet, listen, and guide me meant a great deal.

Calvary is a large, active congregation with strong teaching, heartfelt worship, and a sincere commitment to Scripture. You can feel the love of Christ in the way people greet you, pray with you, and make space for newcomers. For many, this church is home — and I can absolutely see why.

But as I continued my journey, something unexpected happened:
I found myself drawn back to a place that had been quietly woven into my life for decades.

I ultimately found my spiritual home at St. Alfred’s Episcopal Church on Curlew in Palm Harbor — a church I likely attended as a child with my grandfather, Harry B. Vassie, co‑founder of the NSA and later a beloved member of the Palm Harbor community. He served in the Coast Guard Auxiliary on Lake Tarpon and carried himself with the kind of dignity and quiet service that shaped my understanding of faith long before I had words for it.

For the past nine years, I’ve walked with Father Pete at Enterprise Dog Park — a man who never pushed, never preached at me, never tried to steer me. He simply listened. Month after month, year after year, he offered a gentle, patient presence that spoke louder than any sermon. And today, when he preached, something in his words reached a place in me I didn’t expect. His sermon brought tears to my eyes — not from sadness, but from recognition. From the sense that I was finally standing where I belonged.

So while Calvary was an important part of my journey — and I am grateful for the time I spent there — my path ultimately led me somewhere else. That doesn’t diminish Calvary in the slightest. Not every church is meant for every person, and that’s part of the beauty of the Body of Christ. Different voices, different traditions, different ways of drawing people closer to God.

Calvary is a good church with good people, and I’m thankful for their hospitality. If you’re searching, Calvary is absolutely worth visiting. And if your journey takes you somewhere else, that’s okay too. Sometimes God leads us through one door so we can recognize the next one when it opens. Thanks but no thanks.

In this country we have the freedom of the press, and Google reviews is a way for citizens to participate.

name: Calvary Church of Santa Ana - Newport Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
From the moment you walk in the door you feel the spirit.  Debbie one of the greeters remembers everyone’s names and is the sweetest over the years she has become my spiritual mom loving and guiding my son and I to Jesus! Debbie and many others have become family to myself and my son Jaxon.  Raising my son as a single mom I have felt nothing but constant love and belonging! We started attending when my son was 3 he’s 11 now. Calvary is very relational and there is a place for everyone no judgment just LOVE! Highly recommend! We toured almost all of the Christian private schools in OC and could not be happier with our decision to choose Calvary Christian School of Santa Ana. Calvary is deeply rooted in Christian values, and you truly see those values lived out daily through the way teachers care for students and how the community supports one another.

One of the things we love most is the strong sense of community. Families are welcoming, and there are many opportunities for parent involvement, which makes you feel connected to your child’s education. We strongly believe parent involvement plays a huge role in shaping our children’s future. The school also offers many field trips and hands-on learning experiences that keep students excited and engaged.

The teachers are experienced, caring, and genuinely invested in each child’s growth—academically, spiritually, and socially. With over 50 years of history, the school has a strong foundation and clear mission. We also appreciate the diverse student body and the emphasis on mission opportunities. Academically, we love the focus on spelling bees, speech meets, and foreign language instruction starting in first grade. We couldn’t be happier with our experience! Went to the church for 20 plus years, married there, kids attended schools on campus. Begged the "Executive Pastor" Eric Wakling for help and he didn't even have the decency to return an email or call... nothing.......20 plus years of attendance and didn't even qualify for a call. Be warned about this church as they talk a great game but they'll never show up to help you even when you beg for help. Swing and a miss with the comedy act tonight that was light on reflecting Jesus but had severe racial overtones.  It appears this church has strayed from the days of strong Bible teaching I attended under Dave Mitchell.  I don’t think Matt Doan would be proud of what was conveyed in the Worship Center.  The laughing at marriage routine that we went to was TERRIBLE!  Comedian showed up super late, then went down the racial road while pedaling merch, pay-out for additional seminars, and pushing a book.  It was pretty bad and we left feeling taken advantage of.  I’m all for comedy, but not the kind that denigrates “white people”, making it their entire act with a sprinkle of a Bible verse or two.  Calvary staff, please do a better job of vetting who you endorse. Just a great church. Diverse, multi-generational congregation, lots of activities, fantastic worship team, messages that are true to the gospel. Everything a church should be.

NOT A GODLY DRIVEN APPROACH...SATAN HAS HIS HOOKS IN THIS MAN AS ONE OF HIS VOMITING DOGS. It is a large enough church to have all kinds of members, but this type of unwarranted badgering is not good advertising. This is my church. When I walked in I new I belonged. Nice place nice church but I do like my church a lot better Best Bible teaching Bible believing church around. Solid biblical Bible teaching from the pulpit. name: Calvary Community Church - Fullerton Campus
reviewSummary:
Calvary is a wonderful church. You will find strong fellowship, a dedicated music team that leads everyone in worship through song, a wonderful new pastor who brings the Word of God to life and who loves and values the community he serves, and last but not least a safe and interactive Sunday School program for kids that I couldn’t be happier with. A church that is like home! What a great place to worship and pastor Dirk is the best. He really wants to serve Jesus. A small, friendly church, with other churches also renting the facilities. Handicapped accessible, bathrooms available. Calvary itself is a Church of the Lutheran Brethren, sticking to mainstream Lutheran doctrine, except they happen to like songs that were written more recently (good music, solid worship leader). Family focused, friendly, welcoming crowd.

I have attended this church for 33 years, and seen various pastors come and go. The current pastor is quite solid. Intelligent, articulate, friendly, and engaging. Small, welcoming church that feels like family. Authentic and biblical worship and teaching. Went for aa feed for homeless. They offer hot meal . clothes etc. People are great and they offer showers and food to go.

name: Calvary Community Church - Torrance Campus
Calvary Community Church - Woodland Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
Have you been looking for a church that ACTUALLY preaches about Jesus and isn't about politics or weird doctrines? Well Im pleased to tell you that Calvary is that church! The pastor and elders are incredible and on fire for the Good News and Jesus. There's plenty of programs for the kids including special needs. Tons of Bible Study opportunities and stuff for teenagers. But truly the strength of this church is in it's big time love for Jesus. Every sermon leads to Jesus and I love how the church isn't law based/pharisee glazing. I highly recommend coming here. 10/10 Was here for a their annual car show last weekend.  This is a straight up bias All American car show.  Only 1 import won, which was a BMW, and it was even under "People's Choice".  So obviously all the judges cared about and have been caring about are American cars.  WHY even accept Import cars during registration when not even 1 or 2 imports win in Top 10, or other categories.  There were import cars there that you never see around at all, rare import cars, a lot of people were amazed as I observed there reactions to these imports.  Not cool at all Calvary Love My Ride car show staff. Christmas Service. I brought 2 unattending folks, 4 attending another church folks and my bride and me. We all thought the giving section was repetitive... Brian repeated himself 3 or 4 times.

All of us felt the video after was guilting manipulation. Of course Paul wasn:t afraid to guilt the Corinthians to give, but really, at the Christmas service when you probably have more visitors the members? I bet Bill Hybels, who was an influence at one thime, might have a comment.

Pastor Brian was a real downer. His focus on sin and human suffering was not appropriate for families that travelled from all over the US to spend a joyous Christmas celebrating Christ' birth with their families. Further, after fighting a horrible reaction to the COVID vaccine for 3 years that resulted in me nearly dying a couple of times, Brian's message cound not have been a bigger miss. Does he have a clue?

Sean, as usual was Great and my grandson loved the presentation. He is 4 and this was his second time in church.

I get Jesus was born as a sacrifice for me. But I wonder if Jesus would be happy about focusing on the sacrifice over the the joy that came (1) after 700 years of God not speaking to His people, (2) the beginning of the new covenant of love for God and each other and (3) the joy that gentiles were adopted into God's family.

Scripture says there is a season for everything and there is also a good word for every season. Christmas is a season of joy. Our words should reflect that. Brian's word was for the easter season.  Isn't it interesting though, that our liturgical seasons are opposite of the lunar seasons? Beautiful place to stay and listen for God's message. The music always gets to me and my wife. It's always been a great experience  for us and my two kid's. My 10 year old son loves going to his age class friends and my daughter 22 years the enjoyment of hanging out with me and my wife while listening to the message... its her childhood church..
God bless this beautiful establishment being a church! I normally don’t post reviews, but as a parent I feel strongly that other families deserve to know how this church leadership handles serious situations with kids.

My son attended their youth camp this summer and was falsely accused of something very serious. Instead of investigating carefully, the pastors immediately labeled him with a damaging accusation, had the police question him without either parent present, and then sent him home. Later, the story shifted several times — from a very harsh accusation to “disruptive behavior” — with no consistency or clarity or response to my concerns. Even more troubling, my son was never counseled, warned, or guided by a leader at camp before being casting him out of camp, he has zero knowledge he had done anything wrong.

We all expect teenagers to need correction, and as parents, we welcome godly discipline. But what we did not see was Christlike leadership. Rather than using the opportunity to teach, shepherd, and help him grow, the church chose humiliation, much avoidance, and silence. Promised follow-up calls and apologies never came, and messages went unanswered.
When I did finally receive a response from Pastor Brian, who ignored my calls by the way, said 'we have a different perspective' and went without addressing not one concern that I addressed, not one. Truly, I expected more from the head of the head.

My son has taken accountability for the things he did do, but the pastors have not taken responsibility for their overreaction and lack of care for the hurt and damage they have caused. The result was deep embarrassment and harm to a 13-year-old boy’s reputation — all over an accusation later found to be untrue.

If you are considering sending your child here, please be aware: this is not the grace-filled, truth-led leadership that Scripture calls pastors to model. Families deserve better.

name: Calvary La Habra
Calvary La Habra - Brea Campus
reviewSummary:
Excellent Pastors, Excellent people working to WELCOME ALL that come through their doors! Very helpful, very kind, very God Loving!!! Calvary Chapel La Habra is a truly special place. The church is filled with a warm, welcoming congregation that’s willing to step out of their comfort zones to serve those in need—locally, nationally, and internationally. They live out what it means to be the hands and feet of Jesus in a world that desperately needs it.
Pastor Lance is an exceptional preacher and shepherd. His life and character are marked by faithfulness, consistency, purity, and a bold, unwavering commitment to Christ. His teaching is grounded in Scripture and unafraid to speak the truth with love and conviction.
This church is not only a place of sound doctrine, but also a refuge for families. While we're no longer part of it today, we were incredibly blessed to be involved in their homeschool co-op—a rare and precious program that provided our children with a safe, Christ-centered alternative in the midst of a culture and public education system that is growing increasingly hostile to biblical values.
Calvary Chapel La Habra is a beacon of hope—a lighthouse in a dark and turbulent world. It’s a place that honors God, equips believers, and stands firm in the truth. We thank God for this church, its leadership, and the light it shines in these challenging times. Drinking coffee and selling burritos before service starts completely disrespectful people walking in with there cups have no shame it's more important there cup of coffee and walking in late in exchange for the presence of the Lord maybe put the coffee down and pay attention for once Friendly  people. name: Calvary LIFE
Calvary LIFE - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been attending this church since 2023. The people are welcoming. The music is lively and heartfelt. Pastor Chet, along with his wife and co-pastors, is amazing, passionate, funny, authentic, and extremely knowledgeable in the Word of God. His own life experiences show it. I recommend this church. They offer so many programs to help you grow, along with a Thursday evening, Saturday evening, and three Sunday morning services. I love this place, and I’ve attended quite a few in the past. My husband and I totally enjoy the message every Sunday. Worship is so good.
People are welcoming and helpful.
Facility is clean and well cared for.
And it’s great to see so many serving during the service. God’s family taking care of others, with a friendly smile. A truly remarkable pastor and preacher who is exceptionally distinguished, delivering sermons marked by balance and impartiality. Upon entering the church, one is enveloped in an unmistakable aura of divine presence. The worship services are profoundly enriching, imbued with spiritual depth and a palpable sense of God's presence This Church has a great atmosphere, and although it can qualify as a mega Church, it has the vibe of a small family community church because of how everything is set up and how everyone engages with each other. Pastor Chet is one of the better Bible teachers I’ve come across, not only is he relatable and his message but he is also sound in doctrine. Calvary Chapel South Bay has a healthy heart for missions and because of that it is very welcoming and service centered. The kids ministry is also robust and systematic while being able to entertain the children and educate them at the same time, I definitely recommend anyone to go and I’m glad it is here in the Southbay. Calvary life  changed my Life. Pastor Chet n his beautiful wife True people of God...God Bless you both n your children.

name: Calvary South OC, San Clemente
Calvary South OC, San Clemente - Laguna Niguel Campus
reviewSummary:
I rarely leave negative reviews, especially for a church, but my family left this church feeling deeply disappointed.
We were excited to visit and drove over 30 minutes to attend. Before the service began, our infant son was quietly sitting with us and was not making any noise or causing any disruption. After arriving, not a single person greeted us or welcomed us. Instead, we were approached and told that our infant could not remain in the sanctuary. The woman who approached us did not ask our names or introduce herself; she simply informed us that our baby had to leave.
As first-time visitors, this experience was disheartening. We ultimately left and attended another church that welcomes families of all ages into worship. Our baby loves being part of worship, and we believe children deserve the opportunity to witness the body of Christ worshiping together across generations.
In all our years of attending churches, we have never encountered a policy like this. We found it concerning and not reflective of the welcoming spirit we were hoping to find in a church community.
If you are looking for a church that embraces young children and welcomes families with open arms, unfortunately, this was not our experience here. Best church I've ever been to !
I'm so glad a friend invited me here!!
The message is absolutely fantastic every time!
What a beautiful and comfortable, welcoming and warm environment to learn and worship!
The worship team is absolutely fantastic!
I enjoy being outside in the patio area listening to the message ,enjoying the beauty of the green hills, and singing birds that surround us, while I'm sipping coffees or ice water provided and watching our fantastic pastor up on the outdoor screen sharing yet another awesome message.
Our Pastor John Randall is on fire for the Lord with an incredible love for teaching God's truths in a wonderful way and always spot on!
Never boring always something new going on to look forward to.
Come have a beautiful Christ centered, Joy filled morning with us! You'll be so glad you did! This Church is disgusting and evil. They gave my son medication without my approval during VBS. And when I called to question them why, the staff was very rude, vague, cut me off and never answered my questions or returned phone calls. Beware of letting your precious babies be alone with these people! We partnered with this church for a True Girl event and everything and everyone was so very helpful and amazing! So blessed. Been My Church Home for Over a Year—Couldn't Be Happier

I've been attending Calvary South OC for over a year now and it's been incredible for my walk with God. Pastor John teaches straight from the Bible using expository preaching—basically going through books of the Bible verse by verse so you get the full context and deeper understanding of Scripture.

What I really appreciate about Pastor John is how genuine and approachable he is. No celebrity pastor vibes here—he's actually plugged into his congregation and easy to talk to. His Daily Walk videos, Tuesday men's group (they have women's options too), and Wednesday services give you solid biblical teaching throughout the week.

Pastor John has this ability to make Scripture easy to understand and apply to real life. He keeps things relevant, throws in some humor, and never waters down God's Word. Whether you're brand new to faith or have been walking with Christ for years, his teaching meets you right where you are.

If you're looking for a church with solid biblical teaching, real community, and a pastor who actually cares about his people, I can't recommend Calvary South OC enough. It's been a blessing to be part of this church.

Come have a beautiful Christ centered, Joy filled morning with us! You'll be so glad you did! This Church is disgusting and evil. They gave my son medication without my approval during VBS. And when I called to question them why, the staff was very rude, vague, cut me off and never answered my questions or returned phone calls. What I really appreciate about Pastor John is how genuine and approachable he is. No celebrity pastor vibes here—he's actually plugged into his congregation and easy to talk to. His Daily Walk videos, Tuesday men's group (they have women's options too), and Wednesday services give you solid biblical teaching throughout the week.

name: Campus Church
Campus Church - Pensacola Campus
reviewSummary:
Very friendly church. Great for all age groups & stages of life. The kids classes are well staffed. The preaching was wonderful with plenty of scriptural references. This is a place where Christians and families can thrive. The campus church is not just a college/student church, everyone is welcome. Campus Church in Pensacola, Florida is a large congregation (could be classified as a megachurch). The church is located on the property of Pensacola Christian College, however, the church is a separate and distinct entity in which anyone in the community can attend. The church is an Independent, Fundamental, Baptist Church and conducts services accordingly. They follow a typical order of service, starting with video announcements, a worship service with traditional and new hymns, corporate prayer, and then a sermon (typically expository) from the Senior Pastor Dr. Jeff Redlin. Although, the church typically does not include an altar-call style come-down invitation.

Campus Church has a variety of ministries it conducts. For adults, the church has multiple Bible study groups during the Sunday school hour. They also have Wednesday evening small groups that meet for a variety of reasons (Lifeshare book study, Grieving and healing heart ministry, Overcomer Conquer series, Woman to Woman ministry, etc.). For the youth, they have an active Teen group which meets on Wednesday evenings. They also have a nice Children's Sunday School program which utilizes Joyful Life curriculum (last I checked, this could be changed by now). The church also conducts a Master Clubs service for the children on Sunday evenings. Campus Church conducts a variety of other ministry events and community events as well.

Campus Church is a great ministry. Though, no church is without some drawbacks. The size of this ministry makes it difficult to have a church "family" feel. It is nearly impossible to meet and fellowship with the majority of the church as the student attendees leave periodically throughout the year and the church members are so vast in numbers it is difficult to build those relationships. Although, after you eventually build those relationships, the bonds created can be great. Ever since COVID, Campus Church has started heavily relying on technology (livestream, video announcements, QR code Gospel tracts, Online giving, Realm) to which I personally feel is negative to the ministry, however, that is an exceedingly personal opinion. There is no stated dress code for non-PCC attendees, however, it can feel very judgmental if you arrive in anything less formal than Khakis and a Polo.

Overall, I recommend Campus Church as a great Bible-believing church in the Pensacola community. Although, I would recommend considering the drawbacks, and weighing them against the positives of the ministry. This is not everyone's style of church, but it should be a church everyone can consider to call their home. HUGE auditorium with plenty of seats. Several big screens so you can see everything going on, and the sound system was very well designed. The music was God honoring and the message was well presented. Coming from a small church congregation, I felt "lost"/out of place, but we still enjoyed worshipping with other brothers and sisters in Christ. 💜 It is a large church, but their goal is not to have a big church. It is to serve God. The pastor preaches good, Biblical messages, and even though you could get lost in the crowd, they work very hard to make sure that you are seen and understand you are welcome and valuable. Oh we highly recommend this place. We came here with our 6 children. We have always listened to pastor Jeff on rejoice radio from Idaho but since we were going to Destin for vacation we really wanted to stop by Campus church. The orchestra was beautiful, the choir was beautiful, God’s word was spoken by pastor Jeff. It’s a blessing to be here. The parking lot for visitors is plenty enough and we were guided by the helpers outside when we told them it’s our first time. It really is a blessing if you can come to this church!

Candlewood Church
Candlewood Church - Westwood Campus
reviewSummary:
I attended Candlewood Church for approximately a year and a half. During that time, Pastor Glen and his wife were initially friendly and welcoming.

At one point, I submitted a prayer request online regarding my marriage. Pastor Glen called me and remarked, “Do you know how many people see that prayer?” I shared a little about the struggles I was facing, and he responded that he would need to speak with my husband to hear his side of the story and determine whether what I shared was true.

Last year, I confided in Pastor Glen and his wife about the emotional and verbal abuse I was experiencing in my marriage, as well as my feelings of emotional abandonment. I also asked if there might be a church member with a spare bedroom for me and my children, since I was considering separation and did not feel emotionally safe at home. At the time, I nearly sought shelter at a domestic violence home but ultimately did not go.

Later, Pastor Glen called me and said, “Stop telling people I don’t care.” He told me that he believed I was harming my children by separating and insisted that my husband and I simply needed therapy and to “work it out.” I explained that we had already gone through several rounds of therapy without change. I asked him, “What do you do when you’ve tried everything, and your spouse still refuses to change and continues these behaviors?” He admitted, “I don’t know, this is beyond me.” After that call, I felt devastated. I cried, felt alone, and deeply hurt. I did not feel compassion, empathy, or support in that moment, nor was I provided with any resources or constructive solutions.

Shortly afterward, I discovered that Pastor Glen had shared details of our private conversation with his worship pastor, who then told my husband. My husband confronted me, saying, “I heard you didn’t like what the pastor said. Maybe you should listen to them and stop trying to leave me.” This left me feeling that my confidentiality had been violated and that the trust I had placed in my pastor was betrayed.

It is my belief that Pastor Glen may not be adequately equipped to respond to situations involving abuse. Advising a couple to stay together simply because the abuse is not physical ignores the real harm of emotional and verbal abuse, which can severely impact both the spouse’s mental health and the children who witness it.

I eventually left Candlewood Church after that experience. A week later, I found a new, supportive church community that listened with compassion, provided resources, and stood alongside me in my healing journey. That care helped me feel less isolated and more hopeful. Since leaving, I have had no further contact from Pastor Glen, and I never received any follow-up from him or his wife.

I am sharing my experience because I would not want anyone else to go through something similar—feeling unseen in their pain and unsupported in their time of need. Very sweet pastor and wife.
There for me when I least expected.
Thanks for going beyond for my families funeral 🙏 ❤️
You guys are such sweet Christian ✝️ pastors.
Nice family vibe Amazing church service, wonderful praise and worship service. Absolute stellar staff pastor glenn is one of the greatest pastors i've ever met!!! I highly recommend this church Great church ⛪️ 🙏

name: Canvas
Canvas - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary:
A jewel in our current world!
If you are looking for an authentic church with heart, look no further!
Unlike most churches, queer people, and everyone in between are welcome. Like, truly welcome!
And Not in the ostentatious way most churches say “all are welcome”.
This is a genuine place of worship where Love, Service and Community are placed at the forefront Love this church. The pastor is one of the coolest intellectual Christians I know. If you are looking for a church in the area that is simultaneously progressive and Bible based this hits that perfect spot. I have called this church home for a year now and it’s been one of the biggest blessings. It is filled with kind, thoughtful, authentic people who affirm and love ALL types. If you’re a person who has struggled the find a church in our crazy world, you should come try Canvas! We would love to have you. I can’t say enough good things about this church. The community is so warm, welcoming, and genuinely inclusive—it’s a place where everyone is truly embraced. The theology is thoughtful, compassionate, and grounded in love. For the first time in a long time, I feel like I’ve found a church home! I really wanted to like this church and was ready to jump, but sadly, I had a negative experience.

I wanted to bring my therapy dog, since we were going to volunteer at JWA after church.  (Daisy is one of the AirPAWS dogs that bring joy and stress relief to all).  So I wanted to be respectful and ask if she could come and all the powers that be said “Yes, but if this is going to be a long term thing, we’ll have to figure something else out”.  I told her we’d sit in the back, to minimize any distraction which we did.

I was greeted by the woman with whom I spoke earlier in the week (Debbie?) and she was lovely and greeted me warmly.

It is a VERY small church with about 40 parishioners and staff.  Well, if this where God wants me, I’m game.  (I come from Saddleback and Mariners Church, so it was a bit of a shock).

Daisy didn’t create a fuss, except for several people looked as if they were happy to see her.  One woman sat with Daisy on the floor for a good part of the service.

The teaching was fine, a little dry, but I could handle it.

It was sad to me that everyone was so unfriendly, except one guy that wanted to talk about Daisy.  I had to introduce myself to three people and their response was tepid at best.  Didn’t they want people to attend?  Was it because I was there with Daisy?

Walking out the same woman who greeted me was pleasant.  Daisy’s buddy throughout the service didn’t even respond when I thanked her for sitting with Daisy.

Like I said, I really wanted this church to work. My niece is gay, and I was excited to find a church that I could bring her and hopefully she would consider accepting Jesus-something I’ve been praying about for decades.  This was not it.

I really didn’t want to leave a review, but I couldn’t find a way to email the church.  I just knew I had to share my experience with them, so maybe they can be more welcoming in the future.

Its a wonderful to be a church that accepts the LGBTQ+ community and it would more effective if new people felt welcomed.

reviewSummary:
Ben and Katie Brinkman are hands down the best source of Gods word. They preach the word as it is written and it’s true meaning with no spin. Ben has an amazing way of preaching the gospel and capturing your attention. He has a great sense of humor that will make the time fly and leaves you wanting more. They truly care for their congregation and make everyone feel as if they’re family. I’d press anyone to find a better place to meet God and learn the true Gospel. Come and see for yourself. You will not be disappointed. This is an amazing church. It’s big, but not too big. The Holy Spirit is moving through the pastors and worship team and all who attend. You just feel it. There’s a real sense of “family” there. It’s very diverse, it’s a beautiful mix of ages and races and nationalities and backgrounds…no one will feel like an “outsider” there. This place fully and GENUINELY embraces the command to love God and love others. I am so thankful God led me to this wonderful community of beautiful believers and I am so excited to grow in my faith journey with them! Positively wonderful! I went to Canvas after not attending church for over ten years. I'm so glad I did. Warm and welcoming. People I never met prayed for miracles for me! I couldn't believe it! The pastor is knowledgeable and compassionate. His sermon was practical.
I'm still healing from much brokenness and much loss and heartache. I was convinced God abandoned me and I spent 13 years living like that. I'm so grateful I found such a loving church. No judgement...Such a loving, loving, LOVING place! They won't give up on you the way other churches would. Margo was fierce in her love and understanding. Amazing Church!! It’s by far the best one me and my family have been to. It’s definitely an amazing experience here than how we were treated at our old church. I would highly recommend this church because the people are very welcoming and so kind and the pastors are amazing people who bring a powerful and amazing word. This church deserves a 5 star rating and I would recommend this church to everyone. Love this place.  Have gained a whole new family.  Pastors Ben, Katie, Steve n Cathy are all beautiful, genuine people.  The family here is very diverse too which makes it super comfortable no matter who you are or what your situation is.  We all love Jesus and you!  Come check us out!

reviewSummary:
Very good fellowship. Meant to write this review for a couple of years now. We were here for a few sundays but then moved to another fellowship to be with families of kids friends. Good word and genuine fellowship! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Our family has been truly blessed to be a part of Canyon Hills. From the moment we walked through the doors, we were met with warmth and genuine hospitality that made us feel right at home. This small, personable church fosters a welcoming atmosphere where everyone is embraced like family.

What sets Canyon Hills apart is not just the incredible sense of community but also the amazing family events hosted throughout the year. These gatherings have given us the opportunity to connect with other young families, forge meaningful friendships, and create lasting memories with our son. It’s heartwarming to see our child grow and learn alongside others in a nurturing environment.

The teachings here are deeply rooted in Christ and the Bible. Each week, we are inspired by the insightful messages that resonate with our lives, providing us with guidance that carries us through our daily challenges. It’s a true blessing to be part of a congregation that emphasizes growth in faith and encourages us to live out our beliefs.

If you’re looking for a church where you can feel at home, connect with others, and grow spiritually, I highly recommend Canyon Hills! We are grateful to be a part of this wonderful family of believers! Friendly atmosphere. Very welcoming pastors and staff! The congregation feels like family!  If you are new in the area and looking for a church where you can feel part of the community, I highly recommend checking out Canyon Hills! I can't say enough wonderful things about Canyon Hills Friends Church. My husband and I wanted to find a community in a church closer to home and that's exactly what we did. In a short period of time, Canyon Hills has become home to us. God is in every part of this wonderful church from the Sunday messages, to the prayer events, outreach, worship ministry, and children's ministry. The people are genuine as is their love for individuals, the church, and God. Added bonus...Our son loves the children's ministry and asks constantly to go to church. So much love for this place! I have felt welcome in this church from the moment that I walked in the door, it truly feels like home. They live up to their motto of “Not a place you go but people you love”. They offer multiple activities throughout the week for all ages. No matter where I have been in my walk, Canyon Hills has always had a something that fit my lifestyle. Come say hi, I promise you won’t be disappointed.

name: Canyon Ridge Baptist Church
Canyon Ridge Baptist Church - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary:
My family and I look forward to coming to church each week at Canyon Ridge!  We've grown so much in our relationship with Christ through the faithful Bible preaching and teaching.  I love the music on Sundays, the prayer times on Sunday evenings, and the small group Bible studies on Wednesdays!  Wish everyone would come here, experience Canyon Ridge, and grow in Christ . . . ! Been going to this church for over 15 years, I've grown up with it for basically my whole life, they are always loving and supportive! It has a great youth group for teens and an amazing children's ministry for younger kids! This place worships the pastor more than they worship Christ. Literally teaches about “obeying and yielding to pastor.” Creepy! Stay away from this cult! I came here multiple times but I can’t anymore. I’ve been attending Canyon Ridge for the past 8 months, and from the moment I stepped onto the campus, I felt genuinely welcomed and deeply loved. The sense of community here goes beyond fellowship — it feels like family. I’m truly grateful for every person I’ve met. Each sermon is rooted in Scripture, and there’s never any question — it’s the truth, straight from God’s Word.

If you’re looking for a church to call home, come visit — you’ll see for yourself. Whenever I visit San Diego, I always look forward to visiting Canyon Ridge! The church is so welcoming to everyone. The pastor and his family have been a huge encouragement to me as I've gone through a difficult time. The preaching always is both encouraging and convicting and comes straight from the Bible. I'm so thankful for the impact this church has had on me and would recommend it to anyone looking for a loving church in the San Diego area!

name: Canyons Church
Canyons Church - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary: We really appreciate the welcoming and non-judgemental spirit of this congregation.   The music is amazing, Pastor Matt speaks inspiring messages weekly and our children love the children and youth ministries which are energetic and instructional.   I'm certain you'll fall in love with this church too. I had a hard time finding a church that truly kept its focus on Jesus, until I found Canyons Church. The messages are powerful, the pastor is engaging, and the sense of community is real. I got baptized here and finally felt what church is meant to be. The leadership, worship, and tech teams are all incredible. If you're looking for a church to call home, give Canyons a try and you won’t be disappointed. My first visit to Canyons Church and I was so impressed. Everyone greeted me and welcomed me as if I was part of the family. The worship was spirit filled and I felt the presence of God during both the worship and the sermon. I love that they went straight into the word following worship. Pastor Matt delivered  scripture rich sermon, and even packed in some humor keeping it light and engaging. I took notes and received greater revelation that will impact my prayer life. I was invited to their community charity event following service where I got to participate in preparing gifts for children in other nations. It was such a joy to be welcomed into this community and I look forward to making Canyons my home church. We’ve really enjoyed being part of Canyons Church. It has a welcoming, community-oriented environment that makes it easy to feel connected. Pastor Matt shares thoughtful and encouraging messages each week that are both practical and inspiring. We especially appreciate the children’s ministry—it’s engaging, well-organized, and clearly focused on helping kids grow in their faith. There are also plenty of ways to get involved, whether you’re looking to serve, join a group, or just connect with others. It’s been a meaningful place for our family, and we’re happy to call Canyons Church our home! I feel blessed that we found this church. It is a very family oriented place. The kids ministry is absolutely amazing. Our 5 year old literally counts down the days to Sunday. The pastor and his wife have a genuine gift for connecting with people in a simple way and truly helping us grow closer to God and overcome life challenges.

name: Capital City Church
Capital City Church - Tallahassee Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor Matt is genuinely an anointed man of God. The people are welcoming and friendly, anyone in the building will pray for you at the drop of a hat.
Worshiping the one true God is a key focus here. I love this place, and am grateful the Holy Spirit led me to choosing this as my home church! Felt more like a concert than it did church. If you like to read off scripture I would not recommend. Sat in service for about 45 minutes and all they had done was played worship music. No hate like Christian love, huh? This church purposefully lights up their tv sign every night. Their sign so bright it blinds drivers and is also a huge light pollution problem for wildlife. It is unnecessary and vile. name: Capo Beach Church

reviewSummary:

This church and current pastor, Matt, has pushed more people away from the lord and the community than any other church we have been to. Even worst, about a year ago, they wrongfully fired the long-time pastor and spread false malicious lies about him to some of the church members. They degraded a man who served 50 years at the church and poured his life and soul into the community - and the whole community loved him. Not only did the current pastor, Matt, plot against him and spread nasty things, but he refused to let Pastor Craig, the old pastor, speak and say goodbye. He also lied to the people of the church regarding Craig’s absence. Most likely out of fear that Craig would reveal the truth of the current pastors lies and sacrilegious behaviors. Lastly, if you read other reviews, you will see the pattern of the current pastors, Matt’s,  efforts to threaten and act in a gray area. I can assure you, we will never return. This was my first time going to this church people are very friendly what would be expected out of a Christian would love to concern about you also I love the service the song worship even though I'm not of the denomination but I am going back to Arkansas to my church pay that I come back to California for another visit I would visit this church again thank you I have been part of CBC for about 6 years now, and one of the most incredible things about this church is that my children are truly known. Every Sunday when we walk in, multiple people greet my children and me by name. The youth leaders and many leaders at CBC know their names and their stories. To be known and loved in your church community like that is so special and often rare.

The leadership at Capo is exceptionally strong, both the newer leaders and those who have faithfully served the church for decades. The new worship pastor, JC, is outstanding. Each week I genuinely sense that the worship and prayers in worship rise to the Lord as a strong incense (Psalm 141:2).  There are more hands raised in worship now than there has ever been (since I have been here) at this church. Lead Pastor Matt is an incredible Bible teacher and speaker. I appreciate how he consistently brings historical context into his teaching and calls the church to action. Rod Mayer, who has served at the church for over 40 years, leads the youth ministries with incredible energy, joy, and reverence for God. Students are given opportunities to serve and encounter the Lord in real ways.

I am forever grateful to have found CBC 😇  my life has changed forever !  Thank you I feel so safe

name: Captivate Church - Point Loma Campus
Captivate Church - Point Loma Campus - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary:
This place was absolutely wonderful! I came today, Palm Sunday, for the first time and had an absolutely amazing experience. Everyone was so friendly and kind, the service was stirring and the environment felt pleasant and welcoming. "Connect to Captivate" at Captivate Church of San Diego.

Come as you are from wherever you may be and in the name of Jesus Christ may you be set free that you may be free indeed and you will indeed find freedom!
-Amen

P.S. parking can be sparse so come early or enjoy a brisk morning walk ‍
#DontWalkRUNToTheCross Seeking a New Home Church – A Testimony from This Morning

We’ve recently been stationed in San Diego and have been prayerfully seeking a new home church. This morning, we woke up ready and excited to gather in worship and hear the Word of God. We decided to visit Captivate Church in Point Loma for the first time.

As worship began, I did what I always do—I closed my eyes, lifted my hands, and entered into the presence of the Lord. I opened my heart to the Holy Spirit, allowing Him to move in me as I sang, prayed, and worshiped. I felt a deep sense of joy and peace—the undeniable presence of God covering me.

When the worship ended, I opened my eyes and my daughter leaned over to whisper in my ear. She told me that the people around us had been pointing, whispering, and mocking the way I was worshiping. Her face fell, and she began to cry—feeling judged, excluded, and grieved instead of embraced with love, unity, and grace in what’s meant to be the house of the Lord.

Two women in front of us continued to whisper to one another. I gently leaned forward and told them, with respect, that I didn’t appreciate the way they were whispering and judging me while I worshiped.
I explained that I meant no disruption or offense—that I was simply moved by the Holy Spirit in how I chose to worship. I encouraged them to take any offense they felt to God in prayer and left them with a blessing. All they had to say was “you were being disruptive”.

I reminded my daughter that we don’t go to church to be accepted by people. We go to meet with God, to receive what He has prepared for us, and to walk in truth, love, and righteousness. I told her not to let judgment or mockery distract her from the presence of God. People may try to put us in a box—but God calls us to freedom, not performance.

Even though the experience with those around us was painful and disappointing, I still received the Word that God had appointed for us that day. He met me there. And for that, I’m thankful.

This experience reminded me that the Church is not perfect, and sometimes people can bring in judgment instead of grace. But instead of carrying offense, I’m choosing to lay it all at the feet of Jesus and pray for hearts to be softened—mine included.
We’ll continue to seek a church where the Holy Spirit is welcome, where worship is free and full of reverence, and where people are embraced, not silenced. We attended the Wednesday night service and absolutely loved it. Pastor Wes was a guest pastor at our church the previous weekend, and his passion, knowledge, and energy really stood out. He felt so genuine and real that we were motivated to come visit his church and we’re so glad we did.

From the moment we walked in, everyone was welcoming and kind. The atmosphere felt warm and inviting, and God’s presence was truly felt. It’s clear this church is growing and moving in the right direction, and it’s exciting to hear that they’re even opening another location nearby.

Our daughter especially loved the children’s ministry. The teachers, Mr. Landon and Mr. Brock, were incredibly welcoming, and she had such a great time that she asked if we could come back.

We really enjoyed the service and look forward to going back again. Thank you for creating such a loving, faith-filled environment for both adults and kids.

- Jason & Amanda I visited Captivate Church in Point Loma last Sunday after running into my friend Nathanael, and I’m so glad I joined him. From the moment I walked in, it felt very welcoming and comfortable. The service started with uplifting music and then moved into a powerful message from the Bible that connected directly to everyday life. It really spoke to me and left me encouraged. Overall, it was a great experience and a perfect visit. If you’re looking for a church home, I would definitely recommend checking out Captivate! Captivate Church is the community you’ve been searching for.

I’m not sure who will read this, but if you are looking for a genuine, Christ-centered church, this is it. Pastor Wes, the lead pastor, fully embodies Captivate’s mission to end spiritual loneliness. His messages are deeply profound, relatable, and always rooted in Scripture and the teachings of Jesus Christ. What makes Captivate so powerful is its focus: every sermon points back to Jesus—not personal opinions, not interpretations shaped by politics, not self-promotion—but the true Word of God.

Ending spiritual loneliness is no small mission, and I can say from experience that Captivate lives it out. I’m young, multiracial, and a California girl, and yet I feel completely at home here. So many churches today seem to adopt divisive ideologies or push political agendas, turning worship into commentary on culture rather than a reflection of who Christ calls us to be. Captivate is different. Pastor Wes is different.

For a long time, I stayed away from organized religion because of how far many churches had drifted from Christ’s message of love and humility. I was spiritually lonely, trying to navigate my faith on my own. It may sound strange, but I don’t know Pastor Wes’s political stance—and I’m so glad I don’t. What I do know is that he loves people, respects everyone he meets, and leads with humility. He doesn’t pretend to speak for God; instead, he helps us build a relationship with God ourselves.

If you’re looking for a church that’s truly about Jesus Christ—not about “the extra”—Captivate is for you. In just a few months, I’ve met so many wonderful people, brought friends, joined serving teams, attended weekly events, throw my hands up in worship, and volunteered alongside others from church. It’s been such a blessing and a true community.

That said, I do want to share one honest concern in the hope it helps leadership grow even stronger. I’ve experienced two supporting pastors who don’t reflect Pastor Wes’s example and sometimes bring political opinions into their messages. Unfortunately, their words felt divisive and not in line with the heart of Captivate’s mission. I’ve had to walk out of services when the focus shifted from God’s word to personal ideology. I say this because I know what political stances they take and I question how much these particular pastors respect all people, how well they live out the virtues of the Bible, and whether they love all as Christ calls us to. From what I’ve witnessed, they use their platform to speak for God on political matters—something no one should do. That is not what church is for, and not what Captivate stands for.

I share this not out of judgment, but from love for this church and its mission. I pray all pastors at Captivate follow Pastor Wes’s lead—keeping the focus on Christ, not current events or opinions.

Despite that, I truly love this church. It’s authentic, welcoming, and centered on faith. I give here because God moves me to, not because anyone pressures me. I serve here because I believe in what Captivate stands for—community, love, and the true Word of God.

If you’re searching for a church home that is genuinely about Jesus, come to Captivate. It has changed my life.

What makes Captivate so powerful is its focus: every sermon points back to Jesus—not personal opinions, not interpretations shaped by politics, not self-promotion—but the true Word of God.

Ending spiritual loneliness is no small mission, and I can say from experience that Captivate lives it out. I’m young, multiracial, and a California girl, and yet I feel completely at home here. So many churches today seem to adopt divisive ideologies or push political agendas, turning worship into commentary on culture rather than a reflection of who Christ calls us to be. Captivate is different. Pastor Wes is different.

For a long time, I stayed away from organized religion because of how far many churches had drifted from Christ’s message of love and humility. I was spiritually lonely, trying to navigate my faith on my own. It may sound strange, but I don’t know Pastor Wes’s political stance—and I’m so glad I don’t. What I do know is that he loves people, respects everyone he meets, and leads with humility. He doesn’t pretend to speak for God; instead, he helps us build a relationship with God ourselves.

If you’re looking for a church that’s truly about Jesus Christ—not about “the extra”—Captivate is for you. In just a few months, I’ve met so many wonderful people, brought friends, joined serving teams, attended weekly events, throw my hands up in worship, and volunteered alongside others from church. It’s been such a blessing and a true community.

That said, I do want to share one honest concern in the hope it helps leadership grow even stronger. I’ve experienced two supporting pastors who don’t reflect Pastor Wes’s example and sometimes bring political opinions into their messages. Unfortunately, their words felt divisive and not in line with the heart of Captivate’s mission. I’ve had to walk out of services when the focus shifted from God’s word to personal ideology. I say this because I know what political stances they take and I question how much these particular pastors respect all people, how well they live out the virtues of the Bible, and whether they love all as Christ calls us to. From what I’ve witnessed, they use their platform to speak for God on political matters—something no one should do. That is not what church is for, and not what Captivate stands for.

I share this not out of judgment, but from love for this church and its mission. I pray all pastors at Captivate follow Pastor Wes’s lead—keeping the focus on Christ, not current events or opinions.

Despite that, I truly love this church. It’s authentic, welcoming, and centered on faith. I give here because God moves me to, not because anyone pressures me. I serve here because I believe in what Captivate stands for—community, love, and the true Word of God.

If you’re searching for a church home that is genuinely about Jesus, come to Captivate. It has changed my life.

name: CASA Church

reviewSummary:
I came to this church around February three months after my father passed away, i was currently in a bad mental and spiritual shape. I came to CASA with no expectations what so ever.
I never even went into a christian church before.
From the moment i arrived i was received with smiles and hugs, i felt how LOVE ran through their veins and all they cared about was each other and everyone that came in through their doors.
Once i was sitting down for my first ever service i found myself resonating and falling in love with the each song that was sang but once the pastor (Ezequiel Fattore) gave his teaching i was amazed, i have felt like he was speaking directly to me.
I fell in love.
Once the service was done and i wiped all of the tears off my face, i told myself that i wanted more.
So i went ahead and started servicing CASA.
CASA is not a church, this is a family we love and care for each other.
CASA has opened my heart and made me fall in love with god, they have opened a new chapter in my life.
I am Internally Grateful.
I love you CASA for all you have done for me.

So do not be scared to come, grab our hand and we will walk with you in ever step of the way, and do not worry because we do not let go.
What they did for me they can do for you.

Ps: Here are a couple of pictures of my family. Me and my family love casa church so so much, and all thought we haven’t been able to come in person (yet) since we live 3 hours away we watch every Sunday online and we love it. This has been our church for years and honestly although we haven’t been to many churches physically where we live none have the atmosphere and the way of predicar (teaching) that casa church has, everything about it just special and it really does live up to its name and make you feel at home I’ve been going to this church for the past 10 years and counting. This is where I fell in love with God. I owe this place and it’s leaders and pastors so much. In my time as a Christian I haven’t found another community like this one. You’re not joining a church you are joining a family with Christ. You feel so good when you come in here. People greet you nicely, are attentive and make you feel welcome. People care and pray for you. It’s also a great place if you have kids for them to grow with a great community and have leadership opportunities surrounded by Christ - loving individuals. I wouldn’t be where I am today had it not been for this wonderful church and community. Love you guys so much. Thank you for everything you’ve done in the past years. 💯❤️🙏🏼 This is a place where without religiosity we are invited to have a relationship with God. I went to this church after watching a sermon called “empezar de cero después de una herida”. However, when I went on Wednesday night, It felt more like a social club than a church. Not to say that community and activities are not important but the word of God must be the priority. The leaders of these groups did not seem prepared to lead a Bible group. The Bible says that leaders will be judged more harshly so I would be careful with who you are letting lead groups. Also, I shared a personal experience that a family member was going through and I felt pity and lack of genuine care or follow up after. I felt uncomfortable. Definitely if you are going through something keep it basic. If you are going to church is to feel welcome and embrace by God’s family, there are still a lot to learn in this church. However you should go to the main service and remember that even when community is important and we should build relationships, we go to church to worship God and understand the word. There is work to do in this church. I hope this church does not become like Sardis or Ephesus churches mentioned in the Bible. Praying for your leaders and for your church.
