name: Cathedral Basilica of St. Francis of Assisi
Cathedral Basilica of St. Francis of Assisi - Downtown Plaza Campus
Cathedral Basilica of the Assumption
Cathedral Basilica of the Assumption - Covington Campus
reviewSummary: European Gothic cathedral in northern Kentucky!  Knowledgeable and friendly tour guide. We did not have a tour scheduled, but the host at the door basically gave us our own private tour. We also bought the self-guided tour booklet ($10) that you can do from any location, you don't have to be in the cathedral. Also bought a very nice book on the amazing stained glass windows (I think it was $25 or $30.) Prayer candles are real candles, not LED, and were $5. The organist was practicing when we were there, so that made it extra special. I was in town for work. It was a beautiful day so my coworker and I walked here from our hotel, the Radisson. It's a gorgeous cathedral. The greeter was lovely and so informative. They will tell you where you can walk and what you can take photos of (there is an area where no photos are allowed). The stained glass is amazing as well as the mosaics. It does not take long to view everything, definitely look at the hours and visit if you're in the area. One of the most beautiful Churches I have ever been in. The Volunteers are some of the most nicest people. I'm not Catholic but I enjoy going and love sitting in the pews and soaking up all the beauty and usually I say a few prayers of thanks. I've struggled with religion but somehow when I walk into this Church that all seems to go away and I feel like I am home again just like when I was a child and going to Church all the time. Breathtakingly beautiful. The carvings, paintings, stained glass pictures and the religious relics were stunning.  Grateful we had the opportunity to visit. This gorgeous cathedral is a must see for anyone with a love of architecture or art. The vaulted ceilings take your breath away, and the stained glass is of the finest craftsmanship. Our volunteer who was giving us information about the cathedral was very knowledgeable and welcoming. This church boasts two organs, one of them being the oldest working one of its kind in the world. According to our volunteer, he said 700 people were present at the Christmas Eve service and you can see from some of the photos that there are plenty of pews and seating all around the church. This is a beautiful facility and I highly recommend everyone to go. They do not charge admission and the parking is free.

name: Cathedral Church
Cathedral Church - Irvine (Woodbridge) Campus
reviewSummary:
When we moved to Irvine, I wondered what God's plan was for my family. I am still finding my path and God's vision, but the church has become the light leading us closer to Jesus. This church is such a blessing Very unprofessional and unholy culture. After the service the pastor runs out to avoid talking to anyone and never stays to engage with the worshippers which is very different than the culture of shepherd grove years ago and definitely different than the Crystal cathedral. I attempted to speak to him and was intercepted by an employee to give him enough time to dash out as fast as he could. I tested this the following two weeks and got the same results. He also now has an assistant pastor who basically speaks for him. He only reads off of printed material in front of him, feels very inauthentic and quite frankly he looks like he’s forced to be there; his messy hair, the shorts, wrinkled clothing and untrimmed facial Hair definitely don’t help. People who are more like actors are brought in to fall on stage and lay face down and cry and scream and shout in the microphones; feels more like a bad acting performance rather than a place of worship, love and kindness. Fortunately Irvine and Newport have innumerable real pure churches, save your sanity and avoid this one. I watch Shepherd’s Grove Church on TV YouTube from Kentucky, and Bobby Schuller’s sermons are powerful, grounded, and incredibly meaningful (I use to watch his grandpa when he was preaching getting ready for our church in the morning).  Bobby’s messages offer depth, emotional insight, and practical takeaways that genuinely help you grow and reflect, I always walk away having learned something.
If I lived in California, I would absolutely attend in person.  And love their worship music! This church has such a beautiful and thriving community! Their worship is so wonderful. We are so blessed by Pastor Bobby and his teaching! I watch The Hour of Power from Australia. Bobby's sermons are always educational, meaningful & inspiring. Hannah's Prayer Ministry is the backbone of this church's effectiveness 🙏✝️

name: Cathedral of Our Lady of the Angels
Cathedral of Our Lady of the Angels - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
I’m not a religious person, but I visited the Cathedral of Our Lady of the Angels purely to appreciate it as art and architecture, and it truly moved me. The soft light, the modern lines, and the quiet openness create a peaceful atmosphere that anyone can feel. The building itself is thoughtful, sculptural, and full of subtle beauty. It’s a serene place where design, space, and calm come together in a way that stays with you. This is a beautiful church with a huge lot. It is super clean and modern. It's a handicap friendly facility w plenty of handicapped parking spots and pathways for wheelchairs. The parking structure is underground and pretty safe. There are also elevators if needed. This place is amazing. Beautiful and marvelous. Check the underground and thank me later. You’ll be surprise on what you gonna see down there. Parking is free during mass hours. Check out the courtyard, fountain and the bell tower. Plenty of sitting space inside and out. There’s also a gift shop and cafe. What am absolute perfect cathedral. I want to say the mass we attended was great. The prettiest even took the time to sign my child's mass attendance sheet. Very approachable father. I will say I'm happy I arrived early as the parking is difficult if you can find street parking nearby good for you  I went into the maze of the underground parking and wow. Made it to mass just in the nick of time. They have a small chapel in the bottom and the gift shop and cafeteria were top tier. I also like the kids garden area. A great idea for the little ones. We recently visited the Cathedral of Our Lady of the Angels in Los Angeles, and I honestly don’t have enough words to capture how beautiful this place is. From the moment we walked in, there was such a deep sense of peace and reverence.

The architecture is absolutely breathtaking—soaring ceilings, stunning stained glass, incredible artwork, and details everywhere you look. I was especially moved by the historic pieces throughout the cathedral, including the beautiful chapel, mosaics, and preserved altar. Even the courtyard and surrounding grounds felt serene and thoughtfully designed.

Beyond its beauty, what made this experience so special was the feeling inside the cathedral. Despite being such a grand space, it felt incredibly warm, welcoming, and sacred. Whether you visit for Mass, prayer, or simply to admire the architecture, this is truly a place that leaves a lasting impression.

Such a wonderful and memorable experience. I would absolutely recommend visiting if you’re ever in Los Angeles 💛

name: CBCWLA Baptist Church
CBCWLA Baptist Church - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary:
UPDATE 11/1/15 - Time flies!  It's now been a month since I first came to this church.  After my previous review, a couple of members of the church reached out to me and invited me back, introducing me to other members of the church and welcoming me to their fellowship (and apologising profusely for my awful first experience!  Apparently it's not normally like that).

I've been given to understand the church recently grew from 100 members to almost 300 members and it's grown so much that they've had to split the Chinese services in two.  As such, they have experienced growth pains such as newer members serving who don't necessarily know who the new faces within the church may be.  Also not all members are as 'welcoming' as you may expect Christians to be (this is likely through no fault of their own, perhaps they are also one of the shy ones).

They've already made a couple of changes in the welcoming and introduction of new friends or visitors to the church so hopefully what happened to me shouldn't reoccur and I've now decided to settle in this church.  I remember before leaving my church in London that there are only 3 factors you should look for in a new church and if these are met, then you should stay:

1. The word of God is faithfully preached.

Pastor Wang does not mince his words and he is not afraid to offend man to teach the word of God.  I'm not sure about other small groups, but at least in the one I've joined, Bellman Fellowship, they will bring everything back to Christ.  At CBCWLA, this criteria is absolutely met.

2. The love of Christ is shown.

After re-attending and having now attended for about a month, I can safely say that whilst this is not shown perfectly, they are truly trying their best.  Nobody's perfect and you won't always feel God's love through every attendee, but you also shouldn't expect that since every attendee is at a different stage in their walk of faith.

3. You are able to serve.

You are very welcome to serve!  They are not strict, but they do require you to show commitment (and as they should).  This is also a great way to love your fellow brothers and sisters and get to know members of the church better, so please do come and make this your church as well.

I'm thankful that God has made something really good come out of this.  I was struggling to decide if I should stay at this church, but I remembered the words of my previous pastor and thank God that He brought me here as indeed all 3 key criteria are met.  Looks like I will be staying!

I was taught you should always give a church at least 3 tries, if after 3 tries it still doesn't fulfil all 3 factors then move on.  I'm very glad I came back as indeed it got much better after the 3rd time.

If you've experienced some of the issues I had below, please come and find me or one of the longstanding members of the church.  My name's in the review ;)  Or ask for Alight Tsai (M) or I-Shen Lai (F).  Please don't just leave without saying hi!

9/27/15 - Just visited this church for the very first time. I didn't actively try to make myself known but I may as well have been invisible. Ignored by everyone and even the ushers/people welcoming at the door didn't say a word to me. It wasn't busy at the time I walked in either.

It's such a shame as the teaching is very solid but, given that the sermon said that loving one another was the sign of having new life in Christ, it's disheartening to feel absolutely no love for shy newcomers who didn't know anyone. At the end of the service, everyone just walked straight passed me, each talking to their own group of friends. I left, the only words exchanged with me in my entire 2hrs there having been me saying "thank you" when the usher wordlessly handed me a pamphlet at the door.

So disappointed and saddened. Today is mid autumn festival, I was really hoping to find a good church family. I rate this church 2 stars as the teaching really is solid. I strongly suggest to everyone should visit 5his church once. You will come back again. Gorgeous church, easy parking nearby,

name: Celebration Church
Celebration Church - Jacksonville (Southside) Campus
reviewSummary:
Love my church and my pastor!! My family has been EXTREMELY blessed to call this church our HOME! We are a diverse group of Bible-believing Christians that seek the Lord beyond Sunday. I have been challenged, grown and molded in my time at Celebration through dedicated leaders of Bible study and other courses and classes offered. I serve in kids ministry and I know that the volunteers genuinely love and care for those babies with the love of Jesus. I praise God every day for my church family and I pray protection over our leaders and body physically, spiritually and mentally. Celebration Church was the final church I attended in Jacksonville before heading back home to Virginia Beach, Virginia, and what a great church to end that season with. If I had known it was only about 19 minutes away, there would have been many Sundays where I would have split my time between Celebration and the Church of Eleven22 campuses.
The worship music was incredible. In my opinion, very few churches have compared to the energy I experienced at 2819, but Celebration came close. It felt like a full-fledged concert for Christ from beginning to end. The worship was alive, powerful, and full of passion.
I had seen Pastor Tim Timberlake on Instagram and watched some of his reels before attending. I already knew he spoke well, but hearing him in person was different. He preaches with passion, boldness, and volume. He is not timid about the Word, and he does not seem concerned with people’s opinions. I appreciated when he said, “Don’t ask me, go to the Word. Don’t believe what I say.” That is the kind of preaching people need — bold, biblical, and pointing people back to Scripture instead of personality.
The people were also great. While I was sitting with my service dog, a lady named Frenchy came over, sat down, and asked if she could join me at the table. Of course, I said yes. Frenchy, shout out to you and your son. You were both great people. In a time when I needed fellowship, camaraderie, and simple human kindness, you listened, were polite, and made me feel welcomed.
There was also a man whose name I cannot remember, but he wore a cowboy hat. He brought me coffee and helped seat me in a place that was convenient for me and my service dog. He was also an Army veteran, and I appreciated the brotherhood and hospitality. Thank you, bro.
Celebration Church left a strong impression on me. Great worship, great preaching, great people, and real hospitality. I cannot wait to come back into town, hopefully with friends or family, and introduce them to the people and church we talked about.
Keep preaching the Word. I decided to visit this church during a time when I was trying to reconnect with my faith after having drifted away for a while. At first, I appreciated how digestible everything felt, it’s definitely an easy place for newcomers to step into without feeling overwhelmed.
However, when I made the decision to pursue baptism, I was surprised by how informal and unstructured the process felt. It seemed like something you could simply sign up for and complete after a service and then drive home without much guidance, preparation, or spiritual authority. For me, this was a deeply significant step, and I found myself longing for more direction, tradition, and spiritual grounding.
Over time, I also found it difficult to connect with the overall tone of the services, especially the sermons. They often felt crafted more around relatability, humor, and keeping the audience engaged than around reverence or a deep, scripture centered message. The frequent jokes and casual tone made it harder for me to experience the sense of sacredness and reflection that I personally believe church calls for. I guess I was hoping for something more rooted in tradition and exploration of the more challenging aspects of faith. Most of the sermons are just the pastor telling you what you can do to receive bigger blessings, which I do not believe is the fullness of the church.
The use of pop style music, teleprompters, and the overall presentation style further contributed to this feeling that the church is more focused on optics than reverence. Instead of being drawn into a space of reverence and contemplation, I often felt like I was attending something designed more to entertain an audience than to spiritually ground us.
Ultimately, I realized I was looking for a more structured and deeply rooted expression of faith. This led me to return to the Catholicism, where I feel a stronger sense of tradition, guidance, and reverence in worship.
I truly believe this church may be a great fit for those who are new to faith, but ultimately there is really no spiritual authority held at this facility and if you plans to grow in your faith, I would use this church as a steppingstone to do so. The message was “Hidden in Plain Sight “
It was good to be home and to take time to have and experience in our growth of being believers.

name: Central Christian Church - Lexington Campus
reviewSummary: Very rude volunteers who will interrupt you and your social worker Terri Jo is a liar. She offered to come bring  food after work and shop at the pantry, knowing I didn't have transportation at the time and promised a $100 check to help offset rent costs to be sent out the following Tuesday. She never showed up. I called for 3 WEEKS and couldn't get an answer. Begged the volunteers to get a message to her and was told she'll get it when she gets it. Saying they're just too overwhelmed. They told me they didn't have a check on file. Leaving me very confused and was promised the minister would make it right by a volunteer. Then DAYS later after calling and calling and calling Terri Jo is on the phone and I politely asked if it slipped her mind and she told me the conversation never happened and said she wasn't even allowed to leave the property. She gaslit me and treated me like I was crazy. Then had the nerve to ask if I talked to another church. In fact, I didn't. You all not only caused issues with food insecurity while my job wasn't paying me, it also caused my rent to lapse after being falsely promised help. I have a court date coming over this. You all should be ashamed of yourselves! As a homeless transgender addict in recovery, I was welcomed into a small group that included many extremely successful and influential individuals, and was asked my opinion regarding local issues and concerns in the community. I was treated with respect and dignity in my time of need, and although I asked for nothing I believe that they would have given me the shirts off of their backs. I was not the only transgender individual attending, and even though I've only visited twice I would recommend this church for the warmth and friendly behavior of their members. Worship was appropriate and the sermon was easy to follow. Full spread lunch was served after one of the sermons I attended. No one bothered me for using the ladies room, either. Went here to God's pantry I was told by God pantry I wouldn't be discriminated against but was highly discriminated against because I did have sigils tattooed on my hands which was part of the reason why I told God's pantry I didn't want to go to a church will not be back because at the end of the day Christians are supposed to be welcoming with open arms and I definitely was not It hit or miss on finds little treasures. Mostly modern clothing and jewelry.  A good place to find unique earrings and pins and necklaces. This place is not helpful at all. They are more worried about being nosey then helping people ! ! ! The dont even listen just talk over you and be dismissive! ! ! The women i spoke with on the phone for was rude and very non helpful with providing information. I called to get help with rent and utility assistance due to 211 giving me their information for help. Well according to the older woman working in Human Resources I believe her name was debraoh, they don’t offer utilities services, and will not help with rent if they dont want to. After she rudely made loud noises on the phone and said the chruch couldnt help , she proceeded to ask me unnecessary questions like “ how i was going to pay my rent going forward “and “ if i had a job why i cant pay my bills” word from word what she said. Obviously im calling to get help and will figure out the rest later i can only worry about today not next month. What is the point of asking thoughs questions if you cant help me other the just being nosey. According to other review doesnt seem like they help the community AT ALL!

name: Central Church of Christ
Central Church of Christ - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary:
My name is Armanda M. Roberts Wisman.
I am the only child of Harry Roberts Jr & Willie Mae Roberts.
We first attended this church in 1972 where i had my 3rd birthday party in the nursery of the church.
My father Harry was then stationed at Camp Pendleton base when he was a Marine.

I needed for all to know this as it is close to my heart, and these beautiful building that holds all the great treasures of God.

To all who took the time to read this " Thank You"
This IS the church to truly learn Gods word, and not man's.

If anyone who needs to reach me ?
I'm on Facebook as Armanda Maria Roberts Wisman please contact me there 😊
To my church family I LOVE YOU ALL.

God bless you
Armanda, my hubby Jack,
My dad Harry's grandchildren Sonti Carl, Isaac Walters, and great grandson Vincent W. 💛 Best church in the world! Great church!

name: Central City Lutheran Mission
Central City Lutheran Mission - San Bernardino Campus
reviewSummary:
PROS
- They took me in during a time of an emergency
- They feed you Breakfest and Dinner
- You can take a shower everyday
CONS
- I was there for 3 days and was targeted by a few  people in there. Someone stole my clothes and was hated on because I had a job and car.
-If something comes up missing they are not responsible.
- They close you in where the bunks are with no outside air coming in or AC. This is how people get sick from others.

I thank God he was with me and allowed me to endure what I did. But I also thank Lutheran for allowing me to be there during an emergency time in my life.
God Is Good All The Time First , THIS IS A MENS ONLY SHELTER.
Unless things changed.

Also ,this was my experience at the time.
Maybe things have changed.....

Personal Pros

Better than no shelter at all.
You can sleep, clean yourself , get food and coffee in morning . Felt reasonably safe from violence.  You can keep a small amount of stuff there.

Personal Cons

Best for people who have almost nothing.
They have rules which can make an overall
decent , law abiding , freedom - loving person feel uncomfortable , and possibly
``less - than " , as if the place is for ex -cons and the mentally unstable.
Rules like daily  metal detection involving taking off ones belt .
They also require you to wear a mask and take your temperature before you enter premises, and they may comment if you don't have it on. You can get mail there, but , they put it on a common area table , that anyone has access to.
Apparently ,   they trust you not to steal mail , but , not enough to let you walk inside sleeping area without metal detection.
They have a weird rule about no bags inside sleeping area. Only one clear plastic bag for hygiene. Not good for some who keeps a lot of plastic bags to protect personal property
from moisture, and other potential damage .
Had important papers get damaged due to rain and wear .  The only shift you can work is a morning shift to the best of my knowledge.
This is said to keep from disrupting others.

Nothing christian about this place aside from it once being a church. This place gets funding from the government and seems to
lean towards government - style beuracracy.
That is good for enforcing repeatable, constructive rules and policies, but bad if one feels the policies and rules are not the best or  are counter - productive, due to rigidity.
I personally wish they only called it central city mission, and lost the Lutheran part.
Seems misleading in my opinion.
Again, best for men with close to nothing.
For men who are overlall , law - abiding  and freedom loving , it can feel unnecessarily complicated , in a way which negatively affects morale and self - esteem. This haven is such a blessing to so many men, including myself.
There are times when we can NOT do it alone, and we don't want to ask other people for the help.
Greatfully, there are establishments such as this in existence.

Thank you to all the people making LSSSC happen. It is a place to eat shower sleep. It is also a place to get on your feet. You get 90 days. In that time if you find work and do it right. You can have cash in your pocket at the end of 90 days. The office staff are very helpful and have great hearts. If you really want help they do all they can for you. Yes some RVs feel they are more then they are. But not all of them do. Rules are not hard not a lot to handle yes I am a RV here as well as a client. This is a shelter for men only so I've never had any personal contact with them outside of food giveaways which were pretty good..  I do know a few men that have or currently reside at the homeless shelter and have said that the RV's which are shelter residents  that work around the place in order to be able to stay on the grounds while everyone else have to leave for the day, are very disrespectful and mean to the other residents there. They taunt them and have thrown objects that the other residents need onto the floor and made them pick them up if they wanted it. I won't continue to go on about that although there is so much more to speak on about this issue. I've spoken to some of the guys there or were there that are giving me their written statements about their mistreatment by the RVs which will be forwarded to the proper management.. One of the guys left the shelter not having a place to sleep because of the mistreatment..  I feel that something should be done because it is unfair.

reviewSummary: Champion is very welcoming to new members. One can find a sense of community, fellowship and practical stewardship in this space. What an Amazing church! Trevor is such a relatable pastor, and so funny. He reminds me of the Christian comedian John Christ. I love the fact that church is so into philanthropy!! Champion Church is being the hands and feet of Jesus in Saint Johns County!!. We absolutely love Champion Church! The care and connection we receive is like no other. My kids are plugged in and growing in their walk with God. It’s where  our family feels at home. Champion Church has been a true blessing in our lives! From Spirit-led worship to powerful, Scripture-based messages, every service draws us closer to God. Our Pastor and his wife radiate kindness and are true down to earth people, and their heart for the church and helping others is truly undeniable. My boys absolutely love Champion Kids, where they’re growing in their faith through engaging, Christ-centered teaching. This isn’t just a church—it’s a family rooted in God’s Word, and we’re so grateful the Lord led us here! I’ve been looking for a proper church for many years, and never found one that would help fill the gaps in my heart completely… it always felt like there was a hole that still needed to be filled… a few months ago my wife found this church and she tried inviting me multiple times, but I was always too busy to attend… you know how they say the Lord works in mysterious ways. My first sermon at Champion, I felt like it was directed towards me… and at the end of the service… I felt at peace for the first time in many years. I’m so grateful to have found a church where I can finally feel welcomed and comfortable. Thank you Lord for this wonderful blessing!!! And thank you Champion for all you do!!! I had to drop out shortly after begining my second stage classes so I can't speak for the whole process but I do know that I will return one day sooner rather than later. They also offer "scholarships" for people who can't afford the classes but the classes are already only $8 so please don't take advantage of their generosity as the little money they ask for is what funds the place so if you can afford it give them more than they ask for. The people running the volunteer side of this food giveaway are anything but genuine or godly. They treat volunteers terribly and routinely hand out old, expired items—cakes, cheese, and other foods that are clearly molded and well past their expiration dates, which is a serious health code violation.

Many volunteers are there because they themselves are in need, or they know someone who is. Yet this place offers little compassion or integrity. I cannot recommend volunteering here, and if you're coming for food, be aware that much of it is inedible.

Elvira and the guy posing to be a deacon should be ashamed of how they treat people here. Cherry Carson Assembly of God Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
I recently attended a food bank hosted by this church last Sunday. While I’m very grateful for the food provided, my overall experience was unfortunately negative. We were required to wait for about three hours in 85° weather, and were told we couldn’t begin unless everyone first sat inside the chapel. During this time, the pastor was yelling at attendees and came across as very rude and, at times, physically intrusive. I personally began experiencing an asthma attack due to the heat and stepped outside to catch my breath. When I did, I was questioned in a way that felt dismissive and lacked compassion, even after explaining my situation. I believe a church should be a welcoming and supportive environment, especially when serving the community. While I appreciate the resources provided, the way people were treated made the experience uncomfortable and disheartening. reviewSummary:
I recently attended a food bank hosted by this church last Sunday. While I’m very grateful for the food provided, my overall experience was unfortunately negative. We were required to wait for about three hours in 85° weather, and were told we couldn’t begin unless everyone first sat inside the chapel. During this time, the pastor was yelling at attendees and came across as very rude and, at times, physically intrusive. I personally began experiencing an asthma attack due to the heat and stepped outside to catch my breath. When I did, I was questioned in a way that felt dismissive and lacked compassion, even after explaining my situation. I believe a church should be a welcoming and supportive environment, especially when serving the community. While I appreciate the resources provided, the way people were treated made the experience uncomfortable and disheartening. We fell on some financial troubles despite working and attending school.We thank the most high God for allowing these volunteers to take the time to give generously to those in need. This place has  been helpful to our family. Thank you all. Periodically, I go there after my own church service for free food and produce on Sunday afternoons. It is open to the public and I wear my mask because it is open to anyone who has a need, including homeless people.

The volunteers are supportive as much as possible. The actual church service is kinda good. But afterwards all people that want food donation services stay in the sanctuary’s for about 45minutes and they need someone there to control irate homeless guys a little better, if they get out of line . They need to be conscious on how they treat people who receive food services bcuz everyone isn’t homeless or ignorant! I’ll probably never return. They are crooks, my mother sent 50 dollars to me, sent it to them to pick up, and now all I do is get hung up on over and over talk about stealing from the homeless, this was a christmas present. Do not trust them stealing from the homeless!!!!!! You people should be ashamed just take everything from people that have nothing. People call themselves christians! What a joke Blows my mind how they have good reviews! But if you notice there from years ago not sure what happened but do yourself a favor and steer clear COA, The mission now they are people that care they dont steal from people that have nothing to start with. I needed that money to get lice shampoo and get my clothes and blankets washed so I can get rid of this nasty infection and they steel it honestly breaks my heart how places can call themselves churches and christians its beyond me.

Chinese Community Baptist Church - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a small church with mostly native Mandarin speakers middle age and up. It is easy to get to know people.

Pastor James Yeh preaches good sermons in Mandarin and there is  an English translator. He is very personable and friendly.

The worship music is upbeat with a mixture of Mandarin and English praise melodies and a traditional hymn or two.

name: Chino United Methodist Church
Chino United Methodist Church - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary: How can you review a church in Google Maps? This is one of the oldest in Chino, and has for over 110 years been a home to Methodists and their like in the area. The Church is of the Mission style and recently remodeled after a fire. The organ is magnificent for a medium-sized church. The 2-story  large side building was once a school, but has been under-used for many years as church attendance declined. The members are open and warm, and have regular pot-lucks, Christian education, and one of the oldest continuous Boy Scout Troops in the area. Other Christian churches and organizations use the facilities for out reach and services too. Very welcoming church, not a large church but that’s what makes it so warm and reassuring. Sadly I do not go to services here anymore (live to far now) but anytime I’m in the area I try to stop in for one if there informative services. Neat old building.  Their pastor was enjoyable to listen to. A church with family of faithful followers filled with love. Very nice congenial people

name: Chino Valley Community Church
Chino Valley Community Church - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
One of the most loving and welcoming churches I've ever attended. CVCC, church family love each others, spread the love from God.
If you are close to this church, try to attend the bible study, Garry Miler offered clearly and deep bible study; the music worship team also do the great job;  miss the time we stayed there. God bless all ! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

From the moment you step into Chino Valley Community Church (CVCC) you can feel the genuine warmth and welcoming atmosphere. It’s not just a place to worship, but a community where everyone, regardless of their background, is greeted with open arms. Their fellowship programs are exceptional, offering numerous opportunities for members to connect, grow, and serve together. The sermons by Pastor Brian Benson are both thought-provoking and spiritually enriching, with messages that resonate in today’s world. The worship team is on point with amazing songs to prepare your heart before Pastor Brain Benson delivers his messages inspired by the Lord. It’s evident that the pastoral team is deeply committed to nourishing the spiritual growth of its congregation. I especially love the cafe which offers freshly brewed coffee, donuts, bagels, drinks and more.  When you’re running late or have kids on the go, the cafe saves the day. The best part about the cafe is you’re allowed to bring in your drinks and food into the sanctuary. CVCC is a down-to-earth church,  exudes a comforting and welcoming environment.  I love to worship and have my morning coffee all in one.  For anyone looking for a church that truly feels like a home and offers meaningful connections, CVCC in Chino Hills is a top recommendation.  God Bless you!  See you there. Sunday’s 9:00am or 10:45am. Lots of activities to fit in different life stages. At CVCC, me and my family have been blessed with love by the sisterhood and brotherhood. We love the classes of Fundamental Faith and the Financial Peace class by Dave Ramsey. We have grown both spiritually and physically to be strong. Our home church! We love this place. Friendly, welcoming, a ton of ministries for everyone and a fantastic outreach. Great kids programs as well. This is an amazing church here in the Chino Valley.  Come and worship with us!!!!

name: CHOC Children's Hospital Sacred Space & Interfaith Ministry
CHOC Children's Hospital Sacred Space & Interfaith Ministry - Main Campus
Christ Cathedral
Christ Cathedral - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary:
Today I had the opportunity to visit Christ Cathedral and learn about its incredible history. ⛪️

I’m grateful not only to experience such a beautiful place, but also for the staff who took the time to show me around and share the story behind it. Hearing the history and seeing it through a different perspective made the visit even more meaningful.

Moments like these remind me how important it is to slow down, learn, and appreciate the people who help keep history alive. Thankful for the experience, the photos, and the memories made today. 🙏 TikTok/ Instagram:MABO.TRAILS A beautiful venue to experience a rich part of American Christianity and what God can do. It is a Catholic Church now but seeing what it was prior and the history of what makes it special was unique and breath taking. The Catholics have honored the memory of all those that took part in designing the original and building it. (With their own changes for the needs of the church met) while keeping it as original as possible. It shows unity between denominations. Crean Tower at Christ Cathedral is a stunning landmark and an absolute must-visit in Garden Grove. Its elegant design and impressive height make it stand out beautifully against the surrounding campus. The peaceful atmosphere, well-kept grounds, and unique architecture create a memorable experience whether you come for photos, reflection, or simply to admire the beauty of the cathedral complex. Highly recommended for anyone visiting the area A stunning church that captivates with its architecture and style. A peaceful place great for pausing and reflecting on your life.

Lots of space - inside and outside bring your camera to take some good shots. There’s plenty of parking but I walked from my hotel. Beautiful Cathedral,  I left with a very peaceful heart. After every single incounter with Gods presence after Mass. If you have the time to attend at least once before easter it would be so beautiful.  The regular Mass is in 4 languages Vietnamese, Spanish, English and Chinese.

name: Christ Church Cathedral
Christ Church Cathedral - Main Campus
Christ Church Greenwich
Christ Church Greenwich - Main Campus
Christ Church Los Angeles
Christ Church Los Angeles - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
A fantastic church and lovely welcoming community. When I arrived I was met with a vibrant and diverse group of people. Everyone made a real effort to make me feel at home even when it was my first time there. And they succeeded!

Services include great, biblically sound, teaching that is applicable to daily life, well thought out songs and prayers, and a talented worship team.

I can’t recommended checking out this church enough! We’ve been part of this church community for the past four years, and it has truly become a second home for our family. From the moment we walked through the doors, we were welcomed with such warmth and kindness. The people here are genuine, caring, and truly invested in building a strong, supportive community.

Pastor Ken’s sermons are a consistent highlight—thoughtful, deeply rooted in scripture, and always relevant. His teaching challenges and encourages us every week, and we’re so grateful for the wisdom and heart he brings to the pulpit.

Another incredible part of the church is the thriving kids ministry. Our three children (ages 7, 4, and 2) absolutely love attending. They’ve made wonderful friends and are always excited to go—something we’re so thankful for as parents.

If you’re looking for a church that feels like family, where you’ll be spiritually fed and your kids will thrive, this is it. My wife and I have been attending for almost a year now and we love this church. The people are friendly, the staff is very caring, and the total experience (sermons, prayer meetings, mid-week Bible studies) are very edifying to us. A great little faithful church with a welcoming posture towards visitors - I would highly encourage anyone to visit. Christ Church Los Angeles fosters a warm, inclusive environment with powerful sermons and authentic community. Great place to grow in faith and build meaningful relationships. I have grown tremendously as a Christian even in less than a year of attending Christ Church. Our pastors give faithful, nuanced, and practical deep dives into scripture, and our congregation is strong and diverse -- embracing all Christians (and even non-Christians) and are sincerely supportive and curious about each of its members and their individual journeys.

name: Christ Church Plano
Christ Church Plano - Plano Campus
reviewSummary:
We enjoyed our visit on Sunday July 5th and felt right at home. Very friendly and welcoming. They had a very nice playground for kids. I’ve been going since February and I love it. From being greeted at the door to taking holy communion, everything and everyone is Christ centered. The Sanctuary is beautiful, the children’s facilities are great. We are very blessed to have such a great church in our community. Welcome to church in Rivendell. Are you too Catholic for Protestants but also too Protestant for Catholics? Are you tired of Ted-Talk sermons and rock-band worship? Want to put some church back in your church? CCP might just be the place for you.

The architecture of the main sanctuary looks to be of elvish origin,  attested to by the green and gold theme and simple elegance of it all. It brings in the feel of a traditional cathedral but with a modern minimalist twist. I truly enjoy seeing the clear blue Texas skies and rolling clouds ⛅️ through the filtered windows as I worship.

The sermons are relevant for today but with a traditional liturgy and excellent music ministry that ties you back into your connection with church history. The people are very friendly. The clergy all come from diverse theological backgrounds, but all have found their place and home at CCP. All of them are very approachable, collar and all.

They have an excellent children and youth ministry that our kids have enjoyed thoroughly. Bring a dollar on Wednesday nights for the pizza served to the 4th - 12th graders.

There are many ministries that reach the local community and beyond.

We have been taking their foundations class and have really enjoyed it. Every class begins with a fellowship lunch together. We've not been going here for very long but have found that people already know us by name.

If you want to dip your toe back into the traditional church scene, I truly do recommend giving this church a try. Great church to go to regardless of denomination. Incredibly friendly and welcoming, and the music and staff are excellent. Attended a wedding here. The church was beautiful, clean and full of natural light. The fellowship hall was spacious and turned into a beautiful reception venue. There is tons of parking and the seats were comfortable.

name: Christ Church Santa Clarita
Christ Church Santa Clarita - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary: My family has been attending Christ Church for more than 10 years -- we were married here and our children were born and baptized here. We are so thankful to raise our family in this community and participate in beautiful, powerful worship every week. This church is one of the most integral parts of my life and it's the main reason why we're staying in Santa Clarita. As a visitor who is acquainted with many Christ Church families, I can attest that this is a wonderful and unique church community, full of quality people.  Pastor Garrett Craw tells it like it is, speaks with wisdom and authority, and demonstrates real pastoral care for his flock. I enjoyed attending this Seventh Day Adventist Church with a good friend. It is a nice group of people, and they seem to care not just for each other but for yet others, and they care about the place that the Bible has in teaching and instruction. Great like-minded leadership, beautiful music, reverent but enthusiastic worship, biblical teaching, traditional liturgy, diverse ages and backgrounds. This place is not safe especially for children.  I'm attached pictures to clarify.  Look through others posts as well.

name: Christ Church Tallahassee
Christ Church Tallahassee - Tallahassee Campus
reviewSummary: We found this Church after a power-hungry bishop destroyed our Anglican Church that had been the focus or our religious life for 20 years. It made us realize that it has been bishops who have caused problems in all churches over the centuries. This Church provides us with the beautiful Anglican liturgy without the need to pay homage to unscrupulous and arrogant bishops. Most importantly, the clergy are caring, intelligent priests who provide incredible sermons every Sunday. What an incredible blessing Christ Church has been! I have been away from a religious life for decades. After I met and married Linda, we joined this church as it was forming and this had given us both tremendous blessings. The church family is small and very special. I have grown tremendously in my renewed faith and treasure this church and the closeness of our members. A loving, warm environment with kind, caring congregation. We are very blessed to have found Christ Church. A truly loving church for our family. May God continue to bless this sweet parish. Excellent family Worship in the Anglican tradition.

name: Christ City
Christ City - West Palm Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Christ City Church has truly impacted my life in such a powerful way. Even though I’ve only been there for a couple of months, I already feel so welcomed and spiritually refreshed. From the worship to the Word, I genuinely feel the presence of the Holy Spirit every time I attend.
I’m so grateful for the leaders who serve with love, wisdom, and dedication. Thank you for creating a place where the Holy Spirit moves freely.
I am truly happy and blessed to be part of this church family 🤍✨ this is home 🏡 This ministry truly reflects the Spirit of God. From the way God’s Word is taught and displayed, to how the members are stewarded, God is evidenced at this church. I visit from time to time solely because of the distance, but if you’re looking for a Bible teaching church home, I highly recommend checking it out. I am very disappointed in this church. Two times I have been promised transportation to visit. Both times, nobody has contacted me or shown up for transport. They took my name, number, and address. Then they ghosted me. Twice! My home church, I love everything about it. The atmosphere, the people, the worship, the sermons and especially the presence of the Holy Spirit in this place. Also they do community outreach in west palm beach which is a plus for me i enjoy going out and serving!

name: Christ Community Church - Fort Myers Campus

name: Christ Community Church - Laguna Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
Biblical Christian Church Best balance I’ve seen with solid truth, taught and practiced with love by gracious members.  Teaching is meaty and applicable.

Highly rated preschool during the week.

I’ve been attending for about 2 years now and my family and I love it. Great for all ages.

People who are just looking to check the box on Sunday’s every once and a while may even find that being part of an authentic Church family is quite a bit more rewarding than attending a event from time to time.

Please do keep in mind, no church is perfect; if you happen to find one it won’t be anymore after you (or I)  join 😊 For clarification of the churches response to my review, in Matthew 18, the Bible guides protocols for addressing concerns within a church. The first step is to address the issue privately with an individual involved, so I brought my concern regarding teaching yoga to a leader of the Women’s Ministry. Then I addressed the head of this ministry (now having two witnesses regarding this matter of concern). She informed me that the elders were consulted regarding the teaching of yoga during the Women’s Retreat and that all elders have vetted this practice.
Next I emailed the Senior Pastor twice who responded “While I certainly agree with your general theological position I don’t share your particular concern regarding Yoga class… we have vast freedoms in Christ.”
Since there is no indication on your website that teaching yoga has been approved by the Senior Pastor and elders, based on Deuteronomy 12:30–31 I felt compelled to alert those who want to honor these verses and not attend a church that integrates or mixes with other “religious” practices. I wrote the review to bring awareness for those who have discernment and try to honor all of God’s Holy Word. A pastor's primary biblical duty is to serve as an "overseer" or "shepherd" who guards the church against outside spiritual influences and no where is this information available on your website. I was also informed that I was not the only one who had brought this concern to the church elders.

ORIGINAL REVIEW:
Caution, for those who understand the warnings of God's Word regarding NOT incorporating other religious practices into a Christ-based church please be aware that this church has vetted the practice of yoga into their women's retreats.
After bringing up my concerns, I was informed that the elders and pastors have approved of teaching yoga yet they will change the name from "yoga class" to "stretch class" because others have brought up the same concern. Changing the title does not change the truth of the eastern religious origin of yoga (so-called modern yoga still has its origin in eastern mysticism and Hindu "deities").
Isn't it wise to not risk incorporating controversial teachings into a supposedly Bible-based church? God's Word warns against even the appearance of associating with practices that honor other spiritual beliefs.
Romans 12:1-2, "Therefore, I urge you, brothers and sisters, in view of God's mercy, to offer your bodies as a living, sacrifice, holy and pleasing to God - this is your true and proper worship. Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what God's will is - His good, pleasing and perfect will." We’ve been attending CCCLH since July 2024. We love it! The sermons are solid Bible teaching including relevant historical and philosophical perspectives. The building facility is clean and functional with tons of space for all activities, the adult Sunday classes are top notch, our children enjoy their classes and the worship music is so good you worry they’ll leave and sign a record deal! Tons of opportunities to serve and ways to minister (or be ministered to). They also occasionally offer classes for topics such as Biblical Counseling and Parenting. Defiantly recommend this amazing community  to all of my believer friends.  It is a blessing to be a member of this church. I joined the community almost a year ago, and everyone has been super loving and welcoming. It has an awesome positive energy that makes you want t come back again. I am so great full and thankful  that I have the opportunity to hear the true word. Also, I would love to invite everyone to check out our website. We have all kinds of sources to educate our members in every aspects of our Jesus Christ. Such a beautiful picture of a healthy church. The preaching is biblically and theologically solid, and is entertaining and life-giving. The people are kind and welcoming, always willing to engage with you– even if you’re a new face. The music is a harmonious blend of both contemporary music and hymns. There’s a wide range of ages from the elderly to young adults. There are many church events and ministries to serve in and outreach is a growing heart in the church.

If you’re looking for a place to learn about what a healthy church looks like, or if you want to join a solid community, I highly recommend visiting Christ Community.

reviewSummary: Local here.  I’ll tell you my experience. The sermon is more about delivering you to the voting booth, than it is to heaven. name: Christ Episcopal Church Downtown Campus
Christ Fellowship Church - Downtown
Christ Fellowship Church - Downtown - Miami (Downtown/Brickell) Campus
reviewSummary:
I absolutely love my church. I’ve been attending since 2011. Pastor Rick Blackwood and his team were transformational for me. The new team of Pastor Omar, Carlos, Gideon, Tucker and others are filling those giant shoes nicely. I’ve grown so much of the years and I’m so grateful that I found this place. Not sure what rating to give this church. Attended for the first time this past Sunday, and while the message was honest and to my knowledge Biblically sound, I was slightly concerned at the lack of prayer. When the only prayer is the call to salvation and a flashy blessing at the end but there is no constant and humble communication throughout the service thanking God and reflecting all glory back to Him — I wonder, is the church and the worship team receiving the glory?  You are merely a vessel and should act more like one. This is my personal experience.
🚩1.Your not greeted when you enter, your immediately asked for your bag. To check for drugs or weapons
🚩2.There is no “physical” pastor, it’s a live visual electronically on a screen.
🚩3. Within a minute of me sitting down, a man came right in front of me and took a few picture’s. no there was not a single person sitting behind me all the way back. So that was very strange to me.
Again this is just my personal experience. It felt weird the moment I entered and it seems more like a rehearsal, versus an actual church. I’m not aware of the show that was being put on, but it definitely rubbed me the wrong way. The atmosphere didn’t feel very welcoming and I think there should be a disclaimer everywhere for any church.If there is not a physical pastor in it. When I go to church, I’m going there for the word of God. I want to be in Gods presence and physically hear from the preacher. The preacher is going to not only speak the word but feed off of the other energy and spirits in the place. Giving the word or the message that we may personally all need. So I did not stay long.
God bless anyone who does go to this church, it just wasn’t for me. Have a blessed day Absolutely an amazing church.   It’s Bible based  it’s a very kind loving environment.   We were here visiting.   The worship was top notch.   I suppose the only thing I didn’t like would be the fact that the senior pastor was preaching from the main church so he was on the screen but honestly it was just fine the msg was spot on.       If we lived in Miami this would be our home church.   The set up is perfect.  The safety team was fantastic.   I’m sure they don’t call them that but they were great The most amazing church! We have been coming here for about 13 years and are so happy this branch reopened. The staff, pastors and volunteers are second to none. Im grateful to be plugged in as a volunteer and that all members are encouraged to help be the hands and feet of Christ here. I can attest that the children's ministry and small groups are life-giving. My family and I have been blessed by this church and are so grateful for Pastor Gideon and all the wonderful members. If you are looking for a great church that focuses on God's word and living it out with your family, this is the church for you!

name: Christ Fellowship Church - Palmetto Bay
Christ Fellowship Church - Palmetto Bay - Pinecrest / South Miami Campus
reviewSummary:
Great Christian church. All are welcomed. Have multiple services. Fourth and small groups meet Wednesdays at 7PM at the Palmetto Bay campus and other locations,
Sunday services will be changing so look directly on their website for updated times of services but are commonly on
Sundays English and Spanish
9AM
10:30AM
12:45PM
Awesome secure kids program. I come here with my family for service. Very nice messages, my favorite part is the multiple locations across Miami. They even have live on YouTube and you can see past services. The best part is small groups on Wednesdays, they even provide child care. I visited this campus for the first time. The pastor and worship was great! The people and staff not so welcoming, nor friendly. On the contrary, when I visited the West Kendall staff, they greeted me and  were super welcoming. It's a wonderful church with lots of kind loving members albeit really BIG! The best church ever! I felt the holy spirit instantly in this church! All the pastors are amazing and they make you connect to the message!

I had to move out of state and all i think about is my church right here! Miss it dearly

God bless this church and all the staffs

name: Christ Fellowship Church in Boca Raton, FL
Christ Fellowship Church in Boca Raton, FL - Boca Raton Campus
reviewSummary: What a wonderful church! We'd been attending the main campus at Palm Beach Gardens for several months before trying out the Boca Campus and finding this church family so close to home has been a huge value add to our lives. From our very first Sunday we felt warmly welcomed and genuinely included. The people are so friendly and the campus staff team are top notch! So grateful to have checked them out and now we have a new church home. If you're looking for a church in the area, I'm certain you won't be disappointed with Christ Fellowship Boca. Christ fellowship church has great people music and prayer. From the moment you enter their service you are welcomed and included. Kids and adults love it and we will continue to return. Feels so great to be there every Sunday Today was my first Sunday attending Christ fellowship at the Boca Raton location.  Everyone was very friendly and welcoming. I loved the look and feel of the actual church and the live worship music was great. I currently attend another Christian church and wanted to try this one out. I do have a few “cons” if you will. There were no Bibles to be seen. The actual sermon was not a live human preaching in the church. It was on a TV screen where they showed a recording of a service from their main church in Palm Beach Gardens. They said it was live, but was clearly recorded and shown at each service time. They also did not do communion. When I go to a church I really want to see the message in person live with a pastor that’s right there. Other than that it seems like a lovely place. Absolutely amazing up and coming church in the area! All Christ Fellowship locations are awesome but definitely must check this one out. I can not recommend it enough! Everyone is so welcoming/friendly and there are ways for everyone to get connected regardless of their age or stage in their spiritual journey. If you haven’t been you’re 100% missing out. Christ Fellowship makes you feel part of a family with lots of love since you first step in. The joy of seeing so many new people each week thirsty for the word of God. The children excited just to be there not only on Sunday, but on Wednesday night for the youth. We love our Pastor and the his lovely wife that is ready to serve you. The classes are so well taught to help you grow more in your walk with Jesus. Love serving there and can see the work of the Lord growing.

name: Christ Fellowship Church Tampa
Christ Fellowship Church Tampa - Tampa (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
A Truly Welcoming Experience — A New Home in Faith.

I recently visited this church for the first time, and it was hands down the most welcoming experience I’ve had in from a church in Tampa. From the moment I stepped in, I felt embraced by a sense of warmth, kindness, and genuine community.

Everyone I met was inviting and sincere, and it didn’t feel like I was walking into a new place — it felt like I was coming home. There was a true sense of family here, and I could feel the presence of God in the way people treated one another. This is exactly the kind of community I’ve been praying for.

As Romans 15:7 says, “Therefore welcome one another as Christ has welcomed you, for the glory of God.” This church lives that out beautifully. I’m thankful to have found this fellowship and look forward to calling it my new home as I continue growing in faith and walking with others in their paths with the Lord.

God is good, all the time! Awesome Church. I go there and I love it. It's not like a family.  They make you feel like real family.  I've met so many people here I connect with outside of church, who check in, who work with me, who hang out outside. I was invited by someone and so happy that I came. Everyone is welcoming and felt right at home from the moment I got out my car. I’ll be back next Sunday. If you are looking for a church please give them a try. Went to church here last Sunday for the first time.  Really enjoyed the music.  Lively and well done. It's actually easy for the congregation to participate with the musicians.  Love this . Many people greeted us, which doesn't usually happen in most churches these days.  Most people spend greeting time talking with those they already know. There was some of that, but a lot greeted all around the auditorium.  The preaching was very good. Easy to follow and understand.

This  is my  church.   Bible based a
and caring. Fantastic sermons from Pastor Paul,  Pastor Jack and

name: Christ in Me Christian Fellowship
Christ in Me Christian Fellowship - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary: Awesome Pastor and Church Community. Excellent Preaching!

name: Christ Journey Church
Christ Journey Church - Coral Gables Campus
reviewSummary:
Every week after the service,  Christ Journey Church encourages members to join a ministry if they feel a calling in their heart. In response to that encouragement, I completed all required steps, including passing the mandatory background check and complying with additional requirements necessary to serve.
However, despite meeting every requirement, I was left completely in the dark. Certain individuals within some ministries chose not to move forward with my participation, yet no explanation was provided no conversation, no feedback, nothing.
This raises an important question: after someone has fully complied with all requirements, why are concerns or issues (if any) not addressed directly with the individual? On what basis are these decisions made appearance, past experiences, personal background, level of faith?.  Are the Ministries in Christ Journey exclusively for some people, and not for others?
I am genuinely asking: What would Jesus do in this situation?
I do not recall Jesus rejecting people without explanation or refusing them the opportunity to grow, serve, or be restored. I believed Christ Journey Church to be a family-oriented church a place to congregate, to find truth, honesty, and love for one another.
Sadly, that has not been my experience.
As a result, I have made the decision to stop attending Christ Journey. Finally, after much searching I found the place for my worship, sharing and service to God, the creator of heaven and earth. Finding others that understand and work together to help one another is amazing. I am in for the "journey". If you need to connect to the Creator, this place will offer you patience and love as you embark on your "journey". Come as you are. I am so happy to have made the decision one sunday to attend this church because i haven’t missed one since. I love this church the praising, praying and ways they teach and guide is amazing really has helped my life in so many ways and will continue to.  My family and I started attending Christ Journey around May of last year. We came from another church where we had been attending for quite a while, but we truly felt we were being called to leave and find another church home. Christ Journey has been that for us 100%. It has brought about healing, the people are so genuine, the preachings are taught in a way that is fresh and exciting while remaining whole and true, and the presence of God is felt in a way I’ve never seen at any church in Miami. This church has been a blessing to my family and I can’t wait to continue to grow in what God has for us! Also, if you have kids, they will absolutely LOVE CJ Kids! The time, consideration, and attention to detail taken with each craft, story, lesson, and event makes us so happy as parents and the kids love every second of it. ❤️ I love my Church community everyone is so friendly and welcoming and I love hearing Pastor Bill preach  you should go by and see for yourself

name: Christ Lincoln
Christ Lincoln - Sumner Campus
Christ Lutheran Church
Christ Lutheran Church - Brea Campus
reviewSummary: Excellent church with two styles of services tastefully done. People are very friendly and the teaching is fantastic. Great church with great people and great leadership!  If you are looking for a church, I highly recommend them! I really enjoy this church. They teach biblical truth. They are very friendly. You can watch online when you can't make it in, but it is really best to go in person and feel God's presence! I had a very warm and welcoming experience at the 10:45 service. It was traditionsl Lutheran with a twist of lightheartedness. Very enjoyable. I will try the 9:15 Praise service next Sunday. Visited today. The facility is nice and people were friendly.  The message was good and the Vicar who spoke was very articulate. I enjoyed the service even though I'm not a Lutheran.

name: Christ Lutheran Church - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary: Nice looking church (inside and outside), friendly people, need more people to fill the pews. GO to church! We attend scout meetings here. Silent movie

name: Christ Lutheran Church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
Family centered and Spirit led church and school.  Wonderful pastor, worship team and school staff. Join us!!! We visited this church while on vacation. It's a very welcoming congregation. The church is beautiful.  The pastor gave a dynamic sermon which I enjoyed.  We attended the 10:30am service which is the contemporary service. I enjoyed it. However, it may not be everyone's cup of tea. They have a traditional service at 8:30am. We didn't attend that service.  If you're passing through give the church a try. I went here in my teenage years and the teachers were absolutely amazing! The level of education I received here has carried on into my adult life. My twin sister and I attended and loved it! We were on the softball team and we were unbeatable the 3 years we were there lol - 6th, 7th and 8th grade. I have fond memories of this lovely school The most welcoming church and school! Kids are thriving here and loving school again. So easy to get connected and become part of the community here. My 3 grandchildren have been attending the school and Churchill and school since pre-school.
Great environment .

name: Christ Lutheran Church - Pacific Beach Campus
reviewSummary: I have recently come to find Christ Lutheran Church after years of feeling allergic to church in general. This is a very warm and welcoming group of people - not pretentious at all! - and they really practice a “come as you are” approach. They are ELCA which means they are committed to living out God’s love for all people, “saint, sinner and seeker.” Different viewpoints and lifestyles are welcome, and they have a very active program supporting our homeless neighbors. Pastor Kindlee is speaks to my heart in her sermons, and it’s amazing to find a kind young woman who is mothering her whole congregation flock in addition to her joint family. They also have a lovely organist who performs classics on their fine pipe organ, and snacks after each service! I'm not a member of the congregation, but I do like to make a pit stop outside to say prayers and thank God for all the wonderful things he does for me and my son. I've had experience here with the staff as well and they are all very sweet and friendly people. The space is beautiful; the congregation is kind and warm and welcoming; Pastor Kinndlee is fantastic! Very welcoming, with a friendly pastor, and congregation. The sermon is always very relevant personally, locally, and globally. The mission to share God’d love is clear. Love this church.  Get there whenever I visit home.  Pastor Dave us awsome! He married us nearly 20 years ago.

name: Christ Lutheran Church - San Clemente Campus
reviewSummary:
Went to see my grandson do his Christmas program.  Couldn't pry the smile off my face, they are so darn cute. Took me back to the day when I was there watching my son doing his Christmas program around 30 years ago. I had lunch with a friend that works there.
The preschool is nice and well kept. 2 Timothy 4:3-4

name: Christ Lutheran Church - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary:
Church employees are nothing short of ridiculous. Harassing people on a PUBLIC sidewalk exercising their first amendment right. The same amendment that gives you the freedom to believe in your little fairy tale. Do not go here. The church members love to exercise thier first amendment right to freedom of religion but hate when other people exercise thier first amendment right to freedom of press. They hate it so much, they accost people on public sidewalks, harrass them and even go so far as to violate the "dont bear false witness" part of the bible by making false legal claims against the very people they themselves are accosting. Big bunch of hypocrites. Go watch the video for yourself if you don't want to take my word, or if the pastor tries to reply with some comment about how I've never gone to his church. No I haven't and I NEVER would because its clear the pastors message isnt reaching his congregation. As a long-time member of this church, I can't say enough good things about our experience here. Our daughter has been part of this community since preschool, and it’s been a wonderful journey watching her grow up in such a supportive environment. The preschool program was fantastic, giving her a strong foundation in both academics and faith. Now, she’s older and going through confirmation, and it’s been amazing to see how her faith is deepening.

The pastors here are genuinely welcoming and knowledgeable, always ready to answer questions and make us feel like part of the family. They truly care about each member of the congregation, and their sermons are both inspiring and thought-provoking. We are so grateful to be part of this church and look forward to many more years here! I love how CLC builds my faith and has wonderful outreach.  Their mission with Pastor JR and the Navajo Nation in Black Mesa, Arizona has a special connection for me and my daughter. I love CLC, I grew up there and my faith in Jesus was strengthened by all the amazing leaders, our pastors, my friends. I thank God for all the amazing experiences from VBS to mission trips where we served wonderful people and helped rebuild broken lives. I LOVE CLC!

name: Christ Lutheran Church and School
Christ Lutheran Church and School - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary: Today was grandparents day.  It was a day of celebration.  A catered breakfast was served.  A visit to your grandchilds classroom, and a program was performed by all the children from preschool to 8th grade. A flyer was given to Coco's.  A percentage was given to the 8th grade for their trip to Washington DC.  Service at Coco's was excellent.  All in all it was a wonderful day. This church is a great place! I do not really follow Christianity, however I do play on occasion with the small music ensemble. One of the church goers is a friend of mine through my old private violin instructor. She had asked me when I was a sophomore in high school if I would contribute to the ensemble, I gladly accepted and have been a part in many wonderful little performances since. The community is great, the vibes are great, the service is very relaxed and filled with  classical, hymnal style church music. If you're ever I'm the area or free on a Sunday morning pop in and stick around for at least the music! Both of my children went here and have done very well in high school and college! We love this place and we also attend church here. Pastor Jonathan Brandenburg is great.! My son is in the 3rd grade and this is his first year at CLS. He was struggling at his previous school with his school work and the only solution they had was to give him an IEP which basically means they just grade him at a lower standard.  When he came to CLS he started to excel almost immediately...no IEP.  The level of the material is even more challenging than in the public school.  The staff, teachers and principle really care about each student and put 110% effort into their success.  The second week at CLS my son came home and said "Mom, there's no bullying at this school like there was at my other school.  Everyone is so nice to each other."  Praise God! And Praise this School! Not a good school. People are mean, we must forgive and forget, but some of the homeroom teachers don't even help when someone is getting bullied. As teachers they should help and be encouraging. They pick favorites and it is very obvious. They don't give second chances and are not helpful in anyway. I don't recommend.

name: Christ Lutheran Church ELCA
Christ Lutheran Church ELCA - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
The Staff and Members at Christ Lutheran Church make up an amazing and welcoming family providing a nurturing and revitalizing atmosphere for worship.

The congregation is involved, rather than a group who show up to go through the motions each Sunday.

The services are a refreshing blend of traditional and contemporary with great music, an inspiring message and incredible fellowship.

The sharing of Peace itself is more like a weekly reunion than I casual shaking of a few hands. This alone can last 10 minutes and includes warm greetings, smiles, hugs and a genuine sharing of affection. We visited once and were hooked! I highly recommend checking it out if your looking for a great place to share God's love and worship among friends. This is my church since high school. Truly my family and a wonderful place to worship. Our new Pastor is awesome. ALL our welcome. I searched for a new church for 4 years after I moved down from the Bay Area. This church is so welcoming to everyone.  It’s a place for all of God’s kids.  So happy I’m here. My church shares the building with the named entity. Our service is @4:30 pm on Sunday and is a different spiritual belief.
The building and grounds are lovely. We are so fortunate to have been welcomed to this church as our  teenage daughter was baptised. Pastor Pam performed this rite with love and spiritual warmth.

name: Christ Lutheran Church-Orange
Christ Lutheran Church-Orange - Orange Campus
reviewSummary:
Went to an NA meeting here. The people were very friendly, I was just in a funky mood. Thank you for many Cristmas Eve Services.  My Aunt and Uncle would have the whole Family Celebrate Christmas at your Church for over 30 years.
Yesterday  was a Service for my Aunt .
Thank you very much for a tribute to my Aunt  and Uncle Christ Lutheran Church or CLC is a small local church in the City of Orange.  It is a great Christian community whose ministries include on site preschool, hosting of local Boy Scout pack and events, as well as Puerta de Paz, Spanish-speaking church.  Come to and visit us today!  Sunday service is at 10:30 AM with refreshments in Mary's House.  Sunday Bible study is at 9:30 AM.  You will be glad you stopped by.  Blessings! Very accepting of all.  This is a church that does a great job representing their faith. Amazing church that accepts all people

name: Christ Lutheran Pre-School
Christ Lutheran Pre-School - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: My littles has been attending here since she was two. Friendly staff and secure school ! Great school with caring teachers and an attentive Director Lisa who always takes time to make sure our needs are taken care of

name: Christ Lutheran Preschool - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary:
We’ve been really happy with our experience here. The teachers and admin staff are so kind and caring, and you can tell they genuinely love working with the kids. Our kids looks forward to going every day, which says a lot. We’ve seen our kids grow so much socially and academically. The staff does a great job communicating with parents and making everyone feel part of the community. They have so many fun outdoor activities and an AMAZING playground.

The school is so loved, and the waitlist is long. A good tip is to start with the Parent-Tot program (once a week) for 2-year-olds., since that helps get you on the priority list. Sign up for full-time if you can. The kids get great care and make the best memories with their friends and teachers there. Also, full-time kids get extra daycare on many days when school is closed for half-day students, including during the summer. I was surprised that the school does not have higher ratings until I realized that they are all quite outdated.  I have nothing negative to say about Christ Lutheran Preschool. My first child attended this school, and I fell in love with the teaching style and the attentiveness of the staff. Their prices are also very reasonable given the quality of education they provide. They are a play-to-learn school, and I appreciate how their playground allows children to develop in a variety of ways. So excited to now have my other child be a part of this wonderful community. CLP has been a safe space for both of my children to learn, explore, and grow. Their curriculum was developmentally appropriate. From the Mom and Tot class to the Fours class, my children thrived under their play based philosophy of teaching. It is obvious the teachers are all passionate about their place as teachers. Each classroom has a unique culture full of opportunity to develop socially, emotionally, and academically. Both children left prepared for elementary school.  The ongoing efforts to change and improve the school are evidence of their commitment to their families. We absolutely love this school and staff! My son loves going to school here! We loved his previous preschool but needed to send him somewhere closer to home in order to better manage morning drop off for his older siblings. We are so happy with the move and our son is happier than ever at school! This is such a lovely and enriching environment for kids. His teachers really care about getting to know him and encouraging a healthy social and academic development through play and exploration. This is the best preschool in Santa Clarita. The back play area is 10/10 you won’t find a bigger or more engaging space for your little. I have been going to this school for 8 years with all three of my kids. They have always loved school and alive always felt so comfortable in the environment and with the caring teachers! I really was turned off in my preschool search by stuffy rooms with diaper changes where they play—- CLP is a hidden gem! You won’t regret getting your kiddo into this awesome program

name: Christ Our Redeemer AME Church
Christ Our Redeemer AME Church - Main Campus
Christ Our Redeemer Church
Christ Our Redeemer Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
A modern church facility with traditional worship service of the A.M.E denomination Order 30 + LaCroix. That's 540 pounds. And tip 5.00 dollars. Not cool. That's not a fair wage, for the work expected.

To give you perspective. A normal compact car can only hold about 1000 pounds. That's what most gig workers drive. This order is unreasonable and a bad testimony to the generosity and easy yoke that Jesus gives.
