name: Christ Pacific Church
Christ Pacific Church - Huntington Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
𖤐 @fromloss2legacy710 • @elfstoneandie
May 31, 2026 • 3:00 PM • Sunday gratitude vibes 🙏☀️

Massive appreciation, gratitude, and blessings to everyone at Christ Pacific Church for the incredible work they do serving the community every Sunday.

Programs like the Sunday meal service and the Lord’s Closet may seem like simple acts of kindness on the surface, but for many people they make a much bigger difference than most will ever realize.

Life can get busy. Life can get complicated. Sometimes people are carrying challenges that nobody else can see. Having a place where you can show up, be welcomed with kindness, receive a meal, browse clothing resources, and simply be treated with dignity is something truly special.

What stands out most about Christ Pacific Church is the atmosphere.

Nobody makes you feel like a burden.
Nobody makes you feel judged.
Nobody makes you feel like you’re standing in a line asking for help.

Instead, you’re welcomed with compassion, respect, and genuine kindness.

That matters.

The volunteers, staff, donors, and everyone involved create an environment that feels uplifting, organized, and filled with positive energy. You can tell there are a lot of good people behind the scenes putting in time, effort, and resources to make sure these programs continue helping others.

And honestly, programs like this save people more than money.

They save stress.

Knowing there’s a meal available on Sunday from 3 PM to 4 PM might seem like a small thing, but sometimes removing even one worry from someone’s week can make a huge difference.

That’s real impact.

The Lord’s Closet is also an incredible resource and another example of people helping people in a practical and meaningful way.

The entire experience carries a spirit of generosity, humility, and community that is becoming harder and harder to find.

No fanfare.
No ego.
No expectations.

Just people serving others because they genuinely care.

That’s timeless.

That’s leadership.

That’s faith put into action.

To every volunteer, donor, staff member, and person who contributes to making these programs possible:

Thank you.

Your kindness matters.
Your work matters.
And your impact reaches further than you probably realize.

Absolute six-star experience.

Nothing but gratitude and blessings for everyone involved.

May 31, 2026 • 3:00 PM • Sunday gratitude vibes 🙏☀️ 𖤐 @fromloss2legacy710 • @elfstoneandie
May 31, 2026 • 3:00 PM • Sunday gratitude vibes 🙏☀️

There are some places that simply open their doors, and then there are places that open their hearts.

Christ Pacific Church falls into the second category.

Every Sunday from 3 PM to 4 PM, this church provides something that goes far beyond a meal or access to clothing through the Lord’s Closet. They provide peace of mind, dignity, encouragement, and a reminder that community still exists.

The volunteers, staff, donors, and everyone involved deserve tremendous recognition for what they do here.

From the moment you arrive, you’re treated with kindness and respect. There is no feeling of judgment, no feeling of being looked down upon, and no feeling that you’re inconveniencing anyone by being there.

Instead, you’re welcomed.

And that simple act carries more weight than most people realize.

The meal program is incredibly appreciated. In a world where grocery prices seem determined to qualify for astronaut training, having one less meal to worry about can make a meaningful difference for a lot of people.

It’s not just food.

It’s breathing room.

It’s one less thing on the mental checklist.

It’s one less stressor during an already busy week.

The Lord’s Closet is equally amazing. Being able to access clothing resources through a program run with such care and compassion is something that deserves recognition and support.

What stands out most is the culture.

Everyone seems genuinely happy to help.

The volunteers aren’t simply going through the motions. You can feel the kindness behind the work. You can feel the compassion. You can feel that the mission is bigger than the task.

That’s rare.

And honestly, in a world that can sometimes feel rushed, disconnected, and overly transactional, places like Christ Pacific Church remind us what community is supposed to look like.

People helping people.

Simple.
Powerful.
Timeless.

The entire experience carries that white-glove hospitality energy that isn’t built on luxury, but on kindness.

Professional organization.
Compassionate volunteers.
Meaningful programs.
Real impact.

To every volunteer serving meals, every donor contributing resources, every person organizing the Lord’s Closet, and every individual working behind the scenes to make this possible:

Thank you.

You are making a difference.

Absolute six-star experience.

Nothing but gratitude, respect, and blessings for everyone involved.

𖤐 @fromloss2legacy710 • @elfstoneandie
May 31, 2026 • 3:00 PM • Sunday gratitude vibes 🙏☀️ A lovely church with super kind people. I visited their Celebrate Recovery on a Friday night with my friends from our local Celebrate Recovery. We were treated so well and enjoyed a delicious dinner with homemade desserts. The church building itself is nice and immaculate. The worship center where services are held was very spacious, comfortable and offered a peaceful ambience. I cannot say enough nice things about Christ Pacific Church. I have been searching for a church with a heart to serve those in need, and this is it! They practice what they preach- literally! They offer a variety of opportunities to help others in the community of Huntington Beach and around the world. The people here are incredibly kind and sincere, and Pastor Peter is the most amazing teacher. The Holy Spirit shines through him and the entire church. The worship team is also very gifted and their talent is amazing. If you want to attend a church with the heart of Jesus, search no further. It's here! I decided to give this church a try. Many people there were nice.  I did not feel a connection to Pastor Peter’s sermons at all.  He doesn’t preach strongly based on the Bible.  It’s not bad; it’s just OK.  I don’t believe he is gifted to preach to others.  Nothing like Pastor Charles Stanley or Pastor Joel Osteen. There are many Pastors and churches out there, but only a few are genuinely great.  This church is not one of them.  Their worship team isn’t all that great either.  The lead worship minister could barely sing.  I don’t understand why they have her lead the worship team.  She does have a pleasant voice though.  They don’t even come close to singing as great as the worship team at Saddleback church.  Their music also needs to be better.  One guy is able to hit the high notes and sing well but overall, their worship team needs a lot of improvement.  Praising GOD is one of the most important things at church, so why not do it amazingly well or at least pleasantly well?  Also, their graphic designs need improvements.  They don’t really capture the themes properly and do not look very appealing either.  It doesn’t look very creative.  It’s not a big deal but if they want to present to the audience, we do deserve a better presentation. I won’t be going back to this church.  It did not feel right for me.

name: Christ Presbyterian Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
I recently visited Christ Presbyterian church in Carlsbad Ca, and it was a wonderful experience. The sanctuary is absolutely stunning, one of the most beautiful worship spaces I’ve seen in North County San Diego. From the moment I walked in, I was greeted with genuine warmth and hospitality. The community was friendly, inclusive, and made me feel right at home.

What stood out most was their tagline: “A Place of Grace.” It truly reflects the heart of the church. If you’re looking for a welcoming church in Carlsbad with inspiring worship, a strong sense of community, and a beautiful campus, this is a place worth checking out. Lovely, welcoming church in a suburban neighborhood near a community garden. They offer both contemporary and traditional services, special holiday events, family and youth activities, groups for seniors, missions involvement, and other opportunities to get involved. For a smaller church, they really do a lot ! This church has the most loving, faithful, brilliant, and compassionate pastors I've ever encountered. They will help you expand your spiritual and human awareness through sharing their insight as well as being the authentic and caring people they are.

It's not a megachurch so you'll be able to establish a true connection with the people who actively practice their faith. The children's ministry is excellent. Plus the choir and music director, being immensely talented, will probably touch your soul with their heavenly sound. I am not a Christian, but I attended a couple of services at this church because of my wife. What sets this church apart is not just its active engagement with the community but also the dynamic leadership of the  pastor.  The pastor also emphases events with fellow Muslims and Jews.  His sermons are a blend of motivation, wisdom, and a refreshing sense of humor that resonates deeply with all who listen. It's a rare gift to deliver messages of faith that are both profound and accessible, yet the pastor does so with an ease that speaks volumes of his dedication and understanding of the human spirit. CPC is a warm and friendly church that is active in the local community. There are several fun-filled family friendly events throughout the year. The Pastor has a good sense of humor and his sermons are interesting.  The congregation is committed to making a difference.

name: Christ The King Anglican Church
Christ The King Anglican Church - Poway Campus
reviewSummary: I have been a member for 14 years coming from a history of evangelical Churches. I came here through a neighbor and have found it a place of worship. Also, the Church has wonderful ministries into such organizations as RJ Donovan Correctional Facility and San Diego Rescue Mission. The sermons, music and congregational witness to each other is precious. I have been a blessed member of Christ the King Church for over a decade. I am so thankful to be a part of this wonderful church family! Our worship services are a Spirit-filled blend of traditional liturgy, time-tested hymns, contemporary worship music, solid and encouraging sermons, and enthusiastic congregational participation. This is a warm, friendly, family, Bible based church with dynamic Priests and a Deacon.  The services and sermons are wonderful and there are a variety of activities to participate in daily, weekly, and monthly.  We are so happy to be congregants at this church! What a welcoming community this is!  Everyone is so warm and nice, the service was beautiful,  lots of music and singing- which my wife and I always look for in a service.   The sermon was heartfelt and meaningful.   If we lived in the area, my wife and I would definitely be members of this church. ❤️ Great church, small, friendly, solid theology.

name: Christ the King Catholic Church
Christ the King Catholic Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Exploring San Diego's Catholic churches led me to Christ the King last Sunday. What an amazing experience! The service was truly uplifting, especially with the incredible gospel choir. Their voices filled the beautiful church with such joy and energy. It was definitely a highlight of my visit.

Christ the King is surprisingly accessible by public transportation, making it a great option for anyone. And if you're looking for a service with a vibrant, Baptist-inspired feel, this is the place to be. The 8:30 am Mass on Sundays is where the choir shines! Plenty of parking. This place has changed a lot. They are very disorganized and don't return your calls. I went there trying to get a copy of my husband's certificate of baptism and they have not gotten back to me. It's a shame because now my husband is being deported due to a missing document that this disorganized place could not give me. I am highly disappointed. The parking lot if still as horrible as it was over 20 years ago. Very crowded, not structured. I'd give it zero stars if I could. Christ the King Catholic Church in San Diego is a testament to timeless architectural beauty and rich history. Established in 1938, the parish initially held Mass in a modest storefront on Imperial Avenue. A decade later, in 1948, the current church structure was completed, showcasing design elements that reflect both tradition and community spirit. The church's architecture harmoniously blends with its surroundings, featuring design elements that reflect both tradition and community spirit. Inside, the sanctuary offers a serene atmosphere, enhanced by thoughtful design details that inspire reflection. Beyond its physical beauty, Christ the King has been a cornerstone for its diverse congregation, offering various Masses that cater to different cultural expressions of faith. The church's commitment to inclusivity and service makes it a cherished institution in San Diego. HISTORIC CHURCH HELPING THE COMMUNITY AND INDIVIDUAL CASES FROM DIFFERENT AREAS IN OUR LIFE,TEACHING THE COMMUNITY BEING RESPONSIBLE AND BE KIND TO EACH OTHER JUST LIKE JESÚS CHRIST WANT US TO BE. It's supposed to be a Catholic church but has major Baptist vibes. The priest you can barely understand him. They should get a Spanish speaking priest that you can understand easily, for the Spanish mass. It's not hard to request one. SAN DIEGO has lots of Spanish speaking priest but somehow they don't go to Christ the king Baptist church

reviewSummary: This has been my home for many years.  I joined the prayer group last year.  This is the best thing I have done.  You feel the presence of God in the congregation.  We have adoration all the first Fridays of the month.  Rosary at 6:30 pm followed by the mass and all night adoration with the Holly Sacrament.  Need healing?  You have a troubled life? Need love?  Yes I needed all those and I have received all three here and more.  You are welcome to join us!  Jesus is Love! Very peaceful Church loving community been going here for the past 14 years. Fr. Anthony, the pastor of Christ the Redeemer Church, is an attentive and welcoming priest. (I love his inspiring homily). During every Sunday Mass, there is always a welcoming message for new visitors and seminarians. Blessings are given to kids under 18,  those having birthday and couples having wedding anniversary. I also love the community. My beloved parish. Great Catholic community, open and comfortable. Friendly and welcoming. First parish I've officially joined since I moved from Boyle Heights in 1991. Fr. Anthony is new to Christ the Redeemer; we're blessed with yet another kind, smart, easygoing pastor. It's a beautiful community, people is warm and embrace every one.

name: Christ the Vine Lutheran Church
Christ the Vine Lutheran Church - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary: This church is absolutely amazing! I went here from the age of 8 to about 17 they've had a few different pastors in that time, one being my grandfather. If you're looking for a church that holds to the traditional text and honors Martin Luther's beautiful change he brought into the church then this is the church for you! Praise be to Jesus!🙏🏽🙏🏽 I love this church. The pastor is very personal and gets to know the visitors in friendship. I didn't know the pastor and he prayed for me during my cancer treatment. It worked I'm cancer free. Small Church with big loving heart's. If you need a church this is the place to worship with open arms. My family and I have attended CTVL since 2005. Great church wouldn't go anywhere else WELS Lutheran church with K-8th school.  Pastor Bartelt is GREAT!!!

name: Christ's Chapel Anglican Church
Christ's Chapel Anglican Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary: This is a fantastic church that cares about biblical fidelity, community, and the beauty of the liturgy. This is where my family worship. It's a small congregation of believers. Public worship is conducted by the clerics using liturgy congruous with that of the church of England. Services are open to the public. A great Riverside church that’s welcoming, engaging and has beautiful, reverent, approachable Anglican worship services. Sound Biblical teaching, friendly congregation- all age groups present from infants to seniors Amazing church, love the work that is being done there.

name: Christ's Church
Christ's Church - Jacksonville (Southside) Campus
reviewSummary: I love calling Christ's Church my home! from the moment we walked in, to ANY of the campuses, everyone has always been so warm and welcoming. Ended up meeting some of my greatest friends, and now I attend several services and have joined a small group that feels like family. Following the book of Matthew on Jesus's religious challengers was an awesome sermon. Praise & worship very hosanna music style and anointed. A great message on Mother's Day. The Family ministry team & volunteers do a great job pouring their hearts into the next generation! Love getting to serve alongside them! If you are looking for an inviting, but not pushy church to attend, this is the place. Personally, Christian music is how I feel closest to God and they have an excellent Christian band that starts the service. But, I also enjoy Pastor Jason's sermons. When he ends most prays with '.... less of me and more of you (God)', it fills my heart with joy. Great Church for the whole family! Amazing programs and resources for the whole community.  They make a big church feel small when you get connected at Starting Point and Growth Group.

name: CHRISTCHURCH MIAMI
CHRISTCHURCH MIAMI - Pinecrest / South Miami Campus
reviewSummary: Christchurch Miami is a truly special place! From the moment you walk in, you’re welcomed like family. The worship is Christ-centered and uplifting, the teaching is biblical and practical, and the community is full of genuine love and warmth. You’ll find people of all ages and backgrounds coming together as a faith family on mission. If you’re looking for a church in Miami where you can grow in your faith, connect with others, and discover your God-given purpose this is it! This church has helped me grow in my faith so much. The community is super welcoming. The worship is so authentic and the teaching so practical.  I really would encourage anyone to check it out if you’re in the area! Godly leadership, biblical teaching, faith family on a mission. I encourage you to visit more than once and get to know the church. You will be pointed to Christ and all he has done for you! Very theologically sound, heartfelt worship, very friendly people and well organized. Family community feel. Love this church family… caring, authentic, and Christ-centered! Helps my Faith become relevant & practical

name: Christian Assembly Church
Christian Assembly Church - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary:
I'm thrilled to share my experience at Christian Assembly Church, a vibrant and welcoming community under the exceptional leadership of Pastor Robert Concepcion. Since Pastor Robert took the helm a few years ago, the Filipino community within the church has seen remarkable growth, now boasting over 200 active members. These devoted individuals are not just attendees but pillars of the church, deeply engaged in serving, praying, and passionately preaching the Gospel of Jesus.

Pastor Robert is truly a servant leader, embodying the heart of a shepherd with his dedicated and compassionate approach to guiding his flock. His leadership not only inspires but also fosters a strong sense of unity and purpose among us. The church's atmosphere is one of genuine warmth and fervent faith, making it a wonderful place to grow spiritually and connect with fellow believers.

Whether you're looking for a church home or a place to explore your faith, Christian Assembly Church and its thriving Filipino community welcome you with open arms. It’s a place where you can truly feel the love of Christ in action. Highly recommended! I love the Young Adults community. They are very welcoming, the worship and sermons are generally great! And I found it very easy to get connected with people through their life groups I went to this church since birth until leaving the church in my Junior year of high school. I left as I was shunned for speaking out against homophobic preaching from our youth pastor. I tried to have discussions with other pastors and was told that “The bible teaches that marriage is between a man and a woman” and to not question it past that. Youth groups should be a place for children to learn the LOVE of God, preaching HATE to lgbtq+ individuals is not what God teaches. Following a faith blindly and being told to not question the pastor (a non-holy man) is not what God teaches. Was invited by a friend Rico for Woman's Night worship was amazing everyone singing to Lord God & the Hope for Garden sang was very beautiful made me cry the joy God brings. I love to come for Bible Study hopefully next Wednesday It's a beautiful church and a wonderful place to pray and listen to God's words

name: Christian Fellowship
Christian Fellowship - Melbourne Campus
reviewSummary:
I met Pastor Fields last week and I was blown away.  He was the most genuine person I have ever met in the ministry.  He had never met me before, but not only agreed to meet, he ended up talking with me for over an hour and it felt like we were old friends.  His heart is to help people.
He even took the time to take me and let me meet his wife who was one of the kindest and most genuine people I have ever met.
It was an experience I left knowing that God had been in our midst. CF-COGIC is an awesome worship center. Come and experience ministry for the entire family. Christian Fellowship is the best church ever. They make you feel @ home and very welcomed. The Pastor is off the chain and when he speaks you feel like you're there with him. When Pastor Fields preaches he brakes it down for you, Where you can understand everything and not feel lost. Pastor Fields is as real as they come and I respect him for that. First lady Fields is such a beautiful person and is so humble. First Lady is always smiling because God has been good to her. If you ever need someone to talk to or need guidance in your life Christian Fellowship is the place to be. Let's not forget the Musicians, Choir and the praise Team be off the chain. So wether you're young,Older, White, Hispanic, Chinese or whatever race, age or whatever you maybe going thru Christian Fellowship will open their doors for you.So if you're in Melbourne come on to Christian Fellowship and I guarentee you will leave with a smile on your face and Also feeling great about yourself. Christian Fellowship Family continue to do what God has led you to do. Had a graduation here for my 6th grade at diamond community school years and years ago, Dr. Fields and Pastor fields are very nice respectful people, I know the school closed down not long after she retired, but I am not sure if the church is still in business, it was very clean and well setup with plenty of places to sit, and some nice audio equipment for celebrations if anyone from school sees sending love and prayers and wishing you all well 💜💜 Good place to worship God. Friendly people

I used to come here every Sunday with my kids when I needed the most in  god in my life and even I  donate  money that I didn’t have, but I did it with my heart I was going to the hardest thing in life as a single mother I was homeless with my two daughters when they were little and I asked they them if they can help me stay one of their shelters because I had a friend that they say they will help people who needs shelter temporary and I told them about my situation that I was not a US citizen, but my kids are  born here. reviewSummary:
Always make sure You pray for Gods guidance and direction and if you do that be sure he will answer!
I prayed to God and asked him to show me if this church is the right church for me and my son to go to tonight he answered me. I Spoke with Pastor Dwayne Edwards on Wednesday evening inquiring about his church services I found out there was some sort of support Group they had available Tuesday evenings at the church I explained to the pastor that I was very interested in coming to check it out. I also let this pastor know that me and my son who would be coming with me have been very hurt and traumatized by people in churches we’ve gone to he welcomed us to come to the Support Group that they had Tuesday at 6:30 PM. Tonight when I went to go to this church which is about 20 minutes from my house… I got there and I saw that the pastor had a special marked parking space for himself where his car was parked in a parking area that was mostly empty. I parked my car got out tried every door in the church building which was locked I found it to be strange but the pastors car was parked in his special spot so I know he had to be there… I called the church number no answer… I searched through my phone looking for this pastor’s number. After finding his number in my phone from Wednesday night I called and he answered the phone I told him hello I talked to you Wednesday night and I’m here for the Support Group. As he answers the phone he’s coming out a back door of the church talking to me on the phone at the same time. He jokingly laughs shakes my hand and tells me that the Support Group was postponed! What!!! As I am walking back to my car he tells me I can come back next Tuesday! This kind of behavior is very inconsiderate and rude and not what you would hope to expect from a pastor especially after telling him that me and my son have been extremely hurt and traumatized by church people and the whole point of coming to the Support Group is to try to get some kind of healing!!! But I can’t be mad because I asked the Lord to show me if this is the church, he wants us at and I got my answer tonight! Needless to say I will not be coming back here Tuesday night or any other night and definitely would not be recommending this church to  anybody by the way, I forgot to mention I drove to this church on very little gas money I am a single mother of a child with special needs. This was not only an inconvenience and a disappointment but I could’ve used that Gas money to go somewhere else that would’ve benefited us. Great Pastor who preaches the truth and lovely members. Thank you for having us. Great place very friendly staff we stopped by they had a Saturday drive-thru prayer we went through prayers answered God bless you and thank you all you prayed for us that my children would come to the Lord and my mom was missing and my mom was found thank you for all your prayers once again God bless you all and your families We LOVE YOU!!!. Thankyou Lord For CLC Amazing Pastor Dwayne Evans always a blessed word 🙏🏽 Loving church family 💚

name: Christian Life Church
Christian Life Church - Long Beach (Bixby Knolls) Campus
reviewSummary: Thanks for honoring your church's history. I was baptized here by Steelberg. By the way, Bob Weiner (Maranatha Churches) came out of this church. I didnt know about T. Richey's hand. My family stayed until the end of '76. I was 10. We were here nearly a year during T. Ray Rachel's tenure. My dad was healed of a serious kidney illness when the church laid hands on him at the church. I think it was a Sunday night. There was another pentecostal pioneer associated with Steelberg. Well, two. His dad, whose broadcast CM Ward carried on after his dad's passing. Then, his stepfather was Howard Carter. (Not the archeologist 😆) Lester Sumrall has a book about his ministry and partnering with Carter. He was an AG leader in England. Google the book. It's a free download. CLC has a powerful heritage in the Holy Ghost!!! I  truly love this church,  although I don't attend regularly due to my busy schedule in the medical field, I try to attend church with my family as soon as I get a Sunday off. What I really appreciate about the wonderful members of the church is that even if I haven't been attending for a while,  they welcome me with open arms. It doesn't matter if is a month or 6 monthso they are just glad to see me. I am praying I can get Sundays off so I can go to the early Sunday service and get together to meet them. I enjoy God's presence every time I do attend. Although I don't know the pastor personally, whebut you hear his message you can immediately tell his love and passion for God and his love for the members.He is awesome. I am praying for God to continue blessed him, guide him to care for the church and his members. I love the church and the people are so friendly Very friendly church ! Always feel very welcomed ! Godly people who are family that want to share  lifes experiences with you.God is the center of it all

reviewSummary:

The building may be old and not many programs going yet- but the new mission statement is: "To know God & make Him known." 😀 ✝️❤️ My daughter went here for preschool. We loved it and so did she. The songs and prayers my daughter know melt my heart. Gonna miss this place!!!

reviewSummary: The most amazing place in Fort Lauderdale. A true illustration of how the Lord works in mysterious ways and brings people together. Absolutely love my church!  It’s never enough and every service has me looking forward to the following weeks service.  Thank you They are teaching the Good News... What else is there to say? If you're looking for a church in downtown Ft. Lauderdale, or even if you're not, you need to come check out Church by the Glades FTL. I feel so welcome here and I really feel like I'm a part of a family. The worship music is amazing and I always feel uplifted, encouraged and strengthened after hearing the pastor speak. I would say this isn't your grandma's church because this is NOT like any church you've ever been to before, but that's not true—everyone is welcome here, all generations, races and creeds. Come on by! We're here every Sunday at 5 PM! My husband and I have been coming since August and I have not missed one service yet! We have thoroughly enjoyed the word, the people and the music. It's not like any other church you have ever been to I promise. We have gotten to know some of the staff and volunteers and everyone is just wonderful. We LOVE the 5pm service time because I feel like we still get a full weekend and then it wraps up with an awesome message.... every time! Thank you CBG for putting a location downtown. It has greatly impacted me, my husband and our kids!

name: Church In Huntington Beach
Church In Huntington Beach - Huntington Beach (North) Campus
reviewSummary:
I have enjoyed the meetings of the Church in Huntington Beach especially the joint participation of all the members. It is so good and helpful to hear the truths of the Bible spoken by all, including the daily experiences of our living Christ. I’m from the Church in LA, and then I move to OC in 2019, and I went to the church in Irvine, then the pandemic happened and I lost touch, and felt like I was in a Dry desert place, hungry and thirsty. But I started meeting this summer and now I’m happier, more secure and confident. I believe as Christians we really need to meet and be in the church life. Praise the Lord, we have this awesome place to meet, eat and be like a family. This church really helped me to know Jesus and cultivate my relationship with Him! This is a genuine church of genuine believers! Thank you Lord Jesus for this church! Bless everyone there and bless the meetings! Praise the Lord, this is a place for His family! It really felt like I was visiting a big family. So grateful I got to meet you all! Good evening “today 12/12/23 God gave me an answer”. As I was coming out from my house, I saw cross street two gentleman knocking my neighbor door, suddenly I heard a voice saying that’s like Joshua and Caleb. But I wanted to continue with my errands and began to drive off, then I said to myself “wait” let me talk to these two guys “I’m curious”
So I got off my car and asked them two guys their name “sure enough their names are “Josua and Caleb” wow,
Then I told them what happened, and mentioned that I’ve been looking for a church for a long time. They pray for me and invite me to church ! Guess what I’m going to church 😃.
God answered my prayer in a very unique way. Thank you Jesus. Warm and welcoming congregation. In-depth Bible study. You can tell that these people definitely are serious about their pursuit of God.

name: Church of Southland
Church of Southland - Anaheim (Platinum Triangle) Campus
reviewSummary:
I attended this church and was part of a cell group. I eventually stepped away because of concerns around privacy, transparency, and spiritual pressure.

When I joined cell (small group), I was told that what was shared in the group stayed in the group. I later learned that cell leaders write weekly reports summarizing personal sharings, which are passed up to zone leaders and pastoral staff. This was not disclosed upfront. Because I was not comfortable with that, I specifically asked my cell leader not to include my sharings, and she agreed, until recently, when she informed me that she would be including them going forward. This was not presented as a request for my consent, but as a decision. The reasoning given was "spiritual covering," and I was told it had been prayed over and confirmed by multiple church leaders.

For me, this felt like a breach of trust. Privacy and consent should not be reframed as spiritual obedience issues. Prayer and care do not require sharing someone's personal information up a leadership chain without their agreement.

Shortly after leaving my cell group, I was also removed from a ministry I had been faithfully serving in. The reason given was that cell membership is a requirement for serving. This happened around the same time as my last cell attendance, communicated by my zone leader to the ministry leader. It is worth noting that the church is currently in a cell break period through the end of August, meaning this decision was made without waiting to see whether I might find a new cell group when the new season resumes in the fall. I understand that churches can set ministry requirements, but in my experience, the way this was enforced felt rigid and discouraging. To me, it was another example of how this church's institutional structure can override a person's genuine desire, faithfulness, and willingness to serve.

The broader culture here is highly hierarchical and top-down, with pastoral staff, zone leaders, and cell leaders, and a strong emphasis on structure, reporting, and membership requirements. Becoming a member requires regular tithing, cell group participation, a weekend retreat called Encounter, and an 11-12 week Experiencing God program. Some may find that meaningful. For others, it may feel controlled and performative.

I also believe the church should be transparent about how attendance is tracked. There is a small camera on the stage that captures zoomed-in footage of individuals' faces during service, not for security purposes, but so church leaders can identify who attended. This is separate from the headcount that ushers conduct. Attendees are not informed that this is happening. Whether or not it meets a legal threshold for disclosure, people have a right to know they are being visually identified during worship.

There are sincere and kind people here, and I appreciated some aspects of the community. But based on my experience, I would encourage anyone considering this church to ask clear questions about cell reports, privacy practices, ministry eligibility, leadership structure, and attendance tracking before getting deeply involved. reviewSummary:
From the very 1st services I attended I knew I was now home. I was looking for a long time to find a Christian Church that's focused was on the teachings of Jesus, instead of judgements.
It wasn't until after I joined that I discovered that this was the church my pilgrim grandfather built (the first church in Boston, of the Massachusetts Bay Colony)... I really was home again! Our 2 little girls love going to church which is not something at all I remember from my days many years ago in Sunday school.  They have a terrific program for children.  We love Pastor Mike’s sermons, the community we found and supporting the good works.  Very rewarding to be a member of this congregation.  This is not a rigid fundamentalist church that ignores the teachings of Jesus.  This is a church that follows the latest biblical scholarship on the historical Jesus.  This is an inclusive church that loves all our brothers and sisters. Friendly place. Nice music. Good message. This is a christ centered church. Very welcoming to everybody. When this church opens  up again it will be a nice church to go too.

reviewSummary:
The Church of the little Flower has been our place of worship for 3 generations.  My daughter went to school there in the 80’s.  We are practicing Catholics but it’s not the stunning historical location but the amazing clergy that inspires and moves the soul with their word of God! I recently completed my OCIA program through the Church of the Little Flower. The program was 6 months, and throughout that time we frequently visited COTLF, while also being part of a "Teaching Mass" with Fr. Manny & Deacon Fleitas. After my program, I was baptized during the Easter Vigil Mass at the church. My entire experience with COTLF has been nothing short of transformational and my wife and I also celebrated our marriage sacrament there. I highly recommend this church to any and all families looking for a great community. I had the pleasure of attending a beautiful wedding at the Church of the Little Flower in Coral Gables, Florida. The experience was truly memorable, thanks in part to the informative rehearsal two days prior.

The Church of the Little Flower is a picturesque venue with its charming architecture and serene surroundings. The wedding ceremony itself was a breathtaking affair, with the church's ornate interior creating a perfect backdrop for the couple's special day.

What stood out to me was the well-organized and informative rehearsal held two days before the wedding. It ensured that everyone knew their roles and the order of proceedings, making the actual ceremony smooth and enjoyable. Everyone was courteous and accommodating, making sure everything went off without a hitch.

The Church of the Little Flower in Coral Gables, Florida, offers a beautiful setting for weddings and events, and the added benefit of a thorough and helpful rehearsal made the entire experience even more special. It's a place I would wholeheartedly recommend for anyone seeking a memorable and well-executed wedding ceremony. There is no other church community like the Little Flower family. Attending Sunday mass is amazing! My favorite is Christmas! I love the homilies but my favorite part is the music and the ambience that is created. The versatility and melodies that come from the organ is phenomenal. Hands down to the Organist. Then the choir starts to sing suddenly it feels heavenly. Completely at peace. Honestly, no other place like Church of the Little Flower. Wonderful church for weddings and photography. They are well organized and have simple and easy instructions to follow. Shay photography of Fort Lauderdale:)

Church of the Most Precious Blood - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary:
It’s really heartbreaking to see how this church has changed. For years, families from Lauderbach Elementary relied on the church parking lot for safe drop-offs and pickups. It used to feel like a kind and welcoming part of the community.

Before picking up my son, I would even go inside to pray it brought me peace and made me feel spiritually connected. Now, not only are we not allowed to park there, but I can’t even go in to pray anymore. That hurts more than anything.

Now, we’re being treated like intruders  as if we’re criminals just for trying to get our kids to school safely. The traffic outside has become more dangerous, and the stress it causes on both parents and kids is unfair.

Isn’t a church supposed to be a place of compassion and support? I truly hope leadership reflects on the values they’re meant to represent  because right now, many of us are feeling pushed away instead of embraced.

We’re not asking for anything unreasonable — just a little grace and understanding from a place that’s supposed to stand for those very things.

Zoom in on the picture you’ll see the man from the church standing there like a guard, as if we’re a threat. It’s sad 😢 that it’s come to this. Small church, very warm welcome when you arrive. Sunday Spanish mass at 1 pm. Plenty of parking! ♿ Excellent place to play Bingo. Volunteers are great. They serve food and drinks. Free coffee. Different types of flashboard's, double action, show me the money, and free speedy with buy in. Pay off bingo games $200 and consolation $50 Church is open during the day for prayer and has parking. The best feature is the 24 hour adoration room, with its beautiful statues and reverent exposition of the Eucharist it is a great resource for prayerful Catholics. Small, but welcoming and friendly. I've only been here a few times, but I feel elated when I set foot in here. And after Sunday Mass, there are fundraising events. The food there is delicious. I simply have no words when I try out their dishes.

This has to be, in my opinion, the most beautiful church in all of Chula Vista.

I think that they have good solid teaching, they have a great kids program, the campus is beautiful! And above all they just have a warm inviting group of folks and relationships there. I love this place. A welcoming, grace filled community of believers that love Jesus. They have solid bible teaching, discipleship, an amazing children's and student ministry, great Sunday school classes, a very popular VBS program with hundreds of kids, they're very own camp IDRAFOJE (ID RAther Follow JEsus, a sell out every year), a really beautiful campus on the hillside, and a lot more. When I think back on the session, everything was being read from packets of stapled papers, including the deliverance prayers themselves. Nothing felt genuine to me; it all felt forced and rehearsed.

The pastor — whose name I honestly can’t remember — seemed bored and tired, almost like he didn’t even want to be there.

At one point, the pastor’s wife began calling out certain spirits she believed were within me, such as Jezebel and others I can’t specifically remember. She kept demanding answers from the “spirits” inside of me, and honestly, I just gave whatever answers came to my mind in the moment.

As the session continued, both the pastor and his wife instructed me to start coughing into a trash can, saying it was a way to cast the spirits out of me. I did what they told me to do, but I have a very sensitive gag reflex, so the more I coughed, the more I gagged and spit into the trash can.

Toward the end of the session, they prayed for me to receive the gift of speaking in tongues. During the prayer, the pastor’s wife told me to repeat what she was saying and copy her, so I did. Afterward, she was convinced that I had received the gift of tongues, but something about the entire experience has continued to trouble me spiritually ever since.

I was then supposed to have a healing session with someone else, but the appointment always fell through and eventually the person just stopped contacting me. I take that as the Holy Spirit intervening on my behalf to save me from this church.

I would not recommend this church at all just based on my own experience. WE LIVE SUPERNATURALLY!!! healing for people in Downtown, food for those hungry in Mexico, love for the broken-hearted…..But most important, LOVE for the lost 💙 … Church Tsidkenu is not a church for your average Christian on Sunday service, it’s a place for you to encounter the presence of Jesus!  WE LIVE SUPERNATURALLY!!! healing for people in Downtown, food for those hungry in Mexico, love for the broken-hearted…..But most important, LOVE for the lost 💙 The weekend I went was because TSNL with Daniel Adams was there. Many deliverances and healings by both TSNL, Pastor Ben, Pastor Art Montgomery and the Fire Academy.
The Body of Christ here at The Church of Tsidkenu are a beautiful family of worshippers and lovers of Christ Jesus and move in the anointing of the Holy Spirit. 🚩Felt like a dream church, turned into a nightmare!!❌😭PLEASE DO NOT GO HERE

🚩Extreme Manipulation
🚩No accountability (no church board) (no voting on where the money goes!)
🚩”Pastor” Ben does whatever he wants even if it’s sinful and if you don’t like it, he may gaslight/manipulate/gossip about you
🚩Pride in leaders
🚩money mismanagement (lost/possibly stolen money confirmed by multiple witnesses)
🚩if you speak up about a leaders unrepentant sin, you may be preached about and shunned like a CULT

This place has officially turned into a CULT sadly.

If you don’t want a traumatic experience, do NOT go here!!

After years of involvement, my wife and I sadly witnessed SEVERE SPIRITUAL ABUSE and manipulation within the leadership of this church, which caused us deep hurt. We’re sharing out of sincere love and concern for others😢

I hesitated to write this for six months, but it's important to speak up when there’s harm in the Body of Christ. Scripture tells us to expose the works of darkness—not to shame, but to protect and bring things into the light for healing📜✝️
I first attended this church from 2017 to 2024, with a break from 2019 to 2022. In the beginning, I genuinely believe Pastor Ben Wisan started the church with good intentions. However, over time, pride and lack of accountability took root.

🚩No accountability
There is no real accountability for leadership. Pastor Ben’s "spiritual covering" consists of books he reads, and while he claims to consult elders, there's no formal elder board, church board, or congregational voting. In practice, he operates without checks and balances.
🚩Gaslighting, manipulation & jezebel tactics
In 2024, I spent significant time around Pastor Ben during several mission trips, including one abroad. It was during this time I began to see the subtle manipulation and gaslighting that many others, including my wife and I, experienced. When we brought concerns to leadership—often involving actions of other leaders—we were dismissed, blamed, or accused of being “victims,” even though we approached situations with forgiveness and a desire for resolution.
🚩pastor gossiping and slandering
It hurt when Pastor Ben began to gossip and spread false stories about us to close friends in the church. This was done in a polished, spiritual-sounding manner, but beneath the surface, it was gossip and slander. He even went on to publicly accuse us of the very things he was doing—bearing false witness and undermining our character(the devils job as described in John 10…the accuser of the brethren). I now know more than 20 people who’ve experienced similar spiritual trauma under this leadership and are still healing.
My wife and I got married at this church. But just weeks later, God began exposing what had been happening behind the scenes, and the mistreatment worsened when we attempted to address things biblically. Pastor Ben responded NOT with compassion but with harshness, accusations, and a refusal to listen.

I expect this post may be met with defensiveness or attempts to discredit what I’ve shared. That’s been the pattern. We are now planted in a healthy, Spirit-filled church and are growing and healing. I write this only because I care deeply about those still being harmed and deceived—and I hope and pray for repentance and true freedom for this church.

These are some wonderful church options in town where Jesus is truly glorified, including:
The Rock Church

Faith Chapel

Red Seal

The Flood

Jesus Culture

Skyline Church
...and many more.

Skip the trauma and the heartache and go find another church that is actually healthy, because there are multiple healthy churches around San Diego but sadly it is not at Church Tsidkenu😢

God bless you and I pray that this church repents for all their pride and sinful ways and then God will exalt them and bless them. I love all you guys and hope this brings healing as the Lord guides you through the process.

I pray that God will lead you dear reader and guide you to where you are supposed to be under safe care in Jesus name 🙂

name: Church Two42
Church Two42 - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary: I HAVE to leave a review!!!! I wish I could give this church all the stars in the sky! It’s so personal and intimate. I drove all the way down from Orange County to surprise my mother for Mother’s Day. I was not expecting to fall so deeply in love with a small but mighty church. It is also very clean and well organized. The children’s center was lovely too! I have been too many churches before, and have never felt comfortable or felt as though the pastor was really in the spirit. But pastor Craig.. Delivered the most beautiful story, and it was organized and structured in a way that even a beginner can understand! I was blown away and held back tears 4 times. I can’t get the word out of my head, the message and the heart- Truly incredible. I own a business on Sunday is our busiest day- However, I decided right then and there that I would be at least live streaming their sermons three times a month and closing my business down for one Sunday to be there in person once a month. If I could go every Sunday in person I would, But for now this is where I will start and I look forward to  growing with this church and Seeing the Holy Spirit light up in pastor Craig! May God continue to bless and prosper the church, his bride. Great pastor. Great staff. Kids program top notch. Amazing Church!! Amazing family! I started attending this church a little over five months ago and my life has changed dramatically! I was welcomed with open arms and treated like family instantly. Pastor Craig is fantastic, he teaches with love and an easy understanding of the Bible. The worship team is phenomenal, and the entire congregation is full of love and compassion for one another. This church truly mirrors the image of Jesus! Come join us, be part of our family and experience the Lord moving in the church! ❤️ 🙌 Love this church. Pastor Craig is awesome and the worship is beyond powerful. Since I started attending this church in spring 2018, I have grown in leaps and bounds! The church family here are so loving and caring, they have helped my family through some really tough times... I'm so happy to have found Church Two42 ❤ This church is absolutely amazing and Pastor Craig is awesome!  The teaching and worship team aregreat! If you are looking for a welcoming awesome church, you really need to visit this one. There are two Sunday services one at 8:30 and the other at 10:30am.

name: Church180
Church180 - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary:
I started to like this church and our family decided to start to volunteer for Sunday Service. Tragedy happened and my son passed away. Kyra asked me 2 days after my son passed if my family was still going to volunteer that Sunday. Straight to business. I gave her the benefit of the doubt that she might not have known, but she did. She said she was sorry after the fact and please feel free to take time off if needed. If needed?? Wow…needless to say, I don’t go there anymore. Just moved back to San Diego and was looking a church that I felt would be the right one for me and then find a place to stay in the vicinity of the church and Church180 was what I kept coming back to in my searches, felt right even before ever stepping foot inside.

Went to my first service today and it was all that I expected and more! Everyone was so welcoming and inviting and genuine! I would recommend coming here for anyone looking for that  feeling of being welcomed and also just being able to be in the word and being able to get something out of it, I will definitely be going back! This church is very welcoming, and built on foundation of leading people to Christ. Great community for kids and little ones. Events and community service are a pillar in the churches outreach program. I love the people I’ve met along the way from day one. This church is highly encouraged to give a chance and check out on a Sunday @10am. Warm and welcoming atmosphere, genuine people.

I was nervous about attending church after being an Atheist for my entire adult life, but I was curious about studying Christianity and could not have had a better experience. Pastor Tony has a way of relating the Bible to modern times and I always leave church feeling renewed for the week ahead.

I have two young kids who eagerly attend Kids180 and nursery. They’ve learned a lot about Jesus and are excited to continue expanding their knowledge and faith.

After attending regularly, my heart felt ready to receive baptism and what a glorious experience it was to get baptized in the Pacific Ocean with my church family gathered around.

If you feel at all compelled to check out Church180, absolutely do so. You’ll be welcomed with open arms. Went to the grand opening 2 yrs ago and can’t see being anywhere else. From the moment you arrive there are warm welcoming smiles. I have found a church that has become a family.

name: Churchome
reviewSummary: Known for Judah Smith's relatable and passionate preaching style. A digital-first community with a strong following.

name: Citizens Church
Citizens Church - Plano Campus
reviewSummary:
I went last Sunday on Labor Day weekend for the first time. Attended the service. Pastor Jamin Roller was the lead. He spoke about the Bible and Jesus. There was a band and good singers. The hall was pretty full but I was still comfortably seated in the back. After service I saw a lady who took me upstairs to a newcomer meeting. There we met pastors and other staff and it was inviting and interesting. They prayed for me in the end and that felt good. I am signing up for Bible studies on Tuesday mornings. Was visiting Texas to see my grandkids and we came here for Resurrection Sunday. Who ever thought that Ecclesiastes was a great book to preach the risen Christ! Loved all the welcoming people. Our family is thankful for these people and this place, our new church home. If you’re looking for people to heal, learn, laugh, grow, and follow Jesus with, Citizens is a great church to try. We’d love to have you. My dear friend and dentist Dr.Barrett Davidson saw I was in need. What does Dr.Davidson do he gets with his church family ALL OF YOU and other angels that have come into my life and gets me a car I have thanked as many as I could or as many as I know about. Now I want to thank all of the wonderful people at Citizens Church much love and gratitude to all from someone who is feeling so blessed. My prayers and thoughts go out to all of you.
Thank you,
God Bless i’ve never felt more welcome nor loved, than at Citizens. the sermons are very convicting in a gentle yet honest way, that is truly to steer one closer to Christ. i started coming here as a non believer, and Citizens is now my second family. there is a great college and young adults ministry, and there are also so many families and elders who are deeply involved in the community. something unique about here is that they have a recovery ministry, and believe that through Christ, anything can happen, which is very refreshing and faith restoring. love Citizens!!

name: Citizens Church - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary: We walked into this church 3 weeks ago. My anxiety instantly lowered, every single person we met on day 1 was remarkable and welcoming. We were able to dedicate our son to the Lord this last Sunday and that experience was nothing shy of a warm embrace. I have even joined a crew and couldn't be more happier that my family landed here. I've never felt so at home, and so seen in a church. One day, I look forward to giving back in the same way that this church has given me. Citizens along with the holy spirit has reignited a fire back in my soul. Beyond happy to call this place home 💖. Further, our 3 year old son after just 2 weeks looks forward to going to "Jesus" and playing with his friends in the kids ministry. Great atmosphere.  Why the ropes though I feel like I should be able to sit where I please I feel more comfortable towards the back . Also my wife has high functioning anxiety so she prefers to sit towards the back. # no ropes My husband and I are looking for a home church and visited this wonderful church on Sunday.  From the moment we got to the church we greeted with extremely warm welcomes. The worship team is AMAZING! Both message and fellowship were great! I believe we found our church home! I am home! What a wonderful place to worship. The toddler's program during church is awesome and the church service is GREAT. Pastor Chris Norman is an exceptionally blessed worship leader. I leave the services truly appreciating the word of God with a greater understanding. The worshippers are warm and welcoming! I , my daughter and granddaughter love it! Friendly people. Great sermons. I also love the music yet it is too loud for me because of the headaches I have. Yet I get to watch it online ...I love that they have cgroups (small groups) where they meet at different homes to go over the sermons etc, and get to know each other. They have become a part of my family.

name: Citizens LA
Citizens LA - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: I think there's a mismatch on Google Maps in terms of which page this belongs to. This review is, in specific, about Citizens LA Church, a Korean American church that meets at a High School in DTLA (near Chinatown). Overall, service was fantastic. The pastor was grounded in Scripture, the worship was Spirit-led and the ushers were helpful and kind. I've been checking churches in the area but it's tough given that most of the churches with young (20s and 30s) people fall into the Korean American group and, although I have like 4 or 5 Korean friends, it's definitely a more homogeneous, closely-knit and insular group to try and fit into than any other out there (Asian or otherwise). That's on me, though. I came due to a friend's suggestion (he's KorAm), but at the last minute, he flaked on me, and I ended up at a mostly KorAm church by myself, lol. Highly recommended church if you're Asian or Asian American, in college or are post college and still relatively young (20s, 30s), as I think this church specifically caters to that community. Absolutely fantastic experience of church from the sermon to the praise. They have guest speakers here once in a while whom are really great at speaking. The worship is like a live concert. That's how great the praise team is. Pastor Alex is funny uses excellent rhetoric and has awesome sermons. This church has made me grow drastically in my spirituality. PTL. btw all are welcome. I'm gay and I'm happy with their stance. LGBT friendly is a plus. truly an amazing place that shows the strength of the faith of the Korean American community but with one huge issue- nearly a hundred toddlers and babies that share the same large echoing hall for worship service. we could never get into the sermon as babies are crying and screaming and the pastor speaks very loudly to drown out the baby noises with the speakers blasting and ringing in our ears. Go here.

name: City Bible Church
City Bible Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
New satellite service of City Bible Church Cerritos.  All the great things about the Cerritos location in an urban context.  The gospel desperately needs to be brought back to the city as it has become such a dark place without the hope of Christ.  City Bible Church is truly that light in a dark place.  In addition to regular Sunday worship there's a lot of other events and outreaches that take place at the church site as well as other places nearby.  If you're looking for a church that has solid biblical teaching, genuine community, and is willing to engage with the culture then I encourage you to come visit us. My original Yelp Review: I started going to City Bible in 05/2018 because I found them on Yelp!  Nice small church w/ the organic taste of hospitality.

Update 02/2022: I've grown so much at this church, and have seen many others grow at this church.  Especially in relation to church community, it's been a fresh experience of The Lord's design for church.  Deeper commitment to a church has resulted in good fruit of steadfastness, longsuffering, self-control, and that shared bond of gospel partnership.
During the pandemic, It's been fine meeting outdoors in the parking lot, and the Lord is doing some great things in 2022: Little Tokyo City Tours, Street Evangelism, Orphanage Mercy Ministry, Creative Art Shows,  Theology Class, Board Game Tournaments & Meetups, Prayer Retreats, and more! This is a small church that was meeting on the parking lot. The people there are very friendly. They welcomed me and visited with me but there was no pressure on me. The pastor preached a very good bible-based message. We sang a lot of Christmas songs and concluded the service with a candle lighting ceremony. All in all I would highly recommend visiting this church to spread the Gospel light in the city of Los Angeles. A great local church that is all about the three words in the name. A church about the Bible and reaching the city. City Bible Church is on the smaller side with about twenty people every week so it has a nice cozy feeling. They have another service later in the day in Cerritos which is the bulk of its membership. It's on the 2nd floor of the JEMS building and has it's own parking lot which makes it really easy to attend.

name: City Church
City Church - Anaheim (Platinum Triangle) Campus
reviewSummary:
Been coming here since 2018. All of the Pastors and Staff are extremely welcoming and caring. The part that kept me coming back is how the messages are based off of biblical content and context. Direct information straight from the source.

They have a lot of local events and even have a great Kids program. Worship team is always putting together an amazing set every week and you can tell everyone gives a little above and beyond every week.

If you are questioning visiting just go and experience it for yourself. Who knows it might change your life. It did to mine. Wish I could have stayed for the BBQ, but I had a great visit! I was not impressed, I didn't know anybody.
The pastor went on for 3.5 hours he kept crying about everything he talked about. And he spoke about things that didn't make any sense about people from the church that I'd never heard of and all the projects that were going on.  There was no scripture reading, not much prayer and the coffee was mediocre. They have this million dollar reach out which they want you to donate to.So that's a complete turn off. Another church asking for money don't bother. Everyone is so pleasant and very helpful there worship is great
Message is meaningful

name: City Church - Fullerton Campus
reviewSummary:
Been coming here since 2018. All of the Pastors and Staff are extremely welcoming and caring. The part that kept me coming back is how the messages are based off of biblical content and context. Direct information straight from the source.

They have a lot of local events and even have a great Kids program. Worship team is always putting together an amazing set every week and you can tell everyone gives a little above and beyond every week.

If you are questioning visiting just go and experience it for yourself. Who knows it might change your life. It did to mine. Thank you ❤️ I was truly moved by the atmosphere and total experience here. Upbeat praise and worship and direct and positive sermon. A very moving experience that brightened my entire week! Had a great visit!  Worship was great, Pastor Obie told a funny story about going to the wrong airport in his sermon, and the BBQ smelled amazing.  Wish I could have stayed for the BBQ, but I had a great visit! I was not impressed, I didn't know anybody.
The pastor went on for 3.5 hours he kept crying about everything he talked about. And he spoke about things that didn't make any sense about people from the church that I'd never heard of and all the projects that were going on.  There was no scripture reading, not much prayer and the coffee was mediocre. They have this million dollar reach out which they want you to donate to.So that's a complete turn off. Another church asking for money don't bother. Everyone is so pleasant and very helpful there worship is great
Message is meaningful
