name: City Church at Northside
City Church at Northside - Panama City Campus
reviewSummary: It's not really my style. However, the worship is on point and so is the teaching. I haven't been back since hurricane Michael. Which means the music director and/or pastor could have changed since I went. The congregation was very inviting and warm. Definitely good friendly people. Best church ever! Best people ever! We miss everyone there! If Gods plan for our family places us back in Panama City, we will be happily running back into our church home! Authentic, transparent and welcoming to all! Love my church.Been going almost 2 years.Great music even better sermons.All the pastors are great,The lead pastor Luther Stanford is a awesome pastor love his way of teaching the Bible .He really makes church enjoyable....I cook meals youth services on Wednesday's. The youth pastor ,Chaise is very good a his calling to .It is very enjoyable on Wednesday's also.😇😇😇🙏😇🙏👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍I give The City Church experience 10 thimds up.Can I hear an "AMEN" After only 2 visits Pastor Luther knew mine and my wife's name. Pastor Luther is a true shepard to his congregation and a great Bible teacher. He has never flaunted his Phd and you will truly get new insight to the word of God through his teaching. We welcome you to visit our church and feel the love of Christ. Great worship, great fellowship and great opportunities to serve a great God. Good teaching and fellowship. Humble staff. They helped their community after the hurricane even though they were also in need. They minister to the well and broken alike. Come as you are.

name: City Church of Gainesville
City Church of Gainesville - Gainesville Campus
reviewSummary:
I love this place. Great church in downtown Gainesville. If you're new to Gainesville, near UF or downtown this is a great church to check out!!
Chipper, Ryan, Jay & the crew are great folks. They are remodeling the building and it’s going to be an awesome facility when it completed. Everyone is very friendly and always makes you feel welcomed.  Your church community becomes your family and this church does that perfectly. The Lead Pastor is very genuine and down-to-earth.  If you ever need a community of followers of Jesus, this place will make you feel right at home! Completely Recommend!  5 stars! Nothing more needs to be said! My family and I began attending City last summer. Since that time we've become involved with small group, and a local outreach/service. I highly recommend this church for a number of reasons. Firstly, the people have a heart for this city and community, and they express it in very practical ways. The church actively engages with mercy and justice initiatives in the community, and its presence downtown is very intentional in order to be a place of refuge and hope. The Pastors are men of integrity and with deep knowledge and reverence of the Bible. There is clear and transparent governance, the voice of the congregation in decisions is welcomed, and the church body is invited in sharing their testimonies, using their talents, and supporting missions. A unique aspect of this church is weekly communion, which reminds us of the importance of this sacrament in remembering Christ's mission and love, and inviting others to participate. Amazing community of believers with wise, loving elders/pastors leading the sheep. On our first Sunday, and every time we've had people with us who are visiting for the first time, the lead pastor has come over to intentionally talk with us and actually want to get to know those who are new.
We've found so many people on Sunday and in our community group who are extremely loving, caring, mature in their faith, and genuinely in love with the Lord.
The church community also does an amazing job of looking for opportunities to get involved with loving downtown Gainesville, especially with those often marginalized or overlooked.

May the Lord continue to use City Church for His glory! Being involved in a City Church has been such a great experience from the community to the gospel-centered teaching to the social events. I've enjoyed walking alongside the people during this past year and growing in understanding of Christ's love and sacrifice for us.

name: City Church of Long Beach
City Church of Long Beach - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
It's a nice little church. Just what I was looking for. It's small so you can't hide in the messes. I mean like a lot of people. When the preacher introduced himself he also said my pronouns are he and him. That was a surprise to me which it's a good surprise but I'm glad he said it though it let people draw their lines of how they want to believe. It is getting a turn around visit from me again. There are no such thing as coincidences but after not being in church for 20 years it was right there it was spot on a coolant happened any better. Incredible church with amazing pastors. Can’t wait to go back with my family. I highly recommend this church if you are looking for a compassionate and grounded church home where truly caring for others is at the forefront of the mission and sermons. This is my church! I have been attending here for about three years. I love the pastoral staff and really enjoy the sermons presented by Pastors Bill and Brenna. They may not always say what I want to hear, but they always  say what I need to hear.
The people at this church are pretty much like the people anywhere. They are a bunch of sinners. Maybe that's why I feel like I fit right in. It is a diverse, inclusive and welcoming church. This church pretty much welcomes anybody. Kind of like Jesus does. I am in the anybody category. This church truly embraces being a "Christ follower", rather than the typical Christian we've come to know. They are a very welcoming and caring congregation. It's small but mighty. ". .small is the gate and narrow is the road to life and few will find it." If you are looking for a radically open and loving Church, try City Church of Long Beach. I was taken to City Church Long Beach by a friend of mine and I have never been happier at a church than this one! This church has such an amazing community of people always willing to reach out to one another. Theres so much love and peace in my heart after each sunday i spend here. If youre looking for a place to worship or possibly even just a community to support you I recommend coming to city church long beach.

name: City Church Tallahassee
City Church Tallahassee - Tallahassee Campus
reviewSummary:
We attended the Christmas Family event this past Christmas and it was magical for all! My son had amazing time playing  in the bounce houses and going on a train ride. We enjoyed hot cocoa along with arts and crafts. we were even able to snap a picture with Santa!  Thank you City Chirch for hosting this event! My family and I have attended City Church for roughly 10 years, and never been disappointed. We love it, and so do our children. There are tons of ways to get involved and it’s been nothing short of amazing watching the congregation continue to grow at an astonishing rate. The music is phenomenal and Pastor Dean preaches directly from the Bible. He does not waver to what people  WANT to hear, should it oppose scripture; yet he is incredibly graceful & tactful in the way he represents Gods Word. City Church will remain our home for many years to come and we are exceedingly grateful to have started attending here. City Church is like no church I've ever been to. The moment you drive/walk on campus someone is there to greet you and welcome you. This is a Bible based, faith based church that makes no apologies for loving God and telling the world of His good news. They have a large children's service that kids are thriving in and learning about Jesus and God and the Bible. They're music ministries is uplifting and moving. They have a wonderful middle school youth fellowship that meets every Wednesday and am amazing college ministries that is reaching college campuses across the country. If you're looking for a home base church, check it out! Lots of musical talent and an excellent congregation. The pastor has tons of energy and passion - strong messages. I was moved by the love, spirit, and baptisms - my first visit was today. Jessie was very friendly at the guest support table. I look forward to getting “plugged in.” Thanks! For YEARS I have been hearing so many positive words about City Church, and finally decided to give it a try. We have spent the last 5 weeks at City Church. Thus far, the sermons feel relevant and relatable.

After attending Catholic Church for nearly 25 years, I decided I wanted our kids to experience something different within the Christian faith so that their journey to Christ could truly be theirs. City Church felt like "something different" yet still comfortable and close to home.

We arrived at the beginning of a series on politics, and I maybe cringed a little. Politics in church?! Is that even appropriate?! Glad we stuck around for it, even if it made me feel uncomfortable at times.  Found myself truly looking forward to Sundays!

I have so much respect for Pastor Dean Inserra's willingness to actually discuss the really difficult societal topics by tying everything back to the teachings of the bible with sensitively and without judgement. Looking forward to the next series through Christmas and Easter.

We definitely feel welcome here, plan to stick around, and eventually get involved. :-)

We really enjoy the music, too!

name: City Life Church, San Diego
City Life Church, San Diego - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: I walked about five miles from downtown San Diego to attend a service there when I was in a pretty unfortunate situation.  Pastor greeted me right after service and made me feel accepted.  They let me choose a Bible and offered me food when I had nothing to eat and even gave me bus fare so I didn't have to walk all the way back to downtown San Diego.  I was sad to leave but God was calling me elsewhere. I started to visit this church in July and I still going because I liked and feel comfortable. People from the church made you feel like home! ⛪️ 🏡 🤍 This church is the most friendlyest church you ll ever been too City Life Church cares for the community. They love people. I love the people at this church and how authentic they are!  They love their community and God!

name: City Lift Church
City Lift Church - Fort Lauderdale Campus
reviewSummary:
2/22/26--A day or two ago I started to feel something missing inside me. I needed to be around believers. I needed church. The Bible says, “Let us not give up meeting together… but encouraging one another” (Hebrews 10:25). My soul was saying, go find your people.

So yesterday I searched for churches near me. I found one… but when I checked their beliefs, it was more like a we made God to our liking and image and not the other way around a  club with a cross decoration. I was looking for a Bible-believing church, not a “feel good and go home” place.
I prayed: “Lord, lead me.”
Because the Word is clear: “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me” (John 14:6).

Then I found City Church. I went straight to the statement of faith like a spiritual detective 🕵️‍♀️ — if it doesn’t say salvation through Jesus alone by faith alone, I keep scrolling. But this one… this one was solid. I said, maybe this is it.

Just because I am in Florida does not mean I will visit any church. Even on vacation my faith travels with me 😄.

I woke up super early (that is already a miracle — resurrection power level). I took a Lyft and went. But before that… my husband and I had an argument about his brother, the professional, certified, gold-medal pathological liar. Yes, I arrived at church holy on the outside and boiling on the inside. I even said, “Get me a flight back to New England. I am homesick. Florida is not my place!” yes, I don't like Florida , there , I said it!

So there I was — mad, dramatic, and in a Lyft — very spiritual moment.

But when I arrived, a kind gentleman greeted me, and I smelled coffee and pastries… and suddenly my sanctification process started ☕🥐. I was still fuming inside, believe me , I wanted to talk to noone. I made the conversation with that gentleman short and told him look, I am a believer, It is okay! I wanted to be alone , he led me to the sanctuary and I sat there writing in my journal, in my mind with my thoughts and prayers.

Truth to be told, People were so friendly. The worship was beautiful. And the message — wow.
Not many churches preach in a way that challenges you. This one went deep into Scripture, even into the book of Revelation (yes — the book many churches treat like it is classified information).

“He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches” (Revelation 2:7).

The message reminded us that we must share our faith. And I felt convicted — in a good way. Because honestly, I have been quiet.
But “we cannot help speaking about what we have seen and heard” (Acts 4:20).

So here I am sharing with you:

Jesus is salvation.
Only through Him we receive eternal life.
“And this is the testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son” (1 John 5:11-12).

There is a New Jerusalem prepared for those who belong to Him (Revelation 21). That is our real home — not Florida, not New England 😄. I have to remind myself of this.

Any other way leads to eternal separation from God. The Bible says it with love and truth, and real love tells the truth.

So now you know.
The choice is yours.

As for me — I arrived angry, homesick, and dramatic… and I left with coffee in my hand, peace in my heart, and my boarding pass to heaven already confirmed ✈️.

“How lovely is Your dwelling place, Lord Almighty… Blessed are those who dwell in Your house” (Psalm 84:1-4).

This building used to be a library they rent there, so for those complaining about not being handicapped friendly I did see a ramp a  long ramp that leads to the entrance on the side of parking lot.
What I can tell you based on Sunday morning preaching , I would def visit again. My experience at City Lift Church has been phenomenal so far. Coming from an Organizational leadership perspective everything from the coffee station the times, the functionality, the structure, the delivery, and the communication has been very intentional. I don’t feel judged or pressured, I feel loved and accepted. City lift Church is welcoming and aesthetically pleasing.

The service is meaningful, powerful, uplifting, and engaging. The pastor has a way of connecting with all walks of life and making you feel seen and heard. The First Lady is always joyful, expresses gratitude, patient, and calm. Her harmonic tone brings ease yet pulls you in as she shares whether it’s a word from the Bible or a testimony.She’s a bright spot in an anyone’s day. The two together is dynamic you can see the hard work and hustle, but also see the softness and care for others. You can see their heart through their actions, their words and their presence.

And last, but not least my kids absolutely love it from the first day they stepped foot in the doors. The lessons are meaningful and fun, and it’s always great to discuss after church and always excited to go the next time they’re with Mommy. 10/10 experience! This is such a great church where the theology is sound and Pastor Matt teaches with clarity and conviction. The worship team truly creates an atmosphere that invites the presence of Jesus into the room.

And the community, just wow. We’re not meant to do life alone, and being part of this church is a beautiful reminder that God is in the “together” moments.

I’m so grateful for Pastor Matt and Pastor Alyssa and their obedience to God in creating a Christ-centered space for the people of South Florida.

If you haven’t visited yet, come join us at ArtServe at 10:30am! In the past, I was searching for a small church close to home. From the very first time I visited, I felt truly welcomed. That feeling stayed with me, and before I knew it, this became a place I can call my own church.
I’ve already started serving, and even though it has only been one month, it honestly feels like I’ve been here for a whole year. The love, connection, and sense of belonging have been unbelievable.
The pastor is truly inspiring, delivering messages that are both powerful and easy to understand. You can feel the genuine care and passion for the people and the community, which makes a big difference.
One thing I really appreciate is how comfortable and relaxed the atmosphere is—you don’t have to stress about what to wear, you can just come as you are. I love it here! The people are always so welcoming & kind. I’ve never felt pressured to serve God or participate but the pastors allow it come from your heart. Pastors are family orientated and really about the people. Worship is great and the preaching is biblical.

name: City Light Baptist Church
City Light Baptist Church - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a new church that has a vision to impact Irvine with the gospel of Jesus. They are a healthy and vibrant church with great servant leaders. Pastor Kim is a great pastor and spiritual leader. I’m glad I was able to visit during the early weeks of this ministry. Come and see what God is doing here. My son really enjoyed the children’s class. Genuine biblical teaching and pastoral heart

I'm so grateful to have found City Light Baptist Church in Irvine. Pastor James Kim is truly remarkable - you can clearly see that the Holy Spirit is working through him in his ministry. He is someone who has genuinely heeded the call of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ to preach and teach others here in Orange County about who the Lord Jesus is.

What I find most refreshing about this church is the commitment to solid, biblical preaching and teaching of the Holy Scriptures. In a time when many churches focus on "hyping up" congregations with emotional speeches rather than sound doctrine, City Light Baptist Church stands apart with authentic, Christ-centered messages that truly feed your soul.

On top of all that, the people are nice too! In fact, I would say they're the family away from home.

If you're looking for a place where you can grow closer to the Lord through faithful biblical teaching and genuine pastoral care, I wholeheartedly recommend visiting City Light Baptist Church. This is a church where God's Word is honored and His people are shepherded well. Great church! Love this area, and the people!! What a blessing to worship in this church! The preaching is always inspiring and thought-provoking, with a focus on biblical teaching and practical application. Pastor James is genuine, compassionate and truly cares about the well-being of his flock. I highly recommend City Light Baptist Church to anyone looking for a spiritual home where they can grow in their faith, connect with others, and serve the Lord. City Light Baptist Church is a wonderful church to be at. Especially in Irvine, where it is in need of a SOUND DOCTRINE, Pastor James Kim does a great job organizing the church and spreading the GOOD NEWS. Salvation is through faith only, no amount of works can get save you from eternal damnation and Pastor James DOESN'T COMPROMISE on any doctrinal flaws. Not only that, this church seems to be deeply caring for each member, work in unity, and is motivated to grow in Christ. Highly recommend to those who are seeking deeply for the sound truth.

name: City of Angels International Christian Church - Inland Empire Region
City of Angels International Christian Church - Inland Empire Region - Riverside (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: I had to post this to balance out that one star the other reveiwer put. First off, the church is called the city of angels international church. Nowhere in it does it contain the word "empire," that is just the region it is in. Second, Google should have their workers REGULARLY check for idiotic reviews like this one to not let one person determine the star ratings for a set location. As for the church, I personally havent been there since my parents wont let me, but as a disciple, I would say it is worth checking out since it is necessary that we expand our choices in joining ministries. Many churches today follow false doctrine, so it is important we find the right one.

name: City Presbyterian Church
City Presbyterian Church - Long Beach Campus
Citygate Ministries
Citygate Ministries - Fort Myers Campus
reviewSummary:
Awesome place of praise and worship. The pastors are fun and very down to earth. The service is shorter than my past experience but the amount of teaching cannot compare to the longer services. At City Gate you get the Word, Ministries, encounters,and blessings. Most of all the Pastors and their wives are one of us on and off the alter. Thank you Jesus for answering my prayer as I transition to SWFL A place to call home and find family. They offer many groups and workshops. You can find community without judgement. This church has changed my life. CityGate is my home church and I so enjoy it! Seen in the videos and pictures in this review is a Sunday morning service and a couple pictures from Men of Honor/The Herd, CityGate’s Men’s Ministry on Tuesday evenings.

From the first time I walked through the doors, knowing only one person who attends, CityGate has always welcomed me in and encouraged me to become involved.

During my time, I have been able to volunteer at a women’s conference, be a youth group leader for 9th and 10th grade boys, be part of the choir, and everything else that I can’t remember.

I so appreciate that CityGate speaks life during this world living broken.

CityGate does not shy away from the difficult topics and approaches everything with a biblical context and focus.

Glad to be part of CityGate! The pastor called and completely agreed with my battle. Thank you guys for being vigilant.

Thanks for the call and look forward to the meet. This was my first experience and I loved the praise and joy.
Thank You God

name: CityLight LA
CityLight LA - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary:
Exegetical teaching straight from the Bible. A modern church atmosphere and appearance, but rooted in God’s unchanging Word and this church stands on that truth as THE ONE and ONLY truth. Unashamedly preaching to a world and city in need of the Gospel. Amazing community of people. Pastors are amazing devoted men of God. Young adults, parents and families, older folk; it’s a biblical picture of the different cultures, age ranges, and skin colors God has created to make up the church.

Been going here 3 years, and won’t be leaving! Friendly and respectful.  Great for kids and families in the area.  They always have activities to get you involved and have a passion to support the community.  The staff does a fantastic job providing support and go the extra mile to make the experience positive and uplifting.  I’ve been attending here since 2010. After years as a Christian I found a home in Citylight Baptist. The welcoming congregation and youth of the pastor has been a tremendous blessing in my life. Pastor Nick Reed, being a young leader, provides enthusiasm and energy while remaining absolutely true to the word of God. Also, he is able to appeal to younger members and visitors with references to today's technology and how it impacts our lives. Come join us and you will not regret it. Citylight is a wonderful place for all the whole family.  They have wonderful nurseries, childrens classes and teen ministries.  The church leadership are warm, receptive and helpful.  It is a great place to find the true word preached straight from the bible.  The Pastor is on fire for the word and makes it applicable to everyday life.  There are several community events throughout the year that allows us to give back to our community.  Come check us out. For a long time I was looking for a church in where doctrine was more important than the "right" atmosphere or music. Stepping into Citylight, formally Victory Baptist, not only was I greeted by friendly workers but Pastor Nick Reed preached a relevant, but convicting message. Citylight strives on serving the community, and gives people many opportunities to be able to serve in different aspects of the church.  The children's program is wonderful! This is just the right church needed for the LA metro!

name: Cityreach Church Murrieta
Cityreach Church Murrieta - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary: Never have I felt his presents as deep as I have here.. This church is truly a blessing to all that enter.. Love the new CRV ... I go here

name: Clairemont Emmanuel Baptist
Clairemont Emmanuel Baptist - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary: What a lovely church! I came visiting from Florida and a gentleman who works at the enterprise at the airport told me about it. Thank you Philip! Thank you Kay for being so kind! Best church in San Diego. Great leadership, bible oriented, great fellowship, incredible teaching/classes, variety of ministries for all and much love here. This is my home on earth before I am taken. If you are looking for a family friendly place to meet new friends and worship, this is the place to be. The early service is more traditional, then there is time for refreshments. The later service is more contemporary than the first, not Toby Mac style, more like Michael W. Smith. People are friendly. Childcare is available. An amazing view of Mission Bay is the cherry on top! The nicest people all together worshipping and truly caring about their congregation and people around the globe. My wife and I have been members of CEBC for many years. It is a Christian church that teaches biblical principles, sends out and financially supports missionaries, has two services each Sunday and is very family oriented. The membership is counted in the hundreds, not thousands and welcomes newcomers with enthusiasm.

name: Claremont United Church of Christ
Claremont United Church of Christ - Pomona / Claremont Campus
reviewSummary: I just photographed a wedding here and this church was amazing. From the gentlemen that was more than helpful showing me around to the construction crew that made sure we knew they would stop working prior to the wedding. There were some great spots for photos with the sun behind us.. so ideal. I'm posting some photos for inspiration.. and the church doors are soooooo beautiful. ~Maria • Pink Heart Photography I love this church so much. Open and affirming! The pastors are forward thinking and embrace all equally. The organ is to die for! And the new choir director is pretty awesome! Here at CUCC you will find a love and life affirming congregation.  It is a mainline Protestant, but very progressive, church that truly practices what it preaches — “All are welcome here.” Here, you will be welcomed with open arms and open minds. Amazing church, open and affirming, welcoming to all, and has a strong focus on social justice and working for the most vulnerable among us. In addition to all of the above, it's a very active church with many activities for different age/interest groups, and offers a lot of support for its congregants. I came to this church after bad experiences with other churches my entire life, and I'm so happy I found it. Come check it out - you won't regret it! I so enjoy the sermons at this church.  They are relevant, timely, practical and inspiring.  They are based on parts of the Bible I haven't explored in the past.  And then the prayers are written to support the sermon and message.  As is the wonderful music.  Everyone is  welcoming and friendly.  I have found a wonderful community.

name: Claremont United Methodist Church
Claremont United Methodist Church - Pomona / Claremont Campus
reviewSummary: I am in another part of the country and am giving you 5 stars just because of your manger scene! Bless you for "saying it" like it is!!! If we all SPEAK UP and ACT, maybe we can rid our country of this hate and those spewing it. This would be my home in the United Methodist Church! I love that Claremont is an open and affirming church that welcomes all God's children no matter who they are or where they find themselves on the journey of faith. I love that Claremont UMC walks the walk and talks its talk about social justice and serving the least among us both nationally, globally and locally as Jesus taught. I am deeply and passionately moved by their worship that is liturgical and yet full of spirit especially at Easter and Holy Week. I was baptized in this church on Holy Saturday two years ago. Pastors Sharon and Dan are wonderful servant leaders and I am proud to know them as friends, children of God and my brothers and sisters in Christ. God bless you, Claremont UMC! I would highly recommend this church. These 1-star reviews are 5-star reviews for anyone who has an actual clue about Christ's ministry. Highly recommended for people interested in legitimate exploration and expression of their faith Very nice church . went there for my aunts memorial serv.😟 Friendly, open and welcoming people and traditions. Lots of community service.

name: Clearwater Community Church
Clearwater Community Church - Clearwater Campus
reviewSummary: I attended this church for about 4 months. It's a nice, easy going, medium-sized church. I was happy there until I learned that they prohibit women from attaining leadership roles within the church (such as becoming an "elder"). I spoke with one of the pastors and was offered a meeting so that he could explain their reasoning in depth. I declined, as there is nothing that he could say that would convince me to continue bringing my daughters to a church that intended to teach them that they are someone less qualified to lead just because they are women. Jesus preached inclusion and love, not division and discrimination. I will not be going back. I’ve been coming here about a year now and the preaching is awesome, straight out of the Bible. The people are warm and friendly and I truly look forward to seeing EVERYONE. If you’ve been thinking about joining us, just do it. You won’t be sorry. The worship service is pretty great too! I attended this church 3 times after moving down here trying to find the right church home. Great church, sticks to biblical teaching not all about a performance, motivational talk or lights/smoke show type of sermon which is a relief. That being said the third visit the sermon was about Matthew 34-36 and the topic of telling the truth. My 8 year old was present with me when of all examples the pastor decided to go into detail how Santa is a lie and not real. Which IS TRUE. I became a believer 1 year ago, my husband is not. I talked about not lying about Santa, he had no desire to nix that tradition. So when the kids asked I said nothing. So not to disrespect my husband or my God. If I were at dinner with an unbelieving family would I say 'Mommy and Daddy don't participate in grace because the are going to hell and don't believe.' is that true? Yes. Is there a GRACEFUL way to share truth that is not forceful or eager to spoil other's family traditions. Yes. Don't lie is pretty self explanatory, the nuances of application require wisdom. Lacking grace when explaining Jesus' teachings is just not for me, I won't be attending again. I love my church family. Have been a member for about two years. The teaching is sound and centered on God’s Word. Great programs for the kids, teens and adults of all ages. Come check it out! Wonderful church.  It hosts many recovery groups like CR and FA. A genuinely Christian Church. A truly spiritual place that preaches and teaches the Bible correctly. The staff and members are true Christians.  A genuinely friendly and welcoming place. You have to see it to appreciate it!

name: Coast Bible Church
Coast Bible Church - Laguna Niguel Campus
reviewSummary: I grew up at this church. I have also visited and attended many other churches in my life but C. B. C. is more than just a building filled with songs and a sermon. It's a family of people who actually care about each other. A smaller church with a big impact in the community. With a focus on family and the kids/youth, there are lots of great programs and ways for you to get involved. Solid bible teaching that is relatable and great worship make this a great place to call home. Firstly the people here are like non other,  classy,  genuine, have the up most respect for other humans. Secondly there facility is always immaculate, it's kinda hidden [which I personally like] looks small but seems to never end hehe so it is truly a nice place. COOL CHURCH !   This is a nice place to go if you are looking for a church in mission viejo or ladera ranch.  It's not too imposing and they have good worship music.  Coast bible church also has great kid and family program. Even though I was out of town visitor I felt at home I’ve gone to the church a few times and it’s been an amazing experience. It’s a comfortable place to be connected with God, and those around you.

name: Coast City Church
Coast City Church - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary:
I started attending when I saw their sign in Sept of 2020 and a lot of churches were not open due to COVID. This church is about community and loving people. There are many ways to connect and everyone is so welcoming. Very personal staff w/great Pastors. Music includes drums, guitars, multiple singers with high energy and upbeat songs!
Love this place of worship.
Live streaming on YouTube, and FB! I love this church. Pastor Doug (main pastor) is great, also Pastor Bob. There may be others, these are the only 2 I’ve heard. My grandkids love the youth Pastor. The music is great to worship to. It’s a wonderful community church! We’ve been attending this church now for over 2 years and since the first day we came we’ve felt like family. Pastor Doug is an amazing speaker and very intentional with his messages. Everyone there is so kind and loving, immediately walking in you can feel it. Worship is amazing!!! Childcare is very professional and fun for the kids, my son loves the nursery there! Each teacher has a huge heart for the kids. There’s free coffee & donuts and who doesn’t like that?! Haha but in all seriousness, Coast City is an amazing church and we will be very sad to leave when we move. Love you all! I was so worried coming out here across the country from North Carolina. I had such a solid church family and I was afraid we wouldn’t find that again. I was wrong! We absolutely found that at Coast City Church. They made us feel so welcomed and loved when we first came but what got me to stay was that they simply kept loving me and my family! They teach from the Holy Bible, the good news of Jesus Christ.
They have a great youth and child program and they engage the community more than I have seen of most churches!

Come here! You won’t be disappointed!

name: Coast Hills Church
reviewSummary: A welcoming mid-size church in south Orange County known for its modern worship and strong community feel.

name: Coast Hills Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: Wonderful church with wonderful people! I have been a Christian since I was a child and love the authenticity of Pastor Jason, who speaks the truth in love yet is not afraid to preach on hard topics and real life issues. It is not always what you want to hear, but always what you NEED to hear and in accordance with the word of God. Coast Hills Church has encouraged and strengthened me in my relationship with the Lord and started the healing process from my childhood and teenage years of legalistic teachings and misquoting of scripture (other church’s NOT Coast Hills). I love the focus at CHC on real and right relationships with God and with others. My family and I love Coast Hills Church and it has become our church “home.” You will get sound Biblical teaching and solid sermons that focus on leading you to look to the Lord and not the world for your eternal hope. I also love that the pastor is not afraid to speak the truth in love-not all roads lead to Heaven-Jesus Christ is the way, the truth and the life. The pastor and church community are welcoming, real, and we love that it encourages us as believers to always be growing in our relationship with the Lord and with others. Love Coast Hills Church! If you seek solid Biblical teaching, friendly people and beautiful worship music, you will love it here! Pastor Jason's expository teaching of the Bible is amazing and sadly, so hard to find in South OC. I grew up with expository teaching, then switched to "seeker friendly" topical teaching and wow, my eyes were opened about the dangers of purely topical studies. I've learned so much more studying the Bible verse by verse again than I ever learned at churches who have the topical study model. Pastor Jason comes across as humble and very down to earth which is also important and rare, in my experience, for a senior pastor in South OC. I've prayed for about a decade that God would guide us to the right church and I finally feel like God has answered that prayer with Coast Hills Church. Come check it out, you will LOVE it! This is a family-friendly community church with energetic, contemporary worship, and Pastor Jason is an amazing teacher who likes to connect with the people. Great outreaches, children’s ministry, and fabulous women’s ministry too. Loving church. We love this body of believers and the Pastor- such awesome teaching. Pastor Jason picks a book and goes through verse by verse in an easy to understand but also a deep way (milk & meat and potatoes). Great children's program with super fun undersea murals and such warm teachers. Love the women's Bible study too! There's all kinds of support groups there as well (ie cancer care- which was a blessing in a lonely time).

name: Coastline Baptist Church
Coastline Baptist Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
I visited Coastline approximately 14 years ago for the first time. I had very little interest in getting back into church, because I had grown up in church and had strayed far from Christ and His church. Through living people and positive interactions, I returned several times over the next few years before getting my heart right, and ultimately joined. Over the last 11 years, my wife, daughter, and both sons have come to accept Christ! This place has been such a blessing to our family.
The Pastor - preaches God’s Word unfailingly and has a heart for winning souls to Christ.
The facilities are top notch, having recently been completely renovated.
The programs are friendly and have a class for everyone of every age.
The message is to “love God, and love others”
The congregation is friendly, engaging, and very diverse.

Whether your first time ever attending a church, or for are new to the area, you should definitely visit Customs!! Great church… All around… True Bible based teaching, amazing worship Kind of people and a great children’s ministry We love Coastline! We’ve been attending for close to 3 years. We “church shopped” for quite a while in North County, but landed here, and we feel at home!

My husband was raised Lutheran, and I was raised Catholic. We knew we were missing out on a church where we could truly just learn from the Bible. Coastline has been awesome for that. We love that the pastor teaches from the Bible. He teaches us what specific words mean, and their origin, which really helps those (like me) who need it translated a little more.

We’ve felt welcome there since our first day. We’ve had SO much community as a military family since joining their small groups. Our children have loved it as well.  They’ve learned just as much as we have.

We will be so sad to leave this church. I highly recommend Coastline. Pastor Steve is the best. Very welcoming church full of great people From the warm welcome we received on our first visit to the genuine sense of community that permeates every aspect of this church, our experience has been nothing short of exceptional.

The leadership at Coastline Baptist Church is both inspirational and compassionate. Pastor Chappell delivers sermons that are not only spiritually enriching but also highly relevant to our everyday lives.

The worship services are uplifting and filled with a powerful energy that leaves a lasting impact. The music ministry is outstanding, featuring talented musicians that add a beautiful dimension to the worship experience. The blend of traditional hymns and contemporary worship songs caters to a diverse congregation, ensuring that everyone can connect with the music on a personal level.

I wholeheartedly recommend Coastline Baptist Church to anyone seeking a welcoming, spiritually enriching, and community-focused place of worship.

name: Coastline Church
Coastline Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
I am on vacation and visited this church for the first time today, and I absolutely loved it! I felt so close to the Lord during the service. The worship team was incredible, and the music was uplifting and heartfelt. The pastor did an amazing job delivering the message in a way that was both easy to understand and deeply impactful. I wish I could go here every Sunday! Highly recommend! Its a place of community, small groups, serving, and love. As with any church, if you get connected you will feel connected. Come join our "Dream Team" . Gods word and love is alive here. Cafe open Monday & Wednesdays 7:30-10:30 am for a complimentary cup of coffee and fellowship. Come join us & get connected. I’ve attended numerous churches since childhood, but i have to admit, that Coastline is indeed a powerful experience for young or old, that want to grow in their Faith. In addition, our young children love coming to church each Sunday., come visit and see for yourself. The least freindly church I have come across of. I was not talked to once other than greeter. Beautiful grounds. Organized parking lot. Looked like they took the safety of the children in the kids minstery seriously. Their worship is good. The message was interesting. I could tell that a lot time and money was put in to the place by the equipment I saw. That was the first impression of the church. Fantastic church— Loving, giving, caring members— Pastor is genuine, very intelligent, annointed with continually moving messages— Fantastic worship and audio/video mixing and presentation. Truly a one of a kind experience and grateful every day for having found such a one-of-a-kind fellowship and discipleship of Christ Jesus. Coastline Church is lead by people of God who know what the meaning of integrity is without falling into judgemental attitudes that sometimes come with devout churches. They have a kind of motto "No perfect people allowed." Seeing as I'm about as far from perfect as any man could be, I have never once felt judged or shamed for my poor life choices, but those who I have made closer connections with have lovingly kept me accountable for my actions to help me not live my life in the self-destructive ways I once was familiar with.
I always thought of the church as having a giant church experience but with that small church feel. Plus we got the best pastor around.

Coastline Covenant Church - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Coastline Covenant Church is such a blessing!! Solid and impactful sermons, an amazing sense of community, incredible youth groups, and worship that feels like a gospel concert every Sunday! There are not enough stars here to give!  If looking for a new church to go to look no further.  This church feels like home.  They offer excellent kids programs, community groups that meet in homes, solid biblical teaching, engaging worship and an overall strong desire to connect with each other. This is the first church I have been to, that I truly feel excited to go to every week. It is a church that feels welcoming and encouraging to everyone that steps inside. They have an amazing worship team, relatable pastors, and great kids programs. Coastline is not like any other church but rather emphasizes the importance of loving God and loving others as a FAMILY. You are immediately welcomed in and know you belong before you even walk through the doors. A great church with good worship, solid teaching and excellent programs for kids and youth!

name: Codex Christ Church, Corp
Codex Christ Church, Corp - Miami (Downtown/Brickell) Campus
Colonial Church
Colonial Church - St. Augustine Campus
reviewSummary: The cops threatened to forcefully remove my husband if he didn’t leave while he was having a panic attack. Distasteful and offensive at best. I don’t think Jesus is involved with these wolves I’ve had such a wonderful experience at this church! From the very first time I visited, I was welcomed with genuine kindness and open arms. Pastor Matty, along with the Colonial Staff, prioritize community and offer a place where people of all ages can grow in their faith! St Augustine is incredibly fortunate to have this church. Colonial Church welcomed me like family from day one. The people here truly care, and through prayer groups, Grill & Chill, and community, my faith and relationships have grown stronger. This church is more than Sunday services—it’s a family that helps you live a God-first life and gives you the support you need when you need. Me and my wife has been going to Colonial for few years now and we absolutely love it.  All the Pastors there preaches from the Bible not their opinion of what it says but straight from the Bible. They uphold the true word and most inviting folks I've ever met. I feel like I'm family Matt and Jill don't take credit for "being awesome," but they certainly are. Their energy, love and enthusiasm is deeply felt, and is experiential through their music, their worship and sermons! Making others feel "at home" in their Church seems to be effortless, which is a gift to the community. We are excited about their shared "vision" for 2023.

name: Commission Church
Commission Church - Plano Campus
reviewSummary:
Our family had been searching for a church where we could truly feel like we belong- just as we are. With two young daughters, including one on the autism spectrum, finding a welcoming and understanding environment was not easy.
From the moment we visited Commission Church, we felt that sense of acceptance. It’s a place where our child is embraced and supported, and that means everything to us. The church offers incredible childcare and even provides dedicated buddies for children with special needs, which is very amazing. This is a truly Spirit-filled and Bible-based church where the presence of God is real, word of god is taught in truth and you are welcomed just as you are.
Beyond that, there are so many opportunities to get connected, grow in faith, and build meaningful relationships with others. No matter your age or stage in life, there’s something for everyone. We truly feel blessed to be part of this church community and are so grateful we found a place where we are genuinely welcomed and loved. “This church is truly a place of God’s presence and genuine community. The worship is heartfelt, the teaching is biblically grounded, and the leadership demonstrates sincere care for people. I have personally experienced spiritual growth and encouragement through the ministry here. I highly recommend this church to anyone seeking a deeper relationship with God and a loving church family.” Commission Church has changed my life it is the true definition of what a church is suppose to be!! I have been going to Commission since June I am so grateful I listened to the Holy Spirit that led me to Commission! Paster and his wife are amazing the realest people I have ever met! You talk about the Holy Spirit moving come see us , come be apart of our mission!!! Loving God , loving our neighbors!! After visiting numerous churches in Fort Worth and Dallas, my wife and I landed at a Commission Church.  The people are so welcoming and kind! The pastor brings a fresh message that delivers the TRUTH in a loving and understanding way.  The church is diverse and is growing! My wife and I attend now with our kids.  Children’s, pre-teen, youth and young adult leaders are all genuinely caring people that truly want each person to feel connected and grow in their faith.  Love this place. 5 stars! We love Commission Church! My husband and I have been attending Commission Church for about a year and a half. Though we are introverts, the gentle way Pastor Ashish encourages people to get involved has helped us to find our place to serve. In serving, we have gotten to make new friends. I love the multicultural and multigenerational aspect of our church – so many people who love and respect each other.  I also love the Bible teaching and the opportunity to praise and worship the Lord!

name: Commission Church - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary: Wonder community of people at this church. Our daughter love their youth group. Which meets every Sunday  afternoon. And Mallory their youth pastor she really has a heart to serve in these kids and we're very thankful that we found the church as well as our pastor Cam he is really transparent and full of the spirit Beautiful service and beautiful members. I thank God for putting this church family in our lives. Would prefer to hear more of the teachings but the praise and worship is fire too.  We moved out of the area, (which is over 50 miles away). But my great nephew is looking for a church in RC, so I’m making that drive to introduce him to this great church family. May God continue to bless all of you! CCF was my home church for so many years before I moved to live with my daughter. They were always so caring and supportive. When my husband went home to be with the Lord, they were there.  i wish I lived closer to still be a member of this church family. Melanie, Ann and Bob, I really miss you.  God bless you. Betty Torres I miss my church home everyday since we left moved out of state. I found my family there, married there, and dedicated my daughter. This is a place where the broken find not only a place to heal, but a place to grow into who God has always seen them as, perfect, untouched, loving children. It's a place that digs deep and gives you the tools you need to make it in this walk we call life. Holy Spirit dwells within those walls of his people. I love this place.!! Pastor Frasier is the best.. He has dedicated my daughter then yes later also baptised her also. My life has been a struggle as a single mother & pastor Frasier has been there the entire time with & for me.. I love this church!!

reviewSummary: What a fantastic church community! I haven’t been to church in years and was a little hesitant and nervous to come at first, but I am so glad did because I was welcomed with open arms. Great messages, great people and great things are happening here! Visiting my big bro for the weekend and picked this church across the street from his apt. 10:45 service—everyone was so warm and welcoming! And we had FUN. Come on in! Love this church. Found it a couple months ago in walking distance from where we live, and now it's our church home! I now see why it's so important to find a church home. Powerful sermons, amazing association, great fellowship and ways to stay connected to the church family. Even from online, their messages are powerful, Word driven, and applicable to our daily lives to become better stewards for Christ. Kids services are every other week, and our 13 month old daughter loves it there! Join us for service on Sundays at 10:45 a.m., and join one of our circles that are almost every day of the week, to get connected and fellowship even if you work on Sundays! Luminous City Church is unlike any church family I had been a part of! Their culture is so loving and accepting, and they truly love their city. They do monthly I Love My City events around San Diego to spread the love as Jesus would want us to. They talk the talk and walk the walk! Amazing and refreshing! This church is high energy and down to earth, so glad i came. They have powerful messages and amazing worship, and everyone is so warm and friendly. It feels like home

reviewSummary:
I have had the best experience in Community Christian Church...
What a lovely group of people, and so friendly! I feel like Jesus is right in church with me as the music and worship is so inviting and very grounded in the Word....Pastor Justice is a very sincere and caring Pastor and always takes time to be personal with all....He really cares about the family here. The Worship Team is always available to give "hands on" prayer for those whom need to be lifted up and prayed for....I have only been attending since September 2014 but I feel like I am a long time family member......thanks. Even though I oversee a Home Church in my house the Lord has expanded my world and brought me up to Community Christian Church last year (2016). It is a church on fire for the Lord. Pastor George goes deep into the Word and brings out the meat. It is a family. We enjoy lunch every Sunday after service. We have had teachers from Bethel and Oregon Epic Center. We have had a Discovery Weekend from with Kingdom Catalyst to help bring revival to San Pedro and the South Bay. CCCis my new home away from home. I have said more than once that one of the reasons I love Pastor ❤️ George is because he believes in sharing the message he said God had downloaded into him and it comes across that way! To put it simply it may not be what you want to hear but it's What you Need To Hear!! I challenge you to check It Out. IF you are looking for a church Family Look no Farther you have Found IT AT CCC! I attended CCC with my mom Frances, people were really kind to my MOM. She had a nice celebration of life on 6/20/15. Pastor Justus was very kind and friends commented on it. I want to thank all who attended, I know MOM is watching, she  would have wanted to give all of you a big HUG and dance with you. Thank you all again. Andrea Espinosa, MD

PS please update your calendar and web site. I know there is a speaker tomorrow, I wanted to invite a friend but name of the speaker not on your calendar. Please update calendar weekly thanks Great Spirit led worship. Bible study and services based on the word of God. Pastor George, his wife Olivia, and the congregation makes you feel like family from day one!

reviewSummary:
I was watching your service online and was planning on making this my permanent church. However, I was disappointed to see the way the pastor handled a situation. Worship team is amazing filling the room with Gods love to His people while giving praise and worship to God the Father. name: Community Church Congregational
Community Church Congregational - Newport Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
We are so thankful for CDM Community Church Congregational and what a wonderful experience we had with our wedding! We love pastor Bob and loved meeting with him, if we didn’t move to Nevada we would have stayed with the church. Lesslie was a star in making sure everything went seamless with everything to do with the ceremony, just happy beyond words on how smoothly everything went even with little bumps in the road (I forgot my vail in the buss, had to hide coming to church from groom, he was wondering outside the grooms room. It’s such an amazing memory and I hope others will have the same amazing experience here too. We loved how charming, and beautiful the inside and outside of the church is and the photos and lighting came out perfect. Even during pandemic the church has a YouTube live channel set up so our family from back east could watch!!! I am leaving this review as a vendor, not as a church member:

I photographed a wedding at CCC on 09/14.  As soon as my team and I arrived to the church, Leslie (the church coordinator) greeted us, showed us the space, and went over important ceremony information. She and her assistant were helpful and a pleasure to interact with. They ensured that the bride and groom had anything they needed while getting ready in their suites and were always nearby should any family member had any questions. The church space was impeccably clean and looked beautiful (see attached photos to admire the natural light).  I highly recommend CCC to anyone looking to get married at a gorgeous church! We are incredibly grateful that this is the church where we became husband and wife; this church provided everything we were hoping for and more for our wedding ceremony. To start, the location itself is beautiful, with a natural elegance that sets the atmosphere which is both warm and reverent. It was great working with Leslie, the church coordinator: she was notably well organized and provided valuable coordination services during the ceremony, which freed up our wedding coordinators to focus on reception logistics. We also greatly appreciated Emma, the pianist at the church: Emma was so impressive in learning and perfectly playing several songs for us that were sentimental to our family and our love story and added really meaningful touches to our ceremony. Last but certainly not least, we loved that Kipp was our officiant: there is no one else like him. Despite our not having a relationship with him before choosing the church as our ceremony venue, Kip brought a warmth and kindness that made us feel instantly comfortable and blessed to have him start us on our marriage journey. Many of our friends and family who met him also commented on these qualities. We recently sat down to watch the video of our ceremony and were as touched by Kip’s beautiful sermonette as we were on our wedding day.

We look forward to coming back to the church in the future and showing our children where we say our family was born. A beautiful church for weddings! I attended a wedding there this past weekend, and it was a fantastic experience. The space was clean, the instruments sounded great, and the overall atmosphere was perfect for such a special occasion. The only downside—and the reason for my 4-star rating—is the parking situation, which was quite challenging. Other than that, it’s a wonderful place! We had our wedding there last year.  The location is ideal, but it's a wacky little church.  The "pastor" who was our interface was really the pastor's husband and had some odd quirks, so we had to fight to keep him from being prominent  in our ceremony like he seemed to expect.  Also they had a very odd rule of not allowing the congregation to take pictures during a wedding.  I mean come on, this is wedding!  Only those behind the last occupied row were allowed to take pictures.  Of course everyone took pictures anyway (smartphones), but man, what a weird setup.  The location makes for great pictures (which is how they make their money), but I wouldn't recommend anyone getting married there.  Too much weirdness.  I had another friend who had a  similar experience there too.

name: Community Church of Poway
Community Church of Poway - Poway Campus
reviewSummary: Wonderful looking church. The congregation are nice & humble. A wonderful old church. Oldest Christian, non Catholic church still in operation. I'm from Oregon and my nephew Marcus wants us to go. Early 5 star review, 🌟 to be continued...... My brother in law married his wife in this church 30+ years ago. It was beautiful. I hope others can enjoy this historic church for many years to come. Scout Sunday with chartered organization - great support for Venture Crew, Troop, and Pack 109! Sermon of course always a plus.

name: Community Church Rancho
Community Church Rancho - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary: This place feels like home. Ever since I first stepped into this church, we have been coming here almost every weekend for over a year. People are friendly and welcoming, and the beautiful hymns are touching and inspiring, often bringing me to tears. There are different Sunday school classes for children of various ages, including preschoolers, students from grades 1 to 6, and teenagers. Every weekend, I feel a sense of peace and love here. Be careful with this church as it also serves as a home base for Legacy Christian home school/private. We were recommended to the school by what we thought was a friend from our old church WOL. We quickly realized the racial undertones disguised as “like minded” people. Including the different treatment to those that are white or light skin tone. Many incidents with multiple people in leadership to support our conclusion including our so called friend. They are not an “outreach” church as they say. They are not about reaching the lost as Jesus did. Instead those that they feel are worthy to be in their circle/click. They are about keeping themselves and their kids in a bubble. Didn’t Jesus teach us to go out and make disciples? Didn’t Jesus eat with sinners? This is Christianity 101. The mother, daughter running this program will need to stand before Jesus one day. I hope they wake up and repent. Used to go here a lot as a kid was a nice place.They've done a lot of upgrading Loving, accepting, caring church with people and staff who cultivate love, joy, peace, patience, humility, kindness, and self control. Great music, inspiring insightful preaching, memorable heart touching word pictures and video illustration of various themes and passages. Free coffee tea lemonade and treats in the patio after and between services with a generous number of chairs and tables in the refreshment area for comfortable conversation. The Pastor touches your souls, the church community is amazing! I’d recommend this church to anyone and my family and I do!

name: Community Faith Center
Community Faith Center - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary:
I started attending Community Faith Center about 10 years ago. I stopped attending church about 8 years ago. When I decided it was time for me regularly attend church services again, I choose Community Faith Center. I contacted Pastor Eddie and met with me before my first Sunday service. This immediately helped me feel connected and loved.  When I attended the first Sunday, the church treated me as though I never left! Such love, acceptance, and kindness. As of today, I have been attending for three months.
Pros:
Warm and friendly staff and congregation, down to Earth pastor that cares for the need's of the people, experienced and anointed singing and music, lively and fun atmosphere during praise, diversity of ages, cultures, ethnicities, and languages. Updated facilities in a historic building. Sermons that bring life application. A mix of mature and new believers. Focused believers seeking a connection with a Living God. God honors the church's seeking and devotion with powerful manifestations of joy, understanding, and the gifts of the Holy Spirit. God's Spirit confirms His Word. This church believes in fun. There are children's ministries, youth ministries, and other activities to do and participate.
Cons:
If you are not used to a bilingual service, this may come as a surprise and a challenge to your worship. The service is equally English and Spanish. I find this an asset, but others may see it as too challenging. I encourage you to give it a try. If you’re searching for a church where you can worship God with liberty, this is the place for you. Vivacious worship music and anointed sermons that touch your heart and soul. You will be thoroughly fed Good the Word of God, and deeply enriched. You will feel the Holy Spirit- God is alive-Jesus is the chief cornerstone and the center of every worship service. I’ve been attending CFC for two years now, and I felt a very warm welcome from day one. I enjoy the Spanish music, language, and people. The church continues to grow, and more ethnicities seem to be coming in and creating a diversity of people. However, traditionally this Church was founded as a Spanish Apostolic Assembly which still prevails in a beautiful way. Powerful services, and a lovely serene presence of Holiness, and freedom to Worship the King of all kings, Jesus Christ. Everyone is welcome here! My home church absolutely love it ,there is nothing like being in the presence of the Lord. My pastor is a God fearing man and has genuine for his members and any who walks thru the doors Need a church come join us you will love it ,God bless. If your seeking for the lord Community faith faith center is the place to go.

name: Community Lutheran Church
Community Lutheran Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:

Attended as a First-time visitor but would be comfortable coming back.
The Good Friday Service was really good. There was music and preaching plus various meditative stations around the room.
I like the level of volume for the music, and singing hymns is nice to. The music accompanied the singing rather than trying to sing along to the music; very centering.
The stations allowed for personal reflection and how Christ is available at any level since he was at the lowest on Good Friday and died.
Friendly people and meaningful experience. One of the most inviting churches I have ever attended. Very family oriented and inclusive of children. Excellent church in a beautiful location on the hill above O'Neill Regional Park. The people are friendly and the Pastors keep the Sunday service insightful and fun. They start the Sunday service with inviting the kids up front for a children's message which puts a smile on everyone's face. name: Community United Methodist church
Community United Methodist Church - Huntington Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Been here a couple of times for the Pacific Chorale concert. Nice main hall that can seat around a hundred people. Nice big garden outside, and the parking lot is quite spacious too. Restrooms are outside in a building across from the main hall - clean and well maintained. Acoustics inside the main hall were pretty good. Church is easy to get to - pretty close to the 405. We absolutely love Community United Methodist Church (CUMC) in Huntington Beach! Each year, they generously host our annual Green & Clean Shred Event, a day dedicated to paper shredding, E-waste collection, and gathering donations for the Food Pantry. CUMC's unwavering commitment to serving the community truly stands out, making a significant impact on our lives and the lives of many others.

Scott and Philip, long-standing members of our team, have been part of CUMC for years and consistently praise the church's dedication to community service and outreach. Their stories and experiences highlight how CUMC extends its warmth and support not just within its walls but throughout the entire community.

CUMC offers a wide range of programs and events all year round, fostering a welcoming atmosphere for new visitors and regular attendees alike. It's a place where anyone can feel at home, embraced by a community that cares deeply about each individual's spiritual journey and well-being.

We're excitedly preparing for our 11th Annual Green & Clean Shred event in the CUMC parking lot, another testament to the church's support for environmental stewardship and community engagement. If you're looking for a church that truly embodies the spirit of community and open-heartedness, Community United Methodist Church in Huntington Beach is the place to be. Good to the less fortunate with real people just helping serve humanity. Genuinely kind & caring staff leadership  + members!  🙏⭐️❤️ A church that helps the least of God's people and Loves the Lord, they are very welcoming and actively serve to those in need on Fridays food and other resources .

reviewSummary: Distinctly 'Expository'. Reviews consistently praise the 'Verse-by-Verse' teaching style. This is a destination for those seeking 'Meat' and deep biblical literacy over entertainment. It attracts a 'Serious Student' demographic.

name: Compass Bible Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
This church has caused and continues to cause unbelievable amounts of harm to countless strong believers in the area. The problem stems from the very top down into most of the pastoral leadership and some of the staff. Compass has time and again prioritized image, money, and status over actually shepherding their congregation in a biblical and loving way. The lack of love- specifically from the pastors here- is painfully evident. Even more so when you are on the receiving end of sinful behavior at the hands of leadership. Great community can be found here, but one is immediately cut off if one dares to share how they were treated by leadership. The issues here are so serious that most other local Christian pastors are not only very aware of the problems, but frequently discuss them amongst themselves to try to best serve the poor souls that are fleeing from Compass to their churches for refuge.
There are also disturbing issues with the biblical counseling program here. Expect your information to not be kept confidential at the very least.
There is also a great lack of any accountability at the top of leadership here. No lay elders. Everyone who is an elder here is on the payroll and ultimately answers to one man. This model is not only dangerous for both the church and the man, but is also unbiblical. The culture here dares not question this man, but instead almost worships him. In an era of mega churches and social media chasing pastors, do not aim to follow and exalt one man. Instead, aim to follow and exalt Christ. There are some of the finest Christian men and women at this Church. I had the pleasure of meeting Joseph, who’s in charge of much of the music there. He could not have been nicer to work with. He takes a genuine and sincere interest in the kids who learn about God, and music as a form of praise. Good people expressing Christly character. 🙏🏻 Pastor Mike’s verse by verse in depth preaching has grown mine and my husband’s faith immensely! Even though we have moved out of state, we continue to listen to his sermons and other theology series as often as we can and are always convicted and inspired to live out our walk with Christ better! Expository teaching is over the top amazing and life changing.  I tell everyone Compass is a preview of Heaven and they really are my extended family.  We really care for one another ❤️If you want a church that propels your sanctification to a new level this is the church for you😊 I listen to the Compass Bible Church radio program called, “Focal Point” on the app and on 107.9 KMBI FM  Spokane.
I was blessed to be able to attend a National Equipped Conference in Boise a couple of years ago. I am currently watching and listening to the 2024 conference on YouTube and have been greatly encouraged. May the Lord continue to bless and keep  Pastor Mike and his solid Bible teaching.

name: Compass Bible Church Huntington Beach
Compass Bible Church Huntington Beach - Huntington Beach (North) Campus
reviewSummary:
Excellent ministry and very 'open' and accepting new people into the church. Pastor is very committed and his sermons are very well spoken and and enlightening! I've been a Roman Catholic all my life and was raised in a strict Christian setting. I've been to many different churches that were different beliefs and have only found one church out of the many hundreds that I have been to that I would recommend anyone that asks me, to go to: Compass Bible Church Huntington Beach! The music is very good and moving. Uplifts the spirit! But, the pastor is the bestt part of the service.! He speaks the Word with REAL emotion and fills the room with his love of God and knows what he is telling his congregation! He is NOT talking to hear himself speak or crave the attention of the crowd! He seems very genuine and you can feel God's love through his words and sermons! And, it's spoken with true feeli ng, and in a way that is very transparent and makes a point of his sermons. He does NOT just stand up there and babble on about bits and pieces of a particular part of the Bible and not teach us something. He is feeding our souls with God's word and you leave with a full heart and feel uplifted! That's what it's all about! Learn love and follow God's word! Solid Bible teaching church where the Gospel is proclaimed every week! Awesome children's ministry. A church for every family! I enjoy the church and pastor Bobby's teachings. My greatest struggle is that I have tried to get into a small group, but the ball has been dropped several times on their part. I have gone through the foundations course, met with The person in charge of connection, and again put my name in with someone with the Connections group. I have yet to be put into a small group. 😥 It looks like I am going to have to pursue another church to get put into a small group. Feels like the Pastor Bobby back doors salvation. Like you’re saved by faith BUT you’re saved by works?? Idk I was not feeling that sermon at all…

I would avoid this church…watched the sermon online and the Bible is not being preached, but salvation by works is…which is something false religions believe.

Christians are not under God’s wrath btw…The whole point in Jesus dying on the cross is so we WOULDNT perish…not because we have the potential to if we don’t work hard enough.
JOHN 3:16💫🗡️

Be careful in these last days. There will be a lot of Pastors saying “Did God really say?” Like the serpent in the garden. Whether they perceive it themselves or not. But I pray those types of Pastors repent for making Christians think they have to work for their salvation.

Our works is evidence of our faith and we want to do it because the Holy Spirit lives in us, BUT just like Paul we will have moments when we sin and it’s because we live in the flesh still
( read ROMANS 7:19-25 )🗡️💫

We will never be sinless on earth, that includes us Christians. Sinless perfection is heretical and so is salvation by works. If the Bible says we are saved by grace through faith and it’s not of ourselves, it’s the GIFT of God not of WORKS lest any man should boast…we should trust that over false teaching…

Salvation is a FREE gift. 🎁 Amen! My colleague had told me about her church and mentioned they have a week long summer camp for kids.  So we checked it out one Saturday and then signed him up for the camp.

All I gotta say is I was blowwwn away by how amazing they made the camp for the kids.  From completely decorating the kids building floor to ceiling, from the performances, to the worship music/ dances that make it fun for kids, the games, they make fun unique treats and provide snacks (asked my son the first day what he liked about it and he said the bomb snacks 💣) but most importantly their mission to teach kids about Jesus.

The kids absolutely love this place and im so happy my colleague told us to check them out.

Everyone i met so far has been friendly and gone out of their way to talk with us about the church and even their own personal stories of what brought them and their families to this church.

I wish the adult worship had some fun dances like the kids side... I was too into it. 😄

And, it's spoken with true feeli ng, and in a way that is very transparent and makes a point of his sermons. He does NOT just stand up there and babble on about bits and pieces of a particular part of the Bible and not teach us something. He is feeding our souls with God's word and you leave with a full heart and feel uplifted! That's what it's all about! Learn love and follow God's word! Solid Bible teaching church where the Gospel is proclaimed every week! Awesome children's ministry. A church for every family! I enjoy the church and pastor Bobby's teachings. My greatest struggle is that I have tried to get into a small group, but the ball has been dropped several times on their part. I have gone through the foundations course, met with The person in charge of connection, and again put my name in with someone with the Connections group. I have yet to be put into a small group. 😥 It looks like I am going to have to pursue another church to get put into a small group. Feels like the Pastor Bobby back doors salvation. Like you’re saved by faith BUT you’re saved by works?? Idk I was not feeling that sermon at all…

I would avoid this church…watched the sermon online and the Bible is not being preached, but salvation by works is…which is something false religions believe.

Christians are not under God’s wrath btw…The whole point in Jesus dying on the cross is so we WOULDNT perish…not because we have the potential to if we don’t work hard enough.
JOHN 3:16💫🗡️

Be careful in these last days. There will be a lot of Pastors saying “Did God really say?” Like the serpent in the garden. Whether they perceive it themselves or not. But I pray those types of Pastors repent for making Christians think they have to work for their salvation.

Our works is evidence of our faith and we want to do it because the Holy Spirit lives in us, BUT just like Paul we will have moments when we sin and it’s because we live in the flesh still
( read ROMANS 7:19-25 )🗡️💫

We will never be sinless on earth, that includes us Christians. Sinless perfection is heretical and so is salvation by works. If the Bible says we are saved by grace through faith and it’s not of ourselves, it’s the GIFT of God not of WORKS lest any man should boast…we should trust that over false teaching…

Salvation is a FREE gift. 🎁 Amen! My colleague had told me about her church and mentioned they have a week long summer camp for kids.  So we checked it out one Saturday and then signed him up for the camp.

All I gotta say is I was blowwwn away by how amazing they made the camp for the kids.  From completely decorating the kids building floor to ceiling, from the performances, to the worship music/ dances that make it fun for kids, the games, they make fun unique treats and provide snacks (asked my son the first day what he liked about it and he said the bomb snacks 💣) but most importantly their mission to teach kids about Jesus.

The kids absolutely love this place and im so happy my colleague told us to check them out.

Everyone i met so far has been friendly and gone out of their way to talk with us about the church and even their own personal stories of what brought them and their families to this church.

I wish the adult worship had some fun dances like the kids side... I was too into it. 😄
