name: Compass Bible Institute
Compass Bible Institute - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
I took a one-year Bible program at CBI & it was the best decision! I have grown so much in my faith & love for God! We not only took Bible classes but got to go on two trips including one week on the East Coast & a week & a half in Greece & Rome. I grew in my faith & made so many good relationships this year. I strongly recommend this program to anyone who is looking for a year to get biblical grounded no matter what they are planning to do for college! I took the year-long gap year program through CBI and would recommend doing the same to anyone in the post high school stage of life. It not only helps you become grounded in the Christian faith but provides a plethora of opportunities for service in the local church and personal sanctification as well! Along with that, the trips were incredibly helpful in my own personal life, both to Greece and the East coast. Understanding the foundations of Christianity in the US and then also seeing the Bible come to life by visiting Nee Testament sites was something I can use every day for the remainder of my life! Taking courses at Compass Bible Institute was one of the best decisions I have made. CBI is church-based, and you can really feel that. All the classes are focused on preparing you to help you grow and serve effectively in the local church. I took some of the Pastoral Ministry training courses, and I was given opportunities to preach, serve, and lead under the mentorship of godly pastors. The classes are all biblically grounded and faithful, and on top of that, they all transferred to the Southern Baptist Theological Seminary, where I am currently a student. CBI grew my love for God, his word, and his people. If you want to be trained in a setting that holds the Bible high, prioritizes the local church, and keeps Christ at the center, I highly recommend Compass Bible Institute. I was part of a one-year program at CBI and I cannot recommend it enough. CBI provides a highly devoted group of professors and pastors to teach at a professional level for a fraction of the cost. Each class had something unique to love about it and no work or studying feels useless, a big turn-around from my school experience prior. If you have any interest whatsoever in learning more about the Bible, CBI should be at the top of your list! Taking class courses at CBI was so informative for how I am rightly to understand the bible and live it out! It also was a great experience from the teachers who were interactive and experienced in the varying fields they taught!
Plan to take a few more classes there this summer!

name: Concordia Church
Concordia Church - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary:
We love Concordia Preschool ! Our oldest attended from 3s through Pre-K and she was way over prepared for Kinder. Our youngest is there now in the 2s room. Ms Danae is amazing and he is always excited to get dropped off every day.  It's a very small family feel to the school. They also offer before/after school program for kids who go to Camarena with drop off and pick up times that truly support working families. My youngest daughter graduated pre-k from Concordia yesterday and she is our second child to go to school there. I didn't realize how emotional I would be knowing that yesterday was going to be our last time bringing our kids to school at Concordia.

Every single person on staff to Ms. Schmidt the director, Ms. Rachelle the assistant director, and all of the teachers (special shout outs to Ms. Priscilla, Ms. Phyllis, and Ms. Amy) have been absolutely amazing.  Both my daughters are really shy around strangers and everyone at Concordia has made them feel safe and comfortable. Every day after school when I asked, "how was your day?" the answer was always, "Great!" or "So much fun!"

Thank you to everyone at Concordia for a wonderful experience and for preparing my daughters for kindergarten and beyond. We are going to miss the Concordia community! When you're looking for a church home, Concordia will welcome you at the door with a friendly smile and no judgment.  Pastor Schmidt's sermons are so easy to understand and follow, it feels like he's speaking right to your heart.  He'll say, "It's not me, that's the Holy Spirit".  Our family joined this church about 6 mos ago, and have been attending for over a year.  Their council and policies are transparent.  Nothing is hidden, and you feel the honesty.  Concordia does amazing things for its surrounding community.  Every member, from small child to elderly grandparents and beyond, has a purpose and can get plugged in somewhere to make a difference for and within this church.  Concordia's message reaches beyond the four walls, which inspires more Christ-like love and good works.  Live and love like Jesus. We were in search of a church and after many we had sat thru, we knew immediately that Concordia in Eastlake , was the church for us.
I love this church !! Everybody welcomed us and with true sincerity. Answered our questions and made us feel like we belonged. Pastor Schmitt and Melissa are so open and great . The services of worship have brought my faith deeper and there are refreshments and coffee after the service.
Bible Studies are available and kids are always welcome .
Thank you ❤️ for your words of support and I hope everyone reading this will come and see for themselves how our church can be a great part of your life . The people are great at Concordia Church!  Pastor Schmidt is very skilled at relating the Bible to our everyday lives. If your looking for a place you can feel welcome regardless of how experienced or mature you are in your faith, stop looking, you have found it!  All are welcome to Concordia Church!

name: Congregational Church of La Jolla
Congregational Church of La Jolla - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary:
Love! this oldest, progressive & only LGBTQ affirming La Jolla church. The relevant sermans by Harvard trained Pastor Tim speak beautifully about our common humanity on this precious planet. Members of all religious backgrounds feel welcome & uplifted at this gorgeous church. There is great musical talent from the Director to the small Choir. A perfect Sunday, with the nearby Farmer's Market, & ocean activities. I attended last week. A very close-minded church that is more focused on political signaling than on Jesus.  Sad.  If you don't agree with their beliefs, you will feel unsafe and uncomfortable.  Really not a welcoming church A very close-minded church and pastor.  Non-welcoming.  If you support traditional beliefs and want to hear about God, not their political beliefs, stay away.   Way too much political signaling, inside and outside the church.  I felt horrible here. I felt so welcomed in this 100 year old church, where you get to know the people.
After church they have coffee, pastries and fruit in this lovely sunny room with the big french doors opening up to the patio.

The minister Sam gives sermons that gives lots of food for thought.
They truly embrace being open and affirming to all people.

I finally, after going to churches in different countries, feel like coming truly home in this church.
Thank you! We have attended this church when visiting from Canada on many occasions. We deeply appreciated Sam's ministry and wish him well in the future

reviewSummary:
We had an amazing experience at this church! The gospel was preached faithfully, the worship was powerful, and the hospitality was top-notch. Our kids loved the children’s ministry as well. We’re especially thankful for the church’s heart for local missions.

Hoops on Mission Boca Raton coming soon! I love this church!  Been coming here for almost three years and it is definitely turning into my church family.  Pastor Nhu and his family are so dedicated to bringing the Word of God to everyone!  When you are there you feel like you are at home in so many ways.  Women’s Bible Study is wonderful also.  Everyone is so friendly and kind. I love Connected Life  Church in Boca If you want to go to a church where you will learn about God and Jesus directly from The Bible in a clear-cut and easy to understand way this is the church for you! You may need to give it a few Sundays to feel what I feel🙃 My home church since 1968. Update on my original post. The pastors name is Nhu Nugyen. He has spent the past year and a half lying to me at every opportunity. He says that my children hate me. He wants me to disown my children, change my Will and leave my entire estate to him and his church. He thinks he’s going to get possession of my house after I die. He wants to rent it out for his own personal gain . He. told me to pray about this decision, which I did. Friendly and heartfelt congregation. A multicultural group with many strengths that comes together for their belief in Christ and community. Our family has lived back and forth between boca and the Carolinas and always comes back. A great place for those new to church or those that have grown up in church, everyone growing and learning together.

name: Connection Church
Connection Church - Corona Campus
reviewSummary:
My son had invited me to come to church. I was blessed for one thing this was a full circle in my life because my Son gave his life back to God and for him to ask me to come to church was amazing especially this church.Any church that worship and serve our Lord Jesus Christ is HOME to me. This was a beautiful experience with wonderful God-fearing people. The one thing that stood out to me was the Pastor of the church even though he was sick God still used him to minister to the congregation it showed me that he was a true man of God and a selfless person not a selfish person I will be visiting this location again I recommend anyone who want to fellowship and give their life to the Lord. Our need to feel safe comes here. May God bless all  who will read this review. I have been coming to this church since the fall of 2024 and I will say my experience here at Connection has been nothing short of amazing. The pastoral staff is so knowledgeable, and caring towards their flock. The members are warm and welcoming, they make it a point to learn your name and encourage you to become a part of the church family.
If you’re looking for a home church or a place to fellowship, Connection Corona is an amazing place to visit. Great church! I’m so glad I found this community. Everyone is so welcoming, inviting, and intentional. It truly feels like a family. The worship is spirit led and powerful, and the pastor teaches the true Word of God with conviction and with love. I’m so grateful to be part of such a genuine and faith filled church! I love Connection Church! I was looking for a church just before the pandemic. We visited this church and I loved it because of the strong teaching of the Pastor. My oldest son was in a different place emotionally and spiritually, perhaps because we were leaving our very large church where he was not really engaged. He did not want to stay. Our youngest son loved it because as long as he got to play in the children’s ministry and get snacks he was fine!
We returned after the pandemic and joined. I loved the strong teaching. The size was perfect for us to get involved and enjoy! That was November 6, 2022. We are now all involved, our son was just baptized at the recent beach baptism, we serve in several different ministries! They genuinely connected with us when we came! We attended some small groups and really felt connected and love Connection Church! I absolutely love this church! I’ve been attending for 3 years now, and the people here are truly loving and welcoming. At many churches, it can feel cliquish, but not here everyone genuinely loves and cares for others. I’ve never felt so accepted. This is a church that stays true to the Bible. If you want to hear the truth spoken with boldness, without fear or shame, the pastor faithfully preaches God’s Word.

reviewSummary:
FBC Coral Gables is a true blessing to the neighborhood. I recently visited for the second time and had a great experience at the Sunday Bible School. The Service started at 11 am with beautiful hymn music played by a talented pianist. It was a great feeling to sing along with the rest of the congregation as one voice. My husband and I have been coming to this church for the past two years now and it has blessed us in ways we never expected.

From the pastor who humbly shares his incredible breadth of knowledge of the Bible while connecting individually with his congregants, the choir who leads us in singing traditional hymns and the deep fellowship with its loyal, steadfast community. It is the kind of church you can put down roots in, that truly feels like home- where you’ll grow in heart, mind & most of all spirit 🤍 A church that truly feels like home. My husband and I visited several churches in Miami and this one was the one that we connected with. The church members are friendly and inviting and took genuine interest in us. Everyone is caring, thoughtful and genuine. The church is a Christ-centered and bible-based place of worship and prayer. Sunday Service wonderful.
Tks God. This church is filled with the Holy Spirit And the Lord Jesus Christ is alive and well here!! Also just as a heads up at 11 AM is the Spanish worship service, call ahead for English service times!!

name: Coral Gables Congregational United Church of Christ
Coral Gables Congregational United Church of Christ - Coral Gables Campus
reviewSummary:
Me and my wife have been to many concerts at the church. We often go and sit on the bench in front of the church, looking at the Biltmore Hotel and taking in the chirping of birds and the rustle of the palms and trees canopies. And best of all, today we came across the sign outside listing unconditional love for all humans. That really moved us. This church has a big inclusive heart, true to Christ's teachings! Christmas  eve midnite mass was truly amazing!! All were welcome, super talented Christmas  concert!! Made the greatest memories  for myself and my family!! Bell choir 30 min singing and 30 min of the Christmas  story was so perfect it made my Christmas dreams come true!! Not even crowded  seats super padded!! And free cookies  after the service!! Soo beautiful  nothing else compared it really MADE MY CHRISTMAS!!! THANK YOU!! God bless everyone!!! An evening of pure enchantment at the candlelight piano concert in the chapel! The combination of the beautiful venue, the gentle glow of candles, and the soul-stirring melodies played on the piano created a truly magical atmosphere. It was a memorable experience that touched my heart. Beautiful, inspiring, uplifting event.  The candlelight concert pianist is truly a virtuoso! She immersed herself in music and culture to prepare for this event! Her love for music, performing,  hip hop,  and her overall passion is most evident!!I I love and appreciate the connection made between the music of hip hop and social justice!

I also had the privilege to meet the lovely pastor of this church and she was most gracious and altogether wonderful.

I highly recommend this place of worship as well as the music series held there! What a great church trying to create world unity 👍🏼🙏🏼

name: Core Church LA
Core Church LA - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
My wife and I started attending a few months ago and it’s become our home church. The community is warm, welcoming, and encouraging. The men’s discipleship on Saturdays has been personally impactful. Highly recommend! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ I needed to find a good Church in Los Angeles. I google searched Church Near Me that teaches the true word of God. Core Church LA popped
up. I remember I have heard pastor Steve preach on 95.5 KKLA. So I call my mom and ask her what is the best church to go to in Los Angeles? She tells me go to the Chruch that Steve Wilburn pastors. She said I have heard him on the radio and I remember his name it sounded familiar. I look up his name and Core Church LA pops up the same church that was first in my google search! I’ve been reading the Bible for the past 14 years. I was stuck half way in the book of revelations and stopped reading the Bible for a little time maybe 2-3 years. So when I first came to Core Church it was in 2019. I am instantly greeted by the most awesome family of Christ you can imagine instant fellowship and welcome arms. I sit in the service and guess what Pastor Steve is preaching in the book of revelations in the exact same chapter that I stopped reading at in three years ago. I followed through with him through the whole study of the book of revelations and that was the Holy Spirit signifying to me this is the church you need to be in! Not only did I finish reading revelations but I understood what it meant and God has been revealing His word incredibly to me now. After I finish reading revelations I started reading the old testament because I started in the New Testament first and I will have finished reading the whole Bible cover to cover by the end of this year. I promised God I would read the Bible before He would come back and it could be any day now so pick up the word of God the Bible your armor from God Himself come to Core Church and get filled up with the Holy Spirit and let’s spend eternity in heaven together rejoicing and celebrating with our father Jesus Christ our Lord and Savior. I plan on reading the Bible every year for the rest of my life now every morning when I wake up fellowship with the Lord. This church will help you grow in the Lord God bless you all and see you at church! Core Church LA delivers passionate sermons, engaging worship, and a welcoming atmosphere. A place where biblical truth is taught boldly and lives are genuinely transformed. The word of God is always preached 📖. They have so many ministries throughout the week. This is an active church, equipping everyone to become people after God's heart. You will feel LOVED ❤️and KNOW that there is a GOD in heaven that loves you. It seems strange to rate a church so I'll do it like this:
⭐ Not Woke
⭐ Always preaches with an open Bible
⭐ Expository Preaching, not Pastor's topic of the week
⭐ Truth without apology
⭐ Gospel is preached every time
⭐ Christ's love here is Evident in leaders and believers. A safe place to worship in Truth
⭐ My new home 💯

God sent me to Cornerstone Abundant Life Church for a purpose and plan. I understand the purpose and plan for my life. I’m at a soul saving ministry which the word of God changed my life. The leadership is after Gods own heart. If you want to be apart of something great. Cornerstone Abundant Life Church is where you need to be. We live right down the street on Chase . reviewSummary:
Great Bible believing, Jesus worshiping church. Great pastors who love the flock. Great community that really feels like a family. Highly recommended! Cornerstone is a new church full of people of different walks of life and different journeys in their faith.

name: Cornerstone Bible Church - Glendora Campus
reviewSummary:
If you’re new in the area looking for a church that teaches God's word from the Bible. A wonderful family church with good worship and great teaching by pastor Bruce French. We have truly been blessed to find this church. They’re all kind loving people from the community. Pastor Bruce is humble and honest. The staff and volunteers are gracious. I feel this church strives to honor God with teaching the Bible, with worship, with prayer. I've seen how this church strives to honor people with discipleship, service to the community, and support of missionaries. My family and friends have been kindly welcomed and accepted. We love worshiping here with our family. Such an active church. We travel 50 miles one way to attend. Wish we were closer so I could be more involved but it's good to know we have a family of christians for a respite from the messy world we are in.
Thank you pastor Bruce for your sincere love of Christ and your church family. Larry Edit: No longer attend but did not leave with any animosity or issue
Services are currently held at 8:00, 9:30, and 11:00 AM on Sundays. The 9:30 service is the busiest. Finding seats at the 11:00 service is relatively easier. There is no dress code. It is very welcoming to families. A parking lot is planned for the future but parking at this time is limited to street parking. A wheelchair accessible door can be found on the eastern side of the building. The main entrance is at the southwest corner of the building. I have hesitated in writing a review on Cornerstone Church only because the experience I had upon going to the church for the first time was not a welcoming one. I was so upset because we stood in the foyer waiting to be welcomed. It didn't happen in fact I went across the street and walked off my frustration while waiting for services to begin. I've never gone to a church that hasn't welcome to at the door when you're a first-timer or even a second or third or a member of that church. Cornerstone Church made me rethink how we are supposed to behave and match like Jesus did. The service was very good and the music was wonderful we stayed for the service my fiance and I and we enjoyed it tremendously but the people they're the ones that make the church and these people don't make their Church. I went for this sermon in the music and that's what I enjoyed. I don't plan on going back there cuz I feel like we were not welcome we were Outsiders. Being new to the area we were investigating churches to find our home church and this is one of their churches we visited. I was just appointment.

name: Cornerstone Christian Fellowship - Manhattan Beach Campus
reviewSummary: The most enjoyable time we have ever spent in a christian church was a couple of weeks ago, when we dropped a friend off at LAX Airport. We did not have time to drive home before service would have been over. After looking at our phones for a few minutes we choose Cornerstone Christian Fellowship. We are now thinking of changing to Cornerstone. Everyone was wonderful. The pastor delivers a clear and precise message that we really loved. What a friendly church! My wife and I went here while living in the area for a few months on a temporary work assignment. The people are very loving, and the folks in leadership seem humble, fun, and full of integrity. Casual dress. We loved that we could come to church in sandals... just like Jesus, haha. :-) It blessed our heart to be a part of this church even for a short time. Visited church for Easter Service today, and it was a wonderful joy filled worship service. I had flown in from Tampa, Florida  for the week to attend a Memorial service and found a very welcoming congregation and Pastor. Excellent Christian Church with a pastor who understands the mind and heart. We need more Pastors like him in America. He opens the mind and heart to help our journey in life and guide us. Good Church

name: Cornerstone Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary: This church helped God save my life.  I was baptized by this church, and have become a part of its amazing fellowship.  The pastors are inspiring and accessible for one-on-one fellowship and prayer.  We are truly a family of believers, loving and supporting one another through Christ.  I met my husband at this church and now have a beautiful family and Christ filled home.  They have 2 Sunday morning services, Spanish services, a Wednesday night service, many different smaller fellowship Connect Groups, Deeper Bible study, women's Bible study, men's breakfasts, youth camps and so much more. Cornerstone Church is making more devoted followers of Jesus Christ every day. It's a blessing to be part of. ❤️ I visited Cornerstone's Wednesday bible Study Last week and had a wonderful experience.  I have never been greeted or felt so welcomed, honestly, in any church visit in my 23 years seeking the LORD.  The message was really good, I definitely got a take away that benefits my personal walk and the Worship was wonderful, surely felt HIS Presence in it.  Blessings to the BODY So I decided to go check out this church and I was a little late for service when I got there some staff seemed friendly the pastors message was pretty spot on when you compare to scriptures not what you feel think it believe but compared to written scripture the songstress who is the pastors daughter is very nice and pretty my gripe is it was my very first time there and the volunteer security staff thought it was ok to just slander me and call me a liar while ridiculing me because of the way I walk and talk I mean literally right in front of me to 10 other people, I am a disabled army veteran that got really hurt which causes my thought process to be slow despite having high intelligence I have two college degrees in IT one an associates and the other a bachelor's I was a airborne paratrooper and my l5 vertebrae had a crack in it plus I suffered a head injury in the military if this is how veterans that got injured while serving their country then who would want to be a part of it. The man who mocked me was saying he is a security expert and a karate black belt well I worked security protecting people and restraining people for a living plus I have two black belts but that wasn't the first thing I said appearance is deceiving never ever assume plus GOD hates slander it destroys lives If you are a prodigal, just not as close to God as you want to be, or looking for a deeper relationship with Christ this is the perfect church. The Cornerstone is active with plenty of services and small groups. The people there are so friendly and encouraging. They really care about the outcome of your life. The worship is AMAZING, the teaching is pure, the pastors care, the people love and there's plenty of parking 😂. God bless you! You belong here. This is a friendly church, with great worship and solid biblical teaching. It is a church alive that is purposeful in all it does. The campus is spacious , modern and welcoming. There is no better place to be than worshiping with God's people and you can do it here.

name: Cornerstone Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Today I went here for the first time and it was a good experience. The staff were welcoming and kind. The pastor we had (even though he said he was a temporary one) was cool too. Absolutely love Cornerstone. Pastor Jerry and Pastor Dan teach straight from the Bible with conviction, context, and relatability. The worship team is awesome, I am often moved to tears. Such a warm and welcoming body of Christ. The best thing we did was get plugged in, we attend the families group, moms group, dads group, women's and men's Bible studies, and others. Members open up their homes for Bible studies and I feel so grateful to have joined one, I literally didn't know people did that. So many ongoing events and great ways to get involved.  The women's minister Grace reaches out personally, she gets to know so many people and remembers their names. Our kids love going to church. When we're super busy we watch services online but being in person is really special. We started in June 2024 and are sure we have found our home church. They follow the Word 100%. Everyone is very welcoming and kind. Services are also streamed online. Pastor Jerry is very accessible and will pray over you if you ask him. He is very knowledgeable and uses his many experiences to help illustrate God's message. He has a great sense of humor too, and I always learn something new each week. This church has alot of missions abroad and outreach programs that serve long beach. They also have local activities for everyone. I love Cornerstone! Solid preaching. I attend the more relaxing 6pm Sunday night service. Not such a big crowd, plenty of parking. A place to call home for you and your and your family. Solid tradition biblical teaching that doesn't sway from the truth. The Congregation and pastors are friendly and warm and care about you and your walk with Jesus. Amazing children's program, great worship music in the morning. Cornerstone has a lot to offer.

name: Cornerstone Church - Poway Campus
reviewSummary: I have been attending Cornerstone Church for over 35 years. Our kids were born here and now our kids have kids. Cornerstone is a welcoming place that reaches out to the community with free bread every week and free pickleball play on Saturdays. Being here for so long is special because people who have moved away and come back to visit are still recognized and loved. Cornerstone is a very welcoming environment. From the very first day my daughter and I attended, we felt welcomed and included. Our church family has grown considerably since our arrival. There are opportunities for engaging in smaller groups, which we both a participate in, as well as a variety of events throughout the year. Pastor Ed and his wife Karen lead the church with big hearts for Jesus and the congregation. Everyone there, from the staff to the leadership to the volunteers, provide a relaxed and comfortable environment where you can grow your faith. We highly recommend Cornerstone if you are looking for your forever church home! My husband and I are so grateful the Lord has brought us to Cornerstone Church. We had been praying for a year for His leading and guidance. We were looking for a church that would teach the Bible. We believe the Bible is God’s Word and it’s inerrant. Pastor Ed  stays true to God’s Word and teaches it faithfully. We appreciate how he emphasizes the Gospel and Jesus being our Savior. The people in Cornerstone are also very kind and loving. We were greeted and made to feel welcome immediately. Now a year later, we are grateful for what the Lord has done. Please consider joining us if you are looking for a home church. We would love to walk alongside you. Praying for God’s will be done! My husband and I have been attending Cornerstone Church for 2 yrs now and have made it our home church.  From our very first visit we felt the warm, welcoming love and support from Pastor Ed, from the staff, and from all of the members.  We love the Sunday sermons in which the main idea of the biblical text is the main idea of the sermon, and how we are challenged to apply God's word to our lives.  The worship music that is lead by  Pastor Joey is awesome and we enjoy gathering with our bothers and sisters in Christ to praise and sing to the Lord!  Love for God and for others is truly alive in this church, we see servant leadership that has a clear vision and strategy for its congregation.  There are so many services this church offers, from café/fellowship, children's ministry, youth ministry, small groups to deepen your relationships and understanding of God's word, to gathering to play pickle ball, to Believers Baptisms, Foundation classes, Grief Share classes, Men's/Women's Retreats, one on one discipleship, and so much more!  If you are looking for a church to call your "church home" I would highly recommend visiting Cornerstone and see for yourself how they can help support you in "your walk with the Lord".  No matter where you are in life's struggles, or uncertainty of where God fits in your life, you will find support, and love to help you along  your journey! As new believers my husband and I have experienced this and the power of how Jesus can change your life! Thank you Cornerstone Church for welcoming us into your church family, we are truly blessed! I love Cornerstone Church! Everyone is so loving and caring. It feels like extended family to me. I've gone to this Church since I was young. Not only are thier good people there the people prove year after year to be consistently good and upstanding people that honor God.

name: Cornerstone Church of West Los Angeles
Cornerstone Church of West Los Angeles - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary: A wonderful place to grow in faith and community. The pastors and congregation are warm and welcoming, and the sermons are rooted directly in scripture. They’re intentional about building community through sports, game nights, picnics, and other gatherings beyond Sunday service. There are also opportunities to join the Christmas or Easter choir, or take part in deeper dive studies offered each fall and spring. I’m grateful that my boys (one of whom attends UCLA) and I visited Cornerstone Church this past Sunday! The positive Google reviews swayed us to attend. We were warmly greeted by Pastor Scott at the entrance and by another attendee in our pew. The worship team’s music was a blessing. Pastor Brian delivered an inspiring, powerful message that challenged us to regularly hear from God through scripture, believe it as the entire truth, and use it to navigate life. My older son said it was one of the best, clearest sermons he’s ever heard. We look forward to worshipping there when we’re in LA again; I’d probably become a member if we lived there! Hoping my Bruin will visit it again. Been a member since May 2022. One stop shop to a great community--personable pastor-elders who preaches straight out of the bible, a community who prays together, sports after service (basketball/volleyball/frisbee), board game nights and a parking lot! :-) Cornerstone Church of West Los Angeles provides inspiring sermons, a caring community, and meaningful worship—perfect for those seeking growth and connection in faith. Highly recommended! Cornerstone Church, led by a dedicated group of elders, deeply values the Bible and strives to love God and serve His people in Los Angeles. It's a welcoming community where faith and fellowship thrive, making it a true blessing to be part of for 15+ years.

name: Cornerstone Community Church
Cornerstone Community Church - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary:
I absolutely love my church, Cornerstone Community Church. The teaching is Bible-based, thoughtful, and genuinely relevant to everyday life. Our pastors are knowledgeable Bible scholars, but also down-to-earth, authentic people who humbly strive to follow Jesus. That combination makes the teaching both deep and relatable.
The worship is amazing and consistently spiritually moving. It creates space to truly encounter God, not just attend a service.
There are countless ways to get involved — through groups, events, or volunteering — which makes a large church feel like a close, caring community. People are known, supported, and encouraged here.
Of course, I think my church is the best 😉 — but no matter where you attend, being connected with others who are also seeking to follow Jesus is so important…and where else in our society other than church do you find so many people who are doing their best to be kind, loving, giving, encouraging, etc?
As a man, the men’s ministry has been especially meaningful to me. It offers the perfect balance of real and vulnerable conversations, strong spiritual mentoring, and everyday connection through things like hiking, camping, sports, and doing life together. I’m grateful to call Cornerstone my church home! When I was 20 years old I lost my faith. Due to some hurt I received from the church. I never wanted to ever go back to church again.  My cousin invited my husband, myself and our daughter to Cornerstone. I have never been more nervous or afraid. It's been 20 years since I stepped in church or walked in faith. We have never looked back. It's only been a little over a year. But this place has helped us build our relationship with God. I never thought I would have my relationship with God back. I hope to someday be more plugged in to the church as far as being involved. I would highly recommend this church. They are a amazing group of people. My husband and I have been attending Cornerstone for two years in December. While it is a large church, we have found small church friendliness. There are many varieties of groups to help you find your people within the church. We appreciate that Pastor Andy’s teaching is Biblical and relevant and allows for daily application in our lives. The pastoral team incorporates the spiritual disciplines into our spiritual growth journey and over the past two years, I have noticed that u am drawing nearer to God through daily Bible reading, prayer, and giving when there was a time in my journey that I used to practice these as more of a check list where now they are more like a love expression  between God and I. As a result, my peace and contentment have grown and I find my self more of God’s presence through those activities than I want other things that have made me restless in the past. I am on a spiritual journey through religion and it has carried me through very challenging relationship issues, health changes, and life heart breaks. Our time here has not been perfect, but it has been perfectly God! We have been attending for two  years in  December. My husband serves on the Greeting Team. We have found, that while a large church, there is a small church friendliness and many areas to connect and find your people. We are thankful for Biblical, balanced, and relevant teaching that allows for practical application everyday. Pastor Andy brings spiritual disciplines into our growth experience and I find myself  drawing nearer to God through prayer, Bible reading, and giving rather than practicing these behaviors out of obligation. My understanding of and yearning for God is growing as well as my dependency on him through my life’s ups as well as downs. I want to be near him.  My contentment and peace are increasing and I find myself wanting to be entertained by stuff less and less. I am so grateful to be serving God through this community. I love Cornerstone Church.  Been a member for 28 years.  Have watched this church grow and bless this community we live in.  A great children’s ministry. Support groups.  The worship team is amazing.  👩‍🚒🚒😎😆

name: Cornerstone Community Church - San Clemente Campus
reviewSummary:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Cornerstone Community Church in San Clemente, CA is truly something special. From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed, loved, and at home. The community here is sincere and genuinely Christ-centered — you can feel the presence of God the moment worship begins.

Speaking of worship — incredible. Dave, the lead guitarist and worship leader, has a voice that honestly rivals Bryan Adams, maybe even better. His worship comes straight from the heart. The whole worship team is talented, unified, and Spirit-led. It’s the type of worship that fills the room with peace and joy, and stays with you long after Sunday.

The messages are grounded in Scripture — real teaching that helps you grow in your walk with Jesus, not just motivational talk. There’s a strong sense of family, community outreach, and authentic fellowship here in the heart of South Orange County.

As the founder of FaithFlow Records (a Christian music & worship label dedicated to uplifting and inspiring believers worldwide), I can say we were truly moved. We would love to explore future collaboration with the worship team here at Cornerstone — the talent and the heart for Jesus are something rare and beautiful. FaithFlow Records is always searching for worship musicians and singers who lead with authenticity — and this church has that in abundance.

If you’re looking for a Christian church in San Clemente that is welcoming, Spirit-filled, and passionate about worship and the Gospel — this is the place.
Highly recommended. Amen. 🙏 Cornerstone Community Church is my second home where I was welcomed 16 years ago and found place to worship our Lord with Holy Spirit. I have experienced the love of God very closely and sang with energy and tears for welcoming Jesus in my life. Pastor Ron and his wife Diane are servants of true God. Pastor Ron gets connected to congregation through his teachings, experiences and love of God. Now that we are moving to different city I’m going to miss my church the most. I pray may God keep bringing more people to this church so they find same love of Christ as I did. Moderately welcoming people but all friendly. Tight parking. Reasonable music, not too loud. Serious minded worshipping; music to preaching! Young man Jacob did an excellent job!! If U like the Puritans n Reformers You will enjoy the preaching. If not, learn of them! They also have an outreach to former addicts,,, soooo needed these days. Good people. Help them grow n Grow with them! We worship here and it’s a place where the leaders prioritize the word of god. It’s a place where they work through the word and prioritize fellowship. They put themselves under the word and encourage siscipleship and growth. Highly recommended. Awesome fellowship, accountability, love and teaching. Great small church. Easy to get to know people and the childerens ministry is nice. You don't feel like your kid is a # very personable.

name: Cornerstone Fellowship Bible Church
Cornerstone Fellowship Bible Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary:
Hello, I don't do many reviews, but this church, the pastor, and its congregation deserve this one. I have to say not only are their teachings solid and Bible-based, but the pastor (Milton) and the congregation are a fantastic reflection of Christ's love. I have felt more than welcomed here, invited into a family of believers that truly chase after God's heart, not just by reading or talking about the Word but by practicing it in real time, by being transparent, and by honoring God in their everyday walk. far from perfect but being perfected in Christ.

"Expository teaching at its finest, to say the least!"

Anything that says otherwise about this church, its pastor, or its teachings is either a misunderstanding or the enemy trying to attack those who God loves and to keep you, the fellow reviewer, from finding a perfect home church family with a healthy mix of ages and cultures, where the nuclear family is visible and growing.

You will feel welcomed here!!!

Give it a try…. Went to this Church today. Heard a great sermon on John 3:16. A way I had not heard it broken down before. It was great. How God loved the ENTIRE world ALL tribes, All nations, all people even us sinners.  That his son, not us was the only trusted one to die for us. The pastor even said we are still sinners even after accepting even him. That we all need to strive to have a great relationship with God. Except the gift knowing we are not nor will never  perfect. It was very good.....BUT at the end of the service he, the pastor, got up and spoke about a MEMBER IN DETAIL! In the churches defense, said member did do some things that were in direct contrast to the Bible.  They did try working with said member with no luck. So he threw him back to Satan! Hold on wait WHAT did he just say. He went on about this. I thought I just heard this fantastic sermon about Love ❤️.  I do not know how anyone could know someone's heart. During the sermon he even talked about the worst sinners could still be with the Lord! But he had the right to throw him back to Satan. I was so disappointed I thought we found our new church. So people beware you might get mixed messages I know I did! You release them from the church,  release them from their membership and then release back to the Lord to help them because as men we  can not do anything more for him! No pastor you can NOT throw him in the lake of fire. You continue to pray. It's God's time not man's time! I pray for the family I was embarrassed for them! When I first walked into this church I knew something was different. I have attended church full time my whole life but something was different, in a way I had not experienced in a church since I was a kid.  It was all about JESUS.  Not about the latest politics or the latest top single on the radio for worship.  It was to the bone teaching all about Jesus, all about humility, all about the church.  I didn't remember the pastors  name because it didn't matter.  It wasn't about him or any of the other shepherds...only Jesus.  This may sound dramatic but sitting in that pew, I felt like I was sitting at the feet of Paul teaching.  The Love is abounding and the teaching is directly in accordance to the Word of God.  I knew after that first Sunday....."I am home." I have never been so deeply moved to surrender myself to the Lord's gracious will and work as now.   Under the teaching from the Pastors here at Cornerstone, I have been profoundly affected by the commitment to solid teaching, both true to the text and with humility. I enjoy the Sunday Bible studying. And also I have been learning a lot from the Thursday Women Bible Studying. I can feel the God is working on my heart. I’m so glad I found this place.

name: Cornerstone United Methodist Church
Cornerstone United Methodist Church - Orange Campus
reviewSummary: A heartwarming, kind, and friendly church that feels like home. I’m so happy I came here and discovered that this is the church where I belong. I think anyone who visits will feel like they belong here. The church’s young adult small group is fun and faithful to Jesus Christ. We have so many great and unforgettable events and weekly small group gatherings! Highly recommended! 👍 Good worship and sermons.  More traditional flow, but with contemporary music and strong missions and community support.  Lunch after worship! I attended my old church for three years. I never felt accepted there so I was searching for another church for quite some time. I ended up finding Cornerstone in Placentia because one of my best friends went there. Ever since, I have fallen in love with this church and the church family. Pastor John is a great pastor who likes to get to know everyone on a deeper level. The warmth is like no other; it really feels like God is on the move here. If you’re seeking a fun-loving, vibrant, faithful community, this is the place for you. I love this church! The pastor really cares for everyone who visits and will pray with you if you need prayer. There is a fellowship luncheon after service every week. Everyone here is so warm and welcoming. I am so thankful that I have found this church. The people of this church are like family to me now. ❤️🙏 Cornerstone Methodist Church is warm and a prayerful church. They are faith based and believes in Trinity; God the Father, Jesus who died for our sins, and the Holy Spirit.  I came with many flaws and scars but from the compassion and care from this community church, i feel accepted and healed as i shared in my small group.

reviewSummary: I would've gave a better Rating but im very disturbed and disappointed of the judgemental acts towards my son at their daycare that they have. My son my not be a shy quite kid but he's NOT special needs. I dont know why they tell me to get my son some help im sure if i was a high class person they wouldn't even have gone there with me. name: Corpus Christi Catholic Church
reviewSummary: Corpus Christi faith family is so active. The liturgy is beautiful. A vibrant Roman Catholic community in Aliso Viejo. Love the Sunday Mass times.

name: Corpus Christi Catholic Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
We love this Catholic Church! Fr. Mike Rizzo
has done wondrous changes here and Fr. Brandon Dang is continuing the same path. Always feel welcome! ❤️ I attended daily mass. It was absolutely freezing in the church. I looked at my uncomfortableness as penance. 😞
The service was nice. Check out the pictures! The devotion to the Mother of Heaven and earth was nice. Remember that Jesus is God and deeply loves you, so turn to Him in this life. Turn from your sins. His life is so much better than anything this life has to offer. ❤️ Corpus Christi has been my home since its inception and I love it more and more each year. You can feel the presence of the Holy Spirit in the people and the music and especially our Pastor. After visiting several churches in the area, we have found our new home. Fr Dang is a breath of fresh air; his warm demeanor and positivity are infectious. After a very long hiatus, we now look forward to mass every Sunday. Absolutely beautiful church and service, it feels so Holy!

name: Corpus Christi Catholic Church - Corona Campus
reviewSummary:
Spent 8th day Simbang Gabi and Misa de Gallo at Corpus Christi Church in Corona. Many Filipino parishioners. Get involved and everyone is welcome. I love this church in a way that’s hard to put into words. The people here aren’t just involved they make you feel welcomed the moment you walk in. Every time I’m here, I feel drawn to come back again, whether it’s once a week or even more, just to be part of this community and share in the worship that fills this place.

There’s something about the simplicity of this old church that feels like home to me. The music, the warmth, the way God’s presence seems to settle over everything it makes me feel connected. Being here reminds me why faith matters and why community is such a gift. Beautiful church

Father Fidel is a great pastor and Father Leo is Great and The other priest are very great there 🙏.

My God bless them 🙏 💯

Confession Friday (No adoration)and Tuesday 6-7pm (with adoration)
Confessions every Tuesdays except every last Tuesday of the month
Healing Mass at the last Tuesday of the month at 7pm cozy church a little small but has outdoor seating as well Beautiful church, music was great. Traditional ceremony! Enjoyed the sermon. When passing through we will be back.

name: Cottonwood Church
Cottonwood Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary: Lovely church in Orange County located in a great junction with good grounds for parking and ambient  surroundings for worship and fellowship. Loved the ceremony and the pastor. Huge church. I felt very welcomed. Since 1st time there they gave me a Bible and a welcome bag. Their are prayer tents in front for you to pray in after ceremony. Really enjoyed it. Def will be going back. I love this church. Drive from the border of San Diego and Riverside County every Sunday. Communion every 1st week. Baptisms every 4th. My entire family got baptized here. My tithe goes to Cottonwood. Wonderful church with indoor and outdoor seating. Great pastors with a great pastor in pastor Bayless who greets his members every Sunday. I've been to a few big churches and you will never see the pastor outside of the pulpit. I started going to church here regularly after 2 decades of running from God. I just wish I was closer to join small groups. Do yourself a favor and just go. I want to personally thank everyone in this church. Everyone is so welcoming, newcomers are treated respectfully, you don’t have that feeling of entitlement or obligation of any sort. There are hundreds of, maybe even thousands of people at the service, and it’s so heart warming. I’ve gone to other churches and this one sets the bar high for all churches because it’s spectacular. It is 20 minutes of worship (not the biggest fan of it personally) then 45 minutes of Bible study / lecture on a deep dive of the verse that day, and how you can actually apply it to your life day by day. Many wonderful pastors whom rotate every Sunday, and it’s just amazing. Thank you, this service actually give you goosebumps when whatever the speaker is saying actually applies to your life or things you can relate to (this happens a lot). Very clean and professional and various ways of seeing the sermon (outside, inside the church, live on their website). Phenomenal church! This is my first time; this is a great place to worship. Multi-ethnic. Great Bible teaching; message is based on Repentance, baptism, and spreading the Gospel of Jesus. Love, compassion. I am so glad to see where,time is taken out to pray for those who need prayer. The Ministers stay after church and wait for anyone to come forward.
