name: Countryside Christian Church - Clearwater Campus
Countryside Christian Church - Clearwater Campus - Clearwater Campus
reviewSummary:
Me and my family have been attending Countryside Christian Church for about 3 years now. I just realized I have never done a review about it. There are so many great things about this church! Pastor Glen and his son Andrew ( as well as many others) do an amazing job at delivering the word in a easy to relate to way. They all teach straight out of the Bible and always make people feel welcomed and loved.

Our son has been attending the youth church there and absolutely loves it. This will be his second year attending the middle school /high school summer camp and he is so excited about it. If you have a high schooler or middle school age child I highly recommend this camp. The first time he went he came back and said he feels closer to God.

As a bonus there is a cafe inside of the church. We eat breakfast there every Sunday. They have pastries, fresh fruit, scrambled eggs with bacon and toast, breakfast burritos and much more. It's all very good food and very reasonably priced. We always look forward to eating breakfast before church starts.

If you're looking for a church that is non-denominational, preaches the good news, and lots of friendly people, this is the church you need to try. We love this church. Everyone is always friendly, the pastor is amazing and carries a well spoken candlelight service was amazing and the choir sung wonderfully songs, everybody knew, and songs we just learned. I would highly recommend this church. We have been attending Countryside Christian Church for almost 6 months now and absolutely love it! The worship team is fantastic and the sermons are always filled with valuable and meaningful messages - the pastors are amazing!! We’ve learned and grown so much in our faith already just in our short time here! ☺️💗 We always feel welcome and have invited numerous family members to attend and they all feel the same.

And their podcast is amazing!!!

We look forward to getting more involved and coming here for many years to come! ☺️ Countryside Christian Church is amazing!! My family and I all attend on Sundays and Midweek, and it is truly a great place with great leadership. Want to shout out Pastor Marcelo— he has poured into my son and made him feel comfortable going to youth group. All of the pastors at this church are incredible, and we are so grateful for Countryside. This month is officially one year for my husband Wayne and I attending Countryside Christian Church. We now consider it our church family. When we came a year ago for a Wednesday night worship service, our lives changed forever. For me, I felt a genuine sense of belonging. Despite the size, this church, the pastors and it's leaders make you feel so welcome, as if you're visiting family that you haven't seen for a long time. Pastor Glenn Davis is the lead pastor and such a down to earth man. He and his wife Elaine are exceptional stewards of God. He's a rare type of pastor, who leads from the sidelines matching the same challenges we all face in life. The culture he has created here is that "you never walk alone" and he's fostered a sense of peace for the church, knowing, that if you fall, you fall into the hands of people who truly love you. The Co-Pastor is his son, Pastor Andrew, and he is a vessel for deep truths and preaches with a purpose. He has an incredible ability to pull you into the word of God and His message and his passion for the Lord is catchier than his punchlines, it is such a joy to listen to him preaching. Pastor Marcelo is the executive pastor of "next gen" and online. He is an inspiration, especially for our youth. There is an undeniable old soul to the quality of his ministry. He echos great revivalst of the past that captivates and encourages you to dig deep within yourself and confront the person that God is calling you to be. Without hesitation, we quickly signed up for bible study, marriage group, woman's and men's small groups, we've taken the growth track class, volunteered a few times and are currently in Alpha. We're both ready to start serving and do whatever we can to be fully dedicated followers of Christ. Because of this church and the messages we've received from God through the leaders, through the small groups and the fellowship we've experienced here, we both have a new found and deeper love for God and pray His light will shine through us, and everyone we cross paths with.

name: Countryside Christian Church - South Tampa Campus
Countryside Christian Church - South Tampa Campus - Tampa (Hyde Park) Campus
reviewSummary:
A few years back, I surprised my mom for Mother's Day by showing up to church at Countryside Christian South Tampa, after some not-so-subtle "hints" that she'd like me to attend church with her since my younger sister who always went with her, had moved to TX. I made it a few more occasions the remainder of the year like most "Christians" often tend to do (you know, the big Christian holidays). I later committed to making it to communion Sunday each month the following year. And did so. After that, for the following year, I made a commitment to myself that I'd attend service as often as I could. I haven't looked back since. I'm a dreamer and often dream of winning that big lottery jackpot and moving somewhere that's much, much cooler and doesn't exist under the threat of hurricanes. Now, it actually kind of hurts me to think about not being able to be at church with the amazing people I have come to love over the past few years. We have a saying: "Welcome Home." And it really is the only way I could describe Countryside Christian Church. I attend the South Tampa campus and have made it to the main campus in Clearwater. The people are all the same. They're all wonderful and welcoming. Our leadership are all kind, loving, welcoming, and caring. If I'm sick and can't make it to service, I can always watch the streaming service, but it just isn't the same. I am glad I surprised my mom for Mother's Day when I did. And I am proud to be a member of CCC. I even took the step to be baptized as an adult (I was baptized as a teen, because it was the "cool" thing). It was truly one of the most amazing experiences. Come home to Countryside Christian Church - South Tampa. Countryside is truly an amazing church. Our entire family loves it! Our toddlers love going to their classes and always ask if it’s church day.
If your looking for a family friendly church that really live out what they believe you just found it. Countryside Sounth Tampa is truly a loving, helpful, and God-filled place. From the moment you walk through the doors, you're welcomed like family. The atmosphere is full of kindness and genuine care, and it's clear that the presence of God is at the center of everything they do.

There are so many ways to get involved—whether it’s through small groups, outreach programs, worship teams, youth ministries, or volunteer opportunities, there’s something for everyone. It’s more than just a church; it’s a place to grow, serve, and belong.

If you're looking for a church home where you can build real relationships and deepen your faith, Countryside Christian Church ST is a wonderful place to be. We first heard of Countryside when a chance meeting with a person in need spoke of their food pantry where he volunteered. We went to the South Tampa campus and were so warmly greeted that we felt like we were with family. We also found that the service was very accurately based on scripture, and very relevant to today's issues. The personalization with us, we realized, was the beginning of building a more personal relationship with Jesus. Clearly, landing on Countryside was not by chance! We love this church!!!  Such a great experience for our family to have a place where we felt welcome from the moment we parked our car.  Everyone is so welcoming and the atmosphere is great.  You are greeted at the door by friendly people who not only make you feel welcome but make it a priority to provide your family with an amazing experience.  Countryside South Tampa Campus has something for everyone in our family from childcare to youth group, adult groups and opportunities to serve at the church and in the community with their Helping Hands ministry.   Ever since attending they have always provided an exceptional Bible based Godly message with a wonderful worship experience.  Pastor Dan and his amazing staff were especially wonderful to me and my family and I would highly recommend this church to anyone who is looking to have a closer relationship with God.  My wife and I whole heartedly believe that Countryside South Tampa can make a huge impact in your life and your families the same way it has for ours.

name: Countryside Community Church
Countryside Community Church - Tri-Faith Commons
Courageous Church
Courageous Church - Tampa (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
If you’re looking for a church home in Tampa, this is it.

I was searching for a place where I could hear the Lord clearly and grow deeper in my faith — and I found that here. The Word is powerful, the atmosphere is genuine, and the presence of God is real.

As a mom of kids under 11, the children’s ministry means everything to me. My girls love coming to church, and that alone speaks volumes. We didn’t just find a church — we found community.

If you’re looking for a place to belong and grow, come visit. It feels like home. 🕊️✨

If you want it even punchier or a little more fire in it, say the word. Courageous Church has transformed my entire family. The pastors lead with their entire heart and the passion they have for the Lord’s people is evident in everything they do and say. We are eternally grateful for Pastor Ben and Pastor Wendy’s faithful “yes” to the people of Courage Church and advancing the kingdom of God. I love Courageous Church! I have found a wonderful church family through the courageous life program here and have been attending for over a year. I love serving with the children and in production! This is an amazing mid size church on fire for the Lord! I would recommend this church for young adults, families, people that have been in church their whole life and children! Pastor Ben and Pastor Wendy care so much about everyone who steps into this building and you will not leave the same! Courageous Church is an amazing local church right in the heart of Tampa 🙏 I’m grateful for everything they do to impact the community. If you’re looking for a Bible-based church where you can truly grow in your relationship with God, find family, and be encouraged in your faith alongside other believers that are on fire for the Lord… Courageous Church needs to be your church home! I mean.....just look at my picture! That picture I took my first time to Courageous Church and I am still here!!  God is all up and through this church. I am so happy I decided to come to this church and become a member. The pastors actually WANT to get to know you personally!! I haven't joined a church since I was a young child and I finally have a church that I feel at home at!! I was even re-baptized ❤️

name: Covenant Baptist Church
Covenant Baptist Church - Santa Clarita Campus
COVENANT Christian Church
COVENANT Christian Church - Jacksonville (Southside) Campus
reviewSummary: A multi-generational, Filipino-American church that teaches you the Bible and how to grow your relationship with Jesus. For the music worship ministry, it is a mix of contemporary and hymns for the band and the choir. There are also ministries for kids, discipleship, and bible study groups for everyone to join. I've been here for 6+ years since I was in high school and there is no other group I'd like to call my church family. Check out their FB for more photos. For anyone seeking to know more who Jesus is, you are always welcome to join any of the groups or ministries :D Covenant Christian Church is a very friendly and loving church , you will be feed spiritually and materially . A lot of opportunity that you can be involved in any area of ministries.. Come and join with  us this Sunday . Praise The Lord. We finally found the house of God where we can worship and glorify Our Lord Jesus Christ. A beautiful and welcoming place to praise the Lord with wonderful people. Great fellowship! God is glorified in this church!

name: Covenant Church
reviewSummary: Known for extended, passionate worship times and prophetic teaching. The culture is expressive and Spirit-filled.

name: Covenant Church Burbank
Covenant Church Burbank - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary:
Covanent Church Burbank represents how our community comes together to share the fellowship of Christ our Savior. That’s how I perceive it because everything comes together when we put out trust in His divine timing. There is something amazing when we grow in Christ together. Welcome to attend our services Covanent Church website will have all resources available, there service hours and events taking place. We hope you join us. Blessings. I was invited one day to the Covenant church in Burbank and pastor Brooks messages are so strong. He gets right into the the message and the spirit comes alive. It's a beautiful church and the best part that I like about is on evening worship, after the preaching, we are able to ask pastor Brooks questions to try to stump him, I love that part plus they have the Communion once a month.  They music is great and the environment is just wonderful.  The building looks like a castle when you drive up and inside the big garage door there's tables. It's just a beautiful church and you should really try it. But pastor Brooks and his wife Amanda are just two of the sweetest and nicest people you want to meet as well as the whole church congregation, they're all wonderful and the preacher you never get bored of him.

When I came to the church, I was living in my Van, and they accepted me just as I am the whole congregation did. They saw me through 4 surgeries and one of them was cancer.  They prayed the whole time for me. This is the kind of church you want to go to. Because they are  Powerful, their prayers and the care about everybody. I don't live in CA, but if I did, I would definitely go to Covenant Church Burbank! Pastor Brooks and his wife are some of the most genuinely caring people that I know. I am always encouraged whenever I get to talk to them. Plus, Brooks prepares a worship service and a message about Jesus that will reach both your mind and heart... both thought-provoking and joyful at the same time. This is the place to visit if you are seeking the peace of Christ. In my experience I have been to many churches.  So far, Covenant seals the deal where most churches swear by: perks, bells and acclaim. Covenant has ardent faith, steadfast love of community and fellow believers, a great commitment to sound theology all packed in a studio!
Covenant is lead by God through a wonderful Pastor Pipher and many founding members. Three  years prior, it grew from a house church into a church of strong faith and devotion. This church welcomes all those seeking Christ, seeking answers and seeking a fresh start to a new life.

At Covenant, all I see are God’s wonderful people filled with love, joy, compassion and patience and a firm reverence to Christ and His teachings!  To those looking for a new church or just passing by, Covenant Church will not disappoint. This is a wonderful church. There is a noticeable culture of hospitality. The worship is joyful, reverent and biblical, with the preached Word at the center of it all. I’m so thankful for a Presbyterian church in Burbank. If you are in the area, you should definitely visit. Pastor Brooks and his wife Amanda are such encouraging and prayerful people.

name: Covenant Fountain Church
Covenant Fountain Church - Temecula Campus
reviewSummary:
Great church!… CFC has been a blessing to me and my husband teaching me how to step out of my comfort into God’s presence.
A love our great Pastor and his uplifting Godly messages 👍

Every service touches deep in your heart and mind. This is how God works to reach your soul 💒❤️🙏🙌 Covenant Fountain Church is a body of Christ where I fellowship. The preaching and teaching by the Prophet is enriching and changing my life spiritually. Truth and the whole counsel of Jesus Christ is taught and people are richly enhanced in every aspect of life. I always look forward for time of worship and praise, fasting and prayers and of course listening to the preaching and teaching of the word. I have grown spiritually so through this ministry, closer to Jesus than ever before in my entire life. A real place to experience and feel God's presence. Pastor Emmanuel is an extremely humble man. I recommend this church to anyone looking for a local place of worship or for a place to just come and allow the Holy Spirit to really minister to you, in a way that know they are not your emotions but, something supernatural. Thank you! Keep up the great work ~ If you want to experience the presence of God and the resurrection power of Jesus come to Covenant Fountain Church. An amazing place to worship, learn the word of God and be filled with zeal and passion for spreading the gospel of Jesus to the world. Come and be blessed, we love one another as family because we are one in Christ. There is so much love shown towards me when I first visited.
The teaching is such a blessing with powerful revelation knowledge.
Your understanding of the word of God is opened up to understand
the word of God on a new level. I will continue to be a part of this
ministry for this season. So glad to have been made aware of this ministry

name: Covenant Life Christian Fellowship
Covenant Life Christian Fellowship - Corona Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve called this my home for 36 years. I was born into this church,  my grandparents were going and my parents as well. I met my wife here. I’m raising my kids here. Holy Spirit filled and our pastors have held their example for over 40 years. Perfect place to fulfill your call and raise a family! First time here 🙏🏼 The warmest of the people brought me here.  Met Becky and her kind family at the Halloween event .  I know she was chosen to be one of my angels💕 Was here from a baby until I left in when I was in High School, spent many years pursuing everything opposite of Jesus and Church. Came back and was welcomed with open arms and have been abundantly blessed by the Love, commitment, fellowship, and dedication to one another here by the Pastors, Leaders, and congregation.
This is home. Pastors should always be impartial not take sides. That is not the case here. Not only was Pastor Sandy Rude in front of other parishioners it was hurtful and embarrassing for her. I went and it did not feel welcome and will not return.
So sad to put this review about Pastor Jesse and Pastor Sandy but hope they change their outlook 🙏🙏 I was having a bad day awhile back and I was passing by this church and some of the members noticed I was upset and asked if they could pray for me. I agreed and a few others gathered around me and prayed. Although we were complete strangers, the members of this church reached out and left an impression on me that I will always remember.

name: Covenant Presbyterian Church
Covenant Presbyterian Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: While my automobile was inoperable for the holidays, I spoke to the Pastor about trying to work for them to make money to pay for the repairs.  She spoke to her husband (also a Pastor) and although they didn’t have any work for me, agreed to not have my vehicle towed as long as I move it by the following Friday, which was quite the relief as I’ve had other major vehicle expenses recently and didn’t need a tow expense on top of another major vehicle repair.  Just for that act of kindness, I pushed my vehicle off of their lot as soon as I could so as to not worry or trouble them any further.  Small acts of kindness go a long way in my book.  Thank you! First time here. Praise God for having another church I can go to who's dedicated to God, Jesus and the Holy Spirit. It was fun singing from a hymnal again. They have a Bible Study afterwards with coffee and snacks. Lots of teenagers involved was encouraging to see. Saddened... I arrived about 33 minutes early. (Sunday November 25, 2018).  There were 2 people setting up for an obvious function in a courtyard area at the main sanctuary entrance.  I bad them good morning, & asked the time.  I was curtly informed that church didn't start for 30 minutes.  The main entrance doors were locked, & not another word was spoken.  So... I don't know what kind of church this is.   I couldn't get in the front door, on Sunday but with such first reception, & locked doors... I'm saddened, moreso than disappointed. When the expression comes up at church save my life this one literally did. When I was 12 years old single parent home on the streets the church acted as if they were family. Pastorrob and Adele welcome to me in the church. I am now 33 years old business owner married with 3 children my wife is a nurse I owe it all to if it wasn't for the church the guidance that help probably would have went down a different path And drop someone off there and that was it a nice church nice individuals there great experience.

name: Covenant Presbyterian Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary: Warm church with lots of kind and welcoming people. Pastor Jeannine is wonderful and supports an inclusive church. So happy our family started attending. Best Church, Amazing Pastor, Wonderful People. My family has been coming to Covenant Presbyterian for 50+ years. It represents the heart and fabric of Westchester. I remember the days with old Pastor Tom. The new pastor Sue Fisher is brilliant. She makes each sermon relate to current topics and issues, and has such contagious energy. This church is an amazing place for families from young to old. The sunday school, preschool and childcare services are also amazing! Not to mention that the main chapel with its brilliant stained glass windows and smaller chapel are breathtakingly beautiful! The Covenant Presbyterian Church is a place where you can genuinely feel good because there is good people to congregate with here. God Bless. I went there for a memorial service for my best friend. It was a beautiful service and tribute to my friend. I went there for a "HOME GOING" for my Daughter's friend's it was lovely.

name: Covington Church of Christ
Covington Church of Christ - Covington Campus
reviewSummary: Bible based preaching. Friendly GOD loving congregation. A loving group of faithful believes in the Word of GOD! Great Church of Christ!

name: Crescenta Valley Church
Crescenta Valley Church - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary:
They might not return your phone call if you have an issue with any of their members. I love this church. The people are diverse and friendly. The music is phenomenal. And you can hook into a small group during the week easily. They have every type of group, so a person feels included: recovery, women's, men's, young adults, singles, teens, children, and entertainment. Plus bible studies, family camp, youth camp, and concerts. They really walk their talk! This is a loving and supportive family of believers who are waiting for you to join.
The music is top notch modern worship mixed with traditional influences. The decor and hospitality match its bright and warm atmosphere of kindness.
It has a multiethnic flavor of encouragement and support for all souls who are looking to rest in a peaceful nest of joy and light.
The pastor preaches recovery and hope in a very clever, real and straight forward way.
On Friday nights they have a biblical program based on the 12 steps called Celebrate recovery  which provides freedom from life's hurts habits, and hang ups. Check it out! They even have a thoughtful gift bag for newcomers filled with fabulous goodies inside. CV church has been my home church since forever! So welcoming and loving! The message always speaks to me. My kids are all growing up in this church and we all love being a part of the CV church family! Love the authentic in-depth teaching by Scott Wood. allows one to embrace the same meanings for everyday life from those of it's ancient history. Awesome Music too!

name: Crescenta Valley United Methodist Church
Crescenta Valley United Methodist Church - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary:
The pastor's messages strengthen our faith and nurture our spiritual growth. The fellowship is genuine and loving.
Blessings to the church and minister! ESL classes and day care on site Great place for party and family get together We are the Ark of Salvation, a church that conveys the treasures of the Kingdom of Heaven..

Meet Jesus through the Word that conveys the secrets of blessing^~

name: Crest Avenue Baptist Church
Crest Avenue Baptist Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary:
There's a great men's study I try and attend every Tuesday night at 7pm.  great fellowship and welcoming to everyone.
I recently started to visit their Sunday service and enjoyed sound doctrine. I really enjoy that the pastor teaches straight from the Bible (NKJV). It is a place of worship and growth. This is our home church. Love my church family. I like to attend the men’s group meetings on Tuesdays at 7pm. Every guy welcome! (They also have a womans group at the same time, just different building. A church is a safe place to bring all of your questions or doubts concerning your spiritual salvation. If you seek the Lord with all of your heart and allow Him to rule your life then you will not be taking a leap of faith but the first step to recognizing that you are and have always been sinful in nature. Let Jesus Christ, our Lord take you by the hand and lead you back unto the path of righteousness. No matter how difficult you think your life has treated you, it's nothing God can't handle. There is hope right now. God bless you.

"For as the rain and the snow come down from heaven and do not return there but water the earth, making it bring forth and sprout, giving seed to the sower and bread to the eater, so shall my word be that goes out from my mouth; it shall not return to me empty, but it shall accomplish that which I purpose, and shall succeed in the thing for which I sent it.   -ISAIAH 55:10-11 The pastor preaching was great. n the friendly  people. They great  you soon as you walk in the church. I definitely would be back. Sound doctrine, people passionate about serving Christ and NOT a King James Only Church

name: Crest Community Church
Crest Community Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary: Started attending this church with my children last Easter. Absolutely a bible following, scripture based church with amazing warmth and welcoming atmosphere, like a small town church- you will not get lost in a crowd here like we did in a mega church. Pastor Ray is a wonderful teacher who keeps to the word and does not stray from it. I find his sermons ALWAYS pertain to my family/life and I never feel bored or lose interest when he is preaching and that says a lot coming from me, the queen of ADD! We feel at home here and so glad we came for that first Easter service. The crowd is a nice mix of all ages and very kid friendly with precious Sunday school classes :) Please come and visit this amazing church, God bless Crest! I’ve been attending here for four years going on five. It is a solid biblical church. The preaching from the pulpit is chapter by chapter verse by verse solid theologically and so is the worship. No fluff or condoning and patting your back because of your sin, but just straight gospel. Calling everyone to repentance and faith in Jesus Christ alone. They have Tuesday night men’s Bible study at 6:30 Wednesday night coed Bible study at 6:30 Thursday night women’s Bible study at 6:30 and Friday night prayer meeting at 6:30 and of course Sunday morning service at 10:45. Come via part of a solid biblical church, because there are very few of them around anymore. My father in law Pastor Gerald Woodhouse founded this church.  I trust you are still a lighthouse for Christ and reaching out to the whole world     I presume you are still supporting world missions.  Stay faithful to Jesus. I've been going to church here for over 4 years and the people are like a family. Preaching is straight forward and from the Bible. This is truly a community church with lots of opportunities to get involved. Small church but good pastor and good sound Bible teaching. Friendly congregation. Weekly evening Bible studies. A church to feel right at home.

name: Crest Community Church - Riverside (Canyon Crest) Campus
reviewSummary: this church is my home Church and reaches out to the community. it certainly is a community orientated place. The ministers and fellowship are very family orientated and multilingual as well as multiracial. Small church in the UCR neighborhood full of wonderful, caring folks who care about their city and want to follow more the way of Jesus. Peace lovers, community gatherers, kingdom bringers. Great hosts. Frequently volunteer as a polling place. Hosts University Neighborhood community meetings regularly, cant ask anything more of them. Fantastic little church. If you want to grow in your faith, visit this church. God blesses people personally here without a doubt.

name: Crieve Hall Church of Christ
reviewSummary: A traditional Church of Christ congregation in Crieve Hall known for a cappella worship and scripture-centered teaching.

name: Cristo Rey Ontario Iglesia Católica Antigua NO ROMANA
Cristo Rey Ontario Iglesia Católica Antigua NO ROMANA - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
This is not a Roman Catholic Church.  The Baptisms, 1st Communions and other classes are not approved/valid by Roman Catholic Church. Very Powerful Not the kind of Catholic Church I was looking for. I came to Cristo Rey Ontario looking for a church, and what I found was a family in Christ. Father Duque is an excellent human being, full of peace, love, and wisdom. I thank God for putting him in my path and my family's.
Cristo Rey Ontario is a wonderful church. This Catholic Church is not in communion with Rome. They do not have a valid Eucharist. This church is not in communion with Rome. Because it is not united with the Catholic Church, it does not possess a valid apostolic succession recognized by the Catholic Church, and therefore does not have a valid Eucharist.

name: Cross and Crown Lutheran Church
Cross and Crown Lutheran Church - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
Cross and Crown Lutheran Church Office - ELCA
Cross and Crown Lutheran Church Office - ELCA - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary:
This is our polling place. Parking was fine and we were able to get in and out without any delay. The people working the election were nice and friendly. Can't wait til November....... Such a welcoming and friendly church and Pastor Stephanie is wonderful.
So happy I baptized my daughter at Cross and Crown. Small and clean church God bless His people Ok

name: Cross Connection Church
Cross Connection Church - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary:
If you want great line upon line teaching from the Word of God, friendly people to greet you, and a place to connect with other folks young and old, this is a church you should visit. God loves you and is seeking those who want to know him. Please come join us each Sunday 7:30, 9:00 & 11:00 AM to worship the. Lord. Our Children’s program is wonderful and we offer donuts & Coffee and a place to sit and visit with new friends. Come and join us soon. Great Bible in context teaching going through the books of the Bible. Great worship in music. Presence of the Holy Spirit in praise and adoration and gratitude to the Father for the Good News in Christ Jesus. An excellent body of believers, served by a truly committed and loving leadership. Miles DeBenedictus, the senior pastor is a gifted teacher and speaker with an ability to impart the vision of God's work better than anyone I've ever heard. He's not afraid to speak the truth in love and his passion is truly to reach out to those who don't yet have a church to call home, to seek and to save the lost and show them the Father, as Jesus did and still does, through His people. Excellent sermons from a very gifted teacher! Nice and  friendly congregation.
Many activities to join in. If you are looking for the weekly teaching of God's word, look no more,
If you are looking to feel included and loved not judged look no more,
If you are as me a struggling sinner, but by God's Grace have found peace, look no more,
I cherish few things in life, but this body of Christ of which I am a member, I could never find more.

name: Cross of Grace Santa Ana at the Ebell Club
Cross of Grace Santa Ana at the Ebell Club - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary:
Cross of Grace Church has become home for my family. This is the place where we’ve built real friendships, grown in our faith, and found a community we truly love serving alongside.

What stands out most is that they preach the Bible clearly and faithfully. The teaching is grounded in sound doctrine, but the church is also warm, welcoming, and full of people who genuinely care about each other. It doesn’t feel fake or shallow. People show up for one another here.

I also love how much the church reflects and cares for Santa Ana. The community is diverse, engaged, and focused on serving neighbors well instead of staying disconnected from the city around it. There’s a real vision for reaching people and loving the community in practical ways.

My family is deeply grateful for this church and the people in it. A friendly church community full of people that love Jesus and their Santa Ana neighbors. Great sermons that closely follow scripture and are always Gospel centered. Best place to be on a Sunday morning! The community here is so wonderful. But what makes this church so great is that it actually teaches from the Bible. There's community groups, youth groups, kids classes, men's and women's meeting, and they actively invest in their city. Faithful, gospel-centered church that preaches the Bible and joyfully worships God every Sunday. I've experienced a wonderful community here, with genuine people who love Jesus and their neighbors. Great spot for kids as well! There is childcare and classes up to 5th grade, and parking in the Ebell Club parking lot right across the street. My husband and I love the messages preached from the church and how the Gospel is proclaimed every week. Everyone cares for the city and each other. The community is top notch and would highly recommend anyone to give it a visit.

name: Cross Point Church
reviewSummary: Known for its 'Everyone's Welcome' philosophy and 'Technicolor' brand. The environment is casual, creative, and accessible to seekers. Very strong digital presence.

name: Crossbridge Church | Brickell
Crossbridge Church | Brickell - Miami (Downtown/Brickell) Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve been going to Crossbridge Brickell, and it’s honestly one of the friendliest and most down-to-earth churches I’ve been to. The people are warm, welcoming, and really care about building community. What stands out is how seriously they take living with purpose — not just at church, but in everyday life.

The messages on Sundays are focused on the life and teachings of Jesus, and they do a great job of showing how that applies to real life — especially here in Miami. The talks are rooted in the Bible but easy to understand, relatable, and engaging.

They also care a lot about the city — the church regularly supports local nonprofits and encourages people to give back and help those in need. You’ll find a good mix of people here — lots of young professionals (especially in medicine and finance), but also families, kids, and older folks. There’s a great children’s program, and small group meetups during the week help people build friendships and grow personally and spiritually.

On top of that, they host fun events like cookouts and parties where everyone’s welcome, even if you’ve never been to church before. They also occasionally team up with other local churches for worship music nights, cookouts, and community outreach.

If you’re in Brickell and looking for a place that combines meaningful teaching, uplifting music, and a genuine sense of community, I highly recommend checking out Crossbridge Brickell. Here you can belong before you believe! My husband was a skeptic and now is a firm believer all in part to Crossbridge teachings. This church will meet you where you are.

As a person who approaches finding a  church very cautiously , you never know if a church is sticking to biblical teaching until you hang around for awhile. Crossbridge is an amazing gem in the heart of Brickle.  My husband and I recently became official members because we believe in the work their doing.

Our lead pastor Carter has an incredible gift for sharing scripture in a way that feels practical. I always leave church better equipped to progress in my faith.  . Johnny our campus pastor is also so personable, and integral to all of the progession of the church.

It doesn't stop there The community at Crossbridge is SO WELCOMING, no matter how much you may want to run out of there right after service, the more you linger  you start to make meaningful connection . Also Crossbridge has a lot of community driven events  both for the broader city of Miami and the church body including movie nights, dinner parties, food drives , marches, Bible studies and more.

God is doing great things through Crossbridge!
Highly recommend. This is the best church ⛪️ I have ever seen in my life ❤️! I love it, awesome 👌 people and good vibes ❤️ 🙌 💜 God bless pastor John 🙏 his great ! Highly recommend for everyone to go and visit! AMEN Put God first in everything you do! Excellent worship and teaching on Sundays!  Many opportunities go deeper - both in community and in God's Word - throughout the week.  After living decades in another city, Crossbridge was a key factor in helping us feel like Miami was "home." I visited Crossbridge Brickel two years ago and quickly found it to be a community of Christ centered believers with solid Biblical teaching and cross focused worship.   I now call it my church home.  If you are looking for a church home.  Visit!   You won’t be disappointed

name: Crossbridge Church Pinecrest
Crossbridge Church Pinecrest - Pinecrest / South Miami Campus
reviewSummary:
Cross Bridge Pinecrest is truly a special place. From the moment you walk in, you feel a sense of care, professionalism, and genuine community. The environment is welcoming, well-organized, and thoughtfully run, with a team that is attentive, kind, and deeply committed to excellence.

What truly sets Cross Bridge Pinecrest apart is the heart behind everything they do. You can tell there is intention, integrity, and passion woven into the culture. Communication is clear, standards are high, and the overall experience consistently exceeds expectations.

Highly recommended to anyone looking for a trusted, high-quality, and uplifting environment in Pinecrest. A true gem in the community. 💫 CrossBridge is one of the most important parts of our lives today. We were deeply blessed that it was our first church when we moved to Miami nine years ago.

Our closest friends are from CrossBridge Pinecrest. We share our challenges and our victories, and there is always someone walking alongside us through every season of the year.

Through this community, our faith in God grows stronger each day. CrossBridge also creates many opportunities and events that help us connect with others and truly feel supported. Pastors Felipe and Marcus are wise, kind, approachable, and genuine in their love for God.

We are truly blessed to be here. Our lives would not have the same peace in our souls without CrossBridge, our friends, and their prayers.

Thank you, CrossBridge Pinecrest My husband and I have called this place our spiritual home for 18 years. It has been a place to grow in our faith, our knowledge of the Bible, and most importantly, to grow in and be held accountable by a loving community that is corporately committed to honoring God. This church is a reflection of the diversity of Miami. I love playing my violin in the band and our kids are absolutely at home and comfortable here. Their lessons are not watered down, but they challenge them and stay focused on the truth of the radical love of our savior, Jesus. This is a place where anybody can come and belong even before they believe. Questions and discussions are welcome. Atmosphere is modern but not too contemporary, reverent, warm, fantastic musicians and excellent practical teaching. Have been attending for 12 years. Mix of all ages and rich community building and support. Multi cultural and welcoming to all. We were looking for a non-political church where the Word of God is preached truthfully, and where we could find fellowship with other believers. We have recently started attending Crossbridge Pinecrest, and we always feel welcomed. We enjoy the worship services and the sermons. There are many groups available to help us grow spiritually, along with various activities and events. For women, there is a monthly gathering that features inspiring testimonies to encourage one another. We are hopeful that we will find what we were looking for in this church. ❤️

name: Crossing Church North County
Crossing Church North County - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
(I'm Swedish) Me and my husband visit Crossing Church two times in November, during our 7 weeks in Escondido.We just love the loving atmosphere, "family feelings" and we will come back next time we visit our daughter and her family. Good and anointed preaching from the Word of God, and as a "worshiper" from Sweden I love the worship ❤️. Pastor Billy and his wife came and introduced them self for us, and we talked to a couple of others too./ Blessings from 🇸🇪 Sweden Sorry but the worship and atmosphere like most churches today, are like concerts and entertainment centers with colorful fancy stage lighting, wanting everything to look appealing to draw people in, it was difficult to follow and sing with the worship leader because of the range of his voice, I wouldn't even call it direct personal worship to God, it seemed more like the words were more like what we can get from God than direct worship to Him for who He is, today in most churches worship just isn't what it use to be, most disturbing today is you have people drinking coffee and eating their pastry during the worship and preaching of the word, absolutely no reverence towards God,  I also noticed the sermon wasn't really all that inspiring to convict you in drawing closer to God and living a godly life by the pastor, I attended here when the last pastor was here, until he was relocated somewhere else, supposedly because the church wasn't growing fast enough was their excuse, my gosh is the assemblies of God church leaders into numbers now, personally I thought the last pastor was an awesome pastor, I believe he was given a bad unjustful break, he gave some super spirit filled engaging powerful sermons, personally I believe when people hear the raw undeniable truth of God's word, most people get squirmish and uncomfortable because it challenges and convicts them, so they go somewhere else where they can hear cotton candy watered down gospel that makes them feel good, nothing that challenges their selfish manicured controlled lifestyle, something that tickles their itching ears, with that being said, I use to look forward going to church back then, worship was great as well, I was heartbroken when the pastor left, when I visited crossings church some years later, it wasn't the same, and it was still the same size regarding people 🙄 ?, till this day I'm still without a church home. I'm home at Crossing Church! I love the pastors, the messages, the people, the outreach, the atmosphere of praising the Lord. I'm so thankful for finally finding a church home and would encourage everyone to come to service any Sunday at 10:30. You'll be so glad you did! Our family loves the message, the worship songs and the people. Great preschool teachings (Sundays) and Youth program (high school age) on Tuesday evenings.

Looking into Life Groups on Wednesday evenings (aka small group & Bible study) This is not a review for the church, but for Pastor Billy who officiated our wedding. Pastor Billy did an excellent job, both with our ceremony and with our pre-marital counseling. He really took the time and got to know us, and tailored our ceremony to us. He learned about our most memorable dates and included parts of them into what he said. As Pastor Billy told us, though, Weddings take wedding clothes, but marriages take work clothes, and he put his work clothes on with us during pre-marital counseling, which is yet another thing we cannot recommend enough, especially when working with Pastor Billy.

reviewSummary:
(I'm Swedish) Me and my husband visit Crossing Church two times in November, during our 7 weeks in Escondido.We just love the loving atmosphere, "family feelings" and we will come back next time we visit our daughter and her family. Good and anointed preaching from the Word of God, and as a "worshiper" from Sweden I love the worship ❤️. Pastor Billy and his wife came and introduced them self for us, and we talked to a couple of others too./ Blessings from 🇸🇪 Sweden Sorry but the worship and atmosphere like most churches today, are like concerts and entertainment centers with colorful fancy stage lighting, wanting everything to look appealing to draw people in, it was difficult to follow and sing with the worship leader because of the range of his voice, I wouldn't even call it direct personal worship to God, it seemed more like the words were more like what we can get from God than direct worship to Him for who He is, today in most churches worship just isn't what it use to be, most disturbing today is you have people drinking coffee and eating their pastry during the worship and preaching of the word, absolutely no reverence towards God,  I also noticed the sermon wasn't really all that inspiring to convict you in drawing closer to God and living a godly life by the pastor, I attended here when the last pastor was here, until he was relocated somewhere else, supposedly because the church wasn't growing fast enough was their excuse, my gosh is the assemblies of God church leaders into numbers now, personally I thought the last pastor was an awesome pastor, I believe he was given a bad unjustful break, he gave some super spirit filled engaging powerful sermons, personally I believe when people hear the raw undeniable truth of God's word, most people get squirmish and uncomfortable because it challenges and convicts them, so they go somewhere else where they can hear cotton candy watered down gospel that then, worship was great as well, I was heartbroken when the pastor left, when I visited crossings church some years later, it wasn't the same, and it was still the same size regarding people 🙄 ?, till Crossline Church
reviewSummary: Extremely friendly and active church. Thriving kids programs and excellent sermons. A great blended approach. The chapel service is very intimate and sweet.

name: Crossline Community Church
reviewSummary: A casual, outreach-oriented community church in Laguna Hills with a welcoming atmosphere.

name: Crossline Community Church
reviewSummary: A wonderful, highly biblically sound church. Pastor JP Jones is an outstanding teacher. Extremely warm and welcoming congregation. Great food pantry volunteer opportunities.

name: Crossline Community Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
From what I've seen, it looks beautiful. Hope the message delivered is just as good. They have a private lake too that isn't open to the public for fishing but they may hold fishing events. Crossline has become so much more than a church for our family- it’s truly home! From the very first Sunday, 5 years ago.. my family felt genuinely welcomed and embraced.
Pastor JP has a gift for delivering messages that speak straight to your heart — always grounded in faith and full of encouragement.
Women’s Bible Study has been a true blessing in my life; the friendships I’ve built with other faith-driven moms have meant the world to me. Crossline doesn’t just talk about community, they live it. So grateful our family found this place! If you are looking for a church to try, Crossline welcomes everyone. If you are looking to learn the Bible, this is a teaching church with modern day, application. Crossline has several women’s ministries, a great men’s ministry, free counseling services, a relationship & marriage ministry. Not to mention a gorgeous lake and is a wedding venue. It is a tranquil and wonderful campus. My home church is great. Been going here to get fed spiritually and literally for 10 years plus. Got baptized here in 2020 and there are so many wonderful loving people here, you have to experience it. Their motto is "Love God, love people, and have a blast!"

Pastor JP is a solid Holy Spirit Filled Man of God! Food Bank
I am grateful for all the people that serve there at the food Bank.
When registering just walking to that  area workers are not kind, forklift man. When inquiring about what to do and how do I register people there are not patient. It's routine to the volunteers.
They do not explain well.  The lady that said a prayer for me and my family I was grateful however, I felt perhaps that was the wrong job for her. Sometimes it's better not to attend or volunteer if your hearts not into it. All I want is compassion, A reflection of Jesus Christ, An Ambassador of the Crossline Church.

Thank you!

name: CrossPoint
CrossPoint - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary: We love Crosspoint. All praise and Glory to Jesus ~ the King of Kings and the Lord of Lords! We are made to worship Him! It's Sunday services are awesome. Holy Spirit filled.  The warships and messages are beautiful. 🙌🙌👍 My first time worshipping there. Amazingly diverse congregation. Youth ministry facilities are spacious and well thought out. Pastoral leadership is young, fun and faith driven. Sermon was very biblical.  Foursquare churches are huge in Nigeria and it was such a blessing to see quite a few African believers in attendance including one lady wearing an elegant tribal dress. I'm being attending for over a year now and I love it I'm making this my home church and family in Christ, thank you Pastor Leaf This church is doing big thing. Bringing families and the community together. My family had a great time at this year's Christmas event in the parking lot. This place was covered in  SNOW yes SNOW. Thank you so much we had a great time.

name: Crosspoint Baptist Church
Crosspoint Baptist Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary: The pastor and his family have a heart for Jesus. I am new at this congregation and my family and I love it. We love to see some people holding their Bibles during services. We visited other congregations in the area and some don’t take their bibles just their phone and we felt weird taking our bibles. This church is Bible based and we are grateful for that. My little daughter loves the children ministry at Crosspoint. What a God beautiful friendly people! The Best church I have ever been to! Welcoming to all, very friendly congregation! The messages are always bible based, encouraging always lifting up Christ and glorifying him! The pastor and his family offer a 14 week bible study for new believers or anyone interested in digging deeper into their faith! Come check it out, by the grace of God, you will see me there! Solid, Bible-believing church. Pastor has a heart for Jesus and the Great Commission of spreading the gospel. Has been a huge blessing for me and my family; have seen Christ magnified in our lives. If you are in the area, come check it out. Very welcoming environment. If you want to meet a group of people you can call family, come to Crosspoint! You’ll hear a clear message from Pastor Phillip that comes straight from God’s word, hear the gospel preached, and be surrounded by people who actually care. The music is also really great, incorporating both old school hymns and modern contemporary songs in every service. They have a kids class, and weekly bible study where you can dive into the Word and fellowship with others. They also do outreach in the community. So thankful to call Crosspoint my church family! Such a great church! The pastor and his wife have such a love for God and people and it's so evident. A great place for anyone of any age where you can grow in your walk with God and leave inspired to be more like Christ in whatever life stage you're at.

name: CrossPoint Church - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary: I started attending this church over a year ago.  I can't say enough thank you's to this church and to our Lord for this ministry.  I came in hurting, alone, thinking here I am again in a new church.  I've gone through many trials and tribulations, family crisis, daughter with mental illness, and much more.  I came in by faith.  I would drive by the church daily and see the big cross outside which stood out to me.  My first Sunday I was greeted by loving people and met the sweetest lady named Marlene, who showed me so much love. She walked with me after service to get a cup of coffee which meant so much to me.  She introduced me to people.  The lead pastor Don is very loving and teaches sound biblical doctrine which was key for me.  He teaches grace, another plus for me.  He's genuine, down to earth, humble, and kind.  I met Pastor Lon,  pastor of Discipleship, who prayed for me after service.  I like that they have prayer available if you need it.  He's also very compassionate.  I was able to call him at the church for some counsel and he called me back and was very present and provided support and prayer.  I attended a "Starting Point" meeting with Pastor Danny, pastor of Community Life, and he provided information about the church, what they believe, and is also a great asset to the team.  All three of these pastors teach on Sunday mornings and all add a different spiritual dynamic.  The three pastors make a great shepherding team.  They have many small groups, children's classes, my grandkids attend the GEMS and Cadet group there which are like girl/boy scouts.  They have an awesome group of deacons here too!  The Lord used them (Patty, Norma, Mario, Nick) in my time of need and I can't thank them enough for their acts of service.  Thank you so much Crosspoint, pastors, deacons, elders for all that you do for the Lord.  I'm truly grateful for you. Great place to hear God's word being proclaimed. Very good church Fantastic church with very friendly people. Plenty of small groups and Bible studies for both men and women.  People actually care and are involved. We met more people in our first month than we did in 15 years at Calvary Chapel. It has the best pastor, he is both humble & his love for the Lord & his energy in describing the Bible, is so motivating. And the congregation is so warm & welcoming filled with the love of Jesus.

name: CrossPoint Church - Huntington Beach (North) Campus
reviewSummary:
Very friendly church, welcoming atmosphere, excellent sermon! Powerful teaching, great pastor, a loving place for families and bible believing and seeking people who love and want to know Jesus and  God’s Word better and more truly. I have attended CrossPoint many times. Every time they teach what is  in the Bible, nothing more, nothing less. They have many ministries to meet the needs of different types of people going through life. There are many types of well taught Bible studies available to you either at the church or in homes. They have several excellent, well educated, loving, caring pastors ready and willing to help you with anything. This will be our new home. Pastors Bruce and Gregory... PRAISES and WORSHIPS and SINGS ands ENCOURAGES and LOVES and ACCEPTES me WHERE I AM in my walk with Jesus Christ as my savior.
...Titus 2:11-13 READ THIS...
Pastor Bruce teaches me topically and also by book and chapter. This Church body helps me stay connected to God and Christ with LOVE.
Thank you Pastors.
Dennis/M68 Not much social distancing coming here for service. A friend of friend invited me though. Hard to find parking coming here. Felt a bit pressured on how they run on Sunday once visited. Wish they are more nicer.

Based on my experience, it was just complicated to understand and prefer not to visit.  Irresponsible when some are not safe even with masks. Having a hard time process coming. On issues I had, they tend to brush it off and not care to solve. Hard to trust them when they can't handle the real truth.

Seen passing by on their page, there was a youth group and hardly any masks. No proper social distancing as seen during their in-person program. I went to service before once and not much safety they even care meeting up.

name: Crosspoint Church - Temecula Campus
reviewSummary:
Changed rating from 2 to 4. Visited again with a friend and the culture seems more friendly. Church seems to have changed a few policies to be more inclusive of people from various phases in life.

Visited several times...
Pastor speaks about different kinds of people following Jesus, yet church feels cliquey, as if the only way to truly be accepted is to break into the right friend groups. Lots of emphasis placed on joining small groups. If joining is difficult because of erratic work, family, or conflicting schedules (or you're simply not ready yet) there won't be many resources for you or people willing to connect.

Messages were bible-based teaching through a book of the bible. Pastors were inclusive of many different political views while still holding onto sound biblical teaching. There was a clear, continual message that political views don't save. Jesus saves. Also, an overemphasis on personal condemnation.

Songs were upbeat and many instruments used including guitars, drums, and keyboard. Services opened with a couple songs and concluded with a couple songs and communion. Baptisms followed a few of the services.

Parking is challenging, so arrive early or look for guest parking near entrance. Outside of the building is pretty plain, but inside is nicely decorated, especially the children's area which includes a climbing wall, a log cabin stage, and bench seats.

In conclusion, may be a good fit if you instantly feel at home here. If not, you may want to keep moving. Leadership and regular attendees probably go out of their way to make you feel welcome. My husband and I moved to Temecula a year ago and got plugged into Crosspoint right when we got here. This has become more than just a church for us, they are more like family. The whole staff is kind, knowledgeable, helpful, fun, easy to be around and creative. They always have fun events scheduled and the sermons are well laid out and easy to follow. I feel like I have grown so much this past year due to this church family, Jesus is really present. I recommend getting plugged into a small group, it’s a wonderful way to get connected and strengthen your faith. They have two different campuses and a variety of times to satisfy most schedules. I would highly recommend Crosspoint to the established Christian and to someone just curious of what it’s all about. We found this welcoming, Biblical teaching church in the middle of the Pandemic.  We have been attending since October and have had tons of opportunities to get involved serving using our gifts.  The  small groups really helped us to get to know some people on a deeper level and establish community.  Love this church and the people!  You should definitely check it out! We might be biased, because we are partners now, but this is truly a unicorn church that checks off all the boxes when looking for a new home.  Teaching from the bible, all kinds of people welcomed, and true servant leadership….thankful for the way we have been poured into so we can bless others. My first time visiting Crosspoint church and it was an amazing welcoming and the sermon was very nice, love the music. I really think I found my new church. I like the fact that they have service on Saturday night. I really thank my neighbor friends for taking to Crosspoint church.

name: Crosspointe Church Anaheim
Crosspointe Church Anaheim - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary:
I went there for the sunday church service and loved it. A lot of friendly people, everyone was welcoming. I hope to build a strong god fearing community and make good friends i can count on and rely on. The performers on stage are amazing and very talented. The stage effects are on point and get the crowd into it. From the moment I walked through the doors I felt welcomed. Now it feels like home! If you are looking for great worship, authentic community, and people who love the Lord, come check us out! Pastor there prayed for the protection of ICE agents after the murder of Renee Good and wouldn’t even say her name.
I have to conclude that either he is ok with the immoral and often illegal behavior of the agents or he doesn’t want to offend the cruel people who are in favor of their actions.
Either way it’s a dealbreaker for me.
I had been attending this church for the last 8 years and am now going to a new church which didn’t politicize the latest murder of Alex Pretti. The pastor there simply expressed sorrow about what happened and prayed for the actual victims and their families. "To whom it may concern,
I am writing to express a serious concern regarding Pastor Jeff Snodgrass. A pastor is entrusted with the responsibility to live out the message he teaches, but I have observed behavior and conversations
from Pastor Jeff that do not align with the principles he preaches. This inconsistency is troubling, as those in pastoral leadership hold a duty not to cause others to stumble or lose trust in the church. I respectfully request that this matter be taken seriously and reviewed with care, as the spiritual health of the congregation depends on leaders who walk in integrity."
血 It's a great place to worship God. Pastor Brian is amazing he explains the scriptures  into detail. This church also Offers Different  prayer group's to help Marriage Couples,  children/Adolescence  and just regular people who are struggling with gaining a better understanding and connection with God. I love this church everyone is so kind and friendly. This is my new favorite place.

name: Crosspointe Church Brea
Crosspointe Church Brea - Brea Campus
reviewSummary: Crosspointe Brea is truly a welcoming church that has a desire to have a deep connection with God and fellow believers. I have found the congregation to be incredibly generous, serving one another and their community with love and compassion. It is a place where my faith is nurtured in Him. Crosspointe church Brea is a very warm and welcoming place. They love and care for people and I am touched by that! Pastor Rick is wonderful! I am blessed by their generosity to me! Very friendly, encouraging to all ages. Crosspointe Brea is a great place to worship and hear God’s word. The teaching is always on point, the staff is friendly, Kidpointe, the kid’s ministry is engaging and a fun environment for the kids to learn about Jesus. Our family loves attending weekly on Sundays and participating in weekly growth groups! This is a very loving and generous congregation.  I am not even a member of their church and community and despite this, these kind people heard about the hardships my daughter and I have been facing and they gave us a donation to help purchase school clothes for her senior year of high school.  God bless this church!

name: Crossroad Church
Crossroad Church - Tustin Campus
reviewSummary: Crossroad Church is the place to go to hear nothing but the truth straight from the Bible.  Come as you are and feel the presence of the Holy Spirit.  A place to deepen your relationship with the Lord and a place that will introduce you to Jesus should you not know Him as your Savior! The 1st time i experienced going to church. I encouraged myself to know more about jesus. People here comforted me, i didnt feel a stranger. I was very proud that i was babtized on my birthday😎 i told all my sibling that I was a Christian now! I didnt care what theyr reactions. At that time i dont know how i pray, now almost everyday I pray at least i put HIM in my mind all the time. Awesome small loving Church...The people at this church are loving people and help the community every way they can...Definitely recommend this church and you will find the love of God here!!! Crossroad is known as The People Place for a reason.  Come on over worship with us and you will understand why Very warm and loving church body of believers. The music and message glorified God…

name: CrossRoads
CrossRoads - Daytona Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
I stand corrected, the church’s website does not identify itself as an Independent Fundamentalist Baptist Church. Google identifies Cross Roads church as an Independent Fundamentalist Baptist Church.

Contemporary music with electric guitar and drums on the platform. Service was opened by a woman (lead singer) who opened the service with prayer (if correct, there is a chapter in Corinthian’s that speaks about women leading the service).

In regards to my comment on a woman opening the service in prayer, please read 1st Corinthians Chapter 14 and 1st Timothy Chapter 2. Women are an extremely intricate part of any church ministry, however, they are not to lead the men.

Most importantly, there was NO presentation of the Gospel to the lost / unsaved visitors present! A presentation (invitation) of the Gospel should always be given to afford the lost to respond. There was NO presentation or even an altar call.

It appears the Pastor is more interested in pleasing his congregation than preaching biblical truths and salvation by and through Jesus Christ! Loved the Walk Through Bethlehem special event.  Very loving and kind church community dramatization of time of Christ's birth place. CrossRoads church has a great children and youth ministries that our kids enjoy. name: Crossroads Community Church

reviewSummary:
We were visiting our daughter and son-in-law who just moved to the area near this church for the Easter weekend. She had heard about Crossroads Church from a mom in Ladera Ranch that she met. name: Crosswalk Church - Redlands
Crosswalk Church - Redlands - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary:
I love my home church. Learning to love well here has been such a life giving journey. You are welcome here! I have been a Member in Crosswalk Church in Redlands California myself, for over 5 years.  I can confidently say that Crosswalk Church is an exceptional church that truly exemplifies the love of God.  We have 3 weakly in person church service every Saturday starting at 9:00 AM, 10:30 AM, and 12:00 PM.  Kids church also meet at 10:30 AM.  Youngsters, teens, and young adults also have meetings Saturdays and other days of the week.  Weekly homeless feeding every Thursday night, and Medical, Chiropractic, PT, Dental, Occupational therapy, and other free services are also offered.

One of the most striking features of Crosswalk Church is the warm and welcoming environment that greets visitors as they step into the church. The church is known for its inclusivity and its emphasis on making everyone feel like a part of the family. The congregation is made up of people from all walks of life, and the church actively works to create a sense of community and belonging.

The service production at Crosswalk Church is also incredibly professional. The church invests heavily in technology and media to create a high-quality worship experience. The church also has a strong emphasis on music, with a talented team of musicians leading the congregation in worship.

Perhaps the most impressive aspect of Crosswalk Church, however, is the way in which it embodies the love of God. Members of the congregation speak highly of the way in which the church consistently demonstrates compassion and care towards those in need. The church is active in the local community, reaching out to those who are struggling and offering support and encouragement.

Overall, Crosswalk Church is a church that is deeply committed to sharing the love of God with those around them. The church's focus on community, inclusivity, and professional service production, along with its friendly and welcoming atmosphere, make it an excellent place to worship and grow in faith. I would highly recommend Crosswalk Church to anyone looking for a church home in the Redlands area.

reviewSummary:
The “chancery” of our Diocese of San Bernardino. It is extremely clean, spacious, and the chapel is very beautiful. Please pray for our wonderful bishop, priests, and all the people of God. Staff was unable(refused to help) obtaining copy of baptism certificate. Also tried the actual church ( San Salvador in Colton) was given the same help. None!!! I sent my prayers up offered ensense to the Lord blessed my home and I felt a since of relief then I opened my door and felt another spirit or spiritual pressure enter by me through my front door I said you are not welcome and I command you to leave in Jesus name and the neighbors started speaking and saying that I need to pray to there fertility God I'm sure now that this is so hard because the neighbors are keeping it going. The Diocese of San Bernardino has completely failed in its duty to act with integrity and transparency. A serious complaint was made involving a priest and an unlicensed therapist, yet the response was nothing short of negligent. They outright refused to meet, ignored opportunities for dialogue, and appeared more concerned with protecting themselves than addressing wrongdoing. This wasn’t just disappointing—it was a deliberate attempt to avoid accountability. The Church should be a place of truth and justice, not silence and cover-ups. SB Diocese, SB Diocese, Why have you forsaken us?
I echo the sentiments Jesus last spoke as he was crucified by his people in response to how the Diocese of San Bernardino has foresaken its people in Riverside, Ca. A cornerstone of the work of Vatican II was to understand the Church’s need to celebrate Mass in the language of the local congregation to appropriately and effectively “get closer to the people of God so that they could understand well what it does, and this is important for us” Pope Francis, 2015.
St. Thomas the Apostle Church in Riverside, CA has a Parochial Vicar- Celestine Afugwobi who fails at bringing the Word of God to our community. He is unable to effectively communicate in either in English or Spanish to be able to share the Good News. He leaves our community to the time prior to Vatican II where God’s people did not understand the language of the Sacraments being celebrated. This is a huge disservice to his flock. Besides being unintelligible, Celestine’s primary focus is evident: his hometown and his people back in his home country. Celestine does not promote the well-being or development of his community in Riverside but rather capitalizes on ways to extract funding and resources from his home community to take back to his home country. We need a priest focused on improving and developing our community, not one looking to exploit us for the benefit of his friends and family back at home.

reviewSummary:
I was fortunate enough to visit Our Lady at this location twice. The last time I went, I was looking for a new job and asked her to help me find one. Shortly after returning home, I received a job offer from a company I didn’t think would hire me. This place is very popular with the Vietnamese community, and I can see why, Our Lady does not say no to those who run to her. There is a beautiful Virgin Mary here that you can come visit. There are many people that bring flowers to adorn this statue. You should come by here and see this & enjoy the sunny weather as it is located directly across from the beach. We love the Virgin Mary. Stopped by to check this out as every time I drive by, regardless of time of day, there is a huge crowd around it.

There seems to be a never ending cycle of worshippers coming to pay respects and then homeless people coming and stealing the donations.

Supposedly this Virgin Mary statue was ordered to remain by the Buddhist monks that took over the property, which unsurprisingly was a convent prior to becoming a monastery. Our Lady turned her eyes to the sea as a sign to always watch over the fishermen and boats. Around Our Lady, there are always beautiful flower pots, Catholics from all over the world visit her and pray with her. May Our Lady bless us and the whole world. This has become a place of comfort for many elders within my family and community. As Catholics they come to seek solace in times of distress and gratitude in times of joy. Every so often my mom would ask me to drive her here so she could visit Mary. It’s where all my aunts and uncles near and far ask to visit when they’re in town. Just a few quiet moments of reflection and we’re off. Yet somehow those few moments make them feel better, happy as if they’ve visited a loved one. While my devotion is not nearly as strong as theirs, I still find myself saying a soft prayer ever time I’m there. This has become a significant location for Vietnamese Catholics. It overlooks the ocean and is surrounded my bouquets of flowers year round.

name: Eagle Rock Baptist Church
Eagle Rock Baptist Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve been attending Eagle Rock Baptist Church (ERBC) since 1993, when they planted a church in their building, and it has truly been my church home ever since.

Pastor Rick, Andrew, Seth, James, Raquel, and Judy are all incredible people who genuinely care about others. From the moment you walk through the doors, they make you feel welcomed, valued, and like you’re part of a family.

ERBC also has a wonderful children’s ministry and youth ministry, along with small groups that make it easy to build meaningful relationships and grow in your faith.

If you’re looking for a church where you’ll find biblical teaching, authentic community, and people who truly love and serve others, I highly recommend ERBC. It’s been a blessing to my life for many years, and I’m grateful to call it my church family. I was on a mission to find a church for community to help build a better relationship with God, and that is exactly what I found here. I first was able to try the Sunday sermons by livestream, and I absolutely loved how their lessons are focused on the Word and how their staff are knowledgeable on context and history. And then I went in for my first Sunday service, and the community immediately welcomed me with open arms. The people here are so kind and friendly, and they encouraged me to participate in everything from feeding the homeless to women bible study. I really wish I could have stayed in the area for this church alone because I know it will be hard to find a community like this one. More people, More like Jesus.

5 years ago, in the darkness of COVID, God led us to this little church. We were searching for a Bible-based community where we could hear God’s Word and where our children could put down roots.

We live in days where “due to the increase of wickedness, our hearts have grown cold.”  It’s all too easy to align ourselves with churches that fit our preferences or political views. (I confess this sin right here!) But this is not that kind of church. ERBC is Jesus-focused. Only in the presence of Jesus can our stone hearts truly melt—and here, our hearts melted.

Pastor Rick is a gifted speaker with a sense of humor that appeals to everyone—think dry, British-style humor—while Pastor Andrew takes us deep into the Bible with thoughtful, challenging teaching. We love them both, and we are so grateful for all the servants here at ERBC.

In just five years, reading and hearing God’s Word has transformed us—and continues to transform us every single day.

If you are looking for validation of who you voted for, this is not the place. But if you want Jesus—more of Jesus—this is exactly where you need to be. This church is home to a diverse community of welcoming individuals.  I feel the makeup of the church reflects the makeup of the city. They are welcoming to families, and my two elementary-school aged kids have enjoyed going to Sunday school and have made friends. Eagle Rock Baptist Church has been a second home for me. I’ve been in attendance at this church for now going on 7 years. From the first day up until now I’ve grown spiritually-through life group, mental-through understanding the word, intellectually-through the importance of community, and financially-through understanding how money works when God’s word is applied.

I’m alway eager to return to church on Sunday’s & Wednesday’s to learn more about the word with like minded people. Though I’ve become like family to many of the members at ERBC. I can’t help, but to think about how difficult life would be without a covering of Christ while doing life.

I believe that we the people are the church, and God is within us. From the first time I attended ERBC I was able to see that same model duplicated throughout all the members, pastors and other individuals attending sermons.

ERBC has made coming to the house of the Lord a safe and friendly environment for families to grow together in Christ while striving to be exceptional at loving people. If you have a family & your interests in growing not only a community, but knowledge and understanding of the word with your children & God ERBC Is most definitely the place for you!

Hope to see you there!
