name: East Valley Christian Fellowship
East Valley Christian Fellowship - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary:
I am the Youth Director here at East Valley Christian Fellowship, and I am so grateful that this church has become our home. My husband and I have been attending since 2023, and it has been amazing to watch the church continue to grow while still maintaining such a genuine, family atmosphere.

The people here truly care about one another and are sincerely pursuing a deeper relationship with Christ. No one pretends to be perfect, but there is a real desire to grow, learn, and become disciples of Jesus. This church has walked with our family through some of the biggest moments of our lives. They welcomed us with open arms from the very beginning, celebrated with us when we found out we were expecting our son, and have continued to support and love our family as we grow.

Being part of the youth ministry for our junior high and high school students has been such an honor. These are real teens facing real struggles, questions, and challenges, and our goal is to help guide them through life using the truth of God’s Word. We want them to put on the armor of God, turn theology into action, and become strong disciples of Christ who genuinely know Him.

One of the things I love most about East Valley is that there truly is a place for everyone. We have programs for toddlers, kids, teens, men, and women, along with Bible studies, fellowship opportunities, outreach ministries, and more.

If you are looking for a smaller, family-style church where people will genuinely know you, care for you, and grow alongside you in Christ, I highly recommend East Valley Christian Fellowship. I’ve been attending this church as both a member and worship leader for the last five years, and through every blessing and every trial, the Lord has used this church family to shape and strengthen my walk with Christ. Serving under such a faithful pastor and alongside a loving, Christ-centered community has taught me so much over the years. I can honestly say I’m a better Christian and servant today because of the consistent teaching, discipleship, encouragement, and care I’ve received here week after week.

From Tuesday Bible study, Wednesday midweek service, Thursday men’s Bible study, monthly Saturday men’s breakfasts, and Sunday service with fellowship afterward, this church places a deep emphasis on the Word of God — reading it, studying it, living it out, and encouraging one another through it. There is a genuine desire within this body to grow in wisdom, pursue holiness, love one another well, and live lives that honor and glorify Christ.

Over the years, I’ve been able to grow in my understanding of Scripture and sound doctrine while also being part of a church that believes the Holy Spirit is still active and moving today. I’ve witnessed lives transformed, gifts cultivated, and people lovingly discipled through authentic biblical community.

I’ve watched this church grow simply through word of mouth and through what I truly believe is the hand of God bringing people together to grow in truth, love, and service. Having been part of many churches and denominations throughout my life, I can confidently say that Pastor Jason has consistently lived above reproach — loving, serving, listening, and always willing to give biblical counsel with humility, wisdom, and care.

Watching each ministry begin and continue to flourish has been an incredible journey to witness. Being part of this church has grounded me more deeply in Scripture, strengthened my faith, helped me grow in the fruit of the Spirit, and continually encouraged me to pursue a life that is pleasing to God. My family has been coming here for almost 1 year and we really enjoy Sunday service. Something that is so wonderful is the different days I can come and pray or study. The women's ministry led by Michelle is amazing I learn so much and the ladies are so open to sharing, learning, and praying. My family has found a solid church home to serve in. 24 years this church has been amazing to me and my family! I highly recommend you check it out 10am on Sundays 6pm on Wednesdays!! East valley Christian fellowship is a great church Pastor Jason is a great pastor we go by the word of God and the Bible.. it's a very close-knit family...

name: East Village Community Church
East Village Community Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
I love East Village Community Church! They always teach good sound biblical doctrine, and application into our daily lives. Everyone is welcome to worship here.
Sunday Bible study starts at 9am, followed by church service at 11am, which is a great timeframe; not too early 🤗 for those of us who like to sleep in a little bit on the weekends. Very friendly congregation. Nice Pastor. They love Jesus. It's all about the Bible. Very air-conditioned. In winter it's heated. It isn't packed. Room for visitors. Sunday 9:00 am Bible Study by Deacon James. 10:00 Brunch for Bible Study attendees.
Sunday Church Service 11:00 am. Beautiful Church. Very welcoming. Parking Meters on the street. Great  service god is definitely in the house  pastor preach the word of God   I will be back Bible based. Strong Christian values. Great family. Fantastic - bye bye church! Hello LOST ABBEY TASTING ROOM

name: Eastern Presbyterian Church
Eastern Presbyterian Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: WOW. I just watched a video connected to your church. A man was videoing outside the gate on the sidewalk and all hell broke loose. The Pastor came out and got about 2" from the man's face, demanding to know what he was videoing for. Very disrespectful.  A guard then got in this man's face, screaming at him and chased him about 3-4 blocks down the street. Very disrespectful and dangerous.  Then the guard got in the man's face again and started a verbal altercation. Preventing this man from walking on the sidewalk. The guard should have been pepper sprayed. His conduct was absolutely horrendous. This is an example of the people who represent your church? This church owns Apartment buildings. Not only are they not paying taxes on them because it's owned by the church but they never make repairs. The church fought my tooth and nail to make any repairs like my floor that had massive black mold in it and never got repaired in the 7 years that I lived there. They also sold the building when I said I was going to sue them . I lost everything I owned and am still sick from living there .. Good Christians... Isn't greed a sin? Very beautiful church. I was surprised by size and beautiful structures. Simple, clean, beautiful church.  I saw a lot of church to take a photo. This church is 10 out of 10 points awesome. Thank you. Really enjoy staying church. they feed us really good and they treat us good i have been here for 5 years I was an assistant pastor here when it was a Lutheran church.  I am very glad that Our Savior,s has survived as a worshiping congregation.

name: Eastside Christian Church
Eastside Christian Church - Anaheim (Platinum Triangle) Campus
reviewSummary: I have not tried taking my ESA Dog people tell me she’s not really a service dog, but she is a service dog because it says right on my ESA paper that I am handicapped and she has to help me with my handicap and that’s not the only handicap I have but anyway the only other place that ever turned her away was one of the doctor offices. I’ve had her into a couple of different hospitals and nursing home and they loved her. I don’t always take her with me everywhere I go one time one doctor’s office told me I could not have her in there because I don’t have a special patch on her little vest. She’s a little pedigree Shih Tzu and she’s very well behaved and if she does. Or something like that, I would just take her out Eastside Regeneration was so healing for me when I went. Sadly, I have not gone back but I plan to. I miss everyone there, and this truly was such a safe place for me when I attended. I even had the opportunity of volunteering at one point. I hope to be back in God's timing and I highly recommend the regeneration program for physical disabilities, mental health, sexual addiction, and addiction. It is truly one of a kind program. Blessings. This church has mine and my kids whole heart. You can feel the Holy Spirit everytime you come in or hear a message online. We have recently moved and I watch online . I have not found a church where you can feel God as loud as you can in this church . Thank you for all you do Eastside Pastor Gene is so funny. I was atheist/lukewarm and this Church led me home to Jesus. I was baptized in 6th grade on my birthday and they showed me so much love and care. They also protect your stuff in the bathrooms when you're getting baptized. I love this Church. This Church saved my life 15 years ago...I love the people who all make it feel like HOME. The Worship music touches my soul and the Sermon... 9 out of 10 times it relates to me and my life..I'm always amazed by the Compassion and Love I see poured in and out of this church and all its locations...Anaheim, Park Rapids, Bellflower, Redlands, Las Vegas, Irvine....One of the best things that happened during pandemic was Online Church was started and we were still able to worship and hear the message..I'm so grateful to be apart of this amazing Church and it's community...

reviewSummary: Loved this friendly church on my birthday with my son, Nicholas, eating popcorn and drinking coffee while watching parts of the movie Otto with Tom Hanks! Pastor Gene Apple then weaved in a message about how helping/blessing others helps/blesses us - just beautiful 🥹🙏❤️ Amazing worship team, beautiful Irvine location, nice building, friendly staff and godly Bible-based preaching - well-done Eastside Irvine! 👏👏👏 I used to attend the Anaheim location of Eastside Christian Church, but now the Irvine location is much closer to home. name: Ecclesia Christian Fellowship
Ecclesia Christian Fellowship - San Bernardino Campus
reviewSummary: I have been visiting this church for more than a year. Always with a message from other  visiting or in house ministers who brought a great word. I happened to go a few Sundays ago and the Pastor preach a POWERFUL word so rich and educational for me in tithing. OMG. I literally had to stop taking notes!!! He PREACHED without all of the hoopla. He laid it all out with power and grace. Bible study on Sunday works for me. I went back the following Sunday and it was him bringing fire again.   I went t to a women’s ministry event. It was lovely. The leaders were approachable and the service was on time and flowed. The Pastors wife was the speaker. Excellent word. Very good word driven church who are serious about people. I feel good sowing seeds here. Amen. Great church helps its community with food and events for families and community love the people that workk here there not only helpful but friendly and full of praise Brought somebody here to collect food as I've been doing for nearly two years and overall haven't had any bad experiences until recently, as the same person I normally bring to this church was gathering food I was in dire need of a restroom and came inside to use it. As I was heading to the restroom what appeared to be a staff (female, presumably African-American, taller) greeted me in what appeared to be a polite and respectable manner but was under the assumption that I was there to gather food and directed me to where the food was being distributed. Out of concern that I would be denied access to the restroom I did not wish to state that I was here to help somebody else collect food and asked if I can use the restroom without stating why I was there, she allowed me to use the restroom which was greatly appreciated but upon leaving the restroom and attempting to return to my car to wait on who I brought that same staff directed me to where the food was yet again. To avoid potentially causing a scene I went in the direction she pointed and began to look for the person I brought, that same staff further directed me to where the food was after she saw that I was walking in another direction I guess assuming that I didn't know where I was going and starts to speak to me in a manner that I found unnecessary. As an attempt to return to my car I made it known to another staff person (also female, presumably African-American, wearing prescription glasses) that was signing people in and who spoke to me in a more ridiculous manner that I am looking for somebody and quickly walked away to return to my car. Though I made a similar statement the exact statement that I wished to make was "Excuse me, I am looking for somebody but I do not see her. Thanks." but I was afraid that I would start trouble by saying that, while I recognize that I had the option of staying in my car or fetching a restroom elsewhere both of these staff that I encountered appeared to be incompetent when it comes to speaking to people in a sensible manner (addressing me as "sweetie" and "mama") and assumed that all people who came were looking to gather food. This was not the most pleasant experience and I do not wish to return here at least not in-person, this incident occurred approximately on: Wednesday, January 21, 2026 My husband and I were looking for a new church, we thought it would be nice since I came on Saturday with my aunt and parents to a line dancing class everyone was very friendly. It was not the case Sunday, we had a gentleman come in and tell us about the family room which was nice we have our 7 month old baby but he’s been going to church since he was 6 weeks old the music doesn’t bug him and he generally falls asleep or just sits in our laps. When I was outside a usher approached my husband about moving our stroller mind you we are in a back row against a wall where there are 3 empty rows in front of us basically telling him to move the stroller. We chose the back to not be a bother to anyone and the stroller literally wasn’t in the way it was against the wall. Then when I came in and we were sitting another usher came and told us about the family room I was like I know thank you. I enjoy praise and worship so I wanted to enjoy it with everyone. About 7 minutes later another person comes and tells us about this room we already are highly aware of, I told her I know thank you. We took that as our cue to go. My son wasn’t crying, screaming, or shouting just existing. Apparently, it’s a problem to exist as a baby. Didn’t even listen to the sermon. I sang on my churches praise team right after giving birth and the baby wasn’t a problem as an infant or as a 6 month old. Just doing too much. I have been attending that shirt since it's been on date street. Pastor Joshua Beckley is awesome and a bible teaching Pastor. Come by and check us out. Won't be disappointed. Amen

name: Echo Life Church
Echo Life Church - Pensacola Campus
reviewSummary:
Came here looking for a bold, Bible-based church with real conviction, left disappointed. They had a woman come up claiming to be one of the pastors/leaders which is clearly not biblical. Then they promoted a “merch drop” during service like it’s a streetwear brand. If you’re serious about Scripture and want a church that isn’t trying to be trendy, this probably isn’t it. Echo Life Church has been such a blessing for me and my family. We first visited in May, just a week after Easter, and it immediately felt different in the best way. After being away from church for over 10 years, it’s refreshing to be somewhere that doesn’t pressure you but lets you reconnect with God at your own pace.

The pastors’ messages are always heartfelt and easy to relate to. The kids’ program is amazing, the staff are kind, and the coffee shop is such a great touch. Echo Life has helped me grow closer to God in a way that feels real and personal. I’m so grateful for this church and the community we’ve found here. Wow! This was our first time at Echo Life Church! It just happened to be their 7th Year Celebration! We really enjoyed seeing their grassroots slide presentation and how they have become who they are today! Amazing testimony to faithfulness and determination 🙌 👏 🙏 ❤️ ✨️
Pastor Joe had a great sermon and Pastor Suzannah, his wife, was one of the energetic Music  Praise Team members!
They have 2 services- 9 a.m. & 10:45 a.m. We are going to participate in their Steps program next week after the last service to learn more about the church and how to serve!

Update! Now it's July and I can't say enough wonderful things about Echo Life Church! They have expanded to 3 services, since I started attending 5 months ago! There is 8 a.m., 9:45, and 11:30! We go to the 9:45 and it's packed out! I serve as a Greeter at 8 a.m. and that service is quite full too! But, don't be discouraged by that! There's room for everyone!!! Pastors Joe and Suzanna are doing an absolutely wonderful job! 👏 The service starts with wonderful live music that changes members, so everyone who wants to serve can! I love the energy and words to the lyrics on 3 screens! Who doesn't want to not praise the Lord with great worship 🙌 music? Believe me! If you and your family and friends, are searching for a happier life with Jesus, Echo Life Church is an absolutely awesome place to start! They have a great place for your kids at Echo Life Children's Church too! Enjoy a nice cup of coffee before and after the service too! Bring it into the service too! Our city is ready for a revival, like the message from Pastor Joe Driver today, who incorporated film clips from the "Jesus Revolution" and "The Chosen" today! We'll have 2 more Movie Summer Sundays- July 14 & 21, 2024! We even have bagged popcorn 🍿 and sodas, so y'all join us! You won't be disappointed!!! Come on Pensacola!!!! This church will put the fresh wind in your sails! The team of people here go above and beyond the church norm. My wife and I attended over a dozen other churches in Pensacola before finding Echo Life. While life took us back to the Midwest a couple of years later, we still watch online every Sunday. I simply can't recommend enough for you to try this church out!
All the best, -Alex This church is led by an absolute amazing group of pastors who genuinely care about everybody has an individual no matter how much or how big the church will grow. They will continually work to get to know you. This The first time in this church I was invited by a friend and upon walking in I was welcomed with nothing but hospitality and warmth. It definitely made me feel like I was already a part of the community. Echo Life Church is definitely an impact I will never forget I will always be grateful for In my life as it has allowed me to build my faith on levels I did not know existed!

Give this church a visit!!

reviewSummary:

name: El Camino Presbyterian Church
El Camino Presbyterian Church - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary: If you're looking for a place where the Gospel is shared well from the pulpit, fellowship and love abound in the people, and you appreciate the beauty of liturgy- this is the place for you. An added plus is weekly communion. Pastor Eric is wonderful and the congregation is welcoming (without being creepy ;-)). I have been going to ECPC for a few weeks now. The fellowship here is warm and people stay after church for food and fellowship and don't rush out when the service is over. Love worshiping at El Camino. reviewSummary:
I'm still listening to old CDs from this church. They just gave them away for free over 15 years ago but the CDs are still bearing fruit. Thank you. People here are dedicated to understanding God's word and bringing His word to the world.
There are many ways to serve the community and the world. A Wonderful & welcoming house of worship where one can become a disciple of Christ, find ways where you can help and serve others near & far. Increase your knowledge and understanding of Scripture.

E3 has become my spiritual home. I love how inclusive this church is. So welcoming to everyone who wants to worship at every phase of their faith journey. I am very grateful to have been able to call Element3 Church home over the past few years. Our church has been cautious through the pandemic, but we have been faithful and committed to continue creating opportunities for worship, even when those opportunities have been digital. I'm really excited about our progress as our country finds its way beyond the pandemic, and I'm looking forward to seeing God do amazing things in the years to come. Are we the right church family for you to learn to follow Christ in? I hope so. We'd love for you to come out and visit and see. You can also join us online each Sunday at 10:00 AM at element3.online.church.

name: Elevate Church
Elevate Church - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary:
Great place my family and I get to call home.  The Sunday school teachers are trustworthy and their curriculum is bible truth. The pastors are phenomenal and they truly walk the narrow path that leads to life.  Grateful to God that such a community exists and have taken us in as one of their own.  This church is the church that Christ intended. Loving one another and not playing religious games.  Solid doctrine and Pastor Mauricio is a man of prayer.  A man after God’s own heart. Hard to find genuine nowadays. Shining in the darkness brightly. I love this church! You will too. Non-denominational Christian church that teaches the bible as it should be taught. Their goal is for you to know God, and make him known. Not watered down. Pastor Mauricio is the real deal. He talks the talk and walks the walk. You'll notice the difference from just one visit. What happened to other night was truly special.. every Wednesday night is special.. but sometimes you can feel the presence of the Lord Jesus Christ fill the entire building.. a thick anointing.  Thank you Jesus for forgiving our sins and blessing us, day after day. Love pastor Mauricio and you can tell he loves Jesus with all his saved heart. God bless the associate pastors Chris and Henry. A great church to finally be planted in!!  A lot of churches are mislead, lost, deceptive and empty spiritually.. not this place! I attend this church for 7 months and I decided to find another church. The pastor is more interested in your money than he is getting to know you.  The majority of the people that serve in the church are stuck up and act like they’re better than everyone else and it’s because the pastor sets the example. The worship is good but the pastor and others there act like they’re better than you. I left this church because it was the best thing for me and I just wanted to share my experience there. And the reason I lasted 7 months is because a friend of mine went there with his family and I didn’t want to hurt his feelings but I finally had to tell him that I started attending a better church. 3/3 UPDATE: documents were provided only after posting a review

This place seems genuine up front but after attending for 6 months I witnessed Pastor Mauricio and the ushers get physically aggressive with a person in the church during worship. I was so appalled that I have not been able to trust another church. Lastly I gave tithes and donations to this church for which I am yet to receive any tax documents for.

name: Elevate Life Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary:
I love Elevate Life Church a lot. Praise God for guiding me to this wonderful church. When I went for the first time back on 1st of August 2025 to attend a young adults bible study, I felt welcomed and loved by others and I sense that this church will be a good fit. It took a bit of time to get adapted and getting to know other Christians. I got to meet Pastors Tom and Heather, one of the most loving people you'll ever meet! I love them a great deal! I took that big step on attending service, though I started with Wednesdays before doing Sundays and now I can do both. I have grown and I feel like a different person a year later from the fellowship with others to attending service almost every week to making the Lord proud by praying and reading his Word. I am glad to have such a community who is there for me with support, love, and prayer. No doubt I'll give them 5 stars! Visited Elevate Church recently and had a really positive experience. Everyone was welcoming from the moment I walked in, and the atmosphere felt warm and genuine. The message was encouraging, easy to connect with, and uplifting. Music was great, and the overall service was well organized. It’s a place where you can feel comfortable whether it’s your first visit or you’ve been attending for a while. Definitely worth checking out. This church is not alive and not worth the drive!

I attended Elevate Life Church for about two years. When I first started attending, the slogan “Loving People to Life” genuinely reflected what I experienced. The church felt welcoming, focused on discipleship, and passionate about helping people grow in their faith.

Over time, though, it felt like the priorities shifted. From my perspective, the emphasis became more about polished productions, book promotions, comedy-driven sermons, large women’s conferences, and theatrical performances than about discipleship and reaching people. While there’s nothing inherently wrong with those things, they seemed to take center stage in a way that felt different from what originally drew me to the church.

It also seemed like there was an increasing focus on image and presentation. Even the worship felt noticeably different, and the overall culture no longer felt as authentic or Christ-centered as it once had.

I truly hope Elevate Life Church rediscovers the heart that first made it such a welcoming place—a church where loving people to life is more than just a slogan. Really does feel like coming home, even for those of us raised in the church, this place is for the broken and hurting.
If the world, past "churches" and life in general has beat you to death, come on home it's safe and inviting, regardless of your past.
There is power in the name of Jesus.
Amen. Glad I found Elevate.
Pastor Tom and Heather along with everyone there has made going to church something I look forward to.
My understanding of Jesus has grown tremendously since I've been there. I really feel a part of this place.

name: Elevate Miami Church
Elevate Miami Church - Coral Gables Campus
reviewSummary:
Great Church, Great Pastor's, Great Place
It's contemporary and very balanced with the word and spiritual gifts, it's a very prophetic place and the people are very nice. I love the people here. I had great experiences here and consider them to a great church to come and visit if your in the area. It's home for us.  We have been part of this church family for years.  Many special events are shared during the holidays and all year long.  Fall and Winter are my favorite!  Can't wait for Sunday mornings.  It's what you need to get you through the week.  Jesus is the Reason for the Season! I agree somewhat with one of the posts here.  The worship is amazing and that the sermon is a bit too long.  However!  It is by far NOT boring!  Pastor Kevin is an amazing teacher and the time goes by very fast.  Because it's Sunday and I do spend time with my family, yes, it would be best if the preaching was shorter, but we should not tell the spirit what to do and I am sure the pastor is being guided by it.  And yes, all churches need more bodies of Christ, but if we are going too judge it by this and other small details, no one would go to any.  I have been going for over a month, but due to my job, I haven not been able to go every Sunday.  I follow the sermons on Sound Cloud and wish I could just go.  It really is much better bring there.  If you think it needs members, then come and give this church the 5 stars it deserves! Only God knows us perfectly. He used Pastor Kevin and Jeremiah to confirm and give me direction in specific and accurate prophetic words last Sunday. Truth resonates from the teaching and accountability of this ministry which bears great fruit! I immediately moved in the favor if God toward my destiny! Perfect love casts out fear. It's a new day and God has great plans for your life too! Listening to the previous sermons via the cloud now that I'm back in Austin...so thankful for godly men and women who are called to preach, teach and declare heaven on Earth!! Go GOD!! I love this church! The preaching is on amazing! I can’t get enough, the word is preached and you know it’s set you free to help you go to the next level! If you want to grow in Christ this is the church to go to! It’s like a small church in a big city. They have everything you need there. Prayer, God’s Love, Freedom, they have coffee & bagels in the Sunday service. The Pastor has a heart for his people very caring and his wife is so kind and loving, I am so happy my son found this church! Couldn’t be any happier. ❤️✨❤️✨❤️✨

name: Elevate Ministries
Elevate Ministries - Orange Campus
reviewSummary: Can't say enough good things about this place. The community is strong and has a lot of staff that are caring outgoing and helpful. The message of generosity yesterday was so powerful and spirited. The services are amazing. The worship team is off the chain! Both pastors I've seen have given powerful sermons and reached me very deeply. I enjoy  all the people serving this church so much!! Thank you all! Ever since the first time we stepped into the building we have been treated with love and respect. We are glad to call Elevate ministries our home church.  I am so thankful for the leadership and all the friendships we have  made while attending Elevate Ministries. Such a wonderful church. People are so genuine and really do care to get to know you and build Godly friendships. The services are relevant, exciting and filled with truth from the Word of God (Holy Bible). The pastors and staff continuously go out of their way to make you feel included as well as make it clear that they are there to help and serve you whenever needed; even outside their hours of operation. My children love their kids ministry and have learned and matured so much. Choosing to join Elevate Ministries has been the best decision we have ever made for our family. Around 2003 They collected 1 million or so from the congregation for something called the six-year plan which I heard about repeatedly every Sunday. It was for a new church a new building. That never happened instead the pastor's wife got a new mini Cooper and the son got a house.. I remember as a kid seeing the tithing baskets being passed around three times just to see who would give again. They are very much focused on money. They do it to the youth group as well, harping on tithing taking what they can from young adults and children. But they do have a great graphic design team and photographers. At one point the youth program here was peak and it felt like very much in tuned with the neighborhood its in. Also this says that it's in Fullerton. It's not important it's two cities away from Fullerton approximately 13 miles. The youth group in the mother church are in the same industrial cul-de-sac on Alvarez Street in Orange California. Absolutely love the atmosphere at Elevate ministries! I’ve been welcomed from day 1. I’ve grown up going to church and have never experienced Pastors who are so dedicated to helping you and your family grow together. They are the example of living out the Word and we all truly appreciate them and the ministry.  This place is home for us and we have made beautiful, lasting friendships that I cherish.

name: Emmanuel Evangelical Free Church
Emmanuel Evangelical Free Church - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary:
Great spiritual Bible based church
Was welcomed the first day I attended. Great Bible studies lead by Pat McCauley a kind & spiritual lead lady. Made friends by joining the Chior. Pastor Andrea is enthusiastic & shows his love by greeting each Sunday at the front door. Started coming this April and it immediately felt like home! I'm in my early twenties and Emmanuel has a great group of young people as well as super cool people of all ages. Amazing church body! Very welcoming church! Love the biblically-based preaching and the spirit-led worship. If you're looking for a home church with all your future best friends this is it. I have been coming to Emmanuel Church for 25 years and simply put, it is home.  The people and community here are warm, welcoming, and caring and the preaching is always biblical, relevant, and meaningful.  The worship is absolutely amazing and always provides a space for people to encounter God.  I would recommend this church to anyone looking for community and a place to be known and loved. Burbank, California has no shortage of choices when it comes to selecting a church.  Where Emmanuel stands out is the people.  On a Sunday morning, you will be greeted by a team of caring individuals who actually do want to know how you're doing.  Inside those glass double doors is a warm and welcoming sanctuary where you can connect with God and his people.  Emmanuel wants you to have a strong relationship with Christ and has many opportunities to facilitate spiritual growth.  Also, their personal barista, Dan, is THE BEST! :D I came to this church questioning, doubting and in need (of God, of friends, of change...). The people of Emmanuel welcomed me with open arms and without question. I have grown stronger spiritually, mentally and emotionally since coming to this church. If you get involved in classes and programs, or just attend regularly, you will meet some great people!

name: Emmanuel Faith Community Church
Emmanuel Faith Community Church - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary:
Great church! Has a thriving children and young adult ministry. A lot of options for adults to connect. Also has Care and Counseling ministry which includes recovery groups. The Spanish speaking community is integrated into main church, which is unique and fantastic! This is an awesome church. It was the second visit, and my wife and I were very happy we did. The worship is great, and the service was awesome. We found a home church. The fiesta Latina was amazing. And the music is very good. This is a great community. I have enjoyed this church for 33 years. We drive from South Oceanside to attend EFCC. There are many places to be involved and serve the Lord. Absolutely love this church! The lead pastor Ryan Paulson is an amazing communicator: always has plenty of humor, but boy can he layer into a message! Every Sunday we are excited to go to church …and we are never disappointed after! I feel like I am growing more in my spiritual walk now through this church than at any time in my life. So grateful!
Also, really great Kids ministry, including high school.

name: Epicentre West LA
Epicentre West LA - Westwood Campus
reviewSummary:
Visited for the first time this morning. Epicenter West LA church seems to be a younger generation, 20s and 30s very popular. Here’s a little information about my visit.

Parking: Street— I arrived a few minutes late and was still able to find parking along the street. This church meets at a synagogue across the street from Trader Joe’s. They have a small sign out front which is the only indicator that Epicentre meets there.

Welcoming: from the moment I walked up the stairs, I was greeted by Lauren and Kenter. They were both super welcoming and super sweet. They seemed so happy to be greeting visitors and regular comers alike. We exchanged words for a few minutes and they gave me a name tag. Most people wear a name tag at the church. If you leave your visitor badge with your name as you exit, they will make you a permanent badge for when you return. The badges are all placed on a large board at the entrance of the church so you do not forget it from Sunday to Sunday. Kinda cool concept and very helpful to remember people’s names.

Worship: Lights were dimmed and the worship team with about five members did a great job with the music. I really enjoyed the songs and still have one that I’ve never heard stuck in my head. A few people lifted hands but does not seem to be the norm. Pretty small congregation but I understand there are a lot of people out sick this week so they say they may be missing about 30 or 40 people.

Sermon: The message was brought by a young pastor name Steve. It was very short, probably about 15 minutes or less. Apparently the pastor and his whole family are out ill with the flu this week. We went back into worship and sang a few of the same songs we sang through the worship time. Between worship and the sermon, a young man came up and gave the announcements and provided information about the church as well as the Epicenter app they use to transmit information throughout the congregation.

Snack and chat: They had a very cool concept and which I’ve never seen in a church. They provided snacks and encouraged people to hang around to visit and socialize. Lauren and Kenter came after service and brought me a little gift for visitors and we chatted again for a bit during snack and chat. Very sweet couple. I met the girl sitting behind me her name was, Shina.

Life Groups: I went to visit the wall which has the connect groups locations and was greeted by a young doctor from UCLA carrying a baby. (Again, so friendly!) He explained the various groups. There did not seem to be one for my age group really (40s/single) but there seem to be plenty of groups for the younger generation and one even for married people.

This was a friendly church, probably one of the friendliest churches I have ever attended. I would highly recommend it for the younger generation although it doesn’t feel like there’s much of a group my age. Seems to be multicultural although the largest population seems to be Asian. I would absolutely recommend this church to someone looking around for a home. Everyone was so friendly which makes it much easier to connect. Epicentre West LA has an incredibly devoted and inviting group of Christ followers. My wife and I started going to this church upon moving to West LA. We could not be happier with our decision. This church has brought us closer to God and provided us with a community of believers that help us feel like we're a part of something greater. There are no stuffy traditions or hypocrisy at this church. We are invited to come as we are and to love one another as Christ has loved us. Hope to see you here! I've been a part of a church my whole life and many different ones as my wife and I have moved around the US and lived in various countries.  That said, we've been attending Epicentre West LA for a while now and can say that we feel really welcome here.  The community is still small (church just started in February) but very welcoming.  The pastor gives challenging sermons, grounded in Scripture, and always makes sure to make it relevant to life.  We don't have kids, but know there's an excellent children's program.  I also like that they're focused on meeting in "Lifegroups" during the week and have enjoyed being part of one of them.  This is a great place to grow in your faith. Love this church! The moment my girlfriend and I arrived we felt welcomed. Afterwards we looked at each other and said that this church immediately felt like home. People are so passionate in worship, and preaching is super applicable and down to earth. Also, there's food after! They really focus on community and life groups so we'll be checking that out for sure. This has been my church since 2015. I felt welcome right away and had so many people engage with me and care about me. name: Etiwanda Community Church
Etiwanda Community Church - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary:
Nice church and faithful pastor who cares about scripture however this is most certainly not a non-denominational church but Pentecostal (Oneness Pentecostal in particular).

Edit: While the owner denies any association with Oneness Pentecostalism I believe transparency is extremely important when it comes to believers seeking churches. The following is taken from the Wikipedia page on Oneness Pentecostalism, the defining tenets of which, in my experience, Etiwanda Community Church adheres to:

"Oneness Pentecostalism derives its distinctive name from its teaching on the Godhead, which is popularly referred to as the "Oneness doctrine," a form of Modalistic Monarchianism. This doctrine states that there is one God, a singular divine Spirit, who manifests himself in many ways, including as Father, Son, and Holy Spirit. This stands in sharp contrast to the doctrine of three distinct and eternal persons posited by Trinitarian theology. Oneness believers baptize in the name of Jesus Christ, rather than using the Trinitarian formula, of baptizing "in the name of the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit." Oneness believers state that Jesus is the one name of the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit, and so should perform all religious activities in that one name.
Besides their beliefs about the Godhead, Oneness Pentecostals differ significantly from most other Pentecostal and Evangelical Christians in matters of soteriology. Whereas most Pentecostals and Evangelical Protestants believe that only faith in Jesus Christ is the essential element for salvation, Oneness Pentecostalism defines salvation as saved by grace through faith and "true" faith leads to repentance, full-submersion water baptism (in the name of Jesus Christ) and baptism in the Holy Spirit, with the evidence of speaking in other tongues." This is a growing church with a loving pastor. As a fellow Minister, I am excited to see where God is leading this pastor and this local assembly. This church  is one of the most socially acceptable churches I have been to since I was Jr high. I have learned more here about scripture and myself than I have in the 30 years of my life. Connecting point community church is life changing..Great atmosphere and the presence of God is well felt..🔥🙏👏👏👏💯 It's a old church that is delicate but strong

name: Everwell Church
Everwell Church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve gone to church most of my life and the best way to describe my experience with Everwell is PEACEFUL.  This is not a church you go to be entertained - this is a church you attend to be deeply reminded of how much God loves us and loves others. Everwell is a community of amazing friends and family who are fed by the word, and a place where the gospel is preached every week.

I am so thankful to have found Everwell. My husband and I started going about a year ago, and we have since gained an amazing family, friends, and a greater relationship with God.

The church has about 40-60 people, who are a mixture of people: young singles, new families, and those who have been Christians for many decades. There is a Wednesday night community group in CDM that we love going to, in addition to a monthly women’s and men’s coffee. Amazing local church with a great community After living in the world for about 27 years and working as a Deputy Sheriff for about 6 at the time, I had the opportunity to see just how dark the world can truly be. As Jesus started to tug on my heart, a dear friend of mine (who had been going there for years) invited me to Everwell. The message as well as the genuineness of the people seemed sound after the first visit. After the second, The Pastor, Josh ran up to my friend and I as we were at our cars, introduced himself to me and insisted to pray for me. Next thing I know, I’m ugly sobbing in the parking lot with my newfound brothers, the spirit had lit a fire in my heart. A year later, I’m baptized in the name of Jesus and astonished at the vastness of Gods will. It’s safe to say this is my new family.

If you’re nervous about Church in general and you’re with believer with bad church experiences, in that case go for GOD and experience HIM, not for the people (even though the people here are fricken awesome). If you’re unsure about the whole thing that is Christ Jesus, in world full of deception and wickedness, you owe it you to yourself to seek the TRUTH. Come with an open heart and I have faith that you’ll find it.

May God bless anyone who takes the time to read this, I look forward to seein any new faces.🫶🏼

Never thought I’d see myself back and church, and I’m so happy to be back This church is such an amazing house of the Lord ! They offer so much discipleship and amazing fellowship gatherings . A great Christ centered community.  This church is full of kind, generous, caring men and women of God. I highly recommend this place for anyone who wants to be apart of a body of Christ who genuinely walks out the gospel . I just started  coming here 3 weeks ago. I so far really like this church. It a perfect size for me. Everyone is very friendly and kind to me. They also made me feel welcomed. They offered to help me with anything I need.  I really love the worship team.  I feel the holy spirit in this beautiful church.  I really enjoyed the Candle light Christmas service. I used to think writing reviews for churches was so silly -- it seemed so weird to "rate" a faith community, especially when people's experiences with churches tend to be very personal and subjective. But I relent. The Lord has altered my life through Expression 58 and so I have to testify! I'm not even sure how to concisely do this, so this review will probably will end up being extremely long, lol.

Five years ago I moved to LA from the midwest, leaving a vibrant and faith-filled church community behind. I knew no one in the city, and the moment I moved I knew I needed to connect to a faith community -- both to stay rooted and also just... because I wanted friends. But upon my arrival in LA I was completely intimidated by the sheer number of options for churches, as well as the prevailing stereotype that churches in this city are vapid and have weird, worldly theology. While this may be true of some, this is the antithesis of E58. It was immediately obvious to me the moment I heard the first worship song that this is a people passionately running after the Lord's heart.

I cannot say enough about the worship at this church. Worship is a living, breathing thing; it is a conversation with God, prophetic at times and often spontaneous. You are invited to worship any way you like -- you may stand still, sit, kneel, dance, raise your hands, shout, stay quiet. It is truly a community where I feel safe to worship in whatever way I need to, no performance.

The lead pastor, Jen, is a fierce and intelligent woman that does not hold back on theology in her sermons. No pandering... you are gonna LEARN and actually be challenged on Sundays. Not only that, this community walks the talk. They preach the Lord's heart for justice and follow through with numerous justice programs as well as by responding to the immediate justice needs in our community. They preach the importance of diversity, and can boast incredible diversity not just in the congregation but also on the staff and in leadership roles. This diversity extends to age too. While there are many young adults, this is a community for families as well and people at any stage of life.

The community I found at Expression has truly been my village. When my husband (who I also met at E58!) and I were getting married on a budget, there were so many goods and services that we could not afford. SO many people from our E58 community stepped in to help and bless us when we needed it. This made our wedding both successful and unforgettable. Our community is strong and grounded, as well as amazing with accountability and advice.

Do not be mislead -- this church is made up of human beings and therefore is inherently imperfect. We of course deal with very human problems. But if you're looking for a perfect place filled with perfect holy people, I can guarantee that you will not find one. I am deeply grateful to be in a community that embraces difficulties and imperfections, and is constantly re-surrendering to the Lord's perfection.

Okay I'll end it there, even though I could say so much more. If you are searching, may the grace of the Lord bless you on your search. If you ever visit, come say hi!

name: Faith Baptist Church
Faith Baptist Church - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary:
We visited Faith Baptist Church a few years ago while visiting family in the area.
We were well pleased with the friendliness of the people and with the pastor's message. Amazing! Come and see for yourself what a Church of ACTIVE Faith looks like. The auditorium is full on Sunday morning, Sunday Night , and Wednesday evening . Then there’s an army of dedicated Christians of all ages who go out and spend their Saturdays to go spread the Gospel and invite people to come to Church and become a part of the family of God. And this has been going on every week, month and year for over 40+ years and never a Sunday missed. Come and See As a 87 year old retired military and law enforcement person, I have watched the Utube presentation of "let us pray" as well as many other negatives from a few with ongoing gripes.  These web site productions are full of flaws and half truths, and is doing a dishonoring of God's work.  Some need to take time to speak to God through his son Jesus and ask for his Holly spirit to give them peace and guidance for HOPE, FAITH, AND LOVE!

Watching the young people grow and develop a love of Christ and desires to serve our Lord and Savior is paramount in this church group. Numerous young people grew up here and are now preaching the gospel as adult ministers, as well as working in the mission field.

Those who are throwing stones must remember that God tells us to love our brothers and sisters in Christ, not judge them as that is his to do.  My prayers are with the church in its ongoing ministries and producing christian leaders for tomorrow.

May 31, 2025 I watched as ten Faith Baptist Academy high school seniors graduated from High School in preparation for their future.  Many are already committed to ministerial training in Bible School.  This is what this church excels at, winning young folks to Christ and mentoring them in their Christian life.  Let's think about the future of our young who hold our future in their hands as we await the return of our Lord and Savior.  For those who have a problem with recognizing these blessings, may I humbly suggest time on your knees in prayer.

May God continue to bless the Pastor and his flock of Christian people who are doing a great job in our community. Amazing church, the people are very welcoming and the teen department is spectacular. I’m very sad to write this, we were extremely excited to try a new church. My only reason for even writing a review is to further educate staff for misleading people. Last week I called, trying to get some info about the church. I explained I had a special needs child and if they are able to accommodate him and his needs. I was told they had a class for special needs kids and they had someone that could be one on one with him. Upon arrival Sunday we were greeted and everyone was extremely kind and welcoming (which I absolutely loved) we were being shown around and we arrive at the classroom for my son. This was a class with neurotypical kids that were seated so nicely, I said to them that this will not work for my son. He can be aggressive, and will not sit still for lesson in that way at all. They insisted we try, so we did. 3 min later they called asking us to remove him because he was hitting (which I tried to warn them) my husband goes to get our son and the teacher had my son ‘pinned’ to the window. Now I’m not saying it was in an aggressive way but it was clearly lack of experience with special needs children. This ruined my child’s day. Just 3-5 minutes of this. His day was in shambles. I’m upset that we were mislead on accommodation rather than being honest. I don’t expect everywhere to have a solution for my son. Which is why I’m trying to find a church that works for us. It was a waste of time. Please work on communicating to parents what to expect and what you can and cannot accommodate. There are many families with disabled and special needs children, so please..either work on communicating to families or consider opening a class room geared to special needs kids/teens/adults too.
Sad to say, we will not be back.
This review is not based on anything other than our experience. Everyone was very kind and welcoming. I wanted to share in case any other families with high needs children look into this church.

name: Faith Bible Church of San Bernardino
Faith Bible Church of San Bernardino - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary:
I decided to visit this church with my family in search of a well-grounded, non-political church filled with the Lord’s love. Sadly, I don’t understand why so many believe this church is truly grounded in the Lord when it seems to lack love for others. The messages often emphasize “submission to all government authorities” to justify their points, and typical Christian nationalist ideals are promoted within this church.

For those who claim it is grounded in the Lord, I encourage them to reexamine their outlook. Jesus is not a Republican or a Democrat, He transcends political affiliations. The only love this church seems to have is for themselves or for citizens who fit their mold, not for all of God’s children. The church, while perhaps well-intentioned, appeared devoid of genuine compassion and love for others. Last year I started attending this church. I have been looking for a Bible preaching and God honoring church for quite some time and found it here. It's congregation is small but growing. The fellowship of the believers is genuine. Jesus preached in scripture correctly, check. The worship not about self, check. The giving not about making the pastor rich, check. It's hard to find such a church in a sea of churches so I thank God I was led here! Welcoming congregation. Bible based study and not bounce around topical homilies. Simple and straight forward. Good Sunday school programs. Diverse population. Lots of introverts here, so no pressure to be outspoken or over the top. Music is both old and new. A number of fellowship opportunities. Pastor Scott Anderson is a humble and sincere man of God. I attended this church for about a year. During that time pastor Scott gave me Godly advice, he took of his personal time to counsel me on a one to one meeting a few times. You can grow here, the word preached is unadulterated and seeks to glorify God in our lives as we die to ourselves. I'm grateful and I bless pastor Scott's ministry and family.

-Angel M. I really enjoy it here, I had been searching for a church that I felt welcome and comfortable at and this is it. It's pretty small but the faith and the teachings are great. Everyone is very friendly and I recommend giving them a visit on sundays

name: Faith Center Church
Faith Center Church - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary:
I listen to Pastor Melissa Scott, M-Thurs., every week for the past 1-1/2 years. I have never heard the Bible taught the way she teaches. God has given her the gift of teaching. I think of her church, Faith Center, as the University of Faith and she, Melissa Scott, as my Professor. Attended 35 years ago and ignorantly began financial support of Dr. Scott's efforts to preach the gospel. I watched live as Faith Center owned KHOF went off the air for due to the fact that teaching was constantly held up on live TV until set amounts of money were donated from the audience before teaching would continue. KHOF was a UHF band broadcast TV station in Los Angeles. The FCC ended it.

2 weeks ago I discovered their social media stream, which is running 24/7 with a constant message of how important giving is as means to exercise faith and how dangerous backsliding can be. There are promises of 'meatier' messages at the facility, along with reminders of giving where you are being taught. None of the 'chat participants' knew proper English and I let 'them' know how obvious that was. After making adjustments and rebuilding their chat log several times over several days, the chat window still confirmed the obvious.

Access to services at this facility are by phone reservation only which is no surprise. Stay away from Faith Center. A very controversial assembly.  It’s sad they won’t let people walk the grounds.  That’s kind of a backwards mentality and perhaps that’s a symptom of why they had to discontinue their television ministry. Heck, even the Mormons even invite non Mormons to walk their temple grounds, what they consider to be their most sacred space.  My church also has security, but they’re in the shadows and not stalking folks.

As for the Scott’s:  They’re so intelligent that they’re weird.  Perhaps too much for their own good.  Doc used to draw a crowd with his unorthodox style of preaching.  A lot of good nuggets of truth though.

“Kill some Pissants for Jesus” is pretty cool though LOL. If you want to learn about God, Jesus Christ, and the Bible, then come and see. Pastor Scott’s teaching’s are straight out of God’s word which are all encouraging, thoughtful and edifying. Her teaching has inspired me to study more, but more importantly has helped me develop a closer relationship with God and Jesus. It’s all I ever wanted. II Timothy 2:15 thank you for teaching The Way

name: Faith Community Church
Faith Community Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
Such a sweet church community! If you're fatigued ad nauseum with the mega church scene, this family of tight knit believers is for you. I've been a member for almost three years now and haven't regretted a single day of it. The disconnected, country club/jesus points/dressed to the nines/I came to get free child care and coffee nonsense that is so pervasive and cancerous with giant churches in San Diego isn't a factor at Faith Community in the slightest. Having once been a devil worshiper and heavily in the occult, finding a church that totally accepted me, personally counseled me, is currently providing and helping for my wedding via premarital counseling and young engaged fellowship group, there's nothing more to be said concerning whether FCC "walks the walk". Never have I felt more appreciated and intimately cared for by any other religious organization. Not even close.
So if you're venturing to find a church whom's intent is to invest in you on a real, impactful level, this is for you. If you're just showing up to get a box checked and wear your Sunday best to parade around in so people notice you while getting some nebulous sense of moral satisfaction just by being physically present at a church building, I'm sure there are other places more suitable.
It's about the love of Jesus and how he can compassionately and breath takingly change your life for the better. No other elder board, pastors, mentors, A/V department, child care center can come within a hair of FCC. I would give 10 stars if I could. Sound doctrine, sound theology, and not a flashy, pretentious person to be found. Come on in for a visit and get your life changed. :) We love visiting when we are in Cali visiting our Son in the Marines.  Very welcoming group and always good message Probably my favorite Church to go to service and the people there are really great and friendly plus service starts a little later in the morning for those of you that aren't morning people The missionaries who live here are very kind, welcoming, and willing to engage people in discussions of faith and worldview.

name: Faith Community Church - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband and I have called Faith Community our home for over 25 years. We love this church family. The Word of God is taught faithfully and the people truly love one another. Although we are imperfect, our desire is to continually grow to become more like Christ. We visited Faith Community Church as we were visiting family in the area. We were in town from Edmonton, Alberta, Canada. Congregation at FCC were very friendly and welcoming. Great sermon. Absolutely love this church family! My wife and I have been members now for only 2 years, but it feels like we've been here all our lives. No gimmicks, no facades, no smoke and mirrors. Solid, Biblical teaching from series that are both topical and exegetical. Rotating worship bands with different leaders who all exceptionally lead the congregation through modern anthems and classic hymns. Great adult studies, small groups, children's ministries and youth program! Come check us out for a couple of weeks and see if this is where God would have you! The word is preached faithfully here, people love God and love one another well (imperfectly but with genuine care, concern, and desire to reflect Christ well).

The ministries that currently exist (2024) truly seek to magnify Jesus and see their participants know him better.  Children's ministry (CMD) is amazing!! The kids learn so much, are hiding God's word in their hearts, and growing in relationships with each other (we've had 7 of our 10 kids come through this ministry).

FSM, the jr and sr high youth ministries have not only fun activities for the youth, but solid teaching and small groups helping young people apply what they're learning.

Young adults ministry does our best to connect 18-30 year olds to each other through fellowship, teaching, worship, prayer, and to answer/ work through relevant issues in adulting as a believer in the 2020s.

Men's and women's ministries help connect men and women to midweek Bible studies, fellowship, and accountability.  Testimonies of God's faithfulness are shared and individuals grow more deeply in community.

Life groups, global Outreach, some truly amazing men and women in the Spanish ministry... if you've read this far you've picked up that I could go on...😉 ... music ministry, the audio/ visual team... there's so much being done and so much more to do... We are part of the classical conversations Community hosted at this church. It's a wonderful facility and we love our CC community! Anyone who is looking how to find a great Homeschool Group that focuses on education, character development, and growing your children as human beings, check out the CC groups here! There are three CC groups that meet at this church. They are not affiliated with the church. They are made up mostly of families who live in Santa Clarita and every campus has a Wonderful group. CC Community meetings are on Mondays, Thursdays and Fridays.

name: Family Church Downtown
Family Church Downtown - West Palm Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Super thankful to call these amazing family of God my church family!!! They have something for all ages and all stages of life at first it was a bit rocky but once I got to learn more about the foundation of the church and what they are about God really laid it on my heart to not only attend the church but to serve this amazing church and spread the gospel of Jesus to our neighbors and each part of the serving team whether it be on Sunday mornings or Thursday nights all come together as one and I would Highly recommend this church to everyone super Thankful and blessed for this church!! Let the record show: I am writing this review to inform, not to attack.

In June 2025, I reported a sexual assault by a member of Family Church Young Adults. From the beginning, my experience has been deeply disappointing. Instead of pastoral care, I was met with disbelief, spiritual manipulation, and attempts to silence me “for the sake of unity.” I was told that if I spoke out, I would be causing division in the body of Christ.

No one from leadership consistently walked alongside me, checked on my well-being, or provided meaningful protection (as they are trained and obligated to do). At one point, I was even pressured to meet face-to-face with my perpetrator to “hash things out” and “get to the bottom of the truth,” because “it was possible that I had misunderstood the whole situation.” This was neither safe nor biblical.

The church also allowed my perpetrator to attend our co-ed overnight Young Adults retreat, despite my expressed concerns and discomfort. When I continued to raise concerns and finally went public after three months of isolation, I was removed and banned from fellowship—told not to attend church gatherings at any Family Church location, or I would be trespassed and arrested on sight.

Leadership even attempted to criminally charge me for exercising my constitutional right to speak out online. Family Church went so far as to post police outside a Tuesday night Bible study. The West Palm Beach Police Department confirmed the church had no case against me. However, these extreme actions have now drawn further scrutiny and launched a larger investigation into the church’s handling of abuse.

Scripture is clear:
“Have nothing to do with the fruitless deeds of darkness, but rather expose them” (Ephesians 5:11). Unity is never built by covering sin; it is built on truth and accountability.

I am now working with law enforcement and legal counsel because what I experienced at Family Church was not only a failure of leadership but also potentially a violation of victim protection rights. This is not about one individual’s sin but about how leadership chooses to handle serious allegations.

If you are considering attending here, please know: churches should be safe places where victims are believed, protected, and shepherded with care. Sadly, that was not my experience at Family Church—nor has it been the experience of others, who are now coming forward because of my bold stance.

I pray they choose repentance, transparency, and true biblical accountability moving forward.
But until then, prospective members should ask: What are they hiding? And how many others have been silenced? Horrible experience 😪 I walked in wanting to hear the word of God not be judged for being homeless or treated as if I was trying to steal something or what she tell me we don't feed or hand out food ok I didn't ask for anything all I asked was how do I get inside and even then she acted like she didn't want me to go in whole time talking to me like I'm dumb just very judgemental yes I'm going thru a rough season and the only food I wanted was god's word. Anyways never going back there i feel worse than when I walked thru the door. I just moved to the area and tried this church out a couple of times. Though this church may not be for me, I encourage anyone who feels led to, to give it a try. This is just my perspective and my own personal experience, so please take my reasoning listed below with a grain of salt

Worship: The music team is so talented, but at times, it could feel more performance based geared toward streaming than a space for the congregation to truly engage with God. The volume and presentation (lots of lights )  sometimes distracted from the heart of worship. But we are living in different times and a lot of churches are like this nowadays, so it's understandable.

Community: The people are friendly and engaging! I did reach out twice via the website to see about a particular small group and see if spots were available, but i never heard back. It could be that the website isn't working properly, but i did receive emails from the church about other things, so maybe they were just really busy!!!

Financial Talk: I completely understand churches need to be transparent about giving, but there were moments when it felt like  financially heavy discussions, but it could have just been the theme for that service. (I went to this church 7 times)

Sermons: The teaching was biblical, but It could feel a little shallow. For example when addressing a message on temptation in corinthians, the example used was "eating too much ice cream" while entirely relatable it felt like the messages would often times avoid addressing deeper real life struggles with sin that adults may wrestle with. I was hoping for more substance and depth, but like I said, maybe it was an off service, too.

Political and personal focus: some services where the message centered around political figures instead of christ felt a little off to me while it's appropriate to talk about current events.  I can understand bring up some things especially in light of recent events, But often time the events felt cherry picked over which ones were actually relevant and it felt more like political commentary and the politization of Christianity.

I will say however  whoever gave the sermon last Sunday about the "main thing is the main thing:  was a phenomenal speaker.

Needless to say, im glad I tried this church out, I will be moving on, but I sincerely wish them the best of luck out there and encourage them to keep it up! Inspired messages with focus on family and children. Something for everyone! Great musicians!

name: Family Church Village

reviewSummary:
I would like to take a moment to express how truly welcoming this church is. From the moment you walk through the doors, you are greeted with kindness, warmth, and genuine care. The atmosphere is inviting, and it is clear that everyone is welcomed with open arms, no matter where they are in life.

The members of this church make you feel comfortable and valued, creating a sense of belonging that is rare and special. name: Family of Christ Lutheran Church and School
Family of Christ Lutheran Church and School - Tampa Palms Campus
reviewSummary: We are so happy our family found FOC and made it our church. We have enjoyed Worship w Pastor Landon and our kids love Sunday school. The church staff is so friendly and welcoming, and everyone makes you part of the family! Highly recommend to anyone looking for their church home. We love Family of Christ Church. We normally go to the contemporary service.  The church has plenty of activities for all ages and you can be as involved as you would like. Family Of Christ Lutheran Church is wounderful place! The pastor's and people who attended this church are wonderful and kind! They have children's programs for all ages. They also have programs for adults and senior citizens! My family has attended Family of Christ Lutheran Church since my eldest daughter was 4 years old she is now almost 12 years old!  So in total we have been coming here for 8 years! They also have a nursery to take care of infants and children ages up to 3 and a half 4 year olds go to Sunday school. Over the years it has changed a lot but the main focus is family and community! They serve homeless on Thursdays at 6pm. their services are Saturday 6pm and Sunday 9:15am and 10:45am they also do a Spanish service and have Tamil. As well as a West Campus. Also they have school from kindergarten through 8th grade and a child care center on the premises. My son has been a regular at Family of Christ after school care and summer program for 5 years now. Hands down the best child care I've ever found for my little one.

Faro Church Assemblies of God - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary:

name: Father's House OC Church
Father's House OC Church - Garden Grove Campus
reviewSummary: Approx 15 years ago I started to attend this church. I have NEVER been in a more accepting, and loving church as this one. The casual, open, and worshipful atmosphere is full of The Holy Spirit, and -the messages are relevant and quite moving. This place has the heart of God- check it out- you will be blessed and find it to be a homecoming. This church is amazing! I love all the people there and they make you feel like family! I knew after my first visit that I had found my home church! My kids love the children's ministry and I love to see their growth! Love. Life. Purpose. Learn of and experience the love of God through Jesus, celebrate the free gift of eternal life, and take that life into the world with an ordained purpose to love and bless others. That's what Father's House OC lives, teaches and celebrates with worship, fellowship, serving  and teaching in a graceful and loving family atmosphere. I've been a part of this beautiful community for over 15 years and I keep coming!  Join us!! I have always felt comfortable and safe at Father's House OC. As soon as you walk through the doors you are greeted with open arms and open minds. Pastor Tim and Pastor Matt are so gifted as pastors, speakers and worship leaders. This is my church home and my family! Visited while in town from St Louis and had a wonderful experience and encounter with the presence of the Lord. Worship was pure, not entertainment and the Senior Pastor oozed the love of the Father while ministering. Met the sweetest Jesus loving brothers and sisters in Christ. Highly recommend.

name: FCCHB
FCCHB - Huntington Beach (North) Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor Stephen Pate gives wonderful sermons. His enthusiasm, humor and ease in delivering God's message is refreshing. 2 years sgo, I left fcchb as I tired from the previous pastor whom resigned for other endeavors. I wish him well. Having attended fcchb for a few weeks now, I like fcchb's newness. Newly remodeled sanctuary and music sermon are very nice too. Blessings to fcchb.

I suggest next step volunteers that see new  people walk up to them and say hello and introduce themselves. Hello, I do not recognize you. Are you new to FCC? I sat in coffee area and do not know anyone. Just a thought. Not bad of a church. They can do better with more initiative rather do some work get connected. Sermon is good overall here with water & nice space. Typical experience for me even on application. My first time at their drive thru food bank. I am so impressed at how organized and amazing everyone is. Truly blessed and grateful for the  assistance and each person that volunteers.. thank you. I have been active at FCC since 2020.  In a time of growing division, they have kept the focus on Jesus and experiencing his grace and purpose.  FCC has many ways to get involved, grow your faith, and support the community.  I was new to my faith when i joined and always felt welcome.  I love this church and invite you to come check it out. I just love how our church really practices what it preaches. Loving kindness to all. I love how it gives back to the community in so many ways from our food pantry to our Nativity Christmas event and so much more. The Sunday messages are thought provoking and really push you to be more like Jesus. It has lots of ways to get involved and lots of stuff for kids young and old. Happy member for 15 years and 2 blossoming, public school educated, young adults walking in the Word.

reviewSummary:
This church is for sure the real thing when it comes to community, family and involvement!
From the amazing sermons to their fantastic coffee, their amazing welcoming team and super energetic kidz team!
My wife and I absolutely love the this church!
And our glad we made the move to OC to be apart of it! Absolutely incredible church! Could not ask for a more incredible welcoming team and Pastor. Super convenient parking. Amazing kids ministry. If you are looking for a vibrant, new, passionate church that also has great espresso coffee then this is the place for you! Incredible church! you’ll feel at home and most importantly the presence of God in every second of service. An added plus there is an incredible Kids area with loving and genuine teachers! If you’re looking for a community and friends this is the place for you! There’s so much going on in the week to be a part of be loved! I stumbled on a clip of Pastor Jeremy Johnson speaking on Instagram about identity and it was filled with so much truth and encouragement I decided to dig deeper into their vision. After just a few visits to the church and spending some time with the people, I can honestly say that this is a genuinely anointed group of loving people who are so focused on serving and loving people until people ask why.
