Rich, Dalisha, PJ and his wife, and the rest of the family at fearless are truly caring and pure men and women of God. No gimmicks, and no personal agendas. Just honest love for God and the people around them. It’s been great to find amazing friends to do life with the best way Such an amazing church! I went on Sunday and have never felt so welcomed. They had incredible worship and the message felt like it was just for me. They even have their own coffee shop. Can’t recommend enough, I’ll be back! 😊

name: Fellowship Baptist Church
Fellowship Baptist Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary:
I've only been here once, so far, but we were very impressed. Everyone was friendly and welcoming. The sermon was Christ based (most important) and easy to follow. We're looking for a church to call home and this seems to be the place! I found out about Fellowship Baptist Church after I had been researching online to find a solid, Biblically sound, home church for me and my family (I'm a single mom). I liked what I read (and the sermons that I heard) online and decided to visit. I was *not* disappointed! From day one everybody was so warm and friendly; the kids programs were GREAT. I never stopped going. I felt refreshed every time I left the service, and I always learned new things from the preaching. I loved the fact that the pastor wasn't afraid to talk about sin/ungodliness. It wasn't very long after I started going that I got to know Pastor Barrett, his wife Elizabeth and their kids. They're so down to earth, super-duper-approachable, and had a great sense of humor; all in all I found them to be caring people who love  The Lord. There's something to be said about a Pastor that's accessible; if you have an issue you can call him up or email him and he's always quick to respond. If you happen to be looking for a genuine, homely, *Baptist* Church I'd put FBC on the top of your list; you won't regret it.

I need to say something about the family of believers there, too. I went to FBC for several months before I decided that I wanted to officially join the Family there, but to tell you the truth I felt like I was a part of the FBC Family from my first visit. The people are so very loving and sacrificial with their time in helping everyone and anyone who needed it or wanted it. There are so many kind people willing to go out of their way to be a blessing. I'm not talking about a 'painted-face' type of Christianity, but a real genuine spirit of love and humility.

The Elders at FBC are amazing, they weren't critical or mean spirited but approachable and easy to talk to. At the same time, they (along w/the Pastor) provided strong leadership and stayed close to the scriptures as opposed to a lot of liberal entertainment driven churches.

Sadly the time came where I had to move out of state and unfortunately I could no longer attend FBC. I absolutely love my church family at Fellowship Baptist; I miss you all so much! We moved to Riverside in Jan 2002 and I did all kinds of research on different area churches, their doctrine, their mission, their history, etc.  My husband and I prayed for it to be super obvious which church God wanted us to be ministered in and the help minister too.  We ended up never checking out any other church.  It was so obvious that God wanted us here.  This church family has been such a blessing to our family all these years.  We have an awesome group of imperfect people who love Jesus and trust him as our Lord King and Savior.  We believe that God is ROYALTY, the most high king, creator of all.  Therefore, God has every right to be in charge, not us.  However, we REBELLED and are still rebelling, wanting our own selfish ways.  We needed to be RESCUED from our own destruction, which that RESCUER was Jesus Christ, who died in our place when we really deserved the punishment .  But He didn't stay dead because only He has the power over the grave and Jesus ROSE AGAIN (was RESURRECTED).  Knowing that information, you have a RESPONSIBILITY to RESPOND.  Either your reject the truth or accept it.  PIlate asked Jesus "What is truth?"  when truth was staring him in the face and he didn't even recognize it.  I hope that you realize what truth is and I hope to see you here!

P. S. - I was here when Joe was attending.  He seemed to be harboring anger and guilt from his last church that he forced a pastor to counsel a couple who was having problems, even though they didn't ask for his help and then blamed the pastor for their divorce and then tried to claim that the pastor was wrong getting paid for a book he wrote instead of donating it to the church, among so many other things, yet he can be a CPA and get paid for his work.  Very hypocritical!  His friend invited him to our church thinking that Joe had matured.  He was a great children's teacher, so I was told.  However, to be part of our ministry and use your God given talents, you must be a member.  He DESPISED that word and said membership is a cult and all other kinds of things that are said out of anger instead of love.  He claimed there is nowhere in the Bible that says the early Christian church had a membership.  The Bible also never uses the word Trinity but that doesn't mean it's not implied.  However, "we are all MEMBERS of one body" (1 Cor 12:12 & 20-22).  We are all to love our brothers and sisters in Christ.  Joe was NEVER forced to try to be a member, he just had to be a member to minister.  I can never agree with someone who's goal is to tear down a church congregation because they don't agree with his point of view.  We are to be encouragers to each other.  His family was.  Unfortunately HE was not.  He was encouraged to find a church that his family as a whole, including him, could minister.  However, that was not good enough for him.  Toward the end, his nature was sadly so angry I could barely recognize him as a follower of Christ.  I wish Joe and his family no ill will but facts are facts: This church family LOVED him but when there is a cancer you have to cut it out and purposely driving over here constantly to cause discord among fellow believers is wrong.  Joe, I still pray for you and your family.  I hope you found a church that let anyone just plug in without vetting them and caring about their congregation as a whole..  But the Bible is very clear about membership, appointing, elders, deacons, deaconesses, etc.  He and his friends that left with him could've allowed God to use their talents here but unforgiveness and anger do not a good leader make. WENT FOR A SHORT TIME AND FOUND OUT THEY TRY TO FORCE YOU INTO MEMBERSHIP VERY QUICKLY AND ARE VERY AUTHOITARIAN AND FOUND OUT THEY BELIEVE THAT IF YOU DO NOT BECOME A MEMBER YOU ARE NOT SAVED. EVEN THOUGH THEY HAVE BAPTIST IN THE NAME THE REALITY IS IT IS VERY UNBALANCED TOWARDS LEGALISM AND LEANING TO CULT LIKE BEHAVIOR. PLEASE SAVE YOUR SOUL AND SHAKE OFF THE DUST FROM YOUR SANDALS EVEN BEFORE YOU TRY IT. A SPLIT IS HAPPENING SOON! Fantastic place! Very Biblically sound, gospel centered, full of great and loving people!

name: Fellowship Of Believers Church
Fellowship Of Believers Church - Sarasota Campus
reviewSummary:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Fellowship of Believers Church is a truly welcoming and Christ-centered church. The teaching is biblical, heartfelt, and practical, making it easy to apply God’s Word to everyday life. The worship is uplifting, and the sense of community is genuine—you feel like family from the moment you walk in. The pastors and members clearly love the Lord and care deeply for people. If you’re looking for a church that teaches truth, loves well, and lives out the Gospel, Fellowship of Believers Church is a wonderful place to call home. ✝️ Fellowship of Believers Church is truly a place where the presence of God is felt the moment you walk through the doors. The worship is powerful, the preaching is filled with truth and the Holy Spirit, and the atmosphere is full of genuine love, faith, and unity. This is not just another church service — it’s a place where lives are transformed, hearts are healed, and people are drawn closer to Jesus. You can tell this ministry is led with sincerity, passion, and a deep desire to glorify God. I’m incredibly thankful for this church family and highly recommend it to anyone hungry for a real encounter with God. Vibrant church with great music, a desire to honor God, and LOTS of of young families. Rather than a strict 1-hour service, they relax in God's Presence and give opportunity for anyone in the congregation to say what they're hearing/experiencing. Very unique and refreshing. The sermon was very good, delivered in a very non-preachy way. My wife, son and I are very thankful to have found Fellowship of Believers. I personally have encountered more of His Holy Spirit and am seeing transformation, becoming closer with my Lord Christ Jesus since attending. Everyone that we have met has been genuine, lovely people. They have a great children's ministry. They have been around for many years and have NO DEBT (praise God)! The pastors are being led by the Holy Spirit and there is a unique framework of accountability whereas the leadership is comprised of three God-fearing married couples leading the direction of the church. I appreciate this compared to other churches, whereas one person may have too much power and influence, they are all being held accountable according to His Word and Holy Spirit. Fellowship of Believers freely worships but is also very rooted in scripture, which I also value, while also practicing the gifts of the spirit without being off-putting, that uplift others. I also very much love that church service may be different every Sunday, being several hours long or shorter, it depends on what His leadings are. There is also just one service, so you have the opportunity to meet everyone when you attend. Church should be this way and not a formula. Full stop. Perhaps most importantly, there are many multigenerational families that attend here, which is a great blessing to be around to see such true wealth (thriving families) especially coming from a broken family and choosing to break generational bondage and seeking to emulate this within my own growing family. We are so thankful to be a part of Fellowship of Believers and hope God can use us to make a difference for His kingdom here. The morning service is usually from 10 a.m., but people come in advance, chat, talk, get acquainted, drink coffee, you have a very friendly, hospitable atmosphere. I really like the unofficial, free, homely atmosphere in this place and good, friendly and kind people of different ages. There is a continuity of generations and there is no spirit of legalism in the ministry, you can pray and go ahead, even to children who praise Jesus during the glorification. If someone has a need, a minister, spiritual guardians and worshippers approach them, they are offered to pray together without coercion, and the Holy Spirit always acts in different ways, not according to the template. There is a very good children's service. I would also like to have a translation into Spanish, Russian or Ukrainian.
Thank God for you!

reviewSummary:
Firepoint is a non-denominational Christian church. It is a very friendly, open place and is very community-minded. I've found that it's a great place to find friends and teaching that will help you get through the many challenges in life.

There is a Sunday morning service at 10am that is currently held in a beautiful setting at the Angeles National Golf Course banquet hall at the entrance to Big Tujunga Canyon. It's used for a great many weddings and you'll see why. The scenery is fantastic!  The dress is casual. Normally the services run about 100 people and they usually go from 10 to 11:30. There is childcare right in the adjacent room. It usually has about 20 kids and is handled by help that have been vetted through background checks. After the service you can get prayer and many people have been healed. There are quite a few extraordinary stories of miracles happening at this church so if you're in need of one, you might want to pay a visit and get some prayer.

Also, outside of the Sunday service, there are a number of other groups and gatherings and special events that are going on all the time in people's homes and at other venues. They publish a bulletin and they also announce everything on Sunday. Plus, they have updates on Facebook, YouTube and the website so you can just use your favorite platform to catch up on everything.

I think this is well worth your time to visit Firepoint.

reviewSummary: I’ve had nothing but positive experiences with this church. I feel very welcomed by the staff and congregation, and they treat every newcomer as part of the family. I often come and sing with the church choir, and the choral and instrumental music is always varied and engaging. The church itself is expansive and beautiful, with a spacious sanctuary and side chapel, as well as areas for events. If you’re looking for a new church to call home, you’ve found it. Joined this church in 2018 and attended for an entire year, giving of my time, energies, and excessive money in service. In the very beginning I experienced snide remarks by other members, and even refusal to shake my hand from another member, condescending treatment by the secretary, rudeness and shunning by the family members of the choir director, who never participated in any other planned activities or events except choir, and the ABSOLUTE WORST - a clique environment created by the "first lady" where, if one was accepted into the clique, apparently good for them, but if not accepted, all shunning, scorn and wrath was rendered onto the one who was not accepted in..I am one of the latter category. There was an obvious personality problem as this woman made blatant statements to a room full  in her short-lived ladies class such as "I don't care if any of you like me...I have the Lord and Bella...that's all I need" (Didn't even include her husband, the pastor) And " If any of you think by being married to the pastor, it has 'rubbed off' on me, you're wrong."  ZERO reason from anyone in the room to deserve that kind of intimidation, but it happened in all sorts of scenarios on a regular basis. I experienced bizarre things like her grabbing a plate out of my hands at a luncheon, impatiently shouting at me "WHAT IS IT YOU WANT???" when I was making a decision of foods I wanted from the luncheon table, and numerous other outbursts and childish behavior. She even made condescending comments about my accessories such as handbags as if it were indignant jealousy. I finally ceased attending services, and as a retaliation toward me after I explained to the pastor in a heartfelt email why I was no longer in attendance, he conducted a bait-and-switch campaign to get me to submit an application for one of the duplex rentals   the church oversees, (I had sold my house several months prior and began inquiring with interest to lease one of the properties). It became full circle when I was denied the apartment, and now I am convinced it was the pastor's wife that demanded the duplex not be rented to me from the very first time I expressed interest. (Believe me, there were a number of clues along the way; I simply tried to give the benefit of the doubt, and tried to dismiss them) I further believe that anyone unfortunate enough to believe the charade that goes on consistently at this beautiful old building is in for a complete and utter shock...that is, unless.  one happens to become accepted into the clique that is thriving, alive and well within the walls. The recent post of the person indicating there're a lot of "SHADY PEOPLE THAT WORK HERE" and "THEY ARE THE "EXACT OPPOSITE" of who they portray themselves to be...is hauntingly correct and right on. I don't know who this reviewer is, but I trust every word conveyed, because I am personal witness to it, as well. As Jesus warned...there will be FALSE PROPHETS, and my eyes are opened to that prolific reality. this is a lovely church with a beautiful sanctuary, kind and knowledgeable staff, and a particularly wonderful music program! name: First Baptist Church of Pasadena

reviewSummary:
I went there on Easter with my son and his fiance. We started with a brunch, an assortment of scrumptious food brought in by parishioners. We were accompanied by a mariachi band. What a wonderful idea. Celebrating the resurrection of Christ with the happiest music on earth. The pastors were all available and mingled with us before the service. What a wonderful church, people and pastoral staff! FBC is truly special and unique. I came here on my search for churches to be married at. My mom said my great grandma was a member of the church and she remembered it being really beautiful, so I was curious and thought it would be a sentimental touch to my wedding. Mom was right. The church was a bit more contemporary on the outside than I was looking for (I like the old gothic look), but looks can be deceiving!! The inside was just gorgeous!! There is a large gated patio with a water fountain that leads you to the side entrance. The main entrance is breathtaking. There are 2 parallel runways lined with a red carpet leading up to the altar. The windows are all beautiful stained glass windows letting in colorful light. There are giant iron chandeliers and a massive organ and cross at the altar. Needless to say, THIS was it! I met with Marcie and then Cindie the wedding coordinator. Let me say, these 2 ladies are simply angels. They both were so incredibly patient, kind, understanding and helpful every step of the way. I went multiple times prior to the wedding and we emailed and texted often. Again, they are truly angels and I felt so blessed to have them for this process. Words cannot express my gratitude. My wedding was not typical, and I was happy to know that the church was accepting of my non-traditional dress color, my very tattooed bridesmaid and our use of a reverend who was our dear friend marrying us. Our wedding was very challenging, not because of the church, but because of Covid, my hair stylist gone rogue and a venue that was in constant crisis. I felt like everything was going wrong, and many times when I would be upset, the only comfort I had was the church, Cindie and Marcie. I would like to also mention Paul who is INCREDIBLY talented!! He is their musician and can play everything from the organ, to the piano and harp. I told him what songs we wanted-again, none of which are traditional-and he played it all perfectly!! The ceremony was my favorite part of the day and I will cherish that part of our wedding always.  If you are thinking of having your wedding here-DO IT!! The First Baptist Church of Pasadena is a beautiful historical structure. The facilities and grounds look very well taken care of. The Sanctuary is gorgeous, it's close to City hall and within walking distance of many hotels in the Old Town area of Pasadena. First Baptist Church of Pasadena is an elegant, beautiful, spiritual church that I go to attend classical concerts ! Lovely pastor. Great God inspired scripture based teachings. Friendly and diverse (ages, races, schools of thought) congregation. Worship music is very approachable mix of contemporary with some traditional roots.

You'll be hard pressed to find a better church. Oh and the building itself is beautiful too.

First Baptist Church-Pompano - Pompano Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
The friendliest church I have ever attended! So proud to now be a member of this church family! Decided to visit for the first time. Checked the website, said service is at 9:30. Left from Deerfield at 9:00 to get there on time. Arrived at 9:30
To an empty parking lot only to be told by the parking attendant they moved church to 10:30. I guess they didn't care or feel the need to change it.on their website. Thanks for nothing. I am sure the church is great it's the big guy that's works that at night me and my husband were walking by the gate around 7 o'clock walking out dog and she love looking for bugs lizards and this guy comes walking up on the other side saying things to intise a problem so my husband responds back to him the same way and this guy threatened us with violence and were just walking by and he gets aggressive saying he been to prison 20 years even followed us half way to our car I think the people you allow to work there need to be better cause that was out of control and he is not letting this go that  guy should be working around any one of public he tries to fight my husband right in front of the church I will start with the fact that pastor Adam is great. He met me in the prayer room as I was new to religion and made me feel Welcomed.
He invited me back and said that I can come into the prayer room anytime they were open AS LONG AS I was let in and given permission.

Couple months later I walk in because I was going through a mental melt down and headed straight to the Church. Walked in the same door after getting buzzed in. I asked the Lady at the desk if I may use the prayer room. She said go ahead and smiled.

20 minutes later a Paster that I didn't grab a name for but was an older gentleman walked in and asked if he could help me with something. I said 'no but thank you so much". To which he replied with "We don't just let anybody come in here and be on the couch" and then asked me to leave.  Mind you I was holding the Bible to my chest and crying.

By the look on his face and demeaning tone. He clearly wanted me out. I then said to him that I was invited back anytime by Pastor Adam and that I was given permission by the lady at the desk to come in. At that point he started apologizing but the damage was already done. I said it's ok I'll leave and he tried to walk after me mend the uncomfortable encounter that he created. I left and told him thank you so much. I WOULD NOT recommend this place at all. How could you be so unkind to some in such a fragile state.

I could have accepted his apology but I was so overwhelmed by the situation that I just wanted to leave. Besides why would someone want to stay at a place of worship after being kicked out and receiving a half apology ONLY because I said Adams name. Had I NOT how would the conversation have gone?

Sometimes it's not what you say but how you say it. Especially coming from a pastor and you being in such an emotional state. Good bible based church with alot of activities and groups.

reviewSummary: This church is open and affirming, meaning that it welcomes people of all backgrounds and identities, including those from the LGBTQ+ community. I attended a Burbank Community Band Halloween Concert here. They are fantastic!! It is great that the Church supports the community in this way. So fun. Such talented people. Check out the website God bless

Grateful to have experienced such a sincere and uplifting service. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a place that feels real and rooted in purpose. They host a service in Ukrainian language every Sunday at 12:30.

4 stars just cz the service is too long

Pastor Mike is excellent and compassionate in every sermon. All the people are so friendly. You are always greeted with a  smile, which is perfect to start any day. If you are looking for a new church I highly recommend  First Christian Church of Cleatwater. We are celebrating  100 years in April. Please come visit and see for yourself. Love God, Love people. Sounds simple, but it is rare to find. Be doers, not just hearers - also rare. Transparency from the heart, adhering to the Word with authenticity, and solid, confident wisdom is what you get with Pastor Mike. That forms 'trickle down' discipleship and shows tremendously in the Body here. It is the definition of leadership toward Christ. My wife and I have grown much in tangible faith here. We welcome all people to come in and be comfortable in your skin......straight, gay, it matters not! We had our wedding ceremony at First Christian Church and had a great experience. Sheri and Pastor Tracy were a pleasure to work with. They were responsive and worked with us to meet all our needs.  I would recommend First Christian Church if you want to get married in an open and accepting church that does not feel stuffy with classic traditions. they SERVE GOD & HELP HIS OTHER CHILDREN

name: First Christian Church - Fort Myers Campus
reviewSummary:
My family and I have been attending FCC for some time now, and I can honestly say it’s become a place we truly consider home. From the moment we walked through the doors, we felt welcomed and embraced by everyone. What stands out the most about FCC is the sense of community—it’s not just a church, it’s a family.

We’ve made so many meaningful friendships here, and the connections we’ve formed have been a huge blessing. The people here genuinely care for each other, and it’s clear that the church’s leadership is committed to fostering an environment where everyone feels like they belong. Whether it's through small group gatherings, Sunday services, or church events, there are always opportunities to build relationships and grow spiritually alongside others.

Our kids have also flourished in the children's ministry. It’s not just childcare; they’re learning and growing in their faith, and they love going to church every week. The youth program is active and engaging, which gives our teenagers a place to connect and grow in their own faith journey too.

We feel incredibly blessed to be part of First Christian Church. It’s more than just a place of worship—it’s a community where we’ve grown spiritually, made lifelong friends, and found a sense of belonging! Very welcoming & friendly brothers & sister of God. I joined under Pastor Gary who welcomed me whole heatedly to FCC. I pray God richly bless the FCC family now & forever I had an uplifting Sunday morning at First Christian Church! The spacious setting was perfect for the powerful message from Pastor Jimmy Akers. He spoke about King David and how, from his rooftop, he saw Bathsheba and made a costly mistake. “The Lord sees the heart” (1 Samuel 16:7) was a key takeaway, reminding us that God’s perspective is different from ours. The service was a great reminder to stay humble and seek God’s guidance in all things. Highly recommend a visit for anyone looking for insightful teaching and a welcoming atmosphere! :) When I came to FCC, I had a good bit of church hurt I brought with me. My faith in Jesus never wavered, but my love for the ministry of the Church had been damaged.

I see now that God has used this church and community to patch up that hurt I experienced. The staff truly support one other and the congregation through good times and bad. I feel that my soul is cared for, and I know that on bad days, people will be there to pray with me and uplift me out of the mire.

I couldn’t ask for a better place to call home in Fort Myers and I’m glad that this church has embraced me! Good worship, solid biblical message, great demographics. Seems like a healthy church!

name: First Christian Church - Fullerton (Sunny Hills) Campus
reviewSummary:
EDIT as of 2025: We no longer attend this church. While it is a fine space for white gay people, we did not find them receptive to our conecerns about POCs feeling underrepresented and listened to. The pastor of this church, whom we had a six-year relationship with, met us with defensiveness rather than concern and understanding. We cannot in good faith recommend this church to any POC.

--
My partner and I found this church after we were kicked out of our former church for being gay. This church actually MEANS what they say about welcoming, loving, and fully including EVERYONE. Yes, this means affirming gay people in the church- in leadership and all positions- and not treating them like second class citizens. Pastor Mandye's messages are deep and often cover important social justice issues in our world today. This church also commits to helping our local community in Fullerton. This church is everything a church SHOULD be and puts their time, effort, and money into helping rather than keeping up with "appearances" like some of those other "hip" churches that don't practice what they preach!

If you have been hurt by the church or have religious trauma- this is a safe place of healing for you This is a loving and gracious church!  The first time I visited, I had many people come up and welcome me but no one ever pressured me to join. The congregation is kind and giving - it does feel like a "church family".  Pastor Mandye is open-minded, listens and reminds us that our service goes outside of the church walls.
It is wonderful to belong to a church that accepts and welcomes everyone regardless of race, housing situation or sexual orientation. The Outreach Ministry is very active in the community, from offering quarters to people at the laundromat to supporting a soup kitchen at a neighboring church. There is also an arm of the church (Week of Compassion) where you can donate to any cause or disaster and 100% of your donation goes to the cause.  (The charity is supported by a substantial endowment.).
There is no particular dress code, they sing praise songs and they sing hymns. The atmosphere is comfortable and loving...just as Jesus would want!  I'm so happy I found this church! I was looking for a local church where I can worship, learn, connect, contribute and serve people in our community.  I was intrigued when I'd seen this church feed the homeless.

After checking out the website, I called Pastor Mandye to arrange an appointment to chat about what she believes, what she teaches and how the congregation works together outside the Sunday Experience.  She spent dedicated, focused time with me and arranged for me to meet other parents in a similar situation.

After a bit of previous "church trauma" it was difficult for me to enter a church building again. I was warmly welcomed by so many people and invited to participate in the choir and the Outreach Committee.  I'm learning, worshiping, serving and have new friends!

Pastor Mandye has a heart for truly including everyone and for social justice. I've found that Pastor Mandye and the people of this church "walk the walk" of including all, by welcoming, inviting people to join in and even electing a variety of folks to leadership positions.

This has been my church "home" for over a year.  I invite anyone seeking a loving church community to come and experience what I have. I am hearing worse and worse stories about how this church treats the public. The first thing that popped up was an auditor recording in front of this place on the sidewalk and these folks demanding to know their biz. Entitlement is not a good look, do better FCC. I go to the feed for the hungry on Wednesdays here and everytime i go i get harassed by the volunteers because the fact that I'm in my twenties and not homeless but i am hungry and in need. They judge me for the way i look not taking in to account that im in a financial rut with no money to feed my self or to buy my self clothes. I love going  dont get me wrong but sometimes its my only meal of the week. If the volunteers are really doing this for God they need to look at themselves and stop judging people for the way they look.

name: First Christian Church of Fort Lauderdale

reviewSummary:
The First Christian Church of Ft Lauderdale was started by Maude Bollinger and Ruth Repp who offered Sunday school classes on Repp's front porch to the Ft Lauderdale community which was only 143 people at that time. Church services were held at several locations in Ft. Lauderdale including the old Fort Lauderdale Sentinel building.

In 1925, a benefactor donated land for a church at the corner of Southeast 13th Street and Southeast Third Avenue on the site of a former rock pit. Lumber to build the church arrived on Sept. 16, 1926. The very next day the Hurricane of 1926 destroyed the church records, lumber, the tent they were working out of, and all of their equipment. Two children and two adult members of the congregation lost their lives. The church rose from this devastating loss and completed the church building in 1927. A later expanded building incorporates the original church structure.

I love a historic church and I was able to check out First Christian Church of Ft Lauderdale during a tag sale. They held the sale in their basement! I was amazed that there was a building with an actual basement in South Florida. The congregation was so warm and welcoming and I got invited to church service by Katherine. This church is gorgeous and you can feel the history within its walls. Church services are held every Sunday at 10:45. everytime my family is down here we love to go to this church. Great vibes. Great teaching Wednesday night bible study at 8pm is awesome! If I lived in Fort Lauderdale I would be attending this church. Old school Pastor who also serves on the worship team (as I do) and loves Jesus. Loved the stained glass windows and the word and the anointed. If we move here, this is out church where I will help find someone for video!

Phil
Jesus Lives This is, as I understand it, the second oldest continually operating church in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. It was founded in 1911 and continues today as a place where people from all walks of life worship God.

Although the church was once a formal member of the Disciples of Christ denomination, it has been an independent, non-denominational church for the last fifteen years or more. It is organized in the same manner as the churches in the Book of Acts and is elder led.

There is a sweet spirit among its congregation and, upon entering, you can feel the love of God. The multi-ethnic, international membership is a picture of South Florida. What sets them apart is their joyful, loving praise of Jesus Christ.

Sunday School starts at 9:30 a.m. and the church service follows at 10:45 a.m. with a live band leading praise and worship, a sermon from God's Word and communion. After the service, everyone retires to the basement Fellowship Hall for coffee and fellowship. It's a great opportunity to meet your fellow Christians and experience the move of God's Holy Spirit!

Come and join us. Let us worship the Lord, our God, together.

name: First Lutheran Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
Founded in 1892, Historic First Lutheran is one of the oldest churches in Pasadena. It is also the San Gabriel Valley's oldest Lutheran congregation. The church building itself is over 75 years old and is designated a Pasadena City Landmark.
Through the churches which Historic First Lutheran founded, all other Lutheran Churches in Los Angeles and San Bernardino Counties have been started, making Historic First Lutheran the Mother/Grandmother/Great-Grandmother church of those counties.

The church is an excellent example of Mission Revival style architecture. The Church has obviously taken pride in the building and maintained the exterior appearances intact. The following features of the church are characteristic of the Mission Revival style: stucco walls, gable roofs covered with clay tiles, arcades with segmental arches, corner bell tower, balconets and iron railings on the tower, molded front entry surround, and deeply recessed windows.

Frederick Kennedy, Jr. and David Ogilvie were architects whose designs made significant contributions to the architectural heritage of Pasadena.

Frederick Kennedy designed several other major churches in Pasadena, including the Throop Memorial (300 S. Los Robles), First Baptist (with Carlton M. Winslow at 75 N. Marengo), Trinity Lutheran Church (with Quintin and Kerr at 997 E. Walnut), and Third Church of Christ Scientist (2801 E. Colorado, for which he received a California Honor Award). His commercial buildings include the seven-story Pasadena Furniture Co. Building (with Curlett and Beelman on Colorado Blvd. east of Oakland; now demolished), three auto showrooms in the 300 block of W. Colorado Blvd. (NR), and the Fish Building at 24-28 E. Colorado (NR contributor in Old Pasadena). Institutional projects include two Mayfield School buildings and the American Legion Building on N. Marengo (with Ed Maybury). In addition, his designs for houses in Pasadena were often featured in newspaper articles. His expertise in school buildings led to designs for Santa Paula High School, Baldwin Park High School, Mt. Sac Junior College, and four buildings at the University of La Verne, all designs that received California Honor Awards.

City records identify nearly 15 houses in the Pasadena area designed by David Ogilvie, most of them being large houses in the southern part of the city. His South Pasadena home at 2000 Ashbourne Drive won the second place prize in a national competition for the use of brick in homes. A commercial project of his is located at the northwest corner of Green and Madison (new site of Culinary Arts School) in the NR Playhouse District. His design for the Pasadena Golf Club’s Clubhouse in Altadena received numerous mentions in newspapers in the late 1920s.

The Church is the best local example of Mission Revival design in this property type.

reviewSummary:
Our experience with First United Methodist Church Preschool has truly exceeded our expectations. The program offers wonderful enrichment opportunities that are thoughtfully integrated into the curriculum, making each day engaging and meaningful. It’s clear that a lot of care has gone into designing a well-rounded experience for the children. Our daughter even asks to go on the weekends!

The staff consistently go above and beyond, creating a warm, nurturing environment where children can thrive. We couldn’t be happier with our experience and highly recommend this preschool. We couldn’t be happier with our experience at First United Methodist Preschool of Santa Monica. The teachers are incredibly caring, attentive, and genuinely invested in each child’s growth. The environment feels warm, safe, and thoughtfully structured, and it’s clear how much effort goes into creating a positive experience for both kids and families.

Our daughter looks forward to going every day, which says everything. We’ve seen meaningful development not just academically, but socially and emotionally as well.

We truly can’t recommend this school enough. We couldn’t be happier with First UMC preschool. It’s an incredibly nurturing, supportive environment with fantastic directors, teachers, and strong values.

It also has the BEST hours—an 11-month schedule—and they serve delicious lunch and snacks each day. It’s an incredibly convenient setup for working families.

The yard alone sets it apart—easily the best in Los Angeles (and I’ve looked at just about every preschool). The enrichment is also outstanding.

The community is wonderful—engaged, down-to-earth families that we feel lucky to be a part of. Our child is genuinely happy there, and it shows every day. This is a phenomenal school environment for the little ones! We have been so impressed by the leadership of Dane and Johanna. The classrooms are interactive, organized, colorful and engaging for the kids. They are truly focused on cultivating a safe, loving and nurturing place to raise children into caring adults. Highly recommend this vibrant school community!

reviewSummary:
This "All Are Welcome" church fulfills all my spiritual needs. The preaching is always Biblical and aligns my heart, soul, and mind. The option of attending a traditional or a contemporary style service is also welcoming.

But wait. There's more!

I'm a music guy and the 5 music ensembles and amazing musicians add even more energy every Sunday. Additionally the robust Concert Series is a delight. There are also discipleship courses and a dozen Life Groups to encourage deeper relationships and fellowship for all ages and stages of life. Scholarships are available for Summer Camps grades 3-12.

Who could ask for anything more?

The atmosphere is incredibly friendly and welcoming, and I’ve always felt accepted, even as a visitor. The sermons are short, concise, and meaningful, and the worship team is truly wonderful.
Oh—and the food! That’s just the icing on the cake.
If you’re looking for a new church home, definitely give FUMC a try. You won’t be disappointed! I absolutely love my church, First United Methodist of Chula Vista! The traditional and contemporary services are both inspiring, and the preaching and music are  exceptional.  There are 2 adult choirs, a children's choir and a Praise Band that includes some of our talented youth. There are Life Groups, Discipleship classes, Women's Fellowship and a Men's group.  Activities for children include an active Children's Ministry program and busy youth group.  We invite our pre-School families to participate in community events like Vacation Bible School, Trunk or Treat, and a yearly Easter Egg Hunt Celebration. The church sends lots of children and youth to summer camps, and a large number of our congregation travel to Ensenada every January to build homes for needy families.  FUMCCV offers something for everybody.  It is a special place where you can grow in your faith and where everyone is welcome! My family and I have been worshipping here for many years. We were looking for a church that was welcoming, had childrens ministries and good sermons on how to be more Christlike. We found this and a whole lot more. We quickly became part of the First United Methodist family by helping to build a house in Ensenada. On that trip we made amazing friendships rooted in our Christian faith and passion to help others in needs.  We attend the contemporary service at 11am which has an amazing crossing band and is in the fellowship hall which is a little more informal. There is also a more traditional service at 9:30 in the church that has an amazing choir. I highly recommend First United Methodist Church to anyone looking for a place to worship where ALL are welcome! FUMCCV has been my family's home church for over 20 years. This is a church community that year after year, continues to teach us the love of Jesus; to lift up the other, to value the forgotten, to love our neighbor, and to care for the least and the lonely. Come and join us in worship.

name: First United Methodist Church of North Hollywood
First United Methodist Church of North Hollywood - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary:
Friendly people worshipping Jesus. It has an early 20th century feel in architecture, but a very welcoming, diversified 21st century vibe. Impressed with the church interior and wedding arrangement. My Grandparents belonged to the church that began before it was built. My Grandfather helped to build this church and attended and served in it from the 1st day when Dr. Boyer began preaching there. My grandmother was head of the Prayer chain and dialed thousands of numbers on a rotery phone asking for prayers. My parents were married Here. My grandparents memorial services were here. I attended until I was 40 and only stopped because my Grandfather had passed in 2002 at 89 yrs of age and my Grandmother passed in 2008 at age 91 and I had moved out of state. I love this church and am so glad it is still so well loved and attended!
I'm only saddened to see that it's diverted away from scripture to not uphold God's plan and commandments of Love while not supporting distortions of Gender and sexuality. reviewSummary: It is a beautiful church, imbued with a spiritual energy that makes you feel safe. The people there are kind, and the Sunday service possesses a beautiful sense of sanctity. Everyone is welcome here. I made a stop at this location in order to place a request for "Meals on Wheels ". Very kind and loving staff. Extremely helpful. Patti, was very nice to answer my inquiries and very helpful. Yesterday, the youth at our church,  First United Methodist in Pasadena, came out and painted anti-graffiti paint on the mural that are nonprofit commissioned to depict the history of the Once thriving African-American Business district on North fair Oaks.  Was a joy to see them work so hard and have fun.  I love this church. I felt very loved and supported in our housing justice work we do.  People are genuine and real and totally committed to serving the community and beautiful ways.  Pastor Amy  really understands grace and how to love and fully accept people. We are all on a journey to follow the command that the Apostle Paul in the Bible gave us to accept one another  even as Christ has accepted us.  I feel that in this church. Love the interior decor of the church. They have amazing Organ and colorful stained glass. The ceiling is so pretty. The acoustic is wonderful. Even though it doesn't have air-conditioning, but it's wonderful architecture! It is lucky for me to have the chance to perform with a Choir in this famous church with long history. Very sacred and beautiful place to sing the song for Glory of the God and I really enjoy it.

name: First United Methodist Church of San Diego
First United Methodist Church of San Diego - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
If you would have told my younger self who gave up on the Catholic Church, all churches AND God that we’d become a member of a new church, I would have laughed and continue my self-destructive behaviors to prove that there is no God.

Sounds dramatic right? But 100% true. Until something in my heart started to call out for something greater than myself. That call led me here to this church. There’s so many things that I didn’t like about religion, church and what was being fed to us. But, this place spoke to me.

This IS a reconciling congregation and I love that. I love how the pastors are women from different ethnicities. I love how they unapologetically connect scripture to the world we live in today. I love how there’s traditional service with choir and organ music but if you’re uncomfortable with that, the church also has a contemplative way of worship. The organist and choir has my head bobbing to all the notes lol. I love that they integrate technology in a way that I’ve never experienced at another church including a podcast! I love that there’s many ministries and different ways to be of service. All to say, I love church, I love God and I love the spiritual journey I’m on.

At the end of the day, it’s up to you to come and decided if this church is a good fit. To really experience and take it all in. Not what these reviews say, including my own, not what your family or friends say, but you and only you. Centrally located Church in Mission Valley. Off I-8,  Texas St. Mid-day/Mid-Month events for seniors & singles. Bible study, and Wednesday Organ Concerts!!! 🎶🎹🎼 Very hostile and unwelcoming environment.  If you have traditional beliefs they will make you feel like you are evil.  They care more about promoting their leftist political beliefs, than bringing people to God. We were there for Grossmont High School Choir Spring Festival. It is a beautiful church and we are very grateful for being allowed to perform there. Forget about all of the should's of Christianity, Give yourself 2 or 3 minutes to just sit and be with God. No itinerary, No list of shoulds, Just be present like you're with a loving parent. All God ever wanted was to be with you Just the way you are.!!!

name: Five-Fold Church
Five-Fold Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Apostle Kathryn Krick leads this lively Christian church. If you are not able to attend in person, you can watch the Sunday service on Facebook, Instagram, and YouTube. Most of the in-person services take place at the Belasco Theatre. I have been planted at 5F for almost 4 years now, and I have received so much from our Father through the pastor, Apostle Kathryn Krick.  This church truly feels like the Book of Acts come alive.  There are countless miracles and testimonies of God's people being set free.  God's anointing is truly moving through his obedient vessels, and this church is living proof.  All are welcome here.  My prayer is that God would spark curiosity in everyone who hears about or comes across this church online.  May hearts continue to be transformed and drawn closer to Jesus Christ as the good news spreads that God's Revival is here NOW.  May all who have ears to hear receive the good news, and become vessels that share it with others. I’ve gone to many churches in the Los Angeles area and this church is hands down my favorite! God is really moving powerfully here! I struggled with anxiety and depression and conception issues and since coming to this church, I’ve not only been completely set free of anxiety and depression and had a miracle baby, but I also have continued to be equipped for spiritual warfare, grown in my relationship with God, grown in the fruits of the spirit, and matured spiritually. Apostle Kathryn Krick’s teachings are filled with the Holy Spirit and I gain revelation every time! Another great thing about this church is the people! It’s such a pure-hearted, non-judgemental, wonderful family with a fire for God and heart for others. The worship team is really amazing too! I look forward to every Sunday service and love listening to the teachings on podcast or YouTube! I highly recommend checking it out! Revival is truly now at 5F church and for the whole world. Apostle Kathryn is a pure true servant of God. I have been delivered of anxiety, paranoia, desire to drink and smoke, severe nightmares, sexual dreams, lust and unwanted impure thoughts, generational curses of rage, control and manipulation. Truly so much more. I’ve been healed of constant sickness, old injuries that never healed properly, impacted wisdom tooth, years of hip pain and more! By Gods power moving here at 5F church! All glory to God! I’m no longer stuck going around in circles in my faith. I am growing through the teachings and Gods power. The community is on fire for God and full of Christ love. If you need healing, freedom or fire of God you have found the place. God is pouring out His love and power like I’ve never witnessed before! Thank You, Jesus! I started watching videos from 5F Church in 2021 when I was hungry and seeking for more of God. I was completely in awe as I listened to Apostle Kathryn preach because it was simple and powerful, my spirit was leaping within me and I soon planted myself at 5F Church. From that moment, Jesus began to revive my life, He delivered me from fear, panic attacks, rejection, trauma, depression, and more! For the first time I learned that as a child of God I have authority over the devil! As I began walking in that authority I saw the devil flee and victory came! This was mindblowing for me because I had grown up going to church, but never seen change and freedom in my life that I longed for, but the anointing God has entrusted to Apostle Kathryn began to pour into my life and I got to taste abundant life!! Since then, I have remained firmly planted, and Jesus has taken me from glory to glory, I have received more peace, joy and walk in overwhelming victory over the devil! REVIVAL IS NOW! I encourage you to come to 5F Church and experience God’s power and love for yourself! Glory to God!
/Mirjam

name: Florida Coast Church
Florida Coast Church - Pompano Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a great church. For anyone who is seriously wanting to be rooting in Christ centered scripture for themselves and or their family this is the place to go in this area.  The people are loving and elders are knowledgeable, personable and loving as well as theologically capable.  It’s hard to find a gem like this. You will be lovingly challenged to grow in holiness. True to the Gospel and sharing the Good News are their top priority! Family in Faith, warm, friendly and welcoming! I have been attending Florida Coast Church for most of its eight-year history, and not a week goes by that I don’t thank God for making me part of this special congregation.  There is a warm, friendly family atmosphere that is felt the moment you walk in the door.  The worship is simple, participatory, and heart-felt.  Sound biblical preaching provides rich spiritual food, bringing fresh insights to Scripture passages I have been reading and studying for years.  Want more?  There are prayer meetings and Bible studies during the week and an active women’s ministry.  This is authentic, biblical Christianity.

In first posting my review a few years ago, I failed to mention the many wonderful people God has used and continues to use at Florida Coast Church, especially our pastor Larry Trotter and his wife Sandy. They are a seasoned ministry couple, having worked together for over a quarter century as missionaries in Mexico before starting our congregation.  Larry’s teaching and leadership gifts are beautifully complemented by Sandy’s caring hospitality and her work with women and children. We love them both! Great church great sound teaching loving people and excellent pastors it is an amazing place for community Florida Coast Church was welcoming and kind to us as visitors. Many people went out of their way to introduce themselves to us and make us feel loved. Pastor Trotter preached a sermon that was Christ centered, expository and encouraging. Prayer was heart felt and they are strong in supporting missionaries. If you are local to the Pompano Beach or Ft Lauderdale area, please consider attending and becoming a member of this authentic, caring body of believers.

name: Fontana Church, First Assembly of God
Fontana Church, First Assembly of God - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
The presence of God is moving in this place , such amazing worship and the sermons are amazing , 2 services one for English and other for Spanish, This church changed my life for the better ,
This is an amazing church where I met so much amazing people that welcomed me and now we are all a family , the pastors are amazing and makes everyone part of the family, this place is truly amazing and is considered my home My daddy, my faithful heavenly father saved me and my family riding in the car with me from what would have been a ghastly car accident on early morning of October the 6th 2024 driving home from my son's wedding.
Satan thought that he could take the glory that belongs to God, but our Almighty God, the lion of the tribe of Judah, the one that has showed me time and time again that He is ever present in my life rescued us, and prevented the accident from happening.
I have too many reasons to give praises unto God. This is not the first time that He have protected me from a car accident and I know that it will not be the last.
I give Him all the praises, honor, adoration, alleluia, hosannah unto His holy name, Amen and Amen! I remember the first time i came to this church. It was around 10 years ago, I was not yet a member but an invited speaker.  We helped host a youth conference here and from that moment, I can already tell this church was special. As the years have passed, this church has been the place i decided to call my spiritual home. I was married in this church, started my family in this church. And now with my family, we serve this church, which is also our family. A place we pray people will come to and experience community, sound teaching, healing and  restoration. Pastor Daniel and Raquel have been my pastors since I was 8 years old. This has been my home, and I am thankful to the Lord for the community He has given me—a spiritual home, The Lord has been so good to me. If you are looking for a church that is on fire and seeking the Lord, I invite you to come visit us. “With God, we always win; we never lose." – Pastor Daniel. Fontana First Assembly of God is a church full of people who have loved on me and supported me in my walk with Christ. It is a church where I have been able to grow in knowledge of His word and experienced the presence of God. I learned what it is to serve God with my entire heart, and I thank Him for leading me and my family here. This church is my second home ❤️

It was around 10 years ago, I was not yet a member but an invited speaker.  We helped host a youth conference here and from that moment, I can already tell this church was special. As the years have passed, this church has been the place i decided to call my spiritual home. I was married in this church, started my family in this church. And now with my family, we serve this church, which is also our family. A place we pray people will come to and experience community, sound teaching, healing and  restoration. Pastor Daniel and Raquel have been my pastors since I was 8 years old. This has been my home, and I am thankful to the Lord for the community He has given me—a spiritual home, The Lord has been so good to me. If you are looking for a church that is on fire and seeking the Lord, I invite you to come visit us. “With God, we always win; we never lose." – Pastor Daniel. Fontana First Assembly of God is a church full of people who have loved on me and supported me in my walk with Christ. It is a church where I have been able to grow in knowledge of His word and experienced the presence of God. I learned what it is to serve God with my entire heart, and I thank Him for leading me and my family here. This church is my second home ❤️

name: Foothill Church (Baseline Campus)
Foothill Church (Baseline Campus) - Glendora Campus
reviewSummary: Great place of worship.  Christ centered, and Bible based.  People are warm and welcoming.  There are weekly classes, 3 services each Sunday, and classes for the young ones, including babies. Classes to introduce, enhance, and engage you to build a relationship with our LORD JESUS CHRIST. I’m so thankful for Foothill Church! The teaching is solid and biblical...not just for adults but for kids and youth too. The youth group is amazing, and the weekly prayer meetings are such a special time to connect with others and with God. I also love the classes that help you learn more about the Bible. Foothill is also very welcoming and supportive of families with special needs, which means so much to us. It’s a warm, genuine community where you can truly belong. I've been attending Foothill for over 11 years.  I started attending before I was a believer and felt very welcomed.  Eventually I did become a believer and got baptized here.  I love that they preach the gospel and lean into the Bible.  The main pastor is a true gem and we're blessed to have him.  All of the staff is great.  If you're looking for a church I encourage you to stop by for a month to see what we're about. We have been attending Foothill Church in Glendora for over three years now. It is such a gift!! The sermons are fully Biblically based. All ages are included and encouraged to participate. Everything is done intentionally and with excellence. We have felt welcome from the first time we walked in the doors. I am proud to say “This is my church!” Foothill Church has been one of the greatest blessings of our lives. Come learn how to apply the Bible to your life, and be part of a community that will love and welcome you and your family just as you are. There’s something special about Foothill Church—come and see for yourself! And when you get here, enjoy a great cup of coffee.

name: Foothills United Methodist Church
Foothills United Methodist Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary:
Hi everyone, I found the true meaning of humanity in the warm and loving community of Foothills United Methodist Church. Every single member radiates kindness, compassion, and a genuine spirit of hospitality. The moment I walk through the doors, I feel surrounded by peace, love, and positive energy.
What makes this church truly special is that their words are lived out in their actions. Their faith is not only preached but practiced with open hearts and helping hands.
As a foreigner, I came in as a stranger and yet, I was welcomed as family. Today, I feel that this community is not just a church; it is home.
Pastor Leigh, thank you for your unwavering support and gentle care. And dear Susan, director of the Good Shepherd Ministry, thank you for guiding me to this beautiful place. You have given me more than just a church , you’ve given me belonging, love, and hope.
With all my heart, thank you.
Neda❤️ Very lovely setting. I was passing out flyers for a new nonprofit dance studio, Blossom&Bloom in La Mesa. I briefly spoke with personnel at the child care and the pastor of the church.  I mentioned to him that the campus looked beautiful and ready for learners. Anyone looking for childcare would be smart to check out Foothills United Methodist and its childcare programs. Foothills United Methodist Church is an absolutely beautiful venue for a wedding! As a photographer and videographer, I really appreciated their friendly attitude and no restrictions. The warm, inviting atmosphere helped create a memorable day for everyone involved. If you’re looking for a picturesque and welcoming place for your wedding, I highly recommend Foothills United Methodist Church! I loved Foothills when I attended there. At the time Rev. John Farley was Pastor. I found the congregation to be welcoming and most were friendly. It was a “higher scale” with more than average having college degrees and in a higher economic group. That said, the sermons were down to Earth and enjoyable and to the point. I attended two years before joining because one of the Associate Pastors said, God was “Awesome”. Coming from my Baptist upbringing it didn’t seem that was the “right way”, to refer to God. So I attended, watched and listened. At Christmas they hosted a reenactment of Christ’s birth, outside for the community to watch. They featured live animals in the manger, where children could pet them after the play. I met several women, when I volunteered, as they did, to be shepherds on the hill, tending our wooden cutout flock. It was a rewarding experience and we repeated it a few times. On Maudlin Thursday, (the night before Good Friday)
many of us gathered for a Seder Meal. I found it interesting and educational. It’s a church for families and singles alike. I think it’s important to attend a church that has a history and “fellow churches”, you can go from city to city and still find a Methodist Church. You can count on a Pastor who has graduated from a Seminary College and knows what he’s talking and teaching about. That he Believes in God, Jesus Christ as His Son, who God sent  to forgive our sins and be our Savior. I moved to AZ to care for my Granddaughter, so my daughter could go to Nursing School. The “start up” churches here, are pretty much everywhere these days, and can’t compare to a UMC, Baptist, or Congregation Church. I took a nine month Bible course at Foothills and learned so much more about the Lord’s Book. If you’re in the neighborhood and live on Mt Helix, El Cajon, La Mesa or Rancho San Diego, I would highly recommend giving Foothills a try. It’s been twenty years or more since I’ve been able to attend there. I would bet though,  there’s still a Welcoming Source there,  who would love to greet you any Sunday. I have been attending at the church for 2 years. Great teaching from pastoral staff and really great music both from contemporary and traditional services. Congregation is not huge, so you won't feel lost in a huge crowd. There is a school here for wee ones. Kind, open and inviting people.

name: Forest Hill Church
Forest Park Church
Forest Park Church - Panama City Campus
reviewSummary:
We held our VPK graduation at Forest Park Church, and it was a wonderful experience! The facility was clean, spacious, and perfect for our celebration. The staff was incredibly helpful and kind throughout the planning and event. We’re so grateful for their support and would absolutely recommend this venue for any special occasion! Just spoke with Pastor David - “this is David”  let’s you know the mettle and humble spirit of this pastor. I phoned to tell him personally how much I was helped by his sermon this past Sunday.

Pastor David is a master of didactic preaching, the lessons
all girded by scripture and presented in a didactic manner are magnificent and shew forth for all to hear and SEE the Glory of GOD in action! Our church went this week to feed the people in tent city.  You could definitely see that the Forest Park UMC  and its people are very interested in doing what is best for those that are hurt by the storm.  We spoke with the minister and his wife and both are full of God's love for all.  I know Shawn York and know where his heart is.  He has sacrificed a lot for the betterment of all involved.  They want each and every one to be in a better place than they were before the storm.  May God Bless those who have lost so much and those that are there to help. I've been a member of FPUM for a decade. Its a lovely church, but too big. I was married 4 yrs ago & bulletins still came in my maiden name. My birthday nor my anniversary was posted, & when I finally decided to transfer my membership, I was told that they were happy I found a home. Wait...I had one. I got lost among the other patrons. It upsets me. I loved this church and the people, but in the end I was left feeling forgotten or judged. We recently visited Forest Park while serving lunch to many tent city residents.  The church volunteered the use of their kitchen and a dozen or more rump roasts.  There is a donation section set aside for everyone to obtain clothes and other supplies. The United Methodist Committee on Relief is on campus helping people obtain needed services.  Many tent city residents are poor with no place to go. The magnitude of assistance needed from the hurricane disaster is far more then news coverage shows.  Forest Park needs your prayers, group assistance and contributions.

name: Fort Myers Community Church
Fort Myers Community Church - Fort Myers Campus
reviewSummary:
Fort Myers Community Church (FMCC) has been such a tremendous blessing in the life of our family, drawing us closer to our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ. We are forever grateful for the amazing work God is doing through this church and its leadership. Pastor Bill has been given a true gift in sharing the gospel in such an inspiring, relatable, and powerful way. His messages resonate deeply and have helped guide us in walking with Jesus and honoring Him in our daily lives.

We feel truly blessed to have found this beautiful, God-glorifying church. FMCC continually reminds us of God's love for us and encourages us to live out our faith. From being baptized here, attending weekly Bible studies, and having opportunities to serve our community, to Pastor Bill’s amazing reminders of the biblical reasons God brings couples together in marriage during our heartfelt wedding ceremony. Every experience has been a profound blessing.

We are incredibly thankful for this church family, and we look forward to continuing to grow in faith and serve the Lord together. We are truly honored to be part of this incredible community. God bless you all, and thank you, Pastor Bill, for leading us with such grace and wisdom!

With heartfelt gratitude,
Erin & John I was in town visiting a friend. Warm welcome. Greeted as a new comer by multiple people. Worship was great. The message was very well communicated. I went up for prayer and got absolutely crushed by The Holy Spirit. I could not walk. I dropped to my knees. I have never been brought down like that before. It was amazing. Praise God for was I experienced that day. Amazing worship, biblical truth preached without compromise, and a genuinely friendly church family. This is a place where you can grow in faith and feel connected. This is the best church I’ve been to in a very long time… This church truly serves the God of the Bible, as well as Jesus Christ.  Pastor Bill is so genuine, and his messages speaks right to the heart.  My wife and I moved to Fort Myers for the winter months and we found this Church on Facebook.  We walked in and instantly the vibe was amazing.  Young and older people all interacting and being so kind to each other.  The worship was vibrant and extremely talented, and you could tell the Spirit of God was there.  But it definitely wasn't too showy. And at the end of the service we had a lovely young couple come up, say hi, and get to know us.  If you want to go somewhere that's Biblical-based, passionate, genuine, welcoming, and uplifting... definitely check this church out.  We're continuing to go here, so maybe my wife and I will see you there!

name: Forward Church
Forward Church - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor Bogdan is an excellent teacher. The Bible is taught the way it's meant to be received: In context. His illustrations can be hilarious! He is passionate about reaching people. You will enjoy the messages. This has been my home Church for 7 or 8 years and I still love it! I always find the sermons wonderful and my fellow congragents are wonderful!!! Pastor Bogdan is a wonderful leader. His Sunday messages are always inspiring. I’m very grateful we found forward church. My life has changed for the better and for that I’m so grateful. Forward Church is a rare Biblical based church to find in the South California. What I liked is you get solid scriptural based teaching and excellent team of worship. The church is in process of growing, but it's a place where you really see God at work through their growing ministries.
Pastor Bogdan is a very passionate about his ministry, he has great scriptural knowledge but delivers it in very practical and understandable manner. Also what is noticeable is that everyone who serves in this church, you can see has a true passion for what they do. Lately it has been very difficult to find a church where the Bible is preached, and not just the ideas of the pastor. But I did it! When I got here I immediately felt like I was part of a family. Pastor Bogdan is very open hearted man with strong understanding, that only Christ can change people’s hearts! Love this Church so much!

name: Fountain of Life Baptist Church
Fountain of Life Baptist Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
A small Church with a big Heart! I am blessed every time I visit. The Pastor and his family are great, the people are very friendly and kind, the music is Christ-honoring, and the preaching is impactful. God is truly glorified here! They leave junk mail on your porch. I have a No Soliciting sign and they woke up my baby shoving this in my screen door. “How to have eternal life”. Wow thanks, my baby is awake, I have extra trash, but I will live forever now! One of the best decisions of my life was joining Fountain of Life Baptist Church. Pastor Daniel and his family are always faithful, consistent, and loving to each one of us.

This church includes weekly soul-winning evangelism, which very few churches in south Orange County are focusing on. There are also choir opportunities, Sunday School for children, and nursing home ministries.

This is a wonderful church family, and I'm so glad I'm a part of it! My wife and I , the Stiefel family have attended  Fountain of Life Baptist Church since 2006 when we moved to Rancho Santa Margarita, after a visit from Pastor Daniel Pigott knocked on our door and he was doing a survey and we said yes and went to visit with the church from gospel track address. We loved it He shared the gospel and preached from the Word of God we loved it and the worship and a family atmosphere of loving people hungry to know more and more of God His Holy Spirit  transforming lives over the years. What a Blessing we are close to the Pastor and His family so caring and loving and so sacrificial in their love towards and other over the years

reviewSummary:
Love the truth of God's Word in the sermons, bring on the fire of heaven.  It's feels like heaven is parting open during service.  PREACH!!  And so much respect for Pastors who wake up extra early to lead mid-week Prayer meetings!!  Thank you so much for your faithful leadership, this church is blessed 🙏 There is too much flash and no depth in the bible. So much standing even with the services. Sadly, I witnessed a few people physically push a new guy. In all honesty, he did nothing wrong. Angry remarks spoken in private are narcissistic.
