reviewSummary:
It's everything other folks have testified to. The people are very friendly. The new pastor as of a year ago speaks directly to you from his scriptures and from his life.  You will be blessed by these people the Holy Spirit lives here. Pastor Eric is one of the most righteous men I know. He preaches directly from the Bible and brings it to life and truth for what it really is. He is family oriented. His church is so down to earth. The people are so sweet and friendly and definitely family oriented. Diverse and humble. I ve been to the big churches where theyre money hungry ( charges for counseling like Some of these churches) . They really care about you and want God in your life.  Not your money. I love this church and their members. They amazing and lovely, I recommend this church 100 %, if you looking for a place where the Word’s God is explain with passion and truth. I am a single woman. I also have PTSD from things that have happened in my life. When I was changing after a long day at work two men literally beat on my door and window more than once. I was immediately scared. This is not ok!!!!! They left a Easter Sunday Service invite. I love god but this is not ok with me. I do not answer the door to anyone I’m not expecting. Most of all two men. Please spend the money to send through the mail. The guy banged on my door and window. Please never come to My house again. Not Happy!!!!!! This church is more than that, it is a family of believers worshipping together because we love the Lord and love one another🙌

If you don't have a church home, I invite you to visit and feel the love as the Holy Spirit is alive and well.

name: Freedom's Way Baptist Church
Freedom's Way Baptist Church - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary: I thought a church like this did not exist in this valley. Solid King James biblical teaching, amazing pastor, the congregation is one of the most welcoming I have come across. I knew the minute I walked in, this was the church for me. The sermons are ones that when you walk out of church you remember them. I’m so thankful I have found this amazing church. Pastor Cook is very accessible, He is always available for his congregation, and he always makes you feel like he has time for you any question or concern you have Went here because one of my family members had a concert here. Beautiful church. My family member’s friend is actually the pastor of the church. The bathrooms are clean and well decorated. Very friendly people and community in general. There’s actually a Christian school on the lowest floor. It’s really nice and I recommend going here. Thank you Freedom’s Way Baptist Church!!! If you are looking for a solid, King James, bible believing church, this is the place to be. Pastor Cook is great at preaching Gods word without worrying about who it might offend. The way preaching should be done! If you're unsure, you can visit the church's Facebook page. Here you will find past sermons. I encourage all to visit. The people there are very welcoming and nice without all the "fluff". Sunday school and Jr. church for the kids is great. The church is located in a beautiful building that's dedicated solely for this ministry After searching for quite a long time for a local church that preaches and teaches the actual Bible from the King James Bible, I am so grateful to have found Freedom’s Way Baptist Church which is currently located on Sloan Canyon Road in Castaic. Pastor Jerry Cook is a great preacher and with a sense of humor; the members are friendly and caring. I am grateful to be a member of a true Bible Believing church!! Freedom's Way is a fantastic Church home with a lovely community of people gathered to learn from and have a relationship with God. Bible Believing fellowship and fantastic learning programs. Thank God for the opportunities that Freedom's Way provides for its people.

name: FREEDOMHOUSE CHURCH
FREEDOMHOUSE CHURCH - Fullerton Campus
reviewSummary:
Amazing place to worship. I love it. Me an my boyfriend go on Sunday's. Enjoy the friendly people. Got a great pastor. 👍🙂 If you’re looking for atmosphere, production, and personality, you will find ample of it here.

If you’re looking for conviction, humility, and a trembling submission to Scripture — test everything carefully.

Wolves don’t announce themselves. Pastor Joshia and Pastor Marie are great. The atmosphere is very family  oriented. They have a children's  ministry. Also for young  adults  is a great place to be everyone is very friendly and kind. FH also has a small coffee shop within the church. They give back to the community every chance they get. I would recommend  their women's conference too! I was invited to this church by a friend and attended twice. From the start, I had a strong sense of discomfort that I now recognize was my discernment. The services felt more focused on appearances and social media presence than truly teaching the Word. There was also a heavy emphasis on giving money, which to me came across as taking advantage of people who may be in a vulnerable place.

As someone who has been walking in faith for a while, I’m grateful I trusted my intuition and kept searching for a church home that reflects humility, truth, and genuine fellowship. If you’re looking for something flashy and “Instagram worthy,” you might enjoy it here, but if your heart is after authentic teaching and spiritual growth, I would encourage looking elsewhere.

This was my very first Christian church experience, and it honestly turned me off at the time. I just wish someone would’ve shared a perspective like this with me beforehand. To each their own, but I hope this helps someone who is also seeking! And God Bless ♥️😊 Love this church good soil holy Spirit Field

name: Friends Church
Friends Church - Yorba Linda Campus
reviewSummary:
We attended Easter service at Friends Church and had a really uplifting experience. The energy was great from the moment we arrived very welcoming, friendly, and full of life. It’s a large church, but it still felt inviting and well organized.

The service lasted about an hour, which was perfect for families and kept everyone engaged. The music was excellent and really set a positive tone, and the message was meaningful and easy to connect with. They also have a coffee shop on-site, which is a nice touch and great for gathering before or after service.

Overall, it was a wonderful Easter experience. If you’re looking for a church with strong energy, great music, and a welcoming atmosphere, this is definitely a place we would recommend. My son attends the Fortified group here, and we truly feel that everything happened through God’s guidance. Friends Church has been such a warm, welcoming, and positive place for our family.

The community is kind and genuine, the leaders truly care about the kids, and the environment encourages both faith and personal growth. We are very grateful to have found this church. Yay!  I enjoyed the worship songs.  Sound too loud, IMO, but good worship songs.  Very pleasant experience except for sound volume at Sunday 9 AM service. My kid had one week VBS in Friends Church, and he loves here so much. Especially , the kids morning worship was so awesome, everyone was so moved. And even the parking lot employees prayed together. Definitely, we wanna come again. Most Sundays we go and just listen to service. Pastor Matthew is incredible and always delivers a beautiful message. Though we haven't really connected with other families at the church, we still enjoy attending and listening to the messages. I would like to connect more with other members of the community but because it's such a big church, it can be tough to do that. Our kids do love coming here as well. I have recommended this church to several friends.

name: Friends Church Fullerton
Friends Church Fullerton - Fullerton (Sunny Hills) Campus
reviewSummary:
Friends Church Fullerton is a place where relationships are valued & important. It is a place where you feel welcomed and at home. Families are a priority and they have provided so much love & support for my children. The small groups have been a great way for my family to grow & develop a deeper relationship with God & with one another. The pastor and his wife truly care about you and are so welcoming. So grateful for this place we call our church home! Being able to be a part of the church family has been such a blessing for me and my girlfriend especially at Friends Church Fullerton. We were shocked by the love and care this church family shows towards one another and especially for the new members as well. We enjoy the worship and messages and being able to be part of a small group. This church truly does care about your walk with God and will help and support that in anyway they can. We recently moved into the area and were looking for not just a church, but a family.  We found it here!  The congregation opened their arms & hearts and welcomed us with so much love!  The worship is amazing, and I appreciate that they welcome different pastors to speak.  We've been a part of different small groups due to our changing schedule, and the conversations are always God & bible centered.  If you're looking for fellowship, come by and check it out!! Friends Church Fullerton is a new church established in early 2020.
I became a member of the church in June of 2020 , and it has been a wonderful experience building relationships with God fearing people!

Pastor Teddy is a down to earth pastor who doesn’t look at himself any higher or better than his congregation . He is completely engaged with the body , and offers many services to our church for anyone who is in need , or dealing with spiritual warefare!
They offer a wonderful children ministry , weekly Bible study groups, and many family activities throughout the year .

So if your looking for a church home , where you want to be used by God , and grow closer to the body then Friends Church Fullerton is your destination to grow, and strengthen your LOVE relationship with Christ!!

With Love
Roland A. Going to a new church is not easy but Friends Church Fullerton is by far one of the most warm and welcoming churches I’ve ever been to. My boyfriend and I were looking and praying for a church and God answered our prayers. This church and church members have made a huge impact on deepening my relationship with God. Really thankful that God led me to a church that exudes the love of Jesus and genuinely cares for and prays for the members and community. I’m happy to call Friends Church Fullerton my church.

reviewSummary: Hospitality, Jesus joy, and inclusiveness. The praise and worship is phenomenal. The people of this church love the Lord and love serving the Lord. Pastor Curry is a true man of God. You will feel the spirit of the Lord and the kindness of the worshipers. Go visit, you just might become a member! OMG!  The building is beautiful. reviewSummary: Amazing church! Everyone you meet from start to finish is incredibly warm and welcoming. The worship is heartfelt and the sermons are easy to follow and captivating. I love Frontier and feel honored to call it my church home! The community here is exceptionally kind and makes it easy to connect. I love the message of renewing the beauty of Jesus on the frontiers of modern culture! We need that in Los Angeles! Since we have set foot in this church 5 years ago, we have found nothing but love and grace and a new family!  These people love Jesus, pursue the Holy Spirit, foster warm and loving community, and love to worship with all their hearts!  I love that my kids have friends who can pray with them and amazing role models in the volunteers that serve wholeheartedly in the most genuine ways possible!  People here seek no glory for themselves; rather, selflessly pour themselves out to encourage one another and make room for the Holy Spirit to minister among us!  Love you guys!  Thank you Christian and Sue for setting the spiritual temperature to blazing hot! I've been attending Frontier for a little over a year now and found it through a random google search of churches near me but I believe the result was a divine appointment. I have found a church community that is loving, supportive, encouraging, accepting and Spirit led/filled. I also value and cherish the transparency, honesty and genuineness of the leadership - headed by Pastors Christian and Sue. No pretention or facades, just sincere followers/lovers/disciples ofJesus encouraging, equipping and teaching us to be(come) the same in the midst of the messiness, questions, doubts, tensions, etc. Pastors Christian and Susannah are enthusiastic about sharing the Love that is the promise of the Lord. The sermon last week enriched my understanding and educated me about the ways humans make sense of our faith. This church truly seeks to be inclusive. The upcoming Alpha Class sounds really wonderful! Thank you for loving people, Frontier!

name: Fullerton First United Methodist Church Preschool
Fullerton First United Methodist Church Preschool - Fullerton Campus
reviewSummary: FFUMC Preschool provided a warm environment for our daughter to learn through play. The teachers and staff are kind, thoughtful, and patient in their instruction. The Director puts a lot of effort into building a community for the students and their families. I recommend this preschool without reservation, especially to anyone looking for an option that coincides with the academic calendar! We’ve been coming to FFUMC for over 5 years!  All three of our kids attended here.  The staff is amazing and truly care about your children’s development.  I highly recommend FFUMC if you’re looking for more than just a daycare. It’s a place for your child to grow! Fullerton first is such a special place! The teachers really love on each of the kids and take the time for them as individuals. I would recommend it to anyone! This has been our preschool for over 1.5 years. Our second son has also been attending their daycare and will be starting at the preschool in the new school year. We absolutely LOVE this preschool.  It is montessori style, which is amazing, but the biggest factor me me is how it truly feels like a family. I cannot stress enough how wonderful each and every teacher is. I had such anxiety with leaving my oldest for the first time, and trusting someone else with my baby, but they quickly ended that anxiety. They genuinely care about the kids and families, and are happy to help with anything and everything. They have been particularly amazing with supporting both my boys through their potty training journey. The student teacher ratio is perfect and my boys get the attention and love they need, as do their friends. The school is clean and well stocked with good quality toys, and my 3 year old tells me the snacks are pretty great too! I drive 30 minutes each way, twice a day and have zero regrets. I feel so lucky that I managed to find this little preschool, especially when I was an overwhelmed first time, expat mum. I, literally, cannot praise and thank them enough. Loving caring preschool. I felt at ease dropping off my daughter knowing that she was in good hands.

reviewSummary:
While the church members themselves I am sure are good, the current pastor's judgement is ethically questionable at best.

When attempting to resolve issues with the leadership, the pastor refused to communicate and the leadership failed to hold their pastor accountable. Such lack of accountability is echoed in various other independent fundamental Baptist churches with long histories of abuse. Exercise great caution if you have a family with children. We were greeted warmly by many members. It was a teen girl who offered to walk us to the nursery. The preaching was Biblical and thought provoking. When we vacation in this area again, we will definitely be back! I have gone to this church since i was 5. Pastor is so very nice and encouraging his daughters are so very sweet and the whole church is like my 2nd family . They make me feel so welcomed the teachers are very nice and make learning gods will way more fun than it already is . I highly suggest you visit us!! Fusion Christian Church
Fusion Christian Church - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary:
Wonderful Bible teaching local church with a great pastor(s), superb children's ministry, energetic youth directors, talented worship team, and welcoming faces of the church family! The church staff is always on top of day to day operations and usually respond to inquiries promptly! No matter what stage or chapter of life you're in, I highly recommend attending Fusion Christian Church And becoming part of the church family. First Sunday Service 11/30/25.
Walked in (nervous and new) and saw the most beautiful smiles in every direction. People fellowshipping, talking, laughing and smiling who did not hesitate to greet and welcome me (again, with those lovely smiles!).
Thought to myself how I would love to experience some of their joy.
I don't remember ever being invited to join a church in the past. I have since completed the Fusion foundational membership classes. I am now a CHURCH MEMBER! I am making  new friends and joining them in studying God's precious and life giving word.
I hope I never take for granted this cause of joy I am experiencing (fellowship, hope, faith and love) and all those smiles that greet me each time I enter this Church.
I am truly blessed and pray I may bless Fusion church and it's mission to reach and to serve others.
In humble appreciation,
K.B. For anyone searching for a church home to grow in community and strengthen their relationship with Jesus, Fusion Christian church is for you. Fusion has been my church home for about one year now and it has been one of the greatest blessing the Lord has given me and my family. The leadership is marked by humility, sound doctrine, and genuine care for Gods people. You are made to feel welcomed and like you belong there from the moment you walk in the doors.

The kids ministry is amazing! There are separate classes for nursery, prek, kinder through 2nd, and a 3rd through 5th grade where every child is welcomed with love and acceptance. I was so glad to hear that Fusion requires anyone who works in the kids ministry, or is around the children, to undergo a background check and live scan/finger printing! It is such a relief for parents and caregivers to know their children are safe and those given the privilege to care for the kids are held accountable and can be trusted. I’ve never seen such a well organized, safe, and Jesus focused approach to a kids ministry with Bible-centered teaching about the love of the Lord.

There is also a great weekly youth group and so many small group options for people looking to connect with others and grow in their faith through their hobbies or passions.

You actually matter at Fusion, and when you come to church you aren’t just attending a service, you’re welcomed into God’s house where there is always a seat at the table. Trust God. He will bring exactly the right people at His perfect timing to walk alongside you in life to share and celebrate in your joys and weep alongside you when we experience the sorrows Jesus promised this life would bring. His mercy is new every morning and it shows in the outpouring of grace and love this church congregation demonstrates in their service and care of those God brings through the doors.

Fusion has in person services, live streams, social media, monthly Wednesday night services, small home groups, and discipleship programs that are open to everyone who wants to grow in their love of God and learn to serve others.

God is using Fusion for such great, impactful ministry work for His kingdom in the Temecula valley region and local surrounding areas through outreaches and international ministries with the heart to love our God and spread the gospel in love to everyone. We just moved to the area and we’ve been searching for our new home church. We walked into fusion with our 5 month old and sat in the service for about 10 minutes when someone walked up to us and gave us this card. I was really confused because our son was not crying or anything. He was just coo-ing but not consistently. He coo’d maybe once or twice. I felt like we were being kicked out but genuinely feel like our baby was not disrupting the service. Felt discouraged because this is the first time we have tried going to a new church since our son was born. If i knew this would have happened i would have just watched the live stream from my home. We will keep looking. God bless After many years of trying to find my “church home”, I was invited to Fusion by my (then) girlfriend. It felt like the perfect fit. The lead pastor, Zac, is funny, relatable, and caring. Three months later, I was baptized, three months go by, I was married. Soon after that we were expecting our baby girl! Fusion provided us with so much love and support. I don’t know where we would be without them. Praise Jesus for saving us and thank you Zac for always being there.

name: Fusion Christian Church - Temecula Campus
reviewSummary:
Wonderful Bible teaching local church with a great pastor(s), superb children's ministry, energetic youth directors, talented worship team, and welcoming faces of the church family! The church staff is always on top of day to day operations and usually respond to inquiries promptly! No matter what stage or chapter of life you're in, I highly recommend attending Fusion Christian Church And becoming part of the church family. First Sunday Service 11/30/25.
Walked in (nervous and new) and saw the most beautiful smiles in every direction. People fellowshipping, talking, laughing and smiling who did not hesitate to greet and welcome me (again, with those lovely smiles!).
Thought to myself how I would love to experience some of their joy.
I don't remember ever being invited to join a church in the past. I have since completed the Fusion foundational membership classes. I am now a CHURCH MEMBER! I am making  new friends and joining them in studying God's precious and life giving word.
I hope I never take for granted this cause of joy I am experiencing (fellowship, hope, faith and love) and all those smiles that greet me each time I enter this Church.
I am truly blessed and pray I may bless Fusion church and it's mission to reach and to serve others.
In humble appreciation,
K.B. For anyone searching for a church home to grow in community and strengthen their relationship with Jesus, Fusion Christian church is for you. Fusion has been my church home for about one year now and it has been one of the greatest blessing the Lord has given me and my family. The leadership is marked by humility, sound doctrine, and genuine care for Gods people. You are made to feel welcomed and like you belong there from the moment you walk in the doors.

The kids ministry is amazing! There are separate classes for nursery, prek, kinder through 2nd, and a 3rd through 5th grade where every child is welcomed with love and acceptance. I was so glad to hear that Fusion requires anyone who works in the kids ministry, or is around the children, to undergo a background check and live scan/finger printing! It is such a relief for parents and caregivers to know their children are safe and those given the privilege to care for the kids are held accountable and can be trusted. I’ve never seen such a well organized, safe, and Jesus focused approach to a kids ministry with Bible-centered teaching about the love of the Lord.

There is also a great weekly youth group and so many small group options for people looking to connect with others and grow in their faith through their hobbies or passions.

You actually matter at Fusion, and when you come to church you aren’t just attending a service, you’re welcomed into God’s house where there is always a seat at the table. Trust God. He will bring exactly the right people at His perfect timing to walk alongside you in life to share and celebrate in your joys and weep alongside you when we experience the sorrows Jesus promised this life would bring. His mercy is new every morning and it shows in the outpouring of grace and love this church congregation demonstrates in their service and care of those God brings through the doors.

Fusion has in person services, live streams, social media, monthly Wednesday night services, small home groups, and discipleship programs that are open to everyone who wants to grow in their love of God and learn to serve others.

God is using Fusion for such great, impactful ministry work for His kingdom in the Temecula valley region and local surrounding areas through outreaches and international ministries with the heart to love our God and spread the gospel in love to everyone. We just moved to the area and we’ve been searching for our new home church. We walked into fusion with our 5 month old and sat in the service for about 10 minutes when someone walked up to us and gave us this card. I was really confused because our son was not crying or anything. He was just coo-ing but not consistently. He coo’d maybe once or twice. I felt like we were being kicked out but genuinely feel like our baby was not disrupting the service. Felt discouraged because this is the first time we have tried going to a new church since our son was born. If i knew this would have happened i would have just watched the live stream from my home. We will keep looking. God bless After many years of trying to find my “church home”, I was invited to Fusion by my (then) girlfriend. It felt like the perfect fit. The lead pastor, Zac, is funny, relatable, and caring. Three months later, I was baptized, three months go by, I was married. Soon after that we were expecting our baby girl! Fusion provided us with so much love and support. I don’t know where we would be without them. Praise Jesus for saving us and thank you Zac for always being there.

name: Gainesville Christian Center
Gainesville Christian Center - Gainesville Campus
reviewSummary: I experience a vibrant, living Spirit of Fellowship in this community. The sound is LOUD. I brought cotton balls for my ears for my second meeting to savor the Living Spirit fully.

name: Gainesville International Christian Church
Gainesville International Christian Church - Gainesville Campus
reviewSummary:
This church really helped me at such a low point in my life. I was kind of alone living in Gainesville for school, but this the members of this congregation became family with such genuine love. They taught me how to follow God in a biblical way, which ultimately, changed my life forever! I’m currently a part of our sister church in a different city, but the GICC will always have my heart! I highly recommend it to anyone & everyone  The Gainesville International Christian Church is a church that feels like home. It is a great example of what God’s kingdom is supposed to look like because despite all of our differences we are one. This is the church for you‼️🥹❤️🙌 Most importantly, it is a church that relies heavily on God’s word which is crucial as it will help us stay rooted in God‼️ This is my family and I am right where God wants me to be😌 It is a family focus environment. Great singing and lessons that are impactful and crucial to life change.
The first time out I was amazed by the love that was shown. Even how they were willing to walk with me in my daily life. I love this church!! I've been attending the GICC for almost five years and I feel so at home, with being at Santa Fe College and now UF. Plus they preach and obey the Bible FULLY... I've never seen that until coming here. Seriously, check it out... you won't regret it! (They even do personal Bible studies and small discussions, ANYWHERE & ANYTIME.) Sooo many forever friendships made! Such an incredible group of God-loving individuals! My time here has spurred so much spiritual growth, maturity, and wisdom in my life. I really appreciate how this church is bible-based, deriving sermons, teachings, and lifestyle from the scriptures. This congregation calls everyone to live to the standard that the word of God calls us to live. A true Acts 2:42-47 church.

name: Garden Grove Church of God
Garden Grove Church of God - Garden Grove Campus
reviewSummary: Garden Grove Church of God is one of the best churches in Orange County. Don't sleep on this church. It is a loving community of people in Covenant together. The pastor always give a relevant Word of encouragement and deliverance. They also have special events like Christmas concerts that uplift the soul. If you live in or are visiting Orange County and looking for a good church experience look no further than Garden Grove Church of God and celebrate Life Divine with Pastor James Darby and the Garden Grove Church of God family  you will never regret it. These are my friends and family and it’s always good to hang out with Garden Grove.  The people are wonderful, warm and friendly.  The Spirit of the Lord is in this place.  Always great worship and fellowship.  I recommend this place for anyone looking for a church home. Pastor  always gives a powerful    message.  Very friendly and welcoming congregation. A pleasant Church to go to love the people love the energy and it was a safe place to go to

name: Garden Grove United Methodist Church
Garden Grove United Methodist Church - Garden Grove Campus
reviewSummary:
Whenever I return to this place, it feels like coming home 🏡. The warmth and kindness from everyone here make me feel cherished and valued, just like any other visitor. It’s a wonderful reminder of how much care and compassion can be found in this community. Prices to rent the hall are super affordable. We go almost every weekend for an event. Sometimes when there's a concert across the Street, parking is a bit annoying so come early for whatever event you come in the evening. I square dance here around once a month. It's a huge hole has everything that they need to serve refreshments and still have room for 20 squares. The thing I don't like about it is you can't hear when the colors call. I don't know if it's the Acoustics or what but it's just terrible. That's the only thing I can find wrong with it Was there for a loved one's rosary. The viewing times was from 5-9pm andddd they ain't playing about getting everyone out at 9pm.😒

Everything was beautiful Was baptized in 1963 here before the property was updated (1965) and began singing in the Choir back in 1980. Planning to get married here in 2019 to my sweetheart, Pamela Akers, when it becomes possible.

name: Gardena Torrance Southern Baptist
Gardena Torrance Southern Baptist - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary:
This is what home and family is... everyone is friendly and caring. The church is bright and clean with a large parking lot. Visitors are always welcome. Some folks are dressed up and some are casual in jeans.

Sunday school/Kids Zone starts at 9:30am on Sundays for all ages.  Worship service begins at 11:00am and the message is streamed live on Facebook.

Potluck fellowship / monthly birthday celebration on the 4th Sunday of the month. The Lord's Supper is on the 1st Sunday of the month.

There is also a Wednesday night bible study at 7pm.

There are three other churches in this building. Iglesia Cantico Nuevo is a Spanish speaking church. Gardena-Torrance Japanese Baptist Church is a Japanese speaking church. East West Baptist Church is a Chinese speaking church.

The worship includes both contemporary praise and worship songs and classic hymns. If you are looking for a small family orientated church for worship, this is it. Bible driven sermons with open arms that welcome all. One of the best churches I've been to. I loved it. Just Awesome! From parking to inside Loving ever moment of the time i was their

name: Garrard Street Church of Christ
Garrard Street Church of Christ - Covington Campus
reviewSummary: From the moment we walked in, we were met with such genuine warmth and kindness. It didn’t take long to feel like we truly belonged. This church is focused on God’s Word, meaningful fellowship, and real faith! No distractions, just truth and community. I was baptized here today, and it has been such a powerful step in my faith journey. I am so thankful for the family we have made here and I’m so blessed that we followed the nudge to walk through those doors. My girlfriend and I have lived in Covington for 3 years right down the road from this church and in August 2025 we decided to stop in. Everyone was incredibly welcoming and kind, first day there and they were already inviting me into their family. It is an intimate church were we learn about God's word, no fluff just fellowship and Jesus. I was recently baptized here and am so grateful I stepped through those doors into a deeper understanding of faith! The best people in The World. They share the love of The Lord daily! Daily! Please come & see & worship The Lord. The reopening is April 25 2021 all CDC guidelines still in place. You will love it here. I've searched for yrs for a Church to call my home Church & I found it through the spreading of Jesus love, worship & teaching. I have been coming to this church for 45 years with my family. We all love it! Right from the start you are greater by warm and friendly people . Our preacher, Eric always follows the bible and every one gets a song book to look at! There is Sunday school for kids with wonderful teachers! Hope to see you there! As a long time member here, I was planning to share what it means to me to belong to a church family that strives to live in Christ, but today my heart is too full of sorrow to share my love for our congregation.  This weekend we lost a member who shared all his God given talents to help any one of us in need.  When Nick Fryer joined our family he devoted himself to the church .   He repaired anything that needed repair, he painted where paint was needed, he strove to make our place of worship a welcoming site for all.  His love for us was exhibited in ways more meaningful because it was done in Christ's name.

name: Gateway Christian Church
Gateway Christian Church - Los Angeles (Westwood/UCLA) Campus
reviewSummary: A wonderful, family-style Christian church with truly lovely people. Very warm, welcoming, and genuine. I always feel at home here and truly enjoy coming. I grew up attending Gateway.  It has a small congregation, which is great, everyone gets to know one another.  What a great experience. The people at this church are very nice and it is like a small town type of chuch. If you are looking for a great experience, check them out! Great church. Small and like family if that's what you like, it is perfect! Fantastic pastor and fellowship. Small church with a giant heart.

Gateway Christian Fellowship - San Bernardino Campus
reviewSummary: This is a wonderful church that is now my family for many years now and the holy sprit dwells here and I felt it the first time I entered the doors come and see for yourself it’s real and life changing where God touched my life and changed it for the good and for good I pray anyone that comes here finds peace and love and joy and God gives you what you need spiritually and if your heart needs healing you can find it and the answers to your prayers and a home for your heart, May God Bless you on your journey In Jesus Name Amen It's were I found freedom and peace and a love for the word Been a member for 35 of the 75 years no place l would rather be. You need to come an experience for yourself. I have personally been raised in this Church for 19 years, and this is Home. God’s presence comes into this building as the Church worships, praises and hears from God in this place. I am happy to call this my Home Church. The best place to be is in the House of the Lord Jesus.The power of God and the love of God flows in this place

name: Gateway Church
reviewSummary: Analysis of 1,200+ reviews indicates a highly professional and engaging experience. The 'practical' and 'life-application' based preaching is a top driver for attendance. The worship production is concert-level.

name: Gateway Church of Christ
Gateway Church of Christ - Pensacola Campus
reviewSummary: Seth had a great lesson. Everyone was very friendly and inviting. Gateway is a friendly and Evangelistic Church hoping to reach the community of Pensacola. One example is the upcoming summer singles conference which will have single adults from the entire Southeast and possibly further in attendance. Most churches do not reach out to the unmarried so the understanding and compassion is obvious SO many churches locally here in Pensacola online have missed a critical opportunity to pivot their sermons in order to talk about the dynamics of being a Christian and the assassination of Charlie on Wednesday. It's just business as usual for them. There are those that are unsaved in these churches getting nothing which is why it shows that finding a good church is next to impossible in Pensacola these days because the Spirit is not in them. They're dead going through the motions. Pray for the church. This is so disheartening. They will be held accountable. I went with my cousin he invited me and couldn’t believe it Before the service they served fresh free hot coffee doughnuts everyone was so welcoming giving me the warmest acceptance feeling walking around everyone was smiling and open.I have never felt so wanted and comfort from any church. The service was amazing the singing was amazing also. I was a stranger in the parking lot once I touched the church’s door I was family that’s the only way I felt at gateway church the first time I went and continue to feel. A lovely member whom I met in gateway church and her daughter have been 😇. Thank you Gateway Church for opening your doors for me and others. I go to church to hear the word of God, not to hear about your pizza toppings. I sat there for an hour and heard 1 Bible verse. Not to mention, the weird auto tune choir. Pure legalism that they don’t even worship with a piano or guitar.

name: Gateway Church, Agoura Hills
Gateway Church, Agoura Hills - Woodland Hills Campus
reviewSummary: A beautiful beautiful 😍 place kind loving ❤️ people clean huge social room with a kitchen excellent pool excellent yard I couldn't find anything wrong with this place mostly the people ❤️ Wonderful Church ! I have known Pastor Brian and Pastor Laurie for many years and I can tell you that they are the real deal . They are amazing people teaching a Christ centered message. This Church welcomes EVERYONE and you can definitely feel the presence of the Lord. I would encourage everyone to visit Gateway Church here in Agoura Hills and see for yourself. Very welcoming church that has done a great job with youth outreach. I have been looking for a church that preaches Jesus. 2nd time here.  Lovely people but I did not hear anything about Jesus. His name is not used, just the generic references to God.  Much focus on the failures of human beings without expounding on Jesus' finished work. Disappointed! Phenomenal community focused church ⛪️ kind and caring ministry focused on attracting like minded followers of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ. Thanks 🙏  for serving our community so selflessly.

name: Gathering Place Church in San Diego, CA
Gathering Place Church in San Diego, CA - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband and I found Gathering Place Church in 2010 after we moved to San Diego from the East Coast. After a long 7 months of "church shopping", we decided to try one last church. When we got there, we immediately had this feeling of "home". We knew that first day, this was where we were supposed to be. GPC is a spirit filled church, with powerful messages and worship, and an amazing community of people. We love it, and our kids (who have grown up there) love it too! My wife and I visited several churches in north county after we got married and found our new home at Gathering Place Church. We found out immediately that GPC is: welcoming, friendly and loving; the worship is awesome; they believe in the bible and the messages will encourage, strengthen and motivate you; and the prayer is abundant and powerful. In our shared love for God, we are proud to make this our home where we can make a positive impact on the world, our community and you :)

**2025 UPDATE**
Figured I should give a 10 year update :)
My family are still loving Gathering Place Church! The lifelong relationships that have been built is such a blessing. I'd recommend this church to anyone who wants to grow closer to God as well as build lasting friendships. Added picture of a powerful time the men had as we went up to Palomar this past year to encounter God together unified as his mighty men. I began attending The Gathering Place Church in 2010. From the day I walked in seeking more of the Holy Spirit, I felt at home in the presence of God and wanted more! The worship is authentic and powerful, God-exalting, and drenched with the Spirit of God, and the teaching is relevant and penetrating, firmly rooted in the word of God, and tethered to the heart of Jesus. I respect the leadership as those who live what they preach and truly emulate the character of Christ. I treasure the friendships I have built here over the years and the community that genuinely welcomes, loves, and serves one another and lives for the Kingdom of God. I moved out of state for several years, and when I returned, I knew this was the home I would be returning to without question. I love my church and love serving the Lord here and its people. I have lived in many states in the U.S. and have never found anything like it. There are good things about this church.  But at least for me, all that is overshadowed by the fact that in my and my family’s time of crisis (became extremely sick from a prescription medication) we received very little support.  One elder was a notable exception to this and I admire him a lot.  He consistently called to talk to me even though I didn’t know him well prior to my illness.  Thankfully I have mainly recovered ~3 years on.

Ultimately, I don’t believe any church that fails to support a very sick man in healing or seeking reconciliation to his wife (over disagreements related to his illness) is an organization that can be consistently trusted to do right. After a very contentious and costly divorce, I am dislocated to the Midwest, and our children are growing up in a split household situation which hurts me (and more importantly them, in comparison to what should have been) every day.  And I will always wonder if a church showing serious love and support to us might have made a difference. This is a special place.  The people who go here are so kind and inviting.  I normally live in Montana but my family is in Ramona. There  is something for everyone here. The music is uplifting and modern. , the Pastor John has a heart so big, his love for everyone is undeniable. He speaks truth and has a great sense of humor.. There are outreach activities/ministry, kids are in age appropriate classes  with amazing teachers. Mentoring youth, couples , singles young and old. My 5 yr old grandson (new to church -from MT but with us ) absolutely loves it. My 8 and 10 yr old grandchildren have been there for ever. If you are looking for a real place of worship with authentic people and no drama. Please try the #Gathering Place. If you want a family church, or church family, if you want to feel #God in your life, if you try the Gathering Place, He is there. Be blessed and be a blessing,.

Thankfully I have mainly recovered ~3 years on.

Ultimately, I don’t believe any church that fails to support a very sick man in healing or seeking reconciliation to his wife (over disagreements related to his illness) is an organization that can be consistently trusted to do right. After a very contentious and costly divorce, I am dislocated to the Midwest, and our children are growing up in a split household situation which hurts me (and more importantly them, in comparison to what should have been) every day.  And I will always wonder if a church showing serious love and support to us might have made a difference. This is a special place.  The people who go here are so kind and inviting.  I normally live in Montana but my family is in Ramona. There  is something for everyone here. The music is uplifting and modern. , the Pastor John has a heart so big, his love for everyone is undeniable. He speaks truth and has a great sense of humor.. There are outreach activities/ministry, kids are in age appropriate classes  with amazing teachers. Mentoring youth, couples , singles young and old. My 5 yr old grandson (new to church -from MT but with us ) absolutely loves it. My 8 and 10 yr old grandchildren have been there for ever. If you are looking for a real place of worship with authentic people and no drama. Please try the #Gathering Place. If you want a family church, or church family, if you want to feel #God in your life, if you try the Gathering Place, He is there. Be blessed and be a blessing,.

name: GC2 Church
GC2 Church - Poway Campus
reviewSummary:
Amazing church!  Great people, bible -based, great teaching, great location, family friendly, and loving community of people.

Make sure to check out GC2 church!

Pastor Jason is an amazing pastor and his preaching is awesome!

God Bless! I praise God for GC2 church that really emphasize the Great Commission and the Great Commandment mindset and what I love the most is the multi-ethnic atmosphere of Christ-body which is a glimpse of what it will be when we all worship describe in Rev. 7:9. GC2 embodies the rock solid doctrine they espouse. The church, all churches, are only as strong as the spirit within them. You will find the Holy Spirit at work here. Really great preaching and spiritual songs. Very friendly people who put God first in their lives I am probably as discerning an individual as one can be, I have been to so many churches with my children in search of a home with authentic love and priorottization in the Lord and his word and we finally found our home here. name: General Assembly & Church
General Assembly & Church - Fullerton Campus
reviewSummary: Friendly people, pastor sticks to scripture, simple old style service with hymns and piano playing along

name: Generation Church
Generation Church - Coral Gables Campus
reviewSummary: Passing through town, I got to experience this church and was really impressed. It felt very family-oriented with a strong sense of community. The worship music was surprisingly not loud like many churches — bonus points for that. Very passionate, God-loving people here. So thankful I got to experience this church. A faith-filled multicultural church with pastors who lead with transparency and excellence. You shouldn’t do life alone—our awesome small groups make it easy to build real connections. If you’ve been missing something in your life, come give God a chance—you’ll meet Him here. We all have a family in JESUS. The HOLY SPIRIT leading the way every way. We were on holidays in FL early January this year and when in Miami, randomly selected Generation Church for a Sunday service. This was a decision for life. The message was great (as all messages from God) and  clearly and easy understandable (we live in Hungary), people are very nice. Wish to live in Miami - if so, I would attend this church,no doubt. It’s really Spirit filled, I could feel God’s presence there! It is a Church of sound doctrine and The Word of God is being preached. They welcomed me right away as I was stepping in with love and Pastor Rich came to speak with me right after service which was a huge blessing and I was also introduced to other staff members and Church family. Most importantly I believe that they are worshiping in Spirit and in Truth which is The kind of worship that God wants. I’m grateful to God for giving me the opportunity to be able to attend service at Generation Church in Coral Gables, Florida. Looking forward to seeing you soon!Thank you and God Bless you all🙏❤️⛪️

name: Generation Church - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary: Our multigenerational family spent the Easter break in Oceanside. I found this wonderful church through a Google search and it was just what we were wanting! Everyone commented on the wonderful worship, sermon, quaint sanctuary, and how blessed they felt. If I lived in Oceanside I would come to this church. I would describe this church as non-denominational, evangelical, and a multigenerational family church. Oh, the donuts were top notch too! I love this church. No matter where you're at or where you've been, we believe there is hope and freedom found in the grace of Jesus Christ! Generation is a church for every 'generation' and every walk of life. No pretense. No pressure. No guilt. Just Jesus. Come as you are and experience the love of God along with us. Humble leadership; solid guidance based on the Word of God. The Holy Spirit was undeniable the first three visits to Generation church. We found a welcoming home here in the midst of growing our family and going through the hardest times in our life. So thankful for the love this church has for God and the community. Young pastor...Tim....I believe was his name....preached a great Bible based sermon. We are in the days that the Bible speaks about brothers and sisters...pray, read the WORD, choose LOVE and JESUS. And a good Bible based church. Be Blessed 🙏

name: Generations Church (Formerly Watermark OC)
Generations Church (Formerly Watermark OC) - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
If you’re a young family looking for a church, this is a great place to land. We’ve made real friendships here with other parents in the same season of life, and that’s been huge for us. Our kids have friends, we have friends, and it didn’t take long to feel like part of something.
The kids ministry is excellent, which makes a real difference on Sunday mornings. The church is medium-sized but has a big vision for Costa Mesa, and the pastors genuinely care about this city. They’re also very approachable. You can actually have a real conversation with them, which isn’t something you find at every church.
The other thing that’s stood out is how service-oriented the church is as a whole. There’s a real heart for the city and the people in it, and that shows up in tangible ways throughout the year. It’s been a great place for our family to grow, serve, and build community. Highly recommend checking it out. My kids and I went to the open play time (Wednesday mornings!) and really enjoyed it. There were so many activities for young children to partake in, and everyone was so kind. Bethany was great to talk to and made us feel very welcome :-) I don't go to services here but venue beautiful inside and pastor did wonderful funeral service We really enjoyed the worship, teaching, and friendliness of the people. Also, the in-house Coffee Cafe, Lion and Lamb, is superb. Come see for yourself God bless you

name: Generations Church LA
Generations Church LA - Arcadia Campus
reviewSummary:
Local, Christ-centered, community church with wonderful, but simple musical worship and strong biblical teaching.  The growing congregation comprises of young families, lots of student youth and their parents (1st and 1.5 gen.)

Lead Pastor Mike Kim and Associate (Youth) Pastor Andy Kuo are 2nd generation Asian American pastors. The preaching is expository, yet practical.  Pastor Mike always ends with words and key points to "marinate" and put into practice.

They are located in the auditorium of Arcadia Christian School. I've been a member of Generations Church LA since beginning of 2017.  This church was planted as the 2nd generation families of EFC LA had a desire/heart and prayed to start their own English ministry church to spread God's love to all ethnic groups not just Asians. We just recently hired a passionate God loving lead pastor Mike Kim.  We welcome all to join us every Sunday 11am.  We are open for "indoor dinning" to have a wonderful feast with our heavenly Father and fellowship with our brothers and sisters in Christ. We also have many other fellowship including Friday nights youth fellowship and Young Adults just to name a few.

name: Gesù Church
Gesù Church - Miami (Downtown/Brickell) Campus
reviewSummary:
Not a typical Jesuit parish ...

Was hopeful when visiting Miami and Sunday Mass was interesting. Gesù is the oldest Catholic Church in all of South Florida, founded in April of 1896. Gesu is in the heart of Downtown with beautiful architecture and stained-glass windows. ent to the 8:15 bilingual mass this morning and walked out genuinely moved. The readings and prayers switch between English and Spanish in a way that actually works — nothing feels forced or repeated just for the sake of it, you just follow along in whichever language speaks to you. Honestly didn’t know that kind of seamless bilingual liturgy existed until today.
The building itself is stunning. Didn’t realize until afterward that it’s the oldest Catholic parish in Miami (1896, current church from the 1920s). The stained glass windows and the vaulted ceiling are worth showing up early for. Quiet, unhurried atmosphere despite being right in the middle of downtown. GESÙ established in 1896 (the same founding year as the City of Miami itself ) is the first Jesuit Catholic Church ⛪️ in Miami. The land upon which the church stands, was donated to the Roman Catholic Archdiocese by Henry Flagler, an entrepreneur industrialist who settled here and built the railroad from Saint Augustine to Key West. A Catholic School once stood by the rectory. Today the school no longer exists and has, unfortunately been replaced by a parking lot. Love this church and the administration. Thank you. 🥰❤️🙏
Gesù Catholic Church in Miami, built in 1895, radiates timeless beauty with its historic charm and sacred atmosphere, a true spiritual landmark of the city.

name: Glendale Church
Glendale Church - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary:
Glendale Church is a welcoming and uplifting place with a genuine sense of community. The messages are inspiring, the worship is meaningful, and everyone is friendly and welcoming. There are great opportunities to connect, grow in faith, and get involved, whether you're new or have been attending for years. If you're looking for a church where you can feel at home and be encouraged, I highly recommend Glendale Church. We moved to the Pasadena Area 5 years ago, and revisited this Church that we had attended nearly 15 years before for about 3 years during my Residency at USC.  We were looking for a loving family environment, and felt immediately welcome.  With 11,12 and 18 year old children, our decision largely depended upon them finding a place where they fit in.  After several visits, my 12 year old son looked at me and said, "let's stay here, it feels like home."  We have been blessed ever since with our new family and have become involved in the ministry that this congregation does among it's members and outreach to the community.  This is a great place to find God, Worship Him, and do his work in this world. My lovely Aunt's going home ceremony was held there, where she was a active member for many years. The pastor and some of the other working members were wonderful & very helpful. If your looking for a home church, I would definitely recommend this church. Seeking Sponsorship for U4U Program

I hope this message finds you well. My wife Alona (27) and I, Ivan (31), are a married couple from Ukraine, reaching out to express our strong interest in the Uniting for Ukraine (U4U) program. We are excited about the possibility of relocating to the United States and beginning a new chapter in our lives.

I have a solid background as a Web Graphic Designer, specializing in creating visually appealing and functional websites. On the other hand, my wife Alona excels as a Social Media Manager, effectively curating captivating online stories and cultivating active online communities.

With the current situation in Ukraine marked by ongoing conflict and instability, our desire to ensure a secure and promising future has become even more pressing. We view the U4U program as a means to not only escape uncertainty but also contribute positively to our new community in the United States. Our English proficiency and dedication to a healthy lifestyle will undoubtedly aid in our smooth integration.

Upon arrival, our primary focus will be rapid adaptation, securing employment, and self-sufficiency until we establish ourselves professionally. Your support, whether through guidance, advice, or potential sponsorship, would be immensely valuable to us as we undertake this transformative journey.

Thank you for considering our request. We eagerly await your response and the possibility of creating a brighter future together.

Best regards,

Ivan and Alona I absolutely love the Glendale Church of Christ. As a teenager I attended the church from time to time when I visited my Aunt who was a member there and really enjoyed the youth group. Many years later while a member of a different congregation I attended a marriage workshop series at Glendale and felt so at home and comfortable with the changes they had made towards being a more welcoming church. The church family was extremely encouraging and their involvement in their community sparked an interest in me I decided to stick around a little longer to see if Glendale was the right fit for my family. It’s been 6 years now and I still love it. We moved to Orange County for work 7 months ago and have visited a hand full of congregations in the surrounding area but have not found one that has the amazing uplifting singing, active community participation, and amusing encouraging messages all like Glendale. The 84 mile round trip commute every Sunday is worth it.

reviewSummary:

And afterwords provide food and everybody gets together to talk in the fellowship hall. The people here genuinely care about connection. Which is what I like the most about this place.

If you’re looking for a church that focuses on community, the people here are great and peaceful. And they genuinely care about what they teach during the sermons too. Glendale Church of the Brethren is a wonderful neighborhood church. Their Service on Sunday's at 10:45 a.m. is diverse and open to every ethnicity. It is a Church of the Brethren based traditional Christian service in English, uplifting and positive and what I love is that the pastor will read scripture, but then show you how it applies to today's world. I've learned service, and how to be kinder, loving and more "present".  You are greeted warmly and if you get there by 9:30, you are welcomed and fed an amazing home cooked breakfast with hot coffee, waffles, bacon, etc. and then after church there is another meal. Lots of Fellowship and warmth and FOOD. A unique place in Los Angeles where people feel united in brotherhood caring and loving each other.They are open to public for fellowship , no charge breakfast every Sunday at 9 am when people meet for sharing their love for God and each other.An inviting artistic environment is welcoming the group of Christian brothers and sisters.Strangers always welcome,let's

name: Gloria Dei Lutheran Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: Gloria Dei Lutheran Church is a place of reverent worship with beautiful hymns and liturgy. I’m very thankful for Pastor Horn and his faithful preaching and care. Each service points clearly to Christ and His gifts. 💝✝️ Gloria Dei is a wonderful place to worship with members that are warm, welcoming, friendly and spiritual! My husband and I have been members for fours years and previously my parents were devoted members for 25 years. Pastor David is very compassionate and gives meaningful and challenging sermons each week. There are many activities and events for everyone; youth groups, Bible studies, celebrations and volunteer opportunities. Gloria Dei is a wonderful place to worship and to feel like you’re part of a family. Pastor David and his wife have been incredibly helpful to me as I struggled with problems with my husband. I am very thankful for their help after my husband physically abused me. They packed up all my belongings and shipped them to my son's home on the East coast and drove me to the airport. They were wonderful!!  I am happily living with my son’s family of five and listen to the Gloria Dei services every week!  In His love,  Sandy Pyle Pastor David and Pastor Sabrina were amazing to our family at a difficult time in our lives. They were caring, welcoming and supportive.  Pastor David visited our home. Pastor Sabrina helped us plan a Celebration of Life for our dear father. She was compassionate and understanding.  She made the service special and personal.  Thank you both for everything.  To the church members who set up coffee and drinks for our guests,  thank you. All was done in a beautiful and restful church and outside setting. Everyone is very friendly. My kids love the Sunday School and youth activities. The Youth educator, Quinn, is a riot. The kids really like him. My family goes fairly regularly. I find that it has a small church feel and a very nice sense of community.

name: Glory Church of Jesus Christ
Glory Church of Jesus Christ - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
On June 28, I attended the second service at Lord's Glory Church (pastored by Rev. Shin Seung-hoon), located near downtown Los Angeles.
After the service, the entire congregation went outside and lined up to have a bowl of *gukbap* (rice in soup) for one dollar.
Although the chef announced that they had run out of rice and would serve noodles instead, the cashier took it upon herself to hand me a bowl of *gukbap* anyway.
Even though the person was a cashier, she took it upon herself—without any authorization—to go to the table and hand me the *gukbap* (soup and rice) directly, preventing me from even picking it up myself. Handling cash and then touching the food I was about to eat with those dirty hands is a clear violation. Please be careful. Our vision is to be a community of disciples who gives glory to God by being filled with the Spirit through the Word and prayer. See a video on YouTube of guy filming on the side walk and a church member and the security guard followed this guy around it out on the public sidewalk and then the guard and the "ceo" as labeled on his phone, thought it should say pastor but ok, Put hands on the guy and the guard got pepper sprayed out on the public sidewalk. Keep your hands to yourself. I don't agree with everything the auditor was saying but the same amendment that gives him the right to film is public is the same one that gives us our right to our religion. Great place, great people and community. Attended a few events and it definitely feels like one of those production mega churches that's really about making money. Just look at how they treat the homeless and how they make the surrounding area so hostile to outsiders. On top of that, they regularly host far right organizations and speakers. I would stay away from this church that involves so heavily in far right media and big production church services instead of centering on God and empathy for all.

name: Glory Encounter Murrieta Church
Glory Encounter Murrieta Church - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary: Glory Encounter is honestly such a great church! The people there are super friendly and make you feel at home right away. The worship is always amazing — you can really feel God’s presence every time. The messages are real, easy to understand, and always hit at the right moment. The pastors are down-to-earth and genuinely care about everyone. I love how it feels like one big family, no matter if you’re new or have been coming for a while. If you’re looking for a chill but powerful place to grow in your faith, Glory Encounter is the spot! I love this church! The people who serve are so kind and welcoming, and the pastors give really good messages that help you grow in your faith. The worship is awesome and you can really feel God’s presence. It feels like one big family here. Its such a great place to be. Welcoming place.  As we moved to riverside county me and my wife have made this out spiritual home. We have a special needs daugther so its not easy to find a place. Love Glory Encounter! You can feel at home! You can feel the presence of God! 🙏🏽

reviewSummary: Go Life Church is a great church to go to and be encouraged. They have great worship and bring great teaching of the Word. It’s a place where the Holy Spirit really ministers. They are very engaged in the community around them. They go out to minister and reach those who are in need physically, spiritually, and emotionally. They help people receive healing, rehabilitation, and foster a community of faith. We love coming every time. It’s a place where you really feel cared for. This is my kind of Church! Wonderful people who are loving and welcoming no matter who you are or where your from, no matter your past or what your going through. The pastor is just an overall great guy who just wants to become a part of your life and help you become closer to the Lord! I absolutely love the music and the atmosphere is just great. It is more than just another church, it’s a family! God Bless!! Pastor Zakk and Tiffany have a wonderful ministry serving the community with their various outreach programs.  Glad to be a part of it.  My family have been looking for a home church since mid-March. We found it in Go Life.  Come join us! If you are looking for a loving and accepting atmosphere to worship at the beach, this is the church. Pastor Zakk and Tiffany welcome everyone with open arms. This church is pro active and encourages you to get involved in giving back to our community. Our family looks forward to worship on Sunday. You are truly surrounded by love here. Great True Gospel preaching Church, Pastor Zakk and Tiffany are the most kind and welcoming people!!! The atmosphere is laid back & its like one big family coming together I recommend this church to anyone Looking for a good church home that is not into mega churches , you will actually get to meet people and get to know them, And most importantly no the Lord!!!!

name: God's House Of Rest Church
God's House Of Rest Church - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary: Come and Visit, you won't be disapointed Small but powerful in the Lord! God is for sure in this house of rest church The spirit of God is here!

name: Golden Hill Church
Golden Hill Church - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary:
Super nice and humble pastor. Went recently to help a friend due their dad passing away (I also knew their family). Pastor helped me clean setup, and he worked up a sweat! He was very accommodating and hands on. I helped decorate and hostess the meal so the family could relax. The premise had plenty of parking and the church is spacious  and very traditional with pews.

Very warm atmosphere. Very friendly, loving brothers and sisters of God.   Pastor Vicente is very empathetic and kind.  If you have been out of the church loop, feel skittish about attending a service because then you get bombarded with pushiness and it is overwhelming for you then I would say try this place.  It’s low key.  I started coming here mid 2017. Love the friendly people. Very loving Pastor.  This has been an important Worship Center near downtown San Diego for several decades. Our Service is the Second Multicultural in afternoon. This Church doesn't care about Veterans especially homeless Veterans with P.T.S.D.. I am currently a client in Dreams For Change Safe Parking Lot Program! It's Saturday night May 28th and in the last couple of days I asked several different staff members about Monday Memorial Day if since there's no Head Start Program for the children if it's possible we can stay the whole Holiday Monday instead of having a to leave by 6:00am so we could celebrate and I even offered to provide everything myself to barbecue for us homeless individuals and veterans but they said no! I have P.T.S.D. and I have no family except my Emotional Support Animal Cat MIT MIT that keeps me from committing suicide each and every day!! Really gives me and I hope everyone else what this Curch and Dreams For Change Safe Parking Lot Program is all about: jut lining their pockets with money not used to help homeless people or people in need! Please don't support either this Church or Dreams For Change supposedly Non-Profit Organization! Great place to go and hear the word of God. The pastor is real nice and friendly . Great place to worship. They make You feel at home. Reminds me of the church I grew up in

Everyone at good news is super sweet and friendly… Great leadership. Feels like home. A friendly small church atmosphere.

name: Good Samaritan Episcopal Church
Good Samaritan Episcopal Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
I thought this place was great until I was made deeply uncomfortable by a man commenting on my daughter’s “blossoming puberty.” And then another time finding it appropriate to comment on her needing a bra. Complaints go unheard. Will not be going back. Glad to be a member of the Good Samaritan community since 2014. Love the joyful worship, music, and community building and service activities for every age and stage of life. Amazing visit to an important place in my life! Surprised how tall the buildings are! Amazed how close the transit system is to the church! The Seagull sat on the glass on Pentecost Sunday for the entire service! Really followed the Liturgy! I'm homeless came here for help. Was told to come back on a Friday best they could do was 20$. Fed my dog and sent me off. In my opinion that's not help that's an act to keep someone in the situation. I asked for a shower. Was told there isn't one. (It's actually in one for the bathroom stalls). What's the sign for salvation for? After moving for school I came here looking for a good place to connect with the local community and service opportunities. After attending Good Sam I didn’t look any further. The community is so welcoming. Young families, single people from UCSD and a solid group from the surrounding community attend. I was instantly welcomed and shown around.

The congregation seemed used to new attendees and were really helpful to me as I found my footing (I did not grow up Episcopalian).

The congregation is also integrated into the larger San Diego service communities. I was connected to food and clothing drives, opportunities to volunteer at soup kitchens, and opportunities to help families in San Diego’s sister city, Tijuana.

Plus there is coffee and snacks after the service!

name: Good Shepherd Christian Preschool
Good Shepherd Christian Preschool - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
We are incredibly grateful for our experience at Good Shepherd Christian Preschool! From the very beginning, this school has felt like a second home to our family. The love of Christ is evident in every classroom, every interaction, and every activity. The staff go above and beyond to ensure that each child is nurtured spiritually, emotionally, and academically.

While there has been some recent staff turnover, I want to commend the leadership committee and the director Ms. Yahaira for how they handled the transition. They communicated openly and promptly with families, and it was clear that every decision was made prayerfully and thoughtfully with the children's best interests at heart. New staff members have been brought in who are not only highly qualified, but also warm, engaging, and deeply committed to the mission of the school. The consistency and care my child has continued to receive has been outstanding, even in the midst of these changes.

Our child is thriving in this environment--growing in faith, confidence, and curiosity each day. The curriculum is rich with hands-on learning, Scripture-based lessons, and opportunities for social and spiritual development. We especially appreciate the way the school partners with parents to create a strong sense of community and shared values.

We couldn't be more pleased with the way the preschool has continued to shine, even through a period of change. It speaks volumes about the strength of the leadership and the heart behind this ministry. We wholeheartedly recommend this preschool to any family looking for a Christ-centered, nurturing, and high-quality early education! My son loves going to school and we love everything about it. They care
for our son so well and all of the teachers/director are all so helpful and loving. They have a strong, fun curriculum and I'm always surprised at how much my son learns every day. Their lunch/snack menu are great too and my son who used to be such a picky eater now eats more of a variety. We also love how they have service/worship on Fridays. Thank you Good Sheperd! It's a very clean preschool with adequate natural lighting in classroom and the playground space is perfect for outdoor play.  In christian environment, teachers and kids ratio is great and they are loving and respectful toward the kids.  Strong emphasis in art and music is a great plus!  Lunches/snacks provided in their menu calendar is a variety which is important especially in their young developmental growth years! Great school! My daughter loves it here and everyone is sweet and nice.

name: Good Shepherd Lutheran Church
Good Shepherd Lutheran Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary: I saw this church be built. The stone Rejoice went up first, then the church built around it. Walked with my dad, Rev. Howard Lenhardt, in the dirt, holding his hand. This church is my home. So many memories, so many wonderful people I've met, some of whom I'm still in touch with. May the Lord continue to bless this church & all who enter. Great church nice people. Excellent for weddings! Absolutely beautiful Sanctuary with wonderful stained glass depicting scenes from the Bible. The preschool is there for the little ones during the week. I hear great things about it. There are plans to move the Church of Reflections there. Once that happens, the church will become a great destination for tourists and locals alike! Attended a memorial service. Nicely done and we enjoyed the pastor. Was a bit rough with no air conditioning, have to admit. I went there as a kid. This review keeps popping up because my parents live right next to the church,  so whenever I visit Google asks my to review. I only get 3 stars because Im not exactly sure how survice is and I've never met anyone that goes here

name: Good Shepherd Lutheran Church - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary: We love Good Shepherd! We came to this church 4 years ago and experienced amazing hospitality from the staff. Great pastors with shepherd's hearts who truly care for the people and preach realistic, authentic, and applicable sermons that speak God's truth, love, and grace. The congregation has a big heart for the local community and overseas (mission outreach). The best preschool in Irvine! And the only church that emphasizes spiritual formation in discipleship! If you are looking to grow your Christian faith and find a sense of community, Good Shepherd Lutheran Church is the place for you. I have been a member since 2013 and enjoy attending the traditional service at 8:00 am. Our church hosts programs such as Rooted, Invitation to a Journey, and various Bible studies that help me learn about and deepen my faith. I also enjoy developing friendships both within my Life Group and by attending church sponsored social events. The 8am traditional service is truly inspiring with choir, organ and a faith based message. It’s the perfect way to start my week. The community at Good Shepherd is tremendous and heartfelt. I love the various local and global Outreach programs and the opportunities to serve those with specific needs. This is a great church for families as well as couples.  Very welcoming and lots of great activities and a great choir! Good Shepherd Lutheran Church has been out church home for 23 years. Our pastor Tom, his messages, global missions/local outreach, and the relationships we have made over the years makes this a special place.
