name: Good Shepherd Presbyterian Church of Chino Hills (ECO) 선한목자교회
Good Shepherd Presbyterian Church of Chino Hills (ECO) 선한목자교회 - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
I found GSPC because I was looking for a church nearby. Visited the English Ministry Service here. The community went above and beyond making me feel welcome and part of the family. The pastor is very encouraging and helpful. I love the sermons, feels like I learn something new every week! They have lots of fun events regularly which is a bonus. I have been recommending my friends and family to join us. Highly recommended! I recently had the pleasure of attending the Good Shepard Presbyterian Church in Chino Hills, and I must say it was a remarkable spiritual experience. From the moment I entered the church premises, I felt welcomed and embraced by the warm and friendly community.

First and foremost, the church's physical setting is beautiful. Nestled in the serene surroundings of Chino Hills, the building itself exudes a sense of tranquility and reverence. The architecture blends modern and traditional elements, creating an inviting atmosphere for worship. The well-maintained gardens and peaceful outdoor spaces also provide a peaceful retreat for reflection and prayer.

The worship services at Good Shepard Presbyterian Church are truly uplifting. The sermons delivered by the pastor are thought-provoking, relevant, and delivered with passion. The messages are rooted in biblical teachings and are designed to inspire and encourage personal growth in faith. The pastor's ability to connect with the congregation and convey complex ideas in an accessible manner is truly commendable.

What impressed me most about this church was the sense of community and fellowship. The members of Good Shepard Presbyterian Church are warm, welcoming, and inclusive. From the moment I stepped inside, I was greeted with smiles and open arms. The church encourages participation in various activities and ministries, providing ample opportunities to connect with others and build meaningful relationships.

The church offers a wide range of programs and ministries catering to all age groups. From vibrant children's ministries to engaging youth groups and adult Bible studies, there is something for everyone. The dedication of the volunteers and leaders in ensuring the spiritual growth and well-being of the congregation is evident.

In addition to its strong spiritual foundation, Good Shepard Presbyterian Church also places a strong emphasis on community outreach. The church actively engages in serving the local community through various initiatives, such as food drives, charitable events, and partnerships with local organizations. This commitment to making a positive difference in the lives of others is truly inspiring.

Moreover, the church's support for missions and global outreach is noteworthy. It actively participates in supporting and sending missionaries to different parts of the world, demonstrating its commitment to sharing the love of Christ beyond its immediate community.

The Good Shepard Presbyterian Church in Chino Hills is also known for its excellent music ministry. The worship team leads the congregation in heartfelt and uplifting worship, blending contemporary and traditional music styles. The quality of the music, coupled with the participation and enthusiasm of the congregation, creates a truly uplifting and engaging worship experience.

Overall, my experience at Good Shepard Presbyterian Church in Chino Hills was nothing short of exceptional. The beautiful setting, inspiring sermons, strong sense of community, and commitment to outreach make this church a spiritual haven. Whether you are seeking a place to worship, grow in faith, connect with others, or serve the community, Good Shepard Presbyterian Church offers a welcoming and fulfilling experience.

I wholeheartedly recommend Good Shepard Presbyterian Church to anyone seeking a church home where they can deepen their faith, find meaningful connections, and make a positive impact in the world. Pastor Ko, he really allows to be guided in the holy spirit and sets good standards. The word shared through pulpit really challenges you to reflect on your own living and grow in the Word and in your relationship with God. Really, love coming out to the Church on Sundays and Friday evening services. The gospel and sacraments are given faithfully. Best Korean food in a 20 mile radius. I grew up with the people of this church, it may be a new building but the church and it's people still fight on.

name: GoodNews Church
GoodNews Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary: We were looking for a new church a few years ago who moved in the power of the Holy Spirit and not just cookie cutter sermons. Wow, we found our perfect spot! We haven't left since and feel we are home. Our young kids love it here too and ask to go to church multiple times a week. If you want to grow in your gifts and stay in tune with what the Spirit is moving in, this is your place. It's a great place to visit the Schroeders are special people. The Church is full of the Spirit of God. Amazing church- the Holy Spirit is so strong here. The people are very kind and make you feel at home. The pastor and his wife and such genuine. This church believes in the gifts and through prayer for me I was able too see so clearly. The Love of God is evident here, by the love, joy and spirit in this place. I went there 45 years ago when it was called Trinity Christian Center. It used to be a good church then but now a weird modern church. I miss the old days.

name: Gospel City Church
Gospel City Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
I gave my life to Jesus at Gospel City Church. Gospel City is more than just a casual church you go to for your Sunday service. At its core the makeup of Gospel City is a family of believers that do life together and are immersed in the Word of God!! If you’re looking for a local church that makes you feel at home and a part of a community of Christians that care for and love one another Gospel City is that place! I inquire you to come visit a Sunday gathering and experience the Living God at work! Love, love, love this church! We started attending GCC almost 3 years ago, and it is by far my favorite church I have ever attended. The  teaching is so good, the worship is wonderful and so glorifying to God, and the community of people who call it their home church are so great. This church takes the Bible seriously, wants the Holy Spirit's presence with it, lifts up the name of Jesus, and desires to see the Kingdom of God increase in our city. If you are looking for a local church community, you should definitely check out Gospel City! I can’t say enough good things about this church!  The teaching is deeply rooted in the gospel of Jesus Christ and its presented in a way that is powerful and engaging.  Every message points back to Jesus’ love, grace and truth. You will leave feeling encouraged, challenged and refreshed.
This is a place where God is moving. There is physical, emotional and mental healing and people are finding real hope, restoration and freedom in a community that sacrificially serve one another.
The robust and growing kids ministry offers engaging lessons, helping kids learn to love and follow Jesus. It’s amazing to watch them build friendships while also growing in kindness and faith.
If you’re looking for a church where you can grow your faith, experience authentic community and truly encounter Jesus, we welcome you! Gospel City Church is the first church where I felt I belonged. And I’ve been to many! It’s small enough that you don’t get lost. The level of care and concern for others is above and beyond at this church. I suggest that you check out their website and look at any of the videos you’ll hear Pastor Nick talk about the church in general and you’ll see testimonies of the disciples there. A truly gospel-centered church that faithfully teaches the Word while being led by the Spirit. The community is very warm and hospitable—people are genuinely happy to see you from the moment you walk in. Whether you’ve been in church for years or you’re just visiting, you’ll feel completely welcome.

name: Gospel Hills Community Church
Gospel Hills Community Church - Glendora Campus
reviewSummary:
This church is very welcoming for all types and is Bible based with a growing youth ministry Watch Pastor Dom online to get a taste of our messages that is easy to understand but fellowship in person is the best way to know us This is such a wonderful church feels like family when I have visited. My husband and I watch online and we love the Worship and sound Doctrinal teaching from Pastor Dom. Such a blessing to see someone who preaches the word of God with Passion and conviction. We always feel blessed by each message! If you live in the area of Glendora I highly recommend this church!! I have never been as baffled by a church as this one. This is a very cult - like church. I visited this church but was not accepted and not allowed to fit in. They offer classes and when you show up, they do not meet. I had this happen three times. I contacted the pastor to inquire about a class that was supposed to meet and didn't and asked for information about another zoom class and needed the information. I asked him to send it to me as a snapshot, and he did not follow through. I might also add, this pastor never greeted me a single time during the seven or eight visits that I made to this church. Never said hello, waved, or even looked my way. I realize that most churches have fallen asleep, and this church is no exception. andThis church does not have time for a visitors, unless you fit the mold. I am by far very disappointed in how this church works. Every single occasion, I was disappointed and their preaching is blah. I only visited for community, You will not find that here. They were not interested in anyone coming from the outside unless you already belong. Very closed and narrow "church."
This place has fallen asleep... It is stuffy and it's members have forgotten what a church is supposed to be and do. I haven't been a part of this ch since I left the area, but still an incredible group of people. Bible teaching Jesus loving and true disciples of Christ

reviewSummary: Great church for the family Great leadership for all kids. Bus Ministry… how much I miss it. Salutations to all. Awsome church!!! Pastor David Cadriel is Awsome. Please update Phone number and list time of your services so that people can attend. Good church sad I don't go there any more

name: Grace and Peace Church
Grace and Peace Church - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary: My wife and I came over from Las Flores to follow Pastor Nate and his team.  We love his fresh and real approach.  This is a very welcoming community and definitely not your typical chuch experience!  We get more deeply involved every day because it just feels right! Welcoming and mellow atmosphere - great authentic people leading, serving, and attending.  My 5 year old son really liked the children's program too. Our family love attending and serving with this community church. This is a great home for anyone who is jaded by past church experiences or is new in their faith. All are welcome! Friendly atmosphere and great message from Nate Wells, Definately recommend Grace and Peace and I look forward to coming on Sunday nights! I love the evening service. Good people, good message good vibes all around.

name: Grace Anglican Church
Grace Anglican Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
I visited San Diego on vacation and attend and ACNA church up in Seattle. The service here was lovely because it follows the book of common prayer like my liturgical service up in Seattle. The preaching is also strong. This is an amazing church! May God bless it I visited Grace Anglican online; there's a wonderful feeling of community here, and the liturgy is easily understood, even by newcomers. Fr. Bill offers clear insight of the readings in his sermon; he has a powerful singing voice that easily draws the congregation into singing along throughout the service. All-in-all, this is a place where you can feel even closer to Jesus! This was a welcoming congregation. We enjoyed the liturgical worship, the choir and the fellowship time following the service. It is set in an industrial complex.  Just is not for us. The Spanish church

name: Grace Assembly Of God
Grace Assembly Of God - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
I Love Grace!  I live a few blocks away and walked in over 10 years ago.  Pastor Earl and Melissa are loving and welcoming to all. The whole church is warm, welcoming and full of love. They not only teach you to live in God, they show you how to relish in the glory. They are a true community church, charitable and open to all. BLESS TO HAVE BEEN INTRODUCED TO THE HOME OF GOD AT GRACE ASSEMBLY, I WOULDN’T CHANGE IT FOR NO OTHER. I LOVE EVERYONE AT THE GRACE ASSEMBLY CHURCH. Our home church, no matter where we we came from or where go from now, we belong to this place and our hearts are bonded to this congregation.

We used to travel for work and in 2012, that brought us to CA, being new Christians, new marriage and living in another place wasn't easy, but Grace Assembly was the family we didn't have, the friends we made, and the congregation where we grew and served the Lord as a family. Pastor Earl and Pastors Melissa were mentors, and we feel them as family despite the time and space, but what is that for our Lord Jesus and the love of Christian brotherhood.

There are no strangers in this church, engaged with the world by the love of our Lord Jesus. There have never been other like this place, we still long for this family and pray for this ministry, the saved souls and the many more to reach for the kingdom in the name of Jesus. We love you all. Went to LA for the weekend had to get some word to maintain for my upcoming work week.
Felt the presence of the holy spirit for sure.
I'm from the central valley so I was far from home.
Thanks to Grace for filling my cup Grew up in this church. Got married at this church. I’ve met countless people here that have greatly influenced my life for the better. The leaders of this church are not only teaching Gods word but they are living it !!

name: Grace Baptist Church
Grace Baptist Church - Corona Campus
reviewSummary: This church is warm and friendly, and the pastor feeds the people the word of God. The premises are beautiful and there are classrooms and nurseries for children and younger ones. Visitors are kindly welcomed. Adults and small kids were friendly and inquisitive, but not too many teenagers were the same, which is fairly sad in a missions minded church. I've been coming here for awhile. If you want to mature as a follower of Christ, this is the place. The people here are personable, friendly and caring. Most importantly, the pastor is truly dedicated to serving the Lord and truly cares for the people. His messages are encouraging, strengthening and helpful in staying on the right path in living for God. They also have nice gatherings to fellowship as a church and get to know people. The missionary conference is amazing!  It is a wonderful time of learning and meeting the many missionaries this church supports. This church is blessed. I am curious why they are a Baptist Church, if they are teaching the dispensational grace message saved by grace through faith in Christ alone 1st Corinthians 15 3-4.. Hannibal to do baptism because will you accept Christ in your heart we are automatically baptized into the body of Christ, & at the cross he said it is finished there for we do not need to get baptized, only accept what he did at Calvary for the remission of our sins,its by his Blood,Amen!! This is my home church. The pastor is amazing as well as the staff treating you like family. They get involved with you and go above and beyond caring for each other and others.

name: Grace Baptist Church - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary:
No church is perfect, but Grace Baptist is fantastic. The people genuinely care for each other and are committed to showing Christ like love to one another. Their worship is contemporary, but the mix it up which I appreciate (they will do choir and orchestral stuff sometimes but sometimes just the normal band instruments). The pastors are committed to the following Gods word and are extremely approachable. Their Adult Bible Fellowships (Sunday Schools) are awesome and super enriching. I would recommend this church to anyone and everyone! Beautiful, large, flowing water, clearly marked restrooms, excellent place for a large or any sized conference. Beautiful facility with friendly and most helpful people. A place where the love and kindness of Christ shines brightly Strong Bible teaching, Christ Following church home for more than 27 years. Safe environment for children and wonderful kids programs are available, along with child care during services. Two Sunday services, Adult Choir every other Sunday and Worship Teams each week. Check out Grace Baptist Church soon…to find a solid church home and place to worship. Grace to you…and Peace. Great church, and an amazing experience. You can take place in many activities and groups they have for kids and adults almost any day of the week. Amazing summer programs that are great for kids. They have a cafe, even a recreational area. If you want a good song to sing to and great sound to go along with it. They have that. They even have a separate building for junior high / high school students going to Sunday school. This place is great and I have been going for 4 years. Amazing place, amazing people. Just
Great.

name: Grace Bible Church - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary: Think you need to pray extra hard on someone you have a bio on. He’s not a very nice guy for someone who claims to be a church guy. My family and I have benefited immensely from the preaching of the Word and the relationships and friendships the Lord has allowed us to forge here. We are grateful for the intentional approach to life and ministry! It is a blessing to be a part of a church family where I am confident that my wife and I and each of our children will constantly be pushed toward Jesus. GBC is a great place for Christians to gather on Sunday mornings. The Bible teaching is instructive and worship is meaningful. The fellowship at GBC is also warm and inviting. I especially like the comfortable theatre seats for my achy lower back. There's also a great ministry for kids, too! More importantly, If you are of the reformed Biblical perspective this is the place for you! We love this church. It’s biblical. They preach the word. These people will become your family. You will not feel like a number, you will be loved on and discipled. We are so grateful God brought us to GBC. God's word is preached here. Today was my first visit here, I was welcomed by several people who genuinely wanted me to feel like a part of this church family. looking forward to many more visits

name: Grace Bible Church - Port Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary: This church is a family. Welcoming, Sound expository preaching, mixed worship / mostly traditional, great Sunday School based on CEF (Child Evangelism Fellowship), Nursery is clean and organized, Food pantry available, active in Good News Clubs. Wonderful Worship with the music not being overly Loud like a Rock Concert as many others do.  Solid Scriptural teaching and Every age group is represented from young families with infants to seniors enjoying their Fourth Quarter with a big lead!!! Been here my whole life.The pastor is funny and down to earth.We are all children of God and we have so much fun!We have prayer meeting and different games we play out through the week.We aren't perfect but we are home.💒 I don't have many friends outside of church. Great community church. serves the less fortunate in the community with outdoor showers & mobile charging stations

name: Grace Bible Church Anaheim
Grace Bible Church Anaheim - Anaheim (West) Campus
reviewSummary: Small town style church that has been here since the 50's. This church is part of the of the GFF (Grace Gospel Fellowship) network, which operates a college back in Grand Rapids, Michigan. They do not believe in water baptism, speaking in tongues (and the rest of the miracles that were cast away). They believe in one baptism; the baptism of the Holy Spirit. They a dispensational based church and focus heavily on the Apostle Paul messages and his mission to the Gentiles and the children of Israel. They are heed 2 Tim. 2:15 and pride themselves on being good stewards of rightly dividing the Word of God. They believe trinity and that the only way to obtain salvation is through Jesus Christ. They believe in traditional marriage and that you cannot lose your salvation. If you are actually looking to learn from your Bible then I would highly suggest giving this place a try! Sealed for the last 7! plagues. May the Lord have mercy on you. You forsook your true origin settling for the copy after being made by the original! Your choice your double portion is on it's way! Went here on a youth trip and the Sunday school class was more comprehensive than I expected which was a nice surprise and the worship service was delightful A good place to go to if you would like to fellowship with other christians I was baptized here when I was 10. Good memories!

reviewSummary:
Visited while vacationing in Oceanside.  Very welcoming people and was a wonderful service. Highly recommended if you are in the area. For several years of looking for a church that I can call my home and my extended family, Grace Christian Center bestowed me those attributes.
It's next to the Amtrak station and a ten-minute drive from Camp Pendleton. I live on base and it's the best church in Oceanside. Wonderful Holy Ghost filled services, great preaching and teaching.  Pastor Sanders is providing anointed leadership.  More information on learnaboutgrace.com. Awesome presence of the Lord.  Great solid biblical preaching and teaching. Everyone is friendly and welcoming! Great Place to Worship, with Pastor Davis and his lovely wife Sister Davis. ❤️

name: Grace Church
reviewSummary: A biblically solid community focused on robust reformed expository teaching. Wonderful fellowship.

name: Grace Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
It’s been over 20 years since my dad introduced me to this treasure of a church, a true portion of the body of Christ… one that grows with you and you with it, in His grace.
“For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.”
“For by grace you have been saved through faith. And this is not your own doing; it is the gift of God, not a result of works, so that no one may boast. For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand, that we should walk in them.” A truth and God’s love teaching church with a beautiful church family of all ages! Truly the most inspiring and grounded church in this area.  I love the pastors and all the saints here as they are so knowledgeable and sweet ss well.  If you’re looking for a reformed church that seeks to serve the Lord in all the right ways you will be very blessed here. Come on over and worship with us! Pastor is great was there for Easter first time visit. The most important things for me about a church I attend is the faithfulness of the message, the character of the members and if the music is for worship, not entertainment. Grace church exceeds expectations. It is a reformed church, which adheres to a Calvinistic theology. If you're curious about what that means, pay this church a visit.  Here you'll feed on the meat of the gospel. I have attended since the church began back in 2000. What a wonderful body of believers. We grow each Sunday under the faithful teaching of the word.

name: Grace Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
I love my church! The preaching is powerful, always Bible-centered, and easy to apply in everyday life. The worship is uplifting and full of heart, and the kids’ ministry is amazing—including a dedicated classroom for children with special needs, which makes me feel completely at ease leaving my little ones. It’s a place where families are welcomed, community is built, and spiritual growth is encouraged. I’m so grateful to be part of it! Too many mean ppl here...
a heads up, this church is not Mental Illness friendly but if you decide to visit with your loved one with a mental illness they are asking you to kindly disclose it to them prior to your visit( which is a highly protected right btw), i guess its easier for them to keep an eye on you, instead of praying for you to get healed. Pastor praises himself in fasting,prayer & continually pats himself in the back with how close he is with God. Well, what about us who've been praying for our loved ones for years & when they walk into a church for help & santuary, you become upset bc they dont act the way you want them too; you realize how hard it is to go out into this mean world to deal with ppl staring & commenting, then i go in church & theyre even worser that the world out there? Pastor & Grace church: just shut up & listen for once, i dont need your apologies or your explanations, just deal with the truth im giving you & remmember church is for healing & thats what i went for, but i guess it wasnt there, maybe Pastor was too distracted with cracking jokes than to see a broken person coming in from shelter of the world. You can start by getting your bodyguards trained in supporting loved ones with mental illness instead of you screaming at them from the podium, because im not the only one out here, theres alot of us. Also Pator, just letting you know my loved one would never hurt anyone in any way specially at your church because he loves you guys, he always has & hes the one who asked me to take him; he may not understand his illness but hes always had heart & love for ppl & you specially, he would always talk good about you & your family, youve met us before many times & your wife has prayed about him too specifically about his mental illness, his mind may not let him see the mean/cruel side of ppl but i do, & thats why i advocate for him in everyway. And dont say you didnt know us or about my loved ones illness bc we have been connected at your church including: Mental Health Coach/Pastoral Counceling from your church with an amazing woman of God, XO Conference, Small Group, Honey Huddles(which i also volunteered & helped with & spoke about my loved one) & i would continually go up for prayer at service & my prayer was always the same, prayer for my loved one with mental illness; so how much more do you want from me bc i did do my part, & many active/volunteer Godly men & women at your church knew my loved one & myself by name. NAMI is available to support anyone whos dealing with the same rejection & hurt from the world & churches like this one; ppl will never understand the pain we go through everyday. I cant deal with stuff like this anymore, dont worry Grace i wont return, i know you dont accept us, i know we're a bother to you & i know we dont fit in or that i cant see the future & anticipate what my loved one does every single minute of the day but i know he wouldnt hurt anyone, in any way. But i can rest assure, God sees what happens in your church, He knows the whole truth, He knows my prayers & He accepts us because i know for fact that Hes close to the sick & the broken, so Goodbye forever & God deal with you in His own way.
PS: try alittle Grace, kindness & empathy, im pretty sure thats what Jesus would do. For the multiple people calling Grace Church homophobic you need a reality check. The world and prosperity gospel that sinners love has you comfortable in your sins. God forbid a Pastor who ACTUALLY teaches the WORD of CHRIST and preaches repentance. News flash the Bible says homosexuality is a SIN. You will not inherit the Kingdom of God. That's God WORD period point blank. You can't twist the scriptures to fit your lifestyle. You need to change your lifestyle to fit the scriptures. You shouldn't feel offended you should feel convicted. If you're not convicted it's because your heart truly isn't with God. If you're looking for a Church that preaches the Word of God I encourage you to checkout a service. If you're looking for a prosperity gospel Pastor who will keep you comfortable in your sins, never tell you the truth about the Word, and repentance then Grace Church isn't for you. Great church that is very "Bible Based" point by point. They have a great kids ministry, small groups, and are friendly. It's always a little awkward walking into a church you don't know but we've met great people and are glad we stuck around. I highly recommend attending their "meet the pastors" to get a feel for the church and it's goals in the community. We came two weeks ago and we enjoyed ourselves. The kids went into the kids club and they enjoyed themselves. I was able to enter the sanctuary and the worship music was great and the sermon by the pastor was really good! Definitely recommend this Church if you are visiting or new to the area .
We will be back soon !

And dont say you didnt know us or about my loved ones illness bc we have been connected at your church including: Mental Health Coach/Pastoral Counceling from your church with an amazing woman of God, XO Conference, Small Group, Honey Huddles(which i also volunteered & helped with & spoke about my loved one) & i would continually go up for prayer at service & my prayer was always the same, prayer for my loved one with mental illness; so how much more do you want from me bc i did do my part, & many active/volunteer Godly men & women at your church knew my loved one & myself by name. NAMI is available to support anyone whos dealing with the same rejection & hurt from the world & churches like this one; ppl will never understand the pain we go through everyday. I cant deal with stuff like this anymore, dont worry Grace i wont return, i know you dont accept us, i know we're a bother to you & i know we dont fit in or that i cant see the future & anticipate what my loved one does every single minute of the day but i know he wouldnt hurt anyone, in any way. But i can rest assure, God sees what happens in your church, He knows the whole truth, He knows my prayers & He accepts us because i know for fact that Hes close to the sick & the broken, so Goodbye forever & God deal with you in His own way.

The world and prosperity gospel that sinners love has you comfortable in your sins. God forbid a Pastor who ACTUALLY teaches the WORD of CHRIST and preaches repentance. News flash the Bible says homosexuality is a SIN. You will not inherit the Kingdom of God. That's God WORD period point blank. You can't twist the scriptures to fit your lifestyle. You need to change your lifestyle to fit the scriptures. You shouldn't feel offended you should feel convicted. If you're not convicted it's because your heart truly isn't with God. If you're looking for a Church that preaches the Word of God I encourage you to checkout a service. If you're looking for a prosperity gospel Pastor who will keep you comfortable in your sins, never tell you the truth about the Word, and repentance then Grace Church isn't for you. Great church that is very "Bible Based" point by point. They have a great kids ministry, small groups, and are friendly. It's always a little awkward walking into a church you don't know but we've met great people and are glad we stuck around. name: Grace Church - Pompano Beach Campus
reviewSummary: A blessed and blessing place to be on any Sunday morning. Welcoming and friendly,a true church of God,supportive staff, and members. If you are looking for a warm,loving, and inviting  church to attend, look no farther. Grace is the church for you. Second time attending this church - I’ve lived in Pompano Beach for over a year and I’m glad I found this local church - truly genuine people preaching the word of God. I missed church a lot.  I missed every chance I had when I use to go to church. But yet the devil put a stop Our children have gone to Highlands Christian Academy for 10 years. name: Grace Church - San Bernardino Campus
reviewSummary: I just want to say thank you Grace Church for your outreach to the community for  winning souls for Christ. Thank you Pastor Todd being true to your word. name: Grace Church - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary:
This church has a food bank to distribute to people every week. It is very nice of them,  but they have a priority to certain people. Therefore, they give first choices by first distributing food to only Mexican people on the Saturday.  Whatever is left, they will distribute on the next day (Sunday) to every one who wants.
If you are not Mexican, and shown up on the Saturday, they will yelled out loud "NO FOOD", and ask you to leave even though you can see Mexican people taking/carrying food to their cars in the parking lot.
I don't believe that the church has a GOOD practice of big discrimination in front of JESUS.  I went online, I see the logan, "GRACE CHURCH exists to bring JESUS to ESCONDIDO".
To me, it should be changed to ".....to bring JESUS to MEXICAN" based on what they are unfairly doing.
If I could I would rate no STAR because there should be no discrimination in any churches.  They are bad examples for people, and young kids who initially steps to the faith of believing in JESUS.

The church has a food bank program to share with every one. Most of voluntary people working in the food bank are very nice. Unfortunately, there are same families which have 2 volunteers ( either husband and wife / mother and daughter) so they take twice free foods they wanted to full loading in 2 cars for themselves, no sharing to community.

Below was my experience when I was there on a day in April 2026 to participate it. I came in at 9:20 AM. I left my rolling cart in line and went back in my car to sleep because the food bank would not open until 12PM. There was no one behind me at the time I left my cart there. I was the 4th one in line. I came out my car around 11:25AM to get ready  once the food bank opened. I saw a tall lady standing behind my rolling cart.

Around past noon, when the food bank opened, there was a voluntary lady whose name "Eve" (pronounced as EEVEE) came out. The tall lady who stood next and behind my cart told EVE that I was not here earlier, but only my cart. Eve immediately told me to step out of the line without asking me to verify what lady just said. It was unfair that EVE treated me as I was invisible, and did not respect me who is 66 and older than her a lot.

Therefore, EVE let the lady cut in, and came in first. I spoke up. I insisted telling Eve that I left my cart in line at 9:20 AM, and went back to sleep in my car. Eve smartly (in opposite way) told me that, " I was not here because she came here at 9:00AM."

I said, "You were here at 9:00 AM but you had been inside the whole time so you did not see anything to believe whatever that tall lady said, and you did not let me have my voice. Again, I got here around 9:20AM how could you see me here at 9:00AM?"

That was all, I did not say anything bad at all, but EVE told me AT ONCE that if I continued talking she would prohibit me to come inside the food bank  today and FOREVER."

She repeated again loudly that she wouldn't let me to come to the church forever if I did not stop talking to her. She made me so EMBARRASS with other people who were waiting in line at that time. She treated me as I was a committed crime person in the church that she caught.

I wondered that what did I do wrong, but telling her the correct story. Furthermore, THE GRACE CHURCH IS THE JESUS' HOUSE for any one who believes in JESUS to come praying/socializing. It is NOT her own place/house, and she is not one of pastors either to disallow me coming to the church. On whose behalf, Eve had a right to tell me that she could disallow me to come to the church when I have believed in JESUS, and  not done anything wrong. EVE even mentioned me that she is the church member.

EVE made me waiting forever until 12:45 to let me come inside the food bank.  From the 4th one in line, I was the 34th one to come inside. That was how discriminate EVE did to show her power as a church member there to  me.

Thanks for reading my post. First time there I went to see my daughter sing with the pastor's group. It was beautiful and felt the holy Spirit. The next time I went was for my grandbaby and grandson's dedication and it was beautiful. Really nice people and they have events for kids. This church calls the police on the homeless. Some churches are not driven by the principal of the very book they are supposed to be following. I would not recommend this for worship. This church is a well balanced church. The pastors have a heart after God and truly love the people. They are authentic, and practice what they preach. Lots of prayer warriors in this church pulling for revival. Family oriented. Emotionally and spiritually healthy church. We’ve been prospering in every area of our life since we started attending. Great find!

name: Grace Church at Willow Valley

Grace Church Escondido - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary: This is a wonderful Holy Spirit filled church.  There's not another church in my opinion that is more welcoming.  The truth preaching that comes from God through Pastor Rob has inspired me spiritually for over 12 years. I was invited to attend services by a really nice lady whose spirit is full of kindness and love. So I decided to go, because if you can see the light in someone, then I wanted to see where she was attending services.Just want to say this is not the kind of church you will fall asleep during service! If you’re looking for some inspirational spiritual uplifting, and healing this church will lift you up. Through the music and songs and the message. Get up out of your bed !! Sunday and go !! You’ll leave feeling invigorated and happy and full of the spirit. I attended Grace Church in San Marcos for three years until October of 2022 where Pastor Rob was executive Pastor. He and Becky have left such a positive impression on me and my husband that if we were to go back to San Diego County to live, we would be members of Grace Escondido ♥️ Rob Granger is a true man of God, and an one of the most dynamic pastors alive today preaching the Word of God. You feel the Spirit in his presence. I love this church!  They teach the power of Jesus, that Jesus defeated the devil and has NO hold on the people of the  Lord.  AMEN!

name: Grace Church Melbourne
Grace Church Melbourne - Melbourne Campus
reviewSummary:
I started going to Grace in March of 2025. They welcomed us with open arms. We immediately got connected and started serving. We've become family. If you're looking for a church, give us a year. We'll change your way of things about life. We're transforming the space Coast with the radical love of Jesus! I have attended here 3 times now, with mixed reviews. I have been looking for a new church, but don't believe this one is the right fit for me.
The first time the worship music was way too loud, but the sermon was good though. Second time was perfect, the worship not too loud, and Pastor Olenski did a great job with the sermon.

However this past Sunday when we attended, it was the fullest it has been since we have gone for this particular service. Not only were there individuals that attended that were disrespectful in the service by talking, there were crying babies, and youth that were disrespectful. I usually don't have issues with children, but if they cannot sit through a service, they should be in a youth program or crying babies stepped out with. It wasnt just one or two, it was several within the area we sat. So it was difficult to concentrate on the sermon. Once again the worship and volume were also too loud.
It is probably just me, but I don't believe this is one for me. But is a very popular church for the crowd that does attend.
The pastors sermons are good and do focus on feeding the congregation. They seem to meet the spiritual needs of the ones that are members. Me and my family moved here in 2024 from Colorado. We went to Red Rocks church and loved it, so we were looking for something that gave us that same, “welcome home” feeling. Grace church not only made it welcome, it also gave me and my family a chance to encounter our Heavenly Father.

I’ll admit the first time we went, we didn’t really talk to anyone. But we kept going, and soon enough we got involved and the Lord changed our hearts through it! :)

There’s different connection groups you can join, I’ve been involved with sisterhood, a mom’s group, and the worship team! Each has taught me more about my relationship with the Lord. So thankful I took advantage of those opportunities! 🥰

I grew up non-denominational and have always had a personal relationship with Jesus, but had strayed away from him with a life of going to the clubs and getting into trouble! After having an encounter with Jesus, and trusting his good plan for me I rededicated my life to Him!

Let this year be the year you go to church and find a relationship with Jesus. If there’s something you don’t like, PRAY about it and listen. He will answer. Grace Church has been home for us for almost 13 years. If you’re looking for a church home that loves God, becomes family, loves your babies like their own, and has their heads on straight, this is it! We’ve seen Grace Church through many seasons and would not have stayed this long if the things above weren’t true. Aaron and Nicole lead SO well with integrity and hearts after God and His will. They are genuine and loving, and are living out God’s calling on their lives with excellence! The staff and volunteers are amazing and the culture is so healthy. We’re so blessed to have Grace Church in our lives! If I were reviewing this church based on its amazingly designed building, it would be 5 stars no doubt! If i were reviewing this church based on its worship team, again 5 stars.. The reason i must give this church only 2 stars is because the church was established for the “sick in spirit”, the prodigals, the lost, the mother with infants and small children. A church more focused on how they “appear” rather than the direct biblical teachings of our Christ.

Ive attended the church for a few months. As i work on the road my wife will go at times without me cuz im gone. The many services that i attended were mere watered down messages that seemed to hang in the balance between them “feel good” messages and solid word. Now this is not an attack on the people at all. Every single person we ever met was great! The pastors, great! But if im looking for a church home im looking for a church that follows the teachings of the bible. The bible doesnt mention a single thing about tithe being money but i felt that Grace pushed this almost obligation/necessity to give money. There are so many ways members of a church can be of service that doesnt involve money. But thats neither here nor there. I pray that GOD puts this message on the hearts of the pastors so they know this is not an attack merely my person opinions. Much love and GOD BLESS

name: Grace Church Miami
Grace Church Miami - Miami Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Grace Church has been my home for the past four years, and I’m incredibly grateful for this gospel-centered community. The preaching is expository, faithfully unpacking God’s Word each week, always pointing to Christ. The elders lead and serve with humility, shepherding the flock with love and care.

Beyond the preaching, the people of this church have made a lasting impact on my life. My wife and I have met some of our closest friends here, and we have truly become part of one big family—united by one thing that is everything: Christ, our only hope. Through this solid, gospel-centered, biblical church, I have grown tremendously in my faith—something I attribute not only to the teaching but also to the relationships, accountability, and love within the body.

Grace Church is a faithful witness in a city that desperately needs more churches like this—rooted in Scripture, committed to sound doctrine, and passionate about making disciples. If you’re looking for a Christ-centered community that will challenge, encourage, and equip you, I highly recommend this church. For those who want to drop in and see what Grace Church Miami is about, there is one service every Sunday. It starts at 10:30 AM, and attendees hang around the worship center to chat afterward! Then, we get lunch together at a nearby restaurant 🍽️

It’s easy to park in the lot on the southeast corner of NE 4th Ave and NE 96th St! We’ve been attending Grace Church for a little over six months and are so grateful to have found it. The teaching is biblically sound, the worship is deeply Christ-centered, and there’s a sincere, prayerful atmosphere throughout each service. Our child is well cared for in the children’s ministry, which gives us peace as we worship and grow in the Word. It’s clear that everything done here is rooted in a love for Jesus and a desire to honor Him. Awesome people, facilities and leadership. Most important, was that the teaching and worship were in line with biblical foundation and not concepts invented by modern man. iustus ex fide vivit.  Wow , what an awesome church, what an awesome expository preaching . My wife and I had been praying for such a church as this , and the Lord has provided . Beautiful people , anointed expository preaching, beautiful temple . This is an amazing building , multicultural. This pastor is preaching with unction . May the Lord continue to richly bless and keep His people .
If you come here, just as we did , you’ll love it and you will search no more . This is it🙏🏽

name: Grace Church of Glendora
Grace Church of Glendora - Glendora Campus
reviewSummary:
⚾️⚽️ Grace has a great sports program for kids. We’ve participated in baseball and soccer and it’s been a great experience. It’s not a huge commitment like other youth leagues I hear of in the area. The fees are reasonable and the program is well ran. My husband and I had been searching for the right church for quite some time. After nearly four years of visiting different congregations, we finally found what we were looking for. We've been attending for just a month, and already it feels like home.

Pastor Kevin is phenomenal. His messages are powerful, engaging, and easy to follow. He brings scripture to life in a way that’s both clear and meaningful, helping you truly understand God’s Word and how to apply it to everyday life.

The church community is diverse and welcoming, with people of all ages and backgrounds. There's no pressure—just genuine warmth, fellowship, and a shared love for Christ.

We're so thankful to have found this church, and we’re excited for what’s to come. I am raising my 7 grand kids alone.  It's me and the kids.  Two gentleman from Grace Church showed up at my doorstep here in North Pomona last month on or before November 20, 2023 and gave me and the kids a 15 lb Turkey and a box of fixings.  This included Potatoes, Gravy, Biscuits, Cranberry, Stuffing's, Etc.  We where elated by this, so grateful that they would do this for us. I just can't express my thanks, especially on Thanksgiving.  The hand of God is on all of this, Jesus is our Lord and Savior and nothing could every come between this for us.  I've been raising these kids for the past two years during which on 11-19-21 we had a house fire caused by an electrical short in where it destroyed my house that, me and my wife and kids lived in since 1975.  In the interim I took the kids and lived in motels until I was able to rent a house.  I rebuilt my house via my homeowners insurance, the process took a little over a year before we where able to move back. We just move in our newly rebuilt house January 2023.  God was with us the whole time, I prayed and gave it to the Lord everyday and am so thank for...   What Grace Church had done for us was a blessing from the get-go.  We enjoyed a great thanksgiving feast for our entire family! Thank You Grace Church and your entire Staff and all the Volunteers, donors that had made this possible... God Bless and Thank You So Very Much. "IN GOD WE TRUST" AND IN THE NAME OF JESUS' WE PRAY, AMEN...
Sincerely,
Terry Cotterman The church is welcoming and clear about their Mission and vision for the church. The pastors and staff are dedicated to Jesus and they genuinely go to great lengths to provide ample opportunities for members to join small groups, volunteer, and be active members. They have a traditional and contemporary service and their youth ministry is enormous and engaging. You will feel at home calling Grace Church of Glendora your church. 🏈⚽️ Great girls flag football and boys flag football program as well as soccer. If you are looking for a home church, you need to check this one out. It is great!

name: Grace Church of Orange
Grace Church of Orange - Orange Campus
reviewSummary: I began attending this church in 2020. After almost 2 years of looking for a home church what I found at Grace was this... Biblical preaching and a body of believers who loved Jesus and loved one another. I became a member shortly after attending my first time and have been a member for 6 years. God is with us and in this place. The Holy Spirit is among us and that is displayed by the powerful biblical reformed preaching that occurs on Sundays and in the incredible care and love demonstrated by our elders and our amazing head Pastor Mike Sciarra. Join us!!! This is the church you need I would not recommend this Church to anyone.  As said many times, long time members are not welcoming to new members.  The church leaders did not use safe practice during the pandemic which is very sad, and who knows how many elderly and young children became ill.  Some members were very rude to me because I was Jewish who had an open heart to many religions.  I thank Jesus for leading me to a loving church and Temple.  Grace Church leaders, don’t get defensive and do better. The best Church I've ever attended. Christ centered, gospel proclaiming, disciple making, sacrificially serving Jesus community!! You won't find a better church! If it wasn't for this place...I would have left this communist hell hole called California years ago. The love I have for the people at this church is the only reason I'm here This church has been a blessing for my family and myself! A Bible teaching church, with a congregation that loves God to their core.  If you are looking for growth founded on the word of God, this is the place to be

name: Grace Church of Rancho Cucamonga
Grace Church of Rancho Cucamonga - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary: Been attending Grace for over a year now & my experience here has been like no other church I've been to! My first day here I was introduced to the head pastor, and immediately got plugged into young adults. Since then Grace has became a second home me & I have so many people who pour into me & who have helped me grow in my walk with the Lord! Highly recommend if you're looking for a place to not only have Christ centered community but to also be taught the word of God expository style. Absolutely love it here! Solid gospel centered church that preaches the bible, verse by verse. The saints have been well equipped by the shepherds and it is obvious! New believers who desire to grow and learn will be cared for by a loving congregation and more seasoned believers will be refreshed meeting with like-minded people. I love this church! Our family has been attending for over 6 months now. Everyone is very friendly and introduces themselves. If you are looking for a church that goes through the Bible verse by verse - this is it! This church is multigenerational with lots of kids and families and great childcare options up until kindergarten. I must say it’s welcoming if you want to do it their way. Never understand churches when they first meet you want to tell you how things are supposed to be. Like I’m a clueless follower. One of a small number that do this on your first time. It's a small congregation at am service and the same amount for the evening service. The songs they song during service are hymns and they're so beautiful. The junior pastors welcome as you come in before the services but it didn't have a homey feel. no on in the congregation said hi or welcome. I'll go back to both services again maybe that was just an off day for people. the service was very good and the pastor taught from th bible not from personal stories.

name: Grace Church Plano
Grace Church Plano - Plano Campus
reviewSummary: Grace has been my church home since 2019. I  attended Grace when it was a 20 minute drive and now a 45 minute drive. The diversity and love for community is what keeps me coming back. My husband and I met here while serving in their youth and young adults program. Now, my extended family also attends Grace and we can personally share how great it is for each generation. Praise God!! This is one of the best and anointing church in plano.  Excellence is one of their values.  Love the staff and pastor Gerald is unique. I’m no longer a Christian but as a child my mom took me and my siblings here and I remember it being the most welcoming, positive, uplifting churches I’ve ever been to. Grace has provided me some incredible childhood memories when I was a kid and I’m forever grateful. No words can describe how perfect this place is in every single way. I got luck, Gerald Brooks delivered the message thia morning.  Nice church and volunteers.  Can't wait until the Wednesday night service and options to volunteer. Just started attending not long ago after moving to the area. Everyone has been super welcoming and friendly. Feels like I’ve been attending for years already. The youth services, and how its not just babysitting, is the best I’ve seen. They love the kids and are passionate about growing them with Christ and educating them. Love it!

name: Grace Church San Diego
Grace Church San Diego - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary:
Came here to visit for Easter Sunday as first time visit. I have been God serving for over 18 years now but I do have some feedback for the church staff. As a first comer I was not greeted at all when coming in. Rather I was stared at while walking in by a big group of members of the church. The pastors message was great. I decided to give the coffee a try and quickly experienced the same thing. I received another stare from a middle aged blonde lady working in the coffee shop. It was a very unfriendly stare and none of the church members spoke to me. It felt like a very unfriendly and “clique”ish atmosphere. If I was not a Christian I would never come back to church if this was my first time experience. One man greeted me on my way out but I say this out of love please the staff needs to do better. But the pastor message was great. Easter Sunday is an open door for people who don’t know God unbiased with no judgement for anyone to walk in and feel loved and we did not get that loving vibe. Coffee is not enough. There needs to be love. I recommend building and training a strong welcome team who goes the extra mile to greet people As military transitioning into the area, we tried attending this church for our first Sunday service in San Diego. First off parking is a nightmare. There are signs but there is no one from the dream team directing traffic. As a result we were very confused and couldn’t find parking for 10 minutes.
On top of that when we went to Grace Kids to check in our baby one of the volunteers working the kiosk left completely to help someone else and as a result we did not figure out how to check in our kids or where to take them so we ended up carrying our 5 month old to service. When we walked through the door we were not greeted with not even so much as a fake smile. When we walked into the main sanctuary we were just told to go to the balcony in an unfriendly manner where you can barely see the pastor and by the time we did that worship music was already done. Maybe this church is a good church for some people as they had many in attendance but we will not be back because we were not welcomed or helped at all. We ended up leaving 5 minutes into service to go somewhere else. The start of the message was very confusing and there was no back fill for first time guests. Everything about this church seems off balance and there is not a standard set on anything. If the church’s dream team cannot provide an easy, friendly, and welcoming experience it would give the perception that the church staff doesn’t care about how things are run. Not friendly and not welcoming and not considerate of first time guests. While visiting San Diego, we attended a Sunday service at this local church near our hotel. The streets were packed with cars, and we were worried about finding a spot for our rental, but luckily, they had a designated visitor parking area. We stopped by the welcome booth, where a friendly couple gave us a brief overview of the church and answered our questions with a smile. They even gave us coupons for free coffee! After the service, we enjoyed a delicious coffee (worth over $5) at the on-site cafe right next to the church. I have visited Grace 3 or 4 times.  Its a rather large church. It appears to have mostly young families and singles. I am not in that age group, but it is a very loving and friendly church. The preaching is scripturally accurate, loving and encoupppraging.  There seems to be something for everyone.  I will return! Parking is a bit of a challenge. I’ve been attending Grace Church for almost three years after moving here from Hermosa Beach. We were looking for a Spirit-led church that openly teaches the Trinity and the Holy Spirit, and Grace does that. The people are welcoming and it’s easy to build real friendships, and there are many ways to serve. The pastors are relatable, approachable, and easy to talk to, you can always find them after service. It’s not a huge church, but they offer multiple services with childcare. Their podcast (Deeper than Sunday) is also a great way to go deeper after the message. My husband especially loves the church’s heart for missions and sending people out to serve and teach. Like any group of imperfect people, everyone here is truly trying to love one another and build God’s kingdom together!

The streets were packed with cars, and we were worried about finding a spot for our rental, but luckily, they had a designated visitor parking area. We stopped by the welcome booth, where a friendly couple gave us a brief overview of the church and answered our questions with a smile. They even gave us coupons for free coffee! After the service, we enjoyed a delicious coffee (worth over $5) at the on-site cafe right next to the church. I have visited Grace 3 or 4 times.  Its a rather large church. It appears to have mostly young families and singles. I am not in that age group, but it is a very loving and friendly church. The preaching is scripturally accurate, loving and encoupppraging.  There seems to be something for everyone.  I will return! Parking is a bit of a challenge. I’ve been attending Grace Church for almost three years after moving here from Hermosa Beach. We were looking for a Spirit-led church that openly teaches the Trinity and the Holy Spirit, and Grace does that. The people are welcoming and it’s easy to build real friendships, and there are many ways to serve. name: Grace Church Tampa Palms
Grace Church Tampa Palms - Tampa Palms Campus
reviewSummary: My wife and I are so grateful to be a family of Grace, the fruits of the spirit is very evident at Grace ,especially love .We adore  this church ,may God continue to bless, strengthen and guide the leadership and all members of Grace. Thank you for your love               . Roderick and Elsie Shirley Grace Church has a warm and welcoming feeling.  From the moment you step through the doors, you can feel the love not only for the Lord but between the congregation.  It is a family.  When the service is through, you feel as though you have been spiritually awakened.  Our spiritual leader, Father Ben, as he is lovingly called, speaks from the heart during his sermons.  If you love music, then come listen to our choir at the 10:00 AM service.  You'll be amazed what this neighborhood church has to offer. It's filled with an atmosphere of faith; the music and sounds are wonderful. What a great place to worship.  My daughter loves it.  Their youth Sunday (last Sunday of the month) is fabulous; the children lead the church and even have a Youth Band.  Many Episcopal churches are stuffy; this one is not at all and has something for everyone.  Best kept secret in the area.  I hope to see others try it; I think they will be quite pleased. What I love about this church is that the pastor is a true man of God willing to speak the truth even if it is not what sounds good in man's ears.  How refreshing to have boldness in the pulpit, beautiful music from the choir (and the youth on youth Sunday) and a community of believers from many different backgrounds.  Solo deo Gloria!

name: Grace City Church
Grace City Church - Irvine (Woodbridge) Campus
reviewSummary:
Solid Church with relevant and practical teaching based on Bible, serving the community around it.
This is one of the legit and well balanced Christian churches in this area. They meet at Jeffrey Trail Middle School with a plan to acquire a building and move to a more permanent location near the Great Park in the near future. The Pastor's teaching is well grounded in the Bible and brings practical life applications. Members are mature Christians and are genuine. Ethnic make up of the congregation seems 60% Caucasians, 30% Asians, and 10% Others. I can recommend this church to anyone in this area looking for a rock solid, legitimate church that you can call a community church. I will post photos later. Absolutely love this church! From the moment we stepped on-site, people were so friendly, inviting, and welcoming. They live up to their name of creating an atmosphere of grace and life. We’ve easily gotten plugged in and serving on a team and love now getting to be a part of creating the same experience for guests. The teaching goes deep into the Bible and we feel like we leave each Sunday with a better understanding of God’s word and that Carrie’s throughout the week in our small groups. If you’re looking for a church that’s genuine, authentic, and relatable with an inviting and welcoming atmosphere, then this is the place where you belong! I have been recently attending Grace City Church, and I must say, the experience was nothing short of amazing. Pastor Stephen Kimbrell truly brings the Bible to life with his engaging and kind teaching style. He is incredibly approachable, making it easy to ask questions and delve deeper into the faith.

From the moment I arrived, I felt welcomed. The community is warm and inviting, as if we were already friends. The staff ensured we had all the resources we needed as newcomers to the faith, which was a great touch. I appreciated how they distributed cards before the service to gauge our learning preferences and spiritual journeys.

One of my favorite parts of the service was the music at the beginning. The heartfelt songs performed by church members really resonated with me, setting a meaningful tone for the worship.

The sense of community at Grace City Church is truly special; it feels like a family. I’m grateful to have found such a supportive place. My kids also love attending—there are engaging programs for them, and they enjoy playing with their friends at church. Plus, there are plenty of community events that bring everyone together.

Overall, I would highly recommend Grace City Church. If you're looking for a place that feels like home, this is it! Grace City Church is truly a place that you can call home. From the moment you walk through the doors, you are greeted with warmth and kindness from everyone you encounter. The members of this church are truly welcoming, and it's clear that they value building relationships with one another.

The community at Grace City Church is truly something special. Whether you're a long-time member or a newcomer, you will quickly feel like you're part of the family. Everyone is so supportive and encouraging, and it's clear that they are all passionate about their faith and sharing it with others.

In addition to the welcoming atmosphere and strong sense of community, the worship services at Grace City Church are truly inspiring. The music is uplifting and meaningful, and the messages are always relevant and thought-provoking. You will leave each service feeling renewed and refreshed, with a deeper understanding of your faith and a renewed sense of purpose.

Overall, I would highly recommend Grace City Church to anyone looking for a place to call home. The people are wonderful, the community is strong, and the worship services are truly uplifting. Whether you're just starting your faith journey or have been a believer for years, you will find a warm welcome and a supportive community at Grace City Church. Amazing church! Very genuine & caring community. We love the Sunday school for our kids! The pastor & family pastor are bible based and powerful preachers & the worship team is so good! Grace City has changed mine and my families life and we're so thankful to find this church in Irvine. They're about disciples making disciples and we have found life long friends here. I highly encourage joining a city group and serving to get plugged in! ❤️

name: Grace City LA
Grace City LA - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Grace City LA offers vibrant worship, heartfelt community, and practical teachings. It’s a welcoming church focused on authentic faith and real-life impact. Highly recommended! I visited Grace City LA and it was a blessing. Pastor Steve Cha is a faithful preacher of Gods Word. The worship service focuses on exalting and glorifying God based on Truth. If you are looking for a church that is faithful to worshipping God in accordance to His Word, then this is a great church. Grace City also strongly focuses on evangelism in Sharing the Gospel. It was a blessing hearing about their evangelism to the community. If you are looking to get plugged into a new and growing church and are seeking solid scripture-based teaching, I HIGHLY recommend that you check out Grace City LA. I've been a regular attendee of Grace City LA's weekly bible studies for the past three months, and it still surprises me to see how much I've learned and grown as a believer in this short period of time. There's a clarity and boldness in the presentation of the Gospel here that I've never really experienced elsewhere, and it makes a marked difference. It's truly remarkable.

Also, since Grace City LA is a new church, there's plenty of room for you to get involved and serve the growing ministry. Everyone is incredibly welcoming and down-to-earth, and their excitement and enthusiasm for the new ministry is really contagious and refreshing to see.

Lastly, the church is located at the western edge of downtown LA, which has recently been undergoing a lot of development and change, so I see a huge opportunity for Grace City LA to really make an impact on the immediate community--both the long-time residents and the newly arriving folks. There's a big passion on the part of the leadership team for local outreach and evangelism, so I'm really excited to see the transformation that Grace City LA will bring in the future. If you want to know the truth of God's Word, this is the place to be.  The pastor, Steve Cha is an excellent expositor of the Bible.  You will grow in your relationship with the Lord and be a brighter light for Christ.  The church loves evangelism!  I really enjoyed the service and the donuts!  If you live in the downtown area of Los Angeles, then Grace City LA is for you! I heard a wonderful message from Pastor Steve who was kind and very patient with my questions. I appreciate biblical and expository preaching, and thought it was amazing that Grace City LA does street evangelism open-air preaching as a church after each service. They are committed to the Great Commission of proclaiming the GOSPEL to the lost. I felt joy from Holy Spirit during worship so praise God for this new church!

name: Grace City Tampa
Grace City Tampa - Tampa (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Grace City Tampa is the real deal. If you’re looking for a church that’s firmly rooted in Scripture, this is it. Every message is biblically sound, and you can tell the leaders carry a deep honor and reverence for God’s Word. The culture here is incredibly welcoming—genuine, caring, and full of people who actually live out what they believe. The worship? Next level. Easily the best band I’ve ever heard, and it’s not about performance; it’s all about glorifying God. And I love how invested this church is in serving the community beyond its walls. So thankful to call this place home. Grace City is the best Church in Tampa. Great message the pastor puts his heart and soul into. Passionate worship and service. Welcoming entrance and friendly atmosphere. Plenty of teams to join, and baptisms on the regular. Best coffee so far in Tampa great single origin from Colombia to die for.
To everyone try Colombia single origin and the guys are absolutely fantastic Great young thriving church. We visited here when we were over from the UK this weekend and felt very welcomed as a family. Modern worship, great Bible based talk from the lead pastor, thoughtful kids church and a great venue. Would definitely recommend and attend again if we are in town. My first and last visit to GraceCity Tampa was on Mother's Day when my adult daughter, husband and myself visited. We have been in ministry ourselves for 26 years, and were away from home. While the word was good, the people were cold and indifferent to us as visitors. Not even one person spoke to us, welcomed us, or so much as said hello. I post this hoping that you will look into your hearts and ask yourselves if that is how you think Christ would treat visitors.
