name: Grace Community Church - Jacksonville (Southside) Campus
reviewSummary:
This is the first and only church we attended since moving across the country. Someone my wife knew from her teen years invited us to attend when we were assembling a list of churches to visit. It was at top of our list and we gladly accepted. 4 years later and here we are. This Body is so welcoming and loving and Pastor Justin preaches amazing sermons! It is so refreshing to be in a church that actually opens God’s Word and teaches straight from it too.
We have been blessed in so many ways by our brothers and sisters here! Pros:

+ Friendly, although misguided, congregation and leadership

+ Opportunities for discipleship

+ Good children's ministry

+ Rich worship music

Cons:

- Sermons are at least 50 minutes. Many people struggle to pay attention for this duration. The senior pastor has said that he himself sometimes forgets the previous Sunday’s sermon outline.

- No real diversity in views. Every man who teaches has received his education/training from the church itself, The Master's Seminary, or The Expositors Seminary.

- Calvinism is taught as a fact based on the misinterpretation of a few passages like Romans 9 and Ephesians 1, and despite heaps of scriptural evidence to the contrary (John 3:16, 1 Timothy 2:3-6, 2 Peter 3:9, etc.). Not only does this seriously impugn God’s character, but it can cause a bizarre attitude in people. They’re the “chosen ones.” I once heard someone enthusiastically say “God could have predestined me for Hell, and it would be for His glory.”

- Dispensationalism and “Left Behind” rapture theology are taught as a fact.

- Dating environment is complicated, bordering on dysfunctional. Singles and relationships must be approved by leadership.

- Overall, I think it’s fair to say that this church flirts with the BITE Model of control. Grace Community Church is a Bible-believing church. Pastor Justin does an excellent job preaching the Bible verse by verse, also known as expository preaching. My family and I recently moved to this area, and the congregants have welcomed us with open arms. We feel at home. We feel loved and are very happy and grateful to God for having led us to this community of believers. At Grace Community Church, you will find a church that is filled with a deep love and fear of God that is joyful and beautiful.
However, what truly sets Grace Community Church apart is their unwavering commitment to biblical truth. The preaching here is expository, focused solely on what the Bible teaches without relying on religiosity or man's opinion. This calls us to stay grounded in the teachings of Scripture and to continually grow in our faith.

The people at Grace Community Church are what make it truly special. The love and fear of God is evident in every aspect of the church, from how members treat one another to the hospitality that is shown to visitors. The leadership models humility and genuine care, always making themselves available and approachable.

My family and I have been at Grace Community Church for 15 years & we highly recommend Grace Community Church to anyone seeking a Christ-centered, biblical church that is dedicated to truth and love. Come and join us to grow in the word of God in a body of believers that seeks to serve and glorify Him above all. Very welcoming group of believers! Traditional/acoustic worship service. Very nice facility with good children's ministry.

Notes on first visit:

Definitely a particular perspective on the place of evangelism in the modern Christian life - message focused
more on being a "stalwart defender of the Church" than a "Fisher of men". Signs/wonders are regarded as a misinterpretation of Scripture.

Overall a great group of Christians and a great choice!

name: Grace Community Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary: Just absolutely loved it! Everyone very Welcoming, very approachable, friendly, kind, helpful, everyone just makes you feel at home, smiles everywhere.. I will come back when I return to Riverside.. A MUST!! Met some Amazing people. No matter if I was In Hesperia, Devore, Rialto, Fontana I would make sure I would make it to church on Sunday mornings. Love my church family. Service times Sundays at 9 am and 10:45 am, childcare from infant to 6th grade. Prime time on wednesdays ftom 7 pm to 8 pm for the whole family; infant to 6th grade, jr. High & High school classes, adults. I love my church family at Grace. It is a Bible teaching church and Pastor Nathan definitely has a gift to do just that. Teach us the Bible! You will constantly be learning from God’s word here. You will be encouraged, strengthened, and empowered to open up the word for yourself. When you join Grace, you are not just being spiritually fed (which is amazing), but because of that, you are also joining a group of people who love God, love his church, and want to see others thrive faithfully in a personal relationship with Christ. Worship is also awesome. It is lead with Christ in mind, Pastor John makes sure to prioritize the word and where our minds should be when we worship (centered on Jesus). Overall, all of our Pastors have a real love for the fold of God and shepherding His sheep. There are people here serving in children’s ministry, jr high and high school ministries, the young adult ministry AND even behind the scenes who lead with great joy for our Lord Jesus and make it a core value to keep pointing you to the gospel of Jesus who gave His life to give us ours. Awesome for all ages. I went to this church today to their 10AM service. Worship was only 15 minutes, which was disappointing. It was a beautiful service although I was not allowed to have my toddler and 9 month old in the sanctuary. They initially ushered me into the “nursing mother’s room which had a big screen in there. I didn’t want to be in there, so I was forced to take my littles into their kids’ ministry. The pastor seemed very friendly and young. He extended an invitation to anyone who wanted to meet him at the end of service at the altar which was nice. In my opinion, this church is just like Harvest, but way smaller, and without the free drinks, snacks, etc. Visited this church twice with my husband and sadly this church is not very friendly or welcoming to new guests. No one talked to us or welcomed us. We made sure to arrive 15min early too to hopefully connect with someone about this church but we sat there and people walked by us, they just stayed in there little groups talking amongst each other. Disappointing.

name: Grace Community Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary:
Wonderful church were they explain scripture and how it applies to our life. If you want to learn a out God and Jesus and how to have a personal relationship with Jesus this is a place to learn and grow. Take time to go to the book store to, many Wonderful books and Bibles. praise the Lord for your service in the teachings of the Christ brother and you have a wonderful home. thank you especially for your passing of the messages that we so need in these uncertain financial times such as the camel and the eye of the needle, storing treasures in Heaven and not on earth, the serving of the two masters and the very sad story of the traveling rich man in search of the Kingdom of Heaven which i feel may have a very personal connection to us all. God bless you all and thank you for loving each other If there was ever a time I wish I could leave a 0 star review it would be for Grace Community Church. I attended this church for three years. There wasn’t a single time over the course of those three years that I felt that my soul was cared for. They preach hell, fire, and brimstone even to children. They use fear to hold people captive so that they will become church members who will adhere to unrealistic tithing standards. They have turned the message of salvation into a business. For those who attend, I would encourage you to reconsider the systems in place here. For those considering attending, I recommend keeping yourself and your children safe from manipulation and fear-based tactics. Grace Community Church is so ausome! I have followed this ministry for probably four decades. I love a church that holds strongly to the Word of God! Baptisms on Sunday evenings are so special and encouraging. The testimonies of each canidate show the depth of the word that is so well communicated from the pulpit. Brad Klassen is so in tune and compassionate with each one he baptizes. All the ministries of GCC honor God. GTY.org has over 6M messages from Gods Word on its app.
I live in Wisconsin and think about moving to California just to attend. This is NOT a non denomination church but a 5 points Calvinists church Alas, 3/4 of the people don't even know they are.

For example the fundamental of faith (which I took) never clearly tell you that they are a 5 point Calvinism church and that is too bad.

name: Grace Community Church Boca
Grace Community Church Boca - Boca Raton Campus
reviewSummary:
Today, a good friend picked me up to join her at Grace Community Church for an outstanding Easter celebration service. The congregation was warm and welcoming, and the Church grounds were decorated beautifully for the most important celebration of the year!!!

Pastor Jason gave an outstanding sermon, and the music was AMAZING!!! The singer's voices were straight from God!!! I hope to be back before I move out of Boca!!!

I highly recommend a service at Grace Community Church 🤍🤍🤍 - it's totally UPLIFTING !!! Such a great Church.  Pastor Jason is committed to Boca and really cares about this community!   I have had nothing but great interactions with the staff. If you are looking for a church near you where you can feel like you fit right in then
join me here at Grace Community Church Boca Raton. A super friendly group of family oriented, Jesus followers that worship in spirit and in truth.
(Located on Camino Real about a half mile west of Dixie.)
Pastor Jason teachers straight from the Bible, relevant life-changing topics every Sunday that provide a time of focusing on what the word of God the Bible, says about His love for us and what His will for our lives is for today in these challenging times.
The contemporary worship service is amazing. You are going to love the awesome music, songs and vocals in the time of worship with our church family in the sanctuary and the time of prayer because we all need that!
There is childcare provided, coffee & donuts, of course and an adult Sunday morning Bible study that starts at nine in the El Rio room, adjacent to the sanctuary.
Hope to see you here. Come and make it your home too. When you walk into Grace, you feel apart of the family. Such a nice community - Sundays here kick off the week with such joy! I found an American family here, where every Sunday I really have the opportunity to learn more about God.

It is a joy to see how the church is concerned about integrating young people and children so that we have a future generation of worshipers and people who love God with all their hearts.

I am a volunteer and with great pleasure to be part of this church that is concerned in doing everything beautiful and organized.

It's beautiful the way we are directed to God and the concern to reach more people from the local community to actually have an encounter with God.

I am very proud of the leaders of this church.  People who serve with love, humility and affection/care for everyone.
I really see the love of God in them!
Polite and capable people who bring us closer to God every day.
Definitely I love my church, I love this Grace family that God gave me.
#ilovemychurch

And if you have a child, be sure to visit this place!  Amazing people, worship, message and Sunday school.
Lots of events dedicated to the little ones and adults too. Visit the website and check it out.

I hope you can visit this place and have a good experience like I've been having in the last 2 years

name: Grace Community Church of Saddleback Valley
Grace Community Church of Saddleback Valley - Lake Forest Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a great church. Pastor Michael is the most knowledgeable pastor I have ever known personally. Because of their strong dedication to the bible and God they are able to overcome any challenge that is placed in front of them, whether that challenge comes from within or without. People are fallible, God is not, which is why we all need a Savior. This is what the bible teaches and this is what Grace teaches. Love God and Love People. Pastor Stephen is amazing in his worship through sermons. He provides a clear message through scripture directly to my heart each week. Grace Community Church of Saddleback Valley is a great place of love and worship. This is a place where real people are worshipping and serving a real God. Jesus Christ is our Lord and Savior and His grace and mercy are shared through this body of believers. I love this church one they had a awana’s from my boys when they were little
I was a single mom of six, and they always take care of me! Even before I joined the church. Treated me like I was already family. New upbeat Pastor.  Great music.  Wonderful 1st message. I'm going back.

Grace Community Church South Bay
Grace Community Church South Bay - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Grace Community Church South Bay is a biblically grounded church with faithful, Christ-centered teaching. I really appreciate their commitment to sound doctrine, expository preaching, and creating a welcoming community focused on growing in God’s Word. Highly recommend for anyone looking for a solid Reformed church. If you are looking for a church that preaches the Bible this is the church. Every Sunday and Wednesday they preach verse by verse! I would recommend you to visit to experience this type of preaching. Great church! Great preaching. Pastor takes you thru the Scriptures and makes it easy to understand. The church is very welcoming and has a big young adults group. Everyone is very friendly. The guy that does the announcements (I think his name is Luis) is hilarious! Overall 5/5. Great expository preaching and very convicting. Glad to have a church like this in the South Bay 10/10 Church. Amazing gospel presentation. This is a new South Bay church plant started in the home of Ulises Galvez. I've attended the Bible study nearly 2 years ago and have not looked back. This pastor is studying at The Masters Seminary so I know he's learning from top tier instructors. I am proud to serve at this church because we are being powered by Christ. I highly recommend this church service on Wednesday nights and Sunday mornings.

name: Grace Covenant Christian Church of the Harvest
Grace Covenant Christian Church of the Harvest - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: Im only giv8ng a 2 star because nobody talked to me at this church when I visited with a member afew times like 6 years ago. She is black I am only 8 different nationalities and not black, my son is. I did recognize how they really lift up the young black chikdren and it is absolutely the only time I've ever seen this done, mind you I am from Oakland CA was raised by a black foster family and attended an all black baptist church. This is absolutely an amazing church, and these people got it right! Heck, they really emphasize education, abd repeatedly tell their young kids they are strong and black. I did not invite my son ofcpurse, because he would have noticed the shunning. I highly value education and my son did graduate from U.C.S.D.and is blessed to have a mother like me. Unfortunately nobody seemed to notice. That's o.k. cuz Hod does. I still recommend this church if you are black, though. God bless. I feel the Spirit of the Lord GOD every time I walk into the sanctuary!  The prayer time, the worship music, the testimonies, the preached WORD, the joy, the fellowship...I could go on and on! It all is firmly based in the Bible and inspires me to run harder and faster for JESUS!! When I first visited Grace Covenant I was in desperate need of a church home. I had just given my life to Jesus but needed somewhere special to serve him. I was attending The Rock but not connected to it. I missed the closeness of a real "Church Home" and real praise & worship. I immediately felt loved and welcomed when I stepped into Grace. The genuine love of everyone drew me in but the praise & worship kept me there. I found a place to plant my feet and grow my roots. It has been 7 years I came to Grace on a Tuesday night prayer, and I now am raising my children in this Holy Ghost filled, God fearing, praise & worship lifting Church Home. This is a spirit filled church! The worship was like no other. You will definitely feel the presence of the Lord! The Word is so rich. The senior Pastor breaks down the word of God so that it is simple to understand. I like how they have other Pastors that brings the word. They all have different ways but it is all powerful! This church spreads a lot of love and are very welcoming. I came out here to go to school and I was looking for a home away from home. I found it when I came here! Not only do the people here show you so much love, they also preach the truth and you can tell that the relationships that the people have here with God are genuine. It is what inspired me to develop my own close and personal relationship with God, and the teachings that I have received here are what has brought me to this point in my relationship with God today! I HIGHLY RECOMMEND this church for anyone who truly wants to feel the presence of the LORD and grow in his/her walk with Him. I give Grace Covenant Christian Church of the Harvest 5 stars all the way.

name: Grace Episcopal Church
Grace Episcopal Church - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary: Wonderful quaint little church with two services. Nice people and a caring pastor. Lovely little church. The people are amazing and friendly. Was very overwhelmed when my Mom passed and they helped me from beginning to end. I've never met such a nice community of people. The very best church that I have ever attended! Great people, family environment! Highly recommend for anyone looking for a place to worship. Wonderful congregation with warm and welcoming atmosphere This is a great small church with a friendly feel. If you like a church that is welcoming to all and teaches the love of Christ by example, then you've found the right place at Grace.

name: Grace Fellowship
Grace Fellowship - West Palm Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
A great place to hear the word of God proclaimed in a most relatable fashion. There is a Pastor there that give the most amazing hugs. Sometimes the background music and instruments overwhelm the voices of the most excellent chorus. 6/29/2022

Visited Grace Fellowship while I was here on vacation. I chose this one because it is similar to my home church. The Pastor was engaging and the Praise & Worship team were good. When I come back to Florida to visit family I'll visit this church again! I absolutely love this church it’s a honor to be a member they sing beautiful music for Jesus plus pastor Jeff never disappoints with his preaching he’s so amazing at what he does and he doesn’t preach a luke warm gospel I admire how he’s not afraid to say the hard things and that’s exactly what Jesus would want him too do! I ❤️ Grace Fellowship a church for all nations! Don’t look any further choose this church you won’t regret it !!! I attended as a visitor today.  Great Bible based teaching and people made me feel welcome from the parking lot to the greeters.   God Bless this church and all those who attended. I started attending Grace Fellowship this month and I have to say there is such a huge bunch of wonderful people. I love this church. Thank you to Pastor Frank for Baptizing me today. I feel so great words can’t express. I am so excited to start my new foundation at Grace Fellowship. I look forward to service and growing in my faith. Thank you Grace Fellowship

name: Grace Fellowship Church
Grace Fellowship Church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
AMAZING pastor. Doctrinally sound teaching. Great children's ministry. Passionate worship. 1000% recommended. Home church.

Pretty great group of folks trying to love Jesus.

Mixed old timers, young families, and youth.

Good Orange County families and multi-generational attendance. Love this place because of the people - stellar leadership across the board. Grateful.

Amazing young children’s support as well. Pastor Dave is awesome,Christian church has traditional feel very friendly members, strong evangelical vibes Ill be back love this place, not overly smart with message words or harsh, one puts you on,”you might be “”not you are”, standpoint. name: Grace First Presbyterian Church
Grace First Presbyterian Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: My fantastic church. I love it here. Grew up here, and will keep coming back. My wife and I have been members of Grace First for almost three years. We were attracted to the church by its friendliness and the sense of community among members of all ages. And we like the church's top-notch music programs and concerts. This church welcomes anyone with open arms! They have a website, gracefirst.org where you can watch their live stream 9AM services.  The music director composed a beautiful 5 movement Christmas Contada.  They cook and serve food and hold Third Street services to the homeless downtown.  They have Deacons that are there for you personally. They have on-campus concerts from various artists and groups who entertain the Long Beach jazz, country, etc aficionados.  They even went to help out in the Hurricane Katrina disaster, to the West Virginia backhills and even to Peru to help those in need. These folks really care! I've attended this church since I was a child. It's mission of connecting people of different age, ethnicity, and cultural backgrounds shines through. Amazing music program and events for every age and interest! This is a beautiful church with very welcoming members.  I love attending the 9:00 service with the choir.

name: Grace Grove Church
Grace Grove Church - Garden Grove Campus
reviewSummary: Grace Grove Church teaches the Grace of Jesus Christ in the New Covenant. This is the place to come in Southern California. Part of Network 220. Wonderful people. Rich in their traditions. Great programs for the children, Awanas club all during the school year and Vacation bible school in the summer. Love this place! Love My New hutch Family. Very Unified!!

name: Grace Harbor Church & School
Grace Harbor Church & School - Tustin Campus
reviewSummary:
Grace Harbor has been such a blessing for our family. It has truly been the best place for our son, Jackson. He is always excited to go to daycare and absolutely adores his teachers.

The teachers are incredibly caring and intentional—spending meaningful time with him as he learns, explores, and discovers new things each day. We also love that Grace Harbor incorporates Bible-based lessons and sends home the cutest artwork that we treasure.

Knowing our child is loved, supported, and growing in such a positive environment gives us complete peace of mind. I would highly recommend Grace Harbor to any parent looking for a nurturing and faith-centered daycare for their baby. My friends and I were at the Sunday 700PM AA meeting, and were kicked out for having a service dog and for an individual with Tourette’s Syndrome.  We were treated poorly and they were extremely rude.  Do not attend. This has been the worst school experience my family has ever had. I thought long and hard before writing this review, but I feel it’s important to share our experience. My child attended this school for one year. During that time, I received nearly 20 incident reports. My child was hit, bitten, and physically attacked multiple times. At first I assumed this was normal behavior for very young children and decided to wait and see. Unfortunately, the situation did not improve. After transferring to a new school, my child finally shared that he was being repeatedly bullied—the other child would hit and bite him, and when he tried to move away, the child would follow and continue. But teachers told us that the children involved were my kid’s “best buddies”. So ridiculous...  One incident was especially alarming. My child peed in his pants, and no one noticed for hours. By the time I picked him up, his pant had already dried, but his shoes and socks were still soaked in pee. No staff member informed us or addressed the situation. This was the final reason we decided to leave. The contrast after transferring schools was immediate. On the first day at his new school, my child came home singing songs—something he never did during the entire previous year. Now he goes to school happy every day, whereas drop-off at this school was a daily struggle. Called 5 times and left multiple messages to inquire about their preschool enrollment. The numbers for both school and church didn't go anywhere. We got frustrated and just signed up our daughter to another Tutor Time in Irvine. Beautiful facility. Great convenient parking. Watched a speaker and was impressed by the message of experience, strength, and hope. Fabulous break out room and great accoustics.

name: Grace Harvest Church
Grace Harvest Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary: Was invited by a friend n it was so good to go to a true Bible believing church, wonderful traditional worship and straight from Bible preaching, not to mention a few women who made their way to say hello to me, very kind!! Truly enjoyed the service!! I had a powerful holy spirit experience here. I will highly recommend this church to anyone that needs to hear a word from God Great church hidden in Los Angeles county Ppl here are truly family everyone here including the pastors are great group of ppl highly recommend this church You found your place in Grace Very pretty

name: Grace Hills Church
reviewSummary: Grace Hills is a warm, welcoming church home. Pastor Mike is wonderful.

name: Grace Hills Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: I attended here several times during my own ministry Sabbatical. It was a great group of genuine people from age groups and walks of life. I really can’t say enough good things about this church. It’s been many months since I’ve been and I still think of the love, kindness and spiritual care of the people there. My family has been so happy to have found Grace Hills! After living down the street for over 5 years and attending another church, we decided to check out Grace Hills. It is a smaller church than our previous one and we love that! It feels like coming 'home' to visit family every Sunday. Everyone is so warm and welcoming and there are many ways to get involved, from VBS, to Small Groups, to Womens monthly breakfasts, and much more. Not to mention the most important part, the sermons are solid Bible teaching from a wonderful and easy to relate to Pastor! My wife and I have been attending Grace Hills Church for about two years. We are so blessed by the teaching of God's word by our Pastor Mike. We love attending our weekly Life Group and our time of fellowship.  What a great place to attend and worship. I'Ve  been attending Grace Hills Church since 2009.I have my church home, somewhere I can worship with other believers, where I feel loved and accepted. CHRIST is taught and HIS WORD explained .  I feel comfortable with the contemporary service because it is a little more informal and casual.  Really enjoy the Life group where we learn to know each other and pray for one another,  and where the Sunday message  is discussed and questions are answered This has been our home church since 1995.  I love the teaching and my church family.  We have both contemporary worship in the 9:15am  service and traditional music at the 11am service, with a fellowship time in between with coffee, muffins and fruit.  We are a good size family church, not too small that everyone knows your business and not too big that you get swallowed up.  If you visit, stop by the kitchen and fellowship hall and say Hi to me.  I work in the kitchen pretty much every Sunday but I can take a few minutes to show you around and introduce to some friends.  :)

Grace Irvine - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary:
Love this Church! This is a church that glorifies God and benefits people, manifesting His grace and glory, while also revealing the dignity of humanity! Sincere, passionate, filled with God’s love and presence, I feel that Grace Irvine is the home of God, and a home for those like you and me who are seeking Him! I highly recommend Grace Irvine Church to anyone seeking a faithful, gospel-centered spiritual family.

The sermons here are deeply orthodox, firmly grounded in Scripture, and delivered with clarity and conviction. You can always count on receiving solid, uncompromised biblical truth every Sunday.

Furthermore, the staff and ministry team are incredibly dedicated and spiritually mature. They truly live out their faith, displaying a genuine love for Christ and a heart for serving others in everything they do.

Their regular Bible studies are also outstanding. They are deeply engaging, spiritually rich, and provide an excellent environment for anyone looking to grow seriously in their understanding of God's Word. Whether you are new to the area or looking for a healthy community to call home, this church is a wonderful place to grow. This is a small but growing church with a genuine love for God and people. The pastor’s messages are powerful, practical, and rooted in Scripture. I’m grateful to be part of this church family. I’ve really enjoyed being part of this church. The community is warm, the teaching is faithful to God’s Word, and I’ve found grace, peace, love and encouragement here. A small growing church that makes me feel like home. Pastor’s messages are powerful. I’ll keep going

reviewSummary: My second favorite Los Angeles church. It's been a few years. Lots of fond memories. I served as vacancy pastor during my vicarage back in 1989/90. I visit every few years or so. name: Grace Lutheran Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautiful high traditional Lutheran service. The organ is well-maintained and elegant with a skillful organist. Law and gospel in the sermon and a welcoming congregation. The pastor is well-spoken and a good orator, and is also skilled in chanting The chapel feels historic, with artful stained glass and excellent theological symbolism. If you are LCMS, I cannot recommend Grace Lutheran enough. The traditional Divine Service at Grace Lutheran Church provides a beautiful liturgical experience. The liturgy is conducted with great reverence, and the messages delivered by Pastor Thomas are insightful and inspiring. The pipe organ and beautiful Lutheran hymns add greatly to the worship service. There is a strong sense of community despite the “commuter aspect” of the congregation. People from all over the county attend and call Grace Lutheran home. The focus on Scripture, Law/Gospel, and the Lord’s Supper, combined with the congregation's warmth and love, provides an uplifting experience where one feels connected to Christ and spiritually fed. This is one of the most beautiful worship spaces on the west coast AND, one gets to receive God's free gifts of the forgiveness of sins and the strengthening of one's trust in Christ's promises via His words rightly preached and His sacraments rightly delivered!
Come and dine with the Savior, Jesus the Christ, and remember: He promises forgiveness of sins and eternal joys and pleasures forevermore to those who turn from their sins (breaking the Ten Commandment), who are baptized, and who trust the Savior, Jesus, to save them. However, He does not promise your tomorrow.
Come, sit in the back, and let the Divine Physician work on your head and your heart-- this is a 100%-free clinic for your hurting, guilty soul.  And remember, you don't have to be good, because you're not, you are the walking dead, just like the rest of us. But don't worry, Jesus will gladly make you alive by giving you a new heart, with new desires, and will trade His purity, perfection, and life for your impurities, imperfections, and death.  He accomplished this by dying a grusome death on a cross, because sin earns death, and God is just.  So, Jesus took it all into his body and into the grave; He got what you deserve so that, in the end, you get what He deserves.  He then rose from the dead like He said He would, proving that He defeated death, again, for you.  Everything He does is for you!
He is saving a place for you at His table. Won't you come? For the theology, worship, community, architecture, music, and art - 5 stars I liked the format of the website. I have attended intermittently for a long time. For the past three weeks, I have been fortunate to be able to attend every Sunday. This is especially a blessing now as I am experiencing a transitional period in my life.

name: Grace Point Church San Diego
Grace Point Church San Diego - Del Mar Campus
reviewSummary:
Lovely place! My kids used to attend musical program, Awana& VBS here! Great people doing great things there! My wife and I and family have been members for 11 years and really love it here.  The teaching is solid, the children's program is well staffed and the people are friendly.  Great new campus with lots of parking.  It is not perfect but neither are we.  I wish we could find a worship leader who would stay for more than 2 years.  We highly recommend joining a small group.  In that way you are truly connected. You won’t regret visiting! We encourage you to come at least 4–5 times so you can truly learn, grow, and experience the amazing sermons and wonderful worship moments.
We also have a great children’s ministry and many dedicated leaders, including our faithful and inspiring Pastor Bob. I do not live in the area, but when I visited Grace point I was impressed with the preaching and the worship music. The people were very friendly and the children s program was great! Sounds like the guy who left one star has an agenda... Churches are not perfect, they all have issues. Where ever you go there will  be things that are not right. This is why we need a point to start at and find God's grace. The members are in incredibly loving and warm, and they have had a significant impact on my spiritual growth.

name: Grace Presbyterian Church
Grace Presbyterian Church - Brea Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a solid church with solid, faithful preaching, and devout and kind congregants. This is largely the best church in the area for confessionally-Reformed Christians to visit and join. :)

For those interested: this is a conservative Presbyterian congregation subscribing to the Westminster Standards 1647, rev. 1788 and is a member of the Presbyterian Church in America (PCA); the pulpit has R2K and Amillennial leanings and has active ties to Westminster Seminary California, but also welcomes other conservative, Bible-believing Christians for worship and fellowship and the laity have a diversity of opinions. Lots of young growing families, too, and emphasize catechism and Sunday School attendance. Because Pastor Ben was so welcoming and showed me around his church. Danielle, was so friendly and outgoing, I loved her immediately, I'm looking forward to working with both of them, and especially meeting the children! Biblical in all aspects of worship. Christ centered, not focused on pleasing man. Beautiful biblical worship. The people are terrific - lots of kids. If you're looking for a church that's grounded in the Reformed tradition, look no further. This is the needle in the haystack.

name: Grace Presbyterian Church & Preschool
Grace Presbyterian Church & Preschool - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary:
My wife and i love the people here. We have had our three year old here for just over 9 months. He's speech delayed and thus can be a little difficult due to his frustrations in communication but the staff have worked so hard and consistently with him and us to help him every day here's there. We have had him in speech therapy and the staff give us great feedback and work with us and the speech tharapist to make sure our son get's the most out of the work set by the therapist. We get consistent reminders and helpful notes for him and us. We get loads of info on how he's doing every day and at the end of the school year this year we got an entire binder of material to demonstrate the progress made from week one to now.
Frankie, the administrator is such a warm and helpful person, we really appreciate the support and acceptance he brings and manages to keeps us up to date with info and reminders (which for busy parents is a real bonus). Miriam is an incredibly intuitive person with our son, honestly she's just magical to watch work with him and makes drop offs so easy. Denise is our son's go to person, she brings a real sense of care and genuine love for him. Abby is one of the most warm and caring people i've ever met. You can just tell when people seem to be doing something they were put on earth to do and Grace has a few of them.
We could not be happier with the care our son gets here from these amazing people and as they grow i have full confidence they will add more and more absolute stars. We love this preschool. Our daughter has made a lovely group of friends, and the staff is incredible. They are very caring and share a lot of the same values that we have, including parenting and teaching style. I really appreciate how much the staff pays attention to things like daily health and sanitation practices. They are very conscious about this and will go above and beyond to clean and sanitize rooms, toys, equipment, and things regularly. The classrooms are always very clean and orderly, and we appreciate everything that they are teaching our child. Compared to other facilities in the area, Grace was by far our first choice. We are so grateful to have found Grace Presbyterian Preschool. Our son started at Grace about a year ago, and we have seen tremendous growth in him both developmentally and emotionally since then.

The entire staff is truly exceptional. They are experienced, attentive, and genuinely care about every single child and their families. It’s clear that they take the time to get to know each student individually and tailor their approach to meet each child where they are.

What we appreciate most is that they focus not only on academics, but also on helping the children build important values and social-emotional skills they will use in everyday life. The teachers and staff are also incredibly supportive of parents, always offering thoughtful feedback, guidance, and encouragement so we can better support our child’s growth and development at home as well.

We are incredibly thankful for everyone at Grace Preschool and all the love, patience, and dedication they show to the children every day. We feel very lucky to be part of such a caring community. Grace Preschool is a truly wonderful place for young children to learn and grow. The classrooms are bright, welcoming, and thoughtfully organized, creating an engaging environment that supports both learning and play. The teachers are incredibly caring, attentive, and dedicated to each child’s development, making every student feel valued and supported.
One of the things that stands out most is the strong sense of safety and comfort throughout the school. Parents can feel confident knowing their children are in a secure and nurturing environment every day. Most importantly, the children genuinely enjoy being there—you can see it in their smiles and excitement when they arrive.
Grace Preschool is a place where children feel happy, safe, and inspired, and it’s clear that both the staff and environment play a big role in that positive experience. Grace has been a blessing for us in so many ways. It is a friendly church that loves the LORD and serves Him in so many ways. We love how Grace has an after school tutoring program for the local elementary school. It offers food distribution on two mornings each week and a sack dinner once a week. We love seeing the children have fun, learn about Jesus and receive a Bible at Vacation Bible Camp. Frankie Zavala is our Preschool Director and has brought an exceptional Biblical Education to the sweet preschoolers. Love hearing their laughter and seeing their huge smiles on the playground when we are going to our Thursday Morning Bible Study.
Ken and Tricia Sanger

name: Grace United Methodist Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
City of Pasadena Cultural Heritage Landmark - Architect: C.A. Dudley - 1905.
The church combines the Victorian Gothic style with the Mission Revival to create a religious structure which creates a visual focal point on this residential street. The design takes full advantage of the corner siting by placing the tower on the south west property edge and using the street as the open space by which to view the structure in total.
While the main body of the single story building has a cross-gabled roof, the two story tower has a tiled hipped roof with stepped projections on each corner. The gabled roof has overhanging eaves with prominent brackets. These brackets are also found under the tower. The triple lancet pointed Gothic windows are a prominent feature of the church and are found on both the southern and western facades of the building. The triple lancet Gothic windows are reinterpreted on the tower. Other windows around the building are rectangular, some divided across the top, and some with small diamond-shaped panes. Peaceful. Position partial to its pastor. History. I believe God led me here in 1983 for a future work I'm seeking now against discrimination.

If you’re looking for a church that feels like family, where you can come as you are and experience real love and support, GraceLife Sarasota is that place. I’m incredibly grateful to have found it. It’s already embarrassing enough when you have to go to a food pantry for the first time in over a year and a guy that works for the church yells at everyone like they are a cattle of sheep waiting in line. There were signs on one side that don’t say exit but the other side had no signs and my gps pulled me in I had never been before . He starts screaming at me you do not park there and I told him I’m sorry that’s why I was going to ask where to go and he goes that’s why the signs are there …. The signs weren’t on the side I pulled into . They might give out helpful items but idk if I’ll ever go there again in need Pastor Joe is awesome.  It's a small but growing church. I'm new there but my husband has been going for over a year. The people are very welcoming. Grace Life is a great place for recovery from alcohol and drugs. The have church service on Sunday, daily AA meetings,  women's NA meeting on Friday night, Bible study on Wednesday night and food pantry on Mondays. Pastor Joe and his wife Jackie are the most generous people I've met, plus they have a day care so parents can enjoy services with no worries. I can't say enough about how they've helped change my life. I thank God they're there. 🙏❤️ Great place to worship. Pastor Joe Davis is an amazing teacher. He loves his people ❤️

name: Gracepoint Church
Gracepoint Church - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
If you are searching for a Church, or are thinking about changing, I would recommend checking GracePoint Church out in Chino. GracePoint has a friendly atmosphere, people are friendly and very welcoming.

We had searched for a Church and did not care for large or mega churches because we did not feel comfortable at those places and large crowds. Then we found GracePoint, which has been our home now for many years. The Church Family is very supportive and loving as one would expect from a Christian Church. Don't be surprised if someone offers you to bring you food if you're sick.

Pastor Steve's messages are not boring, but rather very informative and easy to understand. He includes jokes, stories and steps we can include in our daily lives to help and love on others. I try to be loving to people at work, but they make it hard sometimes ;-)

The worship songs are diverse and change frequently to accompany the sermon series and message. Common worship songs are part of the sets and hymns from time to time, but my favorites songs are the modern ones (written by David Crowder).

I would recommend checking GracePoint out to anyone (and have), come by at least two times, it grows on you the more often you come. You can watch online, but the live experience is always better, less distractions like pets, kids, neighbor. We drive 20 minutes to attend, but I think it's well worth it. Others come from even farther away and drive up to an hour. That should say something about this Church, right? At Gracepoint, I've found a true sense of home and belonging. Unlike past experiences, I feel accepted and free to be myself while growing closer to God. The caring community here has made all the difference in my spiritual journey. It truly is a place to know God, be known, and find belonging. My family and I started attending this church when I was little. Eventually, I grew up and I went away for college. When I was away, I struggled to find a church because I enjoyed so many aspects of GracePoint.

I missed:
•  the pastor, as he has relatable messages and encourages fun, even during sermons
(ie. during summer, sometimes we watch movie clips in service, called “Flicker of Faith”)
•  the upbeat worship, with mix of hymns
•  the (small) caring community
•  the weekly meetings / home church, where we catch up, pray for our week, and talk about God.
•  how easy it was to get involved / volunteer
•  the casual atmosphere

During the pandemic, GracePoint moved from an elementary school to a permanent building in Chino, making them farther from me. I still choose to drive the extra miles every Sunday because I miss so much, and nothing can replace the community’s love and support that they have for me.

I hope you come visit us for an event and see how accepting the people here are for yourself.
My favorite event is probably the Trunk-or-Treat on Halloween night (which has been going on since at least 2010!). I LOVE THIS PLACE!! Every Sunday I always learn something new. I love that Pastor Steve never shy away from important or typically taboo topics. He is always very intentional with everything he’s talks about. I love the time of fellowship and how personable everyone is, you can really get to know people. It feels safe and like home. I have never felt judged, only ever welcomed and invited. My family loves GracePoint!  It was my home church for 18+ years. The only reason we are not there today is because the leaders built us up so much that I am now serving in full-time ministry at another location. The relationships formed there are lifelong.

GracePoint lives up to its vision of being a place anyone “can know God, be known, and find belonging.” Pastor Steve teaches in a way that is relatable and easy to understand no matter where someone is in their walk with God. I always learned something or got a better perspective each Sunday. Community is a central part of GracePoint’s identity, so people really take the time to get to know you and pray for you. I always felt like I had a group of people in “my corner” who were rooting for me.

The church is not flashy, but the quality is there. The worship is genuine and the people are filled with joy. Again, I am ministering today, much in part because of my positive experience at GracePoint. I definitely recommend visiting a few times and considering joining permanently.

name: Grove Church
Grove Church - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary:
Absolutely amazing church and congregation. They make you feel completely welcome from jump and their outreach programs are completely selfless and tremendous.

John is the most down to earth, caring pastor I’ve ever met. We tried several churches after we left our church we were going to for 15 years. The moment we walked through the door we knew we were home. 🏠 If you are searching for for a real Christ loving, strong family this church is for you. Don’t delay, salvation and God’s love are manifested in this family. My sincere appreciation goes to the Hoffman’s and the community they’ve created. 🙏✝️🇺🇸 I've been attending The Grove church for 4.5years and I can honestly say, this church has such a beautiful heart for Jesus.  It's easy to come in and judge churches sometimes forgetting that everyone in the church is broken. We are all human.   We all make mistakes and no matter how hard you try, you can't please everyone.  I've been guilty of judging churches myself and God proved me wrong in every judgment I tried to have.

I can attest the leadership is incredible and authentic.  We are not there to play church, but to be the church.  There is so much love and support.  The church has grown a ton since I've been going and the way to get connected with people is to attend a Growth Group which they have 3x per year for a series of weeks.  It's a great way to get to know people on a deeper level and to dig into the Word even more.  I've also had the pleasure of serving on the worship team.  Not only have I grown SO much spiritually at this church, but I have grown in the gift that God has given me.  I'm so grateful for The Grove.  God is using this church in a huge way.   The very church I got baptized at. Every one is incredible and so friendly. Their focus on their youth ministry is so important. God bless. Very welcoming. After a few visits, we knew we found our church home. A few weeks later we felt like family. The grove church has the best bible-based teaching I have ever heard. I attend every Sunday and when I can't, I watch online so I don't miss anything. The people here are so welcoming and outgoing, it makes it so fun and easy to get connected and get involved. I have especially loved their children's ministry. I have three kids and they LOVE going to their classes and Cara, the director is so great! She communicates so well and is so caring about our kids and family! I would highly recommend this church to anyone looking to get connected and deepen their relationship with the Lord.

reviewSummary: My home church about 20 yrs... learned tai boxing gone on a few missions to mexico skated on half pipe in old parking lot trained proper techniques to handle and shoot guns and paint ball wars on mens retreat in big bear gone hiking 10 miles to tree line with all geat to survive w/out clean water n only food we brought. Best things I learned in life were through thos family of God in which my dad Bob now is head pastor of For Spiritual growth in good biblical teaching, highly recommend, very warm & welcoming , anyone can blend right in,  look up on Facebook for video sermons of Pastors Bob or Eddie,  love getting close the God Love it! Wednesday bible study at 7pm, sunday service at 10 am. The people there are amazing pastor Bob is amazing. Perfect

name: Hanwoori Korean Presbyterian Church
Hanwoori Korean Presbyterian Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary: Amazing church I would recommend it to any level of believers So welcoming and really dedicated to following the Bible. Awesome church highly recommended Good church Come down to worship God

name: Harbor Baptist Church
Harbor Baptist Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Non discrimination is what I like best. When they say come as you are, it's true. Just be respectful and you'll fit right in. Great church, helping those in need, with a wonderful hard-working staff!

I would recommend this church to everyone. Great church..very nice people...a lot of love 4 everyone.
Ron Kirchner nice people willing to help you with everything they can love it Great place to worship, find peace.

name: Harbor Christian Church
Harbor Christian Church - Newport Beach Campus
reviewSummary: I was--and still am a year later--so very very sad about the loss of one of my very oldest and closest friends. We grew up on Newport Beach (Carona del Mar and Balboa Island) and had, at that time, moved great distances from our early homes. harbor Christian Church provided a lovely context for holding a memorial for my beloved friend....Thank you. Great church community. Sunday service starts at 10! Awesome people. Very warm and welcoming! Good location. Environmentally aware, welcoming and inclusive community.

name: Harbor Christian Fellowship
Harbor Christian Fellowship - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
Very welcoming to me as a poor Spanish-speaker. They translated the introduction just for me and then sent one of their members to help me find the passage in an English Bible. So welcoming!! Great church we spread the word of white power and celebrating the accomplishments of the white race we hold white power rallies every Monday in Laguna Beach. Spamming me with unwanted rude text messages
How can you call yourself Christians when you Harass people with unsolicited rude text messages disrespecting my country and those who serve it?

Just plain disrespectful. An excellent community church that actually serves the people in the community. Because they love you and everyone is there to help you.

name: Harbor Light Church
Harbor Light Church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary: Harbor Light is truly an awesome example of what loving Christ & loving people looks like! Sound biblical teaching, amazing worship & loving people! Watched the First Amendment audit you had with Nathaniel and was so happy to see the warm Christian welcome you gave them. You truly let your light shine! Very positive interaction with 1st amendment auditors. You showed the world how a church should treat strangers. View on the nasty nathaniel channel on YouTube great people over at Harbor Light Church, you can tell they really care. I’ve call Harbor light my church four over 20 years or more. I love the teaching and the worship and all my brother and sister their very loving and caring people.

name: Harbor Point Church
Harbor Point Church - Dana Point Campus
reviewSummary: My family wanted me to join them for Easter service so found myself here.  There was literally nothing that I disliked; I’m not a normal churchgoer but didn’t feel out of place.  The experience was uplifting and wonderful!  Yes, it’s loud AKA they’ve got a really great band.  The message was delivered in a way that was easily understood, appreciated the occasional levity and the accompanying graphics (to read along) were greatly appreciated.  Right off 5 freeway, parking was easy and excellent traffic management for a quick exit.  I’m thankful that I went and actually want to go again. This is a review as somebody who was bringing in a band to perform at a Memorial service at this church. It was extremely difficult to get people to respond to multiple emails and messages to get information about what was being provided and what I would have to bring. Finally  I was told that certain instruments would be available to us. And later I was able to speak to a sound man the day before the event.  He confirmed the available instruments and even said that they would also provide a piano. That was great news.  And then later at 9:30 at night before an 8 AM call the following morning we were told that some promised instruments were no longer available to us. Not the way to treat people who are there to serve a widower and his family in mourning. Unprofessional and super disappointing. And so upsetting it made me leave this review. This is the second time I've attended this particular church today, on Mothers Day, and we had a great experience with the campus, preacher, and friendly congregants. We will definitely be headed back next Sunday!!! My experience on Dec 23, 2025. The Christmas service at this church was absolutely horrifying! As an ex-Christian, and one who has not stepped foot into a church in years this was a solidifying experience as to why. The music was sooo obnoxiously loud, my 82 yr old father had to remove his hearing aids, and then we both had to plug our ears! It's now the day after Christmas and my ears are still ringing from the damage. Then you have the distraction of the glaring light show and fog machines. But hey, it's all theater for baby Jesus's 🍿 bucket for "In God We Trust" fiat currency. The show was so annoying when the popcorn bucket was passed to me, I thought maybe my neighbor wanted me to get a refill from the concession stand. Was there a message at this church? Absolutely there was! We are completely intolerant to loving others, so much so that we will bash another church during our Christmas service to do it. One 🌟 is kind. I was excited to attend the Christmas Eve Eve service. You can never get enough of the Christmas story. I love hearing and learning about baby Jesus. However as a member of The Church Of JESUS CHRIST of Latter Day Saints, I was saddened that you would use the platform of Christmas to have a video from Brother Zundel belittle another Christian church. In a day where we need more kindness, more compassion, more Christianity, How sad that the member of your church had to grab my hand and apologize for her church saying unkind remarks about another church. That's not very Christlike. She also apologized for "The Popcorn Bucket" being passed at the beginning asking for donations. Wouldn't it be more appropriate to mention a family who may need a little help during the holidays and if we would like to contribute please see an usher after. The music selections were awesome. Merry Christmas Harbor Point Church.

name: Harbor Trinity Church
Harbor Trinity Church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
Harbor Trinity Church is a "Welcoming Church".  Whether you are a youngster or a person who has been a believer for many years, this church is a place for you to feel at home in your faith and worship. I was welcomed here from the beginning! this is a family-community church which is always helping and reaching out to the community and people who needs support. Great kids and youth program also!! The preaching is very solid on the Bible and communicates well with all group of ages. Very very friendly environment, to not mention that there’s always good food!! 👌😊🙏 Both my 7 and 5 year old boys attended preschool at Harbor Trinity and they loved it. The staff is very friendly and caring. Sometimes they have guests bring animals to pet, they’ll have some bounce houses in the playground, tricycle racing, etc. I would recommend Harbor Trinity to anyone who is thinking about a good Christian preschool. I have been going to this church for almost a year. Great worship. Down to earth pastor (you will get his humor). The people are TRULY genuine. Make sure to say hi to Chris who meets you at the door. I highly recommend if you are looking for a great bible based (chapter by chapter) small friendly church. Love to listen to Justin talk about the Bible and
how what it says relates to my life.  Love to hear Shane worship Jesus.

name: Harborside Christian Church
Harborside Christian Church - Clearwater Campus
reviewSummary:
I came to Harborside Christian Church for a BNI networking event and had a great experience. The facility is beautiful, clean, and very welcoming. It was a great place to bring local business leaders together to connect and build relationships. You can tell this church cares about the community and creates a great environment for people to gather. Grateful for the hospitality and for churches that open their doors to support the local business community. From the moment Harborside announced they were building the chapel, I was in awe. I watched the progress week after week, attended the groundbreaking ceremony, and fell more in love as the mission and heart behind it unfolded. I knew long before I was engaged that one day I would get married there.

Just under two years after it was completed, I got engaged—and there was no question. The chapel was my one non-negotiable. From the very beginning, the process was seamless. Our coordinator reached out almost immediately, we chose our date, and planning felt easy and intentional.

We were incredibly blessed to have Pastor Kurt officiate our wedding. The premarital equipping was truly priceless. We were matched with mentors who were a perfect fit—especially meaningful since the husband was a pilot like my own. Those honest, real conversations prepared us for marriage in ways we didn’t even know we needed.

Our wedding day was absolutely stunning and seamless. From the décor and timeline to the ceremony and music, everything was perfection. I would choose this chapel over and over again. You don’t just gain a beautiful venue—you gain mentors, support, and the love of the entire Harborside Church congregation. Forever grateful. Great venue for hosting community and business events. I came for a BNI networking meeting and the space was clean, welcoming, and well organized. It’s great to see a church that opens its doors to support local businesses and bring people together. Appreciate the hospitality and the positive environment they’ve created for the community Harborside has been such a welcoming place for me as a recent widow and new resident to the area.  The leadership is filled with genuine love for Jesus and for others.  The worship is heartfelt and the messages empowering and inspiring.  It is a place where families are supported and so many options to grow in small groups. I am so blessed to be a part of this Christian community. Have been attending Harborside for about a year and a half and though it can feel a little overwhelming due to the amount of people, the worship and teaching is so good! I volunteer with the widow's ministry and it has just been such an honor to serve in this way. I encourage others to step out and find your place in this huge church family. All Praise and Glory to God!

name: Harbour Church
Harbour Church - Sarasota Campus
reviewSummary:
I found this church a few months ago and have now made it my home church. The atmosphere is so welcoming, and every sermon is intentional and relatable. I highly recommend those who are strong in their faith or just exploring it! I recently visited this church and loved the people and welcoming atmosphere but found the volume of worship to be uncomfortably loud. While I understand some enjoy a concert like worship experience, I had to leave early due to a headache from the sound levels.

A slight adjustment in sound levels could make a BIG difference for people who are more sensitive to volume. I’d love to come back again and possibly make this my home church if the sound levels were brought down a couple notches. It really seems like there is an amazing community here and a lot to offer! This is a great church. I used to listen to the sermons on their website. I live close to this church so I found it on Google maps.
I really liked that they pray for understanding before they even tell the message.
After a while listening to the sermons for a few months I had a chance to check it out and so I did.
This church is really big on actually doing community service and helping people and I am a big believer that I should be doing that. I like that this church challenges me to be a better Christian. To actually serve the people and make a difference and do God's will.
As I am not an elderly person I like that the church isn't this full of just elderly people as many churches that I've been to have been.
I have just started going to this church but from my impressions they seem to all have a very loving supportive community. A very closely connected church. A family. I had the pleasure of visiting this church in Sarasota over the weekend, and it was an incredible experience from start to finish. The worship was uplifting and filled with powerful, heartfelt music that truly drew me into the presence of God. The message was biblically sound, insightful, and deeply impactful. You can tell this is a church that values truth, community, and authentic worship. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a Christ-centered and welcoming place to grow in their faith! My favorite thing about Harbour Church is the value for God’s presence and the close runner up is the amazing community!

name: Harrison United Methodist Church
reviewSummary: Great blended worship. The contemporary service in Hammill Hall is fantastic.

name: Harvest Community Bible Church
Harvest Community Bible Church - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary: Amazing people here at this church!  Highly recommended!

name: Harvest Community Church of Irvine
Harvest Community Church of Irvine - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary:
We were looking for a home church that reflects our community back in Hawai'i and we found it at Harvest Community Church of Irvine. Their role in biblical perspective is on point to what we were looking for, teach the Bible, Love God, and love people. Plenty of parking, friendly atmosphere (new building), we started off just church hopping but now, we found a home where we, as a family can serve Jesus together. THE church is very good n love the singing and the congregation everyone is very nice
Pastor n members are welcoming. Lovely place to be welcomed. A warm, happy, godly community.  Everyone so friendly and welcoming.  Feels like home. Really had a good time at took my family and my son there somewhere save he had fun definitely go back next year if they have it again Full of kind and warm inviting people

name: Harvest Evangelical Church of San Diego
Harvest Evangelical Church of San Diego - Del Mar Campus
reviewSummary: I have been there by the invite of Brother Enoch to attend the Chinese New Year Celebration party. He held a big plate of delicious food for me since I am right off the airplane and driving from SAN airport, when I arrived it is almost 2 pm. From parking lot, I started to see there were all the tables in the plaza, folks were enjoying the community talk, the fellowship and of course the food. Later events at the church hall were fabulous, I could feel the close relationship among church folks and the vibe is very friendly and showing love in Jesus. May God keep blessing these folks and the Harvest Evangelical church! Excellent parking and an overall prime location for a church in Del Mar. Nice, clean campus. Food got worse but great community. The people there are great and very friendly. Its Sunday service is marvelous.

name: Harvest OC
Harvest OC - Tustin Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautiful church and service.
They offer a big family room where you can still watch the service and the little ones can draw.  Youth group ministry is awesome and my kid now enjoys going to church and he can’t wait to take his Bible on the weekends. Pastor Greg Laurie gives amazing service and we happily drive down to Irvine every weekend for Harvest OC. Great Place to Worship The Lord with family and friends in Christ. Great place for an event. Fire in Your Bones, Teen Challenge was Amazing. Good word, lots of Great Worship, Wonderful Testimonies of Transformation only Possible Through The Healing Power Of Jesus Christ. The Way, The Truth, and The Life. Best church I’ve ever been to. It’s always a great Bible study and praise and worship. Pastor Greg is an inspirational testimony and pastor. My husband and I have been attending for about 2.5 years and he grew up catholic. He loves learning the word of God and has grown hungrier to learn the word. We have grown closer together in our relationship with each other through Christ. We are now serving together, have been baptized together and I have seen Jesus working in our lives. I feel so blessed seeing a transformation in us both. This is what a great church does. It’s all glory to Jesus! Last night at Harvest OC was such a beautiful night of worship wish we could do this every night...spending time at the feet of Jesus is is something we need to do every single moment of our lives...Blessings to all of you in the mighty name of Jesus Amen 🙏 ❤️ God is so worthy of all our praise 👏 amen 🙏 ❤️ Great place great people great church to worship at lots of smiles and very welcoming no matter how I walked in always feel so awesome by the time I walk out

name: Harvest Orthodox Presbyterian Church
Harvest Orthodox Presbyterian Church - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary: Great church for Christ-centered and Reformed teaching and strong Christian fellowship. As an Orthodox Presbyterian Church, they hold to the Westminster confession and catechism. The sermons are always a blessing and full of Biblical truths. The congregation is intimate and friendly to first time visitors and regular attenders alike. I grew up in this church and though I don't attend anymore I love to visit sometimes because of the people. You won't meet a more welcoming and friendly bunch of people! Very traditional music old fashioned, great expositional preaching, flexible outside seating during covid, ok to bring your own chair. Awesome church, very christ centered. Great fellowship and friendly people! Pastor preaches God’s Word.

name: Harvest Riverside
Harvest Riverside - Riverside (Canyon Crest) Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a beautiful church great place to bring your family. They have a great Sunday service. We are located right down the road from them and they call on us periodically for different occasions. I’ve been coming here since I was a child, but it’s definitely changed through the years . Always such a beautiful facility and everyone there is very welcoming. We would love to do more Dove releases at this facility. The church crowd seems to really enjoy it. Greg Laurie has devoted decades to sharing a message of hope and faith, helping many people encounter Jesus and grow spiritually through clear teaching, community support, and outreach efforts — and at Harvest Christian Fellowship in Riverside, that focus on knowing God and making Him known has helped countless individuals feel welcomed, encouraged, and connected in their faith journey. Since my first day attending this church in Riverside was one of the most best experiences awesome and amazing I felt so welcome and so accepted especially after being rejected by other churches this church is a warm welcoming Church very friendly and outgoing and it's super cool when you could serve on the serve
team with my family .. I myself and family just started coming I truly ask if you haven't found a church to try this church out and attend it's very awesome and the word that gets shared the gospel of Christ Is amazing by Greg Laurie,Jonathan Laurie and other fellow pastors so glad I found this church I have been watching it online but I haven't had a chance to attend till recently and it is my new church home for me and my family. Great Bible teaching church of the truth of God and who Jesus is, and His forgiveness of all our sins.
There is great parking. However, there is no Wednesday night Bible studies as before. Office closes early now, and it is closed on Fridays. LOVE HARVEST CHURCH!THE WORSHIP TEAM IS AMAZING! ALWAYS BRINGING THE HOLY SPIRIT WITH THIER WORSHIP! PASTOR'S ARE AMAZING! THIS CHURCH IS ANNOINTED! GLORY BE TO GOD! IN JESUS'S ALMIGHTY POWERFUL NAME! AMEN! 💯🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏🙏

name: Harvest Rock Church
Harvest Rock Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
Nice Church. Only complaint is groups of people were going in and I was the only one asked to empty my pockets and be patted down. I am dressed nice I don't think I look suspicious but seemed a bit weird and I felt profiled. But oh well. Volunteers not very friendly towards me. Not very welcoming Just another right-wing Christian nationalist political church. Unfortunate to see churches turn into political social clubs vs. being places of worship and promoting the name of Jesus. This place has become too busy promoting Trump, their own run for Governorship, and right-wing fascism all under the guise of "Christianity." The leader of that church spends all his time promoting himself for the governorship. He should use other platforms—not the time of worship. The pulpit is for speaking about God and worshipping Him.
That happened all three times I went. I wanted to believe it wouldn't, but—oh well—I hope that changes. The service is beautiful. It starts with prayer, which is my heart. Then, worship. Last but not least the word is given. This is a Bible based and anointed church answering the call Of Jesus to the Great Commission. I'm so thankful the Lord brought me here! Came here for the symphony, which was great. That's what my review is for and not the church. If you have an opportunity to see the symphony here whether it's the Pasadena Pops or whatever definitely come. Not a bad seat in the house.

name: Harvest Time Assembly of God Church
Harvest Time Assembly of God Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary:
The first time I came to Harvest Time Assembly of God Church everything just felt right! The love, the kindness, the warmth they bring to your spirit! God lead me to this church and it was everything I was look for! I give God the glory! Praise God and all the love and work He is doing to this church and the people! Pastor Kurt and Pastor Valerie are so uplifting, gifted, and encouraging! Each service and ministry brings out the joy, the love, and the purpose of our Lord Savior Jesus Christ in our hearts growing each day here and learning more and more! What a wonderful blessing! Thank you Jesus! I stayed quiet for a long time, but I want to be honest about my experience at this church. I came here hoping for support, kindness, and understanding, especially during hard times in my life, but instead I often felt judged, ignored, and unwelcome.

Around 2020 when everything was difficult, I reached out for help while struggling with problems at home, but I felt dismissed and not believed. Instead of support, I felt alone. There were also situations where my concerns did not feel taken seriously, which made me feel even more uncomfortable and hurt.

The pastor’s family also made me feel unwelcome at times. I often felt ignored, judged, or treated coldly, especially by the daughter. There were moments where I felt so uncomfortable emotionally that I wanted to leave early after getting rides because I felt unwanted and embarrassed.

Over time, many people at the church made me feel worse emotionally. Some ignored me or gave rude looks even when I tried being friendly and respectful. More recently, I also felt like my boyfriend was unfairly judged during preaching, which hurt deeply.

I love Jesus Christ and believe church should be a place of compassion, kindness, and support, especially for people who are struggling. Sadly, my experience here became very painful and disappointing. I never thought I would say this because I used to like this church years ago, but I no longer felt welcomed or cared for. I wish I could give 0 stars. An absolutely wonderful church and such warm-hearted people! I always feel so welcomed walking through the doors. The songs are beautiful and the word of God shared by pastor Kurt and Valerie are so meaningful. I highly recommend being a part of this amazing group of Christ centered individuals! A loving and understanding church it doesn't matter how you come into church or where you're at or where you're coming from, they love and support us and guide us to salvation baptism. and most of all lead us to the cross where Jesus Christ died on the cross for since so that we may be saved in return with him 1 day and it's coming soon, so prepare yourselves and it's a beautiful loving church. Hope to see you soon. Such a lovely experience at Harvest Time Assembly of God. The pastors greeted me warmly, and you could feel our Lord’s presence in the church. Everyone was so nice and welcoming and the services are always so wonderful to hear. Thank you for sharing God’s word with everyone.

name: Hephatha Lutheran Church and School
Hephatha Lutheran Church and School - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary: We were at Hephatha for a few years and the majority of it was negative. The one positive is that the other families were wonderful. However, most of the teachers simply did not care. There were many instances where I would speak with the teacher and they’d shrug their shoulders at me. They rarely said hi and smiled. The principal rarely took action on things that went on in the school such as bullying being the biggest problem, character education, the rigor of academia and school culture as a whole. The secretary is nothing short of consistently rude. I would not send your children there. When we left, the principal didn’t respond. They just told us they will stop payment. Super cold and unwelcoming! Hephatha Lutheran School is truly exceptional in every way. The teachers here genuinely care for each student’s academic, spiritual, and social development. It’s clear that they take the time to get to know each child individually and provide the support needed for their success. The school’s curriculum is academically advanced, keeping students challenged and engaged at all times. Beyond academics, Hephatha places a strong emphasis on character development and nurturing a strong sense of community, ensuring that students grow spiritually and socially as well. I am so grateful for the positive impact this school has had on our family! Great pastor and fellowship!!! They are such lovely people to work with. Thank you so much! Love this school.  Teachers and staff are wonderful!
