reviewSummary: This is my favorite place to go in Riverside county and I'm not just saying that because it's the church I go to. It's more to me than just a church, it's like going to a family reunion every time I go - whether regular Sunday services or special events. God and my church family have made my recovery a miracle and I love all of them. I have been attending this church since 2019..this is one of the few churches today that remains Christ-centered and Christ-focused..everyone is welcomed like family; just as you are, you are invited to come, as we look to our Lord Jesus Christ, who alone is our hope and our Savior.. God used Higher Ground Calvery Chapel to get ahold of me. Turn me around and get me back on the right track. I had been watching on Facebook during Covid. I felt the warmth even then. But when I finally came to the church, it was like God had given me a drink of cool crystal clear water when I was desperately thirsty. I am very active in the church, I have made wonderful friends, attend classes to grow in love & knowledge with the Lord. I teach Sunday School. There is always something to do if you want to get involved. They are now my family. Give us a try, I don't think you will be disappointed Haven't attended a church for 30 + years. I've ben going every Sunday now for 2 + months. Have found resources that have helped myself and family and christ. I have been attending Higher Ground Calvary Chapel for a few years now.  Pastor Dr. Harold Anderson is a gifted teacher and pastor.  The church is filled with a diverse group of believers who pray and encourage one another and is welcoming to visitors.  The worship is contemporary.  Come out and give it a try; God will do the rest :-)

name: Higher Ground Sanctuary
Higher Ground Sanctuary - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary:
This place sucks. I was trying to use their outlet to charge my mandated ankle monitor... I had been looking around for days and was just happy to finally find a place that I can charge and not have to worry about catching a violation and heading back to prison. Figured they would have a heart and let me charge. Well they turned the power off on me completely, in one of my most desperate moments that I actually needed help. Yeah this place and these people are something else. A TRUE place of worship. Real preaching without fear or favor. Preaching that speaks to your need not just what makes you feel good. Preaching that is straight from the WORD of GOD! You can truly feel the love and presence of GOD. The pastor and ministry team truly care about your soul! You will not find more genuine people of GOD! This is the first church that I have been to where they walk the walk and not just talk the talk. Their lives and lifestyle match what they say and what you see in church. Because they have truly had a LIFE-CHANGING experience with GOD. And everyone who walks through the doors can have that same experience! Higher Ground is not just my church… but it is my family! Awesome church! Such real people. God really moves here! They have Sunday School on Sunday morning for the kids. I just returned from a ladies retreat with the ladies in the mountains. The speaker did such a great job and really helped my walk with God. I also go to the Monday Funday and monthly events as much as possible. I am excited to go to service every week. I have a true relationship with God since I've attended this church. I attended this church for many years. But I became depressed and selfish and became the lamb that got lost. Last fall my wife was crying and praying and out of the blue, a missionary contacted her and said can I pray for you? January 01, 2021 my wife and I were baptized in the wonderful name of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, as members of the Church of Jesus Christ of LDS. I'm once again loving Jesus and praying and doing all I can to please the Lord. If not for Higher Ground Sanctuary, then on Hanna St, I would probably still be lost. Miss you brother Jack!
Jimmy Hensley Message to Mark Cannon:

Greetings,

God has changed my life and he used this church and it's Pastor to do it. No gimmicks, no scams, no lies, just giving you the real life experience of a member of this church. My relationship with my son's mom (now my wife - thank God) was broken, my relationship with my son was going nowhere, I was drinking everyday in order to drown out the solitude of my own thoughts and that's when I decided to come back to Higher Ground Church. Yes, I said back to. I left the church when I was much younger, and just like you, I didn't like some of the stands this church made on things like television, inappropriate dress on women, and submission to spiritual authority. But, Mark Cannon (if that's your real name - I've attended this smaller sized church for a long time and have never meet or heard of anyone named Mark Cannon), those same standards that I wasn't happy about are the very things that brought me back. There is a church that is contending for the faith once delivered to the saints and I choose (not coerced or brainwashed) to stand with a church and Pastor Ted David who cared enough to help me when I couldn't help myself and who showed me the love of God through their own brokenness and selflessness. We can't argue against power that causes a man to change like this. Only God could do this, especially with a knuckle head like me. I now have 3 children, and one on the way, with my beautiful wife and we love our church.

Your comments sound like those of a hurting man, who needs God just as much as I do. If you're willing to reveal your real name, I would love to open God's Word with you to discuss your thoughts. The solitude of our own thoughts can be a very scary place, I've been there, but there is deliverance. Reach out and allow God to heal your heart.

Your comments can be hurtful to someone who is truly looking for God. Please remove your post, as you know it is not truthful. Again, I would like to make myself available to you for a bible study or simply a cup of coffee. God loves you and He is able.

Thank you for your consideration.

name: Highgrove United Methodist Church
Highgrove United Methodist Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary:
How fondly do I recall this church of my childhood. I see that the fire escape pole has been removed. I spent many a summer day running up to the 2nd floor and jumping to the pole in abject fear, but not wanting to be seen as chicken, and being so thrilled to make the slide down the pole.
I loved Vacation Bible school and Sunday school in the old 2 story parsonage.  Crafting God's Eyes made from popsicle sticks and yarn, memorizing Bibles verses, and reading about Jesus and the many wonderful things of the Bible.  I especially enjoyed and loved singing the children's songs.
The new parsonage was a wonderful experience and I played fort in the hall closet and read many books and comic books while curled on a few blankets and sheets and pillows.
My grandfather Armon Lathrop was pastor there in the early 70s. I loved the big, or seemingly big, back yard. He had a park sized, sturdy swing set put in that allowed my nosy sister and I to swing high enough to see if the next door neighbors were in their swimming pool. They were always so generous and kind to us and would invite us over to swim at times.
The last memory I have of the church was when my parents, my Aunt Char, my sister and I went there to see my Aunt Karen who had cancer. We attended church and later mom and Char played the piano and organ and sang with Aunt Karen and my sister joining in. Thanks to this church for sharing theirs building with us, to praise Our Heavenly Father GOD ALMIGHTY JESUS CHRIST AND THE HOLY SPIRIT....
The people are so nice, friendly.
Thank God for all of them. May our heavenly father bless them in spirit,financial and physical in jesus power name Amen.
God bless you all.... Great place to worship No comment

Highlands Church - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary:
Can't express my gratitude enough to God for leading me to Highlands.
Never imagined a church like this was out there...and I'm not talking about the building (even though that in and of itself is gorgeous with the stained glass in the morning and the lights out front at nighttime). The people, the church body, here are so united in love for Christ and each other. He provided such a heart for the gospel and a heart for hospitality here unlike any church I've ever attended.
Very much recommend at least visiting, if the Lord put it on your heart and mind to! This church is incredible. The husband and wife leading are kind, humble, smart, and full of integrity. The worship is sincere and the community is relatable and committed to building lasting friendships. Highly recommend, our family of 4 loves it and their kids program is amazing! Our family started attending FBCLC in 1967,so my fond memories are many and go way back in time.  We have always had a solid foundation in the Lord, our rock, and sermons accurately based on His Word.  We have always supported many missionaries, many of them having come from our own flock, so it is considered important to reach people in other lands as well as in our own community with the good news of Jesus Christ and His salvation.  We are a loving congregation who care and look after one another.  My "Christian Family" is a major part of my life.  We have groups and programs to meet most every need.  Our Pastor Bill spends much time preparing his good Bible-based sermons and is very active in our community.

Try us, I'm sure you will like us, as many of our newcomers have discovered! This church has been a very loving and community oriented Christ focused family church. My husband and I were looking for a church and were invited to join the worship team. Amazingly I was so moved by the pastor's message.  We were greeted by a warm and inviting group. FBCLC has a classes for young families, youth, men's group, women's groups and a place for anyone just needing a place to learn about the Bible and heal or just have a friend. They are very giving to people in need.  Plus my children have joined the youth group and actually lead several small youth  group meetings.  I highly recommend you just try our church if you are searching to hear God's message. Come find me! I'll show you around! We are a loving family of Christians whose mission is to bring the gospel of Christ to our community, country, and the world. Our time of worship has everything from contemporary Christian music to timeless hymns. Our services are biblically grounded and enlightening. Children and youth are engaged in Christ centered activities and programs like; Vacation Bible School, AWANA, Sunday School, and Summer/Winter Camp. We have ministries that range from local food programs to missionaries across the country and around the world. We would love to talk to you over coffee before or after our 10:45 Sunday service.

name: Hiland Park Baptist Church
Hiland Park Baptist Church - Panama City Campus
reviewSummary:
Red flags and we dont plan on coming back a second time.

Visited on Mother's day and although they looked solid on their website, the preaching was less than 10 minutes of the time the pastor spent up there. Rest of the time was telling jokes or stories that didn't really tie into the passage.
Hope this was a fluke but will not be coming back to this mega church.

The only person who greeted us was at the door despite having an entire welcome  desk fully staffed. First time here, fantastic service, genuine and kind people and atmosphere. The Pastor pulls you in with his words and makes your soul want more. I can't say enough good things! Praise GOD! Excellent place to worship. Wonderful children's ministry. The preaching is solid. So will definitely try this church again. But it’s massive and can feel overwhelming, from the parking to finding your way in and to the right areas, especially if it’s your first time and don’t know the layout. We followed crowds in the side doors and ended up in the youth area. Someone in youth asked if we were new, helped my son check in and then told me how to cut through to the waiting area so I could wait for the next service.
I sat in the foyer and observed from about 9:30-10:15 while I waited for the 9am service to get out and the 10:30 one to start.
I was never greeted, no one ever spoke a word to me as they passed by, but I stayed.
The service was really good, from the music to the preaching, which the message is what we came for. But if you’re late, you may not find a seat if you have 3 or more people and looking to sit together.
Our daughter is moving to PC for college and my son is in The Nutcracker, so we’re looking for somewhere we can go while visiting PC and a church our daughter can call home.
We’ll definitely try this church again.

The message was solid and biblical and there wasn’t any fluff to it and it was delivered well. 5/5 for the preaching. Never have I ever step foot inside of church I felt so quickly at home and at peace with the Lord

name: Hill Avenue Grace Lutheran Church
Hill Avenue Grace Lutheran Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary: The people are welcoming and the message and music is excellent. My church home for many years. Good people, good programs, faith in action. Pictured is a group filling blessing bags for the homeless. A warm and welcoming place for anyone looking to explore and develop their spirituality. Wonderful people here. Fabulous congregation!

name: Hillcrest Baptist Church
Hillcrest Baptist Church - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
Choosing Jesus Christ as my Lord and Savior was the best decision I made in my life and because of Hillcrest Baptist Church I've became a devout Christian, an ambassador of Jesus Christ. Me and my son love our church so much, we are a family, we are loved and most of all we are dedicated.
I saw an Easter flyer 5 years ago, during Covid and we had our service outside the community center's parking lot. I was just looking for something to do for Easter with my son, and ever since then we never stopped coming, and next thing you know, we became part of a beautiful church family. We don't judge or look down on people. We are here to lift you up and be a help in anyway possible.
We have bible studies on Thursdays and church service on Sundays. We have a beautiful worship crew, amazing nursery and children's ministry team and a phenomenal and energetic, hungry for the Lord teen ministry.  We also have women's bible study and men's ministry. And last but never the least, we love to eat!!
Come join us and start your journey with Jesus! I have been to many Churches in the Eastvale and surrounding area but I have found Hillcrest Baptist Church the most aligned with Biblical Teachings.  I was not looking motivational sermons or Churches that just want your money and give you feel good messages to keep you coming back and definitely not a Church like the Church of Laodicea which was Lukewarm.

Pastor Matt does a great job teaching God's Word through Scriptural Preaching as described in 2 Timothy 3:16-17.
I highly recommend for anyone who is looking for a Bible Teaching Church.

The Church Family Acts like the Body of Christ, always willing to help each other out or pray for each others needs. Everyone knows everyone and the Church is very welcoming to those who want to join the Church Family.

The Youth Pastor Jony does a great job with the teens, as a Worship Leader and very much involved in the Church functions.

If you are looking for a Church Family and to build your life in God's Scriptural Truths I highly recommend attending this Church.

All Glory to Jesus Christ our Lord and Savior. We have been attending Hillcrest Church since June 2025, and it has truly been a blessing for our family. We were recommended to this church by a family friend after feeling frustrated and discouraged from attending four different churches where the messages were not directly rooted in the Bible. We often felt like it was more about “itchy ears” than God’s Word.

From the moment we walked into Hillcrest, we were welcomed with genuine smiles and immediately felt a sense of belonging—like home. Pastor Matt’s message that first Sunday was for Father’s Day. It was encouraging and timely, and it made us want to come back. When we returned, we noticed something different: the message was biblical, direct, and spoke clearly about repentance. We walked out feeling convicted, and that’s when we knew this was the church we had been praying for.

We were looking for a church that speaks the truth of the Bible and challenges believers to live as true Christians, and Hillcrest does exactly that. After attending for a few months, we became church members for the first time, and we love the strong sense of community here.

We have four teenagers, and they are very engaged in the church. Hillcrest does an amazing job involving the youth, and because of this church, all of our kids have given their lives to Jesus. We’ve participated in many events and have built strong, meaningful relationships within the church.

If you are feeling the same way we were—looking for a Bible-guided church that speaks truth, calls for repentance, and truly feels like home—this is your church. Stop looking and give Hillcrest Church a try. I have been attending Hillcrest Baptist Church since its very first service. It has been a huge blessing in my life to be apart of such a loving and welcoming church family. If you are looking for a church to call home that teaches you straight from the bible...look no further...Hillcrest is your home. With programs for all ages, you will surely find what you are looking for here. The best church I’ve ever been . It helped me with my spiritual growth and knowing Jesus more everyday personally. Praise the Lord for leading us to Hillcrest Baptist Church where we can truly worship and serve God.

Hills Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
Love this Church, this family! ❤️ They welcomed me with open arms 2 1/2 years ago and have stood by me through thick and thin. I could not be more grateful to God for placing me here and for putting these wonderful people in my path. If you’re looking for a small church where you can grow, you have found it! I have experienced the most personal growth in the past 2 years. The whole pastoral team is awesome! #grateful #thankful 🙏🏼 It’s been a very long time that I have felt as welcomed as I felt at this church! Everyone was gracious and friendly ..I immediately felt comfortable and at home! So very down to earth!
Even though I live in  Lake Elsinore I may make the Ortega trip to attend because I felt the simplicity of Gods love w/out a lot of fal-da-Ral..and pretense! name: Hillside Community Church
Hillside Community Church - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
When I was around 8 or 9 years old attending the Hillside Arts Academy, I was placed with children a year below me in school during a summer camp, which made me extremely self-conscious at that age. These concerns were brought to Harmony Bathour, but I did not feel they were handled with the care, empathy, or understanding you would expect when dealing with a child.  Now that she has children of her own, I hope she can reflect on her actions with humility.

That said, things improved significantly in later years when different people took over directing the shows at the Arts Academy. The environment became much more supportive and encouraging after that change. I believe it’s important, especially within churches and leadership positions, to practice what we preach and treat vulnerable children with kindness, compassion, and care.

I understand no church is perfect, and one experience does not define an entire congregation. Still, I believe churches should be sanctuaries where children feel emotionally safe, supported, and encouraged. have been many churches across countries—first time experiencing racism, and notably, never in the secular world but here, in a place that supposed to be the house of Jesus. Monday Young Adults fellowship: a worship team member showed clear dismissiveness and arrogance from the start; she chuckled when I shared background mentioning I’m from Asia; and the most of time flirting with the guy next to her rather than respectful discussion of Bible study. I stayed and shared out of courtesy, though I wanted to leave.

I’d like to believe this was an isolated incident, but the reviews somehow show a pattern of bias against Asians. What kind of teaching leads to this? Are Jesus’ warnings to the Pharisees all in vain? I’ve been coming since March as a silent listener. I’m just trying to find my way..  this past Sunday I attended the 8:30 service. My intentions were to ask for prayers as I’m having a very hard time these days. I sat in the back as I usually do and my emotions took over. I cried like a baby, the usher was staring at me and I felt uncomfortable and left. (This was before church even started)I felt so alone in a house that shouldn’t make you feel that way. I feel the “clicks” everyone seems to know everyone. I’m quiet and shy so maybe that’s my fault. I will say Pastor Aaron does a great job with his words. I enjoy listening to him. I love my new church. I enjoy worship and fellowship after service. The welcome was very warm and inviting. Thank you Hillside for a new church to honor our father in heaven 🙏🙏🫶🏽🫶🏽 We are blessed to attend Hillside. The strong emphasis on youth programs, Bible exposition, Community, serving the church and others in practical ways drew us here and keeps us here.
Hal & Peg

reviewSummary:
Great church I visited it with my grandson and the cry room is so nice for little ones he enjoyed it and it helped the grown ups. If you need to hear The Word, Sam has the voice you need. He is subtle and deliberate, the impassioned guy next door. Carly, his wife, brings the power. Sam delivers, always on point with a cadence and a vernacular, a word choice that resonates. The Hillsong team… you need to experience this. Great place to sacrifice your kid to BA'AL , right pastor?
*Take a tour of the underground tunnels, but watch your cornhole 💯 ✌🏼 Having gone through Hillsong College I was truly missing the house and it’s heart. When I was in the States for a year for work I was super blessed to find this location just a few minutes away from my office. It was great to be back and experience God’s faithfulness in and through this ministry. I've never felt hostility from a church from the moment I parked my car but here we are. I was driving by on a Sunday at 1130 am and decided to stop by here. I didn't know the service times or anything, I just saw signs for the church and felt compelled to stop by (i do not normally go to church). I was stared at by a gentleman with tattoos and a long biker beard, and as I was walking around outside he confronted me. He asked if there was something I needed, and so I asked what the service times were. He answered abruptly and then walked away. I don't know about you but I was expecting at least a half assed warm welcome since I've obviously never been before (I was wandering around looking lost for sure).

Thanks long bearded wanna be biker. You single handedly put a bad taste in my mouth regarding church, not just hillsong. Is this how Christians treat strangers?

Hilltop Church Chula Vista - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary: I was led to this church by the Holy Spirit. My buddy at work told me I couldn’t be an orphan as a believer.  The following weekend we went to this church.  A brother greeted my family in the front and I asked if we can worship together.  And I was welcomed here.  The Truth of Jesus is preached here.  Come on and join us to glorify God. Solid Bible teaching.   God’s presence is strong.   Great loving community This awesome Christian Church is where I went to Sunday school back in 1962,63,64,65 when it was a little white wood school house building with crickity sounding wood steps separate from the main church on the same dirt lot before the church was enlarged and the little white building was removed. Here is when I took the glorious walk of my life down the main church isle all by myself to meet Pastor Bonner back then in 1965 to accept Jesus Christ as my Lord & Savior as my family and aunt Betty looked on in happiness ever since. Amen Jesus and glory to God.⛪❤🇺🇸✌ Awesome place for fellowship and getting to know Gods word. Very friendly and inviting. Family oriented. Friendly. Fun. Teaches the gospel. Answers questions about the bible, any time. Challenges us to learn the word.

Hilltop Tabernacle - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary:
I was a youth in Sr Gerald Buxtons Church in garden Grove and have never had anything but good experiences there. The Buxtons are the real deal Godly men and women of God.
We are all human and no one is perfect, and we all fall short of God's glory, and yet he paves a way for us to be restored.
When I was in my lowest time, after I survived an abusive marriage, became discouraged and I fell and got myself pregnant out of wedlock, Bro and sister Gerald Buxton never judged me, they Embraced me, helped me heal, they loved me and took me under their wing, Sis Shirley Buxton was more like a mom to me then my own mom.
I've known them since I was 8 and I'm 65 and still keep in touch, (though I now live on tht East coast) they have been and will always will be family to me, no matter where I am in this world, my heart will always value the people (including my sis Dede) who gave me my roots and never gave up on me, even when I messed up, failed or fell short.
That's why I am still living for God today, because God doesn't give up on us when we fail or mess up or even fall short.
So just keep moving forward, don't give up, pray and seek God, you are His and He is more then enough and will walk through the the fire and the valley with you, so trust Him.... ❤️🙏

Watered down church will not lead you to heaven, but a Holy Ghost filled Pastor with the fear of God and not man does his best to lead the way. COME You Will be Blessed and You Will Hear from God 💕

name: Historic Old Mission San Luis Rey Church
Historic Old Mission San Luis Rey Church - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary:
I have visited about ten different California missions so far, but this was my very first time at the Historic Old Mission San Luis Rey, and it truly stands out. Unlike some of the smaller missions, this one features a remarkably large and exceptionally well-maintained community. The entire grounds are beautifully organized, pristine, and full of life. 🏛️✨
Because of its historical significance and beauty, the mission draws a lively crowd of both locals and tourists. Despite the high volume of visitors, the large parking lot makes the entire experience completely smooth and stress-free. There is so much history to absorb and plenty of beautiful sights to see throughout the property. 🌸⛪
It is an incredibly impressive and peaceful place, and if I have guests visiting from out of town in the future, this is absolutely a spot I would love to bring them to. Highly recommended for anyone looking to experience a beautiful piece of California history! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Such a beautiful Mission! It’s a huge mission and it also has a coffee shop, museum, gift shop and a cemetery all in the same lot. There’s plenty of parking. The mission is active and has masses in service. We went on a Sunday and mass was being held at 9am. As soon as the mass was over we were able to go inside to see the beautiful church! We had an awesome time learning about the history of the mission. We also grabbed some coffee and walked around the cemetery. First mission down,  20 to go in California! "The King of Missions" really nice couple of hours visit, started at the cemetery grounds looking at the old tombstones, then entered the main church a classical Franciscan novo-hispanic design similar to those found in Sonora and Chihuahua. Next we hit up the museum which is really nice and has some unique artifacts, finished walking the grounds down to the Lavandería. Recommend to visit this place. California history comes to life. Mission times, Mexican-American war, early 19th century. A nice and peaceful historic church located in Oceanside. This mission is very beautiful inside and is nicely maintained. I’ve had family members get married here and it was beautiful. Also go visit the museum that’s here as well! A beautiful old mission chapel restored and in use for weekly mass. I have been able to attend and find a seat. Normally seats are a premium at all masses held in the mission church 7 am English and 9 am or 7 pm misa en Español. The attendees are always friendly and the priests are very welcoming. The museum, gift shop, and cafe open later and close early, so plan accordingly. I recommend visiting the cemetery as it is beautiful, peaceful, and most the time has a cool ocean breeze passing through. The old priests pass through and have been known to greet and bless you and your loved ones.  🙏👍🏼❤️🌬️🌊

They don’t have any sacramental supper like mash potatoes and gravy or pork chops but Dr. Dan Drangle puts on a nice service praising Gord. Many 12 step meetings take place here. name: Hollywood United Methodist Church
Hollywood United Methodist Church - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary:
"Open hearts, open minds and open doors" - the people of the United Methodist Church (current church wide slogan). Were a congregation who strives to live as Jesus commanded, LOVE others. John 13:34-35: "A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another: just as I have loved you, you also are to love one another. By this all people will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another."
LGBTQ+ affirming. A safe non judgemental congregation. I was looking for a church to visit while on vacation, and I was definitely enticed by the fact that the Enchantment Under the Sea dance from Back to the Future was filmed here. While at the church, I was welcomed kindly and got to participate in worship with a Christ-loving community. I was especially delighted that I had stumbled upon the day of the church picnic and was invited to stay. Through the picnic, I met some wonderful parishioners who really showed me God in a way I didn't expect when I went into church that day. The church's history, theology, and values are listed on their website. (Reposted from my old account.) A Perfect Example Of A Pastor Destroying A Beautiful Faith Community

It's sad what has happened to this church community. It was a thriving church with two campuses. The music was excellent. The leadership was excellent. Message... excellent. A real sense of family.

The new pastor, Hannah Adair Bonner, has destroyed that. She has formal complaints against her by nearly 30 community members, a psychological evaluation has been requested, one campus has closed, the remaining campus is said to be in financial trouble and is losing members and staff. Community members and staff are complaining of chargeable offenses such as harassment, immorality, crime, racism, and discrimination, just to name a few.

And the Bishop, Dottie Escobedo-Frank, spent months ignoring the complaints, letting the community fall apart at the hands of a person accused of numerous abuses.

This didn't have to happen. It's all very sad. walking along Hollywood Star blvd, I was.attracted by this beautiful chuech, and the red ribbon is remarkable I attended the Memoral service for my friend,  [Navy Veteran Richard Settle] in 2024. & it was beautiful and the members of the church were outstanding,  & John West  the music director was very kind to us veterans. Blessings from Andy Harland co-chairman of the Sal Guarriello veterans memorial park committee in West Hollywood ♥️.

name: Holy Angels Catholic Church
Holy Angels Catholic Church - Arcadia Campus
reviewSummary:
I grew up in Arcadia and many friends went to this church. I was raised Methodist but am entering OCIA this fall. While visiting here I attended mass in Pentecost. Wow! What a beautiful mass! I was so moved. The homily was wonderful, the music/choir amazing. I have been thinking about it for days and can't wait to attend again at my next visit. Absolutely beautiful♥️ Pretty much loved this school for myself from PreK to 8th grade.

I'm class of 2009. Shoutout to Ted Carroll the principal, Shawn Huls of the 7th and 8th grade, and the amazing sweet janitors over the years. Thank you for making it a great time of adolescence and maturity for me Holy Angels !!!! Go Angels!!!!!! Always and forever!!!!!!! Best church I have ever been. Big and beautiful. Padres are speaking very clear and understandable. God bless America. This church would not let my platonic work wife get baptized. Her grandfather died and she had to go attend the funeral, requiring her to miss a few classes and the church said she wasn't serious about it and that they didn't want her to be a part of their church. Would Jesus do that? I think not. Beautiful Catholic Church.
Unfortunately my first time here I was there for a funeral.  The church was very welcoming and made all the people in attendance feel at home.  There were many attendees and they Church has a large parking lot to accommodate our family and friends.
The priest gave some very kind words and words of hope and condolences.
The mass was very beautiful.  The priest of course had a very traditional service, there was a singer present who had an amazing voice.
The priest, alter boy/ girl and the entire staff were very professional and cordial, they helped create a very lovely service for our family.

name: Holy Angels Church
Holy Angels Church - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary:
Father Gianni and the Holy Angels church is, in a word, wonderful. Father Gianni crafts thoughtful and pertinent sermons that help parishioners navigate through the world and through their challenges. His strong faith and dedication to the word of God shines brightly in the way he conducts his life and church.

Father Gianni's life story informs his sermons and is interesting in and of itself. If you meet him, hopefully he can share how he came to where he is. I first met Father Gianni as an officiant for my and my wife's wedding. Through that process I learned of Father Gianni's faith, his dedication to his congregation, and who he is as a person. I also count him as one of my and my wife's friends. He is a wonderful person and runs a wonderful church and I'm sure if you ever are to attend his sermons you will come away feeling similarly. This church is purely blissful! Father Gionni and the clergy has been nothing but kind, compassionate and full of love. The people who come to Holy Angels are wonderful and kind! It's the community I have been waiting to be a part of. I recommend Holy Angel's Church to everyone! The Church Community here is very warm and welcoming, with a clean and beautiful physical space. The events are really engaging and promote a sense of community and fellowship among the members. Overall, it's a very positive and enjoyable experience to be a part of this Catholic community. Since I came here I found a welcoming community and made me feel part of the family. I live in Texas but I come to Orange County twice and now I have a family church! Father Gianni is the perfect representative of God - he “gets it”, in the same way Jesus “got it”. He focuses on what is important and comes from the purest of God’s love. As much as I give thanks to God for many things, I also thank Him for messengers he sends such as this man. What a beautiful church 🙌🏼

Holy Assembly Church of God in Christ - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary: I loved the music even though it was too loud 😭😭😭 This is a true place of worship. A place where the Holy Spirit resides. A place where a individual who is lost, can find Jesus. The Bishop who is the overseer at the church is a man by the name of Bishop Christopher Milton and he is a true man of GOD who have a heart for the people. I grew up in this church as a child til a teenager with my grandmother sister Griffin my sister Jennifer and auntie Sister Linda Debose. Hey uncle Chris and Auntie Tonya.🥰🙋🏾‍♀️ The best pastor and Bishop the best first lady the best members it's a beautiful place to worship. Love my church. I second Faith Griffins post, I also miss this church so I’m going back today and hopefully will continue.

Holy Bible Orthodox Baptist Church - Carlsbad Campus

Holy Cross Melkite Catholic Church - Fullerton Campus
reviewSummary: This a wonderful parish for Catholics seeking a more traditional service (Divine Liturgy) in a eastern way. The Liturgy is celebrated on 11:00 in English, Arabic, and a little Greek. name: Holy Family Catholic Church - Orange Campus
reviewSummary:
I love how often the church offers masses daily. Priests are friendly and I love their homilies. The community is also warm and gentle. It is a very nice church to pray and strengthen relationship with Lord. Holy Family is a peaceful church to visit or attend mass.
The choirs are wonderful to hear during masses at 11:00. I feel in a very spiritual place during mass with the music & prayers.
Today it was a very special mass welcoming our Fr. Sy Nguyen. It was a blessing moment for my family to be part of this ceremony with all Holy Family Fathers. 💕🙏 I have grown in my Catholic Faith,  much in part having to do with Father Sy, the Pastor at Holy Family.  My husband and 4 kids have attended Holy Family since 1989, and they all received most of their sacraments there. It will always feel like my Catholic "home" to me. The Holy Mass is very reverent and traditional at Holy Family, which I appreciate.  It is very welcoming. There are many opportunities to be involved in Parish life. Over the years, my husband and I enjoyed helping with Cathecism classes, Jr. High Youth Ministry,  Parish Councel, Ushering, St. Vincent de Paul Society,  Choir member,  and volunteering at the Fiesta, and taking classes to further our understandingof Catholicism. I definitely suggest that you come to Mass any day of the week, and see for yourself what a wonderful place it is to Worship our Lord and be a part of this community of Faith. Good priests there

Spiritual connection for everyone..from quiet prayer time during Adoration..to many church groups to choose from..of course daily Holy mass said always with deep devotion. Many special celebrations during the year.

Wonderful inspiring music ministry

Full and caring community My initial impression of Holy Family was phenomenal. Previously gave the church a 5, updating to a 3 now. Overall, it is a good church. You cannot be too critical of our churches and priests, everyone does their best. The parking lot is big and it’s easy to park. The choir is good. I like that they let you take the Eucharist by tongue, the Michael archangel prayer is a nice touch at the end.

However, the church is incredibly hard to get a hold of. We’ve been attending for 4 months and still haven’t been able to contact anyone about becoming parishioners and the online portal doesn’t work. The Eucharist ministers repeatedly do not give our son the blessing when he carry him up during the Eucharist. Just because he is a baby or asleep doesn’t mean you shouldn’t give it to him - that very much bothers me and we’ve emailed the church about this and never got a response (2mo later).the lady that helps people find a seat during mass is very rude as well and comes off very judgemental to those arriving late.

name: Holy Family Catholic Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
Have wanted to come to mass here for a while and finally had the chance last night. Went to the 5:00 vigil mass and it was wonderful. Very welcoming parish and Father Mateo was so loving. He introduced himself to us afterward and even blessed some items we purchased at their bookstore and some medals we were wearing. Can’t wait to go back.

The church is beautiful. There is an amazing grotto of Our Lady outside and a very sweet depiction of Our Lord learning carpentry alongside St. Jospeh and Our Lady. We visited this church as they are celebrating Simbang Gabi mass. School children dressed up as angels, kings , Mary and Joseph. The children re enacted the nativity scene and sang for the parishioners Beautiful sanctuary and uplifting homily. Loved the experience...and the boy scout pancake breakfast. This church is absolutely beautiful. Wonderful clerg7 and parishioners. Wonderful place of worship. Went to see my friends baptism the day before Easter and it was quite an experience. It was my second time attending mass at holy family and I would definitely go back again. The members are very kind and genuine. The fathers are wise and speak very well during mass. The choir is very talented in fact they sing a lot, it's almost like a spiritual musical. The building is quite a sight to see as well, unique architecture.

reviewSummary:
Reverent masses, both novus ordo and Latin. Holy priests. Vibrant congregation. Beautiful church. A treasure in the heart of Long Beach. Very nice church. I like that the altar is traditional and all the masses are ad orientem, that is, facing towards the tabernacle rather than away from it. And the fact that the tabernacle is front and center is a big plus; not to mention the communion rails and the more traditional method of giving communion. Good, good.

Fr Irving is a wonderful pastor, may the Lord grant him a long and spiritually fruitful life. All of your senses are captivated. The priests’ attention to detail during the Mass is spectacular. It’s so easy to pray. The best church in Long Beach. I love the Traditional Latin Mass. Father Peter & Father Robert both have great sermons. Ever since I started coming here, I have grew a lot more in my faith. Don’t sleep on the Latin Mass.

name: Holy Name of Jesus Church
Holy Name of Jesus Church - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband and I absolutely love our Catholic Church. Every time we attend Mass, we feel God’s presence guiding our marriage, our home, and our spiritual journey. The priests share powerful, meaningful messages that stay with us throughout the week, and the community is warm, welcoming, and full of genuine faith.
This parish has strengthened not only our relationship with God, but also our relationship with each other. We are truly grateful to call this our church home. My wife and I love this Church and its community of faithful believers. We have been active parishoners here for many years. We are blessed to have a wonderful pastor leading us in Father Erik, as well as his trusted team in helping implement the many ministries and visions for our growth and our future. A very special shout out to all of the clergy currently asigned to our parish and especially to Father Thomas Davis for his tireless commitment to God and His people. We had our photo booth Desert Luna Photobooths here for a youth kickoff event and had such a blast! Thanks for having us and letting us be part of a fun celebration!! Very friendly and helpful people. We are visiting here from Cincinnati Ohio for health reasons. The deacon took time after mass to give me a special blessing. The priest was very nice and talked to us at the beginning of mass. The Boy Scout Troop 11 here is the best troop and I think the whole County. They help out all of Redlands and are very good citizens. I hope to see them as the 2018 bicycle classic. I saw these Scout putting up posters for the 2018 bicycle classic and they were very polite to all the people. When I saw people get baptized here at this church Holy Name of Jesus Parish Hall it was so good to see the boys helping out with the fire.

Holy Revival Non Denominational Church - Westwood Campus
reviewSummary: Pastor James and Son are such amazing ppl. They are always trying to help anyone in need. They have FREE FOOD every Tuesday morning. Stop by every Tuesday and Sunday service with pastor James. I love attending Holy Revival's church service. The sanctuary is filled with the presence of the Holy Spirit, and Pastor James is a truly anointed, unique man of God. 🙏🏾 Pastor/Teacher James Thomas is a real man of God and deliver his sermons in alignment to the word. Holy Revival church has  an open door feeling as you enter the building. It is truly a blessing to have a real church in a city mostly known for poverty and crime. Holy Revival Non Denominational Church is a light in the city of Compton, Ca. Holy Revival Non Denominational Church is a welcoming and giving church. Constantly helping and serving the community through the vision and with the help of Pastor James Thomas; and volunteers. Thank you for the time, work, and dedication you have put into the Compton community. Holy Revival is a church where you can fell like a family and where you can learn the truth about the word God. Pastor James is a pastor that is so transparent in delivering the word it will have you researching and wanting to know more bout the word of God. Pastor James wants all his members to be blessed and to succeed. This church is for anybody who wants to hear the raw truth about the word of God. This church is for anybody seeking to be apart of a community and family.

reviewSummary: This is a great church that is welcoming and supportive of all who walk through their doors!  My wife and I have been going here for two years now and we are more than at home here! reviewSummary: This church is an oasis in the frenetic busyness of Orange County. It offers a calm, reflective, sacred space for entering into a worshipful experience and connecting with God in a personal, individual, and safe way.  It is not a typical OC church. If you are looking for a church with a light show, loud band, and fog machine, you won't find those things there. But if you are looking for a place with deep, thought-provoking, intelligent teaching; artistic and sacred worship; and authentic, accepting people, you will not be disappointed.   My spiritual life and understanding of god have deepened significantly since I started attending HTC. Great church ! Wonderful pastor! Great vibes !and  Nicest people that you can meet Beautiful church service, amazing & thoughtful sermons, very welcoming church body - very happy here at Holy Trinity! Really enjoyed the people and worship experience. The preaching was excellent. Very friendly community and committed to prayer, hospitality, and loving the outcast.

name: Hope Lutheran Church - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been going to this church for almost five years.  We were looking for an affirming church.  Even though this church is an Evangelical Lutheran Churches of America church it is far from affirming or progressive. During my time here they have never held a same sex marriage ceremony or celebrated Pride Week. You definitely won’t see a rainbow flag or poster either inside or out.
The pastor, Dan Cole, is progressive, but he is only an interim pastor and has received quite a bit of resistance to any moves to become more welcoming.
I am not saying Hope is a bad church.  It is certainly more ambivalent than most churches in the Temecula Valley, but ambivalence is not the same as welcoming, is it?
If you decide to attend Hope just know what you are getting into.  This is a don’t ask/don’t tell church, with a small intrenched core group of members that is very resistant to any changes that would make it more progressive. Hope Lutheran is a welcoming and friendly congregation.   You get what you put into your experience at HLC, and everyone is willing to walk with you along your journey.  Pastor Sandy is a great leader of our church that is devoted to her congregation.  All are Welcome and are appreciated along with encouraged to grow in there faith.  The facility is really beautiful and the church has a preschool and kindergarten.  Feel free to join us and worship on Sunday either at 8AM or 10:15AM. We are an RIC church and are welcoming to ALL! Excellent school, and excellent teachers!!! ❤️

name: Humanity Church
Humanity Church - Pomona / Claremont Campus
reviewSummary:
"Church shopping" can be difficult and if you're like me, you're looking at reviews to get an idea of what a church is about. So, I am going to do my best to evaluate the church in a way that will be helpful for others searching.

Humanity church is true to its name. There is an overwhelming sense of community here and genuine connection. I felt like I was at a house church in that aspect. My initial impressions upon arriving was to take in the beautiful church building, quaint but stunning. I arrived a couple of minutes late and was greeted warmly by two ladies. The church community is small enough that you could tell they recognize who the visitors are, but they don't put you on blast as some churches do.

The church is definitely charismatic in their worship, preaching, and friendliness. The worship felt like a concert and the sermons were delivered with charisma and conviction. The Holy Spirit is welcome here and the sermons are more "inspired" than a 1-2-3 point sermon. Pastor Nathan brings up a sweat towel to dab at his forehead as he excitedly shares his convictions and relates his message to personal stories to tie in his points. The sermons feel supplemental and appear to be intended to be in conjunction with their "Humanity groups" (life/small groups). It is not taught verse by verse like a Calvary Chapel, but felt more like listening to a speaker at a conference.

At the end of the service they push for you to get connected to a group, which I could tell is really a central part of where their community thrives.

In addition, prior to my visit, I did some internet investigation on the church and found they have a strong social media presence. Through their church website, I was able to click on a link to their Instagram where there were current and up to date postings, keeping people connected. They are a small church but clearly doing something right to have such an enthusiastic congregation.

The only negative comment I have to add is that the worship was not my favorite. There were fog machines and light beams, which really felt too showy to me and was distracting for me to worship. The singers were a bit pitchy, which was also distracting at times. While churches should be inclusive, I also believe that people should be placed where they are gifted and that there should be worship team auditions, as uncomfortable as that may be for some.

I would recommend this church to anyone who is comfortable in a charismatic church setting! I’ve been going since 2016. Simply put, it has been life changing. I am so grateful for this community! People here are very accepting. The talks are super thought-provoking. Nathan the lead pastor and his wife Marla are so creative, very hospitable, even to people who are very different, and yet it’s because of their love for God, his purposes, and their love for all people. People here are so generous and willing to help each other. Jesus is always preached. The Word is always taught. So many people here are not just church goers. They are part of a force that’s becoming unstoppable.  I have so so so so much more to say but it’s way better when you experience this church for yourself. name: Iglesia Bautista de Santa Ana
Iglesia Bautista de Santa Ana - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary:
I live 60 miles away from this church but it's worth it,  100% bible based if you need the truth about JESUCRIST. this is the rigth place. Is great, the word of God is preached the right way. PREACH The people are so kind and  study 📖 all the time the Bible!! What a great blessing from God to have allowed them to form a Bible-based congregation, where the Church of the Lord Jesus Christ can gather to study the holy and powerful Word of God; to celebrate it with all their hearts, worshiping and loving the Triune God, the only true God, and His only begotten Son, the Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have redemption by His blood. 🩸🙌🏻🙇🏻‍♀️

He is worthy of all praise and worship! True God and true man. Let us worship and love Him with all our soul, with all our mind, with all our heart, and with all our strength, for the great love and immense mercy that God has shown us, granting us His grace to rescue and save us from our vain way of life, and adopting us as His children through the immense sacrifice of Jesus Christ on the cross of Calvary. 🙌🏻

It is by His blood 🩸 that we have been redeemed and chosen to be a holy people, pleasing to God, for the glory and honor of God the Father and His Son Jesus Christ. 👆🏻🙌🏻😭❤️🙇🏻‍♀️

Hallelujah! 👆🏻👏🏻

How I wish we had a place like this in Argentina, where CHRIST is truly THE CENTER; where Jesus Christ is truly exalted not only in Word but in spirit and in truth 🙌🏻 where His Word is proclaimed faithfully, without variation or fear; WHERE THE HOLY SPIRIT GOVERNS the life of the church; where HUMILITY, LOVE, and TRUTH can be seen in both the pastors and the entire congregation.

I know that in my country there are also churches and faithful servants of God, and I thank the Lord for them. However, in my personal experience, finding a congregation where these virtues remain has become increasingly difficult.

It is heartbreaking to see how, in many places, some of those called to serve and shepherd God's flock end up lording it over them, when the Scriptures call us precisely to be examples of humility, service, and love. Knowledge can come to take the place of humility, care for souls, and brotherly love, thus contradicting the true vocation to which we have been called: to live and sincerely practice the piety taught in the Gospel of our Lord Jesus Christ.

Therefore, those who have the privilege of gathering in a healthy church faithful to the Scriptures should give thanks to God. It doesn't matter if it is far away; there is no price or distance that can compare to the privilege of meeting with the Lord's saints.

“How good and pleasant it is when God’s people live together in unity!” (Psalm 133:1)

“Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.” (1 Corinthians 8:1b)

My longing is to find a church where, upon entering, one immediately recognizes that CHRIST IS LORD; where spiritual authority is exercised not as dominion, but as service; where the Word reigns supreme over opinions; where the Holy Spirit holds first place; where love is more visible than knowledge; and where those who serve and shepherd are examples rather than protagonists.

Therefore, my words will always begin by worshiping and exalting God, for He is the King to whom I belong and whom I serve. This is also why I long for a church that honors Him in the way He Himself teaches us in His Word.

This is not a secondary matter, nor is it an option that each person can define according to their own judgment. We are all called to humbly submit to the will of our Lord, knowing that one day we will give an account before Him. Therefore, far from trusting in our own humanity or making excuses, we long to live in obedience, depending each day on His grace and the sanctifying work of the Holy Spirit.

Greetings from your sister in Christ Jesus, from Buenos Aires, Argentina. ❤️🙏🏻🕊️

P.S.: I started listening to your teachings on YouTube some time ago. Although I have been attending church for many years, over time I have seen changes that have caused me deep sadness. I continue to pray and seek a church where the Holy Spirit of God reigns and not the spirit of a man.

Iglesia Universal is truly a special place where faith, hope, and transformation come together. From the moment you step inside, you feel a sense of peace and genuine care from the pastors, volunteers, and members of the church. Everyone is welcoming, and you can tell right away that this is a community built on love, prayer, and the desire to help people draw closer to God.

The services are powerful and filled with encouragement. The pastors speak with clarity and passion, delivering messages that are practical, faith-driven, and easy to apply in daily life. Whether you are facing challenges, looking for spiritual growth, or simply seeking direction, the teachings here inspire you to trust in God and keep moving forward.

They have prayers for families, finances, health, and personal battles—reminding us that God cares about every area of our lives. The church truly lives up to its mission of being a place of hope and transformation.

I also appreciate the consistency and dedication of the team here. The church offers daily services, making it possible for anyone to come and receive guidance no matter their schedule. This shows how committed they are to helping the community.

If you are searching for a place where you can grow your faith, find healing, and experience the power of prayer, Iglesia Universal is a wonderful church to be part of. It’s more than just a building—it’s a family that walks with you on your spiritual journey. I am grateful for everything I’ve experienced here, and I highly recommend it to anyone who wants to strengthen their relationship with God. Amazing church! A beautiful church at the mouth of Old Town San Diego.   Definitely worth a visit when in the area. The Immaculate Conception Catholic Church in Old Town San Diego is a stunning piece of history and faith. Completed in 1917, the church was built on the site of California’s first Catholic parish, which dates back to the late 18th century when Father Junípero Serra established the Mission San Diego de Alcalá nearby. The church is a beautiful example of Spanish Revival architecture, with its whitewashed walls, red-tiled roof, and an iconic bell tower that stands as a beacon of San Diego’s Catholic heritage.

Inside, the church exudes a sense of peace and reverence, featuring stained-glass windows and intricate woodwork. As the spiritual heart of Old Town, it continues to serve as a place of worship and community gathering. It’s a quiet reminder of the city’s rich cultural and spiritual roots.

name: Immanuel Baptist Church
Immanuel Baptist Church - Main Campus
Immanuel Baptist Church - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary:
Terrible place for a funeral.

Had my grandma's funeral here, the preacher was genuinely awful. Unfortunately I didn't get his name, he was an old man. Kept going on about how we'll never see our grandma again if we aren't good enough Christians, we'll go to hell ect, and going to die soon. He kept going on about it instead of any comfort for a grieving family. It felt like a judgemental lecture instead of a funeral. Plus he kept forgetting about the basic facts that were just shared about her, it felt like he was trying to make his speech longer because he wasn't prepared. He just felt really rude and judgemental. There were also some technical issues with the microphone, but they were resolved pretty fast so not a big deal there. A perfect place for a Graduation Celebration for Gateway Seminary. Graduates were from many different countries and for inland valley locals to meet new friends and be encouraged along the path of life. Another safe and truly enjoyable 4th of July celebration.
Church staff & volunteers have always been welcoming/friendly, ensuring all who attend feel at home. Went to Immanuel today for the Palm Sunday service. There was no mention of Palm Sunday or the relevance of Palm Sunday.  The second service was only 1/2 full. The pastor gave a sermon on three parables from Luke 15. Ending with the parable of the prodigal son with his own twist of grace. My husband and I were so disappointed because the last time we were there, it was bustling with wonderful people. This time it was very sad. They wanted us to take a succulent and invite our neighbors to "Easter" Services, [secular name for Resurrection Sunday]. Not a word about the power of the resurrection.  I don't think we will be returning to this church except for the fantastic concert given by the Collingsworth Family, which we paid to see. What is happening in the church? I posted a review that I deleted because I know it would have been reported and the possibility to get removed because of how honest and true it was. Although proof of my wedding would secure the review because it would be true!

I have been baptized by this church. I have been counseled by Robb Zinn as a child with my family as well as when I got married at the church. I have never been considered a member as far as I know.  If you don’t tithe you are not a member just a guest.

Uncle Robb after you baptized me did my parents not tithe and  that is why you never try to facilitate the very relationship you anointed? How do you not see how manipulating that baptism was. You definitely never treated me like a child of God, you wanted nothing to do with me because of who my father was. Had to be a family thing not a religious thing right!?!

IBC was the church that laid the foundation for my relationship with Christianity. That foundation was, that Christians act one way in public and another way behind closed doors. Age and experience has taught me how IBC is just a business hiding behind the Bible and religion for some tax breaks. Robb Zinn you of all people should have known better than take a child in the environment and situation I was in and baptize me for show. I am sure you spent many nights in that room on Casa Loma wonder why you were dealt the cards that put you there, what you could of done as a kid to end up in the situation your parents put you in. Yet when given the opportunity to actually do what Jesus said to do, you only did the talking no walking. Do as I say not as I do behind closed doors.
That baptism was you just playing a part and now almost 40 years later that prop you used is here to tell you and everyone the truth. IBC is nothing put a Ponzi scheme using religion to justify their action as sinners and avoid accountability to the damages their actions have done.

name: Immanuel Oceanside
Immanuel Oceanside - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary: Love being a member of this church. We found this church after moving across the country and have enjoyed calling it home. Comfortable pews great for worshipping The Creator and stuff. Please stop by🙏 God Bless✝️✝️ Great home church based on God’s truth. Everyone is truly welcome

name: Immanuel Praise Fellowship
Immanuel Praise Fellowship - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary: Immanuel Praise Fellowship is a transformative ministry that lives out its mission to “change generations one family at a time” every day. Come visit the church I love!!! Great place for worship and praise every Sunday, beautiful environment for adults and children. Love this Church! Great leaders, teachers of God’s Word, excellent Bible study and a congregation that shows love and kindness. Immanuel Praise Fellowship is where the teachings of God is simplified. Healing generations one family at a time. A family oriented church that will love on you to the fullest.  This church’s motto is healing generations one family and a time and that exactly what they work to do!

name: Immanuel Presbyterian Church
Immanuel Presbyterian Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
This 138-year-old church is a beautiful hidden gem in the heart of downtown. The historic architecture, peaceful atmosphere, and timeless charm make it a truly special place to visit. It’s amazing to see such a well-preserved landmark surrounded by the city’s modern skyline. Whether you’re stopping by to admire the architecture, spend a quiet moment in reflection, or learn about its history, it’s definitely worth a visit. Absolutely loved this candlelight concert! It felt so magical! The venue added to the magical feeling. Beautiful cathedral and the event was beautifully lit by so many candles. It was such a joy and amazing experience to witness the beautiful ladies of the string quartet do their thing. Amazing! Immanuel Presbyterian was the perfect venue for the String Quartet tribute to Fleetwood Mac—my all-time favorite band. The quartet was incredibly talented, and their music beautifully complemented the grand and elegant atmosphere of the church. I truly wished the show lasted longer; I could have listened to them for hours.

This was my second Candlelight Concert, and it was absolutely outstanding. I will definitely be booking more shows and bringing my girlfriends along to experience the same magic. Thank you for sharing such beautiful music with us. Nice candlelight experience. Beautiful venue. Easy check in and exit. Nice atmosphere and musicians were great! Beautiful venue. Amazing performance. Great date night idea.  Looking forward to another event.

name: In His Presence Church
In His Presence Church - Woodland Hills Campus
reviewSummary: I love Foundations, it made me see a different side of me that I thought I never had. I have a holy spirit, got baptized and learn to be a disciple. I want to do it again. I want to lean God s wisdom again and again. I met a new family which I love and care for. New freinds, I recommend for anybody that's new or other people that haven't try it yet. You get to discuss the bible with a group of people that also bring food every week. There's alot of help if your just a beginner.  I just love it so much. I love my church! I've started coming here about 15 years ago. Things happened & I left about 4 years in. But Like Jesus, The people of the church never left me. They would call to Check on me, encourage me & to remind me that I was loved. That was exactly what I needed. God knows what we need. I came back home, but I haven't left. With the guidance of Pastor Mel and Desiree, my journey with the Lord got stronger. The lead pastors are anointed and loving. I've built wonderful like-minded friendships & a loving foundation here that I couldn't find anywhere else! Highly Recommend with all my heart! Christian, non-denomination, multicultural church with many options, to love, receive and give.! I’ve been attending this church off and on since 2009 back when they had a 1pm Service!!! I have solid connections I’ve made and see at the services. I recently attended the Foundations class and I learned a lot. I’m trying to make solid connections and make friends with other like minded women something that can be very hard these days. It use to be so much easier. I love that there are more activities to attend. Pastor Desiree is The Best Royal Queen for Christ and she cares about people. Pastor Mel and Desiree speak truth. I’ve gone to many churches on fire for Trump which is cool but this church is on fire for Jesus 100+%. ! I do wish they would talk more about Trump like other churches I’ve been to do. I miss that like I do the 1pm service. I was attending a church on the beach in Santa Monica and there was a Trump inferno that kept me going for a year. They even had a political text group and a member text group where we got together for birthdays and everyone was invited. Also Biblical and political event notifications and we went out to eat afterwards as a group. It’s a small church so that’s why. Back when I was attending another church, Sheila started a Bible verse group with ourselves and a few men on Facebook and these verses nursed me back to health when I attended other churches. I share these verses daily with my sons, another church group text and the group text developed in the Foundations class group I was in. This is a safe church I’m comfortable with bringing my sons to or people I’m close with.This is the longest I’ve ever attended.  The word is marvelous and the worship is fire!!!!! Their Worship Team makes you love Worship music. This is the church!!!!!! Ive attended several churches and always feel the holy spirit and very happy bonding with other Christians and honoring, worshiping GOD. Did not feel the holy spirit here. Did not like the sermon. Didnt even hear them say Jesus once. I got the feeling of wolves in sheep’s clothing, Didn’t even feel the holy spirit when they were praying for people. Felt off and not ok. Really sad feeling. I also had a friend that went here for years and she got super depressed and called the office one day asking for prayer!!! Their response was they DONT pray for people mid week. She was in a deep depression and got no help!!  I do not recommend going here. Even my other friend that went with me said it felt weird!! And she loves church. She said let’s go….. let’s sneak out. She said it was a weird feeling. BEST CHURCH EVER!!!!! It’s easy to pick apart and criticize but we are flawed people in a flawed world with an assignment and that’s to go out into all the world, preach the gospel, witness Jesus, win souls and make disciples. That’s what IHPC is all about! Loving Jesus and loving his people and getting them ready for His return! And most of all, allowing the presence of God to MOVE. It’s Holy ground where you can drop your walls, remove the over analyzing, and allow Holy Spirit to work. It’s life changing and transformational, and I can vouch for that. Blessings pour through IHPC. There is fruit, there is healing, there are so many testimonies of FAITH and MIRACLES. All Glory to King Jesus! Thank you Pastors Mel & Desiree for creating that space for Kingdom work for such a time as this! He’s coming back SOON people! Get ready get ready get ready!

name: Incarnation Catholic Church
Incarnation Catholic Church - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary: I am from Texas and visit this church when I am in the area. I feel very much at home here. The priests are wonderful. I also appreciate the strong church community at this parish. Homily's here vary from helpful to objectionable! Conservatives "patience will be challenged" here?! Yes a Great sound system with some joyful, helpful folks here!   Music Ministry is main draw for many busy exhausted catholics with kids It's beautiful. The priests and deacons are great pastors . The parishioners are wonderful.  It's an amazing faithful community. Easy walk from two Hilton properties I am blessed to be part of this community during my visits to Southern California.  I have been attending masses here since 1973.  The chapel is quiet and calming.  It is a beautiful Parish and community!

name: Incarnation Lutheran Church
Incarnation Lutheran Church - Poway Campus
reviewSummary: This church doesn't have the truth. I don't know what it is, but it's not correct. I know the church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints is. But I would not recommend it! This beautiful church is in Poway. Paster Luther is a wonderful paster to all. Deacon Mindy has her own special way with people. This church also has services on-line. This has been our church for many years. Join our wonderful church family as we worship and serve God. Great church, friendly and welcoming congregation. Excellent choir and music program. Something for everyone. The minister,Luther, delivers a very clever, meaningful sermon I like him.

name: Independent Baptist Church
Independent Baptist Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary: “This is an amazing congregation, filled with kind and welcoming people. Pastor Martinez,the leader, is truly exceptional , one of those rare preachers who faithfully share the true Gospel. I am continually blessed and uplifted by his preaching. May God continue to pour out His blessings upon this wonderful church family.” Just a beautiful small church rich in history since the late 1980's, who sing the good old hymns with piano and organ. The teaching and sermons from Pastor Martinez are of sound teaching and will leave you feeling full! I really enjoyed visiting here. It's small but the Bible teaching is excellent. I hope to visit again soon. Small church with a friendly atmosphere and good, Biblical teaching.

India Christian Assembly - Ontario Campus

name: Indonesian Presbyterian Church Fullerton
Indonesian Presbyterian Church Fullerton - Fullerton Campus
Influence Church Anaheim
Influence Church Anaheim - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary:
A True Home

I’ve been attending Influence Church Anaheim for a few years now.

The Sunday services are consistently excellent: the worship and music are absolutely amazing, lifting your spirit every time, and the teaching is solidly Bible-based, practical, and relevant.

The church community is incredibly friendly and welcoming — you truly feel seen and cared for the moment you walk in.

What makes Influence Church stand out even more is the way they love people practically. The prayer team is at the prayer wall, ready to pray with anyone in need, and every Sundaythe church distributes free food to those who need it.

That kind of genuine care means so much.
I’m especially grateful that three generations of my family are thriving and being blessed here. The growing and vibrant youth ministries serve all ages beautifully, and the Men of Valor and Women of Influence ministries are among the best men’s and women’s ministries I’ve seen anywhere.

If you’re interested in a church that teaches the Word, worships wholeheartedly, and truly loves and cares forget its community, Influence Church Anaheim is the place.

Highly recommended! My husband and I have been attending services here for the past few months, and we truly love it. We’ve started getting more plugged in, and everyone has been so welcoming and kind. Pastor Phil and Tammy are incredible, they’ve taken the time to mentor and guide us, and are so loving! We always leave encouraged, refreshed, and even more on fire for Jesus.

The Wednesday night women’s group and the Bible studies have also been such a gift, an amazing way to make new friends and really feel a part of the community. Had an amazing time at the Easter Egg hunt! My son had fun running and grabbing eggs with the littles at 10am. Had a couple photo shoot moments with the Easter bunny. Can’t wait to attend next year’s event :) Outstanding church! The music worship service is perhaps the best I’ve experienced. We’ve visited many times and everyone seems to be so friendly, regardless if I’m just walking down an aisle or if I strike up a conversation with the person sitting next to us. The men of this church seem to have a strong ministry and many of them are upfront during worship, backslapping and hugging, with very warm greetings. The Word of God is taught clearly, with humor and passion. Both Pastor Phil and his wife Tammy are very warm and outgoing personally and have a strong heart for God, and their community outreach emphasis again rivals any church I’ve attended. There are a dozen schools in Anaheim and Irvine where they host Jesus Clubs every week with pizza, donuts, etc., and I heard that over 5000 students have attended a Jesus Club this fall alone, 20% of which have led to salvations. This church is definitely producing fruit! We love visiting Influence when we are in town. The messages are great… biblically based , relevant. Pastor Phil and Tammy are so sweet and welcoming. Pastor Phil shares such relevant messages for our times. So glad we have a church to attend when we come visit CA.
