Inland Empire Southern Baptist - Ontario Campus
Inland Valley Church of Christ
Inland Valley Church of Christ - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
Come join us and give this church 6 weeks to find out if this is a church you've been seeking:

IVC church is very welcoming, has a prayer room, children's class and an infant/toddler room for parents to stay in or leave with a volunteer and a youth class during the time of sermon, this church has a worship minister and a preacher who preaches from the word of God, the Bible, he preaches in English and there are volunteers who translates for those whose language is in Spanish. There is also a Spanish and Chinese translation on screen (created by the preacher) to read during the sermon.

Hope to see you soon :) A place I have called my home church since 1998. I love this family of believers. The Word is taught and We Love God We Love People and We Make Disciples. Come join us for a bilingual service Sundays at 9 am. This is a church that loves God, follows Jesus and his teachings closely, and loves one another warmly.  You will be blessed to visit and learn more about God's love. Small community church with an enthusiastic congregation. There's a sense of fellowship and friendly parishioners. Services are offered in Spanish and English. Bible is the church's focus and to fellowship with one another in Christ's love. God bless you and come visit us Sundays at 9 to 1130 and Sunday evenings at 5. Hope to see you.

name: Inland Vineyard Church
Inland Vineyard Church - Corona Campus
reviewSummary:
We love this church! A neighbor and I visited to check it out last year (2025) and absolutely loved it!! They are so welcoming! I brought my family and this is our church home! Travis is an amazing Pastor both him and his wife Angie are filled with The Holy Spirit! You leave completely filled! Thank you IVC🙏🏼 Love this church. So welcoming and giving back to community and the children.
Worship is great! Pastor is  a great speaker and very funny. This church is a wonderful and loving place. The staff are very comforting and filled with God's love. I have been to many churches but this one is where my heart is at as my wife, daughter, and myself were recently baptized. I feel at peace when I enter this church and when I leave I feel God's love and presence is with me is even stronger. The pastor Travis has a great heart and is a very good man and out of all of my years, he was the one I was hoping who would do my baptism and it was him as well as the staff that lifted me from that water I was so very grateful that he did my baptism. During the times that my wife and I have been coming to this church there has been certain messages that God has spoke through Travis that pertain to us directly during our struggles and arguments he gave us hope and closure through his words. Honestly, in my eyes I don't think this church would be the same if it wasn't for Travis and has words to each and every one of us although it is God speaking through him Travis is a wonderful man with a beautiful heart we love you Travis. They have a wonderful Pre School and a beautiful Church. So happy to have found the Inland Vineyard Church.  The lead pastor teaches with an immense amount of biblical knowledge.  Also there a many ways to get involved to help the community.  The church is the correct size enabling lifelong friendships.

name: Inn at the Mission San Juan Capistrano, Autograph Collection
Inn at the Mission San Juan Capistrano, Autograph Collection - San Juan Capistrano Campus
reviewSummary:
We stayed for 2 nights to visit with relatives in the area.  Normally, we would have booked with an Ayres Inn as they provide much value and quality.  Thought we’d splurge for this visit and we were disappointed.  Overall, the property is pretty with a lovely location.  It’s within walking distance of most everything in San Juan Cap.  But we thought the room was exceptionally small.  It felt cramped and did NOT meet our expectations which aren’t unreasonable.  The dark, dated furniture made it worse.  And we found out at the last minute, there was a $55 mandatory valet parking fee??  If we had time, we would have cancelled and booked elsewhere.  There’s no ability to park elsewhere so guests are held hostage, so to speak.  Also, there’s a $45 daily destination fee.  Again it was unexpected.  We probably didn’t read the fine print somewhere.  The staff were courteous and professional.  But we felt the price of an almost $500 plus other fees per night room was way too much.  We won’t stay there ever again. Beautiful location, easy walk to plenty of restaurants in cute SJC - right next to the Mission. Gorgeous architecture, circular driveway and entrance, large lobby and restaurant area with beautiful dark beams and intricate architectural details.
I stayed for a nearby conference for work was there for 4 nights. The grand entrance and common areas got me excited to try out the elevated Autograph series for Marriott. The guy at check-in made a big deal of finding me a room that I'd be happy with for 4 nights. That actually continued my excitement.
That ended quickly when I got to my 'special' room, which ended up being on the first floor overlooking an empty parking lot (which they charge a mandatory $55 per night for valet) right across from the gym. So I shut the curtains and got to wake up at 5am when the gym enthusiasts started to work out.
Again the room inside was beautiful, small but adequate, with arched entries and old, dark wood accents. But I didn't want to open my window to remind me of the parking lot/ Bakersfield motel feel. And I couldn't tune out the noise of the gym door opening and closing. In the end, the actual rooms and (small) pool section of the hotel is not any better than a basic hotel/ motel. Not bad, but costs twice a much. Glad I was offsite working all day. We are local to the area and always wanted to check out this hotel because it looks so beautiful and is in walking distance to all of the great shops and restaurants in SJC. We just stayed there to celebrate my birthday and had the very best time. The room is decorated so nicely with a lot of attention to detail and style. The lobby and pool area are super pretty. But most importantly, the staff made our stay extra special. Daniel and Kevin were so friendly and took great care of my car and our luggage. They were such a warm and cool welcome to the property. Nick at the front desk went above and beyond. We were upgraded to a beautiful room, and he knew it was my birthday and after dinner, our room had balloons, gourmet snacks and chocolate with the sweetest personalized birthday note from Nick and the rest of the staff. It was over the top kind. And then my daughter accidentally left a phone charger and expensive retainers in the room and Nick immediately went to go check and called me back to let me know he found the items and was keeping them safe for me to pick up. It doesn’t get better than that for customer service! It was just one night but so special and we will for sure return. We had a wonderful stay at this hotel yesterday—truly the cleanest hotel I’ve ever experienced. Everything was spotless and well-maintained, which made our stay incredibly comfortable.

The staff were all friendly, professional, and welcoming, creating a great overall experience from start to finish. Although the hotel is petite, it thoughtfully offers everything we needed.

The fitness center was impressive—very clean and equipped with the newest workout machines. We also appreciated the $25 credit, which we used for coffee and breakfast at the hotel café. The coffee was excellent and a perfect way to start the day.

Overall, we had a fantastic time and really enjoyed the vibe of the hotel. We will definitely be coming back! We hail from San Diego and are returning for our second stay here. This time, we’re celebrating my wife’s birthday, and we’ve chosen to make it a memorable occasion.

A special shoutout to the front desk clerk, William. His exceptional customer service is truly commendable, and the overall experience at this establishment is nothing short of stellar.

Given our Southern California roots, this place has become our go-to vacation destination, or as we like to call it, our staycation spot. Thank you Marriott !!

name: Jesus Church LA
Jesus Church LA - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary:
If you’re looking for a church you can call home, this is the one.
Since my wife and I’s first visit on Sunday, January 7, 2024, this church became home to us.
Not only we were welcomed with open arms, taken in, loved, but also the way we experienced the presence of God and have continued to do so since that day.

I give glory to the Lord for how he drew us to this church. And I’m thankful to be a part of a church that teaches true biblical principles, SEEKS the face of the Lord and is led by the Spirit of God.

We have grown in this community in the past 2 years, attended Bible school for 2 years, become servants of the Lord ministering in multiple different ministries by the grace of God.

Not to mention the care of this congregation for this city. The church is operating MULTIPLE different ministries daily. Monday’s men’s group, Tuesday’s rehabilitation and recovery meetings and prayers, Wednesday’s midweek prayer and intercession service, Thursday’s young adult meetings, Friday’s youth service, Saturday’s feeding and evangelizing to the homeless of the greater Los Angeles and Sunday 2 services, adding to it MULTIPLE home groups on each day of the week, adding to it elderly home visitation ministry which takes place Monday through Saturday, going to 8 different elderly homes.

God is moving in our midst and is moving through this church.

Come, taste and see that the Lord is good. Me and my family have been coming to this church for the past 6 months, and from the very first service we attended, we truly felt God’s presence. From the pastor’s messages to the worship team, everything is filled with love, encouragement, and the presence of the Holy Spirit. The members of the church are so welcoming and kind, and we love that they offer different services and programs for all ages throughout the week. It has truly been such a blessing finding a church community where we feel spiritually uplifted, supported, and at home. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a church family! This is an excellent church located in the heart of Glendale. It is a suitable place to join the family of God, worship Him, hear from Him, and serve Him.

It offers various ministries for women, men, young adults, teenagers, and children. There are also numerous home groups, prayer groups, as well as ministries focused on prophecy and healing, along with many other services.

Additionally, the church has a great school called LASSM through which you will grow in the Lord, discover your calling, and put it into practice.
COME AND BE BLESSED 😊 I have been a believer for about 17 years, and during that time I attended two different churches. Even while I was attending those churches, I always knew about this church and would visit whenever I had the opportunity, whether it was for a service, conference, or special gathering. From the very beginning, there was always something different I could feel.
This is truly a Spirit filled church where you encounter God’s presence from the moment you walk in. There is a deep sense of peace, love, and warmth, and you immediately feel welcomed. It does not feel like a place you just attend. It feels like a true family.
The church is deeply focused on God and His Word. The teachings are strong, clear, and life transforming if you are truly seeking to grow. This is a place of true discipleship where you are encouraged to walk closely with God and grow deeper in your faith.
Pastor Ruben is a true servant, humble, caring, and anointed. You can see his heart for people in the way he leads and supports the church. The pastor and members are always available, praying for one another and supporting each other in every area of life, including education, personal growth, and spiritual needs.
They offer both Armenian and English services, with translators available, which makes it very welcoming for everyone. There are also many ministries for every age and stage, including women, men, young adults, teenagers, and children. The church has home groups, prayer groups, and ministries that focus on prophecy, healing, and deeper spiritual growth.
Their Sunday school is excellent, with a strong curriculum that helps children grow in faith from a young age. You can see the care and intention behind it.
They also have a school called LASSM, where people can grow deeper in the Lord and discover their calling. I personally have not attended yet because I have two young children, but I truly cannot wait for the opportunity to go. I already feel such a strong desire and hunger to attend because I know it will help me grow deeper, be transformed, and be empowered in a new way.
If you are looking to grow spiritually, learn the Bible, be part of a true family, and build a close relationship with God, I truly recommend this church. If you want to go even deeper in your walk, I also highly recommend attending their school. Great church, IF you are Armenian. If you are not Armenian, the congregation can be a little hostile, disrespectful and very difficult to build God rutted friendships with as well. The English services are done mostly by the pastor’s wife, who bless her heart, doesn’t speak English. Therefore the sermons are done in Armenian, then translated to English. Which can be  frustrating if you don’t speak Armenian. And I understand the church is in Glendale… but Glendale is still in the U.S. , so a little more awareness, love and respect toward other cultures would speak volumes of their “love for Christ”.

Monday’s men’s group, Tuesday’s rehabilitation and recovery meetings and prayers, Wednesday’s midweek prayer and intercession service, Thursday’s young adult meetings, Friday’s youth service, Saturday’s feeding and evangelizing to the homeless of the greater Los Angeles and Sunday 2 services, adding to it MULTIPLE home groups on each day of the week, adding to it elderly home visitation ministry which takes place Monday through Saturday, going to 8 different elderly homes.

God is moving in our midst and is moving through this church.

Come, taste and see that the Lord is good. Me and my family have been coming to this church for the past 6 months, and from the very first service we attended, we truly felt God’s presence. From the pastor’s messages to the worship team, everything is filled with love, encouragement, and the presence of the Holy Spirit. The members of the church are so welcoming and kind, and we love that they offer different services and programs for all ages throughout the week. It has truly been such a blessing finding a church community where we feel spiritually uplifted, supported, and at home. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a church family! This is an excellent church located in the heart of Glendale. It is a suitable place to join the family of God, worship Him, hear from Him, and serve Him.

It offers various ministries for women, men, young adults, teenagers, and children. There are also numerous home groups, prayer groups, as well as ministries focused on prophecy and healing, along with many other services.

Additionally, the church has a great school called LASSM through which you will grow in the Lord, discover your calling, and put it into practice.
COME AND BE BLESSED 😊 I have been a believer for about 17 years, and during that time I attended two different churches. Even while I was attending those churches, I always knew about this church and would visit whenever I had the opportunity, whether it was for a service, conference, or special gathering. From the very beginning, there was always something different I could feel.
This is truly a Spirit filled church where you encounter God’s presence from the moment you walk in. There is a deep sense of peace, love, and warmth, and you immediately feel welcomed. It does not feel like a place you just attend. It feels like a true family.
The church is deeply focused on God and His Word. The teachings are strong, clear, and life transforming if you are truly seeking to grow. This is a place of true discipleship where you are encouraged to walk closely with God and grow deeper in your faith.
Pastor Ruben is a true servant, humble, caring, and anointed. You can see his heart for people in the way he leads and supports the church. The pastor and members are always available, praying for one another and supporting each other in every area of life, including education, personal growth, and spiritual needs.
They offer both Armenian and English services, with translators available, which makes it very welcoming for everyone. There are also many ministries for every age and stage, including women, men, young adults, teenagers, and children. The church has home groups, prayer groups, and ministries that focus on prophecy, healing, and deeper spiritual growth.
Their Sunday school is excellent, with a strong curriculum that helps children grow in faith from a young age. You can see the care and intention behind it.
They also have a school called LASSM, where people can grow deeper in the Lord and discover their calling. I personally have not attended yet because I have two young children, but I truly cannot wait for the opportunity to go. I already feel such a strong desire and hunger to attend because I know it will help me grow deeper, be transformed, and be empowered in a new way.
If you are looking to grow spiritually, learn the Bible, be part of a true family, and build a close relationship with God, I truly recommend this church. If you want to go even deeper in your walk, I also highly recommend attending their school. Great church, IF you are Armenian. If you are not Armenian, the congregation can be a little hostile, disrespectful and very difficult to build God rutted friendships with as well. The English services are done mostly by the pastor’s wife, who bless her heart, doesn’t speak English. Therefore the sermons are done in Armenian, then translated to English. Which can be  frustrating if you don’t speak Armenian. And I understand the church is in Glendale… but Glendale is still in the U.S. , so a little more awareness, love and respect toward other cultures would speak volumes of their “love for Christ”.

name: Joshua Generation Church
Joshua Generation Church - San Clemente Campus
reviewSummary:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Wow!

If you’ve been searching for a place where the Holy Spirit is alive, where worship is passionate and authentic, and where the presence of God fills the room — Joshua Generation Church in San Clemente is truly something special.

The moment worship starts, you can feel heaven move. The musicians are gifted, but more importantly, they carry a genuine heart of worship. The atmosphere is joyful, reverent, and powerfully uplifting — it’s the kind of worship where people raise their hands not because they’re told to, but because they can’t help it.

The worship team is incredible. Kylie, one of the vocalists and worship leaders, has a beautiful, anointed voice — the kind that doesn’t just sound amazing, but shifts the atmosphere and invites the presence of God. Her worship is gentle, powerful, and full of love for Jesus. The band supporting her and the other singers is excellent — guitar, drums, keys — everything blends together to create a unified sound that lifts your spirit and reminds your heart who God is.

The preaching is Biblically strong, refreshing, and alive — real teaching that calls you deeper, but also comforts and strengthens you. It’s clear that this church is not just doing “services” — they are building disciples, community, and family.

As the founder of FaithFlow Records (a Christian worship and inspirational music label), I was truly moved. We are deeply interested in building relationships and possible future collaboration with the worship team here, because the heart, humility, and love for Jesus is REAL. This is the kind of worship that transforms lives.

If you are in San Clemente, Dana Point, San Juan Capistrano, or anywhere in South Orange County and you’re longing for a church where the presence of God is felt, the worship is anointed, and the people are genuine — Joshua Generation Church is a place to come and be renewed.

Praise God for what He’s doing here. Hallelujah. 🙏🔥 Spirit filled worship great teaching with biblical foundation. They really love you and treat you like family come here if you want you life to be turned upside down and begin a journey of growth. Love this place. From the second of walking in the front door, I felt family. There’s something special happening at Josh Gen San Clemente.  I’m so grateful for the growth that I and my family have made. Josh Gen San Clemente is an amazing place to experience the manifest Presence of God and truly encounter HIS love through others. If you want to experience  true joy in HIS Presence come and see that God is real, His son Jesus is preached and the Holy Spirit comes to heal, encourage and mature you in each and every gathering. I love this church body and I am thankful to be covered by this Elder lead leadership. Thank you Josh Gen SanC💕 I just love Josh Gen San Clemente. The people are welcoming and loving. It is a church family and people really care for each other. The children’s ministry is amazing and the worship always draws us into the presence of God.

Journey Church is a breeding ground for God's divine vision to unfold.

name: Journey Community Church
Journey Community Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary:
This chuch hosts a food pantry every week, in drive through style. I attended their Second Friday of the Month Food Pantry and was surprised with how much produce in great condition and quality I received.
It starts at 9 and I arrived at 8:30 and there was a long line already so something to keep in mind if you plan on attending.
I was also able to get diapers for my baby.
The staff is amazing and very kind, thank you Journey Community Church for all that you do for the community. Great worship, sermons, and people! Come get prayed for! Christmas Eve services: December 23 4pm & 6pm, December 24 2pm & 4pm! Regular services: Friday 6:30pm, Sunday 9am & 11am! Just moved to La Mesa from North County, where I had played at a few church's on worship. So, I was looking for a place with a friendly atmosphere, great message and powerful worship. After checking out a few others I decided on  Journey Community for my new home church. They actually play their music with some decent volume, which I love😁🙏 and they just have a great campus with lots of opportunities to get involved. Very friendly people and I really liked the pastor's message.I love it! I went here on a Friday night for church service. The worship was upbeat and very enjoyable. Paul Hicok was teaching about the case for Easter. He was great. He is a natural at public speaking and engaging the audience. I really enjoyed this service. We've been attending Journey for 11 years and love everything about it. Every pastor greets and gets to know every member, new or old, on a first-name basis. Ed is the most amazing and genuine man we've ever known and his wife, Linda, is incredible too. There is always something going on there on campus, seven days a week. From small groups, to youth ministry, to holiday events, and the summer camp our middle daughter has attended four years running. I've given other churches a try that are closer or have services on other days and nothing compares to the feeling of home at Journey. There's zero politics in the sermons, no agendas, no "give us your money to be saved" vibe you get at other churches. The worship is the best anywhere, the message series are meticulously picked and planned, and even the guest pastors are a perfect fit. We'll never find another spot that can compare!

name: Journey Evangelical Church
Journey Evangelical Church - Westminster Campus
reviewSummary: I've been attending Journey for several years now, and I can honestly say that this church really loves God! One of Journey's greatest strengths is the family atmosphere. The pastoral staff is strong, and the congregation is active in its community. There are lots of events for all ages! It's encouraging to see people from all stages of life serve meaningfully in various ministries. This is a great place for both individuals and families to check out while visiting the area, as well as those seeking to find a new family and home. Our family has been attending Journey for a long time, it is a family reunion church and very welcoming to vistors.  We encourage you to hang around and enjoy our weekly refreshments and get to know the other attendees.  We are a multi-cultural church, anglo pastor, hispanic children's minister and bi-cultural youth director.  We are located in Little Saigon, but reach out to many people that live throughout Orange County.  We have  single service at 10:30AM, but also a Family Bible Hour at 9:15AM.  We are mostly second third generation asian professionals, so you will fit right in!! Largely an Asian congregation. Very friendly, welcoming and kind to all who attend, no matter ethnicity nor socioeconomic status. Stopped by because of a post for food and such on CL. Not only did I get some tasty food but it felt more like a family BBQ and I have only been in California for a few months so I don't know anyone here. I will be back, very nice church. Thanks for the food and God Bless There are three Sunday services on the same campus, English, Cantonese, and Vietnamese.  Plenty of parking inside and outside the gate.

name: Journey of Faith Church
Journey of Faith Church - Manhattan Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband, 10 yr old daughter and I love it here. The pastors are gentle, warm and community oriented, and bring wisdom from biblical teachings. The format is action oriented and music based. Pastors Jason, Krista, Alex and Jill are gems and help you connect with the spirit. I forgot the name of the Care pastor as well and he is wonderful and kind too. Ushers seemed fake when we entered, they were a bit creepy as I walked in. I felt that it was a very awkward environment and the people there were only concerned with the people they already knew. It's like one big exclusivity club. Overall not a great church and wouldn't consider going back. Best Church I’ve been to in YEARS and it has absolutely brought me back to putting Jesus first in my life. The staff is friendly, the pastors are so full of love and support, and the sermons aren’t going to put you to sleep and are relatable. I found this church through a care group, and if that isn’t the work of God I don’t know what is!! I have been attending for about 9 years and have grown immensely in my walk with the Lord. My knowledge and understanding of the Bible has grown as well as my character.  Very friendly, not intimidating, plenty of activities for people of all ages to become a part of. I absolutely love this church! :-) If it was not for my Best Friend.  Randy and his wife Sharron from Mira Costa High School (Which is next door) Being so persistent in getting me to a service.  I would have missed out on this "Jewel 💎 of a place". As soon as Jason came on stage I felt at home.
I read some of the other reviews and feel sorry for one lady who complained about such a short service.  To her I would say give it another try.
I'm dying of A GBM Brain 🧠 Tumor grade IV.  I now know where I'm going after my debilitating horrible horrendous Pain I'm in.  Where I'm going for the next phase God has planned for me.

name: King's Cross Church of San Diego
King's Cross Church of San Diego - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary:
Great new church. Casual atmosphere. Sort of a mix of Baptist and non-denominational.  Lots of young adults. Pastor is a good Bible teacher that adds in humor, stories and illustrations; I enjoy him!  Members worked together and gave the community a wonderful outdoor service and carnival. Where to begin!

My husband and I moved to San Diego August of 2020. It was nerve wracking to be moving to a new place amidst COVID and the isolation that it brings. We attended King’s Cross our first weekend here and fell in love! The hospitality of this church is amazing. We instantly felt connected and a part of a community. They do a wonderful job staying on top of COVID regulations and do what they can to keep people safe. The teachings are straight from scripture and Pastor Obed always provides historical context to help the church body understand the words more deeply. We spend time during service actually reading through chapters of the Bible as a church and not just skimming through verses here and there. The messages are so rich and biblically sound. We love that Pastor Obed always emphasizes that we are “a church family on mission with Jesus!”. We truly feel like we found family here in San Diego.

P.S. The views you get at this outdoor church aren’t too bad either! :-) I’ve been going to King’s Cross since 2018. I’m so grateful for the church’s commitment to put Christ first in all things, Pastor Obed’s faithful, expository teaching, and for the authenticity of this community. I was welcomed immediately and found a strong community that I can really do life with as we worship and build God’s kingdom together. I also met my husband here! Obed married us in 2020 and the community has supported us well during our first years of marriage. I’ve been very blessed to be a part of this church and to be on mission with them. I’m amazed at what God has done here in the past five years as so many have been turned to Christ. So many who were wounded by the church in the past have come home and found a place where they don’t need to perform or pretend. Come and see what God is doing in this community! Genuine Souls. Solid Biblical Teaching.

Moved to SD in Jan 2021 and started going here. I feel like I’ve found great community in this group of kind hearted people. They do a great job of respecting all State Guidelines during these times and even though everyone is socially distanced for now I’ve been able to join a Zoom group to learn more about the message from the Bible that was preached the Sunday before.
Also they have a group of people that go out to the beaches each Sunday, which I’ve enjoyed.

Beautiful views from the Mount Soledad Club.

I recommend this church to:
- Anyone new to SD
- Anyone looking for community
- Anyone looking to learn more about the Bible and Jesus Christ and King's Cross is a great church with a fantastic family feel to it. The people here really do care about one another and Pastor Obed is awesome. I appreciate that he does expository preaching as opposed to topical and has a heart for reaching the community with the Gospel of Christ. If you're looking for a church to plug into then come check it out......oh yeah, and the views of downtown San Diego and the beach and bay are not bad either. 😉

P.S. The views you get at this outdoor church aren’t too bad either! :-) I’ve been going to King’s Cross since 2018. I’m so grateful for the church’s commitment to put Christ first in all things, Pastor Obed’s faithful, expository teaching, and for the authenticity of this community. I was welcomed immediately and found a strong community that I can really do life with as we worship and build God’s kingdom together. I also met my husband here! Obed married us in 2020 and the community has supported us well during our first years of marriage. I’ve been very blessed to be a part of this church and to be on mission with them. I’m amazed at what God has done here in the past five years as so many have been turned to Christ. So many who were wounded by the church in the past have come home and found a place where they don’t need to perform or pretend. Come and see what God is doing in this community! Genuine Souls. Solid Biblical Teaching.

Moved to SD in Jan 2021 and started going here. I feel like I’ve found great community in this group of kind hearted people. They do a great job of respecting all State Guidelines during these times and even though everyone is socially distanced for now I’ve been able to join a Zoom group to learn more about the message from the Bible that was preached the Sunday before.
Also they have a group of people that go out to the beaches each Sunday, which I’ve enjoyed.

Beautiful views from the Mount Soledad Club.

I recommend this church to:
- Anyone new to SD
- Anyone looking for community
- Anyone looking to learn more about the Bible and Jesus Christ and King's Cross is a great church with a fantastic family feel to it. The people here really do care about one another and Pastor Obed is awesome. I appreciate that he does expository preaching as opposed to topical and has a heart for reaching the community with the Gospel of Christ. If you're looking for a church to plug into then come check it out......oh yeah, and the views of downtown San Diego and the beach and bay are not bad either. 😉

name: King's Harbor Church
King's Harbor Church - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
My kids (while in middle shcool) were blessed to experience the preaching of Pastor Mike during a church camp outing at Hume Lake. They raved about how he truly made the Bible come alive for them. What a blessing! I was able to hear Pastor Mike teach during an overnight outing in Santa Cruz years ago and his preaching brought me to tears. As a family we were able to visit Kings Harbor a few times when we were visiting the LA Area. WoW, Pastor Mike is a gem. So grateful for his rich and excellent teaching. If we're ever in So Cal again, this is the church we're always happy to attend. The pastor & elders teach from the New King James version & do not compromise. They have 2 sites; here on Garnier in Torrance & Burnout beach Redondo Beach. I serve on the beach but love attending the building for praise & prayer services. We have been here 8 1/2 years. New pastor last year, he is fabulous!!  It is fairly large, so unless you volunteer for a ministry, kinda hard to get connected.
Also look to join a community group to make friends. Look me up, if this will be your first time. You can sit w me and my family, so you won't feel weird. We love meeting new people and making new friends!!! Love this church!! Great people.  The teaching is very practical and biblically sound. The pastor seems to genuinely care although dont know him very well. They have a children's and youth ministries, womens programs, life  groups and reach out to the foster youth. Many of the families have  foster children they have taken into their families. Loved the message so eloquently put to take it and apply its principles, exceptional understanding of the preacher writing  in 5th chapter of Ecclesiastes..
my contentment is a rich blessing from God who gives to me and overwhelms me.. capacity to enjoy and the conviction to renounce- all at once.

GREAT CHURCH!! The pastor can teach the word!! He goes deeper than the average pastor. They have a childrens ministry which is GREAT! My kids love to visit. I wish we lived closer because it would MOST DEFINITELY be my home church. We went to the marriage retreat, which was ABSOLUTELY FABULOUS!! My recommendation, GO!! GO NOW... I love the unity, grace , love and laughter which are shown to every person coming.
It is so welcoming,  Jesus is in the midst of it all.
Worship, teaching scripture  and fellowship is so life changing.
Pastor and his wife and the elders are so loving.
Their prayer time is reaching the heavens.

Thank you Jesus for Kingdom Covenant! Come on out and join us. Sleep in, have breakfast, and we will save a seat for you!! Best most loving church ever I always said I wouldn't be a member of a church because they don't fit how I worship God, but Kingdom Covenant fits and I feel comfortable and my son loves the Sunday school program. name: Kingdom Culture Worship Centre - San Bernardino
Kingdom Culture Worship Centre - San Bernardino - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary: We visited once last year. It’s a great Word driven church. Any preacher can bring a mighty word. It’s for younger parishioners in my opinion and that’s EXACTLY what is needed today!! They are super welcoming. They did not contact us afterwards which was disappointing. I highly recommend to young families young people. Praise and worship is fire. Had a wonderful experience at this fellowship! I was welcome with love. Worship was Holy Spirit led. The Word brought by brother BJ was preached with such grace thru the Holy Spirit in power! Over all great experience. I definitely recommend this fellowship/gathering if your new in the area All Nations Worship Assembly is the most AMAZING church I have been a part of. The worship experiences are great, the people are so loving and welcoming. It’s a come as you are church that has power! The pastors are great and touchable! They are real and always deliver messages that are bible based, but practical and relevant! All Nations is the place to be! I have been attending this church going on six years, and believe me when I tell you that this was the best decision I ever made. I came looking for community (check), growth (check), hearing God’s heart this the preaching/teaching (check and check)! If you are looking for a place that will stretch you and that is filled with people who love God then this is the place! This place of worship has been the gateway to a better life for me personally and professionally. The Apostles continue to push me forward and challenge me while breaking down biblical principals to apply to real life practically. I met my wife here and she gave me a beautiful family filled with blessings and we keep God in the center of all that we do right, wrong, or indifferent.

reviewSummary: Everything is taught from the Bible. Super friendly loving atmosphere. People of all backgrounds are welcome & treated with love. No collections. Very clean & comfortable environment. name: Knott Ave Christian Church
Knott Ave Christian Church - Anaheim (West) Campus
reviewSummary: This church was absolutely beautiful! I got married here recently and had the pleasure of working with Sarah who coordinates weddings here. From the very start Sarah was very helpful and available through text or call later in the day. My family and I visited the venue about four times in total before my actual wedding day to coordinate logistics. The sanctuary seats about 700 people which was way more seats than what we needed. Sarah worked with us to make sure our day was beautiful and perfect. I fell in love with the the modern and contemporary look of the sanctuary. Bathrooms were well kept. Brides can use the mother and baby room across from the restrooms while the groom uses a room located on the other side of the sanctuary (very convenient). Ample amount of parking in the general area. There are two areas to park, general parking area and a smaller parking lot where my wedding party and main guest parked at. Had an overall wonderful experience. Would definitely recommend this beautiful church. If you are looking for a church that will meet you right where you are, whether you are young or old, rich or poor, married or single. If you are looking for a church that will teach you about God and how to have a relationship with Jesus or how to experience the true forgiveness of God. If you are looking for a church that will come along beside you and encourage you to draw near to the only true God, you will find here at Knott Avenue Christian Church. Knott Avenue has a core value that’s so accurate as a description: “Real talk before small talk”. We raised our kids in this church and still attend now. We’ve seen pastors come and go and the Lord has been faithful to use each leader in their unique ways. We currently have a new pastor added to the teaching team, Pastor Joe. He’s the primary teacher and does an excellent job teaching us through the scriptures. The pulpit is shared by other gifted and Godly pastors. A few things have always been the same at our 20 years here; the Word of God will not be compromised, the congregation is beautifully diverse, the people and worship time are not pretentious, and you will grow if you get involved—they make it easy to do that. We love KACC!  Great Sunday services, Wednesday night women's bible study, kids Wednesday nights, and Thursday night Junior High groups.  God centered and focused. Great church if you are not a former Catholic. Even though we both believe in Jesus, you will be told how Catholics have done everything wrong. Pretty sure the intentions are good but not the best way to teach Christ, He loved everyone.

name: Knox Presbyterian Church
Knox Presbyterian Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary: "Inviting thoughtful seekers to intergenerational community and Christian discipleship in the world," Knox has been my church home since 2014. I prayed for a church where my gifts could be used to further the Kingdom of God. Knox has been an answer to that prayer. I've served on the Adult Education and Spiritual Formation Committee and the Sustainability Team; I've participated in a small group that studies the Bible and secondary literature about being a follower of Jesus in the world; I've greeted, run slides, read Scripture, and sung in the choir Sunday mornings; I've been in a Zoom daily prayer group since the pandemic; I've packed sandwiches for the hungry; I've visited the hurting; I've brought gifts to the needy; I've stood on street corners with posters; I've participated in City Council meetings; I've pulled weeds; I've planted California native plants; I've shared produce; I've listened to music, seen plays, and read novels with fellow thoughtful seekers; I've shared hugs, tears, and laughter with brothers and sisters in Christ; I have been fed with beautiful music and challenging preaching and teaching. I have walked with Jesus. Knox is a welcoming church where community and love abound. There is a wonderful mix of families with small children alongside all other ages and stages. Our Pastor is warm, relevant, pastoral and accessible. The sermons are thoughtful and interesting and the focus on caring for our community, the greater community and our world matters deeply. Justice and service and growing in faith with Christ is paramount. AND the children's director is a remarkable leader and lover of kiddos. Knox has been such a welcoming community with so many amazing small groups to join and family events throughout the year. Pastor Matt is such an inspiring pastor and has given some of the best sermons I’ve heard. The Young Adults group has been such a wonderful community with regular bible studies and fun seasonal events, thanks to Josiah for leading it. All around, Knox is a very supportive and welcoming community and I recommend it to everyone. Plus they have pizza every last Sunday of the month! I love this church. I spent a long time looking for a church in Pasadena and stumbled upon Knox. After attending my first Sunday, I knew it was the body I needed to be a part of. The preaching is rich, the worship is honoring (and varied, so you never know what kind of music you'll get to experience), and most importantly, the community is warm and inviting. The easiest way to describe it is that the Holy Spirit is working in this church and you can feel that life. The church members and the pastor are 'heart of gold' people. Deeply concerned about social justice issues in our community. Knox is also a welcoming church with clear-minded folks. I'm new here but have felt supported and have been able to support others.

Koin Church - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
Visiting Koin , here to see my grandson Johnathan Harper and Granddaughter in law Beautiful Amy, Ben and Chayanne, Naomi .
Awesome Pastor and very friendly congregation.  My daughter Venessa and son-in law Jeff invited me and loved their Worship. Also my grandson Jacob Harper 💙
Coreen Carlin Gonzalez. We attended the service because my son and daughter in law were baptized today. Even though this is not my wife and I regular church, we were very impressed with the loving welcome we received when arriving. We enjoyed the sermon that Pastor Sam offered. Very enriching and powerful message. The baptism was very meaningful and touching, my wife added that the ceremony felt very intimate and full of blessing. We wish nothing but the best to this small church, praying for the Pastor and his community of young people to achieve success in reaching more and more souls every day. Today's message did leave a profound impact in me, personality. My son invited me today and I really enjoyed it!! The worship was awesome;  pastor  Sam was awesome and the bonus was the coffee was really good. What a blessed Way to start my day!! I will be coming back! 🙏❤️ Koin Church is most welcoming.  I've been a member since 2017 and I know this Church community blesses me constantly.  Pastor Sam and Pastor Kellie are most welcoming with open arms, connectivity, and hospitality.  The age group varies so there is always someone who reaches out to new members.  If you are looking for a comfortable church to attend, please give Koin Church a try.  You can access their past messages and their current 11am Sunday services on YouTube.  Worship is fantastic. This church is so welcoming and loving!
They are very intentional and do community well.
The Pastor and his wife are great people! Very personable! If you’re looking for a church, this one is a must try! :))

LA CHURCH - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: Phenomenal, welcoming space, inclusive to all. Thankful for this kind of a church in Los Angeles. meets people where they are at and loves deeply. Amazing place. Awesome people the best church I've ever been to, grateful for how incredibly inclusive and amazing this church is!

name: La Crescenta Presbyterian Church
La Crescenta Presbyterian Church - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary: Being born, raised, and accepted here I do love it. Ron I am sorry you had a bad experience if you come back there are many understanding people. The money they take goes back into the church so that we may have a better experience when worshiping the one and only God! Great fellowship dinner and classes on Wednesday night PEAK. Where else can you get a home cooked meal for $3 adults $2 kids. Wednesday night dinner 5:30 - 6:30PM. Various classes start at 6:30 end around 8:00PM. You can't do better than the genius, gentle, kind Pastor Andy Wilson.  His lovely wife Mary, the nonstop genius of one (assistant) Pastor Lee Cook.  Incredible Worship band/music etc.  Plenty of parking at all times.  A legend in the La Crescenta community.  Along with their sister church, La Canada Presbyterian Church.  Very scriptural, humble biblical church - bailed me out of a lot of fear/angst.  Oh - and never challenge their Pastor Andy Wilson - runs every day - you frequently see Andy on runs down Montrose Avenue leading towards Honolulu.  Always beep, I do. Beautiful church, extraordinary childcare, and wonderful people. I love this church, the pastor and the people. Very welcoming and there are so many ways to get involved and to grow as a person. Hope to see you there!

reviewSummary:

In reply: It wasn't like the normal box they give. I bring my neighbor because she cannot drive anymore and she says sometimes she doesn't even get any kind of meat. Super people. Great sermons. An enjoyable experiance. Very nice place

name: La Jolla CA LDS Institute
La Jolla CA LDS Institute - La Jolla Campus

name: La Jolla Christian Fellowship
La Jolla Christian Fellowship - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary:
Really excited about church again!!
I have been a Christian for a number of years. I have had the privilege in that time of listening to a number of good communicators proclaim the gospel message. I have to say, Pastor Adam is among the top Christian communicators I have heard from over the years. He definitely does not preach a soft gospel message. Neither does Adam club us (Sunday morning attendees) over the head (so to speak) with messages that are everything but good news. Rather, I believe, in Adam’s teaching of the gospel there is an essential understanding of what the Bible is actually saying, as well as a general understanding of the many things parishioners are struggling through life with as God’s word calls them, on any given Sunday morning, to a more consistent walk of holiness. There is always much to learn from Adam, and he is truly talented at giving a substantive and strong message, but never in my personal experience, without an appropriate measure of God’s grace. I at times feel convicted to repent of some sinful behavior or thought process, but always with the assurance that God really loves me. Adam wants his congregation to know that God truly loves them, and that he is in the business of calling them (us) to repentance etc because of his great and holy love. I am super thankful for all that is going on at LJCF, all the staff and lay leaders etc. I am especially grateful that God has brought the true gospel message , both sides of the sword, back to LJ in pastor Adam’s preaching. Awesome multi generational family oriented church. Small, friendly, and welcoming. Worship is mix bag of old school w contemporary. While pastor Adam attempts to be culturally relative, his messages often lack acknowledgement of man's spiritual depravity, a call to confession of sin, a call to repentance, and our dire need to surrender to the lordship of Christ. Sadly the result is an incomplete message of the gospel. This is a church I often visit.. I like the message in its delivery I knew this church was my home from the first time I came in. 2 years later I cant imagine leaving. The amazing friends I have made here have helped me change the trajectory of my life. The Holy Spirit truly dwells here. The sweetest people who care for each other and love the Lord. The sermons are robust, the classes are rich and the Holy Spirit is so evident.  You will feel right a home with your first visit.

name: La Jolla Presbyterian Church
La Jolla Presbyterian Church - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary: La Jolla Presbyterian is a wonderful church. It's very big and very welcoming and polite to guests. I recommend it for anyone who wants to visit or stay. It's a very friendly crowd and people are very supportive. It's clear that it's established itself from the top down as a family atmosphere as in one family for those who are there and who are members and who are not yet formally members. It's one big family. There are services at 8:45 10:00 and 11 a.m. on Sundays. I highly recommend this church. They also have delicious baked goods and coffee after each service and it's a beautiful building. Also they do enormous good in the world and the local community. Our pastors from Ebenezer we're being represented here I went to support and what a great bunch of people with a lot of resources for people in need Very nice Spanish style church/school. They were nice enough to offer me a vintage La Crosse 81 soda machine.  I drove down from the Inland Empire to pick it up.  They helped me load it and were just the nicest people. We love visiting this warm and welcoming congregation.  Come early and take a few minutes to enjoy the stained glass windows.  Sermons are biblically based, current, and always relevant.  Choir and La Jolla Brass lift hearts to heaven. Wonderful, welcoming church with a great youth program.  I prefer the early service to the later service with the singing. Try them both and see what works for you.  The programs for young kids, MS kids and HS youth are exceptional.

name: Laguna Beach United Methodist Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a lovely church nestled in the picturesque hills of South Laguna Beach.  The God-given natural beauty of the hill, garden and Pacific Ocean views from the sanctuary is rivaled only by the caring, charismatic and vibrant minister (Pastor Lynn Francis), inclusive, affirmational culture (a UMC Reconciling Ministry), friendly people, incredible music program (including both traditional and contemporary offerings), professionally curated children's, youth and family ministry (including Sunday school for children and youth from four years old through Junior High, Nursery Care for infants to children three years of age, annual summer Vacation Bible School week for children four years old through fifth grade, Messy Church, a creative, interactive, intergenerational monthly gathering held on Sunday afternoon or evening - accompanied by a meal!), and the kind, helpful and efficient staff.  The Easter sunrise service at Main Beach is a stunning way to begin one of the holiest days of the Christian year, sometimes accompanied by dolphins and other local fauna.  Coffee and sweet delicacies on the patio after worship, and occasional festive lunches, provide enjoyable opportunities for additional fellowship.  The vibe is a warm, welcoming and uplifting blend of traditional Methodism meets Beach Cities casual.

LBUMC is active in outreach ministries both locally in Laguna Beach and its surrounding communities in south Orange County (annual Change the World Sunday, the Alternative Sleeping Location monthly dinner for the unhomed, the Friendship Shelter and the Illumination Foundation to name a few) and globally (UMCOR, the United Methodist Committee for Relief, Africa University in Tanzania, and Earthkeepers, a United Methodist Global Ministries Project supporting environmental initiatives in 45 countries).

Laguna Beach United Methodist Church colorfully lives out the core beliefs of the UMC as embraced by it's Open Hearts Open Minds Open Doors theological perspective, the LBUMC mission statement, "Our mission is to 'Bring God’s Love To Life' through worship, study and outreach to the community and the world", and the mantra "With Christ as our inspiration, worshipping together as one loving, inclusive body, we will bring God's love to life through prayers, presence, gifts, service and witness."

As a 26-year congregant, I am clearly not the most unbiased reviewer, but this tranquil refuge continues to keep me coming back for more, and excited to see what comes next.

Additional information may also be accessed via social media, on Facebook, Instagram and Twitter.  For your convenience, the service is live-streamed on-line at 10:00 a.m. every Sunday morning, as well as recorded and available on the website for subsequent viewing.  I highly recommend experiencing this unique place for yourself; who knows, it just may be life-changing. A progressive, diverse congregation, that also has an incredible 180-degree view of the ocean from the sanctuary. They're very active in social justice issues, including being a Reconciling Congregation, which means they believe in equality in society and in the church for LGBTQ people. Also active in poverty ministries like supporting the food bank and supporting homeless ministries. Their motto or slogan is "Bringing Love to Life", and "Open Hearts, Open Minds, Open Doors", and they mean it. Best church I've ever been to! I love how inclusive and welcoming everyone is, which is the way it should be when searching for a church. This church really seems to live by the principles that are the most important. Plus, you get a view of a beautiful Pacific Ocean! 😎🙏 LBUMC is a wonderful church - a friendly, inclusive congregation, a kind and dynamic pastor, and an AMAZING view of the ocean from the sanctuary! The motto "Open Hearts, Open Minds, Open Doors" really rings true - everyone will receive a hearty and genuine welcome no matter who you are, where you're from, or who you love. Laguna Beach United Methodist Church has been an all around great experience.  The church members are extremely welcoming and inviting and made me feel right at home after moving to the area from the east coast in 2012.  Pastor Mandy Flemming, who has been at LBUMC for just over a year now has been a breath of fresh air for the church and her faithful approach to ministry has filled the pews with new members and younger families.  I'd highly recommend LBUMC to anyone looking for a church to call home.

name: Laguna Presbyterian Church
reviewSummary: A beautiful historic church in the heart of Laguna. Highly welcoming and excellent preaching. Love the blended worship options and the very active kids Sunday school.

name: Laguna Presbyterian Church - Lake Forest Campus
reviewSummary:
I went here with the photography class from LCAD and the owner was nice enough to let us shoot inside! The church is beautiful and we got some stellar photos. God bless This community welcomed me when I was a young adult. It is a vibrant, faithful, gracious community of individuals seeking to grow up into Christ and encourage and extend grace to others who are just trying to figure out life and God. This community has a rich history in the roots of Laguna; its early formation as a city. Individual members rallied the call to action in the fire of 1993--and became a place of interfaith caring and compassion for those who lost everything. Laguna Pres was around 12 years be the city was incorporated, I hope it will be around for another 100 year. For 100 years LPC has been inviting everyone to come, just as you are. LPC is a warm, welcoming, deeply committed community of people of all ages and stages in life who seek to live a meaningful life of faith in this world we live in.  The worship services are extraordinarily rich in both the message delivered and the music which is excellent and heartfelt.  I love this church which has been my anchor for 33 years. People may go to church to find God but they stay because they find each other.
I'm an atheist, I went to an Alpha religious exploration meeting at Laguna Pres. It went as well as could be expected. They were friendly enough and the food was decent. I was trying not to be combative but I think I failed.
I'm not sure why I went. I don't think I found what I was looking for. I may go to another meeting if I can remember to put it on my calendar.

Also, I disagree with the Presbyterian values of faith over works but that's a larger issue. Wonderful candlelight Christmas Eve service.  Beautiful old church. Get there early because praise God it was a packed church

I'm an atheist, I went to an Alpha religious exploration meeting at Laguna Pres. It went as well as could be expected. They were friendly enough and the food was decent. I was trying not to be combative but I think I failed.
I'm not sure why I went. I don't think I found what I was looking for. I may go to another meeting if I can remember to put it on my calendar.

Also, I disagree with the Presbyterian values of faith over works but that's a larger issue. Wonderful candlelight Christmas Eve service.  Beautiful old church. Get there early because praise God it was a packed church

name: Lake Avenue Church
Lake Avenue Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
I don't know what they're teaching at this "church," but it's certainly not Christian values. As both an occasional attendee and a long-time neighbor, the lack of Christian consideration for others is astonishing. Every Sunday the neighborhood is invaded by hundreds of congregation members who break traffic laws and routinely endanger pedestrians. Today my dog and I were nearly deliberately hit TWICE by congregants who plowed through intersections where pedestrians are CLEARLY visible without even slowing.

To add insult to near-injury, as we walked ON THE SIDEWALK that crosses their driveway, their parking attendant yelled at ME to "Be careful!" of congregants illegally plowing across the sidewalk.

The most BASIC Christian precept is, "Love they neighborhood as thyself." I was troubled by the lack of basic Christianity in Lake Avenue's teachings and, as Matthew 7:16 makes clear, "You will know them by their fruits..." This is an awesome church on an awesome Pastor and awesome worship Pastor. The campus is awesome and the Worship center is very very beautiful. Can't go wrong here. God bless you all Incredible Christmas Eve sing a long. Excellent orchestra, choir, and the pipe organ was so powerful. I loved the Christmas sermon from the lead pastor. His preaching was relevant, thought provoking, and honest. Their counseling center was terrible. I grew up going to this church so I was confident they could help my partner who was an addict. They basically told me just to get over it. That it was fine he was doing what he was doing and i should just put up with it. I've never met a more sexist, out of touch counselor who really didn't care. Luckily I had the spiritual discernment to know this relationship was wrong for me and to walk away. Both the emotionally abusive ex and the relationship with this "church." But getting zero support from a church that claimed to be God centered taught me a lot. Twenty years later I've gone way down the rabbit hole of what these mega churches actually are and what they're involved in. It has nothing to do with Christianity. I'm so glad I walked away. You cant expect to get spiritual guidance from people who are all about greed. To see them dismiss these experiences that multiple people are having in the comments by saying "well that counseling center is separate from us." No it wasn't. It was recommended by the church, it was run by church members and it was on the campus of the church. Zero accountability coming from this place. Trust me when I tell you, don't use this church as a daycare. We were invited to their Annual Christmas Concert by a member that's on the choir, and it was beautiful! The choir and orchestra were amazing! This was the first time we visited.

Whenever I was in the hospital he would visit me whenever i have been ill he would call to see how I am and pray for me. name: Lakeshore City Church
Lakeshore City Church - Corona Campus
reviewSummary:
I was visiting from out of state. I wish Lakeshore was in my town. What loving,  passionate pastors they have. I loved the prayer time they have with their prayer team at the end of the service, it's one on one, so personal.  I now watch the service on line. May God bless them as much as they have blessed others. TL;DR – 10/10 Would recommend! Family church!

I hadn’t been regularly attending church as I hadn’t found one that I felt truly represented what God’s word meant to me. I had become desensitized as I felt all had become materialistic and commercialized, and it was something I felt brought out an ugly, un-Godly side of me, so I stayed away. My sister had asked that we join her for her birthday, but I had chosen not to as I had assumed it was much like all the other churches I had attended. She respected my decision but encouraged me to reconsider. My dad had joined her, and he also had high recommendations for Lakeshore, encouraging me much the same, so I decided to give it a try. I honestly feel that saying that THIS church is life-changing is cliché, but I’m comfortable saying also that “life-changing” is an understatement. Everyone there is so sweet and welcoming, I instantly felt like family. I didn’t feel any of the phony, commercialized behaviors that had turned me away from so many churches in the past. I found my home, just at the first service. This is it. I’ve been attending Lakeshore since 01.01.2023 and have not missed a single Sunday service, and my family and I come from Orange and LA county to attend this church. THAT is how perfect this little church is. You skip the friendships and instantaneously gain new family members. There’s always someone to be there for you, no matter the ask. The Worship team is always on point and makes me feel like God really hears us, and the Prayer team is always there to help carry our burdens or help us pray for those extra helpings of grace. I couldn’t be more grateful that God led me to Lakeshore City Church! Pastor Charlie, Louise and staff are an authentic group of leaders, welcoming and faithful to the scriptures. If you're looking for a church that teaches in an expository manner (line by line, verse by verse) this might be your place. God bless Lakeshore City Church. I Absolutely love this church. They preach the word accurately and really "do life" with one another. The pastor has a heart for seeing  God's people grow in their faith. I love this Church and the people. Very welcoming & safe place to be.
Pastor Charlie & Louise are wonderful people! Please visit

name: Lakeside Community Chapel
Lakeside Community Chapel - Clearwater Campus
reviewSummary:
I really enjoy worshiping at this church.  The teaching is very very good.  Verse by verse and I am learning so much Pastor Steve delivers very good expository, Bible based, verse by verse preaching sermons every Sunday. It's a
fresh breath of air in comparison to other churches who only delivers sermons whose agenda is to tickle people's ears. I strongly advice you to check out Lakeside if you are seeking and longing to hear God's Word preach as what it says and not take it out of context. You will learn about the Bible in it's entirety from Genesis through Revelation. Great Place, wonderful church that teaches the ays of the bible and the truth found in God, no fallacies or false teachings are found there. They have classes of different subjects that are on a 15 week cycle at the school behind the church and then there is a service in the church itself that is taught by the pastor or occasionally by a guest speaker. Overall it teaches you how to live your life as a Christian without any changes made to the Bible and always offers help to those who are struggling in faith or financially (if member). This church loved me when I hated them and God. They prayed me into salvation by grace alone. What love is this that they cared for me a pill addict. What love is this that I am now free. What love is this that I am now called a child of God! Thank you Lakeside Church and continue glorifying our Father in heaven and the only name by which we must be saved - Jesus Christ - he is mighty to save! I have been attending Lakeside for a year now and the Lord has blessed me through their ministry profoundly. The teaching is nothing but the Word of God in context. Solid food is served every Sunday from the pulpit.
The people have counseled/discipled & edified me throughout my time. With any church one has to do their part to get involved and reach out but once you do they are faithful to come along side you in the race we all are running together for the glory of God.

name: LAX Calvary Chapel
LAX Calvary Chapel - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
We had been going to a mega church in South Bay for a few years. My son said the children’s ministry was so big it felt like he rarely saw the same people twice. To be honest it was easy to be lost. We prayed about a change and found LAX Calvary Chapel and decided to give it a try. We haven’t left and it’s because of the smaller congregation where we eventually get to meet (and like) everyone. And it’s also because Pastor Justin teaches simply and wholly word by word through the Bible. I appreciate how he digs in and weekly reveals grace in every sermon. We highly recommend this church. I am so blessed to have a family church like CCLAX.  I have been part of this family of Christ for about 7 years and I am praying that I will continue to be part of this amazing body of Christ for many more years to come.
The Pastors and their wives and children are just amazing. Always ready to pray with you and sit with you and hear your good and difficult moments. Love the solid teachings and the true love they have for everyone (Jesus heart).

I so encourage you to come visit this church and experience for yourself the love of Christ that flows through them here.
John 3:16 This church is more than just a building, it's a family. I have attended CCLAX for over 15 years, and I have continued to grow in my faith from day 1! They teach the Bible, the whole Bible, not just snippets to make you feel good. It is a church for people who love Jesus, have a desire to grow, and want to serve God. All of the Pastor's who teach here are gifted men of God, who truly desire for the church to grow in their understanding of who God is, and what the Bible teaches.  My children have also been blessed by the loving, devoted children's ministry and all their teachers. The worship is amazing! And I can honestly say that this body of believers are some of the most genuine, loving, caring people I have ever known. I could go on with great things to say, but this review is probably already too long. If you have a desire to draw near to God, and grow in your faith, then this is the place for you! Awesome God's church. Loved pastor Justin, Joel and Andrew. Very encouraging teaching and guidance from the Bible. People are so friendly and loving and kindness. Love to go to this church. Very good Sunday school and very good coffee shop. Yummy hot coco. I ❤️  this church. I love that they stick to God's word, not man's opinions so much. I do not miss topical sermons at all, and they are not afraid to preach the hard stuff many churches shy away from.  If your looking for a church that is not lukewarm this is the place for you.  God bless you and hope you find a christ centered church and community with us

Legacy Church - Plano Campus
reviewSummary: We started going to church here in early 2018.  After just a few weeks, we decided to go to their new member class. We really loved the pastors they have on staff and the way they brought the message of Jesus and salvation down to an easy to understand level. We are now members and part of a life group. Legacy Church is awesome for families with young kids, single adults, or empty nesters.  The women's ministry has great programs and plenty of opportunities to get involved and plugged in. Great to be back in the HOUSE!!! Even though everyone had on masks you could see the smiles in their eyes. So glad we're meeting in person again. In fact, we're having to have an 8:30 service in addition to the 10:30!! Plus, LIVE ONLINE for those not quite ready to be in the building. I love my church!! As an introvert, it has always been a challenge for me to meet new people, especially at church. For this reason, I have always had a hard time finding a church where I feel like I belong. The moment I walked into Legacy Church, however, I was immediately welcomed by genuine, caring people. I felt like I truly belonged, and after 3 years, I still feel like I belong. The people in this church really CARE and have made a huge impact on my life, helping me to trust Jesus every step of the way. Very welcoming environment, friendly staff. Children’s ministry is the best I’ve seen. Sermons include direct bible reading, reasoning and helpful application ideas on real life topics. You hear and feel Love, Truth of the Word and the presence of God in this place. Highly recommend to beginners of faith, or someone looking for a church home near by. Legacy is very warm and welcoming place helping people learn about and follow Jesus. Legacy has a great kids ministry and other groups and programs to help us all grow and advance in our walk with Jesus. On your first visit you’ll feel like you’ve been attending for years! See you Sunday!

Legacy Church O.C - Orange Campus
reviewSummary:
Legacy Church on Tustin Street in City of Orange 🍊 CA is located in old The Village 📽️ Movie Theater. Huge parking 🅿️ lot
Has several service types & times. Many in Espanol. Very well maintained inside and out. Great for the community! 🤙 Legacy Church is a BIG family! The moment you stepped in you feel like you've belonged there for ages. Glory of God, Great message and exceptional leaders. Pastor Uzziel and Julie  are amazing  and readily available. Join us and feel the presence of God! Your life won’t be the same. If your looking for a welcoming atmosphere and a place where you can truly make a connection with God. Definitely come to this church I started attending Legacy Church of Orange County since June 2023.  I was looking to go deeper into my walk with God. This is it! The Holy Spirit is a strong presence at every service!  If you need any healing and deliverance, this is the place. English 10 am and Spanish 12 pm and Weds Spanish 7:30 pm.  The worship is Spirit filled. Everyone here is so welcoming! I am learning so much. Excited to start attending Legacy University soon! Awesome church. Pastor Uzziel is amazing. A church where you feel like one of the family with tons of opportunities to serve. The Word is deep and powerful - worship is amazing they allow the move of the Holy Spirit to flow. I loved the cafe options as well.

name: Legacy Church Pensacola
Legacy Church Pensacola - Pensacola Campus
reviewSummary: This church has felt like home from the first time we walk through the doors. We are so grateful that God put legacy church from Pensacola in our paths and they have become nothing less than family. Even our children have grown so much mentally and in the Grace of this place of worship and amazing people. If you need a good place to worship and feel the Holy Spirit fill a room with people who are going to love you for exactly the person that you are, please I so encouraged you to visit our church. 🙌⛪ Good bless Legacy church stands out for its loving and supportive community. Following our move to Pensacola over a year ago, we visited multiple local churches without finding the warmth we experienced at Legacy. Pastor Ryan and Kim have a heart for the Pensacola community. If you are new to the area check out this awesome church. Warmest and most welcoming church I've ever been to. The people are so friendly and genuine. I think the church congregation itself is a direct reflection of the Pastoral Leadership there. Birds of a feather flock together. If you're looking for a place to call home where you'll be welcomed without judgement or condemnation, check out Legacy Church Pensacola. We feel blessed to belong. We absolutely LOVE Legacy Church! The atmosphere and the people are loving and welcoming. This church has everything from the great preaching, powerful moves of God, and incredible worship. I highly recommend to anyone looking for a church to call home! From the moment I walked in the door, I felt such love and acceptance from each person I encountered at RLC! The services are dynamic with in depth preaching from the Pastor, the worship is great, and the children’s department is top notch. There are so many opportunities to make friends and get involved- no matter what your demographic is. I look forward to church every week!

name: Legacy City Church
Legacy City Church - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary:
There are some really awesome christians here, but the annoiniting has left. If you're looking for a TED talk about positivity, etc, this is the place for you. If a couple approaches you about a Bible study and serves wine or other drinks at that bible study, run.

7/22 - Alcoholic drinks are served at a specific bible study ran by a wealthy donor at their house, not at the church. I  brought it up the leadership and was told to confront him in person, and when I did, he said, "It doesn't bother my conscience..." I reported back to leadership, but nothing was done. I felt the nudging for a while to speak out about this, so I'm doing what's been bothering my conscience. Instead of defending the church, elders need to read the review properly and speak to the individual to stop him from serving drinks at a bible study. In 30 years our family has been active members of 3 churches. Legacy has something for everyone, great musical praise, responsible children’s church, women’s and men’s Bible study and a pastor and deacon team whose family and faith makes them a wonderful and wise resource. Please consider making Legacy, your legacy in a faithful walk with Jesus. Legacy is such a great church located in Studio City. Pastor Josh preaches directly from the word. His message reflects the teachings of Jesus. There’s great community and the members go out of their way to make you feel welcomed. There’s plenty of bible studies to get involved in throughout the week. Been coming for a few months and it already feels like home. I love this church! I always feel welcomed and loved. The people are loving and friendly and the worship is amazing. Pastor Josh teaches from the Bible verse by verse. We are encouraged to bring our bibles and read it for ourselves which I love because the word of God is the ultimate authority. Pastor Josh is humble and down to earth. He is also very friendly and wants to get to know each person that comes in so he encourages people to come meet him after the service or meet with him for coffee. Overall, I love this church and recommend it to anyone and everyone! My home church ❤️. I was looking for a church and found Legacy City Church. I was nervous at first about attending but when I did, I felt so welcomed. I love that people were so friendly and genuine. I feel the presence of the Lord here and I totally recommend Legacy for any one looking for a church in which they can call family. Legacy is family! 🥰
