name: Liberty Baptist Church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
We moved to the area, and had been searching for good churches and discovers Liberty Baptist. Because of my work schedule I hadn’t been able to check out the church but thank be to God that I was able to change my schedule to have Sundays off and today was our first time attending Liberty Church. My mother, brother and I really enjoyed it. The greeting lady gave a warm welcome making us feel right at home. The service was a perfect balance of Spirit filled, King James Bible preaching and traditional but also contemporary worship style. My brother and I connected right with leadership right away and they made us feel like we belong. We are definitely coming back next week. Everyone is really friendly. Definitely feel God's presence at this church. Pastor Ryan has very insightful  sermons that are easy to follow. Unfortunately I'm far and have looked at other churches and none have felt like Liberty. I came lost , then I was found , saved and I have a community , a family in Christ. It is a special place that is constantly reminding you of its foundation , the Bible, it doesn’t bend to the times . This church is a family church however Pastor never forgets to include the “times” in his preaching he shows you weekly not to be intimidated to open that Bible and Gods inspiration will flow on any topic of today . He rolls up his sleeves and tackles anything with the words from the Bible. You will leave always wishing everyday was Sunday ! You are a child of God you are safe you are important and you are loved.Pastor Ryan doesn’t let you leave without that in heart ever! The music is fabulous as well and is planned to go along with the scripture. It is not a passive experience. Fantastic church!  The worship/song leaders have phenomenal voices. When they lead the congregation in worship, I feel very focused on the Lord and His goodness... because they choose songs that are doctrinally rich.  I would describe their style as "blended worship" some modern and some traditional. The preaching is always applicable to my life and helps me to develop my walk with God in a richer way. I highly recommend this church.
***The youth group is very active and has a clear mission of discipling the teens.*** Community, it’s the first thing that comes to mind when I think of Liberty Baptist. I have personally experienced genuine relationships and spiritual growth by attending small groups and other events at this church. name: Liberty Baptist Church - Newport Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
We moved to the area, and had been searching for good churches and discovers Liberty Baptist. You are a child of God you are safe you are important and you are loved.Pastor Ryan doesn’t let you leave without that in heart ever! name: Life Bible Fellowship Church
Life Bible Fellowship Church - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
My mentor was apart of this church and told me to check it out and I was very impressed with the service. Spoke on 1 Peter 4:10-11 and really went into a detail sermon on how this impacts not just the local church but how we are called as Disciples to use gifts because God gave those to us. The church was very beautiful and the community was very welcoming and friendly. Even as a first time visitor I was very impressed with how many were baptized but why they were being baptized. The studying for each person and time. From young to old, husbands, wives baptizing spouses, there kids and friends. Incredible. Worship team was also great. Anyways I highly recommend to check it out ill definitely be going again hopefully soon. Have been going to this church for several years now.  Had a bit of healing to do, and this church allowed that process for me and my family.   I love the real Biblical teaching, without the fluff added in, and the pastors are excellent in presenting the Word in a clear and concise manner.
My children are both grown, so I don't have much to say about that area - other than it appears to be run very well, and with a slew of volunteers.  Lots of young families in the church, so they must be doing something right.
The church focuses on small groups as well, which is a good thing if you have the time to be in one, but so far we have not found a match for our lifestyle.  Sunday school offerings are good - my parents really enjoy their group.  Parking can be a challenge - but only if you go to the 9ish service.  I try to go to the earlier service and do not find parking to be an issue then. I was just visiting today, but had a very good experience. They open the mic on the last Sun of the year and it was kind of a pot luck of sermons from the congregation. They were awesome. Modern worship music. Our family was surrounded by this amazing church when my Daughter and Son in Law lost their Sweet Baby Ellie. I am speechless and can not truly express what this church family did for us. Pastor Mat was at the hospital with us the entire day along with other pastors from the Church. They hosted a 300 + person memorial service for Ellie. Our family was supported in many wonderful ways.
This church does have a large congregation however, it feels very intimate and personable.
I am looking forward to the Grief study group starting this month.
Thank you to this wonderful church, staff and congregation.
Tess We visited this wonderful church for our granddaughter's baby dedication.  The people are warm and friendly.  The sermon was interesting and had life applications. There are a variety of programs for all ages. It would be easy to find your place in this church.

name: Life Christian Church
Life Christian Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
As a Marine I was stationed here in 1995.  I searched all throughout this area for a place of worship I could call home.  I grew up in a non-denominational Church and wanted to find something similar.  Immediately upon entering Life Christian (then called His Church Christian Fellowship) we knew God had directed our path to these Pastors.  My wife had several bad experiences with other Churches in her past however not only did we love the Pastors we also loved the REAL people we meet.
Now in 2012, we are still here. I know many people only stay with a church for a couple years however each year just gets better and better.  So, much so that I had decided to work for the church now that I am retired.
Being here for these 17 years has been wonderful and a place where I can grow in God.  I love the fact my Pastor cares enough about me to make sure I understand God's perfect will for my life.  When my son graduated to heaven at the age of 19 it was my Pastor who was there to help my family through this most difficult time.  In fact it was my Pastor who helped my son stay connected to God and make it to heaven.
I challenge all who read this to stop by a pay us a visit here at Life Christian Church.  I know you to will find what I am talking about is true and real. Life is a great church. I dont go as I should. But I do realize God has saved me and given me talent. The day I walked into His church in 1998 mylife changed. I changed it took some more waisted time. But God was with me and showed me the way. And I'm alive unlike many I've known. I'm free because of God no possible way I could have done it on my own.   Jason D. Williams Nice people, a lot of good programs for members of all ages, and modern music before the sermon.  That's all great, but speaking in tongues freaked me out and I won't be back.  If that's your thing then go for it, but you won't see me there.  I'm also not a fan of paying to receive blessings.  Tithing is important but shouldn't be pushed for the purpose and intent of being rewarded, healed, or otherwise personally benefitted. I visited Life Christian Church for the first time today and was very upset over the statement made by the pastor that falsely alleged that Obama took his oath of office for the U.S. Senate by swearing on a Koran. The facts are that Obama is a Christian and took the oath of office on a Bible.
It's disturbing that the pastor did not check his facts and that he spread falsehood from the pulpit.
It's really a shame they used the opportunity to teach from scripture to preach politics and untruth. Christian Church ha! Just another paster that believes that there is a rapture. One question if you had to go out like the disciples did back in the days of Christ and not get paid would you still be out there witnessing to people about Christ and no pastor it is not your money it is God's. Revalations states that there is a seal of protection around God's people in the end times they were not raptured up so why would we.quit trying to take words out of a written prophecy.

name: Life Church - Fort Myers Campus
reviewSummary:
I had been searching for a church in Fort Myers, asking the Lord to lead me to where He wanted me to plant myself and take root. He led me to Life Church, and I am truly grateful.
I look forward to attending every week. The teachings from Pastor Ryan are inspiring, biblical, and relevant. I genuinely feel that the Lord speaks through him to deliver His message to the body of Christ.
If you want to experience His presence and be fed by the Word of God, this is the church for you. The worship is excellent—genuine, heartfelt, and moving. The presence of the Holy Spirit is present. The sermons are enlightening and challenging, firmly rooted in Scripture while still being accessible to all believers. I occasionally invite friends that are new believers and they have understanding of the messages as well.
The sense of community is strong, and from the moment I arrived, I felt welcomed and encouraged in my walk with Christ. I am thankful that God led me here. If you want to feel the presence of Holy Spirit, and be fed by the word of God, this is the church for you. The contemporary worship is excellent, genuine and moving.  The sermons are enlightening and challenging, Bible based yet accessible for new believers.  The sense of community is strong. Trying to pick up our children from the daycare service was nothing short of just terrible….the experience was extremely disappointing. No one was willing to work with me or offer a solution, and no one apologized for the inconvenience. Instead, the security team was rude and dismissive, which made me feel uncomfortable and unwelcome.

This was especially upsetting because just last week my husband accidentally lost our tag, and the experience was completely different. The staff was kind, patient, and helpful. They explained the policy clearly and worked with us to ensure our children were safely returned without any hostility or embarrassment.

Today, however, I was stopped in the entrance hallway even though my husband had walked in just two minutes before me (with our tag). I was only trying to meet him so we could pick up our children together. I have picked up my kids many times in the past without being stopped until reaching the classroom door, so this inconsistency was confusing and frustrating. I will also add I watched several people walk in without a tag (my mom included) so I’m not sure why they had this issue with me.

Instead of being offered a solution, I was followed out of the church by a staff member who continued to speak to me rudely. Not being understanding of my feelings at all and just kept trying to prove her point. It truly saddens me that we were treated this way, especially because we have loved attending services here. Until today, this church had felt welcoming and supportive. We were believing God to find a church in this area and He led us to Life Church. We were so impressed with everything there from the time we turned into the parking lot. Praise and Worship was outstanding and the preaching was wonderful as well. It was so refreshing to hear preaching that led to eight people to joining the family of God. We thank God for leading us to this church we can't wait to roll up our sleeves and join the Laborers bringing in the harvest.
Now we are believing God to find a home in this area, it is too far of a drive from Chicago. We loved everything there keep doing it saints! The worship service can be powerful for a protestant denomination church. The pastor seems to know his church history and bible and best of all, the congregation is amazing. I love coming here to hear the word of God and interact with magnificent people. What a blessing to have this church so close to home even though I am not a protestant. It is still very powerful to see how it moves the congregation and how the community can be involved with such a great mission. They seem to do a lot with the community and mission of the Lord. I hope they can remain active in the community and be a change for the better. The seats ate comfortable and the parking is plenty. The interior is pretty bland but what is lacking in decor is made up for in character. I love how the sermon is applicable to every day life and can be used as a tool for bettering you and everybody around you. I hope to attend this church again in the future.

name: Life Church of Orange CA
Life Church of Orange CA - Orange Campus
reviewSummary: I believe that this church has lost it's way. For awhile they were really involved and caring about their community. Now it is typical of so many evangelical churches that have lost their way and followed after partisan ideologies rather than true Christian principles. They need to get back to their true roots and what they once were. Christ, Bible, and community centered church. Excellent Spirit-filled worship. Outstanding in every way

name: Life Church San Diego
Life Church San Diego - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary: Unfortunately I was here only a few minutes but it was enough to cause hearing damage the music was so loud and uncomfortable. It looks nice and the people are nice but it's like not very well thought out. Our church is having phenomenal miracles!!! Best church in San Diego CA. I love it so much it's a big help to be there. it's having amazing things in it. People are very friendly and it's a very welcoming station. Try this Everyone!! You're going to love it and it will make your life better. This is a spirit filled God moving Church. It's full of the presence of God. Alot of joy and dancing and praising. Here everyone loves the Lord. Pastor is always on fire for the Lord First time there today Something felt off as soon as I arrived with my wife and daughter, as we were walking to the door I noticed a man outside sitting on a bench he looked uncomfortable like he didn’t want to be inside, as we walked in the door we did not feel welcomed, there was 2 women in the front and we greeted them but they seemed uninterested in greeting us, we went inside to everyone worshipping, once it was done, the pastor read a 1 verse about honoring the elders, they had a family up on the stage, like they were put on a pedestal which I assumed was a pastor and his family, the whole time they were praising them and exalting them, it was more about them than about God, this was very uncomfortable to watch because The word of God calls us to be humble and that we shouldn’t make it about us but about Jesus even pastors aren’t above Christ,  christ is the one that should be praised and exalted, not the pastors, and I believe they dedicated this service to do just that, as they were taking all the praise and glory for themselves my spirit could not take it anymore I told my wife let’s go this isn’t right as I said that I noticed the man that I saw outside get up and walk outside he too didn’t feel comfortable with what was happening, my family and I got up and left because I had seen enough, as we were walking out I heard the pastor say this is my church! Again instead of saying this is Gods church he is putting himself before God. I will not attend this ungodly church and I don’t recommend anyone going there, they seem money hungry I hope this review helps you find a real church that puts Jesus above themselves and where humbleness is found My Husband Billy and I were there today at the Sunday service,for the very first time,and we immediately felt welcome by the church staff,and also immediately felt the holy spirit as soon as we walked into the church! It felt like a family immediately❤And the senior Pastor Nik, is on 🔥 Fire for JESUS❤We definitely will be coming back❤😇🙏

name: Life Mission Church
Life Mission Church - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary:
I can say without a doubt that our family has been beyond blessed by Life Mission Church. I can't imagine what life would be like without this church. Sermons are always biblical and the pastors prioritize God's truth. Music is the same: full of talent, biblical truth, and always encouraging. The community of believers at LMC loves God and loves people. Small but mighty and always striving to glorify God with what's been given to them. We've been here for 10 years and hopefully for many more! Sermon’s are good. Music is great. But it’s not a family/community. I wanted to feel part of something, connecting with ppl but it’s definitely a see you on Sunday type of church.
Update: I’m willing to give it another try. Maybe just bring my own friends for community. Lol It's a family here.  A family though of sinners very thankful for the grace provided us by Christ, with preaching that will very much deepen knowledge of grace and the truth of our nature. I walked in one day and they basically won me over. I love the people and the gospel

name: Life.Church
reviewSummary: Pioneers of the multi-site video model and creators of the Bible App. High-tech, consistent experience across locations. Craig Groeschel's leadership teaching is a major draw.

name: Life.Church West Palm Beach

reviewSummary:

The Bible app they created is very highly recommended. You get the Bible in any language or Bible version you want included the very popular and easy to understand New International Version. We love our church! Over two years strong at Life.Church WPB and wouldn’t trade it for anything. Love our church family 💜 if you’re looking for a place that you feel instantly welcome, come check it out. One service and you’ll see just how special this place is. Guaranteed. The entire LC WPB team is amazing. You can expect to feel comfortable and at home when you come to LC West Palm Beach. Josh, and his team, take such an active role in serving their community.  I have been a member of LC for about 5 years now and it has changed my life.  Thank You to the LC team for all they do. Love and miss going to this church every Sunday hopefully soon life church will open doors in Port Saint Lucie The best church  loving, caring, on fire for christ. .Whoever finds God Finds life.

name: Life150 Church
Life150 Church - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary: Pastor Tymme is a very awesome person and Pastor. Great atmosphere, great people! Come and let down your guard and dance for Jesus! Very blessed to hear pastor Tymme’s messages on Sundays. He is favored by God. A man who seeks God’s heart regularly and really shares what he hears God asking him to share. It’s evident. God bless this church. Very inspiring. Glad we attended. People were friendly. Awesome church, so much life!

The congregation is very friendly and welcoming. Love this church. If you're in the 30ish or younger or have kids, the 9:00am service is awesome!

name: Lifegate Church
Lifegate Church - West Dodge Campus
Lifepoint Church
Lifepoint Church - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary:
I meet Pastor eva a few weeks ago in ocean beach area. She prayed for me and I was able to pass my exam. She is a blessing and always a pleasure to speak to. 🙏 Great church located near downtown La Mesa. It was recommended to me by a friend when I moved to San Diego a year and a half ago, and I've been attending ever since. Mom has been in town visiting for a few weeks and has also fallen in love with the church. Such a welcoming community. Pastor Tony always delivers excellent scripture based sermons. If you are in search of a caring church family i highly recommend Lifepoint Church! Lifepoint Church is all about the people, community and support. Pastor Tony has a youthful vibe and nurturing spirit. He rally cares about his church (people). I have attended a few churches around San Diego where the pastor never gets your name right let alone have a relationship with all the members. If you are looking for encouragement, inspiration and a great bunch of Christian brothers and sisters this is the place.

Worship is amazing, Pastor Tony always delivers a great message. He is the real deal. Great church, centrally located in La Mesa. Nice people, great pastor, awesome youth program. All around great house of worship. If you live nearby, you're gonna love it. bring your family  and friends,  great place to worship  together ❤️

name: Lifepoint Church - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary:
Oh what a beautiful service. I enjoyed the word of God that was preached so much.

"Love God, love his word and love one another."
This is just great. And what a friendly, lovely group of Christians. I felt welcomed, comfortable and just blessed I  made the decision to worship with them. Try and visit LifePoint Church when you are in Rocho Cucamonga and you won't regret it. Lifepoint Church is truly a great Word-teaching ministry! The Elders and Assistant Pastors are extremely knowledgeable. The congregation quickly welcome you and soon you feel the love of the Family of God! There are superb ministries for children, women and men’s fellowships and classes which edify and take you closer to understanding and knowing the Word and Will of God and the Lord. This church will bless you as you grow in wisdom of God’s Word. Lifepoint is a verse by verse Bible teaching church. In a world that pulls us in all sorts of direction we need a place to be grounded in God’s love. Lifepoint is  friendly and welcoming others into their family. Always striving to share the love and knowledge that God has called us to share. It’s all about a Jesus and His saving grace 💕 Everyone here is very down to earth, friendly, and inviting.  They make you feel right at home.  The church itself has daycare during service for infants and children.  A church coffee shop has amazing drinks to keep you caffeinated in the early morning. The services put the the lessons of the Bible into easy to understand examples in today's life. Pastor Glen married us in 2000 and his teaching is very easy to understand with his explanations breaking down the big words some of us don't understand. Please come and feel the warmth and love of my church

name: Lifesong Church
Lifesong Church - Tampa Palms Campus
reviewSummary:
I absolutely LOVE Lifesong! I came to this church after moving to Florida from Missouri and Florida was such a shock to me but Lifesong made me feel like I had found family.  No judgement, no whispers behind my back. They just loved me without question. The pastor teaches directly out of the Bible and is led by the Holy spirit. Here you will know God is love. Here you will find everything you need to know that God is real and that he loves you. Here you will know the Holy Spirit and here you will find the love your life needs to make the difference, find that comfort and hope that will change your life forever. Here you can find home and unconditional love. I am a retired transplant to Florida.  I came three years ago, alone.  I wanted a good spirit-filled, Word fed church where I could fit.  Lifesong opened their doors and hearts to me.  I have been attending for two years and one of the pastors said it perfectly to me yesterday when he commented that I served for two services even on my birthday.  I said that I wouldn't want to be anywhere else.  He said "Because it's home."  This is a wonderful church that is fed by the Word and Jesus shows up every time!  With all their hearts they truly do Love Out Loud! Lifesong is an intimate worship community who welcomed us from the moment we walked in. Members of the church "love out loud", consistently looking to connect with Christ and to bless others. As you can imagine, this attitude creates an atmosphere that is quite invigorating. Pastor Svend and his wife, Katy, are an endearing couple who I'm convinced can connect with just about anyone. They are confident, passionate, upbeat, and serve as excellent role models.

If you are looking for a new church family, give Lifesong a shot! This is the best church I have ever been to. I love pastor Svend because his words are so encouraging. He is also an amazing life coach. His wife is also an amazing example of a great Christian female. They accept all to come and worship our father. If you want to have a relationship with Jesus and you want to see him work miracles in your life, this is the church to learn how to do that. God bless you and may you find the Lord. Amen Lifesong Church is such an inviting and welcoming place! They have the best worship and the pastor brings an amazing message that can apply to everyone! They have great childcare and people of all ages who attend! This is the best church in Tampa and I recommend everyone check it out!

name: Lifesong Community Church
Lifesong Community Church - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary: January 2021, a divine appointment was set up.  We were invited to visit a church and went to the wrong church, so I though. Needless to say, I have been attending Life Song every since that day.  The love of Jesus is shown from the parking lot to the pulpit. The church is very warm and friendly. You get a welcoming vibe. Message gets to you without sermons that take you to a deep sleep. My hubby and I have been searching for a home church after few months of look we found Lifesong. Service was good, everyone made us feel welcome. Great church community. Members are extremely friendly. Newcomers feel welcome. God bless. Reached out asked few questions been 2weeks no response lol 😂 testing waters

name: LifeSpring Assembly of God
LifeSpring Assembly of God - Corona Campus
reviewSummary: This is a great church with kind people. I love the livestreams, and they do what they can to keep sharing the Love of Jesus. I would recommend this church for a person looking for a small friendly church. Wonderful beautiful church and it's people everything they say they do That's God s love 💕 I used to be their next door neighbor.And me and my Family miss going next door to hear and do the word of God.😞 This is the best church I've ever gone to very friendly people they have a band they sing and praise the Lord I only live 5 minutes from this church and I've enjoyed going I'm going to get back into going everyday I pray and read my Bible but I need fellowship with good Christian people like them this is the best Church to go to It's a small church with caring, lovable people. I love this place so much. Was blessed to call Lifespring my home church for 10 years and when I visit it still feels like home. Biblical sound teaching, friendly faces.

reviewSummary: The people were welcoming and the Pastor and first lady are very knowledgeable about the good God almighty gave a great service I will definitely invite others and go again. name: Lifeway Church Glendale
Lifeway Church Glendale - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary: I love the worship music, the heartfelt sharing and the friendships that I have developed in this church. I appreciate how the messages often relate to my daily life. Definitely a place where I have the support to grow spiritually. It is an ethnically diverse fellowship with services in English and Spanish. Great local church in Glendale, CA, reaching the community. A real sense of family here! Love watching their services on youtube. Real genuine authentic worship. I recently became moved to the Lifeway Church to serves as a staff member in 2020. Lifeway Church is full of faithful members who are kind, loving and devoted. They wrapped their arms of my husband, children and I from the start. As a parent of young children, I am impressed by their children’s program. They have gone the extra mile to ensure a safe environment for all children to thrive. Teachers are throughly screened and background checked. Classrooms are cleaned and disinfected. The curriculum is A+ and catered to each age group of children. A loving and caring environment. very encouraging and welcoming church members!  Worship Ministry is awesome! I love the Disciple small group meetings, the Park services! Children, Preteens, teens, Millenials, singles,  and marriage Ministries, are very active to help and encourage each other. All ministries interact, living what the Bible teaches. Encourage one another! I love it! A good, Bible-based church. If you're looking for a place to call home that is all about the Gospel, this is a good option for you.

reviewSummary:

name: Light Church
Light Church - Encinitas Campus
reviewSummary:
We love Light Church. Warm, welcoming and friendly group. Benji, the pastor, is really talented and the worship team that leads music is really good. It’s lovely to have a place like this in Encinitas! This is more of a request, my wife Elizabeth and I never been to California, we're from Tulsa, Oklahoma, I read on Wikipedia that Phil Wickham attends there at Light Church and we want to ask him something...
Brother Phil, I wanted to see if you can visit Tulsa sometime, my wife and I would love to see and hear you sing, if you're able it would be really nice if you can visit our church sometime called Real Church on 315 S Sheridan Rd, my pastor is Apostle Scott C Lovett, he's also a great pastor too, he wrote several books, one of them is Jesus In Your Skin and he also wrote several songs, we live stream on Rumble, look for "RealChurchTulsa"... If you're not able to visit our church then can you do like a concert here in Tulsa at the BOK Center or the Mabee Center? We also want a chance to meet you someday if that's also possible please, we love your music, God bless you for doing God's work, we love you brother! I'm very grateful for a humble community like Light to grow closer to God with. Pastor Benji has challenged my faith exponentially. I really enjoy all the open table options. God bless! rating a church is almost an awkward thing in-itself to rate. since all church's should in theory be doing the work of  God, The God of Love Peace and Mercy, and therefore should all have 5 star ratings. yet in my experience of attending different churches, I have realized there are places of worship that truly connect, preach and live in the humble loving way of Jesus Christ. The Light Church is one of the brightest Lighthouses of Jesus I have ever come across. The Music, community, and Preacher Benji has a gift from God of speaking the word and allowing space for Jesus to connect. Amazing Godly church. Completely heart driven and full of the Holy Spirit. It’s home!

name: Light Church Downtown
Light Church Downtown - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
This church truly feels like family. The leadership is upstanding, thoughtful, and leads with integrity. The community is welcoming and supportive, and the genuine love shared here is evident from the moment you walk in. The messages are meaningful and uplifting, and there are numerous weekly opportunities to get plugged in, grow, and build lasting relationships. I’m incredibly grateful to be part of such a phenomenal church community. My experiences at Light church (San Diego) and it’s “PAY FOR PRAY” business model is feeding themselves from the naive young adults who seek prayer.
They will say they will “help pray for you” and ONLY if the price is right. Prayer from the beanie wearing pastor and his sidekick is like ordering a prayer from their brunch menu where if you buy 2 prayers for $200 and get a free side blessing.
They do not help those in search of Jesus, but claim to be like him and charge you with a bill from any “prayer-time” with you.
This is a profit style business model and not a church!
They feed off those searching for hope and will charge you for every prayer and cash in on any tax write off available including family members.
Pray for them because they need it and DO NOT ATTEND this PAY-for-PRAY organization. A lovely place to be. My coworker recommended this congregation to me and since I haven't attended any churches in awhile I decided to take a chance, and I'm so glad I did. What I love the most is the simplicity, the warm and welcoming people, the sense of community, and the love of the Word. The people I have met so far have really opened their homes and hearts. I look forward to attending more often. Just went for the 2nd time and love it. Really feels like our home church. Love the small atmosphere as it feels like a family. The singing is great and the pastor is AMAZING!! cried during service both time we went...God has truly blessed this man. younger crowd but a great place to be part of the down town , little Italy family.

name: Lighthouse Bible Church Orange County
Lighthouse Bible Church Orange County - Orange Campus
reviewSummary: It’s been a while since we’ve found a church to call our true home. The teaching here is a wonderful balance between truth and grace — not too legalistic and not too loose. The congregation feels like and is family to us. Outstanding in every way

name: Lighthouse Bible Church San Diego
Lighthouse Bible Church San Diego - Encinitas Campus
reviewSummary:
Wooooow! I was at the right place at the right time! Visiting San Diego, I found the church on google. Their head pastor, Patrick, was phenomenal. Jaw dropping with a DEEP bible study on Gen 34, Dinah's rape, titled "violence & vengeance". Paired with mention & prayer of Charlie Kirk's assassination 4 days ago and our mission as Christians. Thank you a well thought out, researched, well constructed sermon, expertly communicated, and connecting it to our reality today with heart. I appreciate being your guest. ❤️

P.S. Thank you for your website providing the change of address, so I didn't get lost. Services are 9 & 11am at University City High School. I visited with my sister, who is a member, yesterday.  Worship is focused on the Lord and the Bible is preached with clarity. Thank you Pastor Patrick for staying true to the Word of God! Truly, Christian fellowship at It’s best I attended Lighthouse Bible Church for six years. I'm so thankful for the leaders and the members for constantly holding fast to the truth of the gospel!

At the end of the six years, it was hard to leave the church. (I moved away to begin graduate school.) I definitely miss the teaching, fellowship, common heart for evangelism. I still look back with thankfulness and joy. Praise God for an awesome 6 years. I wouldn't have it any other way. I came to Lighthouse as an unbelieving college freshman who doubted God’s existence and dreaded going to church. Through listening to the Bible-focused Sunday sermons and interacting with other believers who truly love God and live for God, I learned what it means to be a follower of Christ, our Lord and Savior. Praise God for graciously saving me from my sins and transforming my unbelieving heart : )

I still look back with thankfulness and joy. Praise God for an awesome 6 years. I wouldn't have it any other way. I came to Lighthouse as an unbelieving college freshman who doubted God’s existence and dreaded going to church. Praise God for graciously saving me from my sins and transforming my unbelieving heart : )

name: Lighthouse Christian Church
Lighthouse Christian Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
I would be a member if I didn't live so far away in San Diego, CA.  They have a new pastor; however, the ambiance was the same with the previous pastor!  My niece and her husband are members of this wonderful church.  The people are serious about God's Truth, Love, and Righteousness so much so that you feel it on the grounds as well as in the sanctuary!
There is a vibrant youth group for middle school, high school and college levels.  They are serious about a focus on core Christian principles with a fellowship that gives them a family-like experience that is quite contagious and inspirational to all ages!
I highly-recommend the group of believers for singles, married, widows, and widower!  ✝️❣️💯🔥✔️😁

✔️🔥💯❣️✝️😁 I was at this church for awhile I left and came back. The people here are great. I feel as if the people are like a family here. They have a strong relationship with the Lord which you can see by meeting them. There are a few things though that make me want to find a different church. The worship team sounds "dead." I feel that this church only accommodates people who are elderly 1st and second service. They are set in the old fashion way of things. Their motto is to spread the gospel and make God known..which is awesome! I feel as if they are unwilling to do this though. Part of it seems as if they are not in the present time of accommodating a younger crowd. Perhaps they are not sure how to or they don't want to change. The atmosphere makes me want to fall asleep whether they are singing or speaking. I don't want to sound harsh but this is the simple truth. I was once a part of the children's ministry and it was the same way. I wanted to make it more fun and exciting for the younger crowd and they didn't want that. It was this is the way we wanted it ...but it was dull and boring!They need people for children's ministry but they are not willing to change and I'm not talking about God's word. The rooms in the children's ministry...elementary ages and up seem dull. I guess what I'm saying is that I want to grow and be a part of this church because the people are great and God is awesome but the leaders prevent you from doing this. It's sad😔. I love the traditional service with the choir. The pianists are so great and I love the special music by various artists. The Bible Studies are great with dedicated leaders. Its a church that fulfills its mission to know God and make Him known. The Pastor has great sermons every week and people are warm and inclusive. Come visit! We'd love to have you in Gods family. The best!! So inspirational from staff to congregation! You feel welcome from the time you walk up to the church. They have two services, traditional and contemporary. I enjoy the second service,  contemporary, and the praise and worship leader, Basilio is high energy which is so refreshing, even ending a few services here and there with music that gets us up in celebration! Donuts and coffee between first and second service and after second service. Great fellowship, programs,and Bible studies at church and in surrounding community. Attended a memorial here. It was lovely.  Facility is clean and church is comfortable. Seems like a lovely place to worship. I know some of the people that attend. They're faith is attractive.  This tells me this church teaches the word. If I wasn't already in a church close to home that teaches the Bible well, I'd try this church out.

So lighthouse church is a nice breath of fresh air where they tell you about God. reviewSummary: If you’re travelling and visiting, I’d highly recommend. Came with the wife and we didn’t know what to expect, but we came out grateful and glad! name: Lighthouse Church - Panama City Campus
reviewSummary:
Five stars for Lighthouse Church. From the moment we walked in, everyone was genuinely friendly and welcoming. As a full-time RV family, we visit a lot of churches across the country, and feeling immediately at home is important for us. This one delivered.

Worship was moving and on point - heartfelt, engaging, and centered where it should be. The pastor was passionate and relatable, sharing truth in a way that felt both grounded and practical for real life.

Our kids loved the kids area, which is always a huge win for us. When the kids are excited to go back, you know you’ve found something special.

If you’re looking for a church where you’ll be welcomed right away and hear solid, passionate preaching, Lighthouse Church is absolutely worth a visit. The picture below is some quotes I took from the so called “pastor” The whole service was about what you bring to the church and zero information about the gospel. I have never felt so terrible leaving a church service. Although I’m young I have been lucky enough to grow up in church but seeing all the young people at this church that might not have had that opportunity makes me sick to think they hear  that every Sunday. The fact he mentioned his bad emails that he receives says enough for me. In leadership you can’t make everyone happy but I have a feeling his negative emails are a little different. I don’t even want to call him a pastor but the pastor has put himself on such I high pedestal I hate to see the crash he has when he crumbles from the unrealistic pressure he puts on himself and others. Man you talk about a place where the Spirit is, and the Pastor always allows GOD to use him as a tool. As he always says "Let me fade to the back and you take center stage because I can't save them only you can GOD". You will feel so welcome here from the time you walk in, to the time you are getting to your car. Oh and Praise & Worship there WOW that's all I can say is WOW. Such a wonderful church. Just like me if you attend once , I promise you will attend again becoming a part of the church family. Truly blessed to have found my church home an family. I love this place so much I have never felt at home or so happy in a church since I was little. reviewSummary: They have all kinds of community functions here. I grew up around the corner and have always felt very fond of this friendly neighborhood church ☺️ I haven't made my way to attend this church as of this writing, but I did attend seminary with the pastor, and I can testify that this Pastor Davis is an extraordinary woman of God. Her love for all people, as her Creator has commanded, is beyond explanation.  She personifies the hymn lyric, "Lord prepare ME to be a sanctuary..."  If I were a brand new disciple, or a seasoned saint looking for a new church home, this wonderful, faithful powerful preaching woman's Little White Chapel, would be my first and last stop. Pastor Julie is a dear friend from school. Our teacher, and LWC’s prior leader, Pastor Bill, saw her talent and heart and mentored her. She is one of the smartest people I know and she always leads with compassion and love. I trust her with my own care, as someone in recovery and LGBT. I have been to the church a few times, and it’s a charming, intimate, caring community. I admire the efforts of LWC to help neighbors in need through the pantry, to support diversity and inclusion through participating in Pride, and to offer growth through readings of the Bible and other literature. If you are looking for a welcoming, progressive worship experience Little White Chapel is the place you want to be! Pastor Julie Davis leads our congregation with spiritual wisdom and kindness creating an inclusive environment where truly all are welcome. I am proud to call this church my home. I have had the pleasure of knowing pastor Julie for over 15 years. I am so thankful for having met her and I am both encouraged and inspired by her dedication to Christ’s true mission. To often Christs love gets co-opted for financial or political gain yet Julie and her church stand steadfast to Love everyone where they are at. Looking for love and acceptance? Looking for peace and understanding? You have found it. God bless you Julie - I LoVE YOU!

name: Live Oak United Church of Christ (formerly Brea Congregational Church)
Live Oak United Church of Christ (formerly Brea Congregational Church) - Brea Campus
reviewSummary:
I love the inclusion of Live Oak. It feels great to walk into a sacred space and see so many different types of people. The music here is also wonderful. There’s a choir and a ukulele group as well as very talented keyboardists who keep the service varied and interesting. The messages I hear each week are always thought provoking and heart felt. Live Oak is everything I’ve hoped for in a church but the best part are the people in it. At the beginning of 2020 I had to navigate some extreme emotional trauma. With my social anxieties and a childhood full of disconnection in Christian churches I felt very overwhelmed about testing the waters as an adult with my own household, but I desperately needed a community.
I took the smallest step of reaching out on Facebook to ask questions that would help make my first visit a little less intimidating and I felt so much better after getting responses that made me feel some peace in bringing my family.
Over five years later and I have not once felt "othered" nor anything but welcomed to participate at any level I am comfortable, from celebrations to community volunteering to church meetings.
I feel it to my bones when I hear the pastor instill weekly, "No matter who you are or where you are on life's journey, ALL are welcome here." And I see that, every week, in the pews all around me. This church is so amazing! They are truly welcoming and loving. They sing to the lord with all their hearts and talk about Jesus miracles and love and spreading faith to the community. They welcome everyone with open arms and they are very knowledgeable of the Bible. I love it here Brea is a welcoming friendly church, encouraging people to  feel at right home.  This is a progressive church, promoting the inclusion of all people who love each other and interested in humane and environmental causes.  Adding to that comfortable feeling, people may bring along that special pet to the services and frequent potlucks.  Looking for God's home? Then, this is it. Wonderful Jazz Vesper with sensational Vocalist Rose Mallett and  the Ron Kobayashi Trio. Speakers were engaging and inspirational.

name: Living Faith Presbyterian Church
Living Faith Presbyterian Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Let me begin by saying that I live a nomadic existence. When asked, I like to say, “a Nomad, tethered to Christ.”

I have the unique privilege of Serving and Teaching in a variety of spaces, predominantly overseas, and during the in-between seasons, Los Angeles at times becomes my home base of sorts.

Roughly 3 years ago, like you and others, I found myself on Google Maps looking for a place to Worship and Fellowship. A place that Teaches the Bible clearly, somewhere steady, somewhere at the time, I could walk to. Haha, I know, clearly I'm not from LA but I don't have a car.

By God’s Grace and Favor, that search led me to Living Faith Presbyterian Church. People come here from near and far across LA and beyond. A wonderful quality I think.

Like someone has said before me, it feels a little strange to write a review of a church, but Gratitude asks to be spoken. So here it goes:

Living Faith is centered on the Word of God, not as a concept or a slogan, but as the living and trustworthy foundation for Faith and Life.

Things of Significant Note:
* This is a church that confesses the God who exists eternally as Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.
* Scripture is trusted as the inspired, infallible Word.
* Salvation is understood as entirely by God’s grace, given through Jesus Christ, who lived, died, and rose again for those who trust in HIM. HE is our Hope, our Savior, and our Mediator.
* Through the Holy Spirit, we are guided, strengthened, and slowly shaped to walk in a way that honors HIM.

What I found at Living Faith was not performance or spectacle, but reverent Worship, thoughtful teaching, and a steady, sincere community. I was not treated as someone passing through, but as a Brother/Sister in Christ. There is a gentleness here, subtle but clear.

If you’re reading this, you already know that finding a church can be challenging, to say the least. Churches are filled with us, sinful people, perfectly imperfect, broken and hurting and hurt people often inadvertently or purposely, hurt others. Living Faith is not an exception to that truth; no church is. But what you will find here is a community of people at various stages of life, learning to practice Repentance, Healing, Patience, and Love. A community growing in the Word and in Prayer. A place that equips you to do so daily.

It is a church that loves the Truth, Cares for People, and has a Heart for reaching Global Communities.

If you are seeking a place where the Bible is treasured, Christ is honored, and ordinary Believers walk together in Grace, you may find a home here, even if only for a season.

Be Encouraged and Remember to Pray over your decision to not only visit but possibly stay. God knows exactly where HE wants you.

Jeremiah 29:11 (ESV)
11 For I know the plans I have for you,” declares the Lord, “plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future. It feels odd to write a “review” for a church, so this won’t be that.  Instead, I wanted to share my experiences coming to Living Faith Presbyterian Church (LFPC), and things that I wish I knew when I first visited.  Please note that this information applies to LFPC.  There’s a Korean language church here called The Way Church, which is a separate church.  And there might be some reference to a Hebron Church, which I understand was a different church that used to meet here many years ago.

FINDING LFPC
Finding a church was difficult!  There’s no comprehensive directory so even knowing what’s out there was tough.  I tried Yelp/Google.  I tried churches that people recommended.  At the end of the day, for us, we found this church through the Presbyterian Church in America directory.  We first came about 2 years ago, and became members about a year later.  So please keep in mind that I’m writing this as a fairly new member, but a member nonetheless.

BIBLE TEACHING
We had a list of priorities when we were looking for a church, but in the end, we were drawn to LFPC due to their solid biblical teaching which we saw in their messages, their bible studies, and through the spiritual maturity of the members.  This is a church that is committed to teaching Reformed Theology.

SERVICE
Service starts at 1PM in the main sanctuary.  It’s covenantal worship style, meaning that children stay with adults during service.  However, there is a separate baby room in the back for the littlest ones and their parents as needed.   Service is fairly standard and they have communion every Sunday (praise, offering, prayer, message, communion, benediction, fellowship).  This is an English speaking church, but we share the space with a larger Korean speaking church (called The Way Church), so some of the building signs will be in Korean.  In terms of size, it’s large enough that if you’re new and want to sit in the back and leave right afterwards, you won’t stick out.  But it’s still small enough that someone may notice that you’re new, and will come by to say hello.  And the members are genuinely warm and friendly.  Of course, some people are shier than others, so not everybody will come over to say hello, but there were many who came over to welcome me on my first day, and I’ve seen that this is typical.  The congregation has a mix of children, college students, young adults, couples, and families with children.

BIBLE STUDY
There is a separate children’s ministry program at 11:15 and an adult bible study (or prayer meeting) at the same time.  This is on the third floor of this massive building.  And it’s only accessible via the stairs on the south side of the building, not the north side of the building.  To get there, you’ll need to either go through the metal gate/door across from Jay’s market, or if that’s closed, go through the main building doors, turn left and go down the corridor past the Korean-language service, and then you’ll see the stairs going up. name: Living Faith Presbyterian Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary:
Let me begin by saying that I live a nomadic existence. When asked, I like to say, “a Nomad, tethered to Christ.”

I have the unique privilege of Serving and Teaching in a variety of spaces, predominantly overseas, and during the in-between seasons, Los Angeles at times becomes my home base of sorts.

Roughly 3 years ago, like you and others, I found myself on Google Maps looking for a place to Worship and Fellowship. A place that Teaches the Bible clearly, somewhere steady, somewhere at the time, I could walk to. Haha, I know, clearly I'm not from LA but I don't have a car.

By God’s Grace and Favor, that search led me to Living Faith Presbyterian Church. People come here from near and far across LA and beyond. A wonderful quality I think.

Like someone has said before me, it feels a little strange to write a review of a church, but Gratitude asks to be spoken. So here it goes:

Living Faith is centered on the Word of God, not as a concept or a slogan, but as the living and trustworthy foundation for Faith and Life.

Things of Significant Note:
* This is a church that confesses the God who exists eternally as Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.
* Scripture is trusted as the inspired, infallible Word.
* Salvation is understood as entirely by God’s grace, given through Jesus Christ, who lived, died, and rose again for those who trust in HIM. HE is our Hope, our Savior, and our Mediator.
* Through the Holy Spirit, we are guided, strengthened, and slowly shaped to walk in a way that honors HIM.

What I found at Living Faith was not performance or spectacle, but reverent Worship, thoughtful teaching, and a steady, sincere community. I was not treated as someone passing through, but as a Brother/Sister in Christ. There is a gentleness here, subtle but clear.

If you’re reading this, you already know that finding a church can be challenging, to say the least. Churches are filled with us, sinful people, perfectly imperfect, broken and hurting and hurt people often inadvertently or purposely, hurt others. Living Faith is not an exception to that truth; no church is. But what you will find here is a community of people at various stages of life, learning to practice Repentance, Healing, Patience, and Love. A community growing in the Word and in Prayer. A place that equips you to do so daily.

It is a church that loves the Truth, Cares for People, and has a Heart for reaching Global Communities.

If you are seeking a place where the Bible is treasured, Christ is honored, and ordinary Believers walk together in Grace, you may find a home here, even if only for a season.

Be Encouraged and Remember to Pray over your decision to not only visit but possibly stay. God knows exactly where HE wants you.

Jeremiah 29:11 (ESV)
11 For I know the plans I have for you,” declares the Lord, “plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future. It feels odd to write a “review” for a church, so this won’t be that.  Instead, I wanted to share my experiences coming to Living Faith Presbyterian Church (LFPC), and things that I wish I knew when I first visited.  Please note that this information applies to LFPC.  There’s a Korean language church here called The Way Church, which is a separate church.  And there might be some reference to a Hebron Church, which I understand was a different church that used to meet here many years ago.

FINDING LFPC
Finding a church was difficult!  There’s no comprehensive directory so even knowing what’s out there was tough.  I tried Yelp/Google.  I tried churches that people recommended.  At the end of the day, for us, we found this church through the Presbyterian Church in America directory.  We first came about 2 years ago, and became members about a year later.  So please keep in mind that I’m writing this as a fairly new member, but a member nonetheless.

BIBLE TEACHING
We had a list of priorities when we were looking for a church, but in the end, we were drawn to LFPC due to their solid biblical teaching which we saw in their messages, their bible studies, and through the spiritual maturity of the members.  This is a church that is committed to teaching Reformed Theology.

SERVICE
Service starts at 1PM in the main sanctuary.  It’s covenantal worship style, meaning that children stay with adults during service.  However, there is a separate baby room in the back for the littlest ones and their parents as needed.   Service is fairly standard and they have communion every Sunday (praise, offering, prayer, message, communion, benediction, fellowship).  This is an English speaking church, but we share the space with a larger Korean speaking church (called The Way Church), so some of the building signs will be in Korean.  In terms of size, it’s large enough that if you’re new and want to sit in the back and leave right afterwards, you won’t stick out.  But it’s still small enough that someone may notice that you’re new, and will come by to say hello.  And the members are genuinely warm and friendly.  Of course, some people are shier than others, so not everybody will come over to say hello, but there were many who came over to welcome me on my first day, and I’ve seen that this is typical.  The congregation has a mix of children, college students, young adults, couples, and families with children.

BIBLE STUDY
There is a separate children’s ministry program at 11:15 and an adult bible study (or prayer meeting) at the same time.  This is on the third floor of this massive building.  And it’s only accessible via the stairs on the south side of the building, not the north side of the building.  To get there, you’ll need to either go through the metal gate/door across from Jay’s market, or if that’s closed, go through the main building doors, turn left and go down the corridor past the Korean-language service, and then you’ll see the stairs going up.  Lunch is served between bible study and the worship service.  However, there are some weeks when the church doesn’t have bible study, so I would encourage you to check out the website for the calendar, if you plan to stop by the Bible Study for your first visit.

PARKING
If you’re coming for the 1PM service, there’s a fenced parking lot south of Jay’s Market on Norton Ave.  If you’re coming for the 11:15AM bible study, then heaven help you!!!  Just kidding!!!  There are a few parking spaces on the north side of Pico, at the Union Club parking lot (4075 W. Pico Blvd).  If the club is busy, you just need to tell them that you’re parking for the church.  And there’s usually some street parking within a block or two of the church.  I haven’t had difficulty finding parking on 4th and 5th Avenues, north of Pico, or along Pico.

COMMUNITY GROUPS
As a commuter church, members come from as far away as Granada Hills, Glendale, Downey and the South Bay or as close as 1 block away.  CG info on website. This church has helped me and my family a lot and continues to help. The people are very responsive and kind, everyone is very friendly and eager to talk, even though I don't speak the language very well. Thank you all for being here.
As for parking, there is a fenced-in free parking lot for church parishioners.
I came from my country with prejudices against church, but people who truly call themselves believers gather here.

name: Living Word Lutheran Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
Living world Church took my family and I in a year ago. I was a non believer but my wife encouraged me to go to church. We have family members who are apart of this church and everyone here is very welcoming. Pastor Frey took the time to get to know us and spent every week outside of service to teach us about Lutheran Christianity. He covered all my questions I had and has helped me understand what it is to be a Christian. My daughters love the kids Sunday school where there are a lot of other kids ranging from 2 years old to teens. We love our church and the people in it. I read the 1 star review but did not find video they were talking about. It’s hard to believe since the members have been very kind to everyone who has come and gone. If you’re looking for a traditional Lutheran church or a church in general to help you under learn and understand the Gospel,  this is definitely a place to check out. I'm moving to Mission Viejo soon and was looking for a Lutheran Church to attend I googled/ YouTube your church and wow I was surprised by the actions of the members. How they handle the couple on the sidewalk by confronting them demanding they leave. Calling the sheriff department on them. That was very concerning, it could have been handled so much differently. In the beginning I thought it was going to be a great encounter turned out that the church members turned on the photographers shame on Living Word Lutheran Church Members. Plus having one of your church members follow them was very concerning also. I realize this is an old video maybe a few months ago hopefully the members have a change of heart but I cannot attend the church whose actions are not Christian like. Hopefully they prayed for forgiveness. I just downloaded the sermon of 1/17/16 to my smartphone. Now I can play it again anytime.

Pastor Frey records and posts his sermons on the church’s website. The Transfiguration Sermon really touched me. He talks about billions of Galaxies, Buddha, and of course Jesus.

We are privileged to have such a pastor. He is brilliant and faithful to the Word. Pastor Dave is an avid listener. Beautiful soul and a contented preacher. His Church is small enough to know you and big enough to  minister to your spiritual needs. Everyone should visit this Church. Pastor preaches the true word of God

name: livingStone Church
livingStone Church - St. Augustine Campus
reviewSummary:
If you live here or you’re on vacation in the area and looking for an awesome Church to attend and be uplifted, then livingStone is the place!  From the the very first time my husband and I attended we felt welcomed and accepted.  The people here are so friendly, caring and have become family.  Pastor Chris does a phenomenal job sharing God's word and breaking it down in a way that is easy for everyone to understand. If you love worship music, we have a fabulous worship band.   We also have a wonderful youth ministry.  Come worship with us, you won’t be disappointed. This is a wonderful place! Folks are welcoming and friendly. Great music. Pastor is by the Word, very relatable and always gives ways to apply his message to your everyday life. We love it and consider Living Stone our home church whenever we're in St. Augustine. There's no need to feel shy. Give it a try. You won't be disappointed!! Pastor Chris has a way of teaching the Bible like no other! We were welcomed from the first steps in the door. The music is amazing. Lots of support and fellowship and the Youth Group is solid. Best church in St Augustine area! Livingstone church is a wonderful place to worship.  Chris, the pastor, communicates the word of God like very few can with a transparent, down to earth personality.
The music is worshipful and the people are very friendly and inviting.  Saint Augustine is fortunate to have  a Bible preaching church such as this one.  If you haven’t done so, do yourself a favor and check it out. We are in St. Augustine on vacation and attended service here. The sermon was thought-provoking and Biblically based. Everyone was friendly and welcoming. There are plenty of opportunities for the congregation to meet outside of Sundays.  This would make a lovely home church for anyone living in the area.

name: Local City Church
Local City Church - Tampa (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: I've been attending this church since the very first day they launched and I can proudly say this is HOME. I've found a community here that has helped me feel accepted no matter where I stand in life. If you are looking for somewhere to grow you relationship with God, your Local community, and yourself, then I hope to see you on Sunday :) One of our major concerns we contemplated while considering a move to Tampa 3 years ago was finding a church HOME to continue worshiping, growing our faith and serving by doing. Local City provides all of that and more. We are so thankful. During our stay in Tampa we went to Local city church on the Sunday, before Tropical storm. I couldn’t stop crying! Thank you Holy Spirit for always showing up, when needed. Pastor was Amazing! We've been 2 times now.  Love having this church right in my neighborhood.  Love the reputation they have built with the school.  Heard great report from a friend who is an administrator at Hillsborough high school.  The music is well done,  preaching alive, interesting,  on the spot in doctrine and Jesus is presented and represented in a way I feel makes His heart happy and brings a smile to His face.  It's definitely worth a try if you are seeking answers to life's hard questions or just need something bigger than yourself. Local City Church is home to us. Everyone treats you as one of their own. When my 17 year old daughter told me she wanted to give it a try, I thought it was just going to be a temporary thing. To my surprise she has felt comfortable there since day one. Yes I say surprise because we all know how teenagers are very quick to change their minds. I have sat and have stood next to my daughter and seen how she has been touched by the power of God. When I saw her tears running down her face I felt joy and knew that she was comfortable at Local City Church. God is one in the same no matter where you worship him. I am glad that she has found it in her heart to allow us to call Local City Church home.

name: Logos Church
Logos Church - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary:
They have excelled in creating a community. I've never felt so welcomed. The people are amazing in this church!
Pastor Andrea preaches in a way where everything is referenced and I love that. I do feel like I walk away having learned something every time. My wife and I love this church.  It's friendly and inviting with an emphasis on expository preaching.  They preach the Word of God. It's a great place to expand your knowledge of the scripture and grow in your faith. All ages are represented. I highly recommend this church. As a bonus, there are plenty of great places in the area to eat after the church service. Are you looking for a new church? Are you tired of a watered-down Gospel message? Look no further than Logos Church, a beacon of reformed theology and expositional teaching and preaching. Stepping into Logos Church feels like entering a family gathering rather than a consumer-driven event. But what truly sets Logos Church apart is how attending becomes a transformative journey, an unparalleled opportunity to grow your relationship with God like never before. Here, the depth of theology intertwines seamlessly with the warmth of a familial atmosphere, creating an extraordinary environment for spiritual enrichment and connection. A church that loves people, and puts the preaching of the Word of God first and foremost.  Big emphasis on family, and the church loving and serving one another.  A small congregation but not cliquey, they make everyone feel welcome. I love Logos church from the people that are creating a community of family, the worship music reaching to spirit and soul speaking directly to your heart, and the preaching. I have sat under many pastors and never learned a depth of teaching Pastor Andrea brings. Listen to Pastor Andrea encourages me to learn the Bible on my own.

reviewSummary:
Since I came in America year 2001, I've been attending here, Praise the Lord. I like their Vision. Passion for God, Empower Disciples & Reach people. I Thank God for directing  my steps in this Church. Lord of Harvest-LA. They are doing a great job. All for God's glory.
By the grace of God they have Filipino Worship, And English & Spanish. I am truly grateful to be part of Lord of Harvest LA. In a time when many people are searching for purpose, truth, and genuine relationships, I have found this church to be a place where Christ is not just talked about—He is genuinely lived out.

What has impacted me the most is the love of the people. From the pastors to the members, I have experienced sincere care, encouragement, and a desire to see one another grow in our walk with God. This is not a place where people simply attend a service and go home; it is a church family that prays together, serves together, and helps each other become more like Christ.

The preaching is rooted in God's Word and continually points us back to Jesus. I appreciate that the focus is not on entertainment or popularity, but on discipleship, spiritual growth, and living out our faith in everyday life.

Through Lord of Harvest, I have seen people transformed by God's grace, families strengthened, and believers challenged to deepen their relationship with Christ. The church has helped me grow spiritually and has reminded me what the body of Christ should look like—a community of imperfect people pursuing a perfect Savior.

No church is perfect, but I can honestly say that Lord of Harvest LA is a place where people genuinely love Jesus, love His Word, and strive to love others as He commanded. I am blessed to call this church my home and would gladly recommend it to anyone seeking a Christ-centered church family. Lord of Harvest has been a huge blessing in my life. The people are friendly and welcoming, and it’s where I grew closer to the Lord. If you’re looking for a church to grow in your faith and experience God’s presence, I highly recommend attending a service. The Word of God is faithfully preached, and it has truly changed my life. 🙏❤️ I have experienced spiritual growth in a church whose heart is in discipleship. The Holy Spirit is moving! The people here are welcoming, Christ centered, and the atmosphere felt warm and uplifting. I felt spiritually refreshed, and looking forward to grow in the Lord.

reviewSummary: We used this church as the venue for our wedding ceremony in 2018. They were very accommodating and it was a beautiful venue. Traditional but still had a fresh modern feel. We used minimal florals and greenery, along with a string quartet and it was perfect. I love this church.. so many wonderful memories here. My family went here all through the 80s and early 90s. We moved away since, but would love to visit again when in the area.🥰 Looks big, but plays small; has great acoustics which serves the community by its affiliation with CSULB School Of Music, hosting choral competitions, brass & wind ensembles, etc.  They also make space available for local meetings of AA, etc. at reasonable rates. Located at Woodruff & Willow, with an onramp to NB fwy 405, it is a welcoming place Mon-Sun for God ttto hang His/Her, + Hat. Very nice to be able to use one of their out buildings for a committee meeting of an organization I belong to.  One of our members is also a long-time church member so I don't believe we were charged for the use of it. Attended Chair Yoga 2x a week.  The class is held in a classroom on premise, and conducted by a licensed instructor.  The cost/recommended donation is $5 per session, and each session lasts 1 hr.

name: Los Angeles Temple Visitors' Center
Los Angeles Temple Visitors' Center - Westwood Campus
reviewSummary:
What a beautiful historic place!! Brought my mom here for Mother’s Day. We were greeted with kind smiles all around. We looked at all the displays and watched some interactive videos. It was awesome to learn about the history of the temple and how and when it was built. Highly recommend coming here if you’re an active member of the LDS. The landscape is stunning. Very serene and peaceful. Beautiful ground to explore. Easy parking,  the center itself is very modern with display and hands on experience. There is also a kids corner to do things.  Good for entire family.
Staff are super nice and knowledgeable of the church.
If it is a good weather,  take a stroll outside the visitor center.  The ground is so nice. A remarkable place to feel peace and learn about the temple! I have loved whenever I go, it's such a refuge. I didn’t get to see everything on 6/20/25 but I hadn’t been in many years and there are some amazing updates, including a tomb-like area with depictions of the life of Jesus Christ. There were friendly missionaries (sisters) that greeted my wife and me. I want to go on their tour next time. The pictures I took do not give July justice as I am not very good at taking them… Also there was a question on the review about tickets and I wanted to clarify that it is free. I suppose depending on the day or time it would be more busy but when I was there in the afternoon  just after 1:30 on a Friday there weren’t a lot of people. My group traveled from over 700 miles and we showed up 20 minutes before the visitor center closed. Even though we had showed up so late the senior missionaries were so welcoming and inviting. The hospitality they gave us and the way they made our group feel so comfortable was extremely nice. They even took the time and stayed late after shift to give us a full tour of all there exhibits and even explained an event they were having soon. That was such a selfless act of Christlike love. The LA Temple visitor center is a must see if you've ever been curious about LDS temples or religion.

reviewSummary: I have had three kids attend Loving Savior Preschool and the teachers and staff have become family. My kids wake up excited to go to school; to participate in the activities, see their friends and hug their teachers. Some of the specific reasons LS has such high value:  Diverse parents and peers who all value a Christian faith foundation.  On site security and secure check in/out. Communication with teachers is constant (in person and via app in real time, so I always know what's happening). Classrooms are well organized and not overwhelming, toys are cleaned, there' s ample outside time, and the kids are monitored for health changes. My kids' academic levels, friendship building and self-confidence have continued to grow exponentially each year. The staff is professional and loving and have created a community that pours into my children. I am appreciative of what they've built and am proud to be a part of it. I just have to share my experience with Loving Savior Preschool. After a tough time at a previous preschool, I was nervous about switching schools. But Loving Savior has been such a blessing! My child is thriving. She feels safe, she’s growing academically, and she’s even being nurtured spiritually. If you’re a parent, I truly hope you look at the full picture: academics, emotional, and spiritual well-being. Loving Savior Preschool exceeded all my expectations! This is a private school ranging from 1st grade to 8th grade. Wonderful front office staff and caring teachers. I have friends sending their kids here to receive excellent education and a myriad of school activities. Genuine people with Christian theme and a close knit community! Two thumbs up from me! My family has attended Loving Savior Church for 20 years. On the school side -our daughter started out at the preschool there and onto the elementary school. We had awesome teachers. After all these years (15) we still keep in touch with a few of them. We feel so close to all that attend the Sunday 9:30 am church service. It’s like one big family. We genuinely care about each other. A group of us go out for a quick lunch afterwards. (Arby, Wendy’s etc)  Some of my dear friendships have come from attending Loving Savior Church. I love Pastor Wu, he is so down to earth and caring. I love the smaller congregation. So many wonderful memories for me at this church. Everyone pretty much knows everyone. I have friends that attend the larger churches, they know no one, just leave knowing the next week they won’t know anyone again. I hope you give Loving Savior a try 🙏 I guess every school has good and bad teachers, judging from the reviews.  Some teacher are just not as friendly as other and they don't always great the parents or kids when they get dropped off in the morning.  Maybe it's just that class that my kid is in.  Also, I did not know that they let the kids watch TV everyday. I am not sure how long, but supposedly after their outside playtime for 45 min until they get transferred to another room for the pick up.  Another time is whenever it rains in the morning and every Friday morning before 8:30am. So, it you have a job that drops off early and pick up later, know that your kids will be watching TV possibly for over 1 hour each day.

name: Manhattan Beach Community Church
Manhattan Beach Community Church - Manhattan Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Great Church. We went there with my wife as first timers on Easter Sunday! We're considering becoming members.

The pastor seems to strike a good balance between tradition and contemporary practices. Sermon depth was decent without being boring. No truisms here.

“Ecce quam bonum et quam iucundum habitare fratres in unum!”
— Psalm 133:1

Much love,

G I was here for a dance company recital with my niece. Everything was amazing. Great place to host a play, dance recital, or event. We started attending mass at MBCC a few years ago after coming to some of the theater productions they host.   Now my kids are performing in them:)  This is a church but it's also a wonderful community.  It is small enough that you don't feel overwhelmed by the number of people.  There are many activities for the family including drive in movies, art nights, discussion groups, game nights and volunteer opportunities.  All of which were very important to us for making faith part of our children's life.  Especially the Sunday School offering which has been consistent even thru the challenges of Covid.  We really feel at home at MBCC.   As each mass starts we are reminded that no matter who you are, or where you are in life's journey you are welcome here!  And we really feel that way! I have attended MBCC for many years now, with young kids, teens and now as a soon to be empty nester. At all stages, I have found MBCC to be a safe and supportive church to explore faith, be of service and find community.  MBCC is an open and inclusive church with opportunities for all to feel connected. This church produces 2 theatrical productions each year as part of a 60 year old tradition. Noel Cowards Blithe Spirit just ended today. Cash and checks only. No reserved seating. About 75 seats. The set was very well done as well as costumes. Acting in this play was superb with crisp dialogue and deft stage blocking.
