There was a Sunday service I came to with some male pastor (I don’t remember his name), but it was the fourth part in a multi-week story about David. The topic of sex came up, and slightly homosexuality, and the pastor spoke in a manner of wanting to agitate the youth by reinforcing traditional, anti-progressive ideals. I understand, it’s a church, and they have certain traditions, but the manner in which this particular pastor seemed delighted in the offense of the youth completely turned me off from this church. I never stepped foot in it again, and while I was recently looking for churches to go to, as I would like to return to a weekly service, something told me to submit this review, as a warning and hopefully a lesson for the pastor. Work in God’s name, and don’t be a jerk. I love this church!!!! You feel the holy spirit here.  The staff is amazing.  I love Pastor Nate and his wife Michelle.  Tracy at the children’s ministry is wonderful.  I found my home here!! Thank you Jesus!! ❤️✝️ This is my church home! The moment you walk in, you feel the incredible energy and love. The messages are always relevant and powerful, the people are so welcoming, and the pastor is amazing. I also love that there are three different service times on Sunday, which makes it easy to attend. If you're looking for a church that feels like family, this is it! From the first time I went to Movement, I knew I had found my community. During service you feel the Spirit working through even the hearts of the hardest stone, and bringing about the most amazing life changes. 4 years into being a member of the church, and my daughter and I have grown to truly know the Lord and have been baptized with this church family. What truly sets this church apart is its dedication to outreach. They have an incredible program that supports local schools, helps feed the hungry, and provides much-needed assistance to those who are struggling. The church’s impact on the community is tangible, and it’s clear that they deeply care about making a difference in people’s lives. They’re also focused on uplifting all generations, investing in the youngest as future leaders and calling older generations to disciple them. Their youth and young adult programs are incredible!

The Movement Church doesn’t just focus on the spiritual aspect of its members but emphasizes health and well-being from the top down. It’s a place where personal growth, both spiritually and physically, is encouraged and supported. They truly focus on getting to know people, which makes it a special and unique environment for families and individuals alike.

If you're looking for a church that is dedicated to Biblical truth, community outreach, and overall well-being, The Movement Church is definitely worth checking out. It’s home away from home❤️ The Movement has always been — and will always be — a place of refuge for me. A place where the Bible is taught in a way that’s real, practical, and full of truth. Their heart is simple: love God, love people. And they live it. The leadership is solid, Spirit-led, and fully aligned with the Word of God. So deeply thankful for this church and the covering it’s been in my life when I lived in Cali. Normal people loving normal people. This Bible based church was pivotal in my life and my family's life. I love this church family! I'm a member of the military that was stationed in the SD area and stumbled (more like led) on this church in 2015 and knew this was the place I belonged! The Movement Church accepts EVERYONE! Come as you are and you will be fed with the Word with authentic, loving leadership and fellowship. They have a great kids center for children of all Ages led by caring staff. If you're new to church in general don't worry you will have genuine members that will guide you every step of the way. Join a group and get engaged! They have multiple ministries that you can connect with. The Men's ministry is great and led by guys that want the best from our men and hold each other accountable. I cannot praise our God enough for putting the senior leaders in the Movement Church to further Gods Word in North county!

My Pastor Preaches a Fruitful Lesson. A beautiful service and the Pastor's message was a Blessing

name: Mt Olive Lutheran Church
Mt Olive Lutheran Church - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary:
I've only been attending this church for a few months now but it feels like home!! Pastor Christie is wonderful and each and every member is so kind and welcoming. This church is also LGBTQ+-friendly which is a big reason why my fiancé and I decided to attend. I've been to many other churches but Mt. Olive just has that special something! This church is very kid-friendly and the music is so lovely. I've never been excited to go to church until I came to Mt. Olive!

P.S.
This church also offers the space for wedding ceremonies and it also has a pre-school. I ❤️ Mt. Olive! I hope my daughter gets to experience her entire school time like this. We have loved it here. One of the sweetest, most engaged and community friendly preschools we have ever come across. If you are looking for a neighborhood church with a beautiful sanctuary and a warm and welcoming congregation, this is the place to go. Reverend Christie is caring and kind. I feel God's peaceful presence when I attend Mt. Olive. Very inviting atmosphere.  Activities for children were provided in the sanctuary. People-friendly worship! Beautiful church. Worth attending

name: Mt Olive Lutheran Church LCMS
Mt Olive Lutheran Church LCMS - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautiful church, great Pastor, traditional service! We started going here about 14 months ago after years of being agnostic and immediately felt at home. We were so proud to have our daughter baptized here! It was totally what we needed to rekindle our spirituality, it's small but warm and we have a lot of young families. The sermons will always give you perspective and something to think about, couldn't be happier, this is HOME. Plus, if you like Bach you'll love our talented organist. Mt Olive is a wonderful, cozy, and welcoming Lutheran Church and community. The church has a handful of young families and a very active social calendar for both children and adults alike. Pastor's mini children sermon is adorable and the kids love it. It's also very refreshing to have a traditional service with organ and a small choir.

Come check it out! There are several meetings a week at this location. Welcoming crowd. Nice building meetings held in the basement which is clean and we'll lit. The Wednesday night 7:30 meeting was a full house...good meeting. A small but welcoming congregation. The Pastor is a friendly guy and a gifted preacher of law and gospel. The liturgy is beautiful, traditional and full of gospel comfort. The church is affiliated with the Missouri Synod. Love it and the meetings as well

name: Mt Zion Church of Ontario
Mt Zion Church of Ontario - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
Sitting here with tears in my eyes.  While I am not a religious person at all.
But seeing the effects that the Nelson Family had on the community,  in their church and if their lives, saddens me that they were taken  in such a manner.. Being role models  for kids, it's such a tragedy. I HOPE that they , with who they were , had an effect ofln other members to become like them...  May the rest in his peace and glory. The password is amazing. He's truly a godsend. He speaks from the Bible. And he teaches us also, the members of the church are very friendly and inviting. Just wanted to give a shout out to the lovely ushers during our friend’s memorial service. The lady and gentleman ushers were so kind, gentle, caring, and attentive. I was very touched by their hospitality- showing direction, passing out tissue, water, fans, and exuding such sweet energy. Thank you! I enjoyed the service at Mount Zion Church the word was brought and explained and I hope to go again 🙏🏾🩵 Thank you for your kindness and love shown to my family in the passing of our precious loved one. It was nice to hear the true wonderful remarks about our praying songbird... Dorothy Williams. My aunt touched many lives. Again thank you for the love, the prayers, and hospitality.

name: Mt Zion Missionary Baptist Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: New Pastor Dennis Anderson is fired up! He's doing great and wonderful things. New Programs for children and they have a vested interest in the continued growth of the surrounding community. This is a promising church, and I'm excited to see how this church family takes off! Beautiful church with amazing people! Love the Church and the brother are warm welcoming. God bless the Pastor. Enjoy being there evertime we can. This is my church. I grew up in this church. This is God's house and I am a child who loves to go home. Please, come and worship with us. My first time here add my Marine friend home going service it was amazing beautiful Church

name: Mt. Zion Missionary Baptist Church
Mt. Zion Missionary Baptist Church - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary: This is a small Church family oriented. Very kind people. Obviously they were hit by the pandemic and lost some members. But God is working with them and he will provide. name: Murdock Christian Church
Murdock Christian Church - Port Charlotte Campus

name: Murrieta Church of Christ
Murrieta Church of Christ - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary:
My wife and I have attended for many years.  This is a welcoming family of goodhearted Christians.  I love the fact that this is a diverse family of all ages races and backgrounds. The lessons are Biblically sound and delivered in a meaningful way.  There are classes for all ages  and the youth minister and his wife are an inspiration to the teens.  Last year, the new teen center was completed and provides a center of teen activities, study and growth.  We love it here. We first visited this church after moving to Murrieta a few years ago.  We are so happy we found it and eventually became members. I feel like I can come just as I am without being judged.  The youth minister and children's worship leaders really take the time to get to know and care about my kids.  Our kids look forward to getting together with the other teens/kids at the church and it is a place where they can let down their guard and just be themselves.  Personally, I've found that there are no "out of bounds" questions. If the leadership doesn't know an answer they admit it and encourage us to look for an answer together in the Bible.  Sometimes the answers are easily found and sometimes they take a long time, but I like that we try to figure it out together. Of course this is one of the best churches in the Murrieta area. It's warm and friendly. There is always someone there to greet you and talk to you if it is your first time or if you've been there many times. The preacher is outstanding. He keeps your attention with his biblical knowledge and examples of everyday Christian practices. Come join us, you will be glad you did. A very friendly bible based church. Minister is very knowledgeable and is always open to any questions or concerns that you might have. If you love singing, this church is the one for you. Great youth minister and active youth program. This is definitely a family oriented church that will make you feel welcome. My husband and I walked into the Murrieta Church of Christ, and we knew we had found our place of worship.  We visited several churches in our search. We were amazed by this congregation and its members - from the welcome at the front doors to the preaching and lessons learned during service.  We believe God led us to this church.

At MCoC we have found compassionate, caring, fellowship while pursuing our life with Christ.  We are thankful and blessed.

name: Murrieta Korean Presbyterian Church
Murrieta Korean Presbyterian Church - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary: This is a wonderful congregation of very sweet and loving people.  I recently had cancer and the church supported me with prayers, visits and food.  I am cancer free now and I could not have done it without my church. I am one of the few non-Koreans in the church (my wife is Korean) but they all know me and know that inside I am very Korean!  I love them all! 😊💕🙏🏻 A really wonderful church! People are friendly and nice. They have both Korean and English services on Sunday mornings. Faithful, Full of love, Pastor's sermon is gracious It is a beautiful church where the pastor is filled with the Holy Spirit, the Word, and grace, and where the sincere love of the saints overflows.

name: Murrieta United Methodist Church
Murrieta United Methodist Church - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary:
Some of the people that hand out the food pantry items are very rude, condescending and just plain mean to the people who are in desperate need of food. Like the table with milk, and especially the women at the table with fruits and vegetables. Just because I’m disabled making it impossible to work doesn’t mean I should be treated like trash when I’m just trying not to starve. Thank goodness I found places to get help around here so I don’t have to come back in case I’m desperate enough to have to get help again. Thanks to you all helping Jesus Christ feed his family I'm grateful for your help, love and giving nature ❣️ thanks for your faith, hope and most of all your love to God through Jesus Christ Amen 🙏 A friend had taken me there last Friday
To be involved in their  food pantry and  my goodness  it was unbelievable, my EBT money hasn't been going as far as it had in the past and this was a way to make those ends meet! I try and never take more than I need  and leave  items for others. Went to see a children's  Christmas  program. People  were very friendly. The children  captured  the true  meaning of Christmas. Was a lot of fun. Thanks  to the youth  teachers,  job well done. Oh yes, Great food enjoyed it very much!!! Very friendly here and they help a lot of families with their food pantry every Friday

name: Mvc Mountain View Church
Mvc Mountain View Church - Dana Point Campus
reviewSummary:
This church feels like home. Never felt so welcomed and valued . They do a great job at keeping the focus on Jesus, they are Spirit filled, stick to the word, worship is so amazing and they do a great job at being in the community.  Don't get me started on how amazing the children's ministry is. My kids are developing such a strong relationship with God so young because of them! Wow, Mountain View Church is on fire!
From the worship team, to the new location, to pastor Todd, it’s quite an experience.

The worship team is led by Ryan Kirkland who’s toured with Switch Foot and Anberlin and has an amazing voice and high energy. The rest of the crew is equally talented and “all-in” making the worship high energy and inspiring. The songs are a great mix of some the latest worship songs, a few originals and some great hymns mixed in.

Pastor Todd is like the best friend you wish lived next door. His humility and scriptural knowledge are well balanced. His desire to share his best understanding of scriptures from his experiences, leading theologians and what God’s placed on his heart is refreshing and he’s got a great sense of humor as well. Our family has found that his teaching and practical application to today’s life has challenged us to reflect on how we represent Christ.

The children's, high school and college ministries are amazing. I have witnessed teens that have shown more maturity and selflessness than most adults. Their success in these programs are easy to see when you take into consideration that the number of kids in these programs are currently almost equal to the number of adults in church! (Wow)

Last but not least, the congregation has been so welcoming. The opportunities to truly get connected to people who love the Lord are endless. The smiles, warm welcomes and the helping hands I've witnesses brings to mind an “Acts Based Church”. This is a truly unique church and we feel blessed to call it home now.

Don't take my word for it. Come and check it out! Yesterday was our first time attending Mountain View. I felt god calling me to go there and I’m so glad I did. I wanted a place for my family to all feel welcomed. If we stay in California I think this will be the church we’ll call Home. Pastor Todd was very relatable and spoke truth to us. So glad God guided us here. Oh my goodness! What an amazing facility! So comfortable and welcoming and the ministry group is so friendly and knowledgeable and insightful. It must be wonderful to be a regular memder I was from out of town Are you looking for a church to call home?  If so, be sure to check out MVC - the friendly, family atmosphere you will find here cannot be beat.  Pastor Todd Rodarmel shares the message of God's love for us in such an authentic and relatable manner.  Worship music led by Ryan Kirkland is amazing and inspiring.  My family and I have loved every moment spent at our "home" church and my guess is that you will as well.

name: Naples Christian Church
Naples Christian Church - Naples Campus
reviewSummary: I had the pleasure of attending Naples Christian Church this morning and was warmly welcomed by Jamie.  Was able to witness their delightful Christmas play that truly brought the joy of the season to life! As Proverbs says, “A cheerful heart is good medicine” and this church delivered! :) Great sermon, singing and community. Naples Christian Church is my home and it's people are my family.  My faith and connection with God grew when I walked through its doors, got involved, and invested in its people.  As a family we have experienced great highs and challenging lows - and surprise, we are not perfect - but through it all we strive to love, follow the Spirit and do what we can to help Christ radically change lives. Above all, I learned at NCC that it really isn't all about me - but about worshiping and working for the God who orchestrates it all.  I am proud to call NCC home. My church family  home for 33 years. A special place to worship, be accepted and feel the love and unity of believers. You feel like family from your first visit. Most caring and kind people I’ve ever met !!!

name: Naples Church of Christ
Naples Church of Christ - Naples Campus
reviewSummary: We attended service only which started at 9 AM,  Good sermon. The worship was uplifting. The sermon and worship were bible based.  God wants us to be loving, kind and generous to others. This Church exhibits the spirit of love. That is a wonderful place to workshop with God and Jesus it is a big congregation and very friendly and helpful and loving people. Bible study is first at 10 am then church services is at 11 to 12 at night is at 6 PM on Wednesday night it starts ai 6: 30pm.we enjoy it there. Great service worshipping God! name: Naples Community Church
Naples Community Church - Naples Campus
reviewSummary:
I found Naples Community Church online recently.  I feel I was led there by to Lord and my experience has been wonderful. The people there are very warm and friendly. The music and worship are inspiring and the worship leader's singing can bring tears to your eyes. I always watch for a Gospel message from the pastor and he has delivered it every time.  His messages are not long but short and sweet and you can tell he truly loves the Lord. I know I found a church home for my winters in Florida. Naples Community Church is an amazing gathering of warm and friendly people who welcome all attendees. The music and song component is inspirational and Pastor Kirt shares his remarkable gifts as a speaker with insights in the Old and New Testament and how they relate to the human condition grappling with today’s issues. So thankful to have found this  gem! Mariann Wilson & Gary Helms I'm up North now and can't wait together back to Naples and NCC.           There are a lot of churches here in CT but nothing compares to NCC.           The first time we attended we were treated like a long lost friend returning home. And love those old soul piercing hymns.                                     See you soon. Visited Naples Community church in April 2021 when we were vacationing in the area.  A wonderful and very hospitable congregation.  I felt like I was at my hone church in Delaware.  Just about every week since my visit I try to watch Pastor Kirk’s sermon online.  If you are in the Naples area pay them a visit - you will not regret it!

Jim
Bridgeville DE Every service reaches into my soul… I feel God’s arms around me in this church! No strangers… clearly he lives within its walls! Music takes you away to a spot we all belong in our world today; we are one in this lovely place.

name: Naples United Church of Christ
Naples United Church of Christ - Naples Campus
reviewSummary: The benefit concert by world-renowned organist, Andre Knevel was well received. I was invited to give my personal recovery testimony from alcoholism for St. Matthew's House during the benefit. There were approximately 150 attending donors. A very memorable night that raised money for a great cause. A delightful evening of operatic musical pieces and Queen presented in a totally different way. We loved the string quartet’s rendering of their hits! The venue, the staff, the music, and most of all, the musicians were excellent, extraordinary! We loved every minute. Love the concert w the 4 Orchestra i instruments.  Wonderful amazing would go again in a heart beat. The venue was beautifully lit by hundreds of candles. Our talented string quartet brought Vivaldi to life. They talked about the pieces and we took away new knowledge. A wonderful experience overall. Wonderful event.  The musicians were excellent and the insightful commentary was very helpful.

name: National Community Church
reviewSummary: Led by Mark Batterson, known for creative teaching and a multi-site model including a coffeehouse church. Very urban and culturally relevant.

name: Nations Church Los Angeles
Nations Church Los Angeles - Woodland Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
Nations church has been a pillar in the community for over 20 years. Pastor Phil and his team have been there for my family on multiple occasions, from hosting my dads funeral, to visiting my mom and providing meals while she went through cancer treatments along with tons of free events and giveaways for the neighborhood. Love seeing that it’s starting to grow more. Highly recommend! Amazing church. Great Pastor and very friendly people that you can tell care about one another and the surrounding community. They are a Bible believing, Holy Spirit, faith-filled church and it’s definitely worth coming to check it out. Great Coffee bar too! My family and I have been attending this church for some time now. I can honestly recommend and encourage anyone to come visit for the first time or pick up right where you left off. I had been looking for a place to get back into my relationship with God. As a kid, my family always attended pentecostal Church, so that's what I had been looking for. I had visited some surrounding churches in the Northridge area as well as the Granada Hills area. I wanted to attend somewhere in my neighborhood to have a sense of community. My wife and kids were  invited to a service here and shortly after I came.
The staff was friendly and welcoming. The congregation itself is very diverse in race, culture, and age range. I like the small town feel to it. But most importantly, the teaching and theology is 100% Bible based, served in an everyday real-life way. Pastor Phil is unapologetic about loving people and making disciples of all nations. The church is pentecostal, like I was raised in. It's a great place to lay down some roots and be part of the family of God. This church is a warm and welcoming place for all peoples. This is witnessed  by the multi cultural congregation who attend on Sunday.

I discovered over time the pastor, staff and congregation truly reflect the love of Christ to all who attend. The pastor is easy to talk to and genuinely interested in people no mater where you are in life.

The worship is not only professional but Spirit led in that you can sense the presence of God as the congregation worships. If your looking for a place to serve God with others you found the place.

Scott R. This church is amazing! Friendly people, super welcoming, awesome staff, great live worship music, great environment and an awesome pastor! I'm so grateful and thank God to have found a church like this. I feel accepted and wanted here. Also feel God in this place every time. I've been recommending this chuch to all of my friends, family and coworkers. There is also a coffee bar inside the church which I was very happily surprised about.

name: Native American United Methodist Church
Native American United Methodist Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a wonderful sacred space and grounds! I was welcomed, along with my partner and a close friend, at a recent powwow hosted at the church.

As a non-indigenous individual attending her first powwow proper, I was a little nervous about offending anyone or doing something uncouth... but fret not! Everyone was warm and welcoming, and giving and informative in their own way. The grounds are well-kept by a *very* small team. The Sanctuary is historic and breathtaking. Parking is easy.

I particularly appreciated the powerful sounds and movement, the participatory nature of the event, the gorgeous landscaping and central courtyard, the open design of the main hall, the inclusivity, and the fry bread, the savory and the sweet! (¡Claro que sí!)

But my favorite was exploring the Sanctuary. Burning sage was so therapeutic and grounding. Be sure to visit the upper level, if you can. It's inspiring that the (sizeable and "old") property is sustained not only by the Native American Methodist congregation but is also supported by the Catholic church that meets there 3 times a week, as well as by Inspire Arts organization. Especially as an artist and arts educator, I found immense joy in seeing the photos of the happy artists in the main hall.

Services open to all every Sunday at 10:30am. Plus, check out Pastor Greg (Gregory Douglass) on YouTube! Everyone is welcome!
Come and worship with us!
Diversify congregation coming together to fellowship with one another and share his Good News! This minister (Greg) shares powerful, spiritual insights which I haven't learned prior to meeting him. A great congregation with a strong sense of the gospel of Jesus the Christ. Great church to go to iam a member here

Now, I understand why so many people are away from church, I called to ask if they could mention my grandmother’s name on the petition prayer  on Sunday mass because is her 2 year death anniversary and they told me no because the list was full. name: Nativity Confraternity-Christian
Nativity Confraternity-Christian - Torrance Campus
Neighborhood Congregational Church
Neighborhood Congregational Church - Laguna Niguel Campus
reviewSummary:
This church hosted one of the most peaceful and moving candlelight nights I’ve ever attended. The setting was breathtaking hundreds of candles, beautiful live string music, and a calm, reverent atmosphere that truly touched the soul.

Everything was thoughtfully organized, from the music to the lighting, creating a moment of reflection, peace, and connection. It felt intimate, welcoming, and spiritually uplifting.

A truly special evening and a wonderful experience for the Laguna Beach community. Highly recommended to anyone looking for something meaningful and memorable. Enchanting, intimate venue, phenomenal musicians, and  very well run. Showcasing Hans Zimmer is no simple feat, but this string quartet translated Zimmers iconic work brilliantly. This was our first Candlelight Music experience & we look forward to many, many more! BRAVO!!! So enjoyed last night’s Candlelight Concert featuring Queen music. Church pews were very comfortable and ambiance was wonderful. I'm a local Laguna Beach wedding photographer and I would like to share that this church is absolutely amazing!  The design and architecture and the reception hall is truly a artful creation, and with plenty of parking.  This is really a gem being so close to the beach as well.  I can't say enough about the "bridal getting ready room" - it was light and airy and had plenty of space.  Cheers to a wonderful experience... Took hubby to Hans Zimmer show in Laguna for his bday. Heard great things about these candlelight events and it did not disappoint. Only critic is the seating & price, but had a great experience overall.

name: Neighbors Pantry - Anaheim United Methodist Church - Food Distribution Center
Neighbors Pantry - Anaheim United Methodist Church - Food Distribution Center - Orange Campus
reviewSummary: I have never needed to visit a food pantry until now, but beyond thankful for this one. They treat you kindly with respect and without judgement. They have healthy food and fresh vegetables and fruit. Sandie, Lee and the rest of the staff were so nice and helpful as a first time recipient. God bless you for doing the Lord’s work. 🤍 Things will get better for my family this coming year. 🙏🏼 I have been going with my mom for at least  6 months now and very clean and organized food distribution to those that are struggling to put food on table as I had to stop working due to stage 1 ovarian tumors and bone tumors on femur bone and were able to get help through this church whom has treated us very well with getting us appointments every month for healthy food and have met very friendly and supportive staff here. And was referred by city of hope Seacliff after my oncology appointment for a resource of food. May God continue to bless the stores that donate to this food pantry and God bless your steadfast ministry Anaheim Methodist church. I volunteer in the food Pantry but this isn't my home church. name: New Beginnings Christian Church
New Beginnings Christian Church - Tampa (Hyde Park) Campus
reviewSummary:
Such a Godly, Jesus loving church. My husband and I have been overwhelmed by the amount of love and acceptance we feel from the people here. Genuine, Jesus seeking people. It was easy for us to get involved, there’s always something to do or get involved with.

The preacher is always spot on and has such a gift for teaching the Bible. He never sugar coats but always preaches through love.

They got a new worship leader recently and he is amazing. Always spot on!

We send our baby to the nursery and when we pick her up she’s always happy, fed, well napped and changed. And I’ve never seen a cleaner nursery! That Sunday school teacher is a miracle worker!

We felt very safe sending our child to Sunday school. They have a check in system and everybody seems to know everybody. All the families are very friendly and opening to us. You’ll get invited to lunch by 5 different people before you leave.

Overall I think we’ve found a “home” here. The church is growing so fast and we just feel so blessed to be apart of it. Great church made up of real people. Pastor Steve is phenomenal and does a great job of articulating the message in an easy to digest manner that enables real world application. I absolutely love this church. We recently started coming here after leaving our regular church we had been at for years. It just got to big and just didn't fit us anymore. New beginnings has made us feel at home from day one! I am naturally a very anxious person but literally every person here I've met is so genuine and real. Steve keeps it real and is not scared to preach it like it is and I appreciate that. Also there is a great women's group and a men's group my husband and I attend which is awesome plus the child care staff is amazing... so basically if you are thinking about trying this church out do it!! Trying to find a church home after military displacement is always difficult! However, New Beginnings has been such a God sent! The motto of this church precedes it! Real People living Real lives! Only the Bible truths given with nothing left out! Warm and friendly environment! And just love calling this my new church home! Attended the drive up service for the first time a few weeks ago.  There is such a sweet spirit there.  The singing, and the message were much of a blessing to those of us in the drive up congregation.  Blessings to Pastor Steve and all who were there.
Matthew 18:20 - For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.

name: New Beginnings Christian Counseling
New Beginnings Christian Counseling - Yorba Linda Campus
reviewSummary:
I highly recommend New Beginnings Christian Counseling￼. Mayra creates a safe, compassionate environment where people can truly feel seen, heard, and supported. Her approach thoughtfully integrates clinical counseling tools with Biblical truth, which brings a depth of healing that speaks to both the heart and mind.

Mayra has a special gift for helping people work through anxiety, trauma, and difficult life experiences while restoring hope and identity. Her care is genuine, her insight is thoughtful, and she walks alongside clients with patience and encouragement.

If you are looking for a therapist who combines professional expertise with faith-centered guidance, I would absolutely recommend Mayra and the team at New Beginnings. Mayra is truly gifted in her work—grounded in faith, compassionate, and deeply caring toward her clients. She genuinely wants to see people grow and heal. She’s always professional, prompt, and responsible, creating a space that feels safe and encouraging. Her insight, wisdom, and skill make each session meaningful and productive. I highly recommend her to anyone seeking therapy that combines both excellence and a strong sense of faith and purpose. Mayra is a thoughtful and compassionate therapist who is deeply attuned to her clients’ needs. She provides a warm, supportive environment where clients feel seen, heard, and understood. As a colleague, I feel fully confident referring clients her way, knowing they will be met with care, professionalism, and genuine empathy. I highly recommend Mayra and her associates at New  Beginnings Christian Counseling. They are dedicated to helping others by integrating, both spiritual and therapeutic interventions in a warm, safe and compassionate setting. Mayra is a solid person and therapist! We met at a Christian conference for therapists and I would feel very comfortable referring clients to her!

name: New Birth Church
New Birth Church - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary:
New to the Murrieta area and was searching for a new church to attend and found New Birth online. Came with my daughter and as soon as we entered we were greeted by the ushers with warm smiles. The sermon was pretty good and the pastor was funny and very spot on.
At the end of church, walking out, the pastor was outside to greet and thank everyone for coming. I thought that was very nice.
Hopefully this will be a new home for me and my family. This is a wonderful church, and there is never a boring moment from start to finish. The pastor is on fire and is relatable to all ages and all socio -economic groups. The congregation is 99% black, and the parishioners are responsive and authentic in their engagement with the Pastor. This is a 'Come as you are' church and even the pastor dresses casually. Unfortunately. there is no live choir, but the sermon  is enough to compensate for the lack of a live music program. The church feels insular and it has not contacted to do a follow up and see if I want to join. That is the part that confuses me. When church ends. There is no real engagement. The pastor does not stand at the door and greet the parishioners or guests on the way out. People just get in their cars and drive home. I guess bc of covid. There is no live music, no hugs , no food 😢 💔 But the message is always on point!!! Love this church! Everyone is friendly and so welcoming.  I highly recommend New Birth Church to anyone looking for a loving inclusive house of worship. Excellent place of worship, congregation is warm and loving! Great multicultural church. Awesome preaching, singing and music.

A great place  to worship  and hear the word of the Lord  people  are warm and friendly  love to worship  and praise the Lord there Beautiful presence of the spirit

name: New City Church of Los Angeles
New City Church of Los Angeles - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Visited our friend Pastor Phyllis and really like the family feel with the couches. The kids stayed in service this week. They are intentional with group discussion and I appreciate that as someone who promotes active learning. All the staff goes above and beyond to make you feel welcome. Very diverse. I love seeing the #Christian #brothers #sisters  their #children #family & #friends. It is an amazing place to #connect with the #Bible in a #non #denominational #setting. The building was an #old#bank #transformed into a #theatre where one can enjoy #olays throughout the week weekend & #nights. The building is surrended by #eateries, #entertainment #businesses #Starbucks #CVSPharmacy & after Sunday #Service #foodies #crafts &#groceries at the #Historical #Core #Farmers #Market.
It's my best day of the #entire #week! . I just moved to the area and have been on the church hunt. Maybe I've just gone to too many mega churches with that commercial feel, you know how some churches just try too hard, no offense because hey, different strokes for different folks, right? Well, this church to me, just has that It Factor. If you're looking for a real gem with unique music, a thought provoking sermon and where you can get involved in the community, this is it. Also Phil the greeter is the sweetest guy ever ! I've been going to New City for almost a year now and LOVE IT!  It is the most racially diverse and economically diverse church I have been to.  The first time I went I was immediately noticed and welcomed warmly...It's not like other churches where you walk in and no one talks to you except for a good morning from the person handing you the bulletin.  I was not only greeted but welcomed immediately.  From the very first day, I loved Kevin's message of grace.  He captures the heart of the Bible; God's heart for people.  He doesn't bog down his messages with rules and regulations and religiosity, but teaches from the Bible, God's love, truth and all consuming grace.  When I hear one of Kevin's messages I learn more about the historical time period each verse is coming from and I learn more and more about the heart of God.  Not only does it help me in my walk today, but also teaches me more about the origins of the Bible.  Not may pastors can do both as Kevin does.  Jonathan, the associate pastor, is also a wonderful speaker and is an exceptional leader in the church.  Being apart of a grow and serve group is what really cemented my connection and love for the church.  That's where I created and foster lasting friendships with people that have become like family to me.  We get  deep in the word and in each others lives and it's powerful.  All groups also have a serve portion where we reach out, volunteer and serve our community.  New City has forever changed my life and I feel incredibly blessed to be apart of such an incredible, loving, open, innovative, diverse, cutting edge, non religious, Bible based, community centered, church! My husband and I have been attending New City Church for about six years ever since it was in the beginning days. As a bi-racial woman I appreciated the diversity of ethnicity and socioeconomic, but more important than that the gospel is presented in sermon, action and presence. New City has offered me community in a way that I have never experienced and I have seen this church go from 20 people to about 400. I told my husband when it reached 100 I would be ready to leave. Ok. I'm still there and not planning to leave anytime soon.

No church will offer you 100% satisfaction, but New City offers sermons based on the Word, the gospel upheld and a dose of reality to bring you to your knees. This is my home.

name: New Community Brethren in Christ

reviewSummary: If you are looking for a small Christian church where everyone knows your name, New Community BIC is the church for you. We meet every Sunday at 9 am in a room rented from the Upward Call Nazarene church in Chino. The retired, or currently not working, meet on the third Monday of every month at the Patio Grill and Cantina on Central Avenue in Chino. A mid week bible study is held every Wednesday at 7 pm in Chino Hills. The church women have monthly outings to a variety of fun places. Come and join us if you are looking for something different and ready for a change. You are welcome to join our Sunday service or any of our activities listed above. reviewSummary:

name: New Day Christian Fellowship

reviewSummary:

Bishop teaches directly from the Bible and from his heart. You can genuinely feel that he cares and wants all of us to grow spiritually and be where God has called us to be.

reviewSummary: In my opinion, New Life is a great church for those who are looking for a korean-american church with solid leadership and gospel centered mission. Somewhat strange how under-the-radar it appears on google maps though. People here are so kind ! The best church ever 😁

name: New Life Presbyterian Church - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary:
Disrespectful to surrounding neighborhood. Gardeners starting well before city ordinance. Unacceptable. A rare jewel of a congregation! Authentically welcoming.  A place for everyone: kids, teens, adults, seniors.  Compassionate and smart teaching.  Sincere worship singing.  Group and program opportunities.    Come and see ! I rate it 5 stars partly because I'm biased... But also because the theology and gospel centered teaching is very awesome, and if you feel like getting plugged into a church in Escondido, new life has lots of ministries nursery, elementary, middle high school college and career, and beyond. Also, sign up (your kids) for the annual VBS--literally so much fun😄 God choose this church for me.  Thank the good Lord I obeyed him.
What can I say?  Where do I start?I have been so blessed since coming
First of all our pastor is a man who with his lovely wife walk the walk. His preaching style is that of one of my former pastors, Lloyd Olgive.  Lloyd left Hollywood Presbyterian to become the Chaplain of the US senate.  The first time I heard Pastor Ted preach. I said to myself, that sounds like Lloyd Olgivie.
The entire congregation made me feel welcome
Wednesday night is Bible study.  What a blessing that has been.  Then I decided to go to the Wednesday. Bible study and got blessed that much more.
I was in my late 20's when I attended Hollywood Presbyterian.  New life id like Hollywood only smaller. If you want a church where the word of God is preached, those who come on
a regular basis are do friendly.
I have made many dear friends since coming about 2 and 1/2 years ago.  Have been a member
since last February thanks to good old Mr. Covid.
New life has a phenomenal youth program. For children in elementary school age (fifth grade) or younger, AND if you fill out the bulletin after the benediction you can come to the kid's booth on the patio to exchange your filled out bulletin for some prizes. There will be volunteers at the booth who will stamp your bulletin and check to see you completed it, and there are various prizes for trying to complete it!  How cool is that?
It is New Life's hope that this will be a way for your child to stay engaged during the worship service, to be encouraged by. God's word, and to love God for what he has done for us in Christ
more and more.
New life provides an option for parents with children aged 3.5
(birthday on or before 3/1/2017) to attend Children's Church, and for children ages 2.5- 3.5 (birthday after 3/2/2017 to attend
Toddler's Church.  While we encourage our families to worship together, ee also provide , as an option for parents with kids of those ages.

name: New Life Redlands Church
New Life Redlands Church - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary:
absolutely LOVE this church. The message, the worship team, the church community. everyone and everything is very welcoming. My Husband and I attended church maybe 5 months ago. I was expecting at the time, now everyone knows my babies name and blesses her. They are all super sweet and caring and always friendly. Newlife Redlands is a warm welcoming church to everyone!  Pastor Dennis shares God's word and love in practical, understandable words and actions.  Stephanie the Children's ministry director brings  inspiring encouragement and creativity to teaching and guiding the youth and teachers.  If your looking for a perfect church this is not it.  However if  your looking for  a church who accepts you as you are and strives together to love, honor and trust God, one another and build family then you have found it!   The praise and worship is contemporary and lead by the Holy spirit.  The church is careful to observe safety precautions. There is both indoor and outdoor seating available. I remember our first visit we expected to go "visit" and automatically felt at home. Everyone was so welcoming and inviting and made us feel like we belonged right away! Thank you to Pastor Dennis & Julie for your kindness and love. God placed us right where we needed to be at the best time! Pastor Diane and Pastor Steeve, you 2 are Godsent! Awesome job with Kids Connection and your dedication to the community! New Life Foursquare Church is a place where the love of Christ is shared with one another as well as with those in the surrounding community.  The pastoral staff has a passion for preaching and teaching the Word of God and seeing others grow in their Christian faith and apply His truth in every area of life. The praise and worship leader and his team lead the congregation in worship that brings glory and honor to the Lord.  I strongly recommend New Life Foursquare Church to anyone looking for a church family that truly reflects the love of God and his heart for serving and loving one another. Due to a recent transition, I was in search of a good Gospel Preaching  Church in the Redlands area. It was by chance that I came across the path of Pastor Diane Arseneault at a secular business meeting. However, I was struck by her passion, compassion, and love as she spoke regarding her position as Program Director of Kids Connection. Her message stayed with me for weeks after she shared with us that Thursday evening. As a result, a few months later  Pastor Diane asked me to be  a part of the Kids Connection Team on Friday evenings. To sum it up quickly. I have been blessed and my life has been changed. Furthermore, I did not realize this was a divine appointment until Diane invited me to visit the Sunday Church service. I was immediately struck by how welcomed everyone made me feel from the time I stepped through the front door where I received a warm, loving welcome by Kay,
followed by an awesome message by Pastor Dennis along with Praise Prayer and Worship.The Ministry Team that I have personally come in contact with: Nela, Janet, and Pastor Steve have been an added blessing. New Life Foursquare Church Redlands Is definitely
One of the best Ministries I have attended in my 31 years as a Christian.
I would give it 10 Stars if that were possible.

name: New Life Worship Center-Fort Myers, FL
New Life Worship Center-Fort Myers, FL - Fort Myers Campus
reviewSummary:
I used to think this church was like family until I begin to question my walk while attending this church.  They are very money hungry!!! My kids, my kids father & I have been attending here for nearly 8 years I recently stopped maybe 4 months ago, I reached out to Denise Johnson as well as Bishop Johnson on Several occasions for therapy about the turmoil I have been dealing with in my household with my spouse they haven’t PUSHED us for therapy or pushed us for marriage the ENTIRE time we attended this place, I was living a life of sin they accepted thousands of dollars from me knowing the struggles and life I was living for their “new building” that still hasn’t manifested.  Denise has also called me on several occasions asking me for money/donations for their building after I gave a huge donation from my heart the first time, but she never prayed or worked or helped towards pronouncing the blood of Jesus over my house and my family and kids, I went crying several times to her about my situation and having 3 kids by this man I was with for 10 years I begged pleaded they never helped just always turned it into a situation for their self gain.  This church has ruined my family but thankfully I didn’t loose my faith in God.  I pray God touch the heart of all the members of this center.  Be careful. I love this church. I feel that they are super sincere in their worship and committed to the cause. God bless this ministry. I pray they expand and grow to become a staple in the community and the city at large I joined Newlife Worship Center 6 years ago and truly my life has NEVER been the same !  I came in, not really knowing what to expect because I'd only been to church for funerals.  When I left, I left  filled with so much excitement, the experience of encountering the presence of God, the love of God and a hunger to know him more. New life is a teaching ministry,  and that's what I needed, I needed to be taught. They taught me how to seek God and get to know him personally for myself. I thank God for my church and my Passionate Leaders, Bishop Eric Johnson & First Lady Denise Johnson. They are truly great leaders after the heart of God, wanting to see God's children fulfill their purpose in him. Because of this ministry, I divorced my past and married my future and I'm determined to never go back ! I love New Life Worship Center December will make 3years that I have been going to this church.  Since being at  New Life Worship Center I been totally set free from drugs,clubbing and sleeping around with different men.Bishop Johnson and First Lady Denise Johnson are awesome spiritual leaders they break the Bible down so you can have a understanding so you can grow in God.  If you ever walk through them doors that's exactly what you will receive a new life.. I thank the lord for placing me in a ministry where I can grow and learn how to pray and read the Bible and do daily devotions and build my personal relationship with God. New Life Worship Center is definitely a place where God is glorified and the people of God is edified and the Devil is terrified. My family and I attended New Life for the first time on New Years Eve. Service started at 9:30p and concluded at midnight. One word: Phenomenal! The  pastor spoke a powerful, moving word for 2020, the year of vision, clarity and living in your divine purpose. I was changed after that service and now I’m ready to allow the Lord to work through me.

I must also add that the congregation is filled with young, talented members with voices that will give you chills, and words that will bring tears of joy to your eyes.

I definitely felt the presence of the Lord in the place. Thanks Google for helping me find this church. We will be back!

name: New Revelation Missionary Baptist Church
New Revelation Missionary Baptist Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
I am proud to come from a lineage of true civil rights activists in Pasadena, California. My grandfather, John Henry English, served as a leader among the Pasadena civil rights activists, and as a little girl I remember sitting on his shoulders during rallies at New Revelation Baptist Church – 855 N Orange Grove Blvd, Pasadena, California.

I remember my grandfather standing alongside Reverend Jesse Jackson as the movement for justice and equality continued to grow across this nation. I remember listening to the speeches, watching the people gather in faith and unity, and I remember those big “Keep Hope Alive” buttons that I loved so much as a child.

Those moments shaped generations of us and taught us that faith and action must walk hand in hand if we truly want to change our communities.

The Rainbow Coalition movement Reverend Jesse Jackson helped build.

Rest in peace Uncle Jesse.
Your courage, your voice, and the doors you opened will never be forgotten. Your legacy lives on through those of us who continue to serve our communities today. ✊🏾 My mom been a member  for 10+ plus years she loves her pastor. Pastor Turner is a  very intellectual warrior of  Christ and my mother and I had some very hard time was in need  when I was going through a lot of stuff in my life their prayers their support really brought through it I want to thank you Revelation so much much love pastor....brandi We had a Wonderful time at the revival on last Wednesday night. If you didn't already know I am part of the Deacons Ministry @ 2nd Baptist Church in Monrovia located at 925 South Shamrock Avenue. Please anyone who is reading this review of New Revelation Church please feel free to visit either of these two churches. You won't be disappointed. To God be the glory.. I became a member of New Revelation in the mid 60's Pastor William Turner, Jr. had just became the New Pastor.. church was 🔥,good Sunday School lesson, singing, prayers, and most importantly, the preaching of the word by Rev. William Turner, Jr.  Friendly and family oriented church. .. . Til this day, it's one of the best churches around.. go see for yourself. ... Well first of all all Praises to God my Lord an Saviour Jesus Christ! I joined New Revelation Baptist Church in 1967 an l fell in love with the church an my Pastor Dr. William Turner would set the church on🔥🔥🔥 with his word from the Lord an he still preaches like this u can watch it on live stream. I like in the AV now but this is still my church home! ❤ my Pastor an my Church family!❤❤❤

name: New Season's Church
New Season's Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary:
We recently joined New Seasons and my family and I have grown spiritually and we feel the love of God throughout the church. Bishop Vines preaches the unadulterated truth of the Bible. We are beyond thankful to God for leading us to this church! Lots of love, amazing sermons every week. Bishop Vines is the best preacher I have ever had.
Wonderful members, always ready to serve and help, when needed.
Love my church family and the lessons I have learned 🥰 So grateful for the food it's just sad the walk ups have to wait until the vehicles are done  I was setting on the ground praying there would still be food for us in line as walk ups but great full for the food and the volunteers thank y'all folks People are welcoming, kind and you feel the love. The word is broken down so that you'll understand what is being taught.  The food that is served is always fresh and taste good. You will not be disappointed. This is a great church and I would recommend it to everyone. Everyone is genuinely nice. From the time you walk in until you leave. There is a peaceful presence in this church. Bishop Vines is awesome. I fairly new and I already became a member. I love it!!

name: New Song Community Church - Oceanside Campus
New Song Community Church - Oceanside Campus - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
This church was where I first started following Jesus. Very beautiful family anyone can be a part of. Pastor Hal Seed is very kind and an incredibly wise pastor. The worship team does a wonderful job helping everyone 'leave their problems at the door' so they can better focus on Jesus. God is definitely moving through this place. This is one of the best churches in the area to help you and your family spiritually grow together. If you're looking for a church, you must give this place a visit. Not a new Testament church.Jesus made it clear you would know His followers by their fruit.Patty is rude And Mara will ignore you.This is clearly a business and not a true church that operates in full surrender to The Holy Spirit. You will not find love & support here when your in crisis.They pick & choose whom they help or refuse to.
Guard your heart and avoid this place.They will have to give an account to God they obviously do not reverence. The staff is so kind and welcoming, and the atmosphere feels like home. The sermon this morning was amazing — it was all about the power of prayer, and the message was presented so clearly and beautifully. I love how they talk about the miracles in the Bible and genuinely believe that God still works miracles today. It’s refreshing to be part of a church that focuses on faith, hope, and the real presence of God. I left feeling inspired, uplifted, and closer to God. Highly recommend this church to anyone looking for a genuine community! This is the most amazing church . I found Jesus and recommitted my life to him because of this congregation. This church family loved me and took me and cared for me my son and show us God’s love . I’ll forever be grateful for the people who serve here Pastor Hal. Susan bogus , Debby Waller, Leah houligin and Diane Berry. They love everyone and help. Truly offer support. The Holy Spirit and hand of god is on this church. Thank you new song for all the many years. I love you. And will shout from the mountain and rooftops to come visit this place I call home 🙏 I went here for a birthday party to their playland located in the back of the church.  WOW!  This is a hidden gem.  They have a little coffee stand inside, a large play structure where the kids can run wild, all while enclosed in a gated area.  The wifi is great, and there's a recreation room with a pool table, air hockey, TV/gaming and more. This is a fantastic place to host a kids birthday party because as a parent, you can walk around and check things out, and watch your child without having to make awkward small talk with other parents you don't know.  :)

reviewSummary: My family's second home. We have gotten so much support and help. What a blessing pastor Mark and Carol are we thank you both so very much. From The Silva's This church is great pastor joe is down to earth and real he's not your typical pastor that was born and raised in the church (not that this would be bad) but I feel like it makes him more like me an everyday person who had some kind of religious upbringing but still lost my way and has found my way back to Jesus. There is also a sense of community here and the people are so nice! Every time we have been here people remember us and actually care to hear how we are doing.. It's great! I'm not a huge fan of the music because it's kind of more like a jam session than the whole church giving praise but they do use a lot of modern music that you would hear on the Christian radio stations and We like that. The kids program seems relatively new and there's not a lot of options like the awana program but this church seems new and since we've started attending they've added more kids programs and bible studies. Overall I would highly recommend this church the community is great and the message is great. Coach Giraffe is amazing. Tower 8 is the farthest north on The Strand. The directions may leave you at tower 2, so turn right off of Surfrider and drive all the way to end of street and tower 8. Inviting atmosphere. Friendly group of people. Awesome worship! Excellent message. Definitely will be returning.

name: New Song Worship Center
New Song Worship Center - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary: Ok but exaggerated too much. A bunch of random noises here. Free water & clean look coming in. Felt empty to be honest with barely any substance. These people are true believers and welcome you with a smile and love. Today was my second time visiting this blessed church. I found it joyful and filled with the Holy Spirit. I wish I had stayed after to mingle. I feel I missed an opportunity. I will stay next week. I also blessed the truck! Great Worship..it was a little long for my taste (about an hour) but the guess pastor Manolo Rivera was right on point, preaching on Psalms and our place as his children... Great message Awesome place for worship and a great kids program!

reviewSummary: The most beautiful place I know. Its home. Love churches only been to 2 idk other one I,m gonna give it a 5 star because it's a good church Love this church.  Pastor Clark is the best. Pastor Clark is a caring Wonderful place to worship.

name: New Vintage Church
New Vintage Church - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary: I think what the church is trying to do is great! The pastor seems kind, the worship team is awesome, the pregnant lady has an amazing voice. God blessed her with great talent and wow it’s great to hear her. I love that they do communion every Sunday too. However I gave it a 3 because there are a few things I am not a fan of. The limit worship to 3 songs before service, I do feel worship should be a little longer. There seems to be something missing in the worship. Everyone seems so gloomy. At the end worship is like half a song. I also noticed sometimes they don’t add the Bible verse until the very end slide. Which is unfortunate for the people who want to follow along but don’t know where he’s reading from. Sometimes I have also seen they missed the Bible verse. Which can be a concern for someone trying to find a church. I prefer seeing it so that I can check my Bible also. I also feel a little more could be done as far as getting to know new comers, getting fellowship going on and more participation throughout. I see so much more potential… Love this place!!! Real community vibe with caring people. I always feel welcome. The music/worship is great. The lead singer has the most amazing voice. What a blessing this church is to Escondido. Great church with great messages that apply to daily life. The worship is wonderful! We have had 4 kids go through their youth program and they have all been positively impacted by the messages and lessons they have learned. We always look forward to going and leave feeling uplifted and refreshed. NVC is home for us!  From the moment you walk in the door, you are greeted with a smile, hugs, and great conversations.  The worship is amazing because it is centered on the Lord and not a "performance."  Pastor Matt is an incredible teacher! He knows the Word and teaches it in a way that you can understand, both for the time it was written and the application it has in your own life now. I’ve gone to another church my entire life. Granted it was a big church..but I never truly felt Christs love until going to NVC. If you’re looking for a judgement free, god fearing, family oriented church community…this is the church for you!

name: Newbreak Church Ocean Beach Assemblies of God
Newbreak Church Ocean Beach Assemblies of God - Pacific Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
We were in town on vacation and absolutely loved our experience attending Newbreak OB for Easter Sunday! From the moment we walked in we felt welcomed with open arms. Our kids too. The people, the worship, and the sermon all made our visit a 10/10. Wish we lived here and got to experience this every week. The pastor hit the nail on the head with me. I was in tears for part of the preaching/ teaching because the Holy Sprit was touching my soul. Thank you pastor for listening to the Holy Spirit and touching mine and many others souls. I love the multigenerational, multiethnic community here. The pastors are friendly, and the worship and kid’s ministry teams pour God’s truth and love into us. Wonderful home fellowships help you get and stay connected. Gotta check this place out! You’ll love it! My family & I started coming here when our first child was born as it was within walking distance for us. We are transplants to SD & have felt so at home here! Such a wonderful atmosphere & people are loved on just as they are without fear of being rejected. Everyone I met was very welcoming.  The service was awesome. The pastor really connects with all the members who were really sincere and helpful.  I wanna go everyday.!
.

name: Newbreak Church Scripps Ranch Assemblies of God
Newbreak Church Scripps Ranch Assemblies of God - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary: This is the place to be if you’re looking for authentic people trying to be a light in their community and make a positive impact on Scripps Ranch neighbors and beyond. Pastor Jared teaches the Word of God with boldness, clarity, and humility. The kids and students ministries are such a blessing as a parent, and their variety of life groups helped us find a home away from home as SD transplants. Great church that really loves God and people. They do so much to serve the community, and really live what they teach. My family has been attending for many years and we appreciate the leadership, great messages and music, and engaging programs for kids and teens. Nice friendly Church.  Pastors Jared and Ashley do a great job teaching the Bible.  Great singers with uplifting music. Absolutely fantastic church. They love the community with their actions, the team is very close, and the pastor is a great Spirit filled teacher, one of the best I've heard. Good people, and I think Pastor Jared does an excellent job of teaching in a positive manner out of the Bible.

name: Newport Center United Methodist Church
Newport Center United Methodist Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: This is a new church I joined recently after attending over an 8 year period of time. Dynamic minister and a welcoming, talented and warm congregation! We found this church because our child went to the pre-school attached to it and boy, we found our forever home here. The community around the church is vibrant, people are extremely welcoming and come from a variety of walks of life. It's a beautiful place that I would recommend for anyone to try out looking for a church home. I visited many preschools and I thought this one was one of the nicest as far as the facilities were concerned.  I showed up at the school and the administrators in the office (excluding the helpful young lady sitting at the front desk) seemed to be snotty and rude.  Peggy (Older Brunette Lady) gave me a tour and let me know that scheduled tours were given at an earlier date.  She appeared to be annoyed that she had to take time out of her day to show me around.  I needed to find a preschool soon, so I put my feelings aside in regards to the office staff.  I went ahead and filled out the paperwork at the end of March 2012 and the front office put a lot of urgency on collecting our money to hold our spot, so I turned in my payment the following day.  Anyhow, our financial circumstances changed in May and NCUMP does not offer any kind of flexible child before/after care for working parents, so we attempted to cancel our registration under the assumption they would keep our $125.00 registration fee and prorate the remainder of what we paid.  Keep this in mind it is 4 months before school even starts.  According to their rules they kept 50% of what we paid plus the $125.00 registration plus the $50.00 for the Family number.  (Shame on us for not reading the "contract" carefully.)  They basically received about $900.00 for no services rendered.  Now I know why their facilities look so great.  What kind of Christian Organization feels they are entiled to keeping so much money for doing absolutely nothing?  What does this do to the family who is struggling with their finances while NCUMP keeps more than 1/2 of your money for doing absolutely nothing!!!  I believe everything happens for a reason and out of this bad situation we found a good preschool for a much more reasonable price with flexible hours depending on what you need (7:30 am - 6:00 pm) with "real Christian values" and they are open 12 months out of the year.  Orange Tree Preschool on Bison & Jamboree right next to Newport Christian School.

name: Newport Harbor Lutheran Church
Newport Harbor Lutheran Church - Newport Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
We have had three children attend this preschool over the past five years, and we could not be more grateful for our experience. The director and teachers  are compassionate and kind, and they truly care about each child. Communication with parents is excellent, and they work hard to create a strong, supportive community. This preschool has been such a special part of our family’s early years. Nice place. Has big parking lot and is adjacent to a path that leads to a beautiful view of the newport beach balboa peninsula back bay. Can walk over a mile along a Cliffside waterfront overlooking all of Ocean and south Orange county with lots of airplanes landing and taking off just north of path. Great church , Christmas service was beautiful. The concert prior to the service was outstanding, the acoustics are phenomenal. Very welcoming community. Wonderful school and great environment for their students.
Terrific teachers; very caring. Love this school. Everyone is so nice and they have lots of fun activities for the children.

name: Newport Harbor Lutheran Church and School
reviewSummary: Beautiful traditional Lutheran service. Organ and choir are top tier.

name: Newsong Church 10ten
Newsong Church 10ten - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary: Loved visiting Newsong. Love their mission, “Love God, love people.”  And their work with the community speaks to their mission. They are living it out. The pews and stain glass gives it a special touch to the worship experience. This is a great balance of modern with traditional. The band is great and the Dave Gibbons, the lead pastor is amazing! They have a coffee bar with baristas actually prepping pour overs for their attendees as part of their hospitality team. Overall a great place to worship, hear and be challenged by great bible messages and to build community. “The church of the misfits” where you’re accepted, encouraged, equipped, and redeemed as you are for whom you are. This is more than a church of diverse multicultural individuals; this is a place you can call home! When I got here over a decade ago I felt so lost and broken beyond repair. Through the years and through this journey with Newsong I sought out and found Christs unwavering love in the faces of this love built community. The connections built and the tools provided have taught me that not only am I a beloved child of God but I am also a representation of many like me who’s trials and tribulations serve as a testimony of the triumphs through HE who refines and strengthens us. At Newsong they don’t just preach, they teach through action. Wether you connect through the mix, kings table, seeds &sparks, moms ministry, kaleidoscope, live, conneXion, havens, casa hogar,  or any of the multitude of affiliates that enrich what it’s like to live out unwavering love through service. If you’re searching to discover true faith and uncover the divine essence of your story… then I invite you to come visit and maybe even discover what it feels like to finally be welcomed home. 🫶🏽 This community does not judge, and treats you like family. They meet everyone with love like Jesus would. No judgment, come as you are. This community has forever impacted my life and I will never forget how God moved in my life through New Song Church. My daughter invited me to this church and I absolutely love it. Great family church and the gospel is preached according to God’s word. Love this place and love the fellow members! Full of love and that's what we all need in the world right now. Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a place of worship. Can't say enough about Newsong.

name: NewStory Church
NewStory Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Everybody here is like a family. It is a great church for people with kids. My kids hang out Outside of church with people they met at church. In particular, a young man named Alistair, his friends with my child, And he’s such a good role model. He taught him about biblical principles, The golden rule, And a concept called scat. Some say a church Is made by its people, If that is true, this church deserves a five Great preaching, and great pastor. They have ways to get plugged in almost immediately and it helps people feel welcome and get to know others as soon as possible. There are many opportunities to volunteer, to fellowship, to get involved and to be part of the greater purpose of God for our lives. My church is incredible....and every worship service is like going to a Christian rock concert. We are a family....not just people that go to the same church. New Story is the real deal when it comes to partnership with other ministries and serving God joyfully.

The congregation and staff at New Story are incredible people who are willing to go the extra mile to help. We hosted a ministry fundraising event for Cru, a college ministry, here about a week ago. They helped coordinate the facilities, audio/visual, and everything we needed to make the event go smoothly.

After the event, we needed some extra help cleaning up and getting things back to how they were. At 10:30 at night Pastor Blake was still working hard to help us out after being there for hours and then two of the young adults who had finished up a missions meeting came and helped us clean up. I felt so cared for and served. It was a sweet picture of the body of Christ coming around each other. First time in this NewStory church and it was a welcoming experience and really good service and and good pastor. I definitely recommend you check it out and I will be back.

name: North Coast Calvary Chapel
North Coast Calvary Chapel - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
I visited this church for the first time today, and I was truly impressed. From the moment I arrived, the community was incredibly welcoming, making me feel right at home. The pastor’s message was captivating and inspiring. It really held my attention and gave me a lot to reflect on. Overall, it was a wonderful experience, and I’m looking forward to attending again and getting more involved. The day I sat down in this church, my life changed. I encountered God in a real way and everything shifted for me. I found not just a place to worship, but a place where I truly belong. This church became my family, my support, and my tribe. This church has been such a blessing in my life. The sermons stay rooted in Jesus and His teachings, with no political agenda—just faith, love, and truth. The church itself is beautiful, and the people who attend are some of the best souls you’ll meet. Ryan’s messages always leave me feeling hopeful. I’m so grateful for this church. It’s refreshing to hear messages that focus purely on Jesus and His teachings, free from political influence. I feel at home here every week. ❤️ So went here for the first time tonight. Looking for a home church while I live in Carlsbad.

On my drive here there was a white Honda that kept cutting people off and wouldn't let me over when I had my blinker on for 2 blocks and low and behold they were coming to the church as well. Hmmm.

The pastor was great, the message right on , no checks in my spirit. The worship was very good. The campus is beautiful. (the reason for my 4 star rating)

But no one talked to me, or said hi, except during the time the pastor said to say hi to those around you. Everyone took off as soon as the service was over. Didn't look like there are a lot of close relationships here.

I will probably give it another try next week to see if it remains the same. This place rocks they have so many programs for every age level... coffee house for Fellowship afterwards lots of classes for Seekers during the week people that are not clear on their faith and the Sunday service is always educational love the compass and the people here. It's a great welcoming Church
