name: North Coast Church
North Coast Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary: OK, so I have been on a journey.trying to find a church that truly felt like home. I was raised Catholic, but for a while there I was only showing up at Christmas and Easter, and I knew in my heart I needed something more. Something that would light me up inside and that I'd actually be excited to bring my whole family to. And then I found North Coast Church, and honestly? It changed everything. What I love most is that they offer so many different types of services , a Latin service, a more contemporary rock music service, a live music service, an outside service,  so even though it's a large church, it never feels overwhelming or impersonal. No one is forcing anything on you, which I deeply appreciate. And Pastor Chris Brown? He is just so wonderful. North Coast is a church on a mission, and you can feel that the moment you walk in. If you are searching for a church home, please do yourself a favor and check them out. Go to a Brownie with Browns event, it's a great way to get to know the mission and the heart behind everything they do. I'm so, so glad I found them. North Coast Church has been such a blessing to me and my family. From the moment we walked in, everyone made us feel genuinely welcome. The messages are practical, biblical, and encouraging, and the worship is uplifting every week. I also appreciate the wonderful programs for children and the strong sense of community. Whether you’re new to church or looking for a place to grow in your faith, I highly recommend North Coast Church. It’s a place where you can truly feel at home. Im 14 and have been going to north coast church since i was almost 2! This is my favorite place ever! I always get greeted with smiles! This church is incredible . The church itself is awesome. Not a fan of the head pastor though. During certain presidencies he encourages people to follow the law and during other presidencies, he encourages them to break the law. There are quite a few other inconsistencies and actual issues he seemingly supports that goes against the Bible. I’m not the only person that has left this church because of him. I’ve met a surprising amount in my hunt to find a new church. Until I find that church, I’m listening to Lakepointe and Live Free with Josh Howerton. Give it a listen - it’s really good. If I could, I’d attend that church. I’ve never met a pastor that could make people so excited about the Bible as he does. I love ❤️ North Coast Church. It's a very welcoming Church that is active in giving back to the community with volunteer projects and the like. It's a come as you are Church, no need to feel like you have to dress up. Just come share God's love and teachings. 👣

name: North Coast Church Carlsbad
North Coast Church Carlsbad - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
North Coast Church – Carlsbad Campus (not North Coast Calvary Chapel)
North Coast Church has been such a blessing for my husband and me. The Carlsbad campus has a relaxed, friendly vibe and feels like home. It’s a smaller campus where many people already know each other, so you may need to take a little initiative to get plugged in (volunteering is a great start, and life group)—but I've been going here for three years and everyone I’ve met has been kind, genuine, and welcoming.
The teaching is exceptional—biblically grounded, insightful, and refreshingly apolitical. I love that the focus stays on Scripture and spiritual growth, not politics. Chris Brown and Larry are both incredible teachers who bring the Bible to life with humor, depth, and historical context.
North Coast staff make a real effort to create a safe, accepting environment for everyone, regardless of background.
The Carlsbad campus has a great Saturday night service with dinner afterward, bounce house and games for kids, and live music—perfect for families. Plus, the church is incredibly active in community service and outreach, including the annual “Serve Your City” weekend when services pause so everyone can volunteer across San Diego County.
It’s a church that truly lives out its faith, and I’m so grateful to call it home. Love North Coast Church. I've attended various campuses for the majority of my life. The church does a great job at being an easy to attend welcoming environment that stays true to Biblical teachings. There are multiple services and different areas to attend depending on your comfort and preferences on environment. Amazing Biblical teachings. Especially by lead pastor, Chris Brown! This campus is VERY clicky and unfriendly. It's been shocking really. Even the staff won't make eye contact and smile at you. Pretty tough for new folks. Especially for someone that has to attend church alone.Tried a Life Group so maybe I would know a couple of people on campus and after attending and running small groups for decades the group at this campus turned out to be the most WORLDLY and hateful group of folks I have ever met at church  with the leaders being the worst of them all Modern day Christian church. College like Bible focused teachings. Great youth classes/groups. Its all about the kids! They have different venues for different worship styles. The main campus is in Vista, this Carlsbad campus has the sermon streamed on a large screen. I like that the attire is casual, and no worries if you are running late, no judgment. Christ-focused and Bible teaching church. Amazing leaders who serve their church, lead by example, and teach the Bible no matter what. Best kids program around too. Come check it out and be amazed with how God changes your life. Grace alone by faith alone through Christ alone revealed in Scripture alone.

name: North Coast Church Rancho Bernardo Office
North Coast Church Rancho Bernardo Office - San Diego (Rancho Bernardo) Campus
reviewSummary: If you are looking for a family friendly, God-focused, welcoming community, I recommend North Coast Church. There isn't a lot of fluff to what they do, just organic relational ministry. The focus of the community is to grow each person's individual relationship with God and with each other. After checking out the main service on Sundays, I recommend connecting to a Life Group. My Life Group connections go deep because they have been there to support me through some tough times as well as just hang out. I've grown so much because of it. Loved it alot. I really enjoyed the Thursday youth too.

name: North Coast Church San Marcos/Escondido
North Coast Church San Marcos/Escondido - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary: Best church in all of North county!! Great people and great teaching Pastors!! 🫶🏽🫶🏽🫶🏽 if you are looking for a community to get plugged into to serve, please his is the place!! Absolutely love this church. I've been going since it opened (about 13 years ago). Great, friendly staff. Absolutely amazing pastors. Great life groups of many different types and ages to allow you to get rooted in Christian community. The services have grown to over a 1,000 people per average service. The live band and worship team is awesome, it's like watching a live concert. Great church with friendly people, and they give you opportunities to give back to the community. It was my first time there and it was a beautiful church. However, I am truly disappointed that they did not mention our brother in Christ, Charlie Kirk, in the sermon. He deserved to be to be mentioned and his family deserved to be prayed for. I’ve read that a lot of people are changing churches because of this, but I’m not sure how I feel about it right now, so we’ll see. My family and I started coming here a little over a year ago.  We have all found a home in North Coast.  Our kids are super involved in the youth programs, my oldest did not enjoy church where we were at before, but now can’t wait to go, and also went away on his first camp trip with the youth group!  Chris Brown and all the pastoral staff are amazing.  Tracie Moss at the San Marcos/Escondido is also top notch!  Come  to church!

name: North County Baptist Church
North County Baptist Church - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary:
The church itself pressured its members for loyalty above family and told me that while it was great that I was attending the church on Sunday mornings, and the church's school (Attached to the same building basically) mon-Friday with evening services on Wed. and Door knocking on Saturday - that it was unacceptable that my family wanted to have their 15 year old son home for Sunday dinners and that if I couldn't attend that i would need to consider other schooling options because "we cant bend the rules for some and not others"

Not only that but they pushed an unaccredited schooling option on the congregation and used fear tactics regarding public schooling to fan the flames of fear for anyone considering an alternative. Too bad the classes didnt count for anything in real life, thank God (ha) that i found out in time and actually graduated with a diploma.

I have no clue who's running this show now but In my opinion Pastor Miller was an awful pastor.

Imagine being so impacted but the BS that went on here that you feel compelled to leave an honest 1 star review like 21 years later.

No trauma induced here at all folks ; )

name: North County Church of Christ
North County Church of Christ - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary:
A Welcoming Easter Service at North County Church of Christ (San Marcos)
My son and I recently had the opportunity to attend an Easter service at North County Church of Christ in San Marcos, thanks to an invitation from his friend. While I'm not typically a church-going person, I was pleasantly surprised by the experience and we both had a really decent time, even participating in the fun Easter egg hunt afterwards.
The service itself was engaging. The hymns and songs they sang were quite good, and the pastor delivered his message with what seemed like genuine care and passion. You could tell he believed in what he was saying, which made it more impactful.
What struck me most was the sense of community within the congregation. Everyone seemed to know each other and get along well, suggesting a strong and established fellowship. As visitors, my son and I were met with nothing but inviting and friendly attitudes. There was absolutely no sense of judgment, which made us feel comfortable and welcome.
If you are someone who regularly attends church or are looking for a welcoming faith community in the San Marcos area, based on my experience, North County Church of Christ seems like a good place to consider. The service was meaningful, the music was enjoyable, and the people were genuinely kind. Not here but this review is for the school. My sister don’t like it. I hear the school don’t have support more challenging I have only visited a couple of churches in San Diego and did not get what I was looking for. After reading NCCC website, they had a lot of great information that was confirmed during my visit. They were friendly, warm, and welcoming. Many church of Christ are strictly biblical, but I love that NCCC incorporates practical life lessons. Also, their adult classes are very practical as well, which is awesome. We have only attended once, but they seems to have a really great children's program and I love that they have bible class as well as a children's bible hours during adult worship. I am looking forward to attending again and possibly placing membership. NCCC is a wonderful ministry-oriented fellowship that strives to stay focused on Christ and his bride the church. You will definitely enjoy the living atmosphere and you will grow in your walk with the Lord A nice and welcoming church. I've been going here for like 8 years and everyone is really welcoming.

name: North Hills Church
North Hills Church - Brea Campus
reviewSummary:
I love my church! name: North Orange Christian Church
North Orange Christian Church - Orange Campus
reviewSummary: NOCC has been my church home for the past 10 years, and I cannot think of going anywhere else. I love serving alongside my fellow sisters and brothers in Christ. We truly are a community that loves to serve The LORD and others. As a mother of three and family of six ,I am super grateful for the support the church offers with their weekly food banks .I do want to say that it took me alot to go and ask for help .I've always had to much pride to do it .But I did and am so thankful for everything they offer without asking for anything in return .I do want to say that there is one woman there that makes me feel uncomfortable and almost I am a burden to her .It is burning hot out,I am pregnant and I stood in the shade just as the others did in front of me but she asked me to move so I did and apologized as I was feeling faint due to the heat and waiting .Then I get inside the older Asian woman asks me how many people are in my family and what their ages are .I told her no problem and proceeded .The same woman that told me to stand in the sun then proceeds to keep staring at me and when I approach the counter where they hand out dairy and frozen items she hands me a couple of bags rather then letting me choose two items as they normally would .I then asked if they had any dairy (Milk,eggs,yogurt etc)She then asked how many are in my family I again told her even though I already said it when I entered and had not received any dairy items even though there was several on the counter behind her .I then ask if I may have one container of the guacamole she has behind her as there was 10 .She seemed really annoyed and said oh my lord there is some on the wall over there can't you see ?I said I'm sorry I didn't .Then hands me the guacamole.I then asked if there was any milk .She says no they didn't receive any this week .I said ok and left .I don't want to complain .I understand this is free and nothing is guaranteed.I also am very grateful but it just made me feel down and like I was a bother or maybe she thinks I don't need the help .Coming down here after being able to support myself my whole life so far and now struggling was a huge thing for me to accept I needed to do .I would never take more then what my family needs nor take from others.I just thought this needed to be said so that hopefully others don't feel the same way when they come looking for help and are made to feel like they are stealing or are a bother. But thank you to all the people that volunteer and make this possible you are truly God's warriors. Seems like this place will turn away anyone that they don't see fit to be there. Church is meant to be a place of gathering and love and I felt neither here. I moved here recently and loved to use my old church as a safe place to worship and skateboard when we weren't in service. Do not come here seeking comfort, safety, or family. They will turn you away. Instead of pushing your community away you should invite them in and make them feel welcome in your community. "Do unto others as you would have them do unto you" We moved to the area in 2021 and started church shopping.  North Orange Christian Church was the first church we checked out.  We wanted a church with solid bible teaching, worship that helped you draw closer to God, a good Life Group / Small Group program, a Children's ministry and a Youth ministry, and NOCC  checked all the boxes.  It felt like home immediately, and the people we met made us feel welcome.  We never left.  If you are looking for such a church, come check it out.   You'll be blessed that you did. Went into the church office with a fellow brother in Christ to inquire about getting him some help. After he received a bag of groceries, we went over to a bench in front of the Chappell to pray, and I answered some of his questions regarding the sabbath. Less than 10 minutes after sitting there, Andrew, who helped us in the office, came out and told us we needed to leave immediately. When I asked why, he said there have been stabbings there, and the police don't want anyone hanging around. I told him we were fine that we trust in the Holy Spirit to protect us. Then he said it's the law and we have to leave! He couldn't tell me which penal code we were breaking, but to avoid confrontation, we left. It makes me wonder if God is working in this church when I experience actions such as this? Needless to say, I will not be returning to this church and I will tell everyone about my unbelievable encounter with one of many demons that do attend here!

Northeast Christian Church - Lexington Campus
reviewSummary: Most of everyone was amazing sweet and calm, food selection was amazing best I have seen. But at one point a older man with the church was raising his voice at my deaf brother in law I tried to tell him that he was deaf and instead of listening to me walked passed and continued to raise his voice until he reached him. I understand no one was supposed to be standing on that side of the hall but it's very disrespectful to raise your voice at a deaf person as if they will magically hear you. There was a good mix of seniors which I relate with and the younger people offer a needed vibrancy. Wendell's music selections were contemporary without being over powering. Most importantly, Pastor Roy's sermon was on point. Biblical teaching made relevant to modern times with just the right amount of humor. I may have found a church home Came for the coffee stayed for the service. It was about self-care and unplugging.
These people were welcoming folk. I did not perceive any political bias here. Went there for utility assistance and my 1st thought was God must be happy this place is gorgeous and even has its own coffee shop and kids indoor playground (like ones in McDonald's), and friendly faces every where you look! I'm thinking of attending just off my experience here. Lovely place and people! God is great all the time! Amen! I have been going there for the past 7 years. Intermittent as I left the area for 3 years and then the pandemic began. I attended online during the pandemic, finally retired and returned to Northstar when I returned to Florida. I can honestly say that I have never been been happier than than to be back. Pastor Marty is like none that I have ever known. He's genuine, honest, transparent but mostly kind with the greatest love for God and his members. It's an honor and a privilege to be a member of this home. Not church, but home because that's what it is. Pastor Roy is my hero and he met a need for me when my brother passed away. Rock Harbor Mission Viejo is a great, small church looking to serve the Lord and reach the lost. You are most welcome here and God will definitely meet you where you're at in this place. name: Oasis Church

reviewSummary: I worship at this church any time I visit LA, about once every three months. The atmosphere is welcoming, the people are very friendly and accepting, the worship is God-glorifying, the anointed messages are inspiring and faith-building/faith-enhancing. I always look forward to attending the services. Oasis Church offers a refreshing take on spirituality, far from your average church experience. Initially attending to support a friend, I was pleasantly surprised by the profoundly uplifting message and the vibrant, welcoming congregation. The atmosphere is charged with positivity, fostering a sense of community and belonging. It's a place where fun and faith intertwine seamlessly, making every service not just a ritual, but a truly joyful gathering. Whether you're there for support or seeking a spiritual home, Oasis Church stands out as a beacon of hope and togetherness. I started going to Oasis a few months ago after attending Fearless LA for the past 7 years. I enjoy Pastor Julian's message and they are always on point. The worship band is incredible but most importantly, Pastor believes in the individual God given talents of the members and I admire that. Not Sure What to Think, a Place of Contrasts. Old church, covered stained glass windows, cross dwarfed by moving neon lights, a little too Las Vegas but full of energy. Some Bible verses and motivational stories, but too much performance and talk about money. Would Jesus, homeless and in sandals--humble--be welcomed here? Yet God sends His Spirit to those who seek . . . I live out of state but I love attending their online services which are always so inspiring.

Initially attending to support a friend, I was pleasantly surprised by the profoundly uplifting message and the vibrant, welcoming congregation. The atmosphere is charged with positivity, fostering a sense of community and belonging. It's a place where fun and faith intertwine seamlessly, making every service not just a ritual, but a truly joyful gathering. Whether you're there for support or seeking a spiritual home, Oasis Church stands out as a beacon of hope and togetherness. I started going to Oasis a few months ago after attending Fearless LA for the past 7 years. I enjoy Pastor Julian's message and they are always on point. The worship band is incredible but most importantly, Pastor believes in the individual God given talents of the members and I admire that. Not Sure What to Think, a Place of Contrasts. Old church, covered stained glass windows, cross dwarfed by moving neon lights, a little too Las Vegas but full of energy. Some Bible verses and motivational stories, but too much performance and talk about money. Would Jesus, homeless and in sandals--humble--be welcomed here? Yet God sends His Spirit to those who seek . . . I live out of state but I love attending their online services which are always so inspiring.

name: OC Singles For Christ Church
OC Singles For Christ Church - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary:
I had such a meaningful and uplifting experience at OC Single for Christ.
The atmosphere was warm, welcoming, and genuinely Christ-centered. What stood out the most to me was how friendly and open everyone was — it truly felt like a safe space to meet other believers who share similar values and life goals.

The organizers were caring and intentional, making sure people felt included rather than awkward. The group attracts mature, sincere Christians who are looking for real connection, not superficial small talk. I left feeling encouraged, refreshed, and grateful to have discovered this community.

Highly recommend it to anyone in Orange County who wants fellowship, growth, and the chance to build Christ-honoring relationships. The only church anywhere just for Singles!

They believe in all the fundamental doctrines of the evangelical Protestant church. For example, they believe in the inerrancy of Scripture, from the Bible, Old and New Testaments, is the inspired, infallible Word of God. This is most definitely a senior citizen singles get together.  OTOH  it is so not a place for the spiritually mature   The Bible study is appropriate for a 1rst grade Sunday school.

The median age is 65-75.   You will probably run out of there if you don't fall in this category.  If you're looking to meet someone of the opposite sex, and you are not in this age range, I'll save you some time, you will not feel comfortable here

Something that was really egregious to me was the begging for $.

My pastor NEVER asks for $, he says "If God guides God provides"

OCSFC will spend an inordinate amount of time on instructing you to give (so cringe for a first time visitor)  which made me write them off right off the bat

They are at best a source of entertainment on Friday night for the over 65 crowd, it is FR not a church.   It is similar to an activities event at a skilled nursing facility.

Look no further if that's what you are after

After the "message" was karaoke.   99% of the participants were completely off key, singing their hearts out

The "performances" were so laughable, yet no one was laughing.  Maybe they were great vocalists, but the sound system was against them ?   That is the one positive thing I can say about this organization, that no one was mocking them, which is a plus as far as I'm concerned

Anyways, if a deep spiritual message or meaningful fellowship with seasoned believers does not matter to you, if you don't mind the leadership pleading with you to part with your $, and you are extremely elderly and single this may be the perfect place for you It is way better than public clubs. The pastor keeps it God centered. The people are great. OC Singles pros-cons
pros
1.	Nice friendly people, safe environment, ping pong, karaoke, low cost dinner, big on dancing events. Friday nights are free to attend. Teaching and worship music are adequate.
Cons
2.	Older crowd, 55plus, hardly any young folks, OC Singles would like to be a church, but it more a place to meet for fellowship and hangout. People come for the fellowship and to meet new people, almost everyone attends church elsewhere. It’s one of the very few single Christian weekly gatherings in Orange County.

name: OC Summit Church
OC Summit Church - Laguna Niguel Campus
reviewSummary: My church home and I love it.

name: Ocean City Church
Ocean City Church - Jacksonville Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
I attended Sunday service while vacationing, It was one block from my hotel.
I was warmly welcomed at the door & had a great cup of coffee. The worship was powerful, the message biblical & inspiring. It’s a very homey atmosphere with a memorable message. I enjoyed the service & if I lived in Jax I definitely would come back. 15 years ago I was put in Foster Care by the youth pastor. Today I let that go with the push & welcome of my friends to attend this church. I don't know what my attendance will be for this church or in general but I am eternally grateful. This church is our family. We love it because it has a nice smaller amount of people so it makes it easier to form meaningful relationships. There's a lot of opportunities to come together and grow together socially through weekly city groups and monthly meet ups. My favorite part of this church is the people, worship, and of course the weekly messages. Whoever is up front to deliver a message definitely leaves you feeling spiritually fed. This was my second time visiting this Church I was very disappointed the Pastor did not even mention what happened yesterday at the Trump rally. Someone lost their life and President Trump was nearly killed the Pastor didn't even mention it extremely strange we should have prayed for the family that lost a loved one as well as prayed for the President and our Country overall. It's not about politics it's a spiritual issue going on but the Pastor chose to ignore and crack jokes and talk about waterfalls. OCC just feels like home. I have been in churches my whole life and this one is such a gem. I never feel like I have to be perfect or have my stuff together before I walk in to worship and grow. From the teachings to the worship to the community groups to the lessons our children learn, there is always a focus on God's rescuing grace. So grateful for the constant reminder to choose freedom!

name: Ocean Hills Church
reviewSummary: A warm and inviting non-denominational community. Excellent contemporary worship team.

name: Ocean View Church | Chula Vista
Ocean View Church | Chula Vista - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary:
wonderful atmosphere, pastor Logan delivered a great sermon,  my mother-in-law had a great time to. and I thought she would Never enter. nor let alone enjoy the service. but she did,
, hope we can attend again soon. This church has been serving the community for over 70 years. Relaunched in October of 2021 you will find a welcoming multi-generational congregation who, are not ashamed of the gospel of Jesus. Our pastor is warm and authentic. The worship invites the presence of the Holy Spirit. Open to all, 10:15am on Sundays, enjoy a casual service and dare to make connections.  There are kids and senior ministries and more. - and as a bonus the farmers market and many 3rd avenue eateries are open after church 😊✝️💕 Excellent place to worship. Close to community and lots of different things happening in the week. A great place for kids, adults, families, everyone! Based solidly on Scripture and overflowing with care and welcome, Ocean View Church Chula Vista has been our home church for years! Every time you are there with Pastor Steve, you will be filled with Christ! He is so knowledgeable about our Holy Father and the Bible you will just want for more. Thank you Jesus for him.

name: Oceans Church
Oceans Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
I’m so grateful to be a part of a church that is full of the Holy Spirit, and that preaches the truth. I have seen it grow from the beginning! Sunday services are always powerful. Each week people get saved and healed - miracles are always happening! Sundays are a place you can be equipped as a Christian but they are also a space where people who don’t know Jesus can encounter Him.

I love the spaces created beyond Sunday as well to go deeper, like weekly prayer, small groups, and Wave Night. People are being discipled, and that’s a process that takes time, but we have countless leaders committed to building up the people in this house.

My life has been deeply impacted by Pastors Mark and Rachelle Francey over many years, and I love getting to be a part of this church family! God restored and changed my life through this church. I have been here for 2 years and am currently in the Oceans College, and the wisdom and care I have received here has surpassed any other church I have gone to. I've seen the shift in my life, my marriage, my intimacy with God, and even the spill over effect on to my family. I'm so grateful for Pastor Mark and Rachelle Francey, Pastor Joel and Melanie Foust, and all of the lead pastors and staff of Oceans. God bringing me to Oceans Church has changed my life in ways I can’t articulate. This church has such amazing pastors and staff; everyone embodies the heart of Jesus. I’ve met my best friends, I’ve encountered most importantly the presence of God like never before. I thank Oceans Church for the fruit they’ve reaped that pours out to each person that walks into this church. God is truly doing such a mighty work and I thank the pastors for their obedience, stewardship and humble authority that is so inspiring and encouraging. I love oceans church and I will forever be grateful for the ways God has blessed me with such an amazing church and community I get to call home💕💕 I am so grateful for this church! The pastors are the same on and off the stage and they pour so much into the people of this house. I have found some of my best friends, got plugged into small groups, and have been taught sound biblical teaching each week. The kids team does such an amazing job teaching the kids and giving them a space to learn and grow and each team serving does so with a smile on their face. Been attending oceans since 2020 and for the past 6 years Oceans church has been a church that puts Jesus First. No Church is perfect it has its flaws, but that's the whole body of Christ. This church does a very good job on holding each other accountable and sharpening each other. It's Holy Spirit filled and the faith at Oceans is abundant. Definitely an amazing church!

name: Oceans Church (SJC)
Oceans Church (SJC) - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
What stands out most is the genuine connection among the people. Whether it’s your first visit or your fiftieth, you’re treated like family. The smiles are real. The prayers are sincere. And the love of Christ is everywhere! The worship is powerful and spirit-led, with music that lifts your soul and messages that speak straight to the heart. The pastors are authentic, passionate, and deeply rooted in Scripture. Every sermon leaves you feeling both challenged and encouraged to grow in your walk with God.
You’re Invited to Oceans Church – Come Experience the Difference! The Spirit of God is in this place.

Super good praise and worship
Super good preaching

If you want to go to real authentic church, look no further. This is the place to be in Southern California, Orange County.

They are meeting outside under tent covering due to covid. Nevertheless this place is real. Come one, come all and experience God the maker of Heaven and Earth This is a amazing church no holding back from the word of God here. If you're looking for a home church and want to know all that God has for you check it out. My daughter and her family attend here and I got to visit and witness my grandchildren be dedicated to the Lord. Thank You Jesus!! We’ve been church-goers our whole lives but have never experienced the transformation and communion with God like we have through Oceans Church. The Spirit of the Lord is here! This is a church that honors the Lord above all else, prays faithfully and teaches the full Gospel. The lead pastors are true shepherds, devoted to seeking God’s will and living Romans 12:1-2 lives. Refreshing! Our kids love the youth programs and have and have made great friendships. Exceedingly and eternally (literally) grateful for Oceans! I mean wow what a powerful service!
This is an amazing amazing church. Just excellence from the moment you walk in to the moment you walk out. The worship was so anointed! The preaching with so anointed and appointed with a timely message. The worship was so anointed! The preaching with so anointed and appointed with a timely message. They had baptisms after service and it was son fun and high energy!
This was my first time from Jersey and can't wait to get back. Great job Oceans Team!

Oceanside Christian Fellowship - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
My daughter just performed in her first play here. They have a great theater program for kids. My family and I don't attend Church since we're not religious so i can't tell you what mass is like but the people who work for the church are very friendly and seem to be great people. I highly recommend signing your kids up here if they enjoy theater. My daughter is just 3 and she loved every moment. 🗣️For anyone reading, please don’t let an experience like this discourage your personal relationship with God. ✝️

I was looking forward to attending a women’s retreat and connecting with a new community during a challenging time in my life. Unfortunately, my experience trying to sign up was disappointing and left me feeling discouraged. 😔

I was told (by Nicole) I needed to attend a Sunday service before receiving the retreat signup link, which felt more like a barrier than an invitation. 🥹While I understand churches have processes, the way the conversation was handled left me feeling overwhelmed, uncomfortable, and unwelcome especially after I had openly shared that I was going through a lot.

I shared with Nicole how I was feeling in the moment, but didn’t receive any follow up or encouragement afterward.😭

I personally host women’s events, and I would NEVER interact with someone this way, especially when they are coming in vulnerable and seeking community. 🤍

My hope is that churches remember how important it is to lead with warmth and compassion, especially when someone is reaching out in need. I’m grateful my faith is strong, but I can imagine how an experience like this could impact someone who is new or searching. 🙏🏽

I’ve prayed about sharing this and ultimately chose to speak up, not to tear anyone down, but to advocate for myself and for others who may be seeking support and community. Wonderful worship. Great message. Amazing people. I was very welcomed and embraced. Fellowship for all ages and stages of life! If you're looking for a church near Westchester, playa del Rey, or beach city area, I highly recommend you visit OCF! Holy Spirit is present here! Visiting our Daughter and Son in Law we got to go to their awesome church. People were friendly, awesome music, and relevant Bible based message.
If you want to hear God's word in the crazy world we live in, this church will be a great choice We go here when we're in town to visit family. The people are welcoming and the message is Bible-based. They have "plurality of leadership," so there's a different preacher each Sunday, and they've all been good. The music is current (think KLOVE) but not too loud or showy. They're not giving a concert; they're worshipful.

reviewSummary:

Genuine people doing life together and loving each other well.  If you are looking for a great church community, this is worth a visit! Such a great church! name: Oceanside First Presbyterian Church
Oceanside First Presbyterian Church - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband and I absolutely love Oceanside First Presbyterian Church and preschool. From the moment we walked in, people were incredibly welcoming and genuine. It truly feels like a church family.

The Sunday service is meaningful and encouraging with great worship music, choir, and band, and Pastor Mike’s biblical teaching is thoughtful, practical, and centered on Jesus. The atmosphere is joyful and relaxed, and the free coffee and courtyard fellowship make it easy to connect with people.

One of the things we appreciate most is how much this church cares about the Oceanside community. They are actively involved in outreach programs and service projects that make a real difference.

If you are looking for a welcoming Christian church in Oceanside where people are authentic, friendly, and serious about growing in faith, I highly recommend visiting Oceanside First Presbyterian church and preschool. Oceanside First Presbyterian Church is such a warm and welcoming space to Reach, Teach, and Serve each other, those in our community, and across the globe. The first time I attended, I immediately felt at home and accepted.
The church is politics free space, accepting all people and family, regardless of prior experiences, beliefs,race, Marital status, and sexual orientation.
I joined the choir, have attended the Wednesday Women’s fellowship, the monthly seniors activities, and special services, concerts, and community events.
Adult , teens, and children’s ministries are offered, as well as presentations such as the Parkinson’s and Cancer support groups.
I hope you will come and experience Oceanside First Presbyterian Church and find out for yourself! We’ve had such a wonderful experience with this preschool. From day one, the environment has been incredibly welcoming, making both my daughter and our family feel comfortable and supported.

This was my daughter’s first time in a school environment, and I was naturally a bit nervous. The teachers (Mrs. Marks and Mrs. Saldaña) took the time to walk me through what to expect and gave helpful guidance on how to navigate those first couple of weeks. They reassured me that the transition period was normal and they were absolutely right. With their support and encouragement, my daughter adjusted beautifully. By week three, she was excited, happy, and eager to go to school each day.

The teachers are attentive, caring, and truly invested in the children. I really appreciate how they take the time to provide daily summaries at pickup, so I always know how my daughter’s day went. It gives me so much peace of mind.

The school also does a great job of keeping parents informed about upcoming events and activities, which helps us stay involved and better support our daughter’s growth and development.

Overall, I’m so grateful for the positive, nurturing environment they’ve created. It’s clear they genuinely care about the children and their families. The church members are very friendly and welcoming. The music is a great mix of classic hymns and contemporary. The Pastor is personally welcoming and his messages truly hit home. The church offers many activities and worthy causes. I truly enjoy coming! Oceanside First Presbyterian Church and Preschool has been a wonderful community for my children and family. The preschool, community, staff and teachers are so amazing. I could not be happier with the experience here Church and preschool both.

name: Oceanside Sanctuary
Oceanside Sanctuary - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve been attending Oceanside Sanctuary Church for about 6 years. I was looking for a deeper spiritual life and happily found this amazing church. First, I love the beautiful, stained glass historic building. But the real gems are the co-pastors, Jason and Jenell Coker and all the wonderful people that are a part of this church. It is a rare space where all are welcome, where we are asked to think and live deeply in our faith. It is a rare space of inclusion, love, diversity, while embracing the word of God and the life of Jesus. It is a rare space of welcoming atheists, agnostics, and those who aren’t sure what they believe. And we find so many ways to be of service to our community.
This loving community has restored my faith, given me a new home, and connected me to the wonders of God. I am so grateful to have found my home in this church and now finally feel close to God again thanks to the leaders here & the community. I am extremely grateful for the loving, inclusive community of OSC & their focus on justice, joy & inclusion in the name of jesus! Love this Church and all the wonderful people who attend here!! Very Gay friendly and a loving community.  🙏 It's already humiliating enough to have to go to a pantry to be treated without a spirit of love. It hurts when you need help and your talked down to.Sarah wouldn't approve. My wife and I have been going to this church for several weeks now and it is by far the best church we have ever been members of. The staff is friendly and genuine. Jason and his wife Jenelle are cornerstones of the community. The church is inclusive and LGBTQ+ friendly. We found our home here for sure.

UPDATE

We have now been members for almost two years and there is a reason this church is growing. The community here is unparalleled. The staff, the volunteers, and of course Jason and Janelle are our home away from home. If you’re looking for a church that actually acts like one and doesn’t just talk about it, come to OSC.

name: Oceanside United Reformed Church
Oceanside United Reformed Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
Oceanside URC is one of the most welcoming churches I have ever been to. This church was my introduction to any reformed church and I absolutely loved it. Duncan, and elder at this church, made sure me and my family were greeted, and he made us feel like family the second we met him. The preaching was biblical, the Gospel was proclaimed, and we sung songs straight from the Bible. As a visitor to the Southern California area anytime someone I know is in Carlsbad or Oceanside I always recommend they spend their sundays here. A wonderful, welcoming, and warm church. They seek first and foremost to glorify God, and show how to enjoy Him forever by grace through faith in His Son, Christ Jesus. I love this congregation so much. I was a visitor, and I was welcomed in not as an outsider, but as a brother in Christ. Their Biblical hospitality was matched by sound, and faithful teaching of God’s Word, unapologetically. I thank God that in a world marked by compromise, that God sustains congregations like this one to spread the Light to the world. My family attended Oceanside URC in the recent past—our second son was baptized here. This congregation is genuinely unique in that you will find solid scriptural preaching, hospitality, and a tight-knit community which takes the Lord's worship AND loving one another seriously. If you become a member here you WILL make friends who will look after you. You WILL have a pastor and elders who are regularly involved in caring for your family's spiritual welfare. You WILL break bread with your congregation every Sunday. You WILL experience historic protestant catholicity in word, sacrament, and worship. You WILL hear the Word preached faithfully and the Gospel clearly proclaimed.

The Rev. Dr. Danny Hyde is a gem who is uniquely gifted as both a pastor and a scholar, which is a very rare combination to find in a local church today. If you are looking to grow in Christ you need to give this church your first visit. My church fam at Oceanside URC, where the gospel of our King is faithfully preached in love! Christ-centered teaching from the Scriptures, and worship of our Triune God in song and prayer, in word and sacrament. "In Him, we have redemption through His blood, and the forgiveness of our sins, all according to the riches of His grace" (Eph 1:7).

We enjoy learning of and sharing in the richness of our historic Christian faith through the ages, and as confessed in the Three Forms of Unity. A warm, welcoming congregation, serving our merciful God; we look forward to meeting you soon! Oceanside United Reformed Church its an oasis in the mids of desert of shallow Christianity. It was an answer to our prayers  for our family to find a solid Reformed and Confessional church. Committed to historicity of the church, confessing the catholic and ecumenical Creeds of Christianity (Nicene Creed, Athanasian Creed, Apostles creed ). We partake of the Lord's Supper every Lord's Day. Wonderful Church family, very hospitable. If you are seeking a faithful Gospel centered church, that takes the gospel and scripture seriously, you will be gladly welcome!

name: OCGrace Church
OCGrace Church - Garden Grove Campus
reviewSummary:
OCGrace Church is a wonderful place to worship, grow in faith, and experience a welcoming community. From the moment you walk in, everyone is friendly, kind, and genuinely caring. The messages are inspiring, Bible-centered, and easy to apply to everyday life.

The worship is uplifting, and the atmosphere is warm, peaceful, and filled with God’s presence. Whether you’re new to church or have been attending for years, you’ll feel accepted and encouraged here.

I’m grateful for this church and the amazing people who make it such a special place. If you’re looking for a church where you can grow spiritually, build meaningful relationships, and feel at home, I highly recommend OCGrace Church. God is truly at work here. 🙏❤️✝️ If you want a nice comfortable place to worship, this is the place to be. God's word is shared here. And the congregation is incredibly loving and caring. I see people walking in and someone greets them and ask them their name and learn a little bit about them if there's time. This is a bible-believing Christian Church where the Bible is absolute word of God. Today is Paster Day! We all thankful of your teaching everyday we received wisdom and Love of GOD through you guys!!! THANK YOU! Nice people and best place to worship in OC. Let's make this clear: I am not a Seventh Day Adventist. I grew up in a traditional Buddhist family. However, I've always been open-minded and curious about other religions. I started going to this church because my girlfriend is an SDA. I must say, the experience has been transformative and enlightening. Everyone at this church has been super friendly and extremely welcoming. They do not push their religion down your throat, yet they focus on change and action through devotion, service, and community. They have a new pastor, Pastor Jonny, who has been doing wondrous work for the church and the community. His sermons are so insightful, empowering, and reflective. This church is made even more special by all the members. They are so devoted to the church to making each Sabbath a special service - to the Audio/Visual team, to the Lights/Sound team, to the Praise/Worship team - they all put their heart and soul to spread their faith and love for God. If you are an SDA family visiting in town nearby, or just a non-denominational religious person,  or even a curious non-religious person/family who is missing something in their life/lives, come check out one Saturday service. You will be renewed and rejuvenated!

name: Old Town Community Church
Old Town Community Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
It's a good food bank; they give out food, including lots of fruits and vegetables. Went there, couple months ago, it was a basic food distribution place, nothing special about it, no different than the Salvation Army or other food banks in other places.
What really surprised me is that you see nothing but Filipinos!.. why is that???... Is this a Filipino Church???... I mean it's in the heart of Classic Western themes, culture and heritage, such as Old Town, which is American, Mexican and Native American culture.
All of the people giving out the food were all Pingoys!

Why is that??... Where is the diversity???

I didn't see any White, no Black,no Hispanics, no Middle Eastern, no Asian people, except for the 100 % Filipino presence.

It seemed strange. I guess I would like to see more diversity.

2025 update, Came back again recently, and the Filipinos take all the best food for themselves!...

As soon as you see 1 or more Filipinos, you know that they are taking all of the good stuff, all the best meat and cheese and fruits and vegetables. I have seen how they park separately and away from public eyes, and earlier that most and they get food carts full of the best food, and when Black, Hispanics and Whites compe over to get food, all of the best food is gone because they take it!...

Please make it a more diverse atmosphere, not just Filipino, it's Old Town, it's mainly Spanish, Mexican, Anglo and Native American place and Historical park. Why are there so many Filipinos involved!..

Is it a Filipino church or something?? Pastor had a great message. Christ is King! Food Distribution is Open Wednesdays.

From 9:00am thru 3:00pm. Nice small community church in Old Town. They have food distribution Mon-Wed. 12-3. They members are so nice

name: Olive Branch Church & School
Olive Branch Church & School - Corona Campus
reviewSummary:
I have two kids one in fourth and one in sixth grade. and I’m currently a teachers aid for the kindergarten class. I thank God every day for a safe place for my kids to learn I never have to worry about what’s being taught, not only in academics but also in learning about Gods love for us. Olive branch has so many nice and loving staff to help  the kiddos learn to love live and share christ! They offer after school daycare, new enrichment classes being offered to homeschool families, competitive sports, kindergarten just got a brand new playground, I could literally go on and on! I am so grateful to have Olive Branch, they are like a family to us! Olive Branch Christian School is truly a gem! The school provides a well-rounded education that nurtures students academically, spiritually, and socially. The strong church partnership with creates a Christ-centered environment where students grow in both faith and knowledge. The academics are rigorous yet engaging, with dedicated teachers who challenge and support students to reach their full potential. Beyond the classroom, the school offers enriching extracurricular activities, a caring community, and a culture that fosters both character and leadership. We are beyond grateful to be part of such a loving and inspiring school family! Olive Branch School has been a home away from home for my three children over the last eight years, with my son graduating from 8th grade last year. The teachers and staff care deeply—not just about academics, but about the whole child. They create a nurturing environment where students feel seen, supported, and encouraged to grow both intellectually and personally.

The small class sizes allow for individualized attention, and the dedication of the faculty is evident in the way they pour into each student. Beyond academics, the school fosters strong values, character development, and a true sense of community. It’s a place where my children have not only thrived in their education but have also built meaningful friendships and lasting memories.

If you’re looking for a school that prioritizes both excellence in education and the heart of a child, Olive Branch is truly something special. We are so grateful to be part of this community! My family and I moved to Corona from OC and we tried a few churches in the area and we fell in love with Olive Branch Church it was warm and everyone was so welcoming. We especially liked that it was verse by verse teaching straight from the bible, it was exactly what our hearts needed. Our littles loved coming every Sunday.
When we learned that they had a school we were really excited to help give our kids a solid foundation all while building a community here at our home church.
My kids have been coming here for the last 3 years, I love watching them grow in their knowledge but even more so in their love for Jesus. All the teachers here are incredible and pour God's love into every child daily. So grateful for Olive Branch Church & School. My son Noah loves Olive Branch Christian School. Everyday he attends school he runs up to his classroom and is so excited to be there. All of the teachers and staff are outstanding! They are so compassionate, committed and truly caring to all of the students and parents. We are truly thankful to be apart of the school. Noah is sad to be graduating preschool because he has had such a phenomenal experience but excited to be apart of the school age group. I highly recommend Olive Branch School. I love how dedicated everyone is. It’s amazing how the kids can learn and grow to be close to the Lord too. We serve a good God. Blessings, The Biggs Family

name: Olympic Presbyterian Church (올림픽장로교회)
Olympic Presbyterian Church (올림픽장로교회) - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a Korean church. Good pastor and good people who love God and purple. This is a Spirit-filled church focused on knowing Jesus Christ. Good pastors The session musicians and three female vocalists began the service with a preparatory hymn for the second service. It was impressive to see the choir build harmonies from the middle of the opening hymn after the preparatory hymn, creating a rich sound.

Afterward, the Senior Pastor led the service. The way the congregation moved around the sanctuary to fellowship, rather than conducting the fellowship time merely as a formality, was a symbolic aspect of this church's worship. The order of service that followed followed a traditional format.

The Pastor delivered his message by interpreting the Bible and incorporating anecdotes about his own spiritual parents.

There seemed to be fewer instances of the congregation empathizing and responding with "Amen" than expected. I did not find anything particularly special in the sermon. After the message, a prayer of commitment was offered aloud, but the congregation's prayers did not seem as earnest as the sound of the Pastor's prayer. Although it appeared that the message of the day's scripture, 1 Samuel Chapter 1, was not conveyed effectively, the overall atmosphere of the church was one of welcoming and embracing the congregation. During the offering time, a special piano performance was followed by the presentation of gifts. It felt different from other churches that the praise team and choir accompanist were men. A place where excellent ministers equipped with the Word and spirituality, and saints who always serve with the labor of love and joy, are building and dreaming of a beautiful community of Christ. I highly recommend it.

My family and I are very happy we found this church. What a miraculous church and place where I feel the presence of God. The service is beautiful and the worship is absolutely amazing.

I love it here. It is my church! I visited the church on Sunday and really enjoyed the service.  The people are nice and I felt God's presence during the service. My wife and I visited One City Church and from the moment we entered through those doors, it felt like home.

name: One Community Church
One Community Church - Plano Campus
reviewSummary: I’ve been visiting this church  and I’ve never heard a message on repentance,  the second coming of Christ, sexual immorality, people living in sin, the rapture of the church, Bible prophecy, the tribulation, the mark of the beast, nothing along those lines.  People need to be aware of what’s forth coming  so they can accept Christ and not be left behind.  This church has a conference almost every month for ticket sales, but no mention of repentance and turning from sin and righteous living.  This is why the Bible speaks of lukewarm Christians and many will be deceived and left behind.   The praise and worship is good, but there is something missing in the message.  The church is packed however I wonder if the people are really aware of what’s next on God’s timetable, which is the rapture.  The preaching seems scripted and full of stage props.  Jesus didn’t need props or displays to relay the gospel and neither did his disciples.  The church is ran more like a business than true discipleship.  On my first visit I was totally disrespected by one of the parking agents because I forgot to turn on my blinker.  He stopped me and chewed me out and literally embarrassed me and my daughter.  I couldn’t believe it.  I overlooked the incident and still decided to go back.  I think now this isn’t the place for me and my family.  They have many locations around the city but no meat in the word. Preach Repentance. Jesus is coming back and the people need to be prepared.  Remember the 10 virgins in the Bible. name: Ontario United Reformed Church
Ontario United Reformed Church - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
I came to this church after searching for faithful, reverent worship and clear, uncompromising gospel preaching. I didn’t want politics from the pulpit I wanted to be taught the Word of God with depth, care, and conviction.

From my very first visit, it was clear this church takes Scripture seriously. The preaching is careful, consistent, and deeply rooted in the text. Over the past four years, I’ve grown more here both intellectually and spiritually than anywhere else I’ve been.

The men of this church, both the pastors and the congregation, have personally invested in me. There’s a real sense of brotherhood, accountability, and Christ-like love that is rare today.

By God’s grace, I’ve now been accepted into seminary, and I can truly say this church played a major role in that. I wasn’t just attending I was being shaped and discipled.

If you’re looking for a church that prioritizes reverence in worship, serious biblical teaching, and genuine Christian community, this is the place. They love Christ, and you see it clearly in how they love one another.
Highly recommended. Love this church! Awesome leadership and body of loving, welcoming members. Great fellowship opportunities, various events and seminars for individuals seeking an involved, passionate community of believers.
I highly recommend this to become your church home! Come let your faith be strengthened by pure biblical preaching, where you can partake in the pure administration of the sacraments with reverent worship and edifying fellowship. Pastors Taylor and Daniel are faithful servants of God who faithfully preach the whole counsel of God. I am incredibly thankful for the expository, Christ-centered proclamation of the gospel which lifts my eyes to Christ Jesus. After years of feeling spiritually restless at a large non-denominational church—plenty of energy, not enough roots—I found Ontario United Reformed Church in Ontario, CA and, over time, became a member.

The difference was immediate. Worship is ordered and unhurried, shaped entirely by Scripture. The preaching is expository—the text sets the agenda, and the pastor follows it. The congregation sings from the Psalter, which took some getting used to but now feels natural and deeply spiritually fitting.

Membership isn’t a formality. The membership class,  walks through church history, church government, and Reformed doctrine—you come to membership knowing what you believe, why you believe it, and what you’re committing to.

With Sunday morning and evening services, a Spanish service after the morning worship, and Sunday school, there are consistent opportunities to grow week after week.

No performance. No padding. Just God’s Word, faithfully preached and sung by a congregation that means it.

If you’re looking for a Reformed church in Ontario, CA that is grounded in Scripture and focused on Christ, come visit and experience a traditional service for yourself. Biblical preaching
Confessionally reformed
Strong community of believers.

reviewSummary:
This is a great place to get free food on every Thursday 10am to 12 pm everyone is welcome
PS I volunteer there and I enjoyed meeting new people It felt great to attend after years of being gone. Have you ever walked into a church loved the sermon but didn’t feel the warmth or smiles of the people around you and walked out feeling alone? Well not here you feel refreshed, loved and accepted and the hand shakes are genuine. It’s what I expected coming back to my home church nothing less. Pastor and his wife have hearts of Gold. Thank you OC First Assembly of God for sharing the love and salvation through Christ Jesus! 🙏 Sermon's are preached from the Bible....  Teaching is from the bible.... reviewSummary:

Nice people good message

name: Orchard Community Church
Orchard Community Church - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary: We love this church! Orchard has been our home church for a few years - there is great bible-based teaching from Pastor Assad every Sunday and fun kids and youth programs on Sundays and throughout the week too. Great AWANA program on Thursday nights. We have found a strong sense of community here. This is the friendliest church I have ever been to.  Dr. Asaad, Pastor and his wife, Summer, are so welcoming all the time setting the tone.  You can relax and be yourself, wearing whatever you like.    The children from age birth through high school have a great time too.  There are groups to join for everyone if you want to get involved.  I drive miles and mile just to heard the word of God from my pastor who loves us all. The Orchard Church is not just a wonderful church to worship, its home. A place that is welcoming & embracing of who you are & meets you where you are, committed to teaching & walking along side you by doing life with you in fellowship & discipleship. The Orchard church Pastor & Church Family has been a blessing to my entire family & I pray you come to check it out. The most welcoming, friendly, diverse church where there is always something for someone (kids, youth, women, men, and families). I just moved to the area in July and this was the first church I attended and didn’t need to attend another church. I knew I could call this place home. This church is so warm and welcoming. Great kids programs Sunday mornings and youth programs Sundays & Wednesdays. The pastor is committed to Bible teaching and he cares deeply for his church family. This church is all about sharing the love of Jesus. They are serving the community through weekly food distribution and various fun events like Trunk or Treat and the Christmas Tree lighting!

name: Osborne Neighborhood Church
Osborne Neighborhood Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary:
To see the Israeli flag flying outside a place of worship, a place meant to offer refuge, peace, and moral clarity intentionally or not, it signals a blind eye to the immense suffering of oppressed Palestinian people. For many, it feels like a betrayal of the very values the church is meant to stand for: justice, compassion, and the sacredness of human life.

Right now, we are witnessing a humanitarian catastrophe, the destruction of entire families, neighborhoods, and lives. Over 30,000 plus Palestinians, many of them children, have been killed. Homes, hospitals, and places of worship have been reduced to rubble. For those of us watching this unfold, the pain is indescribable.

The trauma spans generations.

I hope you will reflect deeply on whether this is truly the message you want to send not only to your congregation, but to those crying out for dignity, justice, and the basic right to live. Osborne Church showed me true Christ’s love. I was on my way to a mission trip alone from VA to Mexico, however Osborne Church had one empty seat, and without even knowing me welcomed me to join them. The trip down there and back in their van, being at the orphanage and staying with their group, and doing ministry with them was spiritually uplifting and healing - it was VERY encouraging to find and spend time with true Christ followers who loved so well. Pastor Ryan and his family demonstrate the Lords love very well- along with the congregation- so many to mention! They touched my life. They are what we need more of in this world. If I lived in CA, I would attend, but I definitely recommend to anyone and everyone in that area! These people really love the Lord! They are concerned about their fellow man/woman and delve into prayer for each other quickly. Pastor Ryan has a passion for God and an incredible knowledge of the Bible. He has a wife and 4 kids which makes his perspective valid, fun, and interesting. If you are looking for a church for you and your family, I would highly recommend you attend on Sunday. You will find people that care about you and you will gain insight into the Bible. They have sunday school for all ages and a large remodeled nursery and toddler room. Each summer they have an INCREDIBLE vacation bible school. One of the workers takes her vacation time each year to participate because she loves it so much. The church is perfect in size. It's not too big to be lost in the crowd. It is not a small church either. It's just large enough for you to participate in a variety of activities. I would recommend this church. This is a great place to meet friendly and lively people. Everyone is so welcoming and the minute you walk in you feel like family. They really know how to love people well. They have ministries for all ages like young adult, youth group, and children’s and adult groups. They take missions trips and support missionaries around the world. If you’re looking for a place to feel like you’re home, check out Osborne! This church is extremely family oriented. The young adult leaders are totally personal and the meeting time on Monday nights is really good. Great worship, amazing teaching, and the people there are very welcoming. They even go out afterwards to hang out and eat to get to know everyone better! Super awesome.

name: Our Lady of Angels Church
Our Lady of Angels Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: In my ongoing journey to experience all the Catholic churches in San Diego County, Our Lady of Angels stole the show. Ample, well-lit parking made the arrival stress-free, and the wide doorways and readily available ramps ensured everyone felt welcome. But it was the heart of the church that truly impressed me. The warm sunlight cascading through stained glass windows illuminated a serene sanctuary, and the air buzzed with a gentle hum of quiet prayers. Father's homily wasn't just informative, it was a tapestry woven with personal anecdotes and profound wisdom that resonated deep within me. I left feeling uplifted and connected, like I had found a hidden gem in the heart of San Diego. Thank you, Our Lady of Angels, for reminding me of the beauty of faith and community. Our Lady of Angels Church, in San Diego's Sherman Heights neighborhood, is a beautiful example of Gothic Revival architecture. Established as San Diego's second Catholic parish, the church has been a spiritual center for the community since its founding. The building's distinctive design features pointed arches and intricate detailing, characteristic of the Gothic Revival style. A beautiful building! Love this parish. name: Our Lady of Lourdes Catholic Church
Our Lady of Lourdes Catholic Church - Main Campus
Our Lady of Lourdes Church
Our Lady of Lourdes Church - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
I’m not writing this lightly.

I was an altar server here between roughly 2003 to 2005 when Sister Angela and Father Bob were still part of the parish. Back then, this church was thriving. There were a ton of altar servers, strong community involvement, and it genuinely felt like a place people belonged.

Father Bob, from my direct experience, was someone I respected and trusted. He was present, approachable, and played a meaningful role in my life growing up. Being an altar server here was one of the highlights of my childhood.

Years later, I ran into former members and was told that Father Bob had been removed under allegations of misconduct. I can only speak from my own experience, but I never witnessed anything inappropriate during my time serving. Hearing that, and then later finding out he passed away, was honestly upsetting.

Over time, and after reconnecting with people who were around back then, I have come to question how everything unfolded and who was involved. Certain names, like Alicia, kept coming up in conversations about that period and the direction the parish took afterward. I will not claim to know every detail, but it is hard to ignore the patterns people describe.

Fast forward to now, my experience with the current parish has been completely different.

I recently reached out to get a form signed so I could baptize my daughter at the church we attend now. My entire family has roots here, baptisms, communions, years of involvement, so I did not expect any issues. Instead, I was told Father Clarence was too busy, and the process was essentially stalled. At the same time, I was encouraged to just do the baptism there instead.

That did not sit right with me.

On top of that, there are already public concerns out there about Father Clarence’s leadership. There is a Change.org petition titled “Remove Father Clarence Saldua from Our Lady of Lourdes” that outlines complaints from parents and members of the school community regarding his involvement, communication, and relationship with the school. Anyone can look it up and read it for themselves.

Between my own experience and seeing concerns like that publicly shared by others, it paints a very different picture of what this church used to be.

The overall atmosphere now feels closed off. It no longer feels like a community. It feels like unless you are already part of a certain circle, you are on the outside.

That is not the church I grew up in.

What used to be a welcoming, community driven place now feels like something very different. And for those of us who remember what it was, that is honestly hard to see.

My family and I felt very bad and are wondering if the Asian priest is like this with everyone or not, but it was extremely rude of him, will not forget and will not go back.

reviewSummary:
I have never had the opportunity to visit here, but throughout the years I continuously hear good things about this church from many different people. If I were in Long Beach, I would love to visit this church My family and I attended this church for about a year, and overall, we loved it. I gave my life to the Lord in May of 2014, but I found this church in 2018. It wasn’t until the beginning of 2024 that I committed to attending regularly. I felt God tugging at my heart and calling me to make this commitment, so I started attending, and soon after, my wife and son joined me.

This church has a very tight-knit community where most members seem to have grown up together. While that creates a sense of familiarity and unity, it can make it difficult for newcomers to build relationships. There were a few individuals who really went out of their way to connect with us, and one standout was Joseph, the assistant pastor. Joseph genuinely cared about building a relationship with my family and made an effort to make us feel welcome. I also attended Joseph’s class, which was a great opportunity to engage and grow spiritually.

However, I had a different experience with one of the leaders. On more than one occasion, I tried to start a conversation, but the leader often walked away or didn’t seem interested in connecting. To clarify, I wasn’t looking for validation from men, but I believe it’s important to build a relationship with those we choose to have a significant influence in our lives.

One thing to note is that being a part of this family of believers requires baptism. Despite the challenges in connecting with that leader, I still grew tremendously in my personal relationship with God during my time at this church. A major transformation happened in my life because I really zoned in on what God was calling me to have faith in.

To anyone joining this church, or any church for that matter, I encourage you to take your relationship with God seriously. Don’t make it about you and man, but about you and God. Take every step in faith and involve God in all your decision-making. Most importantly, make sure you are spending more time in the Word of God than with anyone or anywhere else to ensure you’re grounded in the truth.

name: Pacific Beach Christian Church
Pacific Beach Christian Church - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary:
My family and I have been attending Pacific Beach Christian Church since 2019, and it has truly been one of the greatest blessings we’ve found. From the very first Sunday, we were welcomed with open arms by a warm, loving, and genuinely inclusive community. “All are welcome” isn’t just something they say here—it’s something they live.
We’ve watched our kids grow up in this church, supported by a wonderful youth ministry that gives them guidance, friendship, and a sense of belonging. The facility is beautiful and well-kept, making it a comfortable and uplifting place to worship every week.
We absolutely love Pastor Brian. His messages, kindness, and leadership make PB Christian Church feel like family to us.
If you’re looking for a church home where you’ll be truly welcomed and supported, this is it. Highly recommend! 🙏💙 Pacific Beach Christian Church is a truly special place. Many many years ago I visited several churches with my daughter while searching for a community that felt genuine, and we recently returned here again. From the moment you walk in, you feel welcomed. The people are kind, the location is beautiful, and the sense of community is real. It genuinely feels like a family. The teachings stay true to what Jesus taught, and what I appreciate most is that there’s no hierarchy or “first-class section” here—just real people gathering together in faith. A real church with a real heart. Pacific Beach Christian Church has a truly warm, family-like atmosphere that makes everyone feel welcome from the moment they walk in. The congregation is friendly, supportive, and genuinely cares about one another, creating a strong sense of community that’s hard to find. Whether you’re attending a Sunday service, participating in a small group, or bringing your children to activities, there is a clear focus on faith, kindness, and connection. It’s a place where people of all ages can grow spiritually while building meaningful relationships, and many who attend quickly feel like they’ve found a second family. My time at Pacific Beach Christian Church began when my parents started attending before I was born.  Growing up in the church, I always had a sense that the congregation was my extended family, which makes Pacific Beach Christian Church so meaningful to me; it’s family.  Having a family that can bond around faith, and project that faith to serve the wider community has resonated with me as far back as I can remember.  From the uplifting Sunday worship service, to the community outreach, children and youth ministries, along with being an open and affirming church to all, my family and I are proud to be apart of and to serve with Pacific Beach Christian Church. For the first time in my life I look forward to going to church…walking in the door I feel good energy…genuine caring people…diversity…and the pastor is amazing!

name: Pacific Church of Irvine
Pacific Church of Irvine - Irvine (University) Campus
reviewSummary: The most kid friendly church in Orange County! In addition to Sunday school, they have kids involved in many ministries on Sundays serving alongside adults who love and teach them about Jesus. It's a very special place! The sound booth photo is of my husband and my son on a Sunday morning. If you are looking for a family friendly church and place to belong, come to PCI! We love pastor Seth’s teaching and small church feel. My family has attended Pacific Church for over 10 years, and the best way that I can describe this church is as extension of our family.  This church is not a church for the "have-it-all-together" people.  This church is a church for real people that have regular issues and every-day problems.  Pastor Seth is so down to earth and teaches from real life experience with wisdom and humility. You feel at home right away, plus you learn and grow so much through shared experiences and struggles.  This is a small church and everyone is friendly, outgoing and inviting. Folks are invested in each other's lives. We have built lasting life-long relationships here and are blessed to call this church home! I am blessed to have been part of this church community since I moved to Orange County as a college student in 1988. What I love most about Pacific is that it's a place where I can be honest about my struggles and brokenness, and experience the grace and unconditional love of Jesus as demonstrated through His people. Bible-centered teaching by our pastors will encourage and challenge you to grow and apply God's Word to your everyday life. Sunday worship will empower you to walk faithfully throughout the week. The relationships I have with my multi-generational PCI family have benefited me, my husband, my marriage and my children. I cannot say enough good things about how God has used this church in my life. I hope you will join us and discover for yourself what I have already experienced! We've been going here for about 15 years, and our growth has been awesome.  Great family atmostphere, with a humble pastor, awesome worship, and a youth ministry that has encouraged our son to follow God.  This is not a place to get lost in the crowd, but rather, a place to belong, fellowship, and learn your purpose in God's Master Plan.
