reviewSummary:
Wonderfully kind, welcoming and enthusiastic group of people.  The music was well-done, but not over-the-top.  They had new members join the Sunday we were there, and one of them was baptized, which was sweet and moving.  Diverse group of people.  The sermon was biblical and proclaimed the Gospel.  If we lived in the area, we would be be regular attenders or members. As a first-time visitor to Santa Monica while on vacation, I absolutely loved my visit to Pacific Crossroads Church! The church was warm and welcoming to me, and they definitely seem to have a heart for Jesus and for their community of Santa Monica and the greater Los Angeles area, doing service projects to serve those in need. I loved the opportunity to worship Jesus with a family of believers from many diverse cultures, taking Communion together, worshiping the Lord together, being edified by God’s Word, and lifting up the name of Jesus! Was deeply impacted by both the worship and outstanding message when visiting family in the area in February 2026 — incredible, moving, Christ-  centered experience I love this church! I’ve been attending for about a month  and a half now. I’m very reserved and I always attend by myself. I was welcomed by so many people they are so kind and so caring. I always feel welcomed even if I’m a bit more quiet. The message feels super to the point and we all share a love for the community in the church and as well as around us 🫶❤️ I'm in my 40's.  The way I'd describe this church is like my parent's church or maybe even my parent's parent's church.  And not because it's lacking any hipster coolness or relevance in that modern sense.

But it's very much a studious, in-the-box Christianity from the 80-90's era.  Things are sterile here.  The worship is very technical (like get things right) but lacking heart and Spirit.  I know, I know, it's Presbyterian.  But yeah, it's very much that.  Frozen chosen cringe.

But I think that's why those who attend, remain.  There may be a bit of nostalgia from past-time or perhaps comfort.  It just feels like something these Christians are used to.  It makes sense since the leadership picked a new pastor that aligns with this.  The sermon was lots of logos, bereft of ethos and pathos.

The redeeming part about this church, and I think why so many families are here, is that the children's and youth program are the true heart and soul of the church.  I have friends here where Gloria has taken the time to become inclusive.  P. Joe is also very  down to earth and relevant.  The youth enjoy being around him.

This church is so out-of-place and out-of-time in 2023 post-covid, post-evangelical mileu.  And no, I don't mean timeless.

From an ops standpoint, they also need more signs, more people to welcome and direct new people.  It feels very much like a "you should just know" culture for people who already show up there.  The kids check-in system also seemed to utilize outdated software which was confusing for those running it.

Overall faith is intellectualized here instead of embodied.

name: Pacific Hills Calvary Chapel
Pacific Hills Calvary Chapel - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: What's not to say...I've been here for decades...Dave's biblical -book by book- teachings are great. The good and the "hard to hear" commentary..."the feel good" and the convicting. Strictly bible based teaching; the teaching that encourages YOU to read your bible. The worship is top notch...understated. It's about the Lord...not them...spirit led. Always feel welcomed...Nancy is so warm and friendly at the door...Mike (usher) and others are  great. Special events are the norm...outreaches...volunteering too....and the coffee is good and hot! Two thumbs way up 👍👍 If you're looking for a church to tell you the Truth, teach you, challenge you in your walk, and hold you accountable, this is your church. I came several years ago for the men's morning study, and found a congregation of men with decades of service and endless knowledge of the Bible and of God. Then there's the lead pastor David, you won't find a more sound teacher. Through the Bible from a historical, and personal perspective from a lifetime of devotion to ministry of others. There are many sound churches in Orange County, but this one stands out. Eric, Jim, Jerry, and Ken are some of the pastors and retired pastors available at every service. I'm now on the other side of the continent, but feel this needed to be posted to help direct anyone searching for a church. Was invited for their Easter service.  Very well organized, welcoming, immaculate and has a very relaxed vibe. I want to go here but haven't I live right inside gate 3 about two blocks away. I'm sure it's awesome inside. I’ve never been there in person to Pacific Hills in South Orange County. However, I do like listening to Dave Rolf, the senior pastor, as his Bible teaching style is very unique. Dave is a brilliant man and has a very interesting take on so many scripture passages. I think he’s probably getting ready to retire, so he’s not teaching every week, unfortunately. He follows in the footsteps of our spiritual father, Chuck Smith of Calvary Chapel, Costa Mesa. Dave also is still on K wave radio 107.9 FM.

Pastor John teaches the cross centered life that every Christian needs to know “ Jesus died on the cross for your sin to bring you back into fellowship with God” Pacific Hope Church changed my life. God is good. My husband and I have been looking for a Church like this! Small and family oriented. A great place to worship. Pastor John Leeder is a wonderful pastor and we love the way he conveys the Word!! Love this place of worship. Sound doctrine, right Theology. Many ministries for the body to grow and serve. Christ exalting church with great biblical teaching, and wonderful fellowship. Excellent place of prayer for the nations! Reformed theology.  Christ centered theology.  You'll be hard pressed to find a church that preaches the Gospel as faithfully as you'll find here.

name: Pacific Life Church
Pacific Life Church - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary: I have been attending services here for about 10 years (even before it was called PLC) and absolutely love it! Once you’ve heard one of Pastor Steve’s messages you will want to hear more! Come as you are. Everyone is super chill. Pacific life church is a “come as you are” church with great worship music and a great community. The messages are powerful and relevant to our everyday lives. I highly recommend checking out PLC! Pacific Life Church has become our family’s new home over the past couple of years. Its warm community of people have made us feel welcomed and genuinely cared for. They provide a great youth group for our teen, and a fun Sunday school program for our 9 yr old. The worship music is great and Pastor Steve and his staff deliver uplifting scripture filled messages every Sunday.  We love the casual-come as you are vibe, the laughter, love and friendships we have through Pacific Life Church. Great messages, small church, so you can get to know people. Great music. Great small friendly church. Come as you are, wear flip flops and shorts and fit right in! Pastor Steve is a great speaker and the messages are relevant for today. You won't feel lost, definitely NOT a "megachurch".

name: Pacific Point Church
Pacific Point Church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
Just standard church to go with good sermon. Wish it uses less sarcasm though. Alright welcome to get through as could just be more than saying hi. Looks nicely open yet lack enough groups during the week. If you want to connect with people and keep it Biblical, this is your church! We're "Salty" not "Churchy" and we'd love to see you there!

I've been attending over 14 years, and we are a family at PPC!  Come, the way you are, worship with us, visit us, grow with us!

There is child care, kids church, worship, donuts-we got you! Life groups and events are great ways to connect!

Love to see you, we have young couples to connect with, and every other age in between, diverse and welcoming! Hope to see you!🙏❤️ Pastor John Blue is inspirational and humorous. His family are there and everyone is friendly. It is an educational and a rewarding social experience. Thanks to the Lord.

Pacific Southwest District-LCMS - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary: This office is filled with brilliant, warm-hearted, fiddly people who are so helpful in guiding others in their walk with God. Best district of the LCMS

Pacifica Synod of the Evangelical Lutheran Church - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary: I really appreciate the work of the Synod.  They want every church to succeed and are looking for unconventional ways to make that happen.  Thank you, Bishop Dave and all of the Synod office family. Beautiful building, custom design, courtyard and water feature. Excelent service It's a very nice and very clean place.

name: Packinghouse Church
Packinghouse Church - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary:
I like pastor Ed, he didn't speak on Father's Day me and my family that went on Father's Day thought it was so weird to talk about a eunuch on Father's Day Teaching God's Word through many ministries and excellent pastors,teachers and staff! The Packinghouse Church also has a very welcoming and comfortable feeling and those that attend are very nice people and family friendly! They have an excellent teen and young people ministry at the Packinghouse Church if you have kids or teens! God is good and so is the Packinghouse Church in Redlands California!
.

.
#packinghouse #packinghousechurch #godsword #biblestudy #jesussaves #packinghousechurchredlands #ilovejesus
#beblessed #readgodsword #jesus #calvarychapel #seetheusa #pureword Paster Ed has a great way of making things understandable and relatable.  People have tried to greet and speak with me but I'm adhd with tourettes so I try to avoid being too social as I'm not good with carrying conversations.  I wish that wasn't so. But I digressed.

Is a great church. Stars?
I snuck in and sat where I used to sit last Sunday: I didn't see Eve, I didn't see Kelley and I barely saw myself.
I love this church, I really do and I apologize for not being emotionally mature enough to approach leadership when it might have made a difference.
Feeling like I am one of the original kids from the Costa Mesa movement all those years ago affords me a special spot on the telephone wire. All the popular "mega-church" campuses are waning. It's not the buildings fault either.
I would love to help but honestly, after having done relatively nothing while feeling like I gave it all I had, what's left?
I'b he happy to come sweep the parking lot. I mean that in the most sincere and loving way, metaphorically AND literally.
I did find out one of my students from long ago, a student I loved and taught is now a ballerina and that warmed my soul. Michael was going to be a pastor and Alex was my little discerner that wanted his dad to do better. I miss it so much and I love you all. Took our youth group to the youth led youth rally and it was such a blessing.  Can't wait for the next years rally.

name: Palm City Church
Palm City Church - Tampa Palms Campus
reviewSummary:
My family and I have been at Palm City for almost 3 years now and we have truly found a home here. God has drastically changed our lives through the people of Palm City in which I am forever grateful for. My husband and I along with our middle schooler serve on the best grow team and our youngest two children attend an awesome and purpose filled children’s ministry. You won’t regret visiting Palm City and your life just might change in the best way possible! Palm city has been such a special place for our family! We love the Bagwells. We love to serve here. Myself, my husband and our oldest daughter have all been baptized at Palm city. We’ve made so many friends and connected with lots of families 💚 Palm City has been my family’s church for about 3 years. It is a Bible-based church with a pastor whose messages are direct yet tempered with humor. The church family is friendly and welcoming and there are ample opportunities to serve- whether in-house or outreach to the community. At last count there were about 30 different City Groups to join. These cover a gamut of interests; whether you are a wanting to learn more about the Bible, or just looking for friends to meet for lunch. Either way, you will meet friends who will quickly become your church family! My wife and I have had an overwhelmingly positive experience at Palm city church. I am very grateful for the impact it has had on my entire family’s life and spiritual growth. From the very first visit, We felt a genuine sense of belonging, a feeling that I have never experienced in prior churches. My wife and I can truly say we found a true church family. You will feel the strong sense of community with amazing people.

One of the greatest values of Palm city church is its commitment to helping people become followers of Jesus Christ. The message is consistently grounded in Scripture, offering clear, thoughtful, and practical guidance for renewing the mind and applying biblical truth to everyday life. Each message enhances a deeper understanding of the Bible and strengthens personal faith.

The worship experience is another highlight. The music is uplifting, heartfelt, and Christ-centered, creating an atmosphere that draws people into authentic praise and worship. It’s both inspiring and refreshing each week.

Families with children will especially appreciate the excellent palm city kid’s area. It is well organized, safe, and led by caring people who are genuinely invested in helping children learn about God in a fun and meaningful way.

Palm city church has a wonderful safety team that makes parents feel at ease during the message.

Overall, this church has provided me with community, spiritual growth, and a sense of purpose. I highly recommend palm city church to anyone who is seeking a place to connect, grow, and strengthen their walk with Christ.

If you are looking for a home church this Easter, look no further and strengthen your relationship with Jesus Christ at Palm city church! I LOVE PALM CITY. It only took one visit at Palm City for me to realize this church was where I belonged. It has become so much more than just a church to me- at palm city i have found true community, confidence & a new love for life that I never expected. Pastor Brian challenges you to grow beyond being a lukewarm, Sunday-only Christian, all while bringing humor and authenticity to every message. There is no judgment here, just encouragement to spiritually grow into the best version of yourself. I can’t thank Palm City enough for the opportunities they’ve given me & the growth they have inspired in every aspect of my life.

name: Palm Harvest Church
Palm Harvest Church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
This place has caused my family only suffering with the way too loud music blaring into the night on weekdays and through the weekends. There’s no number to call to ask them to turn down the amps, stop the drumming, and to quiet the absolute worst singing of all time into the mic. Worst church. Oh man, the BLASTING live band is killing me!
Tonight they've got the amps and base full force and the infrasound is legit vibrating my chest and skull.
I want to barf it hurts!!
WED NIGHT 8:45 PM
JULY 8, 2025 Not sure which church uses this facility on Wednesday nights, but it is a man straight up yelling into a mic in the evenings and it's extremely aggressive and loud (even with my windows shut).

If you're looking at apartments near here, don't do it. Most ANNOYING part of this neighborhood, it's not peaceful by any means. Every day there is a different service going on, and children play there after school so there really isn't a time for quietness. I attended this past Sunday and as a Costa Mesa native you will be right at home. Super chill place to grow and fellowship. What can I say about this church? I've been a member since the first time I met it. I knew I was in the perfect place, but I won't say much more than to recommend it. See for yourselves if you have any doubts.

name: Palomar Japanese Baptist Church
Palomar Japanese Baptist Church - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary: There are very kind pastor and saints, and the Word is good. This church has a warm atmosphere and welcomes even non-Christians like me. It's relatively small, but there are university students (many of whom are international students), young people, singles, married people, and families. The pastor is cheerful, friendly, bright, and kind. There's ample parking.

name: Palos Verdes Baptist Church
Palos Verdes Baptist Church - Palos Verdes Estates Campus
reviewSummary: Warm, friendly, Bible centered, multi-generational church woth contemporary praise music & very good, down-to-earth, practical sermons.

reviewSummary: Warm, friendly, Bible centered, multi-generational church woth contemporary praise music & very good, down-to-earth, practical sermons.

name: Panama City Church of Christ
Panama City Church of Christ - Panama City Campus
reviewSummary:
Wonderful group of Christians. Very friendly. Bible class was interesting with good discussion. We will go back. Welcoming group of sound believers. Enjoyed the class and sermon...both based in New Testament teaching. It's so nice to find a church when traveling, and it's always the first thing we look for! Thanks for having us! Wonderful experience friendly Bible teaching adherence to new testament church in worship singing the Lords supper .
Will definitely worship here again when in the area. Visited here while driving through the area. Impressed with the teaching, using the Bible as their guide. It’s obvious they love God and studying the Bible. Really friendly people! The church of Christ here at Panama is a very good and sound congregation. I really recommend worshiping and studing the bible with them there. Very friendly and loving Christians that want to do Gods will.

name: Panorama Baptist Church
Panorama Baptist Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary:
The food pantry event was delayed and was poorly organized in terms of managing the line. A lot of old people had to go down the porch cause its not suitable for disabled people. Also, the food selection was pretty poor too - barely no veggies, no beverages, the variety was not good.
BUT the big plus is they were trying their best to make it work. And unlike other pantries the food here was actually fresh and not expired. Cant complain that much - solid 4 stars. Keep up the work you are doing for the community 👍 I attended back in 1974 - 1984. name: Park Hill Church
Park Hill Church - Pacific Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Necessary ending after hearing the pastor announce plans to expand staffing hires despite quarterly report of significant budget shortfalls with church budget.

July 12, 2026 TL;DR this church saved my faith. In 2020, discouraged by the lack of pastors preaching unity from the pulpit in the midst of racial tensions, I left the church altogether. I spent 2021 deconstructing a faith I’d been born into. After realizing that life without God in community is no better, I decided to dip my toe in church life again, and was led to Park Hill. By the grace of God, I entered a community group where the topics I was struggling with were directly addressed, and was even invited into the racial reconciliation cohort. Here, I had a safe space to wrestle through the issues that pushed me away from church in the first place. The lead pastors were even part of that cohort, not to speak and be heard but simply hear what the vulnerable members of their congregation had to say. I can tell you from experience, that this willingness to hear how the Church had done the vulnerable, wrong, is not a commitment I have seen at other places. The leadership leaning in and making change from the pulpit, preaching against division in this country and emphasizing God’s heart for unity through sound scripture, helped heal my heart for the church. I got to know the lead pastors from a few interactions over the years, and I can tell you that their heart is truly burdened for their flock and for sound biblical teaching in an increasingly divided landscape. To those who put down leadership behind the scenes: it’s true, they’re not perfect, and running any size church is hard. To the person who said the pastors walked right past you: have grace. New people come in all the time, and if you introduce yourself they will welcome you warmly. From my experience and that of many I had met there — genuine Christ followers trying to grow and learn and do better — Park Hill fosters environments that challenges us to put our flesh aside and grow as a body. We need more of this now, Christians unafraid to stand on scripture FOR people, not against them, than ever. Been going here for 6 years and it is truly our church home for life! I strongly disagree with the positive reviews. As someone who has had personal interactions with the leadership and specifically Evan, it is not a welcoming place or one of good community. There are many challenges behind the scenes and a lot of turnover in attendance. The cliques are strong and leadership is a mess. The Sunday sermons are fine, but the church itself is one to avoid due to the organizational trouble and failure to provide access to community. I’ve been at this church multiple years, it has solid biblical teaching and worship with a great community of those seeking to know God in a deeper way. Many of the less than 5 star reviews here are from people who like the idea of Christianity but don’t believe all of the teachings of the Bible are relevant. This church teaches directly from the Bible without skirting past controversial topics.

reviewSummary:
I have been a member of this church since 2017. This is also when I moved back to Dena. When I came back, I got involved with a housing justice group. The workshop for this housing justice group took place at the West campus of this church. That was my first experience with Pasadena Church, social justice. The church was hosting this workshop. “Interesting,” I thought.

When I became a member of the housing justice group, which wasn’t connected to the church, we would go to City Council meetings to fight for more ADUs, affordable and permanent supportive housing in our community. Pastor Kerwin and members of Pasadena Church would be there. “Interesting,” I thought.

When our group would meet with the Dept of Housing, again, members of Pasadena Church would be there.

I finally decided to visit this church that was so active in community matters. When I did, I learned that Pastors Kerwin and Madelyn just recently lost their precious daughter, Morgan.

They were transparent with their grief. It was a beautiful service with so much love it made sense that the same love I felt, would be overflowing to their community.

I was shook witnessing the amount of faith these pastors would have to be able to continue worshiping, serving their community, receiving support and giving through what had to be one of the darkest seasons of their lives.

I walked away from that service convinced that this was a church that didn’t just preach the gospel but lived it. While there is no such thing as a “perfect” church, this church had been perfect for me. Really disappointed that this Church in Pasadena is afraid of people standing in the public area with cameras. They will violate your rights and call the police on you! Be careful… I have nothing but positive things to say about the leadership and membership of Pasadena Church. name: Pastor Jack Hibbs
Pastor Jack Hibbs - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
I’m leaving this review to share a serious concern for anyone considering attending this church or engaging with this pastor’s ministry.

In a recent Instagram video, the pastor said the following:

“God wants His people to be unmoved by the headlines of the news....If you don’t get rooted and grounded in understanding through a Biblical worldview, prophetic worldview, lens of the news that’s around you, if you don’t get that down, you’re going to turn into a crazy lunatic that’s out on the streets in Minnesota crying.”

Hearing a pastor speak this way, mocking and dismissing people who are genuinely scared, was deeply disturbing. Many people in Minnesota are experiencing real fear and trauma related to the current immigration climate. These are not just “headlines” to them; these are their lives, families, and communities.

Faith in God does not stop bad things from happening, and it does not justify belittling people who are afraid or grieving. What stood out to me was not compassion or spiritual leadership, but a lack of empathy toward people who are suffering.

I believe people deserve to know the tone, values, and character they may encounter before placing their trust in a pastor or church. My wife and I  love Pastor Jack! We watch him live on youtube Sunday mornings and Wednesday nights. The Bible is taught line by line in an interesting way that is understandable to regular people. Keep up the good work Jack Hibbs. Love, Pastor Jack Hibbs. I tell everybody about him. He makes learning about the Bible so interesting and easy to understand and how having a personal relationship with Jesus is the most important thing in your life you can do and have.  Thank you for spreading God's word. Cindy from Michigan I listened to a radio show and was dis-hearted that he would twist Bible verse to put control on women, Mary Magdalene was the first person that Jesus went to when he was resurrected and to show we are all equal in his eyes, but then centuries later all but a handful of apostles are credited and used in the New Testament the hypocrisy and Jesus knows this.. As an outsider to this great church, I watch on YouTube and other media outlets and I am very pleased with what seems to be correct teaching/preaching. I hope I have the opportunity to visit some day (as I live in Shepparton, Victoria, Australia). As a christian historian I value the accuracy in "Spiritual Information." Thank you to all the staff at Calvary Chapel and all those who support this great Ministry.

name: Pathway Church San Diego Assemblies of God
Pathway Church San Diego Assemblies of God - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary: Everyone is very friendly and seems like one big family! Everything is very casual and has a comfortable feeling. The lighting and sound equipment is insane and worth a visit to see. They have great kids' classes that go on during the adult service which gives the parents a break for a little while. And the kids aren't just being babysat, but they are actually getting a Bible lesson made just for them and they get to play really fun games which is really cool. The pastor has new series every few weeks/months and helps the people there understand deeper concepts in the Bible while relating it to our everyday lives at the same time! And for the icing on the cake, this church focuses on reaching its community and offers free events all the time just for them! So to wrap up this review, this place is awesome and you should really check it out! So thankful for this place and all that they do not just for those in the church (as a place to belong, be encouraged & be challenged to grow in your relationship with Christ), but also for all that they do in and for the community! Community events from this church are the best! 🙌🏼 Pastor Bart & leadership serve behind the scenes more than any other leaders I’ve known... 10/10. 😊 Lester Aguilar

name: Patria Church - Generosity Center
Patria Church - Generosity Center - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary:
You can feel the love and the spirit of God before you even receive the blessing of the food. If you are in need please get there with your head held high they don't judge they support in Jesus name 🙌🏼 It's closed? 1st Saturday of January 2026 and there's no one here!? We don't get holidays and we are sorry we are forced to rely on the help but, please! Not all of us can afford the gas for exercises in futility.  If you post being open, please be open! Just because it takes 11 days to starve to death doesn't mean we can wait 10. By day 5 an non-suicidal person would be contemplating theft! Help the community. Not everyone is taking advantage of the system. Some of us are truly in need A BLESSING FOR MANY OF US THAT NEED THE FOOD ASSISTANCE!🙏
I AM IN THE BORDER LINE WHERE I DO NOT QUALIFY FOR FOOD STAMPS!!! 😞
AND GOD TOOK ME TO THIS CHURCH,.
WHERE THERE'S LOTS OF HARD WORKING PEOPLE!
PARENTS WITH THEIR KIDS HELPING OUT.
PACKING AND LOADING LONG LINES OF CARS.
EVERY SATURDAY RAIN  🌧️ OR SHINE! 🌞
FAST AND FRIENDLY!!!  🥰
I LOOK FORWARD TO GO BECAUSE THEY  PRAY FOR ME!!! 🙏
AND I GET MY FOOD, THAT I SHARE WITH MY PARENTS, MY FRIEND AND GRANDKIDS
THEY ENJOY THE STARBUCKS ITEMS.
BLESSINGS!!! 🙏
FROM: JURUPA VALLEY CALIFORNIA, USA Came here twice to pick up food for myself and my elderly neighbor. I received severely expired food that was not frozen and salads that were puffed up and warm . I thought maybe it was just that time. I tried again last weekend they gave me only juice and 1 bag of expired broccoli with 6 magazines for their church. The people are nice and doing a good thing but everyone should get equal items and food should be quality checked. I don’t want my kids sick because we’re hungry. My husband and I are so grateful for the generosity and caring that we receive from Patria Church.  We have been going through immense hardship and the generosity center has helped us out tremendously.  All the volunteers are very polite and friendly and always welcome me with a smile.  Patria truly does mean FAMILY.
May the Lord continue blessing this amazing Church.

name: Patria Church Rancho Cucamonga
Patria Church Rancho Cucamonga - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary: Mega abundant worship great music. A complete church. As Calvinists, we’ve always loved this church, but ever since the Patria rebrand, when they went fully Calvinist, we’ve loved it even more. They brought in an exceptional pastoral staff with the highest level of education from TMS/TMU, one of the most prominent training grounds for understanding the Bible from a Calvinist lens. They even have cool merch swaggert and vibes. Christ is King. I only been here one time I love the vibe I was looking into getting my children into school as well but not sure if it's public?? Very clean including the bathrooms we sat outside in the patio very clean at a church and when I went inside I was amazed how clean and nice it love the way everyone is like a family I'm giving it a five-star from the one-day experience I’ve always gone to this church and loved it, even before they changed their name to patria and when Adam’s dad was preaching and I always loved it but I was recently diagnosed with leukemia (AML) October 25th 2025 and of course with my diagnosis I decided to try get closer to God so I started reading my bible while in the hospital doing chemo. I was told on February 17th my cancer came back stronger and church was on my mind specially sitting in the front row to hopefully get some prayer so I (24 years old) decided to bring my wife and son to church Wednesday February 18th 2026 even asked my wife to sit in the front even tho we’ve never done that before and it was out of our comfort zone. We ended up sitting a couple rows back from the front because I seen most of the chairs had reserved signs but then I seen way some front row seats probably about 8 of them that don’t have a reserved sign on them so I brought my family to the front and was happy to be able to sit in the front which was exactly what I was hoping for but then a church worker came up and said that if my son will be fine in the front and I said yes and they left. Then another man came up and ask if we were ok and I said yes and he mentioned the seats are usually for the elders and they forgot to put reserved signs on the chairs and then said if we would be ok here and I said yes then another guy came and said if we are ok again and at this point I just said plainly “do you want us to move?” And he said “yes please” church was already about to start at that point so when we got up to move all the chairs were filled and we had to sit all the way in back. I firmly believe there shouldn’t be reserved seats in a church not matter who you are because everyone deserves to listen to the word where they want. Personally if I was the worker and seen people sitting already comfortable I’d just let them sit there. I guess elders have more right to sit in the front more than everyone else. Been my church over 15 years..plus now..love every moment!!! God is moving always and is here in this place! HALLELUJUAH!!

reviewSummary: Peace is a ‘family’ church .. all are welcome .. young and old alike. It has been a joy attending since 2021. So many different ways to get involved and their website has all sorts of helpful info from service times to what to expect when you attend. These folks are clearly doing God’s work!! Not one person said a word to me. For sure not an inviting church. I'll have to look further from home now. This church has really grown in the last few years.. The pastor is genuine. The people are really friendly and vibrant. If you're looking for a place to meet the real Jesus and walk with him, this is it! Great local church that is thriving and growing. Wonderful vibe in worship, multigenerational, great preaching. You need to check out this great church with intentional leadership and kind congregants! Such an amazing place and congregation! It would be so great if everyone could join us!

name: Pentecostal Missionary Church of Christ (4th Watch) South Bay
Pentecostal Missionary Church of Christ (4th Watch) South Bay - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary:
This church really gives you that heartfelt tug when it comes to God. You feel HIS presence during the service. They preach deeply the words of God and relate it to our everyday life. I have been holding off on this review for quite some time now. The reason is that I felt that it would be biased since I used to be a member of this church.

However, I think it's fair to speak about my opinions and point of view about the church now since I am no longer active.

I'll tell you this; there are ups and downs -- just like any other Church.

This is not a perfect church. Instead, it is a church that is being perfected and prepared for His Arrival.

Below you will see incredibly remarkable pictures. The image of me in the purple setting next to the guy in the black suit believe it or not we used to be enemies. We used to be from rival gangs when we were younger. Sometimes the human instinct goes back to default and tends to remember the past too much. However, when I saw him and when he saw me we made this peace treaty amongst our fellow friends and cities.

The picture with me wearing blue. I'm next to my friend who used to be in business with me. Let's say that... It's not the kind of business that you would want to talk about ever. However, I can't believe that I was able to convince them to come to church and to accept God and to leave our old business behind.

Moreover, to this day we remain friends; we are closer than ever and have both grown so much. We are so thankful to the church, to the leaders, to the Bible students, and the members.

Overall once you become a member of this church, it will feel like you are a lifetime member. Even though you're inactive or active, you will always have a place here. I have done so many things that should have me band probably from this church. However, to this day I still keep in contact with many of them. They always invite me to come back, but it's something within that stopping me.

The next pictures show my one friend and sister who has never given up on me. Moreover, I got to tell you I have made some dumb decisions that have affected many people and hurt them.

Moreover, they still accept me for who I am and even would like me to return.

Maybe one day I will, but for now, I believe it's best.

It's best that I grow up. I would become mature, and the next time, if there is a next time, I'll be way more prepared and ready to serve God.

If you are someone who struggles with depression, anxiety, loneliness, confusion, and existential stress, this is the place to go.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

I highly recommend this church as a local guide of Google. Also, if you are in the area as a traveler and you are looking for a place of worship. This is the place to go.

Come As You Are and be ready to worship. Also, be ready to eat, there's a lot of food!

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
cheers! I hadn't been a church goer in a number of years when I first set in the church a number of years ago.  I found the church at random while searching Google, and decided to pay them a visit.  I didn't stay then, but I would occasionally visit the church over the years, during their big events.
Eventually, I found myself in a situation where became open to the support of a group of believers in order to strengthen and maintain myself.  After about 9 days of praying, I was again invited to another church anniversary.  I went, earnestly praying for and looking specifically for a word from God, and He certainly did not disappoint.  The first words out of Bishop Jonathan Ferriol's mouth were exactly what I needed to hear. (1st Peter 2:9 if anyone is interested)

It would take a few weeks of meticulous scrutiny before I would join the church.  In those weeks, however, I saw so much.  I continued to discern the move of the Holy Spirit within the preaching.  Though initially not an extroverted person, I found that a number of members already knew who I was, even though I didn't know their names (to be fair, remembering names hasn't always been my strong point).  I even saw the zeal and dedication of the young people who were prepping for their ministries.

Since joining the church, every single point of potential doctrinal contention I could have had, any questions about whether I am a valued member or just another number, or any doubts if I had made the right decision have all been answered.  Keep in mind, no church, no pastor, no one group of people are absolutely perfect, but if I had to find myself another church of highly motivated, and truly dedicated people; it might not be an easy task.  I give this church 5 stars because they have continued to serve my needs, and are very supportive as I begin to realize my own God-given abilities in service to Him.  I hope this "testimony" reaches and encourages many people.
God Bless I have been with this church for almost 2 years. I've always been skeptical of any religious group...I was born into a Catholic faith and I felt that anyother religion outside catholisism is a joke. And I felt that I am ok as far as my faith is concern. Although there are times some areas in the faith I do not understand because I do read the bible and some of the things we do as catholic is kind of unique from what is in the bible. Praying the rosary, novena, feast day and praying to different saints for different reasons....it's not in the Bible? Until a friend of mine introduced me to this church and they were very kind, warm. They offered to conduct a bible study at our house which we did and they gave me answers to some of the questions I have and refered all to the Bible.  The Pastor was very kind and sincere to what he was saying and I was that convinced with the truth they have that I did not hesistate to receive Jesus Christ as my Lord and Savior and I got baptized that night. I felt there was a heavy weight lifted from me. After that night I began attending their bible studies, they do personal ones and they even have bible studies as a congregation. I began attending their Sunday Services as well. I have never been so sure of my faith since that day of my baptism. Other people will say this church is a cult? I say otherwise, because as I grew on my faith I have witnessed how the leaders in the church models true worship and service to God. They are not salaried. Sure, they get love gifts/offerings for when they conduct speakerships and they're basic needs like food, clothing and transportation are provided by the church but compared to other church leaders they do not own any property and they are the ones who actually give the most in their offerings! One Bishop even gave $25K as their church anniversary thanksgiving offering! And that is only here in the US! This was unheard of for me. Oh! And the pastors in this church gives their tithes as well!  In fact, they are one of the top tithers! Typically, other leaders gets salaries from the congregation and some even have pensions from when they retire not to mention owning acres and acres of properties and even luxurios lfestyles.....not the leaders of the PMCC 4th watch! They are down right for real and you can even check it out for yourselves! They have a transparency policy...mind you!

I don't know about you but this church is as Legit as it can be....I invite you to see for yourselves!

Praise the Lord! If your not Filipino it's kind of awkward. Plus they do an altar call if your a first time visitor. There is no personal one on one asking you if your a believer or not. They only encourage church bible study and not Individual bible study. It seems like a cult.

name: Pentecostals of OC
Pentecostals of OC - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary:
The Holy Spirit led me to this church I went in obedience, I was in the Lord's presence and cried the whole service it is a loving place to praise and worship everyone is on fire I love this church and thank the Lord everyday for directing my steps. Pastor Pryor speaks the truth and the truth shall set you free.
Please visit if your in town very friendly and loving church. My wife Mia and I went in search of Truth and anointed preaching visited POC and it was a Holy Ghost filled experience with God's liberty. There is genuine love and fellowship at this church. God is Faithful and present at every service. If you seek anointed preaching with God's love, POC is the place. Pastor Mark Pryor delivers Holy Ghost filled messages each time the doors are open. Pentecostals of Orange members will greet you with a spirit of love.

Mia and I were married by Pastor Pryor in November 2014 and we now host Connect Groups in our home. We have grown spiritually as a family and individually. The members have now become our new family,

name: People's Church San Diego Assemblies of God
People's Church San Diego Assemblies of God - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary: You can come as you are. People are warm and very welcoming. The music was great and the atmosphere was amazing. The message was very good and understandable. There’s a really cool coffee shop that serves great coffee and drinks. There’s an outdoor shaded space with a screen  where you can sit with your friends watch the live stream from the main building. It’s also got a multi generation demographic. There’s a great kids program and youth group (that meets on Friday nights). They’re invested and regularly have community outreach programs. People are very warm. This church is my home. I love this place. This is my safe place. It's where I'm able to just be myself and be vulnerable. This church family has supported me and my family through thick and thin. There's no judgment and everyone loves Jesus and their mission is to connect people to Jesus and help them become more christ like. Not to mention all of their holiday events are the best and safe and fun for everyone especially the kids. It’s a Great Diverse Community of People and everyone is so welcoming and accepting just as you are.. It's a place where you're accepted, loved and led to the One who loves you the most. Wonderful, Energized in the Spirit of our Lord and Savior, A Great Place to Reconnect and Create a New Beginning... Randy Morton

name: Pilgrim Progressive Baptist
Pilgrim Progressive Baptist - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband & I attend our beloved family member homegoing it was a glorious time in the Lord, the pastor preached a good word and the choirs sung until heaven got the news we had a beautiful home going for her and at the end of the server's the doves was released to say that her Spirit was now free she is free at last thank God Almighty she's free at last the church is large very much accommodating to a large crowd the parking lot is humongous the location was great right off the freeway I enjoyed everything Attended this fellowship in 1993 when I lived in San Diego with my daughter. Born and grew up in Raleigh NC...was seeking to join a Missionary Baptist church when as a child I grew up attending a Baptist church. The HOLY SPIRIT flows from heart to heart. at Pilgrim Progressive beginning at Elder Foxworth, the deacons/deconesses; music ministry; Sister Gladney( awesome woman of purpose); ministering ushers....I returned to NC after my father had stroke...but I let all my bulletins/programs from Pilgrim Progressive...the praise/faith building Bible studies/powerful teaching-preaching of Elder Foxworth remain within my heart....there is a WORD from the Lord!! To anyone coming into the area and looking for a place of worship, I can't recommend Pilgrim Progressive enough. You'll walk in a stranger, and walk out of service family. Take a moment and drop in for a service. I promise, you won't forget it. Beautiful ministry amazing Pastor & family 🙏🏻 Great Service both congregations Showed up
and Showed out.

name: Pilgrim United Church-Christ
Pilgrim United Church-Christ - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
Just the nicest congregation EVER. It took me a long time to find this wonderful inclusive church.   I have been going over the last month and I will join soon as a member.  This church and their loving thoughtful ways must indeed make Christ smile. Have attended this church since childhood, incredible people with an inclusive and affirming community. This is a wonderful church. It may be smaller than some but it is mightier in many ways. I see it as a hub where we all come together teaching, learning, and living in fellowship with one another so we can go out into the world in many directions spreading the news of God’s love through Jesus Christ and JEDI, Justice, Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion. Pilgrim UCC is unique in the San Diego region.  A community dedicated to an honest exploration of the meaning and significance of Jesus and how that understanding manifests in spirituality and service to others.  The community has a passion for social justice action and a genuine concern for each other.  And Rev. Madison Shockley, as the (only?) black pastor of a predominately white church in San Diego, brings a "tell it like it is" perspective to both theological and current issues which is concurrently challenging and non-condescending (like "Wow, I haven't looked at it that way before."). Although I live in downtown San Diego, I have yet to find a spiritual community that compares to Pilgrim.  Suggest you give it a try some Sunday at 10:00 in person or 10:30 on Facebook and see if it resonates with you. Progressive church with great messages every week.

Active fellowship based on serving others in need and learning how to actively help.

name: Pillar Church of Oceanside
Pillar Church of Oceanside - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary:
Faithful, God-fearing, Gospel-minded church. I’ve been attending this church since May 2022, and it has been a tremendous blessing. The elders are well-equipped and faithful in their role of shepherding the church. The congregation is faithful and united with the same goal in mind: to know Jesus and make Him known. If you’re in the Oceanside area, I encourage you to come and join us for a service. Pillar Church of Oceanside is a really great group of Christian worshipers in the Valley in Northeast Oceanside. Saturday service is presently held in an older church building on Stallion Road off North River Road. The church building is shared with a smaller but separate church group. For over ten years Pillar Church services used to be held in the spacious multi-purpose room at nearby Del Rio Elementary School next to Melba Bishop Park.

The main two pastors are Marine and Air Force veterans who are also talented musicians. A third pastor is an active-duty Naval chaplain. The pastors rotate and focus on various religious themes throughout the year and reference verses from the New and Old Testaments. All references to scripture are clearly visible on the overhead screen. During my two years there, politics was never included in their sermons. They DO NOT try to sway members to think or vote a certain way.

Their focus is for everyone “to know Jesus Christ and to make Him known.”

All of the congregants are active duty military personnel, retired military, veterans, and their families. However, everyone in the community is welcomed. Pillar Church also provides Bible study and various support groups with lots of food and uplifting spiritual songs and prayer.

Finally, Pillar Church has a growing number of churches next to military bases throughout the country and a few around the world. Everyone is welcomed. I attend service at Pillar Church of Oceanside from January 2018 to June 2020. Prior to this I attended church at Pillar Church in Dumfries, VA and Pillar Church in Jacksonville, NC.  I have never felt more at home than I have at a Pillar Church.

I recently returned for a weekend after moving out of town and felt like I was right back with my family.  I love this church and cannot express how much they have helped me to grow in my walk with Christ. Visited while on vacation, great community, service, and worship. Love the service and message

name: Pillar of Fire Church San Diego
Pillar of Fire Church San Diego - Pacific Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
I absolutely loved this church! The message is clear and more importantly extremely powerful! There is a very welcoming crowd and I felt at home! I strongly recommend checking this place out! 12:30 Sunday! Be there and your week will be much more fulfilled! Don't take my word for it go see for yourself!! Pillar of Fire is one of the most loving, welcoming, accepting churches in San Diego.  The intimacy of the community there, their commitment to teaching the Bible, their practice of weekly intercessory prayer, their Celebrate Recovery, their TUMI class, their authentic expressions of musical worship, their outreach to their community and more are all very clear evidences that God's Spirit and present is alive and active there! I like a bible referred message and contemporary worship. Pastor Danny does just that. I've been to last Sunday's service and mid-week service on Wednesday's. Friday I plan to go to the Celebrate Recovery mtgs..... Pillar Of Fire Church of San Diego is where I attend, ots my church.  I recommend for anyone looking for a church and to get fed with the Word Of God and be satisfied I was having a hard time and I came across the book pillar of fire and wanted to say thank you for our talks and your counsel. God has given me hope when I felt like my world was falling apart. The love I get from God is so personal and on a whole nother level its unexplainable. Thank You Pastor Dan.
-Robert Oson

name: Pinecrest Presbyterian Church
Pinecrest Presbyterian Church - Pinecrest / South Miami Campus
reviewSummary: Lovely service by fine people. Warmly received. Beautiful interior. Excellent teachers and staff. ;) Pastor Jackie is awesome! Awesome church and staff!!!

name: Pioneer Ocean View United Church of Christ
Pioneer Ocean View United Church of Christ - Pacific Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
From the moment I stepped foot into Pioneer Ocean View UCC about 2 years ago, it felt like home. Yes, it's located in a beautiful spot near Point Loma, but there's more to it. It only gets better after you walk through the doors.
The congregation is so genuine, kind, and welcoming! So many people immediately came up to greet me the first time I attended. They took the time to get to know me and make me feel welcome. The church merged two congregations nearly 20 years ago, but you wouldn't know it. Everyone is so open, warm, and kind! You can tell they all care about each other.
Pastor Mary Sue Brookshire is incredible! Her sermons are relevant and applicable to every day life. She is passionate and compassionate. She practices what she preaches. After I became a member, she took the time outside of church to get to know me better.
The congregation cares about the San Diego community - dedicating themselves to important causes, such as climate change, homelessness, immigration, and equality. Just as the pastor practices what she preaches - so does the congregation. There are always opportunities to serve - no matter how small or big.
My favorite part is the lunch fellowship after service. Because everyone is so welcoming, it's always a great time to catch up with people who have become my friends and to get to know other members better. It's all a team effort with different groups taking turns each week to make lunch - which makes it more fun.
Being part of POVUCC has been great and enriching. I definitely recommend visiting and giving it a chance - even if you aren't a churchgoer. We attended Pioneer Ocean View United Church of Christ online last week and in person this week. We experienced an extravagant welcome! We were invited to introduce ourselves or not as we wished. We were treated to a great UCC service. And then we were invited to lunch after worship. Everyone was so friendly! Very welcoming Church with equally amazing view. As a newcomer to Church & religion, I found PioneerChurch to be a friendly, warm & welcoming, place of worship. Pastor Mary Sue has great energy in her presentation & message! She makes Sundays a treat. I attended Yone Shiwotsuka's memorial service and made my first visit to the new physical site for the Church.  I absolutely love the view and location of our new Church.  I also enjoyed meeting and listening to our new pastor during the wonderful service for a wonderful person, Yone.

name: Pipeline Avenue Baptist Church
Pipeline Avenue Baptist Church - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor Lloyd & Julie & Ken ...love you guys ...God Bless Found it with no problem. Have a blessed day. If you're looking for a good pastor and Bible teacher in a healthy church, this is the place!
Pastor Ernesto and Pastor Lloyd are a blessing!

name: Placentia Presbyterian Church
Placentia Presbyterian Church - Brea Campus
reviewSummary: Friendly, sociable. My mo-in-law was choir director for 20 years, back in the 1960's - 80 's. A few remembered her, so I enjoyed some nostalgia. Worship music is modern, upbeat. To be honest, I’ve never attended church here, however this church hosts Music In The Parks choir competition every year. They are excellent hosts, they make a very good hamburger for the kids for a very reasonable price. They provide clean restrooms, dressing rooms and practice rooms for us. I appreciate them very much and am always excited when I see they will again be our competition venue. If their compassion is the same in their congregation, I assume they are a great group if people with whom to worship. Fresh new outlook if you're looking for a progressive and contemporary Place To Worship. Plenty of loving people there and an excellent choir Plus a separate children's ministry. Lots of fun activities for the kids and a modern vibe to the singing with electric guitar, drums, the band Etc. This church loves to reach out to the community and really get involved in this wonderful little city of Placentia. You will definitely feel God's love all around you there. name: Presbyterian Church of The Master - Lake Forest Campus
reviewSummary: Been here a few times to listen to a friend who is part of Festival Singers. This is a very spacious church with couple levels of seating, and the acoustics are great. Can even hear the singers and the audience's claps clearly from the restroom stalls. Great church with fantastic teaching. Very loving. Not too big but big enough it’s great for kids and youth. Love all the youth leaders especially.  Contemporary service has great music/worship with a mix of contemplative and fun songs. My late husband and I attended here for 25 wonderful years, from Pastor Jack Loo through Pastor Jackson!  We thoroughly enjoyed every minute of singing in the choir under the great direction of John Elg!  A need to move out-of-state is the only reason I’m not still there, and, aside from people, the only thing we miss from ÇA is PCOM! ❤️🙏 An excellent evangelical Church. I attend when visiting the area because my children and grandchildren are there, but I would likely choose it in any case, if we lived nearby because of the traditional service with magnificent music and solid Biblical preaching. The pipe organ is excellent, the main musicians truly gifted, the choir is fine, and because there are so few churches today with choirs it's nice to see one continuing that tradition. It's one of the few churches remaining today where you want to stay after the benediction to hear the postlude. The pastors are warm and approachable. They have been remarkably supportive of my children and their family during difficult times. For those preferring a contemporary-style, there is a contemporary worship service and the young pastor leading this service is personally known to me and also excellent. Christ centered and a caring congregation! Tremendous children and youth programs and missional outreach! Beautiful facilities and great biblical teaching by three highly regarded pastors. We've raised our family starting with preschool into adulthood! No regrets! A church at its best!

name: Prestonwood Baptist Church - Plano Campus
Prestonwood Baptist Church - Plano Campus - Plano Campus
reviewSummary:
The pastor is not afraid to speak the truth, and his sermons are powerful. The kids ministry is safe and secure, but the little kid ministry (pre-k) videos are too long and there are always teachers talking through the videos so it’s very distracting (and a tiny bit rude- it’s hard enough to focus.) However, they do big lesson cards that reiterate the lesson back in the classrooms so I love that. And I will say all the teachers and volunteers (including me) are SO sweet and love kids. They truly seem to have a passion for Christ and children.

Also, if you have to use the restroom during the adult service you get locked out!!! I have health issues and had to use the restroom and tried to go back. A security guy told me I can’t go back to my seat unless I’m on the back row. He was pretty rude about it and I told him I was on the back row (only by coincidence and God’s grace,) and he did let me in (probably because I was starting to panic and start crying) but he gave a stern warning that once the service starts… if you leave… you can’t get back in. I 100% understand churches needing security, but if you have health issues or are older— this is an issue! Don’t forget your cell to text your husband that you’re not allowed back in.

Also, my mom tried to join this church with us, and they wouldn’t let her be a member unless she got BAPTIZED AGAIN because she wasn’t baptized into a Baptist church. She was baptized at 14 yrs old by being dunked in a tub of water at a non-denominational church. I understand asking people be baptized again if they were sprinkled as babies or never baptized (as those aren’t biblical baptisms,) but my mom was of age, accepted Christ, and dunked in water as a public proclamation; if you’re baptized legit then you’re baptized. I think it’s ethically wrong to demand someone be baptized again.

Don’t get me wrong, this is a Bible-based Spirit-filled church. The sermons and worship are AMAZING. They are so loving and there’s always something going on. Get involved and it’s a wonderful place to be. I just don’t agree with everything they do, and my health makes their security rules hard. Prestonwood Baptist Church is a phenomenal place of worship, and our family is incredibly grateful for the impact it has made in our lives. This summer, our kids attended the Vacation Bible School (VBS), and they had an absolute blast learning about God in a fun, high-energy environment. The entire experience was exceptional, largely thanks to the wonderful staff and volunteers who were incredibly friendly, approachable, and truly dedicated to the children.
The facilities here are absolutely amazing—modern, safe, beautifully maintained, and perfectly equipped for families. If you love the energy, resources, and dynamic worship of a mega-church, this is absolutely the place to be. While the scale of the campus is massive, the church has a beautiful way of making the community feel tightly knit and deeply personal. To experience that close fellowship, you just need to be intentional about plugging in, whether that is through small groups, volunteer ministries, or family events. Prestonwood excels at providing a welcoming sanctuary where families can anchor themselves in a strong, biblical worldview. It is a true blessing to have such a vibrant, Christ-centered community right here to help us grow together in faith. NOT a welcoming or open community for outside families.

I am writing this to warn other parents who are considering sending their children to Prestonwood's youth programs or Vacation Bible School (VBS). We chose to send our 8-year-old daughter here thinking it was a kind, welcoming, Christian environment. Instead, it proved to be an incredibly rigid, exclusionary, and hurtful space.
During a discussion about baptism at camp, my daughter mentioned that she had been baptized as a baby (in our Episcopal tradition). An adult instructor literally told an 8-year-old child that hers "wasn't a real baptism."

To say something so deeply invalidating and disrespectful to a young child is completely unacceptable. We have raised our daughter to respect other people's religious backgrounds, yet she was met with judgment by an adult leader who decided her family’s faith traditions weren't legitimate.

If this church community cannot handle questions, differences, or basic respect for other Christian backgrounds, they need to limit their programs strictly to their own congregation. What my child experienced here was not Christian. Look elsewhere if you want an actual welcoming environment for your kids. We were visiting Dallas and wanted to try a negachurch. name: Rancho Church
Rancho Church - Temecula Campus
reviewSummary:
I highly recommend Rancho Church in Temecula. It’s a multicultural church with services in Spanish, English, and Korean, making everyone feel welcome.

I attend the Spanish service, and it keeps growing with a great atmosphere, positive energy, and motivating messages. The English community is also large and hosts great events.

The facilities are clean and spacious, located on a Christian school campus, and the staff is always friendly.

Overall, it’s a great place for a healthy, family-oriented environment. It truly feels like one big family. Let’s bow our heads and pray is not something I have heard from any of the pastors at Rancho, in recent history, yes, even on Christmas Eve. Instead we heard “I pray that you have a good night “or something to that effect.The power of prayer in a group setting  is something that cannot be denied. When people go to church are they not looking for that unity in prayer? Like praying before we eat or praying before we receive the gift of a sermon? I invited a friend of mine who had invited me to their church, to come to Rancho; thats when it was first brought to my attention. She said “oh yeah, I’ve been there 4 times, my best friend goes there, the pastor doesn’t pray, which I find really weird.” I thought about what they said and sure enough praying as a congregation before and or after sermon is not something I’ve seen done there, by any of the pastors. “Open your Bible’s and turn to” is also something I do not hear at Rancho. “Open your Bible app” would suffice but that doesn’t happen either and the pastor holding an actual Bible is lacking too.  RAncho has Christ followers for sure, but where is the fear of God? Where are the Ten Commandments and the fear of God as the congregation works to hold themselves accountable to the basic instructions before leaving earth?  Anyhow, it’s taken me a long time to write this and I haven’t said it to the pastors because I’m someone who has anxiety with confrontation. I really hope a pastor at Rancho sees this and replies or better yet, includes congregational prayer and sights the Bible during their next sermon. We have been coming to Rancho Church for almost a year now, and we’re so glad we found it!  The messages are so good and have enhanced our spiritual journey!  Despite attending various churches over the years, my husband and I both agree that Rancho Church is the best church we have been to.  The messages are great, and Scott, Steve, and Karissa do an incredible job of sharing them with the congregation every Sunday.  The worship music is great, and we love the before-service music.  We are RV’ers, so we can’t always make it to church in person, but we listen to the service online.  We really appreciate all the hard work that the whole team at Rancho Church does to make every Sunday so special! Visited while we were visiting from out of state. Great worship and message. Troop 384 meets here nearly every Monday night. 7-8:30pm.  Stop by and see us if you are interested in Scouting BSA.

name: Reach Church Palos Verdes
Reach Church Palos Verdes - Palos Verdes Estates Campus
reviewSummary:
Looking for a church that feels like family from the moment you walk in? This church, located at Crestwood Elementary in Rancho Palos Verdes, is exactly that! The people are warm, welcoming, and genuinely excited to meet new faces. It’s the kind of place where strangers quickly become friends.

Pastor Luke and Shatera are incredible leaders with huge hearts for both people and the Palos Verdes community. Their passion, authenticity, and love for serving others shine through in everything they do.

The messages are biblically sound, relevant, and encouraging, while the worship is heartfelt, uplifting, and centered on God. Whether you’re searching for a church home, curious about faith, or just looking for a community to belong to, this is a great place to visit. Come see what God is doing here you might just find exactly what you’ve been looking for! January 2026 my daughters and I decided we needed to start going to church. I grew up going to Spanish speaking churches but wanted to find and English-speaking church so my daughters can fully understand the word of God. We went online and a few churches showed up in our area, Reach Church PV had one review on Yelp and it was good, so we decided to visit them that weekend. Pastor Luke, Shatera and the rest of the congregation were so welcoming. Everyone is so nice and make you feel like family. We have been attending for 3 months and we have felt so much love from everyone. I am proud to say I am part of such a great congregation! This is a great church! I know God placed us at the right place! A warm and welcoming Christian church with a heart for Jesus and the community. Pastors Luke and Shatera Duperron faithfully teach God’s Word and make everyone feel like family. ReachPV is a wonderful place to grow in faith, build relationships, and worship together. Looking for a church that feels like family? Reach Church Palos Verdes is full of welcoming people, uplifting worship, and biblical teaching. Pastors Luke and Shatera have a true heart for serving others and helping people grow in their faith. We’d love to see you there! 🙏🏽✝️❤️ This is my STORY

I'm Jacob I always knew I had to answer to a higher calling in my life if I did bad or wrong but I never had a "relationship" with Jesus christ fast forward a couple years down the road my grandma died at home she was like a mom to me because my mom was working all the time I grew up in a single parent home so my grandma technically was my mom per say. When my grandma died I was there to be a comfort to her during her lasts breathes and sometime after that I got exposed to pornography and found that as an outlet for my grief but little did I know that it would bring anxiety,depression, fear and insecurities.
And during my middle and high school years it made a huge negative impact on my performance in school. Fast forward 2025 I lost my job, fiance and was stripped from everything I idolized I had plans to kill myself in my truck but I ran into Luke and shatera at Sam’s club and invited me to they’re church anytime and I felt so welcomed and just genuinely felt concerned about and loved ever since then I have been coming getting connected and met some great men and women in the church that I call family…

name: Real Life Church
Real Life Church - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary: I've been coming to Real Life church for a few years now and as a raised Catholic, I really enjoy it. The previous lead Pastor, Rusty and now Jake have been able to create an environment balance of what we all face in Real Life, and what the Bible has taught us. I love seeing my friends and family as volunteers and running into familiar faces as well. Even those i don't know are super friendly and inviting. If you are looking for a local Church for you or your family, this place is worth a look! Hear me Real Life Church. Make God the main character always. We are not main characters, but rather side characters in this grand story. Who cares if 90% of the congregation leaves, a biblically sound church is best, not a lukewarm church that the Lord will spit out of his mouth. If you are doing this great, but when I attended a few years past this was not my experience. During our visit to Santa Clarita we had the opportunity to visit RLC in Christmas eve. The people and services were great.  Such a welcoming and beautiful services. We were able to take services outdoors without going inside. We enjoyed our visit and will definitely attend services during our next visit. Nice place. Love the outdoor seating. Lots of people to help with anything you need. Pet friendly Didn't go to the church. They have a great market that comes to the parking lot several times in the summer. Awesome.

The message is good, everyone is friendly and welcoming, and the music is great too! A super welcoming group of folks. Jim the pastor is a great teacher. For the longest time we didn’t attend church.
