If you are checking the google reviews of a church before going, not something I would think to check, but this is a good church, trying our best to humble ourselves to God and scriptures. Terrible people judgemental your pastor prince is a lier and treats people by there race I can't believe he represents  Christianity

name: Reality Church Miami
Reality Church Miami - Miami (Downtown/Brickell) Campus
reviewSummary:
I attend Sunday morning services here when I am visiting Miami. Wonderful music, bible-based preaching, and exceptionally friendly people. Regardless of your background, you will feel welcome and loved here. Reality Church Miami has been a great place for my family and I to grow closer to God. Every week, we come together with friendly people who have been welcoming to our family. Whether you're new to Miami, or have lived here for years, this is a great place for you to learn what it means to follow Jesus and make friends along the way. My teenagers are volunteering and loving it. In my experience, the people in the congregation were judgmental, and ironically, remind me of the Pharisees from the bible. They judged me according to their moral ethic, many did not communicate with me in an honest straightforward way, I did not feel welcome at all over the months of being there. It was during a transition part of my life where I was looking for healing and community.

They would encourage you from the stage to get involved and volunteer, but whenever I ask how I can get involved in volunteer, they would never let me and kept on telling me to talk to the pastor, I don’t know why. It may be because we had differing beliefs or doctrine about the scripture. In my view, I just wanted to help them do good things in the community, but they kept on creating a rift because of their perceived difference in our doctrine. They never really explained it.

but I feel like the people were not able to resolve this agreement and instead my intuition tells me that they kept it to themselves and discuss Only behind my back. It was a strange experience, I felt like there were always looking at me judgmentally but they would not communicate it. I’ve been to many churches, and none of them have ever treated me like this.

Somebody also lied about my conduct and accused me of doing something that I was warned not to do, which is not true. I stepped into the Sunday school room to say hi to somebody that I knew and they accused me of violating safety protocols that supposedly somebody told me not to go in there, which was not true at all.

It makes me wonder where this kind of behavior and perception comes from, it’s still a mystery to me that I pray about.

I pray that we can all move forward and grow from this experience. I do feel like the people are good people and maybe I am a teaching lesson to them and they are teaching lesson for me . All the best. I can’t recommend this church enough. It’s a beautiful community that truly lives out its love for the gospel, the people, and the city of Miami. If you’re searching for a church home, you really need to come by and experience it firsthand. Reality Church of Miami is a wonderful place to come, where they will welcome you with open arms. From the wonderful worship music, to the great teachings of the word, and everyone involved that volunteer every Sunday. It all has such a community atmosphere that welcomes you in if it’s your very first time at church or if you’ve been going your whole life. God has a lot in store for them for the future!

name: Reality LA Sunday Gatherings
Reality LA Sunday Gatherings - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
I checked out this church around 2 weeks ago and it went well! For their morning service, they meet in the auditorium of a big High School. The parking lot is fantastic and the organization is top-notch. The preacher preacher the Gospel itself without watering it down, and I was impressed and touched by the message. Lots of diversity and a lot of people from all walk of life. Definitely will be back. False teachings. When the first pastor left it Seems like they were looking for anyone and stuck the first person on stage that they could find. This is not a church more like opinion based teachings. Also congregants seemed very self centered and unfriendly First time here today and loved it :) loved the worship in the beginning, loved that people were friendly and welcoming, loved the message. It felt like a real community. Church is at 10am. Note that it is a bit longer than other services, but I still enjoyed it I loved it!! I moved from the Inland Empire ( San Bernardino area) and I felt it was HOME.

I appreciate the people really worshipping of the King, not the person on the stage.

Parking is at a high school with tandem parking, and covered parking.

A well organized set up creates a homey feeling in the courtyard.

God bless California, and our nation.
Reality LA, thank you for answering the call Sound teaching of God’s word and unwavering in their commitment to loving God and loving Los Angeles. What an amazing non-profit they also founded, SERVE LA, that feeds and clothes and welcomes thousands of those struggling through homelessness at the Hope Center. I was saved at this church along with my brother and husband. Community is everything and we’ve been plugged in for over a decade. This is family.

name: Reconcile Church Los Angeles
Reconcile Church Los Angeles - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
The Holy Spirit truly fills this church, and sometimes, you can’t help but be moved to tears of rejoice. If you’re looking for a church that truly delves into the Word, Pastor Daryl and Pastor Mike both take their time to truly break down Scripture, verse by verse in each sermon series and their passion to share the goodness of God is truly exhibited. The members, the body of this church, are so welcoming and the heart of Christ really pours out of them. The church offers fellowship, accompanied with some snacks and drinks, afterwards and the conversations that occur are always so uplifting. God has beautifully talented the worship team at Reconcile with various musicians who lead the church in joining along with heaven as we all worship King Jesus. Reconcile Church is a wonderful church located in Mid-Wilshire/Park La Brea truly serving God’s mission to reconcile people to each other and back to God. Definitely a great experience! Awesome church plant! Located at one of the best places in LA, across the La Brea Tarpits. Beautiful location. Worship on the second floor. Small and intimate church. Church starts at 10am. Pastor Mike and Pastor Daryl are so welcoming and easy going. Very easy to talk to. Amazing church for anyone. I grew up going to church my whole life but never seemed to find one that really encouraged & inspired me to grow spiritually and in community until I found Reconcile LA.

I’m forever grateful to have stumbled upon this church after my fiancé at the time stumbled upon Pastor Daryl who did our premarital counseling. Pastor Daryl is a gift from God who’s words really touch in a way that I haven’t experienced from others. One of this church’s mission and goals is to provide a safe space and community for ALL Individuals regardless of background, race, history, etc. all are truly welcomed here! If I were to describe my time at Reconcile LA in a few words, it would be: authentic, loving, inclusive, and growth. I came across this church when I was looking for a biblically sound church (which is not easy to find) that is multicultural, and focused on disciplining and authentic connection with God through Jesus and interconnection between the body (us). It’s a very small church and i thought I wanted a big church but i stayed because the preaching, the love of Jesus from the body there, and also the workship music ministry really touched my soul. Rarely do you have a church that you can contribute to since it’s so small and help determine how it’s shaped and be a part of moving it forward. Being a servant is part of this walk and also fellowshiping together which comes and feels really natural there. I thank the Lord for bringing me there! There are not many churches in mid city but look no further this is the one! There are kids teenagers young adults, older adults it’s a great place! And I believe it it’s just gonna keep going bigger and better. Awesome word. Best teaching I've listened to in a long time. Nice music ministry.

name: Red Hill Lutheran Church
Red Hill Lutheran Church - Tustin Campus
reviewSummary: Our family is loving this place. 💞 After many years, I found out that the Walker family whom we met at City of Hope attends here. Kevin Walker beat Stage 4 Pancreatic cancer and it's what gave my late husband hope that he could get 5 years with his terminal stage 4 stomach cancer, and Ryan, my late husband, did. Little did we know that when we met Kevin in the elevator with our first little baby girl that his family and his church would be some of the miracles that would allow us to be together, because they prayed for us. Kevin's father, the late Donald Walker was a special choir director here for many years, and he and his wonderful widow were married almost 70 years!! Now the amazing Harney family is blessing Red Hill Lutheran Church with musical gifts from each and every one of their family members who is still local. The Lord directed us here and I will, Lord willing, never stop finding ways for me, as a young widow, to show gratitude for the awesome Pastor Seth and his beautiful wife Julie Britton, and their church congregation!! A welcoming place for people who want to know Jesus personally, love deeply, and serve humbly. God's Blessings to you and your family ✝️ I've gone here for 12 years now and I've loved every minute of it.  There are wonderful sermons, activities, and the people are kind and loving.  We're like one big happy family! Redhill Lutheran is small but beautiful church, in so many ways. The sanctuary is filled with  all the traditional artifacts of an historical Christian church. The liturgical prayers and hymns are all biblical and historical. Truly an environment of respectful and joyful worship. The communion of saints is visible and palpable. No way does the sneaky snap reflect the church or the man. Shame on you for the snarky commentary. We were here for the Foothill High School Fall Choir Concert. The church is beautiful and the acoustics are great. Sometimes the parking is a bit challenging. The parking lot is also very dark and after the concert we nearly got hit by a car backing out. Be careful! Our family started coming here when our Son was in third Grade. The Spirit Filled Worship, true biblical teaching and family loving feeling have made it  source of strength for our spirits. Be Blessed :)

name: Redeemer Baptist Church
Redeemer Baptist Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary: This is such a welcoming, loving Christ like congregation. I was visiting with my son and his wife as this is where their church home. The worship svc was a bit more toned down musically than im used to, but that's not a bad thing, just a different  thing. The posture of the heart during worship is what brings us into the presence of God, not the musicality and instruments. The elders at Redeemer care about their flock. They strive to make much of Christ in everything they do. Every sermon points to Christ. The members are friendly and really seek to have a community that magnifies God! I recommend this church to anyone who is looking for a church in Riverside! I love this church and a lot CBU student goes there, a lot my friend goes there as well, CBU the best, same as the church lol. Gospel loving church with a beautiful, diverse community that loves Jesus and the world 💚 Very loving people. They get what it means to follow Jesus

name: Redeemer Bible Church
Redeemer Bible Church - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary: This is a very Christ centered church that will help you grow in the Lord. In addition to Sunday service, they also have mid week small group bible studies throughout North County.  They also focus on discipleship. And they have an awesome preschool ministry, and a youth ministry that my kids are a part of. Awesomeness

name: Redeemer Bible Church - Temecula Campus
Redeemer by the Sea Lutheran Church, Kindergarten & Preschool
Redeemer by the Sea Lutheran Church, Kindergarten & Preschool - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
Redeemer by the Sea creates the most welcoming environment for these kids! The warm smiles and happy enthusiastic greetings literally do not change from the start to the end of the school year. The directors Ms. Malloy & Ms. Rhonda both greet the kids every morning and afternoon by name. You can tell all of the teachers are genuinely excited to be there, they are all so friendly and engaging.

Our son had Ms. Stephanie and Ms. Violetta. They are the sweetest and energetic duo with a ton of experience. They make the kids feel so special and loved. They are respectful and take the time to really get to know the kids. They make learning fun (my personal fav - they even taught them about dental health and why brushing teeth is so important, amazing!) it's play based learning and they do the cutest crafts too. They have a pumpkin patch event, Mother's Day/Father's Day parties, a Christmas + Easter performance, and even a jog-a-thon! Our son also has a food allergy, which they take very seriously and we greatly appreciate. We feel totally at ease when we drop him off.

This is was our first experience choosing a preschool with our first child so we toured.. several.. schools!! After we toured Redeemer we knew hands down, it was the one. We couldn't be more pleased with our decision. We are now on his second year here - our son still gets so excited and truly looks forward to going to preschool every day. They get to go to chapel once a month and Pastor D makes it so much fun! The campus is new, clean, has a spacious playground and is extremely safe/secure! A growing and vibrant church. This is the place where we come together to celebrate and serve our God. Outstanding preschool and Kindergarten - there are a lot of families with young children. There is a great mix of traditional Lutheran liturgy and values and also forward leaning contemporary services with great live music from a praise band. There is a home here where any race, economic or family background will find friends and support. Give this place a try... we did 6 years ago and have been part of the Redeemer family ever since. We had a pretty awful experience with Redeemer. We signed up our daughter after being on the waitlist, and paid a non-refundable deposit for tuition, supplies and registration fee. You have no choice but to sign this as you sign up. A couple months later, we got a diagnosis our daughter had a special need and needed therapy, but the only time to do that was during the time we had class at Redeemer. The other option Redeemer gave us was in the afternoon sessions which didn't work for us, since we work. We withdrew 2+ months before school began and they replaced her spot but refused to give us back our deposit, even after we laid out the circumstance to them.

We had to take them to court to try to recover it. The judge ruled that even though it's bad business for them to do this and a bad way to treat families of those you're supposed to be helping, they could keep the nearly $500 because they offered us an option B (an option which didn't work for us).  This, also despite the fact that the CA Supreme Court has ruled non-refundable deposits ARE refundable if a replacement "buyer" (student) is found. They can't legally enrich themselves over our unfortunate circumstance, but they--a church preschool--opted to do that.

We are very frustrated, and not the first family to deal with this. Be wary of what you sign, and the fact that Redeemer's people don't necessarily have your best interests in mind, even when it comes to an unforeseen circumstance surrounding a 3-year-old. Worst Easter experience at any church.  First time at this church.  Some major photo production out front (poor timing on the second busiest time of the year). Greeted at door by old guys wearing white holy robes (like episcopalians and Catholics wear), and elders who gave me a printed packet.  I stepped out front to read while waiting for my children and grandchildren in their van. Photographer immediately approached me to push me aside, out of view because of my Hawaiian shirt in background (I forgot my Armani and tie).  Sorry, I don't attend churches where the type of car you arrive in, and what you're wearing make the poison inside of the cup seem clean (Isn't that what the Sanhedrin were criticized for by Jesus?).  Yikes.  Me thinks not.  I think I will stick with Bible-based non-denominational churches and leave all this religiosity for those who expect our appearance is what makes us holy enough to meet Jesus.  By the way, a professional photographer (like me) would have arranged his venue timing so that crowds of people (like on Easter Sunday) don't cramp his style or backgrounds.  Never coming back.  Stick to KWave (107.9) and your bible if you want to meet God.  Oh, I'm pretty sure he wears a white tunic with gold sash and gold boots (Yep, that's what it says in Daniel 10:5), sans tie and jacket, and the pearl white Lexus (or worse:  Black Beemer, Satan's car). Very friendly nice people

name: Redeemer Church OC

name: Redeemer Church of Orange County
Redeemer City Church
Redeemer City Church - Tampa (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Looking for a place where you can freely worship God? This is the place! No pretenses with this Pastor. His messages are down to earth and apply to today's life problems. Fantastic contemporary music! Two services 9:15 and 11:00 am Sundays with weekly City Group (small group) meeting throughout the Tampa area during the week. All ages are welcome and represented. A great place for children to learn the word of God. This is a very welcoming church with a great kids ministry and Bible teaching from the lead pastor Mitch. This is a church to call home and find community. Words cannot adequately express how much I love this church. The sound biblical teaching from Pastor Mitch is second to none. This church is my family, and I couldn't imagine doing life anywhere else. If you're looking for a fantastic church home, and live anywhere near Tampa, I highly recommend Redeemer City Church! If you are looking to be a part of a church community in a meaningful way and are unhappy with typical sermons that are simply self-promoting or filled with platitudes, then you should come check out Redeemer City Church.  This is an incredible new church with a warm and welcoming community. My family hunted all over South Tampa looking for a church community; we found an authentic and biblical one here at Redeemer. The teachings challenge (not just help us feel better about ourselves) us all to be more Christlike, emphasizing the point that we are not "better" than others because we call ourselves Christians - we struggle to live out our faith every day and try to be more faithful through life with our community. I would describe the preaching to be of a similar vein as Tim Keller (unapologetic, yet approachable, Christian teachings meant for everyone without ridicule). The church is also committed to having a demonstrable impact on the community of Tampa Heights through frequent service opportunities by partnering with local charities. The building is easy to miss, but don't let that fool you. Being a military family, we’ve been to a myriad of churches everywhere we’ve moved. This move to Tampa was the hardest for us to find a place where we could belong as grace-needy, in-process, don’t-have-it-all-together people until we stumbled into Redeemer City Church. Since then, we’re still those same grace-needy people, but we’re having those daily needs met with solid gospel preaching and shepherding, meaningful membership, a place to use our gifts and serve others, and a people to call our own. It’s truly a place where you can come as you are, consistently hear the good news about Jesus, and leave better than you were.

Our four kids are excited about the children’s and youth ministry (a first in the last several churches we’ve been a part of) and my husband and I are nourished by our weekly City Group where we can go deeper in Scripture and relationships as we break bread and open our bibles together.

We only wish we had stumbled into Redeemer sooner!

name: Redeemer Lutheran Church
Redeemer Lutheran Church - Huntington Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
I started attending Redeemer Lutheran Church in March 2025, went through confirmation classes with Pastor Ernst Jeong, and officially became a member in October—and my boyfriend and I have absolutely loved it.

It truly reminds me of the church I grew up in: a small, family-oriented community that teaches the Truth and stays grounded in the Gospel. There’s a more traditional feel to the services, which I really appreciate, and it creates a meaningful, reverent environment.

What has stood out most is how personally invested this church has been in me. From the very beginning, people have been incredibly welcoming, and it genuinely feels like a place where you’re known and cared for. Many families have been attending for decades, which speaks so much to the strength of the community.

They also host such fun and thoughtful events—we joined for preschool Trunk or Treat (dressed as Romans!) and have loved things like soup suppers and pie contests. There’s also a small, intentional preschool and a growing young adult community, which has been really special to be part of.

If you’re looking for a church that is rooted in truth, centered on the Gospel, and has a strong sense of community, I can’t recommend this church enough. With Easter coming up, it’s the perfect time to visit! When I moved to the area I began looking for a church that espoused the true word of God while keeping to the traditional Lutheran confessions. This church not only met my expectations, but exceeded them.

The community is incredibly sincere and welcoming, including generations of families that have been raised through this church. The young adult group is small, but still new and growing.

The traditional service structure provides the attention and reverance that the Word deserves. The sacraments are carried out weekly, providing the healing gifts that only the Lord can provide.

Let the Spirit bring you here and you will not be disappointed. Great church. Friendly congregation. Teachs the pure word of God. I did chair massage for teacher appreciation. Really great staff! Traditional Christian values are important to me.

name: Redeemer Lutheran Church - Ontario Campus
Redeemer OC
Redeemer OC - Newport Beach Campus
reviewSummary: I’ve been attending here with my wife for two years and we are grateful. Would definitely recommend to anyone. We have a great mix of cultures, races, and the service currently takes place in a Jewish temple, pretty cool! Also, there are many young families/Individuals here compared to other presbyterian churches I’ve visited.Come, check it out for yourself and say hello. God bless My family has been worshipping at Redeemer OC for about six years and love the order of worship and the teaching on Sunday mornings. We drive all the way down from north Orange County and have found a great Redeemer OC community up in our area that meets regularly together for meals and bible studies. We have been members at Redeemer for nearly 17 years and love this community of people! We are fed spiritually and grateful to be a part of an established, gospel-centered church. Redeemer is a wonderful place to worship. At Redeemer you find gospel centered teaching and a community of faith that seeks to live out that teaching in daily life. I love being a member and elder at Redeemer. It's a place where the Bible is taught faithfully, and people are known, loved, and cared for well.

name: Redeemer Presbyterian Church
Redeemer Presbyterian Church - Encinitas Campus
reviewSummary:
This church is truly a blessing! It is filled with kind, humble and Christ centered people. Even though it’s a large church, it has an incredible sense of community where you really feel like you belong.

The children’s program is phenomenal—biblically grounded, engaging, and full of love for the kids. The young adult community is equally vibrant, offering great fellowship, encouragement, and opportunities to grow together in Christ.

Every sermon is deeply rooted in Scripture, and it’s clear Redeemer is a true Bible-preaching church that faithfully adheres to God’s Word. Pastor Paul is a gifted preacher and wise shepherd who leads with humility and vision. He is passionate about making disciples who make disciples, faithfully fulfilling the Great Commission. His stewardship of the church is both inspiring and encouraging.

The community groups are a great way to meet people and there are plenty of welcome events and volunteer opportunities.  My wife and I were plugged in quickly and soon hosted a community group. I am glad I found this church! Like every church (lowercase c) it has it's pluses and minuses but my experience was best when I first attended and had some young adult friendships from 2018-2019. Pastor Paul sermons are probably the best reason to keep going, along with the diversity and the modern style worship in a nice space.
However, the biggest negatives of the church now are 2nd and 3rd services are totally crowded packed with parking challenging, and that the current "young adults" is very lacking on substance in terms of theological study and co-ed life maturity. As a 35 year old single male, I do feel I've had trouble connecting here and engaging faith in a meaningful way with people my life stage and the CG (community groups). We tried a few churches in San Diego and we found a real home here at Redeemer. The pastors are humble and inspiring. The congregation is friendly. It is multi generational, multi cultural and truly an inspiration. I highly recommend trying out this church.  If you’re further east or south you could try our church plant Trinity, another wonderful group Great church, very inviting atmosphere, and great engaging speakers!  They have a very contemporary worship environment with people of all backgrounds.  I would highly recommend a visit to check it out. After many years reasons for leaving best summed up here.
Look for people who are "real" about who they are, not trying to appear perfect.  Those are trustworthy people, and God is on their side.

God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble James 4:6

name: Redeemer Presbyterian Church - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Great PCA church with amazing people to go through life with! The church meets at 1:30pm at Baycities - Lomita (2043 Lomita Blvd, Lomita, CA 90717) and would love to have you visit.

name: Redemption Church
Redemption Church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary: Love the authenticity and engagement of people in the church. It is a small church environment that allows you to wrestle with your faith. Sincearity, simplicity in front of God

name: Redemption Church North County
Redemption Church North County - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary: My 3 Sunday experience is that of a Biblical Christ centered worship service including Christ exalting music, a humbling call to confession, an abundance of scripture, prayer, and direction, and the Lord's supper reminding of the only truths that matter, who and what He Is, has done and will do. This new congregation restores my hope for the Church here is San Diego. The Holy Spirit is at work here. I am grateful. Christ centered preaching! The Lord’s grace is working mightily at this church. Amazing to be apart of a congregation that’s foundation is their faith in the finished work of Christ. The dedication to evangelism is on going and fruitful. Thankful for God’s work in this Church The sovereignty and grace of Christ is exalted through the teaching and worship while the fruit of love, joy and  gratitude is evident among the body of believers doing life together in unity. Christ is preached weekly by expositional preaching book by book. Communion weekly. Reformed. Baptist. Law/Gospel distinction. Couldn't ask for more! Christ-Centered biblical teaching!

name: Redemption City Church
Redemption City Church - Daytona Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
This is the most welcoming loving Church I’ve ever been to. I’ve been with them since the beginning, and I can say they live by there Motto:  It’s not about nickels and noses. It’s about life-change in Christ. Fire and brimstone? Not here… There all about the love and GRACE of GOD and discernment.❤️✝️ This is home.
We find this church 3 years ago and we got plugged in very easily. Now it feels like family. The teaching is always clear, church staff is friendly and kind. There's kids care, students ministry, life groups during the week so there's plenty ways to participate and connect with others.
Check services time to visit 😊 So thankful God brought our family to Redemption City! God’s word is faithfully preached, the Gospel proclaimed, and people are known and loved. It took me a long time to find a new home church when I moved back home to Ormond Beach, and a great friend invited me to Redemption City Church and after my first visit I knew this would be my home church, period!
Thank you Jesus for bringing me here! A great place to attend; to follow Jesus.

name: Redlands Christian Center
Redlands Christian Center - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary: I have learned so much from the teachings of the pastors at Redlands Christian Center. It has impacted how I view myself and others in the light of the Gospel. This is truly a church that cares about its congregation! This is my Church filled with children families, worship and love.  PERIOD! Love it Good Service!

name: Redlands United Church of Christ
Redlands United Church of Christ - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary:
I never thought I would feel comfortable in a Christian church. If you had told me two years ago that I would not only become a member but that I would be part of the church choir, I would have laughed in your face. Yet here I am. 🙂 This has been our church home for more than two decades. It's open and affirming (meaning all are welcome - lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender and queer (LGBTQ+).) My wife and I raised our kids in this church and enjoy volunteering. RUCC is justice-oriented following the teachings of Jesus Christ. There are lots of opportunities to serve and be served. I love my Church, we are welcomed by all who attends.
The sermons are so meaningful and you know that The Lord is with you. The music is amazing and there is a quiet peace. If you are looking for a place to worship all are welcome. It is becoming embarrassingly difficult to find a church that embodies the love and compassion that Christ called us to show - too many would rather dwell on imagined attacks and hatred.  Fortunately, RUCC not only offers that love with open arms, but the sermons are in easy-listening layman's terms and often accompanied by brilliant visual aides.  Truly a brilliant church for the restless listener and learner, with a congregation that's never short on welcome! We're member of this church. Our church is open and affirming. If other church rejects you, our church accepts all the walk of life including the LGBTQ. Members are really nice. Pastor Jill is awesome!

name: Redondo Beach Center for Spiritual Living
Redondo Beach Center for Spiritual Living - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
What a wonderful, loving, welcoming community. i'm so glad I went to the service on sunday because it was very inspirational.  And Rev. Gregory was an encouraging, positive, and uplifting speaker. Everyone was kind and welcoming. Thank you ❤️ An inspiring, accepting place in the South Bay for everyone!  This Center helped me recognize the spirit in me and in everyone around me. You can tell by the way people stay after and visit with each other that lifelong bonds are created here.  Taking one of their classes helped me not only grow, but make connections and deep, caring friendships💖. Their kids mindfulness program is amazing and the adult classes like meditation, sound healing, and foundational spiritual classes will change your life💫✨⭐️! Simply put...life changing!!  This is the first place I truly feel at home.  Through the Center,  I've gained tools on how to be a better me and learn the steps to my current, abundant prosperity in my vocation and relationships.  I continue to evolve every day and love this community of like minded, welcoming and talented individuals! So many friends, feels like family, everybody's welcome.  Easy-going, peaceful. Lots of fun activities. People really care about you. I feel like I can leave my troubles at the door. I found my spiritual home. The first time I walked into this church, I was 16. Now I’m 40, and it has been a beautiful part of my life ever since. My oldest child grew up here, and the memories we’ve made will always stay with me.
I will always hold dear the love and guidance of Dr. Moira and Rev. Martha Topel, who led the Spanish ministry with so much grace.
Today, our church continues to grow and thrive under the leadership of Rev. Gregory. He has been a true blessing, helping guide our community through the challenges after Covid and bringing new life to our church.
The youth program is especially amazing. It’s led by Robyn and a former teen from the church who now serves as the teen advisor, which makes it even more special. Seeing that growth and continuity is truly inspiring. My kids and teen are now part of it, and it means so much to me.
This church truly feels like home. 💛

name: Redondo Beach Church of Christ
Redondo Beach Church of Christ - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
A warm welcoming congregation where all regular attenders openly acknowledge their brokenness because of sin and confess their faith in Jesus and live yielded lives to Him so others may see His light and be saved by His grace through faith and by confessing their sins and putting on Jesus in baptism.

•Genuine faith-filled congregation where only the Word of God is taught and practiced.

•Joyful and grateful congregation that sings of praise to our risen savior Jesus and God our Father.

•A prayerful congregation that knows the power of prayer through the Spirit in the name of Jesus that heals, leads, and comforts all our petitions when prayer is offered up in accordance with God’s will.

You are encouraged to visit the congregation in Redondo Beach, on Pacific Coast Highway. This is where we meet to worship our risen Lord in truth and humble sincerity.

There is but one church, the body of Christ, and there no single church that is on earth that scripture states one is to attend, yet scripture is clear in what a faithful gathering of believers shall worship our living God. So if you are curious what true faith in Jesus is all about or are already a member of the body of Christ, I encourage you to make a visit to the Redondo Beach Church and experience what I believe will be a life-changing experience because of the love of Christ shown to any and all those who attend. Very friendly people, a family atmosphere. Jesus is clearly the focus. Grew up going to RB Church of Christ and it feels like a second home. It is a warm and friendly environment with beautiful singing & prayer. Plus a delicious Sunday morning doughnut! Redondo Beach COC is a great church community with kind, welcoming people. We moved away a few years ago, but when we are back in town to visit,  Sunday service here still feels like coming home. Welcome!  Join us for inspiring relational messages of Christ's grace and mercy from minister Devin and from the caring warm friendly people, inspiring congressional singing of gospel hymns that praise our Lord with inspirational words for life which acknowledge His goodness and our thankfulness, prayers of encouraging hope and thankfulness, a time to focus on Christ's sacrificial death and resurrection as we participate in His communion that gives our faith the assurance of "Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the Lord for ever."

name: Reflection Church
Reflection Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been attending Reflection Church for about 5 months and it has been the best community I could find in Pasadena. I love how welcoming and friendly everyone has been. It also has been an amazing place for me to grow in my faith, Pastor Benjamin is the best! He gives a great message without fail every Sunday. If you are looking for a church that accepts you just as you are in this moment, Reflection Church is for you. Reflection Church in Pasadena became my home the minute I walked in. This is where I belong. It’s the place where I feel rooted, seen, heard, and deeply loved.

I have grown so much here — spiritually and personally. The messages are biblically grounded, practical, and truly transformative. The worship creates space to reflect, reset, and reconnect with God in a real and powerful way.

This is where I see my roots going deep. If you’re looking for a church that feels like home and helps you grow in faith with authenticity and love, Reflection Church is that place. Reflection Church has not only introduced who Jesus was to me, but this church has healed me from religious “church hurt”. I’ve learned that a lot of things I believed in and believed about myself were all lies. God is PRESENT at Reflection and I pray more will find their true home here. This is a place to call home! Pastor Ben and his family are so welcoming, and his teachings are authentic and speak to me every time. So happy my family and I are now a part of this Christian family. Our journey together in faith has begun.
Blessings ~ My husband and I are raising a young, multi-cultural family (4yo and 2yo). We were invited to Reflection to witness a baptism 1.5 years ago, and we’ve been hooked ever since. Pastor Ben is a grounded, humble, and caring leader - evident in the way he walks with Jesus, leads his family, and the Reflection family. It’s beautiful to see a diverse community coming together to build God’s church the way he intended… inclusive of people from all backgrounds, ages, and walks of life. If you’re looking for a place to be known, seen, cared for, and have purpose in growing God’s kingdom - you will not be disappointed. It’s a small, but growing, purpose-driven, Jesus-centered group of people to be connected to. We’ve been blessed in how we’ve grown so much in our faith and how we lead our family, which can often feel very lonely. Hope you consider checking it out!

name: Reformed Baptist Church of Riverside
Reformed Baptist Church of Riverside - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary:
This church is warm and welcoming. Their army of volunteers served the Reformed Baptist Network diligently and cheerfully as they hosted the annual conference this year.

I had the joy of serving alongside one of the elders, Troy Lamberth, and his son, Jackson as well as a robust AV team of volunteers and they made my life a breeze.

If you are local and looking for a solid church that preaches the full, revealed counsel of God through His Word then look no further than growing with this local body of believers! Annually hosts the Southern California Youth Conference which is such a wonderful event. Thank you for all the work you put into it! This is a solid church, Bible based, careful exegesis, excellent brotherly affection displayed, mission-centred congregation. The leadership of this church is dedicated to the authority of the Bible, believing it to be a revelation from God, and to the good news about Jesus coming to save us from the consequences of our disobedience. The preaching is careful and warm and the people seem happy to be here. I appreciate the fellowship you can find here; the diversity of the congregation, united by a shared faith; and how many kids there are! The Lord and Savior Jesus Christ is proclaimed here.

name: Refuge Bible Fellowship
Refuge Bible Fellowship - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary:
We were looking for a new church closer to home. We started coming here and they are welcoming, it feels like family and I am able to understand the word when the pastor is speaking about the word. They have rooms for your little ones to go to while you get to worship and hear from the Bible. Jesus loves us and you should turn to the Lord and walk with him. Come to this church while turning to and loving Jesus!!! This group operates more like a personality-driven movement or cult than a church. Their emphasis and near-worship on the pastor overshadows the teachings of and worship of Jesus. The community carries strong political messaging, with rhetoric that gets very extreme and is so overtly stated that I am surprised they are still tax-exempt.

During the pandemic, they openly disregarded mask legal requirements, and the congregation experienced a high number of deaths. Rather than reexamining their practices, leadership placed blame on individual members. Fear-based messaging, extremism, and tolerance for troubling behavior within the group are recurring themes.

For a long period, their website featured nothing but a donation request. That alone reflects their priorities. I am thankful to see this was finally changed.

Visitors may find them welcoming at first, but over time the culture becomes controlling and dismissive. Acceptance within the community depends on compliance with leadership’s expectations, even in trivial matters. Those who do not conform risk being shunned or targeted. Other churches provide healthier environments without these issues.

If leadership challenges this review, I am prepared to appeal and support it with evidence so it will remain. It is important that prospective visitors are aware of what they may encounter.

Sincerely,

A previous member for many years who is using an alternative account to protect those I knew before from being retaliated against for this review Pastor Raul teaches from the Bible verse by verse which is sadly rare these days. My family and I love attending this church and have grown in the Lord so much since we started attending. Refuge Bible Fellowship is my church home. I love the family atmosphere, the fellowship and caring people. Most of all I  relish the word of God preaced through Pastor Raul. Excellent church.  Great pastor, nice people.  He teaches through the Bible in a way anyone can understand.  They just had a Men's conference that had some solid teaching.  Check it out if you are looking for a home church.

name: Refuge Calvary Chapel Huntington Beach
Refuge Calvary Chapel Huntington Beach - Huntington Beach (North) Campus
reviewSummary:
This place is very welcoming! We felt at home. Pastor Geoff is awesome him and my husband hit it off he's down to earth.
We attended first service on Sunday morning 7:30 then we tried Saturday night 6 both were very good. Come as you are and have Happy Hour with Jesus! I found a church home! This church is welcoming and has mid week activities plus women’s retreats and Bible studies in the fall. I’m beyond happy. There are people my age ( 87) people I knew from Calvary chapel Costa  Mesa ; , women’s Friday morning study (50 years ago) we are blessed. the Holy Spirit is here.! Gods presence is obvious. . This church is AWESOME I came to church here with a walker and was having a hard time being able to walk without feeling dizzy and often falling backwards. In this church I heard the truth about precious Jesus and through Christ lead preaching I believe I have been healed I no longer need a walker or a cane, or any mobility device. I truly believe if you really want to belong to a solid church that does not sugar coat what it says in the Word and you want to grow and learn how to live a Christ filled life this is the church for you.At this church they make you feel at home and welcome and like part of a bigger family. Thank you God for this church may you help continue to build it up in your ways Lord Amen. My father recently passed away from metastatic liver cancer (Stage 4). His cancer metastasized from his liver to his spinal cord & entire skeletal structure. I felt as though life lacked any meaningful purpose. Out of desperation, I cycled for a multitude of miles alongside the beach and could not develop any sense of peace, regardless of the extent of my energy expenditure.

While returning home, I identified Refuge Calvary Chapel. The following day, I contacted Refuge Calvary Chapel and an individual answered the telephone. She was very calm, composed, compassionate, and understanding.

She offered a prayer and I immediately accepted the prayer. To be sincere, she delivered an immeasurable amount of peace within me. There are no words that can define how her prayer reinvigorated my soul. I felt a strong sense of peace and identified that my father has transcended this short-lived (temporary) material world and has entered the Kingdom of God.

Thank you for your prayer, may God bless you with many years. We need more people like you. God bless us ALL 🙏 everywhere, anywhere
Amen.....
Went to Sundays service before; it was and usually is: very calming, freeing and I love everyday tho how God has always shown up for me. HIS daughter His child. So in turn I love you continue to go on and live my lifetime here,H. B. Ca. faithful to our God-Father thank You again Almighty-Savior 🙏 ❤️ love you my Lord. Oh yeah and Also food bank here at church ⛪️ on Mondays, Tuesdays afternoon's is absolutely 💯 👌 yummy 😋 and wonderful!
Amen 🙏

name: REIGN Christian Fellowship ~ Pentecostal church in San Juan Capistrano ~ SUNDAY 10AM
REIGN Christian Fellowship ~ Pentecostal church in San Juan Capistrano ~ SUNDAY 10AM - San Clemente Campus
reviewSummary:
Started attending 2 sundays and everything has been good the Holy Spirit presence has been big and welcoming! Started going to encourage my kids to seek Gods kingdom first specially for my daughter 21 and son Luis Moreno 24 years old who I know will be attending soon because nothing is impossible for God !!! Reign Christian Fellowship has been my church home since November 2013. Sunday morning service is amazing. Spirit filled worship, love of Jesus, powerful, life-changing message from the Word of God. Pastor Terry and Pastor Debbie Hilgen are annointed, compassionate servant leaders who display the love of Jesus in a way that is authentic and nurturing. They are dedicated to helping others live a joyful, Spirit-powered life, grow in maturity and wisdom, discover their unique gifts, and walk in their calling. Reign provides opportunities during the week for prayer, fellowship, bible study, discipleship, and outreach. Pastor Terry and Pastor Debbie also offer mentoring for married couples and individuals. There is a wonderful Children's Ministry, and lunch is served each week after Sunday service. If you are looking for a church home, come and join us. Experience joy, live, and freedom in Jesus. You will be blessed and changed! Love, love, love Reign. This church is amazing, the pastors walk in the most love I have ever seen. Pastor Terry is a wonderful Shepard and powerful teacher, prayer person and leader. His wife Debbie teaches the best bible studies I have ever gone to and I've been a Christian my whole life.
They are sold out for Jesus and very wise and caring.

The have a wonderful lunch after Sunday service which is a beautiful way for people to spend more time together.

Grew so much there and felt safe, protected and prayed for.
Nedalee Thomas I had the pleasure of visiting Reign Church and I was welcomed with open arms. Both the pastor and his wife were incredibly friendly and made me feel right at home. The church itself was comfortable and inviting, and the worship team was truly amazing. It was clear that everyone there had a deep love and reverence for the Lord. Pastor Terry & Debbie Hilgen have restored my belief that loving Christians actually exist.  After walking away from the church for almost 20 years because of the things I experienced in it and and after coming back to the Lord six years ago because of His amazing love and mercy, I googled “Spirit Fill Church” and found Reign. My wife and I went and Pastor Terry after his  message  immediately came over to us and said come up here we want to pray for you. And it’s been a very loving and graceful relationship  between Pastor Terry and myself. He’s always there to encourage and route me on with the things of God.  And everyone that I’ve come  to know at the church are also very loving and supportive of all that God has in store for my wife and I. Reign is awesome!

name: Relevant Church
Relevant Church - Daytona Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
I've quite literally grown up while attending this church. The community support is incredible. We've made life long friends, connected through serving on the media team, and I could go on and on about how much fuller my life has become from being here.

I would 1000% suggest anyone of any walks of life, all backgrounds, any age.. to come just try walking through the doors. You will feel the love and warmth, and leave feeling empowered and full of purpose. I recently moved to the area, I was really missing my home church and was in search of a church where I could build connections and be a part of a Church family that connects with the community. This is the place!!!  I love being around like minded people who love Jesus!  The  pastors of this church are absolutely amazing and Holy Spirit filled!!!  They welcomed me with open arms. If you’re looking for a church where you are family ,this place of worshiping Jesus is for you. I have to mention how many different groups they offer at this church. Just check out their webpage. A huge shout out to my Pastor back home for helping me find this church. When my husband and I were first married and moved here to Daytona Beach from Jacksonville, we were looking for a place to call home. We went “church shopping”, I attended as many connect groups as I could, but I felt like we never quite fit… UNTIL we came to Relevant Church. One service — and we instantly knew. This was home. A place to start and raise a family. Fast forward to 7 years later, three kids later, we are so blessed by all that God has done and is yet to do in our lives at this amazing church!!! To God be the glory!!!!! "At Relevant Church, we don’t do 'religion as usual.' We believe in Jesus Christ—yesterday, today, and forever. Period.
We know the world is loud, but we’re here to provide a safe place to grow for every believer. You’re going to get the uncut Word of God here—no filters, no watering it down, just the truth that sets you free. As soon as I came to the door I had my backpack with me because I was just doing a little exploring and they asked to search my bag and I told them  no lol so I started to walk away but I said you know what I'm going to worship the Lord so I let them check my bag and at first they said you could let us check your bag and you can go in. Then they asked me if I would just keep it in the front entrance and I started in my head like what the heck so I said okay go ahead so I went in there tell me why when I sat down they had two big old guys come sit behind me so me being me I got up and went to the other side LOL 😂 then they followed me over there. But when I got there it was like already like 45 minutes into the service so I stayed for the second service and then they approached me and asked me my name and I said you all don't make me feel welcome LOL anyways we got into the worship and I went up to the front and started worshiping and they kept coming up to me saying sir can you come sit down we don't allow people in front and I said well I'm worshiping I'm in the presence of the Lord and you guys are grabbing me and disturbing me and and still during worship they finally came up to me and said you got to come with us or we're going to call the cops and so I go back to in the back with them and they're like sir you just look too suspicious and I said are you serious right now you guys got my bag in the front with you you guys checked it and you passed it what do you want from me I just want to worship the Lord and hear the word and they were like well this is our church and I said hold up hold up I thought this was God's church and he said no this is our church and I said okay I'm sorry I came to the wrong place LOL

name: Relevant Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary:
This is one of the most amazing Churches to experience. I was honored to preach and do my Martial Arts demonstration. The peopke and Pastor are so friendly. Relevant Church has forever changed my life. Since day one from meeting Pastor Jonathan at the Life Arts Center in Downtown to Riverside during the Art's Walk passing out water to the community and then again running into him at the UPS Store where I worked at. I always knew that Relevant Church will always have a place in my heart. They have an awesome Worship Experience every morning plus they also have a great children's and youth ministry! What I also love about this church is the passion of being involved within the community and as well being involved in your life. They welcome you home with open arms and they will be there with you when you feel that the whole world is on your shoulders. Relevant Church is all about doing life with one another! They not only became apart of my life, but my families' lives as well. You will never feel alone, judge etc. You will only feel the love and joy once you walk into Relevant Church. Like we say the first time your a guest, but the second time your family! I highly recommend coming to Relevant Church! Relevant Church has changed my life! I'm so thankful for Pastor Jonathan and all of the team. The word and the worship are amazing. Pastor Jonathan has made me a better person and has helped me build my relationship with God. He has given me the tools to get though the trails of my life! It does exist, a place where the church is not trying to control you or change you. A place where there isn't endless life application nonsense.  If you're looking for a church:  check it out.  if you think you don't need it: check it out. If you hate church: check it out. Peace, and see you there. Whether it's your first time ever visiting a church or you've been to church for many years, this experience in for you! It's such a loving atmosphere where people truly care and make you feel like you belong. My wife and I have two small boys who thoroughly enjoy the great kid's programing! We're really looking forward to this Sunday! We highly recommend it! See you there! I feel accepted, loved and part of a family! Appreciate and cherish the relationships that I have built here and going to continue to build! Relevant Church has challenged me to love all, meet people where they are at, make Jesus relevant, share the grace of God in my circle of influence!

This is a church that Kingdom minded and not Religious focused.

name: Relevant Church - Tampa (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been to this church twice. Pastor Paul's message is great and based in the Bible with verses cited. Not just a feel good message but teaching that challenges you to grow in your faith. He is authentic and real. The worship is great, it really is corporate and ellicts a response from the congregation. It is contemporary and loud but it is great. I don't know if this is the best church in Tampa, but if you want real Bible based teaching with great worship try Relevant in Sundays. After leaving the church I’ve been at for my entire life, Relevant was a welcoming new church home. You can come as you are. The sermons are biblical & realistic for things we are dealing with today. It’s not a giant church, but the people are kind & compassionate. They do so much for the Ybor and surrounding communities. I am glad to be going to Relevant during this phase of my life.  ❤️ I don’t know how exactly this place passes as a church. This is one strong example of the Western/American modern church that cares more about filling seats, than the Spirit filling up the people who are in desperate need of Him.

A few, and I mean a few of the people I've met there, I've grown to know more, and still to this day, I love having them as brothers and sisters in Christ.

However, my experiences personally with certain people have made my time there very challenging. Especially after providing the gifts God has given me to bring God's light, I became burnt out and discouraged that my involvement with Relevant wasn't truly valued. I don't see a leadership that exemplifies patience or gentleness, which is truly sad. They have made this church run more like a corporation rather than a church. Roles shouldn't be filled for the sake of being filled. That, by the way, is a toxic form of leadership. Roles should be in place of people who have been gifted the role and are honored in their ways. May I add that as I was leaving Relevant, I felt as though I had my hands tied to not leave the church until I was met with guilt that going elsewhere to find true fellowship was a big insult to injury. Churches ought to honor that God calls certain people to minister elsewhere. I'm not the only one who has had these similar experiences.

I'll say it this way: if God calls His followers to be obedient to His call, and someone gets in the way, those who get in the way disobey God, denying their calling.

Sometimes I will even see through service that people aren't as engaged, passionate, or zealous. Rarely but notably so would I see some people just put on a front.  There was only one thing I could be positive about, which was one life/community group I knew I could be around, learn from, and gain wisdom. Outside of that, it all feels like some people are just checking off a box, living the same life, not a sanctified life. There's a thing with their baptism that I don't see in the Bible, which is whether the person getting baptized has "asked Jesus to come into their heart." It's coming to the knowledge of one's sin, repenting of it, believing Jesus died and rose for us to be forgiven and have our sins paid for, to be made new, making Jesus Lord and Savior.

After leaving Relevant, I was contacted only by a few people who truly cared. And for some reason, Relevant decides to block me on social media. Guess I'm not good enough for them. But God has made me new, a new creation, a new identity, and that's what matters more.

I personally wouldn't recommend Relevant Church, whether you're just moving to the area, or trying to profit the Kingdom with the gifts Jesus has given you. Anyone can read the Bible, but their actions will tell a different side of the story. It's a Geral place for the family to praise the Lord, kid friendly rooms. Summer Vocational bible class for a week. Kids have a wonderful time. Volunteers provide free water every last Friday no strings attached. Great staff members and volunteers, overall I give this place 100 stars. Just absolutely an amazing  church to wordship/hear the TRUTH of GOD!  Where you can just simply be yourself  without being  judged. ❤️❤️❤️

name: Relevant Church LA
Relevant Church LA - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary: My family love Relevant Church LA. When we moved here from Detroit, we visited several church locations in Los Angeles and here in the Valley. We found the Relevant church Family was the church home for us. A church that believe in living holy, teaching and preaching God’s word from the Holy Bible and the Power of Prayer. The church has an intercessory prayer team that is dedicated to the family, the local and national government and for those who may have lost their way on all levels. Love Relevant! Fun welcoming church family... focused on You building a strong Relationship with God. The word of God is being preached out of the Bible.  It’s hard to fine churches that do that now days, but this church doesn’t compromise the word of God to fit culture.

name: Reliance Church
Reliance Church - Temecula Campus
reviewSummary: This church is solid in so many ways. If you’re looking for a church that preaches the Word, then look no further. All of the pastors rightly divide the truth. If it ain’t in the Bible, they’re not mixing it into the sermons. No spiritual gymnastics here. There are many programs outside of Sunday services to get plugged in and connected. I especially like the effort put into growing men and making disciples. This is a church about putting “Feet on your faith,” As Pastor Ted often says. You will experience a deep commitment to representing the life of Christ amongst the people who attend. Of course, there are no perfect churches, but our eyes are on Christ and Him magnified and glorified. We excitedly await his second coming! We just tried this church for the first time today 12/21/25 after moving here. We tried another local area non/denominational church (revival off Scott road) with our three kids but were told we couldn’t take our 2 year old in the sanctuary because she might be loud. Needless to say we didn’t go back and tried reliance. When we got there we checked in our kids to the children’s program but asked about bringing our 2 year old into the sanctuary. The lady was so nice and said “ Paster Ted has a bunch of grandkids and loves kids. All were welcome in sanctuary if they didn’t want to participate in the children’s programs.” We tried the kids programs any way and all 3 of our kids loved it. Pastor Ted’s message was deep and hopeful and just what we needed to hear. Parking was great, it was like Disneyland where they direct you right to a spot. Same with getting into the sanctuary. Very welcoming. I think we found our new home church. I love this church family! I've been attending and serving here for over a year, and I'm thankful for this Gospel-driven community of people. The Bible is faithfully taught and preached, and there is intentional and fruitful discipleship. I came from a much smaller church before and I was nervous about trying to find a place to serve, but it was easy for me to get connected with a ministry and grow in my gifting. There is a wide array of ministries available to anyone who wants to find loving and prayerful community in the church. Reliance Church has been a blessing in my family’s life. Our three girls have grown up in this church and are now teenagers. They have become rooted with God at the center of their being. Our Pastors teach THE BIBLE! Not the “Bible according to man’s opinion”. The Men’s Bible studies and Men’s tactical group have been a blessing to me personally. Thank you Lord for our Reliance Church Family, may others experience your love and grace through this church. 🙏 The church has a lot of younger adults here. And the worship was good. No religious spirit here. But they are lacking in the fear of the LORD and in love. It was as if many of them thought it was just a concert and not worship. It's not about quantity but quality. Jesus had 72 disciples at one point yet only 11 were with him on the mount of olives. I see a lot of work needed here. I pray for them 🙏🏻❤️

name: Reliance Community Church
Reliance Community Church - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
I’m so thankful that the Lord lead me to the Reliance church and family. This is truly a place where the Word of God is being spoken, where Jesus Christ is declared as Lord, and where the Holy Spirit is dwelling in our hearts. Like many other people, I’ve had some experiences at other churches that made me feel like I wasn’t noticed, wasn’t welcomed, etc. and I don’t want to make such a big comparison because I believe we as a people (believers) are the church, but Reliance definitely is somewhere that I have been noticed, greeted, hugged, welcomed and felt loved at since day 1. I absolutely recommend and WELCOME anyone and everyone to visit Reliance; all glory to God. 🙌🏼 I went today with my mom for the first time. It was the first time we've been to church in over a year due to us having been badly hurt at our previous 2 churches. My parents were Baptist pastors for several decades until my dad passed away, and I've been a Christian since childhood (and I've been ordained as well). We enjoyed the service and the sermon and the music. However, that said, we had higher expectations that were not met. Being first time visitors (we are church shopping as we'd like to find somewhere to congregate again) we expected to be approached by someone in the leadership just to ask about us and make us feel welcome... You know, get to know us a bit and ask for contact info... to make us feel comfortable (my dad taught me the importance of that as well as my grandfather who was also a pastor, and to just turn in a visitor card is just impersonal, though I'd gladly give one to someone who interacted with us more), and that didn't happen. After the service we even stood outside for several minutes waiting to see if someone would talk to us and no one did... People just passed us by. In short, our hospitality expectation fell short. Because of that, I give 3 out of 5 stars. They need to work on that aspect. It's very important to make first time visitors feel VERY welcome. Reliance is a wonderful church! The members are warm and inviting. Pastor Joel is amazing preacher and a mighty leader. If you are looking for a great loving friendly church for your family you really should join us on Sunday mornings at 10am or Wednesday at 7pm. Both services are wonderful. To everyone at Reliance church Happy New Years!!! This church is absolutely amazing.

No judgement, just love.

I guarantee you'll find something that's completely out of the norm from what you'd expect a church to be like. I was raised Christian, and hated going to church. Because of Reliance, my perspective has completely changed!

You should definitely give it a shot! Feel free to reach out to me if you have any questions! I've been here twice so far. It's a really lovely church service, and I even teared up last Sunday as they had three baptisms! I checked them as an alternative to the mega church I feel lost in, and I will be back!

name: Renew Church LA
Renew Church LA - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary:
I found Renew on a Google search in 2021 and over the last 5 years it's been a place that has truly become home. It's been a place where I've met my closest friends, found and discovered parts of my calling, and learned more about Jesus and how to follow Jesus.

Welcoming community, great pastoral teaching based on the Bible, and wonderful worship.

Come on the first Sunday of the month for community Sunday with a potluck, fellowship opportunities, and activities for kids. Great community and friendly folks at Renew LA.  The church is beautiful and in a great location.  My kids and family are growing spiritually and we enjoy our time here getting to know new people.  The worship team is awesome and Pastor Dihan always delivers a relevant and powerful message. Beautiful expression of God’s church. Diverse in age, culture and socio-economics. Renew is deeply committed to the Bible while also pressing into life with Holy Spirit. I highly recommend this church! The Lord is good! This was my first home church and the place where I found my faith. I was lost on my path and drifting away from the great vision He had for my life. At 26 years old, I was baptized at this church when it was located in Culver City. I can’t express enough how much this church and Pastor Dihan have done for me. Through them, I went back to school and got my life back on track. I can’t wait to visit again the next time I’m in California. The Lord is so good! I've been going to Renew for a while now, and I have to say, it’s been a really great experience. The staff is super welcoming, and the people here are awesome. It’s such a comfortable, non-judgmental community where you can really feel at home.

The pastors—Dihan, Raul, and Paul—are all great. They're easy to talk to, down-to-earth, and they do an awesome job breaking down scripture and showing us how we can apply it to our everyday lives. You can tell they really care about helping us grow in our faith.

One of the things I love most about Renew is how much they encourage discipleship. We have small groups that meet during the week, which is a great way to not only go deeper into the Bible but also share life with each other. It’s really about building strong relationships and community beyond just Sunday mornings.

If you're looking for a Bible-based church that’s welcoming, encouraging, and has a real sense of community, I’d definitely recommend checking out Renew Church LA!

name: Renew Church OC, Brea
Renew Church OC, Brea - Brea Campus
reviewSummary:
I have attended Renew for 2 years now and can honestly report that it's a great church. No church is perfect, and it took me a few months to feel truly connected to the community here. For anyone trying to break in, I recommend putting more effort into it than you may think is needed. Once you find your community here, it's excellent. The teaching is doctrinally sound and I trust the leadership. Renew Church is the best church in Orange County! It starts with the tremendous leadership of our church. Our pastors and elders instill an open and inviting environment that spills into the whole church. Renew is more than just fun, engaging, and biblically sound messages (which they are). It’s a tight knit family and a community that not only loves each other and pours into each other, but pours into our community and is about living out the truth of love and Jesus. I’ve been here for 5 years and it’s been the best decision to be invested in God’s community and for his community to invest in me as well. I have been a Christian growing up and so I've been to many churches. After attending Renew Church the past few months, I definitely feel that I've found my spiritual family at Renew church. I appreciate their church motto "for imperfect people only", and I feel that I have been able to be real and not have to put up an act to be accepted. The people there are very warm and welcoming and genuinely want to get to know one another.

They also have an awesome children's ministry! All of the staff seem to really love the kids and love teaching the kids about God and having fun with them. When I asked about volunteering, there is an application and screening process that everyone has to go through so I know this children's ministry is legit.

I also really enjoy that this church strives to be missional, multi-ethnic, and multi-generational. I love seeing people from different life stages and different walks of life worshipping God together and sharing life together. There are a lot of people I can learn from and have relationships with, both older and younger than me.

I would definitely recommend checking out Renew Church, it's been a great community, the senior pastor is super cool and feels like just one of the guys, and I really enjoy the teachings of God's Word here.

Oh and remember to park on the second floor of their parking structure. It's on top of a gym, so it might feel weird pulling in, but their second floor has banquet rooms where the church service is held. Been attending Renew Church OC for about 6-7 months now and purposely waited to write this review to be fair and offer an honest review.

Since our first Sunday, Renew has been welcoming, friendly, and caring. All the Pastors and staff have big hearts and truly care about everyone that visits. There are so many different ministries from Youth, College, Young Adult, Young Families, Global Missions, and classes ranging for sexual addiction to divorce care for kids. There's also a sports ministry that includes basketball, volleyball, and pickleball. I'm sure i i didn't list all the ministries since i'm still very new but Renew has so much to offer. They've been very caring and supportive to me and my family. We just had a beach baptism at Huntington Beach where my Dtr was baptized and it was perfect.

We also recently have this new partnership with Hope Intl Univ where Renew offers accredited college and seminary classes that are transferable to local colleges. How many other churches offer classes and for credit?

Renew likes to share we're a church for imperfect people but nobody's perfect on this planet.

Thank the Lord for Renew Church!! Blessings!! I've been going here since late January. I had some friends going there and they invited me. I've loved it since I started going, everyone is so genuine, welcoming, and loving. The church is constantly growing and it's amazing to see what God is doing through this church community within the local community and beyond. I'd recommend Renew to anyone looking for a new church.

reviewSummary: We finally found a home church after years of hopping around. Pastor Sam is a wonderful, practical, inclusive, welcoming, and unafraid pastor. He will speak truth to power. Virtually we did a 40 day lent journaling activity. Most of all, I think the sermons and worship are an honest time with God. It’s not a nightclub turned concert heavy church with light shows and black light live art installations so if that’s what you’re looking for, it’s not that. I’ve had a lot of personal and intimate shifts with God here and I feel very at peace and at home. If you’re looking for a church that will help inform how you can use your talents to help change the world, welcome home. I didn't go to church although I was IN the church. reviewSummary: If you are contemplating or even serious about learning about the word of God and a family atmosphere, then this is the place for you. We have a pastor-teacher on Sundays and Bible classes on Tuesday nights via zoom where he will further teach but make sure to have your bibles. He encourages you to follow up what is taught, so that you know what has been taught is “thus said the Lord” and is coming strictly from the Bible. I like this church! name: Renewed Life Church - Poway Campus
reviewSummary:
Renewed Life Church is our family’s recharging station. We rebuild our souls weekly, as we forge through life’s up and downs. We are constantly surrounded with people that love and support us. Been here for 15 yrs and plan on being here for the next 15. This is my home church.  After years of attending large mega-churches in San Diego, it is wonderful to be a part of a tight community of Christians serving each other and the community.  This warm, welcoming congregation is free of the politics and cliques we saw at larger churches.  Our pastor and staff keep us focused on the Bible and its application - not on side issues and popular, experiential-based distractions.  There's a strong small group ministry, and it's easy to get plugged into even more intimate fellowship.  There's a lot of history here, and you'll be warmly welcomed into it! We’ve been attending OBCF since December 2020. Olive Branch Christian Fellowship is a wonderful, multigenerational community of Jesus loving Christians really living out Jesus’ teachings. We love being part of a home group at this church where we can practice showing Jesus’ love to other families in our lives and have really grown and benefited from all of the relationships we’ve developed at this church.

I would recommend this church to anyone looking for a church of Christians looking to live real lives with each other, to be fully known and still fully loved, just as Jesus loves us. We've been at Olive Branch since the start of 2021. It was a breath of fresh air after attending a giant, monolithic church in RB prior. My family and I noticed immediately that the members of this sweet church deeply care about God and about others. Watching folks during the "greet each other" moments, I saw genuine interactions, smiles, tears and hugs, laughter---all from folks who span ages 14 to 94.

I have my guard up when exploring new churches or ministries, watching for bad teaching and theology or disingenuous people who just want to love-bomb you into staying in their fold. Well, we're still here and happy because none of that exists at Olive Branch. The recently-retired Pastor Scott taught his congregation to love well, even and especially in spite of differences of opinion/walks of life/stages of life; and the recently initiated Pastors Trevor and Danny teach the Bible faithfully and completely, in context (verse-by-verse), applying it to life only as far as can be done without adding one's own opinions.

The multigenerational nature of the church has only grown, but to date, the Sunday gathering is still small enough for people who remember each other and engage with one another. Plus, during the week, our home groups are another touch point for care and doing life together. My own home group has widows/widowers, young families, and everything in between. We discuss Christian teaching, challenge each other, edify each other, and grow in Christ together.

Last word: this church puts hands and treasure to service. Funds from congregational giving are dispatched as needs arise in the community far and wide, from partnering with other local ministries, to serving lunch and notes of encouragement to the staff of the school where we gather, to fulfilling tangible needs for Ukrainian churches and rescue/ministry efforts during the current crisis (buying a sprinter van, funding the building of shower stalls for refugees staying on-site, etc.).

We'd love for you to join us, and if what I've described doesn't hold up, you should find a church that honors God this way; but first, find a pastor, elder, or home group leader, and give them your honest feedback. Thanks for reading! Digging into the Bible every Sunday, relaxed fellowship over coffee,  building deeper relationships in weekly home groups - Olive Branch has been a place of renewal and blessing, with meaningful opportunities to serve, both locally and around the world.
