name: Saddleback Church San Diego
Saddleback Church San Diego - Del Mar Campus
reviewSummary:
By came from L.A.
Thankfully that Saddleback a church is located in SD County. Pastor Rick Warren is the head pastor based out of Lake Forest, CA in Orange county. There are 20 campuses in southern California and internationally. This is a satellite campus that projects the message on a screen. There is a local campus pastor who welcomes, prays, and gives guidance at the end of each sermon. The worship team is live and unique to each campus. This is the only location in San Diego so far, and has about 400 people each week. Services are 9am and 11am every Sunday. Great for all walks of life. They have children's care and student ministries for the teens. They provide TV screen outside with seating for those who choose to participate there instead of inside. There is usually something fun and extra after the service like kettle corn, bounce house, baptisms, and anything else to encourage people to hang out and fellowship. They encourage everyone to get involved in a small group so that as the church grows bigger, everyone can stay intimately connected. I had come here for the past 1.5 years and, it’s better than nothing.  If you’re not finding what you want at this location for praise, worship and education about God, Christ and the Holy Spirit and how to apply such knowledge to your life …. within walking distance of this location is a Grace Point Church that is an authentic spot and a different option for you at:

13340 Hayford Way, just down the street.
🙏🏻❤️ I was in San Diego on vacation and looked forward to experiencing Saddleback Church.  Warm people, talented worship leaders, a welcome environment for you to experience God and worship him without obstacles.

It was easy to find a parking place, great signage and direction from the parking lot crew.
“Welcome Back” statements by several people when walking in was a little strange, as I was a new visitor, but maybe I look like someone who’s been there before.  *shrug*

It appears that the church is new and growing (or maybe it’s a summer vacancy) as there were quite a few empty seats.

Welcome team was genuine and not invasive.

A lot of the message today was, “You can’t allow your feelings to…”.  Best two moments were scriptures read from Malachi about God hating divorce but not divorcees.  And experiencing God’s forgiveness as a means of forgiving others.

There is freedom in admitting that we fall short, that we don’t have it all together, and that God is forgiving us daily.  Book-study message today communicated forgiving the faults of others, which is hard to do when we don’t soak in God’s grace over our own shortcomings.

Thanks, Church, for providing me a place to worship and experience the presence of God today.

Warmly,
Ryan We became familiar with Saddleback after attending a Celebrate Recovery Summit at their main Lake Forest campus years ago. We love everything about Saddleback, their love, and focus on serving God and the community. The sermons are always SOO instructional and inspirational. And we always meet someone who genuinely seems to care (this time it was Joseph, his son Grant and two young visiting Asian women who were there for the 1st time and delighted us by asking LOTS of questions.)

name: Saddleback Church San Juan Capistrano
Saddleback Church San Juan Capistrano - San Juan Capistrano Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautiful property and church experience. Very friendly and welcoming. Lots of parking and service times. And they always have coffee and donuts, excellent Sunday school and child care for the littlest. Lots of sweet events for holidays etc. What a wonderful place. The people working here are so kind and friendly. The facility was phenomenal for our meeting of about 150. The rooms are very comfortable. I was there for meetings during two days. It is a very nice casual place. It is a good place to walk and talk. I am going every Sunday and my life is changed. Love this church very good massage and great environment . Beautiful huge campus!
Amazing wildlife and views.
Lake with ducks too.
Lots of parking.

name: Saddleback Church South Bay
Saddleback Church South Bay - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Excited to announce that the Bay Church will join the family of Saddleback Church. Becoming Saddleback South Bay. Lomita campus. Will start painting and clean up December 1st. Hope to have first service as Saddleback South Bay Church beginning of January. #Saddlebackchurchsouthbay Amazing loving Pastor's and Christ loving Church family. Come visit soon to hear encouraging messages from the bible:) Beautiful prayer team, worship and kids of all ages will love it! Come and visit on Sunday.  You will find a group of people who are welcoming, and loving.  You will be encouraged to grow in your faith.  If you have kids, the kiddos will be cared for by awesome people - while you attend service.  The campus pastor has a phrase, "We are not about religion, but relationship" - You will see this lived out here. We are all about relationships and helping each other through this journey of faith a very welcoming environment. Such a great church! Saint Andrew Catholic Church - Food Distribution Center - Pasadena Campus

name: Saint Angela Merici Catholic Church
Saint Angela Merici Catholic Church - Brea Campus
reviewSummary:
I had the pleasure of being part of my couples wedding in this church. The way the sun hit them during their ceremony was just beautiful. The whole look of this church is absolutely beautiful. Opening Night of Brea SummerFest was awesome. The church is host and has an amazing property. First time attending this church and we were shock seeing catholic girls wearing short skirts 5 inch above knees. This is so wrong. Feel like attending k-pop dance class instead. Didn't feel pure and clean attending the mass but disturbance. I celebrate the Euchrist at 5pm Sunday.
The youth group and their music, participation and enthusiasm sets the tone for a beautiful celebration!
I have lived in Brea for only 20 years of my 80.
This is the third parish I've belonged to and they've all been very similar especially with a parish grade school.
The amazing families and their participation are amazing.
I've been a Lector and Euchristic minister in those earlier years.
I continue to be a very proud Catholic praying for all the needs of my church and our Holy Father Pope Francis.🙏 The festival was so fun and the bands that played were excellent.  Highly impressed.

I had the pleasure of being part of my couples wedding in this church. The way the sun hit them during their ceremony was just beautiful. The whole look of this church is absolutely beautiful. Opening Night of Brea SummerFest was awesome. The church is host and has an amazing property. First time attending this church and we were shock seeing catholic girls wearing short skirts 5 inch above knees. This is so wrong. Feel like attending k-pop dance class instead. Didn't feel pure and clean attending the mass but disturbance. I celebrate the Euchrist at 5pm Sunday.
The youth group and their music, participation and enthusiasm sets the tone for a beautiful celebration!
I have lived in Brea for only 20 years of my 80.
This is the third parish I've belonged to and they've all been very similar especially with a parish grade school.
The amazing families and their participation are amazing.

name: Saint Angela Merici Church - Food Distribution Center
Saint Angela Merici Church - Food Distribution Center - Brea Campus
reviewSummary: Great and friendly thank you so much Great experience

name: Saint Anne Catholic Church
Saint Anne Catholic Church - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary: This is my favorite church in Orange County. The building has stained glass windows with beautiful holy images.The sermons from the priests and deacons are positive and inspirational. The music service in English and Spanish is amazing. The singers have beautiful voices and the people who play the instruments are very devoted and talented. Sometimes they have mariachi for special occasions and that just makes the Mass even more spectacular. If you're lucky you may even experience a few miracles here. During the Mass of the Virgen Mary on December 12, there was a mystical scent of fresh roses at the beginning of Mass. During the Christmas Mass on December 25,there was a bright ray of sunshine coming through the window and shining onto the alter. When you walk out of Mass you feel so much peace and calmness from the grace of God. I absolutely love this Church. This parish has been my home for many years. The community is friendly and the staff in the adult faith formation (Efrain and Silvia) are very good at their job. They guide and help so well. I love this church. I feel really close to God when I go in there. I feel his presence. 🙏 This church has a great environment the lighting is not that great for photography and they don't allow Flash when you're having events like a baptism quinceaneras or weddings I've also seen that they have a lot of funeral services this Catholic Church also provides classes for catechism I've also been here to take classes on how to be a Godfather so you can get certified and be a Godfather in this church or any other Catholic Church affiliated once I took a class here so I could be a Godfather in a church in Mexico I have had nothing but good experiences in this church. It is such a shame that parishioners are so openly racist. As a Vietnamese woman myself, I am so embarrassed

name: Saint Anne Church & Shrine
Saint Anne Church & Shrine - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary: I love the many different times they offer services, both in English and Spanish, and the different special celebrations frequently taking place. A very close-to-heart kind of place, very peaceful. The Shrine is an amazing place to meditate and pray. I already gave a rave review of this church under my other Google email. It’s a nice church I haven’t had a chance to get there in awhile, as I Lyft/Uber everywhere. The pastor had great sermons. Outside Grotto to  Our Lady is very beautiful.. I attend the morning mass at 10 am for the first time. I was very delighted Excellent service priest was awesome very kind and marvelous sermon. I want to keep on going to this service. I enjoy the homolies and messages behind  every mass that I attend and the community members are very kind and friendly

name: Saint Barbara Catholic Church
Saint Barbara Catholic Church - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary:
It is really upsetting to see someone who works at a church treating people with disrespect, especially by yelling at them. A church is supposed to be a place where people feel welcomed, safe, and supported, not judged or intimidated. When a staff member raises their voice or speaks harshly, it creates an uncomfortable and even hostile environment, which goes completely against the values that a church is meant to represent, kindness, patience, and compassion. People come to church for peace, guidance, and sometimes during difficult moments in their lives, so being yelled at can be discouraging and hurtful. It reflects poorly not only on that individual but also on the entire community. Those in positions of responsibility should set an example of respect and understanding, and it’s disappointing when they fail to do so. This place is honestly a disgrace to what a church is supposed to represent. Instead of kindness, you’re met with arrogance and disrespect. The way people are treated here completely contradicts any message of compassion or humility. It’s disturbing to see a space that claims moral authority act with such hostility and lack of basic decency. If this is how they treat others, then they seriously need to question what they actually stand for. It was my first visit to this Catholic Church. It was nice and there was ample parking. I got there a little after the 9am Mass and was able to find time to sit and pray. I would go again. Its parishioners were so friendly. My mother-in-law's Vietnamese funeral service was superbly done. I am Irish and was not familiar with the full traditional funeral ceremony. I also don't understand Vietnamese. The choir is very good and moved me without knowing the words. For me, it was the most healing funeral I've ever participated in

The church is beautiful inside and out. School on the property. Seems very involved with the Santa Ana area community The church offers several masses on Saturday for Sunday masses. And more masses for Sunday. Some masses are tailored for the Vietnamese community.

name: Saint Brides Celtic Catholic Church
Saint Brides Celtic Catholic Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary: I’m seeing reviews here denouncing this church as “illegitimate.” Well, illegitimate according to whom? The Church makes no claims to Roman Catholicism, and one quick read of the church’s name makes that clear. So what exactly is the problem? Many religious groups follow the Catholic tradition. Do you walk into an Orthodox or Anglican Church and review negatively for their lack of communion with Rome? Well, you shouldn’t; that’s silly. They have a different history within Catholicism than the Roman church. Rather, it seems that some Roman Catholics are getting confused about what this church is and seek to punish it for their own lack of due diligence. That seems to reflect more poorly on the Roman Catholic than this community. Not a legitimate Catholic Church approved by the diocese of San Bernardino. Don't attend this if you take your Catholic faith seriously. If your catholic do not attend. Their are lots of Catholic churches in the area.

name: Saint Charles Borromeo Catholic Church and Academy
Saint Charles Borromeo Catholic Church and Academy - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: In my quest to visit every Catholic Church in San Diego county, I recently attended a Sunday Mass at Saint Charles Borromeo Catholic Church in San Diego. The 10 AM service was well-attended but not crowded, and the atmosphere was welcoming and inviting. The Mass was celebrated in English, and the priest gave an inspiring homily. I was impressed by the cool vibe of the community, and I would definitely recommend attending Mass at this church if you are near Liberty Station and looking for a lovely and welcoming place to worship. Bad experience with Nextdoor. They suspended me for showcasing our Farmers Market vendors on Saturdays 9-1. Great church and school I love there community and the students there are very kind and polite My wife and I had never been to this place before though The neighborhood has a very comfortable feeling to it where it is. Stopped by to attend mass on Mother's Day and really enjoyed the service. This is a Catholic Church, so if you are Catholic you made enjoy the experience here. Sometimes it's great to have different places to go to. Even if you are not Catholic you just might like it here. It would be my hope that you gain a most heart fulfilled experience here. I certainly would not be surprised. My 3 kids have been going to this school for 4 years now.  I know of a handful of great catholic schools in the area, but this one happens to fit our family well.  We've gone through 2 Priests and 2 Principles since we've been here.  The current Priest, Father John is so down to earth and really loves the academy.  As for the new Principle, she is a loving and kind person with kids of her own that go here.  Please ignore the negative reviews and visit the school yourself to make your own judgement.

name: Saint Columban Catholic Church
Saint Columban Catholic Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary: This church has some major issues with its servers whatever you call them.  Their attitude, manner and behaviors just rub the wrong way, as they don’t belong in a worshipping place.  Maybe they need to change their religion. It’s not easy to be Catholic because the rules are very strict.  If they cannot follow Canon laws maybe consider joining other Christian dominations where they can pick and choose the rules they like or open their own church to worship themselves. St. Columban is my hometown Church where I grew up going for over 30 years. Even if I moved I still come back and attend mass when i can on the weekends or special holidays mass. I come to Duc Me La Vang to pray and our family is blessed. I take my kids here to pray all the time. There is a new restroom and the church is always super clean. Gorgeous church and beautiful Christmas decorations. What the janitor giving the evil eye? Been a while since I turned to God. But as soon as I got there the Hispanic janitor giving me the evil stare like saying get out of here. 😠 He used to never be there. And it was a perfect adorable time to adore Jesus. So sad 😢 Horrible experience at the 7pm Vietnamese mass. The priest gave me two body of Christ. I didn’t realize this until I was halfway to my seat since I normally pray and do the sign of the cross as I’m walking away. Wasn’t sure if you can consume both or not, so I held onto one and planned to give it to the priest after. After mass I went up to him and gave him the extra I had. He looked at me like I stole it and freaked out. I told him he accidentally gave me two. He then scolded me and told me I should have given it back right away (there was no time, they had already started putting the body of christ away) or consumed both. I told him I didn’t know that I could do that, and he then continued to tell me I was in the wrong. Literally the worst experience ever and has honestly turned me off from this church and religion. Disgusting.

Saint David's Anglican Church - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary:
Great to welcoming church that embraced me and our family. Got connected to people and was able to serve. It’s been a Blessing. Everyone is so warm and caring. The Bible studies and meeting have really helped me understand scripture better and it has given me the tools to have better knowledge of scripture as well . Best church I ever attended. Intelligent and orthodox Biblical teaching and preaching. The congregation is diverse and very loving. So are the lay and ordained staff with leaders of both genders. Welcoming and friendly place to worship.  Congregation is loving and kind, pastor is convicted and speaks God's word in a way we can all understand.  Service was spirit filled and beautiful. I love st. David Church. They are very helpful. As well as I have seen many miracles there.
People very friendly, in a peaceful environment and always God’s massages spoken. Also, when Fr. José was there many miracles happened to me 🙏 St.David's is a place of compassion and love in action. Our family has been supported and encouraged for years.   We've met lifelong friends here. Stop by if you're seeking a place to grow in faith, life, and fun.

name: Saint Elizabeth Ann Seton Church
Saint Elizabeth Ann Seton Church - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary:
The best Catholic church in Irvine. It is not big nor crowded. But a close community of christians. They have excellent Children ministry and Choir. Father Paul and Father Brandon are taking it to the next level A welcoming congregation with parishioners from elderly to infants, families, students from UCI, singles. Numerous ministries available for volunteering, including the area’s most active Knights of Columbus men’s group. Lovely church with the friendliest community. Haven't lived in Irvine for many years but I still visit the church on occasion. Beautiful Mass Holy Thursday.
English, Spanish and Chinese combined . I believe there was even a song sang in Philipino.
Beautiful church and All priests are very welcoming.
Love to go to mass here. 🙏❤️ Adoration on Tuesdays where one feels the presence of the Lord. Sacred place of worship.

name: Saint Finbar Church
Saint Finbar Church - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary: This Parrish is my Home! For the last 4 years it has been a Blessing to count myself as a member of Saint Finbars wonderful Family! A great community where I can Praise and Worship Our loving God. May God bless our Father Francis Always. Beautiful community and church. Band is okay, nothing compared to a Christian church with the more modernized music vibe. Nonetheless, if you are a catholic like me, this church is a go-to, and the pastors are my favorite. Kind and understanding messages that you can comprehend and understand (clear voices). The church has a lot of space and speakers all around. Can get crowded around holidays. Great small church, good pastor, vibrant community, English, Spanish, And Vietnamese masses. I grew up with St Finbar as my parish. I was so excited to get married there since my parents also got married there however my wedding day was a disaster. Father did the entire mass out of order, made us kiss before we even exchanged rings and then didn’t even say the vows we chose, which threw us off completely and for that reason I didn’t get the “I do” moment I waited my entire life for. Just really made me so sad on my wedding day, a moment I dreamt of for the longest time just completely botched and I never got my I do moment. This was also because they never set up a proper rehearsal for my husband and I. I was baptized here in 1959 my holy safe place

name: Saint Francis de Sales Catholic Church
Saint Francis de Sales Catholic Church - Miami Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Was eating my lunch out front got told from the pastor him self we was not allowed to eat out front and kicked us out. I thought a church was nice friendly and caring not mean and aggressive. Thank you pastor for the warm and kind words you gave us. This Catholic church is a heavenly place in Miami Beach. The priest who serves this Parish is extremely blessed and he is indeed guided by the Holy Spirit when he talks. I have confessed here twice and both times I felt as if Jesus Himself was there listening to me and talking to me. The decoration here is beautiful. The helpers are caring and loving. When in South Beach, I recommend: cone and pray at Saint Francis de Sales Catholic Church. It’s a fine church if you are bilingual but can be hard to understand the priest. It was fine until the priest on a Sunday said to please ENJOY the refreshments in the back of the church after mass, that ended up being a horrible time. We went to be nice and be part of the community but once we went to the table to grab a cookie they didn’t say a word to us, we were in that room talking and two men come up to me and my sister telling us that we stole, we thought he was joking but they all started giving us horrible faces. Now my boyfriend was talking with someone else and finished his muffin and stepped out and they all started shouting that he was a thief and he didn’t pay to go grab him that he needs to pay. Mind you, they didn’t say “that would be $3.50” or anything so how would we know? Then proceeded to make an entire scene about it. That is not how a church operates.
Then we come back to pay them in cash and they say they aren’t even part of the church. We thought that was weird.
Very disrespectful and disappointing experience. This is a place needed every Sunday. I am from NY and I make sure to find a church I can attend my weekly mass. The place where we all are 1, 1 in the father, we are all family. If you are having a ruff day or week this is the place to feel better and ask for forgiveness, which both will be bestowed upon you. I felt like I was at home with  my family. All praise given to the Alpha and Omega. If you are reading this review, may all the blessings be with you and all your loved ones. AMEN! Always 5⭐️ Great spirit within this church. Loved attending mass on my vacation.

name: Saint Francis Xavier Church
Saint Francis Xavier Church - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautiful church and school. Warm and friendly. A great place to worship. We were there for mass and a celebration. Witnessed some pretty severe liturgical abuse during Mass while traveling here last spring. Not only were they singing alleluias during Lent, but they also had laypeople reading the gospel, interrupting it repeatedly to sing songs. A truly disturbing experience. I would advise finding a Catholic Church that actually treats the Mass with the solemnity and respect that is warranted. I haven't been to church in a very long time. I'm talking decades. Given my history I never expected to be accepted this way into a church. I'll be here every Sunday regardless of what else is going on in my life. Because it seems to me to be a genuine place. The kind of place where I can come to terms with my past and finally connect with God. Signed up for their baptism workshop and we were pretty much picked on because we wouldn't go to church every Sunday. Our God mother to be was embarrassed by the priest cause she had her daughter at a young age. When we finally survived that workshop we had to make another appointment to meet with the priest before the baptism. We called for a month and heard nothing back. Finally we made an appointment and on the day of the priest cancelled on us and said he would call us back to make another appointment. Never happened. We called two more times and nothing. So, in the end we just gave up. I felt like I was judged from people who are supposed to inspire faith and much more. A lot more happened at the workshop but i won't mention any more Was a lay minister here, and I have to confess I knew next to nothing about the Holy Faith. But this is the Novus Ordo Church, completely and purposely disconnected from Tradition. Thankfully now, I am a sedevacantist and wait for the day when the Latin Mass and the Dogmas of the Church may be reestablished.
Pax Christi.

name: Saint James Catholic Church
Saint James Catholic Church - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
This place feels deeply blessed and touched by God’s presence. The solemn and peaceful atmosphere brings comfort to the heart and soul. It is a beautiful sanctuary where you can pray, reflect, and feel spiritually renewed. Being here reminds you of God’s love and grace. I never expected one of the most painful phone calls of my life to be to a church.

I called St. James Catholic Church because I am facing a financial crisis and desperately needed help with rent. I understand that not every parish offers financial assistance. That was never my biggest disappointment.

It was the lack of compassion.

When I asked whether they offered rental assistance, the receptionist, Katie Concklin, responded in an annoyed tone, “Who is saying that we offer that?” I was shocked. I replied that I simply thought a church would understand why someone in need might call asking for mercy and help. She hung up on me. When I called back to explain how hurtful the interaction had been, she hung up on me again.

I later spoke with Fr. Matt Murphy, hoping he would at least listen. Instead, he defended the interaction and told me, in a condescending voice, “You are not acting like someone who needs help.”

That sentence broke my heart.

I have lived with severe mental illness for more than 30 years and Complex PTSD. I have spent decades trying therapy, medications, treatment programs, and doing everything I can to heal. It is not my fault that our mental health system is so broken or that so many people fall through the cracks. When someone has been drowning for years, they may sound desperate. Desperation is not a character flaw.

What shocked me most is that even if the church could not help financially, no one stopped to ask if I was okay, offer a prayer, or refer me to another organization that might help. Compassion costs nothing.

Sadly, this is not my first experience like this. In my personal experience, some of the least compassionate responses I have received during my darkest moments have come from people within the Catholic Church. That is one of the reasons I am no longer Catholic.

Jesus met suffering with compassion. Pope Leo XIV has repeatedly called on Christians to accompany the vulnerable with mercy, tenderness, and love. That is what I hoped to find when I called a church.

I am sharing this because I believe the Church can do better. The next person who calls may be suicidal, homeless, or experiencing the worst day of their life. A few moments of kindness could change everything.

I also cannot ignore that, as a Latina, I left wondering whether bias played a role in how I was spoken to. I cannot say that it did, but I know I felt dismissed and spoken to as though I were unintelligent.

This isn’t about money anymore.

It’s about compassion.

I pray so that God can touch the hearts of Fr Matt Murphy and Katie Conklin so that He can touch their hearts and they can be nicer to people in need no matter their background, sex, religion or race 🙏🏽. Amen. My favorite Church in Southern California  in which I feel peace and tranquility especially during the most challenging times! It is sad that this is a place of worship that has placed a sign on their grass that excludes so many individuals. No Ball Games, No Dogs, No Skateboards, No Scooters, No Bicycles etc. etc. etc. No Trespassing. I've never known a Catholic Church to be private and only include "authorized persons". I guess "all are welcome" is not the message here. This is my local church. Everyone here is friendly and welcoming. Check the website for all the coming events.

name: Saint Joachim Catholic Church
Saint Joachim Catholic Church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
My wife and I were visiting this parish while in Newport Beach, and we had a very difficult experience during Communion. My wife has been receiving the Eucharist kneeling for several years as a personal act of reverence, which is permitted in the Catholic Church.

When she approached to receive kneeling, the priest (Fr. Capone) instructed her to stand and would not give her Communion until she did. It was uncomfortable to witness and clearly distressing for her, especially in what should be a deeply sacred and peaceful moment.

I’m sharing this so that others who feel strongly about receiving kneeling are aware that, in our experience, it was not permitted here.” You should have a choice whether you want to stand or Neil. No one should force you if you want to be extra reverent to Jesus, our Lord and Savior.  What will the priest do the day they see him? Will they kneel or will they stand every knee shall bow down to our Lord.  Let’s not be lukewarm let’s be hot for Christ. San Joachim holds a special place in my heart and I’ve only been there once! Beautiful church and atmosphere! Thank you for all that you do! Amen! St Joachim is a lovely church, gets full, many activities, photo is during Night Adoration of Blessed Sacrament. St. Joachim Catholic School protects children who bully others. Bullies will always exist. Our Catholic belief that all are beautiful children of God, necessarily supports that Catholic school staff are obligated to keep our children safe from bullies. But the principal, pastor and staff at St Joachim school don’t believe this. Wondering if this school is still Catholic. Beautiful church music is amazing.

name: Saint John Lutheran Church
Saint John Lutheran Church - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary: Dedicated congregation . Excellent service and attention; you can feel the warmth of family. Each celebration is a wonderful experience of living and feeling our faith. Pastor María Paiva, with her message from the Word of God, leads us to reflect on our daily commitment to living the Christian faith. It is a beautiful experience of unity, prayer, and respect as a community. Good service, the people are nice. 🙂

name: Saint John Paul II Polish Center
Saint John Paul II Polish Center - Yorba Linda Campus
reviewSummary: Nice church for a prayer with good Polish community and very welcoming pastor. They have a small Polish festival every September, which we attend. Easy parking, nice entertainment. The crepes and pierogi are delicious. Sometimes it's difficult to find a place to sit to eat and the line is always long for the desserts. It's all a good time, though. Thank you! I love The Polish Festival they have here every year. I never miss it! Everybody is always having a great time. There's music and great food. I love the stuffed cabbage! Visit their Dozynki Harvest Festival each September. Small Catholic Church that offers services in English, Polish (and Latin - Tridentine Mass). The Center is also a home to Polish School (for children but there are also classes for English speakers who want to learn Polish). The Center hosts many events, including a music concert that recently raised thousands of dollars for Ukrainian refugees. A wonderful place to worship and practice our Catholic Faith. The Polish Language Mass is warm and moving and all are invited.  If you are looking for a traditional Spiritual Mass, this is the place to be.  I especially enjoy the lovely courtyard and the wonderful tributes to Saint John Paul II, our former Pope, who has blessed so many through his intercession. Viva il Papa, Pope Saint John Paul II!  Chwała Ojcu!!

name: Saint John the Baptist Catholic Church
Saint John the Baptist Catholic Church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
I really like the Norbertine religious. The mass was very nice and the homily clear and pertinent to today. I’m here visiting the area from Salt Lake City for daily mass. Great church and great school. Families here are so welcoming from the school and church. They hold a summer festival each year my kids love going to. Jackson is a great security there. Highly recommend this parish as the community here is very tight group and very welcoming. Offer church services on Saturday evenings and all day Sundays My childhood church.  The inside is gorgeous. Norbertine priests so very traditional . Lots of parking also a school so very community based.  Fish fry during lent is the best!!! Beautiful church to get married at! Staff was helpful and friendly.  The ceremony was incredibly moving and meaningful.  There is ample parking, too.

Bonus point: this church features one of my favorite stained glass windows (photo attached). St John the Baptist parish and the Norbertine fathers saved my life. Thank God. There is no other parish in Orange County like this one besides the St Michael’s Abbey. The Saints and Early Church Fathers are indeed smiling down on SJB.

name: Saint John the Baptist Catholic School

horrible experience, my daughter was in a class here and the teachers are so mean towards the kids. This is one of the churches of my youth. My grandmother sang in the choir at st. John when I was a little girl. It sure did brought back some great memories for me. name: Saint John's Episcopal Church

reviewSummary: A joyous and welcoming experience. It was a celebration of 50 years of service by the organist. Amazing music, both keyboards (organ and piano) and voice. name: Saint Joseph Catholic Church
Saint Joseph Catholic Church Campus
Saint Joseph Church
Saint Joseph Church - Orange Campus
reviewSummary: The Cardinal is a  local in the Orange County Diocese.  He has conducted Mass, in English at Saint Barbara's, on Euclid. The believing families are, truly Christian here. The decor is prestigious and well kept. Clean and Tidy.  There were Avocado farmers offering  deals on Avocado fruit, outside of the cathedral,  for some type of fundraising to benefit the churches involvement in local city affairs.  Plenty of comfortable seating, and a musically inspired precession.  Nice place to have a church "Sunday ", morning... St. Joseph’s church is absolutely beautiful. I had been in the past a few times. I now live in San Diego and came to Santa Ana to go to mass with family for Easter. So I chose St. Joseph’s Church remembering how beautiful. Just wanted others to be aware it has changed a lot. I went to the 9 am English mass and it wasn’t a traditional mass. They had a lot of Samoan traditions incorporated in the mass. It really took my mind off of Jesus and the resurrection on this most special day. Also almost all songs were in a different language and sounded very islandie and sung in a very load volume. After I received communion I could not hear my own thoughts let alone focus on praying. It was very theatrical. All traditions are beautiful and I respect them, I would have wanted to know what I was in for and have the option to choose a more traditional Catholic Church where the focus is purely on God, our lord and savior Jesus Christ and the gospel. The mass should be labeled English/Samoan mass. Gods bless everyone and always keep your focus on Jesus especially in Church. July 22nd 2023 - My 2nd time Capturing a wedding ceremony here and the Architecture is beautiful outside! Congratulations to Stephanie & Francisco. Nice little church in Downtown Santa Ana. Near the County Civic Center. Mass in English on Holy Days of Obligation at 12.15 pm. Plenty of seats and music and normally a good sermon. Parking is available close to the church. Beautiful church . Priests are helpful in family values and spiritual growth ❤️🙏

name: Saint Jude Melkite Greek Catholic Church
Saint Jude Melkite Greek Catholic Church - Miami (Downtown/Brickell) Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautiful church that brings me peace walking around! Spend 10 minutes sitting in the garden. It will help brighten your day! Very special church and the area where it is.
This church has a style that it seems like you are visiting a place from the 1930s.
Close to it there cafeterias, a border with the sea, etc.
I recommend it. Enjoy it. Truly shining the unity of the church, a place where latinos, americans and middle easterners can all worship together. In the heart of Miami. Beautiful mosaics and Icons. Rich history. This has always been my favorite Church in the entire Miami Dade County, one of the most beautiful and peaceful churches we have in town.  The Day of St. Jude on October 28 it used to be one of the most beautiful days, the church held the St. Jude Festival, the mass is so powerful, the church gets really crowded and you feel the energy, faith and devotion of the people, and the church chorus is just amazing, it really complements the whole spiritual experience.

There is a gift shop right by the main entrance of the church where you will find ll type of religious items like rosaries, little statues of St. Jude and jewelry, with really good prices.

Parking could be an inconvenience depending on the day and time of the visit as only street parking is available in the area.

When you visit Miami if you are in the Downtown area, Brickell is just a few mins away, so I highly recommend to visit this peaceful church!

Blessings 🙏 Historic beautiful Melkate Catholic Church,ancient rite. The house of the miraculous Saint Jude. 3 masses every Sunday. 9:00 (inglish)11:30(inglish-àrabe)6:00(español)

name: Saint Jude Shrine of the West
Saint Jude Shrine of the West - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
For personal reasons, this parish will always have a special place in my heart, and serves me an occasional visit. I attend Mass at another parish. That said, I deeply lament the fact that they added the vending machines for votive candles inside the church. It's very much irreverent and a lack of respect for the house of God. Vending machines have no place inside a church. While there praying, someone purchased a candle from the machine and the sound it made as the candle was dispensed was super loud. Again, a most disrespectful addition.

We were there recently for the St. Jude festival, and I felt they were pushing the donations hard. One big bin labeled "donations" would have been enough. But they added four bins around the St. Jude statue they bring out for the festival. Almost begging for it. It was a tacky look. View the attached image. I circled all the donation baskets. Between the vending machines and all the donation baskets, it comes off as if this church just cares about finding the most ways to get your money. On my quest to visit every church in San Diego county, I visited Saint Jude's Shrine for Sunday Mass.  4 stars only because there is almost no parking and ss of October 2022, they are still making everyone wear a face mask 😷. ♿ Parking available and access to church as well. Welcoming church. St.Jude in National City is one of the most peaceful, beautiful and incredibly spiritual churches I have ever been to. St. Jude is the parton saint of hopeless cases.....St. Jude is always ♥️ there for me. I’m very disappointed with the office staff at St. Jude’s Church. I was placed on hold for 30 minutes and no one ever came back to the line. Eventually, I had to hang up because no one answered. I never received a call back or any follow-up. This kind of experience makes it really hard to feel supported or welcomed when reaching out for help or information. I hope this can be addressed moving forward. Amazing church, I was fortunate to go to the relic of the St Jude tour.

Saint Justin Martyr Catholic Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary:
It was nice. Reminds me of the 1970’s when growing up with guitar mass and non-judgmental parishioners. Very diverse and also very individualistic- and I’m good with that. It was reverent in a down to earth way. Just normal sinners hanging out with JC wondering if Mercy will come our way. The faith here seems about as real as you can get. Very nice congregation. Super quiet and very nice masses. Priests here are very good with their sermons... Beautiful Church nice service this morning. Lots of folks... Thanks God🙏🙏🕊🕊 First time visiting was a few years back the day after the mass shooting at the El Paso, TX Walmart.  We were actually driving up to Anaheim the day it took place. Prayed and meditated for about 20 minutes.  I’ll visit every time we are back here.  Thank you for being open.

name: Saint Kateri Tekakwitha Catholic Church
Saint Kateri Tekakwitha Catholic Church - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary:
My recent experience at St. Kateri Catholic School was disappointing and left me feeling uncomfortable as a parent.

I was attending while my child was participating in a class and had initially been told that I could wait outside the classroom. After sitting quietly for a few minutes, a staff member approached me and asked that I leave the area and wait upstairs. I politely explained that I prefer not to leave my son alone in a building I am unfamiliar with, especially since another parent was seated nearby waiting as well.

Despite this, I was again asked to move. In an effort to cooperate, I relocated to the area near the school office and even began the fingerprint/background process they require for parents. While sitting there quietly and not interacting with any children or staff, I was approached again and told to go wait upstairs.

At no point was I disruptive or interfering with any activities—I was simply sitting and waiting for my child. The repeated requests to move, despite my cooperation, made the situation feel unnecessary and uncomfortable. Given that another parent was allowed to remain nearby and considering that I was wearing a tank top and have visible tattoos, the interaction unfortunately left me feeling as though I may have been unfairly profiled.

I fully respect the need for safety protocols in schools, but policies should be communicated clearly and applied consistently to all parents. My hope is that the school reviews how these situations are handled so that parents are treated with respect and made to feel welcome while supporting their children. Gabrielle and Cassandra we're very emphatic and contradicting to one another as one staff member told me I can sit in a certain area and wait they would come in and say I could not, a different staff member invited me in to sit in the classroom they came in and collected me and removed me very unwelcoming I've never felt so targeted based on my appearance especially at a church. St. Kateri Tekakwitha Catholic Church is such a beautiful and welcoming parish. From the moment you walk in, you can feel the warmth and kindness of the community. The church itself is stunning — with high ceilings, glass windows instead of walls, and plenty of natural light that fills the space with peace and harmony.

The priests are incredibly caring and always make time to support anyone who needs guidance or comfort. There are also so many wonderful ministries for both adults and children. One of our family’s favorite parts of the year is Vacation Bible School — my kids look forward to it all year long!

There are several Mass options throughout the week, making it easy for everyone to attend, and the Sunday 10:30 a.m. Children’s Mass is especially uplifting. Parking can get busy, but arriving a little early helps a lot.

Overall, St. Kateri is more than just a church — it’s a community filled with faith, love, and light. We feel so blessed to call it our parish home. 🙏💛 I loved attending masses in this church. The parish office however, in my opinion, needs improvement.  It will be so much better if the front desk people there would be more conscious of the fact that they work in a church office, not just any ordinary office.  Some parishioners go there because they just lost a loved one and would want to ask for prayers and mass intentions.  We understand that the schedule can be really packed since "we have over 5000 parishioners" but it will be really great if the office is staffed by compassionate people who are truly willing to help. I was visiting the area last Sunday and stopped in for mass. The church campus was beautiful and people were very nice! After church the priest told us about Saint Kateri, the first Native American saint. It was a wonderful experience. I would definitely go back! Saint Kateri Tekakwitha is a beautiful modern church in the north part of Santa Clarita off Copper Hill. Lots of parking and easy entry and exit. The church is spacious and the 5.30 pm Sunday mass was perfect with ample seating and enjoyable music. Deacon provided a captivating and relatable homily and the mass flowed nicely. Enjoyable visit to attend Sunday mass.

name: Saint Kilian Church
Saint Kilian Church - Mission Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
A beautiful church and a good Catholic community. The priests, Fr. Angelos & Fr. Tuan, are very good and are helpful bringing those who worship here enrichment in their faith. I recently called for a friend who wanted a hot meal,,, The guy that answered was really stern and kind of rude,,, This is not a place you can get warm food so do not call them... Thank you anyway This is a beautiful Church. The services for saying farewell to our loved one were carried out  professionally. We had lunch on site in the facilities the offer. It was a very good experience during a very hard time in our lives. Beautiful church Through Sunday, breakfasts are amazing and going to miss father, Scott, we love you, we miss you and to your journey to Notre Dame, my friend, we all love you blessings. Thanks to them and all those involved with the RCIA program, restoring my faith (journey) has been smoother then expect it.

God Bless all!

name: Saint Mark's Episcopal Church
Saint Mark's Episcopal Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary:
I visited St. Mark's on October 23. It was my home church from 1953 to 1970, and it was wonderful to be back. Of all the churches I've visited as a guest over the years. St. Mark's was easily the most welcoming, with a sincere warmth from all the people, without being overbearing and with no sense of falsity or just "surface politeness". The priest was accessible without stepping away from leadership. His sermon was memorable and to the point. The Mass was truly worshipful without being too stiff. There was a simple and deep genuineness in every part of my time there. Very unwelcoming church. Lady who claimed to be in charge 'Robin' and her office secretary/chihuahua are very rude. Office is usually always closed and 'Robin' trained the chihuahua to not give ANY information regarding the church. Its almost like they're hiding some kind of fraud or embezzlement. I do not recommend this place. This is an Episcopalian Church in the Diocese of Los Angeles; the current times for their Masses & Misa is on their website!

Everyone is welcome, their is Bus Service, however, it's tricky, but worth the hassle of the amount of time, it takes to visit Padre Vince &
no pricy auto rental for the out of Towner to worry about! & theirs UBER Cab as well!

I've  enjoy coming here; Padre Vince being the only friends in town; it's worth the Invesment.

Warm Hospitality;
Gracias mi Amingos Everyone is welcome here, and services are held in various languages.. the Luganda service happens every Sunday.. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

name: Saint Marks Mission Church
Saint Marks Mission Church - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary: It would seem that the church now is indoors obviating the need for folding chairs for outdoor mass or services. The drive there is most scenic. The actual mission Church itself is very basic, but there is a definite feel of community here. The congregation is small since the actual physical building is relatively small. They are so kind and generous here. I took a friend that could use some help and they hooked him right up. Food stamps, medi-cal was applied for there, how convenient. Plus he got a huge box of fresh food and he needed it too! You can go back once a month for a box of free food. Also there is a thrift shop where nice clothes can be had for cheap Go there for the 10:30am mass in English. Mass in Spanish is at 1 pm. Very small but comfortable. Make sure to bring a chair, since most masses are outside. A small Roman Catholic Church where everyone is very friendly. Great alternative to a bigger Church. Friendly place to attend mass.  Visiting priest, Fr. Moses, is excellent.  Lits of parking and not crowded.  Very good location.

name: Saint Martin De Porres Church
Saint Martin De Porres Church - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
Well had both my children baptized here in 1992 n 98 I do want to let it be know that when I was going through my divorce which was in 1993..I called the church to seek counseling n was told by the office receptionist very rudely that there was no place here since I was getting divorced...not only was she cold n quite mean..it really turned me off from being a catholic I didnt return back to saint Martin til 25 years later.Instead went to Calvary Christian churches where I was welcomed with open arms...but came back to Saint Martin due to growing up being a catholic and Italian It just felt right coming back.. I ATTEND pretty regularly however I do want to say some of the parishioners volunteering on Sundays are not only unfriendly if you are an attractive woman..but they barely smile its the most unbelievable thing I have ever seen in any church..I dont let that stop me from attending but I find it annoying to be met with such unfriendly faces when u greet them or smile..I just see that as people who are unhappy inside n really dont have the lord in their hearts ..and outwardly that shows.I suggest you visit n see how you feel yourself.
God bless🙏I do want to say the church is quite beautiful  and peaceful..other than my thoughts regarding the unfriendly few..most parishioners are friendly.The priest are friendly and mass is never boring because they have a sense of humor ...which I appreciate. Gorgeous place, with 24/7 Adoration!🙏🏻 please take a moment of your busy day to get some peace in His Presence, totally worth it!🙏🏻❤️ Choose another place of worship. This church does not welcome diversity and are hypocritical. They recently decided to host a Super Bowl watch party only to choose to watch the “All American half time show” but they have the nerve to host a yearly carnival where they sell food from various Non-American cultures. So which is it? You want vendors to donate Mexican food for your church so you can raise money but you don’t want to celebrate their culture when given the chance? Really beautiful church with great and strong Catholic community and young families. The community of service.  They're wonderful at making you feel welcome.  We love the 10:30am mass.  We learned to get there around 10:15am to not stress over parking.  We also learn to sit closer to the very front.  We can be so open to pray and have our 3 year old daughter see how we can participate in mass.  We are encouraged to confess and repent, and stay away from sin. The Lord hears the cry of the poor.

reviewSummary: The best kept secret of Huntington Beach as far as Catholic Church's go. There are several Masses to choose from on the weekend including the Latin High Mass at noon. They have Daily Mass with the Holy Rosary starting at 7:25 a.m. and the Divine Mercy Chaplet recited after daily mass. Fr. Chu and the local parishioners have done a great job keeping the devotions and prayer groups going including the Miraculous Medal Novena on Wednesday mornings and Adoration on Thursdays. Check online Bulletin for more details. A Holy Church to feel close to God. Receive graces and spiritual nourishment for mind, body and souls! Beautiful seaside church. Reminiscent of old sea town church. Very quaint and service great Beautiful and friendly little church. But I walked a long way from my hotel for the Latin Mass, only to find I had arrived on the first Sunday of its extinction. The priest told us to be grateful to God for the service being in English, which added insult to injury a long way from home. If the Faith hates the Faith, what is left? We visit this church some Sundays at noon to attend their Latin mass. If you have never attended a Latin mass, you must come to this one. The Father and the Altar boys are absolutely phenomenal.  It is a beautiful mass. One of the best masses I've ever seen. Soooo reverend. It fills your heart of joy.

name: Saint Matthew Ecumenical Catholic Church
Saint Matthew Ecumenical Catholic Church - Brea Campus
reviewSummary: Church advertised they would provide Ash services on Ash Wednesday from 1-6pm. Many at 4:30 were outside wandering with no clue and doors locked. I had called and the woman on the phone said they had closed at 5 (it wasn’t even 5 yet). She stated they closed it since no one had been coming to stop by. Many people showed up after 4 due to getting off of work and were left confused and saddened that they couldn’t recieve this reminder of mortality as they prepare their hearts for Easter. The Spirit of the Lord moves within St. Matthew's church. The community is very loving and welcoming to all! This is one place to come and feel great. You can feel the warmth as the people there greets you. Welcomes you like a family. Padre Arturo is an amazing leader. We couldn't be at a better place to teach our girls to love God and follow their lifes on the way to Gods. Saint Matthew Ecumenical "Catholic" Church is not really Catholic, they are not in communion with the Bishop of Orange or with the Pope and other bishops of the Catholic Church.  There are several friendly and welcoming Catholic Churches in the area (i.e. Saint Angela Merici, Our Lady of Guadalupe, Saint Mary's, Saint Martin de Porres, Saint Denis, etc) please do not go here thinking this is a Catholic Church even though some of the trappings and prayers are taken from the Catholic Church.  I pray that those running and attending this Church will come home to the One Holy Catholic and Apostolic Church founded by our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ that we may be one in Him and His Church as He commanded not separated by following our own ways instead of His.  Thanks be to God always This place is unlike any other church I have ever been to and that's a GOOD thing. The nicest, most genuine people you will ever meet. Zero judgement, casual attire and everyone is welcome.  I had been turned off by churches due to the hypocrites and fakes. This church is the exact opposite and I am beyond grateful to have found it. Seriously, check it out, you will be very happy you did.

We couldn't be at a better place to teach our girls to love God and follow their lifes on the way to Gods. Saint Matthew Ecumenical "Catholic" Church is not really Catholic, they are not in communion with the Bishop of Orange or with the Pope and other bishops of the Catholic Church.  There are several friendly and welcoming Catholic Churches in the area (i.e. Saint Angela Merici, Our Lady of Guadalupe, Saint Mary's, Saint Martin de Porres, Saint Denis, etc) please do not go here thinking this is a Catholic Church even though some of the trappings and prayers are taken from the Catholic Church.  I pray that those running and attending this Church will come home to the One Holy Catholic and Apostolic Church founded by our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ that we may be one in Him and His Church as He commanded not separated by following our own ways instead of His.  Thanks be to God always This place is unlike any other church I have ever been to and that's a GOOD thing. The nicest, most genuine people you will ever meet. Zero judgement, casual attire and everyone is welcome.  I had been turned off by churches due to the hypocrites and fakes. This church is the exact opposite and I am beyond grateful to have found it. Seriously, check it out, you will be very happy you did.

name: Saint Nicholas Catholic Church
Saint Nicholas Catholic Church - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary: I’m here from Salt Lake City for daily mass this week. I’ve enjoyed my “refocus “ on Jesus time here. It is a clean big spacious church in Laguna Woods, California! Check it out and don’t forget Jesus in the Blessed Sacrament chapel! St Nicholas is a beautiful church is there many times with my father and just recently for his funeral My niece is getting married this Saturday in Texas and she needed a form filled out and signed by me in presence of a deacon, priest. Jayne and Father Leo were the most kindest and caring people I ever thought I’d come across. I can’t describe how helpful, patient, diligent they were in getting this form out to my niece’s deacon in Texas. May GOD shower them with an abundance of blessings. I can’t thank them both enough for making it so easy for me to provide my niece with what she needs for her upcoming wedding. Very nice and beautiful church! Recently remodel to the altar and look pretty good and my cousin is a priest at this church! A wonderful church thanks to the loving shepherds(all the pastors) , the joyous and friendly congregation and one of the best choirs you will ever hear! Join us for the beautiful mass celebrations.

name: Saint Oscar Romero Catholic Community, Inc.
Saint Oscar Romero Catholic Community, Inc. - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary: I love our church!  Everyone is friendly, the priest is wonderful, and it's fun watching it grow.  The grounds around the church office are looking better and more beautiful all the time.  Everyone involved cares so much about our parish and wants to bring everyone and their families closer and closer to God. Have been part of this church for the past 3 years. Father Pat is very approachable and caring.  He makes mass personal and relevant.  I love the warmth that our church community has.  Even though our church takes place at a school it is so much more than an actual church building.  Father Pat has led us into becoming our own church which is so much more than just a building.   Can't wait to see how much more our church family grows. Priest is the ideal modern priest with still traditional Catholicism, he is a joy to listen too and laugh with. Not to mention the Amazing acoustic musician that plays great music ( John metering) relaxing and great atmosphere. Love to be in a church that I truely enjoy listening to the gospel ( it is so relevant to today World), he touches your hearts and you’ll never catch yourself falling asleep. Love it Father Pat is an awesome priest. No matter who the priest here is though, we are here to praise God and receive communion because "whoever eats my body and drinks my blood has life in them". The only reason I rated it a 4 stars , is that the church is being built. Currently, the Catholic community in this area is attending mass at a school on Harrison Ave. The wait for the new church is taking too long.

name: Saint Patrick Catholic Parish
Saint Patrick Catholic Parish - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
On my pilgrimage to visit every Catholic Church in San Diego County, I found myself immersed in the beauty and history of this Church. As the seventh church built in San Diego (1921) and at one time considered to be San Diego’s cathedral, it exudes a special kind of grandeur. The Mass was truly inspiring, and the warm spirit of the parish added to the overall experience. Stepping into Saint Patrick Catholic Parish, I was instantly captivated by its old-world charm. The welcoming community made me feel connected to the rich history within these walls. A must-visit for any church explorer! A blessing for many learned who love all peoples and and a safe comforting home in which to pray to our Creator. The homily was to point and educational advice. The location wonderful, the attendees open armed in welcoming everyone, trying to get us all to be able to get to Eternity Beautiful church. Lot of beautiful stained glass. I love old architecture and this church is just the perfect kind; it's been around for just over a century. Mass was excellent, so far each priest there has shared some gem homilies. This is my new home parish. Worth it!  Yes, it is worth the time and effort to attend 8am daily Mass!  People smile at you!  They are kind and reverent!  Priests give clear, concise, and sobering homilies!  Shout out to Father Carlos and Father Phil!

Also, there is daily Rosary after daily Mass.

I feel joyful when great traditions of the Catholic Church continue.  So good for the soul!

name: Saint Paul the Apostle Catholic Community
Saint Paul the Apostle Catholic Community - Westwood Campus
reviewSummary: I basically grew up in this church and I am very thankful and fortunate for the Paul's fathers and the Catholic community ! I have very fun childhood memories my family has been associated with this church for a very long time we think the Paul's fathers for their thoughts and the prayers for their help and assistance over the years ! Please keep Phil Duncan your thoughts and your prayers especially during the holiday season I myself and my husband and our four dogs lost or one bedroom apartment from a fire in North Hollywood almost 3 months ago and we are just trying to get our lives back together it's been a financial emotional time for us thank you and God bless It’s Parish Hall for meetings & gatherings and faith development & faith formation programs are held here. It's ok.   Good parking. Father Gil Martinez needs to refrain from making political statements. Please stick to the Gospel, which transcends earthly politics.

Saint Paul the Apostle Church - Westwood Campus
reviewSummary: I never ever going to this church anymore. Today first time i saw you guys closed for private event and not letting the other people to come inside … this is bazaar i never ever seen this type of racism before and im going to let all my community to not show up their .. because of end of the day this is God place everyone can able to get in their. Very easy to get to and an amazing Priest who gave the service.  Made it very deep, yet light!! How ironic the ICU nurse recommended St. Paul's where I attended elementary school!   I was flooded with memories and realized my faith and tendency to chat with Creator started there in front of the statue of St. Joseph and the Virgen de Guadalupe.  🕊⛪😇 I was there for my mother's funeral and for Easter Mass and found it very comforting and welcoming. We're from Oakland  The Cathedral  of Christ the light

name: Saint Paul's Lutheran Church
Saint Paul's Lutheran Church - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been a member of St Paul’s Irvine since I was baptized in 2002. Now being a young adult I have grown to love and cherish the Divine Service with its Liturgy and hymns. This church also provides wonderful teaching and preaching from Pastor Espinosa or Pastor Mueller. Come and visit on Sunday 9:30 am or early evening at 4 pm to receive the gifts that God has given to us in His Word and Sacraments. Also come on Wednesdays at 7 pm for a brief Service of the Word. The pastor is incredibly knowledgeable, sharing deep insights into the Bible and faith with wisdom and clarity. When I first arrived, I struggled with the language barrier, but despite that, I could deeply feel the power and mercy of God. His presence was undeniable, guiding me toward understanding and peace. Moved by His grace, I decided to be baptized. This church has become a place of spiritual growth, love, and faith for me, and I am forever grateful for the journey it has led me on. Extremely friendly. Serves communion both the common cup or the chalice.
If you’ll be kind enough to sign in, you’ll have a sticker with your name on it. When Pastor offers you the bread/body of Christ he will usually say your name it’s very personal. Great service & sermons that are biblical sound, friendly people and beautiful stain glass sanctuary!

name: Saint Polycarp Catholic Church
Saint Polycarp Catholic Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary:

Saint Therese Roman Catholic Church
Saint Therese Roman Catholic Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
Very respectful
Clean
Organized
Original mass in latin
Not crowded
I recommend to come to mass at 1pm in latin every sunday St. Therese Church is a very lovely and spiritual community. The prist are very holy all of them, they always are helping people and you can feel very welcome here. I feel very blessed to be in this church. If you want or need the presence of God,come to St. Therese church.
They also have the perpetual adoration chapel 24 hours open. Exc church. Im a 15 year christian and besides catholics  praying to saints and as christians we all pray to GOD AND HIS ONLY SON JC...  but when i cant make it to my church i do the evening mass and its great.  Peace be with you. Traditional Latin Mass offered at 1pm Sundays. Beautiful, reverent. Priest comes from Saint Michael's Abbey. Also, Red missals provided, and women veil. Bring everyone! I feel at home here, like family. It's a beautiful, spacious church.  Everyone is very friendly.  I mean everyone.  From the clergy to the office staff, even the congregation. There is a chapel that you can visit any time of the day with a key card that can be purchased for $20.00.  Confession is held three times a week and mass is offered throughout the day on Sundays.

name: Saint Thomas Korean Catholic Center
Saint Thomas Korean Catholic Center - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary:
A vibrant and welcoming Korean community. I enjoyed Father Dominic Chai’s first mass on June 15. What a delight! This is the largest Korean Catholic Church in Southern California when considering the capacity of parishioners it can accommodate within its premises. They underwent renovations after my departure from California in 2000. Whenever I am in Orange County to visit family, I make it a point to attend Mass at this church. The church is splendid, roomy, and invokes a sense of devotion when praying before the tabernacle. The cantor's melodic voice adds to the reverent atmosphere during the Mass. Despite the circumstances in society, relationships among people, and church leadership, I believe it's crucial for us to continue attending church to worship the Lord. This practice fuels our spiritual growth, provides meaning to life, and paves the way for salvation, for Jesus is the way, the truth, and the life. Going there to participate in Table Tennis with other adults and take private 1/2 hour coaching lessons with a competent excellent and patient English/ German speaking coach used by many of the Korean players. The seats of the sanctuary are removed and tables take their place.  So ceilings are very high, the lighting is great and the room is air conditioned.

Play times are Tuesday 1pm-5pm and Sunday 2pm-6 pm. In addition, I pay an annual facility fee of $100. I do not know if lessons can be taken without paying the additional fee. But feel practice/play time is important. And the coach can also observe my technique between intervals of his coaching other players. Those things are important for me to speed along my progress. There is a ping-pong robot  and two other free to use tables each with a basket full of practice balls. Best korean Catholic church in U.S. Cinvenient access from I5 and 91 fway and parking lot is spacious. Provide a variety of programs for all generations year round. July 4th Bbq party and October Fest are real fun I am not too comfortable with fancy indoor decorations in catholic centers. But I still see some places to upgrade a bit... still not so comfortable 😕..

name: Saint Thomas More Catholic Church
Saint Thomas More Catholic Church - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary:
I stopped attending after they kept asking for money to finish building the rest of the church EVERY MASS!! When this campaign first began, it was $4 million. Mind you, the land is already pitched, plumbing, electrical, septic, and ground prep have already been run to the spot. So it's pretty absurd. Well, not as absurd as them upping it within a couple years to $8 million. I didn't go for a while because I felt this was an underhanded money grab. But I went to a holiday service where they had grossly grown their pitch to $13 million!! Who the hell needs a $13 million chapel? Does the church know how many people that would feed? Does it care? Nope. It DOES care about the looks of the place and keeping up with modern non-denominational churches. Its a total waste of resources and screams of corruption from the inside. This parish is very different than many I’ve attended or called home. It’s large and modern, and has that feel.

The people are very welcoming, and the priests, including Fr Joe, are excellent.

The outside patio area is really nice, as is the walkway through the parking lot. As you walk you will fine signs that tell you various things about Saint Thomas More.

It’s a peaceful place to be. Recently moved to Tustin Ranch and I discovered this church. It is a real blessing. I love it and feel happy when I visit it STM hosts abundant opportunities for parishoner involvement, including Bible studies and a wonderful young adult community! We’re so blessed to have a beautiful church and clergy especially Father Eugene and Fr Thomas who are very compassionate about the church! We are also thankful for the many hard working ministries available to participate . Looking forward to the new building and development of St Thomas More which is so needed!

name: Saint Thomas of Canterbury E​piscopal Church​ & School
Saint Thomas of Canterbury E​piscopal Church​ & School - Temecula Campus
reviewSummary: I witnessed two ladies, one in a military uniform, yell at a woman who was trying to park in a handicapped spot. A little boy looking like 3 years old was running in front of the lady's black truck. The lady asked if they can get their little boy and the two black ladies went off on the lady in the truck. Calling the lady names. Another woman who claimed to work in the preschool began defending the lafies. How is a stranger More concerned for a toddler than the mother???  Very sad.  Unsurprising actually. This is our episcopal church that we have been going to since the covid-19 epidemic. It is small but the atmosphere is very welcoming. Everyone is very down to earth. The church service on Sunday is unassuming and the choir is very nice. It will be worthwhile for someone who is searching for spiritual needs. Great newer facility; new vicar due in a couple of weeks. Great congregation. Bless this wonderful, welcoming church, the main Episcopal church in the Temecula Valley! Excellent place of worship. Welcoming and easy to get involved.

name: Saint Timothy Church
Saint Timothy Church - Laguna Niguel Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve had the pleasure of photographing two weddings at this beautiful church, and each experience has been wonderful. The architecture and natural light provide a stunning backdrop for capturing meaningful moments, and the peaceful atmosphere really adds to the reverence of the day.
The staff and clergy have always been welcoming, organized, and respectful—not just to the couples and guests, but also to vendors like myself. Their professionalism and kindness help everything flow smoothly, allowing everyone to focus on the celebration. Saint Timothy's Catholic Church seems to be a great spiritual home. From the moment you arrive on the beautiful, peaceful grounds, there's a sense of peace and welcome that's truly special.

The church itself is architecturally beautiful with its modern yet reverent design. The worship space feels both intimate and grand at the same time, with excellent acoustics that enhance both the music ministry and the priests' homilies.

There was an Asian priest when I attended that delivered a thoughtful, humorous , relevant homily that connected scripture to daily life in ways that stay with people. It struck that perfect balance of being spiritually nourishing without being overly lengthy or preachy.

What really seems to set Saint Timothy's shine is its vibrant community. The parishioners are genuinely welcoming to newcomers.

Whether you're looking for a new parish home or just visiting the area, Saint Timothy's welcomes all with open arms. The 8:30 AM Morning Mass was especially vibrant. They also offer convenient confession times and adoration hours for those seeking those sacraments.

Saint Timothy's truly embodies what a parish community should be - a place of worship, growth, service, and connection. I'm sorry been a while since I went to a mass. This was granddaughter's first Communion. Very nice. They did not have big screen TVs in my previous churches haha. I guess that's the new way The love for the Lord Jesus is infecting and contagious. Be on time and attend for it will be uplifting and your worthwhile precious time will thank you for it! 1st time on St. Timothy church during Easter Sunday mass & very festive celebration.
