Saints Felicitas & Perpetua Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary: We attended a funeral mass for a friend and it was very solemn.  Fr. John, the pastor gave a very nice homily/eulogy. The cantor was great and it made the celebration of life very solemn & meaningful. Only issue is parking when you have about 300-400 people attending. The walk to a residential parking spot will cover your daily exercise. Good school and great church.  It's a peaceful sanctuary and they have a really fun fair in the Spring. They're in a beautiful neighborhood in San Marino and the parking there is terrific and Fr. Paul is an amazing, inspirational priest. Went in to St Felicitas Catholic Church. In San Marino. Stopped in with an elder friend I work for. We went to light a candle and say a few prayers for all this confusing  days and times.  She, however is a long time member of this  Church. I belong to the San Gabriel Mission Parish.  Born and raised in the thee adjacent neighborhood as a child growing up. St. Felicitas Church is beautiful and like all Catholic churches in thee area have some history.                      Very peaceful and relaxing to walk in and feel blessed and safe. I do Co+Sign for This place of a safe haven. A place to go to if feeling a little over whelmed with the madness in the streets, and everyday life?. photos to follow. This is Chuy Vara Viramontes signing off for now from a Small City that they call Alhambra Town,. Gateway to the San Gabriel Valley, SGV AKA SG,. With Respectt Father John is great. Really comes prepared with his homily. Great cantors. We are Saturday churchgoers. Also, Their lectors are well trained. Wonderful church. While visiting from Santa Rosa ca I attended Sunday mass here. That was about a year ago. Now I’m back and looking forward to joining service again in this most beautiful church.

name: Saints Simon & Jude Catholic Church
Saints Simon & Jude Catholic Church - Huntington Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
💕❤ We appreciate the little ones! Cheerleaders!
Summer Kick Off barbecue night is a blast! With Live band too! 💕❤ I attended Mass at this church on my recent visit to California. It is a large and easy to access church with plenty of parking. Although I did not take advantage of it, there was a "meet and greet" before Mass. The congregation was friendly and welcoming. The musicians were excellent - I suspect most are professionals. The celebrant was easy to understand and I greatly enjoyed his homily on the Pentecost. Beautiful location for my Aunts funeral service. I wasn't sure what would happen after the Franciscans left, but the priests have been great. Active men's club. Solid high school youth program, grade school, sermons, and social justice outreach. Generally welcoming. A few people could be a little more LGBTQIA+ friendly. Friendly parishioners. Newly remodeled. Kind Priest

name: Salem Lutheran Church
Salem Lutheran Church - Orange Campus
reviewSummary: Pastor Frick is a phenomenal Pastor his messages always hit home. He truly cares for and knows his congregation personally. The music is beautiful and the music director is a true artist inspired by God weekly. A great place to worship I rated this church 6 years ago, 5 star.  We went to Easter Services at 10:30.  It was the most people I have ever seen at a holiday service.  A good sermon was lead by Pastor Frick.  Also this was the first time I saw him in traditional robes.  He usually is in shorts and a Hawaiian shirt, which is his trademark.  loved the singing and the musical program.  I like to sing along and keep tempo to the beat.  They had an Easter Egg hunt for the kids.  The field was wet so they kept the hunting too the facilities. About a year ago, my boyfriend and I decided that we wanted to find a church in Orange County to get plugged into. The first time we visited Salem, we fell in love with the community so much that we decided to return the following week and never left. We recently completed the new member class, forming relationships with other new members and getting the chance to learn more about Salem's values, reaffirming our decision that Salem is where God called us to be. We have also connected by having the privilege to become leaders in Salem's student ministry. We look forward to our Sunday morning hugs from Pastor Frick and are so appreciative to call Salem our home! Are you looking for a church to call home?  Salem Lutheran Church in Orange is it! We were looking to get connected with a church closer to home a few years ago, somewhere to find community, where the kids could be involved, and a good fit for our family.  Pastor Frick had recently joined Salem at this time and the rest is history!  My husband and I have been able to join small groups as a couple and individually, our kids love Sunday school, the worship team is amazing, and my favorite part are the Sunday BBQ’s which are always extended to the great neighbors of OPA.  We Love ❤️ Salem!! I grew up attending Salem Church. I went away for College and had not been back to Salem for many years. When I came back, it was amazing to step right back into the Church Family. Everyone is extremely kind and welcoming. My wife didn’t know anyone at Salem because she was from Texas, but now she absolutely loves it! Salem has been great to us and we will definitely be there for a long time.

name: Salem Lutheran Church and School
Salem Lutheran Church and School - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary: Amazing community, great pastors/leaders and caring church! Its a great school! Thats where i am going now Welcoming people. Great music! Excellent church

San Antonio de Padua Catholic Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
San Antonio de Padua Catholic Church is a smaller church located in East LA! It has a nice atmosphere and is inclusive! Enjoyed the beautiful sculptures and their service. Gracias por todo! Que dios me los bendiga! Amén! It is such of blessing for our community of Boyle Heights to have this beautiful humble church, for several generations. Serving with reverence and respect to all parishioners. All of my events from my wedding, the baptism of my children and funeral mass for my dear father sister and brothers had all been done in accordance to our traditional Catholic faith. I went to school when it was one I grad 1984 and now i go church is small but humble and spiritual Worst of the worst Catholic Church. If I can give it no stars will have rated ZERO stars. It’s impossible to be the godparents if you aren’t married through a Catholic Church. Never ever will we baptized there again. Back when I can recall, my dear mother had to work two jobs to make sure we,(sister & I)went to the best school’s & were taught properly,
In the beginning everything seemed to be going well, but throughout time what seemed to be a normal timeout punishment , for not finishing our lunch meals turned into abuse by these so called,, “Godly Nun’s.”
I thought I was the only one being abused & tortured, but one day when I was taken out of class to the directory’s office, as many other times, I noticed my sister laying on the floor and gagged to the mouth sobbing in tears.
My sister and I were physically and emotionally abused for more than a year,
We were threatened to never say a word to anyone and till this day my sister and I have kept silent.
I have forgiven these evil women, I just hope they repent for their sins and may our Father God forgive them.

name: San Antonio de Padua del Cañon Church
San Antonio de Padua del Cañon Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary:
Came from out of town to attend a Sunday vigil. The environment seemed very welcoming and friendly. This is my first time attending a mass that has a projection of the hymns, prayers, and readings (if I can recall correctly). I really enjoyed that as I have trouble at times reading small letters. This church is smaller than my regular one and I found that many of the seats were full (not packed, but looked like a good turnout). It my parish Church. Been going for over 30 years! Wonderful people; Beautiful day to celebrate children's First Communion Day, May 4, 8:30 a.m. Went to the annual fiesta as I have done for countless years as I live within walking distance. I found the security guards at the entrance to be extremely rude and unprofessional. I am a 52 year old
man. Having me empty my pockets, lift up my shirt and turn around to enter a carnival
seemed extremely excessive and was simply embarrassing. Won’t be back next year. The way they were treating people was completely uncalled for. Here in America we are innocent until proven guilty, not the other way around. This church was nice, clean and the people are very friendly. We visited our favorite priest, Father Dave, who was our priest from our old church in Lake Forest and the service was outstanding like always! We missed Father Dave's sermons, the best ever!

name: San Diego Japanese Christian Church

reviewSummary: I’m a Japanese from Japan myself. My major language is still Japanese,after having lived in U.S. for so many years. And, so,I joined the ministry which is ministered in the Japanese language,rather than the ministry for the American-Japanese people   ministered here at this church,ministered in English. The church,mostly,was found no problem in itself,but there was an middle-aged woman who obviously had a mental problem (my profession is a mental health worker,so I could professionaly tell that) at the church. She restlessly kept walking into and out from the room we were gathering, and boldly expressed her illusional hatred against me from the first moment she saw me. I call it illusional,because I never even talked with her,and I didn’t even know her name. Somehow,she kept hurassing me, mostly verbally and by the attitude. Once she even distructed me when I was praying in our praying time together. But other than about herself,I feel a great grief that no one ever did anything on her marking me as a personal enemy in her little mental world, not even the paster and his wife. And,how strange ! After a while,even some of other members of the same ministry started to treat me like an enemy. I actually joined the ministry together with my wife for a while. But we,my wife and I,finally decided to,and in fact had to leave them behind. So,that’s the story. My wife can witnes it all as true. I grew up at this church and it was the most amazing place to be I always felt so much love and kindness from everyone. The congregation is full of wonderful amazing people who truly love the lord and do their best to follow his word. If you have a chance to visit this church I'd highly recommend it for anyone not just anyone of Japanese or Asian decent. This church embraces all of gods people equally. Very nice kind and loving  arigatou doshimashite one day when the right time I was welcomed by very nice people.

reviewSummary: I believe I found my new church home. This place is open to all. There is a sense of calm here. There is an inviting sense of Faith here. You will be impressed if you arrive a little bit before 10:00 a.m. That's when the service starts and you want to be there to get the entire experience. You will be happily satisfied. Hope to see you there. I really can't wait to go to church and I'm not a Bible thumper. Have a good day. Enjoyed worshipping God and Pastor Jeff Johnson is a good pastor and explains the word of God in a manner that makes sense in today's world! Pastor Jeff really cares about his people. He sent me a letter and he always goes out of his way to say hello and to pray for you! Beautiful on the inside, see the pics. Come check it out for yourself! Great group of people, and Pastor Jeff and his team are awesome! I come here to get spiritually refreshed, reminded and educated on Sundays 10:30am, before starting the workweek again. This place is a wonderful church and a blessing I had no idea of the joy that comes over a person after attending mass. Never felt it at the other church. These wonderful people are helping us with  counseling to better our situation. The cost is fair, i have to be willing that is it. I have to be willing to better my situation. I feel a lot of love from them, they are serious to help me and if I want I can accept their church, they are not pushing it. Well I actually really like it. I now have a desire to obtain knowledge to feed my soul.  This is mind blowing because I was going to Die a Catholic just because I was taken there by my family.  Boy was I wrong. I encourage you to come and feel the joy I feel. I didn't know I was thirsty until They gave me a taste.

name: San Salvador Catholic Church
San Salvador Catholic Church - San Bernardino Campus
reviewSummary:
A beautiful place of worship, centered in family, community, and service to both. The clergy are humble, bilingual, and accommodating. They offer free food and services for faith based  practices. There are festivals at least twice a year for all to enjoy. Always preaching a good message. You can find peace and rest here. The buildings have been recently updated and the church looks beautiful.

reviewSummary: Great church proud to be a member in San salvador feel like I’m at home and my family love it definitely recommend 🙏🏼 I've been coming to San Salvador now for 8 years, and I have never wanted to come to church and feel a part of something so special this much. I come to 10 am mass with father Moises and Deacon Mark and always get that weekly boost/healing that we need for the week. name: San Secondo d'Asti Catholic Church
San Secondo d'Asti Catholic Church - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
We attended one of the three daily Masses at this beautiful, quaint church today. Our first time here.The reverence was striking — many of the women parishioners wore veils, and the priest faced the altar throughout the Mass (ad orientem). It felt peaceful, traditional, and deeply sacred. It was very reverent, traditional experience. I'll definitely go back whenever I will be in the area. 🙏🧡✝️☦️ Latin Mass absolutely stunning, reverent, a must go for my fellow Catholics. Such a deep sense of peace. I’m very grateful to have found this extraordinary gem of a church. ❤️‍🔥 Been going a lot here lately for 2:30 and sometimes 5:00 masses. The church itself is beautiful and reverent, but the temperature inside is honestly unbearable. It is ridiculously hot!!!!!!!!! not just uncomfortable, but distracting to the point where it’s hard to focus on prayer or the liturgy. What’s most concerning is that this it feels stifling even if we are supposed to be in the cold season currently. The heat builds quickly once people are inside, and there is very little airflow. Sitting through a full service feels like being in a closed, overheated room. it was not like this before.

I hope the staff  can address the ventilation or cooling system soon, because the environment inside the church should support worship, not make it physically exhausting. At least fix the air so that there is airflow inside. We have children too and I don't think this kind of stagnant air is healthy at all. I thought it was just me, I was not surprised to see other reviews saying the church is uncomfortably hot and so long lately. My husband and I decided to go to Our Lady of Guadalupe in Sultana for 5:00 PM. More comfortable and closer to my husband's work. Beautiful parish community, filled with reverence & love, & close to work for first Friday observance.  Their spirit of hospitality fills me with gratitude.🙏🏼

reviewSummary: Pastor moi and his staff are the best. They are there for you when times are good and bad. If your struggling or just curious about Jesus I definitely reccomend this church. I’ve witnessed so many changes and I’m proud of our journey, which has included a lot of growth. I have been attending the Anaheim campus since it opened during the pandemic. A warm, welcoming environment that knows how to worship through song, prayer, baptism, taco Tuesdays, and so much more to reach the community of Anaheim & share the love of Jesus. I would recommend that anyone looking for a place to be authentic and to be lifted up come and check it out. Excellent kids ministry too. :) This is my favorite church. They have such a great community and are super open and nice to newcomers. Highly recommend!! When picking a church, I was looking for a few things; leadership, a mission/vision for the future of the church, and a place that felt authentic and transparent. What I found at sandals was leaders that I could buy into and trust, with a mission and vision of impacting not only members of the church but playing a major role in the community. And as for authenticity and transparency, the leaders of this church are open books and are the definition of servant leaders. You can’t describe an experience, so you’ll just have to come in and see for yourself. reviewSummary:

reviewSummary: God led me to this Church.  They welcomed me with open arms.  I was blessed enough to meet them 1 week before Easter Sunday. I visited this church one Sunday trying to fellowship without my usual 1.5 hour commute to my home church, and right away felt at home. Everyone was so welcoming and friendly. I also appreciated the personal touch of small group prayer, it made the experience more personable and intimate as you connect with fellow believers. name: Santa Clarita United Reformed Church
Santa Clarita United Reformed Church - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary:
Solid, Bible-believing church with clear and deep preaching as well as reverent worship focusing on singing the 3,000-year old Psalms, substantive hymns, & celebration of the Lord’s Supper! How unique in our day!! Highly recommended for those in and near Santa Clarita. I found refuge in this church after attending several mega "non-denominational" churches with questionable eschatology. This church in contrast is small as it is a satellite church of the URC in Chino. The people are warm, welcoming, and passionate about scripture. I get the feeling that most members are not there by default but have chosen to be there specifically to grow in Christ. Traditional hymns are sung - no large choirs, orchestras or rock bands. The bible and the church are the focus. I thank the Lord for Rev Lee Irons who God blessed with a passion for the Word. His sermons are scripturally sound and edifying due to his years of study and a heart filled with the Holy Spirit. He holds an adult Sunday school after the morning service which allows us to delve more into how to apply the sermon to our daily lives. It reminds me of what the early church must have been like. I feel blessed to have found this church. After consuming reformed resources over many years from theologians like Luther, Calvin, Owen, Machen, Sproul, Fesko, Godfrey, etc, I was thrilled to finally discover a wonderful, Biblically solid, confessional, reformation church here in Santa Clarita! This friendly and warm congregation is committed to sound theology and caring for each person that walks through the door.

The minister, a brilliant and approachable graduate of Westminster Seminary (not to mention an expert in Greek and Biblical Theology), faithfully preaches from the Bible, proclaims the Gospel in every service, cares for each person in church, and can answer in an understandable way the most difficult challenges/questions.

There’s a large group of children ranging from infant to teenagers that are also extremely welcoming and kind - one of the coolest things was seeing teenagers and older kids being so kind to my young daughter. There’s also regular men’s and women’s Bible studies, frequent gatherings, and LOTS of excellent food.

I love bringing my family to hear the truth, be ministered to by the Word and sacraments, and enjoy the fellowship. More importantly, in an era of great compromise, error, and novel doctrine, I trust SCURC to be steadfast to their Biblical, confessionally reformed, historical, orthodox, sound convictions.

Wherever you are in your life; whether you’re wondering about, new to, struggling, or strong in your faith; whether you’re curious about or committed to reformed theology (or somewhere in between); whether you’re a student, single, married with a family, younger, or older… and just simply want to have rest, peace, and assurance in Christ - this is the place to come! I really enjoy the Christ centered expository preaching where the good news of the gospel is always present. There is a wonderful spirit of hospitality and warmth in the close knit community of believers there that makes everyone feel welcome. Great new church in the area, faithful to God's Word.

name: Seacoast Community Church
Seacoast Community Church - Encinitas Campus
reviewSummary: Ever since I started coming here a few months ago, Seacoast has felt like home. I love the engaging messages, genuine people, and care whenever I am here, whether that's for regular services on Sunday, or events throughout the week, especially the Young Adults group. If you're looking for an authentic church fellowship which doesn't take itself too seriously, you've found the right place! Anyone who's been to a typical nondenom/Calvary Chapel-type church will really like it here. Most welcoming church community I've ever met. Past Ryan's sermons are inspiring, relatable and always sprinkled with humor. There is always a positive take-home message and concepts to think about. There's volunteer opportunities and many group activities. A great community, can't say enough! Wonderful group of people. So positive, thoughtful and engaged in our community Very welcoming church. The community is strong and the people are friendly! Great ~20 min worship and a nice long sermon to think on. :) Free coffee & tea too! Great smaller community church. My husband and I feel strongly connected here, it’s a family and you don’t just feel like a number. Great church congregation of quality people!

name: Searchlight Ministries
Searchlight Ministries - Fullerton Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a one of a kind church.  It has been my home and family for 18 years.  Pastor Mark is a true blue Lutheran pastor who preaches Law and Gospel every sermon, and emphasizes the message that Christ loves you.

-Outreach opportunities
-Group nights for different ages
-Contemporary worship with some liturgy Love my church family! Everyone is welcoming and loves each other. The pastor preaches verse by verse straight from the Bible while offering historical and cultural insights. The Gospel is preached in every sermon because it all points to Jesus! The worship is contemporary with some hymns sprinkled in, and communion is served weekly. Come check it out! I've been attending this church for over 20 years. First, come for the teaching. The pastor, Mark, is not going to pull any punches. He preaches Christ, through the Bible, and his teaching is detailed (he'll even throw in some dad jokes for you to groan, or chuckle at, depending on your age). If you've got questions, Mark loves to talk about them, and, typically, will suggest resources that will discuss several different points of view so that you can dig a little deeper into, what can be, difficult areas of study. Apart from the education, and guidance, the church genuinely cares for you. Drop your preconceptions, bring your questions, and join the family. 😊 If you are looking for a church of friendly people, one that makes you feel good after you leave, Searchlight Ministries is the place you want to attend.  Pastor Mark is not just a preacher, he is a teacher.  You will not leave one of his sermons without learning something about Jesus or the Bible that you didn't know when you walked in. Searchlight is one of Orange County's hidden church gems. I visited this church in partnership with a college ministry, and my impression is that this is a community that feels like a family. People are genuinely very kind and are seeking to reach out to the community and show Jesus' love to people. Welcoming to new people whether you've never encountered God before and are curious or walked with God for a long time.

name: Seaside Community Church UCC
Seaside Community Church UCC - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
How the presence of God in our Lives is the greatest gift of Life was the theme of our sermon by Scott Winters. I love this church: the members, clergy, musicians and visitors who make attending church so engaging and memorable. Seaside Community  Church is a wonderful place to worship.  It is geared towards families and the size of the congregation is small and welcoming.  The sermon's by Pastor Ben are not the fire and brimstone type rather his sermons are engaging and the messages are timely.  The church is highly active in the community with many outreach programs.  Would highly recommend this church. I've been a member of Seaside Community for almost 30 years. The congregation really is a family, so supportive and welcoming to all. They participate in many outreach events both at the church and in the community. Pastor Ben is excellent! His unique perspectives offer great insight to help find direction and navigate life's hurdles. Highly recommend checking out a service... you will be glad you did! My family and I have been members at Seaside for over 20 years.  What a great community to have a family grow up in!  People are supportive and interested in our family's activities outside of church also.  Since we moved to Torrance from other parts of the country, our families are dispersed.  Having Seaside members treat us like family is  very important, especially as our kids were growing up.  If someone in the church, or outside of the church,  has a need, Seaside tries to help.  The Outreach program is outstanding and makes me feel that we are making a difference.  It's casual and an easy place to feel part of! I have been a member of Seaside Community Church for over 43 Years. The members have helped me raise over $200,000 through my benefit piano jazz concerts.  Their support has been invaluable.

Seaside is an open and affirming church and all are welcomed. New comers are consistently greeted with a hug and a handshake.  The church makes music part of the Sunday services and participation is welcomed.

name: Second Baptist Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: In March 1968, parishoners shouted "Amen!" from the church pews after Reverend Dr. Martin Luther King Jr. proclaimed that racism was still a glaring reality and that it was "time for somebody in Washington to say we made a mistake in Vietnam." Just weeks later, he was assassinated in Memphis, Tennessee. King received the Nobel Peace Prize in 1964 for his efforts to end segregation and racial discrimination through civil disobedience and other nonviolent means. I learned this recently: “The [Second Baptist] church has been an important force in the Civil Rights Movement, hosting national conventions of the National Association for the Advancement of Colored Persons ("NAACP") in 1928, 1942, and 1949, and also serving as the site of important speeches by Martin Luther King Jr., Malcolm X, and others.” We went here with our high school choir in March 2015 to sing for their congregation. It was an incredibly moving experience, and their entire congregation was so welcoming and kind to us. After the meeting, they served us lunch in the basement of the church, and wouldn't even let us help clean up. These are some of the kindest and most Christ-like people I've ever met. I highly recommend visiting this historic building where Martin Luther King Jr. spoke just three weeks prior to his death. You'll be sure to have a wonderful experience. The rich history, incredible spirit, and caring leaders make this a wonderful Church to attend. Ample seating for large event. Every seat a great seat. Dynamic pastor.  Parking lots near by. Someone I met said that they had a great experience. The choir was so  spirituality uplifting. You feel that CHRIST was in the present

reviewSummary: Second Sunday holds a special place in my heart. It’s where I go for spiritual fuel, for good people, and for good music. Regardless of how my week has been, it’s a place where I can go and feel at peace and at home. I’m not one to typically feel comfortable in a church setting or any type of organized religion, but this community is really forward thinking, welcoming, and open minded. I am a recovering addict and have found a space to talk and connect with people who are willing to listen, encourage, keep me accountable and keep me in service. The music is killer and so is the coffee, during the week it’s a great space to meet or work on creative projects. I’m actually getting married here in September! A warm and inviting community. A refuge in a part of the city that can really use a place of peace....As I’m updating my review 2 years later, I can say even more confidently: This empathetic, loving group of people is a safe harbor. They pursue truth and love God & community in such inspiring, artful, thoughtful & emotionally intelligent ways. Second Sunday holds a special place in the flow of my life and the lives of many. It's a welcoming community that draws people of all walks of life and faith (or non-faith) backgrounds. I am blessed to be part of this community and look forward to each week that I'm able to attend in person. They did an amazing job pivoting to YouTube during Covid and still offer that remote option every Sunday at 5 pm. In person church is Sundays at 10 am at J & 11th. (New location) God has His hand on this incredible church.  Every Sunday is a blessing that is filled with the anointing of the Holy Spirit.  The message and music are the best I have ever heard. reviewSummary:

I spent several years deeply involved with Congress WBN events and small groups, so I feel responsible to share what I eventually came to see clearly.

Leadership, centered on Dr. Noel Woodroffe, teaches that he carries a unique “apostolic mandate” and higher spiritual authority than ordinary believers, closer to God than the rest of us. Questioning his direction or teachings was regularly presented as rebellion against God Himself. Over time, many of us were strongly encouraged to limit or end contact with family and friends who didn’t fully support the ministry. Personal decisions, dating, career, finances, even where we lived increasingly required leadership approval. Local churches that partnered with Congress WBN often found themselves expected to hand over significant control and transparency.

The early years felt exhilarating with breakthrough, constant encouragement, and a deep sense of purpose. Later, that same intensity turned into fear; fear of being labeled a backslider, fear of spiritual curses, fear that leaving would mean losing God’s plan for your life. That shift from love to fear is something many former members only recognized after they stepped away.

If any of this sounds familiar, if you feel exhausted from proving your loyalty, watched in your relationships, or afraid to trust your own thoughts, please know those feelings make sense. A genuine spiritual home should give you more freedom, not less. It’s okay to quietly talk with someone completely outside the circle, read stories from others who have left, and decide for yourself what is true.

You deserve peace that doesn’t depend on never disappointing leadership. Wishing everyone reading this real clarity and courage. A place that is lead by the spirit and operates according to biblical principles and patterns. They help build and edify men, women, marriages, and youth to be SENT out to their place of employment, schools, and society to be successful contributors and representatives of Christ. I'm wyatt

name: Serra Chapel

reviewSummary:
During my recent visit to Mission San Juan Capistrano, I was profoundly moved by the experience at Serra Chapel. As California's oldest church, this historic gem offers an intimate and serene atmosphere that invites reflection and spiritual connection.

The chapel's interior is adorned with a stunning 400-year-old golden retablo, imported from Barcelona, Spain, which serves as a breathtaking focal point. The meticulous preservation of this artifact, along with the chapel's other historical elements, speaks volumes about the dedication to maintaining its historical integrity. It was a place that made me beautiful, reverent, and calm. Amen. Beautifully adorned with sculptures and religious artworks. It's the only existing structure that Saint Serra conducted mass. Beautiful! Recommend weekday mass at 6:30a. Special kind of Holy! Because I have felt so much more love and acceptance than i have im traditional blue collar church's.  The homeless and poor will forever be among us as it states in the good book. name: Shadow Mountain Community Church
Shadow Mountain Community Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary:
God has always come first in our lives, so without a shadow of a doubt, the highlight of our trip was to make the 2 hour drive from Los Angeles to San Diego to visit our absolute favorite pastor in the world, Dr. David Jeremiah at Shadow Mountain Community Church!!!

We’ve lived overseas most of our lives and currently in Dubai. We’ve struggled to find congregations we felt comfortable in, and often resorted to watching Dr. David’s sermons on YouTube as a substitute for in-person church service. He is truly a wonderful preacher who isn’t boisterous like so many prosperity gospel preachers, nor is he dull or doom and gloom like so many other apocalyptic pastors. He deftly balances explaining God’s word in simple context, weaving in wholesome humor and genuine life experiences to create a session with God that feels refreshing to one’s soul. His is one of the few that I haven’t fallen asleep to, that’s how riveting his sermons are!

For us this is the Christian equivalent of seeing a Will Smith concert or watching Kobe play live. It was the absolute privilege of our lives. He is 85 now and while he still appears to be in good health, I knew the opportunity to see him preach were becoming slimmer by the year. We needed a bit of a spiritual jolt with the hardships we’ve dealt with in recent months, and we received our spiritual rejuvenation in spades!

One of the highlights of our visit to SMCC was joining a legion of fellow believers in singing one of our favorite worship songs: Holy Forever.

The song itself is incredibly meaningful to us. Its message is simple yet profound: while everything around us is temporary, God remains eternally holy, sovereign, and worthy of our praise. Long after our own voices fall silent, generations yet to come will continue singing His name.

What moved me most, however, wasn’t just the song. It was witnessing an entire congregation, a massive choir, and countless voices rising together in worship. In a world that seems increasingly divided, there is something breathtaking about believers gathering with a single purpose: to exalt God.

My wife and I have always wanted to experience traditional gospel singing at a southern Baptist church. While this wasn’t quite that, it was certainly close enough for us! The scale of the production was astonishing. The choir, musicians, lighting, and worship leaders felt more akin to a Hollywood or Broadway production than anything we’re accustomed to. Yet despite its grandeur, the focus never drifted from the One it was intended to glorify.

As we joined in singing, I couldn’t help but imagine what heaven itself might sound like: countless voices from every nation, tribe, and tongue united in praise before the throne of God. A small glimpse of eternity, and a memory we will cherish for years to come.

“A thousand generations falling down in worship, to sing the song of ages to the Lamb.”

Hallelujah, God is truly great, and we are immensely thankful to Him for bringing one of our greatest aspirations in our lives as Christians to fruition! 🙌🏽 Bible Centered Church. Dr. David Jeremiah is a powerful preacher who truly knows the Bible and can explain it in terms  easily understood by all. The sanctuary is beautiful; the campus is huge and the. church members are friendly and welcoming. Plenty of parking; with special, designated parking for first-time visitors. Long time listener first time visitor.  Wonderful Christmas worship music from adult and kids choir.  Dr. Jeremiah appears frail but his physical condition had not diminished his Biblically sound preaching.   Parking and moving of people in and out of the worship center went well.  We were blessed to attend.  😇 Grateful for the warm hospitality of Shadow Mountain Community Church. From the thoughtful meals to the care shown to our choir, we truly felt welcomed like family. Your kindness filled our hearts even more. An excellent event to celebrate our nation's birthday (Independence Day). A wonderful patriotic program with music choral and orchestral) and the pastor spoke a great message. The event ended with a fireworks display that was beautiful! Crowd was handled very smoothly and well monitored.

name: Shadow Mountain Community Church - Encinitas
Shadow Mountain Community Church - Encinitas - Encinitas Campus
reviewSummary:
Great church in Encinitas great worship. The people are really friendly. And the pastor is doing a good job running the services! We felt very welcomed. If you’re looking for a church to come this Sunday, please come! If you love Pastor David Jeremiah's solid Biblical teaching, but you prefer a smaller congregation, this is your place. This body of believers will welcome you and you will love them. It is a place to plug in and belong.  There are weekly activities to be part of.  The worship style is a mixture of both classic hymns and new songs.  Plus, you can see the ocean from the parking lot! Reverend Adam greeted us at the entryway even before I finished my coffee and donut. Lots of smiley and friendly people will welcome you and make you feel at home. This place has such a sweet, sincere spirit; warm welcoming atmosphere & truly caring people! Nice to have the benefits of both a large church and a small church at the same time without the general challenges normally based on church size...The best of both worlds! Under the leadership of Dr. David Jeremiah and the campus Pastor Robert Pedroza this is a great choice for a place to grow & go to enjoy worship each week! I hope to see you there soon...Look for me & say, "Hi"! Arrive by 10:15 or so on Sundays to mingle & enjoy well known local treats from VG Doughnuts and Bird Rock Coffee! I’ve been going to this church recently and it’s been such a refreshing experience. It’s a satellite location of Shadow Mountain Community Church, which has its main campus in El Cajon — a solid 30-minute drive from where I live in Del Mar. So having this Encinitas location makes it a lot more accessible, and I’m really grateful for it.

The environment is incredibly peaceful. They don’t use bright overhead lights — instead, natural sunlight fills the main room, giving the space a calm, relaxed atmosphere. Every Sunday, Pastor David Jeremiah appears on the screen with a sermon that’s clear, powerful, and easy to connect with. His ability to break down and communicate God’s word in such a simple, yet profound way is something I really appreciate. They also provide printed notes each week, which makes it easier to follow along and reflect afterward.

Everyone at this location is welcoming and kind — including the local pastor, who brings a warm and positive energy to the space. There’s fresh coffee and donuts available every time I go, which just adds to the comfort and sense of community. It’s a great place to show up just as you are, relax, and spend time growing in your faith.

name: Shepherd Church
Shepherd Church - Westwood Campus
reviewSummary:
07/04/2026

I always miss the fireworks show here every 4th of july for 3 years now due to my work but this year I managed to attend. This church seem to be a good one and many people seem to like it.

They had people parachuting, military air planes flying by and beautiful fireworks. The whole Rinaldi street was packed with people. I absolutely love it here! From the first day I came I felt the Holy Spirit. The energy is always So vibrant and I love the preacher. His message always resonates with me. I love that I get to bring my daughter here too because they have a children’s area to the side with TVs in there as well. Great church, always a great service. I highly recommend. If you are looking for a church that remains deeply rooted in scripture, this is a fantastic church to visit. The pastor is excellent, delivering messages that are consistently Bible-based and Jesus-centered. It is refreshing to attend a service where the focus stays so clearly on the Gospel. For me, the person worship is not long enough. There's only two songs with a break and then one more song. Also, there is no prayer offered for up at the end for healing and or Deliverance. However, the atmosphere is very loving and it seems they have a good children and youth center. They also have classes for grief. This is the kind of California church that I had been used to. Honestly it’s been years from stepping back into a church. And this time I was really going with a broken heart. I showed up with my 8 month old daughter. Walking in no one told me about the stroller being an issue, going inside to sit down they stated they’re not allowed in there, which is fine the man took the stroller and put it else where.
My daughter got excited because of the praising music they started with and after I was calming her down by breast feeding her and I’m covered. The man who took the stroller comes to me and tells me “if your kid doesn’t quiet down they will ask you to leave” which I understand yet the way he said it and approached me made me upset. My daughter is already falling asleep breast feeding and makes one more noise and he comes to me again and tells me to leave. Brings my stroller and grabs my diaper bag not giving me a moment to grab my things if not rushed me out. And honestly I am never stepping back into this church. My sister mentioned me regarding the baby care center they have there yet since it was my first time I did not want to just leave her there. She was already getting quiet and I felt like it didn’t matter. She wasn’t even crying she was just grunting. If having children there is an issue then they should state that before entry, just like the stroller. And speak to the people on the floor to be more compassionate before removing someone because the way I was treated did not feel right especially coming from a church.

name: Shepherd Church Simi Valley
Shepherd Church Simi Valley - Woodland Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
Pastor Caleb is so chill and laid back. He keeps it real and when he speaks to you directly..you get the sense of him being honest and you realize he is just like us with everyday issues..but he explains how God has helped him through difficult times and there is hope and salvation for us all..He has helped change my life with a Bible study and teaching at every service that Pastor Caleb makes fun, interesting, and easy to understand. My son Shane and myself have been attending simi shepard for over 2 years now. I was baptized in june 2024 and I am so grateful.. we attend every Sunday at 11:30 and sit in the front row. we love church.. Caleb has made church great again..! thank you and God Bless You All . Patrick Reilly 🙏 Pastor Caleb and the staff here are amazing. I love Shepherd Church because of the structured Bible teaching highly recommend this church. And another thing I love is a sermon notes that keeps me engaged. I truly love this church and am deeply grateful for the community, teaching, kindness, and genuine love for people here. It has been a place of growth, healing, and encouragement for me, and I can honestly say so much good is happening through this church.

One small piece of feedback I wanted to share thoughtfully is regarding the secular music played before and after service. While I understand the intention may be to create a welcoming and upbeat atmosphere, I believe worship music can accomplish the same thing while also keeping hearts and minds centered on God from the moment people walk in until they leave.

There is so much modern worship music today that is uplifting, joyful, musically excellent, and just as engaging or “catchy” as secular music — without pulling our attention back toward the world’s themes, emotions, or atmosphere. Music affects people deeply, often more than we realize, and church feels uniquely special when the environment remains fully focused on Christ throughout the entire experience.

This isn’t coming from a place of criticism at all, but from love and appreciation for what this church already does so well. I’d personally love to see the atmosphere continue moving toward worship, reverence, peace, and spiritual focus from beginning to end.

Thank you for all you do for this community. Awesome church ⛪️ 🙏 🙌  Pastor Caleb is the best. Diverse with great music and message for all. Kids section is also lovely and helpful for parents. Get there early as parking can be a challenge otherwise. A wonderful place, nice people, a very spiritual praise team and excellent worshipers, they really preach only the word of God. Pastor Caleb is young but he is knowledgeable and very committed to the Word of God.

I cannot say enough of this beautiful church, and everyone involved. I have been attending for around 3 years. This past year has been tough, and I have not been in person. But the GREAT thing is I can attend online. Not the same as fellowshipping which is so important in my book. I invite all to come and enjoy this beautiful church. Please come and visit our church and listen to Pastor C‘s sermon. You will not be disappointed. SOTH is the right place to worship, fellowship, and study the Word of God. ✝️

name: Shepherd of the Hills United Methodist
Shepherd of the Hills United Methodist - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: The pastor is warm and earnest and the congregation, welcoming. There is a feeling of fellowship and many opportunities for all ages to get involved. Both Sunday services (traditional and modern) are relaxed. I am comforted and blessed by the worship. I was a member of this church as a youth and have come home as an adult with young children. Our family loves SOTH for its inclusiveness, close-family-like feeling and amazing desire to love everyone. If you're looking for an inclusive environment with a strong history of community involvement this church is for you. I love this church and this church family. They are really caring people and walk the walk. Since I have had to be home bound more, even before Covid, they always check on us and send cards. Our Pastor Karl Stuckenberg is warm, sincere and very approachable. We are blessed to have him as our spiritual leader. If you are looking for a home church, this is the place to be.~Nancy SOTH UMC in Mission Viejo is a beautiful church campus with such features as a peaceful atrium in the main sanctuary, memorial garden, prayer garden and more. And as with all churches, it's really the people that make this a great worship experience. The congregation at SOTH is focused on connecting with Christ and each other and is very committed to outreach in both the local community and beyond. From missions to small groups, Bible studies, music and special events there are endless opportunities to connect and get involved. Nice newer building with all the standard Methodist dogma.  Nice pre-school.  Very closed minded congregation.  They are slow to warm up to newcomers.  If you only want to see your church friends for 45 minutes in church and 15 minutes for coffee, this UMC is for you!

Shepherd of the Valley Lutheran Church - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a fine church with a conservative, traditional Missouri Synod Lutheran church message, mixing God's law versus gospel in a very Christian, fair way.  Berating a church and it's Pastor based on a farm that is, to this day, still welcome to grow food and help people, but voluntarily ended it's unbelieveably affordable lease because of the beliefs of the person running the farm, is very unfair to the congregation and to it's leaders.
Before pre-judging the Shepherd of the Valley's message, which is primarily to love one another as Christ loves you, you are entirely welcome to visit and hear and experience God's message  every Sunday at 10am, led by our beloved Pastor Joel Luckemeier.  We will love to see you there! Wow just found out because of this church's pastor a pesticide free farm had to close down.  Imagine an organization showing love to all the people vs this tax free church who only loves it's direct members...wow what a message to share not of live but hate. Guess I'm not surprised it is a church after all Not the kind of Christians I'd like to know- closed down Community Roots Farm because of their closed mindedness. What a shame, totally missing the point of the entire religion and focusing on the wrong things. Pastor Luckemeyer and the congregation are so very thoughtful and welcoming.  A true church home where the Word of God is taught and lived. Pastor Joel is great!   A small, caring, friendly, ,supporting church dedicated to growing in love and faith.

name: Sherman Oaks Presbyterian Church
Sherman Oaks Presbyterian Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary: Members of the congregation where harassing some poor lady on the street who was just filming, made me very uncomfortable bad the church members didn't respect this poor ladies first amendment Amazing pastor and amazing people! I have been going to the 11am service for about a year and half and would recommend this church to anyone looking for a church. I go here for a men's meeting on Monday nights in the fellowship hall and it is a nice facility. That's all I can tell you.... Great warm church love everyone that attends, the pastor is great!! Love this church. Feels like home. PREACH love, PREACH compassion!

name: Shield of Faith Christian Center
Shield of Faith Christian Center - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
Warm and welcoming congregation.  Not too many people in church the day I went. A great place to learn about the Lord Jesus Christ Wonderful, great Christian teaching,small group

Still having great service in the parking lot And on Facebook! You feel the love of the people here. A place that makes you smile. God's presence is there. I love Shield of Faith Pasadena, CA. This church invests in people!

name: Shiloh Church of God In Christ
Shiloh Church of God In Christ - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary: I have been a member of Shiloh Church of God since 2017. Shiloh is a spirit filled Bible teaching church. We are blessed to have a church that keeps their members active and engaged in their walk with the lord. We have Bible study, Sunday morning service, discipleship, intercessory prayer, children flag worship ministry, Women’s ministry men’s ministry, silver saints Ministry, children’s ministry, marriage enrichment ministry, Food distribution, community outreach, international outreach, Nursing home outreach,  bible drive, blanket drive, socks drive, toys for tot, and Monday night Spanish ministry and coffee with the pastor. Shiloh is a family  oriented environment. We have church picnic, bowling day, movie night, bible family feud time,  and day in an Amusement Boomers. As a member I thank the lord for Pastor Bailey and the leadership. They are led by God to shepherd us with sound doctrine and a humble spirit. Please come and visit us. We are eager to meet you with a warm welcome into the house of the lord. Shiloh COGIC, is an amazing church! The people make you feel at home, and it's like family when you walk in the door. The Pastor is an amazing speaker, leader, father and husband. I have a family of 5 and we've been members since 2011. Great Church Highly recommend. The Pastor & First Lady were very nice. The congregation was very welcoming. HIGHLY RECOMMEND Definitely a Rhema Word.  It's nice to come back to Shiloh Church and see that the spirit of a God remains even with the face lift.  Preach Pastor preach.  Wow.  Amazing The Love and smiling faces. The love...the warmth....the kindness is the presence of God!!

name: Shorelife Church
Shorelife Church - Huntington Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Shorelife isn’t perfect, but no church is. It’s genuine and passionate about Jesus Christ. As someone who’s been welcomed and supported through Shorelife, I can confidently say it’s a Good Church. If you’re looking for a church this is a place full of people who will welcome you every Sunday, you just have to show up! This church and the leaders will always take the initiative to invite you to Bible studies or opportunities to learn more about the Gospel. God bless to those God is inviting to Shorelife! A wonderful community church with a culture of Biblical teaching, discipleship, and missions. We love that it's a community size where you can get to know everyone, be served and have the opportunity to serve others.

Highly recommended for those who are looking for a healthy church and be part of a serving community. Good looking church but weak to follow up after. Wish they can improve on fellowship. Service is ok through the whole time. A lot more action can help but got furniture around near the entrance. This is a wonderful church and our family has called it our home for over 5 years now. The community and fellowship are among my many favorite things about ShoreLife. The preaching is also outstanding, very solid and biblically sound. I love the music and worship time especially. The youth programs are amazing and our kids felt right at home so quickly when we first attended and still to this day. The pastors and their families really care about every single person that comes through the doors and we quickly found ourselves getting plugged into this wonderful community. Great church! People are very warm and welcoming! They teach the gospel message most importantly. Jesus is the way, the truth and the life! We moved to CA almost three years ago and needed to find a home church. After much online research we found Shorelife and wanted to try there first. We as a family loved it so much we never tried anywhere else. They have programs for every age group in the family to meet a families needs. If you are looking for a church to feel a part of and to help you grow in your walk with Christ, I highly recommend Shorelife Huntington Beach.

name: Shoreline Baptist Church
Shoreline Baptist Church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary: A great preschool that's filled with loving and caring teachers. They have a great program that nurtures the kids academically as well as personal growth wise. You get pictures, videos, and message updates of your kid's daily activities. We're very glad to see this preschool has grown in size and hope for it to continue to grow. The word is out on this great preschool! We highly recommend it! The pastor is great, kind, smart and amazing. The people are super awesome. Went for a school choir concert. Handicapped parking was difficult. Their sports program for kids is such a great outlet for kids to learn a new sport, learn how to play in a team and a bit about God at the same time. A great way to let kids break into sports. It might not be for everyone,  but is certainly a safe way to enter into sports and get an introduction to how God wants to know you as an individual. This is a wonderful church, serving Christ by serving the local community. I sent my kids for VBS last month and they loved it. Whenever I saw the staffs, dropping off my kids, everyone looks happy. I guess that's why my kids wanted to go on Sunday as well. (But I can't let them go because we already to go our church:)) Thank you so much for all the hard works for VBS!

name: Sierra Vista Baptist Church
Sierra Vista Baptist Church - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary: Love it I've ben going there since I was a kid and they have a kid area where they can learn the basics of God Small church, friendly people, God's Word and that alone - Love it!

name: Silver Lake Community Church
Silver Lake Community Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: I absolutely love this church! It’s such a warm and welcoming place. Pastor Kyle has a great way of making the readings engaging and never boring. I really appreciate that they offer a baby/kids area, so little ones have a place to go while parents can fully enjoy the service. It makes the whole experience so much more comfortable for families. A wonderful church in Silver Lake. Very welcoming community with a strong spirit of volunteering and support. They truly care and help people in need. Grateful to be part of this place. Awesome place: mobile showers and hot meals and donated clothes on Saturday starting at 10 am til 2 pm and in the circle steps area an AA meeting from 11 am to 12:30~1 pm, Hot food also on Wednesday along with a food bank out of the back that offers taking it to your drive-up vehicle, as well as other services I don't actively use, but I know they have. It is the greatest place on Earth. If you're an individua who's in need of a little to get you back on your feet. I recommend going. Don't expect a great transformation . It only happens to those who do something about it. No this place is for peace of mind and people who are there  to  give you peace of mind. So big shout out to those who wake up everyday and help. Much Luv ya. PEACE Really enjoyed Catholic religious service very peaceful tight-knit community

Silverado United Methodist Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: I grew up at this church. Loved every minute spent there. One day I will return to my home church. Church falling apart

name: Simple Faith Baptist Church Oceanside
Simple Faith Baptist Church Oceanside - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
Don't call or go or tithe to here. Carlos is extremely freshly, unspiritual, impatient, way easily & quickly triggered, defensive, not humble at all, has no self control, can't reason or use basic logic. And 100% he definitely he can't think critically or hold a basic conversation that challenges his MANY false reachings.

He doesn't understand basic Christian things you try to say to him, he shuns Christians out God sends to help him learn, & has a very unteachable spirit.

I called about godly advice on something. He kept assuming I wasn't even saved all bc he doesn't even know that people can repent apart from saying a sinners prayer, I had to repeat many times to him I'm saved, how God has changed me, he still couldn't understand the Bible's most basic concept you repent, confess your sins, & believe. He kept pushing this "yes but did you ask him into your heart though"over&over. What a shame he doesn't even know extremely basic Christianity.

Next, I explain to him I understand God's will in the situation I'm going through, he picks a theological fight like a punk with me. I tell him "I know you're an evangelist and you're a respectful person," he says he's going to hang up on me and feels bad hanging up on a woman being respectful to him. I tell him then don't hang up, you have the fruit of the spirit so put it on.

He had asked me my whole life in the beginning, yet in the end, was utterly & useless to give me any scripture whatsoever, let alone any godly counsel at all.

All he did was accuse me of believing things I didn't, & WHEN he asked me how I could believe such things, & I tried to answer him how I didn't, he shut me out, refused to listen tome.

He even told me that's not what our call is about, he's not the one needing help here (extremely proud and very arrogant), that I'm the one needing help here all because I had called him for advice.

Well, I reminded him yes, but you asked me why I believed something and I'm trying to answer your question, and you shun Christians who disagree with you, you're not supposed to behave that way towards God's people.

He says he doesn't have any questions, he was trying to answer my question (again very extremely prideful and arrogant to "presuppose" he's got nothing to learn from a Christian woman).

Anyways, he actually hung up on me while I spoke. This man cleaves to his heretical inconsistent Arminianism and fights Christians over his "paradigm" and "system" of beliefs which he doesn't even understand, nor Christian basics, to understand that he keeps "inserting" his theological "presupposition" into scripture, "out of context."

Well, apparently, nobody has taught this person Christian basics, such as we are called to judge with righteous judgment. He didn't even know this much. He thinks judging him as incorrect is a sin, like calling him out on unbiblical doctrine & behavior.

It's most obvious he has never even learned the most basics of Christian teaching which would have taught him that doctrine & behavior ARE extremely important.

I was very calm and respectful, but he wouldn't calm down, & kept disrespectfully talking over me. I told him he should show love & care for the false doctrine he is holding bc it's ruining his ministry to the extent he hates Christian brethren > by his actions towards them  Simple Faith Baptist Church is one of the sweetest places I’ve ever been. The pastor and the pastor’s wife make me proud to be in the family of God. The people in this church are so special and caring. This church preaches from the Bible. It’s one of my favorite spots in Oceanside. Amazing church with a great pastor. I would highly recommend this church to anyone in the Oceanside area. This is one of the Best churches I’ve ever been to. It my be small, but God still works in that church. Solid BIBLE BASED Church who talks the talk and walks the walk. Great fellowship and learning experience! Praise the Lord!

reviewSummary:
Loved visiting the Mother House. It is an awesome place. Very beautiful and nostalgic. Truly a blessing from God! One of the absolute worst.
You'll get no needed help from them.

You'll get very little to no supplies covered by Medicare from them.

name: Site of the Original Calvary Chapel (1965)
Site of the Original Calvary Chapel (1965) - Newport Beach Campus
Skycrest Community Church
Skycrest Community Church - Clearwater Campus
reviewSummary:
Skycrest Community Church is a Family Friendly place for all ages. They often have events to bring us together 💗 SUCH things as Student Camp June 22 to 26th this 2026. Easter Egg 🥚 Hunt March 28th 12:30pm - 2:30pm 2026; Good Friday Special Event on April 3rd at 12pm and Easter Sunday with Two Services 8:30am and 10:30am The worship service is a meaningful and uplifting time with a community of believers. Meeting in Connection Groups (Bible Study) on Sunday morning is a great opportunity to share insights and learn from others. Everyone is so friendly and the Pastoral staff are very encouraging!

If you are looking for a church, come and visit and experience being a part of the family of God! Skycrest Community Church is a truly special place! The worship is powerful, the teaching is inspiring, and the community is warm and welcoming. My family loves being part of this church—our kids have an amazing time, and we all continue to grow in faith.

Skycrest is committed to Making Friends, Meeting Needs, and Making Disciples, and it shows in everything they do. If you're looking for a church that feels like home, this is the place!

#SkycrestCommunity #FaithFamily #GreatWorship Pastor Chris has never failed to give a thought-provoking sermon. I have found the members of this church to be authentic, loving, kind people. If you are looking for a church home, definitely visit here. You will feel welcomed and glad you came. A warm, bible teaching and believing church.  Authentic people - if you're looking for a local church - visit Skycrest a few times.  The current pastor, Pastor Chris Stephens, has a brilliant way of teaching and equipping that will never leave you bored.  There are plenty of small group studies to choose from as well.  If you see me in the pews Sunday morning, don't hesitate to stop by and say hi.  :- )

name: Skyline Church
Skyline Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary: Ask yourself this. Does your church right now give warmth and a welcomed feeling? If not come here they have plenty to go around for you and for your family. It's really fun for all ages and they have kids service, a youth service, and a service for the adults with a family room for people with little ones. ❤️❤️ Absolutely love this church! Been going here since it was 7SD in lakeside and Jeremy is definitely one of the most influential motivating pastors I’ve experienced. Lots of scripture in his sermons and every week is just amazing. My sister now works for the school and I volunteer as much as I can. This church is such a blessing for the community. Today was a sermon on greed and the pastor assumed people can live off 50% of their income and pushed tithing as they often do. If this church wasn’t in such a wealthy area I doubt people would be fine with them pushing for you to empty your pockets. They also push their app on you often multiple during the prayer I prefer prayer and speaking to congregations to be separate as it makes the prayer feel less sacred. This is a mega church not very down to earth in my eyes more focused on a big show, advertising, and money extraction. A wonderful church I have been attending for 5 years. You will feel welcomed and enjoy the atmosphere. Pastor Jeremy is a great preacher. We love our Skyline family!   Good people that are here to serve the Lord and our community.  We have never felt so connected to Jesus as we do at Skyline.  Saved people serve people, and that is exactly what we do here everyday.  If you want teaching based on the Scriptures, this is may very well be your home.

name: Slavic Bible Church
Slavic Bible Church - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary:

Whether you want to get credentialed or simply desire to know more about the Old and New Testaments, the SoCal School of Ministry is an excellent choice and a wonderful experience that is offered through the SoCal A/G Network👍✝️ Pastor Rich came to Higher Vision Church. A profoundly different and impressive experience meeting with John and Tom this morning regarding church outreach. This is the beginning of a new day! Great set of leaders for a wonderful group of churches. A/G is full of competent and Godly leadership. Amazing, spirit-filled and great leaders and teachers. Best education given.

name: SoCal Network Assemblies of God
Sola Church
Sola Church - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary: This church is a hidden gem!!!  They’ve just started this church and it meets in the Joslyn Park Auditorium-adjacent to the dog park.  The teaching is world class-biblically solid, insightful, with lots of application.  The worship is excellent!  Don’t judge by its small beginnings, this church is going to grow!   It’s welcoming to ALL, and the people are so warm and friendly.  They even have an area for people to enjoy the service outside, with their dogs, under a canopy.  The children’s ministry is adorable.  Parking is plentiful on 7th street, between Kensington and Strand. Sola Church is a MUST visit, you won’t be disappointed!!! SoLA Church, a place where anyone can believe and everyone belongs. Pastor Allen and his wife Miranda are very welcoming and non-judgmental. Pastor Allen’s ministry is very enlightening. He explains the Bible teachings in ways we can understand. Miranda, with her wonderful singing ability, leads worship. You leave church feeling uplifted and feeling you are not alone; you have someone who cares and will walk with you through any issues you may have. Give it a try!! I love everything about SoLA church. The church where everyone can believe and everyone belongs. I love the people, the fellowship, the teaching of the Word of God and last but certainly not least praise and worship. The music is absolutely heavenly. It definitely takes you to a place of spiritual ecstasy. Pastor Allen’s wife, Mirand has been blessed with a beautiful voice. I look forward to hearing her sing every Sunday. On our first visit we were blown away by how welcoming the members are. We love that the teachings each Sunday are truly Bible driven and for real world application. I thank God for SoLA because in every service I know we will hear Gods Words no matter what’s going on in the world. I know Gods love, His Word and His people are in this place. It’s amazing that Pastor Allen and his wife does so much and give back so much to the community. I love that. You can feel the Spirit of God moving in this place. I told Pastor Allen that on my very first visit. There is peace, love and harmony here. The thing I love most about this church is the evidence I find abundantly testifying is the fact that this is where God’s will is for my husband and I. The peace that comes from the confidence and assurance of being where God wants us to is extraordinarily comforting. SoLA has been an amazing place to worship on Sunday mornings. I had been unchurched for over 10 years looking for a place that would accept ME and my wife. Sola was just that place. They welcomed us with open arms and an open heart. They don’t focus on our “lifestyle” but help me focus on my relationship with God! The teaching is outstanding! My knowledge has grown leaps and bounds as well as my relationship with Jesus. This doesn’t feel churchy but more like a warm hug full of loving people, who love God. We are small now, but HUGE in love, support and acceptance. Check it out! Coming to SOLA means getting to enjoy true fellowship as well as solid Bible teaching week after week.  We have been attending for about a year now and have made some very positive friendships and creative Bible studies.    If you are looking to get involved in a small church context, SOLA is the place for you and your family.

name: Solid Rock Christian Church
Solid Rock Christian Church - Boca Raton Campus
reviewSummary:
Great Real Church. My  Journey starts  in the  year of 2000 . Meeting Pastor  Joe And his Wife  Kathy , has been  won of the greatest  things  to happen in my  life . Being  a recovered drug addict with many times of falling back into my addiction, they have been there for me, always only wanting the best and God's best. They love me when I was unlovable. Spoke the truth in love.
When I didn't want to hear it here. Without solid rock pastor Joe and kathy and most of all Jesus christ I would  be Dead, spiritually definitely physically .Are church ⛪️  preaches the word of God as the bible speaks it 🙏  it's a Family  Church. We share are joys trials.
And experiences with each other.
And we do all overcome. If you're reading this i hope you can join us to experience
What I am living in my life.The power of Jesus christ .Thank you Pastor  Joe ,Kathy with your a Faithfulness  to The LORDS  calling  to Ministry and  Solid  Rock. See  ya Sunday 😊 🙏🙌👏 Solid Rock Christian Church is truly a place where faith comes alive. From the moment you walk through the doors, you’re greeted with warmth, love, and a genuine sense of family. The worship is uplifting and Spirit-filled, creating an atmosphere where you can truly connect with God. The teaching is powerful, rooted in Scripture, and full of practical wisdom that helps you grow deeper in your walk with Christ. Every service leaves you encouraged, challenged, and inspired to live out God’s Word in your daily life. Solid Rock isn’t just a church—it’s a community where lives are transformed, and where you can truly experience God’s presence and purpose. I love to attend the service after.  I learn a lot and the worship time is sooo amazing. I love pastor Joe and Kathy, his wife, they are the sweetest people in town. 💕 Great church! Pastor Joe teaches the Bible very well and in a way that is easy to understand. I love Solid Rock. Is my family for years. Thank you for all guys, all the blessing, all the support, all the prayers. I love you guys 💛

name: Son Light Christian Center
Son Light Christian Center - Orange Campus
reviewSummary:
Passive aggressive vibe to get here. Not much welcome to get till after service. Unstable to walk through the church. Helps to upgrade overall on spacing. Some events offered here though. I have loved Son Light and Pastor Joe and Nancy for at least 45 yrs now!! Son Light is always my home Church even though I live in Palm Springs now. I view Sunday Services and daily devotions online almost daily!! I’ve never been able to find a Pastors Sermons that compare with Pastor Joe!!
The Church was built by Cecil B Demille many years ago and of course was a Theater then. It’s so Historic and beautiful and a must see if you are in Orange , Orange County CA!! I attended Son Light starting at the age of 5. I am almost 41 and life has moved me to the other side of the country. But I can say, I still have friends there, I still have contact with some of my childhood youth group friends and I have yet to find a place of worship like Son Light. The ministry is right on. Pastor Joe Magliato is the exact same man off stage as he is on stage. His wife and their children all live their lives with what they preach. this is a solid ministry. I miss them greatly. This is the ministry that is truly unconditionally unconditional. Come as you are, you are valid, you are valuable, you are desired, you are deeply loved. I was truly saved in Son Light. I got saved in June 1989. I had been in California for one day I got saved playing the board game Risk that was on a Friday  on that Sunday I got baptised. That Sunday by Pastor Joe. I love this church. I went to church everytime it was open. I volunteered for everything. Went for at least a year became a salesman for a Christian company. I was a minimum wage worker prior to God giving me a life and a career. I have recruited trained and managed over 2000 sales people between 2003 and 2010.
I traveled home to Chicago for my grand mother's funeral. I desided to move back to Chicago to marry my ex girl friend. I realized after that first year I had to get married well I moved back and 7 months later I married a completely different lady I was 21 and she was 33 from the outside it didn't look like a good fit.z Her husband died several years before.  Well she got saved in her kitchen with me and she was a friend of my aunts. God had a plan I needed to get married because temptation was unbelievable. We have been married for 32 years. We had 2 kids. My life has been better a miracle I had an 8 the grade education.
I built a company in 47 months I employed about  79 people I started the company with six thousand dollars I sold the business for over a million dollars 47 months later.Hiw only God could have doith e is unbelievable. Pastor Joe gave me a good foundation and a code to live by with rules and making decisions based on right and wrong. God put Pastor Joe in Son light to changed my thinking and to be an example of  how 8 am supposed to carry myself. He didn't know it but I studied him from a distant.  He knew what he knew and that was the deal God is  not open for debate. I returned about 7 or 8 years ago and went to a mens Bible study. I talked to pastor Joe and he didn't remember me. I look so much different if I had a picture from 1989 he would have said i remember. It's great that everyone always loud and brash. So the fact I was so well behaved I never made a scene. My name is George Dodson
If you are looking for a new way of life. You never have to feel the way you may feel right now.  All the best to you on. Your journey. Love sonlight raised all my kids here now there grown & have fond memories of the love & kindness they received here, infact they dont want to go to any other church, i had moved away & stopped going for a good 6 years but the good lord brought me & my kids back as for the commentor that its a rasist church so not true im of mixed race & never got that indication. One bad person or experience doesnt make it a racist church infact all different races go to son light. Family based & owned church with lots of history, what a blessing!

name: Sound House Church
Sound House Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: I began attending Sound House Church about 3 years ago. What a blessing it has been!! Shortly after my first attendance I made it my home church. I love that it's not just a church on Sunday. They have outreaches, bible studies, community groups, and a great program for kids! Pastor Ryan teaches from the Bible and delivers God's word in a way that is understandable and relatable. Associate Pastor Chad does the same. For me Sunday service would not be complete without some praise and worship. You should see (or maybe hear) the amazing Worship team!! If you're looking for a good church with solid values and a friendly congregation you should give Sound House a try. We love Sound House Church.   We don’t live in Southern California, but visit there 4-5 times a year and never miss a Sunday when we are there!  Everyone is very friendly and welcoming.  Ryan’s message always resonates.  We drive away after service and my husband and I always say that if we lived in Southern California, Sound House would be our home church. My husband and I have been attending Soundhouse for years and now our kids love attending! There has always been and continues to be the most welcoming community that I immediately felt from our first Sunday visiting. From the worship and message to the kids programs and women's ministry, I love every aspect of this church. I've gotten to know so many friends through the community groups they host throughout the year in a more casual setting and I can't tell you how blessed I've been by the new mom group, MomCo, and the various women's events and retreats. My kids love VBS every summer and there are so many other fun events throughout the year that we look forward to. If you're looking for a church in Long Beach for your family, definitely give this one a try! Our family has been involved at Sound House for almost four years. We've been so grateful for this community. It's been so exciting to be a part of a growing church. We love the worship, message, and kids ministry. Coffee and donuts every Sunday, yes please! My husband and I visited Sound House when we first moved to Long Beach. We felt welcome from the moment we arrived and we soon made Sound House our church home. We love the community here!
