name: South Bay Christian Alliance
South Bay Christian Alliance - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary:
I’m a FTM, and for Mother’s Day, I decided to attend and check out South Bay Christian Alliance Church alongside my friend and her son — she’s also a FTM like me. Before coming to this church, I had been longing to find a church family, and I truly felt like God was leading me here.

Everyone was so welcoming from the moment we arrived. I especially loved that they have a baby nursery room because, as a breastfeeding mom, I was able to feed my son and let him nap comfortably while still listening to the sermon.

The ladies there were so kind, loving, and caring. After church, they had lunch, and they even made me a plate 🥹 Their kindness truly touched my heart.

I LOVE this church and the people here, and I look forward to continuing to attend. Thank You, Jesus 🤍 Wonderful church and welcoming environment. I love how community focused SBCA is and how rooted they are in the truth of the Bible. Our kids love the Sunday school program, and it's nice they have a large nursery for our baby. The worship team is always full of joy and Pastor Jeff's sermons are both informative and interesting. Couldn't recommend enough. the quality of the sermons here is top-notch, engaging, and truly impactful. the welcoming community and genuine atmosphere make every visit special. Incredible experience, great community, wonderful worship. Will definitely be coming back. Thanks Jeff for making me feel so welcome!

Very friendly church.  Messages each week are timely, from the heart, and true to the word of God.  Down to earth membership here, as well.   A comfortable and caring place. An Awesome place to worship. The music is good, the people are friendly and the message was honest and applicable for today.

name: South Bay Community Church
South Bay Community Church - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
SBCC is a growing church, now with four services. The blessed thing about it is that they aren't chasing growth in people numbers, they are focused on growing each individual's knowledge of scripture and personal faith in Christ. They primarily teach through books of the Bible (rather than have constant "themed" messages). This is critical in teaching because going verse-by-verse forces the teacher to address the full beauty of God's word, from the good to the uncomfortable, from the basic truths to the challenging sections.

The pastoral staff and the overall staff are very friendly, approachable, and most importantly, prayerful. This is not a high-pressure church at all, it's Spirit-lead, organic maybe. They accept each person as they come and are dedicated to teaching each person in a way that is simple but with outstanding depth. I have never felt shamed or condemned by the messages, just convicted in way that points to my shortcomings but fills with hope in my future, strength in my walk, and the joy promises of God's love, mercy, and patience with us. First time visiting this church today and it was amazing. Found it on Google. The folks were very nice, lots of attendees, children's church is available and snacks and refreshments are available.  They do have life groups that you can connect to during the week. I will be back next week. SBCC is a great place to find God and Salvation through Faith in Jesus Christ.  SBCC provides an loving and supportive community of people dedicated to living and serving our lives to show the existence of the Holy Spirit working through us to help the world 🌎 find God! ! Amen! PTL! Hallelujah!! Glory be to God!

It’s an Awesome Place to Be! I just attended a celebration of life for a friend and the pastor was amazing I wish I lived closer to this church this is a community of love and friendship. The best church in the South Bay. All of the pastors do a great job of tying everything in scripture to our daily lives as well as making you feel welcome and appreciated.

Highly recommend if you are either new to the area or are choosing to follow Christ in a larger church setting!

name: South Bay Mission Church
South Bay Mission Church - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary:
I’m biased because I’ve been attending this church for 13-14 years (since it was first planted). We’ve moved locations several times, but the mission has always remained the same: building and growing gospel-centered community.

The preaching is solid where each sermon ties back to what Jesus did for us on the cross. Our pastors often go through entire books (both OT and NT) for each sermon series.

We’re far from perfect, so apologies if you visited and didn’t feel welcomed. There’s plenty of other great churches in the area as well :) Amazing place with great vibes! Everyone is so cool and they totally hook you up! highly recommend and they also have ping pong Of course the church members are going to 5 star the church. It's run down. Service didn't call out to me.

name: South Bay Pentecostal Church
South Bay Pentecostal Church - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary:
Tremendous Pentecostal church in the San Diego Bay area - great worship, powerful preaching, very friendly folks - God is doing great things at South Bay!! A very good church wirh a very good pastor and congregation.  Most of the people have the gift of speaking in tongues. Awesome leadership. Welcoming and wonderful church. So glad we were able to visit while we were in town. Great church. Great people. Truly the one church where I've felt loved the minute I walked in. The pastor of the church has been pastoring there for over forty years.

The people are friendly and treat you well. They will try to go out of their way to make you feel comfortable and welcome.

The singing and worship services are great. The worship is genuine and there is a sweet presence of the Lord that can be felt.

The congregation really knows how to worship and you can feel the presence of the Lord in a mighty way.

The pastor is friendly and makes you feel welcome. He is very likable and you can feel a genuine  anointing as he is preaching. He loves and cares about people and you can see that and feel that from him.

I highly recommend this church and I will definitely visit again  when I am in that area.

name: South Coast Christian Church
South Coast Christian Church - Dana Point Campus
reviewSummary: Made me feel at home from my very first visit. Pastor Tom gives the best sermons. The worship band is phenomenal. Everyone is so kind and welcoming. Lucky to have found such a wonderful group of people. My daughter attends South Coast Christian for Bible study Tuesdays, and she simply loves the campus and her mentors.  What better way to raise your child than in this lovely house of the Lord! Thanks a bunch South Coast Christian church for your support in prayer and faith! My family has been members of SCC since Fall 2019 and we enjoy attending church each Sunday since everyone is so friendly and really cares about us. SCC is a special place since it's motto is "creating environments to see what God can do through you." This means that as a church, they provide opportunities to serve, grow & lead in our church and community. If you are looking for a true church "family", I highly recommend you joining us on Sundays at 10am! God bless you! Just LOVE our church!!  It's a church for the community, state and world!!  With all our outreaches and events, you can see that our hearts are for people!!  Our Sunday services are pretty amazing as well.  Lively but spirit filled worship and a relevant message every Sunday!!  Lots of families who love hanging out together!!! The first time I walked into South Coast Christian, I knew I was home. We were looking for a church that teaches from the Bible, good worship, and the presence of the Holy Spirit. We found that and so much more, including lifelong friends. We have attended South Coast for 2.5 years now. Pastor Tom did our premarital counseling,  married us, and genuinely cares about every member of the congregation. I look forward to going to church every week!

name: South Coast Presbytery (PCA)

South Daytona Christian Church - Daytona Beach Campus
reviewSummary: I love worshipping with our church family! We also love the opportunities to bless South Daytona! If you are looking for a church home, visit SDCC. You’ll be glad you did! Love this church! Beyond the Sunday service (which is awesome!), they do so much for the community, from weekly meals for those in need to free community parties and celebrations throughout the year. congregation is full of warm, joyful, down-to-earth people, including the staff. It’s truly a special place! My family's church for over 20 years.  Gospel based with sound Biblical teaching.  Community oriented "In the heart of the Community with the Community at heart".  Loving pastors and members who care. Thank you for a wonderful service this morning. I haven't attended church in years, and with recent tragic events, something said to me to go worship. I'm so glad I did. The moment I walked in the doors I heard in my heart, it's good to see you. Thank you again and I will be attending regularly!!! Love this church defiantly for the kiddos my grands both went there for pre VPK and VPK. Love Trevor and Ms Fricke and Tori Fricke and Ms Ford when she was there and defiantly Ms Bradshaw and of coarse Ms Ville! But I truly have to say the front office staff Ms Sandy needs to be a little more cheerful at her job cause she is the first place of the church! Not a very happy lady which is sad being in Gods house 🥺

name: South Hills Burbank
South Hills Burbank - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary:
I'm honored to have JR Carmichael as my pastor. His staff truly elevated our church. We now are more involved and love the message that SHB brings to the community of Burbank. This congregation does not judge and gives back 100%. We are blessed to call this establishment our family. Plus, Miss Maria is the children's director and couldn't ask for a better role model for our daughter ❤️ Very different vibe since it was passed on to another pastor years back. Was a very fun, lively & packed church and now it just has a different atmosphere. But the important thing is spreading the word of the Lord 💞 Best Church I have had the privilege to attend. I visit numerous congregations throughout Southern California & by far South Hills is at the top of my list. It’s obviously not as crowded as one of the mega stadium seating churches but that allows you to actually be acknowledged and greeted. They have multiple people greet you and that allows you to feel welcomed and I appreciate the diversity and hospitality. Very unique experience. The worship team is very intimate and you feel easily connected to worship and the message is communicated effectively and in a respectful amount of time. Here I found family and friends. So grab a friend, checkout Sunday Service.
8 AM Service 10 AM ServIce  1130 AM. I found my congregation. I've met a lot of amazing people please. Please come join and feel at home I hadn't gone back to a church since the pandemic and it felt ok. The music was nice but it had more sound of the instruments than the voice of the singers I could barely hear them.  I'm pretty sure they sing beautifully so let there be more voices of the singers. The pastor there has a name that you would never forget "JR" Pretty easy huh? His preaching was good so I guess I will go back and check it out again. Oh and this church has like a little coffee shop but the coffee is free and you can grab some coffee and go listen to the service or get coffee after the service. They also give you donuts which I don't eat donuts, But that's very nice for the people that do. The only thing not nice that I have to say is that when I was grabbing some coffee after the service, this lady behind me that I guess wanted to grab some coffee too. She looked at me like I didn't belong I guess she just wanted her coffee. I did see she knew people there because she was calling them by their names. But no worries, she's not going to stop me from going back Because I like the service.

name: South Hills Church - Costa Mesa Campus
South Hills Church - Costa Mesa Campus - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary:
We were just passing through and decided to stop at this church. Very kind and welcoming. They had a separate place for our 7 year old daughter to go to. Music was great and the sermon was fantastic. Highly recommended. Worship music is amazing everyone is welcomed and the sermon is always touching I love the warm intimate environment of this church feels like family South Hills Church is an incredible place to experience God’s presence.

From the moment you walk in, you can feel God is with us. 🙌 The worship is powerful 🎶 and touches your heart in ways words can’t describe.

Worship twice a day—when you feel like it and when you don’t—because God deserves our praise in every season. 🙏✨

They’ve got an awesome kids' section 🎉 and a growing teens' group too! 👧🧑‍🎓 Perfect for the whole family. ❤️

If you’re looking for faith, connection, and community, South Hills Church is the place to be! ⛪🌟 My family and I have been coming to this church since 2018 (that was when we were meeting at Ensign Jr. High) and then we moved away in 2019 and after that the pandemic hit.  We tried several churches in our area (Irvine) and nothing compared.  We started coming back in person in September of 2022 and lo and behold the church moved WAY closer to us!  So now instead of schlepping down the fwy and all the way across Costa Mesa, it's now a matter of a few fwy exits!  When we came back I was really looking for a sense of community, so I joined a small group and it was (and still is) an instant family vibe.  We still walk out life together and we are all family.  We recently went through a lot because there was a shift in leadership, but for me, as long as I have an opportunity to learn, grow and praise the Lord on Sunday and do life with my group and as long as there continues to be amazing childcare I'M IN!!!! This is a GREAT church for many reasons.  First, they follow the word of God, they are a nondenominational church - no religion.  They truly care about everyone that walk through their doors.
One if the most exciting things about this church is we are committed to tithe, as the Bible says. For 90 days. Pastor Moses says if anyone's life isn't blessed, that HE WILL PERSONALLY PAY YOU BACK EVERY PENNY YOU TITHED!!
THERE ARE SO MANY FUN EVENTS HAPPENING THERE.
I AM happy to say that I fit at South Hills Church- Costa Mesa.
Pamela Lafferman

name: South Hills Church - San Clemente Campus
South Hills Church - San Clemente Campus - San Clemente Campus
reviewSummary:
It's a blessing to be a part of a church family with people who truly care about each other. South Hills San Clemente is my church family. I look forward to seeing smiling faces every Sunday. We are blessed to have 2 wonderful men of God, Pastor James and Pastor Eric,  lead us in service. If you're looking for a welcoming church, this is the church for you. If you have to see it to believe it, come see for yourself, Sunday mornings at 10am.
- Christina Wonderful, welcoming church with accessible, practical messages. Pastor James is engaging and fun! Great music, too, as well as a Kids and Students Ministries…and donuts & coffee. 🙂 Awesome small church in San Clemente ! Reverent but not plagued by dogma. A place to do life with people who wanna know God and spread heaven al ‘round these parts. South Hills San Clemente is authentic and family oriented. If you’re looking to actually know people in the church and be connected with a community, this is the place!

name: South Hills Community Church
South Hills Community Church - Corona Campus
reviewSummary: We have found our new home in SHCC!  Pastor Smith always delivers a great message and our 9 year old loves the children’s ministry, which means so much to us! Very thankful we found South Hills! The perfect church for imperfect people. Pastor Adam enriches each sermon with insightful reflections and relatable real-life stories. I hadn’t been to church in a long time and didn’t intend to go regularly. After one event, I have been hooked. Going for just under 4 months now. I find myself attending as often as I can make the drive. When I’m not there in person, I usually watch from home. Thank you, South Hills community. I've been going to South Hills Corona campus for a little under a year now, and there is nothing to say better than amazing! Pastor Adam and his wife Gretchen are amazing people who have handpicked a wonderful staff. Our business recently was able to perform charitable detailing services for someone of the local churchgoers, and South Hills facilitated it all with ease and great compassion. I would recommend for any and all! My family loves Pastor Adam.  My husband and I have searched long,  hard and intensely for someone who has the right perspective, faith, and guidance to lead our family especially our 3 daughters.  Not only is Pastor very relatable, grounded and firm in his faith but funny and approaches lives’ adversities with less stress and more understanding. South Hills church is another place to call home. Pastor Adam and Gretchen are wonderful people. South Hills has a way of expressing God so uniquely that bring such a range of people together. It is such a loving and embracing community.

name: South Hills Manhattan Beach
South Hills Manhattan Beach - Manhattan Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Before you even walk in the door you will be warmly greeted. There is always hot or iced coffee and Randy's donuts waiting for you every Sunday. The service is an hour long and consists of worship, announcements, and a practical teaching/sermon. Children's church and nursery are also available during service. After service they encourage fellowship and provide lunch on the patio every week.

Pastor Bryon and Pastor Mike are humble, teach biblically sound teaching and have great hearts.

There are weekly women's or men's groups, a co-ed Bible Study, youth group, and prayer groups.

There is no lack of community at this church. The church truly is family. Come give South Hills Church a visit. BEST CHRISTIAN CHURCH IN MANHATTAN BEACH AND THE SOUTH BAY!!  The people and leadership are welcoming and kind, and the pastor is on point in the Scripture and  Word!!

They offer many programs for people of any age or need!!

Come on by

They also offer food for all and it's good!! Jesus King! Beautiful people beautiful place!
You are more than welcome to visit and join family! Pastor Bryon is the most "humble" GOD loving man. He is so down to earth , admits his difficulties in having doubt, like us all.  He's the best!! Try a service. You won't be disappointed.   Food suggests before & after services. Pastor Brian is so relatable in the way he presents his message of God and faith, Thankful I found this place to refresh my Belief in the Christian way of life. Blessed to have found such a wonderful place to Worship. Thank You 🙏

name: South Hills Santa Clarita
South Hills Santa Clarita - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary: This church is awesome. Pastor Efren’s message really hit home with me. Church is very friendly and welcoming. You feel like family. I visited today for the first time and I will be back. One of the most amazing Church's I have ever attended. Pastor Efren makes you feel important and like you are part of the family. I was never an every Sunday kind of person but now I can't wait til Sunday. It is a place that makes you feel good about yourself rather than guilty about yourself.  It has changed my life for the better for sure!!!!🙏 This Church is amazing, we recently attended one Sunday. The people were so nice and the Pastor was on point, real and delivered the message powerfully!!! I love bringing my family here. Great people and great east to understand sermons/message. The kids service is absolutely amazing and wonderful. Beautiful church with sermons that truly touches the heart!

name: South Pasadena Christian Church
South Pasadena Christian Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
My life used to be filled with sadness and sorrow until I opened my heart and let God into my life, and then I found this church on Google. I truly love going here; everyone welcomes me with warmth and kindness. Pastor Darrell’s teachings from the Bible inspire me deeply. The church also provides a nursery for the little ones and a Bible class for the children. At the center of this multi-ethnic, multi-cultural church lies a warm, compassionate congregation. Preaching is straightforward and effective, with class offerings a great chance to learn. This church also provides many volunteer opportunities for community services. All of this explains why I have been here for over 20 years. I love this church! It’s a warm and welcoming multi-ethnic community that truly focuses on teaching and living out the Word of God. The church is very friendly to Chinese people, and there are Chinese members serving in the leadership team as well.

Every Friday evening, there’s a Chinese Bible study group where we can learn the Bible and know God in our own language. At the same time, the youth also have their own fellowship gatherings.

On Sundays, the pastor’s messages are clear, practical, and deeply rooted in Scripture. They always help me apply my faith in daily life. I’m thankful to be part of a community where we can grow together in Christ and build up the church as one family. I have been attending for a couple years now. I keep coming because The pastor has a biblical message every week and bible study Thursday night (English), and Chinese Friday night. Also like being in a multicultural Church Family. Also they serve the community in a half a dozen ways I felt welcomed from the first moment I entered the church three years ago. It’s a wonderfully diverse church family with an online Tuesday night prayer meeting, service outreach in the community on Wednesdays, an English Bible study on Thursdays, a Chinese Bible study and youth group on Fridays, solid biblical teaching and a wonderful lunch after every service. The Sunday services are in English with simultaneous Mandarin translation (using headsets).

name: South Shore Community Church
South Shore Community Church - Sarasota Campus
reviewSummary:
This is one of the most amazing groups of people I’ve ever been associated with all loving and kind the service from Pastor Nick and all the other pastors that lean in and spread the word of Jesus is nothing short of spectacular. If you haven’t been to a high energy service in the past or judgment and condemning is not part of the preach then come and enjoy the music and the energy and love that spread in this room. If you haven’t found Jesus yet I recommend you visit and receive eternal life. I grew up in southern baptist and non-denominational churches across Sarasota and Manatee County. Eventually the clickiness, weird vibes, creepy things going on under the surface at so many places I experienced ran me off from attending church all together. I spent 18yrs walking alone in my faith. Relocated for much of that time up north (unrelated).

Then I moved back to FL and decided it was time to search until I found a real, genuine church to call home for my family. It took 3yrs. I looked everywhere. Tried several. Finally we found Southshore Community Church and I knew I was home. SCC is a center of Godly principles, Biblical study and real people with heart and deep roots in community enrichment. A congregation genuinely dedicated to including others in all directions and healing those who have been burned by other experiences. A place to TRULY come as you are. No judgement. No weird clicky vibes. Roll outta bed and walk in if you want. Or spend 2hrs getting ready and show up in your finest. Either way you're getting coffee, donuts and a warm smile at the door. Every message I've witnessed over the last year and a half (attending most every weekend) has been full of everything I've hoped for in a church for over 20yrs. I'm so thankful for SCC 💙🤍. We are the church!! After 25 years of practicing Judaism my husband I visited South Shore. I have been inspired at every service. The pastor is special. God gave me a pastor who speaks to me every Sunday! Every service ends with the pastor asking "Who is the church?" And the congregation replies "We are the church!" I'd love us to join this church soon. At Southshore community church attendees dont go to church they are the Church... They are believers and defenders of the Word of God.. Jesus Christ.. Dr . Pastor Nic Williams is also a acclaimed  christian author and Amazon. Best seller.. South Shore is a great family church and also focuses on recovery as well for decades now.. Their celebrate Recovery has a positive track record with alot of community envolvement. Like other churches in our area Southshore is rooted in community. Great Bible based church. Pastor Nick is down to earth and inspiring. 3 Sunday services and now Thursday nights too! "At South Shore we don't just go to Church, we are the the Church, Go be the Church!"

name: South Shores Church
reviewSummary: A wonderful, highly biblically solid community. The ocean views are stunning and the people are very friendly. Great blended worship. The contemporary music is very professional.

name: South Shores Church - Dana Point Campus
reviewSummary:
I LOVE this church. They have so many wonderful things to do with you personally and they have wonderful people to teach your children.  They also have a recovery meeting on Tuesdays that will help anyone struggling with addiction.  God is truly there I love this church!!!
From the second we walked into this church we were welcomed and treated like family ❤
The music is amazing the church is simply beautiful and the Pastor is engaging, funny and informative.
If you are looking for a church to call home,... look no further than this place. I looked at 3 other churches before I came here. I walked in and I knew this was my place and I felt God everywhere.🙏 This church is located on a hill and was the perfect viewing point to watch August’s Sturgeon moon. Seeing the halo of light from the moon shimmering high above the city was heavenly, so to speak. My husband and I attended a funeral held at South Shores. The staff was incredible to all of the guests. Also, those that served in the Ocean Room for the reception afterwards were stellar. The view off the Ocean Room is impeccable! I am not a member of this church and today was my first time visiting. I find the music easy to follow and well performed. The teaching was practical with clear teaching from the Bible not just self help. I found everyone warm and welcoming. My children enjoyed their classes and were welcomed and names remembered even after leaving their classes. They have all kinds of upcoming events for all ages. This church is definitely multigenerational which is very rare. Three generations could attend this church and all call it home. The campus is beautiful and the parking was easy. We look forward to coming back again soon.

name: Southern Baptist Convention
Southland Christian Church - Lexington Campus
Southland Christian Church - Lexington Campus - Lexington Campus
reviewSummary:
This church holds such a special place in my heart because it’s where I begin and continue to grow in my walk with God. It’s where my Christian life truly takes root, and even now, I carry the foundation it gives me every single day.
The teachings are grounded in the Word and fully aligned with the teachings of Jesus. Every service speaks directly to my spirit, challenges me to grow, and reminds me who I am in Christ. The messages aren’t just words — they are truth, guidance, and life.
Southland doesn’t just talk about faith — they live it. They serve wholeheartedly, love genuinely, and create a space where people can encounter God in a real and personal way.
I am deeply grateful for this church. It is where my faith grows, where I am mentored, and where I continue becoming who God is calling me to be. Visited my 2023 college graduate daughter's Christian church for Mother's Day. Her steady boyfriend volunteers working for the church on the tech & cameras. Very mellow rock music. The pastor seemed down to earth while teaching. Nothing too eccentric & no pressure. I did take communion & it was clean & safe.  If I lived there in that state, I would probably be a regular attendee. At first glance the church was intimidating.  Upon seeing first time Parkers spot and a welcome crew as you walk in they quickly dispelled any stress. The church is indescribably beautiful.  The seats are cushy and the people are friendly. The worship amd praise team and singing was amazing. You can definitely tell this church was filled with the holy spirit and God ever present.  Highly recommended for nervous or first timers very comfortable. Many groups to join as well for Sunday school study before church or on off days. A++ We have visited Lexington twice in the last 3 months and have attended this church. To be at church so large it amazes me how personal they are and you can tell that they love their community. I love the relevancy and the truth of their sermons and their worship. I have been going to the church since I was a baby, I absolutely love this church. The pastors are so nice and welcoming to every new person. They have new hair response for anyone who has never been to the church so that they can get to know you. Anyways, just wanted to share that this was an amazing church and I think you should join!!!!✝️

name: Southlands Church Brea
Southlands Church Brea - Brea Campus
reviewSummary:
Worship was as good as Bethel. Wow. Teaching was solid. I'd make this my home church if I wasn't living overseas. They have an outstanding pastoral staff of Bible teachers, just excellent!
The worship is good, although you may want ear protection as it's on the loud side but very passionate. The sanctuary is a bit dark, take your reading glasses. My wife and I first visited Southlands four years ago and are so thankful to have found this church and community. We love the gospel centered preaching, their willingness to listen to the Holy Spirit, and their multiplying culture of creating communities on mission all for the gospel. This is a church that truly loves their city and the people around them. If you live in the Brea area and are looking for a church, a family, or to learn more about Jesus. I highly recommend Southlands Church. I love this church. I've been to so many churches and never felt so connected like I do here. It's a great church family that balances it's size very well with small groups and many community events. The preaching is always biblically sound and easy to understand not to mention the worship is fantastic. I have been going to Southlands for over two years. When I first started coming, I had just moved from Studio City. I didn't know anyone in the area. I joined a lifegroup right away and met some amazing people who have become some of my best friends. I have been blessed to serve on the worship team and joined the church shortly after my first time coming. I love the focus on mission, prayer, biblical teaching, and worship. I encourage everyone to try it out and stick with it for a few weeks.

name: Southlands Church Santa Ana
Southlands Church Santa Ana - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary:
Awesome church! They clearly have a love for Jesus and the truth of the Bible. They meet in person with safety measures. Jon is a terrific person.  He is kind, wise, and able to lend a hand where he sees a need. I feel he is a wonderful person to lead this congregation into the future. Thanks Jon and best wishes. Southlands Santa Ana is HOME! I love this church so much! The people are truly like family and the preaching is GOSPEL centered! Hallelujah! Teachings are straight from the Bible and most services often have a time of response to the message. Definitely a smaller church, which means you won’t get lost on a crowd. 🤗 We joined Southlands Santa Ana in spring 2021 and have enjoyed being a part of the church (which is a smaller plant from a church in Brea). The community is small enough for us to actually connect with other people and also allows us to engage with serving in the church. Most importantly the pastor and pastoral team really care about teaching people to love and obey Jesus and to know the Bible.

The church meets outdoors which is nice for COVID considerations-- FYI no masks are worn but there's respect if you're like me and choose to wear one anyways.

There's also lots of opportunities to serve and do outreach, such as prayer/evangelism, serving those in foster care, etc. Definitely check it out and see if Southlands Santa Ana could be your church home. We have visited several times when in town and have been warmly welcomed; from the coffee and donuts to the warm hugs and offer for prayer. Each time we’ve attended, communion was part of the service, which I appreciate. The pastor, Jon, is not only knowledgeable in the Word, but also relatable, funny and kind. We will be back.

name: Southpoint Community Church
Southpoint Community Church - Jacksonville (Southside) Campus
reviewSummary:
Me and my family visited Jacksonville for the weekend and we wanted to go to a church in the area, the reviews were decent so we gave Southpoint a try. At the beginning it was ok, the music was ok, and the initial opening was ok, but then the old bald pastor (i don't remember his name) started going off topic and it never stopped, but the part where I had to walk out was when he started going off about how young people are immature and ungrateful and compared to the old days we have it easy because of (medicine being so advanced). I couldn't take it, we had to leave, with us being a young family and currently struggling because inflation has been insane and everything has quadrupled in price I've had enough. I'm not gonna be preached to by some old dude that prolly owns a 4 bedroom house and has been retired for 10+ years about how young people should be grateful for this system that his generation created and threw us into. I'm happy to announce that we will never be coming back and I will never forget about this experience, but go ahead and tithe to these people yall, so they can pay for another pastor vacation for their lead retirees. As much as my Husband liked being in church on Sundays but this Church does  not take into consideration of Kids with special needs. Something as simple as language delay in a child, there was nothing like inclusion for such child.  I believe this church can do better especially if you are teaching about Jesus christ the saviour of the world. My greatest disappointment with this church was simply that the service could have been impactful, but the pastor so overwhelmed the message with his personal biases, opinions, and politics that the depth of Christ’s teaching was completely lost.

Firstly, the screen clearly projected that the topic was Luke 3-9, yet we never read a single verse from said book. Instead, we opened to Matthew and discussed the instructions of Jesus to His disciples on how to address the public on their own. The core of the message was to “wipe the dust from your feet” or in other words to not allow the past to follow you into your present/future.

Secondly, this sentiment alone is incredibly moving and applicable to endless aspects of life. And yet, the pastor managed to make the entire conversation about how black people deserve better treatment in the form of free education and special privilege by employers (which is inherently racist despite his desperation to appear as a white ally), how young people are ignorant to the struggles of past generations and the easy way of life they provided us, and honestly I left shortly after the hour mark and he had moved on to talking about his golf game.

Thirdly, I would like to briefly dissect things he shared that are unbiblical and entirely his personal philosophies:
(1) “We are a ‘white-ish’ church and need to better understand and serve people of color since we could never understand their lament.” Paul very beautifully described how to combat racism as members of God’s Kingdom in ‭‭Galatians‬ ‭3‬:‭28‬ — “There is neither Jew nor Gentile, neither slave nor free, nor is there male and female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.”
Recognizing there are cultures and peoples that are treated worse than others is nothing new and Jesus simply calls us to love our neighbors (all people) as we love ourselves. No need for evening acknowledging skin color.
(2)”Young people are living in the easiest time in history.”
Aside from this being blatantly false due to the state of the economy, the downfall of morality in our country, and the satanic pedophilic horrors plaguing our society as well as inexcusably dismissive of the difficulties that come with living in a sinful world in any generation, this is also unbiblical. I will list a few scriptures that I recommend reading — 2 Timothy 3:1,13; Ecclesiastes 7:10; Matthew 24:6.

Overall, the doctrine of this pastor was abhorrent. The church building is beautiful and the people were welcoming, compassionate, and respectful. But as Jesus said to the Pharisees, “Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You are like whitewashed tombs, which look beautiful on the outside but on the inside are full of the bones of the dead and everything unclean.”
‭‭(Matthew‬ ‭23‬:‭27‬) First of all the people were very nice, they held the doors and smiled at you. The place is also incredibly clean with comfortable chairs. The sermon was really bad though. The pastor constantly kept going off topic, giving stories about golfing, childhood church, and even going to the bathroom at his grandma's house. He would say something so basic and then give an example for it which would make him think of a story and then he would give the story... The sermon could've easily been 20 mins based off what he was talking about, but he just kept talking about something else which drew it out to almost an hour before I walked out and he still had 2 more points on the board. He would also give examples with language that made me think of Ai. I will say that he doesn't seem like the main pastor. He did say that he gets sent to other churches which makes me think that the church thinks he actually does a good job. I didn't learn anything and he made fun of his own church music, young people, and called the church full of every race "white-ish" after going on a rant where he tried to seem inclusive, but was just racist. Big church with a big diverse community and wonderful pastors. The Holy Spirit is definitely present :)

name: Sovereign Grace Bible Church
Sovereign Grace Bible Church - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
This church is a huge blessing in my life because the people are sincere, godly believers, and the worship services feed Christ's sheep. Christ Jesus is the only one this flock strives to glorify. This is a true church being blessed by the Lord Jesus Christ! This church is anything but Christian. Last Thursday morning, in order to avoid getting a ticket from the street sweeper team, I parked in this church’s parking lot. It was raining and I was the only car there.

It’s been known in the neighborhood that the church doesn’t mind so long as no action is on, and there was no church activity whatsoever. When I returned to the car an hour later, my car is gone. I thought it’s stolen because no way someone from the church called in my car. Right? Wrong!

According to Nathan’s Towing Service, they can’t tow unless someone from the property calls it in. So, why did someone at the church need to call my car in when nobody else was in the lot? Cost me $375.

Well, I plan to attend church on Sundays from now on, and if I do, I will be secretly making small withdrawals from the tithe basket until I’m made whole. I also saved a young lady, the following day, from getting her car towed. Eye for an eye. You know, Christian values. Nice friendly people, sound doctrine, bible based messages. Straight preaching from the Bible. Family friendly. Great message always !

name: Sovereign Grace Church
Sovereign Grace Church - Orange Campus
reviewSummary: We attended the Christmas Eve service at Sovereign Grace Church of Orange in December of 2020.  We have been attending regularly ever since!  We love the excellent biblical teaching, the welcoming atmosphere, the fabulous worship, and the way our church family takes care of each other.   If you need a church home, we recommend to try Sovereign Grace.  The picture I included was taken at the Christmas Eve service 12/24/2025. I met some of the w people before I attended my first service and everyone was just the same... kind, welcoming and genuine. Love these people. This is a wonderful and faithful church! My husband and I were members here in the past, moved away, and became members again when we returned. This church is gospel centered, loving, and active. They have very clear, thorough, and biblical church government and policies which protect and guide the individuals who attend here. They have been very accommodating and caring towards my husband and I who suffer with disabilities. Wonderful, wonderful gathering of believers. Absolutely love this Church! My family attended a service five years ago and never looked back. The men and women here are full of the grace and mercy of Jesus Christ, always exalting the name and glory of Jesus. Our family has been incredibly blessed by the love and generosity of this local church. There is nowhere we would rather be on a Sunday! Were so thankful for the work God is doing through this church in Old Town Orange. My husband and I recently moved to Orange, and we tried many local churches before we stumbled upon Sovereign Grace OC. The people are amazing, loving, accepting, and wonderfully welcoming. From the moment we walked in, we have felt a part of the community. If you are looking for a church to call home, this church is passionate about community, and most of all Jesus Christ and teaching the gospel message.

reviewSummary: Loved it..Great people and Pastor preaches a great word from the Bible. I’ve been going to Spectrum Church for approx 14 years.  It amazing. Friendly. Loving. Great worship. name: Spectrum Church Irvine
Spectrum Church Irvine - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve been attending this church for a few years, and it has been a really meaningful place for me. The preaching is one of the biggest reasons I stay—it’s consistently Bible-centered, thoughtful, and actually challenges me while still pointing clearly back to the gospel each week.
The music is contemporary, but it feels genuine rather than performative, which makes it easier to focus on worship instead of just the experience.
It’s a smaller church, and that’s honestly something I’ve come to value a lot. It’s easier to get to know people and feel like you’re part of a real community instead of just showing up on Sundays. I’ve felt welcomed and encouraged here. When I first moved from Utah to Irvine for my job, I felt pretty lost and was craving a church home where I could actually serve, feel apart of, and gain genuine friends that have a connection to Jesus. I stumbled on Spectrum Church  through a quick Google search one Sunday morning, and man, it changed everything. From the second I walked in, the people greeted me like family, with  genuine hugs and “we’re so glad you’re here!”
What really hooked me were the service events they have lined up. You can just sign up with members of the church with whatever fits your schedule, and it’s been the perfect way for me to roll up my sleeves and work for the Lord like I’d been praying about. Their young adults group is awesome too, super fun hangouts, real conversations, and friends who actually check in on you.
This church is soaked in the Holy Spirit, and the folks here are hands down some of the most loving, kind people I’ve ever met. It’s been such a blessing in my new chapter. If you’re in the area, check it out! You’ll feel right at home. Feel free to say hi to me as well! Spectrum Church Irvine is and has been such a blessing to our family. From Pastor Gabe’s sermons, to wonderful worship music, and Sunday School, it has gone beyond meeting our families needs.
The relationships and love I feel from and for the congregation is a treasure to me. Every week I look forward to being there with “family”. Thank you, Lord for directing us to Your church! I moved to Irvine from Los Angeles not really wanting to be here and not knowing anyone.
I found Spectrum Church online and decided to give it a try. From my very first Sunday, people actually took the time to get to know me not just small talk, but real connection.
A month later, I had surgery and didn’t have family nearby, and this church prayed for me, checked in, and remembered my name.
That meant so much.

Spectrum isn’t just a place to go on Sundays it’s a community that truly loves God and cares for people.
I’m really thankful I found this church. I have faithfully attended several great churches in my life. Spectrum Church Irvine is the one I attend now and absolutely love!
Our pastor, Gabe Fung, is not only extremely knowledgeable, he is also an excellent writer and speaker!
Our congregation, board, musicians, tech team, are just like our welcome team, whom are always caring, warm, and welcoming!
Please join us and you’ll see what I mean!

name: St Andrew's By the Sea UMC
St Andrew's By the Sea UMC - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
We absolutely love this church! It is very welcoming to everyone, and we have brought numerous friends and family members here. Our kids have participated in their youth programs since they were infants and toddlers, and it has been a loving, nurturing, and kind place for them to grow. There is a nice variety of music each Sunday. Pastor Karl’s sermons are focused, engaging, and relevant to my day to day life. I truly feel like I am learning and growing spiritually. We’ve laughed and cried (in a good way 😊) in church, and I’m always glad we attended. I have been attending this church for almost three years now and have truly found my church home. I started there just after the passing of my husband of 53 years. My first impression was very good. I was greeted by friendly people including Pastor Karl, all of whom wanted to know a little about me. I  went back the following week and was impressed by the fact that they remembered my name and why I initially came.
Most of all I have enjoyed Pastor Karl’s sermons and his time with the kids.
It is a place where you can get involved as much or as little as you wish knowing everyone is so supportive in whatever you decide to do. Getting involved has been a blessing to me as I now have many more friends and am still meeting more. I have watched the church grow considerably in the almost three years I have attended. I have even brought along some of my friends who have all joined the church family.
So if you are looking for a good church home with great music and very interesting sermons by a great pastor, this is the place to come. This is the finest church I have ever attended. The music is superb. The organist/pianist is the best I have ever heard. The musical selections are always varying, interesting and supportive of the sermon of the day. The minister is young and energetic. The sermons are always delivering a message I can relate to and hopefully make me a better Christian.  The location has a superb view of the Pacific Ocean. Either before or after the service take the time to enjoy the wonderful view provided by God. St Andrew’s By the Sea is a Michelin Church. They also having amazing potlucks. Pastor Karl is amazing. I always leave church learning something new and feeling my spiritual soul lifted. His Sermons are never boring I especially love Finding God in the movies and the Tuesday Matinee. The Band, Choir and Bells music augment the Sermons  The Music Director often educates in the origins of the music. Great fun. It is truly the church of connecting - there is so much to participate in if you want. Come Connect and
Grow.
Dee member side 1988. Raised my children and now my grandchildren who recently became members at age 15 and 19
They drive up from San Diego to be with the church and Youth which is outstanding  Hope to see you soon. 🙏 Went here for preschool in ‘97. Ruined my life as an introvert child. I remember that pointed building not knowing it had anything to do with religiousness. Here I am in my 30s, addict and hating life remembering the lower level where they had two rooms to separate the children that played and the ones that didn’t. Then came Lobo elementary. Then in the 2nd grade I was put in a mixed class portable at the end of the property in a 2/3 grade combo. Can’t forget the YMCA a couple portables down.

reviewSummary: Having gone for the 1st time thru a friends invite i was so happy that i accepted the invite. The church itself is nice and welcoming and the ushers at the door are so pleasant and friendly. The singing is nice and it helps that the song words are on a big screen so you can join in the chorus. Very uplifting preaching and singing. I love this new church.  I’ve been absent for years trying to find something that spoke to me and St Andrew’s has been the best answer to my prayers. Blessings to all at this church. Our family has been attending St. Andrews Presbyterian Church for over 15 years. The church is a charming, neighborhood church that really cares about its community and each other. The church encourages authentic discipleship, relationship with Jesus, and each other. The church has a heart and genuine compassion for its homeless ministry. In a time where church is not as relevant, our family is so blessed to have this community. The sign outside says "Welcome home"...and they really mean it.  It is the warmest, most welcoming church I have ever attended.  Pastor Peter Dunn is an accessible, loving man of God an I am honored and extremely grateful to worship at St. Andrew's. Their children's and youth department are exceptional, led by a phenomenal teaching staff. Come join us so you, too, can experience the absolute genuine joy it is to be a part of it all. A community church that also, has many events throughout the  year. I  find it has a few clicks that occassionally makes for a bad experience,  however  most people are loving and have a warm spirit, it offers two services one at 8:30 , the traditional one, usually with organ and the choir and a 10:00 service with a rock band and contemporary Christian rock music. The Pastor  has a current upbeat message and is usually very interesting.  The church caters to the homeless on Tuesdays and Thursdays,  a hot lunch is served at 11:30 . The  church has missionaries working in  other parts of the world. I'm sure it's a great place to worship, I hear it is so, but I come on Tuesdays and Thursdays for lunch. They serve great Italian dishes to those in need, and then also offer services and clothing. 11am to 1pm.

name: St Augustine By-The-Sea Church
St Augustine By-The-Sea Church - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary:
What a marvelous event this was! I found out about this event last minute, Baroque Collegium Meditations , at this church in Santa Monica. I didn't even notice the denomination of the church. It turned out it's a sister church of mine, All Saints Episcopal church in Pasadena.
The ambience was perfect for meditation. The lighting , the beautiful glass windows of the church. I had never been here before . The people working in the event were very helpful guiding guests to the restrooms and those with mobility issues were properly guided through an accessible restroom. The restrooms are so clean and well maintained.
I am not surprised at their courtesy , inclusion and friendliness.  I am proud to be part of the episcopal family.
The event it self was a world class act. The music was simply delightful! The musicians and singers are quite  experienced and well known in their field. I didn't want to be disrespectful so I didn't do a video  of it.  It was a very moving experience. I am very grateful to this community led by Reverend Nate and Katie. They welcomed me and my kids early in our spiritual journey back to God. I've really had to think about how to express my reason for leaving St Augustine's 2-1/2 years ago.

I'm Jewish by birth and converted 26 years ago. I chose to become Episcopalian. So it was disappointing and painful to sit through a 70-minute service on October 8, 2023, listen to a sermon about "love, love, love" and not hear a single word of compassion ~ or any mention at all ~ about the worst attack on Jews since the Holocaust.

The following week, that omission was justified by saying "We didn't know how bad it was." That felt like a dagger to the heart because it was that priest in whom I placed my trust to teach me, to hear my confessions during Lent and receive counseling. From my perspective, this was an individual who "walked the walk" more authentically than anyone I'd encountered in my then-23 years as an Episcopalian.

There was wall-to-wall graphic coverage from early morning on October 7,  it was all over the internet, and it was in the papers. It strains credulity to believe neither person on the alter heard or read anything. What hurt most is the voices on the alter expressed what felt like sincere empathy each time a horror was inflicted on marginalized groups, for natural disasters, for humanity. It sadly didn't happen in October 2023.

My faith was broken in those 2 weeks and I haven't been able to bring myself to set foot in any church since then. I have spoken with 2 trusted friends since childhood about what wasn't acknowledged at a church I'd loved so much. One is a prominent Deacon in the Catholic church who said, among other things, "today I am a Jew"; the other is a pastor with the UCC Church because my heart ached, still does, and needs to be fed.

I understand now that Jesus and God never hurt me ~ it was the humans on the alter. Humans make mistakes. It's not unreasonable to expect better from those who teach and preach. Warm and inclusive community of people St. Augustine by-the-Sea Episcopal Church has become a place where I feel genuinely welcomed, seen, and supported. What I appreciate most is the sense of inclusivity you feel the moment you walk through the doors—everyone is embraced exactly as they are, without judgment, pressure, or dogma. We attended a small service and had our dog blessed, there was music and a short sermon and it was a lovely special day, we drove from Lg Beach and really enjoyed this church.

name: St Augustine Church of Christ
St Augustine Church of Christ - St. Augustine Campus
reviewSummary:
I am truly grateful for this church and the boldness with which it speaks the truth. In a time when it's easy to water down the message, this church remains grounded in Scripture and committed to preaching the Word without compromise. The sermons are not just inspiring—they’re convicting, challenging, and rooted in biblical truth.

You can feel the presence of God here, not only in the worship but in the way the leadership speaks honestly about sin, grace, repentance, and hope. It’s not always the easiest message to hear, but it’s the one we need—and that’s what makes this church so powerful and authentic.

If you’re searching for a place that doesn’t shy away from the truth but speaks it in love, this is it. You’ll leave encouraged, but also transformed. I have recently started attending services and not only has everyone been extremely welcoming, but the services are easy to follow along with and completely backed with scripture. I have been to several churches growing up, and I had not found one that fit before now.

Update: I have been attending services for about 5 months now and my original review still stands. This is a wonderful establishment of God, and I am so thrilled to have found it! Very friendly and sound congregation Very unique and engaging service....my son loved it and actually paid close attention to the teaching of the Lord's word. I recommend this warm and friendly congregation Beautiful congregation,  very friendly.  The service was lovely. Bro Burkert preached a good sermon on Christian Influence

name: St Bartholomew Catholic Church
St Bartholomew Catholic Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
This is the perfect intimate church where it is small enough that you really create a community of Belmont Shore - Long Beach feel. Open & accepting church to all. They offer bible study classes for kids that I am proud to be part of . You really get a warm feeling from everyone here. Helping children learn about Jesus is what we do. Love Saint Bartholomew Church. Make sure that you are there on time for mass because parking could be tricky. #GODisGREAT Im a member of this parish and have been for over 15 years. The parish is open  to all and i became part of it because i felt its a warm and accepting parish.  You will feel welcomed with open arms from both the priests and community.  The masses are traditional but the homily s are related to modern lifestyles. The parish offers alot of extra activities in faith formation,  neighborhood out reach,  activities for all ages from elementary school thru parishioners in golden years.  They have annual book sales, fashion shows, art shows, some with artist from international locals, cont ed for religious growth,  giving trees to help make Christmas brighter for the children who would otherwise not have one.   I could keep.going on but suffice it to say they offer alot to the neighborhood,  and the neighborhood gives back.  You will have a sense of belonging to a bigger community....life.
Plus i just love the Irish priests....i could listen to their musical accents forever. Beautiful Catholic Church! Great stained glass windows and pews, and they even have a childrens chapel for noisy kids!

Only downside is the parking, gotta park on the street. Advent/Christmas season at St. Bartholomew's was beautiful despite the pandemic environment. Thanks to all who made it so. I would recommend finding a different church. The people coming to service are not the type of people you want to bring your family around. They may put on a smile but that means nothing. God bless.

reviewSummary: This is a wonderfully supportive church congregation with excellent opportunities for community members to enjoy or participate in choral music and musical theater. Beautiful church, well designed,  excellent music program,  friendly people. Excellent service and very friendly people.  Very attractive and up-to-date facilities. I wasn't eager to attend the service, but a friend prevailed and I ended up enjoying the female priest's sermon. And, the music was exceptional! They have both small in person, covid guideline following services and remote. They emphasized their congregations safety and getting through things together. I really appriciate a church that cares more for it's congregation than it's pocket book. Wish more churches stood up and publisized doing the right thing instead of complaining about "freedom" and claiming to be persecuted when asked to do the same thing as any other organization. It was quite refreshing and I wouldn't mind going back. We visited whilst on holiday. Although not ourselves Episcapol Christians we were blessed by the service. The sermon was inspiring, challenging and relevant.

name: St Bridget Chinese Catholic Church
St Bridget Chinese Catholic Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:

It has many communities within the church and also great events.  I just participated the Chinese New Year celebration event with lots of games and Chinese traditionsl foods and things to do. Parishioners commute from all over LA and even from Orange County to attend mass as well as church events here.   It is a very close knit community.  It offers CCD classes to different age groups.  Highly recommend this church! Cozy church with friendly parishioners.
Love the Sunday school program with parents support.  Mass time is great and both Chinese and English masses are available. I love this cozy church. Parishioners are great and they are like families. There are so many events all year long that keeps me and my entire family very engaging.

It wonderful that he is a priest and has same beliefs but...I come to understand and connect Beautiful masses with amazing music at the 5:30 Saturday Vigil mass and 5:30 Sunday mass.

Current Schedule 📅
Sunday Mass: Saturday 5:30 pm. Sunday 7:30, 9, and 11 am, and 5:30 pm. Daily Mass at 7:30 am. Reconciliation every Saturday at 4 pm. Saint B's has a wonderful, multi-generational church community that is very welcoming and inclusive. There are lots of opportunities to get involved in (OCIA, Neighbors in Need ministry, Connection to Christ bible study groups, ushering/altar serving) and it truly feels like a church family. Their motto is to encounter, love and serve Jesus, one another and the world and this parish puts this into practice. Walking distance from our stay while we were there, Deacon Chris is a very nice person, he came to say hi directly to us, feel like he was expecting us to come. Beautiful church. Great pastor! Father Steve is the best!

name: St Catherine of Alexandria Church Temecula
St Catherine of Alexandria Church Temecula - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary:
With all due respect for the parishioners but this Church architecture is very modern for me, the main Christ in the church that is hanging is one of the most scariest figure I ever seen, and the environment feels kind of protestan. God bless the people that goes to  this Church! 🙏 Beautiful Church, priest, workers, and volunteers. I have been attending this church since 2020. My daughter start attending the first communion classes and I go to pray the rosary and to mass. I really love this community and church and staff. Thanks for all you do. You're doing great. I highly recommend visiting St Catherine of Alexandria Very nice church , only problem is too much traffic , to get in & out of the parking lot. We've been parishioners here since 2012 and Fr. Tim is making it a more cohesive parish. Thanks be to God for our current pastor. After two months of debating whether to write this, I feel a responsibility to warn other couples considering getting married here. Another reviewer mentioned that working with this parish was the hardest part of her wedding planning, and I couldn’t agree more. Communication was extremely slow, and the entire process felt confusing and unclear.

At no point did anyone mention that our marriage file needed approval from both their archdiocese and my home parish’s archdiocese, since we were marrying outside of our parish. I found this out one week before my wedding when they called to say that without a completed file, the wedding could not move forward. It was the first time they had ever brought it up.

The coordinator also reversed her prior approval of our ceremony music, informing us the day before, at the rehearsal, that the songs could no longer be used. While the priest who married us was wonderful and made the ceremony truly special, several guests shared with us afterward that staff members had been rude to them.

The cost was also unexpected. It was over a thousand dollars to marry here, with additional required deposits for music, altar servers, and even the priest. While I understand higher fees for non parishioners, these add-ons (pianist, cleaning deposit, alter server, etc.) felt unusual, especially since many of these are typically voluntary offerings decided by the couple.

I would encourage the head priest to consider whether his staff is representing the parish in the way he would hope. Despite the beauty of the ceremony itself, the experience leading up to it was unnecessarily stressful and disappointing

Great service and thank god for help with food after Very beautiful  & updated multi purpose campus.

name: St Dunstan's Episcopal Church
St Dunstan's Episcopal Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: Attended a chili cook off the church held recently that was open to the community.  Everyone was very welcoming and friendly. My husband, daughter and I went and had a wonderful time. Thank you for hosting this event and opening up to the surrounding neighborhood 😀. The place for toy train swap meet I was attending a Al-Anon workshop and Round Table on a Saturday morning. The facility is fantastic and all the church staff were very very helpful in making sure that our event went well. The parking lot is adequate I was attending a Al-Anon workshop and round table on a Saturday morning. The facility is fantastic and all the church staff were very very helpful and making sure that our event went well. The parking lot is adequate and everything is very organized and clean. This is a great church and we have a family group that meets regularly.  Join us!! This location was the AGTTA (All Gauge Toy Train) site for members to showcase their trains, etc. for sale to the public.  Clean place and convenient.

name: St Elisabeth Church
St Elisabeth Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary:
ASH WEDNESDAY 12:00 MASS
Arrived at 12:10, doors locked. Mass in going on inside. Man in black suit blocking door says cannot come in. I left work to get my ashes.  Big crowd outside asking why church is locking us out. I left. Will never go to this church again!! Ugh :( My hometown Church Lovett been coming here since I was a kid . They have two annual carnivals one in May the other in September My go to church if the first Friday n Saturday of the  month comes by... no other churches around me offers such St. Elisabeth and St'Jane are unmatched ... St. Elizabeth used to be my church while growing up in Van Nuys...! My sister got married there! and the rules were not as bad as they are now... for photographers/videographers that is! It used to be that we were allowed to move from one side to the other, walking BEHIND the church goers of course... but that changed a few years ago! we were to stay on one side of the altar, and shoot our images/video from there... which gave us a good angle! and we usually were able place a camera on the other side, out of the way, so we could capture the Bible readings... but now! we can't even do that!!! We are forced to stay on the handicaped ramp to the right side of the altar, and were told to "not move from there" until it is time to go to the other side for the offering of flowers to the Virgin Mary... which is hidden away in the very far part of the altar... which you can NOT get to, unless you get to walk there BEFORE the flower time! and to make matters worse... because of the Pope's passing, they had a shrine built to the right of our location, so we could not get a shot of the altar!!! I was told that I could NOT place a camera in the far side of sanctuary, because "those were the rules", so I asked "who makes the rules?" and Miguel said that each church has its own rules... I asked why not let me place a camera out of the way? it wasn't on anybody's way! again... "those are the rules"... So I asked him.. "why do they allow so many cameras during mass at the Vatican? they must have a hundred cameras! he said that they were "unmanned"... so I said I could do that! I can put up to 5 unmanned cameras! He said "No, you can not! those are the rules!" The church lady...(I didn't catch her name) told me I could come back to the altar for a few pictures after the service... but when I brought the girl back, she screamed at me that no more pictures were allowed! that they had another quinceañera coming in! I said "I was told I could get a few" she yelled "who told you that?" I said "YOU DID!" and then she said okay! only one! I did a test shot, she said "that is enough!" REALLY?! it was a test shot! I took 3 pictures of the same pose and walked out! Hoping I will never have to come back to this church!!! and I will tell everyone of my clients to change their mind about having their event there... it seems like they are in the "business" of faith... because the service is NOT free... like the Pope said, but they get around that with the technicality of calling it an "offering"... which should be called a "bribe" if we're being honest.
I have been doing professional photography and video for over 3 decades! and I have often asked my clients, if they knew their house was going to flood in a few minutes, what items would they rescue from it? the answer is almost always their pictures and videos... but not the clients from St. Elizabeth! since they don't have any of those! because "those are the rules". I am not a regular church goer to this place.But I do know that they go out of their way to serve their community.I'm there with my dance group to perform every year for their festivals. A lot of planning that goes into that time and effort from everyone that is involved

name: St Elizabeth Ann Seton Church - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
Nice and convenient location with plenty of parking. The church itself was welcoming; however, it was difficult at times to fully understand the mass due to the priest having a very strong accent. Came by today for Mass and Rosary.

Can't say enough good things about this community.

Parishioners were really nice and welcoming. Pastor was out front on my way in talking and laughing with everybody.

Church is beautiful. Great layout. It felt like a comfortable Holy space.

Had projectors showing the text for the readings and songs on the walls on either side of the altar. Have never seen this before. Loved it.

Sound and Music were great. The big choir was A plus.  Catholicism done very well IMHO. ❤️ Pretty reliable for confession times; however, the Priest can sometimes be a bit snappy at you depending on your sin so watch out for that.

They have pretty good Adoration etiquette too which is nice. This beautiful church has inviting individuals and members. I highly recommend finding your faith in this church as they have groups for children, teens, and couples. Finding your faith may not be easy, but it’s 100% worth it. I did it on line, was not sure if I could get to mass on Sunday, but I did.
I really enjoyed this mass and will probably do it most Saturdays and do my church Sunday. You know us die hard cradle Catholics we need our Eucharist.

name: St Elizabeth Seton Catholic
St Elizabeth Seton Catholic - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
A beautiful and peaceful church.
Father Michael is a kind pastor like his homily. Great community I attended Easter Mass here for the first time in about 21 years. There were some genuinely beautiful parts of the experience, especially Communion, which was deeply meaningful to me. The church itself was welcoming enough, and I was able to have a real spiritual experience in spite of my concerns.

Unfortunately, the priest’s message was deeply disappointing and spiritually troubling to me. He repeatedly emphasized identity, cumulative personal experience, and the idea that there is no real transformation, which to me completely misses the heart of resurrection. I also found the repeated emphasis on Satan, the devil, and prayers framed around first responders and “our troops” to feel more political and fear-based than Christ-centered or universal. For me, the message felt narrow, backward, and out of alignment with love, transformation, and the deeper spiritual truth Easter is supposed to represent.

So while there was real beauty in the sacramental part of the Mass, the homily and overall framing left me disturbed rather than uplifted. Your mileage may vary. This Church has a reputation…Yes indeed! The most active church I have ever been a part of! The priest is literally a Holy Man… Father Michael heads his flock. Great group of MOSES men gather at 6:30 am Saturdays for coffee and doughnuts and study… what a wonderful group of humble men… check it out yourself! Beautiful Church. Took my grandma to their Sunday Mass while I was visiting. The priest gave some lovely homilies that he put a lot of heart into. The churchgoers were all pretty friendly. Hope I get to go again, someday! Beautiful Catholic Church. There’s a wonderful statue outside in the plaza. A good place to go pray. The service was wonderful and the people inviting
