name: St Ephrem Maronite Catholic Church
St Ephrem Maronite Catholic Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary:
St. Ephrem Maronite Church in San Diego is an absolute gem for the Lebanese community and beyond. They host some of the most vibrant events, drawing people from all over for the spectacular celebrations. At their big festivals, you’ll find an incredible array of traditional Lebanese food—think shawarma, kebabs, and rich desserts like baklava—and, of course, the iconic Arabic coffee. The church also fosters a family-friendly environment, offering Dabke dance classes, performances by renowned singers, and kids' activities. Beyond the cultural richness, their marketplace is a must-see—filled with olive oil, perfumes, traditional clothing, and beautiful jewelry. It’s truly a centerpiece of culture, faith, and celebration. God bless them. Especially Mariam.. the mass gives you spiritual enlightenment.  The chorus is in harmony with the maestro Tony.  After the mass on some Sundays.  You can enjoy the Lebanese food that smells so great and reminds you of Middle Eastern street food.  They have three masses on Sunday for your convenience Brotherhood, fraternity, ... MARONITE YOUTH ADULT. That's what the church is about! That's what the churches should adopt as an approach to keep young adults close to God Come visit the Maronite shrine to our Blessed Mother.
A peaceful oasis in east county. Love our amazing church ⛪️ it feels like home ❤️

name: St Francis Episcopal Church
St Francis Episcopal Church - Palos Verdes Estates Campus
reviewSummary:
It was my first time going this morning alone and it felt great everyone was friendly and there was snacks and coffee afterwards which I didn’t stay for but possibly next time. I will be back again. Everyone was welcoming it’s in a beautiful location and parking was easy to find. Had some time off with this weekend and stop by the St. Francis church. It was such a beautiful place. I differently want to go back and attend a church service in the original old church. I spend hours just walking around and taken in the tranquil setting. So peaceful. The idyllic setting is tranquil and peaceful which suited me just fine in my search for a (temporary while I was staying in the area for a few weeks) spiritual home. I attended ash Wednesday and their Lenten lectures. They had a thought provoking Wednesday night series (by a local Psychiatrist). Loved it. It was also very well attended. Which is nice to see.
They have two services first at 8am in their small chapel and the second at 10 in the main church. Plenty of parking because it's a small congregation. My 5 star rating here is not to be construed as an endorsement of any particular religion, only the fact that the church makes it multi-purpose rooms open to non-profit groups for meetings. It's also the home to Town & Country Nursery School, in the past, a wonderful nursery school started by one of the most wonderful people I every knew, Pat Horan, may God rest her soul. Filming a Christian music video there.  The little chapel has such an old-world feel to it. The rector seems like a great guy and family man.

name: St Francis Episcopal Church - San Bernardino Campus
reviewSummary: The small, anglo, elderly congregation was friendly, with a Pakistani family that said they were regular worshippers there. The building and surroundings were exquisite, hearkening back to a time when the attendees were more numerous and prosperous. The liturgy, music and communion were traditional, authentic Episcopalian. However, the social/economic changes of San Bernardino have had a deleterious effect on this sacred community. Very nice place to worship.

name: St Francis Home
St Francis Home - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary:
Mom is very happy here. The Sisters are so caring and generous with affection and support. While not a nursing facility, they do administrate meds and really try to provide the necessary and desired dietary needs. They have daily Mass and rosaries, regular activities and frequent musical visitors. A great value, and they are very responsive to family visitors and advocates. What a blessing. The sisters here are amazing!  We attend daily mass in their beautiful chapel.   The priests are reverent and humble.   The elderly ladies seem to really like it here.   This place is a gem. What a wonderful, caring loving place. The Nuns and Caretakers really care about the residents.
Lots of activities to keep them busy and my sister loves to go to Mass twice a day even though she isn’t Catholic.
I highly recommend St. Francis Assisted Living Home In Santa Ana, CA. It was a blessing we found St. Francis. My Grandma Margaret Mora Luna worked thier for thirty years she was a night nurse.
She took me with her to work many times.
Know this place sister Cecilia and mother superior. My mom had dementia. She has not known me in a decade the nuns took care of her and gave her proper medication she is back. knows and loves me.😁💒🌷

name: St Gabriel Catholic Church
St Gabriel Catholic Church - Poway Campus
reviewSummary:
I see a lot of reviews in here saying this place is friendly and welcoming.  I've attended several services but rarely do the members talk to people they aren't already friends with or family.   Its not as welcoming as the reviews make it seem.  Members will greet during the part of the service where the priest says to.  But other than that its not that friendly or welcoming.

They are very strict when it comes to booking and catering.  Its expensive,  and you must pay everything before the day of the event.  The event coordinator never made me feel good or that she was there to help.  I dont really know how she stays in her role.

I only give the rating I do because of my family.  If it wasnt for them it would be lower. What a cool church! We went here for a friends wedding. Beautiful and ornate for a church not built in the 1500s, like the cathedrals in rome. The fountain out front is really nice And calming. The presiding bishop(?) Was very nice both at the rehearsal and the ceremony, although he was losing his voice. I'm assuming the wedding planner cane with the church or works there and she was good at organizing everyone and keeping the reverence of the church. Love this church! Masses are great and RCIA classes are insightful. They also have community events. In English and Spanish so peaceful--perfect place to have silence with God.This beautiful Spanish inspired Catholic church is a good place to marry privately at the Blessed sacrament if you don't have enough budget. I had the most memorable wedding ever-no need to spend so much-what is important is you marry in the eyes of God and close family. One of the most beautiful churches I've ever been to, at the back is a beautiful golden tabernacle with a lot of natural lighting.

name: St George's Episcopal Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
Love this Church. It has allot to offer the community. It provides daycare and has a little school. Also has a Hall for events such as weddings and Celebrations of life. The church is so beautiful and Rev.Pat is so awesome. I love her sermons you can tell they come from the heart. You can always check out all the services they provide on their website:
stgeorgesparish.org
This place is amazing and for everyone.
They are always so welcoming. My family's place of worship 🙏 Reverend Pat is amazing, you are definitely family St. George’s was there for me when I needed time to pray alone in the church. They opened their doors for me and welcomed me in. I will not forget. Rev Pat gave a wonderful service for my Mother in 2023, which to this day warms my heart and eases my pain of her passing. God Bless. The catering hall is lovely and Joyce was caring and thoughtful in arranging food and venue. Absolutely appalled at the nerve the owners had in regards to a family event held here last month. Family paid $17k+ for a very special event and the food promised to be served was either nonexistent or stale and hard as a rock. Our family supplied the drinks and when checking everything off we realized 5 cases were missing from our original dropped off amount. The event coordinator was basically a useless statue and had the hosts running back and forth apologizing to guests for the poor service instead of being able to enjoy their event. One guest had to step in and do the job of the coordinator and missed out on their part of the event. I would absolutely never recommend this location for your events.

name: St George's Episcopal Church - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been singing in Saint George's choir for more years than I can remember,  and for all that time, it has always been a haven for those seeking openness and welcome. The services are very relaxed, and the gospel discussions are lively and extremely spiritual. I invite anyone who is looking for a different, more refreshing church experience to give Saint George Episcopal a visit. We'd love to see you. Love the parishioners
Love the choir
Love everything ❣️ Very beautiful 🙏🥰

name: St Gregory's Episcopal Church
St Gregory's Episcopal Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
My wife and I feel blessed to have found an inclusive spiritual home at St. Gregory’s Episcopal Church. The community is welcoming to the LGBTQ+ community in word and deed. Thanks to Father Michael for the valuable spiritual counseling before our wedding, for officiating our special day, and for creating a nurturing spiritual space for our family. We look forward to being a part of the congregation as a family. Thank you and God Bless! My mother has been part of this church for years.  This is a small, genuinely welcoming and caring congregation, and I am very happy to say that I have able to attend and partake of the services when returning to California.   Priest, Michael Fincher, has been a true blessing to my ill mother and all in his flock with his profound and steadfast devotion and ministry. We visited St. Gregory's years ago because we wanted our children to learn about God, Christ, and how to strengthen our community. Everyone we meet was friendly & welcoming. We felt good about it & attended another service & had another positive experience. We joined St. Gregory's. We are blessed & fortunate to be a member of St. Gregory's because of the congregation & the many community out reach programs such as Feed My Lambs, Adopt-A Family, plus many more. The Episcopal Church Welcomes You is a popular saying and this church lives by that motto.  They warmly welcome visitors and newcomers.  Visitors are acknowledged during the service and are given a bag which contains information about the church and its programs along with a St. Gregory's coffee mug.  Visitors are asked to pray for the church each time they drink from the mug.

I appreciate that are welcome to share in Holy Communion regardless of your faith journey and that they have gluten fee communion wafers! Went there for a memorial service for a friend who passed away.  The church was very nice and welcoming. Although I'm not Episcopal  i felt welcome and part of the proceedings. Recommended.

I attend AA meetings there.
Thank you to the Church for allowing the space for it.
Absolutely beautiful building. Walking into the St.James Episcopal Church was a beautiful heartwarming experience. I couldn't be more grateful to Ms.Margaret who's love for humanity is something beautiful and quite frankly, very rare. If you are looking to donate I recommend this place they actually care for human beings and see that the donations go to the community. There was something very authentic and beautiful about this place. When you walk into this place the love and generosity from the volunteers and Ms.Margaret is to be honest a bit overwhelming and I couldn't be more grateful. We were fed, clothes were given to our family and food to take home. I want to thank Ms.Magaret and the wonderful volunteers of the St.James Episcopal Church.

A great Pastor and a friendly congregation. If you want to truley enjoy and learn the word of God, this is a great place to do that! The Pastor and everyone was so spiritual This is my church!!

reviewSummary:

Environment inspires the soul to think about the spiritual while in the material world.  I love the True Presence🌹

Beautiful Stations of the Cross!

For the uninstructed in the Catholic Faith, you will feel valued.  Be prepared to be pleasantly surprised by the warmth, wisdom, and wealth of beauty.

This past Sunday, I attended pancake breakfast that was a fundraiser for a house building in Tijuana.  Last week, Taco Sunday gathered the hungry and mouths were fed!

name: St John's Episcopal Cathedral
St John's Episcopal Cathedral - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
I'm from out of town and like to explore Episcopalian Cathedrals when I get a chance. The Cannon Parish Administrator, Kyle Black, greeted me at the door and gave me a 30 minute impromptu tour of the stunning interior. I highly recommend visiting this beautiful cathedral if you have the opportunity? Great cathedral with amazing artworks, murals, sculpture, stained glass works displayed and installed all over the building. Attended a Sunday Eucharist here and everyone was friendly, music was great. They had a tour after the service and it was very informational tour about the church and the building. They seemed to have many other ministries as well. Highly recommended to visit or attend services! I haven't had the opportunity to worship here with the congregation, this is based off of being here for two wedding ceremonies. The space is very beautiful with a very high church feel. There is a beautiful tile mural of Saint John. Definitely a sense of sacred space. Cathedral is beautiful on the inside. The service seemed a bit too formulaic for my taste. Tradition is fine, but it was missing the zest I want to feel when it comes to worship. The Cathedral itself is full of artistic wonders. The congregants are friendly and open. The sermon was thought-provoking, the choir was amazing; and as today was a feast day, the "high" service supplied all the majesty available.
We attended on the 4th Sunday of the month, so a tour of the Cathedral treasures was available after the 11am service. Walter, the tour guide, was most knowledgeable and charming.

name: St John's Episcopal Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
We attended St. John's a number of times over the last 2-3 years when visiting family in the area.  We always found the reception we got to be most friendly and welcoming.  The vicar is simply tremendous, so much so, he's been elected to become the new Bishop of the Los Angeles diocese.  The music is majestic though classical, not for those preferring a modern style perhaps with guitars, etc. like that to which we were accustomed.  None the less, the music is indeed powerful.  The church itself is both simple and beautiful.  The variety of ministries, especially outreach, is impressive and offers opportunities for generous community contributions of service as well as spiritual growth.
We have now moved into the vicinity and have changed our membership to this church. Had my wife's funeral here a couple of weeks ago and the church staff went above and beyond in working with me, the mortuary, and St. John's School in capturing the life of my wife.

Friends and family talked about the beautiful service and beautiful church.  I agree that everything couldn't have been better.  Thank you At. John's Church and School family for everything you've done. There are so many things to share about this church that are so fine. First is their Priest, Fr. John is a bright star as the servant of this wonderful community. They are busy in the community serving others and offer numerous ways to grow in one's faith. The people are friendly, the Clergy and staff care very much about their people, and there’s just a beautiful sense of acceptance and love. What a blessing. Beautiful church with warm, welcoming people.

reviewSummary:
St. Johns is home to a great community of people supporting each other. My family and I have attended for about a decade now. In the Episcopal Church you will find an interesting mix of tradition and progressive values.
St. Johns has a particularly strong focus on young children. There is a much larger proportion of school age children than most churches, and a very active youth group. My family and I joined St. John's this year. It is a great church community, with a life-giving emphasis on the children and youth of the church. The people are friendly and welcoming, and our son felt welcomed and affirmed enough to ask for baptism. I haven't been to mass however I have visited this church to go vote. I don't know if the people running the polls attend this church or not however  I've been here two times and both times the staff was extremely rude. If your on hutch property be kind. Be respectful. This year June 2016 I was greeted by the most unfriendly black
Lady who was not only rude w/o cause she gave dirty looks. This isn't mandatory community service. Don't volunteer if you don't want to be there. The previous time an elderly white lady was rude. If this is tolerated on church property I will never attend this church. If they have no affiliation with church I hope church realizes these attitudes are major turn offs. Opening the church like this offers an opportunity to grow & spread the word, staff like this destroys that.  If you allow this you deserve one star as they represent the establishment they stand on. If they are not part of congregation and you have to accept them because you they signed up then don't offer the church make them go to fire Dept to cast votes. This is a church. Represent. I'm
Sure I was not the only person turned off by these attitudes. I saw many people insulted like myself. Amazing community. When my Mom was in a coma this congregation banded together and not only provided prayers but real support. They made us meals, mowed our lawn and helped my siblings and I get to and from school. I cannot say enough about this church and community. St. John's has the best church family a girl could ask for! They've helped mold me in to the woman I am today. And are now helping mold my children in to amazing young men. I've attended St. John's for the past 23 years.

reviewSummary: Got stranded in SB and found this church on the corner. A blessing to have found it in time before my phone died.  They let me use the bathroom, charge me phone, and they were doing the food bank bags and clothing exchange. Even tho I'm not homeless, I was given 3 bags of donations with food and clothing. I was so thankful cause i was starving! But still shared my help and donated the rest to the ones who needed it more than i did. More love from the kitchen than the groups but it's the lesson an we should stay more than friends but once family alwaY I think the pastors are great! Come to here the words of God and say hi to Father Gary and Peg they are both priest. Great, clean and friendly environment my 3 children love participating in the valet folkloric Its a good way to begin if u are looking for a way to get your relationship started with the Lord.

reviewSummary:
Beautiful church with great leadership in Monsignor Kevin Kostelnick.
A new baptismal font was installed and it’s gorgeous. I've been attending this church for three months. Last Sunday, the Monsignor chose to incorporate his political views into his homily. I come to worship God, not to hear about his political opinions. As a result, I am now looking for another church that keeps religion and politics separate. Wonderful ⛪️. My wife and i have been parishioners for years. Very nice services and community oriented. Mass performed at the Lawn, Fortunately it was overcast, the sun did not bother anyone and the ceremony was perform with absolutely no interruption.
EPB It was the Solemnity of St Joseph, I was visiting the area and luckily found this parish on Google search. I'm not going to comment on the community or the building. I'm a bit disappointed that the church building itself is not always open. I was able to sneak in because there was an activity ending so I was able to go to the blessed sacrament area to have some quiet moment, that was really wishful thinking. The place was noisy as people were putting away stuff while conversing. I pretty much rushed through all five joyful mysteries because they were closing up the church. I wish for one day, on the feast day of their patron saint that they would at least keep the church open. Anyway it is what it is.

name: St Joseph the Worker Catholic Church
St Joseph the Worker Catholic Church - San Bernardino Campus
reviewSummary:
I visited St. Joseph the Worker Church in Loma Linda. It was easy to find this small church on Mountain View just south of the 10 freeway.

The church was smaller than most churches but I was welcomed by the biggest smile from a friendly gentleman. He was a Sacristan at the church and he welcomed me along with other guests.

It was a quiet afternoon in the church and it felt so welcoming and comforting to pray inside. Right before sunset, the lights from the stained glass illuminated the inside of the chapel with various colors like a kaleidoscope.

I will definitely be back. The church, although small, was easy to find using Google Maps. The people there are really nice, the best church to go and send your prayers to our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ 😇🙏🏾✝️ Nice small catholic church. Love Father Noel's homilies. Beautiful. My favorite church for a long, long time.
To me, it's home away from home 🏡 💕 Chapel like. Nice place. Very calm and solemn. Mass info could be found from the church website.

name: St Joseph's & Immaculate Heart
St Joseph's & Immaculate Heart - San Bernardino Campus
reviewSummary: The traditional mass of the ages is the only way to go.  One, Holy, Catholic, and Apostolic.  This is the true Catholic experience.  I love my God and His Holy Queen Mother. This is His house and I will never leave.  You should go and you will finally be HOME.  You will see it and feel it deep in your soul. A wonderful chapel!  This chapel is beautiful, serene, and so Catholic!  So refreshing to hear the visiting priest, who comes quite a distance to take care of the parishioners, teach the Catholic faith without watering it down like in so many diocesan parishes!  If you want a beautiful traditional liturgy, reverent. friendly parishioners, and extremely well-educated priests who truly care about the salvation of souls, this is the place for you. A hidden Jewel in Colton California! This beautiful church celebrates the holy Latin mass and how many people have found this beautiful treasure and drive many hours if needed to arrive to experience the most secret ceremony in the holy Latin mass! Definitely a blessing for all Catholics to experience. The traditional Latin Mass is offered here on Sundays.  Rediscover the beauty of Catholic tradition - sanctified by 2,000 years of church usage.  Church usage over a long time does sanctify a liturgy.  That's why the traditional Latin Mass is so much better than new modern "hippy" liturgies from the 1960s. We decided to attend the Tridentine mass at this chapel, and we have not looked back, even though it is a drive for our family it is well worth our effort. After being in the Catholic Church for close to 15 years and attending many churches by far our family/children love attending this chapel and assisting this mass, with joy. This quaint little chapel will edify your soul and catechize you in the true faith of the Catholic Church through their sermons and sacraments, which are fully in line with the Magisterium, and always historically accurate. There is absolutely no heresy preached, syncretism and universal salvation need not apply. We are very grateful for Father Gillilan for all that he does and his devotion to the Church. When we do have visiting priests, that is an added bonus and we have had the privilege of hearing great sermons from priests such as Father Robinson, who is a wonderful preacher and priest. We are blessed to have this mass and church,  we know we are getting fed the truth.

name: St Joseph's Catholic Church - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
We are incredibly blessed to call this our home parish. The sense of community and genuine care here means so much to our family. Father Alex and Father Freddie lead with compassion, faith, and dedication, and we are deeply thankful for their spiritual guidance. i played basketball (5, 6th) against st. joseph’s many times. but this one game in particular was absolutely unacceptable. the players from st. joseph’s kept HITTING my own teammates. two were hit in the face multiple times. i personally was elbowed in the sternum, and hit in the back. absolutely disgusting and intolerable. the worst of all was that the coach was ENCOURAGING the players to keep fouling our team. these are not catholic values, and this is what the school allows. the school allows parents like this to coach YOUR children. find a better school with better values and parents. Visited this church to view The Apostle’s Jude’s relic. This a very Novus Ordo church, parishioners part take HOLY Communion in the hands.. (I understand it is acceptable although, I would like to address that only priests have consecrated hands) 🙏🏻If we truly believe in real presence of our Lord let’s take him with all the REVERENCE and Respect. Also I have a child and during Mass my 9month old baby was a bit fussy, I tried avoiding the eye rolling from parishioners and a FEW Altar boys who seemed bothered by a BABY(FYI I was in the “children’s room or  crying room”). Seems as if you cannot welcome the little ones unless they are perfectly quiet. I stepped out to feed my child and went back to continue as a Mother with her vocation to bring my baby to Jesus. Just a reminder if your church does not have a crying baby.. that’s it with the next generations you’ll have 0 crying babies and your church is dying. Please don’t shame a mother who has a fussy baby. You wouldn’t do that to Our Blessed Mother with Baby Jesus in her arms.
Other than that there were wonderful Elderly woman who are parishioners there.They seems more understanding who actually have Sympathy and helpful, such Lovely women. I can surely tell you I will visit once more because the Father give a beautiful Homily. Hopefully my experience helps someone prepare before visiting. Peace be with you all and God bless🙏🏻 The staff here is nice! The church is lit really well. I  have photographed a few events here and they always look amazing It's a beautiful temple. The people who work there are very friendly, warm and welcoming.

name: St Louis Catholic Church
St Louis Catholic Church - Pinecrest / South Miami Campus
reviewSummary:
What a beautiful, special vibe parish and church! It's part of a large parish complex. I attended an Easter service and was very moved by the love and spirituality ❤️ you feel here, and how nice the parishioners were! As a former altar boy and Wedding and Event DJ in Miami, South Florida, Key Largo, Islamorada, the Florida Keys, and Southwest Florida, I'm especially sensitive to spiritual, and people's vibes. It's named after King Louis IX of France, who did many good things before he passed away in The Crusades in 1270 A.D.
The design here is also modern, well laid out, and contemporary. There's a school, Fellowship Center, Family Center, Media Center, Athletic Field, Library, Lecture Hall, Assembly Hall, in addition to the Main Sanctuary shown here (see map in pics). Such a pleasure and wonderful spiritual and personal experience to attend a service here. 🙏. I'll definitely be back and recommend you visit. Many blessings to you and your loved ones ❤️ 🙏. Hadn’t been here for decades and was surprised at how little had changed, but still how well kept and fresh everything felt. They were towards the end of the church renovations when I went and had to attend mass in the gym, but even that was classy and well done. Still and exceptionally vibrant church. Highly recommend. Visited June 2, 2023 for my niece baptism!

June 2, 2023 The beautiful Church of St.Louis in Miami where we celebrated baby Sofia's Baptism! Wow beautiful Catholic Church! I’ve been in Emaus México and for me was a beautiful experience to know the place where it started everything! I wanna share pictures! And if you are in Miami I recommend you to go. ❤️ We were visitors to Saint Louis whilst on vacation. Where is the tabernacle? We could not locate it upon entering the church, which was disconcerting. It was not on the altar that we could see , nor on the side.

name: St Louise De Marillac Church
St Louise De Marillac Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary:
I've been a part of large parishes but my family decided to be "roaming Catholics" one year and we visited this church because we knew the pastor. Who knew that a tiny mountain-top church with 14 pews would charm us into staying. This parish is a wonderful little community and the people are so welcoming. Fr. Scott is genuine and truly cares for the parish. The church also hosts several parish and community events throughout the year. Intimate church, friendly parishioners, fabulous Pastor in Fr Scott. I love the feeling of kinship among the congregation members. I felt welcomed from the start! Most importantly, when you leave you feel as though you've been blessed in a special way. Love it! We love this small country church and its parishioners. We have coffee and doughnuts after the Sunday Masses. There are special events throughout the year. Everybody turns out for the semi-annual parish clean up days. Our priest is a gifted pastor who is loved by all because of his concern for others exceeds his self-concern. Only half of the parishioners come from Crest; the other half are from all over South and East County. Very personable pastor Scott, and happy parishioners. I have enjoyed participating here during my long stay in San Diego. Easier to feel community spirit in small parish.
God Bless all of you. 😇 Absolutely love the gentleness, kindness, and understanding of Father Scott. This is a wonderful little quiet, peaceful place filled with God’s presence. Highly recommend coming for reconciliation Saturday’s at 4pm. Thank you for your healing words, Father Scott.

name: St Luke Catholic Church
St Luke Catholic Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary:
Father Ron and all the deacons of St. Luke's are wonderful! If you are seeking the truth, peace and love, please give St. Luke or any other Catholic Church a chance. Father Ron has a special way of explaining the context before each of the readings and gives a spiritual yet informative homily that we can apply in our daily lives to make us better Christians. I am a revert to Catholicism and am experiencing God's grace, guidance, mercy and forgiveness like never before. This place is great if you want a Protestant service
Church was cold,no holy images,women talking like it was a bridge or mahjong card game some dressed as if they were going clubbing instead of going to the Creators home
Mother Church I hope can get reverence back into the mass
It was kind of like a cocktail party
I left
I was brought up in the Novus Ordo mass,went to the Latin mass,the Chaldean,and Byzantine mass and the Eastern Orthodox Divine liturgy Beautifuli sensed God was there won't be going to another Novus Ordo Mass until it worships God and not people
Have a great day Nice catholic community,  so neat and comfortable It was a very last minute call when I called St. Luke's Catholic Church and ask for a priest to perform for a anointing of the sick for my loved one, they didnt hesitate to help me and I was so relief. Father Ron came and prayed for Michael Ryder, my fiance. He passed the same day. I thank St. Luke's Catholic Church, the staff who took my call who was proactive to rely the message, especially to Fr. Ron. You are all Angels... I thank you all from the bottom of my heart. Please include Michael Ryder in all your prayers❤ God bless you all! This was my parish before I moved to Washington state.  You feel the presence of God from the moment that you walk through the doors.  When I am in the area, I attend Mass here.  It's like coming home.  Fr. Ron is one of the most compassionate priest's that I have ever met.

name: St Luke's Anglican Church
St Luke's Anglican Church - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary: Its very nice people at the church make you are very welcome Nice church 🙏🏻

name: St Luke's Anglican Church - Pomona / Claremont Campus
reviewSummary: Its very nice people at the church make you are very welcome Nice church 🙏🏻

name: St Luke's Evangelical Lutheran Church
St Luke's Evangelical Lutheran Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Close family type church. Small congregation for 9am service. Outstanding band. Super friendly and welcoming. Please come and join us. Wonderful people and wonderful church to hear the word of God. Clean with openly of parking. It is a great church Welcoming and caring people.

name: St Luke's Lutheran Church
St Luke's Lutheran Church - Fullerton Campus
reviewSummary: … a great church a great pastor…recently celebrated the life and love of my good friend Christian LOUCEL… whose life was cut short by cancer… died at age 46… an inspiring tribute by the entire LOUCEL family… owners of a long time original COBBLER shoe shop in FULLERTON Vinces Shoes… stop by and honor the life of Christian LOUCEL, a very good man.🥲🙋‍♂️💓🙏 I just love my church family. We worship together, pray together, we serve together.  I love my Sunday mornings, I can’t wait to get to church and sing my favorite hymns and songs.  I invite everyone to come check out our church.  We have a blended style just like we are blended.  Our Pastor delivers the Good News of how much we are loved by our Lord and Savior Everyone at this church truly cares and loves everyone that comes into this church. They share God's love and beauty with the community and abroad. 1sr time attended for my friend Bill's celebration of life service. Peaceful. Was there for a afterlife celebration and this church looks small but once inside....I kept getting lost!

name: St Luke's of the Mountains Episcopal Church
St Luke's of the Mountains Episcopal Church - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary: As a life long Episcopalian I can say this was one if the MOST irreverent Holy Eucharist I’ve been to.  A rock band is present on the altar and the priest desires to be the center of attention and shouts to rally the congregation like at some pep rally.  Mass is not the appropriate place for silly Pentecostals-style emotionalism.  Furthermore the priest said something pretty flippant about the Episcopal Church (of which he is supposed to be a priest!) stating that “we are no longer being the “frozen chosen”.”  Excuse me sir?  Just because it’s been our tradition to worship God in beauty, holiness, and reverence without silly emotionalism doesn’t mean we’re the “frozen chosen”… it means we believe in worshipping God with reverence and dignity without bringing in call and response type yelling and irreverent nonsense.  If you’re an Episcopalian who enjoys a reverent, traditional and dignified service.  THIS IS NOT THE PARISH TO GO TO!  It has all the dignity and reverence of a Waffle House!  Go to another parish with a higher ecclesiology and save yourself the waste of a Sunday service that is not glorifying to God. A very loving, accepting, inclusive church with meaningful liturgy in both English and Spanish. The remarkable sanctuary alone is worth the trip. All are expected. I saw the exterior only. It is not well proportioned and the stonework is rustic without charm. Parking is limited. I went to see the craft fair and was not impressed. A beautiful building which matches the absolutely adorable lovable and generous people.There is a spirit of peace and love in this bicultural family led by a caring priest Father Antonio. This is not my Church, but I grew up in the area.   I love how they built it of local granite rocks.  Beautifully done.

name: St Margaret's Catholic Church
St Margaret's Catholic Church - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary: Where you can get the body of Christ in regular or low gluten Beautiful and reverent parish but the community is very inward looking and not very kind to new people. I even tried to register there as a parishioner once after attending for years, but was told that I couldn’t because I didn’t “live in their jurisdiction.” Just tried to get information and schedule a mask for my mother and her name. The receptionist was so not helpful. She kept asking me if there was a family member that lived in their vicinity. I just kept repeating myself that my mother lived in their facility. I just so disappointed. I have attended this church for 5 years now, and I know it to be the most beautiful and most reverent Mass given by Fr Bill. He is kind and patient, careful to keep the most traditional service anywhere in San Diego county. Incorporates Latin often, on special occasions, and has very talented Cantor sing traditional songs in English and Latin. The music is absolutely the most beautiful! Art work and statues are amazing. Mass can be heard outside the church as well in our courtyard. We have a wonderful Legion of Mary, Knights of Columbus and successful OCIA program. Gift Shop too after each Mass for one hour. Please come join us! Absolutely beautiful mass. Very solemn.

name: St Maria Goretti Catholic Church
St Maria Goretti Catholic Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: It’s an amazing school great education and such an amazing and beautiful church We enjoy coming to church to attend mass by Fr.truc. All around a super good church. Priest promotes good faith and has relevant homilies and prayers. Goes out of his way to celebrate birthdays and anniversaries each week 😊. Lots of ministries to get involved in. Also, one of the few parishes in East Long Beach / Lakewood that has a Spanish mass. Fantastic new pastor. Has been my parish since 1967. Went to school there. Many good people. Would like to see the carnival come back. Fr. AL Scott at 90 years old is a blessing to have him celebrate 8 o'clock mass. This Church is real Mary is the best ever…Tina and Albert you guys are the read deal they walk the walk and talk the talk.

name: St Marina Coptic Orthodox Church
St Marina Coptic Orthodox Church - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary: This church is home. The services here are always fulfilling, the priests are ultra caring, and the people are welcoming. Every year the annual festival is something we look forward to. We are so honored to attend this church for multiple services. God bless St Marina Church always. Absolutely beautiful experience.  The father was beyond kind, and the congregation was gracious and filled with unconditional love.  Before coming I read the story of Marina, and this church perfectly represents the selfless nature of that amazing and God filled woman.  May we all strive to be like Marina child of God. The St. Marina Church Festival was a wonderful celebration that brought the community together in such a joyful and uplifting way. The variety of activities and delicious food truly showcased the spirit of God. St. Marina never fails to build important connections and a kind environment for everyone! My lovely church, the place where you can pray and worship God 🙏 open for every body ✝️ at the same time you will find many activities and services for kids and adults. Love and unity are the core characteristics of St Marina.  May God bless the priests who are not saving any effort to serve the congregation.  I love to be in St Marina and attend all the services and activities.

name: St Mark Baptist Church
St Mark Baptist Church - San Bernardino Campus
reviewSummary: If you want a word from God from a man of God this is the church. Everyone is accepted and Loved ,I travel over an hour to get there but my children and I wouldn't think of going anywhere else! Best Bible teaching church Best place to go to be feed the word of God I worship there every Sunday from Sunday school starting at 9:30 ending at 10:15 chruch starts at 11:00 lets out at 1:00 Pastor Harper is the best preacher in San Bernardino Come enjoy the lord with us You will gain wisdom, knowledge and understanding of God's word and His will for your life. HALLELUJAH!!! Historical Church, became an Historic place on 11/18/2018.

name: St Mark Encinitas
St Mark Encinitas - Encinitas Campus
reviewSummary: The people at St Mark Lutheran Church are very welcoming and genuinely caring. They have a wonderful children's program and Sunday school program. Pastor Joel, Kristen and the leadership team do so much to serve the community. Ms. Paula is always welcoming everyone with a loving smile. For anyone looking for a loving church, this is it! Warm and welcoming congregation. Definitely feels like an extended family. Services are liturgical with traditional hymns and theologically solid contemporary music. Faithful preaching. St Mark Lutheran Church members welcomed us warmly the first day we visited. Their motto is "Welcome Home!" and they live this out in they way they care for each other and the community. Pastor Joel's sermons are Biblically sound and relevant. Love our new church home! Happily married here on Christmas Eve, 1986. The overview Photos of this Church was Beautiful. I was planning to go this Fast Sunday.

name: St Mark's Episcopal Church
St Mark's Episcopal Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Nice community Church. It is nothing fancy but the people serve the community. They have tutoring for refugees NIMBY, I confess. Literally, because they are right behind my apartment. I get a full 180-degree view of the street people they keep drawing into the neighborhood. They feed the poor which I am not opposed to, but they are irresponsible in ensuring that these potentially dangerous people disburse the area when they are finished feeding them. They are camping out in the area now, with tents and blankets and shopping carts full of garbage, smoking and drinking alcohol, and there are mentally ill people beginning to camp out, increasing in numbers. This alley is used by high school kids when traversing between Hoover High and their homes or the shopping mall; the potential for danger is extremely high. They raid our trash dumpster and leave trash lying around the area, filling it up with their discards. People who rent in their temporary apartments park in our parking stalls that are clearly marked "Tenant Parking Only."
This problem has been reported to the police department, who have had to break up the encampment several times already. Great place to reconnect with your higher power! Friendly and down to earth people here. Not stuffy at all. Good place for some nurishment of bread and wine to keep you focused all week. St. Marks is a center for loving.  Not only is the worship deep and meaningful, the outreach programs serve the homeless and the working poor in the area.  This is what Christianity is all about. No dress code, come as you are... ready to serve the needy.   Or if you are in  need come  for help.

name: St Mark's Lutheran Church
St Mark's Lutheran Church - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary:
Project Hand gives homeless people food once a month, but that's not nearly enough. Not everyone has a way to prepare food, so they need food more often. Very disappointed. They also seemed to want to rush me out of the door. So sad for a members of an church to treat people in need like that I was a weekly church goer at this church, the Korean ministries.  Even though I didn't understand Korean I liked the people that attended, but when I reached out to the pastor for compassion and guidance, they wouldn't even give me an appointment.

Why?  Because I am not Korean, and I had some issues involving Korean members.  All I requested was a sitdown, and to receive spiritual guidance.

That's not true christian behavior. There is a wheelchair-accessible entrance at the front of the sanctuary and at the dropoff point by the driveway. There are wheelchair-accessible restroom,  wheelchair-accessible seating and parking. We welcome families with young children and neighbors looking for a church home. A very welcoming Congregation, very friendly Spiritual and accommodating atmosphere! Lots of activities for the youth,and other groups. Bible studies, First Communion and Confirmation Classes and much more!! there are total of 17 reviews, 12 of them are from "LOCAL GUIDE"
What does it mean?
Do you serve free food after church on Sunday?

name: St Mark's Lutheran Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: Love the energy, warm hospitality, and dynamic sermons, as well as the social justice focus from the Christian Tradition! Great Church at a great location close to USC right across the street stop by and talk to Pastor Matt. Inviting people. All are welcome there and it's a great service Old and new pastor friendly They are very welcoming and very nice people.The sermons are servicable and evangelical,they are mostly about social justice,good for new Christians.Overall, a nice community and church

name: St Mark's Roman Catholic Church
St Mark's Roman Catholic Church - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary:
I was taught in highschool confirmation to believe in miracles that saints did, mentioned it to the deacon dave or frank at the adult confirmation about padre pio bi locating and deacon annointed non believer said "thats impossible!" and I said "it's true look it up" and argued for a minute and then he used the fallacy of authority that he knows more because he is older and a deacon and then the room went silent, proving he is shoveling lies and that the church really does prove god isnt real otherwise god would have made sure he knows and doesn't disagree with the pope or any church teaching .Philippians 4:13, which states: "I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me."Matthew 17:20 Matthew 17:20: "He replied, 'Because you have so little faith. Truly I tell you, if you have faith as small as a mustard seed, you can say to this mountain, 'Move from here to there,' and it will move. Nothing will be impossible for you.'" talking to a mountain and making itself move isnt logical and was not figurative if people say he really walked on water. where do you see people performing supernatural miracles today? the fact you have a non-believer for a leader proves your lie of religion you're no different from any other religion claiming to be the one correct way of life or way. (N Matthew 7:21- 7:23. Being older or anointed doesn't make you better or correct on every detail nuances occur all the time. clearlty Martin Luther a priest did not get cannonized even though the promise of a crown in heaven for people who prayed the rosary was a statement by Mary in apparitions and also Martin Luther was a priest with a devotion to Mary. There are a lot of people that get confirmed and dont believe. your oil on the forehead doesn't actually mean it's true or you get some magical powers and or abilities. it's a placebo at best. religion is full of it. this is coming from a person who formerly prayed daily for things, fasted, studied, sacrificed, enjoyed, and made religion their life. ask for a blessing and nothing will happen. It's something that people use to tell themselves to explain coincidences and nature. I was very disappointed by my experience at this church. This was the first time I have ever attended a church that turned people away from receiving Communion and ashes.

The church doors were closed before the Gospel began, and ushers were stationed at the entrance to prevent anyone from coming in. While I understand the need to maintain order during the service, what was most upsetting was that those who arrived were not offered Communion. They waited patiently and were willing to remain outside just to receive ashes.

When the doors were eventually opened to allow those inside to leave, people were permitted to enter—but by then, the ministers distributing ashes were no longer present. It was heartbreaking to see individuals who had waited respectfully turned away without receiving either Communion or ashes.

In my understanding, this practice does not reflect the welcoming spirit and teachings of the Church. My entire family was with me, including my daughter and grandson, who are not regular churchgoers. I have been encouraging them to attend Mass more often, but after this experience, it is difficult to know what to say.

I sincerely hope the parish reflects on how situations like this impact both devoted parishioners and those trying to return to the Church. When we first moved to California from Oregon, we became members of this parish. My siblings and I did our sacraments here and even my kids were baptized and had their 1st communion's at this parish. We have recently moved to Valley Center but continue to attend mass here as we feel its the parish we belong to. Turns out, I called to book a Quince Mass for my daughter and they completely denied my request. They said I needed to inquire with my new parish and start new roots in the new city. Ridiculous much?!? I asked if I could provide a family members address who currently resides in the city to "qualify" for a mass and they said I would have that in my conscience.. meaning I would be lying. I told the young lady (Aleydi) who works in the front desk that it was going to be in her conscience that they closed the doors to their parish to a faithful Catholic family who had been attending mass at that parish for years!! I called St. Francis in Vista and they are willing to schedule a mass for my daughter without being members of their parish, and St. Stephens in Valley Center also has availability. Its very unfortunate to have a parish be so inconsiderate and not care if you no longer attend their parish after moving out of the city. You'd think they would try to keep your faithful family for many years to come but that is not the case and it truly breaks my heart that they make it more of a business then a religious place. If I could give a ZERO for customer service I would, I am in loss of words!! This is wonderful church to truly worship and praise God.  In today's world the only way to hv peace is to let God live in our hearts and soul.  To show love and kindness.  To follow Jesus and His ways.....AMEN. The father’s are very nice and funny. They make sure to make you feel comfortable and they have a room just for kids to not interrupt you’re church time as well as the bathroom, they are extremely clean so I recommend coming to this church because they have classes for different languages so you should definitely come here.

name: St Marks United Methodist Church, San Diego
St Marks United Methodist Church, San Diego - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
We’ve been members of St. Mark’s for over 30 years, and many of our fellow members feel like extended family. Cindy and I were married here in 1995. Both of our sons were baptized at St. Mark’s, attended Sunday School, served as acolytes, played in the bell choir, and participated in many children’s productions. It’s a wonderful church for young families and for anyone seeking a safe, welcoming place to explore their faith. I was baptized here, I’ve been attending regularly since I was about five, and I’ve been in the Children’s Choir for the vast majority of the time since. This church is an incredibly loving and open-minded environment.
It’s an amazing church, though I’m not extremely religious and most weeks I just come to the see wonderful people that I’ve met through this place, each week I still end up leaving with something to think about or at the very least a smile on my face. I grew up attending St Mark’s with my parents and now am raising my family here as well. It is a kind and welcoming community. My kids look forward to coming to Children’s church and youth group. The sanctuary is a beautiful and peaceful place with wonderful musicians from the children’s choir to the adult choir, pipe organ and thoughtful sermons. St Mark’s has been an amazing part of our family for well over a decade.  There are many reasons this has been so special, though if I had to pick one, it would be how the church has supported and loved our kids as they have grown in the church.  From the choir, to children’s time each Sunday, to youth group on Sunday evenings, the church has brought lots of love into our boy’s lives.  I’m very happy St Mark’s has been such an important part of our lives. A beautiful church with a stained-glass-enclosed sanctuary that inspires awe and reverence. The traditional service features inspiring music with accomplished musicians. The pastor’s teaching is current yet timeless and Biblical. Best of all is the warm and friendly community of all ages. Families and children are obviously welcome. A wonderful place to explore and deepen one’s faith.

name: St Martin of Tours Catholic Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary:
Visited this lovely church for the first time l!  San Martin Caballero is the Patron Saint of my wife's hometown in Guanajuato As part of my pilgrimage to attend mass at every church in San Diego County, I visited Saint Martin of Tours on Sunday. They offer a convenient 5 pm service, perfect for my itinerary, though they also have earlier Sunday masses at 7, 9, and 11  am.

The church provided ample parking, with designated disabled spots close by. I was warmly welcomed by the parishioners and enjoyed the beautiful music provided by the church chorus. Friendly and welcoming parishioners at St. Martin of Tours Parish, excellent experience seeing Auxiliary Bishop Michael Pham interactions with this parish.  There is a small childrens family area to the left and right sides on the altar, not visible in photos. Beautiful! Loved the mass!  Energy is bery welcoming! Attended years ago and had a pleasant experience-today, Saturday September 20, 2025-I hope, pray, and don’t worry as Padre Pio says “worry is useless” Jesus I trust you to see that I am able to celebrate Holy Mass at Saint Martin of Tours! Pray for us! And the Saint Martyrs who died for the one true faith in Jesus Christ found in the one holy Catholic apostle Church!

name: St Mary Catholic Church
St Mary Catholic Church - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary:
We really enjoyed attending mass here when we were in town for a graduation. It's a traditional Novus Ordo mass, some ladies were wearing mantillas, the church itself is pretty, and the singing was beautiful. We were actually there for a baccalaureate Mass and it was very nice! The bishop attended and I the there were 4 priests in all, and many young altar servers. ❤️

Then we attended a Spanish mass before we left for home (because our flight was on a Sunday) and we only understood a word here or there, haha. It was interesting but we participated as best we could. Great Catholic Church experience on Sunday* a little bit sad that the church doesn't join hands for the "Our Father Prayer" This is a beautiful church with a strong devotion to our blessed mother Mary. They have an enormous rosary suspended from their outdoor "overhang" and a lovely grotto devoted to Our Lady of Guadalupe. While visiting Escondido, we went to their fish fry during Lent on a Friday evening and it was superb! We attended the Saturday evening 5 pm Vigil Mass the next day and I found it a very spiritual Mass. I was struck by the Holy Spirit while giving thanks after holy communion. The tears flowed copiously. I feel this is a very holy parish. I have attended this church my entire life. It is ever growing and has  great qualities within the mass, the church it self I like. Yet It is missing a foundational heart. The people who attend mass seem to go in with open hearts and seeking the Lord. It just seems that the church organization it self is becoming less of the heart of our church. Admin at church has become over controlling and controlled to the point of making the church feel unwelcoming. There is clear Bias going on at this church and It only seems as though Father Scott and those working along side him are going to continue on with their own desires for the church rather than what the church needs. I have called the office multiple times to seek help and given almost 0 help and only asked for more money. Peace of Christ Jesus surrounds you here at Saint Mary Catholic Church! (Wednesday April 7, 2021)

God would rather die than tell lie that He didn't love you!

Be of good cheer - temporarily, God was dead!  On the third day He did rise  again indeed! He's alive!

Atheists don't give you the complete thought!

Pray for all who have never heard of God's Church, mistakenly believe wrongly about His Church, and have left the source and summit of authentic Christianity! It's One, Holy, Catholic and Apostolic!
Happy Easter!

name: St Mary of the Angels Church
St Mary of the Angels Church - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary:
Kinda bummed to see that this church never joined the Catholic Anglican Ordinariate... Fr. Andrew Bartus was able to join, but I guess the congregation wasn't keen on it. This church used to be open during the week for anyone to go inside and pray.  Some reviewers hate it, but I really liked the ability to kneel down and pray in a traditional church interior setting with lots of room for privacy to pray.  (I do attend more modern church on the weekends). I used to drop by after work and pray quietly alone and ability to do that was wonderful, I miss it since the place isn't open much lately with the pandemic. I grew up here, 1952 - 58. Sang in choir, confirmation and acolyte.

I was not prepaired for first confession. Hated kneeling. We never had youth bible study. I was not an anglophile - the tradition meant nothing.

No mission activities. Said it was,open but once entered, everything was locked. We called but no one answered. If you are seeking a high Anglican Catholic mass, St. Mary's does it right.

St Mary's Episcopal Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: A really nice spot that serves the LA area; hosts Hunger Action LA, and has nice meeting spaces. A great little community church. Wonderful atmosphere. Great for meetings. I love this church. It has a deep history in Los Angeles.. Very nice church that hosts Hunger Action LA.org It's a very peaceful place, and the church is the best.

name: St Matthew Orthodox Christian Church
St Matthew Orthodox Christian Church - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary: My partner and I went here just last week. Absolutely breath taking, Father John is a great man of God. James, and Nathen (or Nathanael) were great, and gave us a good introduction. God bless you guys! Highly recommend checking this place out, even as a Christian guest, it's awesome! Amazing church with a good hearted priest love the orthodox religion and traditions most importantly I love god..hope me my daughter and wife become baptized as Orthodox Christians one day  to accomplish our journey with the lord and to seal our relationship with him one day amen  🙏 ❤️ Started attending here the beginning of 2024. Out of the parishes that I have attended, this is by far the most vibrant and beautiful. The parish is small, but the heart of the community is bigger than life. I love the priest, Father John, and all the parishioners here! Glory to God. Father John and his community are a gift of God. I was visiting LA and randomly stepped into John at breakfast in a restaurant nearby. He invited me to the sunday service and the lunch afterwards and it was one of the most wonderful, surprising, touching experiences I lived in LA: talk to people, share some food, felt at home. I experienced how America can be a place for everybody: different cultures, languages, ideas can gather around the same table and share bread. I was just a foreigner and they treated me like a brother. Thanks guys, God bless you all! Beautiful church in a nice community. Had some great conversations during coffee hour and food. Plan on returning .

name: St Matthew's Church - Newport Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Loved coming here! Very friendly clergy and good community I was here for 3 1/2 years. It was due to an unresolvable personal issue that I finally left. I could not stay after having been somewhat devastated by how I was responded to after going to the Bishop with an ongoing relationship issue. I tried to work out an understanding, but it wasn't possible. After leaving, I heard from only one person who wished me well. No one else reached out. That was my experience here for the most part, that if you don't fit in right away you will be sort of an outsider. They don't make much effort to connect with people individually. The high mass is beautiful, but genuine concern for parishioners is even better than that. The other clergy are just fine though. Some very thoughtful sermons given. I did learn a lot. Fantastic! Beautiful Anglican expression of the historic christian faith. Beautiful liturgy. I'm a bit more of a Reformed Anglican and even I can attest that holy communion at St Matthew's is the best picture of what the world to come looks like I've ever seen. I have been around the Church “block” so to speak. I was Greek Orthodox for 2 years in college, I was Roman Catholic as a teenager, I found my wife at a non-denominational/mega church. And I have traveled the country due to my previous job…There is no place like St. Matt’s. Come try “via-media” there’s nothing like it! :)

name: St Mel's Catholic Church
St Mel's Catholic Church - Corona Campus
reviewSummary:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
St Mel's Catholic Church is a beautiful and peaceful place for worship. The church has a very welcoming atmosphere, and the community is warm and friendly. The sermons are meaningful and inspiring, and the staff are always kind and helpful. The building itself is well maintained and creates a calm environment for prayer and reflection. A wonderful place to visit and be part of the community. Small town church with caring people. We’ve been part of this church since 2006.  Ms. Emily has been a great mentor for my children and I. This church was beautiful for my cousin's wedding, the Priest was great. most wedding get boring but not this one, the priest was funny and held our interest through the whole ceremony. Nice little country church.  Friendly people. Love the area and atmosphere. Beautiful ceremony. Thank you God for allowing me to bless my marriage in your presence.

name: St Michael's Catholic Church
St Michael's Catholic Church - Poway Campus
reviewSummary: Beautifully set up church with a homey feel. Currently under remodel with services in the Holy Family Center. Plenty of seating. Was blessed to sing with the choir on July 4th service and the reception we got made you feel like family! A very nice church, the interior feels very new and clean while at the same time having very quick masses. A very pretty and clean church. We chose this church for the fact that it had a school connected to it and we have children. So we assume the prisoners would be used to kids. And they were it was very very nice there. Beautiful singing and the priest was excellent. Wonderful Service! I enjoyed the entire Mass! Celebrant was . not very friendly after Mass. Maybe I'm accustomed to friendlier receptions at other churches. Or he may have been ill. Otherwise I'd give a 5 star rating. A very active parish! 5 english masses ( all full ) on sunday. Father David McNamara is an amazing priest!

name: St Michael's Charismatic Episcopal Church
St Michael's Charismatic Episcopal Church - Mission Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
Saint Michael's Church is the friendliest place I've ever visited. The warm greetings and welcoming atmosphere make everyone feel at home. Their commitment to the community is impressive, with active volunteer efforts and outreach programs, from food drives to local clean-ups. Saint Michael's isn't just a church; it's a supportive hub that truly embodies compassion and connection. Went to school there from 1998-2005 and these people are still like family to this day. Just got back from a fundraiser get-together tonight and it was great seeing all the familiar faces. Brothers and sisters in Christ til the end. My younger daughter attended preschool here years ago. However today when I walked in to ask a simple question, a dark-haired, heavy-set woman was incredibly rude to me. Instead of asking if I had a question, she very rudely said, "We're not open you can't come in for another hour". This is a representative of a church of God??? St. Michael's is one big family from the school to the worship services you can feel the presence of the Holy Spirit the people who work there and the congregation could not be more giving and kind. I am so blessed to be a part of it 🙏👏❤️ I just want to thank EVERYBODY that prayed with me and/ or, for me. I'm sure that my exam would not have gone so well without your prayers and your faith in them and in OUR GOD!! We were able
to rule out abdominal, or aortic aneurysms and that gives me more strength as I come up on my brain scan in September. I really don't wanna go on the table. I'm sure my Neurosurgeon is great and all, but so far and ALWAYS, I feel more comfortable in GOD'S  hands as HE takes care of my needs, not my wants and in spite of my worry and apparent lack of faith, a character defect that needs a lot of work. I'm  so grateful that HE can look past that and still love me.
Again. Thank you all so much. You have made a great difference in my life. God Bless you all. Respectfully,  M. And I don't know if this is appropriate, or not, but Thank you Eddie!!! If it's not I'll remove it 😳.

St Norbert Catholic Church - Orange Campus
reviewSummary:
Nice church. Their priest for Spanish mass was the real deal, and this church is very community focused. They hosted workshops for family’s on the dangers of drug use for teens. Sadly I have been to a few too many funerals there lately, lots of seating, friendly people Father Moneypenny is welcoming and friendly They are bad neighbors.  There attendees park in the residential neighborhood regularly and their annual festival leaves trash throughout the neighborhood.  NOT to mention loud concerts and carnival rides way past city regulations.   If you need God in your life, this isnt the place. Is a nice church i guess the best Attended a funeral at St. Norbert’s and had not been to this church in decades!
It’s a beautiful and calming church! The service was comforting and just so well done for our friend!

name: St Patrick Catholic Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
Friendly and welcoming Catholic community, the priests are caring,  always there to serve your spiritual needs. Beautiful decorated for Christmas. Excellent school as well.
Thursday is soup night for all. Homemade soup and bread.  Very loving people,  great place for Seniors to stop and visit.

Attend 11.00am Mass on Sundays,  enough parking,  never crowded, the priests give nice homily. Attended the most impactful Good Friday Stations of the Cross yesterday. Each station was read by a member of the church and placed us all back to Good Friday when our Lord was crucified. 🙏 Top notch . Little taken back with people wearing hats and shorts to Mass.
Also strong armed on a donation for a donut wasn’t that cool either. I was traveling on Mothers Day and Im a traditional Latin mass goer. The 7:30 mass was welcoming and priest was traditional and communion by mouth was welcomed. Thank You father. Saint Patrick, pray for us!

Drive the proverbial snakes from our midst and keep us holy and merit heaven as you have!

For the repose of the souls of our dearly beloved who have died (birthed into eternal life) may they rest in peace!

The Catholic Church is God through us!

St Paul Lutheran Church - Fullerton Campus
reviewSummary: What others have posted is correct: the pastor is energetic, the music director is great, the congregation is friendly.  Also, there are strong Sunday School and school programs.  Unfortunately, the pastor has been delving deeper into politics in his sermons.  If you believe in the separation of church and State, this may not be the right fit for you. Best church in town! I've been going to this church since I was a very small child. I went through confirmation, attended pacific and national youth gatherings, participate in the praise team, and play in the annual golf tournament. There are plenty of opportunities for you and your family to worship, serve, and have fun. Stop by and check it out for yourself. See you on Sunday! St. Paul Lutheran Church has a caring community of people who share their faith and are there for each other in times of need. Have been attending this church since 1977 and have made many lasting friendships here. The worship services are inspirational. The music director brings so much vitality on Sunday morning. The congregation is friendly and welcoming.Great energetic pastor..

reviewSummary:
I went to their food  pantry  program on that they offer to the community on Thursdays and they were very welcoming.
I showed up to service that  Sunday along  with my family and  have  made St. Paul's our church home. Pastor Raphael  stays true to The Holy Bible and his delivery of the word is right on point.
The word  is not only for  those in our church, but  for every single person  that comes in contact with each of it's  members.

St Paul's Baptist Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: My Bishop and First Lady are the best. Anointed and full of love for the people. People seem fine,don't know anything about just live a few homes anyway from. Excellent service. Warmed hearted people. Spirit of the LORD is in the people & building The best church in La county God is at work on this place.

name: St Paul's Episcopal Cathedral
St Paul's Episcopal Cathedral - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Fun and unique experience. Made for a good date night. An Older crowd for the beetles one. Talented quartet. Seating pretty uncomfortable at the location we were at. but it only lasted an hour so it wasn’t unbearable. I personally would have liked it more if it had felt more quiet and Sacred given that it was in a chapel with all the candlelight, the loud mic, and joking between sets and how we all doing? Having fun? energy didn’t fit the space. Great experience! My husband also really enjoyed it. Great ambience, location and very talented musicians. Everyone working the event was very friendly and helpful! We look forward to attending another one! This place was listed as a resource for showers for Gods less fortunate children but its ONLY THE SECOND SATURDAY of each month just so all my other less fortunate brethren that are in need so you don't show up and get let down like I did. This is such a profoundly beautiful congregation.

Unfortunately, the structural beauty is not matched by biblical truth or theological orthodoxy. The Word of God is not fully adhered to or preached there. Great place to visit very peaceful you can climb 500 stairs to the dome , which ofcourse I did with my daughter . Wonderful place to visit . Btw there is entry fee for fsmily we paid 💶 60

name: St Paul's Episcopal Church
St Paul's Episcopal Church - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
St. Paul's is one of the most beautiful and Christ-like churches I have ever attended. Fr. Mark is kind, welcoming and progressive.  The service is a wonderful compromise between traditional with a twist of the new.  The congregation is fun and hospitable.  No matter who you are or where you are in your faith journey St. Paul's will welcome you. Everyone is very warmth and welcoming.
I felt at home the very first time I visited.
Open doors for EVERYONE, no discrimination to any gender or sexual orientation.
Spanish mass is at 12:30 Sunday's and English at 8 am and 10 am.
Come over and experiment what a church should feel like!!! This place is the place I feel at home. Every Sunday I feel the Holy Sprite and the lord with me. The people there are great, and very welcoming, 12 1/2 years my family been coming to this church and we call it home. Blessed be thy name.💒 I really love this church. I am not a member, but we visit on some Holy Days. Their Ash Wednesday service is particularly lovely. Went to wedding here it was beautiful!! Staff was great! I heard the pricing was very good as well.

name: St Paul's Episcopal Church - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary: Went to a meeting there for the first time and met old friends. Perfect place for an early mindset. Very positive and I will return to charge the soul batteries. Great service,good people ,visit whenever you can They have free dinner every Sunday. And we are very grateful for it. The food has been delicious every time. And they cook every bit if it from scratch. And its not a can of beans and a hot dog. Its great sloppy joes and zucchini with mushrooms and taco soups and homemade corn bread and salads. Then they have a grocery line after dinner.  They also have clothing and other items that you can get something if you need it. Everyone there us so sweet and caring. They are always polite and the kids that are there serving are the same. And we all know that people being caring and polite are a rarity now days. I look forward to being there every Sunday. In where its warm, nice people Nd good food. I have been attending for about 15 years.  The current rector, assistant, music, staff and lay leadership are all wonderfully committed, compassionate and thoughtful Christians.  Compassion, Celebration and Community are the hallmarks of the church, and the worship services are terrific.  All are welcome at God's table at this church, which emphasizes the discovery of your own, authentic, personal journey of Christian faith instead of marking off dogmatic checklists from the distant past -- which, if I remember right, was central to Jesus' teaching as well.  :)  Please come visit.  I think you'll like it. I have not been in a church since 2008. ..... been to new York city to California. And only a handful I would say. Helps people. The ENERGY in here is so real. I hope I can be part of this community. As of right now we are in need of help. And because they help I will return the favor.... this place is beautiful. If you have been lost. I'm sure you will reconnect. ^_^ here. Just park in parking lot. And feel the energy this place is giving. !
