name: St Paul's Lutheran Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Truly a great church! The pastor faithfully peached both law and gospel following the liturgical Lutheran tradition. The community was also very welcoming and kind. You’ll see all ages at St. Paul’s from baby toddlers running around, to young adults and seniors, I can’t recommend a better church in the area! St. Paul's Preschool is the best in town!  Both my son's attended the preschool as well as my niece and nephew.  We put our 100% trust and faith in the kind and caring staff to take wonderful care of our children everyday.  Each member of the staff is dedicated to providing the children with the tools they need to be steps ahead of others when the graduate to kindergarten.  I cannot imagine a better place to send my children or my family for preschool. Just visited and if you have a child that is 2 years old or older, they potty train if needed and are considered as one of the best schools in the Long Beach area. This is one of the better preschools in the area.  The staff are all well educated, and each classroom follow a consistent and progressive teaching process that includes music, art, creative play and phonics, which of course helps all the children to enjoy reading and creative play. St. Paul's is where God's eternal, healing and life-giving Word is rightly preached, and God's free gifts, those that build trust in Christ's promises and provide forgiveness of sins, via His physical  means of delivery (water baptism,  bread-and-wine communion, and His spoken words of forgiveness) are rightly delivered.  Did you know that Jesus of Nazareth regularly dined with some really awful, notorious people-- the most despised of His day (Luke 15:2)?  (In middle-Eastern culture, you only dined with those who were in your social circle.)   He purposely sought them out, and He still does today!  Why?  Because he cares for all people and doesn't want any to perish (1 Peter 5:7, 2 Peter 3:9).  He requests your presence at His weekly "banquet" so He can feed you (Lord's Supper), wash you (Baptism), and speak to you His words of mercy and forgiveness (Absolution), through His called and ordained servants rightly preaching His Words (Holy Bible) to you, in a liturgical worship service, for the building and fortifying of your trust in Him and in His promises.  He will then clothe you with a spotless robe of His righteousness (Rev 3:5) and He will place a ring on your finger, honoring you as His adopted son or daughter (Luke 15:22-25).  He does everything for you, for free; it's pure gift, so you can live with Him forever in fullness of joy and with pleasures forevermore-- the VERY reason you were created (Psalms 16:11)!  What do you have do?  Just show up!  What do you need to bring to the table?  The same thing the homeless do when they show up at a soup kitchen-- nothing but themselves.  You're like the recently-diagnosed HIV/AIDS patient  who shows up at the clinic for free treatment-- you bring NOTHING but yourself and your ultimately deadly, but treatable disease (sin).  You just have got to get yourself there.   His is an open invitation, whether you feel the need or not,  to share His life-giving food and drink, water and words.  The "worst of the worse" (today, it would be drug-dealing, child pornographers, for example) are who He dined with back then, and He is no different today.  He is patiently waiting to serve you, heal you, and give you life everlasting,  whenever you'd like to come. Great Church. Blessed to worship there. Great Pastor  (Mark Pierson).

name: St Paul's Lutheran Church - Orange Campus
reviewSummary: With a freshly renovated sanctuary, new energy in the youth ministries, an inspiring music director and amazing sermons from the dedicated pastors, St. Paul's is a warm and welcoming place to worship Christ. I've been a member my whole life, went to school here, raised my sons here and it keeps getting better and better! Many opportunities to get involved, make lifelong friendships and serve the Lord; a truly special place to find your place. St. Paul's offers a warm and welcoming atmosphere with talented pastors, musicians, and vocalists.  The sermons are focused on scripture and relevant topics for us today.  I love that the 10:30 service is live streamed in case we are out of town.  They offer many ways for people to get connected and involved so you become part of the community.  The youth group has been wonderful for my children and the small group Bible studies have been meaningful for me and my husband.  It takes dedication to make all of this happen at such a high caliber, I'm proud of all of our church workers ❤️ I have been a member of this church for over 20 years.  I have raised my daughter in their school, and youth groups.  This church has a firm foundation in the Bible, and is very helpful to its members.  They have brought me meals post surgery, provided transportation when needed, and the pastors have visited me and brought me communion when house bound. I'm am happy to call St. Paul's Lutheran Church my second home. St. Paul’s is such an amazing place to worship, and raise a family. I’ve been blessed to call St. Paul’s my church home for nearly 20 years. The schools are wonderful, and the parishioners are welcoming and supportive. Pastor C is a man of God, who had always show leadership and vision. I highly recommend visiting St. Paul’s, which to me is the best church home you can find in Orange County! St. Paul's Lutheran Church is my second home.  I literally could not imagine my life without this church family in it in a variety of ways on a weekly basis.  Not only has the church, its pastor, and numerous members been there for me throughout difficult periods in my life, but I have also witnessed their care and compassion over and over again throughout the decades I have been a member there.  This same care extends to the St. Paul's Lutheran ECDC and School through its campus and teachers.  Whenever anyone new is looking for a church, I immediately recommend St. Paul's.  Members like me have remained there for decades because of the care, comfort, and home community we feel there.  In fact, it has been the church home of my family for generations and with good reason!  Weddings, Baptisms, Holidays and all our important life events have been with and through St. Paul's.  I could go on and on, really really, about how deep and significant and important St. Paul's Lutheran Church has and will continue to be to my family!

name: St Paul's Lutheran Church - Pomona / Claremont Campus
reviewSummary:
The Good News about Jesus the Messiah is preached here.  Holy Communion is celebrated every Sunday.  The historical liturgies in the Lutheran Service Book are used for worship. Beautiful classic hymns are sung.  The Christian Calendar is observed.  All are welcomed.  This congregation is a member of the Lutheran Church Missouri Synod. We have been members here since 2011. We came to visit but we liked this congregation so much that we stayed. People are welcoming and loving, they care for everyone, and don't get in other people's business. It is a Christ-centered congregation where the gospel is preached and communion is served every Sunday. Went to church school there.  Loved every moment.  Sang in choir.  So grateful for this church and school.  I am 78 now and live in Oregon but still miss it.
GODS BLESDINGS TO ALL!
Rhonda Young Proclaiming Christ and Serving Others in Pomona and abroad since 1920! St. Paul's is a loving, welcoming, Christ-centered church!

name: St Paul's United Methodist Church
St Paul's United Methodist Church - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary: This wonderful Church helps people all the time. And twice per month they partner with the LA Food Bank and impact greatly the neighborhood that surrounds it. Authentically nurturing, encouraging, Pastor on site, available for prayer on Sundays and beyond. St. Paul's Inter-generational, multi-cultural Ministries provide arts and culture, food pantry, children's church, multi-media bible studies  and outreach/support for many community issues. It is a sincerely friendly place where no one is treated as a stranger and all are welcomed to not only hear the Good News but become a part of the story. The community of St Paul's is so very special. Wonderful family to join for Church on Sunday mornings. You will be welcomed warmly and enjoy a truly blessed worship experience. Prayerful, sharing, loving,people. Always helping the community.  Pastor Lynette and family are wonderful! Wonderful Community Food Pantry they accept baby food as well as Adult food

name: St Paul's United Methodist Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
The inside architecture of the church looks so much like the inside of an old ship.  We went on a day when the choir was practicing.  It was peaceful.  There is wall wings on the outside of the church. We have such beautiful memories attending St. Paul’s UMC. The congregation is so welcoming and no matter where the Army sends us, we always miss St. Paul’s. It is truly a gem which is why we became members. Best church family ever! Celebrating 130 years anniversary. Feeling like something is missing in your life. The missing piece is God! Come and be made whole. The music was amazing. The choir, orchestra, and soloists were so good, it brought tears to my eyes. This was a fabulous service to get into the Christmas spirit. I am the caregiver to lauris boyer.
This location has amazing singers for choir. Their performance brought me to tears. Thank you.

name: St Peter & St Paul Catholic Church
St Peter & St Paul Catholic Church - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary: Last week my family held a viewing and mass for my grandmas funeral here at St Peter & St Paul church. We cannot thank Gloria, Carolina, and the rest of the church enough for their services. They were empathetic, kind and well organized. The father and deacon were also great. We especially appreciate that the deacon tried his best to speak Spanish at the cemetery and he did great. Overall my family had a great experience with this church under the circumstances. Love this Church so much!! Such a wonderful mass ❤️ so beautiful inside and out. Love our church! Such a beautiful place where everyone is welcomed and treated like family “God is Good” 💐💕✝️🙏🏻 ⛪️ Visiting from Tulsa, Oklahoma. Went to a weekday Mass and I did not feel like a visitor. Beautiful Church, Beautiful Mass and the Celebrating Priest was welcoming and friendly. Been on the fence about a lot in my life and I was able to talk to a priest here and it really helped me a lot.

name: St Peter Chaldean Catholic Cathedral
St Peter Chaldean Catholic Cathedral - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary: Beautiful architecture on the outside and even better inside. Gives you European Cathedral vibes, and it was hot while I was in New York so it was nice to come inside and it be ice cold 😎. Christ is King ✝️ Great church and great people.  With amazing priests who understand the Bible and the people My son got married yesterday at this church. Most beautiful church in San Diego Got married here, super pretty church. Heads up in case you want to get married here they only accept cash or check for the donation and purchase of armband

name: St Peter Chanel Catholic Church
St Peter Chanel Catholic Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Very wonderful to participate in community prayers as well as received healing and can share wellbeing by helping others in what you can(examples:praying for others,also listening,learning then sharing what was learned.) I drive an hour every Sunday to participate in the various formation opportunities offered by Fr Broom and his faithful parish leaders at St Peter Chanel. They are very organized.

I have learned so much through the 10 week Ignatian Spiritual Exercise course and now Acts of the Apostles.  Even my 10 year old loves Fr Brooms teachings!

This parish is alive!!

I pray for the priests here and parish leaders and all of us attending the workshops and am grateful they help us on our quest for holiness and our path towards heaven.  I’m inspired to bring workshops and teachings to my parish as well through the Grace of God. Empty me.  Fill me. Use me Lord. one of the best churches I have ever known, there is always a service and all week there is mass in English and Spanish and the fathers have a schedule where you can go to confession. Everything is very good with this church. I really recommend it a lot. Apart from that, it is very beautiful and feels a wonderful peace. One of may favorite parishes. Amazing humble dedicated priest. There is daily mass, and daily adoration. There are spiritual exercises online, and everyday sermons. When I was a child this was one of my favorite churches. One of the few churches that only accept donations, and does not charge for any sacraments. Although the church building itself is modern, such as the architecture, but the the parish still holds the Catholic faith. The Catholic faith which is based off both scripture, and tradition. We came to this church hoping for guidance and support as we prepare for marriage, but unfortunately our experience has been disappointing and unnecessarily difficult.

Despite being practicing Catholics, we were made to feel almost denied service simply because we do not regularly attend this specific parish. We were asked to provide a copy of a past civil marriage license, which has no relevance to our sacramental marriage in the Church. Additionally, my fiancé was asked to submit another copy of his baptism papers, even though these were already provided and previously accepted—only to later be told they are now “not valid,” with no clear explanation.

The most troubling part of this experience was the lack of compassion and respect. When I expressed concern about why it was being made so difficult for my fiancé to complete his final two sacraments, a woman named Ana responded rudely by saying, “That’s why you should’ve gotten it done when you were younger.” This comment felt dismissive, judgmental, and completely unpastoral.

We expected understanding, patience, and guidance from a church that preaches love and support—especially for couples seeking to receive the sacraments properly. Instead, we were met with obstacles, poor communication, and disrespect.

I truly hope this church reflects on how it treats couples who are sincerely trying to grow in their faith and receive the sacraments, regardless of their past or parish history.

name: St Peter Evangelical Lutheran Church
St Peter Evangelical Lutheran Church - Santa Ana Campus
reviewSummary: My family and St. Peter’s go back a long way. When the family moved into the area in 1961 we started attending St. Peter’s. I was confirmed there, I was an alter boy in my early teens. For decades my mom, Bea Jensen, volunteered to work in the office and help in the kitchen. A little over a decade ago, when my mother was too sick to leave the house Pastor Wes came out to the house to perform a baptism for her two great grand children in her backyard. We set her bed so she could look out and see. It made her so happy. My last visit there I looked around and saw a few seniors in the congregation I remembered from back when we were all kids there. I retired out of state a decade ago but will always have fond memories of St. Peter’s. May it continue to serve the area for the decades to come and bring God’s message to future generations. Lovely old Lutheran church. Beautiful and special place for my daughter's wedding. A lovely young bilingual pastor. Felt very much comfortable in that house of the Lord. Love the spanish service here. The choir is amazing. Was there for a memorial service and the pastor and service was great

name: St Peter's By-the-Sea Presbyterian Church
St Peter's By-the-Sea Presbyterian Church - Huntington Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Love this church and the kind welcoming  congregation. Been a member for 30’years. Beaitiful facility, with caring souls. Small private place of personal spirituality If I could it would be 10 stars Great church very loving

name: St Peter's Episcopal Church
St Peter's Episcopal Church - San Bernardino Campus
reviewSummary: A warm and welcoming community. Thoughtful liturgy, programming that has included game nights, quarterly yard sales, music events, Saturday evening AA meetings. Fellowship and sanctuary open to all. Also visit the beautiful cactus garden as a place for meditation and prayer. This place brought me back to learning about Jesus and God. Very welcoming and Father Jay is a walking Bible. I enjoy the services! We started attending St. Peter’s Episcopal Church late last year, and from the very beginning, we were met with warmth, inclusivity, and genuine hospitality. The community is welcoming to all, and we’ve truly found a church home here. The services are thoughtful and spirit-filled, and the sense of belonging and connection has meant so much to us. We're grateful to be part of such a compassionate and affirming congregation. The priest was very friendly and empathetic. The congregation, though small, was very friendly. I chatted with a few people there over coffee and cookies for an hour after the service! Felt out of place. Nothing but an older crowd that has been there for a long time. I could be wrong. Please go there and see for yourself

name: St Peter's Italian Catholic Church
St Peter's Italian Catholic Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautiful church with an Italian flavor.

Wonderful sculptures with an emphasis on Italian culture. After services I found myself walking around the church and appreciating the various painted works of art. The altar was is the most amazing that depicts a fisherman. Smaller church compared to others Catholic churches. Great views of downtown from the steps of the church. What an amazing parish! I attended the Sunday evening mass and it started with a gentleman that was so polite as he greeted my wife and I at the door.

The priests name is Father Leonardo and he was so in depth with his homily and made it applicable to me and everyone it seemed.

The people are so nice. Some of the parishioners were so warm and sincere that we have returned for mass many times over. We have had the chance to get to know some of the parishioners, as well as brief conversations with Father Leonardo too.

The architecture is extremely nice, but I am more impressed with the thoroughness of Father Leonardo's homilies and the warmth of the community at the evening mass. Pretty catholic church with an unusual altar. Prepared for a wedding, so we had to air out church because of musty smell. Attended another wonderful St. Joseph’s Table event. Amazing food and delicious pastries and cakes to buy. Such a beautiful little church. The priest gave a great sermon. Very wise.

name: St Philip the Apostle Church
St Philip the Apostle Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautiful church with a tight-knit parish community. Confession and Adoration offered throughout the week. Boasts more than 30 ministries and groups, including a vibrant college student and young adult ministry called the Newman Center.

Make sure to visit the beautiful Marian chapel in honor of Our Lady of Guadalupe at the front of the church. Great, Eucharistic community that has a lively Newman Center for young adults. St. Philip's also has Eucharistic adoration M - F from 8-12 pm and 1-5 pm, unless posted otherwise.

The parish community recently renovated the old baptismal room and turned it into a Marian chapel. The chapel is open during normal church hours.

Regarding liturgy, the parish offers contemporary and more traditional litugies. The 5 pm Saturday, 7 am, 9 am, and 5 pm are more on the contemporary style. The 12:30 pm Spanish Mass is also on the contemporary side. There are also two Masses with sacred music: the 10:45 and 7 pm Candlelit Mass. The priests are direct,  inspiring,  very spiritual. The church is beautiful but their people are amazing.  The service is always filling in Soul, mind and Spirit. This is a nice old cathedral style neighborhood Church. The choir was practicing right before the 5 pm mass today. Nice church for visit. The place invited to pray and stay for a while.

St Philip The Apostle Melkite Catholic كنيسة القديس فيلبس للروم الملكيين الكاثوليك - San Bernardino Campus

St Stephen's Episcopal Church - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary:
Welcoming to all! People are friendly and inclusive, which allows a sense of community. I appreciate the service bulletin, because it allows everyone to be part of the mass. I enjoy listening to The Sermon and how
It connects to present events. I feel amazing every time I leave. Faithful, friendly congregation. Rev Christopher is an excellent preacher who bases his sermons on the scripture lessons for the day and always gives us practical guidance on sharing Jesus’ love within our community. We appreciate the traditional liturgy and beautiful music weekly. Great fellowship and support to SCV and those even a distance...highly recommend for young and old! Incredible, living and accepting church. St. Stephen's is a warm and accepting church! I love going to church here and have found the congregation warm and friendly. Rev. Kelly O'Connell welcomes all to the our church, if you are looking to renew your spirituality or are new to the area please come in and say hi!

name: St Thomas of Canterbury
St Thomas of Canterbury - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Small welcoming congregation and service. Natural light and stone floors felt comforting too. A nice place to pray. My home church for 25+ years. Weekly communion, and all baptized are welcome to take communion - no questions asked. Different services with and without music. Follows the church-year liturgical calendar (Advent, Epiphany, Lent, Easter, Pentecost). Love this church. Very welcoming,  but don't be shy, say hello and introduce yourself. Father George is so nice.  As are the people on his team. Went to a wedding, parking difficult

name: St Thomas Syro-Malabar Catholic Forane Church
St Thomas Syro-Malabar Catholic Forane Church - Orange Campus
reviewSummary:
This church offers a serene atmosphere for worship and reflection. The solemn ambiance create a sense of reverence. The services are spiritually uplifting. Overall, it's a place where one can find peace and solace in their faith. Ephesians 2:19-22

Nice place
I really enjoyed my traditional Syrian Catholic Mass Best Church in all of Orange County. Great atmosphere. Amazing Faith. Incredible People. Nice church before they use to sell on Sundays Menudo very good

name: St Timothy Catholic Parish
St Timothy Catholic Parish - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary: A frequent visitor to this area and have attended mass at several area churches.  I attended the 8:30 am Sunday mass and found the mass and parishioners to be reverent and compelling.  The priest's homily was meaningful, relevant and thought provoking.  I always miss my home parish's music, but St. Timothy's was good and felt sacred.  If you have not visited St. Timothys recently, I encourage you to check it out. We visited for the Saturday vigil mass. The songs and music was great. Everyone is welcoming. It was a great experience. With exception of only having one priest to do the mass and cannot come to the cemetery to give a few words for the families of the deceased, the funeral mass for my wife's uncle was really nice. I am use to Good Shepherd church that when somebody died they will do the Funeral Mass Service and the cemetery service for the family of the deceased. The church is nice and the music is really solemn and nice, I came before when the same Uncle has their anniversary. 2025: We love Father Cávana Wallace. When we moved down here from the OC we attended Saint Margaret’s in Oceanside under his guidance. When he was relocated it broke our heart. Once he was back in the NorCo vicinity we began attending Saint Timothy because of Father Cavana.  His honesty and obvious compassion for those around him is clearly evident. He’s religiously inspirational and that is hard to find in today’s world. Lots of parking especially handicapped. Easy handicapped auto door and very clean restrooms

name: St Vincent de Paul Catholic Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
A solid parish, decent parishioners,  the Ukrainian Folks have been Exceptional..I wish them well.. A simple, but very beautiful church serving the faithful of its parish.

The church (and associated school) is built near a shopping district, which makes parking a little challenging.  There is paid meter parking across Hawk street, but if you turn the corner, you'll find some free angled-spaces (limited number of spots).

The priest during the weekday Mass follows the traditional Norvos Ovo devoutly.  It did not seem like English was his first language, but he had a great homily.

After the Mass, exposition was offered. On my pilgrimage to visit every Catholic Church in San Diego County, I found myself in Saint Vincent Catholic Church. The Mass was inspiring. Plenty of parking on the street.  Overall worth the visit. I thank God that we live near this church, & able to join its services.  Its Pastor (Fr Alex), volunteers & deacons are inspiring, humble & approachable. It's a nice church with friendly parishioners. I do not feel out of place in that church. A bonus... Father Alex knows sign language!

name: St Wilfrid's Episcopal Church
St Wilfrid's Episcopal Church - Huntington Beach Campus
reviewSummary: I’ve attended many churches in a wide variety of locations. St. Wilfred’s in Huntington Beach is an amazing church with a sincerely welcoming congregation from all paths of life. If you are seeking a place, you will be accepted here. If this is your first or hundredth time attending church, you will be welcomed. The first time I visited in July/September 2025 I was a bit nervous, but there was no reason to be. I came to the 10:30 service and was met outside the sanctuary by a greeter who helped me with any questions. Coming to this church has changed my life. St. Wilfred’s has brought me closer in my faith through learning, guidance, and support of the congregation and the leadership of the church. I truly hope that you attend one of our services and experience the many wonderful qualities for yourself. A lovely church which I have only ever entered to view the OC women’s choir perform. The space is beautiful & I love their courtyard! St. Wilfrid’s is such a welcoming church! I discovered it a few years ago and it felt like coming home. The people in the parish are genuine and friendly. And, Father Nathan truly cares about his parishioners! Our family joined St. Wilfrid’s church shortly after we enrolled our kids in the preschool.  Our kids did Sunday school, became acolytes, participated in the youth group, and eventually went away to college.  St. Wilfrid’s was (and still is) the right church for us because the sermons are uplifting, the parishioners accept anyone who walks through the door, and I’m not forced to believe anything that doesn’t make sense to me.  The 10:30 service has an amazing choir, and the 8:30 service is a little more relaxed with fun praise band.  Church always puts me in a better mood, and gives me a little time to think about what’s important and what’s not.  I’m really happy to leave this review, not sure what took me so long. St. Wilfrid's is a very welcoming and friendly church and is inclusive of all people. Whether you are looking for a new church home or just need a break from the ongoing stresses of daily life, I recommend you come and see. There are two services on Sunday. At 8:30 there's contemporary and traditional music with a praise band.  The 10:30 service has the wonderful St. Wilfrid's choir and beautiful pipe organ. The latter service is broadcast online too. I am so glad we came here and am grateful to call St. Wilfrid's my church home.

name: St. Alban's Episcopal Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
On October 11, 2025, I walked into St. Alban’s feeling a little overwhelmed... the kind of nerves that come with any wedding morning, even when everything has been planned beautifully. From the moment we arrived to the venue something shifted. The calm, the care, the warmth in that space made it feel like the Holy Spirit truly stepped in and carried us through the day.

Rev. Adam Dawkins and his team made the entire planning process incredibly easy, even from afar while we live in Bozeman, Montana. Every detail was handled with intention, kindness, and professionalism, so when our wedding day arrived, everything came together seamlessly. Vendors arrived, photos were taken, the space was transformed and it all unfolded with such grace that it felt nothing short of a gift.

Being able to be married in a church as a gay couple was deeply meaningful to us. From our very first visit, St. Alban’s has made us feel safe, welcomed, and celebrated. When we’re in Los Angeles, we attend Sunday services and community events whenever we can, and every time we walk through those doors we feel at home. To be married there, surrounded by that love and acceptance, was something we will carry with us forever.
The music alone made the day unforgettable. Ray was incredible, thoughtfully curating music that fit the spirit and emotion of our ceremony perfectly. And Virginia’s voice, truly breathtaking, had so many of us in tears. It was one of those moments you don’t just hear, you feel.

We are endlessly grateful to the entire team who made our day so special: A. on the admin side who kept everything organized leading up to the wedding, Adam McCrory for his warmth and hospitality, Alfons for his thoughtful assistance throughout the day, Adam Hartsock for his kind words and support, and again Rev. Adam a true gift to not only us but this church, the connections he brought along with amazing life advice and guidance will stay with us for all of time. We again cannot thank you enough.

Everyone treated our wedding with care, respect, and genuine joy.
If you are looking for a place to celebrate your marriage, we truly could not recommend St. Alban’s enough. The church itself is beautiful, and the outdoor patio in the evening was magical. From start to finish, our experience was loving, seamless, and filled with grace.

St. Alban’s wasn’t just our wedding venue, it was a blessing, and now a place we can return to that feels like home. 💛

— Gunner & Alex My first time attending the 10 AM Sunday Service at St Alban's Episcopal Church.
-I can say it was one of the most touching and  memorable Masses  I had  attended through the years.
-First and foremost One feels valued by the Parishioners  who greet u as though u are a regular.
-What impressed me even moreso is the sincere heartfelt welcoming of :
The Reverend Adam L. Dawkins!!👍
-I hyke in that area and i always stop briefly to say a short prayer in the courtyard of the Church  at the statue Of Mary and Jesus , as well when passing by the stained glass of Jesus's refection outside the Chapel.
-Always Reverend Dawkins approaches to greet me  with a smile as well as  the Pastors and  attendees.
-I got curious and felt drawn to the cozy little Chapel so intimate I decided to attend 2 or more Sunday Masses thus far.
-But on  July 27th I attended Mass for the first time in the church
-My mind was blown!
-So touching! It was SUPERB! The Choir felt like Mozart musique to the ears. Heavenly!
-The church architecture so tasteful! Soothing calming colors.
Let Alone The Reverends Sermons !
That of Reverend Adam Dawkins and Reverend Joshua Paget's Both .
-I really encourage you to try and attend Mass there regardless  of religion and/or beliefs, you will  feel the sincere warm welcome By all.
-Thank you Reverend Dawkins for ur   Presence there , for ur welcoming open arms and for your wonderful gracious attitude to all.
-Thank you Reverend Paget as much!
-Thank you Pastors  and parishioners!
You
make me feel valued  and welcome even when am just passing  by ..
-Thank you lovely Heavenly Music Choir , it was truly amazing . As Christmas approaches, I am reminded of the beautiful Christmas Eve service at midnight that St Alban’s held. This year it is unfortunate that many places of worship will be closed due to the pandemic. I always felt a warmth here. The choir is spectacular. The Christmas decor beautiful and the mass is uplifting and really symbolizes the love of Christ. It is a place of members, friends and visitors. I hope that many who are alone this year and also struggling can find the Light and Hope. Merry Christmas! Really beautiful and pretty progressive church.
I have seen several friends here perform and have come for Christmas and easter services.
Beautiful building, very welcoming and friendly parishioners.
Our family has come here a number of times and always felt right at home. Love the acoustics and music I love this place!

I found St. Alban's while I was a student at UCLA.  The people here were friendly and welcoming.  I got involved with the campus ministry and a book study group.  Years later, well after graduating, this place is still my home.

If you're not familiar with the Episcopal Church, here are a few details about who we are:

Inclusion: all are welcome as you are.
Tradition: the services are simple, but have deep roots going back millennia.
Reason: scripture and tradition are held with reason and are informed by our growing understanding.

St. Andrew Catholic Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
Absolutely stunning church! As a wedding photographer and filmmaker, I was blown away by the beautiful architecture, incredible artwork, and elegant atmosphere. The space photographs and films beautifully from every angle, creating a timeless setting for a wedding ceremony.

We had the pleasure of capturing both photo and video here, and the experience was truly incredible. St. Andrew Catholic Church offers a breathtaking backdrop for couples looking for a classic and elegant wedding celebration.

You can see more wedding photography and films from this beautiful church on our YouTube channel, Natalia Bell Photography & Film. I attended Mass at St. Andrew Catholic Church in Pasadena on July 19, 2026, and it was one of the most powerful spiritual experiences I have had in years.

From the moment I entered the church, I was struck by the reverence, beauty, and sense of the sacred. The Mass was celebrated with extraordinary dignity, incorporating the richness of Latin prayers and traditional Catholic devotion while remaining fully accessible and spiritually engaging. It felt like a beautiful bridge between the timeless traditions of the Church and the living faith of today.

The priest celebrated with deep devotion and genuine holiness. At the conclusion of Mass, hearing the Prayer to St. Michael the Archangel prayed with the congregation was profoundly moving. I also received a personal blessing for fatherhood and leadership that touched my heart in a way I will never forget.

I stayed to pray the Rosary and found myself overwhelmed with gratitude. In a world that often feels distracted, noisy, and spiritually empty, St. Andrew's felt like a sanctuary where Christ is truly at the center. The beauty of the liturgy moved me to tears and renewed my love for the Catholic faith.

If you are seeking a reverent Mass, faithful Catholic teaching, meaningful prayer, and a community that treasures the sacred, I cannot recommend St. Andrew Catholic Church highly enough. This parish was a spiritual oasis for me and a reminder that God is still drawing souls to Himself through truth, beauty, and reverence.

Five stars without hesitation. WHAT A BEAUTIFUL CHURCH!
Its just as massive inside with its grand pillars and Tall Ceilings!
Capturing a wedding here was a blessing. Attended a concert at the St. Andrew a while ago. The architecture of this church was breathtaking. It was hard not to gawk and stare. The altar was spectacular and I wanted to go up and take a thousand pictures of every angle.
Had a wonderful experience visiting this church to support my friend and his Cal State LA Masters Program summer chorale concert. They performed Dona Nobis Pacem which was so gorgeously performed. I'm so glad we made the drive up to see it and to hear it performed with the acoustics in this grand church. Saw this beautiful church passing by and had to stop to see it, we also passed by nearby city halls beatifull building.

Must see if you are around the area!

name: St. Andrews Presbyterian Church - Newport Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
We’ve had the pleasure of completing many projects with St. Andrews Presbyterian Church, and it has always been a wonderful experience. The entire team is kind, honest, and professional. They truly respect the work and always make collaboration easy and enjoyable. They’re consistently available to help, communicate clearly, and treat every project with care and integrity.

A special thanks to Tom, Catherine, Peter, James, Chuck, Don, Kim, Bill, Merry, and so many lovely people for their constant support, kindness, and teamwork! It’s always a privilege working with you. The greatest musical ministry anywhere! The lead pastor Jason Smith is a dynamic and inspiring leader. The entire staff including the associate pastors and the volunteers do incredible good for the community;  and the global outreach programs and the church support for outside community organizations doing so much good is truly admirable. No matter what your individual Christian faith history I encourage you to experience St Andrews and prepare to be enthralled and warmly welcomed to a devoted congregation. Start with the Classic 9 am Sunday service or watch live on-line. So many programs offering meaningful ways to participate.
You will be Blessed in the process. St. Andrew's is a great place to grow in your faith, or discover it for the first time.  Pastor Jason is a great teacher, our worship is the best (both traditional and contemporary) and we have many ways to connect with each other in different ways.  Excellent Bible study groups and other community groups.  Love St. Andrew's! We have found a supportive, biblical group of Christians @ St. Andrews, living out their faith in real, tangible ways.  BUT we have stepped out and gotten involved to become part of this community of believers.  God is definitely at work here and our staff is supportive, genuine and desiring to serve both the congregation and the community. Remember, don't judge anything on your first visit --- give it three or four times before making a decision as important as a church home.  If you visited more than 5 years ago, give us another try - we have a new, younger pastor with good vision and maturity, lots of program options and in-depth teaching that's attracting a younger generation.  Hope to see you soon!  No church is "perfect" but that's why we're eager to go to heaven, right!? Is there enough room?  Looking from the outside, you see a building.  I see so many faces that I have known and so many still active in so many ways.  They are our stones of remembrance, good families, good strong people of God.  They are the bricks and mortar that I see.  We came as a family to St. Andrews because we were becoming spiritually dry in a denomination that we put our heart into every phase but that was the problem, we were tired of laboring with so many dead ends.  We needed more.  After many family conversations we started to attend St. Andrews.  We hadn't realized how much we were spiritually missing.  We have never changed in our minds but did change greatly in meeting  spiritual strength.  This was at a time of Kim Srutt's and Chris Strutt's and John Stylls  marvellous leading the youth and they warm my heart in the way they led to love and live for Jesus and that group became strong in their leadership..  Our Beth and Dave included.  And I see all of those young Pastors that started out in our church and went out to spread The Word at churches all over and in mission work.  Our church school has loved every child so much and given them meaning for life in knowing Jesus.  All our Senior Staff are people who know how to lead us to God and all those who have ever worked in our church were so loving and kind.  I am thrilled with the young married couples in our church who are exceptional in their raising up a beautiful family for God.
Do you want more?  Our family has more than 40 years worth.

name: St. Anne Catholic Church
St. Anne Catholic Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: Been coming here since 2018, my husband since 2016. This is where we met, got married, and baptized our babies. This church is our comfort, and our home away from home. If you are not familiar with the Latin Mass, and its rubrics and guidelines, I recommend you to do your homework, otherwise you might mistake a rule of theirs as being uncharitable when it is anything but. The dress code is posted near every door. I LOVE THIS CHURCH!!! Mass is celebrated in LATIN! How WONDERFUL . Everyone kneels in front of the church to receive Jesus in The Holy Eucharist! I am so grateful for this type of mass . Conservative dress attire, women cover head with a veil. They're stocked if you need them. A LOVELY BEAUTIFUL CONGREGATION.The Priests ARE SO REVERENT and NICE . This church practices the traditional Latin Mass. Check their website for the dress code. It is beautiful and I recommend you try it at least once. Parking is a problem, expect to walk and please be respectful of the neighbors. While all the other churches in downtown were closed. Not allowing people to come inside to pray in front of the tabernacle, St. Anne parish allowed the faithful to come inside to pray and meditate. The high alter is so beautiful and the statues of our Lord and the saints are breath taking! Thank you for opening your doors to the this humble servant to see Christ and to pray. I went to mass with my family on Thanksgiving at St. Anne's Church and we had a wonderful experience because Jesus is truly there. We didn't know it was going to be a Latin Mass, but the experience was different and beautiful. Most importantly we received the Eucharist. Thanks to our priests we can receive Jesus and all the sacraments that Jesus gave us. Pray for the priesthood do not attack them instead say the rosary for them they are not perfect. You are so special to Jesus. God bless you. The devil always wants to steal our peace. Be at Peace.

name: St. Anthony Claret Catholic Church
St. Anthony Claret Catholic Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary:
I would like to share some feedback about the recent Mass service. I truly appreciate the effort that goes into organizing everything, but I found the service to be quite long.
I noticed that the Mass was conducted in both English and Spanish during the same service, which made it longer than expected. I was wondering if it might be possible to have separate Mass times for each language, as this could help keep the services more concise and better accommodate everyone’s needs.
Additionally, some of the songs felt longer than usual, which also added to the overall length of the service.
Thank you for taking the time to consider this feedback. I share it with respect and appreciation for all that you do for the community I had the privilege of setting up a wedding this past weekend at St. Anthony. An absolutely beautiful church. Pristine and clean. The whole staff was incredible and extremely pleasant and professional and a joy to work with. They did an outstanding and amazing job in the reception hall. The fabric draping was remarkable. The chairs and table settings were perfectly placed. Thank you St. Anthony's! Came here for a service held for my grandmother. It’s a big church very beautiful. Abundance of parking. Nice sized tents. Nice congration and excellent priest. Also nice sound system. I took my mom for a pray-sesh. I waited for her outside. I witnessed a disheveled man harassing a few females: first one caught my attention because I heard him yelling (I couldn't make out what he was saying) at a elderly, petite lady. He kept saying "senora" (lady) and using an abrasive tone/decorum. The lady then ran away...within a few minutes (I was in my car w/windows down) I hear him harassing/bothering two ladies, older as well. He was bumbling, but I could make out: " senora!!" "Go!! Go!!" "Orita!!" (Right now). I then see him coming my direction.  I immediately turned my car on and rolled my windows up and he just proceeded to walk past me.
I looked around to see if there was security patrolling, and there was not. Which worried me bc my mom is elderly and goes to this church regularly.
Be careful, if you come to this church. Pay attention to your surroundings and carry something you can self-defend yourself with.

name: St. Anthony Croatian Catholic Church
St. Anthony Croatian Catholic Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
St Anthony’s annual Croatian picnic 2025 was amazing!!  Prepare yourself and come hungary!!  Delicious authentic Croatian food, drink , music and fun all in L. A.  It only happens once a year so check their website for 2026 tickets. We had our wedding at this beautiful Catholic church, and it was truly an unforgettable experience. The church itself was newly renovated and absolutely stunning, which made our ceremony even more special and meaningful.

Using the parish hall for our reception was incredibly convenient. It had everything we needed, from a well-equipped bar to a spacious and elegant hall that comfortably accommodated our 200 guests. The space was perfect for celebrating with our loved ones.

The staff at the church were exceptionally kind and helpful every step of the way, ensuring that both our ceremony and reception went smoothly. We highly recommend this venue for anyone looking for a truly wonderful Catholic wedding experience, from a sacred and beautiful ceremony to a fun and well-organized reception! Such a beautiful church! Found parking on the street and the people were very welcoming. The church is small but detailed with beautiful statues of our Lord and the Virgen Mary. I am a wedding coordinator, and let me tell you...this venue is so great to work with! From the time I was hired on by our couple and reached out to Roxanne & Marilyn [Venue Coordinators] it was seriously so simple! They are super accommodating and will try everything that they can to give the couple the wedding of their dreams. This venue is also absolutely gorgeous, and they are working on updating it as I write this. If you're looking for a venue that can hold a large guest count, has great staff to work with and is gorgeous....you found the right one! The event space at St. Anthony's Church was the perfect venue for my father's retirement dinner. The ballroom was the perfect size to host our 160 person party with plenty of extra space to spare. The small hall had a beautifully built bar and was great for cocktail hour prior to the event. The outside patio had space heaters and seating and was large enough for our catered taco guy to set up.

There is plenty of secured parking in the garage as well as street parking, security on site, and they also had a list of furniture available for use as needed (tables, chairs, cocktail tables, flatware, glassware, etc) which made was so convenient when planning the event. There was a great audio/visual setup for us to run a slideshow on a projector screen and tvs in the small hall and by the bar, our own playlist of music, and mic setup for speeches.

From start to finish, Marilyn (the venue event coordinator) and her team were incredibly accommodating, friendly, and worked so hard to make our night as seamless as possible. We couldn't have done it all without them! Big thanks to St. Anthony's and we HIGHLY recommend for anyone needing an event venue in the downtown Los Angeles area!!

name: St. Athanasius Episcopal Church at St. Paul's Commons
St. Athanasius Episcopal Church at St. Paul's Commons - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: St. Athanasius Episcopal Church at St. Paul's Commons is a truly wonderful place to worship. The community here is incredibly welcoming and kind. Fun and unique church with people who actually care about you and your walk with God. Come check us out say hi! Service starts @3pm every Sunday. Here on the 2nd floor This church is filled with the kindest, truest, wonderful people.  It's located right in front of Echo Lake.  I like to go paddle boarding after services. Always liked this church, the Episcopal Diocese always helping the poor and social causes feel good. I am a volunteer at the Foodbank every Friday 8 to 10am and on senior day every third Thursday

name: St. Barnabas Catholic Church
St. Barnabas Catholic Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Parking is never lacking. There is always plenty of parking on Orange Avenue right in front of the church.

Now, brace yourselves. The Priests accents are extremely difficult to understand and one of them likes to hold his parishioners hostage by keeping them waaaaay after Holy Communion, with extra long homilies, additional collections, and end-of-the-mass anniversary and birthday announcements.

I detest this. Mass is supposed to be a celebration of the Liturgy & Eucharist. Not a celebration of so-and-so's Birthday.

And don't even get me started on the 'encouraged' applause for these 'social' celebrations. The applause is irreverent and somehow detracts from the solemnity of the worship experience.

If you are looking for a social hall Sunday celebration, this is your church! Love this church. I felt so welcome and the staff is wonderful and warm. Farthers are very friendly and helpful. Enjoy the Sunday service. St. Barnabas is a great church with a caring staff and it has a school k-8. We love the community and the parish is made up of not just the community around the church but also the families of those who attend the school here. This is a beautiful and simple church. I love going to Jesus house my grandson would say.  I moved out of the city but still come to this church every Sunday. I feel home sweet home here, I can feel the holy spirit here. everyone is very welcoming, and the choir is awesome to listen to.  Sunday i do the rosary at 8 and mass at 9.

name: St. Barnabas Episcopal Church
St. Barnabas Episcopal Church - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary: St. Barnabas Episcopal Church in Eagle Rock is reopening its doors.  Lots of great things are happening - a community garden, yoga, dinner and Bible study, jump rope challenges, and a plan for a new pre-school.  Check it out! St Barnabas is my New home church home until  we rebuild St Mark s . Until then I will serve and worship there.  Eric Thom Loved hearing live music@The Harmony Room attached 2 Church. $15 cover, free donated fresh veggies & tomatoes to take with you. I'm diggin' it! Beautiful historic church with a lovely small congregation, thoughtful sermons, inspiring hymns led by talented musicians. I've been returning every Sunday since moving to L.A. Lovely California bungalow church, historic.  Photos are of the parish hall and don't do justice to this lovely historic sanctuary.

name: St. Bernardine
St. Bernardine - San Bernardino Campus
reviewSummary:
Quaint and welcoming church.  The priests that I met after mass was very warm and friendly.   Everyone was very curtious.  Surroundings were clean and plenty of parking as well. Good place to worship the Lord ...plus my mom Lydia plays the piano for mass I used to go here a lot for noon mass. I really liked it. Very peaceful.  Father Lenny is very nice. I have grown up in this church, been here for 18 years and everyone is so welcoming. They really are like family. There are both Spanish and English services in the weekend and mass during the week. Religious classes are low cost and they really help the community that surrounds them. I've been a member since the early 90s and I'm still an active member.
I enjoy its diverse community.
Is a small, although active community.
There are several ministries to become involved.
We have a two pastoral councils:
An adults' and a youths'
We have 7 choirs.

name: St. Bernardine of Siena Catholic Community
St. Bernardine of Siena Catholic Community - Woodland Hills Campus
reviewSummary: attended the 11:30 Holy Mass here last Sunday We Attend Wayly's 80 Birthday At Parish Hall Wonderful quiet garden to sit in prayer 🙏 We've been members for over 26+ yrs. Wonderful church with  an amazing sense of community. Beautiful and clean facilities. It really is the people that make the church alive. I have found them to be warm, friendly, caring and rooted in their faith. The parish also has a wonderful preschool and elementary school. All our welcome. Check out wonderful merchandises at our gift shop. The door knocker looks fabulous at our front door. Super friendly parishioners. A+ community. Check out Pre-school. My kids enjoyed their preschool fun @ St. B. The best of all. I met my college friend after 20+ years at St. B preschool when she took her son there for preschool education. How wonderful that God put everything and everyone in our path for our journey.

name: St. Bonaventure Church
St. Bonaventure Church - Huntington Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Beautiful Parish there is so many stained glass windows and the biggest one above the altar is quite impressive. The stations of the cross art is gorgeous one of the best I've seen. The Parish community is very active. Our parish truly feels like a special place. Every visit is a meaningful experience, filled with a deep sense of spirituality and peace. The church community is welcoming, and the atmosphere encourages reflection, prayer, and connection with God. It’s a blessing to be part of a parish that brings people together and strengthens our faith. Beautiful church, great sermon from the father, felt the presence of God through the Holy Spirit 🙏 Love the stain glass windows, Holy Water Cross, and Jesus statues. I enjoy praying here. Thank you. We went here today from out of town. They have late mass available. The proests were nice. The church kind of looks like our Parish church. It was air-conditioned.  Good service overall and nice music.It was a nice experience.  The parishioners and  priests were friendly and welcoming. We got parking free.

name: St. Boniface Catholic Church
St. Boniface Catholic Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary:
A beautiful majestic church in downtown Anaheim. Stain-glass windows tall steeple with active bells and masses at various times in English and Spanish make this a go to church in Anaheim. Parish School closed many years ago.  ✝️⛪️ St. Boniface Catholic Church is truly a beautiful and reverent place of worship. The church itself is stunning—so old, artistic, and rich in character inside. The Nativity scene was especially beautiful and thoughtfully displayed, adding so much meaning and joy to the Christmas celebration.
Parking was plentiful and very convenient, which made attending Mass stress-free. I was also very happy that they offered a 5:00 PM Christmas Mass—it made it possible for our family to attend without rushing.
A wonderful parish with a sacred atmosphere. Highly recommended, especially during the Christmas season. Wonderful little Parish I visited while going to Disneyland Resort in Anaheim california. I decided to come to this place and I found completed inner peace and Tranquility as I prayed my rosary. My wife and son were at the beach this day and I figured I would go around town and see what was outside of Disneyland and I found this nice little Parish clean well lit and open for prayers. People say it's not a nice neighborhood but personally where I've lived in Pennsylvania and Kansas supposedly they were not so great neighborhoods either. I believe this is a Working Class People and this is a working class person's Church like the kind of Catholic churches I attended and Pennsylvania and Kansas. Great little Parish wish I would have had time to come to a service but they were either early in the morning or they were later ones and it took me an hour to walk up there because I did not have a vehicle to drive. If I come back to Anaheim I would like to attend a mass great warm feeling and my beautiful cathedral I would come here again! My family and I attended mass yesterday at 6:30 pm.  This mass was in Spanish. Growing up in Anaheim, my family was devoted Catholics. I even did my first communion at Saint Boniface. Fast forward 10 years and I live in the Los Angeles area. My grandmother still lives in Anaheim and I accompanied her to church. I was definitely disappointed. The priest talked about Politics and Trump. I don’t want to hear how much money Trump has/ spends. I don’t want to hear about church allegations. Twenty minutes talking about fundraisers. I want to hear about Our Lord and Savior. Priest needs to work on his approach to his audience and having a more welcoming attitude.  Also, the echoing in this building is horrible.  This church needs to find ways to reduce echoing in the building, you can’t even understand half of the mass. Visited Anaheim and attended mass 6:30 am Sunday mass. I had a nice experience.

name: St. Boniface Catholic Church - Main Campus
St. Bridget of Sweden Catholic Church
St. Bridget of Sweden Catholic Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary: We went to a funeral there. I am not Catholic so its abundance of statues and saints does nothing for me spiritually,but I respect those who find comfort and the Lord there. Very welcoming parish!  Saturday English Vigil mass was sparsely attended, so no problem if you’re concerned about being too close.  Beautiful side altars!  Wonderful neighborhood church. Love the school and the teachers my daughters went there years ago. I volunteered many years there we are a real community. My nieces and nephew went to that school and now my grand nephews and nieces do also. They all felt very loved, thank you. This the first time for me ever rating a church. I am sad that its come to this, but it has. I have transferred to many Catholic churches within the past year. It always depended on if they had mass in person, the times the masses were available, how often there were confessions etc. In the middle of these transitions my parents would volunteer in these churches in various vocations: sometimes as lectors, sometimes part of the beautification committee or Eucharistic ministers. For the first time ever though one of my parents became a sacristan at the request of the pastor. And also for the first time ever, my parent was denied the right to volunteer after a couple of months of being a sacristan on the basis that there were to many "Spanish speaking volunteers". This is weird to me because the majority of the demographic of the church is mostly "Spanish speaking" as they so kindly put it. I would also like you to keep in mind that my parent also speaks English. I hope they realize that this is a discriminatory and humiliating act. I would also hope they realize that if they keep this up they will turn people away from the church. I apologize to the people who were not involved in this and find my comment a bit brash. However, this my truth and I am the one who had to feel the affects of these actions. Thank you and many blessings! My Son was baptized here as we have been members for many years. Praying with this Parish is beautiful, peaceful, and harmonious.  Very eventful and filled with the Holy Spirit. We enjoy every Sunday and Holiday here, AMEN!

name: St. Catherine Laboure Church
St. Catherine Laboure Church - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary:
Both of my kids attend St. Catherine Laboure School, and we couldn’t be happier with our experience! The school provides high-quality instruction, ensuring that students are challenged academically while also receiving the support they need to succeed. The teachers are dedicated, knowledgeable, and truly care about their students’ growth.

Beyond academics, the school offers a safe and nurturing environment. As a parent, knowing that my children are in a place where they feel secure and supported means everything. The sense of community here is also outstanding. Families, staff, and faculty are welcoming and inclusive, making it easy to get involved and feel connected.

If you're looking for a school that prioritizes education, safety, and a strong sense of community, I highly recommend St. Catherine Laboure! Great place to worship and practice your Catholic faith. Beautiful church , I used to come here when I was young. Now just came back for a sad visit due to a passing of my beloved nephew. This church has brought back too many memories that I had. Love coming here. Father Carpenter has help me out a lot! I am so grateful for my catholic cumminity. Very nice Catholic Church and you can light up real candles inside before covid.

name: St. Catherine of Alexandria Catholic Church
St. Catherine of Alexandria Catholic Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary:
We came here for a wedding ceremony yesterday and we had a good time. The church is very beautiful inside and they have decent amount of parking places. Their bathroom is not the best and I almost slip when I step inside since there was liquid on the floor. Their PA systems also had feedback while the priest was talking or someone was singing. This church is also next to a school so you might hear the school bells from time to time. A beautiful church and Newlyweds that I had the great pleasure of photographing here at this catholic Church.
Congratulations Samantha and Alfredo! Beautiful CATHOLIC Church. Feels like home!
🤗❤️🎶💒 Father Art, Father Christi, and Father Ephraim are such a blessing and Deacon John and his wife along w the best Usher in Riverside Robert make it so welcoming to come and worship together. We had a nice funeral mass recently. It was well organized and very well done.

name: St. Catherine of Siena Church
reviewSummary: A beautiful and highly reverent parish in Laguna Beach. Mass is wonderful. Extremely welcoming community and fantastic liturgical music.

reviewSummary:

Church has quite a few activities going on, including a school. Employees were very helpful with funeral arrangements and ceremony. A beautiful place. This is a peaceful catholic church, sit back and enjoy the peace Great church for any service & authentically beautiful architecture.

name: St. Clare Catholic Church
St. Clare Catholic Church - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary:
A beautiful Catholic Church in Canyon Country. The mass attended was beautiful and the priest was excellent and provided guidance in his homily.   I was captivated by the ceiling painted light blue with clouds. The altar and crucifix were unique and eye catching. The stations of the cross were very detailed and carved out of wood. The detail of the presentation of the church made the visit and mass very special and memorable. I have been attending Mass at Saint Clare Parish since 2011, and it has truly been a blessing to watch the parish grow and flourish over the years. The sense of community here is warm, welcoming, and deeply rooted in faith.
There have been so many beautiful improvements throughout the years, including the addition of the peaceful prayer garden dedicated to Our Lady of Guadalupe. It adds so much spiritual beauty to the parish grounds.
The church continues to nurture both spiritual growth and community connection. I am grateful to call Saint Clare my parish home. Beautiful church. I highly recommend to attend healing prayers on Mondays at 7:00pm (Spanish) or Tuesdays at 7:00pm . I visited St. Clare’s for the 9 AM service on Pentecost Sunday. It was very lovely. There is a wide variety of parishioners of all ages and backgrounds. The choir sounded amazing. The priest was welcoming and gave a nice homily. The church itself is very beautiful, with stained glass windows and smaller areas for prayer. They seem to be active in the community and have many programs available to their parishioners. I love going to St Clares, I am a parishioner there and I have been for many years. I love everything about this Church❤️

name: St. Clement Catholic Church
St. Clement Catholic Church - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary:
Great place. Sunday morning mass is very enjoyable. Always come with my family here Oh my goodness, one of the most giving food bank place.I have been to clean food, beautiful people beautiful Smiles. And yes, great food. If you are in need of food because prices are so high right now. He's sometimes find yourself in a fool bag. Don't be embarrassed or shy.  Feature family and this is a place to go Great 9am mass Fr. Wu (new priest) and parishioners are all very welcoming.
An added bonus was the delicious breakfast that was being served by volunteer parishioners to raise funds for this hidden gem by the sea!!! The perfect Catholic seaside chapel in Santa Monica, literally on the Venice Beach border. Great community. I really like this church, because people are very friendly.

name: St. Clement's By-the-Sea Episcopal Church
reviewSummary: A beautiful, welcoming church community. Outstanding choir and historic Spanish architecture.

name: St. Clement's By-The-Sea Episcopal Church - San Clemente Campus
reviewSummary: This little Oasis, by the sea, is a wonderful church and gathering spot for their breakfast and after our coffee at midnight meditations. A beautiful church. Home to my 12 Step meetings and a very welcoming and lovely church. Nice old church with great AA meetings I come here on Wednesdays for the CA meetings and it's a really good place! Great place for meeting and events

name: St. Columban Catholic Church
St. Columban Catholic Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: One of a kind RC church in Los Angeles. Very close to dt LA. Small but significant church for the surrounding communities. Non Filpino priests with roots/backgrounds from the Philippines. I saw mostly Filipinos attend this church with a few Caucasians and Hispanics.  Church helpers are very passionate about their works. Restrooms are available. Parking is abundant except during Simbang gabi, etc.Good English service and straightforward. Mostly Filipino traditions. Simple but the oldest Filipino church in Los Angeles. Far from the elaborate churches of the Philippines but it represents the humble beginnings of the community. We went to this church when we were in downtown LA. They had a dinner gathering in the basement and I think it was for Thanksgiving and they invited us. We had a great time and the people are really friendly especially the president which is the organizer of the event. We felt the Filipino hospitality at this church. The mass is in English so everyone can come and celebrate. Very welcoming Church. Get ready to be greeted no matter the gap between vists. Although a Filipino Church, Masses are in English with influence from the Columban Fathers. Arrive early for parking if you cannot walk. Candles are around 50 cents to 1 dollar. One of the older more historic of the Los Angeles Catholic churches. Nice place to visit.

name: St. Cornelius Catholic Church
St. Cornelius Catholic Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
This church is located in a nice long beach neighborhood, the souns speakers are great and the people at this church are very welcoming to new members and even visits, they are very caring, when it is time of comunión, all pass to receive either comunión or a blessing and all stay standing until last person has passed then all kneal, I was told is so that those that cannot take comunión don't feel bad being recognized as they remain sitted, so that is very thoughtful.   One must arrive early to mass because the parking area gets full quick and you will have to park outside in neighborhood streets surrounding the church, but it is a nice city and neighbors know it is church traffic, they are kind.  But wait, the best part is that there is Sunday confessions, Yup, you are reading correctly, there is confessions on SUNDAY after EACH mass!!!!  Nothing better than having churches do what they are suppose to do to bring the Lord's people closer to him.    You should visit sometime and enjoy the Blessings of the Lord with churches like this doing the Lord's work, to Serve his people in every possible way to help them save their SOUL!!! Wonderful church and great community feel.
Fr. Jay is amazing and I look forward to hearing him weekly Love St Cornelius very peaceful church clean too🙏🏻💐❤️ This is without a doubt the best Catholic Church I’ve ever been to. I went to Catholic schools and have been to many Catholic Churches in many cities . This place is SO welcoming, has great classes and the best priests . The music is beautiful, there is plenty of parking and lots of space ! I haven’t been able to find a church that’s holds a candle since I moved to Northern California. I miss this place with all my heart. Although I am not catholic, my wife, her father and my 3 kids are very active catholics. This is their parish and is very nice. I bring my 88 year old father-in-law to 5pm mass during the week.

name: St. David's Episcopal Church
St. David's Episcopal Church - Downtown Austin Campus
St. Denis Catholic Church
St. Denis Catholic Church - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
An absolutely stunning church, easily one of the most beautiful I have ever seen. The architecture and atmosphere are incredible, and it was an absolute honor to be able to shoot inside. Originally built in the pre-Vatican II style but since reconfigured to allow for more participation by parishioners, St Denis is a beautiful church, featuring lots of marble and stone. The courtyard is ample enough for large gatherings. The Eucharistic chapel is breathtaking and quiet. St. Denis Catholic Church is a true spiritual home, and it has earned my heartfelt five-star review. From the dedicated priests to the beautiful liturgy, it’s a place that genuinely nurtures the soul.

I’m especially grateful for the consistent access to the Sacrament of Reconciliation, with daily confessions offered Monday through Saturday (noting only occasional exceptions on Saturdays). This commitment is a tremendous gift to the community.

The priests are a remarkable blessing. Father John is wonderfully detail-oriented and has a constant, positive vision for improving the church grounds and parish life. Father Dennis provides a perfect balance—he is a profoundly warm and calming presence with a true gift for hospitality, even remembering the names of those who attend regularly.

The music ministry elevates the worship experience beautifully. The Sunday 11:00 AM choir is excellent, and the Young Adult choir at the 5:30 PM Mass is both skilled and spiritually moving to listen to.

Overall, St. Denis is a parish that clearly cares for its people through prayer, service, and a very welcoming atmosphere. I highly recommend it to anyone seeking a faithful and vibrant church community. Beautiful church ⛪️ not a local here & went here for Mass closer to place we were staying. Love my church father Denis is an amazing person ❤️ We just had my daughter's 16 . Connie was our singer and she had such a beautiful voice. It was amazing  what a blessing.

name: St. Didacus Catholic Church
St. Didacus Catholic Church - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband and I have been attending this church as members for a couple of years. When we got engaged, we enrolled in the parish's marriage preparation program and their Rite of Christian Initiation of Adults (RCIA) program to finish some of our missing sacraments. Deacon Dino Serafini prepared us and officiated our rite of marriage, and Elena Platas and Roman Becerra led our preparation to become fully initiated Catholics. All of them are some of the kindest and wisest people I've had the pleasure to meet. They are very welcoming and genuinely care about the people attending our parish.

We had ~160 guests on our wedding day, with lots of space for up to ~200 guests in the parish. We also had a live mariachi band play at our wedding. We opted for very minimal decorations, as the church is beautiful already. In all, we are very happy to have married at St. Didacus, and we look forward to continuing to attend this parish for years to come. I recently attended Mass at a church in San Diego County as part of my goal to visit different churches in the area. While I found it challenging to understand the priest at times, I appreciated the opportunity to experience the service and learn more about the church community. The community seemed very close-knit and welcoming. St. Didacus Church is a beautiful church with an outstanding staff. They scheduled my father's funeral mass on the first Friday of lent when no other Catholic church in San Diego would. The priest also volunteered to come to the burial site after the mass to bless the final resting place.
My mother still talks about how blessed we were to find St. Didacus. Thank you and God bless you. I had such a beautiful Christmas meditation at this shrine. I'm so grateful to the Church community for offering such a devotional and inspiring place. I was a parishioners of this church and attended regular mass. Their choir would sing an uplifting hym about community and family that kept me returning almost every Sunday just to hear them and learn more about the faith under Pastor Mike Senior.

name: St. Edward Catholic Church
reviewSummary: A traditional Catholic parish in Nashville with reverent liturgical worship and active parish life.

name: St. Edward the Confessor Catholic Church
St. Edward the Confessor Catholic Church - Dana Point Campus
reviewSummary:
My visit to Saint Edward the Confessor Catholic Church was truly uplifting. The Sunday Mass was celebrated in a sanctuary filled with a vibrant, engaged congregation that clearly forms the heart of this parish community.

The church grounds are absolutely breathtaking, with carefully maintained gardens that complement the stunning ocean views. Standing in the courtyard after Mass, watching the Pacific shimmer in the distance, provided a moment of peaceful reflection that perfectly extended the spiritual experience.

The Father's homily was thoughtfully crafted and delivered with genuine passion. He masterfully connected scripture to everyday life in a way that had the entire congregation truly reflecting on the message. You could tell he puts great effort into engaging with his parishioners, addressing real concerns while offering hope and guidance.

The warmth of the community was evident in how parishioners greeted each other before and after the service. This is clearly not just a place of worship but a true spiritual family.

Whether you're a longtime parishioner or just visiting Laguna, Saint Edward the Confessor offers both spiritual nourishment and natural beauty that feeds the soul. Highly recommended for anyone seeking connection to faith in a stunning setting.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​ My favorite church hands down and of course I am biased. I had moved around OC and attended many churches from Tustin to Dana Point but this church stole my heart. I had been coming for more than 10 years at some point and it still is my preferred church to go to whenever I visit SoCal.

It has ample parking, central location, great sermon, family mass, and beautiful backdrop for the cross … the cross just hangs so beautifully in the place of peace. I went to mass today by myself and felt very welcomed by the priest's sermon on gratitude. How wonderful to recommend living our life being grateful. I went to the pancake breakfast by the Knights of Columbus and sat alone. I was so grateful that Dan and Randy both came up and introduced themselves and spoke to me during my meal. I will be back again next week! We're so fortunate to have such wonderful clergy in this parish community.  The sermons are excellent and there is much fellowship. We are back!  Fr. Mike & the entire St. Edward team has brought back the vibrancy of our faith & parish by preaching the word so we can apply to our everyday lives. Masses are packed with young families & we continue to grow.  Come join us.  It’s amazing to be this close to God!

name: St. Edward the Confessor Church
reviewSummary: A beautiful Catholic church on a hill with a breathtaking view of the harbor. Mass is outstanding. Extremely active parish, great school, and very reverent liturgy.

name: St. Edwards Catholic Church
St. Edwards Catholic Church - Corona Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautiful peaceful place to be.I love the side garden area must 👀 see. Guadalupanos the area for Our Lady of Guadalupe is beautiful and peaceful. reviewSummary:
A few years ago, I discovered the St James concert series. I think, at the time, I was listening to the choral group Voces 8, when I found out they were playing there. I breathe heavy metal, but I'm also a sucker for baroque and the human voice and everything in-between. I thought to myself, "I've spent worse Sundays than being in La Jolla. Why not?" Traffic...is, but the more South you go, towards the church, the parking gets much easier, especially late afternoon.
I'm gonna say it. I don't think you will find a better musical experience for the money in San Diego. First, the accoustics are devine. Groups better be good to sing there because nothing slips by and nothing gets lost in there. NOTE: There are pipe organ concerts there as well. I can't speak for how that sounds, but I'll give it a listen, eventually. And congratulations to whoever does the lineup for the series. I've enjoyed every group I've seen there.
If you ask me, I think every music-loving San Diegan should try something completely different on a Sunday afternoon / evening and check this place out sometime. I think a lot of people will be really surprised. I shot a wedding here this past weekend. It's a very beautiful church, but there are a lot of restrictions for photography during wedding service. Outside of that, the staff and clergy are kind and polite. Very home-y.  A beautiful interior and a rich history.  Stanford men's choir sings here every year, among other frequent events brought held. I called this church a while back over the phone, and spoke with one of the male receptionist, and from what I gathered through our conversation, no compassion, no fruit of the spirit, very disappointed. I thought to myself, this is a bad representation of what followers of the word are displaying in these times!!!👎🏻 The Assembly of Daughters of the King held on May 21, 2016 was beautifully arranged and executed by Elena Luz, D.O.K. Chapter President
and her friendly assistants!  It was a lovely event from the food to the flowers and the inspiring speaker, the Rev. Monica Mainwaring.  Thank you everyone!

name: St. John Henry Newman Catholic Church
