reviewSummary: I was invited to Story City Church in 2020 ( Pandemic time) by my neighbors, a very nice couple who also had a wonderful spirit. When I visited Story City for the 1st time, I understood where and how my neighbors got their beautiful spirit. From the Pastor to All the congregation, they are beautiful, loving, kind hearted, welcoming, friendly, caring Christian. This church is a Home. They Pray, they have Bible study small groups, they have church events, The preached word is the truth, uplifting, spirit moving, Hallelujah Amen fulfilling. The songs they sang every Sunday create a room for spiritual praise and honor to God welcoming God’s presence. I’ve never, not one Sunday gone to Story City Church and Not been feed a Good word, greeted by welcoming friendly people, felt Gods presence, not enjoyed the songs and the service. The love you get and feel at this church is beautiful and Godly. They invite you in as family regardless of race. The neighbors who invited me were white, the people who invited me to their birthday parties, baby showers, house, dinner, book writers group, were white and black. The 1st day I visited as I was walking out a lady ran after me to greet me, welcome me,  introduced herself, talked to me,  prayed for me right then and there and gave me her number. I left that day so happy, oh and yes she was a white lady who is actually a celebrity still doing movies today. I can’t began to name the amazing people there because there’s not enough space here but just know this church has learned how to live as true Godly people with the love of God in their hearts.  They welcome everyone regardless of your race. I made friends and found them to be like family in and outside of my race and learned more about how God is while going to Story City. They are not a religious church they are a Godly Church. Preaching and teaching the true word of God. The Pastor Jarred is amazing. He studies the word and preaches it from the spirit of God, the anointing of the Holy Spirit. I don’t praise man, I praise God so I’m thankful for the good word that the pastor preached but Pastor didn’t just preach a good word. He prayed and taught and lived a good word. He didn’t act Holier than thou. He never claimed to be perfect, he preached Gods Word and always showed Godly love. I asked him for prayer and not only did he pray but he’s set up meetings to talk. It was easier for me to do zoom so we met on zoom. He listened. Then explained and he prayed for me. Amen. I joined the morning pray team that prays early before the service starts. Even they prayers blessed me. They didn’t Preach/ Pray, they prayed to Gods ears from their heart as ambassadors of Christ for the church for the Pastor for the service for the block for the city The praise praised team etc. AMEN.  I moved and I’m no longer there but I tell you I haven’t found another church like  Story City yet But I am still friends with a lot of people that I’ve connected with there because they are beautiful people from their soul and the spirit. If you’re Anywhere near Burbank, California Story City is a church to call home. Incredible gathering of people who deeply care about the community & sharing God's love! The sermons are Gospel-centered & the donuts are delicious. Kids have a fun, safe place to play, learn, & be known individually by passionate, fun-loving teachers. SCC thrives on welcoming newcomers & offers a life of joy through Jesus Christ! 😊🤗 I love this church. I love the Bible centered messages. I love the heart felt amazing worship lead by a variety of very talented people. My husband and I work with the elementary aged children at least twice a month and alternate with another couple who are amazing. My husband is diligent to study the scripture/story being taught and prepare the lessons in advance, and we plan fun activities to reinforce the lessons. It is a joy getting to know the kids and their parents, and sharing the truths of God's words with them. Stopped in from out of town and very much appreciated the kindness, friendliness, and sincere adherence to a scripture-based teaching.  Great church, I hope to stop back sometime. This place honestly makes moving to a diffrrent state with no friends or family super comforting and I can’t wait to meet and learn about everyone! I love love love love this church !

It's been 15 years since I committed to a church, and I won't be leaving any time soon! I love it so much I offered to volunteer, and I never volunteer for anything! A church that truly lives out grace.

This past Sunday was my first time attending Suncoast Community Church, and I was genuinely moved by the experience. From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed—not judged, not sized up—just welcomed.

The message was rooted in the story of the prodigal son, and the takeaway was powerful: You are not too broken. You are not too different. And it’s never too late.

Pastor Larry emphasized that the church is a hospital, not a courtroom—a place for healing, not condemnation. And that’s exactly what it felt like. The message was honest, heartfelt, and deeply grounded in grace.

Oh—and the band? Phenomenal. Seriously talented musicians who don’t just perform—they lead with soul. The music set the tone beautifully and made the whole experience even more powerful.

I’ve been looking for a place where I could reconnect spiritually without pressure or pretense, and I found that at Suncoast. Whether you’re curious, hurting, questioning, or simply searching for a church that leads with love, this is a beautiful place to begin again.

Highly recommend visiting—just as you are.

name: Tapestry LA
Tapestry LA - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
This church is for GenZ, young people. The church has so many members, about 400-500 people per each service.  But it's spiritual place and welcoming place. Many service volunteers are so happy and so bright. This church makes a welcoming and gathering evironment by proving donuts and coffee.  I can eat donuts and coffee every Sunday. I love this church. Praying team is awesome and spiritual.
Everyone is speaking English.
I noticed that more and more young people are attending this church and this church is getting culturally diversed.
There is free street parking on Sundays. i go to another church nearby but had heard great things about tapestry so i checked it out.

if you are looking for a congregation is largely younger (high school, college, and a big demographic in the 20s and 30s), then you will probably like tapestry.  no church can be all things to all people but i found the people welcoming.  the church is definitely on the modern side with modern worship, big production and a modern space.

if i had any criticisms or concerns for people who are looking to check it out, it would be the following.  bear in mind that these are preference issues and fundamentally i think very highly of the church, but these may be dealbreakers for you.

1.  pastor tends to speak very long...frequently over 60 minutes.  i didn't find the pastor to be very dynamic, but again, this is a preference issue.  as far as theology and content, the messages are very much on point.

2.  congregation is on the young side, and the demographic is largely asian.

3.  parking can be a little difficult in this part of DTLA and it's a little more run-down but then again, so is my church's area (i go to newstory LA).

if this appeals to you, check out their services on youtube for a sense of what they are like.  their channel is "tapestry LA church." This is the perfect church if you are looking for:

1. Experience. The main worship area is very dark to set the right mood. No lights for you to read your Bible. In fact, I was the only one with my Bible (paper kind) and I could not read it because it was so dark. I should have traded down my Bible for an iPad since that seems to be what everyone else had or their phones. Actually there was no need for your Bible since every passage was displayed on the big screen. Also right when you walk in, you're greeted by a huge coffee area giving you the feel that you're not at stuffy/traditional church but a hip coffee shop with cool merch. But hey, the proceeds go towards missions so it's all good.

2. Emotion. This church charges you up with great emotion. From the moment you enter their building music is blaring and you can't hear anyone singing. There is also skits and dancing before the sermon comes. An emotionally charged ballet dancer weeps off the stage as they try to visibly display the Philippians 4 passage about not being anxious. People around me were crying from watching the ballet performance. The crowd also got into the break dancing moves by the male ballet dancer. I just love it when there is break dancing at church!  Nothing gets me close with God like break dancing! Woot, woot!

The songs were also very emotionally driven by talented singers and band members. The songs were very generic about God and feeling. It could have been songs about any god since no mention of Christ or his atoning work for sin is mentioned. In fact, the songs seem to be vetted and carefully chosen to give you an emotional experience. Perfect for those who are looking for a pure emotional experience.

3. Eloquence. The pastor, Aaron Kim, was incredibly eloquent. He quoted Andrew Sullivan and Henri Nouwen, two openly homosexual Roman Catholics, waxing eloquent on their views about being still and quiet. The pastor spent more time quoting theologians and philosophers instead of explaining the meaning of the biblical text. Very impressive!

If you are looking for a place which will preach the Word of God, the gospel as the remedy for sin through faith in Christ alone according to the Word of God alone to the glory of God alone, look elsewhere. If you want the Bible with context, exegesis, and biblical exposition you will not like this church. Instead the sermon drips with worldly eloquence!

But if you're looking for emotionally charged, experientially inviting, and eloquent speakers - this is the church for you! They are very open and do not want you to be offended. They will make you feel very welcome and feel great. They are such a great church!, I thought I Will be out of place but the people at this church are very friendly and loving. I love rooted group and I will join cell group soon. They are a good community. Amazing Church in the Los Angeles area! The people are very welcoming and loving. Pastor Charles is a great man of God

name: Temecula United Methodist Church

reviewSummary:
Thank you for taking the time to share your thoughts and concerns about Temecula United Methodist Church. We value each voice in our community, and it’s important to us to engage in open and loving dialogue.

At our church, we believe that all individuals, including our LGBTQIA+ friends, are embraced by God’s love and are integral members of our spiritual family. Our affirming stance reflects our commitment to inclusivity, recognizing that everyone is created in the image of God and deserving of love and respect.

We understand that our celebration of diversity and our support for the LGBTQIA+ community may raise questions for some. However, we firmly believe that love and acceptance are at the heart of Christ’s message. Celebrating our LGBTQIA+ friends is not about condoning sin; rather, it is about acknowledging the beautiful diversity of God’s creation and the inherent worth of every person. I actually enjoyed the service and church. Can not give 5 stars due to my feelings on the "pride" celebration. All sin is sin but the open celebration of sin is a mocking of Gods word in my opinion. Not judging in condemnation, just an opinion. Love is not a sin, but openly celebrating what we do in private that is sin, is a mockery. The most welcoming and inclusive church in the area. name: TerraNova Church
TerraNova Church - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve been going TerraNova about 8 years and its a great church to be part of, the leaders are awesome and every week the message is new and fulfilling. I’ve made some great friends there and never feel judged or out of place. They are always offering new Life Groups to join and there are so many to choose from.  There is a little something for everyone at this church.   The Worship music is fabulous. We have been privileged to call Terra Nova our church home for the past 6 years. It is truly a come as you are experience. The worship band is incredible, and we learn something new in the message every week. There is something for every age if you are looking for a small group, the children’s ministry is amazing, and the women’s ministry is very active with so many fun activities to take part in. I have met such special women here.  The best part is knowing how well TN supports the community, local schools,  and many needs worldwide. A very generous, loving group to be a part of! Come check it out! We love TerraNova Church.  We had been searching for a new Church and tried several before going to TerraNova.  We new right away we had found our place. Pastor John's sermons feel like they speak directly to you and his passion and energy is sincere and inspiring. I started going to TerraNova when I moved down to Southern California, and it has been an awesome first experience as a newer follower of Christ! The small groups are all welcoming and becoming a part of serving the within TerraNova and the community is so easy. The sermons are in depth and give context, scripture, and perspective into changing habits to better align with Jesus’s teachings, and I have been able to share them with family members who are non-believers, and they are always interested! The pastors are very friendly and work hard to support, teach, and guide everyone who attends.
The youth ministry is also super epic, and I’ve gotten to work with the Junior Highers with their leader ( shout out to Doah!) who is probably one of the coolest dudes. He keeps the middle schoolers engaged and interested in the lessons and supports them into growing into their own faith and being able to defend difficult topics.
The band is also phenomenal and are very down to earth. When I first attended I was brought to tears by the music and was shocked to learn that some of the songs are originals from the worship singer!
Very good stuff. Basically if your thinking of going to a church with strong community, and your a parent, a single parent, a young adult, an older individual, or are a first timer like I was, this is the place to be! TerraNova is a community filled with genuine and friendly people who are very welcoming and committed to making a difference. After visiting several different types of churches in the area, TN stood out the most and remembered my name after 1 visit! Plenty of small group options available and opportunities to give back to the community. If you are still searching for a place to belong, it's worth the visit.

name: Thanh Le Church
Thanh Le Church - Stanton Campus
reviewSummary:
This church has both Vietnamese and English-speaking congregations, which creates a welcoming and diverse community. It became my home church after I married my husband, and I feel incredibly blessed to be part of it. The love, biblical truth, and genuine care demonstrated by the pastors, elders, and members are evident in every interaction, regardless of age or stage of life.

The church offers many small groups for Bible study and fellowship, as well as opportunities to participate in local and international mission trips. One thing that I don't often see at other churches is the SALT program (1:1 discipleship), which has been beneficial for my spiritual growth and walk with God. A church that preaches the truth of God’s Word with love. The community is welcoming, genuine, and truly feels like family. A place to grow in faith and fellowship! Great place for gathering for worship.

name: Thanksgiving Church Lifepoint Ministry
Thanksgiving Church Lifepoint Ministry - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary: Been a member at this church for nearly 8 years! Community can be a little exclusive in the high school and college ministries,  but I always loved the pastors and teachers growing up! Lifepoint (the adult ministry) on the hand is wonderful. Very friendly from the beginning to now :) Pastor James has also been an amazing speaker! Loved all his messages since EPIC ministry! If you are looking for a church, I'd recommend you try a visit I've been a member of this church for 13ish years. I started in the high school ministry back when Pastor James Myoung was leading it and was also a part of the college ministry in the last year with Pastor Scott Oh and then a year with Pastor Tom Taylor. Now I've been with lifepoint with my husband for about 3 good years. I think all the years leading up to the recent last two years I was able to find a good community of strong believers where we could uplift and speak God's truth into the lives of each other. People were so much more active back then with outreach, bible studies, hangouts outside church, etc. Unfortunately now, I can say it's not the same as what it used to be. Seems like a lot of the good pastors within the English speaking part of the church are leaving because of low pay or because of disagreements with the Korean congregational part of the church. As a whole, the church feels a lot more divided. Much of the members seem also very comfortable hanging out more with the people they know than willing to be around new members or those within the church they haven't gotten to get to know yet. Many are also very reluctant with excuses to why they can't come out to events, hangouts, lifegroups, volunteer, etc. I'm guilty of that sometimes as well. Lifepoint (the English adult ministry) preaches about being one body, but the community doesn't feel like one body. Anyone reading this, whether you were visiting or once came here and felt this way, you weren't alone in that feeling. I can only hope the community in this church changes for the better in the future. Very good church good for both Korean and English and very together especially in youth groups Great church full of holy people.      Caring and do food donations Great church and amazing people. I really like this church

name: The Allen Chapel AME Church of Riverside
The Allen Chapel AME Church of Riverside - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary: Mt. Rubidoux trail has the most beautiful sights. A gorgeous peaceful stroll that leads you to the top of the peak where a beautiful cross stands tall. Lovely service. My family and I felt comfortable and welcomed from beginning to end. The sermon was invigorating and the music was inspirational. We will definitely return! I love my church it's always a peaceful place to be and a great amazing church to hear the amazing word of God the pastor and his family and the congregation are so welcoming and give you a open arms church and family love Allen chapel of Riverside. Pastor Barry Settle and Pastor Rochelle Settle and the Allen Chapel family are very caring people. They truly represent the love of God. I had a great time visiting this church.. And we had a wonderful service and I even like the pastor like the pastor.

name: The Anchor: Calvary Chapel San Pedro
The Anchor: Calvary Chapel San Pedro - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary: About the praise music: Psalm 33:2,3 Psalm 98:4-6 Psalm 150:3-5 tells what one expect when you show up Sunday mornings.  Music fit for a King! (NKJV)  Free parking on 7th St Excellent church. Bible-based and Pastor Jerry is a great pastor. Teaches from the Bible line-by-line. Also other great ministries to be in like Women's Bible Study and other groups. If you want or need Jesus in your life, try Calvary Chapel San Pedro out. You'll be glad you did. Right in downtown Pedro. God bless 🙏 A church for everyone. Pastor Jerry teaches the Word, the whole Word and nothing but the Word in such a way, that it ministers to everyone.  I pray that no one leaves the service, without feeling they have been in the presence of God.  I pray that everyone who hears Pastor Jerry's message, receives and learns exactly what God is speaking to them through CCSP.  I am amazed at the growth of the church, in number and in the Word.  They wholeheartedly reach out to the community, to be a blessing where ever they can.  I would be a front pew member, if I lived closer.  I enjoy the services online when ever possible. This church is awesome. Pastor Jerry is a really good teacher. The woman's ministry is doing great things. They have a awesome worship team too. I highly recommend going to one of there services. CCSP is a great church. It is bible based. The pastor, Pastor Jerry, goes verse by verse. The church is 3 yrs old in June. My husband and I discovered it almost 2 years ago and we love it.  The women's ministry is great ,we have a bible study twice a week. The children's ministry actually teaches your kids and doesn't just baby sit them.  The mid week study gets in depth. Again Calvary Chapel San Pedro is a great bible believing and bible teaching church. I highly recommend it

name: The Apostolic Church International - Riverside Assembly
The Apostolic Church International - Riverside Assembly - Corona Campus
reviewSummary: God is truly in this place. Prayer house and a warm and loving family. If you love prayers, then be part of us.

name: The Awakening Church
The Awakening Church - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary:
Great house of the Lord! Worship was awesome! Big place , fill with friendly believers . The wifey and I are still on our surch for our new church. I can not say enough good about this church  and the people who are a part of it. They are great people inside and outside of church

I moved to California from out of state and this place has made me feel as if I have family out here.

Services are great whether you have been a long long church goer or newer as I am.

Very kid friendly services as well. A Fellowship where the family of God can grow in the power of God's love demonstrated in the Son directed by the Holy Spirit's opening of your heart and mind acording to Gods word. Come and see! This was the first church I went to when I got saved. Pastor Kerry truly is a man after God's heart. His sermons are solid and biblical. The only reason I didn't stay was because I moved outta state. The pastor gives Biblical, applicable, well thought out sermons. He starts with a topic, theme or question & his whole sermon revolves around his chosen topic.
The worship music is beautiful & the site is clean, welcoming & comfortable. For Thanksgiving, people who were part of the "Rooted" group Bible studies held up placards in front of the congregation, one by one, to share what their involvement in "Rooted" did for them. It was powerful! Music played in the background & they didn't say a word. It brought tears to my eyes. He keeps non-believers in mind & does a weekly invitation to accept Jesus as Savior.

name: The Bethel Church
The Bethel Church - Jacksonville (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
It was a great first time experience. And you can tell the spirit, was there. I would definitely return. My cousins homegoing celebration was held here recently, as well as my late Aunts over a year ago. All I can say is "Won't he do it! Amen
Great place to worship with a warm loving and friendly atmosphere from beginning to end. You will definitely get biblical teachings and a powerful word from God, every time. And that's the Bethel Experience. I love so much your preaching and teaching the words of God. It's helpful for all congregation. Great service! The word of God is preached. Large sanctuary with a balcony. Ushers are available to assist you in finding a seat. The parking area is large,  Children church is available.  A separate teen service is also available.  Many ministries are available, from outreach to grief.

name: The Branch Church
The Branch Church - Arcadia Campus
reviewSummary:
This is my home church and I just love it. It is small but the people are so warm and welcoming. They don't care your color, race or what language you speak, they will welcome you with open arms. The service is done in English and praise and worship are also in english. The music is amazing and I have been blessed every week. From the first day I walked in the doors I was welcomed with open arms and I felt like the people there were already my family. Everyone I have met has been very kind. This church already feels like home! The music is possibly my favorite part! The band is great and leads us through a worship experience. I really like the fellowship time afterwards too. The preaching every week is engaging and heartfelt. The message is Biblically based, applicable to daily life, and encouraging. This is such an awesome church and I'm excited to be a part of this church as it grows! Amazing community of young people that praise and worship God. Its a non denominational church that welcomes everyone 💗 it's not your ordinary boring fellowship place, you will be greeted by Groot from guardian of the galaxy at entrance then feel free to get your caffeine fix ☕
If you want to experience the presence of God and being renew in your spiritual needs just stopby for their sunday service at 10.30am. Trust me not, you will enjoy the praise and worship, got your spiritual stamina refilled for the week, meet bunch of talented people and as bonus: fun and friendly fellowship with yummy lunch afterwards 👍🏼
Follow the signage to get to the parking lot at the back and or there's plenty of street parking. Come and hangout with us 👍🏼💗 Praise the Lord we have The Branch Church for our family. Love the humble and hospitality leader. A very welcoming church. Great for for all ages 🙂

name: The Bridge
The Bridge - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
The Bridge Church has truly become our second home. My family and I have been attending since the fall of 2020, and it has been life-changing. We’ve grown closer to Jesus and developed a deeper relationship with Him, thanks to the amazing community and family we’ve gained by being a part of this church. It’s a place where we feel welcomed, supported, and spiritually renewed.

Pastors Mark and Rachel are incredible stewards and examples of faith, love, and leadership. We’re so grateful for their guidance and for the way they reflect Christ’s love in all they do. The Bridge Church in Chino has been an incredible blessing for me and my family. The minute you walk in, you feel genuine love and warmth from everyone around. The worship experience is powerful, and the messages are always insightful, relatable and grounded in scripture. There’s a strong sense of community. The Bridge truly makes you feel like family, where everyone is welcomed with open arms. The Bridge has genuinely helped in the transformation of my life. My experience at the bridge has been nothing short of amazing and has strengthened my walk with Jesus. I am truly blessed to call The Bridge my safe place, and home. Thank you to Pastor Mark and everyone at The Bridge Chino. The Bridge Church is truly a blessing to the Chino community from the moment you walk through the doors. We were welcomed into a warm and inviting atmosphere. Everyone feels valued and seen no matter where they’re coming from or what season of life they’re in.
The pastoral team is fantastic with teaching that is biblically sound and relevant. The children’s ministry is vibrant and inclusive.

One of the things I appreciate most is the Bridge’s commitment to truly building a community and creating personal relationships. Through missions, small groups, youth programs, courses, trainings, and service opportunities, they prioritize plugging in and making an impact.

If you’re looking for a church in the Chino Valley that combines solid teaching with genuine community, I highly recommend joining us at The Bridge Church.  It’s more than a place of worship. It’s a place to personally connect and equip our purpose. If you’re looking for a Christ centered, fun and friendly church with an awesome diverse community of loving people, The Bridge is the church for you. My wife, two daughters and I have been attending for over 2 years and we love the Pastors, amazing worship, kids ministry and the people! What we love the most is how the Holy Spirit moves in every service. Pastor Mark and Pastor Brock are wonderful teachers and are so intentional about allowing the Holy Spirit to guide their sermons. We are beyond grateful for The Bridge! Blessings.

Edgar Sorelo We use to attend Calvary Chapel Diamond Bar and decided to leave when the Pastor started discussing politics. We then went to The Bridge and from the moment you step in you feel welcomed and loved. The Bridge is an amazing place where all the sermons are biblical. Every sermon, class or activity is intentional. We have been attending for over 2 years now and definitely will not be going anywhere else. The Bridge is home for our spiritual needs. You will not regret joining.

name: The Bridge Bible Fellowship
The Bridge Bible Fellowship - Woodland Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
As a privious Muslim who has been
saved by Jesus my origional Church in West covina was a training tour to prepare me for home at The Bridge Bible Fellow ship Church. I wake up every day asking myself
IS IT SUNDAY YET? This church publically shames innocent people without getting their facts straight. How can this church say someone is not saved without giving both sides?  I thought if you have accepted Jesus as your Lord and Savior you are saved.  How can this church say you are not?  When did they become God?  Only Jesus knows a person’s heart!  To publicly shame someone knowing only one side is despicable! I've attended this church since 2001 with my family. This is a practical, Bible-teaching church full of genuine people who care about each other and desire to grow in their love for Jesus together!!

Our worship pastor does a great job with the music as well!! Always a good mix of contemporary and classic hymns, something for everybody, Great church!   Awesome expository preaching and teaching.. plenty of opportunities to serve Christ!   We have Bible counseling, teaching,  youth services and much more!!              Come worship with us and learn more about our precious Savior!! I just started doing online and following.  Christian and bible based.  New pastors there  enjoying the teaching  revelation.
Great local church.  Encouraged by it already.

name: The Bridge Church
The Bridge Church - Corona Campus
reviewSummary: Great church, Pastor Scott is 100% dedicated to God and to serving the community of Corona and beyond. If you’re looking for a church, bible study or just wanna stop by and visit with your extended family in Christ you should definitely come and visit. I feel the Holy Spirit here. Solid fact checking truths from the bible delivered to you in a simple yet effective way to give feet to your faith. I love the Pastor he helps his church in all that we need. Everyone is so loving and kind and has helped me overcome many battles and also helps me to know God for who He really is and how great His love is for us! Great place to worship. Pastor Scott always has a great message and the worship team is amazing. Very friendly family of believers. Great Wordhip and right on teaching of the word. We have come 4 weeks, loved the pastor & so many friendly people, young & older.  ❤️🙏☝️

name: The Bridge Church - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary: Absolutely The Best Church on the Planet!! Pastors Gary, Zach Martin, and youth Pastor Cory are such Wonderful Pastors. They now have 3 Church services every Sunday and the Praise and Worship at the Beginning is Awesome!. I've been attending The Bridge Church Murrieta for 16yrs now and It's My home. I highly encourage all who are looking for a Great home to worship. You'll absolutely Love it This church is an absolutely amazing place! Very welcoming and the pastors do a great job of helping everyone stay connected and closer to God. Thank you Zach, Gary and Cory for helping me on my journey in life! You guys have truly made a huge impact on my family and I’s life. Wonderful people, Pastor Ryan brings the Bible to life and the worship music is fantastic.  Absolutely incredible children's classes and infant care. Such a welcoming and awesome church. We had been looking for awhile when we came across The Bridge. Our kids love it and so do we. The Pastor and his Wife are amazing people as well as the staff. The kids rooms are super cute and they have so much for them to do. The Pastor also recognizes Military personnel and their families which is very cool. I’ve been there in the church for many years. I moved out of Temecula and I always remember the friendly people who help me through my first years of Christianity.. so grateful Pastor Gary is amazing also Pastor Ann, very loving and kind people🙌🏻

name: The Bridge Church - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary: As a single mom and disabled veteran I've gone back and forth with churches and what I believe...That being said The Bridge is hands down a 5 star place to celebrate and love God and the bible! I've had my struggles and before ever setting foot at a service Pastor Greg and the church were there for my children and myself! I love these guys and appreciate they truly love the lord play awesome music (Dylan and Bobby kill it together), and the fact this church is there for the right reason and not for the $$$$!!!!! Check them out I promise you wont br disappointed I just wish I hadn't moved away Pastor Greg teaches us the word of God.  The music is fantastic and great people attend! Very caring people. Bible oriented sermons & I like spending Sunday mornings hee. Caring. Inclusive. God loving ppl who share the works of the Bible.

name: The Bridge Church Pasadena
The Bridge Church Pasadena - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary: Amazing church!!! Such a family feel, super welcoming and feels like home the first time you walk in. Have been attending for about 6 months now and I am so glad we found this little gem!! If you’re looking for a smaller church that feels like a tight knit community this would be a great place for you! Also, the pastor is very intentional about leading the congregation to grow deeper, so this is a great place for spiritual growth if you’re looking for something more than the average surface level Christianity. I was at Bridges Church on Christmas Eve, and I LOVED being there. The whole service was so uplifting and the people were so soul-soothing. Pastor Dennis gave us valuable things to consider daily, and there was a dynamic lady doing an awesome spoken Word. I thoroughly appreciated all the ministry staff and their offerings. I do plan to go back.😍 Pihop Monthly Meetings are here and loved the lay out of the church.... Nice people. Great visit while in town. Community here is amazing.

name: The Bridge College Ministry
The Bridge College Ministry - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: Awesome south OC Christian college group. These people love Jesus and love one another!

name: The Burbank Church of Christ
The Burbank Church of Christ - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary: We traveled to Hollywood on vacation and wanted to attend church before heading back home. We are members of a Church of Christ church in our town, so we search for a CoC in Hollywood and came across this one. It's a small congregation, but worth attending. Everyone was so welcoming and nice.  They made us feel at home. Definitely will be back when visiting Hollywood again. Visited LA and delighted to find a faithful church of Christ which worshipped God in spirit and in truth. 5 acts of worship including acapella singing. We were thrilled to find the Lord's church near Hollywood as we were on vacation.  These Christians follow God's will for His new testament church. Godly people doing the Lord's work. Great church to develop a personal relationship with Christ. This is a place blessed by God. And It is where my soul can live.

name: The Calling Church
The Calling Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary: Went to Christmas Eve or candlelight service. Really nice. The people right off the bat we're welcoming. Before the service started, they had a hot coco station. Awesome,  I love hot coco! It was just the right amount of water to coco, too. Made my day, even had marshmallows, the tiny ones! What way to start candlelight service. I felt so good. The production was cute. Had the kids in it. Great music, sincere heart for the people. I enjoyed myself, but the best was the smiling kindness! I love it! Morning worship is fantastic. I love their songs. You can feel that God is there. Pastor Michael Alfaro is a real down to earth guy that you can relate to. I love the way he preaches. He is not boring. I relate to his messages. Very welcoming, makes you feel good and acknowledge besides friendly. Great church nice people. Enthusiastic yet knowledgeable pastor. Emphasizes learning the Bible, what it means and how to apply it to our lives. I like that politics are in no way involved. Neither side is emphasized die to the fact that it's the Bible and the word that are important not politics. Highly recommend . They have services broadcased on you tube as well. Amazing church!!  Pastor Mike with his wife, Corine lead a phenomenal church community with wisdom,  knowledge,  and passion!!  They are personable and keep church fun.   It is a smaller,  yet very supportive community. One of the best churches in Southern California. The people here are so genuine and Jesus centered. It's totally worth a try. I totally recommend this church

name: The Campus Community Church (C3)
The Campus Community Church (C3) - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a church that inspires you to be the best version that God has intended for you to be. Being a part of this church for 4 years, I have seen myself transformed mentally, and spiritually in ways that only God can receive glory for.

As a man, finding community can be difficult, and even more so as a married man. But, this church makes space for me and the community of men here are excellent in their own right. The pastor preaches from the heart, the culture of the church pushes for discipline and growth, and an air of accountability and love is concentrated here!

If you're interested, and want to take the next step in your faith or simply interested in what we do. Please  swing by our church and we would love to get to know you!!! I first heard about this church through a friend who invited me to Bible study, and I was learning so much that it eventually just made sense for me to make the switch. Coming to this church is truly one of the best decisions I've ever made.

Pastor Bullus and Pastor Vebiang Gago are true "do as I do" leaders, the Spirit of God is alive at C3, and the people are so warm and welcoming. There's a sincerity here and a real hunger to know God more deeply that you can feel. There's no other church for me. I genuinely love it here, and my deepest desire is that more people get the chance to be reintroduced to Jesus through this community. I love my church! If you are looking for a church where you can encounter God, grow spiritually, and build community. The Campus Community Church (C3) is the place to be. Attending C3 has been life-changing and I look forward to going to church every Sunday! This isn't church as usual. If you're looking for a place that teaches the actual word of God with sound doctrine, a place you will grow in your spiritual giftings, a place with great worship and genuine people, then look no further. C3 welcomes you!! Best way to explain C3….it’s a place where heaven meets earth.  The worship and the word are 🔥 and the people are SO friendly.  Proud to say this is my church.

name: The Cathedral of the Assumption
The Cathedral of the Assumption - Main Campus
The Cause Church | Brea
The Cause Church | Brea - Brea Campus
reviewSummary:
VERY charismatic church. I’ve watched someone allegedly pray in tongues on the stage (with no interpretation), and I’ve heard phrases like “we release the Spirit (which seems very much like the tail is trying to wag the dog). If you’re trying to get the “feels,” then this is your spot. I sincerely pray that those who really care about the Lord and His people will consider what it is that they are doing, and examine whether these things are what He wants. Pastor Jenny delivered an amazing message today. I felt God really spoke to me and my family. God bless my home church and my pastors. 🙏 Wonderful place! Great in every way!! So grateful for the Cause!

Wonderful Easter service! Loved the Cause Kingdom Business Dinner! My best friend invited me and Was awesome. Spent few good hours self development and gaining valuable information! The cause church is such a blessing to Brea, La Habra and surrounding communities. This church is a great one! Keep up the good work family!

name: THE CHAPEL at Pasadena
THE CHAPEL at Pasadena - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
This church has been such a great fit for me. I recently moved to Pasadena from NY, and the community is great. Above this though, the pastor faithfully preaches God’s word, and they make a great effort to explain and apply the Bible for our lives. This is the first church I’ve chosen to go to for myself since moving away from my parents, and I couldn’t be happier here! Each service biblically addresses a passage of scripture and how it applies to our lives, rather than the alternative picking-and-choosing scriptures that fit what we want to hear. I have been genuinely welcomed with smiles and meaningful conversations every Sunday, and grown in deep relationships with peers and mentors ever since my first time coming. I am so happy to call The Chapel at Pasadena not just my home church, but my home! I'm a single dad with two kids age 7 1/2 and 6.  It took me a long time to find a church where my kids felt comfortable and enjoyed going AND where I had the community and solid teaching that I needed as well.  When I heard that my friend of 17 years and my girlfriend just so happened to be going to the same small church in Pasadena, I had to check it out.

I personally needed a church that was theologically solid, preaching from the text and not jumping around scripture to make people feel comfortable.  I also needed a place that had transparent and authentic community where I could be imperfect and flawed and still feel like I fit in.  This church fulfills both needs wonderfully.

My kids also very quickly found friends there and often don't want to leave.  It's the first church we've been to out of half a dozen where the kids are excited when I tell them it's a Sunday and we're going to church!

As you can imagine from being a single father, I have a rough and messy past and that has never ever been a problem when connecting with people here.  Even though it's a reformed, sola scriptura church, there is no judgment for those that come in with some scars and baggage.  That's incredibly refreshing.  Come visit the church this Sunday.  It may just be the (imperfect but genuine) community you've needed for a long time. Very welcoming and loving church that teaches the gospel and tries to live it in everything they do.  Being a part of this church has changed my life for the better. Love the openess and sincerity of fellow worshippers and pastor of this church. A Bible-focused message and strong emphasis on community groups to grow in our walk with the Lord.

name: The Church at Channelside
The Church at Channelside - Tampa (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: What a special experience  I had at this place last Sunday. HOLY SPIRIT filled Church  no doubt. Preaching straight out the Bible word for word and from the heart. Couldnt have asked for a better home Church to be apart of. Don't get me started with the outreach work in the community their doing too . A Spirit filled woman named Lily is a big part in uplifting the needing in the area. I can't wait to roll up my sleeves and make a difference with them . Made me feel a piece of Heaven and the Worship 🎶 Music got me pulled closer to our Heavenly FATHER. Can't wait to go again next Sunday !! What a beautiful Church!! We were in Tampa during Easter (Did not realize it was so early this year - we are from Ohio) and we were looking for a Christian (Christ) based church.  Holy Cow!  We found the Church at Channelside in the Embassy Suites across from our hotel.  What a welcoming group of Christian brothers and sisters - young, mid-life, and old.  The message was all about Christ, in this case, about Peter and his take on the resurrection before and after.  What was really great was how at the start, a young woman explained to everyone, in simple terms what Easter and the resurrection as about.  The pastor gave a great sermon that really showed, through the eyes of Peter, how we are forgiven.  I cannot say enough about this wonderful group of believers and the Holy Spirit working through them to deliver the message.  Thank you, Church of Channelside, for delivering God's word on this day of our Savior's rising. Your praise team sang the song "Jesus paid it all" and I will finish with these lyrics that they sang:  "Oh praise the one who paid my debt. And praise this life up from the dead".  May God continue to bless this community of believers. When I moved to Tampa a few months ago, I really wanted to find a church that was easy to connect with and passionate about serving the community in impactful ways. From the start, this church welcomed me beyond what I expected. It was an instant genuine sense of home. Building relationships here has never felt like work, because everyone is actively and selflessly investing in each others’ lives. Growing with this church has been an incredible blessing. This is an amazing new church right in the heart of Channelside. I've had the opportunity to sit down with the pastor and leadership team of this church and they are an incredibly genuine and welcoming bunch. In addition to being a church that is focused on biblical values and teaching, I've also admired the many ways that I've seen members of this church out and about serving the community - from street cleanups to port support for tired and weary crew members, and everything in-between, this church really cares about our city and it shows! The Church at Channelside is truly such a special part of Tampa for me. Pastor John, his wife Shea, and all of the members at TCAC do a phenomenal job of fostering community. One thing I really love about the church is how they truly meet everyone where they are at. From the Alpha class that is geared towards new believers or non-believers with questions about faith to church membership and the CORE team for devoted Christian members who want to volunteer their time serving the community and the church family. I have found so much love and peach at the Church at Channelside! It is also right in the heart of the channelside area/Downtown Tampa, making it very easily accessible and walkable.

name: The Church at Rancho Bernardo
The Church at Rancho Bernardo - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary: This is a great church that treats everyone like family. Pastor Jared's messages are biblically based and have challenged and convicted me and really caused me to grow in my faith. He and the rest of the team on staff are amazing! This church has truly blessed my life in good times and hard times. The men's Bible study groups are awesome here as well! CRB truly feels like home. From the moment you walk in, you are welcomed with genuine kindness and a sense of community that is hard to find. The messages are meaningful, the worship is uplifting, and there is a strong focus on faith, family, and serving others. It’s a place where you feel supported, encouraged, and spiritually refreshed every week. We are so grateful to be part of such a wonderful church family. My family and I have been attending CRB for almost 4 years now. Although it was a little intimidating at first attending a bigger church than we were previously used to, we immediately found a home in CRB. The scriptural messages from Pastor Jared and the rest of the pastoral staff spoke to all of us personally. So relevant and current. We look forward every Sunday to hearing from them. There are also so many ways to quickly and naturally get involved in the church. From Men’s Ministries, Bible studies, cooking circles, and even a pickleball group, opportunities are everywhere to surround yourself with like-minded people all seeking a closer relationship with Jesus. Jesus is truly the center of this church, everything from the worship to the message, always points to his love and grace. Pastor Jared has a true go first heart for seeking Jesus and always leads the church with passion, true faith in Jesus, and grace.  The worship team is unlike any other church I’ve been to, every Sunday you cannot help but feel the presence of God in the room. This is a welcoming church, a spirit filled place to grow in your faith, and a true community of God. Love calling Church at Rancho Bernardo my home! Since first day I attended a broken man, the Worship, the messages from Pastor Jared and Pastor Josh, and being a Go First Church have allowed me to grow and experience the love that Christ has poured over me!

name: The Church at Rocky Peak
The Church at Rocky Peak - Woodland Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a GREAT church for people to hear the good news and messages of Jesus!!!  The Pastor Michael Yearley is so incredibly caring and loving with his attendees... and has a beautiful way of explaining Christianity and what is required of a true servant of God.

The location and the church itself are beautiful too... but that is not the reason for going there... it's the community!!!  The people who attend this church are the BEST people!!!  They have both Saturday evening services and two Sunday morning services.

Coffee, tea, water donuts and bananas are made available for attendees.  Come by... join the community of people who are committed to Jesus!!!  Come meet the pastor who makes himself available... along with so many other resources to those who need it.

I myself was Baptized on 2/21/26

#MakeHeavenCrowded
🙌🕊🩸✝️🙏❤️🥹 My father passed away recently, and our family asked to hold his funeral at this church — the church his family has attended for generations. We've tithed for years, paid preschool tuition here, and have personal relationships with the executive pastors.

The financial administrative assistant refused us. We weren't "members."

Then we mentioned we'd be making a donation. The refusal vanished immediately, and suddenly she was happy to help.

That's the whole story. Our family's decades of faithfulness meant nothing, but a check changed everything in a single conversation. We had to buy compassion from a church, during the worst week of our lives.

The funeral will happen, and I'm glad my father will be honored where he belongs. But if you're considering this church for your family — especially for the moments when you'll be at your most vulnerable — know how we were treated when we came to their door in grief. I worked very hard to find a church that truly felt like home. I previously was a Catholic, but after having many questions about my faith, I stepped away and began reading the Bible daily for myself. I visited several churches in my area, but I never felt completely at home or as though I was clearly understanding the messages. That changed when I walked into Rocky Peak. Pastor Michael and the other pastors and speakers deliver messages that are clear, educational, and easy to understand. Each sermon has helped me grow deeper in my faith, better understand the Bible, and strengthen my relationship with God. The music is also beautiful. The musicians are talented, experienced, and you can tell they play from the heart. What I appreciate most is that the worship is not overly flashy, too loud, or in your face. The volume and lighting feel just right. The music, visuals, and overall atmosphere blend together beautifully, creating a peaceful, calming, and at home feeling that allows you to focus on worship and the message. The church is located in a beautiful area overlooking the valley, and the property is always clean and well maintained. The staff and volunteers are friendly, welcoming, and willing to listen. Before each service, they offer coffee and donuts, along with healthier options such as bananas and fruit bars. Donations are accepted, but there is never any pressure. Each service includes a helpful pamphlet that allows you to follow along, take notes, learn about upcoming events, and request prayer. After the sermon, there are also frequently people available to pray with you. I especially appreciate how everything at Rocky Peak remains focused on God, the truth of His Word, and how to build and continue a genuine relationship with Him.
I recently began serving at the church and immediately felt welcomed, encouraged, and supported. The sermons are also available online, making it easy to watch and follow along when you cannot attend in person. I love everything about this church. After searching for so long, I feel incredibly blessed and excited to have finally found my church home. God has truly blessed this church abundantly! The Word of God is preached boldly and faithfully—never sugar-coated—yet always without condemnation or judgment. In every service, Jesus is the only name exalted, and I love how the pastors consistently call Him “King Jesus”—a practice I’ve now adopted in my own prayers.

The pastors are humble, knowledgeable, and their genuine love for God and the church shines through in both their preaching and the programs they lead.

The RPK children’s ministry has been such a blessing for my sons—well-organized, thoughtful, and Christ-centered. Since we joined in February 2025, I’ve noticed a refreshing focus here: no Easter egg hunts, no man-made traditions, no compromise, no wokeness—just pure biblical truth in the worship, teaching, and programs. They even host kids’ camps, and I can only hope one day they’ll open a school as well.

Rocky Peak also offers so much for spiritual growth—apologetics seminars, encounter worship nights, singles services, and more. The Life Groups are wonderful, and the weekly study guides are a great tool for going deeper into the Word.

This is truly a church for everyone. If you want to grow in your faith, be encouraged in your walk with God, and experience a community where Jesus is at the center, Rocky Peak is home! Mike Yearly is the real deal, he seems to be extremely down to earth, a genuine human being with a gift for sharing God’s Word. He’s factual, interesting & his presentation is direct & relates to today. (I’m able to retain the message applying it to my week! which is huge for me.. 😉lol)
It doesn’t hurt that the church is in one of the Valley’s highest areas where one can sit & read or chat at any of several tables & chairs set up in front of the chapel & take in the breathtaking views of the entire Valley & more. My husband & I have been attending Rocky Peak almost 3 years on & off now & we love going!

name: The Church By The Sea
The Church By The Sea - Fort Lauderdale Campus
reviewSummary:
My sister and I parked here for Tortuga 2024 all weekend, this is truly an amazing group. Firstly, I called in advance and they were extremely accommodating in allowing me to book parking in advance. Pastor Marie was very responsive & super helpful. The group working the parking lot all weekend was super cheerful & just a pleasure to be around. On our final day, there was a gentleman in the parking lot (I can’t remember his name, so bad with names I’m sorry) who was informing people who were departing that their bathrooms were open for us. This was such a kind and thoughtful gesture. On our way out, my sister asked that he pray with us for a safe drive back home (we’re from out of town). We prayed together & he wished us well. For context, Tortuga is a music festival notorious for good drinks, great food & an even better party. That being said, they could’ve easily been judgy and stuffy with us, as I know many other churches would have been. Our experience here was impactful in a such a positive way and I just wanted to share. If I’m ever in the area I would absolutely attend service. They made us feel like family & we will return every year. These are the kind of people you want to spend your money with as I just know they are the glue in their community. Thank you all & God Bless ❤️🙏🏻 Our family came to this area 3.5 years ago and did not have to go far to find a home at Church by the sea. This church is beyond welcoming, they are a ‘yes’ to anything this community needs.  Their involvement in outside projects exceeds the capacity we have in volunteers but it never stops them from getting involved, rallying whoever they can and they come through in full force.

Our personal experience has been so good I recommend it to anyone I know looking for a church family. The Pastor is such a good person and his love for all of us shines from the pulpit - he has an incredible sense of humor and brings light to a one hour sermon. His wife is an incredible leader, full of life, ready to serve, always listening to the needs of others and her smile,  kindness and generosity is boundless. The people are warm, welcoming and even if you happen to be one of those that wants to be under the radar - you can be! But moreover, if you are looking for a place to participate, volunteer, and lead - this is an incredible find. Most of all they receive everyone with openness and genuineness. This is a Christ- centered church that welcomes all denominations and lifestyles and their slogan — ‘where the less than perfect are more than welcome’ is tried and true to the culture.

Things to think about : church starts promptly at 10am. Parking can be tough when the snow birds are in town so get there early to find a space. There are two chapels and my favorite is not the main chapel but the side chapel on the right side of the main door. If you get there after 10, use the side chapel - not the main entrance so you can quietly come in and no one will notice 😉. There is a kids Sunday school and your child WILL make friends. Stay after church for a few minutes to fellowship in the courtyard- someone is always signed up to bring coffee and sweets and this is a great time to network or reconnect. We have been a part of this church for >6 years. We followed the pastor (who married us) here after he left the prior church we were affiliated with. Let me just tell you, it was best decision ever. Not only is this church like a family to us but it is truly a place to make you feel like "the less than perfect are more than welcome" (the church motto). Our children have grown up here. We are centered around God, children of God but supporters of each other. No judgment. No drama. Just wonderful people praising our Lord together. Uplifting eachother.  So happy to be part of this church. Wonderful church , people friendly, lovely and accepting of everyone.
The staff is stellar, inspirational and full of love, wisdom, kindness and compassion. They are also filled with the spirit and are very smart🙏🏻👍 You are more welcome than anywhere else

name: The Church in Chula Vista
The Church in Chula Vista - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary: The church in Chula Vista is amazing! The brothers and sisters are all like a big family who love and live the Lord. Christ is really seen in them.❤️ Every morning, I love how they have a concert. The problem is I work graveyard. I hate that I can't get any sleep because of it. Guys please! Seriously you're not the only people around. You're in the middle of a neighborhood!. 😭 A small group who is pursuing Christ for the sake of His body the church.

name: The Church in San Diego
The Church in San Diego - San Diego (UTC / La Jolla) Campus
reviewSummary:
I was in San Diego for a short business trip in 2022. I am so glad that I could attend this church which was very closeby my hotel. The people of God welcomed me and I could see the eagerness and thirst for God's word and His ways in everyone there. Praise God for this church. Great place with sound doctrine of the Bible , also very friendly to guests and newcomers .
Visiting San Diego from Ontario CA Each church out there focuses on different things. This one focuses on two:

1. Scriptural truth. They are very serious on helping everybody understand as many verses in the Bible as possible. They do it in a nice and mutual way by providing all kinds of materials and programs. If you’re interested in understanding the Bible, look no further.

2. Small groups. Have you heard of a church that doesn’t want to get big? This church is so committed in small groups, they actually spin out groups when they get big. (By big I mean about 100 people.) Some church goers may want to walk in and go out of a service talking to nobody. Then this church won’t work for you, but I personally love the warmth and friendship I built up with people who believe in the same thing through the small groups here. A church community based on the principle of mutuality, the Church in San Diego welcomes people of all backgrounds. They are non-denominational, but this is merely a technical matter. The church that meets here is lovely and family oriented - the members open their homes to meet "house to house". A truly sweet and lovely place! A practice of the church life on the ground of oneness according to the biblical way with the functioning of all the members of the Body of Christ for the growth unto maturity to fulfill God's eternal purpose.

name: The Church in Temecula
The Church in Temecula - Temecula Campus
The Church in Yorba Linda
The Church in Yorba Linda - Yorba Linda Campus
reviewSummary:
Warm-hearted people! Joyful children's meeting! Great people. Very sweet Updated: This is the vision of the end times. Satan, through the mouths of men, recklessly attacks the church and its brothers and sisters. If your flesh dislikes the church, you attack it and its brothers and sisters, which is to say, you are attacking God, trampling on God, and showing no reverence for Him. The consequences of offending God are severe; be mindful of your actions.

Original: I wrote this comment specifically to address the malicious comment below from Satan. God wants us to speak words of building up humanity, yet Satan is constantly trying to destroy the unity of the body of Christ. I have been in the Lord's recovery for 20 years, and due to life's changes, I have lived in over a dozen churches. I have never felt that elders have any sense of official rank. Expanding the enduring fruit is inherently difficult work; it requires much prayer, allowing God to pave the way, rather than using human notions and simply focusing on quantity, which is not what pleases God. This is a church unblessed by God. It is deeply entrenched in bureaucratic hierarchy; elders serve for life, thus the system cannot expand, change, or be renewed. The elders' positions are equivalent to "officials," and they are unwilling to step down or become new members.

When Li Changshou was alive, they were about forty years old; now they are eighty, even ninety, yet they still insist on not retiring and have not mentored younger co-workers. The generation that Li Changshou nurtured back then has now become the root cause of the system's stagnation.

Because this is a church unblessed by God, it has been unable to expand or truly move forward over the years.

name: The Church of God
The Church of God - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary: You will never regret coming here to find real people who are serious about Salvation. They live what they preach and are very happy about life. It is amazing to discover this wonderful place. If you love the presence of God coming down into your soul and love the Truth you will find it here.  The preachers are so loving and kind they will preach the truth from the Bible. I love this congregation!  Earnest Christians.  Godly young people. Great preaching. These are people you can trust.  They live what they teach. Real preaching from the Bible and real people who live the Bible . The acapella  singing is wonderful too . God fills this place. What a blessing. No place on Earth like it, and I am not just saying that.

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: I joined this church when I was in my 30’s. I had attended Catholic churches, Protestant Churches and even tried to practice Buddhism, but I knew I loved Jesus Christ and The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints is teaching and guiding me and my children through the LOVE of Christ! Come home here! I promise you will feel the spirit! My wife and son moved to Aliso Viejo not knowing anyone in the area. We went to church here and love it. We felt welcome and have made a lot of great friends over the last year. I really enjoy the Christ centered approach to the worship and how dedicated the members are to following the example of Jesus Christ. I was searching for a Christian Church in Laguna Hills, and I’ve been to multiple other churches so I thought I’d give the LDS Church a try… I was amazed! Never felt so welcome and the atmosphere was amazing. Definitely my go to church for laguna hills. Come check it out! Everyone is so sweet and friendly! The ward is very welcoming and it is a beautiful building! The messages were focused on Christ and I felt the Spirit. It's a great church. Family friendly, beautiful hymns are sung. There are Sunday school and scripture studies the second hour. The 1st hour everyone gathers in the chapel to worship God and hear some talks. That is also when the sacrament is administered. A beautiful and spiritual time for everyone, even if there are sometimes toddlers running up and down the isles.

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Arcadia Campus
reviewSummary: They were holding up traffic for their vehicles to leave sequentially for some political rally or something. I was on my way to the hospital to  get my baby delivered, it was inconvenient. I love this belief it has brought me great Peace in times of turmoil. I hope you give the Church and the Savior a chance. Close access to the freeway. Different style of building. Beautiful. Usually open on the west side. Dang. This Church is so Awesome! It's True! I highly Recommend everyone attend! Horrible!!...sending 3 young men in the pouring rain to evangelize. #Storm JAN 14,2023. What  a way to get people to convert. Ridiculous.

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary:
Wonderful experience attending church here. I was welcomed with open arms and sincerity. I love the focus on Jesus Christ in the worship services. Sort of an interesting religion. If you fit into the culture, it can bring a great sense of community. The structure is setup such that if you are an active member of the community, they will be there to help you when you are ill, need to move, or a person to talk to.

Tribalism is employed in much of the dogma, which creates a narrative where if one doesn't agree with doctrine, or finds the truth claims to be false, leaving the tribe creates an end to most "friendships." It can be painful to follow truth, and it's harder when the members are taught to shun those who leave. The shunning is real, but not nearly as drastic as one might find among the Scientologists or Jehova's Witnesses.

Lastly, the truth claims don't align with reality or history. There's constant whitewashing of history to deal with this.  The doctrine will change to reflect societies reflection of the world, but it is always behind the times, always reacting never predicting. The leaders are never ahead of the curve, on the side of right. African-Americans, for example, were not allowed to be exalted in the theistic teachings until well after the USA had shifted its stance on equality. We find a similar shift happening with regard to the homosexual stance. This church is not a safe-space for any LGBTQ, and if you don't know where your children fit on that spectrum, I'd advice not bringing them here to hear the less-than loving dogma. I was baptized a member of the Church or Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints at this building; it holds many fond memories for me as a teenager who was seeking the truth and found it.  It is in a wonderful location and the people who go there are wonderful as well. Truly wonderful church and community with so much of God's love. I love the people there and their love for Christ and others is incredibly apparent! Very unique when it comes to LDS chapels. I love attending church here when I go back to visit my family.

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
Worshipped Jesus Christ at 10:30am Sunday Sacrament Meeting. Friendly group; insightful scriptural discussions. We visited this church today from Arizona. It was a great experience. The speakers were genuine and shared their life experiences and testimonies of Jesus Christ. The music was delightful. I attended the youth class with my teenage son and daughter which was insightful and engaging. AND, while it’s not the most important part of attending church, they had homemade rolls and cookies after. :) A very fun touch. Everyone was friendly and welcoming. What a great community of Christians they have here in Carlsbad! The community is welcoming, uplifting, and focused on strengthening families and building faith in Jesus Christ. Services are Christ-centered, with talks and lessons given by everyday members, which makes it very personal and inspiring.

I also appreciate the emphasis on service—whether it’s helping neighbors, supporting those in need, or creating a strong sense of unity. The teachings encourage living with integrity, kindness, and purpose.

Whether you’re a lifelong member, new to faith, or simply curious, you’ll find genuine warmth and a strong sense of belonging here. I went to church here and I was overwhelmed by the friendliness of the people here and could feel the spirit during the service. I attended an amazing church service on August 10th. The music was amazing. There was a violin/piano duet that brought tears to my eyes because it was so beautiful. Thank you for such a wonderful experience.

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary: Everyone is always super welcoming and kind. A truly Christ centered church full of love. There are mandarin, spanish, and english services with visitors of all ages and backgrounds always welcomed. One of my favorite places to worship. I'm at college now, but the amount of genuine care and acceptance was key during my growing-up times. I felt like I learned a lot about how to treat other people and a lot of truth about Jesus Christ and the power he can hold in our lives. Not only are the grounds beautiful, but there is a genuine warmth inside.  The people are welcoming and friendly.  During the worship service, you will meet families of all kind; single people, older couples (empty-nesters), young families, etc.  Though their backgrounds differ, their level of kindness and willingness to help you have a great experience is the same, and it is unmatched.  You will have a great experience while learning about the Savior, Jesus Christ and interacting with others who believe in Him. There's a weekly service for anyone 18-30 and it's awesome. I love going to church and worshipping with people in my age group. We go bowling together, play pool together, we have activities and a small scripture study every Monday. It's just awesome. I attended this chapel as a youth and loved it.  The Bishop and youth leaders truly care about the youth.  The doctrines of Jesus Christ were taught weekly during sacrament meeting, Sunday school, and other meetings.  Great building.  Many basketball games played there as well.

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Del Mar Campus
reviewSummary: The church is amazing. Everyone there is so kind and really a disciple of Christ. They treat you with so much love. In the Church of Jesus Christ of latter-day Saints you are counseled to learn not only on Sunday but every day. The individuals who give talks in this church have spent hours of their lives preparing thoughts that are in harmony with the doctrine of Christ. We each have the privilege to learn from them each Sunday. A wonderful and enriching experience each week. Friendliest people on the planet.  Very welcoming to first time visitors and a great place to worship Jesus Christ.  Sacrament Meetings start at 8:30 am and 12 p.m. Welcoming. Relevant. Uplifting. Caring. Speakers were teenagers and adults as well as male and female. Uplifting music. Wonderful worship experience. Changed my life immensely for the better. Many tremendous individuals and communities doing their best to follow Jesus Christ.

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Garden Grove Campus
reviewSummary: Very nice place.  The members of this ward are super friendly and kind.  They have created a very welcoming atmosphere.  I recommend attending this church. Having grown up in this area, I have fond memories of this building and congregation. The members are the friendliest I've known. The chapel has a large window, letting in plenty of wonderful natural light. Come learn of Christ! This is my ward building, I love being a member. We get a lot of people on vacation and all are welcome. Sacrament meeting starts at 9 am for the my ward. The next sacrament meeting for the other ward is at 10:30 I believe. Use to go here almost every sunday back in the days , Bishop Grier best Bishop ever , you are dearly missed Along with President Lewis true role models and and true Followers of Crist , Good Christian church. But the members were not friendly, and I did not get a warm, accepted feeling when I went missionaries over rated the warm family feeling I would get and decreased my spiritual feelings

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Glendale Campus
reviewSummary:
This meetinghouse is a special place and all are welcome to feel the love of Christ. I recommend coming any Sunday to feel the spirit and learn about Jesus! I'm not Mormon but was made to feel at home. I attended a Mormon wedding here and wasn't sure I'd be welcomed as I'm not of Mormon faith and  was pleasantly surprised to be made so welcome. The Bishop was as friendly as he could be as were all the church people. This is a place of learning, community, and especially a place to feel Christ's love! If you're interested in feeling peace and want to come closer to Christ, come here, all are welcome. This is not a bad building the Glendale Singles Ward meets there the YSA and MSA.  They've got this huge parking structure which is pretty cool lots of fun events that have included that parking structure like there was a an event where they had a band play on the roof of the parking structure as well as I think a haunted house that went through the parking structure is pretty fun Welcome to The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints! Hablamos español en la rama de Lark Ellen. I attend the English speaking Covina Ward.
