¡Extendemos una cordial bienvenida a todos!

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Huntington Beach Campus
reviewSummary: For 2026, the worship service begins at 9 am in the chapel.  One hour Sacrament service the celebrates our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.  This is followed by a one hour Sunday School lesson (or potentially Priesthood/Relief Society).  Visitors are always welcome. Very friendly and welcoming people!  We visited while here from out of town. Multiple people went out of their way to welcome us. The meetings were centered on Jesus Christ and His message of redemption, hope, and love. It was the highlight of our visit to Huntington Beach. Such a wonderful place to worship our Savior Jesus Christ with fellow Christians. I've worshipped in many places around the world but here I've found a home for my family to grow in their knowledge of God's Plan for us, and how we can return to live with him some day. We attend the 8:30am meeting but their are meetings at 10:30am and noon as well. I love the community we have formed with our fellow friends and neighbors in Christ. A great place to meet with other believers in Jesus Christ and to feel his peace together. Enhance your spirituality on your own and with others. I attend this church with my young family. It’s calm and everyone is super friendly. The Church of Jesus Christ likes to keep their congregations smaller and intimate of about 120-150 people, so they have multiple times to attend. This chapel has a 9a and 11a service. They also have a Spanish speaking service.

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Laguna Niguel Campus
reviewSummary:
My family has attended church at this location for about seven years. It’s brought me closer to Christ and provided my family with a wonderful community of friends. Visitors are always welcome to join in the religious services on Sundays or to attend any of the church activities. I love this church so much! It has brought me so much happiness and peace through the hard times in life. Coming here every Sunday is the best. All of my worries and stresses are removed from my mind while I am there A lovely little church nestled in a mini wilderness. Going to this church holds great memories. It was while attending at this particular church that I decided to serve a mission. It was at this church that I found lovely life long friends. It was at this church that I have felt the Spirit of God, and I know you can listen to God's word here. I know that the doctrines of the gospel of Jesus Christ that are taught here are true doctrines. Like a light in the middle of increasing darkness. Love it. I went to church here as a child and have loved being able to bring my own kids to church here since we’ve moved back to California.
Everyone meets together for a sacrament meeting the first hour and then kids head to Sunday School, teenagers attend youth meetings, and adults meet with other adults for the second hour.
We have found a congregation that feels like family. 💗 I love the opportunity to get to know so many different people who all love Christ and His teachings.  We study scripture together everyone can participate.  We have opportunities to serve within the church and in the community. Helping those in temporal need as well as spiritual

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Lake Forest Campus
reviewSummary: I've always enjoyed going to that church. The people there are so warm and friendly. I would enjoy taking someone there to meet these great people. If I needed something the sisters and brothers where always there for me. I am so grateful to know them. Great fellowship.  Being going for about 30 years.  Nice people. This church has given me friends and a deeper relationship with the Savior. I'm so glad I found it! This church helps me grow my relationship with Jesus Christ I grew up in the church and I love the feeling I get each time I walk through the door.

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Mission Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: I always feel welcomed here.  It's so good to have meetings again -even with masks, hand sanitizers and social distancing.  Don't be shy!  "Come and see!  Come and stay.  Come and serve."   This is such a great church. The people here are so friendly and willing to help others. You really feel like you are coming home when you are with the people here, they even have a sign out front that says 'visitors welcome'! I love my Church in Mission Viejo. While there we learn about our Savior Jesus Christ. There are classes for every age and lots of friendly people. As a Catholic convert I laugh at myself sometimes thinking of how much I love going to church now that I have the Gospel of Jesus Christ in my life come join us If you want to learn what you can do to return home to God after this life, stop by.❤️

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Newport Beach Campus
reviewSummary: I’m here visiting with my wife, and it is such a beautiful place to feel the holy spirit and to feel closer to my Savior, Jesus Christ! The Newport Beach California Temple is a place of peace, reflection, and spiritual renewal. As I approached its magnificent spires, I immediately felt the Spirit confirming the holiness of this sacred building. The carefully maintained gardens and serene surroundings create an environment perfect for prayer and meditation. Inside the temple, the Spirit was strong, confirming my personal testimony and the importance of temple covenants. Every ordinance I participated in strengthened my faith and deepened my understanding of the Savior’s love. Leaving the temple, I felt my heart full of gratitude and my spirit uplifted, knowing that I had been in a place of holiness where God’s guidance is palpable. The Newport Beach Temple is not just a building; it is a refuge where souls are strengthened, hearts are healed, and eternal truths are felt personally. Wonderful service, starts at 9am. There are hymnals on every bench so that anyone can look up the number and sing along! It brings a beautiful spirit to the meeting. After the beginning service there are individual classes for sunday school based on age groups, really nice to find friends of the same age looking for the same values When my wife and I moved to Newport we started to attend this congregation and were instantly welcomed. We have loved it ever since! The principles they teach here are digestible, yet invoke a deeper understanding of Christ and how we can be more like Him. All are welcomed to come and see. I would highly recommend attending. I have visited this Church every summer for 6-7 years now. As a visitor I always feel very welcome. Members of the congregation are very kind and inclusive. Meetings are very inspiring and Christ-centered. Great place for families with a nursery, primary classes, youth classes, and adult Sunday School.

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Pacific Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
I’m late to church almost every week because I’m still learning how to get kids out the door on time. X) Yet coming to this chapel is still one of my favorite parts of my week. The people here are so loving and reflect the love of God with how they treat each other.

The children’s classes are so filled with songs and lessons that strengthen their faith in Jesus Christ (my kids are sad anytime we have to stay home due to sickness because they miss going to their classes). The adult discussions are focused on the Savior and I always learn so much from everyone’s unique perspectives and testimonies of God’s dealings in their lives.

I cherish this church and the way I’ve been able to grow closer to my Heavenly Father, the Savior, and the Holy Ghost because of the beautiful teachings of scripture and prophets, both ancient and modern. I visited this LDS church with an open heart and hoped of learning more about its teachings, but I left with deep concerns. The doctrine here diverges from the true gospel found in the Bible. According to Scripture, there is only one God, and Jesus is fully God (Isaiah 43:10-11, John 1:1, John 10:30). However, the teachings of Joseph Smith and the Book of Mormon seem to undermine this truth, presenting ideas that often contradict the Bible.

The concept of an apostasy and the need for 'new' scripture is not supported by the Bible. Galatians 1:6-9 warns against accepting a different gospel, which I feel the Book of Mormon promotes by leading believers away from Jesus as the sole way to salvation. Ephesians 2:8-9 emphasizes that we are saved by grace through faith alone, yet LDS teachings seem to add layers of works and requirements beyond what Jesus taught.

If you are seeking a relationship with God, I encourage you to look solely to the Bible for the true gospel. Jesus' teachings are complete and trustworthy as they are, without the need for additional prophets or scriptures. My hope is that everyone will come to know the simplicity and truth of Jesus’ gospel found in the Bible alone.

I spoke at their podium sharing my testimony of love and was confronted by their state bishop and he gave me a very passive aggressive look and handshake along with grabbing my arm in a manner that was physically altercating and off putting. Such a great congregation. Happy, friendly, welcoming people worshipping Jesus Christ. Really cool building built BY the members years ago--somewhat unlike other Church of Jesus Christ of Latter Day Saint chapels. Our family attended this chapel last year while we were on vacation, and it was a fantastic experience! Our little 2 year-old was having a tough time that day, yet she did well in the Nursery class that was available. (There were plenty of kind teachers, fun toys, activities, and even a play-yard outside.) Everyone was so kind and welcoming whether we were in a classroom, or in the chapel getting ready for the sacrament meeting. We have been members of the this congregation since 1991.  All are welcome to attend.  It is a place of refuge in a time when the world needs the peace that can come from focusing on Jesus Christ.

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Poway Campus
reviewSummary:
Great place for 18 to 35 year old single adults to connect, have fun, worship, and to learn about Jesus Christ. I would like to know the schedule of available services and when the brothers are available; I would like to attend. My family has attended church here for over 10 years. We felt welcomed when we first came and have continued to feel loved as we attend. I have had my belief in Christ strengthened and have seen the same for my children as they have attended many youth activities. There are two congregations meeting here at 9 a.m. and 10:30 a.m. to worship. Visitors are always welcome to attend and members are always willing to answer any questions. I moved to Poway in 2007 with my family and joined the local "Green Valley Ward" that meets at 1 pm at this location.  I've been Mormon my whole life and wondered what type of a church we would find in Poway.  The experience has been wonderful.  We have met so many kind and committed Christians who welcome everyone into their church family.

I've grown so much in my relationship with God and been given great opportunities to work side by side with others - both in and out of the church.  All are welcomed and loved.   I love this church.  If you drop in, feel free to ask for me -  Marc Davis. I have lived in Poway for 20 years and have attended this church for the entire time that my family and I have lived in Poway.  This LDS church has a congregation that is very friendly and outgoing to any person who would like to visit the meetings held in this building.  My association with the LDS members has been a great asset to both my wife and I in raising our 4 children.

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - San Clemente Campus
reviewSummary: This building is gorgeous! And more importantly the people are so nice and welcoming. The feeling when you walk in is one in a million. Definitely should join us! Have felt so welcomed ever since we arrived in 2020.  So thankful that my faith (and my family’s faith) in Christ has grown here. Such a Christ centered church with an amazing group of people. Everyone was so kind and I learned so much here. I love this church so much!! I felt so welcomed and appreciated and it was the perfect way to start my week. The congregation here is very friendly. I really felt at home, even though I don't live here. Also, the view from this church is to amazing, and the the building is very beautiful as well. The pastor was very kind, and does it all without getting paid. I would definitely go back. It is a great place on sundays to feel peace from my troubles and learn about Jesus Christ! The people here are great!

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - San Diego (Rancho Bernardo) Campus
reviewSummary:
There are two Wards (congregations) that meet in this building.
One at 9 am, and the other at 10:30. Each Ward in the church is under the same global leadership. Hence, they are very much the same anywhere in the world. No paid clergy, no fancy outfits, just plain people like the rest of us. No paid choir; every member, young and old, gets to sing and worship through song. Check it out: "all are welcome." I love it here!  It is a truly sacred, warm and welcoming place where they worship Jesus as the living Christ.  I feel the Holy Ghost during the services which include the holy sacrament, traditional and new Christian hymns, inspiring talks prepared by members, all with a strong focus on Jesus Christ. It’s a lay ministry—no paid preacher—and donations are private, with a monthly worldwide fast to support those in need.

I love the two-hour Sunday format: the first hour is for family worship and sacrament, and the second for uplifting classes, a robust youth group and a vibrant primary. The Bible and Book of Mormon are both honored as sacred scripture, and the global church is led by a living prophet and apostles.

The Relief Society (the world’s oldest women’s organization), the youth speakers, and the beautiful artwork of Christ throughout the building make this a place of faith, love, and growth. I truly look forward to coming each week. I love coming to Church here. As a single and foreign person, I know sometimes it can be intimidating going to a new Church. I have found so much kindness coming here, and I feel closer to God's love. I feel better coming here than doing any other activities on a Sunday morning. I love this church. It is very welcoming and my kids love attending every week. They have a great youth group. They teach from the Bible and teach of Jesus Christ’s life. This Church believes in Christ and testifies of Him everytime I come. We believe that Jesus died on the cross and rose again on the 3rd day. He is our Savior. I love the spirit I feel here. Come! All are welcome! I feel close to God when I attend church here. The congregation is so friendly and embraces everyone. You will quickly recognize the love Jesus has for you through the people in this building. Jesus is real and loves us. He suffered and died so that we can repent and live with Heavenly parents again. The doctrine taught in this church will help you recognize the spirit of God in your life.

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - San Juan Capistrano Campus
reviewSummary: This is an amazing place to come learn of Jesus Christ and His restored gospel. Without a doubt the second you step into the building you will feel of His Spirit and be surrounded by the most incredible people. This place is awesome! I love going to church and feeling the love of our Heavenly Father! This is the place to learn about Jesus Christ and His beautiful gospel. The people strive to live Christs teachings and serve one another. However, just come and see for yourself. Come with an open mind and heart. Seek to meet new people and push outside of your comfort zone to make new friends. We get out of life what we put into it. We recently moved into the area, I was surprised by the number of young families in the congregation! Despite COVID, we've really felt welcomed. We're meeting virtually and all the speakers have been great. I have been impressed with the youth speakers in particular. The Bishop is kind and earnest, and the focus of all our learning is Jesus Christ and His doctrine. Highly recommend. This church is more than just a church, the food here is great with excellent service. Like seriously my waiter was great and they were super well dressed. I believe it is the only other place besides McDonalds to offer the Travis Scott Burger©, which is honestly really cool. Besides being just restaurant, the dentist here is absolutely phenomenal from what i've seen so far. I haven't gotten my teeth done from him yet, but so far he looks to be a really friendly guy. Another thing here I still have to try but I recommend to others would be their PC building program. One of family members got their PC fixed and modified there a few months ago and now it works better than it ever had before. It looks like they also got the best deals around too. Another thing i've heard about here is something about wormholes too, but I guess i'll have to look into that more. Like who wouldn't want to go to another dimension, that sounds so cool. Apparently there's other stuff this church also has to offer, but I guess I'll find out more about the other amenities the next time I visit. this place is very easily 5/5, i'd love to come by another time for all the stuff offered

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary: Loved that there was parking. Nice church building, friendly atmosphere and great sunday message of staying true to your values and living a Christ centered life. The children sang beautifully in their class. Would highly recommend! This historic meetinghouse was built in 1923. It stands as one of the oldest buildings in Santa Monica.The congregation still holds worship services every Sunday at 10am. All visitors are welcome. Big yes. Christ lives in our community and it so happens I know. Believe me a real church with real Saints for the new space our world is traveling'* lies with in these doors. The church is accommodating to all. Very nice members and family oriented This church is a great place to bring family and friends.

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Tustin Campus
reviewSummary: This is absolutely amazing Christian church in the Tustin area. the members are so friendly and caring. I remember when I first time look for a Christian church while I first come to this country. Some member from Utah connect me with the local members and they immediately get contacted with me that time and invited me to go to their BBQ activity. that was an amazing experience. I met wonderful people in that activity. They have so many different activities held for youth for women and man. Sunday sacrament meeting are so spiritual. after the meeting, always feel so full at my heart. They have so many different branches which speaks different languages. Definitely check it out if you are interested learning Jesus Christ. My church is the truest Church ever . I love Sunday school and relief society both to day is fast and testomony day . I really wanted to maybe because I didn't fast .  Overall one good day .....bless our fast we 🙏 pray . I have been attending the Red Hill Ward (congregation) since 1996!  We have raised our kids here & now are close to retiring!  We were welcomed in & enjoy doing the same for others.  Church starts at 9am every Sunday.  The meetings are Christ centered & we strive to live a Christ centered life.    We overlap meetings in our building with the Chinese branch so the children (18 months up to 11 yrs old) & youth (12-18 yrs old) can attend in English.  Tustin Meadows Ward currently meets at 1pm.  We have many friends in each of the congregations & hope you will come & join us! I have been meeting in this building for Christ-centered Sunday church services for over 20 years.  We also have fun youth activities during the week in this building.  The people are friendly and very welcoming. I love the Red Hill Ward congregation. I’ve been attending this congregation for more than 25 years. It feels like family—the functional kind 😃. I always leave this place feeling better than when I entered. Today’s Sacrament Meeting was powerful. A woman leader gave an amazing talk about our Savior’s love, grace and healing power!  Then we sang the Hymn, I Know My Redeemer Lives. Really a soul-stirring way to close the meeting!

name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints - Woodland Hills Campus
reviewSummary: By going to this church I have found peace and direction in my life.  I'm so excited to go here every week and learn more about Jesus Christ and his restored church.  I promise you that by attending church here you will have a happier and more meaningful life.  Come and see!  We love visitors and everyone is welcome. I hope to meet you soon. Awesome youth ages 4 through 18 and adults all ages in Woodland Hills -  If you want make friends and feel uplifted and enrich your life while going through struggles, this is the place. You can join a Childrens Chorus, Youth Chorus, or Adult Choir at this church, too. All are welcome. This building has been there for probably over 50 years as a church building. Very clear and well kept. The landscaping is beautiful. There are special programs throughout to year but especially during the holidays! Enjoy!! These are the most un-welcoming and most judgmental people I’ve ever encountered. This is not Christ’s church or people. I came here right after I went through my divorce and they were aggressively judgmental and would not let me be part of the ward. What a unified church!  These people are so friendly and loving.  It is a great church for anyone who wants to be somewhere where they feel loved.  They have great meetings and activities.

name: The Church Of Our Saviour and The Holy Apostles
The Church Of Our Saviour and The Holy Apostles - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Lovely community, very friendly and welcoming. Without Google, it is impossible to find. There is no sign outside mentioning that inside the Anglican church is also a Romanian church. We will be back. We live over 50 miles away and would still go almost every Sunday. The warm friendly faces, the pure love of humanity, and the feeling of God's presence are within the walls. I love learning and visiting other churches throughout my life, but Church Of Our Saviour and The Holy Apostles will be where I picture myself when I pray. Much Love to all the parishioners and priests! *Hugs DMA+* Amazing atmosphere, great energy and good people! Beautiful Christian Orthodox ceremonies 11.30 am- 1.30 pm on Sundays ( Romanian and English languages).
Thank you for the food too! The ladies who cook for everyone and bring food every Sunday are angels!!! NOTE this is not an episcopal church, it is something more traditional, more historic, it is the Anglican Provence of Christ the King, but still a fantastic and welcoming church and religion! Blessing to all The people of the church are very nice.  Ambiance is lovely.

The Church on the Solid Rock - Laguna Hills Campus
The Church On The Way
The Church On The Way - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary:
Christmas extravaganza -- blew my tiny mind.  Everything was so professional, music was powerful, light show was gorgeous, great versions of Carol's, other languages represented, and amazing Latin jazz, too boot! You could have knocked me over with a feather. The staff are really nice and talented If I was given the opportunity to make a lowest score than a one star, I definitely would, being someone from a different country. I am here in America, looking at churches, trying to find a new home church I checked out this church and the utmost disrespect that the heads of this congregation, and the people they surround themselves with is really horrible, in all honesty this is one of the worst churches I have ever been to. I don’t know why you would treat someone with such disrespect when you try to pretend like you follow God, you’re not living by the words you preach, highly recommend finding a different church than this one. Excellent Service. I feel the presence of the Holy Spirit. Beautiful atmosphere and decoration.  Very welcoming brothers and sisters. I love my family in God. Hallelujah! Amen!. What a wonderful first time experience. I sat close to the front middle and I’m glad I did. The worship lasts 30 minutes and I enjoyed every bit of it. The sermon was very well put together and I enjoy the pastor. I would like to have a sheet of the notes. A 1 page fill in the blank sheet for notes on each sermon would help a lot :) Well, I am a lot biased, as i have grown up with this church in my neighborhood since I was 8. It probably was a church member who had me accept Christ as an 8 year old on the corner of Van Nuys and Vose ( I'm 60 now)
So T.C.O.T.W. has been a part of my now matured faith for many seasons on and off.

I visited today from my home in Las Vegas. And I was sentimentally struck by the memories. But I was made more aware of the love of God over my life by the message which just happened to be pin point accurate to the circumstances of this week.
This reminded me of of all the supernatural things that have happened to me over the years in direct correlation to the activities of this church.

What can person review of a church? It's staff, it's services, it everything.  It is a church. They act like a church.

But here..for me, it's God's Church.  I i experienced God yet once again.

That's what we all need.

name: The Church Without Walls
reviewSummary: Led by Dr. Ralph Douglas West. A powerhouse of 'Expository' preaching within a high-energy, multicultural context. Deeply committed to community engagement.

name: The Commons LA Church
The Commons LA Church - Westwood Campus
reviewSummary:
great church in the heart of westwood ❤️ first attended this church as an undergrad student at ucla and can’t emphasize enough what a blessing this church is from the sermons to community! highly recommmend checking out The Commons LA Church

alsoooo, we have a great kids ministry! If you’re looking for a place to call home and don’t want to follow Jesus alone, TCLA is the church for you. Besides the free lunch on Sundays, this church is dedicated to thinking Biblically, loving sacrificially, and living Jesus-centered. Committing to this family is worth it! The Commons LA Church offers a welcoming community with inspiring sermons and uplifting worship. A great place to grow spiritually and connect with others. This is the first church I really got plugged into since moving away from home for college. I'm now a part of this church on a level that I didn't expect from any church.

I feel like the community at this church are like family. I love that we always have free lunch on Sundays because it lets me hang out with such great people and talk about anything from God to random memes.

I think that it is 100% worth your time!

Edited to update review:

It's been over 5 years since I wrote my last review and I am deeply grateful for all of the experiences I have had with this church family. The people and rhythms have changed a lot over the years, but I think that is to be expected in a church that is pursuing God in such a transient city. Committing to be a part of this community has been a joy. They draw me deeper into relationship with God and tangibly reflect the love that he has for me.

All that to say, you should definitely check it out and see if it is the community that God wants you to meet you in. Worst case scenario, we still provide free lunches every Sunday! (which is actually extra awesome because it allows us to get to know you!) TCLA is a Christ-centered, biblically-grounded, and Spirit-filled church. It’s a smallish community (~100 people) which really allows us to live like family!

On Sundays, we gather at Upside Down for a weekly gathering and we all share (free!) lunch together as well after. We also have small groups (DGs) and community groups (MCs) throughout the week which allows folks to go deeper and build more meaningful relationships.

On Sundays, we often pray aloud together during the service, (which may surprise people so is worth knowing beforehand!) which is an awesome opportunity to learn how to pray by hearing others.

name: The Connection Church
The Connection Church - Huntington Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Love this church, I used to go regularly but I moved away from this area. It always feels like home when we visit. He has been the pastor for my nieces quinceañera, my wedding, and my uncles funeral. Pastor Richard is a blessing and is a great example of a Godly man. Love this church. Pastor Richard is a blessing. ♥️ When you feel like singing just raise your hands and make it so! This is a straight up cult, where everyone claims they are an excorcist. good

name: The Connection Church - Lake Forest Campus
reviewSummary: Small congregation. Welcoming and nice people. The pastor there will gladly talk and is very caring tword people and the community they serve. Worth a shot if you are tired of the MEGA church money grabbers that dont care about you as an individual. Great, authentic, biblical teaching,  contemporary Christian music. Fun children's ministry and lots of family events. Great non denominational church... definitely feel God presence here. Preaching is good and out of the bible . The Spirit of God moved in a mighty way, the word was empowering. Good for families 👏

name: The Cross Church
The Cross Church - Pensacola Campus
reviewSummary: The Cross Church has excellent teaching and sound doctrine provided by the pastors. Very theologically rich music absorbed in Biblical truth. Family integration is also key in The Cross Church as the elders encourage families to practice family worship weekly. There are also parenting seminars, men’s internships, men’s and boys gatherings, women’s prayer groups, women’s Bible studies, and youth events. For youth events, the goal is for the entire church to be bringing up the youth in the ways of the Lord and is not merely for the youth to have “fun” though that does happen as well. There are “city group” Bible studies most evenings throughout the week which are dispersed around the city. City group leaders conduct a gospel catechism with the rest of the group and then discuss in-depth the sermon preached from that Sunday. If you are looking to grow as a Christian and become more like Christ, please give The Cross Church a chance! Reformed baptistic, the pastors/elders are John-Mark and Kent, and both are good teachers. The layout and content of the service is very purposeful and gospel centered, and the preaching of the word is well laid out and central to the service. We take the Lord's Supper every week as a good reminder and good accountability. They have catechism for children, nursery for young ones, and early prayer for adults. Very sound teaching, and a great place to bring unbelievers who are in need of the gospel message, which is shared each week. My family moved to Pensacola specifically to attend The Cross. We had listened to the sermons online for over a year before deciding it was the right church for us. The preaching is unashamedly Bible truth and spoken with grace and a true love for the body; the doctrine is solid reformed theology; the pastors strive for excellence, are approachable, genuine, and loving members of the body; the people genuinely care for one another and are welcoming; the music is biblically based; the Lord’s Supper is taken weekly; small groups place an emphasis on sound teaching and Christian fellowship; membership is taken seriously; the atmosphere is one of true family worship. We have grown exponentially since coming to The Cross and are so thankful for it! At The Cross, there’s a genuine love for The Lord. There is right teaching, worship, and love for one another rooted in scripture. The pastors and people are genuine and intentional in your life and truly want to experience God in greater ways, and live out the gospel together. Even going through challenging or difficult times, the love shown towards me and countless others through the years was incredible. The Cross Church is a body of believers whose utmost desire is to glorify Christ. Christ and his gospel are preeminent in every service and small group meeting, and the members spur one another on to love and good works. This church has pastoral elders who shepherd their sheep well and expound with excellence the word of God.

name: The Crossing Church
The Crossing Church - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary: Bro, my friends (of color) and I stopped attending. We felt like the "majority" wasn't INCLUSIVE enough. Nor did they try to be. Seems like just more of the same bland potato salad WITH Raisins. I will never go back! Great music, good sermon. Loved it. Check out their webpage. Made message applicable to everyday. This place is HOME🖤from the minute I stepped foot at The Crossing I knew my heart found peace, my soul found a safe resting home. After being submerged in a dark storm in Jan of 2018 and being introduced to this wonderful loving place around May 2018 I knew I had found my safe haven. Growing up Catholic, I had never encountered God the way I have now. I’ve been to other Christian church’s and let me say, none have felt as welcoming as The Crossing, everyone welcomes you with open arms. You are treated as family, you are not being judged🖤 For anyone who comes across this review, I would like to personally ask you for one favor, to give The Crossing a chance. You will not leave disappointed. I can’t believe it took me so many years to finally find a place where I feel accepted and treated with so much love. I started attending this church several months ago and it immediately felt like home. The pastors and volunteers make you feel so welcome and at home. Now both my wife and I are volunteers as well, serving with our spiritual gifts! We love this Church so much that we commute from Fullerton! Been coming here off and on for years and it's still a great place to worship. A kids room for different age groups is available to drop off your children, services aren't too long, and it's fun... water fun days are my kids favorite

The Danish Church and Cultural Center - Yorba Linda Campus

The craft fair isn't real big, but is always busy. They also sell danish pastries and food. I'm half danish, and I really enjoy and look forward to going every year. Its a treat to visit here. Wonderful church lovely people snd awesome pastor Really sweet group of people. I enjoyed being part of their entertainment for the night. I had my wedding here in 2016 & I don’t think there could’ve been a better location. The couple running the church were so down to earth. It was a great experience. Historic small fully function parish church.

name: The Door Christian Center
The Door Christian Center - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary: The holy Spirit is most definitely here and the pastor is great and preach the word of God 🙏 Awesome church. I gave my life to Christ here and I've never been the same. It's been such amazing to see all that he has done in my life the last three years. It's a blessing to be in a church that preaches the TRUTH and shares a vision for masses amount of souls to get saved! If you don't know Jesus this is a place where you can meet him and grow in a relationship with him. amazing! The power of God will change your life, you will never be the same. Down to earth,  friendly great praise and worship,  with wonderful pray warriors. I cried when I had to leave this church. But I will be back someday

name: The Door Christian Church
The Door Christian Church - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary: I love this place. Atmosphere is great. Everyone is friendly. I love the music and the talented voices from all the wonderful women!!! I have been looking for a church home since after the pandemic, I finally asked my brother in-law’s girlfriend where do she go to worship God? She invited me to the Door church. I must say it was crowded but it was Father’s Day, and I didn’t think the church would attract a large following. So I came back the next Sunday and I was totally surprised as to how many more people attended the Sunday after Father’s Day. Pastor Stacy and First Lady, Daphne Dillard , are two of the most Genuine people that I have ever met. Pastor Stacy knows how to keep his congregation coming back Sunday after Sunday. His messages are ALWAYS right on time. I have found my church home. Great church, family oriented and very carring people go here. I went once and now go every Sunday. I have no family in San Diego and now the church is my family. Very prejudice, it's a black thing.  They kicked out my husband  after 3 yrs because he wanted to lead someone to the Lord. They don't do that.  So I left with him. Still looking for another church. Do you do baptisms? And deliverances?

name: The Door Christian Fellowship
The Door Christian Fellowship - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary:
It's not my kind of place.
Middle of last prayer, a servant walked up, sat next to me, and tapped on my shoulder and asked if i was saved ( not cool )
Also, im not comfortable with the pastor speaking in tongues at the last worship song without an interpreter.
No saying this is bad. it's just not for me The pastor and many of the congregants have a heart for Jesus and a passion for His mission of saving souls. The sermons are anointed and they have many guest preachers with the same heart and passion. If you want definitive change in your life give your heart, mind, and soul to Jesus. And if you want to also cultivate that change and make it your  lifestyle, attend this church. I love this church!  The Door of Redlands is a very friendly and welcoming church. I have been attending this church for some time now and have grown in my spiritual walk tremendously. The pastor is down to earth and encourages the congregation to develop a personal relationship with Christ through personal devotions. One of the churches best attributes is the willingness to accept and reach out to every soul that comes through the doors. It is encouraging to be a part of a church that walks in Christ footsteps. I finally found what I was looking for in a church! The best part of the Sunday morning service is the adult interactive Bible study. Had a chance to meet Pastor Rich after the service. Most pastors don't make themselves available to the members outside of an appointment, however, Pastor Rich is easily accessible plus he teaches an uncompromised word. The mission here is clear. Help sinners learn about Jesus, repent, convert, disciple them, and give everyone this opportunity.

If you’re serious about changing your life and serving others, this place fits the bill. Prayer every morning from 6-8. Saturday Outreach from 10am-12pm. Sunday School and New Believers Class @10am, Sunday Service @ 11am, and Sunday Evening Service @ 7pm. Monday Evening Follow-Up. Tuesday evening band, puppets, and drama practices (hours vary). Wednesday Midweek Service @ 7:30pm. Thursday Outreach 7/7:30pm. Friday bible studies (various times and locations). Spanish Ministry Service 7:30pm Friday.

You get what you put into it.

name: The Door Church Downtown LB
The Door Church Downtown LB - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Truly GOD’s people. So blessed to be apart of this fellowship. This is my safe Haven. I’ve never met people so caring, understanding and humbled. I don’t know where I’d be if I didn’t start coming to this church. ALL are welcomed. Be open for change and allow God to work into your life. GOD IS MOVING. Come and be blessed  🙏🏼 Everything about this church is 5 stars. The Pastor has so much passion and a way to speak to your heart it's priceless, all the people there are so kind and inviting. Highly recommend checking it out, you will not regret it! I truly enjoyed my visit. If you're looking for Spirit filled church, this one is. I love the friendly enviroment and encouraging graceful preaching!

name: The Episcopal Diocese of San Diego
The Episcopal Diocese of San Diego - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
I truly love this Church, Mr. Green and the Nice lady in the Mail Room are God's sent. I have been homeless for five years. I love their help and I appreciate that they make me feel a human being and NOT 🗑️ trash.
Thank you so much 😊🙏
Victor Galindo Came here for the Street Dogs Vet Coalition, and spent the entire morning receiving dirty looks and terrible treatment by those attending the services inside. Not to mention there's a "volunteer" from the church who constantly wears a 'I Vote Felon' hoodie which is just insane to wear in a church. Like. Are you kidding?

Definition of performative. If you actually cared about the homeless, your followers wouldn't treat them so poorly as if they're not even people. I had devoted 3.5 years of my life experiences as well as my culinary cooking skills, and grounds keeping skills so that the Bishop, staff, and visitors. Experience what I found to be, the campus where God is present. And God does have a sense of humor. He let me and Hero be there.😃🐱 I begin volunteering there around March of 2018. That was a difficult time of me. I was in a wheelchair and homeless. I was alone and had no family or ideas for me to turn to. For the first time in my lifetime! I had no one and nothing. I've been trying to get assistance from Veterans Community Services, who are, the organization that took my case from the VA hospital. In the October's month of 2017.
What I received from the Veterans Community Services wasn't assistance. That organization, who's using veteran's fundings to operate their misappropriation under. Left me outside of the Veterans Community Services building's front door. I came out of surgery on September 9, 2017. My motorcycle accident was August 21, 2017. I can not stand up at all and I'm taking very powerful medications. I have a morphine bag doing a control drip for areas to my right leg and ankle. I was just left there. I'd go in and asked questions and what's always told me? The intake coordinator is the best person to get the process started. The counter when pick up the phone and looks over at me and says, he's leaving a message. (Male or Female is never associated with whom this message was left with?) I was left to existing on the front porch to the Veterans Community Services. That's on the corner of El Cajon Blvd and 54th Street. Very uncomfortable nights from October 2017 until after Thanksgiving holiday. It's the beauty salon that was next door to the Veterans Community Services that brought me a Thanksgiving dinner that evening. I'd take me in that wheelchair and I'd bathed around 3:00AM and where I couldn't be seen by the public. My apartment things are in a 6x4 unit at Morena Storage. I never blamed no one other than myself. Payday was the week before my motorcycle accident and all the bills were paid, so I through a grill cookout in the apartment's outdoor grill area and patio. Now that was a beautiful patio garden area. The residents have a smoking and non-smoking area. Very spacious for entertaining outdoor and, the whole apartment complex is gated.
Never say, never to yourself. I had to give up my apartment or suffer eviction. Everyone that lives there are inform about the waiting list. So the residents place a good neighbor policy in the recreation hall. No resident will suffer the humiliation coming from eviction. My move out was fun. You have to be over 55 years old just to get on the list. I'd turned 61 years of age in 2017. I'm in a wheelchair and for the life in me. I had no intentions of making another feel bad for me. I still had a lot of soda's and pastries from the last grill I hosted. So I used my God given talent for making anything joyous. Plus, I got the things in the apartment to storage said goodbye. On October 6th of 2017 I'm not from San Diego, CA and I not good at getting close to anyone. I found out that left me sleeping outdoor in a wheelchair. Not Cool! I also learned, that, there is people in the San Diego city who would do just about anything, even create lies about me, to see if I'd brake down. Lose all hope in my beliefs to a beautiful life. I will probably not. I'm at the edge of a similar battle and I still past that hope I have for my beliefs to a beautiful life to anyone that's smiling back to me. I have nothing negative to the people of the attack on my character. I smile 😊. I've ✋ it over to my beliefs to see what the truth will be properly presented. Then I'll get back what's taken? Then I and the proper representative will give the city of San Diego what it sort. Remember I was a third person here and I know it story.

Otis Jack,
Just a quick note to express to you my dissatisfaction with your church (which I attend) serving the homeless food as you do on Sunset Cliffs Avenue. I am a tax paying resident,with a family, and we do not appreciate looking at or dealing with the homeless who come to your church for a free meal. On more than one occasion we have had issue walking bye with our young son. We are also well aware of many many other residents of Ocean Beach that do not appreciate this.  Why don't you deliver the food to shelters or take it downtown where there are not homeowners? I am not heartless but enough is enough!!! This is a neighborhood. Its time that we clean up Ocean Beach and you are not helping.

name: The Everyday Church
The Everyday Church - Tustin Campus
reviewSummary:
Got church on a daily basis, especially during the week. Sermon was on point but little more details can help. I wish it was more welcoming directly rather than 1 person in audience does all the work. Worship is nice and acceptable to listen. How I LOVE, LOVE, LOVE
The Everyday Church!
Pastor Mark is absolutely inspiring, and an OUTSTANDING teacher whose own life carries incredible testimonies.
I am and feel blessed for the EVERYDAY teachings by Mark.

The rest of the Pastors and staff, especially Justin, are so
heart-warming, kind, and genuine.
Their generosities are more than
I can even describe.

Come to their church and/or listen online.   I hope that they will touch your heart as they have held mine. I love the Everyday Church!!
I look forward to the encouraging biblical truths that is taught there so faithfully each day by Pastor Mark Warner.
If you want to know more about Jesus and His love, that's presented in a way that anyone can easily understand, you can watch everyday at 12:00 noon on Facebook. Straight , Sincere, and Committed..

name: The Father’s House
The Father’s House - Main Campus
The Father's House - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary:
The Father’s House is a very biblically sound Church with amazing people and even more amazing Pastor and his family. It feels like a small family even though there are many in attendance. I highly recommend this church!! Took my family to visit The Fathers House Church today. It was an incredible experience the worship was 🔥🙌🏻🔥🙌🏻🔥🙌🏻, the message was engaging, challenging and encouraging 🙏🏼🙏🏼🙏🏼🙏🏼! After not being able to gather for a church service for the past several months, we heard TFH were opening doors on Fathers day. We showed up early got a good seat and man we really needed it.. God is Awesome and this church community is Great. I really enjoyed listening to Pastor John and Pastor Cyndi when they were at New Hope Oahu and I was pretty stoked when I got to watch a service online at The Father's House. They are really a true gem to the word of God and for those who don't understand the Bible but are trying to keep up with it Pastor John is really awesome at helping you understand the parables. His delivery and how he can make it relatable to a situation. love this church! I felt right at home when I walked into the doors. Really connected to the worship, which is so important because it brings you into the presence God! Also loved the teaching from Pastor Dan. Relatable, funny, real and also brought so much scripture to his message. This will be my home church!

- Sarah Wimberly I just found my church Victory Outreach at The Father's House. Very nice place thire children's Chapel is very nice my granddaughter loves it. My grandkids really like thier new church.

name: The Father's House OC
The Father's House OC - Brea Campus
reviewSummary:
You can feel Gods presence here. The volunteers are the best & Pastor B let’s the Holy Spirit guide her EVEN WHEN it isn’t easy. I visited TFHOC this morning all the way from WV. We were complete strangers walking in that made friends with 4 people in an hour. From being welcomed into seats, given coffee, asked intentionally about our stories, being hugged, cared for and prayed over while we were there. Every person was welcoming and compassionate. The presence and character of God is there!
Pastor Bianca even made time to talk with us one on one and pray over us. If you are new to church, looking for a safe place with authentic people or nervous to try a new one…you will be met with God’s love here. The happiest most warmest welcome me and my kids have ever felt! The word was powerful made me cry, my kids church class awesome! Whole experience amazing. It's all church should be. Also looks modern so clean so cozy. Worship singers amazing too. I love this church. I remember going to the theatre and watching movies. Now I am watching God's movie and watching people change, for his GLORY. THANK YOU, Matt and Bianca for being our shepherd (director). May you always be abundantly blessed. We came to visit this church while on our Disneyland vacation and loved the atmosphere. We've watched many times online but to be in the presence of such an amazing team was a delight. The way in which Matt and Bianca preach true moves me. Thank you TFHOC!!

name: The Fellowship of Orange
The Fellowship of Orange - Orange Campus
reviewSummary: A beautiful church family, warm and welcoming to share the love of Jesus with! Come early for Sunday School (all ages welcomed)  for an intimate setting to learn and ask questions, along with age appropriate teaching for the children. Wonderful Pastor, wonderful church people and wonderful teaching of Gods word and presence of God! Think the Westborough Baptist church but a bit less extreme when it comes to public image, but don't let that fool you, deep down this place is just as bad.

name: The Fields Church
The Fields Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary: This is a great church to call home. I started going to the fields 8 years ago when I moved to the area and it has been such a blessing to be a part of the community and family there. The teaching is great and centered on the Bible and the community is very friendly, welcoming, and supportive. If you are looking for a church in the area I couldn't recommend the Fields enough We’ve been at this church about 6 years now and it really does feel more like family than just a place we go on Sundays. It didn’t take long to get connected either, it just kind of happened naturally, no pressure or weirdness, just real relationships forming over time. The pastors are humble and genuinely care about people, and even though no church is perfect, this one is real and we’re really grateful to call it home. The Fields has been my church for about 10 years now. This is a great church where the gospel is preached every week, people are pointed to Christ, and the Bible is faithfully taught. The community here is genuinely welcoming and Christ-centered. I started going to this church March of last year. As someone who struggles to understand the word completely I love how this church has been taking the time to break down what is being taught in the word. They also have some solid opportunity to build relationship in community throughout the week which has added positively in my life. The fields church truly is a church that emulates what it looks like to show Christ like love to everyone. If you’re interested in a new church I found this one and it’s absolutely great! The community is amazing the people within the church community make you feel welcomed. They will seek out new faces to ensure you find your new church home!

name: The Flipside Church
The Flipside Church - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary: We love The Flipside, Pastor Kev and all the staff and volunteers. We’ve been a part of a really big church, but Flipside feels like home. Every week the message is Biblical and aligned with the teaching of Jesus. There’s plenty of opportunities to serve and grow your faith. We highly recommend I started attending this church as my home church in January 2025. I was despondent, just destroyed when my beautiful wife passed away on October 26,2024. The care ministry was a game changer! Jaymee in particular was incredibly kind, understanding and extremely helpful! It did not take long for me to reach a plateau that I could function in again. They have a very dynamic children's ministry, all kinds of outreach opportunities, and the teaching! Straight up Biblical truth! Pastor Kev is a very astute, kind, personable and dynamic teacher. You will not be falling asleep here!  The Worship music is incredible (and historically, I have never been a big fan of modern Worship music!) But, after being a Christian for almost 40 years. I finally feel that I am at the right place at the right time. Come to Flipside Church in Rancho Cucamonga! I can be found in the audiovisual room at the third service each Sunday! Ask for Phil! Pastor Kev, is awesome. However,  pastor Jimmy is a great as well. It's a safe place for kids of all ages. People are so warm and welcoming. The atmosphere along with the teachings, transcends into piece. You feel the love and power God has.. This church is refreshing! They love Jesus and each other! The ministry leaders go out of their way to find ways to serve God's people well! The lead pastor is a humble and powerful man of God, He loves the sheep and preaches the truth! My wife and I love this place! A truly amazing Church! If you are looking for a place you will be truly welcomed no matter what, this is the place for you. A true Church family. Every week pastor Kevin's sermons speak to your heart and mind. There are growth groups offered as well to help strengthen your bond with God and his followers.

name: The Foundry Community Church
The Foundry Community Church - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary:
This community oriented church is wonderful. They dont just talk the talk, but walk the walk here. Not only are their services, they are engaging, and heart felt. They have several programs to help the community out with strengthening your Christian walk, recovery and food. I am so blessed to have found the Foundry. What a horrible experience we just had here with Alex at your food pantry.  We drove all the way from Vista to get food and when we arrived had to park at the bottom of a hill, get out the wagon (we were instructed to bring a cart) and walk up to where the food is distributed.  I am disabled, do not have the spare gas money to spend getting here and back home (empty-handed), and this was not easy.  We arrived at 1:00, but after the extra walking up the hill and wagon ordeal, it took us until 1:03 to get to the top.  Once there, I was informed they're closed and told to speak with the supervisor when I inquired further. I walked over to the area where Alex, the supervisor was and waited for her to be available, then spoke with her.  She pointed to the clock on her wall which read 1:05 and said she is closed, has handed out all the numbers, and doesn't have anymore food.  I explained my situation and she repeated herself. I am completely APPALLED and DISGUSTED at this treatment!  There are people walking away with carts FULL of food....they are NOT out of food!  (I wonder if she just gave 1 can, 1 bag of beans, 1 box, or 1 vegetable, etc less per person.... this would by far make enough to accommodate an entire "order".).  I can not conceive, however, how your church would completely turn us away for food, and so rudely. We specifically went to The Foundry because we previously had a positive experience there at a church service.  THIS is NOT the same Christ-like people that The Foundry is remembered for.
What a shame to deny food to God's children. Shame on Alex and shame on The Foundry! I grew up attending church, listening to the Gospel, but not really. Being part of The Foundry Community Church reminded me of what a disciple should be like. It's a true blessing to serve God and serve others. Everyone I've spoken to about this church is spoken very highly of it with pure shear gratitude and I am going to go for the first time today I will let you know how my experiences afterwards but I'm more so sure that it will be lovely and joyous I came to The Foundry Commity Church through it's Recovery program, and then I felt totally welcomed to the new family I found here. Definitely a place that loves this community.

name: The Fountain Church International
The Fountain Church International - Pomona / Claremont Campus
reviewSummary:
This church has changed my life and allowed me to grow in my relationship with God and seek him daily! From living in sin daily, coming to church weekly over time God helped me through bishop to grow and realize what I needed to change and my life has been filled with God ever since! My life has changed since joining Fountain of Love. Pastor and all the leadership are Spirit led. Everything is done in excellence.. a loving environment.. you will most definitely experience the power of God. You will grow strong in the Spirit , in wisdom, and in every area of your life. It's up to you how far you go. Come see for yourself. A man of God truly in love with the heart of God,  his wife and family, and serving God's people! A church with awesome word and unbelievable worship experience and atmosphere. I have yet to find another church like this since I've been. Trust me, if you go your life will never be the same! 😎🙏🏾🙌🏾 Great word and good teaching love this church I love this church. GOD is in this place, over Bishop Jarron O'Neal & his beautiful wife Lady C. The choir and the band are truly anointed. It's a friendly loving, caring atmosphere, and always a wonderful greeting every Sunday. ALWAYS A POWERFUL WORD SPOKEN THROUGH BISHOP JARRON WHEN HE IS DELIVERING GOD'S MESSAGE.
Thank you, GOD, for sending me here.

name: The Gate Christian Bible Church
The Gate Christian Bible Church - Mission Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
A great Bible based friendly church that will welcome everyone
Come check us out next Sunday at 9:00 AM. Developing fully devoted followers of Christ. The only living that matters is living by God's design. In God we trust!

name: The Gathering at Corona
The Gathering at Corona - Corona Campus
reviewSummary: If you are looking for a church this is the place.  This church is a family oriented environment.  Offering awesome praise and worship.  Pastor Seymour has recently taken the position as lead pastor. He is an awesome man of God who is encouraging and fill of the word of God.  So it and visit.  Hey connected.  See your life changed. Great family church.  They teach truth.  They really love people here and pray when they say they are going to pray.  I am amazed at how supportive this church is, not clicky at all. There are alot of good churches but this one I will love forever.  Such amazing people to fellowship with. The presence of the Holy Spirit was very evident and worship and the message were both excellent. Love this church!

name: The Gathering Place
The Gathering Place - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary:
For over 20 years I've called TGP a "Gideon's army Church"... Leaders and Core are a  wonderful group of Mature believers. Services are led by the Holy Spirit, with meaningful worship, anointed sharing of the WORD, a healthy integration of the Prophetic, faith for His Healing...
TGP has an emphasis on powerful Intercession (for the city of LA & our nation)! Pastors Rick and Pam truly care about their people & can also pastor the mature in Christ so well! (So rare/hard to find.) I love this Community of /in Christ! As a relatively new convert, I was on the lookout for a welcoming space. I'm coming out of a long relationship with another faith and lost a lot of my old innocence. I'd worshipped the old beasts, electrical rats, sexy bunnies, Professors. But I was left with an emptiness. No matter how much energy I accumulated, how much I evolved, I still felt the emptiness.
But at The Gathering Place, I learned about Magic. While I'd previously walked the plains, I could now overcome my summoning sickness and tap that thang. No longer was I a follower of the sparky rodent, I now had ... aura. Great Pastors, leadership & fellowship with like-minded believers !!! You are getting fed the meat of the word ...such a safe place with rock solid teaching from the true word of God ! TGP is the real deal , Generals of intercession reside here so much love also 🩷 and because of that, THE HOLY SPIRIT moves powerfully 🩷 The Lord is at The Gathering Place! I received the Baptism of The Holy Spirit with the gift of speaking in tongues there. Pastors Jim and Pam are such wonderful servants of God. They yield to the flow of the Holy Spirit and teach His word soundly. If I hadn't moved to Arizona I would still be there. :) God bless TGP! The clear world of God and what God is doing in the world today....a amazing mixing of the truth of the word and power and gifts of the spirit! Wonderful place where Kingdom reigns. Highly recommend!

name: The Grove Community Church
The Grove Community Church - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary:
I attended this church off and on for a few years, while my parents were active members of this church, as well.  I applied to dedicate my son to the Lord at this church when he was about 8 months old. I had to make an appointment with the youth pastor and was on a waiting list for about a month or two. When it was finally time for our appointment, we arrived at the church offices, had to check in at the front desk (very corporate style), waited for the youth pastor, and went into his office where we were interviewed/ interrogated. Long story short, we were turned down. (Never knew that was even possible) The youth pastor said that he didn't think that we were ready to dedicate my child. (Side note: I have been going to church my entire life) He gave us his business card and told us we could call him in a few weeks if we had questions. This church never checked back in with us, never asked how they could support us, never asked if we were still interested, nothing.

Nevertheless, we were able to find another church that welcomed us with open arms, they loved us, lead us, taught us, and offered support if needed. We dedicated our baby boy shortly after. It was beautiful. I contemplated on writing this review for some time, but decided this needed to be known. I was very disappointed in this negative experience by The Grove Community Church, and I have not been back since. (I am a Black-American for context) Visited for sunrise Easter service last week, and really enjoyed it! I live in HTX but was in the area for a wellness retreat. The church was about a mile walk away, which was super pleasant! I would definitely again if I were in the area! My host said she attends weekly midweek women's Bible study. Attended an event at their community center. Beautiful grounds, clean and welcoming. In the book of Luke 4:18-19 it talks about preaching the Gospel. This church needs to preach the gospel at every sermon so that Jesus Christ can save his people. I pray may the Lord bless this church and put it in their hearts to preach the Gospel of Jesus Christ. What happens if a person goes to this church and they're not preaching the Gospel then the next day that person takes their life? PREACH GOD, PREACH JESUS. Visited from out of town for Easter and really enjoyed it! Seems like the people are very friendly and the pastor preached in a way that was easy to understand and keep me engaged. Its a big church but seems like when you get plugged in you'll find community there!

name: The Harvest
The Harvest - Sarasota Campus
reviewSummary: My husband and I were ready to give up on church altogether when we stumbled upon Harvest a little over a year ago. This isn't even really a church. It is a ministry and a family, with a church attached. You know that your tithe money is going to be used to love and help the community rather than on expensive lighting rigs or something like that. And Pastor Dan's messages are challenging and new. NEVER "listen to me 'cause I am the pastor" and ALWAYS "here is a new and different way to think about this topic, decide if it is right for you." Questions are welcome! Broken people are welcome! And DIVERSITY is welcomed including LGBTQ+! If you are sick and tired of the typical toxic evangelical church presentation, then please visit Harvest. I think you will find it to be a breath of fresh air just like we did. Harvest House provides supportive community services to the homeless, veterans and families in need of housing support. Church service on Sunday at 10. I went two Sundays in a row while on vacation and it was a wonderful experience. Dan's sermons were spirited and genuine, and the church is very loud about loving people the way Jesus would (and does) --- something that made us feel welcome immediately. The music here is beautiful and powerful, too! I was moved to tears each weekend. Great job to those singers and musicians! Thanks for the expired food it was a waste of time waiting in line I threw it all in the trash seems like all you guys are trying to do is poison people with expired food instead of trying and help them I hope the wrath of God comes down on your church This church is not like any other you will ever attend. The minute you walk in, you feel a warm welcome. Pastor Dan is amazing. Not only does he play guitar with the awesome band of many, (and he can sing), but his messages are heartfelt, real, and thought provoking. This church helps our community right here in Sarasota! There are many opportunities to meet nice caring people with several weekly functions/outings throughout each month. Come with an open mind and experience this for yourself, this just could be your church home as it unexpectedly became mine!

name: The Hill Church

name: The Immaculata Catholic Church
The Immaculata Catholic Church - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary: Stunning church with an amazing amount of seating. Was there for my brother's wedding. Good acoustics and lighting. Mass has a good choir using organ, piano, and trumpet player. It is so beautiful inside, and Fr. gives sermons concise and on point. They serve donuts and coffee after outside. Attended Easter mass and had no problems with parking or seating. It's a warm and welcoming parish where all were greeted warmly. The cruciform architecture is on proud display with stunning stained glass filling the clerestory in every section. The church has incredible attention to detail everywhere you look without seeming gawdy. It is  beautifully maintained. But that is just a building. The true beauty of a church is better measured by its members and it's culture which comes from parish leadership. Everyone we met and saw interacted with genuinely welcoming hearts and were very gracious, all while being inundated with newcomers and nonparish members. If you have the chance, add this to your list of places to visit whether you wish to attend mass or seek a quiet moment of reflection. Immaculata Parish at the University of San Diego is a majestic Spanish‑Revival church, dedicated in 1959. With its iconic blue mosaic dome, red tile roof, cruciform layout, and soaring bell tower, it seats about 900. Adorned with Italian chapels, stained glass, and marble, it serves both students and the community. On my quest to visit every Catholic Church in San Diego county, I attended mass here on a Sunday morning. The atmosphere was very welcoming. The mass was celebrated in English, and the priest gave a very inspiring homily. I was mostly impressed by the beauty of the church and the warmth of the parish community. I recommend attending mass at this Church... Just such a beautiful and welcoming church to worship in!

name: The Methodist Church
The Methodist Church - Brea Campus
reviewSummary:
First off, let it be said that any information about any certain incidents that have occurred in the past are now outdated; they no longer attend the church as far as I’m aware, and the community that is there is certainly welcoming.

How do I know this?

I’ve been attending BUMC since 2013-2014, back when I first lived in Brea; I’ve seen multiple pastors come and go throughout the years, changing per the Methodist conferences that transpire… each and every pastor I’ve met and spoken with allowed me to keep up the faith, of pursuing something better in life.

That pursuit (besides happiness)? The search for a family… a community to lean on when you have nowhere else to go, a family to be a part of, express yourself when times are dark… a place of worship where one can get their start in career and their life.

BUMC will always hold a special place in my heart for all of these things above, as they helped guide me through the pandemic, for providing a place of acceptance for the love of my life, for providing a place of service when I had no other sources of income.

Now, as I move eastward towards new horizons, I can only hope that this church may evolve for the better, perhaps leave behind a legacy in music, in outreach, in spreading the word that God is indeed good.

I wish you all the best, and have a blessed day/week.

The church fosters an inviting atmosphere where people can gather for worship, fellowship, and service.

With a strong focus on inclusivity, compassion, and outreach, visitors will find a caring church family committed to faith, connection, and living out Christ’s message of love for all. After reading your "statement of faith" on the church's website, and following our 1st visit, (3 months ago)  we became clear that we would be staying, and are hoping to get involved in serving/helping out as needed.
We moved to this area almost a year ago from Idaho, and until we found this wonderful body of sweet believers in Jesus, we had to do a bit.. (OK, ..more than a bit..) of "church hopping", which is not fun! Can any of you relate?! Anyhow, just want to let y'all know that we love you ALL, our brothers and sisters in Christ! So,...you're "stuck with us".......the good kind of "stuck". Ha! Love everything and everyone at this church!  David & JC preach and teach God's word, bringing it to you in a way that you walk out excited and inspired...every week.  Everyone is so nice...lots of young people... My wife and I have lived next to this church for 9 years. They are terrible neighbors. I work hard during the week, I’m up at 4:30 am Monday - Friday overseeing a construction crew. My weekends are critical for catching up on sleep, but this morning I was woken by them ringing their church bell probably 30 consecutive times at 7:45 am. Every Sunday I wake up to Sunday school kids emitting blood curdling screams with seemingly no adult supervision right outside my window.
Not to mention their patrons ‘s parking overflows beyond the designated parking lot into our street, taking over the neighborhood on weekends. On rare occasions we will hear young adults on weeknights screaming and yelling within the church late at night. They are probably just goofing off… it looks like a youth group or something, but still, bothersome to the neighbors. They act like they own the community, not to mention they have never once reached out to us in any welcoming way, despite them being direct disruptive neighbors.

Over nine years… not one reach out, just issues, thanks. The Mission Church is a second home to me! I have been attending for a couple years now. After exploring many churches in Carlsbad, The Mission Church stands out for many reasons. Pastor David and JC have a strong reverence for the Bible and teach it very well. They clearly study the Word very deeply and teach the Word with a strong reverence. I have learned so much while attending this church. I was saved before I started attending, but the teaching I have received from The Mission has reignited my faith and strengthened my relationship with the Lord exponentially. Pastor David preaches the Bible in a way that illuminates how deeply God loves us. Pastor David also strongly encourages the congregation to study The Word for themselves and that has helped me make my faith my own. Another reason why I respect The Mission so much is they practice what they preach. Although there are complaints about The Mission being too political, I believe the Church should be speaking out against injustices and Pastor David and JC are very brave to speak truth despite making some people feel uncomfortable. I met my husband there, I have made life-long friendships there, and gained mentors there as well. The staff is clearly devoted to serving the Lord and care deeply for the congregation. Pastor JC leads an amazing Young Adults program that has changed the lives of many Young Adults, including myself. Their Women’s Ministry is extremely edifying and special as well. This is a Holy Spirit filled church and I am so grateful to have found The Mission! So happy our neighbors told us about this church; it has been such a positive influence on my family. My husband and I were looking for a Christian church that aligned with our values and was true to the word of God. The first service we attended was so welcoming. They give you a coffee mug and connection cards for Fellowship on your first visit. The church has multiple events throughout the year including park Olympics, BBQs, hikes, surf lessons, etc. My husband was even Baptized at Moonlight Beach with 45 other members. The Pastors and Youth ministry leaders are such a blessing! We are approaching our 1 year mark and it warms my heart to know we have finally found our people.

reviewSummary: This church is my family! Nothing compares to the feeling of being in the presence of God while being with family. This church is excellent! name: The Movement Church
The Movement Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
I wrote the below review in July on Yelp and wanted to share here as well:

I've been part of this church community for a little bit and have appreciated the warmth and spiritual grounding it provides. However, I'm deeply disheartened by the silence around the humanitarian crisis caused by recent ICE activity in the Los Angeles area. As people of faith, I believe we are called to stand with the vulnerable and speak truth in love--and right now, many of our neighbors are scared and suffering. I had hoped for acknowledgment, prayer, or support from leadership, but it feels like this issue has been overlooked. I share this not out of anger, but out of longing for a church that truly reflects the compassion of Christ in both word and action.

I also wrote this review prior to seeing Pastor Carey's Instagram posts on the topic. To say I'm disheartened by the posts would be an understatement. If you're planning on visiting the church and want to gain understanding on where they stand on these issues, I encourage you to look at the pastors' posts and responses yourself. If you can't feel the Holy Spirit here during worship, you need to check your pulse. This place has an amazing anointing on it. Great message delivered by a very charismatic and knowledgeable staff.  Highly recommend  with today's climate. If your looking for a church to call "Home" this is it!!
My family is forever Changed by The Movement Church.
From the moment you get out of your car your greeted with smiling faces and people who intentionally want to get to know you. Our kids love the kids program and look forward to church every weekend. My Husband and I have made some amazing friendships here and love ALL the powerful life changing messages from the Pastors. If you are looking for a great connection, a meaningful message and the opportunity to build authentic relationships with amazing people, The Movement Church is the right church! The pastors,  Carey and Meghan, co-lead the church and bring a great message every week. For those that have kids, of any age from baby through high school, they have a wonderful kids ministry with great teachers and mentors. My kids look forward to going every week and have made great friends, something that we had searched for many years to find. We call The Movement Church home and truly value their mission to know the people that attend and to find the one and bring them closer to God. If you are looking for a church, come visit and try out The Movement Church OC!

If you haven't been to church since COVID, are looking for a new church, or simply up for trying something out, give The Movement Church a shot this coming Saturday night at 5pm. 32382 Del Obispo St, San Juan Capistrano, CA 92675 (It says Mountain View Church on the outside) you are in the right place. Movement Church hosts an amazing service at this location every Saturday night. After COVID-19 I was looking for a smaller and more personal church. I have been an active member of a couple mega churches in Orange County, CA over the past years. Each of them carried a great message but made it hard to feel connected to your church, pastors, and the message they bring. The Movement Church I now call home and it is for good reasons. Pastor Carey and Meghan are a husband & wife team co-leading the church. They make it clear their mission is to know the members of their church and you certainly feel like family when you walk in the doors.

Movement Church hosts an amazing service at this location every Saturday night.
