name: The Neighborhood Church
The Neighborhood Church - Palos Verdes Estates Campus
reviewSummary:
Our wedding was beyond what could have imagined thanks in part to the beautiful Neighborhood Church, I can't thank Setta enough for helping us book our wedding ceremony. I was in search of a Church to hold our ceremony and this location does not disappoint. The views are extraordinary, I was visiting the area and suddenly came across the Church and was taken aback, it was exactly what we were looking for. Not only is this location stunning but the Pastor Mary was kind enough to include verses/readings from the Quran as my family is of both muslim and catholic diversity. They were all so helpful and inclusive. I loved everything about it. A special thanks also to Dr. Hyunju Hwang the organist, who was exceptional !! She was able to include unique pieces that my husband and I both love. I attended a wedding here, and it was absolutely gorgeous. There was a private trail leading to the ocean and a fascinating cave. They allowed us to rehearse the ceremony the day before, which was very convenient. However, the experience was marred by random visitors dropping by and walking through our photos, as the venue seemed to be open to the public without any signs indicating a wedding was in progress. It would have been much better if they had blocked off certain areas during the ceremony to prevent tourists in flip-flops from walking by and talking near the open windows while vows were being exchanged. I understand that people want to visit the church, and they have every right to do so, but when such a significant amount of money is paid, there should be signs or specific hours posted to inform visitors to avoid certain areas during private events. This is a very beautiful church with breathtaking views. It reminds me a lot of the Hearst Castle. But more importantly, Pastor Rick and the church staff, especially the Director of Communications, Anne Smith are all so amazing!

Pastor Rick’s sermons resonate within you and has a unique way of delivering the teachings/readings in the Bible very well. I love how much he includes and engages the kids during worship. I can’t wait when my baby grows old enough to understand and really participate in the kids’ activities. His sense of humor is a bonus too! My family and I look forward to Sundays to attend service!

The Director of Communications, Anne Smith has been such a reliable, efficient and thoughtful person to connect and work with! She makes sure your questions and concerns are addressed while still accommodating if there’s anything more that she can assist you with up to the last minute.

We also met with the Sunday school teachers Ms. Allie and Ms. Shannon who are both so kind, approachable and great with kids!

This church is a sanctuary, a peaceful and serene place of worship. It’s a sacred place to get connected with Christ, re-connect or start, “ wherever you are on your journey of faith”, as they say. 🤍

Thank you Pastor Rick, Anne, and the rest of the church staff who make sure the church is working like a well-oiled machine. 🙏🏼 Summer concerts resumed in 2023. We attended the first one in June 2023. It was beautiful.

Older reviews: Sunday Summer Concert Series - awesome performance on June 23, 2019. Sarah Fantappie impressed with her voice and her talent as the MC for this concert.
Thank you! I have been a member since 1977.
My two daughters have been baptized and grew up in the church.
Our present minister was selected by groups who filled out forms on what they wanted in a minister.  I said I wanted a minister with a sense of humor.  And I got my wish.  Linda

This church is a sanctuary, a peaceful and serene place of worship. It’s a sacred place to get connected with Christ, re-connect or start, “ wherever you are on your journey of faith”, as they say. 🤍

Thank you Pastor Rick, Anne, and the rest of the church staff who make sure the church is working like a well-oiled machine. 🙏🏼 Summer concerts resumed in 2023. We attended the first one in June 2023. It was beautiful.

Older reviews: Sunday Summer Concert Series - awesome performance on June 23, 2019. Sarah Fantappie impressed with her voice and her talent as the MC for this concert.
Thank you! I have been a member since 1977.
My two daughters have been baptized and grew up in the church.
Our present minister was selected by groups who filled out forms on what they wanted in a minister.  I said I wanted a minister with a sense of humor.  And I got my wish.  Linda

name: The New Presbyterian Church
The New Presbyterian Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: Beautiful people. Church is small, but friendly. Good Word and good fellowship... Korean Presbyterian church, PC. USA. Message was not excellent. This is a wonderful church with powerful praise and words. It blends tradition and modernity well, and the EM ministry is truly excellent.

name: The Olive Branch Church Campus
The Olive Branch Church Campus - Temecula Campus
reviewSummary: This church helped me through some very difficult times. Such loving people! I appreciate the Love and support throughout the years! I highly highly recommend attending one of the services in person or online. You will not be disappointed. God Bless 🙏🏼 Pastor Martinez is an awesome teacher of the gospel!! We will miss coming here but watching on u tube! We moved to bullhead Arizona… hope to find an awesome church like this one. Lynda and Tommy A true family atmosphere. Everyone I’ve met and talked to has been the sweetest. I never thought I’d go to church ever again in my life but this place made me think twice. The Olive Branch Church was a blessing for my friend and I when we visited- we recommend to go- the people are kind and happy.  The pastor and wife greeted us and they have morning coffee, tea , continental breakfast.  The Word of God is preached and prayer is offered. What a blessing to the city of Hemet and San Jacinto area.  May the LORD bless.  Amen. Sis. Jenny. God is alive in this church I love my lord and my family in Christ .And the Pastor teaches his people right from the Bible. Pastor Anthony & his Wife God has blessed  Amen starts at 10 am on Sundays God has called me there for a reason..

name: The Place City of Miracles Cathedral
The Place City of Miracles Cathedral - Temecula Campus
reviewSummary: Today I was blessed to meet a few amazing members of the congregation, walking down my street praying for all of us who live here. We shared a couple of stories, they all prayed over me and we even shared some laughs!  Lovely men and women of God spreading the word, caring for others and being His disciples!  Keep up your beauty, your love for Christ and others, you are the light He talks about! See you soon!

name: The Point Church
The Point Church - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary:
I visited the church twice last year, felt a bit overwhelmed with the many questions about where I am from(I guess because of my accent they wanted to know my ethnicity or is i was really American). I don't mind talking about who I am and what I do but it didn't felt organic, it felt more like an interrogation. There was no followup or attempt for me to keep coming or same my life.

I ended up finding another church where they immediately welcomed me and didn't pry too much about me. They even came to my home to save my soul, I felt much more appreciated. Sad that I couldn't be part of an apostolic Christian church like i was raised. The Point Church has been a great fit for my family. The people are kind and loving. Pastor Mike is amazing! I love my church! I came to The Point about 8 years ago looking for a good church to raise kids in and haven't left since. The people were all so warm and welcoming and I have made many lifelong friends here. The Pastor and Pastor's wife are some of the greatest people I know. Pastor is an amazing teacher of the Bible, is a great leader, and funny too, so services are always engaging and allow me to take something and implement it in my every day life. The worship in the services is awesome. You can really feel God's spirit. And I never feel self-conscience about how I worship here. My kids (8 months, 2 years, and 4 years) all love Sunday school and their teachers. They have learned many Bible stories to give them a good foundation in the Word. If you want a church that feels more like a family and has a real sense of community, come to The Point. I'm looking for a church where the pastor is himself when preaching and not performing, I'm  looking for a church without legalism. I came to this church by way of my son while I was in a very dark place.  I was  welcomed with open arms and such love that is given a family member.  I received the Holy Spirit who taught me to speak in tongues and got baptized soon after.  I am thankful for this most awesome spiritual gift that God has seen fit to give me.  It is through the guidance and teachings of Pastor Sargent that I have learned and grown so much in Faith.

name: The Potter's House
reviewSummary: An iconic global ministry led by Bishop T.D. Jakes. Reviews consistently mention the 'powerful' worship and 'life-changing' preaching. It is celebrated as a model of diversity.

name: The Potter's House - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary: Friendly faces, exciting events during the holidays!

name: The Potter's House (Orange)
The Potter's House (Orange) - Anaheim (Platinum Triangle) Campus
reviewSummary: Tremendous presence of God. I feel at home when I visit this church. Everyone is friendly. Great Place to Worship Jesus Christ, uninhibited. God is 😊! Great place to worship God !

name: The Potter's House Christian Church
The Potter's House Christian Church - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a REAL Bible believing church. Here’s what’s true: if you look hard enough
for something negative about a church, you will find it no matter where you go. But, if you’re looking for a positive, uplifting place to go to develop a relationship with Christ and like minded individuals, this is the place to go! God has transformed my life and showed me what it means to love and be loved, how to live as a Christian (not in name only), and how to forgive as I have been forgiven! Come see for yourself what God’s plan for your life is and let Jesus transform your life!! Hospitable, faithful and kind believers in Jesus!
We visit annually for a marriage retreat weekend and are always blessed. I grew up a religious person thinking that I was going to heaven because I was a “good person” and no one told me that I was so wrong. I was invited to this church and the first day I went I felt a strong conviction for my sinful ways and realized that I needed Jesus. If it wasn’t for churches like this one , that preaches the true gospel , I would’ve continued to be lost in this world. No one is perfect but you can feel a genuine love for Christ and a desire to see true miracle so in peoples lives in this church. The pastor has always been a strong leader and I am so thankful that God lead me here. There are rare places in life that shape not just who you are but who you become, and for me, this place is one of them. It’s not just where I raised my family—it’s where I grew into the person I am today. In a world where many miss the mark due to a lack of reverence for Godly authority, this place has stood as a guiding light, grounding me in faith and purpose in Jesus Christ name, not religion. With that being said, I’ve launched my children from my shoulders, not my feet, giving them a foundation of strength, faith, and love to carry forward. #OSIDECFM In October 2012, one day before finalizing my divorce, I stumbled upon the Oceanside Potter’s House Christian Fellowship Church. A chance encounter near a Navy Federal Credit Union ATM led me to this church, just 20 feet away. At rock bottom, their Sunday morning worship song drew me in. Pastor Tim Moynihan, through scripture, showed me the path to unity under God. I was saved, and miraculously, my wife followed suit three days later. The day we were supposed to finalize our divorce at the Vista Courthouse, my wife and I showed up and tore the divorce papers. Since then, with gratitude to Pastor Tim and, above all, to our Lord Jesus Christ, we’ve been together with our three beautiful children to this day. All glory to Jesus Christ, our Lord and Savior!

name: The Potter's House Christian Church - San Marcos Campus
reviewSummary: Love this Church. The pastor and his wife are dynamic, approachable and down to earth. The congregation is small but growing every service. This church is not afraid to preach the truth and to move in the gifts of the spirit! If you are looking for a church that is on the move, visit the Potter's House in San Marcos, CA! Nice little church great message and great worship music . Visiting from Texas I will be back. Great church with great people running it The Potter’s House of San Marcos is a welcoming, Bible-believing church with a strong focus on discipleship, evangelism, and spreading the Gospel. The Word of God is taken seriously, and there’s a genuine desire to see lives transformed through Jesus Christ. If you’re looking for a church that will encourage you to grow in your faith and reach others with the Gospel, I highly recommend visiting! Outstanding Word of God and really nice songs

name: The Potters House Christian Fellowship Church
The Potters House Christian Fellowship Church - Temecula Campus
reviewSummary: This Church is Genuine and all about Jesus Christ. They speak 100% truth about the Gospel. It changed my life forever. Praise God, our Lord Jesus Christ. Encouraging ... Life Changing preaching. The Lord is lifted up. It was great Gets the best out of you .

name: The Presbyterian Church of Bowling Green
The Presbyterian Church of Bowling Green Campus
The Promise Church
The Promise Church - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary:
Not reviewing based on the service, but for their parking situation and how inconsiderate it is. I have lived right next to this church before it was the Promise Church. The previous establishment was not as inconsiderate with parking and the residents who live around the area. With how popular this church has become, there's been an influx of people who have been going to this church which is great, but not so great for the residents that live nearby. The church has its own parking lot in which 95% of the time is empty, or barely utilized; for cars atleast. This is an ongoing issue as parking on the street is a hassle due to the church having so many events and not utilizing their lot. To whom this concerns, all we ask is that the church please utilize the parking lot before having people park on the street where residents park their cars, or at least spread awareness of the people attending to try to park in the designated parking lot. Thank you. You can truly feel the presence of the Holy Spirit and as part of the family. Bishop Alas and his family are always attentive to everyone. The members  of the church are all very welcoming and helpful. I felt right at home.  Thank you Jesus❤🙏🏻 Blessed to have found this place, most genuinely caring people to pray for U & help U. The diaper bank & food distribution is weekly. Resources for housing available. Thank U God, for blessing me w these wonderful people whom welcome me w open arms giving me faith w the strength of their prayer. I have not attended their worship service and came here only with a friend to pick up free food that they are giving away 3 times a week and I think the days are Mondays, Wednesdays,  and Thursdays.

Be prepared to wait in line for at least an hour or so. They have two lines for vehicles that is alternating and three staff working: An elderly woman who directs the two Male staff or volunteers. And this is the reason for the long wait because  out of the 2 volunteers, only one is really working or doing the work because the other just stands there and directs the other what to do. But hey, free food is always worth the wait, right? A warm and heart-felted place to visit. Better yet, to be part of: is a welcoming family of people. They have an English and Spanish service on Sundays.

name: The Promise Church - Poway Campus
reviewSummary:
The Promise Church is a vibrant, Spirit-filled community where the truth of God's Word is boldly preached, the Holy Spirit is powerfully at work, and the love of Jesus is felt in every moment. Worship is deeply rooted in Scripture, and it's a place where miracles, signs, and wonders are not just believed in—they happen.

With an incredible pastoral team, heartfelt worship, and a welcoming, supportive congregation, this church truly feels like family. If you're looking for a place where you can grow in your faith, experience God’s presence, and be surrounded by people who genuinely care, this is the place to be. The children's ministry is phenomenal, the Bible college is life-changing, and every service is filled with the power and presence of God. I’m beyond thankful that God led me and my family here—The Promise Church is home. The Promise Church has transformed my life in many ways.   They teach the word of God and dive deep into scriptures.  They are not afraid to share the gifts and promises available to all of us.  I continue to learn and grow because of the Promise Church.  Although I live in Hawaii, I am blessed with a Life Group, which I consider an extension of the Promise and meet to discuss Sunday’s service together.  If you are in the area or have access online I highly recommend attending and you will be blessed beyond measure. This church is nothing like I've ever experienced. First class teachings with a true family-like environment. Everyone is so approachable, friendly, and genuine from all walks of life. I have never been to a church with such a diverse and loving group of people. I love how Pastor Henry backs up everything he preaches with the Word. I've learned more about the Bible and grown in my relationship with God more in these past two years at the Promise than I ever have before anywhere else. This is the place where I got saved and even met my husband! So thankful for The Promise Church! Great Spirit filled Church. You feel the presence of God at every service. Pastor are Awesome and Supportive. Very friendly congregation. Pastor Henry and Pastor Cindy preach the Truth Very Good Bible Based Church. Worship is Awesome. Unbelievable children ministry ♡ Bible College Amazing ♡ Love My Promise Family This is the most amazing loving church! I feel like right away I had a family that took me in.
The young adult is really growing and we always have so much fun! (Not cliquey)
And I am so lucky to be taught by our one and only Pastor Henry! He is not shallow in his teaching, it does get challenging, but I know it is what God wants him to teach to us so we can increase, and the testimonies prove it!!!!

name: The Refinery Church
The Refinery Church - Chula Vista Campus
reviewSummary: I consider it a blessing and a privilege to have become a part of this family of believers. My wife grew up in this church and it's a lovely place to call home... the location is home to many groups who use the facilities and the people here are very active serving the surrounding community. I'm enjoying building friendships with pastor Jon and the rest of the staff. When you feel like you're alone and you sit in darkness, the light of heaven will give you everlasting light Message is well preached.  So nice to hear the gospel the way was preached also. This is very come as you are church. Don't need to be dressed up. Music is fantastic. I would definitely give this a try. Speaking as an outside observer. I am not a member here. Was just visiting. First time here. Feel connected spiritually and the message was good. If you want to be surrounded by genuine, Jesus-loving people, the Refinery is the place to go.  Everyone is very friendly and open.  The church has a very inviting, welcoming atmosphere.  The worship is amazing and the preaching is transformative.  I highly recommend this church!

name: The Rise Church
The Rise Church - Oceanside Campus
reviewSummary: Love, love, love this church and the family feeling. Pastor and First Lady are very awesome...the music is really awesome as well as the singer's. If you haven't been to this church, make it a point to go..you'll be so blessed. Great teaching of the Word, outstanding family experiences and fellowship in the Word of God!! Was a member for over 30 years until we moved to Oklahoma 5 years ago. Fantastic!!!!  The best ever I love it . I felt like it never left Praise and Worship is Amazing with Biblical Doctrine going forth.

name: The River Christian Reformed Church
The River Christian Reformed Church - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary: This is a good church. The people are friendly and the pastor greets the congregation before it begins. It's not too small or too big. If parents does not like their kids on camera, say directly to us, NOT TO PASTOR!! Is this school or what?! Because what i seen its like in school where the principle waiting bad student in front of gate and give the student write up lol  We're here not cause drama nor problem nor crime but together we want to hear His words and worship God. Next time, write it down " NO CAMS FOR KIDS" ALSO please be fair to other kid who has problem with delay speech just because they have problem with that, does not mean that kid can't do something. My wife and I absolutely love going to church here we looked for a family for so long and we feel at home and all the pastors are great we love everyone there People are friendly.  Service was good. I've been going to The River since I was born. It is a huge part of my life and I love the family that I have there.

name: The River Church Of The South Bay
The River Church Of The South Bay - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary: This is a wonderful place to worship. Very friendly people that care. Bible based. Great music. They have an early morning beach service. We love the teaching and the people at The River.  Once we came, we knew we found our new church home

name: The Rock at Mount of Olives Church
The Rock at Mount of Olives Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: With rock n' roll style, it was truly awsome! Me and my friends stopped here and it was cool! Not only that, it helps you stay connected to God. For those of you who think church is typically boring, this gives you a whole new perspective...

name: The Rock Calvary Chapel
The Rock Calvary Chapel - Port Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary:
Me and my family have now been attending The Rock for about half a year. We love the leaders of the church and love the emphasis on grounded Biblical teaching, making sure we are getting the entire context of Scripture. Pastor Aaron is very friendly and wise. He has a strong desire to grow the kingdom of God through raising up leaders and planting other churches. The School of Ministry does an incredible job of preparing ministry leaders. The church also has the correct mindset when it comes to praise and worship. It is not about putting on a show and making it like a concert, it's about getting the opportunity to worship God and put our focus on Him. I love that!

The Rock is such a great church with lots of an amazing families! I strongly recommend checking out this church and making it your church home. I went to the service today at 11:00 my friend invited me there .I enjoyed singing to the Lord and the word about Marta and Mary . i felt full of joy with my Jesus in my heart. I love this church and wish I had found it sooner.  Finally, a real church family! The preaching is excellent - verse by verse in the Old Testament on Thursday nights and the New Testament on Sunday mornings.  Pastor Aaron has an amazing gift of teaching and his love for his congregation is always apparent. There are so many fellowship opportunities available every week. If you really want to learn the Bible in its entirety and crave fellowship with other believers, this is the church for you. They are a wonderful Bible verse by verse teaching church.  The people are very friendly and loving. It’s a lovely church that my husband and I admire and enjoy going to. Leadership is uplifting, encouraging, and go above and beyond to equip, teach, and support.
Pastor Aaron church looks beyond their agenda to extend the kingdom of God by equipping others inside and outside of their church. It’s a church that doesn’t just talk the talk but walks the walk as well in fellowship, love, and much more. Robbyn is the sweetest and wisest pastors wife out there. The Rock Calvary Chapel family Rocks!!

name: The Rock Church
The Rock Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary: My 3 star rating is only due to a neutral stance for church's. I was invited for easter sunday by a close friend. Im use to more low-key reverent church services, so this was a new experience for me. Everyone was really nice. The service was good. But lacked in a bit of what or why easter is celebrated. Im sure thats probably just my worldly thinking. But it was good. They have a band and play music and invite all to sing. So if thats your thing then this is the church for you. First time I visit the rock, very friendly people very helpful finding a parking. The spirit of God was in the church. It was a blessing and also one of the pastors prayed for me and my husband. Thank you for all your love and support. It was a blessing to be there The best place for worshipping God. This Church is no joke by far the best church I have ever been part of. If you go there everyone will make you feel welcome. You are free to praise God and pastor Jerry is the best pastor ever. Everyone at THE ROCK has been very kind and welcoming. I just want to start by saying you never know who will come into your life and really make a difference. This year has been a year of FAITH AND GROWTH for my family. I was invited to this church by a very young coworker a whole 10yr gap sit between us but god knew I needed this opportunity. My first service was so peaceful and I felt filled with gratitude. Pastor Kimberly is so warm and inviting, makes you feel right at home. The staff that watches over the little ones was also very kind. Amber was so kind and helpful, she took the time to show us around and watched over my little one. This was my husband’s and my first Christian service and worship. The worship is amazing, it’s a feeling you need to experience yourself. I want to thank everyone at THE ROCK for making my family feel welcomed and finding a home church ❤️.  Thank you 🙏🏽 I have been a member of this church since 2004. I have been a member of a previous church and visited many Christian churches in the county but never have I been to one that is more sincere, warm, welcoming and loving than The Rock. The encouragement in growing in my relationship with Jesus &  support of the church family is priceless! There is so much to offer regarding classes to help you grow in your understanding of God and His ways as well as being able to apply the gifts that God has given you to share. I have not been surprised to realize that a number of families travel quite a distance because of the integrity of the pastoral staff and members. There's a lot for everyone especially for the youth as they have Treasure Island for those of elementary-age. There's a time for them to have play at what I have always explained as a Christian Chuck-E-Cheese style play area but more importantly a time for them to have Bible studies that are at their level of understanding. There's a youth ministry for those that are tweeners and in junior high, a high school ministry for those of high school age, young adults for those 18 to 29, a singles ministry, a married couples ministry, a seniors ministry and now men's and women's Bible study too. Yes they even have child care & an opportunity to love on the infants and toddlers by a team of volunteers that have been trained and background checked to provide a safe and loving environment for your children. We have the English (including Chinese translation), Spanish, Korean and the Vietnamese congregations not to mention multiple campuses in Santa Clarita, Seal Beach, South OC, Lake Elsinore and Corona as well as two Saturday night services, two Sunday morning services, a Wednesday night service, etc. There's something for everyone and I would encourage you to come and receive the true love from God the Father,  Jesus Christ the Son and the Holy Spirit. I know you'll never be the same in Jesus name! I pray that you'll join us.

name: The Rock Church and World Outreach Center
The Rock Church and World Outreach Center - San Bernardino Campus
reviewSummary:
My family and I came here for the food drive. It was my 2nd time here and I wasn't aware that dependents could use my card. We had moved from the general lines to the 1st timer/no ID line. I had my family member apply as a 1st timer since it was their 1st time there, and as I was unaware they could use my card as a dependent. We'd been there since 6am, and we were finally seen at around 8:40, where we were told that they could use my card. Instead of being let thru with a badge and a warning, we were sent to the back of the line. It was 8:56 by then. We did as we were told, excited at the prospect of finally getting food when we were stopped by a guy at the end. He had told us that he'd seen us leave the back of the 1st timer line when we'd clearly come from the tables. He'd been very hard headed, refusing to understand our situation. He begun to mock and ridicule us as we kept trying to explain, so frustrated, we went to go get another volunteer who'd seen us in line since 6. He refused to listen to both us and the volunteer, and would not let us thru despite having been there for hours, so ultimately, we went home empty handed.

A little empathy, none of the mockery/ridicule and some understanding would have gone a long way. I have been in church my entire life and attended many churches of different denominations and have never experienced such hospitality, care for the community, and reverence for God as I do at The Rock. The house of God is truly taken care of and the Spirit of God leads everything they do. The church and Pastors truly love people to life, which is the mission of the church. Thank you, Rock Church, for being the hands and feet of Jesus. Thank you to all the Pastors for equipping us with biblical truth every service. You are so appreciated! Awesome experience.
I was just visiting from Northern California, and this was the closest place to my hotel. What a wonderful house of prayer and worship?! Makes me want to move! How many angels must be in an establishment of this caliper? My schedule and health changed so I went looking for an evening service. Regulars were very welcoming and the evening service is smaller. I was even invited to their salt group which meets after morning Sunday service for lunch for older folk every two weeks. The service is only an hour which makes it even easier to attend. The campus is beautiful and sprawling. Definitely will be going again! Very inspirational message. Speaker was Pastor Jeff T Osborne from Patria Church (ALFC) who spoke on unseen advantages, rest and give it to God. This was my first time and I will visit again.

name: The Rock Church Fort Myers
The Rock Church Fort Myers - Fort Myers Campus
reviewSummary:
I remember the first time I walked through the doors, from the moment I arrived, I felt the presence of God. Everyone was welcoming, genuine, and inviting.
Eight years later, that feeling remains the same. There is a sweet presence of God here, and it truly feels like home. There is no place I would rather be.
I have built lifelong friendships and experienced tremendous spiritual growth in this wonderful church. The pastor and his wife are truly exceptional people whose love, leadership, and dedication are a blessing to so many.
I am deeply humbled and grateful that God led my family and me here. This church has been an incredible part of our journey, and I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone looking for a place to grow in faith and be part of a loving church family. I attended this church for over 3 years and initially loved the music and energy, but over time my experience changed. I began to feel that acceptance depended on conforming to leadership rules, giving money through tithes, and giving money for special leadership lavish gifts, overworking in ministry, and never questioning anything or showing tiredness.

While volunteering in a particular ministry, everything felt last minute and if it didn't fit my schedule then I was told I was not being flexible enough. When I decided to stop volunteering in that ministry, it was demanded that I have a meeting to get permission to stop volunteering. When I started setting healthy boundaries and asking questions, it felt I was labeled as having a “rebellious spirit” and it felt I was treated as if I was "backsliding". If I missed one service, I received texts from leadership and other nosey folks asking why I was not there.

The preaching often felt aggressive with yelling and felt very repetitive, and services seemed very production-driven with a strong focus on emotional reactions manipulated by music. My kids and I also experienced judgment and elitism, where it felt like certain families or people in the “inner circle” were treated very differently, like royalty. I felt judged constantly, whether it was something I was wearing, something I was doing or not doing, something my kids were doing or not doing, or when I'd speak up, etc.

What troubled me most was seeing leadership living very lavish lifestyles while some members, including myself, were struggling financially to support the family. I appreciate transparency with where tithes are allocated but I never seen this once while attending/giving here.

Unfortunately, I never felt the genuine love, support, or healthy community that a church environment should provide. My experience here was disappointing, hurtful, and ultimately led me to leave. I went to the rock for the first time these past Sunday with my 11-year-old daughter who almost lost her life last week. No doubt about it she was saved by our Lord Jesus Christ. I had so many proof of it. At the church, I had an experience like no other, kids running happily, the beautiful choir, making everybody jump and down in absolute joy, and the pastor was something else! I’m going back and then back and then back some more. I’m going to get baptized in this church and will baptize my daughter. The energy at this holy place is extraordinary. The people are beyond friendly and welcoming. A life changing experience! Such an amazing church. This has been my church for the last 6 years. I moved across the country and found a place that I know I could truly call home. So thankful for the Godly atmosphere and love that is in this place. Raising a family here is such a blessing, knowing my children will be surrounded by good Godly people is a huge deal. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a home church for you and/or your family. This is the place to come and be apart! What a church. TRC is truly a blessing and I thank God for the Bishop and the members. When I first came to the church in 2020. My mother and I were in a dark place. Our family had been trying to survive the devastating murder of my brother so we moved from Broward county to Lee County. God brought me to TRC using a instagram reel of the choir singing and I had ran to so my mom. She saw her coworker up in the choir and said that’s the church my coworker told me about. We immediately loved the church in our first visit. people tend to go to church to meet their own expectations or experience. But when I tell you that the spirit of the Lord is in this church I mean it. My story and testimony is long for this section. But I would compel anyone to visit just once and leave your expectations and what you think church should be and come with an open heart and trust me you will see God move like never before. Come experience the difference.

name: The Rock Church Temecula Valley

reviewSummary:
Love this church! It has a great community and an overall loving atmosphere. I’m having to find another church since I’m moving soon, and I’m hoping to find one just like this! Pastor Henny is so passionate about the word and he preaches truth! If you want the word of god if you wanna grow and learn give it a try. We absolutely love it every their is so passionate about the lord and the word Landen is also great.
Be blessed I simply wanted to go into the parking lot. Pull up, cones? Okay no problem I’m good at listening to cones. Then I get forced to take a right? Into a giant church line that will take 30+ mins? Crazy, but I’ll turn out. I can’t turn out because you blocked EVERY AISLE? Okay nah, imma turn around and leave. *I pulled into a parking spot for my dr office, turned around, and drove 30 feet back the way I came to the ONLY exit*. THEY TRIED TO KEEP ME FROM THE EXIT. They also blocked 1,000ft of the right lane of Sky Canyon Dr. Better hope yall have a permit for this, blocking a *disabled x2* car from leaving a parking lot you crowded takeover style. name: The Rock Community Church
The Rock Community Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary: Most amazing place to worship with fellow Christians. Line by line Biblical teaching, gracious, loving and amazing staff and entire church family. Pastor Marty is the BEST Pastor in the Santa Clarita Valley! I was so happy to find this church. My husband loves going to church now. Thank you Pastor Marty. Pastor Marty is knowledgeable & funny. name: The Sanctuary Church FTL
The Sanctuary Church FTL - Fort Lauderdale Campus
reviewSummary:
An enchanted experience🧡The music was exquisitely presented. The musicians excellent. The atmosphere and acoustics of this mid-century church were superb. The brief introduction by each one of the musicians of each movement gave insight, which gave personal engagement with each musician. So grateful! Excellent! This was a date night for my husband and I, was a bit nervous since I planned it, BUT was pleasantly surprised and excited to walk into the venue. We both had Tito's and cran and enjoyed the ambiance of the moment. Would we do it again...absolutely!!! The atmosphere was magical, the candlelight created a deep sense of peace, and the music of Juan Gabriel was simply beautiful and full of soul. His songs felt timeless, emotional, and deeply moving in this setting. An intimate and unforgettable evening that touched the heart. Highly recommended. I saw the Bridgerton candlelight string Quartet, concert here, and what a stunning venue. They really have a beautiful team for decorations, including fresh florals, the music was incredible, and the ambience is fabulous here. The ambiance was so beautiful.
The overall atmosphere and performance by the Collin’s quartet was amazing. Can’t wait to go to another event.
Not trying to start another east coast west coast beef but 3 Tupac songs and 5 biggies songs.  One on. lol.

name: The Santa Anita Church
The Santa Anita Church - Arcadia Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautiful church space inside lots of windows and natural light. The stained glass backdrop is also lovely. The church service itself felt very traditional, even though the messaging of the church seemed more contemporary. Even though the music was more contemporary the way that it was performed, felt more hymnal. Absolutely the best church of all time. We sing Beatles songs. They are very non judgemental. This is how every church should be. An amazing LGBTQ
+ Community 😘💖🐶💖🏳️‍🌈💖🙏🪩‼️ We were married there in 1981. Still married. Church is perfect setting for a wedding. Our daughter is going to be married there this Saturday. We recently had our daughter's wedding and reception at the Church.  It was fantastic. The Church Wedding planner was friendly and wonderful to work with. Terry conducted a beautiful ceremony and added a perfect touch to it by adding a rose exchange and American Indian prayer.  The entire day was perfect! Would recommend this Church for upcoming Weddings.

name: The Shoreline Church
reviewSummary: Incredible 'sandy feet friendly' church. Extremely welcoming and solid bible teaching. The Saturday night service with the inflatables and dinner is a wonderful idea for kids.

name: The Shoreline Church - San Clemente Campus
reviewSummary: You will know the leadership by their love. There are many at Shoreline that are sincere Christians and amazing people. Unfortunately, I can’t say that about some of the “pastoral staff”. It’s all about appearance there, but when it gets to the core of integrity of maintaining the name of Christianity… Very disappointing. My Daughter introduced my wife and I to The Shoreline.  We have since made it our home.    Really enjoy the message and the Christian community here at The Shoreline The shoreline church is a come as you are congregation with arms wide open. I found this church through a fried and it has just been a fit for me because I’m a surfer, love the ocean and love Jesus but not a big fan of some traditional churches that lack passion, energy and life. You’ll find inspiring and inspirational sermons along with great music.  A little over 2 years ago, I began attending Monday night Celebrate Recovery held at the shoreline church, including taking the step study last year and that has been ever life-changing. I highly encourage you to go as you are with an open heart and be healed of life’s hurts, hang-ups and habits!! I have attended Shoreline Church of San Clemente since it's opening.  I love the community of caring people. I love the teaching, which is Biblically right-on! The worship music is superb - a nice variety of the stand up and clap-type to the mellow, soulful get close to God stuff. What I like the best has to be the many generations represented.  We started as a young church with young families.  Those families have grown up over the past 13 years, which is so much fun to watch. I would encourage anyone who is searching for just the right church to call home to come visit us. I live in the south bay and I attended the Mother's Day service as my wife and I were looking for a new house to rent in San Clemente.  I was so happy to hear the gospel of our Lord proclaimed from the pulpit. I went back the following week to pick up some furniture in the area and stopped by again, and I gave God all the glory once again as they faithfully delivered the gospel again. I pray that the pastors that are called to preach  will not be afraid of the people or look to please board members but are faithful to the our Lord who called them out for service. It was a great experience.

name: The SoCalDistrict The Pentecostal Church
The SoCalDistrict The Pentecostal Church - Santa Clarita Campus
The Spoken Word Christian Church
The Spoken Word Christian Church - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
Attending 10+ years.  The church has a wonderful heart and great personality with truly caring and active people. The lead pastor Bob is thoughtful and a really strong leader and teacher but most of all his strength lies in his heart as a shepherd.  Pastor John is a deep thinker and extraordinary teacher.  I often leave the service contemplating the message.

When we initially attended, after shopping around, we never felt pushed to join but felt noticed and that was from the love of Christ these people have.

My wife and I were seeking a Christ center church family where we could get connected and we found it at the Spoken Word Church.

Be blessed!

Rick Rutecki 10-years ago my wife and I were looking for a smaller church with with a pastor who teaches directly from the bible.  This church also had to have a true family feel.  Less than 5 minutes inside the door we knew we found our church home/family.  Since then our faith and our understanding of the word has made an immeasurable impact on not just us but, by extension, our closest friends and family. Thank you, Pastor Bob, for allowing God to lead you and our church. Angie and I were drawn to the Spoken Word church in January of 2018 because of our young granddaughter's weekly experience at the church's program for young children.  Since that time, we have been blessed to not only experience a true sense of community with everyone that attends / participates in the Sunday services, but the leadership of both Pastors Bob Cote and John Chipman have been instrumental in the expansion of our biblical knowledge.
If you are longing for a church that literally "walks the walk" when applying Christian principles, fellowship, education, and the ability to grow your faith, then I would encourage you to attend a Sunday service as soon as possible.  You will definitely not be disappointed. This is a great, small church where you will always be greeted and welcomed!  The sermons are informative, bible-based and help me grow in my knowledge.  The Bible studies are excellent and prayer and fellowship are very strong with every encounter. Personal relationships, availability, and feelings of belonging are what comes to mind when describing the Spoken Word Christian Church. It filters down from Pastor Bob Cote .He genuinely invests in everyone. And it is his nature. This beautiful trait cannot be faked. And it seems to be contagious as it brings out the same in others at church. As Bob often reminds us, it all comes as a gift from Jesus. We just have to accept it. And Him.

name: The Station Church, Carlsbad CA
The Station Church, Carlsbad CA - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
The Station Church is very welcoming and the people are very kind. Feels like family right from the start. Beautiful worship and I find the teachings to be timely, 100% biblical, and relevant to everyday life. I believe Pastor Josh has an anointing to preach. I feel the presence of God and am blessed every time I hear him. I highly recommend visiting here. You may find you never want to go anywhere else.😍
Thank you Lord for what You’re doing at the Station Church!! Our family Loves the station church !! We love the kids program- our kids have so much fun, are safe and learn about Jesus. Worship is on fire and Pastor Josh does such a wonderful job with sermons.  He breaks down verses and how it relates to our real life- and even throws in a joke or two make sure you’re paying attention. And Cant wait till Sunday 9 or 10:30 for our free coffee and donuts !!!! Love this church!! Friendly people, welcoming environment, great Christian community. The preacher has such a modern preaching style, makes The Bible so easy to understand. Iv been going here for 8 years and have grown to love this church more and more 🤍 I’m a pretty picky person when it comes to people and places, but this church stands out.

The pastor has a way of bringing lightness to the Word of God, making it feel approachable without losing its depth. And the worship? I haven’t experienced anything like it anywhere else—it’s truly powerful.

Honestly, more people should come and experience this place for themselves. It’s weird to think that the first day I walked into The Station Church, it felt like home without knowing anyone. That’s what The Station has been… home. A place for my family to grow, for our kids to be loved and learn who God is in a real way, and for my husband and I to be encouraged and supported in every season.

Honestly, more people should come and experience this place for themselves. It’s weird to think that the first day I walked into The Station Church, it felt like home without knowing anyone. That’s what The Station has been… home. A place for my family to grow, for our kids to be loved and learn who God is in a real way, and for my husband and I to be encouraged and supported in every season.

name: The Summit Lighthouse of Los Angeles
The Summit Lighthouse of Los Angeles - Arcadia Campus
reviewSummary: Not here to judge. A very interesting in place. Their headquarters is in the Rocky Mountains of Montana and this site is their Los Angeles church. Very intelligent and interesting place

name: The United Methodist Center
The United Methodist Center - Pasadena Campus
The Valley Vineyard Christian Church
The Valley Vineyard Christian Church - Woodland Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
Very welcoming, feels like family 💕 This church is such a wonderful light in the valley. I only attended for a matter of months, but this place still feels like family over a year after leaving the area. The Lord really met me in this place where and when I needed help in my life most.

I always had a belief and fear of God throughout my life, but here I found Christ (again) and He delivered me back on my feet in one piece.  I met lifelong friends and found a path to healing. The pastor(s) and leaders are such God-loving and humble people--it is such a refreshing and encouraging experience in today's world.

I pray if you are reading this you will also find the connection with Christ and community here to encourage you on your walk.  This church is so worth your visit! I was a member of the church for over 10 years and really enjoyed it. Pastor Bill is great; we went on a mission trip together, attended his weekly home group, and he came to the hospital when my son was born. Thanks, Bill. I love this church. I'm biased because I've been here for 30 years but I love the people so much, I can't go anywhere else and find that kind of acceptance and love. We want to take Jesus out of the church and into the street where people are. I feel safe here and encouraged to be genuine in my love for Jesus. The Holy Spirit is active in that place.

name: The Village Church
reviewSummary: Best known for Matt Chandler's deep, theological preaching. The culture is serious about discipleship and covenant membership. 'Home Groups' are the engine of the church.

name: The Village Church of Irvine
The Village Church of Irvine - Main Campus
The Village Community Presbyterian Church
The Village Community Presbyterian Church - Encinitas Campus
reviewSummary: Amazing church! I’ve been attending weekly for over 6 months now. Pastor Jack and Pastor Jan truly care about the congregation, the church, and the community as a whole. But most importantly, this church puts God first. The traditional service has one of the most beautiful choirs I’ve ever heard. The service has such a nice structure: prayer, benediction, and hymns accompanied by a lovely organ. I would 10/10 recommend this church to anyone! Even if you’re Catholic, Orthodox, or any denomination of Protestant. This church welcomes everyone to the table of Christ. This church is so welcoming. The traditional service is nicely structured with vivid prayers, nourishing sermons and the most stunning choir. The sanctuary is gorgeous and the church really teaches you to walk with Christ, through the service and all the events they do. It is the perfect mix of praising God, fellowship, serving others and fun. So glad I found The Village Community Presbyterian Church. I love it! Wonderful choir, meaningful sermons that you are drawn to discuss after the service with one another, great attention paid to tweens with a robust Confirmation program lead by devoted pastors. Church hosts many community building events. We heard the Sea Chanters in concert at this church last night. The Sea Chanters are part of The United States Navy Band. They were absolutely awesome. If you get a chance to hear them, I highly recommend it. Great concert. Excellent venue!

name: The Village SBC
The Village SBC - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary: Truly blessed and anointed people of God led by a man and woman of God who have served the Lord all their lives! I have been a musician here since I was in high school and I have been truly blessed in how God has used me and guided me while at this ministry. This is a church that is all about family, prayer, worship, and the true word of God. You won't leave without receiving an importation from God. The Village SBC has met the spiritual needs of my family.  The church is spiritually sound, biblically based, and you can feel the presence of the Holy Spirit.  A great Chuch for family worship! Bishop Jackie Green is a Master Teacher, if you want to learn the Bible, I highly recommend to come and enjoy the services, also she has a Bible university, you will learn so much!! Called RDU register today! Your life will never be the same!! The Village is a great place for seeking Worship and the hearing a NOW Word. Awesome atmosphere were you can truly feel the Holy Spirit and knowing Jesus is welcomed.

name: The Vine Church
The Vine Church - Daytona Beach
The Vine Church - Daytona Beach - Daytona Beach Campus
reviewSummary: We love Christ church. The message is easy to understand. The people are friendly and welcoming. We love that Christchurch has come to Daytona Beach. Perfect for families and those who are seeking God. Nice  remodel place  God bless this building  in Jesus name Amen 🙏 Love my church trend setting and ground breaking the new  Daytona Beach Location is absolutely beautiful and very inviting come see for yourself and experience Awesome people and great preaching and ministering of the word of God I look forward to Sunday Evenings. Great Energy, Very Welcoming, Beautiful People!!! Pastor Jesse is amazing. I love his sermons.

name: The Vine Church - Pomona / Claremont Campus
reviewSummary: I went to this church for worship and prayer, it was amazing. They Have Celebrate Recovery on Thursdays. The people are very friendly. Stopped by for their 11am Sunday service last weekend on a referral of a  friend, had an pleasant experience. Ivan did a great job sharing the word he has become so stronger, grounded and walking in faith. One of my favorite congregations I would say this is my family of God had been going there for over 10 years. I moved so I’m not able to go as much anymore, but the pastor is amazing and everybody in the church we’re just like a family we have our ups and downs, but we love each each other at the end of the day and we love God just the same. And various small groups each day of the week.

name: The Vine Church Of Rancho Cucamonga
The Vine Church Of Rancho Cucamonga - Rancho Cucamonga Campus
reviewSummary:
Been going to this church for little over a year.  Pastor Jeff has been such an amazing blessing.  He truly has a heart for people and provides the Word.  The people are "real" and coming together with the body of Christ each week to worship is great!!!  Just give it a try.  You won't be disappointed. I have been going here for about 3 years and I love it. The people are friendly and inviting and Pastor Jeff has a heart after Jesus. You will never ever find a perfect church so don't expect to. What you will find is God's word being taught and that's what you need. Pastor Jeff is amazing.  His messages, besides my own father's, are amazing!  The childrens ministry is over the top fun.
The women's bible studies amd mom 2 mom group are fun to be apart of. The overall thing I love about this church is that it is a giving church. The only thing I’d recommend to my brothers in Christ, is to update their phone number. I’m a truck driver and needed to park and wanted to call and ask for authorization to do it; wrong number listed so I parked on the other side, at Walmart, risking that they probably would give me a ticket. Knowing WALMART!!! Blessings brothers and keep rejoicing in our Great Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. One of the most loving churches in Cucamonga. People are down to earth and family oriented while loving and trusting God . The Vine Church is a great place to worship Jesus Christ.

name: The Way
The Way - Brea Campus
reviewSummary: I Love The Way! It’s a church made with God’s special design.  This is not only church but a multi-cultural family that is filled with love, support and led by God!❤️ I visited one time with a friend and it was such a good message. I also love how the people there are so nice and welcoming. I did notice that with my friend she was struggling with relationships within the church but would never tell me for the sake of her church's reputation and I found that a bit weird. Other than that I enjoyed it. When joining this church I was a little hesitant (because I was raised catholic) but I decided to go and give it a chance and I am so glad I did. Everyone was so welcoming and 10 years (I think) they have become a family. The pastors are amazing. Some of my family members are also apart of the church. If you are looking for a new church you should definitely check out The Way in Brea. 🥰🥰🥰 The Way has opened my eyes to a different way of life. The very first time, the day I walked in the door. I started to experience something different. I have lots to say but I’ll let it out a little at a time. I’ve been catholic for most of my life. What I’ve learned is amazing. I feel like a changed man. You should try it one day🙏🏻 You can feel the sense of community in this place that most giant churches are now lacking. At least that's my humble opinion.

name: The Way Family Church
The Way Family Church - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary:
My husband and I attended this church hoping to hear solid biblical teaching, and while the pastor did teach God’s Word, his preaching style was overwhelmingly loud and emotional. Instead of drawing our attention to Scripture, the constant yelling and dramatic delivery made it difficult to concentrate on the actual message.

Passion is one thing, but this felt excessive and distracting. To us, it came across as disingenuous and more like an emotional performance than thoughtful preaching. We left feeling that the delivery overshadowed the message itself. We were looking for a church where the focus was on clearly teaching God’s Word in a way that encouraged reflection, and unfortunately, this wasn’t that experience for us. AMAZING CHURCH!! The Bible is preached boldly, worship is powerful, and the tangible presence of God is at this church! Everyone treats you like family and is so friendly! The Pastors are the REAL DEAL and are so loving/genuine! They also have great ministries for children, youth, and young adults! I am so blessed to have found this place! Thank you Jesus! If you are looking for a Holy Spirit filled church, you have to visit here! There’s truly no place like The Way!
The Spirit of God is so evident here—every time I walk in, I feel His presence. The preaching is passionate, Spirit-led, and most importantly, grounded in the Word of God. If you’re looking to encounter Jesus in a real and powerful way, this is the place. I love it here!! I’ve never felt so at home! Walking through the doors and stepping into the sanctuary I’m filled with such joy and peace. This church is so special! From the amazing Pastors to the wonderful people who serve here. Worship and the word of God is so anointed! Please go and check it out yourself. My mom, my sister, and I have been impacted by this church in more ways than I can describe. I found this church on Instagram after just recently moving to Murrieta. My family was dealing with the sudden loss of my father and we were looking for a new church to call home. When we first came to a Sunday service, we knew that this is where we were supposed to be. The powerful worship, the passionate biblical preaching, and the loving community is a breath of fresh air. I’ve experienced the power of God in a way I never had before. I am so thankful for The Way and know that God is doing something AMAZING here! If you’re looking for a great Holy Spirit filled church, come visit!

name: The Well
The Well - Poway Campus
reviewSummary:
This is truly a house of the Lord! To walk through the doors of The Well is to feel loved!. We love the pastors, we love the congregation and yes… we are Jewish! We have had meals in their beautiful  Succah, we have joined the wonderful Passover Seders and we are honored to have attended the most memorable Yom Ha’Shoah services. The Well is a family treasure in Poway. Soooo what can I say about The Well... I'm am biased, so I'll just put that out there!!❤ My husband and I are the Pastors, so why am I giving it 5 stars 🌟 you may ask? I'm giving it the highest rating because of the people!!! The folk at the Well are kind and genuine!❤ We come from very different backgrounds and ethnic groups but we love one another!❤ We translate into Spanish for our Spanish speakers and even though I'm African American and my husband is white,  we have folk from South Korea, Philippines 🇵🇭, China, Mexico 🇲🇽, Netherlands 🇳🇱 and America 🇺🇸 we are one! So it's the people that make this place and we pray, ALOT... and we love God! Not perfect... but a FAMILY! We are small but mighty. I am privileged to say The Well has been my home church for the past 17 years   ! If you are looking  for a small, strong church   with a solid teaching  of the gospel   and  a firm  belief  of the Lordship  of God, please visit us. You will be embraced . Beautiful worship service! The Holy Spirit truly lives here and I was warmly welcomed as a first-time visitor. The pastors teach the true Word of God. I was also very moved by the music ministery. This church offers so much to Poway and surrounding cities. I definitely recommend attending it and I look forward to attending it again when I am in the area!

Thank you Jesus for providing this wonderful place of worship and praise! VBS this summer at The Well was so fun, the children learned so much, great games, activities, lessons from the Bible as well as lessons about interacting with other children in a healthy way and managing emotions during the pandemic, the recital on the final day was so well done and so sweet it brought me to tears, thank you for offering our children some normalcy in these trying times... staff at the VBS made this a fun event and great learning experience and an opportunity to make new friends! can't wait to come back for the fall VBS weekend!

name: The Well Christian Church
The Well Christian Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary: Wonderful organization caring and helping many in this area!  Keep up the good work Loving, welcoming, Christ centered church I love the Wells Church

name: The Well Christian Fellowship

If you are looking for a church, please come see for yourself how great this place is! Wonderful church across the street from the beach.  This church has a wonderful body of members who show real love and compassion. This is not a run of the mill come for the experience and go home church. If you have a question about faith or nlooking for a church home try this church you will be happy you did. I love this church! I feel like it is my extended family. Warm. Welcoming and Steeped in the Word!

Come and experience Jesus the way the Disciples did;. These are real people sharing the love of God!

The Pastor, Tone Benedict, is very passionate about loving people in tangible ways and encouraging people to meet the needs of their neighbors. Ive been a member for three years and I love it here. I feel loved and accepted. This church has given my life so much purpose. There is so much opportunity to get involved with the many different missions we have including delivering showers to our street friends, furnishing the homes of people in need, or feeding the hungry.... All of this and much more, centers around LOVE and meeting people wherever they are at in life. Jesus said, "its the sick who need a doctor" and thats who we try to serve. This church means HOME to me. Come join us! This review is actually from Lucille Gabany Pastor Tone and Jesse and all of the staff and the congregation the time I’ve been coming I feel the presence of God I see God in the lives of the people. I love how  the Well church is committed to spreading the need for Jesus for ALL People.

name: The Well SGV
The Well SGV - Arcadia Campus
reviewSummary:
I am so glad to have visited The Well SGV today. For the record, I have no history or personal affiliation with this church. I walked through the doors this morning as a completely random first time visitor who only found this church through Yelp...

But what I found surprised me.

I found a new church plant that started merely 3 months ago. I found smiling faces and heart for Jesus and new visitors like me. Very little effort was needed on my part as I was immediately greeted by Peggie at the Greeters Table. Introductions and laughter were shared. Then directly after service, Peggie led Pastor David right to my wife and I so we could meet and shake hands with him... I had great conversations with Pastor David and Pastor Rick. And another shout out to Wilson and Annie for your warm welcome.

While this is a new church plant and might lack a few of the bells and whistles of more established churches. They preach the gospel in a real and approachable way here. The Well SGV has all the heart without all the pretense. They care, without caring who you are, or where you come from. And I appreciate that.

This church aims to be multi-ethnic and multi-generational and I hope that will come to fruition. But as it stands right now, most of the congregation seem to be of Asian descent. I really only point that out so anyone visiting can get a glimpse of what to expect on your visit.

Wrapping up, I understand that this is less of a review and more of a recounting of my first time visit. But I hope this recounting takes away any anxiousness you might feel walking into a new church for the first time. And I hope this helps you on your journey to find a body of believers you can call home.

I absolutely plan to visit again. And you should too... Started going here since August 2023 and it’s crazy how time flies! Everyone here is so welcoming and I feel like I’ve found my family.

There’s free lunches every Sunday which has been great to get to meet individuals. There’s also plenty of parking!

The preaching is very theologically sound and pastor David is extremely kind and humble. I love going to Well because everyone is so warm and loving. I felt the brotherly love. The atmosphere is very joyful. Pastor David ‘s sermon is so rewarding and powerful and he is very humble and gentle and always preaching the truth of god’s word. It is a very blessing place to learn and get to know Jesus! This is a new church plant in the SGV area. It's a multi-ethnic, multi-generational, gospel-centered church. We meet on Sundays at 10 AM at the Arcadia Community Center. Come join us for worship. All are welcome! Every member at The Well SGV is so nice and welcoming! Even though the community just started, it really feels like a family. We welcome all to checking us out :)

name: The Well South Bay
The Well South Bay - Torrance Campus
The Westside Church
The Westside Church - Westwood Campus
reviewSummary: I am from New York and I joined this Church. This Church has changed my life as I found purpose, community, and eternal life. Jesus has changed my life and i’m so encouraged I can build my faith with brothers and sisters. Westside has been my home for the last 4 years, I joined the college ministry in 2022, and have been connected with the church until my senior graduating year. This church values community, sound doctrine, and living life to the full. I love this church and I would highly recommend pulling through to our community. :) The Westside church has been a welcoming, supportive faith community where I’ve built authentic friendships. The Bible teaching is in-depth and meaningful, with something for all ages and walks of life. The worship music is beautiful and uplifting, creating a great atmosphere each service. A wonderful place to grow in faith and connect with others! I am a part of the college campus ministry in Westside. This church has truly gave me community in college and has forever changed my experience. Please come out and meet the most amazing family of believers you will meet!! I’ve been part of The Westside Church for 4.5 years now — how time flies! Being part of such an enriching community, making lifelong friends, and encouraging one another to grow in maturity and likeness of Jesus has been such a gift. I’ve never felt more confident recommending something. If you’re visiting, I encourage you to take it slow and join a small group on Wednesday nights — in my opinion, it’s the easiest and most meaningful way to build close relationships.

name: The Worldwide Christian Center Church
The Worldwide Christian Center Church - Pompano Beach Campus
reviewSummary: My wife and I joined the Worldwide Christian Center Church Jan. 1, 2020. I joined because Dr. Pastor O'Neil Dozier is teaching the Holy uncompromising words of God. The Pastor and the assistant Pastors are all on one accord with the teachings of God's Holy Words. The church meets Wednesdays at 7:30pm and Sundays at 11am, the scriptures are broken down into its simplest form for understanding and translated back into Hebrew for the Old Testament and Greek for the New Testament. The church Minister of music is a awesome brother who loves the Lord,  you can feel the love in his heart as he sing God's anorting songs each week. If you want Soul Food for your Spirit and you're ready to fall in love with your Saviour Jesus Christ than this is the house you need to be in! Amen There are not many Pastors that teach uncompromising Word of God . Dr Dozier teach the truth lead by Holy Spirit . If you're ready to grow spiritually this church is a open Bible teaching. Truly a bible based church where everyone is like family. This is a great place to fellowship and hear the word of God. Here there is "Preaching for reaching " the least and the lost.

name: theeffect church
theeffect church - San Juan Capistrano Campus
reviewSummary:
I just wanted to tell all at  theeffect how much I love all of you. So many of us have been given hope from despair and delivered from  desperation and set free through your faith ministry  and finding God and our savior Jesus.  You gave us a place to be at peace and find love and share love with all of you.

I am so blessed, as many other before me and now are, that you share your love with us.

God was thinking of you when he created us.  LOVE you foever

John The Effect is a very warm ,  friendly and genuine place.  Dave is an amazing pastor portraying a loving God.  You learn more on what Jesus really said and how he was understood in by 1st century Hebrews.  The atmosphere is very accepting and it is all about how we can continue to transform. Leaving someone better than when you first met them.  Learning to live in the moment rather than regretting the past or worrying about the future. The effect church has become an integral part of my life. I love the welcoming and warm atmosphere, the exceptional live music, and Pastor Dave’s inspiring and thought provoking messages. It’s a place of peace, love, and friendship. My relationship with the Lord has grown and matured. The effect has proven to be a one of a kind experience that I cherish. We have been attending this church regularly for a few years now. Our kids love it, and get disappointed if we're not able to go.  The music is amazing and the feeling that everyone is accepted just as they are is something that can't be beat. I love Dave's style of teaching instead of preaching, he presents information and invites you to take your own spiritual journey, by striping away the things you thought you knew about God and Jesus, bringing it back to the core, and starting new by finding purpose and new way of living life. It's never a bottled message. After attending a mega church for 27 years, this was a refreshing and needed change. The homey, "come as you are" atmosphere immediately put my soul at ease. After 5 years of attending theeffect, I can truly say that personal transformation has occurred in a way I never experienced before or ever dreamed possible. The message Pastor Dave delivers never fails to resonate in a deep heart-felt way and the worship team consistently rocks! Love this place!

name: Theophilus Orthodox Presbyterian Church
Theophilus Orthodox Presbyterian Church - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary: coming from India, I wanted to find a church that is biblical and multi-cultural.  I found that church with Theophilus.  The wonderful diversity of brothers and sisters in the Lord reminds me of heaven, every time I am in worship. I like everything about this body of Christ-Church Theophilus. Worship every lord's day with the Christ centered sermon, hymns and fellowship with all the church member, Grateful to God for this church. Very welcoming local church rooted in reformed theology - always a blessing to worship here! People there are friendly and easy to talk to. I like the sermons especially because they are Christ centered Reformed and Christ-centered worship.  Friendly and welcoming fellowship.

name: Thrive LA Church
Thrive LA Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: Thrive offers a very open, caring and welcome atmosphere. If you're looking for a place to connect and thrive, I recommend checking out one of the services. Thrive is such an inclusive & wonderful place to fellowship and learn about having a relationship with Christ. So much LOVE ❣️ It's hard to find family in LA.

name: Torrance Community Church of Christ
Torrance Community Church of Christ - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary:
A True Blessing and a Welcoming Family! Joining this church community about a month ago has been such a wonderful blessing in my life. From day one, the pastor and his wife have been unbelievably kind and welcoming, and the entire congregation feels like a real, caring family. I was recently baptized here, and I cannot express how grateful I am to have found this home.
I look forward to coming every single week, whether it's diving deeper into the Word during Friday night Bible study or worshipping together on Sunday morning. If you are looking for a place filled with love, warmth, and genuine faith, I can't recommend this church enough. I am so happy and deeply grateful to be a part of this community! 🥰🥰🥰 Lovely welcoming church with kind people, great sermons and their eyes  fixated on God. I have been searching for a local church where I would feel comfortable and be able to have fellowship with a mixed congregation - there are people from all races, states and backgrounds which I love. I'm from the UK so for me, it was crucial I found a place that was multicultural and accepting. Nobody make comments about my accent and I wasnt questioned about what i was doing there etc etc.

The leader Marcus and his wife are extremely personable and friendly, Marcus delivers sermons with ease and passion. His desire to know God is reflected through his teachings and it comes from a pure heart. He is even inspiring me in that he urges me to want to know the lord more not just turn up to church on sundays.

There is a bible study on wednesdays at 4.30 pm which lasts an hour and a half and another one at 9 am before church service on sundays. After church service finishes there is a room at the back where people go to share a coffee or piece of cake. Some people bring homemade cakes and it's a fantastic opportunity to naturally meet and get to know members of the congregation.

I recommend this church for all ages. It's a good place to go if you are starting out your journey with the lord or want to know more or follow a calling you have. Excellent service. Everyone is so friendly and the worship is lovely, looking forward to visiting again when i’m in town. Me and my family love coming to church every Sunday and for mid week bible study. The minister brother Marcus Lyons has simplified the LORDS word in his sermons and brought much more understanding of the scriptures to me and my family. He has taught us to handle everything with love and patience. The congregation has shown us a lot of love and has shared their wisdom. They have started a children's worship class, and the teacher has made the experience fun for my daughter well learning at the same time. Thank you Torrance Church of Christ for helping me and my family grow Spiritually. Church of Christ is a place with good people who have kind hearts!
LATELY they have put a lot of prayer & effort into making the place welcoming for new attendees & you can really feel the love flowing through there. The residents are down to earth and very kind, they make you feel like part of the family from the get go. Highly Recommend.

name: Torrance First Baptist Church
Torrance First Baptist Church - Redondo Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
I went to a very nice concert here yesterday and it was really good I grew up with the senior pastor, a real solid good guy who loves God’s word, easy to talk to and has 20+ years of ministry experience. His wife and daughters are stellar!! People who are friendly and available to others. I only visited once bc I live an hour away but everyone there was very friendly to me. My teenagers went to the youth group and I have to say, it was their first time really feeling welcomed at a youth group.
