name: Torrance New Life Church
Torrance New Life Church - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary:
My daughter was searching for a church to attend and praying for guidance. ‘One day, she told me, this is the place where the Lord is showing me to attend’. That is how we joined the congregation, there we felt the moving of the Holy Spirit and the love of the pastor and congregation. I praise the
Lord for guiding us to New Life Church. I had so much fun with Jesus.  I got healed.  The best time ever at a church.  Magnificent people of God.  God bless you all.  ❤️ My family and I attend and serve at this beautiful church!.

I thank the Lord Jesus Christ for saving me and turning my life around at a time when all hope was lost. It's this very church where my family and I heard the gospel for the very first time.
Since that Sunday morning back in 2014, my wife and I have never looked back. We found very friendly, loving people that welcomed us and made us feel at home, eventually we became like family. There is lots of great potential in this church and many Opportunities for growth. The worship is fantastic!, There is also a beautiful nursery for babies and toddlers and a children's ministry upstairs. After service everyone is invited to the fellowship hall for a delicious meal and a time to connect with guests and staff. But most important of all is that the gospel of Jesus christ is preached with no watered down messages! And everyone gets to experience the power of God.

I would highly recommend coming to this church to fellowship with other believers!
And to EXPERIENCE GOD then FIND HOPE and SHARE CHRIST. People were very kind and welcoming. The sermon was even better. There so many small groups and activities. In addition, teen ages can hangout with their peers. Pastor Glen and wife Marie, prayed for me during a time of need and that was comforting to be able to get to know the  leader of church on a personal level. Many other churches I have attended before, I was only able to greet the Pastors in passing and know of him by what was posted on Internet. Torrance New Life Church was intimate but yet just as spirit filled as the bigger denomination churches. I would definitely recommend checking out a Sunday service on Sunday and attending  a life group Wed. Nights at the church.

name: Torrey Pines Church
Torrey Pines Church - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary:
Look, I've tried to find a reason not to love this church. I've got nothing.

Pastor Mingo is the kind of pastor who makes you forget you're sitting in a chair. Every. Single. Sunday. Enlightening, funny, edge-of-your-seat stuff, the man does not miss.

Maya's worship? Banger after banger. I don't know how she keeps topping herself but here we are. The worship is fire Sunday after Sunday, come and see for yourself!

I don't even have young kids and I was genuinely jealous today. 500 children. 8,000 Easter eggs. Multiple jumping castles. I'm a grown adult and I seriously considered getting in line.

The location is La Jolla. As in, arguably the most beautiful place on the planet. As in, you're sitting there thinking about God with the Pacific Ocean basically just off in the distance.

And then — THEN — they hand you a pour-over coffee. For free. Just because.

Five stars isn't enough. My wife and I have attended this church for many years, and it truly feels like home. It’s relaxed, welcoming, and open to believers, seekers, and skeptics alike. There are both modern and traditional services with the same Bible-based message. The pastors are engaging, practical, and thoughtful. The campus is beautiful, parking is easy, the kids’ program is excellent, and there are great opportunities for fellowship and spiritual growth. Such an amazing atmosphere to worship and friendly people who feels like a family.  Wonderful family environment with caring and safe kids ministry.  Nice to see so many young adults and you families. A wonderful, warm and welcoming church. Every week brings multiple blessings- from the strengthening message from Pastor Tim (always bible based), to the gracious members who are always welcoming and the presence of the Lord that surrounds us all! Great place to feel welcome love the vibes we are always doing community events and inviting everyone to find and follow Jesus

name: Trabuco Presbyterian Church - Lake Forest Campus
reviewSummary: A few years ago I was trying to find a place to rest because I had just become homeless. I tried to rest on the lawn in front of the church. There were people there who came out to tell me to leave. Not a big deal, I started packing up my stuff and I started asking about the church. The women basically told me it wasn’t for me, and turned me away. Come to find out years later it’s a Presbyterian church like I grew up going to?? I didn’t even get into the fact that I was a young girl in my 20’s on the streets - something they couldn’t care less about. People like this and how I was treated make me sick now because I realize how full of it you all are. Yes, I have a family now and we’re not homeless. Y’all are heartless. Trabuco Presbyterian is the most inclusive and engaging church community I have been to. Shoutout to Caleb Henry for his amazing youth program, he is truly the best. This church is a good place to raise your kids in and in my opinion the best. We’ve attended this church for many years. Christ-centered, biblical-based worship and caring, warm community. Offers children’s programs, bible studies, and many other programs. Church community actively serving many other ministries, as well (support missionaries, food drives, work with homeless programs, etc). All welcome! Phenomenal community that seeks to build people up, encourage them, and create space for authentic life together while preaching and teaching Christs truth in unique and creative ways!! Easter Sunday! Loved celebrating Easter with our community and church family!

name: Transformation Church
reviewSummary: Exploded in popularity through social media. Mike Todd's illustrative sermons are viral hits. The culture is urban, fashionable, and culturally relevant.

name: Transformation Church - Tallahassee Campus
reviewSummary: I experienced a great church full of friendly people in a welcoming environment with pastors who lead with integrity! And, most importantly, there was a tangible presence of God that permeated the service! I highly recommend this church! Hello, and prayers to everyone reading also God Bless and have a happy new year! I’ve been struggling as a college student for a while now and started two new jobs PT and looking for a Third, because I am in school I haven’t received many blessings and now with possibly leaving college im begging God to send me signs and what to do so this what God decides, ask the community . I’ve been denied food stamps, rental assistance . I was told to sell my body and I refused started crying and praying for God to send me ANYTHING!!! I called churches all over and have been told I need to be a member and pay a fee but because I’m low on money there is NO WAY I can pay. My cash app is $Cponds19 I know I can go to the pantry for food but ANYTHING will help✨🙏🏽 I’ve been in a really bad place the past few years. I hid it well from everyone. I got myself together. I drive by the transformation church all the time. Finally I was like you know what I’m gonna go. Even though I grew up Catholic. I was welcomed. They brought me inside. I had some coffee. They introduced me to some people. I’m alone in Tallahassee so I have no friends or family. Right away the girl said please think of me as family. I went into the church. I sat next to this wonderful lady. During the singing and when the pastor came out to talk, I boo-hoo’d like a baby. The lady next to me comforted me. This church has transformed me. I haven’t gone to the other meetings yet, but I will. After the first time I went two weeks ago in the front, they had these wonderful people saying well you can come up personally and we will pray for you. I didn’t want to say why I was asking for prayer. I said you know health and other things. The lady exactly knew what was wrong with me immediately and said to God, please help her with her trauma. How did she know? She said God spoke to Her. At that point my heart opened. I left a very traumatic relationship that I was abused in every way for three years. About a year ago I moved to Tallahassee. Since then, I tried to drown my sorrows and that didn’t work. But opening my heart to Jesus has changed me in so many ways. Two times I’ve gone and like I said, transformed me. Try it maybe you’ll love it. I hope you do❣️praise God and praise this church. 🙏🙏🙏 A true welcome to the kingdom of God . A wonderful vision and mission at Transformation Church. You immediately find guidance and support! The fellowship is amazing. Every Sunday you are able to takeaway a meaningful message from service for the week ahead. This was one of the first churches my husband tried out before the rest of our family moved to the area to be with him. He loved the message given that day and was excited to take us there. Since then we enjoy worship and every message. Pastor Ryan, Andrea, James, and Mike always deliver well and are passionate about the lord. The children’s ministry is TOP NOTCH. Pastor Emily is really the heart beat of the next gen wing and everyone who interacts with her loves her! She is feeding the children’s ministry with all the love and guidance each child needs to know Him! I am proud to call this church my “home” thankful and blessed to have found this church! Our family’s faith has TRANSFORMED since attending. We love you transformation!

name: Tri-City Bible Church
Tri-City Bible Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve visited this church a few times now, and each visit has been a great experience. The messages are clear, accurate, and grounded in scripture. The worship leader is very talented and leads others well during worship, which really adds to the experience. The atmosphere is welcoming, and everyone I’ve met has been kind and friendly. I am so thankful for this church, I joined eight years ago in 2016. The expository verse by verse Bible teaching has been such a blessing to my heart. We are now in Matthew. Our pastor preaches through the Bible and I receive such wonderful instruction and guidance every time I listen to him. There is a sense of family here. This is such a loving, caring body of believers. I love our women’s ministry as well as many caring connections. Next year we will be studying through the book of Isaiah. I’m praying God‘s blessing on our church and the year ahead.

Numbers 6:24-26
“ May the Lord bless you and keep you;  may the Lord make a face to shine up on you and be gracious to you; may the Lord lift up his countenance upon you and give you peace,”

Jude verses 24-25
“Now to him who is able to keep you from stumbling and to present, you blameless before the presence of his glory with great joy, to the only God, our Savior , through Jesus Christ our Lord,  be glory, majesty, dominion and authority , before all time and now and  forever. Amen “ Tri City Bible Church is a blessing to anyone looking for solid, biblical teaching. The pastor is truly gifted and dedicated to delivering God’s Word in a clear, powerful way. Every sermon is expository, going verse by verse through Scripture, allowing the truth of the Bible to be the foundation of every message. This approach keeps the focus on God’s Word and its application in our daily lives. If you're looking for a church that takes Scripture seriously and seeks to glorify God through accurate, meaningful teaching, this is the place to be! Recommend avoiding the church due to integrity issues on behalf of the pastor. Won't get into it but lots of people left because of it and no change was made. Some of the elders then told the congregation that people left for differences in belief when in reality it had to do with lying and lack of integrity issues from leadership. Anyone who left was labeled as divisive dissenters.

Attended the church myself for about a year and introduced myself a bunch of times. Each time the pastor  totally forgot who I was, he and his wife also seemed to shun us away. Others have reported the same. So unfortunately the pastor seems annoyed by the sheep. Best to get yourself into a church that cares for all of their people and not just a select group. Hope this helps and God bless you in your church search. I have attended here for 7 years and continue to be blessed with the faithful teaching of scripture and the community of genuine believers who continue to love and serve the body of Christ.

For the young man who left the one star review, my heart is grieved that you would take to the internet to air opinions and slander a fellow believer's character in front of a watching world.  This does not glorify our God, or Christ, who prayed that we would be one as He and the Father are one.  Christ builds His church and doesn't need us to take to google reviews to help people hear the Gospel, or brothers and sisters in Christ find a church to worship God and serve the body.  Yet here we are.  Church is not for perfect people and it's not free from human error in perception and judgement, and we aren't immune from hurt feelings and broken relationships.  But we are called to be humble and to pursue peace and reconciliation in love.  My hope is that you have found a church body that you can continue to grow in Christ.

I had to select a number of stars to leave this review, but I would've preferred not to.  Only to God be the glory, and for the seeker of a church, if you walk through our doors you will be welcomed and loved.

name: Trinity Baptist Church
Trinity Baptist Church - El Cajon Campus
reviewSummary:
Trinity Baptist Church has been an incredible blessing to my life. If you’re looking for a church that takes the Word of God seriously, this is the place. Pastor Matthew Hardy’s expository teaching is truly exceptional—he doesn’t skip around or rely on shallow interpretation. He opens the Scriptures, explains them in context, and applies them with clarity, conviction, and accuracy.

Every sermon is grounded in the text, not opinion. Pastor Hardy walks verse-by-verse through Scripture in a way that is both deeply instructive and easy to follow, and you can tell he’s committed to faithfully handling God’s Word. I consistently leave each service encouraged, challenged, and spiritually fed.

Trinity Baptist is a church where truth is taught, Christ is exalted, and the Bible is central. I can’t recommend it highly enough.

name: Trinity Church
Trinity Church - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary:
⭐️⭐️ 2/5 – A Disappointing and Uncomfortable Experience

I attended Trinity Church with my daughter because we simply wanted to hear God’s message, worship, and spend some peaceful time together. We sat toward the back and were fully participating — repeating the prayers, listening, and being present. However, from early on we felt pressured to move to the front, almost as if sitting in the back wasn’t acceptable. It created an uncomfortable feeling, like we were obligated to respond a certain way rather than allowed to worship freely.

We’ve been to many churches, and we understand every congregation has its own style. But the overall approach here felt very aggressive and pushy. At one point, the pastor highlighted items like crutches and other objects as proof of people being healed in the church. While I respect testimonies and personal beliefs, the delivery felt more like a performance than a message, and it didn’t sit well with me or my daughter.

There were also giveaways, which at first sounded generous, but they were presented in a way that came across as if the church itself was providing everything — when clearly these things come from the people who faithfully give to the church. It felt more like a show than genuine outreach.

Overall, my daughter felt uneasy, and I walked away disappointed. I understand their intentions, but the pressure and intensity overshadowed the message. I hope they find a way to share their faith without making visitors feel obligated or uncomfortable If there was a way to leave 0 stars I would. I grew up here and this church turned me off to Christianity. They care about money and if you have it. The teachings are shallow and if you want a safe place for your family it’s not here!! Love this church! It's been my home church for 14 years and it has incredible people! It good dude without being too big and had all kinds of events throughout the wee. The love Jesus and love the Bible. Highly recommend. Im so glad I found this wonderful church. The congregation are very kind and genuine. The teaching is easy to understand and the worship is pleasing to God. Lastly, there are many ways to get involved. I have been searching for an amazing Church and a friend recommended Trinity.  I checked out sermons online and it is perfect for me...a Bible focused Church for sure and wonderful Church family...So many program and group opportunities for Christian's from all age groups...walks of life including those with any special needs. Have been there faithfully for 10 weeks and look forward to it each week. Check out the family and sermons online or better yet come on down on Sunday for one of the 3 convenient services.

Greg Chase

Communication with parents is excellent—we always feel informed, supported, and included. We also deeply appreciate that the school teaches children about God and strong values, which means so much to our family.

We feel very blessed to be part of this school community and highly recommend it to any family looking for a caring, faith-based environment. Great preschool and daycare facilities. My daughter attended this school through Junior High School. The facility currently has pre k and after school care. We are praying they will expand there curriculum and include kindergarten classes so our grand daughter can continue a Christ based education with caring and nurturing Christ centered people. We love what the educators and Pastor Elmore have created here. The preschool and church are family! They have been foundational to my children's early education with strong academics, a loving faculty, with an emphasis on fun that inspires creativity. TLC continues to bless us through the church. We are honored to call this place our home church. We love Trinity Lutheran Christian School and Preschool.  Trinity has a wonderful staff, high academic standards and teaches Biblical truths and character traits! Wonderful school with really caring faculty and staff! The academics are top notch and the Christian environment is warm and sincere.

name: Trinity Lutheran Church - Grand Island Campus
Trinity Lutheran Church - Long Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Very good groups of all kinds held there even Mothers meeting oldest in long beach history. Gorgeous church. Incredible pastor and congregation. I'm going back for sure. First time was the best. Thankful for the food/clothing distribution on the fourth Saturday of the month at 10:30 a.m. The pastors are very friendly! Awesome Sunday night NA meeting held here. Attended a beautiful wedding here. Kind people and inspiring message. Loved it!

name: Trinity Lutheran Church - Main Campus
Trinity Lutheran Church - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary: I noticed how austere this church looks ordinarily, so I wanted to get intimate with it in optimal light. Warm and welcoming congregation. Bright and articulate, kind and caring Pastor. Very involved in mission to the community. They have a weekly food bank and work with the community emergency shelter. Review their programs and photos and see. Thursday Rejoicing Spirits service Beautiful, historic church with wonderful stained glass windows, a welcoming minister and congregation, and Sunday services (with Communion) at 8:00 a.m. and 10:00 a.m. I have been a member of this church since I can remember.  From Sunday school, vacation bible school every summer, my first communion, confirmation, quinceanera, and wedding.  I have many fond memories.

name: Trinity Lutheran Church - Pomona / Claremont Campus
reviewSummary: Enjoyed the service of worship and praise very inviting congregation ! Everyone filled with Love and concern. First time guests receive free gifts relating to God. They gave free food and a free sermon on CD. Very personal church. After service you get to meet the Pastor and chat for a minute. The pastor delivers a powerful and insightful message sermon. Church very well kept and I truly felt blessed in my spirit AMEN Mister Pastor Lance is one outgoing and charismatic speaker.  I was honoured that he invited Britta and I to the ARK for life fundraiser.  The church is great.  If you are looking for a house of worship, check this church out. Trinity Lutheran Church is a relevant community place that seeks to bring all who enter it's doors to the hope, love, and forgiveness of our Lord Jesus Christ. The pastor here currently is Pastor Lance Irey and the decon is Gene Bohat, and they are absolutely amazing people and very welcoming. Everyone here is so nice and so welcoming it's like a second home to me, and the services here are a lovely traditional format. Trinity is also a grounds for 2 other  churches called  CDC or Christian development center & Revive Christian church, both of which also offer amazing services with great pastors. CDC is a more modern approach and revive is a spanish speaking church. I'm sure that all who come here will feel welcomed and blessed. 🙏🙏 It's a church ya'll,  with a cross no less. VERY CLEAN CHURCH , SMELLS AMAZING AND GREAT STAFF

name: Trinity Lutheran Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary:
I was happy that I got to visit Trinity today. It is a beautiful church. This church is trying to bring the congregation back to pre pandemic days as is my church, it's difficult. The message on Sunday was biblically based, but set in a business setting.
I am an outgoing person, so I got to meet most of the people by going up and introducing myself, although there were a handful that greeted me.
I was glad that I was invited to their luncheon workshop, I was able to meet another group of people, and I was able to participate in the workshop, even though I was just visiting. I got some insight as to what my church can do better.
In closing I just want to share that although I was a visitor, I did not feel like a stranger, because I was in the midst of other children of God, and that was what united me with both those that greeted me, as well as those who did not. It was a pleasurable experience. They hold AA meetings here, there is a meeting known as the Casa Blanca into action meeting every Thursday here at 7:30 pm. If your looking to stop drinking, need a sponsor, or just looking to hear a story with a good spiritual message then definitely make the time to stop by here and sit in for one of the meetings, you definitely won't regret it The pastor makes the church pastor Kent is soft spoken ,compassionate and easy to talk to.My wife and I embrace his genuine influence . Great church and great programs ay Trinity. Incredibly friendly congregation. Lutheran services - one more contemporary & one tradional. Excellent music & fabulous Pastor!

name: Trinity Lutheran Church - San Bernardino Campus
reviewSummary: I love this church & miss the congregation and Pastor very much since moving out of state. The people here are warm, friendly and caring. Pastor Jeff is wonderful as a minister. I highly recommend this church 'family' to worship with or learn about our Lord and Saviour. Tremendous education and leadership in to faith, love and a understanding of all. A caring group of people with strong community outreach. These people truly walk with the lord. Apparently this is the address of where the famous Super Smash Bros. Melee Wombo Combo happened I attended this church every Sunday with my Mom when I was growing up. 😊 It is my church and I love going there!

name: Trinity Lutheran Church - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary:
Best people ever!
People are warm and inviting without being overbearing. No one looks down on anyone else. Trinity is The children's ministry here is known throughout the community due to the God Rocks musicals performed winter and spring. I've been to churches all over the world.  I believe this is one of the best I've ever been to. There is a warm family atmosphere that has activities for every age group. The leadership and preaching is excellent. If your looking for a church that sticks to Bible, and want to develop friendships with solid Christians this is the place to come. This church and it's members are truly a blessing in my life.
So many things going on.
I've found a home, they have been so very welcome to me and my service animal. I was introduced to the church by a wonderful friend of mine. I also love Trinity Church.  True Gospel Living from the teaching of the pastors.
I wish I could do much more as a volunteer but it is almost impossible to get around.  The congregation has been very loving toward me and that's what I need.  Thank The Lord for that. One of the best churches I’ve ever attended. Great fellowship, the congregation of people are so wonderful and friendly,  It overwhelms me with delight, in addition to our Pastor Nathan,  Exceptional Pastor, Preacher And teacher,  very smart intelligent guy, makes thinks easy to understand, inspirational like a Joel Osteen and a T. D.. Jakes, combination!

name: Trinity Lutheran Church Temecula
Trinity Lutheran Church Temecula - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary:
Lovely school and staff went for a conference, nice location, near old town and the freeway. I love the open space where the cross sits in the picture, nice size classrooms and the sanctuary was small and cozy. I am very thankful for Trinity Lutheran. Pastor Jim and his wife, Jennifer, are excellent. I always feel cared about and welcomed when I enter and leave this terrific church. The staff compliments the experience of belonging here. If you haven't found your church home, give Trinity a try. A loving God is there. The people at Trinity are so warm and genuine.  Went to the preschool
Veterans Day parade, and it was awesome. Trinity Lutheran Church is the most reverent and welcoming church my family and I have ever attended. The Pastor preaches in truth and love, and genuinely cares about the salvation of others. The staff are the hardest working, warmest people I’ve ever met. And as great as all that is, what tops it off, is that Christ is truly at the center of it all. This is a Bible based church focusing on God's love for us and our response to that love. There are multiple community outreach projects because we are part of the larger community of Temecula. Our hope is to show God's love by our actions towards each other and to our visitors.

name: Trinity Lutheran Preschool And Kindergarten, Temecula
Trinity Lutheran Preschool And Kindergarten, Temecula - Temecula Campus
reviewSummary:
I LOVE Trinity Lutheran Preschool! The staff is so warm and caring! My children look forward to going to school everyday! Classrooms are clean, safe, and full of fun learning activities! My kids and I feel safe and supported by the staff! Couldn’t have chosen a better school for my kids. Thank you! We were looking for a preschool; we found a community & ultimately an extended family at Trinity! The teachers are caring, patient, and truly invested in each child's growth. We are grateful that our children are learning in a safe, nurturing, faith-based environment where kindness and Christian values are #1 We absolutely love Trinity Preschool! Our daughter started in the toddler classroom when she was 2½ years old, and we have been so grateful for our experience.

I was so nervous to drop her off at school for the first time, but the teachers are incredibly warm, kind, and welcoming. They have helped her feel loved and confident from day one.

She has blossomed so much over the past year, and we’re so excited for her to begin the preschool classroom this week!

The teachers put so much thought and creativity into the art projects, hands-on activities, and classroom experiences. She loves bringing home her artwork and talking about the fun things she did at school.

We also feel confident in Trinity’s commitment to safety. The school has excellent safety protocols in place and does a wonderful job communicating with families, which gives us so much peace of mind.

The staff truly goes above and beyond by planning special events that bring families together and create such a strong sense of community. We especially love the music performances the children work so hard to prepare for. Watching them perform is always such a joy!

We are incredibly thankful we found Trinity Preschool and couldn’t recommend it more highly! Our family has been part of this preschool for the past four years, and we truly can't say enough wonderful things about it. From the moment we enrolled, we've felt like more than just another family—we've felt like we belong.

The teachers and staff genuinely love and care for each child, and it shows. Our kids have always felt safe, excited to learn, and have grown so much academically, socially, and emotionally.

Some of our favorite memories have been the Christmas program and the Mother's Day celebration. These special traditions are so thoughtfully planned and create memories our family will always treasure.

As busy working parents, we also really appreciate the school's communication. The reminders about upcoming events and important dates help us stay connected and never miss out on the special moments.

We are incredibly grateful for the love, care, and exceptional education our children have received. If you're looking for a preschool where your children will truly be known, loved, and prepared for the future, we couldn't recommend Trinity more! Truly such an amazing place! The staff are incredibly kind and caring and the activities they prepare for the kids are fun and engaging. We are so thankful our son got to spend 3 years here!

name: Trinity Presbyterian Church of Orange County
Trinity Presbyterian Church of Orange County - Orange Campus
reviewSummary: What draws me back to this church is its desire make Jesus the center of their lives. The messages spoken here aren't your typical self-help sermons. It centers around who Jesus is, and who we are in relationship to Him. The truth that finally sets us free. Freedom from our restlessness, into joy and peace. The people aren't perfect, but that's the point. The church allows people like me to come as I am, and be welcome to ask the difficult questions, and to struggle through them together. No judgement, but freedom to pursue truth in community. I go here for A.A. meetings so by default I have to give it a 10/10 because it's a great building to rent for a couple times through the week. Been in churches most of my life, this  church has the best of everything, people, pastor, programs, music, and love!!

name: Trinity San Diego Assemblies of God
Trinity San Diego Assemblies of God - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
My mom and me were visiting the area for a family bridal shower last Sunday. We wanted to find a church close by the celebration. My mom gets the credit for finding this awesome church.

I really liked the vibe and like that it is a church where the Holy Spirit is welcome and invited….super hospitable. Both Pastor Todd and his wife Katie are friendly, warm and involved in the church too. The moment we walked in the church we were greeted and offered donuts and coffee. Then, we loved the nice welcoming touch with the sign that says, this seat has been prayed over (or something along those lines…).

I love that their prayer meeting is at 7am and it’s via zoom. I have been to other churches and they are in the evening or during my workday. I think I can participate.

The church seems very pro community and wanted to help out and get involved by building churches in Mexico and beginning to help foster families which I think are both amazing causes.

I’d love to visit and bring my family of five back especially after seeing their children’s church room had a slide 😂!!if you’re thinking about visiting, do it! You will be blessed 😊. We went to this wonderful church  for Easter Service at the invitation of our family who are members ! Great message , warm and welcoming congregation too   ! They have been praying for us as we endured life changing events w our health , and are grateful for the power of prayer 🙏🏻 Truly a place that my entire family can call "home."  Vulnerable, practical, bible-based teaching, riveting worship experience, connect groups everyday of the week and a fantastic children's program. Would highly recommend to anyone in the area (or online!) Love this church and filled with love! The presence of the Lord is there and his word is not just spoken but also brought fourth in action. His grace and mercy is made evediant in the life of the people. My mental health state is not very good, I am trying to cope with memory loss
I don't want to cause any problems for anyone, I just want to be Grateful for the time I have left,Thank you Jesus for everything 🙏

name: Trinity United Methodist Church
Trinity United Methodist Church - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary: This is a beautiful church where my mother's funeral service was held. One could imagine just as easily a beautiful wedding here as well. The outside of the building does not portray the beauty of its inner sanctum. There is a quintessential courtyard at the center of the building. Even a skeptic like me could imagine angels dancing to celebrate the new love of marriage or an angelic entourage welcoming a tired soul home to heaven. It is an old, yet beautiful church with a vintage air that makes one feel there is a connection to the other world within its doors. Church in there is a kitchen and medium sized reception hall upstairs. It's a simple, no-frills  space, but efficient and economical. Staff was very friendly and helpful during this mournful time for me and my family and we are profoundly grateful. I was baptized in this church. Ive was married and baptized my children here also. It is a beautiful church with a lot of history. OK place to worship. It has indoor court and a large theater chamber for events. Was used in the 2017 movie "I Believe ". Good movie. Only place in Pomona where the homeless can shower when the shelter isn't open.

They're supportive and affirming of LGBT+ folks, and it just feels like your little local church, with a few great surprises when you visit. The music, for example, is phenomenal. It's a great church! I love the sense of community at Trinity Unity Methodist Church. Is very warm and loving and compassionate. This is because it's a small congregation. Love this very Welcoming Church.  And Celebrate Recovery is Awesome. I used to visit on Christmas Eve. Nice service s. I wish Pastor Tim was still there.

name: Trinity United Presbyterian Church
Trinity United Presbyterian Church - Newport Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Great praise and worship music and solid Bible teaching, genuine Christian folks at Sunday School who love the Lord and bate about each other, and this church is  supporting Jesus' command to go to all nations and make disciples. Highly recommend this church. What a welcoming church!
We have been very grateful for the presence of the Spirit in this place & the transformation of lives we’ve witnessed.
May you know the joy of being welcomed into community here, too!
God is good, all the time. All the time, gGod is good. Very caring and intelligent group of believers.  Wonderful children's and young adult programs. Loving our neighbors. Came back to my childhood church to join in their 150th anniversary celebration. Came all the way from Maine to California. Was not disappointed. First attended Trinity about 8 years ago after moving to Orange County. Immediately knew we had found our church home. The worship, music and preaching make Sunday mornings a highlight of every week. Off the charts children's and youth ministry. Deeply invested in partnership with many local and international ministries that address physical, emotional and spiritual needs. Easy to find a way to make a difference by serving at the church and in the community.

name: Trinity-Central Lutheran Church
Trinity-Central Lutheran Church - Los Angeles (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: Beautiful, warm congregations. Spanish service at 9:30, English at 10:00 and Korean at 11:30. Always a blessing. As long as there aren't any homeless people nearby, it is an old building but well-organized and clean. Dear fellow parishioners with beautiful and warm hearts! Thank you.

TrueVine Pentecostal Church - Murrieta Campus
reviewSummary: Diverse church, great praise n worship team , great new pastor and bishop, just need to have w midweek Bible study or service and this would be a perfect spot This is truly a house of God! reviewSummary:
Wonderful church here in the heart of Redlands, California. The energy is so abundant and welcoming. Highly recommend everyone to check this place out. A amazing church filled with the Holy Spirit! Felt like family as soon as I walked in. The pastor preaches solely on God’s Word and never adds or subtracts from it. You can feel the power and FIRE of God here! I was attending a JogDawgs running event next to this church when I needed to use the restroom. I politely asked a greeter if I could use the facilities and was told they were only for people attending the service.

While I understand policies may exist, this felt unnecessarily unwelcoming given the church’s location beside a public community event. Churches are often seen as places of hospitality, and I hope there is more awareness of how interactions like this impact visitors and the surrounding community. An amazing church where the Holy Ghost is present everything I attend their services. Very encouraging environment and the people are so kind. Misleading and Disappointing Experience

We attended this church’s “back-to-school” event expecting, as the flyer suggested, a school supply and backpack giveaway. Instead, it turned into something very different — and honestly, very misleading.

We arrived about an hour early, stood in line in the blistering Redlands heat for over an hour, and were asked for our names, phone numbers, and how many kids we had before being led into their assembly room. Inside was unbearably hot — my husband almost passed out — and there was no water or refreshments for the families who had already been waiting for hours.

Instead of quickly distributing backpacks, the event turned into a nearly hour-long sermon. The pastor repeatedly said he was “just about to pray” but instead kept speaking about parents being on drugs, which was disheartening and felt like an unfair assumption about the community. At one point, people were asked to come forward to “surrender to Jesus.” A woman even approached my children asking if she could “take them” to pray, despite us politely declining multiple times.

Families with young kids, including one mom who had been waiting since 6 AM with five kids, were left hungry, thirsty, and frustrated. The flyer never mentioned that we would be required to sit through a lengthy service before receiving any supplies.

If the event was intended to be a ministry service first and foremost, it should have been clearly stated. We would have made an informed choice and avoided putting our children through that uncomfortable and disappointing experience. We will not be returning.

We came for a backpack giveaway — instead, we got over an hour in the scorching sun, then forced into a hot room for a long sermon. No water, no snacks, and kids were hungry and uncomfortable. The flyer never said we’d have to sit through a ministry service.

When we asked for water, we were told to go back inside. When we asked for backpacks, they seemed reluctant and told us to go back in to “finish the ministry” first. Only after pushing did someone finally give us a backpack so we could leave.

If this was meant to be a church service, it should have been stated upfront. This felt manipulative, and we won’t be back.

University Christian Church (Disciples of Christ)/United Church of Christ - San Diego (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: This was an awesome experience! Everyone is so friendly here everyone is welcome this was palm Sunday it was alot of fun service was not long and drawn out either It’s a business, and the man running it does not exemplify a man of God in any way, shape, or form. I’ve never been treated with so little grace and compassion in entire my life, and I grew up in small town churches. This place is a farce. They hide behind a fake veil of inclusivity, but Jesus asked us to LOVE. they do not operate from a place of love or mercy here. He runs a business in Hillcrest. Not a church. I’ve been attending this amazing church for about 18 months and I continue to be overwhelmed at the friendliness, creativity, love, and genuine caring that radiates from everyone here.  I am a straight older woman and this is a very diverse congregation that truly welcomes EVERYONE and encourages each of us to be the hands and feet of Jesus in our community, nation, and the world.  We’re actively involved in social justice and vigorously fight for the rights of all people because we’re all children of God!  The pastors and staff are empathetic and caring and we have tons of fun, too.  As part of every Sunday service, we say “I am welcome here.  You are welcome here.  We are welcome here.”  And we truly mean it! This is a fabulous church to worship God and learn about Jesus. As Christians we go out into the community to be good people and spread, love, warmth and positivity. It is an LGBTQ open and affirming church. Everyone is welcome here. It’s sad when family members are homophobic . We have never had cheesy drag shows. However, there are some fabulously written and performed acts that take place in October for our Theology of Broadway theme. These services will not disappoint and are beautifully portrayed by the loving congregation members. Never a dull moment and we have a fun and positive approach to our children’s Worship and Wonder as well. This is not a Christian church and it does not follow Jesus or his teachings.

name: University City United Church
University City United Church - San Diego (UTC / La Jolla) Campus
reviewSummary:
I'm so glad the church is here.  It's refreshing to be apart of a church were openness and tolerance is so important!
Also my children attended the preschool and it is amazing!! Also, very affordable. Pastor Iona is great. The church welcomes everyone and is also great for families and kids. This church has had a powerful positive impact on my life. Love Jesus Yeah yeah yeah yeah

name: University Lutheran Church
University Lutheran Church - La Jolla Campus
reviewSummary:
Very nice LCMS parish with generally traditional order of mass; I know the guy carrying the Processional Cross pretty well.
Congregation is lovely, very friendly and also provides a meal every Sunday. Weekday Bible studies are also great, and also have a provided meal.
Wonderful place overall to receive Word & Sacrament for students and non-students alike, and to praise Christ for His victory in the Gospel. ULC is an amazing church that I proudly call my home Small church, great organist, service is on a tablet  available in lobby if you don't have one, use a qr code to access it, most of service is projected. Lovely folks  - Sharing the Gospel - receiving Grace

University Presbyterian Church
University Presbyterian Church - Westwood Campus
reviewSummary: Love this church! Attended UCLA for undergrad and this church was conveniently located very close to campus and they also offer shuttle services from the dorms. Great community of fellow college students, post-grads, and families as well. They also have small groups that meet during the week for undergrad, recently graduated, working adults, and families. ++ anddd they serve lunch after service every Sunday so it was very easy to get acquainted with other attendees :) This is the church that make you feel like a home. People here are genuinely nice, warm and kind! Great church family.  Great pastor and loving pastor wife

name: University United Methodist Church
reviewSummary: A lovely, progressive Methodist church. Highly inclusive and welcoming.

name: University United Methodist Church - Redlands Campus
reviewSummary:
I am not the most consistent attendee at this church, but when I am able to attend (in person or online), I find the people welcoming and warm.  I really like the pastor and other members of the church.
It is a place for those who are leary of attending any church.  I recommend anyone to attend (via Zoom right now) and you will find it a comfortable place to be.  It is a scripture based church that looks at the love that God has for His people.
Come. Enjoy. Stay for the breakouts after the service. Friendly and welcoming. No pressure to join if you want to try it out.  traditional services and slowly merging with contemporary. The congregation is small, so may not be for those that are trying to hide but nobody will be offended if you are just trying to find a new home and this is not a fit for you. Beautiful church and grounds. People are friendly. One of their missions is serving the Homeless a hot meal each Saturday Open hearts, open minds, open doors! Come visit and worship with us! We are now starting a Spanish service at  12:00 p.m. on Sundays ❤️ We served a meal for the homeless in the social hall.  It has plenty of room for a large gathering.

name: University United Methodist Church Irvine
University United Methodist Church Irvine - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
I've been coming here about 8 years. What drew me in, and defines the church, is how welcoming they are. The leadership and the congregation lead with grace. There is a focus on serving God and each other through community and actions.

This is an LGBT-affirming church, and when the pastor says "all are welcome", she means it. It leans socially progressive without being overtly political. Love, not judgement, is emphasized.

The main service is at 9:30am and lasts about an hour. Children begin in the main service with their parents and then are dismissed to the children's program. There is an active social gathering on the patio after service with coffee and treats. I would encourage you to stay for 15-30 minutes rather than sneak out the back - I guarantee someone will come and talk to you!

Methodism has a rich musical tradition thanks to the Wesley brothers and we have a fantastic choir. Praise is mostly traditional hymns and the church sings together, as opposed to a praise band signing to the church. Accompaniment is usually by piano, though we also have guest musicians.

Communion (the Lord's Supper) is the first Sunday of the month. Services are lightly liturgical - more so than an evangelical church but much less so than a Catholic Mass. We say the Lord's Prayer together every Sunday.

Come and visit us and see for yourself. This is a place that feels like all truly are welcome. The church members are so friendly and you get the sense that they really care about each other and, through their programs and services, they are putting God’s word into deeds throughout the community. The sermons are inspiring, the choir is second to none, and the work of this church is alive and well. I came to this church at age 8, 51 years ago. It never fails that visitors tell us that our members are some of the most welcoming people that they have met at any of the churches they tried. Where they were ignored at other churches,  they were made to feel welcome here: Introduced around the Gathering Grounds after service and invited to chat as they were comfortable. All ages are equally welcome and we have wonderful children's and youth programs. Plus we are known for our choir. Belong, Believe, Be Love! UUMC has been a home for my family for 50 years. The gospel is preached each Sunday along with beautiful music from our choir & accompanist. For all ages there are classes & events which encourage us to learn about our faith and how to practice Christ’s love in action. Multiple members actively participate in the many outreach programs. Our church motto summarizes this well:  Belong, Believe & Be Love.  Mickey Chase My husband and I were looking to “belong” to a Church family and we absolutely found it in University United Methodist Church.  It’s everything we were looking for.  A warm Pastor (Cathi Capp) who truly wants everyone to feel welcome.  There are no exclusions- only inclusion! For anyone new to Irvine or is out there Church shopping, come on in and be marvelled. The congregation couldn’t be nicer- in addition, our post services provide the best baking in Irvine.  You’re all invited🙏😁
