name: Upland Lighthouse Church
Upland Lighthouse Church - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
God is still working in this church. The praise team has the seal of approval and the altar is on fire for the Lord. You can feel the presence of the Lord our God. He is eager to fill us with His spirit. Join us for a time of fellowship, communion, and Sharing the word of God. If you’re looking for a church, look no further this is it! God loves you 🥰 God bless you ALL All glory to the Lord Jesus Christ. I thank him every day that he planted my family and I at the Upland Lighthouse. This church has been a critical in every aspect not just for me but for my wife and 3 children .They have grounded us in truth and changed our lives forever. As we continue to grow I suggest anyone searching for truth searching for purpose in their life to come and see what Jesus Christ can do for you . Love you all and God bless you. Best church in the inland empire!
The Presence of God is so strong and everyone is so welcoming❤️ I've been attending ULC for 12 years now. And I am HONORED to call this my home church. God has restored my relationship with my husband and has restored my kids' relationship with their father. We have an amazing Pastor who loves everyone, and he sees the potential in every family. We love God, and we worship God with all our hearts. If you are looking for a church,  please come by, and you won't be disappointed. The Spirit of God will be evident. Best church you’ll ever visit. 🙏🏼🤍

name: Upward Call Church Chino
Upward Call Church Chino - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
What a wonderful family. It was a privilege to visit, we loved the opportunity to experience this amazing community. A wonderful church where everyone is welcome. The focus is on Jesus and the Scripture. Hi, upward call chino church
Im a local resident nearby your church, your alarm system has been blaring off for the ENTIRE night. Please fix this issue.

It is not the first night this has happened also.
.
From,
Sleep deprived chino resident Wow! Darian, Pastor at Upward Call, tells it like it is! His messages are clear and always points the listener to Jesus! Another thing I love about Upward Call is that they take a 7-minute fellowship time during the service every week to give people a chance to actually have a conversation with others around them. They believe church is family and encourage people to connect in a real, meaningful way. We love it! Church like it is meant to be. IMHO An old but nice church used by the city for different types of events and meetings. Wedding receptions, company parties, group meetings, etc. Two large rooms, one with a stage, and a couple smaller rooms. Large kitchen also available. Folding tables and chairs available at the facility. Large parking lot and a small park with swings and a playground. I attend two events there each week.  Check it out for your next event, contact the city of Chino for rental dates and times.

name: Valencia Christian Center
Valencia Christian Center - Santa Clarita Campus
Valencia Hills Community Church
Valencia Hills Community Church - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary: It is definitely an authentic Biblical community in Valencia and Santa Clarita, founded on God's word, seeking to love God and love our neighbor. I've attended the Arabic services with pastor Issa. The Arabic church started there recently and it has been growing and growing. It is definitely a great place to check out if you speak Arabic and planing to grow spiritually and learn the Bible. They have actual services in Arabic every Sunday at 6:30 pm and they have Bible study and multiple other activities for the whole family My daughter invited me to VHCC 3 years ago, I  am now a member.  I was looking for a small intimate church that was also welcoming and friendly,  and thats what I found here. My family have been attending just over a year. We quickly noticed and felt the authenticity of the people we met, the emphasis on teaching God's Word, God uplifting worship, and the importance of reaching outside of the church doors to bring the love and grace of God to others through the many ministries and opportunities to serve. We like this church, and go there whenever we are visiting my mother-in-law. Paster Denis does a great job of delving into the gospel, and explaining it in layman's terms. Great Bible-based church full of caring people practicing authentic Christianity. Pastor Dennis exudes the love of God and his preaching is excellent.

name: Valencia United Methodist Church
Valencia United Methodist Church - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary: Wow.  Church reviews, what a concept....  My partner and I have been members here for decades. It was the obvious love of music on display during services that initially attracted us, but now we're grateful to have found such a warm and caring Faith Community.  Drop in at 9:00 or 10:30 Sunday morning and see for yourself...we've been praying for you. I love this church! All are welcome here. It’s a warm and welcoming community of faith. The choir and music ministries are fantastic and help to lead worship in amazing ways. There are many opportunities to serve our community too. When we moved from NJ 5 years ago, we visited many churches in town. When we first arrived to VUMC, we immediate felt welcomed and accepted. The programs for the kids and youth are great! My teen actually asks to go to youth group and a teen being enthusiastic about anything is saying a lot. 😉 It is important to me that this is one of the few LGBTQIA+ affirming churches in town. I feel the members truly live out the motto “All are welcome and all means all.” Pastors Andy and Camille are very down to earth, open minded, and welcome questioning and discourse. My family found our church home here. ❤️ My family and I love attending Valencia United Methodist Church. We generally go to the 10:30 praise band service, but try to take my Mother In Law a few times a year to the 9:00 service to hear their amazing Choir. This Church has a great youth program, Kids Zone,  Vacation Bible School, and many more activities. I've been attending Valencia United Methodist Church for many years, and for many reasons. It's a warm and welcoming church with relatable sermons and friendly people. And the music is amazing! The first service has a beautiful choir and the second service has a lively modern band. All very talented. Through a small group I joined (a blend of Bible study, book club and support group) I made new friends whom I cherish.

name: Valley Baptist Church
Valley Baptist Church - Burbank Campus
Valley Bethel Presbyterian Church
Valley Bethel Presbyterian Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary: 8-19-18 came here today and i loved it, this place has english service at 11am and this place has quality worship time, the parking lot is spacious, there is lunch after the worship time and everyone is so nice. Thank you again for being a blessing to the city of Chatsworth

name: Valley Christian Church
Valley Christian Church - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
Visited VCC for the first time today! Great to learn and study systematic Theology. Everyone was very welcoming and brother Rick prayed with me towards the end. Looking forward to returning. God bless. Such a fantastic church!

The beauty of Valley Christian lies in the people who populate its sanctuary every week. The kindness and love conveyed by the congregation members become infectious. The members are as genuine and authentic as can be. The feeling of welcome-ness my family received when they set foot in that place was phenomenal!

Unfortunately, my family was only able to be part of the church for a little over a year before life relocated us out of state. Yet, even though our time of fellowship in the congregation was brief, members from VCC still reach out to us periodically to ask about our family's well-being. That, my friends, is how you do church!

That being said, if you still haven't found a church to call home and want to experience the love of God in fellowship and sound teaching, Valley Christian Church is a surefire bet...although some of Pastor Mike's sermons may persuade you to reconsider the practice of making bets in the future...I digress, but I hope you get my point.

Shalom! I love how this church is so welcoming since the start. Im proud growing up and it being a great neighbor. The church has made the surrounding neighborhood a safe and granted faith with those who surround it... The community is supper friendly we move from New Hope Center because it close down. A good worship experience.  Warm and freindly church.

name: Valley Lighthouse Pentecostal Church
Valley Lighthouse Pentecostal Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary:
I'm a tough sell for where I worship.  I stick to what is written by inspiration of Yahweh thru the hands of the writers.  I am not one that follows traditions.  This is a Pentecostal congregation so some traditions are apparent but they are such a loving group I easily look past that.  I have only attended a few months now but am comfy here. Visited this wonderful church two Sundays ago. Anointed, warm, a thriving house of God. Because the Pastor and his Wife and members  are so genuine.  The members  love the Lord , they believe  in Praise, Prayer , &  Worship .
No one is Perfect but it's a Blessing  to be apart of this Church  and the Ministry. A great place to worship. Pastor Chacon and his wife are the best. The worship team is the best. I highly recommend it for anyone in the area looking for a new church Awesome church! The Spirit baptized me through a Pastor visiting from TX with the gift of tongues! Aside from that, great place!

name: Valley Lights Church
Valley Lights Church - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary:
such an amazing and welcoming place! nice refreshments and very friendly congregation! loved worship and took a lot of great notes from the sermon!!! Valley Lights Church has been a great place to visit! Whether it was a Sunday service or a midweek event, I’ve always felt welcomed and encouraged to invite others along. Even in the different spaces they’ve met in, the team consistently creates an excellent environment to worship God and connect with others in.

I’ve been especially impressed by the way the church leaders sacrifice for the mission and stay focused on helping people take steps to get closer to Jesus — all without any pressure. It’s a group of people that genuinely cares about people. Valley Lights Church is amazing! The whole church is a community in the truest sense, and have always made me feel so welcomed when I join in on a Sunday. The messages are biblically focused, and always have my husband and I leaving in a state of worship. We can’t recommend this church enough! I’ve visited Valley Lights Church twice now, and each time I’ve felt genuinely welcomed by the community. The message was encouraging and practical—rooted in the Bible, but easy to apply to everyday life. I also love that the church values staying connected throughout the week through different events and gatherings. It’s clear they’re intentional about building real relationships. I can definitely see myself coming back again! I’ve had the pleasure & blessing of attending Valley Lights while visiting Southern California many times since the church began. One can expect a warm welcome, uplifting worship, relevant Biblical preaching, a great children’s program, & most times, delicious drinks & treats! I’ve enjoyed the sense of community & connection they put an emphasis on which is why I make every effort to attend when visiting!

name: Valley Metro Church
Valley Metro Church - Woodland Hills Campus
reviewSummary: I've visited Valley Metro Church twice now, and each time the preaching spoke directly to my heart. I truly felt like the message was meant for me. I'm so grateful to God for leading me there and for the amazing ministry happening through this church. 🙏 Though still fairly new to the church, here at Valley Metro my husband and I have found more love and support than we even knew existed!  I personally find myself being brought back to my early days as a young Christian, when  the worship was clean and pure and the sermons impacted my life and my heart directly where I needed them to.  I tell you folks, this church is an absolute treasure in the heart of the San Fernando Valley and the Holy Spirit is moving there in purity and in power.  The church is free of so much of the nonsense that goes on in some churches today and instead, you leave each Sunday feeling loved and challenged to be a better Christian!  So thankful to call Pastor Brian and Kristi our Pastors! Pharmacy is hands down the worst!  4 people chatting it up behind the counter.  3 customers waiting!  Called in the prescription 24 hours prior and they put it on hold and didn’t bother to call.  Then asked me to come back the next day!  Finally the pharmacist came and released the hold but after already waiting for 20 minutes it’s another 10 minutes!  Can’t make this up.  Cvs needs to clean house in the pharmacy on Roscoe and de Soto! We are so happy to have found a church we can identify with and feel the holy spirit. Having moved from Glendale to Northridge, we began our search for a new Calvary Church due to the commute! We searched for a new holy home in the valley, but didn't truly feel like a community, nor identify with the ones we visited. Finally, we found one we attended for a period until we didn't appreciate the jokes of other dominations, so we continued our search until we were finally found Valley Metro (Calvary Church). Valley Metro Church has been our home for years now! Pastor Brian and his beautiful, humorous wife our incredible! Valley Metro is a bible teaching church that reflects just that! Come and see! I am so happy to see that Valley Metro Church is a blessed house of Christians being a part of the united body of Christ.  I attended church here in the 1950's and 60's when it was the a Disciples of Christ Church.  I was saved here and baptized by Reverend Hensley.  My father who was a master sheet metal worker made the steeple and donated it as his "mite".  The building looks great!  Thank you and God bless all of you.

name: Valley Park Baptist Church
Valley Park Baptist Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary:
My children attend this school, and it's the best option for us. The teachers here are very attentive and friendly, always happy to see you and always kind to your children. I really appreciate the individualized approach they take. This is a wonderful place. I’ve been coming to this church almost every week for the past two years. The people here — staff and volunteers — are truly amazing. It’s thanks to places like this that my attitude toward churches has changed significantly. Year after year, they carry their challenging mission with dedication. Thank you so much! I attended service this Sunday and I really enjoyed it. I'm happy I found this church. The pastor was very knowledgeable and really preach from the bible.the choir was also really great everyone was very nice and welcoming. Very welcoming. They have helped me and my family multiple times. Amazing people These folks are the absolute best!!
Even if you don't attend services, they'll still love you anyway

name: Valley Presbyterian Church
Valley Presbyterian Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary:
Scripture is taught by going through chapters, not only by popular topics.
Strong Bible study groups for adults at various times. Friendly congregation. God glorifying, Christ-centered preaching and Spirit filled worship. Very kind church that allowed us to begin a Bible study for the Assyrian speaking members. Thank you and God bless! Great preaching and fellowship. Extremely grateful for this church! Warm people, combined with an excellent Bible centered ministry.

name: Valley Presbyterian Hospital
Valley Presbyterian Hospital - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary:
This place was absolutely incredible. The hospital is  very clean. I got a private room. It's very well set up with equipment and honestly looked like a good movie about doctors.

Everyone gave me so much warmth and attention, starting from the ER, then into the hospital and the staff that prepared me for the operation and the care after. I wrote several recommendation letters regarding the staff here. The doctors were amazing, very knowledgeable and willing to take a bit of time and talk to you. The nurses knew the smallest details of my information and passed information over to the next shift next day.

Specifically wanted to mention Male Nurse - Neiman, thank you for your care and attention man!  And you're so knowledgeable hope you'll be a doctor, to enrich lives of many patients!

And Nurse Alexis , thank you for showing so much love towards your patients! Appreciate you guys!

I felt very well taken care of and very safe.

I give this place 10/10 , and staff 12/10

Much love, Alexey I have the unfortunate experience of having to come here often. All times being the emergency room. I’ve grown up coming here and I must say there kid department is much much better.

The emergency room is a mess. I try to write this review from a place of understanding and actively studying the medical field. But the way things are handled are so poor it’s a disgrace to anyone in the medical field.
Everyone has no sense of urgency or passion at all. This is the fast food of hospitals, a mear transaction. A formula. Quantity of quality.
I’ve had many experiences where I’ve waited hours upon hours. To only be transferred to wait even more hours and more hours.
The staff made it an agonizingly and miserably a slow experience. Again, no sense of urgency. I see staff, nurses, chatting before patients. I’ve had nurses who were about to draw blood for an exam. And before even drawing blood. She stood outside my room chatting with a nurse. A whole 5 minute conversation before getting on with my blood extraction. Again, after she finish, another conversation. Like please get the process at least started for crying out loud. Then maybe chat.

I think a lot of staff choose to ignore, or simply forget the fact a lot of people are in pain. They come here because maybe this is the only option? Maybe this is their only turn for help. I hope some sort of upper management has some sort of reform. It honest sucks seeing so many people in pain being talked back to, stalled, and in endless waiting for them to do a half ass job with half ass results. This review is about nurse Eric Bell and the rude staff who needs an attitude adjustment. Because why are you rude to sick patients?

I would never come back here, even though my insurance says this is the only hospital I can be admitted to. I have sickle cell, so that should tell you a lot. On June 20th, I was transferred from Kaiser Woodland Hills to this hospital. I was supposed to get a room immediately since I was being transferred from Kaiser‘s ER bed. Instead, I waited two hours in the hallway, even though I was having an active sickle cell pain crisis. I was placed in the hallway with other sick patients, which is known not to be appropriate for sickle cell patients because we are high risk and our immune system is non existent. I wasn’t even given a face mask. Not only did I wait in the hallway for two hours, but once Igot an ER bed, I waited three hours for a room (which I never got because I left). When I finally gor an ER bed, about 30 minutes to an hour later, I was given IV Dilaudid and fluids because that’s what sickle cell patients are supposed to receive, and that’s what I was given at Kaiser. They were supposed to give me IV antibiotics, but they never did. Three hours later, upon receiving the first IV Dilaudid, I asked for more Dilaudid because I was still in pain and still waiting to be admitted to a room, even though I was told I would be admitted immediately. My nurse (Eric Bell) told me that IV Dilaudid is administered every six hours, which is not true—it is every three hours. That’s why I asked about more Dilaudid on that third hour, even though I am used to nurses and doctors who know about sickle cell administering every one to two hours. I realized my nurse did not know about sickle cell because, before I asked for more Dilaudid, he asked me several questions about sickle cell and how it affects me. Even though he is African-American.. that should also tell you a lot about this hospital. I decided to call my husband and leave. When my husband arrived, he asked my nurse why he said every six hours for IV Dilaudid when it is actually every three hours, the nurse only kept repeating, “for IV Dilaudid it is every three hours.” When my husband asked how come when I asked, he said six hours then?, he just kept repeating, “for IV Dilaudid it is every three hours.” I asked to file a grievance, but even though they knew I was in constant pain, they made my husband and me wait at least 20 minutes just to tell us I had to file the grievance online or over the phone. I signed an AMA and left. If you have sickle cell, I would never in life come here. Not only did Eric Bell not know what he was doing, but all of the staff was very rude except for the doctor that I had Because she seemed to know about sickle cell. She said if I needed anything to ask her, and if I needed more medication to ask my nurse, and that is what I did and I was turned away. i’m very disappointed. We always used to go here as a child. But today I went in with a severe fever and a severe headache they  Drew blood out two times. They did x-rays a took me back outside. I waited for four hours  my head was hurting really bad. I told the lady in the waiting room is there anyway I could get medication or a cup of water  She said no unfortunately that will have to be inside and we don’t know how long it’s going to take. Very disappointed. Very bad service. The lady was rude. Never gonna come back ever again to the hospital. I’m very disappointed. They took 5 days to insert a feeding to into my grandma's stomach!! She was 82. She's needed nutrients and that left of time without food was making her weaker and her organs will begin to fail. Then they inserted it and she was starting to feel better and then they said the tube was leaking and they took it out and she did not receive food for another 3 days. At that point she was very weak. And the doctors didn't seem to be helping at all. Some of the nurses don't even speak good English and can't explain what is going on when asked for details of the situation. After 2 weeks my grandma died. If I were you I WOULD NEVER BRING MY PARENT TO THIS HOSPITAL!!!!!!

name: Valley Presbyterian Hospital Emergency Room
Valley Presbyterian Hospital Emergency Room - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary:
I've been to this ER many times. I don't get people who are mean to nurses or doctors. I've only had good experiences! The doctors and nurses listen. I can see that they care. Just be patient when they're understaffed please. Anyone who has/had a job where they're understaffed will understand! The Healthcare system sucks in this country but at least the nurses and doctors care here! I had a very disappointing experience at this emergency room. I waited almost four hours without being placed in a room, even though I told the staff I was feeling dizzy and felt like I might faint.

The nurses seemed dismissive, and I felt that my concerns were not taken seriously. When I spoke with the doctor about how I was feeling, I did not feel that there was much concern for my symptoms or my well-being.

When someone goes to the emergency room, they are usually scared and not feeling well. Patients deserve to feel heard, cared for, and treated with urgency. Unfortunately, that was not my experience during this visit.

In contrast, I have had much better experiences at West Hills Hospital. The nurses there are attentive, and the doctors genuinely seem to care about their patients’ health and well-being. I hope this hospital can improve its level of care and communication so patients feel safer and more supported. I am extremely disappointed with the level of care I received at this hospital. From the moment I arrived, the experience was frustrating and stressful. The staff seemed disorganized, and communication was poor throughout my stay.

The nurses, in particular, were inattentive and unprofessional. It often felt like I was being ignored when I needed assistance, and when they did respond, their attitude came across as rushed and dismissive. Basic requests took far too long, and there was little empathy or concern shown for my condition.

Cleanliness and overall management also raised concerns, making the environment feel uncomfortable and unsafe. A hospital should be a place where patients feel cared for and supported, but unfortunately, that was not my experience here.

I would not recommend this hospital to others based on the lack of proper care, professionalism, and attention from the nursing staff. If I could give 0 stars, I would. Absolutely horrible ER. The waiting room was dirty and smelled awful, with trash all over the floor. I told them my sibling had diarrhea and was vomiting — no one cared. The staff were laughing and chatting with each other instead of doing their jobs. 0/10.
Tarzana Hospital is the best — fast, organized, professional, and respectful. If you have time to make a choice - it should be TARZANA!!! Great service. Great empathy. Great speed. I went here 2 times this year and they took great care of me in a timely manner and diagnosed me properly as well.

name: Valley Presbyterian Professional Center
Valley Presbyterian Professional Center - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary:
Why is police car illegal parked and blocking patients to get pickup or walk through. No police light are on no police officers inside the vehicle. This is a illegal parking and he is going to get a parking ticket plus violation for leaving the vehicle unintended. This has been send to parking enforcement. And we will be heading over to the Van Nuys police station to find the driver of this vehicle. I've been to their ER twice. Once I wasn't in much of a rush a they took care of me well and I'm uninsured so I just paid about $187. The second time it was very much an emergency​. I just had my nose (deviated septum) fixed 2 days prior and woke up with a severe nose bleed, with blood coming out my nose, mouth on being swallowed. Worse, I had an 8 inch long blood clot from my sinuses going down my throat or I could cough it out so it hung out my mouth like my tongue and was choking on it for around 45 min at least while waiting for the Dr and since it was covered in blood and slippery I couldn't grip it to pull it out. A nurse tried with gloves to pull it out but twas too slippery. Finally when the Dr and his nurse came in she tried to pull it out by wrapping a small towel around it and it worked and I told her that's all I was yelling about for the past hour and was no longer choking. Then because of all the blood I swallowed I threw up approx a half pint to a pint of blood into a bed pan. The Dr called the Dr who did the surgery and the surgeon told him to put these inflatable long things in my nose and kept pumping them full of air, which was what he was told by the surgeon to do. But it hurt more than most things in life. It was like Arnold Schwarzenegger pulling that thing out of his nose in that 80's movie Total Recall. But that also just cost me $187.
So for an ER visit that was very cheap with no insurance. They must get govt funding. Didn't like the wait but​ was grateful for them for taking care of me for just $187... Worse experience I had at this hospital
I have arrived 930 pm and left 2 am
I was feeling horrible with serius flu the waiting time was horrible also they don’t have no water either tissues people have flu.
After I waited 5 hours the doctor come to check me and tell me that he can give me any medication for my flu basically I went there for no reason I waste my time and money because they still charging my health insurance. The elevators in the building dont work properly Terrible, they give you an appointment and then wait two hours. I don't like it.

name: Van Nuys United Methodist Church
Van Nuys United Methodist Church - Van Nuys Campus
reviewSummary: This place was so nice I went to there night swap meet and it was absolutely fabulous, the people where so nice They rent rooms 2 groups and give music lessons Awsome church It was basically church!

name: Venice Church
Venice Church - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary: Great fast growing church for all who are looking for a church home. They have good beliefs and transparent what they do and expect. They even have three worships on each Sunday. They have a diverse community with different age groups, backgrounds and ethnicity. Discovery class was a good place to know what their history is and what to expect. Rooted class is an opportunity to connect with new members and deepen the faith. I’m happy to recommend this church. Vacationing here, from Texas, I looked up churches in our area & came across Venice Church.  I’m so glad God led us to visit this church!  Everyone was so warm & friendly!  There was a sense of joy radiating among the church goers!  Pastor Mark preached a very interesting sermon that I got a lot out of & he referenced Bible scripture often.  The Holy Spirit can truly be felt here.  I also love the mission work they are doing in the Venice community!  If we lived here, this is the church we would attend & serve in!  We loved worshipping with y’all!! This church has been here since I’ve lived in Mar Vista for over 30 years. They have kindly allowed Steve with Petramale Pizza to have a pop-up of the world’s best pizza every FRIDAY. This is the best best best pizza! This is from me studying abroad in Italy and traveling around the world. There’s nothing like it! Please support your local community and try some of his pizza on Fridays. Love this church!! Very welcoming. You can be yourself, and Pastor Mark is so good. We always leave feeling good and learn something we can apply to our daily life and relationship w God and his people. Overall, it is one of the most peaceful,  calming atmospheres. Generally, I don't want to even leave. This is the best church in california in my opinion

name: Venture Church
Venture Church - Encinitas Campus
reviewSummary:
My family and I began attending Venture Church about three months ago after our previous church, Revé, merged with Venture. We were baptized at Revé, so this new season has been especially meaningful. The transition has been smooth and from the very beginning we have felt genuinely welcomed by the people and staff.

The worship is uplifting and Christ centered, and the messages are biblically-grounded and relatable. We have especially enjoyed being part of the grow groups, which have helped us connect with others and grow deeper in our faith.

We especially love that Venture Church offers so much through its ministries, grow groups, university, and camps, all focused on helping people know and follow Jesus.

If you are looking for a church home where you will be encouraged, equipped, and welcomed, I highly recommend Venture. I just attended Venture Church this past Sunday for the first time and I LOVED it! Everybody was so welcoming. I even found my first friend in the women’s bathroom, who asked me my name. My new, dear, big blonde sister, Genta! I will definitely be returning, thank you! God is good! Venture Church welcomes all who enter to worship our Lord! I feel comfortable the minute I walk in the door. The Worship Team is amazing and I love and anticipate the Venture News; very informative and always a good laugh! The sermons are Biblical and always related to our daily lives. This is seriously such an amazing church I am so grateful the Lord led me to this church and Pastor Troy and his wife Jessica. They are fabulous and so is the message of love and Jesus they spread. Great group of people and everyone will feel welcome and loved here. Enjoying their Christmas Eve Candle Light service, I must say everyone seemed very welcoming. Going in, following the previous service, made things a little confusing. But who isn't confused their first time. The music was great and helped to eliminate the distractions for me to praise and worship. FYI: one may find ear plugs useful to dampen the impact of the sound. It was a different kind of Christmas message, a reflective message. Try out the weekly messages and see what you think.

name: Venture Church Carmel Valley
Venture Church Carmel Valley - Del Mar Campus
reviewSummary: Do not I repeat do not attend this church, complete superficiality, lack of true authenticity, and really miss the boat of what it means to live out with love. Grateful after this experience to find a church much more welcoming, less judgmental or shame based This church is truly incredible. The sermons are grounded in truth, the people are kind and welcoming, and the pastors genuinely care. I joined their small group and have gained invaluable insights into emotionally healthy spirituality. You can feel the church’s sincere commitment to the well-being of its congregation. I came and stayed during an incredibly painful season of my life and God has used this church to heal me in ways I never even knew I needed. From the very first moment I came to Reve the pastor Todd & his wife Shannon along with Derek, Liz, Robert and all there amazing dream team were so welcoming! They were and are all so friendly. I’ve learned so much from there Womens Scripture study, their small groups, and I get so much out of the sermons. Every time I walk into worship you can really feel the presence of God. This church has become my home ❤️ And they have such an amazing and powerful story as to how they got here which I find to be inspiring! Revé church is a welcoming and supportive environment where I have been able to enjoy our pastors as well as the community of believers. Sunday service has awesome music, coffee and bible based teachings that give me something to reference all week. There is a great children’s church program keeping the littles happy and entertained. Love it and definitely recommend. Reve has been such an amazing home & community for us! Shannon & Todd are so incredibly welcoming and warm, the kid’s-care activities impressive, and the entire team such a light in our world. We are new to our faith journey but knew that a community based in compassion, selflessness & mutual support was something we wanted to raise our daughter within. Reve has been just that. They have welcomed us, nourished our budding relationship with God & made it fun & exciting along the way. Such a pleasure to call this community home!

name: Venture Español
Venture Español - Encinitas Campus
reviewSummary: very welcoming This is a wonderful church! I felt God's love through the people of Venture Español. They welcomed me with open arms, and I currently attend their services. God is doing great things in the Hispanic community!

name: Vermont Avenue Baptist Church
Vermont Avenue Baptist Church - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary:
Best church ever!  Pastor Lance is so knowledgeable and entertaining.  Best Bible based church i ever attended.  They have a sunday school that my 6yr daughter loves!
Best Christian band ever!  They are really involved with the community.  I just cant say enough with this house of love! How disgusting and shameful that a church and school keeps living animals in such an inhumane and dreadful condition. How dare this church and school deny the proper care for these animals and refuse to give them up so they can be taken to a veterinary hospital. It’s also disgusting and cruel how one of your workers even laughed about the death of one your rabbits recently. Rocken Band, good people,good message, great for young adults. Parking lot needs work😞. Basketball court still works. Pot luck lunches really work.😄
Check em out.

PS. Casual and friendly also works  😁 Very pleasant church! Congregation is warm and welcoming & Pastor Lance delivers a Great message every week! Suggest you bring your family and friends to visit :) I went here back in 1977 to 1987 and was in the kids choir and really enjoyed the pastor back then was John  H Wilson  and the music was great and when the kids choir took over the entire morning service and night service as well  we had Pastor Wilson sit in the congregation as the kids choir took over the the service, I also attended the school there as well back in 1977 to about 1980 and yes the potlucks are very good at the end of a morning service and  so are the round up Sundays when Pastor John H Wilson brings in the horses from Oklahoma.

name: Verve City Church
Verve City Church - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary:
I am an on-line participant, and I follow Verve because Pastor Josh never fails to meet us where we are, and is REAL about what is happening in our personal lives and in the life of our country.  I always appreciate how he is courageous enough to preach about what is really happening around us, and does not give in to the political manipulations of many churches in America today. We love Verve City Church! We’ve called this place home for years and years for so many reasons. The mission of our church is to help people find life by following Jesus and we see that happening through baptisms, outreach events, people volunteering their time, and investing their gifts to grow in their relationships with God. These things are true for us as well, we know the importance of being part of community in growing as Christ followers and have experienced this in more ways than we can count here. We feel it’s so welcoming too, and we really enjoy Josh’s messages. We feel encouraged and challenged each Sunday. These are just a few of the things that help us to know The Verve is where we’re meant to be. If you’re looking for community, Verve City is the place to be! The people and staff are all welcoming, friendly, and very helpful. They have incredible ministries for every age— the children's and students ministries are engaging and all around a great place for the kids to learn about Jesus. It’s a safe and fun place to bring the whole family.
The main church teachings are centered on the gospel and are presented in an educated and easily digestible way. I always feel like I get something practical out of the messages that directly relates to my life. You can really feel the love this church has for each other and for the Lord! AND amazing free coffee! My husband, three elementary age kids, and I, have been attending Verve City Church for 2 years now. We instantly knew this was the place for us and have been at this church ever since our first Sunday. The kids church is incredible. The people are friendly and so welcoming. I am most proud of all that this church does for our community. Visit once and it will feel like home. I am so grateful to be a part of Verve City Church. The community here is warm, welcoming, and truly feels like family. The services are inspiring and meaningful, with messages that uplift and challenge me to grow spiritually. The worship team is wonderful, and it’s clear that everyone involved puts their heart into every aspect of the service.

name: Verve Community Church
Verve Community Church - Riverside (Canyon Crest) Campus
reviewSummary:
We had the honor of providing our ‘SHINE’ marquee letters for Verve Community Church’s 2026 Night to Shine, and it was a truly unforgettable experience.

This prom-themed evening for individuals with special needs was filled with so much joy and genuine connection. The community at Verve was incredibly welcoming, making the setup and pick-up for our equipment smooth and stress-free. The building is spacious, beautifully maintained, and perfectly suited for large-scale events.

When we returned for pick-up, the energy in the room was still so uplifting — you could truly feel the care and intention that went into every detail of the night. Verve has built something special here, and we are so grateful to have played a small part in such a meaningful event. I highly recommend them for their beautiful facility and, more importantly, the heart they have for our community!

— Annalicia | Together Time Party Rentals This is a place that my family and I reached out to when we we're lost spiritually, and they have taken us in like their own family. Everybody looks out for each other and it's always a good time. I invite anybody that would like to come out to the services. It's on Sunday. There are 2 services. The first service is at 9:30 AM and the second service is at 11 AM. Hope to see you soon. This church is very dear to my son and me. From the moment you walk in, you can truly feel the love and warmth. They offer classes for just about everyone, no matter your stage in life. If you're looking for a welcoming place to grow in faith, come visit one of the services at 9:30 AM or 11:00 AM. We'd love to see you there. 🙏💛 The architecture alone is beautiful to come and look at. The entire Parish is filled with awesome mind human beings.  The preschool program there is fantastic! My children absolutely look forward to going there during the week. The staff is an exact replica of their parish staff. They make you feel comfortable and right at home. A church that is truly HOME.   Friendly, warm atmosphere and very welcoming.   I was tired of traditional church and actually had given up on being a member anywhere.  Just me and Jesus.  Then when life happened and lost my Dad I went to church with my sister to get comfort for my grief. What I found is a leadership team that is authentic, inspired and transparent teachers of the Word who live out their walk like you and I.  Looking forward to walking out our faith walk collaboratively.  There is a place for YOU.

name: Victoria Presbyterian Church
Victoria Presbyterian Church - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary:
A beautiful church, with nice folks.

I travel for work, and often find myself visiting Presbyterian churches in distant cities. Sometimes you're positively surrounded by curious members of the congregation, and that's nice, but not always quite what you're in the mood for.

Victoria was not this kind of church, though. Folks were welcoming in a reserved kind of way; I definitely felt that if I'd been seeking a lot of attention for being a visitor, I could have gotten it, but I let myself rest instead on the respectful and reserved warmth the Fellowship here offered.

I will attend again, if I stay long enough to have visited some other Churches I'm interested in visiting in the area. They treat people that are homeless with respect and dignity and they don't run you off as fast as most places do if your homeless so always you can go by the Presbyterian Church he'll keep you safe Closed during open hours 1-9 People are kind and sharing and worship is great. I highly recomend coming and finding out for yourself. Great grandson goes to preschool there.  It's clean & teachers are very caring.

name: Victory Anaheim
Victory Anaheim - Anaheim Campus
reviewSummary: A welcoming community check them out. Absolutely lovely church with the most welcoming faces. name: Victory Church
Victory Church - Boca Raton Campus
reviewSummary:
Hi! I started going to Victory mainly for youth on Wednesdays after a friend recommended I try it. I hadn’t really been attending church and was hopeful this would be a positive experience. Unfortunately, from the moment I walked in, the environment felt noticeably judgmental and uncomfortable. We were split into groups and talked for a bit, and afterward I opened up slightly to the main worship leader. At first, she appeared kind and trustworthy, which made me feel comfortable enough to share, but looking back, that assumption was clearly misplaced. I struggle with anxiety, so opening up was already a challenge. Instead of receiving support or guidance, I was met with passive-aggressive responses and unnecessary snarky comments. I was simply talking about school and things I was going through, yet somehow left feeling out of place and uncomfortable. Later, I found out that what I shared had been discussed with other people in the church, which was especially hurtful—considering it was one of my first times opening up to someone in that setting. A church should feel welcoming and safe, and this experience was anything but that. When you are in a leadership position, sharing someone’s personal information should not be optional or based on convenience; unless someone is in danger, those conversations should remain private. Unfortunately, this situation felt far more like gossip than genuine care. I also expressed interest in joining the worship team, as I have a strong passion for singing and growing closer to God. I went through the audition process with the same leader and submitted a singing video as instructed. Weeks passed, and I continued to feel uncomfortable walking into the church, only to never hear back at all. The lack of follow-up or communication felt unprofessional and dismissive. The people are what make up a church, and unfortunately, a small group of individuals managed to overshadow what could have been a meaningful experience. Being in a “godly” environment should not feel like walking into a space filled with gossip and judgment—especially when those who claim to worship God are the ones participating in it. sadly, I’ve since spoken to several others who shared similar experiences with this same leader, including favoritism, bias, poor communication, and sharing personal information. (this is not only with one person, it’s with multiple people)
While the preaching and vocals were good, the overall environment was unhealthy and took a toll on my mental health. Because of that, I would not return, and I would not recommend you go/ send your child to this church.

Nothing wrong with these things, if that is what you are looking for.  But a word of caution for those who seek more of a non-denominational, relaxed and friendly environment.

name: Viewpoint Church
Viewpoint Church - Newport Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Viewpoint Church is truly a special place!

This church is intimate, connected, and welcoming. From the moment I walked in, I felt at home with how friendly and genuine everyone is. One of the things I really appreciate about Viewpoint is the worship—it’s powerful and heartfelt. The messages are always relevant, based on the Bible readings for the upcoming week, which helps you dive deeper into Scripture and understand what you're reading. Pastor Roger and Becky Tirabassi are amazing co-pastors with a wealth of wisdom and hearts on fire for the Lord! Pastor Dr. Ryan Montague has amazing sermons with practical takeaways for you each time he preaches!

Viewpoint Church isn’t just a place to attend; it’s a place where people truly do life together. I came in as a nonbeliever, just exploring, but when I decided to give my life to Jesus, I’m so thankful for the community that supported me on my journey. If you’re looking for a welcoming, Bible-focused church, I highly recommend checking out Viewpoint Church! Family friendly church. Viewpoint’s DNA includes a dedication to reading and studying God’s word, community outreach, worship, and weekly prayer meetings. They have excellent teen and young professional ministries, a diverse congregation with warm and welcoming members. Also, experienced (teaching) pastors who focus on Scripture. Definitely worth checking out! This is by far one of the most joyful and loving Bible-based churches I've ever been to.  It's a family and a community. Even the pastors are so personable you can have lunch with them after church. Come check it out! We love Viewpoint Church, it’s been a blessing in our lives. We’ve been going for about 11 years,  and we have been reading the whole Bible along with the church for just as long. Every Sunday we can expect to hear a message on what we will be reading the following week, along with the whole church. The sense of community on Viewpoint is something we missed when we used to go to a big church, it’s easy to connect and get to know people. If you’re looking for a church that will pray with you and encourage you to read your Bible I highly recommend Viewpoint. Being a part of Viewpoint Church has done so much to better our marriage, our family, and our faith. VP is small enough for you to feel welcome and engaged (we found that hard in larger churches) but still has many resources like a bigger church to support you. For great fellowship and wonderful pastors who speak biblical truth, VP is the place.

name: Village Bible Church
Village Bible Church - Garden Grove Campus
reviewSummary: I’ve been attending Village Bible Church for nearly five years now and am so grateful to be part of this church family who is devoted to serving one another, side by side, as each grows in their faith-filled walk. Working with the jr. high youth has been such a blessing to me. One of the best groups of sinners, saved by grace, we have had the opportunity to worship, grow and serve with.  Teaching from scripture with core values: Outreach, Community, Spiritual Growth and Ministry. A cross generational community.  Realizing the unique experience, my boys concluded that it is a result of transparency and accessibility to leadership. If you don't have a home church, please join us.  Our annual Living Nativity is amazing. I came to this church when I was 11 years old and fell in love on the first day. 8 years later and i'm still coming. The Lord has used this church and it's people to teach and show me so many wonderful things. My ministry is welcoming booth so come say hi! I used to live right across the street and would go to Awana as a kid, best place to have been during some rough times being so young. It really was a blessing. I miss worship time with all the sing along songs. My favorite was “Don’t build your house on a sandy land”. Stay blessed.🫶🏼🥹 This church does a wonderful live re-enactments of the birth of Jesus back in the old days of Jerusalem and animals are there too with refreshments in the month of December each year. An awesome back in Time experience. I truly enjoyed it!!!

name: Village Church
Village Church - Burbank Campus
reviewSummary:
Lovely welcome and good fellowship, home from home...(on holiday from Wales, UK with wife and 2 kids in late teens).
Good biblical teaching from Pastor Ryan with honest worship.
Bless you guys. My Husband Andrew and I have been at Village Church since 2005. And as we enter our 15th year I must say this is an amazing Church. Pastor Wade and his staff are all so kind and loving and they make everyone feel worthy and special and they make you feel at home. I am always blessed to be part of Village Church and there is no other Churxh I would rather be at than the one God brought us to.  Thank You Village Church for giving us a him to be at . Music lyrics were very biblical and meaningful and easy to follow on screen.  Sermon was also. Enjoyed the enthusiastic children's choir and the membership seems to cover a wide range of age groups. This was the Saturday evening service I attended. Great church, very inviting and friendly, non judgemental, lots of great small groups that meet during the weeks, so something for everyone. From celebrate recovery, to general bible studys, young married group, young singles group, youth group, womens bible study, mens bible study, and several others... sunday morning before the main service there are several sunday school groups that meet for all age groups, and youth groups, and child care durring the service. The saturday night and sunday morning services are full of great biblical teaching, and sound doctrine...Pastor Wade is a great Teacher who has a down to earth easy to understand & apply way of teaching thru the Bible! the musical portion of worship service is more modern, with some classic hymns. the members are very loving and welcoming. There are people from all over the world, and every background all together with love for eachother to worship the creator & savior of the world! Also the church supports and participate in a variety of mission trips thruout the year. If you are looking for a congregation to join in worship , or just have questions or are curious about God, Jesus, & the Bible come check it out! Village church would love to have you, and serve you! And please check out the welcome center in the back of the auditorium, there are people there who would love to answer all your questions, & help you get plugged in! God Bless! Went to a Sunday night dinner that was all kinds of chili made from all the different people of the church it was really cool..

name: Village Church - Santa Clarita Campus
reviewSummary: I love my church. We are all a family, and our pastors are such a blessing.  LOVE ,ACCEPTANCE, FORGIVENESS IS THE ROLE MODEL. Every one is welcome  if you are tired,lonely and need some awesome people to lift you up an encourage you this church is for  yo. The presence of God is felt when we the church come together.  We wait with open arms to welcome you and all your loved ones. This place personifies God's love in every way imaginable. What a cool, eclectic congregation. The father-and-son pastoral staff truly reflect the Lord in their words and actions. This church is incredibly amazing! They preach what the Bible says, believe in the full gospel, (The indwelling of the Holy Spirit, the gifts of the Spirit, & the fruit of the Spirit,) and are true to their motto, LOVE, ACCEPTANCE, FORGIVENESS. Also, their praise & worship team Rock! The pastor, (i think he was) he had the biggest bible and a nice cross is absolutely nuts. the first thing on their mind is someone who is different is a satanist. shame full. If your looking for a family church. This is a place to be. The Pastors and everyone else there will love you and make you know, you are most welcome everytime you walk through the doors of the church. I am always looking forward for all the services.

name: Village Church of Irvine
Village Church of Irvine - Irvine (University) Campus
reviewSummary:
My wife and I visited first outdoors during Covid and have made this our new church home. This is a place of authentic people seeking Jesus. We especially love the “family dinner” style first sundays of the month where you can have some great food and meet some new friends. I found the Village after several months of trying churches in Irvine and my family have been members now for over 3 years. The Village met all the Biblical criteria of a faithful bible teaching church. The authority of scripture is foundational. The Gospel is shared often. The leaders are hospitable, gracious, and humble. The church has great community groups all across orange county, where discipleship and spiritual growth take place. The Village believes in reformed theology, but they do not make secondary issues overly important. They give the congregation the room to disagree on secondary issues which allows for appropriate defense of primary issues.

If you are a follower of Christ, I highly recommend The Village Church in Irvine. On the very first Sunday we visited Village Church back in 2016, we were warmly greeted and even invited to join a community group. Nearly seven years later, we continue to be grateful every day being part of a local church that emphasizes biblical authority, gospel centrality, and community. I’ve been attending VCI for several years now, and I’ve grown tremendously in my faith here. I know so many people at this church who are real people with flaws, but who are growing because they are sincerely following Jesus and pursuing a relationship with Him. Come join us on a Sunday, and get plugged into a community group or Bible study so we can do life with you, too! We love Village Church of Irvine! Solid, Biblical teaching and training, great community, good serving opportunities, and a great kid ministry. We love being part of this church!

name: Village Seven Main Campus
Village Seven Presbyterian Church
Vine Church Tampa
Vine Church Tampa - Tampa Palms Campus
reviewSummary:
As a follower of Christ for many years, I have had the joy of being a part of many fellowships. Last year I found Vine Church Tampa and was able to join them in worship and fellowship. I  highly recommend this church for anyone looking to grow in their faith and needing a welcoming community. This group of believers seeks to Glorify Christ in every aspect of their gathering. A family united in Christ, who gathers at the hotel-for now- every Sunday for 2 services (English and Spanish) to listen to the Holy word of God. A place to call home in the midst of this chaotic life. Welcoming family and sane doctrine preached on every encounter. We immediately felt welcomed at this church! The sermons are Bible focused and Christ centered. Community is genuine and friendly. Vine Church Tampa is a bilingual church, with one service in English and another in Spanish. Although there are two languages, the church is intentionally lived and feels like one family.

It is a church that is:

• Serious in its doctrine.

• Focused on Christ and Scripture.

• Intentionally supportive of community and its members.

This is a family of faith, a place to grow in Christ and His commission. Vine Church Tampa is a healthy church where you can find excellent biblical exposition of the Word, Jesus Christ-centered worship, and a fellowship that transcends the physical limits of a building.

name: Vine-Life Christian Fellowship
Vine-Life Christian Fellowship - Riverside Campus
reviewSummary: I love Vinelife ,I love pastor Wilks....he's real and down to earth.he always makes his sermons relatable. Im always able to connect with the words he's giving for the day. He appeals to the youth the elders & every walk of life in between. I really love this church. Always receiving the word Pastor Wilks is very transparent, doesn't hold anything back, If you are looking for a Pastor who will tell you what you need to hear and know about the word of God, come join us on Sunday morning, very powerful message each and every service.God has called and anointed Dr. Robert L. Wilks, Jr. to teach people how to position themselves for God to bless them so that they can be a blessing to other people The Church seems to be a little unorganized. I really didn't know when church started from all the people that was standing around talking while the young man on stage was trying to sing praises. It looked like the people gathered themselves after the Pastor came, and even then, I got the feeling that things was still out of order. I pray that everything will come together. The Pastor is the best Teacher of THE WORD of GOD! He lives to give and has taught me about: THE LOVE OF GOD now I live to give like GOD!!! VLCF is dedicated to teaching the unaltered Word of God, strictly as it is biblically written. Great teaching!

name: Vineyard Church Glendora
Vineyard Church Glendora - Glendora Campus
reviewSummary: A rich and good combo of smart, loving teaching with sincere community-building and outreach opportunities. The worship is talented without being a production, sincere and ministering. My fav thing is ministry time every week for prayer—if you need support for comfort or breakthrough, every week it’s available in prayer time with pastors and the people attending. VCG is what I imagine church should and can be—discipleship and togetherness. The people of this church have been very supportative, in practical ways (transportation to & from Chemo, meals, yardwork, pick up prescriptions ), during the time my roommate was struggling with Cancer. And, now that I am alone, they have continued with support and sharing God's love with me.  I am so grateful for this church Family. Vineyard Church Glendora is a welcoming community church with bible based teachings.  Vineyard has programs for children, youth and adults, and also has periodic activities for the surrounding community.  Pastors Abigail and Jacob truly have hearts for the Lord! This church is very supportive. When my sister was dying of cancer they went above and beyond with support and love for her. I can’t thank God enough for them. A good group of people

name: Vineyard Covington
Vineyard Covington - Covington Campus
reviewSummary: My family loves it here! So friendly and welcoming. This is a new building for the church but the church has been gathering for a few years elsewhere. It’s a great place to be! Warm and inviting place to worship Jesus! Wonderful church with wonderful people that are relatable, down to earth, and just what you need

name: Vineyard Fullerton Church
Vineyard Fullerton Church - Fullerton Campus
reviewSummary:
Amazing church and wonderful people who make you feel welcome. Discovered this church in 2015 and absolutely fell in love with it. Now that we're back in SoCal, we are attending again. The people are authentic and real. The worship music is by far the best I think I've ever experienced. The sermons/teaching is always relevant and thought provoking.
This church goes out of their building and in to the community to try and make a difference in the lives of those who call Fullerton home. Lots of opportunity to get involved.
This is a great church to call "home". Great group of people who care about you. Real biblical application in this modern world. Wonderful worship team and pastors. Highly recommend. A great place with great people. Meeting on Saturday night is nice since we have Sunday to reflect and rest before the week starts. Such a wonderful place. Meet another of people.  Been in hospital  but am out now. Hope to come to to service again.

name: Vineyard Laguna Niguel
Vineyard Laguna Niguel - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
Great services, I really enjoyed this Easter but my favorites are Monday nights in person, you can check it out on Facebook, they broadcast it live Monday nights . I have attended this church for over a dozen years now. More so while my kids were growing up. The Wednesday nights are amazing as well as the Monday’s for those who want to learn and grow in a way that you and God see fit. People are non-judge mental. Truly a come as you are church. Meaning don’t be worried by the cares of this world. You can be broken, afraid or fully on fire. Wear your Sunday best or without shoes. People are real and authentic. Life happens to all of us including all of us at this church.  There is more here than the traditional Bible teaching. Hear from God. He shows up to do business with each of us. This Church is a healthy place to grow in God. It Carries the Father's Love, A Love for Worship and Teaches you hands on to help you grow. This church gives room for others to grow in their gifts and pursue a relationship with God. Its becoming a kingdom culture community seeing the best in others,praying for others,encouraging one another. Learning how to operate in Mark 16 mandate. You also see and learn of many miracles operate at this church and it's one of the largest in the community that serves the poor and needy. You get God connected in a NEW deeper way. And if you been wounded by past churches,this is a safe place to restore you. I Love Love Love this Church Family !!!
Pastor Mike is A Genuine Pastor.
His Love and Care as a Good Shepherd for his Congregation is Awesome.
This is a Place to be fed the Truth of God’s Word. The Atmosphere is Filled with The Holy Spirit at Every Service and Event by the Dedicated Worship Leaders and Bands. They Literally Change the Atmosphere with Their Music. We have Experienced Emotional and Physical Healings during times of Worship !!!
I’m Glad I found my Church Family Here. I've been to many churches throughout my Christian life and have never seen so many true miracles in all my life!  I love the people and the teaching and am growing so much!  I love this church and everyone I've invited many friends and they've all felt the same way!  Come by on a Monday night at 7:15 for worship or come for a regular Sunday service at 11;15 on Sundays! :-)

name: Vintage Church LA Santa Monica
Vintage Church LA Santa Monica - Santa Monica Campus
reviewSummary:
This community is welcoming, fun and kind. Weather you have all the questions, are a "baby christian" or a master theologian, you can all come worship and grow together. It's a glimpse of Heaven in the streets of LA.
Kids, teens, young adults, moms, dads, "vintage" ages all have groups (and more, check online for all the info). And their coffee is well brewed! See you there! This is a very beautiful church in a classic church building with a modern twist. I really enjoyed my first service. It’s peaceful, bright, and everyone was very kind. If you’re looking for a church that sets the flashy lights and performances aside for ACTUAL scripture, this is it. I loved it and I will be back.

My only complaints are these: I wish on the website it had given a disclaimer about the 10am services and parking. I arrived on time hoping to get a spot in the first time visitor lot, but there was nothing and nobody in the parking lot to direct anyone elsewhere. I had to pull over and look up their alternate lot.

The alternate lot was ALSO full, and by the time I found something I was 30 min late to service. I live in the valley so I didn’t think the parking situation would be this hard. By the time I got inside, the entire church was FULL. It’s great to see a church so popular, but I wish I had been warned about its 10am popularity. Noted: arrive more than half hour early if you want to see the 10am.

I hung out at a coffee shop nearby until the 11:45am service, which was a lot less busy but still lovely.

I would have loved to attend the meet&eat session, but I was receiving prayer at the end of the service. By the time I walked outside the connect tent was already gone, and neither security or the person security directed me to could tell me who specifically to talk to. I would have loved to be connected to someone specific but instead I was told to go mingle until I find them. Sorry, but I’m kind of shy, and I really wish someone could have connected me directly and having to go around figuring it out myself was enough to make me leave. I think this church needs to have a couple people standing by directing and connecting people if they need. Doesn’t even need to be a whole tent, maybe just a sign or a flag with one person standing there for questions. Great atmosphere. It was quite the drive for me (I came all the way from Pasadena), and I also had to pick up a friend on my way there. It ended up being around an hour or so, but I was able to make it (a bit late) to their 11:45am service. They serve donuts and coffee, which is a nice touch. It was a bit difficult to find people to connect with, but that is understandable, since I'm assuming volunteers had been up since 8am, and this was the last service for them (I've volunteered at churches before and I know how exhausting it can get at the end of a 3-back-to-back services morning). I visited a Sunday service a few weeks ago and stopped by the welcome booth because I was interested in getting connected.

During my visit, I learned that joining a small group requires completing a course first, which was unexpected. I was also told the next course is not scheduled until the fall, which means there can be a significant delay before participating in community groups.

I found that disappointing, as I was hoping for a more immediate path to meeting people and building relationships. Whether you know Jesus or want to see what it’s all about, this is the church to join on Sundays. Real people, kind and happy to gather in community. The teaching is strong and the worship so good. And a coffee on the sidewalk is a welcome treat.  Come check it out. Sundays at 8:15, 10 & 11:45 am.  Teenagers programming is great too! During the 10am service.

name: Vintage Church Pasadena
Vintage Church Pasadena - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary:
We visited from arizona and reallt enjoyed this church. 1st there is a parking garage about a block down with free parking, plus street parking. The service was awesome.  We recited the lord's prayer together and they offered blessings with the communion.  The pastor is very down to earth and personable.  We will now be watching online along with our regular church service in our home town. Thank you for a beautiful service. I've never been to church here but they left beautiful hand painted rocks, seeds and a message of hope on many of my neighbors lots that had been burned in the fire in Altadena. I noticed them walking in the neighborhood and today found one by my mailbox and it was so lovely to be thought of. Thank you for not forgetting us up here and for leaving little pieces of kindness in all the tragedy...you have no idea how much it means. Vintage Church Pasadena is a great Church. From the moment I walked in, I was welcomed with warmth and love. The worship is awesome, Tom Reed is truly a gifted worship leader that is always mixing new contemporary worship songs with the old standards that is wonderfully uplifting. Pastor Ben Chase is an excellent pastor bringing the Word of God to real applications to use in our hectic lives, making faith real and relevant. This church isn’t just a place to attend—it’s a family where lives are transformed. The rest of the staff are amazing people that truly love God and want to help you in any way. I can speak from my own experience. This is the most friendly Church I've ever been to, where the word of God is being preached every service where people's faith is being renewed and nurtured.  If you're looking for a place to grow, serve, and experience God’s love, Vintage is it! Highly recommend! Truly I call HOME! Love the church, the people, the building, the community and the passion of our pastor and pastal staffs.  I know I found my home church the very first Sunday in Vintage.  People were so friendly and genuine, coffee and donuts brought in additional warm feeling, I got to know more people in 2 weeks period than I knew people in years in the previous church. Then the compassion during Eaton Canyon Fire, the community stays so strong together, helping one another, paying forward... Church activities & volunteer become the center of my life.  Prays to God! Vintage Pasadena is a welcoming, Gospel-centered community with a diverse congregation. If you're looking for a church home, it's definitely worth a visit.

Finding genuine community in Los Angeles can be tough—commitment is practically a dreaded word in LA. But if you take the leap and visit Vintage more than once, join a community group, volunteer, and embrace a few awkward conversations, you'll find a place where deep friendships and your spiritual life can flourish.

name: VISION Calvary Chapel Offices
VISION Calvary Chapel Offices - Irvine Campus
Vision Christian Fellowship
Vision Christian Fellowship - Pasadena Campus
reviewSummary: Went to this church long ago, only lived in LA for a year. Truly remarkable — I’ve been to many churches and what Michael and this community bring is honesty, vulnerability, deep insight, connection, and spiritual gifts. I would go back in a heartbeat. Pastor Michael Koh is likely the most gifted preacher in S California right now. But the real essence of VCF is the way the spirit moves. Come here expecting that— Working in the Pasadena area i wanted to be active in a church. The genuine sense of community and compassion in this church is what made me stay and want to seek a new church to attend. I feel very Blessed to have found Vision Christain Fellowship. I never dreamed that I would study, worship & have that type of relationship with other people & the LORD. I went there just once as I was just visiting in the area. I felt very comfortable there. It was like being at home. I think it's a great church

name: Vivid Church
Vivid Church - Brea Campus
reviewSummary:
I love this church! I moved to a college near this area and spent my entire first semester looking for a genuine, good and welcoming church and could not find one until a friend invited me to Vivid my second semester and now Vivid is home! I come with my finacé and my friend group and am so happy to have a home church like Vivid! Truly is the best experience being in the presence and even serving is so rewarding! THE MOST UNDERRATED CHURCH EVER!

Vivid Church is such an amazing house filled with God led pastors and a God led team who treats everyone with love and respect! I don’t really feel at home with churches that I’ve visited in the past, but being at Vivid hits different. Pastor Joe, Pastor Krissy, Pastor Eric, The Dream Team, everyone is just filled with the Holy Spirit and they are all so kind.

I definitely suggest a visit here, even if  you’ve never been to a church, or you have a home church or not. Stop by and check it out!! Vivid is one of the most genuine churches I’ve ever attended. You are noticed as soon as you enter through the door, and known by name by everyone. You feel encouraged by just being around each other, and it truly feels like a family. Pastor Joe speaks genuinely and is real, he doesn’t act like a pastor that is above everyone else. I truly love being apart of this team & being a member of this church! Vivid Church has truly become home for me. The people are authentic, welcoming, and passionate about Jesus. I’ve experienced meaningful community, prayer, encouragement, and spiritual growth here. If you’re looking for a church where you can encounter God and grow in your faith, I highly recommend visiting Vivid Church. VIVID has made an amazing change to our family. Since the first day we walked in everyone has been so friendly and welcoming. We have made VIVID our home church since the first day. All the pastors are amazing and willing to talk to you at anytime. We love VIVID church

If you’re looking for a church where you can encounter God and grow in your faith, I highly recommend visiting Vivid Church. VIVID has made an amazing change to our family. Since the first day we walked in everyone has been so friendly and welcoming. We have made VIVID our home church since the first day. All the pastors are amazing and willing to talk to you at anytime. We love VIVID church

name: Vivid Church - Tustin Campus
reviewSummary:
I love this church! I moved to a college near this area and spent my entire first semester looking for a genuine, good and welcoming church and could not find one until a friend invited me to Vivid my second semester and now Vivid is home! I come with my finacé and my friend group and am so happy to have a home church like Vivid! Truly is the best experience being in the presence and even serving is so rewarding! THE MOST UNDERRATED CHURCH EVER!

Vivid Church is such an amazing house filled with God led pastors and a God led team who treats everyone with love and respect! I don’t really feel at home with churches that I’ve visited in the past, but being at Vivid hits different. Pastor Joe, Pastor Krissy, Pastor Eric, The Dream Team, everyone is just filled with the Holy Spirit and they are all so kind.

I definitely suggest a visit here, even if  you’ve never been to a church, or you have a home church or not. Stop by and check it out!! Vivid is one of the most genuine churches I’ve ever attended. You are noticed as soon as you enter through the door, and known by name by everyone. You feel encouraged by just being around each other, and it truly feels like a family.
