All the pastors are amazing and willing to talk to you at anytime. We love VIVID church

name: Voice Church
Voice Church - Tustin Campus
reviewSummary:
I ABSOLUTELY love this church! If you are looking for a smaller church to grow with, this is your church! The praise and worship is amazing. Every time I have attended service there, you feel nothing but God’s presence in the building. Taka, the head pastor, has such a gift of breaking down a topic spiritually and making it relatable to present day. I definitely leave every Sunday with my cup filled. The second time we attended service Taka’s wife Natalie made it a point to introduce herself to our family. The whole community there is very welcoming.  I have two kids that also attend their kids club while we are in service. Knowing how God views the church makes me so happy that my wife found the Voice church to make home. Started coming here couple months ago. My experience here has been so refreshing. The passion and vision of this church is what really made us decide Voice as our home church !

If anyone is looking for a safe, people loving, and Bible loving church, I’d say check this place out.

As new parents, the awesome children’s ministry didn’t hurt 😌 We’ve been attending Voice for a couple of months now and it has truly been a blessing. We love the pastors, community, and messages we receive. I feel seen here. I feel loved here. I feel at home here. I appreciate how quickly we can serve and how our voices matter. I also value how open, friendly, and transparent our pastors are with everything. I’m excited to see where God takes Voice Church this year! We had just moved into the OC and were looking for a place to call home and a church family. After visiting a few places, nothing really stood out. I found Voice after seeing their trailer in a shopping area and decided to go check it out. After the first service, it was hands down the church for our family.

The generosity and love of the people is infectious, the worship/service is simple and thoughtful, yet so impactful, the sermons drive deep into the heart and are just real, and this church really does feel like the answer to what Jesus would’ve done in modern times (diverse and reflective of the local community, outreach driven, yet purposefully built to meet the needs of its people). I’m so grateful for the amazing leaders here and highly encourage you to come check it out! You will be greeted with love, no judgments and a smile. Voice Church is unlike any church I have ever attended. I came from a past of bad experience with the church and was terrified to try yet another church where I could potentially get hurt again. However, God truly lead me to a place with people who love Him so much and have a heart for Jesus and those around them that is so evident. From the first day my boyfriend (now husband) and I walked in we were met with welcoming smiles and people who genuinely cared to know us! Pastor Taka and Pastor Natalie use God’s word at the center of all sermons and you leave every Sunday with a hunger to learn more about Jesus and the honest truth of the Bible in your heart. Coming from someone who was terrified to try church again, I can say with complete honesty that Voice Church is full of so much love that you will feel so welcomed and sought after here! My husband and I call Voice Church home and the people there our family, we thank Jesus each day for leading us to a place where we can learn more about His word and strengthen our relationship with Him!

name: Voyage Calvary Chapel
Voyage Calvary Chapel - Costa Mesa Campus
reviewSummary: This is a wonderful Bible church. Pastor Brent is fantastic at delivering scripture based messages going through the entire Bible, and the congregation is very welcoming. This is a great place to worship! Voyage Calvary is a wonderful community of God Loving brothers and sisters. Pastor Brent is a gifted teacher and pastor. During a time when my mother-in-law was suffering the onset of dementia, Voyage Calvary was an Oasis where Gina and I could get filled back up with God’s Word and the warm love of a Christian community. Pastor Brent officiated at my mother-in-law’s memorial service and we are so thankful we found Voyage Calvary while traveling monthly to Orange County from Colorado.If you are looking for a church that teaches God’s Word and will help your family to grow in Christ, Voyage Calvary should strongly considered. It's an awesome place to hear God's word, Pastor Brent loves God, loves Jesus, teaches God's word, scripture to interpret scripture, personal and intentional with others, like his wife Brynn, she loves people and is an awesome worship leader the leadership is genuine. Like the leadership, the people here including myself who attended this church, are real, not hiding behind some facade, and are nor afraid to share whether they are struggling or hurting. The support a person receives here in the body of Christ is a huge blessing. This is a solid Bible teaching church. Pastor Brent Wagner teaches through the Bible in a way that's very interesting and relevant. He is also a teacher at the Calvary Chapel Bible college so he comes with good credentials! The people are friendly and welcoming, it's a close-knit community Church that is starting to grow their young family ministry. You'll feel very comfortable here. Warm and welcoming, followers of Christ

name: Voyagers Bible Church
Voyagers Bible Church - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary: Great place. Excellent message great leadership Great men’s Bible study on Friday morning at 7 AM. Really awesome praise band! Am I the only person whose iPhone lists this as their active location, despite never once visiting or traveling near it?  This has been an ongoing issue for over a year & despite manual corrections/changes within my location settings, the location always reverts to 6000 Irvine Center Drive, Irvine, California 92618, United States. The teaching is Bible based and full of application. The youth group K-12 is awesome. Love, love, love Pastor Pete! His Influencers valentine dessert & dance is heartwarming.

name: Walteria United Methodist Church
Walteria United Methodist Church - Torrance Campus
reviewSummary: Good Concerned  People

name: Warner Avenue Baptist Church
Warner Avenue Baptist Church - Huntington Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Stopped in as a visitor. Very warm and welcoming Bible believing church. Great conservative music, great preaching.

Will return. They love God, scripture, and people and work to provide a environment for Christian growth and practical living out of the Christian's faith. Highly recommend if you are in the area. None of us are perfect, but we should be progressing in our walk with Jesus. You can expect that to happen here. I visited there several times last year when I was in California visiting my son and his family. Bible presching and the people were very welcoming and friendly. I am going again this summer and I plan to visit again. In the world we live in, it is hard to find a church that preach and sing like the Bible teaches. I went to church here for about ten years in all. The Pastor Steve preaches very convicting, challenging, and encouraging sermons and I have always enjoyed them. Wonderful caring people in this church.

name: Washington National Cathedral
reviewSummary: A spiritual home for the nation. Beautiful gothic architecture and traditional liturgical worship.

name: Water of Life Community Church
Water of Life Community Church - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
Been attending wol for about 10 years. It’s
Not the same with Dan gone. Shane tries but so many including myself feel lost when he preaches. It’s hard for me to say this because I know that’s Dan’s son. I pray it gets better. I wish like many others pastor Joel would preach more than just once a every other month or if lucky once a month. He is so good and really breaks the message down so well. It not only blesses me but also my teen boys who really stay engaged when he preaches. Please Shane let Pastor Joel have more opportunity. God will raise you up for doing so. Or maybe let him preach every Saturday night. Thanks for your consideration. Wonderful non denominational church. Loving staff and always holy spirit led. Message is always amazing and on point. Bible teaching. Many other classes and Bible studies. I would send anyone new to the faith or needing a new church to give it a try. My personal tribute to Former Assistant Pastor Bob Bryant - Water of Life Church

Back around 2016 I had this kind of prophetic message to give to the Water of Life Community Church of Fontana, so I wrote it on a piece of paper and went to this church and ended up being met by Assistant Pastor Bob Bryant. I have only had a few of these messages in my life to give to churches and all other churches either kicked me out, locked their doors, sent security after me or yelled at me at the top of their lungs. Not Bob Bryant though. He was different. He heard me out, then he took out his phone and looked up some of the shared scriptures and said that he would keep my message in mind. I was actually surprised of how positive he was about it, as my church prophetic messages in the past have never been anything to be taken lightly, as they were always kind of chastising in a way, yet only by words, so don't worry.

Lately I have been talking to someone who is in the area of where the church is located, so I decided to see if I could give a recommendation of a local church in that area, since no churches are perfect, and the fact that Assistant Pastor Bob Bryant still made feel that if I ever chose to become a member of this church that I would still be welcome there.

Lyrics though on the radio as I just now find out of the death of former Assistant Pastor Bob Bryant, as I shed a few tears from hearing the news of his passing --- "I'm runnin' out of faith, I see the future I pictured slowly fade away, and when the tears of pain and heartache are pouring down my face, I find my peace in Jesus' name."

I decide to then find out more details regarding the circumstances surrounding his death back in 2020 and these next lyrics on the radio catch my attention:

"...Why are you crying?
Let me lift up your face
Just don't turn away..."

Someone on the radio just said - "My father passed away last year, so I went straight to Him and to the music for encouragement."

Lyrics on the radio as I nearly  finalize this review - "...everything is different nowadays. I lost a few ones along the way. I had to learn to trust it'll be okay, it'll be okay."

Then the next song - "He will come and wipe our tears away. No more fear. No more pain. No more sorrow, sin or shame. The King is coming back again. A reign of love that will never end."

I tried to see if any of the reviews here happened to mention him by name, yet nothing. Well here is a review for you Assistant Pastor Bob Bryant. 5 stars for the first impression that you gave. I'm sorry to hear of so much negativity found online regarding the circumstances of your death.

--- "Nobody is perfect, not a one is good. Only God is good. Rest in peace my friend." --- Google says: This message is highly biblically sound and rooted in key scriptures. It reflects the theological truth that all humans are sinful by nature (Romans 3:10, 3:23) and that God is the only absolute standard of goodness, as stated by Jesus in Mark 10:18, "No one is good—except God alone"

Google also says: This message is strongly rooted in Biblical theology, specifically regarding human nature and God's holiness. The statement aligns with scripture that emphasizes humanity's sinfulness and the unique, perfect goodness of God, primarily echoing Mark 10:18 (and Luke 18:19) where Jesus states, "No one is good—except God alone," and Romans 3:10, which says, "None is righteous, no, not one."

--- Keep the faith ---

In the Bible, "keeping the faith" means maintaining unwavering trust in God, adhering to biblical truth, and enduring spiritually despite challenges or persecution. It signifies holding fast to the gospel of Jesus Christ, as Paul did (2 Timothy 4:7), to finish one's spiritual journey with steadfast commitment and obedience.

Key Aspects of "Keep the Faith"

Perseverance & Endurance: It is a lifelong commitment to stay faithful, enduring hardships and not giving up on God’s promises.

Keeping the faith is viewed as a dynamic, "worked" response to God's love, aimed at enduring through the end of one's life. This church is the bees knees.
Big & beautiful.
I'm new round here but I use to come way back in the day & I luved & miss Pastor Dan.
Joel Sanchez is their best pastor now & I wished he was there more frequently. A lot to offer depending on what you are looking for. From kids programs, prayer, healing classes, adult ministry school and a k-8th school. Weekend services are excellent. Come early however as on-site parking fills up fast and then off-site parking is the place to go.

Water of Life Community Church: Upland - Ontario Campus
reviewSummary:
No offense to any1 but this guy is the best pastor around.
Sure the Fontana campus is nice & big but if he ain't cooking then we ain't having a good church day.
On God fr fr I love this little church. I was introduced to the one in Fontana, which I love also but this one is just right down the street five minutes away. I really enjoyed coming to this church.❤️ They are never there to help their own.
They do have part of city link , which helps only uh fontana Residence.
And the upland facility it's only in video.
Because pastor Dan wants to keep all the MILLIONS HE MAKES within his family. If you want to lean, feel, and experience God, this is the church you been looking for.
Great community of believers, ready to partner with you in your journey. Lots of different ways to learn skills to grow in your knowledge of the word and God’s love for you. Yes God is crazy about you, that NONE should perish NONE.
Hope you can make it. There’s a seat always waiting For You!,,...and a brother or sister to embrace you and welcome you!! I have been a member of Water of Life for about 7 years. I love this Church because I feel welcomed, loved, encouraged,  and blessed to be a part of such an amazing group of God’s people! Pastor Dan is everything I want and and need in a Pastor! He is down to earth, honest, talks about the things that are going on in the real world and how to deal with that as Christians. He teaches from the Bible and makes it relevant to my life. Pastor Dan teaches me how to be a better Christian!! If you are looking for a place to worship give Water of Life a try; you have nothing to loose and so much to gain!!

name: Water's Edge Church
Water's Edge Church - Encinitas Campus
reviewSummary: What a great church in so many ways! My family has visited many churches before happily settling in with Water’s Edge because it was easy to feel at home. It’s plain to see that the Lord is working through Andy during his talks. He has a way of getting to the heart of the Bible in a way listeners can relate. You’ll find vulnerability, challenging and stimulating talks, a sense of family and close community, openness and comfort. No judgments here, just people hungry for the Word. Kids ministry is also amazing with Deb’s wonderful age-appropriate talks about Jesus and the Bible. This is the first time my two kiddos have truly enjoyed church…and received sound teachings! Water's Edge Church is the house-church-family experience that is Jesus-led and Spirit-filled & less about the entertainment or special programs. This church balances being close-knit & doing "life-together" with being so welcoming and warm to new people coming in the doors. There is an honest heart for people who need authentic community, healing, mercy, or just a warm meal or help with their kids! I love that we have people of all ages and walks of life coming together for the sole purpose of hearing and responding to God's voice. It's a come-as-you-are kind of place. I love being part of Water's Edge! It is a strong community of people who share life together, who are real with each other. Kids are valued and welcomed into this community. They know they are loved. There is an honest heart of all of God's people, both inside and outside the church. You see this in how they serve each other and serve the community. My heart is full. This is a great place to belong! The Water’s Edge Church is not like any other church I’ve been apart of. They keep each week fresh by changing up the format of the gatherings. Water’s Edge Church and it’s members are like family and friends, they care for one another just like you would care for your family and dearest friends. There are many family’s with young children, and the way the church focuses on loving and ministering to the children is beautiful (and I love that they break up the youth program to developmentally appropriate segments for the children, my children look forward to going to church each week). Water's Edge church exhibits the best of what it means to be like Jesus. They love their community, both within the church walls and outside, so well. Andy, the lead pastor, brings the Word and is accesible to his WE Crew. Would recommend this church to anyone looking for home.

name: Watermark Community Church
reviewSummary: Famous for its 'Authentic' and high-commitment culture (Regeneration, Membership). Teaching is 'Expository' and 'Uncompromising'. A massive hub for 'Young Adults' and professionals in Dallas. The 'Porch' ministry is a frequent entry point.

name: Watermark Fellowship Church
Watermark Fellowship Church - Chino Hills Campus
reviewSummary: I attended this church due to a friend of mine doing a sermon here on evangelism. Upon arrival I was greeted with friendly faces and a warmth I had never experienced at other churches. It has now been three years here and I am now a proud member of this church. It is a church that is focused on disciple-making, teaching, and solid biblical exegesis. It is a reformed Baptist church that teaches and applies the Bible to everyday life. We are small, but we have a children's ministry, youth ministry, and we host lifegroups as well. We host a BSF group here and we also allow two other churches to rent out our facilities. Pastor Alan is a great pastor who graduated from the Master's Seminary (associated with pastor John MacArthur). Being here is like being part of a family and I am so grateful to God that He led me here. Friendly! Nice !

name: Watermark South Dallas
Waxhaw Campus
reviewSummary: One of the most beautiful and welcoming Catholic parishes in the country. The liturgy is incredibly reverent. A wonderful faith family. Mass is always uplifting, especially the choir.

name: WAY CHURCH
WAY CHURCH - Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary:
Amazing church! Great people there. Awesome worship. Loved getting to experience a service here. Powerful leadership and preaching and the volunteers and staff were very friendly and welcoming. I highly recommend checking out this place if you are looking to get plugged into a local church. I have never felt so welcomed at a church! Everyone was so welcoming and went out of their way to introduce themselves and get to know me. The worship is amazing and the Holy spirit was moving in the space and through the Pastor as he spoke! I highly recommend coming to check out what they are doing! amazing church filled with amazing, loving, kind people who love to connect with others! From the moment my family and I walked in we felt welcomed.  The kids ministry is awesome! My 6yr old loves it! we love Resound OC and are so thankful to be apart of it!♥️ This church community is pretty special...they are totally our family! Authentic relationship is at the base of all they do...naturally their gatherings reflect that. Great worship and word based message every time but gee this congregation will genuinely walk with you! This church is phenomenal. Throughout my life I’ve explored multitudes of churches from all over the country. After being raised in the church from a very young age, I’d developed a certain amount of jaded expectations in association with certain places of worship. In my latter years, I shied entirely away from church because nearly every one I encountered gave off an impression of shallowness or insincerity which turned me off entirely from the idea of church.

On Christmas Eve, I attended my first Resound service, and I’ve been coming back ever since. There is something incredible and wholehearted about the manner and energy in which the Reid’s  conduct their services that for the first time since I was a little girl has me EXCITED about church and the people I will meet. The space they’ve facilitated, their personal story, and their gift of connecting with people is truly unlike any church I’ve been to before and I feel right at home with Resound. Highly highly recommend!!!

name: Wayside Baptist Church
Wayside Baptist Church - Pinecrest / South Miami Campus
reviewSummary:
This is the most Good News carrying, comfortable, and Fellowshipping live, laugh, and love type of experience to attend and especially becoming a member. So amazing and honorable. My family and I absolutely love this church! They make you feel like family from the start. We have seen so much growth in our relationship with the Lord and the body of Christ over the past 2 years of attending. Not the right church at all. The Pastor got upset because he and his wife wanted to pass by my house last Saturday in the morning and I had already made plans. They never called me again! I am glad. Because I don’t want to be at a church where people are odd! I believe you have God in your heart not a church. Thanks and God Bless You! Very warm and welcoming environment. Although this is a southern baptist church (SBA) , they don't really talk about the Blessed hope too much. Which is kind of a shame.

I've been going here for over a year now , I have met some wonderful people . This church is very active with its Outreach ministries, like it's visitations, its corporate prayer, and so much MORE. For instance, there is a beautiful animated movie called King of kings, coming out a week before Resurrection sunday, commonly known as Easter.

On the events page, they have a place where someone got a group rate to go watch this movie. Only $6. So I'm going to watch this movie with my church family. This is one of the nice things about this church. It's almost like we have a church within the church.

This is an updated review. I updated this in April of 2025. I don't know what the problem is, but they have been looking for a new pastor, because the other Pastor went to a church in Jacksonville Florida.

Apparently they had been through this before, I don't get into the church politics, because I just don't want to . But in order to get a pastor, they set up a pastor search committee. It has literally been OVER a year, and we have not had a new pastor yet. Why is this? We have an interim pastor, a man named Gary Johnson, he's a good pastor.

Although I personally prefer the preaching style of the one that left to JACKSONVILLE, FL more .

So let's get into the preaching, very near and dear to my heart because I want as many people to come to the Saving Grace and knowledge of Jesus the Messiah, because we all know the days that we are living in. And if anyone is reading their bibles, they would know what is coming right around the corner. But boy does the devil have people distracted. I wish they did more expository Style teaching. But they do have Bible study groups that meet before the 11 a.m. Worship On Sunday.

Worship music = AWESOME. Impressed with the Sound Stage setup, the musicians, I like the songs that they play. They try to mix it up as much as possible. It's not always contemporary Christian music, sometimes they just do acoustic sessions, sometimes the choir sings, they really mix it up a lot. There are no flashing lights, it doesn't look like a discotheque, so don't worry about that.

The only thing I find strange for a Baptist church, is that they DO NOT give out the elements for communion, in which we are TOLD to do in the scriptures. I've been to other Baptist churches who always have communion once a month at LEAST.

The other thing which I don't like, is I don't see public baptisms. Once in a blue moon, they'll bring up the topic about being baptized, but I have yet to see one here at Wayside.

I used to go to Pines Baptist Church, the one right across from the fire station. That was a wonderful Baptist church. True old school Baptist church, where they sing hymns instead of contemporary Christian music, I remember the pastor there didn't even allow drums. I miss that church.

Most Baptist Churches have one of those bathtubs right there behind the altar, in which you get baptized. That's the right way to do it. But not at Wayside. And they rarely stress getting baptized. 😔

As we all know, there is a great falling away, An apostasy that is going on throughout many churches, and I'm a little concerned about Wayside.

🚫Knowing Jesus Christ is a relationship, it has nothing to do with a religion.

And my friends, only the TRUTH will set you free. Run to Jesus the Christ as quickly as you can. The ONLY way to the Father is through the son.

"Look carefully then how you walk, not as unwise but as wise, making the best use of the time, because the days are evil. Therefore do not be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is. And do not get drunk with wine, for that is debauchery, but be filled with the Spirit, addressing one another in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs, singing and making melody to the Lord with your heart, ...(Ephesians 5:15-21).

Time is literally running out. Read your Bibles ‼️ Shortly after relocating to the Miami area, my husband and I decided to begin looking for a new church home (knowing it would likely be trial and error for a bit until we felt we'd found a good fit
for us). I came across Wayside in an internet search and we joined an 11oclock worship service about 6 months ago. After our first Sunday service, we stopped our search and immediately felt this was the place God lead us to be in our time in Miami.

Wayside is a fairly large church with a two-story mezzanine and a congregation of all ages. On our first visit, pastor David, and his wife, Kelly personally greeted us as they recognized new faces and made it a point to welcome us. They were eager to introduce us to the leaders of a Sunday-school group for young adults, which has
cultivated relationships we intend to always keep. The messages we receive each week are biblical, relatable, and full of Godly wisdom in which we have been able to apply to our lives in the
past few months. We feel that God is working in a multitude of ways through Wayside and are blessed to be a part of it.

We would suggest and invite anyone to visit Wayside and see the great things that are happening here.

It's  been my church for 10 years. Bathrooms clean and a open space for children to play. One bench distance and 6' apart. Excellent place that takes very good care of their patients. Big, service in the morning every Monday, come and hear the God's word Need better traffic signs or directions for pick ups LOOKING TOWARDS THE PAST, PRESENT, AND FUTURE OF WEST ANAHEIM THEORY CHURCH

February 1956 - July 2025
West Anaheim Methodist Church (WAUMC) has a 70-year history. The church was founded on February 2, 1956, through the ministry of Pastor David Deshler. In its early years, the church purchased 2.5 acres of land at 2045 W. Ball Road, Anaheim, California.

The Chapel was the first building constructed in 1958. The chapel has a capacity of approximately 120 people. The main sanctuary was built in 1964 with a capacity of five hundred people. The first worship service at the church was held on January 3, 1965.

The church built three more buildings: an education center, a meeting hall, and an office building, and purchased a house at 306 Archer Street in Anaheim to serve as the pastor's family residence. In its first 15 years, WAUMC grew rapidly, reaching a peak membership of 1,700 in 1970.

Following the Vietnam War in 1975, many people left Vietnam to immigrate to the United States. In 1980, Pastor Nguyen Xuan Duc met with the WAUMC Board of Directors to express his desire to establish the first Methodist ministry for Vietnamese Americans in the United States. WAUMC welcomed him warmly, and in February 1980, Pastor Nguyen Xuan Son was appointed to begin ministry for the Vietnamese community there.

Therefore, WAUMC is the birthplace of the first Vietnamese Methodist Church in the world!

After 10 years of ministry, Pastor Nguyen Xuan Son dedicated his time to theological studies, now known as Union University of California. In January 1990, Pastor Tran Trong Luat was appointed the second pastor for the Vietnamese congregation at WAUMC. God abundantly blessed the church. Many Vietnamese families sponsored and assisted by the church accepted the Lord and became faithful and zealous believers.

On April 2, 2001, the Vietnamese congregation at WAUMC became an official church of the Methodist Church under the name "Anaheim Vietnamese United Methodist Church".

Over time, the number of American believers at WAUMC gradually changed for various reasons. By 2014, most of the English-speaking members were elderly, so they decided to merge with the Vietnamese Church, which at the time had about 150 members, to become a single church. On July 1, 2014, the two churches officially merged under the name "West Anaheim United Methodist Church."

After 27 years of dedicated service at WAUMC, Pastor Tran Trong Luat retired at the end of June 2017. Pastor Dang Thao Nhon (Esther) was appointed as his successor to serve the Vietnamese group; WAUMC still has an assistant pastor to serve the English-speaking group.

In September 2018, Pastor Thao Nhon was appointed to serve both the Vietnamese and American congregations.

name: West Campus
West Coast Baptist Church
West Coast Baptist Church - Carlsbad Campus
reviewSummary:
Maturing is realizing this place is a cult guys! Because why is the pastor kinda weird? And they push the religion to extreme.. Like I've seen reviews of a people having weird experiences or this lady who got a flirtatious comment from pastor Clark! Gross? I know! Like talk about crazy. This is a church. They even believe females shouldn't work... And stay jobless! Gasppp, yeah. They will say weird comments to you most likely if you wear "too much makeup" Or "wearing shorts or pants" like this is where you worship God? Not where you care about what people are wearing. You may think these are the good guys but they aren't they have some drama too.. Like this is a church a place of God not a theatre class. Talk about embarrassing.. They try to force you perfect like crystal clear.. Well that's not happening.. Especially with this drama!!! And nobody's perfect. There's gonna be ups and downs obviously... Well whatever my point is don't go here if your not prepared for the weird pastor!  I have truly enjoyed attending this Independent Baptist church. The preaching is biblical, direct, and rooted firmly in the Word of God. This is not a “feel-good” ministry, and that is exactly what I appreciate about it. The messages are Scripture-based and focused on conviction, repentance, and holy living rather than entertainment or emotional hype.

Pastor Philip Clark is a faithful and bold preacher of the Bible. He does not water down the Word, and he does not shy away from difficult topics. The teaching is old-fashioned, biblical preaching that calls believers to examine themselves and grow spiritually.

This church stands on biblical principles, including modesty, holiness, and separation from worldliness not as man-made rules, but as convictions that flow from understanding Scripture. When you know better, you do better. The preaching challenges you, and at times conviction can feel uncomfortable, but that is the purpose of God’s Word. It is meant to refine us and draw us closer to Him.

If you are looking for a Bible-believing church that prioritizes truth over trend, Scripture over emotion, and conviction over comfort, this is a place where you will grow.

I am thankful for the clear teaching and the commitment to standing firmly on the Word of God. Hi, I'm Nathan. I'm a Marine on Camp Pendleton and I have been going to West Coast Baptist Church for 2 years now. I remember looking at the Google Maps for this church and seeing that they had reviews but never bothered to read them.  Today I read them. Before I started going to this church I was smoking, drinking, cursing, living for myself, living a life unpleasing to God.
Growing up, My church back home didn't know the gospel well, but by the grace of God, I was saved at a young age. I believed on Jesus Christ and repented. I believed God's Word. But my church back home never told me anything about baptism, which comes after salvation or about discipleship(going through God's word with another saved person that's been living out the christian life), which ought to be done with every newly saved Christian. I had little to no spiritual growth until I actually started reading my bible in about 10th grade. Through God's Word, I realized I wasn't living according to God's Word (I was worldly) and that my church was not following the Bible. My pastor couldn't even answer some of my questions. Over time these realizations lead me to have a strong desire to leave my church; and I believe this was the pull of the Holy Spirit on my life to bring me closer to God and to a strong Bible believing Church. That lead me to start technical school, which lead me to join the USMC which lead me into alcohol, cussing, and smoking at times. I was receiving the chastisement of God because of those actions and would ask God, "why am I going through these things?Why is my life so miserable?" But God lead me to this church. I was walking on a Sunday morning already dressed and going somewhere( I forget where), and I see someone From my shop walking in nice clothes, church clothes, and I ask him where he's going. He tells me he's going to church. I say, oh, I'm looking for a church. Can I come with? and he Says, sure. And I went there and realized, this is where I need to be. This is where I can Grow. Then I joined the church. I got discipled by one of the men at the church. I learned in their Bible institute. I went soul winning(going out with the church and telling people about Jesus Christ) for the first time in my life, and didn't stop going. I can now give an answer for the faith I hold. I can now actually present the Gospel Jesus Christ to anyone who asks. I never really had a problem with alcohol or smoking growing up, but after I joined this church two years ago, I haven't touched alcohol or smoked since then. I've submitted to be a preacher and to start churches. We preach the whole Bible, we preach Jesus Christ and Him crucified, we preach repentance toward God and faith toward our Lord Jesus Christ. There are some negative comments here; and I wasn't at the church long enough to really know what was going on with those comments, but I hope that my short testimony can extinguish those fiery darts. God Bless. Take care. Great church that is faithful to the Word of God.  The people are very friendly and caring.  They preach the true gospel faithfully and boldly, worship God in spirit and in truth, and seek to live consistent Christian lives out of love for the resurrected Lord, Jesus Christ.  If we lived in the area (instead of, as we currently were, visiting it) we would gladly be members of this church and serve the Lord there. Joline Solomon left a review a year ago. A rebuking review with details of her experience. Sadly this is not the 1st time this type of incident has happened. My mother experienced the same experience when her and my dad met with Wesley Clark, at the time. He ran his eyes from top to bottom and made similar comments. In my own personal experience also, the Gossip in Leadership was so bad I decided to leave. After I did the next Sunday the Pastor got up in Church and excommunicated me and asked the church members to have nothing to do with me. Cult is a fitting word for this place.

reviewSummary: WCLC is an amazing church, especially for youth. I look forward to youth every week. I was excited as it is a Word of Faith church which lines up with what scripture teaches. I left in late Summer 2023 as the culture of the church was off.  I became involved in hospitality and a specialty group to help single mothers. No one was outwardly rude but not communicative either.  A mandatory meeting for the hospitality group was called and hardly anyone showed up.  I lived a bit of a distance from the church.  I signed up for an activity at a certain time and when I got there, the task was done by someone else.  I would get text notices about events and ask people about them and no was able to explain.  For the specialty Mothers group I had no communication about how the event would be executed.  I showed legitimate interest in being involved but felt that others were standoffish.. I really couldn't put my finger on it and just sum it up in this review as an odd culture.  Perhaps you could say cliquesh.  Just posting now as I thought the leaders weren't really interested in an honest review.  Had a change of heart as I now see the importance of speaking up.  I will say that the teaching by Pastor Ray was excellent.  The rest of church life and interaction was mediocre to poor. Love this church, and these Pastors!  My life and my family have grown in faith and in love here.  Such a great place to connect with believers.  Pastors Ray and Beth are the real deal! West Coast Life Church is an awesome church!  The pastors are amazing!  Pastor Ray is loaded with the word and only preaches the word and not his opinion.  Pastor Beth is so beautiful and sincere. name: Westminster Christian Assembly
Westminster Christian Assembly - Garden Grove Campus
reviewSummary:
I used to go here as a youth kid years back and Collin and Mellica were huge parts of my life. I have been extremely blessed with the fellowship and the close knit relationships, we did life together and they were nothing but fully of joy during that time.

Pastor Collin and Mellica have taken this place of worship and body of believers under their wings just as they once did to our youth group and are putting amazing time and effort into doing God's will for the community. This body is absolutely worth your time to visit. It's booming with life and believers striving to get to know God.

I am extremely grateful for the time I personally got to spend with the Finley family (even before they were a family ;) ) and I pray that others also take the time to be grateful for this community. The pastors are very nice and welcoming. I have so much fun with the youth and helping the community. This church helps the broken and lost to find Jesus. I’ve became a changed woman with the help of the church. I've been attending the 1:30 PM and 3:00 PM Zion Gospel Church services and the community is extremely loving and welcoming. I love that there are services for English speakers, Vietnamese speakers, and bilingual services! Not many churches are accessible to both first and second generation immigrants! It really is "multi-ethnic, multi-cultural, and multi-generational." Additionally, the conversations that I've had with the pastors and team members have been edifying and kind. Everyone at English Zion Gospel service was friendly and welcoming…the members, staffs and pastors. I’ve met many people there. Great music and easy to follow message. Looking forward to get to know everyone. This is a church family where all are made to feel welcomed.  If you are in need of spiritual and prayer support, you will feel at home there.  Not a large church, but the praise and worship is excellent.

name: Westminster Presbyterian Church - Escondido Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a church where you and your family will feel truly welcomed! If you want to experience a wonderful worship experience that incorporates glorious music (there is a full orchestra on the last Sunday of the month), talented singers, a beautiful choir, this is the place. If you're trying to find a church your size as opposed to a megachurch, this is the place for you. If you want to learn from a wise, caring, gifted and understanding pastor (a great teacher!), you will have found a home and family here! Come and test it out!! I love this church. It is a smaller congregation and very warm and welcoming. Good for families, couples, older folks!!
There are 2 services, a contemporary with uplifting music at 9 and a later service with traditional hymns at 11.
Child care is also available and Great Sunday school classes for all age groups. Our grandchildren Love going!
There is a nice "fellowship" gathering time in between services too with coffee and snacks.
I really hope you too might come sit with us for a Sunday morning of praise!
Blessings to each if you!! WPC Escondido is a great place to grow your relationship with Jesus in a real and down-to-earth way. It’s welcoming, family-friendly, and makes it easy to feel connected from the start. Went for a memorial. Pastoral staff are very friendly and comforting. My understanding is the church will be moving in the future. A wonderful, welcoming congregation. Challenging, bible-based learning. Great children and youth programs. Amazing traditional and contemporary music programs. Meaningful community outreach and global mission. This church is a great place to support your spiritual growth. Wherever you are in that journey, you are welcome here.

name: Westwood United Methodist Church
Westwood United Methodist Church - Westwood Campus
reviewSummary: A family-oriented, welcoming-to-all church. Their two service options — the traditional sanctuary service and the newer Loft format — provide a space where people can worship in the way that works best for them, with the Loft service being a more communal and casual space for a younger church population (also starting later!). The pastors are amazing humans and teachers, clergy you can connect with deeply. And they have the most wonderful Sunday School staff and program! This church was one that my husband likes to say he attended "in utero" because his folks attended this church over 70 years ago. He retired from being a pastor and we returned to his "home church". I love this place  mostly because they are have so many ways to serve and help others in the community, the nation, and the world. They are accepting and welcoming of everyone regardless of one's ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender, financial standing, or belief system. They encourage folks to think, not just believe blindly.  A breath of fresh air. Thank you pastor Molly for making us feel welcome. And the greeters each week are so welcoming as well. I find the sermons relevant and insightful delivered with a genuine dose of humanity. God is so present in this church and we are so lucky we found it. Thank you WUMC for being our new home ❤️ I go to The Loft upstairs. It's such a refreshing place to worship God. They're super progressive and accepting to everyone. Many people who attend aren't in faith, but still come for the community. A place to be loved.

#wildwoodcalvarychapelc #john3:16 #yucaipacalifornia #yucaipachurches #calvarychapel #Yucaipa #godisgood #ilovejesus We visited Wildwood Calvary Chapel for the first time.  We generally attend another non-denominational church, but my granddaughter had been invited to try youth group.  Her friend ended up not coming so she joined me in church.  Positive:  We really liked the pastor who spoke.  I loved the scripture references and bases of his sermon.  I felt the sermon was lead by God, not scripted.  I do not know who the pastor was because he didn't introduce himself nor did the pamphlet we were given say who he was. Negative:  The worship hall was generic and cold. The seating is difficult to see the band or pastor.   We were seated in the back after asking for help by an usher.
Most of the closer seating being saved by people who looked at us like we were bothering them for a seat.  An usher escorted us to the "family section" in the back.  We were a party of three, myself, a 7 year old, and a 12 year old, both kids very well behaved.   None of us could see the pastor.  Growing up in a Calvary Chapel of Orange County on the 70's, things have definitely changed.  We looked clearly new and felted more judged than accepted.  I am sad because I really wanted to like it more. Such a gem of a church ! Messages are always super solid- biblically sound, verse by verse straight from the Word, no compromise, really dive deep. Worship and prayer is always incredible- so powerful and Spirit-led. I love how we have prayer/worship night every first Wednesday of the month. The Young Adults here is the best- such an awesome group to get into the Word, worship, pray, and do life with. So thankful to call Wildwood home ! GOOD MORNING. MY SON WAS REJECTED AS HE TOOK HIS 84 YRS OLD GRAMA TO SUNRISE SERVICE.MR.BOB ONE OF THE TRAFFIC CONTROLLER TOLD HIM HE COULDN'T DROP OFF HIS 84 GRAMA AS I WAS WATCHING EVERYONE ELSE WERE GETTING DROPPED OFF . UNFORTUNATELY MY SON HAD TO SLOWLY WALK HIS 84 GRAMA DOWN THE STEEP HILL. SHAME ON YOU MR BOB THIS WAS OUR 4 TH YEAR N NEVER HAD NEEN REJECTED. Wildwood Calvary is extremely warm, welcoming and hospitable. Their pastoral staff and care for their community is remarkable. Being a welcoming church is a great thing and every true Christian should be open to all, but “affirming” sin of any kind (as your website states) goes directly against God’s expectations for us to rebuke and/or turn away from sin. Jesus said, “Go and sin no more,” not “Stay and sin some more,” nor did He ever state that He affirmed sinfulness. No sin is praiseworthy, nor is it affirmed anywhere in The Holy Bible.
To be authentic followers of Christ Jesus, we must all deny our earthly lusts and come to earnest repentance (for every one of our current or past wrongdoings). Anything that goes against God’s design, sullies one’s soul, or breaks His commandments MUST be repented for. We need to find sincere spiritual contrition (true guilt for sin) and we’ll never find that if we think our sinfulness is okay solely because it was praised, accepted and affirmed by the church.
Matthew 16:24 Then Jesus said to His disciples, “If anyone wants to come after Me, he must deny himself, take up his cross, and follow Me.”
2 Corinthians 7:10 For godly sorrow produces repentance leading to salvation, not to be regretted; but the sorrow of the world produces death.
Jeremiah 25:5 They said, ‘Repent now everyone of his evil way and his evil doings, and dwell in the land that the Lord has given to you and your fathers forever and ever.’
If we want to affirm anything, we should be affirming that we’re all sinners and we all fall short, and that’s why everyone needs to repent. By accepting sin, you are consciously going against God’s commands and law; by affirming sin, you are deliberately denying God’s Word and truth! An exclusion of God results in an inclusion of Satan. You cannot live in habitual sin yet also live for God:
Hebrews 10:26 For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there no longer remains a sacrifice for sins.
1 John 2:3-5 Now by this we know that we know Him, if we keep His commandments. He who says, “I know Him,” and does not keep His commandments, is a liar, and the truth is not in him. But whoever keeps His word, truly the love of God is perfected in him. By this we know that we are in Him.
Titus 1:16 They profess to know God, but in works they deny Him, being abominable, disobedient, and disqualified for every good work.
FYI, Jesus spoke of hell more than heaven and sin more than love. Throughout the Bible, the need for genuine repentance is an underlying requirement, not merely God’s suggestion or recommendation. We must have a full change of heart and mind, leading to unquestionable belief/trust/faith and total repentance.
With that said, no man/woman is more worthy of redemption than another and Christ’s ultimate sacrifice can set anyone free from sinful bondage. Everyone can find salvation and be born again by earnest repentance, genuine sorrow for sin, a change of heart/mind, and belief/trust in Jesus Christ. We’re all messed up and that’s why we need a perfect Savior.
But, don’t follow false teachings and/or deceptive doctrines that claim a sinful lifestyle is an acceptable choice as Christ expects us to turn from ALL SIN. We’ll still slip up here and there but real salvation is a nonstop commitment to turn away from the things which God declared are wrong. If God called something an abomination in His own book, then who are we to affirm those same exact abominable acts?
2 Timothy 4:3-4 For the time will come when they will not endure sound doctrine, but according to their own desires, because they have itching ears, they will heap up for themselves teachers; and they will turn their ears away from the truth, and be turned aside to fables.
Everything stated here is backed up by scripture. Don’t seek affirmation for your sins, but rather, earnestly repent for them, place all of it at Christ’s feet, and put God first in your life for once. In doing so, you’ll be given new desires and a new mind. We must die to selfish desires and live for His selfless gift and sacrifice for all. I went there last Sunday. I will definitely be coming back. I was super impressed. I've been a very active member at Woodland for 26 years! A faith community that truly walks the walk. ALL are welcomed and embraced. In my 20th year as a member of Woodland.  It is a welcoming, diverse faith community that represents the teachings of Jesus. Woodland is warm, welcoming and truly exudes love. It’s a church that accepts you for who you are and where you’re at. You should check it out!
